Season of Ghosts.name: 肆季鬼志 Season of Ghosts
Season of Ghosts.description:
柳岸镇这座小镇遇上了大麻烦——它被诅咒了！当一群英雄在林地中醒来时，他们刚参加完一个送别春天最后一天、迎接夏天的节日——这段时节在当地被称为鬼魂的季节；他们随即发现，自己的家乡已被怪物、诡异的天气以及可怖的鬼魂所侵袭。然而，与《肆季鬼志》中那些等待被发掘的、令人不寒而栗的秘密相比，这些威胁着柳岸镇的古老邪恶显现根本不算什么。

The small town of Willowshore has a big problem—it´s cursed! When a group of heroes awaken in the woods after a festival to usher out the last day of spring and welcome in the summer—a time known locally as the season of ghosts, they find their hometown has been invaded by monsters, strange weather, and horrifying ghosts. Yet theses manifestations of the ancient evil that threatens Willowshore are nothing compared to the harrowing secrets awaiting discovery in Season of Ghosts.

Emperor Cobra Venom.name: 帝王眼镜蛇毒液 Emperor Cobra Venom
Emperor Cobra Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

最长持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] 伤害（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] 伤害且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round)

Flare Hood.name: 耀光兜帽 Flare Hood
Flare Hood.description:
帝王眼镜蛇张开其颈罩。每个位于 @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] 内的非帝王眼镜蛇生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:22] 意志豁免。随后，该生物会暂时免疫1分钟。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}。

The emperor cobra flares its hood. Each non–emperor cobra creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Emperor Cobra.publicNotes:
这些强大的蛇类栖息于沼泽与低地。尽管它们体长超过16英尺、体重超过200磅，仍能在数秒内攀爬上树。帝王眼镜蛇会张开颈罩，并朝攻击者发出嘶声，以此吓退捕食者。和许多有毒的蛇一样，它们会以带毒的啃咬攻击猎物，随后撤退，等到受害者死亡后再返回将其整只吞下。

各种各样的蛇类在每一种非极地生态环境中都能繁衍生息，各自有着独特的狩猎方式与防御机制。

These powerful serpents infest bogs and lowlands. Despite being over 16 feet long and weighing more than 200 pounds, they can climb trees in seconds. Emperor cobras ward off predators by flaring their hoods and hissing at attackers. Like many venomous snakes, they hunt by striking prey with their poison bite, retreating until their victims die, and then returning to swallow them whole.

Snakes of some variety thrive in every non-arctic ecosystem, each with their own particular hunting patterns and defense mechanisms.

Silkwasp Bandit.name: 绢黄蜂强盗 Silkwasp Bandit

Hide Armor.name: 皮甲 Hide Armor
Hide Armor.description:
这种护甲由毛皮、结实的皮革，以及有时经塑形的煮制皮革混合制成。它凭借层层皮革提供防护，但其笨重会拖慢穿戴者并降低机动性。

A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些弹丸是弓所用的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行时靠一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则带有金属头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Explosive Arrow.name: 爆炸箭 Explosive Arrow
Explosive Arrow.description:
弹药 任意

启动 A（操作）

这件弹药涂覆着粗糙的黑色煤灰。当启动后的爆炸弹药击中目标时，投射物会爆炸，对@Template[burst|distance:10]内区域中的每个生物（包括目标）造成@Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害。每个生物都必须尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect]豁免。

Ammunition any

Activate A (manipulate)

This piece of ammunition is coated in gritty black soot. When activated explosive ammunition hits a target, the missile explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:10], dealing @Damage[6d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area (including the target). Each creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save.

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Rage.name: 狂暴 Rage
Rage.description:
需求 怪物猎人未处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}状态，且未处于狂暴中

效果 怪物猎人获得9点持续到狂暴结束的临时生命值。处于狂暴中时，他们的近战攻击额外造成8点伤害，获得+10足的速度状态加值，并且 AC 受到 -1 减值。怪物猎人不能使用具有专注特征的动作，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}和狂暴动作除外。

狂暴持续1分钟，直到怪物猎人无法察觉任何敌人，或直到怪物猎人失去意识。

狂暴结束后，怪物猎人在1分钟内不能再次进入狂暴。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{效果：狂暴}

Requirements The monster hunter isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or raging

Effect The monster hunter gains 9 temporary Hit Points that last until the rage ends. While raging, they deal 8 additional damage with melee attacks, gain a +10-foot status bonus to their Speed, and take a -1 penalty to AC. The monster hunter can't use concentrate actions except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and rage actions.

The rage lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies the monster hunter can perceive, or until the monster hunter falls unconscious.

Once the rage ends, the monster hunter can't again for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{Effect: Rage}

Sudden Charge.name: 突袭 Sudden Charge
Sudden Charge.description:
怪物猎人行走两次，并进行一次近战打击。

The monster hunter Strides twice and makes a melee Strike.

Silkwasp Bandit.publicNotes:
一些雇佣兵避开政治、效忠誓言与臣服关系带来的复杂纠葛，只拿钱去猎杀怪物。这是一种直截了当的雇佣兵服务形式，往往危险至极，但也可能带来荣耀与名声。

这是一个宽泛的类别，其中包括使用武器、法术，甚至诡计与狡猾的人；雇佣兵将自己和自身专长出租给那些付得起钱的人。

Some mercenaries eschew the complications of politics, oaths of service, and fealty and just get paid to hunt monsters. It's a straightforward form of mercenary service, often dangerous in the extreme, but one that can yield glory and fame.

A broad category that includes those wielding arms, spells, or even guile and cunning, mercenaries hire themselves and their expertise to those with the gold to pay for it.
Silkwasp Bandit.blurb:
变体怪物猎人
variant monster hunter

Kagekuma.name: 影隈 Kagekuma

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Rewrite Memory.name: 重写记忆 Rewrite Memory
Rewrite Memory.description:
你通过抹除一段记忆、增强一段记忆的清晰度、改变一段记忆，或添加一段虚假记忆来篡改目标的记忆。目标可以尝试进行一次意志豁免以抵抗该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响，并意识到你曾试图篡改其记忆。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西，而非重写记忆，除非它辨识出了该法术。

失败 在该法术持续时间的前5分钟内，你每轮都可以通过维持该法术来修改一段记忆一次。当你这么做时，你会构想最多6秒的记忆内容进行修改，最多可涉及连续5分钟的记忆。

只要该法术仍然生效，你所改动的任何记忆都会保持被更改的状态。如果在5分钟结束前目标移出射程，你就无法继续修改更多记忆。

升阶（6环） 你可以对一个自愿目标施放该法术，以压制其关于某个特定主题的全部记忆，该主题需用不超过50个词加以描述。该效果为永久，并会以一片模糊不清的迷雾补上这些缺失。

You alter the target's memories by erasing a memory, enhancing a memory's clarity, altering a memory, or adding a false memory. The target can attempt a Will save to resist the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to alter its memory.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of rewrite memory, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure During the first 5 minutes of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to modify a memory once each round. When you do, you imagine up to 6 seconds of memory to modify, to a maximum of 5 continuous minutes of memory.

Any memories you've altered remain changed as long as the spell is active. If the target moves out of range before the 5 minutes is up, you can't alter any further memories.

Heightened (6th) You can Cast the Spell on a willing target to suppress all memory of a particular topic, detailed in 50 words or fewer. The effect is permanent, and it patches these omissions with an indistinct haze.

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品从当前空间瞬间传送到你视线内射程范围内一个未被占据的空间。如果这会让另一个生物和你一同传送——即使你是将其装在异次元容器中携带——该法术会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道其相对于你的位置与距离即可。随后你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Veil of Privacy.name: 隐私之幕 Veil of Privacy
Veil of Privacy.description:
你设下保护性的护，使目标难以通过魔法侦测。隐私之幕会尝试反制在持续时间内针对目标或目标道具所使用的一切侦测、揭示和探知效果，并且为此将戏法视为1环法术。若成功反制一个以区域或多个目标为目标的法术，则只会消除该法术对隐私之幕目标的效果。

You erect protective wards that make the target difficult to detect via magic. Veil of privacy attempts to counteract all detection, revelation, and scrying effects used against the target or the target's gear throughout the duration, counting cantrips as 1st-rank spells for this purpose. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets negates the effects for only veil of privacy's target.

Blur.name: 朦胧术 Blur
Blur.description:
目标的形体显得模糊不清。它变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于此效果的性质仍使目标的位置显而易见，因此目标不能利用这种隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。

The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一次精神冲击使其眩晕。该冲击造成 1d6 精神伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标的豁免结果为大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状况好得多或差得多。施放此法术时，决定你想让该物体看起来是破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装得破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。完好的物品若被伪装得更好，则会看起来仿佛崭新出厂，并且经过高度抛光或精心保养。破损的物品会显得完好且功能正常。被摧毁的物品无法成为此法术的影响对象。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破该幻觉。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动嘴，但这些话并不会从你口中说出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听你的话并不会比你平常只动嘴时更清楚，但目标听见你的话时，就仿佛站在你身边一样。目标可以用一个简短的回应作为一个反应动作（），或者如果他们愿意，也可以在自己下一回合以一个自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能看见你且位于射程内才能这么做。如果他们作出回应，他们的回答也会像最初的传讯一样，直接送到你的耳边。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、松散且无人持用、负载为1或更低的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体由你掷出的物体决定。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成正常伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Broken Kusarigama.name: 破损的锁镰 Broken Kusarigama
Broken Kusarigama.description:
这种令人印象深刻的武器由一个重锤通过一段链条连接到一把镰刃上组成，这有助于缴械对手或从远处发动攻击。

This impressive weapon consists of a weight attached to a kama via a length of chain, which aids with disarming an opponent or attacking from a distance.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被影隈杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为亡灵。影隈会自动尝试反制任何对其所杀死生物施加的复活术或将其转化为亡灵的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+16 #Counteract]]{+16}，反制等级 4）。如果杀死该生物的影隈被杀死，该生物便可以正常地从死亡中被带回，或正常地变成亡灵。

Creatures killed by a kagekuma are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The kagekuma automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+16 #Counteract]]{+16}, counteract rank 4). If the kagekuma who slew the creature is slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Bundle.name: 具现捆子 Manifest Bundle
Manifest Bundle.description:
频率 每小时一次

效果 影隈显现出一大捆稻草、芦苇、绳索、纱线、毛发或类似物品，全部用绳子捆扎在一起并绑在它的背上。只要它的捆子保持显现，影隈的 AC 就提高至 27，但其速度会降至 15 尺。

Frequency once per hour

Effect The kagekuma manifests a large bundle of straw, reeds, rope, yarn, hair, or the like, all lashed together with cords and strapped to its back. The kagekuma's AC increases to 27 as long as its bundle remains manifested, but its Speed is reduced to 15 feet.

Ruin Wielder.name: 持骸者 Ruin Wielder
Ruin Wielder.description:
当影隈持用一把破损的、非魔法武器时，它们不会承受该武器处于破损状态的任何不利影响。当影隈持用它时，该武器变为一把+1强击武器，并且在成功命中时额外造成 1d6 心灵伤害。

When a kagekuma wields a broken, non-magical weapon, they don't take any of the disadvantages of the weapon being broken. While the kagekuma wields it, the weapon becomes a +1 striking weapon, and it deals an additional 1d6 mental damage on a successful hit.

Shadow Bite.name: 阴影啃咬 Shadow Bite
Shadow Bite.description:
需求 影隈正在投下阴影

效果 影隈以一个邻近且正在投下阴影的生物为目标，随后它的阴影啃食该生物的阴影。如果影隈拥有已显化的捆子，观察者（包括其阴影正被啃咬的生物）只有在成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:38] 检定后，才能察觉影隈的阴影啃咬。目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭2}）。

Requirements The kagekuma is casting a shadow

Effect The kagekuma targets an adjacent creature that's casting a shadow, then its shadow feeds on that creature's shadow. If the kagekuma has a manifested bundle, observers (including the creature whose shadow is being bitten) can notice the kagekuma's Shadow Bite only if they succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:38] check. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure).

Shed Bundle.name: 摘下捆子 Shed Bundle
Shed Bundle.description:
需求 影隈拥有已显化的捆子

频率 每天一次

效果 影隈使其捆子消失，魅影野猪行走，然后尝试进行一次锁镰打击和一次啃咬打击。

Requirements The kagekuma has a manifested bundle

Frequency once per day

Effect The kagekuma causes its bundle to vanish, Strides, and then attempts a kusarigama Strike and a bite Strike.

Kagekuma.publicNotes:
影隈存在于边缘地带，潜伏在猎物本身的阴影之中。在一些地区，它们被称为“影煞”；这种宁多鲁拥有伪装成群人中不起眼角色的能力，因此即使在人口稠密的地方也能进食。影隈看起来像一种佝偻着身子的类人生物，有着细长的脖颈和布满尖牙的嘴，但当它披上捆子时，这种生物的头和脖颈会紧紧缩入双肩之间，变得完全被遮掩。影隈体现了在一段复杂关系中，信任一再建立又一再破裂的循环。

痂苦魔的捆子

影隈的捆子不仅仅是伪装和护甲——它还是一种实体化的标志，显示它们终结了多少生命，又吞食了多少灵魂。无论这捆子是由稻草、绳索、毛发还是其他材料构成，其中每一条单独的细长物都象征着某种“死神的收割”；捆子中的每一缕都代表着这宁多鲁斩断并收集起来的一条隐喻性的生命线——直到所夺取的众多生命在世间彻底淹没了这宁多鲁自身的存在。

Kagekumas exist in the periphery, lurking in the very shadows of their prey. Known in some regions as "shadefiends," this nindoru's ability to appear as uninteresting figures in the crowd allows them to feed even in populated areas. A kagekuma appears as a hunched over humanoid with a long neck and a fanged mouth, but when wearing a bundle, the creature's head and neck tuck in tight between its shoulders to become entirely obscured. The kagekuma personifies the cycle of trust being built and broken over and over again through the course of a complex relationship.

Kagekuma Bundles

A kagekuma's bundle is more than just a disguise and armor—it's a physical indication of how many lives they've cut short and how many souls they've supped upon. Whether the bundle is composed of straw, ropes, hair, or other materials, the individual lengths symbolize a sort of "reaper's harvest," with each strand in the bundle representing a metaphorical lifeline that the nindoru has severed and collected—to an extent that the multitude of lives taken overwhelms the nindoru's own presence in the world.

Injigo's Loving Embrace.name: 莓莓的怀抱 Injigo's Loving Embrace
Injigo's Loving Embrace.description:
这张@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.T8EopYZLT137CsdW]{网}由络新妇印绮子织成，她将其作为赠礼送给自己地精爱人玛拉，好在印绮子外出狩猎远征时，保护她们山地小屋中的玛拉安全。莓莓的怀抱的功能如同一张普通的网。你使用这张网进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{擒拿}时，进行的运动检定获得+1物品加值。

启动 2 构想，交互

频率 每日一次

效果你将网朝30尺内一个你看得见的虚体生物方向旋出。丝绸般的力场线条猛然甩出，缠绕住该虚体生物；它必须尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:25]豁免，以避免陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，直到你下个回合结束。你可以维持此次启动最多1分钟，且该生物必须成功通过一次DC 25检定才能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱}这张网。

启动 10分钟（构想，交互）

频率 每周一次

效果你在准备入睡时将网裹在自己身上，如同一条毯子。只要你获得8小时睡眠术或类似的休息，你就会梦见自己在给某个你所爱慕的人写爱情书信：这可能是真正的情人、你感兴趣的人，或是某个未知之人，而你醒来后不记得其身份。醒来时，你会因那些未寄出的书信而充满一丝忧郁，但这些情绪会让你从其他更不愉快的想法中分心，使你在接下来的8小时内获得精神伤害抗力5，并在对抗精神效果的豁免骰上获得+1物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.EeU33F3eBq5OPYp0]{效果：莓莓的怀抱}

This @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.T8EopYZLT137CsdW]{Net} was woven by the jorogumo Injigo, who presented it as a gift to her gnome sweetheart, Mara, to keep her safe in their mountain cottage when Injigo left on hunting expeditions. Injigo's Loving Embrace functions as a typical net. You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} with the net.

Activate 2 envision, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You spin the net in the direction of an incorporeal creature within 30 feet that you can see. Lines of silken force whip out to lash around the incorporeal creature, who must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:25] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain this activation for up to 1 minute, and the creature must succeed at a DC 25 check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} the net.

Activate 10 minutes (envision, Interact)

Frequency once per week

Effect You wrap the net around you like a blanket as you prepare to sleep. As long as you get 8 hours of sleep or analogous rest, you dream of writing love letters to someone you adore: this could be an actual paramour, someone you're interested in, or someone unknown whose identity you don't recall after waking. When you wake, you're filled with a sense of melancholia about those unsent letters, but these feelings distract you from other, more unpleasant thoughts, granting you resistance 5 to mental damage and a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects for the next 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.EeU33F3eBq5OPYp0]{Effect: Injigo's Loving Embrace}

Kinburi's Sandals of Bounding.name: 锦振的腾跃木屐 Kinburi's Sandals of Bounding
Kinburi's Sandals of Bounding.description:
这双高底木屐曾属于一位名叫锦振的高傲狐人。众所周知，她的迅捷与优雅无人能及，旁观者形容她每一步都仿佛掠于地面之上。她常常挑战他人与她赌速度，但随着人们渐渐学聪明了，她不得不隐藏自己的身份，或承诺若她输了便交出自己的木屐。

这双木屐使你进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{跳远} 的运动检定时获得 +1 物品加值。此外，当你使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} 动作时，若为水平跳跃，你可以多移动 5 尺；若为垂直跳跃，你可以多跳高 3 尺。

启动 2（命令术）

频率 每小时一次

效果 你高声夸耀自己的优雅与敏捷，然后以任意组合进行两次 High Jump 或跳远。你不需要先移动，并且在两次跳跃之间，你只需在进行第二次跳跃前接触到一个实体物体；这个物体不必能承受你的重量，甚至不必连接在地面上——你可以视需要从一片飘浮的羽毛、一根细小的分支，甚至一堵纸墙上起跳。这些跳跃的木屐物品加值提升为 +2。

These elevated wooden sandals once belonged to a haughty kitsune named Kinburi. It was well known that her swiftness and grace were unmatched, and observers described her as seeming to glide above the earth with each step. She often challenged others to wager on her speed, but as people began to grow wise, she was forced to conceal her identity or promise to forfeit her sandals if she lost.

These sandals give you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}. In addition, when you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.

Activate 2 (command)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You loudly boast about your grace and agility, then take any combination of two High Jumps or Long Jumps. You do not need to Stride first, and between the two jumps, you need only to come into contact with a physical object before making the second jump; this object doesn't need to be one that can bear your weight, or even be attached to the ground—you can jump off from a floating feather or a thin branch or even off a paper wall as needed. The sandals' item bonus increases to +2 for these jumps.

Vashu's Ninth Life.name: 瓦修的第九条命 Vashu's Ninth Life
Vashu's Ninth Life.description:
这把+1强击幽冥打刀由三百多年前一名名为叫瓦修·维加鲁的猫人游荡者从群猫之王那里偷来的一根胡须制成。他寻求这根胡须中的魔法，以超自然地延长自己的寿命；而有些人相信他至今仍然活着，因为他最终成功舍弃了这把剑，从而逃过了王者的怒火。

启动 f（观想）

触发 你的回合结束

频率 每小时一次

效果 你将感官延伸至刀刃之中，使你能够对附近的移动做出反应。瓦修的第九条命获得招架特征，并自行抬起至招架姿态，使你获得AC +1环境加值，直到你的下一回合开始。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.05mIW5FMX2socBY9]{效果：瓦修的第九条命}

启动 r（观想）

触发 你用瓦修的第九条命杀死一个活着的生物

频率 每天一次

效果 被杀死生物的一部分生命力穿过刀刃，流入你的灵魂，强化你自己的生命。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{死硬}专长的好处，持续1分钟。这使你会在濒死5时死亡，而非濒死4。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.p0piyFHae9uBfNRa]{效果：瓦修的第九条命（死硬）}

This +1 striking ghost touch katana is made from a whisker stolen from the king of cats over three hundred years ago by a catfolk rogue named Vashu Vigaru. He sought the magic of the whisker to preternaturally extend his life, and some believe he still lives, having successfully divested himself of the sword to escape the king's wrath in the end.

Activate f (envision)

Trigger Your turn ends

Frequency once per hour

Effect You extend your senses through the blade, allowing you to react to nearby movement. Vashu's Ninth Life gains the parry trait and raises itself into parrying position, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.05mIW5FMX2socBY9]{Effect: Vashu's Ninth Life}

Activate r (envision)

Trigger You slay a living creature with Vashu's Ninth Life

Frequency once per day

Effect A portion of the slain creature's life force travels through the blade and into your soul, bolstering your own life. You gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat for 1 minute. This causes you to die from the dying condition at dying 5 rather than dying 4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.p0piyFHae9uBfNRa]{Effect: Vashu's Ninth Life (Diehard)}

Juubun's One Thousand Poems.name: 重文的千篇诗 Juubun's One Thousand Poems
Juubun's One Thousand Poems.description:
这份磨损严重的手稿以褪色的淡紫色线进行侧缝装订。书中写满了一位名为星司重文的哲学家许久之前写下的诗篇，蕴含着一生的智慧，就极为广泛的主题提供信息与建议。

启动 1 构想（情绪，心灵，法术塑形）

频率 每天一次

效果 如果你的下一个动作是施放一个具有语言（特征）且以1个生物为目标的法术，你会被重文的精魂所支配，而你法术中的言语成分会变得极具诗意且富有感染力。如果目标是盟友，你的话语会激励对方，使其获得10点临时生命值，持续1分钟。如果成为目标的生物是敌人，且该法术需要进行豁免，并且该敌人豁免失败，则其会因绝望与悲伤而成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Rn2Nl2iXlRMijTNb]{效果：重文的千篇诗}

This well-worn manuscript is side stitched with fading lilac-colored thread. It is filled with poems written long ago by a philosopher named Seiji Juubun, which contain a lifetime of wisdom, presenting information and advice on a tremendous breadth of topics.

Activate 1 envision (emotion, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has the linguistic trait and that targets 1 creature, you are overtaken by Juubun's spirit, and the spoken elements of your spell become impactfully poetic. If the target is an ally, your words inspire them and they gain 10 temporary Hit Points, which last for 1 minute. If the targeted creature is an enemy and the spell requires a saving throw, and if the enemy fails its saving throw, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as a result of despair and sadness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Rn2Nl2iXlRMijTNb]{Effect: Juubun's One Thousand Poems}

Kugaptee's Anger.name: 苦迦菩提的愤怒 Kugaptee's Anger
Kugaptee's Anger.tokenName: 苦迦菩提的愤怒 Kugaptee's Anger

Terrifying Roar.name: 骇魂咆哮 Terrifying Roar
Terrifying Roar.description:
触发 一名玩家角色拾起穗静的心脏

效果 一声震耳欲聋的咆哮在森林中回荡。所有玩家角色都必须尝试进行一次 @Check[will|dc:22] 意志豁免。该作祟掷先攻。

大成功 该角色不受影响，并在接下来的24小时内暂时免疫骇魂咆哮。

成功 该角色不受影响。

失败 该角色陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

大失败 该角色的惊惧（状态）值增加2。如果这会使该角色的惊惧（状态）值超过4，则该角色改为陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，直到其下个回合结束。

Trigger A PC picks up Sui-Jing's heart

Effect A thunderous roar ripples through the forest. All of the PCs must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. The haunt rolls initiative.

Critical Success The character is unaffected and is temporally immune to Terrifying Roar for 24 hours.

Success The character is unaffected.

Failure The character is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The character's frightened condition increases by 2. If this would increase the character's frightened condition value above 4, the character is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of their next turn.

Kugaptee's Anger.disable:
@Check[nature|dc:23] 或 @Check[religion|dc:23] 进行祷告以对抗邪恶，使苦迦菩提的愤怒在其惯例中的动作减少为 1（见下文），持续 1 轮；将穗静的心脏放入她位于区域 A2 的尸体中，是解除此危害的唯一方法

@Check[nature|dc:23] or @Check[religion|dc:23] to offer prayers against the evil to reduce Kugaptee's Anger's actions during its routine to 1 (see below) for 1 round; Placing Sui-Jing's heart into her corpse at area A2 is the only way to disable this hazard
Kugaptee's Anger.hazarddescription:
树木倾倒的声音与雷鸣般的脚步声充斥着空气，仿佛某个巨大的巨人已经察觉到了什么，正缓缓穿过森林逼近。

The sound of toppling trees and thunderous footsteps fills the air, as if some immense giant had taken notice and now slowly approaches through the forest.
Kugaptee's Anger.routine:
（2 动作）某种巨物在视线之外穿过森林、黑暗和迷雾迈步前行的声音充满了空气。该作祟的第一个动作是施放一次骇魂咆哮（@Check[will|dc:22]，效果与上方的骇魂咆哮相同）。第二个动作则是将整个心景中的树木灌注以恶毒的生命力，使如爪般的枝条向每个玩家角色猛抽而出。这些爪击对每个角色造成 @Damage[4d6[slashing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] 反射豁免）。站在小径上或空地中的角色在此次豁免中获得 +1 环境加值，而携带穗静之心的角色在此次豁免中获得 +4 物品加值。在玩家角色的回合中，他们可以采取进一步的动作来保护自己免受这些爪状枝条的伤害。通过在举起盾牌或趴下，玩家角色对其反射豁免获得 +2 环境加值。处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地} 状态的玩家角色可以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{寻找掩蔽}，以获得对抗这些爪击的强化掩蔽收益（使其对此次反射豁免的环境加值提高至 +4）。在其回合中进行翻滚且 @Check[acrobatics|dc:22] 检定成功的玩家角色，对抗这些爪状枝条的反射豁免获得 +2 状态加值。以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行} 进行 @Check[stealth|dc:22] 检定并成功的玩家角色，其反射豁免结果提高一个成功等级。

如果某个玩家角色在上一轮成功使用自然或宗教祷告以对抗邪恶，则苦迦菩提的愤怒只有 1 个动作；随机决定它在该动作中是使用骇魂咆哮，还是以树木发动抽击。

(2 actions) The sound of something immense striding just out of sight through the forest, darkness, and fog fills the air. The haunt's first action is to unleash a Terrifying Roar (@Check[will|dc:22] with the same effects as Terrifying Roar above). The second action is to infuse the trees of the entire mindscape with malevolent life, causing clawlike branches to lash out at each PC. These claws inflict @Damage[4d6[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save) to each character. A character standing on the path or in a clearing gets a +1 circumstance bonus to this saving throw, and the character who carries Sui-Jing's heart gains a +4 item bonus to this saving throw. On a PC's turn, they can take further action to protect themselves from the clawed branches. By Raising a Shield or by Dropping Prone, a PC gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Reflex saving throw. A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} PC can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} to gain the benefits of greater cover against the claws (increasing their circumstance bonus to this Reflex save to +4). A PC who Tumbles Through on their turn and succeeds at a @Check[acrobatics|dc:22] check gains a +2 status bonus to their Reflex saves against the clawed branches. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[stealth|dc:22] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} improves the result of their Reflex save by one degree of success.

If a PC successfully used Nature or Religion to pray against the evil on the previous round, Kugaptee's Anger has only 1 action; randomly determine if it uses its Terrifying Roar or lashes out with trees with this action.
Kugaptee's Anger.prototypeToken: 苦迦菩提的愤怒 Kugaptee's Anger

Noppera-bo Grunt.name: 无面鬼士兵 Noppera-bo Grunt

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
这种护甲由柔韧的熟皮革与定型的硬化皮革混合制成，在提供一定防护的同时，保有最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸妖没有视觉，但它们的听觉极其敏锐。它们不需要呼吸，并免疫于需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上是将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；它们也可以用这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

Noppera-bos have no sense of vision, but their sense of hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，它们便处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as a noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description:
无面鬼士兵变成在过去24小时内他们接触过的一名小型或中型类人生物的无脸版本。处于变形状态且其面部被遮盖时，该士兵对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}时获得+2环境加值。无面鬼士兵可以再次使用此能力来变回原样。

The noppera-bo grunt changes into a faceless version of a Small or Medium humanoid they've touched during the last 24 hours. While transformed and their face is covered, the grunt gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} that creature. The noppera-bo grunt can change back by using this ability again.

Noppera-bo Grunt.publicNotes:
无面鬼喽啰缺乏必要的社交风度，无法用他人的面孔将自己完全伪装起来。

无脸妖从背后看起来像是普通的人类，甚至可能像你认识的某个人，直到他们转过身来，露出一张毫无五官的脸。

额外学识完美专家

虽然普通的无脸鬼残忍成性，并沉迷于惊吓或折磨类人生物的行为，但并非所有无脸鬼都沉溺于邪恶。中立的无脸鬼往往是爱恶作剧的家伙，会用自己的能力欺骗和捉弄他人；而罕见的善良无脸鬼则会用自己的能力来致敬并效仿自己钦佩的对象，同时把自己的时间花在磨炼艺术或制作方面的技艺上。

额外学识无面鬼起源

关于无脸妖的起源有许多理论——从变形能力出了差错的化狸，到被诅咒扭曲的类人生物，再到自然诞生的妖怪。还有人甚至认为这种状态是一种像兽化症那样能够传播的诅咒。大多数无脸妖并不记得自己的起源，而且他们往往更感兴趣的是假装自己完全是另一个人。

Noppera-bo grunts lack the social graces necessary to fully disguise themselves with another person's face.

Noppera-bos appear to be regular humans from behind, and might even resemble someone you know, until they turn to reveal a featureless face.

Consummate Professionals

While the typical noppera-bo is cruel and revels in the act of frightening or tormenting humanoid creatures, not all of them wallow in evil. Neutral noppera-bos tend to be pranksters who use their abilities to trick and tease, while the rare good noppera- bos instead use their abilities to honor and idolize those they admire while focusing their own time on developing their skills at art or crafting.

Noppera-bo Origins

There are many theories on the origins of noppera-bos—from tanuki whose change shape ability went wrong, to humanoids who were warped by curses, to naturally spawning yokai. Some even theorize this condition is a transmissible curse like lycanthropy. Most noppera-bos don't recall their origins, and are often more interested in pretending to be someone else entirely.

Wolf.name: 狼 Wolf

Pack Attack.name: 群体攻击 Pack Attack
Pack Attack.description:
狼的打击对处于至少两个狼盟友触及范围内的生物额外造成1d4伤害。

The wolf's Strikes deal 1d4 extra damage to creatures within reach of at least two of the wolf's allies.

Wolf.publicNotes:
狼群居并以群体方式狩猎。与普遍看法相反，狼群并不是由群体中最强壮的个体领导，而通常是由一对配偶、它们的幼崽，以及先前繁殖季所生的未成年后代组成。后代一般会在成年后离开父母的狼群，此时它们会去寻找自己的配偶，并在别处组建自己的狼群。

类人生物传统上并不被视为狼的猎物，但在特殊情况下，这些动物也会袭击人，尤其是在冬季月份以及其他传统猎物（主要是鹿和麋鹿）稀缺的时候。某些存在，例如强大的吸血鬼，能够召来狼在战斗中协助它们。

狼出没于森林、丘陵和其他荒野地带，它们成群狩猎，先不断骚扰并包围猎物，然后再上前将其杀死。和大多数捕食性动物一样，狼更倾向于攻击它们所能找到的最弱小或最脆弱的猎物。

Wolves live and hunt in packs, which, contrary to popular belief, are not led by the strongest in the group, but typically consist of a mated pair, their pups, and juvenile offspring from previous mating seasons. Offspring generally leave their parents' pack upon reaching maturity, at which point they seek out mates of their own to form their own packs elsewhere.

Humanoids are not traditionally viewed as prey animals by wolves, but extraordinary circumstances can lead these animals to attack people, especially in winter months and other situations where traditional prey (deer and elk mainly) is scarce. Some beings, such as powerful vampires, can call upon wolves to aid them in combat.

Wolves roam forests, hills, and other wild lands, where they hunt in packs to beleaguer and surround their prey before going in for the kill. Like most predatory animals, wolves prefer to attack the weakest or most vulnerable prey they can find.

Heart-Eating Vulture.name: 食心秃鹫 Heart-Eating Vulture

Death Burst.name: 死亡绽放 Death Burst
Death Burst.description:
当食心秃鹫被击杀时，它的身体在坠落地面时痉挛并猛烈抽搐，红光开始透过它血肉上的裂缝闪耀出来。在该轮结束时，食心秃鹫爆裂成一团半径为 @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10尺} 的红色宁朵露蝶，它们锋利如剃刀的翼与爪击造成 @Damage[5d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] 反射豁免），只留下它曾用一只利爪紧抓着的那颗心脏。

When the heart-eating vulture is slain, its body spasms and thrashes as it falls to the ground while red light begins to shine through splits in its flesh. At the end of the round, the heart-eating vulture explodes into a @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10-foot radius} blast of red nindoru butterflies, their razor-sharp wings and claws inflicting @Damage[5d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save), leaving behind only the heart it clutched in one of its talons.

Carrion Fever.name: 腐尸热 Carrion Fever
Carrion Fever.description:
腐尸热导致的恶心（状态）在该苦难仍然存在时无法减少

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

潜伏期 1天

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}（1天）

阶段 2 恶心 1、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，以及疲乏（1天）

The sickened condition from carrion fever can't be reduced while the affliction remains

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 day)

Stage 2 sickened 1, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and fatigued (1 day)

Projectile Vomit.name: 喷射性呕吐 Projectile Vomit
Projectile Vomit.description:
频率 每小时一次

效果 巨型秃鹫将它上一餐呕吐到 10 尺内的一名生物身上。该生物受到 @Damage[3d6[acid]] 伤害，并进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] 豁免。若豁免失败，目标还会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

Frequency once per hour

Effect The giant vulture vomits up its last meal on a creature within 10 feet. The creature takes @Damage[3d6[acid]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save. On a failed save, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Heart-Eating Vulture.publicNotes:
秃鹫可从远处凭借其黑色羽毛和光秃的颈部辨认出来。它们乘着气流漂行，寻找腐肉作为下一餐。它们常以四五只为一组结成群体，这些食腐者盘旋于战场和瘟疫肆虐的城镇上空，急切地等待进食。这种取食循环发挥着重要作用，尤其是在炎热地区，因为它们特别强效的胃酸能中和食物中的危险细菌，从而将其自环境中清除。

巨型秃鹫的翼展可达25英尺，体重可达600磅。它们比体型较小的近亲更为少见，通常生活在能够供养多种巨型动物的地方。尽管外表骇人，而且在受到挑衅时确实危险，但即便是巨型秃鹫，天性也并非敌对；它们更喜欢享用其他生物留下的猎物。比起攻击其他生物，它们更可能在逃跑时吐出上一餐来分散对方注意。然而，在格外匮乏的时期，饥饿的巨型秃鹫群有时会协同行动，把家畜当作一餐。

巨型秃鹫偶尔会与体型更大的生物，如龙或巨人，形成寄生关系，啄食那些无人看管或被遗忘的残余餐食。那些在工作中使用骨骼的工匠已开始重视这种行为。要正确地剥净一具生物的尸体，速度远比不上让一群秃鹫将尸骸啄剥干净，只留下洁净的骷髅。由于它们是受食物驱动的掠食者，以这种方式饲养的年轻秃鹫可以被训练得对主人产生印刻，因此也带动了将其作为异宠饲养的风潮。

尽管秃鹫的本质并非魔法，但秃鹫利爪在传统上常被用作护符，用于治疗和祛除疾病；这源于一种古老信念，认为这些猛禽不受它们所涉足污秽之物的影响。尽管这种说法并不完全正确，秃鹫确实具备若干独特的适应能力，能够避开那些足以害死掠食者、甚至其他食腐动物的常见疾病。由于体型巨大，巨型秃鹫的利爪在其他资源匮乏的地区，有时还会被用来制作武器。

Recognizable at a distance by their black feathers and bald necks, vultures drift along air currents looking for carrion to serve as their next meal. Often grouping in committees of four or five, these scavengers wheel above battles and plague-stricken towns, eager to feed. This feeding cycle plays an important role, especially in hot regions, as their particularly potent stomach acid neutralizes dangerous bacteria in their meals and thus removes it from the environment.

A giant vulture has a wingspan of up to 25 feet across and weighs up to 600 pounds. Less common than their smaller cousins, they typically live in areas that support a number of megafauna species. While imposing and certainly dangerous when provoked, even giant vultures are not hostile by nature, preferring to feast on the kills of others. They are more likely to vomit their last meal as a distraction while they flee than to attack other creatures. However, during particularly lean times, starving groups of giant vultures might work in unison to make a meal of livestock.

Giant vultures occasionally form parasitic relationships with larger creatures such as dragons or giants, picking at the remains of an unattended or forgotten meal. Crafters who use bones in their work have come to value this type of behavior. Flensing a creature properly is far slower than letting a committee of vultures strip the carcass and leave behind a clean skeleton. As food-motivated predators, younger vultures raised this way can be made to imprint upon owners, leading to a trend of keeping them as unusual pets.

While not magical in nature, vulture talons are traditionally used as charms in healing and removing disease, stemming from an old belief that the raptors were immune to the filth in which they strode. While this belief isn't strictly true, vultures do have several unique adaptations to avoid common diseases that would take out predators or even other scavengers. Due to their size, giant vulture talons in particular are sometimes used to craft weapons in regions where other resources are scarce.
Heart-Eating Vulture.blurb:
变种巨型秃鹫
Variant giant vulture

Sumika.name: 澄香 Sumika

Padded Armor.name: 软甲 Padded Armor
Padded Armor.description:
这种护甲只是一层厚重的绗缝布料，但有时会因为价格极其低廉而被使用。软甲比其他类型的护甲更容易受损和被摧毁。重甲附带一件软甲内衬，其价格已包含在重甲的价格中，不过当它穿在重甲之下时，会失去舒适特征。如果你的重甲被摧毁，或者你在其他情况下没有穿着完整的重甲，你可以只穿这件软甲内衬入睡。这样你仍然可以维持魔法护甲的灌注，并从相关重甲上的任何符文力量中受益，但没有这件软甲内衬，其他人就无法穿戴你的重甲。

This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep magic armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Snare Toolkit (Functions as Artisan's To.name: 陷阱工具包（功能等同于工匠工具包）
Snare Toolkit (Functions as Artisan's To.description:
你需要这些工具才能用制作技能从原始材料中制造物品。不同类型的工作需要不同的工具包，由游戏主持决定；例如，铁匠的工具包不同于木工的工具包。如果你穿戴着你的工匠工具包，你可以在使用它的动作中将其取出并收回。

You need these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些抛射物是弓所用的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则带有金属头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Expert Subsistence.name: 专家级生存技能 Expert Subsistence
Expert Subsistence.description:
当偷猎者使用求生来[[/act subsist statistic=survival]]时，若其结果比成功更差，则其获得成功。若成功，他们可以为自己和另外四个生物提供基本生活所需；若大成功，则他们可以照料的生物数量是成功时的两倍。

While using Survival to [[/act subsist statistic=survival]], if the poacher rolls any result worse than a success, they get a success. On a success, they can provide subsistence living for themselves and four additional creatures, and on a critical success, they can take care of twice as many creatures as on a success.

Snare Crafting.name: 陷阱制作 Snare Crafting
Snare Crafting.description:
这名偷猎者知道如何制作以下陷阱：

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.AFX1V0Go9DqPWBlN]{警报陷阱}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Km4lSOsyrip5q6iD]{妨碍陷阱}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oplQpQSTyTvHDDtq]{标记陷阱}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XcD8p1o71tPohZWT]{讯号陷阱}

这名偷猎者每天最多可以制作四个陷阱而无需支付材料费用，并以3个交互动作来部署一个陷阱。该陷阱会在24小时后失效。

The poacher knows how to craft the following snares:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.AFX1V0Go9DqPWBlN]{Alarm Snare}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Km4lSOsyrip5q6iD]{Hampering Snare}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oplQpQSTyTvHDDtq]{Marking Snare}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XcD8p1o71tPohZWT]{Signaling Snare}

The poacher can create up to four snares each day without paying for the materials, using 3 Interact actions to deploy a snare. The snare becomes inert after 24 hours.

On the Hunt.name: 狩猎中 On the Hunt
On the Hunt.description:
偷猎者将其正在观察或追踪的一名生物指定为其猎物。偷猎者在对猎物进行[[/act seek]]搜索的察觉检定，以及对猎物进行[[/act track]]追踪的求生检定时，获得+2环境加值。偷猎者每轮第一次命中被指定的猎物时，会额外造成1d4精准伤害。这些效果持续至偷猎者再次使用狩猎中为止。

The poacher designates one creature they're observing or tracking as their prey. The poacher gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the prey and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the prey. The first time the poacher hits the designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d4 precision damage. These effects last until the poacher uses On the Hunt again.

Sumika.publicNotes:
禁止狩猎的规定可能是为了保护贵族的私人保留地，或在特定季节保障共享森林中动物种群的存续能力。偷猎者违反这些法律——有时出于贪婪，有时出于绝望，有时则只是为了取乐。

探索者通常装备精良、训练有素，能够应对各种类型的危害，并且热衷于带领他人进入荒野。

Rules against hunting may insulate the private reserves of nobles or guard the viability of animal populations in shared forests during specific seasons. Poachers violate those laws—sometimes out of greed, sometimes out of desperation, and sometimes for sport.

Explorers are often well-equipped and well-trained for any type of hazard and are eager to lead others into the wild.

Enko.name: 圆光 Enko

Head Bowl.name: 头碗 Head Bowl
Head Bowl.description:
河童头顶的凹陷处盛有水。若将河童头顶的水全部泼洒、蒸发或以其他方式移除，则在水盆再次装满水之前，其所有速度都降为5尺。陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地} 的河童必须成功通过一次 @Check[reflex|dc:15] 豁免，否则会洒出自己的水；而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识} 的河童则会自动洒出自己的水。

如果河童被擒抱、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚} 或陷入震慑，另一名生物可以花费一个单动作，以一个具有攻击和操作特征的动作，尝试进行一次对抗河童强韧难度等级的运动检定，来打翻其头碗中的水。若成功，该生物会洒出河童的水。

The depression atop a kappa's head is filled with water. Spilling, evaporating, or otherwise removing all the water from the top of a kappa's head reduces all their Speeds to 5 feet until the basin is again filled with water. A kappa who becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:15] save or spill their water, and a kappa who becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} automatically spills their water.

If a kappa is grappled, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or stunned, another creature can attempt to spill the water from their bowl by spending a single action, which has the attack and manipulate traits, to attempt an Athletics check against the kappa's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature spills the kappa's water.

Pull Arm.name: 拉拽手臂 Pull Arm
Pull Arm.description:
河童拉拽自己的一只手臂，使该手臂获得10足触及。与之相对的那只手臂会缩短，变得几乎只剩下一只从其甲壳中伸出的手。河童仍可以用这只缩短的手拿东西，但不能用那只手持用护盾或武器。河童花费一个单动作拉拽其相对的手臂，即可使双臂恢复原本长度。

The kappa pulls one of their arms, gaining 10-foot reach with that arm. The opposing arm shrinks to little more than a hand extending from their shell. The kappa can still use their shortened hand to hold things, but they can't use that hand to wield a shield or weapon. By spending a single action to pull their opposing arm, the kappa can return their arms to their original length.

Enko.publicNotes:
河童天性顽皮，喜欢捉弄毫无防备的旅人。虽然通常并非明显怀有恶意，但它们也会造成不小的麻烦，比如偷走毫无防备的沐浴者的衣物，或从营火旁顺手拿走无人看管的食物。河童也喜欢在力量比试中证明自己的本事，而且尽管它们爱耍花招，却以恪守承诺、在交谈中彬彬有礼的竞争者而闻名。

虽然不同地区的河童在外形特征上各有差异，但它们全都是两栖的、形似乌龟的人形生物，长着喙状的嘴、带蹼的手脚，以及滑腻的鳞片，颜色从蓝绿色到淡黄色不等。它们通常有一圈黑发，用来环绕头顶中央的凹陷。来自河童故乡湖泊、溪流或河流的水会盛在这个凹陷中，也就是它们的头碗，而这被认为是它们力量的来源。年轻的河童很容易被骗得低头行礼，从而不慎把自己头碗里的水倒空。失去这些水会让河童变得萎靡不振。河童的头碗空着的时间越久，它们就会变得越虚弱。对于住在故乡水域附近的河童来说，这种情况很少会造成严重危险；但对于那些远走他乡、喜爱冒险的河童而言，却可能致命。

河童并非天生敌对，也曾与孤独的孩子结为朋友，并通过指路或提供简单医疗照料来帮助受困的冒险者。尽管如此，在许多河童栖居的地区，常常会竖有警示牌，提醒人们它们的存在，并鼓励靠近水边的旅人投下一根黄瓜——河童最喜欢的食物——以换取安全通行。有时这些牌子甚至就是河童自己立的，好提高自己收到美味点心的机会。

Mischievous by nature, kappas delight in playing pranks on unsuspecting travelers. While usually not overtly malicious, they can be a significant nuisance, stealing clothes from unsuspecting bathers or snatching unattended food from campfires. Kappas also enjoy proving their worth in competitions of strength and, despite their propensity for trickery, are known to be honorable competitors who keep their word and remain polite in conversation.

While kappas vary in physical attributes from region to region, they're all amphibious, turtle-like humanoids with beaked mouths, webbed hands and feet, and slimy scales that range in color from bluish green to pale yellow. They often have black hair, arranged in a ring to accommodate the central depression atop their head. Water from a kappa's home lake, stream, or river fills this depression, or head bowl, which is believed to be the source of their strength. Younger kappas are easily tricked into bowing and accidentally emptying the water from their own head bowls. Losing this water makes a kappa lethargic. The longer a kappa's head bowl remains empty, the weaker they grow. While this rarely poses a serious danger for a kappa living near their home body of water, it can prove fatal to a more adventurous kappa wandering afar.

Kappas aren't inherently hostile and have been known to befriend lonely children and lend aid to stranded adventurers by providing directions or minor medical treatment. Still, many areas where kappas dwell feature posted signs warning of their presence that encourage travelers venturing near water to toss in a cucumber—kappas' favorite food—in exchange for safe passage. Kappas sometimes put up these signs themselves to increase the likelihood of receiving a tasty treat.

Additional materials to craft two other.name: 用于制作由玩家角色自选的另外两个通用1级陷阱的额外材料 Additional materials to craft two other common 1st-level snares of the PCs’ choice

Supplies for Spirit Traps.name: 精魂陷阱的补给品 Supplies for Spirit Traps
Supplies for Spirit Traps.description:
精魂陷阱由一张浸过水、并以神圣草药浸泡过的网构成，以便更有效地对抗魅影。这个陷阱的构件在未布设时可作为一张网使用。你将这个陷阱布设在一个10足×10足的区域内。第一个踏入该区域、具有精魂（特征）的生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:16]强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响

成功 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，持续1轮。

失败 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1轮。

大失败 该生物陷入禁足，直到它逃脱。

A spirit trap consists of a net dipped in water that has been steeped with sacred herbs to better combat phantoms. This snare's components function as a net when not set up. You set this snare up in a 10-foot-by-10-foot area. The first creature with the spirit trait that steps into the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is immobilized until it Escapes (DC 16).

Phantom Boar.name: 魅影野猪 Phantom Boar

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的思维蒙上阴云，并以一道精神冲击令其陷入眩晕术。该冲击造成等于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标心中植入恐惧；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑} 1轮。

升阶（3环） 你至多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Walk the Ethereal Line.name: 游于两界 Walk the Ethereal Line
Walk the Ethereal Line.description:
魅影行走于以太位面与物质位面之间的纤细界线上，以同时存在于这两个位面之中。

它们可以再次使用该能力，转回仅存在于以太位面。

The phantom walks the thin line between the Ethereal and Material Planes in order to exist on both planes simultaneously.

They can shift back to solely the Ethereal Plane by using this ability again.

Susceptible to Death.name: 易于死亡 Susceptible to Death
Susceptible to Death.description:
尽管魅影并非活物，但它们也不是不死生物，并且会对死亡效果表现出独特的易受影响性。

若魅影因死亡效果（例如来自法术 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute}）而使其生命值降至 0，它会立即被卷送至灵魂之河，在那里，它的灵魂将重新踏上通往来世的通常道路。

Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they undead, and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death.

A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a death effect (such as from a spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute}) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

Vulnerable to Kindness.name: 友善易伤 Vulnerable to Kindness
Vulnerable to Kindness.description:
任何位于30尺内且魅影能够看见和听见的生物，都可以用一个具有听觉、专注、语言和心灵（特征）的双动作行动，向它发出冷静且友善的问候。以这种方式向魅影问候的生物，必须尝试进行一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:18] 检定。

大成功 魅影受到 @Damage[4d8[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

成功 魅影受到 @Damage[2d8[mental]] 伤害。

失败 魅影受到 @Damage[1d8[mental]] 伤害。

大失败 魅影不受影响，并且在1轮内不受此弱点影响。

Any creature within 30 feet that the phantom can see and hear can issue a calm and friendly greeting to it as a two-action activity with the auditory, concentrate, linguistic, and mental traits. A creature greeting the phantom in this manner must attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:18] check.

Critical Success The phantom takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The phantom takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage.

Failure The phantom takes @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The phantom is unaffected, and is not affected by this weakness for 1 round.

Boar Charge.name: 猪突 Boar Charge
Boar Charge.description:
魅影野猪进行两次魅影野猪行走，然后进行一次獠牙打击。只要它至少移动了20尺，它的攻击掷骰就获得+2环境加值。

The phantom boar Strides twice and then makes a tusk Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll.

Phantom Boar.publicNotes:
据大多数神学家的说法，灵魂通往来世的普通轨迹相当直接。凡人死去时，其灵魂会进入灵魂之河，并最终抵达骨园，在那里接受法拉斯玛的审判。经审判后的灵魂会前往与其相应的最终安息领域——天堂、地狱、阿巴顿等——并在那里成为祈求者。

然而，当一个排队等待审判的灵魂过早离开灵魂之河，并被转移到以太位面时，情况就会变得复杂。无论是由于夜鬼婆之类心怀不轨的闯入者、恶毒的位面魔法，还是命运使然，这些灵魂都会脱离生死的自然秩序，滞留在某种炼狱般的状态中。与祈求者不同，这些以太魅影保留着死前生时的记忆；而与幽灵等精魂不同，魅影并未沾染不死生物那种污秽的影响——至少一开始还没有，尽管堕落的威胁始终沉重地笼罩着魅影的存在。有些最终屈从于那样的命运，另一些则最终重新汇入灵魂之河。在那之前，这些游荡的灵魂自成一类——没有真正的家园、目标或意义。

许多魅影都不愿继续停留在这种奇异的炼狱状态中，要么是因为他们寻求继续自己穿越灵魂之河的旅程，要么是因为他们恐惧不死生物的腐化。为了完成自然的灵性循环并接受审判，从而继续前往来世，魅影只需设法回到灵魂之河中即可。然而，这样的追寻绝非易事——以太位面朦胧的迷雾足以使最有经验的旅人也迷失方向，而无数掠食者则在这片领域中潜行，搜索那些离群的灵魂，以便将其束缚或吞噬。

The typical trajectory for souls passing to the afterlife is fairly straightforward, according to most theologians. When a mortal dies, their soul enters the River of Souls and eventually reaches the Boneyard, where it is judged by Pharasma. The judged soul moves onto its appropriate domain of final rest-Heaven, Hell, Abaddon, and so forth-where it becomes a petitioner.

Complications arise, however, when a soul in queue for judgment prematurely departs from the River of Souls and is shunted into the Ethereal Plane. Whether as a result of nefarious interlopers like night hags, malignant planar magic, or even fate, these souls become dislodged from the natural order of life and death and linger in a sort of purgatory. Unlike petitioners, these ethereal phantoms retain memories of their life before death, and unlike spirits such as ghosts, phantoms aren't tinged with the foul influences of undeath-at least, not at first, though the threat of corruption hangs heavy over a phantom's existence. Some eventually succumb to that fate, while others eventually rejoin the River of Souls. Until then, these wandering souls are a kind unto themselves-one without a true home, agenda, or purpose.

Many phantoms have no desire to remain in their strange state of purgatory, either because they seek to continue their journey through the River of Souls or because they fear the corruption of undeath. In order to complete the natural spiritual cycle and become judged so they can continue to the afterlife, a phantom must simply find a way back into the River of Souls. Such a quest is no easy feat, however-the hazy mists of the Ethereal Plane can befuddle even the most experienced traveler, and numerous predators prowl the realm in search of stray souls to bind or devour.

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description:
一名无面鬼模仿者携带一把+1强击武器，其外观看起来与其所模仿的玩家角色所偏好的武器完全相同。如果该玩家角色偏好徒手打击，它就会显现为手部缠带。如果该玩家角色偏好远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，而是改为使用上述远程武器规则；否则，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果该玩家角色不偏好任何武器，则无面鬼会挥舞一根短棒作为其虚假武器。这把虚假武器只有部分真实，在命中时只造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原始武器的任何特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损、被缴械或被放下，它就会消散。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟重新制作一把替代的虚假武器。

A noppera-bo impersonator carries a +1 striking weapon that looks identical to the favored weapon of the PC being impersonated. If the PC favors unarmed strikes, it appears as hand wraps. If the PC favors a ranged weapon, then the noppera-bo impersonator has no melee weapon and instead uses the ranged weapon rules above; otherwise, the noppera-bo impersonator has no ranged weapon. If the PCs favors no weapon, then the noppera-bo wields a club as its false weapon. This false weapon is only partially real and inflicts only mental damage when it hits; it gains none of the original weapon's traits or magical enhancements. If a noppera-bo impersonator's false weapon is broken, disarmed, or set down, it fades away. The noppera-bo impersonator can craft a replacement false weapon by spending 10 minutes to recreate one.

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无面鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉极其敏锐。他们不需要呼吸，并免疫于需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得维生——传统上会将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用来“饮用”；他们也能以这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

The noppera-bo has no sense of vision, but their hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}状态，它们就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as the noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonated Abilities.name: 模仿能力 Impersonated Abilities
Impersonated Abilities.description:
无面鬼模仿者获得以下由你选择的一项能力。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.kkP0tagXmAYuSH3u]{效果：模仿能力}

  • 装甲 无面鬼看起来身披重甲，其 AC 提升至 24。
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]{借机攻击}
  • 持盾者 无面鬼携带一面下等百炼盾（若其被摧毁、脱手，或无面鬼死亡时，它会变形成一个无用的道具），并获得护盾格挡泛用专长。
  • 武器提升 无面鬼从以下武器特征中选择一项加入其虚假武器：灵巧、致命 d8、强力、招架、触及、推撞、横扫或绊摔。

The noppera-bo impersonator gains one of the following abilities of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.kkP0tagXmAYuSH3u]{Effect: Impersonated Ability}

  • Armored The noppera-bo appears to be heavily armored, and they increase their AC to 24.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]{Attack of Opportunity}
  • Shield Carrier The noppera-bo carries a minor sturdy shield (that transforms into a useless prop if it's destroyed, dropped, or upon the noppera-bo's death), and they gain the Shield Block general feat.
  • Weapon Perk The noppera-bo chooses one of these weapon traits to add to their false weapon: agile, deadly d8, forceful, parry, reach, shove, sweep, or trip.

You So-jin.name: 尤素珍 You So-jin
You So-jin.blurb:
神秘的女性精灵草药师
 mysterious female elf herbalist

Yami's Gift.name: 小暗的赋礼 Yami's Gift

Grim Trophy.name: 阴森战利品 Grim Trophy
Grim Trophy.description:
它看起来像是一只仍然带血的人类耳朵。

启动 A (专注)

这种护符有多种形式，最常见的是以某种骇人的方式展示出来的类人生物残肢。当你启动这件战利品时，进行一次威吓检定，以对至多两个目标使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{挫败士气}，并将你的威吓检定结果与他们两者的难度等级进行比较。

It appears to be a still-bloody human ear.

Activate A (concentrate)

This talisman comes in many forms, most often a severed piece of a humanoid creature displayed in some gruesome manner. When you activate the trophy, make an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} up to two targets, comparing your Intimidation check result to both of their DCs.

Yami's Gift.hazarddescription:
*此赋礼只能被掷骰一次；对此赋礼的后续掷骰结果视为 1 枚白金币。

*This gift can only be rolled once; treat further rolls of this gift as 1 platinum coin.

Heh Shan-Bao.name: 赫山宝 Heh Shan-Bao
Heh Shan-Bao.privateNotes:
柳岸镇的受任行政官；目前失踪

appointed administrator of Willowshore; currently missing
Heh Shan-Bao.blurb: 男性天夏人总督 male Tian-shu governor

Manor Wards.name: 庄园护卫 Manor Wards

Denied!.name: 拒绝！
Denied!.description:
触发 一名手上没有虚无封印纹印的生物接近宅邸5尺内，或试图对宅邸造成伤害

效果 一阵爆炸性的魔法冲击猛烈撞向入侵者，其必须进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:33] 豁免。若触发该效果的生物并不邻接宅邸，则将此次豁免结果的成功等级上调一级。

大成功 该生物受到 @Damage[1d12[force]] 伤害，并被向远离宅邸的方向推开5尺。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[(2d12+13)[force]] 伤害，并被向远离宅邸的方向推开5尺。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(4d12+16)[force]] 伤害，并被向后抛出20尺且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并因坠落受到 @Damage[10[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] 伤害。

大失败 如失败，但被向后抛出100尺且陷入倒地，并因坠落受到 @Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] 伤害。

Trigger A creature without a nullifying seal script on their hand approaches within 5 feet of the manor or attempts to damage the manor

Effect An explosive blast of magic violently slams against the intruder, who must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:33] save. If the triggering creature isn't adjacent to the manor, it adjusts the result of this save up by one degree of success.

Critical Success The creature takes @Damage[1d12[force]] damage and is pushed 5 feet away from the manor.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(2d12+13)[force]] damage and is pushed 5 feet away from the manor.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(4d12+16)[force]] damage and is thrown 20 feet back and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, taking @Damage[10[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage from the fall.

Critical Failure As failure, but 100 feet back and knocked prone, taking @Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage from the fall.

Manor Wards.disable:
@Check[arcana|dc:35]、@Check[occultism|dc:35]或@Check[thievery|dc:35]（大师）以破坏魔法从而允许进入庄园，@Check[athletics|dc:32]以强行穿过屏障并进入庄园（不过这并不能让其他玩家角色跟在你身后进入！），或使用解除魔法（第5等级；反制 DC 28）来反制庄园护卫

@Check[arcana|dc:35], @Check[occultism|dc:35], or @Check[thievery|dc:35] (master) to compromise the magic to allow entry into the manor, @Check[athletics|dc:32] to force your way through the barrier and enter the manor (this doesn't allow other PCs to enter behind you, though!), or dispel magic (5th level; counteract DC 28) to counteract the wards
Manor Wards.hazarddescription:
层层符箓与印有祷告的缎带贴满了庄园的墙壁和入口，在宅邸周围划出一道边界，使任何幽灵或精魂都无法通过。

Layers of fulus and strips of prayer-printed ribbons are plastered over the walls and entrances to the manor, demarcating a boundary around the mansion where no ghosts or spirits can pass.
Manor Wards.reset:
这些防护会自动重置，持续阻止进入，并对试图绕过它们的人造成伤害，直到它们被禁用为止。

The wards reset automatically, continuing to prevent entry and damaging those attempting to bypass until they're disabled.

Kim Gu-won.name: 金久元 Kim Gu-won
Kim Gu-won.blurb:
科夫萨赫的男性人类牧师
patient male human cleric of Kofusach

Divine Spontaneous Spells.name: 神术自发法术 Divine Spontaneous Spells

Sending.name: 短讯术 Sending
Sending.description:
你向该生物发送一则不超过25个词的心灵传讯，它可以立即以自身一则不超过25个词的传讯作出回应。

You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.

Divine Wrath.name: 神圣狂怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你向敌人引导神圣之怒。区域内的敌人受到4d10精魂伤害，具体效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

大失败 该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}；当其处于恶心时，还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

升环（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Holy Cascade.name: 圣瀑冲击 Holy Cascade
Holy Cascade.description:
你呼唤神圣能量来强化一瓶@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{圣水}，将其投掷到惊人的距离。它会猛烈爆炸，对区域内的生物造成3d6点钝击伤害，来源于水流飞溅的冲击。区域内具有邪秽（特征）的生物还会受到额外的@Damage[((@item.level*2)-2)d6[spirit]]伤害。

升阶（+1） 钝击伤害增加1d6，且额外的精魂伤害增加2d6。

You call upon sacred energy to amplify a vial of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{Holy Water}, tossing it an incredible distance. It explodes in an enormous burst that deals 3d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in the area from the cascade of water. The water deals an additional @Damage[((@item.level*2)-2)d6[spirit]] damage to creatures with the unholy trait in the area.

Heightened (+1) The bludgeoning damage increases by 1d6, and the additional spirit damage increases by 2d6.

Planar Tether.name: 位面系链 Planar Tether
Planar Tether.description:
你将目标缝系在其当前所在的位面上。当目标受到位面系链影响时，该法术会尝试反制任何会移动目标的传送效果，或任何会将其运送至不同位面的效果。位面系链的持续时间由目标的意志豁免决定。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 该效果的持续时间为1分钟。

失败 该效果的持续时间为10分钟。

大失败 该效果的持续时间为1小时。

You stitch the target to its current plane. While the target is affected by planar tether, the spell attempts to counteract any teleportation effect that would move the target, or any effect that would transport it to a different plane. Planar tether's duration is determined by the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The effect's duration is 1 minute.

Failure The effect's duration is 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The effect's duration is 1 hour.

Holy Light.name: 圣光 Holy Light
Holy Light.description:
你射出一道带有神圣能量、炽烈耀眼的光线。进行一次远程法术攻击。该光线造成 5d6 火焰伤害。若目标具有邪秽（特征），你额外造成 5d6 精魂伤害。

大成功 目标受到双倍伤害。

成功 目标受到全部伤害。

如果光线穿过魔法黑暗区域，或以受魔法黑暗影响的生物为目标，则圣光会尝试反制该黑暗。若你需要判定光线是否穿过黑暗区域，在你与该法术的目标之间画一条线。

升阶（+1） 火焰伤害增加 2d6，对邪秽生物造成的精魂伤害增加 2d6。

You shine a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target has the unholy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, holy light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.

Augury.name: 占卜 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放这个法术期间，询问某一特定行动方案的结果。该法术可以预测未来最多30分钟内的结果，并揭示游戏主持对以下结果中最可能情况的最佳判断：好、坏、好坏参半（结果会同时包含好与坏），以及无事（不会有特别好或特别坏的结果）。

游戏主持进行一次秘密的 @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]。在失败时，结果总是“无事”。这使得人们无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。如果在额外一次施放占卜时，有人询问与第一次施放相同的话题，游戏主持会使用第一次施放时的秘密检定结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Clear Mind.name: 澄明心智 Clear Mind
Clear Mind.description:
你将心灵污染从目标的心智中驱除。尝试反制一个由你选择、并使目标陷入以下状态之一的效果：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}以及@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞}。如果你反制该效果失败，但若其反制阶位低2级你本会成功，则改为压制该效果直到你的下一回合开始。该效果被压制期间，其持续时间不会流逝。此法术不能反制或压制那些属于诅咒、疾病，或目标自然状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{受控}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}加入状态列表。

升阶（6环） 将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭}加入状态列表。

升阶（8环） 将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}加入状态列表。

You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of curses, diseases, or a natural state of the target.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (8th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} to the list of conditions.

Consecrate.name: 祝圣 Consecrate
Consecrate.description:
区域 以一处属于你神祇的固定祭坛、圣祠或设施为中心，40足半径爆发

你将一处场所祝圣给你的神祇，吟诵赞歌并创造出一片神圣空间。在该区域内，你神祇的崇拜者对攻击掷骰、技能检定、豁免骰和察觉检定获得+1状态加值，而与你神祇禁忌相悖的生物（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{萨伦雷} 所厌恶的亡灵）则对此类掷骰承受-1状态减值。若你神祇的神圣圣化允许你在神圣或邪恶之间进行选择，你也可以选择将该祝圣场所设为神圣或邪恶。若该神祇的圣化必须为神圣或邪恶，则你必须令该场所与该圣化一致。你神祇的崇拜者在该区域内作出的打击获得该场所的圣化特征（若有）。

大成功 祝圣成功，且其持续时间改为10年而非1年，或者覆盖半径加倍的区域。偶尔，在你神祇的恩宠下，这还可能产生更惊人的效果，例如永久祝圣的区域，或使该效果覆盖整座大教堂。

成功 祝圣成功。

失败 祝圣失败。

大失败 祝圣惨烈失败并激怒了你的神祇，祂会降下不悦的征兆。至少在1年内，进一步尝试祝圣该地点都会失败。

升阶（7环） 被祝圣的区域还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{位面封印}法术的效果，但该效果不会尝试反制你神祇崇拜者进行的传送。其花费提高为 200 gp × 法术环阶。

Area 40-foot-radius burst around an immobile altar, shrine, or fixture of your deity

You consecrate a site to your deity, chanting praises and creating a sacred space. While within the area, worshippers of your deity gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws, and Perception checks, and creatures anathema to your deity (such as undead for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{Sarenrae}) take a -1 status penalty to those rolls. If your deity's divine sanctification allows you to choose holy or unholy, you can choose to make the consecrated site holy or unholy as well. If the deity's sanctification must be holy or unholy, you must make the site match that sanctification. Strikes made by worshippers of your deity within the area gain the site's sanctification trait, if any.

Critical Success The consecration succeeds, and it either lasts for 10 years instead of 1 or covers an area with twice the radius. Occasionally, with your deity's favor, this might produce an even more amazing effect, such as a permanently consecrated area or the effect covering an entire cathedral.

Success The consecration succeeds.

Failure The consecration fails.

Critical Failure The consecration fails spectacularly and angers your deity, who sends a sign of displeasure. For at least 1 year, further attempts to consecrate the site fail.

Heightened (7th) The consecrated area also gains the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{Planar Seal} spell, but the effect doesn't attempt to counteract teleportation by worshippers of your deity. The cost increases to 200 gp × the spell rank.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你拆解一个法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。如果你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在10分钟内变成其对应类型的凡俗物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是一件神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

See the Unseen.name: 目睹无形者 See the Unseen
See the Unseen.description:
你的目光能够洞穿幻觉，发现@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物和精魂。你能够看见隐形生物，仿佛它们并未隐形，尽管它们的特征仍然模糊，使其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态且难以辨认。你还能够看见虚体生物，例如幽灵，在距离物体表面10尺内穿入物体中的模糊轮廓，如同透过那些物体看到的一般。更细微的线索还会使你进行识破幻觉的检定时获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 该法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：目睹无形者}

Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

Bless.name: 祝福 Bless
Bless.description:
来自彼方的祝福帮助你的伙伴更精准地打击。你和你的盟友在散发范围内进行攻击掷骰时，获得+1状态加值。在后续回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术，使散发的半径增加10尺。

祝福可以反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{灾祸术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{灵光：祝福}

Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet.

Bless can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{Aura: Bless}

Cleanse Cuisine.name: 净化料理 Cleanse Cuisine
Cleanse Cuisine.description:
你将区域内所有食物和饮料变成美味佳肴，把水变成葡萄酒或其他上等饮品，或者提升食物的味道和原料，使其成为一道美食。你也可以选择移除食物中的所有毒素和污染物。该法术无法防止未来的污染、自然腐坏或变质，也不会让食物变得更有营养。

升阶（+2） 区域增加另一个立方足，且必须与其余部分相连。

You transform all food and beverages in the area into delicious fare, changing water into wine or another fine beverage, or enhancing the food's taste and ingredients to make it a gourmet treat. You can also choose to remove all toxins and contaminations from the food. This spell doesn't prevent future contamination, natural decay, or spoilage, nor does it make the food any more nutritious.

Heightened (+2) Add another cubic foot to the area, which must be contiguous with the rest.

Divine Lance.name: 圣枪术 Divine Lance
Divine Lance.description:
你释放出一道神圣能量光束。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 2d4 精魂伤害（大成功时伤害加倍）。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Forbidding Ward.name: 禁绝护 Forbidding Ward
Forbidding Ward.description:
你为一名盟友施加护，使其抵御目标敌人的攻击和敌对法术。目标盟友针对目标敌人的攻击、法术和其他效果的护甲等级和豁免骰获得 +1 状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{Spell Effect: 禁绝护}

升阶（6环） 该状态加值提高至 +2。

You ward an ally against the attacks and hostile spells from the target enemy. The target ally gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against the target enemy's attacks, spells, and other effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{Spell Effect: Forbidding Ward}

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命能量来治疗活体或对不死生物造成伤害。如果目标是自愿的活体生物，你恢复其1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量的活力伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （专注） 该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活体生物，恢复的生命值增加8。

3 （专注） 你将生命能量散布于一个@Template[emanation|distance:30]中。这以散发中的所有活体生物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害提高1d8，且双动作版本的额外治疗提高8。

You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Sanctuary.name: 庇护术 Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
你以防护能量护住一个生物，阻止针对其发起的攻击。试图攻击目标的生物每次都必须进行一次意志豁免。如果目标使用了敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试其攻击，以及本回合内针对目标的任何其他攻击。

失败 该生物无法攻击目标，且该动作被浪费。它在本回合内不能进一步尝试针对目标的攻击。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，且在庇护术的剩余持续时间内都不能尝试攻击目标。

You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一面魔法力场护盾。这视为使用举起护盾动作，使你获得对 AC 的 +1 环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，但无需手来使用。
