当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{护盾格挡} 反应动作（）。该护盾具有 5 点硬度。你可以使用该法术的反应动作（）来减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使其不造成物理伤害也是如此。在你使用护盾格挡后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内不能再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该护盾的硬度提高 5 点。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Stabilize.name: 稳定伤势 Stabilize
Stabilize.description:
生命能量关上死亡之门。目标失去 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死（状态）} 状态，但在 0 生命值时仍处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}。

Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

Vitality Lash.name: 活力鞭笞 Vitality Lash
Vitality Lash.description:
你用来自创世熔炉的能量摧毁目标被腐化的本质。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，并受到 @Damage[2d6[vitality]] 伤害。若该生物的豁免大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到你的下一回合开始。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You demolish the target's corrupted essence with energy from Creation's Forge. You deal @Damage[2d6[vitality]] damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the creature critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Void Warp.name: 虚空扭曲 Void Warp
Void Warp.description:
你呼唤虚空来伤害生命力。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，并受到2d4点虚空伤害。若大失败，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4。

You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Holy Water.name: 圣水 Holy Water
Holy Water.description:
启动 A 打击

这个小瓶中装有受到一位仁善神祇祝福的水。你通过将一瓶圣水作为一次打击投出以启动它。它是一种简易投掷武器，射程增量为20尺。

圣水造成1d6精魂伤害和1点精魂溅射伤害。圣水只能伤害具有邪秽（特征）的生物。

Activate A Strike

This vial contains water blessed by a benevolent deity. You activate a vial of holy water by throwing it as a Strike. It's a simple thrown weapon with a range increment of 20 feet.

Holy water deals 1d6 spirit damage and 1 spirit splash damage. Holy water can damage only creatures with the unholy trait.

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
这种护甲由柔韧与定型的煮制皮革混合制成，提供一定的防护，同时保持最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些抛射物是弓所用的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则带有金属头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Spiritual Arrows.name: 灵体箭矢 Spiritual Arrows
Spiritual Arrows.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 巫女搭上一支箭矢，低声吟唱，随后释放出一阵神圣之力的洪流，化作数十支发光的幽灵箭矢。@Template[line|distance:60]内的生物受到 @Damage[10d6[force]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:immobilized] 豁免）。若大失败，该生物还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}（[[/act escape dc=28]]）1分钟。

Frequency once per day

Effect The shrine maiden nocks an arrow and whispers a chant before unleashing a torrent of holy power in the form of dozens of ghostly glowing arrows. Creatures in a @Template[line|distance:60] take @Damage[10d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:immobilized] save). On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} ([[/act escape dc=28]]) for 1 minute.

Twang.name: 铮然一响 Twang
Twang.description:
巫女拨动她的弓弦，制造出一道能量脉冲，抽打20尺内的一个目标。该生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免。

大成功 无效果。

成功 目标被从巫女身边向后推开5尺。

失败 目标被从巫女身边向后推开10尺并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

大失败 目标被从巫女身边抛飞15尺，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，且在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

The shrine maiden strums her bowstring, creating a pulse of energy that lashes out at a target within 20 feet. That creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The target is pushed 5 feet back from the shrine maiden.

Failure The target is pushed 10 feet back from the shrine maiden and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The target is flung 15 feet away from the shrine maiden, falls prone, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Slain Mandragoras.name: 被杀死的曼陀罗草 Slain Mandragoras
Slain Mandragoras.tokenName: 被杀死的曼陀罗草 Slain Mandragoras

Clot of Crystallized Blood.name: 结晶血块 Clot of Crystallized Blood
Clot of Crystallized Blood.description:
这些凝块中的每一块都是一枚恐惧宝石护符。

启动 2（专注）

这枚黑曜石宝石内部似乎有黑暗烟雾在翻腾。当你启动这枚宝石时，进行一次近战打击。若你命中并造成伤害，则目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}；若为大成功，则改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

如果你拥有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lkcM4V3VDAtjlR9P]{威吓打击} 专长，则该打击造成的惊惧（状态）值提高为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}；若为大成功，则改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}。

Each of these clots is a fear gem talisman.

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Dark smoke seems to writhe within this obsidian gem. When you activate the gem, make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lkcM4V3VDAtjlR9P]{Intimidating Strike} feat, increase the frightened condition value caused by the Strike to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical hit.

Slain Mandragoras.prototypeToken: 被杀死的曼陀罗草 Slain Mandragoras

Valuable Bottles of Rice Wine and Liquor.name: 珍贵的米酒与烈酒酒瓶 Valuable Bottles of Rice Wine and Liquor

Ascendant Dragon Spirit.name: 升龙烈酒 Ascendant Dragon Spirit
Ascendant Dragon Spirit.description:
启动 1 交互

这种精心酿制的烈酒被调入一杯强效的魔法鸡尾酒中，并装在一个葫芦里，葫芦上雕刻着一条盘绕其上的林龙。饮下它时，你会尝到一种引人入胜的平衡风味：木烟、蜂蜜，以及随后浮现的明亮花香。饮用后，你的双臂会灌注林龙的致命力量。持续1分钟，你的徒手打击额外造成1d6毒素伤害和1d6虚空伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.vJfRASrNBBYW6MEC]{效果：升龙烈酒}

Activate 1 Interact

This masterfully crafted spirit is mixed into a potent magical cocktail and packaged in a gourd with an engraving of a forest dragon coiling around it. Drinking it imparts an intriguing balance of woodsmoke, honey, and bright floral notes on the back end. When consumed, your arms become infused with the deadly power of a forest dragon. For 1 minute, your unarmed Strikes deal an additional 1d6 poison damage and an additional 1d6 void damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.vJfRASrNBBYW6MEC]{Effect: Ascendant Dragon Spirit}

Vengeful Demon's Tears.name: 厉魔之泪 Vengeful Demon's Tears
Vengeful Demon's Tears.description:
启动 1 交互

复仇恶魔之泪是一种臭名昭著、极其呛人的烈酒，与强效魔法鸡尾酒混合而成，传统上装在一个刻有骇人恶魔面容的葫芦中。饮下它的感觉，就像点燃了你的喉咙，再用草药补剂将火扑灭。当你启动这瓶药水时，你获得持续3轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，并且每轮都可以将额外动作用于打击、行走，或执行以下动作。

释放恶魔 1（专注，治疗）

你专注于生命在你血肉中燃烧的感觉，并获得持续1轮的2d8临时生命值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.5S2jlx6WZMAF4sxg]{效果：厉魔之泪}

Activate 1 Interact

Vengeful demon's tears is an infamously noxious spirit mixed into a potent magical cocktail and traditionally packaged in a gourd adorned with an engraving of a terrifying demonic face. Drinking it feels akin to lighting your throat on fire and putting it out with an herbal tonic. When you activate this potion, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition for 3 rounds and can use the extra action each round to Strike, Stride, or to take the following action.

Release the Demon 1 (concentrate, healing)

You focus on the sensation of life burning within your flesh and gain 2d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.5S2jlx6WZMAF4sxg]{Effect: Vengeful Demon's Tears}

Healing Potion (Moderate).name: 治疗药水（中等）
Healing Potion (Moderate).description:
启动 A (操作)

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的酥麻感。当你喝下治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] Hit Points.

Smoke Ball (Greater).name: 烟雾球（高等）
Smoke Ball (Greater).description:
启动 1 (操作)

当你将这个球砸向地面时，你会立刻在以你空间的一个角落为中心的 @Template[burst|distance:20] 内制造出一片浓厚、不透明的烟幕。该区域内的所有生物都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，而对它们而言，所有其他生物也都是隐蔽的。烟幕持续1分钟，或直到被强风驱散。

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Upon smashing this ball on the ground, you instantly create a screen of thick, opaque smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:20] centered on one corner of your space. All creatures within that area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

Tenon.name: 榫头 Tenon

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Illusory Object.name: 幻象物体 Illusory Object
Illusory Object.description:
你创造一个静止物体的幻象视觉影像。整个影像必须适应于该法术的区域内。该物体看起来会自然地活动，但不会发出声音或产生气味。例如，水看起来会从幻象瀑布中倾泻而下，但将会是无声的。

任何接触该影像或使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。

升环（2环） 你的影像会发出适当的声音，产生正常的气味，并且接触起来感觉正确。该法术获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。持续时间增加至1小时。

升环（5环） 如同2环版本，但持续时间为无限。

You create an illusory visual image of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, water would appear to pour down an illusory waterfall, but it would be silent.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your image makes appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory and olfactory traits. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你使目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状态好得多或差得多。当你施放该法术时，决定你想让该物体看起来是破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装得破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。完好的物品若被伪装得更好，则会显得仿佛崭新出厂，并经过高度抛光或精心保养。破损物品会显得完好且功能正常。被摧毁的物品无法受该法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破该幻象。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你制造出一个光球，在你选择的颜色下于20足半径内散发明亮光照（接下来的20足为昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所在的同一空间内创造该光，你可以将光附着在该生物上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮在其附近。你可以维持该法术以将光移动最多60足；作为此次移动的一部分，你可以将其附着到一个生物上或从一个生物上分离。

你可以解除该法术。若你在已同时维持四个光法术生效时施放此法术，你必须选择一个现有法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光}

高阶化（4环） 该光球在60足半径内散发光照（接下来的60足为昏暗光照）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造出一只漂浮的、魔法的手，可以是隐形或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并使其向任意方向缓慢飘浮，最多 20 足。当你维持该法术时，你可以使该物体额外移动 20 足。如果该物体在法术结束时处于空中，该物体会坠落。

增强（3环） 你可以将一个负载为 1 或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

增强（5环） 射程增加至 60 足，且你可以将一个负载为 1 或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

增强（7环） 射程增加至 60 足，且你可以将一个负载为 2 或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个松散、无人持用且位于射程内、1 负载或以下的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则造成 2d6 钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体由你掷出的物体决定。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Inhabit Home.name: 栖身住宅 Inhabit Home
Inhabit Home.description:
逝宅神栖居并控制着一栋朴素的建筑。当建筑被附体时，其装饰会随逝宅神的情绪而变化，例如充满明亮光照（当逝宅神高兴时），或显得陈旧肮脏（如果他们情绪低落）。逝宅神无法主动离开自己的家；如果被强行逐出家园，逝宅神会在其每个回合开始时受到 @Damage[3d10[force]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] 强韧豁免）。

The silsyche inhabits a modest building and controls it. While the building is possessed, its decor shifts to reflect the silsyche's mood, such as being filled with bright light (when the silsyche is happy) or appearing old and filthy (if they're depressed). A silsyche can't willingly leave their home; if forced out of their home, the silsyche takes @Damage[3d10[force]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save) at the start of each of their turns.

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当一位逝宅神被杀死时，他们会在作为其领域的废弃居所中于 [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天} 后重新成形。只有当其居所被彻底摧毁时，逝宅神才会被永久杀死。

When a silsyche is slain, they re-form after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the abandoned home that serves as their domain. A silsyche can be permanently killed only if their home is completely destroyed.

Hallucinatory Home.name: 幻觉住宅 Hallucinatory Home
Hallucinatory Home.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 逝宅神制造出一个宜人但虚幻的环境，试图引诱其目标留下，其中包括食物与便利设施。建筑内的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:24] 意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物会将这处住宅感知为如逝宅神幻象所呈现的那样，但不会被迫留下。

失败 该生物对这栋建筑陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷}，并拒绝离开。该生物可以在其每个回合结束时再次尝试一次意志豁免。若成功，它将不再着迷。

大失败 如失败，但该生物会对任何试图让其离开建筑的人变为敌对。只有在其攻击一名盟友的任意回合结束时，该生物才能再次尝试一次意志豁免以结束此效果。

Frequency once per day

Effect The silsyche creates a hospitable but illusory environment in an attempt to entice their targets into staying, including food and amenities. Creatures in the building must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature perceives the home to be as the silsyche's illusion presents it but isn't compelled to stay.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the building and refuses to leave. The creature can attempt another Will save at the end of each turn. On a success, they're no longer fascinated.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature becomes hostile to anyone who tries to make them leave the building. The creature can only attempt another Will save to end the effect at the end of any turn in which they attack an ally.

Tenon.publicNotes:
当一所房屋在被世代居住之后遭到废弃时，有时建筑本身会因失去自己的家人而过度悲恸，以至于吸引来一位尚未认领受监护者的神使的怜悯。类似于付丧神如何显现，这种灵性力量的结合可能会形成逝宅神——一种被遗弃之家所化的精魂，渴求陪伴。逝宅神从不会意图直接伤害进入它们所依附房屋的人。它们只是极度渴望联系，并且不明白大多数其他存在并不乐于接受囚禁。

逝宅神的真实形态是一个纤细、如孩童般闪烁的身影，头饰看起来像它最初显现所依托的建筑结构。这些对逝宅神第一之家的呈现，反映出它们所渴望的温暖与欢迎，甚至可能会展示早已离去的屋中居民留下的纪念物。

占据范围

大多数逝宅神会与单独一所房屋建立联系，通常是只有一两层的小型建筑。更强大的逝宅神能够与更大的结构建立联系，例如堡垒或城堡，甚至是像航海船只这样的大型载具。关于整座城镇被单个强大得不可思议的逝宅神占据的传说，至今仍流传于故事之中。

When a home is abandoned after it has been lived in for generations, sometimes the building itself mourns the loss of its family so greatly that it attracts the pity of a kami who has yet to claim a ward. Similar to how a tsukumogami manifests, such a conjoining of spiritual power can result in the formation of a silsyche—a spirit of an abandoned home who craves companionship. A silsyche never aims to outright harm those who enter the homes they form from. They are merely desperate for connection and lack the understanding that most others don't take kindly to captivity.

The silsyche's true form is a slender, childlike shimmering figure with a headpiece resembling the structure they initially manifested from. These representations of the silsyche's first home reflect the warmth and welcome they yearn for, potentially even displaying mementos of the house's inhabitants that have long gone.

Range Of Possession

Most silsyches bond with a single home, typically a small building with one or two floors. More powerful silsyches can bond with larger structures, like fortresses or castles, or even large vehicles like sailing ships. Legends of entire towns being claimed by a single, incredibly powerful silsyche persist in stories to this day.

Goh's Shame.name: 吴的耻辱 Goh's Shame

Grasping Hands.name: 与手同去 Grasping Hands
Grasping Hands.description:
触发 吴踏入木棉河

效果 一个看起来像是在游泳的孩子的阴影身影出现，抓住吴的脚踝，并开始把他拉向更深的水中；吴陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{抓取}。随后，该作祟进行先攻掷骰。

Trigger Goh steps into the Ceiba River

Effect A shadowy figure that looks like a swimming child appears to grab ahold of Goh's ankles and begins to pull him deeper into the water; Goh becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Goh's Shame.disable:
@Check[diplomacy|dc:21] 以交涉使吴足够冷静，从而让作祟消散，@Check[religion|dc:23] 以宗教驱除作祟，或 @Check[intimidation|dc:25] 以威吓把吴的“羞耻吓出来”

@Check[diplomacy|dc:21] to calm Goh enough that the haunt dissipates, @Check[religion|dc:23] to exorcise the haunt, or @Check[intimidation|dc:25] to "scare the shame" out of Goh
Goh's Shame.hazarddescription:
一个奇异的阴影身影在吴脚边的水中翻腾。

A strange shadowy figure churns in the waters at Goh's feet.
Goh's Shame.reset:
如果吴死亡，作祟就会结束，且不会重置。如果吴被拖出水面，作祟会在它下个回合结束时结束，但当吴下一次进入河流时会立即重置。

The haunt ends if Goh dies and doesn't reset. If Goh is dragged out of the water, the haunt ends at the end of its next turn but resets immediately the next time Goh enters the river.
Goh's Shame.routine:
（2个动作；情绪、惑控、恐惧、失能、心灵、异能）该作祟用它的第一个动作对吴进行擒拿，并尝试把他拉到水下。吴的强韧难度等级为19。为了把吴拉到水下，该作祟必须对他进行擒拿检定并取得大成功，且结果必须达到29或更高，才能成功使吴陷入束缚。吴被恐惧压倒，完全不会尝试挣脱，因此让他从作祟手中脱困的责任就落在PC们身上。如果吴处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}状态并被拉到水下，该作祟必须在后续轮次中持续对他进行擒拿。如果该作祟在吴处于束缚状态时成功对其擒拿并取得大成功，此人便会因惊骇与溺水共同作用而死亡，此时该作祟立即结束。

如果吴被拉出并带离水面，该作祟失去1个动作，且不再尝试对他进行擒拿。该作祟用它的第二个动作显现出一个可怖的溺亡水中幽灵影像，使其30尺内的一个目标生物进行一次@Check[will|dc:22]意志豁免（如果可能，该作祟总是以曾尝试将吴从其控制中救出的生物为目标）。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}，并在其保持惊惧期间处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态。

大失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并在其保持惊惧期间处于逃跑状态，或持续1分钟，以较晚结束者为准。

(2 actions; emotion, enchantment, fear incapacitation, mental, occult) The haunt uses its first action to grapple with Goh and attempts to pull him underwater. Goh has a Fortitude DC of 19. In order to pull Goh underwater, the haunt must critically succeed at its grapple check against him with a result of 29 or higher to successfully restrain Goh. Goh is overwhelmed by terror and makes no attempt to escape, so it falls to the PCs to get him free from the haunt. If Goh is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} and pulled underwater, the haunt must continue to grapple him in following rounds. If the haunt manages to critically succeed at grappling Goh while he's restrained, the man dies from a combination of fright and drowning, at which point the haunt immediately ends.

If Goh is pulled free and taken out of the water, the haunt loses one action and no longer attempts to grapple him. The haunt uses its second action to manifest the image of a frightening watery drowned ghost, causing one creature it targets within 30 feet to attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save (the haunt always targets a creature who attempted to free Goh from its grip if possible).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it remains frightened.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and fleeing as long as it remains frightened, or for 1 minute, whichever comes second.

Persona Mask (Greater).name: 人格面具（高等）
Persona Mask (Greater).description:
尽管覆盖了整张脸，这张雪花石膏面具并不会妨碍视觉或其他感官。佩戴这张面具时，在演戏、演说、表演喜剧或歌唱时进行的表演检定获得 +2 物品加值。

启动—承担角色 A （专注）

效果 你将面具的外观改变为你所选择的一名戏剧角色的艺术化形象。

启动—牺牲角色 R （专注、幸运）

频率 每天一次

触发 你在一次受益于该面具加值的表演检定中失败

效果 你改变面具所呈现的角色，并重骰该次表演检定，采用第二次结果。

Despite covering the entire face, this alabaster mask does not hinder vision or other senses. Wearing the mask grants a +2 item bonus to Performance checks while acting, orating, performing comedy, or singing.

Activate—Assume Role A (concentrate)

Effect You change the mask's appearance into an artistic rendition of a dramatic character of your choice.

Activate—Sacrifice Role R (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a Performance check that benefits from the mask's bonus

Effect You change the mask's character and reroll the Performance check, using the second result.

Desolation Locket.name: 荒寂坠饰 Desolation Locket
Desolation Locket.description:
这枚金色的心形坠盒表面几乎被裂纹磨蚀殆尽。若将其打开，里面会显现出一幅肖像，画像中的人是持有者曾深深爱过却已失去之人。通过启动此物品施放的任何法术，其法术DC为24。

  • 护甲 荒寂坠饰会令你对进一步的绝望感到麻木，你获得对抗情绪效果的豁免骰+2物品加值。
  • 武器（情绪、心灵）在你通过启动坠饰施放一个非戏法法术后，你会在一个 @Template[emanation|distance:5] 散发中散发出绝望灵气，直到你的下个回合开始。任何在该灵气中结束其回合的生物都必须成功通过一次对抗坠饰法术DC的 @Check[will|dc:24|traits:emotion,mental] 豁免骰，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}（若大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速2}），直到其下个回合结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.WJ9L6rgUTZVV7vEE]{Effect: Desolation Locket - Armor}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.NwEVRZmLbM9QKoIH]{Effect: Desolation Locket - Weapon}

启动 施放法术

效果 你施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b5BQbwmuBhgPXTyi]{Haunting Hymn}。

启动 施放法术

频率 每日一次

效果 你施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{恐惧术}。

The surface of this golden, heart-shaped locket is nearly worn through with cracks. If opened, it reveals a portrait of someone the bearer loved dearly and has lost. The spell DC of any spell cast by activating this item is 24.

  • Armor The desolation locket numbs you to further despair, and you gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.
  • Weapon (emotion, mental) After you cast a non-cantrip spell by activating the locket, you emanate an aura of hopelessness in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] until the start of your next turn. A creature that ends its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:24|traits:emotion,mental] saving throw against the locket's spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure) until the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.WJ9L6rgUTZVV7vEE]{Effect: Desolation Locket - Armor}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.NwEVRZmLbM9QKoIH]{Effect: Desolation Locket - Weapon}

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b5BQbwmuBhgPXTyi]{Haunting Hymn}.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear}.

Mountain Summit Grass.name: 山巅草 Mountain Summit Grass
Mountain Summit Grass.blurb:
玩世不恭的无性别蕈人制茶师
 irreverent agender leshy teamaker

Assorted pieces of jewelry.name: 各式珠宝首饰碎件 Assorted pieces of jewelry

Vanishing Coin.name: 消失硬币 Vanishing Coin
Vanishing Coin.description:
启动 F（专注）

触发 你尝试为先攻进行一次隐秘检定，但尚未掷骰

需求 你受训于隐秘

这枚铜币悬挂在一条皮革细带上，细带穿过了其中心钻出的小孔。在启动之前，这枚硬币会每隔几分钟随机有几秒钟变得隐形。

当你启动这枚硬币时，它会对你施放一个 2 环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}法术，持续至你的下一回合结束。

Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You attempt a Stealth check for initiative, but you haven't rolled yet

Requirements You are trained in Stealth

This copper coin dangles from a leather strip strung through a hole drilled in the center. Until activated, the coin becomes invisible for a few seconds at random intervals every few minutes.

When you activate the coin, it casts a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell on you, lasting until the end of your next turn.

Wand of Soothe (Rank 4).name: 4环安抚术魔杖
Wand of Soothe (Rank 4).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{安抚术}

这根短杖约有一足长，并容纳一个单一法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施放法术

频率 每天一次，外加过载

效果 你以所标示的环阶施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次所列环阶的该法术施放。

注意：要创建特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料库或资料库浏览器拖入玩家角色、非玩家角色或战利品角色的物品栏中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{Soothe}

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of the spell at the listed rank.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Injured Kappa.name: 受伤的河童 Injured Kappa

Head Bowl.name: 头碗 Head Bowl
Head Bowl.description:
河童头顶的凹陷处盛有水。若将河童头顶的水全部泼出、蒸发或以其他方式移除，其所有速度都会降至5尺，直到盆状凹陷再次装满水为止。若河童变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，则必须成功通过一次@Check[reflex|dc:15]豁免，否则会洒出其水；若河童变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，则会自动洒出其水。

如果河童被擒抱、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}或目眩，另一只生物可以花费一个单动作（具有攻击和操作特征）来尝试将其碗中的水泼出，对河童的强韧难度等级进行一次运动检定。成功时，该生物会洒出河童的水。

The depression atop a kappa's head is filled with water. Spilling, evaporating, or otherwise removing all the water from the top of a kappa's head reduces all their Speeds to 5 feet until the basin is again filled with water. A kappa who becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:15] save or spill their water, and a kappa who becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} automatically spills their water.

If a kappa is grappled, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or stunned, another creature can attempt to spill the water from their bowl by spending a single action, which has the attack and manipulate traits, to attempt an Athletics check against the kappa's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature spills the kappa's water.

Pull Arm.name: 拉拽手臂 Pull Arm
Pull Arm.description:
河童拉拽自己的一只手臂，使该手臂获得10足触及。另一只相对的手臂则缩短，几乎只剩下一只从其龟壳中伸出的手。河童仍然可以用这只缩短的手来持握物品，但不能用那只手持用护盾或武器。河童花费一个单动作来拉拽另一只手臂后，便可使双臂恢复到原本的长度。

The kappa pulls one of their arms, gaining 10-foot reach with that arm. The opposing arm shrinks to little more than a hand extending from their shell. The kappa can still use their shortened hand to hold things, but they can't use that hand to wield a shield or weapon. By spending a single action to pull their opposing arm, the kappa can return their arms to their original length.

Injured Kappa.publicNotes:
天性顽皮的河童喜欢捉弄毫无防备的旅人。它们通常并非明显怀有恶意，但也足以造成不小的麻烦，比如偷走毫无防备的沐浴者的衣物，或从无人看管的营火旁顺走食物。河童也喜欢在力量较量中证明自己的本事，而且尽管它们爱耍花招，却也以恪守承诺、交谈时彬彬有礼的光荣竞争者而闻名。

虽然不同地区的河童在外形特征上各有差异，但它们全都是两栖的、形似乌龟的人形生物，长着喙状的嘴、带蹼的手脚，以及颜色从蓝绿色到淡黄色不等的黏滑鳞片。它们通常有黑色头发，沿着一圈生长，以避开头顶中央的凹陷。来自河童家乡湖泊、溪流或河流的水会盛在这个凹陷中，也就是头碗；人们认为那是它们力量的来源。年幼的河童很容易被诱使鞠躬，不小心把自己头碗里的水倒空。失去这些水会让河童变得无精打采。河童的头碗空置得越久，它们就会变得越虚弱。对于住在家乡水域附近的河童来说，这种情况很少会构成严重危险；但对于远游在外、更加爱冒险的河童而言，这却可能致命。

河童并非天生敌对，也曾有与孤独的孩子成为朋友，或通过指路、提供轻微医疗照料来帮助受困冒险者的记载。尽管如此，许多河童栖居的地区仍会张贴告示，警告人们此地有河童出没，并鼓励靠近水边的旅人往水里丢一根黄瓜——这是河童最喜欢的食物——以换取安全通行。河童有时甚至会自己竖起这些告示，好让自己更有机会得到美味的小点心。

Mischievous by nature, kappas delight in playing pranks on unsuspecting travelers. While usually not overtly malicious, they can be a significant nuisance, stealing clothes from unsuspecting bathers or snatching unattended food from campfires. Kappas also enjoy proving their worth in competitions of strength and, despite their propensity for trickery, are known to be honorable competitors who keep their word and remain polite in conversation.

While kappas vary in physical attributes from region to region, they're all amphibious, turtle-like humanoids with beaked mouths, webbed hands and feet, and slimy scales that range in color from bluish green to pale yellow. They often have black hair, arranged in a ring to accommodate the central depression atop their head. Water from a kappa's home lake, stream, or river fills this depression, or head bowl, which is believed to be the source of their strength. Younger kappas are easily tricked into bowing and accidentally emptying the water from their own head bowls. Losing this water makes a kappa lethargic. The longer a kappa's head bowl remains empty, the weaker they grow. While this rarely poses a serious danger for a kappa living near their home body of water, it can prove fatal to a more adventurous kappa wandering afar.

Kappas aren't inherently hostile and have been known to befriend lonely children and lend aid to stranded adventurers by providing directions or minor medical treatment. Still, many areas where kappas dwell feature posted signs warning of their presence that encourage travelers venturing near water to toss in a cucumber—kappas' favorite food—in exchange for safe passage. Kappas sometimes put up these signs themselves to increase the likelihood of receiving a tasty treat.

Servant.name: 仆役 Servant

Serving Platter.name: 盛菜盘 Serving Platter
Serving Platter.description:
这种非常小巧的盾牌深受决斗家和敏捷、轻甲战士的喜爱。它通常由钢制成，并绑在你的前臂上。只要你的那只手空着，或者那只手拿着一个非武器的轻型物体，你就可以用你的圆盾举起护盾。

硬度 HP BT
3 6 3

This very small shield is a favorite of duelists and quick, lightly armored warriors. It's typically made of steel and strapped to your forearm. You can Raise a Shield with your buckler as long as you have that hand free or are holding a light object that's not a weapon in that hand.

Hardness HP BT
3 6 3

Servant's Uniform.name: 仆役制服 Servant's Uniform
Servant's Uniform.description:
普通服装具有基本剪裁，注重实用性，例如农民服饰、僧袍或工作服。

Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

Protective Platter.name: 防护拼盘 Protective Platter
Protective Platter.description:
仆役可以通过使用“举起护盾”动作来举起他们的盛菜盘。该盘子的统计数据与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1k3AsSW7lpU0kEpY]{圆盾} 相同，但需要一只手来持握。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.4hfQEMiEOBbqelAh]{举起护盾}

The servant can raise their serving platter using the Raise a Shield action. The platter has the same statistics as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1k3AsSW7lpU0kEpY]{Buckler} but requires a hand to hold.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.4hfQEMiEOBbqelAh]{Raise a Shield}

Quick Catch.name: 快速接住 Quick Catch
Quick Catch.description:
触发 一个仆役能够单手持握的物体在仆役的触及内掉落

需求 该仆役至少有一只手是空着的

效果 仆役在掉落的物体撞到地板或离开其触及之前接住它。

Trigger An object the servant could hold in one hand is dropped within the servant's reach

Requirements The servant has at least one hand free

Effect The servant catches the dropped object before it hits the floor or leaves their reach.

Raise a Shield.name: 举起护盾 Raise a Shield
Raise a Shield.description:
需求 你正持用一面护盾。

你调整护盾的位置来保护自己。当你已举起护盾时，你获得其列出的 AC 环境加值。你的护盾会一直保持举起，直到你的下个回合开始时。

Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You position your shield to protect yourself. When you have Raised a Shield, you gain its listed circumstance bonus to AC. Your shield remains raised until the start of your next turn.

Lore (any one subcategory related to the.name: 学识（与其工作相关的任一子类别，例如酒精学识、烘焙学识或家务学识）

Servant.publicNotes:
仆役可能是女仆或男管家，负责让住宅维持正常运作；也可能是在旅店等场所工作的侍者，负责点单并为顾客服务。

社会建立在劳工的肩背之上。

A servant might be a maid or butler, keeping a home in working order, or a server in an establishment like an inn, taking orders and serving customers.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.

Large Book bound in Green Cloth.name: 以绿色布料装订的大书 Large Book bound in Green Cloth
Large Book bound in Green Cloth.description:
一本以绿色布料装订的大书，散发着茶叶的清雅香气。这本书收录了以下魔茶的副本，以及@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.oYxxcgszpT242sEi]{Winter's Breath}仪式。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ByaYlK0QmnqEbCE2]{立契茶}

Unholy Hunger.name: 邪秽饥渴 Unholy Hunger

Worse Than It Smells.name: 比闻起来更糟 Worse Than It Smells
Worse Than It Smells.description:
触发 一个非宁多鲁生物把烹饪锅的锅盖拿开

效果 锅15尺内的所有生物都必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:27] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。触发生物则必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:24] 豁免，以抵抗将脸埋进炖煮物并吞下一大口的强迫（该效果具有惑控和心灵特征）。若失败，触发生物受到 @Damage[5d6[poison]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] 基础豁免）。

Trigger A non-nindoru creature takes the lid off the cooking pot

Effect All creatures within 15 feet of the pot must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}. The triggering creature instead must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save to resist the compulsion to dip their face into the stew and swallow a mouthful of the stuff (this effect has the enchantment and mental traits). On a failure, the triggering creature takes @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save).

Unholy Hunger.disable:
@Check[cooking-lore|dc:19]通过从附近搁板上加入几种精选香料来中和这锅作祟的炖菜，或 @Check[religion|dc:25]驱除该作祟

@Check[cooking-lore|dc:19] to neutralize the haunted stew with the addition of a few select spices from nearby shelves, or @Check[religion|dc:25] to exorcise the haunt
Unholy Hunger.hazarddescription:
一股恶臭的蒸汽瘴气从汤中翻涌而起，蒸汽中的尖啸面孔在气泡间几乎可见。

A miasma of foul-smelling vapor with shrieking faces barely visible in the steam bubbles up from the soup.
Unholy Hunger.reset:
将烹饪锅的锅盖重新盖上后，此作祟会在 1 轮后重置。

The haunt resets 1 round after the lid is replaced on the cooking pot.

Yu Er.name: 于尔 Yu Er

Collaborative Thievery.name: 协同盗窃 Collaborative Thievery
Collaborative Thievery.description:
这名流浪儿在 10 尺内有一名拥有扒窃能力的盟友时，进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{偷窃} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{藏匿物体} 时获得 +1 环境加值。

The urchin gains a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object} while within 10 feet of an ally who has the pickpocket ability.

Pickpocket.name: 扒窃 Pickpocket
Pickpocket.description:
对于街头孤儿而言，[[/act steal]] 或 [[/act palm-an-object]] 的难度等级不会因某件被严密看守的物品而增加 5。他们可以窃取那些原本会非常显眼或需要很长时间才能移走的物体（例如穿着的鞋子、护甲，或正在主动持用的物体）。

For an urchin, the DC to [[/act steal]] or [[/act palm-an-object]] isn't increased by 5 for an item that's closely guarded. They can Steal objects that would be extremely noticeable or time-consuming to remove (like worn shoes, armor, or actively wielded objects).

Yu Er.publicNotes:
尽管他们的冒险经历或许臭名昭著，但很少有流浪儿是真正追求刺激的人。对一些流浪儿来说，当单靠乞讨已不足以填饱肚子时，偷窃就成了一种可行的求生手段。许多地底势力也会把流浪儿当作间谍和信使来使用，同时训练他们成为未来的扒窃者、窃贼和步卒。

不幸的是，每个社会都有生活在边缘的人。尽管良善的社群会努力为贫困潦倒者提供援助与喘息之机，但有时——由于经济衰退、饥荒或战争——不幸者的数量会超出社群所能支援的范围。在冷酷无情的中立与邪恶社会中，贫困被视为一种永远无法真正根除的必然现象，甚至更糟，被当作一种可为政治利益所操弄的工具。

Although their escapades might be notorious, few urchins are thrill-seekers. For some urchins, when begging alone is not enough to fill their bellies, theft becomes a viable survival tactic. Many underworld powers also use urchins as spies and messengers, while training them to become future pickpockets, burglars, and foot soldiers.

Unfortunately, every society has people living on its fringes. While good communities work to grant aid and respite to their downtrodden, sometimes-due to economic downturn, famine, or war-the ranks of the less fortunate exceed the community's capacity to support them. In heartless neutral and evil societies, poverty is seen as an inevitability that can never be truly eradicated, or even worse, as a tool to be manipulated for political gain.
Yu Er.blurb:
女性人类流浪儿
Female human urchin

Bravo's Brew (Lesser).name: 勇士之酿（次级）
Bravo's Brew (Lesser).description:
启动 A（操作）

这瓶泡沫啤酒会赋予勇气。饮下这瓶灵药后的接下来1小时内，你的意志豁免获得+1物品加值；若是对抗恐惧时进行的意志豁免，则改为获得+2物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.eh7EqmDBDW30ShCu]{Effect: Bravo's Brew}

Activate A (manipulate)

This flask of foaming beer grants courage. For the next hour after drinking this elixir, you gain a +1 item bonus to Will saves, or +2 when attempting Will saves against fear.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.eh7EqmDBDW30ShCu]{Effect: Bravo's Brew}

Yix.name: 翼 Yix

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Read Omens.name: 阅读预兆 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥视未来。选择一个你计划在 1 周内进行的特定目标或行动，或一个你预计可能会在 1 周内发生的事件。你会得知一条隐晦的线索或建议，能够帮助应对所选事件，通常会以谜语般的诗句或预兆的形式出现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一丝生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。这个法术唤起的是肉体身体中潜藏的记忆，而非将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大致完整，法术才能生效。尸体所受的伤害越重，它的回答就越不准确、越支离破碎，而且它必须有喉咙和嘴巴才能说话。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过这个法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用其死亡时代原本生物的数据进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，并且目标的精魂会在24小时内作祟于你，骚扰你并使你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的回答可能简短、隐晦且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延时间，使法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题之前结束。

大失败 如失败，但目标的回答更直接、重复更少，不过仍然隐晦。它在进行欺瞒检定来欺骗或误导你时承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).name: 隐形术（随意，自身限定）
Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).description:
幻象将光线绕着目标弯折，使其变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找该目标，从而改为使其对它们而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿} 状态。如果目标进行敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标进行敌对动作，也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Noise Blast.name: 噪音爆破 Noise Blast
Noise Blast.description:
一阵刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} 状态，持续 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入失聪状态 1 分钟，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
疫鸟呈现为渡鸦或鸣禽的外观。这不会改变它的速度，也不会改变其打击的攻击与伤害调整值。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The nosoi takes the appearance of a raven or songbird. This doesn't change its Speed or its attack and damage modifiers with its Strikes.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Haunting Melody.name: 萦回旋律 Haunting Melody
Haunting Melody.description:
疫鸟哼唱出一首令人着迷的歌曲。每个处于 @Template[emanation|distance:60] 内的活体或不死生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:18] 豁免。该效果持续至疫鸟下个回合结束，但疫鸟可以维持它。豁免成功的生物会对此暂时免疫24小时。尽管这是一个精神效果，该能力依然会影响无心智不死生物。

引魂使对此能力免疫。

失败 该生物陷入对疫鸟的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷} 状态。

大失败 该生物对疫鸟着迷，且在其回合中必须将自己的每个动作都用于尽可能迅速地向疫鸟靠近，同时避开明显的危险。如果一个着迷的生物与疫鸟相邻，它会停在原地且不行动。如果该生物受到攻击，这种着迷便会结束。

The nosoi croons an entrancing song. Each living or undead creature within a @Template[emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save. The effect lasts until the end of the nosoi's next turn, but the nosoi can Sustain it. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours. Despite being a mental effect, this ability affects mindless undead.

Psychopomps are immune to this ability.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the nosoi.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated with the nosoi and must spend each of its actions on its turn to move closer to the nosoi as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a fascinated creature is adjacent to the nosoi, it stays still and doesn't act. If the creature is attacked, the fascination ends.

Shepherd's Touch.name: 牧羊人的接触 Shepherd's Touch
Shepherd's Touch.description:
疫鸟的打击具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}属性符文的效果，并且对活着的生物额外造成 @Damage[1d6[void]] 伤害，或对不死生物额外造成 @Damage[1d6[vitality]] 伤害。

A nosoi's Strikes have the benefit of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune and deal an additional @Damage[1d6[void]] damage to living creatures or @Damage[1d6[vitality]] damage to undead.

Yix.publicNotes:
疫鸟看起来像一只戴着厚重皮革瘟疫医生面具的夜鹰、麻雀或其他小鸟。它们是骨园的文书、信使和书记官，见证裁决、引导灵魂，并总体上承担维持骨园运转所需的各种行政杂务。大多数疫鸟都特别健谈，并且很乐于谈论它们认为自己各自负责的任务有多么重要。

引魂使是骨园中死者的守护者与引路人。骨园是埋葬万物的广阔位面，凡人的灵魂会在此接受审判，随后前往自己永恒的奖励或惩罚之所。引魂使确保死者能够接受自己从凡俗生命迈向另一阶段的转变，并被妥善归入合适的来世。它们也会保护灵魂，使其不受超自然掠食者的侵害。几乎所有引魂使都佩戴面具，尤其是在它们可能与凡人接触的时候，不过它们所戴面具的种类也和引魂使本身一样多种多样。骨园的法庭使用雷奎安语主持审判，这是一种庄重而富有旋律感的语言，说话时语速缓慢，并带有各种声调变化。

许多引魂使都深度参与骨园庞大的官僚体系。它们很少追求仁慈、正义或个人利益；对法拉斯玛及其骨园的职责高于一切。尽管如此，不同的引魂使对自身职责仍有不同理解，这可能使它们与凡人，甚至彼此之间发生冲突。

A nosoi resembles a whippoorwill, sparrow, or other small bird wearing a heavy leather plague doctor's mask. They are the clerks, messengers, and scribes of the Boneyard, witnessing judgments, directing souls, and generally performing the administrative grunt work that keeps the Boneyard functioning. Most nosois are particularly chatty and eager to discuss how important they consider their individual assignments to be.

Psychopomps are guardians and shepherds of the dead in the Boneyard, the vast plane of graves where mortal souls are judged and sent on to their eternal rewards or damnations. Psychopomps ensure that the dead come to terms with their transition from mortality and are properly sorted into the appropriate afterlife. They also protect souls from being preyed upon by supernatural predators. Nearly all psychopomps wear masks, especially when they're likely to be interacting with mortals, although the types of masks they wear are as varied as the psychopomps themselves. The courts of the Boneyard preside in Requian, a somber yet melodic language spoken slowly with various tonal shifts.

Many psychopomps are intimately involved with the Boneyard's massive bureaucracy. Few pursue mercy, justice, or personal gain; their duties to Pharasma and her Boneyard are supreme. Nevertheless, individual psychopomps interpret their duties in different ways, which might put them in conflict with mortals or even with each other.
Yix.blurb: 男性疫鸟引魂使 Male nosoi psychopomp

Antidote (Lesser).name: 解毒剂（次级） Antidote (Lesser)
Antidote (Lesser).description:
启动 A（操作）

解毒剂会保护你免受毒素侵害。饮用解毒剂后，你在对抗毒素的强韧豁免骰上获得+2物品加值，持续6小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.TjBxxlTvb6tJP1jS]{Effect: Antidote}

Activate A (manipulate)

An antidote protects you against toxins. Upon drinking an antidote, you gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poisons for 6 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.TjBxxlTvb6tJP1jS]{Effect: Antidote}

Dalgyal Gwishin.name: 蛋脸鬼 Dalgyal Gwishin

Lifesense (Precise) 120 feet.name: 生命感应（精准）120尺 Lifesense (Precise) 120 feet
Lifesense (Precise) 120 feet.description:
蛋脸鬼感应到所列射程内活体与亡灵生物的生命精华。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Lifesense]

The dalgyal gwishin senses the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Lifesense]

Stone-Faced.name: 石脸 Stone-Faced
Stone-Faced.description:
虽然蛋脸鬼没有实体身体，但它的石脸是坚实的。它不能穿过固体物体。

While the dalgyal gwishin has no physical body, its stone face is solid. It can't pass through solid objects.

Jealous Frenzy.name: 嫉妒狂暴 Jealous Frenzy
Jealous Frenzy.description:
触发 蛋脸鬼打击一个魅力调整值高于它自身的生物

频率 每天一次

效果 蛋脸鬼感知到它所打中的生物身上强烈的友谊联系与人格魅力，因此陷入嫉妒狂暴。蛋脸鬼变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}，但它只能使用其迅捷动作来打击触发该能力的生物。如果蛋脸鬼在其回合中未能至少一次打击触发该能力的生物，则嫉妒狂暴结束。该状态也会在1分钟后结束。嫉妒狂暴结束后，蛋脸鬼获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

Trigger The dalgyal gwishin Strikes a creature that has a higher Charisma modifier than itself

Frequency once per day

Effect The dalgyal gwishin enters an envious frenzy as it senses strong ties of friendship and personality within the creature it struck. The dalgyal gwishin becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} but can only use its quickened action to Strike the triggering creature. If the dalgyal gwishin fails to Strike the triggering creature at least once during its turn, Jealous Frenzy ends. It also ends after 1 minute. After Jealous Frenzy ends, the dalgyal gwishin is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Peel Face.name: 剥取面容 Peel Face
Peel Face.description:
触发 蛋脸鬼在嫉妒狂暴中对一个生物造成大成功或大失败，或将一个生物的生命值降至0

效果 蛋脸鬼将它如石头般的脸压在该生物脸上，使那张脸的幽魂印痕剥离出来并复制到它的头上。触发的生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:22] 豁免中成功，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}）。蛋脸鬼的嫉妒狂暴结束，且它不会变为减速1。

Trigger The dalgyal gwishin critically hits a creature or reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points while in a Jealous Frenzy

Effect The dalgyal gwishin presses its stony face to the creature's face, causing a ghostly imprint of that face to peel away and duplicate onto its head. The triggering creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure). The dalgyal gwishin's Jealous Frenzy ends, and it doesn't become slowed.

Dalgyal Gwishin.publicNotes:
蛋脸鬼是一种无面、佩戴石质面具的亡灵精魂。这种悲凉的亡灵由一名孤独死去、无人记得其存在的凡者之灵魂形成，因此也同样无法记起自己生前的模样。蛋脸鬼在生者的土地上游荡，寻找任何关于自己活着时是谁的痕迹。它们满怀怒火，始终嫉妒那些备受爱戴或声名显赫、被亲密友人与仰慕者环绕的人——那种绝不会落得与蛋脸鬼同样下场的人。

蛋脸鬼除了由雾气构成的幽魅身体外几乎别无他物，但它戴在头上的那张无貌石面具却是坚实的。即便是它夺来的面孔也只是短暂之物，一天后便会龟裂脱落，形成看似脆弱瓷质死亡面具的东西。有些这样的孤独精魂会保留这些面具，并将其加入自己位于偏远凄凉巢穴中的收藏，希望能在一排不断增多的沉默面孔中找到陪伴。

无面骇物

蛋脸鬼最显著的身体特征——没有面孔——也存在于被称为无脸妖的活体异怪身上。尽管拥有这一共同特征以及窃取面容的能力，这两种生物彼此并不合作，而且往往还是愤懑的死敌。任何被蛋脸鬼杀死的人，都会留下一具令人不安的无面尸体。

A dalgyal gwishin is a faceless, undead spirit that wears a stone mask. This forlorn undead forms from the soul of a mortal who died a lonely death with no one to remember them, and is similarly unable to remember what it looked like in life. A dalgyal gwishin wanders the land of the living in search of any trace of who they were when they were alive. Full of anger, they remain envious of well-loved or famous individuals who are surrounded by close friends and admirers—the type of people who would never share the dalgyal gwishin's fate.

While a dalgyal gwishin has little more than a ghostly body made of mist, the featureless stone mask it wears on its head is solid. Even the stolen faces it claims are transitory, cracking off after a day to form what looks akin to a fragile porcelain death mask. Some of these lonely spirits keep these masks and add them to a collection in a remote and forlorn lair, hoping to find companionship in an ever-growing display of silent faces.

Faceless Horror

The dalgyal gwishin's most significant physical trait—the lack of a face—is shared with the living aberrations known as noppera-bos. Despite this shared feature and the ability to steal faces, the two creatures don't cooperate and are more often bitter enemies. Anyone slain by a dalgyal gwishin leaves behind an unnerving faceless corpse.

Incense Burner.name: 香炉 Incense Burner

Silver and Oak Incense Burner.name: 银与橡木香炉 Silver and Oak Incense Burner
Silver and Oak Incense Burner.description:
一个以银与橡木精巧打造的香炉，能够保护其中的香不被风和雨熄灭。这个香炉价值 50 gp，外形如同龙的头，因此烟雾会从它的鼻孔中袅袅飘出。

A cunningly crafted silver and oak incense burner that shields the incense within from being extinguished by wind and rain. This incense burner is worth 50 gp and is shaped like a dragon’s head, so that the smoke wafts from its nostrils.

Incense Burner.hazarddescription:
一名在圣祠中进行搜索并成功通过@Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search]检定的玩家角色，还会发现一个制作精巧的银与橡木香炉，它能保护其中的香不被风与雨熄灭

A PC who Searches the shrine and succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check also discovers a cunningly crafted silver and oak incense burner that shields the incense within from being extinguished by wind and rain

Noppera-bo Trickster.name: 无面鬼骗子 Noppera-bo Trickster

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
这种护甲由柔韧皮革与定型硬化皮革混制而成，在提供一定防护的同时，也保有最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些抛射物是弓所用的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它通过一端的羽饰在飞行中保持稳定，另一端则带有金属头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸妖没有视觉，但它们的听觉极其敏锐。它们不需要呼吸，并且免疫需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上是将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用来“饮用”；它们也能以这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

Noppera-bos have no sense of vision, but their sense of hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}状态，他们就会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as a noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description:
无脸鬼变成过去24小时内其接触过的一名小型或中型类人生物的样子，并获得目标生物的面容与声音。处于变形状态时，无脸鬼在对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}时获得+2环境加值，并失去其无面能力和所列免疫。无脸鬼可以再次使用此能力来变回原状。

The noppera-bo changes into a version of a Small or Medium humanoid they've touched during the last 24 hours, and gains the target creature's face and voice. While transformed, the noppera-bo gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} that creature and loses its no face ability and listed immunities. The noppera-bo can change back by using this ability again.

Remove Face.name: 移除面容 Remove Face
Remove Face.description:
需求 无面鬼骗子正在乔装成一个有脸的生物

效果 无面鬼骗子的面部特征融化为虚无，并威吓30尺内的一个生物。该生物在一次失败的@Check[will|dc:17]意志豁免后陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（若大失败，则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。

Requirements The noppera-bo trickster is Impersonating a creature with a face

Effect The noppera-bo trickster's facial features melt into nothingness, and they menace a creature within 30 feet. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} on a failed @Check[will|dc:17] save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
无面鬼骗子对处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}的生物额外造成 1d4 精准伤害。

The noppera-bo trickster deals an additional 1d4 precision damage to creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

Noppera-bo Trickster.publicNotes:
这些无脸妖已精通伪装艺术。

无脸妖从背后看起来像普通人类，甚至可能像你认识的某个人，直到他们转过身来，露出一张没有五官的脸。

额外学识完美专家

虽然普通无脸妖通常残忍，并以惊吓或折磨类人生物为乐，但并非所有无脸妖都沉溺于邪恶。中立的无脸妖往往是爱恶作剧的家伙，会用自己的能力欺骗、捉弄他人；而罕见的善良无脸妖则会用自己的能力向自己钦佩的人表达敬意与崇拜，同时把自己的时间投入到磨练艺术或制作方面的技能上。

额外学识无面鬼起源

关于无脸妖的起源有许多理论——从变形能力出错的化狸，到被诅咒扭曲的类人生物，再到自然诞生的妖怪。甚至还有人认为这种状态是一种像兽化症那样可以传播的诅咒。大多数无脸妖都不记得自己的起源，而且它们往往更感兴趣的是假装成另一个人。

These noppera-bos have mastered the art of disguise.

Noppera-bos appear to be regular humans from behind, and might even resemble someone you know, until they turn to reveal a featureless face.

Consummate Professionals

While the typical noppera-bo is cruel and revels in the act of frightening or tormenting humanoid creatures, not all of them wallow in evil. Neutral noppera-bos tend to be pranksters who use their abilities to trick and tease, while the rare good noppera- bos instead use their abilities to honor and idolize those they admire while focusing their own time on developing their skills at art or crafting.

Noppera-bo Origins

There are many theories on the origins of noppera-bos—from tanuki whose change shape ability went wrong, to humanoids who were warped by curses, to naturally spawning yokai. Some even theorize this condition is a transmissible curse like lycanthropy. Most noppera-bos don't recall their origins, and are often more interested in pretending to be someone else entirely.

Financial Paperwork.name: 财务文书 Financial Paperwork
Financial Paperwork.description:
这些文件清楚表明，这家茶馆的财务困境早在龙华崩溃之前就已经开始了。文件中还包括一份题为“庆麦来的最后遗嘱”的文书。

Paperwork that lays bare the fact that the teahouse’s financial troubles began long before Lung Wa collapsed. The papers also include a document titled “The Last Will and Testament of Qing Mai-Lai”.

Pan Fenfang.name: 潘芬芳 Pan Fenfang

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Crushing Despair.name: 极度绝望 Crushing Despair
Crushing Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物的结果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作，且必须在其回合开始时再次尝试一次豁免；若失败，它会因无法控制地啜泣而在该回合中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 同失败，且该生物自动处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域扩大为60足锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Glibness.name: 巧言术 Glibness
Glibness.description:
谎言从你唇间滑出，宛如丝绸般顺滑。你进行欺瞒检定以说谎，以及对抗用于辨别你是否说真话的察觉检定时，获得+4状态加值，且即使你未受训，也能加上你的等级。若你的谎言因不合情理而导致环境减值或难度等级提高，则将该减值或提高幅度减半。

Falsehoods pass your lips as smoothly as silk. You gain a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to Lie and against Perception checks to discern if you are telling the truth, and you add your level even if you're untrained. If the implausibility of your lies prompts a circumstance penalty or a DC increase, reduce that penalty or increase by half.

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一丝生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。这个法术调用的是物理身体中潜藏的记忆，而非将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大致完整，这个法术才能生效。尸体受到的伤害越多，它的回答就越不准确、越支离破碎，而且它必须有喉咙和嘴巴才能说话。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过这个法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用其死亡时原本生物的数据进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，并且目标的精魂会在24小时内作祟于你，骚扰你并导致你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息，或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的答案可能简短、隐晦且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延时间，使法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题之前耗尽。

大失败 如失败，但目标的回答更直接、重复更少，不过仍然隐晦。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或误导你时承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Illusory Creature.name: 幻影生物 Illusory Creature
Illusory Creature.description:
你创造一个大型或更小生物的幻象影像。它会产生恰当的声音、气味，并且在接触时显得真实可信。如果你与该影像之间的距离超过500尺，此法术结束。

该影像不能说话，但你可以使用你的动作借由该生物发声，而法术会将你的声音恰当地伪装起来。你可能需要尝试一次欺瞒或表演检定来模仿该生物，由游戏主持裁定。如果你试图模仿某个特定人物，并与认识那个人的人互动，这种情况尤其可能发生。

在战斗中，该幻象每回合可以使用2个动作，而这些动作在你维持法术时使用。它的攻击掷骰使用你的法术攻击调整，其AC使用你的法术DC。它的豁免调整值等于你的法术DC – 10。它具有足够的实体性，因此可以与其他生物形成夹击。如果该影像被一次攻击命中或未通过一次豁免，此法术结束。

该幻象可以通过让目标相信其攻击真实存在来造成伤害，但除此之外，它不能直接影响物理世界。如果幻影生物以一次打击命中，目标受到@Damage[3d4[mental]]伤害。该幻象的打击为非致命。如果该伤害与怪物影像不相符——例如，一个幻象大型巨龙却只造成5点伤害——游戏主持可能允许目标立即尝试一次察觉检定以识破该法术。任何相关的抗力与弱点都会在目标认为其适用时生效，由游戏主持裁定。例如，如果该幻象挥舞一把战锤并攻击一个对钝击伤害具有抗力的生物，则该生物会受到较少的心灵伤害。然而，幻象伤害不会使再生失效，也不会触发其他要求特定伤害类型的效果。游戏主持应追踪该幻象所造成的幻象伤害。

任何接触该影像的生物，或使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。当一个生物识破该幻象时，它会恢复自己此前因此受到伤害的一半（如果有），并且之后不再受到它造成的伤害。

升阶（+1） 该影像打击的伤害增加1d4，并且你能够创造的生物最大体型提高一级（最大为超巨型）。

You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the spell. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[3d4[mental]] damage. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一道精神冲击使其因@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zTQWJQjR8FBuQYJ5]{眩晕术}而恍惚。这道冲击造成 1d6 点精神伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出一种简单声音的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四名正常人类齐声喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛处于好得多或差得多的物理状态。施放该法术时，决定你是要让该物体看起来破旧不堪，还是完美无瑕。被弄得看起来破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。看起来更好的完好物品会显得仿佛全新，并且经过高度抛光或精心保养。破损的物品则会显得完好且可正常使用。已摧毁的物品无法受到该法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破该幻象。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动口，但这些话并不会从你口中说出，而是被直接传送到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，其效果并不比你平时只动口不出声更好，但目标却能像站在你身边一样清楚地听见你的话。目标可以用一个简短回应作为一个反应动作（），或者如果他们愿意，则在其下个回合中以一个自由动作（）进行回应，但他们必须能看见你且位于射程内才能这样做。如果他们回应了，他们的回答也会像最初的传讯一样，直接传到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成 2d4 点心灵伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到全部初始伤害，但不受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标受到全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心状态中恢复，则持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 如失败，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d4，持续伤害增加 1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被恪尸魔杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为不死生物。恪尸魔会自动尝试反制任何对其所杀死生物施放复活术或将其转化为不死生物的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+19 #Counteract]]{+19}，反制等级5）。如果杀死该生物的恪尸魔被杀死，那么该生物就可以正常地从死亡中归来或变成不死生物。

Creatures killed by an akashti are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The akashti automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+19 #Counteract]]{+19}, counteract rank 5). If the akashti who slew the creature is slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Body.name: 具现身躯 Manifest Body
Manifest Body.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 恪尸魔经过10分钟的专注，在其纤细的骸骨躯体外显现出一具中空的人形身体。若这段时间是在一具死亡未满一周的人形生物尸体10尺范围内度过的，则恪尸魔所显现的身体会与该死去的人形生物生前一模一样，并作为该生物的伪装发挥作用。若恪尸魔能够吞食它所要复制之身体的一部分，则它在以欺瞒检定进行乔装、冒充该生物时，获得+4环境加值。当穿着显现出的身体时，恪尸魔失去其爪击打击，且它的声音听起来与死去的该生物相同；它并不拥有死者的任何记忆或技能，必须依靠欺瞒才能在遭受审视时继续维持这场伪装。若恪尸魔不每天花费10分钟来维持这层虚假血肉的显现，它所显现的身体便会迅速腐朽。该身体拥有10生命值，且防御与恪尸魔相同。当这具身体被摧毁时，恪尸魔会毫发无伤地浮现，而留下的血肉外壳会散成一团红色蝴蝶之云，并迅速消散为红色薄雾。

Frequency once per day

Effect The akashti manifests a hollow humanoid body around its slender skeletal frame over the course of 10 minutes of concentration. If this time is spent within 10 feet of a humanoid body that has been dead for less than a week, the akashti's manifested body looks identical to that of the dead humanoid when they lived and functions as a disguise of that creature. If the akashti can consume a portion of the body it's duplicating, it gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate the creature. While wearing a manifested body, the akashti loses its claw Strike, and its voice sounds like that of the dead creature; it doesn't possess any of the dead creature's memories or skills and must rely on deception to continue the charade in the face of scrutiny. An akashti's manifested body decays swiftly if it doesn't take 10 minutes once per day to maintain the manifestation of the false flesh. The body has 10 Hit Points and the same defenses as the akashti. When the body is destroyed, the akashti emerges unharmed and the fleshy shell left behind scatters into a cloud of red butterflies that swiftly fade into red mist.

Stunning Despair.name: 震慑绝望 Stunning Despair
Stunning Despair.description:
恪尸魔爆发出压倒性的绝望恸哭。30尺内的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 3}）。恪尸魔在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用震慑绝望。

The akashti unleashes overwhelming sobs of despair. Creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure). The akashti can't use Stunning Despair again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4 rounds}.

Pan Fenfang True Form.name: 潘芬芳真身 Pan Fenfang True Form

Pan Fenfang.publicNotes:
阿卡什提斯是善于操弄的邪魔，专门猎食哀悼中的人；它们会化作新近死去的挚爱之人的模样，以便潜入家中，然后杀害并吞食悲痛家庭成员的灵魂。有时也被称为“拟尸”，恪尸魔在真实形态下看起来像一具覆着皮肤的骷髅，手指上长着锋利的利爪，无睑的双眼中滴落着血泪。它的骷髅头顶像碗一样敞开，里面栖着一捧深红色的蝴蝶。当恪尸魔躲藏在它显化出的身体之内时，若仔细检查，有时就能看出真相：那位似乎死而复生的挚爱之人的头皮会微微起伏鼓动，因为其中的蝴蝶正在蠕动。阿卡什提斯体现了悲伤的复杂循环。

已死的入侵者

有时，阿卡什提斯伏击并杀害目标，并不是为了沉浸于其挚爱之人的悲痛之中，而是为了化作其形貌，从内部渗透某个组织，腐化既有的同袍情谊。然而，这些阿卡什提斯最终还是会对欺瞒感到厌倦，并把他们的新盟友引入陷阱，予以屠杀。

Akashtis are manipulative fiends who prey on those in mourning; they assume the form of a recently deceased loved one so they can infiltrate homes, then murder and consume the souls of grieving families. Sometimes called a "copycorpse," an akashti in its true form appears as a skin-covered skeleton with sharp talons on its fingers and tears of blood dripping from its lidless eyes. Its skull appears open like a bowl, and inside nest handfuls of crimson butterflies. When an akashti hides within its manifested body, close investigation can sometimes reveal the truth when the scalp of the supposed beloved one returned to life seems to subtly ripple and bulge as the butterflies within writhe. Akashtis embody the complex cycle of grief.

Deathly Invaders

Sometimes, akashtis ambush and murder targets not to bask in the grief of their loved ones, but instead to assume their form and infiltrate an organization from within to corrupt established bonds of camaraderie. Inevitably, though, these akashtis grow bored with deception and lead their new allies into a trap for slaughter.
Pan Fenfang.blurb:
阿卡什提宁多如
Akashti nindoru

Bunk Bed Post.name: 双层床床柱 Bunk Bed Post
Bunk Bed Post.tokenName: 双层床床柱 Bunk Bed Post

Taljjae Tassel.name: 魌头君流苏 Taljjae Tassel
Taljjae Tassel.description:
启动 f 想象

触发 你使用所附着的武器进行的打击获得了大成功。

被称为塔尔杰的生物那鲜红明亮的流苏，是花国随处可见的纹样，人们将其用作魅惑物，以祈求好运并酬谢巨大的付出。它们装饰在衣物、武器，甚至饮水葫芦上。这些特殊的流苏内里蕴含着那神秘妖精的一部分强大力量。当你启动一条魌头君流苏时，你的武器在此次触发攻击期间获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qUnDHEXteUQGE8yp]{Grievous} 符文的属性。

Activate f envision

Trigger Your Strike with the affixed weapon was a critical success.

The bright red tassels of the creature known as Taljjae are a ubiquitous motif in Hwanggot and are used as charms to pray for good fortune and reward for great effort. They adorn clothing, weapons, and even drinking gourds. These particular tassels carry within them a potent fraction of the mysterious fey's power. When you activate a Taljjae tassel, your weapon gains the properties of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qUnDHEXteUQGE8yp]{Grievous} rune for the duration of the triggering attack.

Bunk Bed Post.prototypeToken: 双层床床柱 Bunk Bed Post

Supplies for an Alarm Snare.name: 警报圈套的材料 Supplies for an Alarm Snare
Supplies for an Alarm Snare.description:
你通过将一个或多个会发出噪音的物体连接到绊线上或压力板上，来制造一个警报陷阱。当你制造一个警报陷阱时，你指定一个100到500英尺的射程，决定它能被听见的范围。当一个小型或更大的生物进入该格时，这个陷阱会发出足够响亮的噪音，使你所指定射程内的所有生物都能听见。

You create an alarm snare by rigging one or more noisy objects to a trip wire or pressure plate. When you create an alarm snare, you designate a range between 100 to 500 feet at which it can be heard. When a Small or larger creature enters the square, the snare makes a noise loud enough that it can be heard by all creatures in the range you designated.

Ghost Charge (Lesser).name: 幽灵充能瓶（次级）
Ghost Charge (Lesser).description:
启动 A 打击

这些弹簧装填的金属罐中装有化学物质与盐类的混合物，能够抽离并瓦解附近的亡灵生物。

幽灵充能瓶造成1d8点活力伤害和1点活力溅射伤害，不过如同活力伤害的一般规则，这种伤害只会伤害亡灵和具有虚空治疗的生物。受到幽灵充能瓶伤害的主要目标会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

幽灵充能瓶被设计成即使接触到灵体物质也会爆炸，因此非常适合用来伤害虚体亡灵。

Activate A Strike

These spring-loaded metal canisters contain a mixture of chemicals and salts that drain and disintegrate nearby undead creatures.

A ghost charge deals 1d8 vitality damage and 1 vitality splash damage, though as usual for vitality damage, this damage harms only undead and creatures with void healing. A primary target that takes damage from a ghost charge becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Ghost charges are designed to explode even on contact with a spiritual substance, making them ideal for damaging incorporeal undead.

Hungry Ghost.name: 饿鬼 Hungry Ghost

Living Visage.name: 活化面容 Living Visage
Living Visage.description:
当饿鬼拥有超过30点HP时，其看起来像是活着的生物。它在用于隐藏其不死生物身份的欺瞒检定和DC上自动取得34的结果，并且可以秘密地以活人为食。

While they have more than 30 HP, the hungry ghost appears to be a living creature. They have an automatic result of 34 on Deception checks and DCs to conceal their undead status and can Feed on the Living covertly.

Feed on the Living.name: 以活人为食 Feed on the Living
Feed on the Living.description:
饿鬼接触触及内的一名活着的生物，以窃取其生命力。若该幽灵处于其活化面容中，它可以将以活人为食伪装成一次无害的接触，并在让目标未察觉该效果的情况下，将效果延迟至最多1分钟后生效。一个生物同一时间只能受到一个延迟的以活人为食影响，且如果该幽灵在这1分钟内失去其活化面容，则该延迟效果消失。当以活人为食生效时，目标根据其 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 豁免的结果，受到 @Damage[(2d8+4)[void]] 伤害。

大成功 目标的生命能量压倒了该幽灵。饿鬼受到 @Damage[5[vitality]] 伤害，且目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害，且饿鬼恢复等同于所造成伤害的生命值。

失败 目标受到全额伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} 持续1分钟，且饿鬼恢复等同于所造成伤害的生命值。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} 持续1分钟，且饿鬼恢复等同于所造成伤害的生命值。

The hungry ghost touches a living creature in reach to steal its life force. If the ghost is in their living visage, they can disguise Feed on the Living as a benign touch and delay the effects for up to 1 minute while keeping the target unaware of the effect. A creature can be affected by only one delayed Feed on the Living at a time, and if the ghost loses their living visage during that minute, the delayed effect is lost. When Feed on the Living takes effect, the target takes @Damage[(2d8+4)[void]] damage, depending on the result of its @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target's life energy overpowers the ghost. The hungry ghost takes @Damage[5[vitality]] damage, and the target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage, and the hungry ghost regains HP equal to the damage dealt.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 minute, and the hungry ghost regains HP equal to the damage dealt.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute, and the hungry ghost regains HP equal to the damage dealt.

Ravenous Undoing.name: 贪婪的抹消 Ravenous Undoing
Ravenous Undoing.description:
在每个24小时周期内，饿鬼必须使用以活人为食，吞噬30点HP（幽灵将会获得的任何HP都计入此总数，即使幽灵拥有足够的HP，实际上并未回复全部数量）。如果幽灵没有吞噬足够的HP，它就会麻木而鲁莽地以遇到的任何活着的生物为食，直到饱足为止。

In each 24-hour period, the hungry ghost must use Feed on the Living to consume 30 HP (any HP the ghost would gain count toward this total, even if the ghost has enough HP that they don't actually regain the full amount). If the ghost hasn't consumed enough HP, they mindlessly and recklessly feed on any living creature they come across until satiated.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当一只饿鬼被摧毁时，它会在 [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 天}后于上次被摧毁的地点重组，并完全恢复。只有在它得到妥善安葬、其坟墓被清理并维护至少一年，或被法拉斯玛判定为已获救赎时，它才会被永久摧毁。

When a hungry ghost is destroyed, they reform after [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} fully healed at the location where they were last destroyed. They're only permanently destroyed when they have been given a proper burial, have had their grave cleaned and maintained for at least a year, or have been judged to be redeemed by Pharasma.

Hungry Ghost.publicNotes:
饿鬼源自那些未获妥善安葬或其坟墓遭到忽视之人。它们并不受缚于某个地点或物品，而是被驱使去寻找行善的机会，希望借此获得恩惠，帮助自己达成最终的安息。然而，它们汲取生者能量的需求往往会与这一目标相冲突。

因死后仍被尚未化解的强烈情绪束缚于世，幽灵会以昔日自我的悲伤回响作祟于生者。创建幽灵的规则见《怪物图鉴》第160页。

Hungry ghosts arise from those who didn't receive proper burials or whose graves were neglected. They are not bound to a site or item but are compelled to see opportunities to commit good deeds in hopes of gaining favors that can aid them in achieving a final rest.
