Their need to feed on living energy often conflicts with this goal, however.

Tethered to the world after death by powerful emotions that haven't been resolved, ghosts haunt the living as sad echoes of their former selves. Rules for creating a ghost start on page 160 of Monster Core.

Sparrow.name: 麻雀 Sparrow

Cunning.name: 狡猾 Cunning
Cunning.description:
渡鸦可以将简单物品当作工具使用，例如把一根小棍伸进开口里，拨弄出一块食物。它们也非常擅长偷窃物体。渡鸦不能用巧手来 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{藏匿物体}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{解除装置}或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{开锁}，但它可以用巧手来 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{偷窃}它能用喙或利爪携带的轻型物体，或完成其他相对简单的任务。

A raven can use simple items as tools, such as poking a stick at an opening to tease out a piece of food. They're also quite adept at stealing objects. A raven can't use Thievery to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}, but it can use Thievery to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} light objects that it can carry in its beak or talons or to accomplish other relatively simple tasks.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
渡鸦的打击对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物额外造成1d4精准伤害。

A raven's Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Sparrow.publicNotes:
这些杂食性的鸟类是狡猾且善于把握机会的食腐者。它们能够解开简单的谜题来取回想要的物品，渡鸦聚集在文明边缘，在不于荒野中狩猎时，便会在有需要时袭扰那里。渡鸦以诡计多端而闻名，而且常被训练来进一步发挥这种天性。受过训练的渡鸦会等待可乘之机，啄击敌人脆弱的部位。

很少有鸟类像渡鸦一样既狡猾又合群。

These omnivorous birds are cunning and opportunistic scavengers. Capable of solving simple puzzles to retrieve desired items, ravens gather at the periphery of civilization, raiding it as needed when they're not hunting in the wilds. Ravens are known for trickery and often trained to further this instinct. Trained ravens will wait for an opening and peck their foes in vulnerable spots.

Few birds are as cunning and social as the raven.

Mugirou the Rebel.name: 叛逆者麦郎 Mugirou the Rebel
Mugirou the Rebel.tokenName: 叛逆者麦郎 Mugirou the Rebel

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
这种护甲由柔韧的熟皮与模压的硬化皮革混合制成，在提供一定防护的同时保有最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些抛射物是弓使用的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则带有金属头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸妖没有视觉，但听觉极其敏锐。它们不需要呼吸，并免疫于需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上会将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；它们也可以用这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中受益。

Noppera-bos have no sense of vision, but their sense of hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}状态，他们就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as a noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description:
无脸鬼变成一个在过去24小时内接触过的小型或中型类人生物的版本，并获得目标生物的面容与声音。变形期间，无脸鬼对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}时获得+2环境加值，并失去其无面能力与所列免疫。无脸鬼可以再次使用此能力变回原状。

The noppera-bo changes into a version of a Small or Medium humanoid they've touched during the last 24 hours, and gains the target creature's face and voice. While transformed, the noppera-bo gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} that creature and loses its no face ability and listed immunities. The noppera-bo can change back by using this ability again.

Remove Face.name: 移除面容 Remove Face
Remove Face.description:
需求 无面鬼骗子正在冒充一个有脸的生物

效果 无面鬼骗子的面部特征融化为虚无，并威吓30尺内的一个生物。该生物在@Check[will|dc:17]意志豁免失败时变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。

Requirements The noppera-bo trickster is Impersonating a creature with a face

Effect The noppera-bo trickster's facial features melt into nothingness, and they menace a creature within 30 feet. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} on a failed @Check[will|dc:17] save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
无面鬼骗子对处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态的生物额外造成 1d4 精准伤害。

The noppera-bo trickster deals an additional 1d4 precision damage to creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

Mugirou the Rebel.publicNotes:
这些无脸妖已精通伪装艺术。

无脸鬼从背后看起来像是普通的人类，甚至可能像是你认识的某个人，直到他们转过身来，露出一张没有五官的脸。

额外学识完美专家

虽然普通无脸鬼通常残忍，并乐于惊吓或折磨类人生物，但并非所有无脸鬼都沉溺于邪恶。中立的无脸妖往往是恶作剧者，会用自己的能力欺骗和戏弄他人；而罕见的善良无脸妖则会用自己的能力来致敬并崇敬他们所仰慕的人，同时把自己的时间投入到发展艺术或制作方面的技能上。

额外学识无面鬼起源

关于无脸妖的起源有许多理论——从变形能力出了差错的化狸，到被诅咒扭曲的类人生物，再到自然诞生的妖怪。有些人甚至推测，这种情况是一种像兽化症一样能够传播的诅咒。大多数无脸妖都不记得自己的起源，而且他们往往更感兴趣的是假装成另一个完全不同的人。

These noppera-bos have mastered the art of disguise.

Noppera-bos appear to be regular humans from behind, and might even resemble someone you know, until they turn to reveal a featureless face.

Consummate Professionals

While the typical noppera-bo is cruel and revels in the act of frightening or tormenting humanoid creatures, not all of them wallow in evil. Neutral noppera-bos tend to be pranksters who use their abilities to trick and tease, while the rare good noppera- bos instead use their abilities to honor and idolize those they admire while focusing their own time on developing their skills at art or crafting.

Noppera-bo Origins

There are many theories on the origins of noppera-bos—from tanuki whose change shape ability went wrong, to humanoids who were warped by curses, to naturally spawning yokai. Some even theorize this condition is a transmissible curse like lycanthropy. Most noppera-bos don't recall their origins, and are often more interested in pretending to be someone else entirely.
Mugirou the Rebel.blurb:
精英无面鬼骗子
Elite noppera-bo trickster
Mugirou the Rebel.prototypeToken: 叛逆者麦郎 Mugirou the Rebel

Luda Bama.name: 卢达·巴马 Luda Bama
Luda Bama.blurb:
善于操纵他人的半身人女性走私者
manipulative female halfling smuggler

Hu Deming.name: 胡德明 Hu Deming

Padded Armor.name: 软甲 Padded Armor
Padded Armor.description:
这种护甲只是一层厚实的绗缝布料，但有时人们会因为它极其便宜而使用它。软甲比其他类型的护甲更容易受损和被毁坏。重甲的价格中包含一件软甲内衬，不过当它穿在重甲下面时，会失去舒适特征。如果你的重甲被摧毁，或者你没有穿完整的重甲，或是要穿着睡觉时，你也可以只穿这件软甲内衬。这样一来，你仍然可以维持魔法护甲的灌注，并从相关重甲上任何符文的力量中获益，但没有软甲内衬，其他人就无法穿戴你的重甲。

This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep magic armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Appraising Eye.name: 鉴定之眼 Appraising Eye
Appraising Eye.description:
该商人可以使用商贸学识来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}与物品相关的信息，包括判断其价值。他们也可以尝试使用商贸学识来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}，并且无需先知道该物品是否具有魔法。

The merchant can use Mercantile Lore to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about items, including determining their value. They can also attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} using Mercantile Lore and can do so without first knowing whether the item is magical.

Sales Specialist.name: 销售专员 Sales Specialist
Sales Specialist.description:
对于涉及谈判或商贸技艺的遭遇，一名商人相当于4级挑战。

For encounters involving negotiation or mercantile skill, a merchant is a 4th-level challenge.

Hu Deming.publicNotes:
小型聚居地通常只能维持一两名综合型商人，而较大的城市则有多名专精于某一类产品的专家。商人的范围很广，从在公共广场上四处招徕生意的小贩，到经营整个商业组织的富有巨头，都包括在内。商人可能还拥有一项关于特定物品类别的额外学识（技能）（例如珠宝或魔法武器），其技能调整值等于他们的商贸学识。

专长是经年累月的努力与往往枯燥的工作锻造而成的。工匠是其手艺的大师，能够创造出既实用又美观的作品。

Small settlements can typically support one or two generalist merchants, and larger cities house multiple specialists—experts in one type of product. Merchants range from vendors hustling in the public square to wealthy tycoons running entire commercial organizations. A merchant might have an additional Lore skill about a specific category of item (such as jewelry or magic weapons), with a skill modifier equal to their Mercantile Lore.

Expertise is forged through years of effort and often tedious work. Artisans are masters of their craft, able to create works both practical and beautiful.
Hu Deming.blurb:
男性人类商人
Male human merchant

Spider Swarm.name: 蜘蛛群 Spider Swarm

Web Sense.name: 蛛网感知 Web Sense
Web Sense.description:
蜘蛛群拥有不精确的震动感知，用以侦测接触其蛛网的生物所产生的振动。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

The spider swarm has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

Spider Swarm Venom.name: 蜘蛛群毒液 Spider Swarm Venom
Spider Swarm Venom.description:
强韧豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

最长持续时间 4轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1[poison]] 且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d4[poison]] 且 虚弱1（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d4[poison]] and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Swarming Bites.name: 蜂拥噬咬 Swarming Bites
Swarming Bites.description:
蜘蛛群空间内的每个敌人都要进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:14|basic] 豁免，并受到 @Damage[1d4[piercing]] 伤害。

豁免失败的生物会暴露于蜘蛛群毒液。

Each enemy in the spider swarm's space takes @Damage[1d4[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:14|basic] save.

A creature that fails its save is exposed to spider swarm venom.

Spider Swarm.publicNotes:
丰富的食物、突然孵化的一窝卵，或魔法影响都可能使较小的蜘蛛聚集成令人恐惧、致命的群体。

在日常害虫中，几乎没有什么能像臭名昭著的蜘蛛那样激起如此强烈的恐惧。

An abundance of food, the sudden hatching of a clutch of eggs, or magical influence can cause smaller spiders to gather in terrifying, deadly masses.

Few everyday vermin inspire as much dread as the infamous spider.

Ren Mei Li.name: 任美璃 Ren Mei Li

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Mind Probe.name: 精神质询 Mind Probe
Mind Probe.description:
你将自己的思绪投射进一个生物的心智中，从中筛取信息。你会接触到目标的记忆与知识，除非它以一次意志豁免将你挡开。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 在此法术的持续时间内，每一轮你都可以维持该法术，提出一个不同的问题，并尝试发掘答案。对于每个问题，目标都可以对抗你的法术DC进行一次欺瞒检定；若目标成功，你不会得知答案，而若其大成功，则目标会给出一个你会相信是真实的虚假答案。一旦你已经向目标问过某个特定问题，再次询问该问题——即使是以一次单独施放的精神质询——也会产生相同的结果。

大失败 如同失败，且目标对抗你的问题进行欺瞒检定时承受 –4 环境减值。

You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.

Truespeech (Constant).name: 真言（恒定）
Truespeech (Constant).description:
目标可以理解所有词语，不受语言限制，并且也能说出其他生物的语言。处于由不同生物组成的混合群体中时，每次目标说话，它都可以选择一个生物，并以该生物能够理解的语言说话，即使目标并不知道那是什么语言。

高阶化（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Outcast's Curse.name: 流放诅咒 Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
你以一项诅咒加诸目标，使其存在感变得令人不快且难以亲近。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 在10分钟内，目标每当尝试进行一次欺瞒、交涉、威吓或表演检定时，必须掷两次骰并采用较差的结果，并且他们在遭遇的生物眼中，其初始态度会恶化一级（例如，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友善}，而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{冷淡}）。

失败 同成功，但该效果为永久。

大失败 同失败，且目标所遭遇的生物对其的初始态度会恶化两级。

You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你的甜言蜜语让生物难以抗拒。你向目标提出一项行动建议，其措辞必须让目标觉得这是合乎逻辑的行动方案，且不能具有自我毁灭性，也不能明显违背目标自身利益。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你曾试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标会立刻遵从你的建议。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一项有限的建议，或该建议变得具有自我毁灭性，或产生其他明显的负面效果。

大失败 如同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以指定10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你瞬间将自己以及你正在穿戴和持握的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的射程内一个未被占据的空间。若这会让另一个生物随你一同传送——即使你是用超维容器携带它——则该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见目的地，只要你曾经到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置和与你之间的距离即可。随后你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Mind Reading (At Will).name: 读心术（随意）
Mind Reading (At Will).description:
通过一次粗略的心灵接触，你尝试读取目标的思维。它必须进行一次意志豁免。随后，该目标在1小时内暂时免疫你的读心术。

大成功 当你施放该法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放该法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思绪，并得知其智力是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大失败 如同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Speak with Animals (Constant, Spiders On.name: 动物交谈（恒定，仅限蜘蛛）
Speak with Animals (Constant, Spiders On.description:
你可以向动物提问、从它们那里获得回答，并对动物使用交涉技能。该法术不会让它们比平常更加友善。狡猾的动物往往言辞简短且闪烁其词，而不那么聪明的动物则常常会说些毫无意义的话。

You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Charm.name: 魅惑术 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语宛如蜜糖，而你的容貌仿佛沐浴在梦幻般的朦胧之中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友最近威胁过它或对它使用了敌对动作，则该豁免获得 +4 环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。当法术结束时，除非它与你之间的友谊，或你说服它采取的动作，与它的预期相冲突，否则目标不一定会意识到自己曾被魅惑术影响；这意味着你有可能通过普通手段说服目标继续把你当作朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你曾试图魅惑它。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非魅惑术，除非它辨识出了该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果它原本是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于助人}。它不能对你使用敌对动作。

大失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，且它不能对你使用敌对动作。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延续至你下一次进行每日准备时。

升阶（8环） 持续时间延续至你下一次进行每日准备时，且你最多可以将 10 个生物作为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Summon Animal (Spiders Only).name: 召唤动物（仅限蜘蛛）
Summon Animal (Spiders Only).description:
你召唤一个具有动物特征且其等级为 –1 的生物为你而战。

升阶 如召唤（特征）中所列

You summon a creature that has the animal trait and whose level is –1 to fight for you.

Heightened As listed in the summon trait

Darting Legs.name: 蛛腿拨挡 Darting Legs
Darting Legs.description:
需求 络新妇已伸出其蜘蛛腿，或已使用变形

触发 络新妇成为一次攻击的目标

效果 络新妇抬起一条腿，对抗此次触发攻击的 AC 获得 +2 环境加值。

Requirements The jorogumo has their spider legs extended or has Changed Shape

Trigger The jorogumo is targeted with an attack

Effect The jorogumo raises a leg, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
络新妇呈现为任意一种小型或中型蜘蛛的外观。这不会改变它们的速度或打击。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The jorogumo takes on the appearance of any Small or Medium spider. This doesn't change their Speed or Strikes.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Jorogumo Venom.name: 络新妇毒 Jorogumo Venom
Jorogumo Venom.description:
强韧 @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

最长持续时间 4小时

阶段 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]]伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]]伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[4d6[poison]]伤害并且 呆滞 2（1轮）

阶段 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #Duration Paralyzed]]{1d4小时}

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and Stupefied 2 (1 round)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for [[/gmr 1d4 #Duration Paralyzed]]{1d4 hours}

Silver Mistwalk.name: 白银雾行 Silver Mistwalk
Silver Mistwalk.description:
需求任美璃当前位于她在神门领地的边界之内

频率每小时一次

效果一股旋涡般的银雾从任美璃脚下升起，如缓慢旋转的龙卷风般缠绕她的身体，随后立刻将她以及她所穿戴和持握的任何物品，从她当前所在的空间传送到她在神门领地内曾到访过的任意一处空旷空间，只要她知道该处相对于自己的位置与距离即可。由于任美璃过去曾到访过柳岸镇的废墟，因此她可以使用此能力出现在城镇中的任何地方，不过如果无人预料她会现身，她通常会避免直接出现在建筑物内部。

Requirements Ren Mei Li is currently located within the boundaries of her domain in Shenmen

Frequency once per hour

Effect A swirling vortex of silver mist rises up from Ren Mei Li's feet to wrap around her body like a slowly-rotating tornado, then instantly transports her and any items she's wearing and holding from her current space to a clear space anywhere within her domain in Shenmen that she has visited before, provided she knows its relative location and distance from her. Since Ren Mei Li has visited Willowshore's ruins in the past, she can appear anywhere in the town using this ability, but she generally avoids directly appearing inside a structure if she isn't expected.

Spider Legs.name: 蜘蛛腿 Spider Legs
Spider Legs.description:
需求 该络新妇处于类人形态

效果 八条大型蜘蛛腿从络新妇的背部生出，使其获得40足攀爬速度，并可使用蛛腿拨挡。

Requirements The jorogumo is in humanoid form

Effect Eight large spider legs sprout from the jorogumo's back, granting them a 40-foot climb Speed and allowing them to use the Darting Legs reaction.

Web Trap.name: 网缚 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被络新妇的蛛网攻击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并被黏在最近的表面上，阻止该生物移动。

挣脱或强行打开网缚的难度等级为32。

A creature hit by the jorogumo's web attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface, preventing the creature from moving.

The DC to [[/act escape dc=32]] or [[/act force-open dc=32]] the web trap is 32.

Ren Mei Li.publicNotes:
络新妇外表是美丽、衣着考究的人类，潜伏于高山之中，以旅人为猎物。这些邪恶的生物能够完全变成一只巨型蜘蛛，或从背后长出蜘蛛腿，而且她们常把巨型蜘蛛当作宠物饲养。络新妇通常会吃掉猎物，但有些类人生物会遭遇更为可怖的命运——成为络新妇虫卵的活体孵化器。尽管大多数络新妇都是独居生物，但有些已经开始崇拜诺格博，并作为追随该神“灰色宗师”化身的盗贼行会的宝贵盟友效力。

Appearing as beautiful, well-dressed humans, jorogumo lurk in the high mountains and prey on travelers. These evil creatures can fully change into a giant spider or sprout spider legs from their backs, and they often keep giant spiders as pets. Jorogumo usually eat their prey, but some humanoids meet an even more gruesome fate as living incubators for jorogumo eggs. Though most jorogumos are solitary creatures, some have taken up worship of Norgorber and serve as valuable allies to thieves' guilds following that god's guise as the Gray Master.

Guhdggi.name: 孤寂魔 Guhdggi

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你扭曲目标周围的时间流动，使其动作变慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以将10个生物作为目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Wanderer's Guide.name: 旅者向导 Wanderer's Guide
Wanderer's Guide.description:
你呼唤彼方来指引你的路线。当你施放此法术时，选择一个目的地；你会获得一条通往该目的地的灵感路线，使你和与你一同进行陆上旅行的盟友在持续时间内，只要不偏离这条灵感路线，就能将困难地形导致的移动减值减半。这不会对遭遇中的移动产生任何效果。如果你在持续时间结束前再次使用此能力，此效果会结束，并被新路线的效果取代。

You call upon the beyond to guide your route. When you Cast this Spell, choose a destination; you receive an inspired route to that destination, allowing you and allies who travel overland with you to reduce the movement penalty from difficult terrain by half for the duration, as long as you don't deviate from the inspired route. This doesn't have any effect on movement during encounters. If you use this ability again before the duration is over, this effect ends and is replaced by that of the new route.

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动战技 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
随着一阵念动力的猛冲，你移动一个敌人或其携带的某件物品。你可以尝试对目标进行缴械、推撞或绊摔，以法术攻击掷骰代替运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的思绪蒙上一层迷雾，并以一道心灵震击令其恍惚。该震击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的心灵伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，则它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体在外观和触感上都像是处于好得多或坏得多的状态。施放该法术时，决定你想让该物体看起来是破败不堪还是完美无瑕。被弄得看起来破败的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗劣。一个完好的物品若被弄得看起来更好，则会显得像是崭新出厂，并且高度抛光或保养良好。一个破损物品会显得完好且能正常使用。被摧毁的物品无法被该法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破这个幻象。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Know the Way.name: 识途 Know the Way
Know the Way.description:
你在心眼中以魔法重新校准自己的方位。你会立刻知道北方在哪个方向（如果你当前所在位置存在北方），并且你可以选择一个你在过去24小时内到过的地点，得知它位于哪个方向。

升阶（3环） 你可以选择一个你在过去一周内到过的地点。

升阶（7环） 你可以选择一个你曾到过的地点，无论那是多久以前。

In your mind's eye, you magically reorient yourself. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location), and you can choose a location you were at within the last 24 hours and learn what direction it lies.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose a location you were at within the last week.

Heightened (7th) You can choose a location you were at regardless of how long ago you were there.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道汲取敌人力量的射线从你的手中闪出。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免，以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则将其豁免结果按低一个成功等级的结果处理。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被孤寂魔杀死的生物很难被复活或转化为不死生物。孤寂魔会自动尝试反制任何对其所杀死的生物施加的复活术或转化为不死生物的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+13 #Counteract]]{+13}，反制等级 3）。如果杀死该生物的孤寂魔本身被杀死，则该生物可以正常地从死亡中被带回，或正常地变成不死生物。

Creatures killed by a guhdggi are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The guhdggi automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+13 #Counteract]]{+13}, counteract rank 3). If the guhdggi who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Belch Butterflies.name: 喷吐蝴蝶 Belch Butterflies
Belch Butterflies.description:
孤寂魔张开它的两张嘴，从最里面那张类人生物的口中喷出一阵红色蝴蝶，形成一个 @Template[cone|distance:15]。区域内所有生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:22|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:sickened] 豁免，因为这些可憎昆虫那如剃刀般锋利的翅膀和细小的爪击会撕裂并切开暴露在外的血肉。孤寂魔在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Belch Butterflies]]{1d4轮} 内无法再次使用喷吐蝴蝶。

大成功 该生物不会受到这些蝴蝶造成的伤害。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[2d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] 伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[4d6[slashing],1d6[bleed]|options:area-damage]{4d6 挥砍伤害，1d6 持续流血伤害}，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[8d6[slashing],2d6[bleed]|options:area-damage]{8d6 挥砍伤害，2d6 持续流血伤害}，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

The guhdggi opens both of its mouths and, from its innermost humanoid mouth, belches forth a blast of red butterflies in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. All creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:sickened] save as the hideous insects' razor sharp wings and tiny claws slash and cut away at exposed flesh. The guhdggi can't Belch Butterflies again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Belch Butterflies]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage from the butterflies.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage from the butterflies.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d6[slashing],1d6[bleed]|options:area-damage]{4d6 slashing damage, 1d6 persistent bleed damage}, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d6[slashing],2d6[bleed]|options:area-damage]{8d6 slashing damage, 2d6 persistent bleed damage}, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Cage Prey.name: 笼中猎物 Cage Prey
Cage Prey.description:
需求 孤寂魔已用其发鞭擒拿了一个中型或更小的生物，且没有生物被关在笼子中

效果 孤寂魔尝试进行一次 @Check[athletics|against:reflex] 检定，对抗被 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 生物的反射DC。若成功，它会将该生物放入其背上携带的笼子中。孤寂魔的发鞭不再擒拿该生物，且它不能攻击其笼子中的生物。

被关在笼子中的生物处于 grabbed 状态。它在首次被关入笼子时，以及之后每个自己回合结束时，只要仍被关在笼中，都会受到 @Damage[(2d4+6)[mental]] 伤害。被关在笼中的受害者可以尝试 [[/act force-open dc=22]] 或 [[/act escape dc=22]] 直到它逃脱，也可以攻击笼子的柳条栅栏，但只能使用徒手攻击或负载为轻或更低的武器。其他生物也可以攻击柳条栅栏，但如果孤寂魔能够抵抗，它们不能尝试强行打开笼子，也不能协助笼中生物的脱身。对笼子的攻击以孤寂魔的AC作为目标结算；如果笼子因单次攻击或法术受到至少16点钝击或挥砍伤害，则笼中的生物获得自由。

如果孤寂魔死亡，它的笼子会碎裂成残片。

Requirements The guhdggi has grappled a Medium or smaller creature with its hair lash and doesn't have a creature caged

Effect The guhdggi attempts an @Check[athletics|against:reflex] check opposed by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature's Reflex DC. If it succeeds, it places the creature into the cage it carries on its back. The guhdggi's hair lash no longer grapples the creature, and it can't attack a creature in its cage.

The caged creature is grabbed. It takes @Damage[(2d4+6)[mental]] damage when first caged and at the end of each of its turns while it's caged. A caged victim can attempt to [[/act force-open dc=22]] or [[/act escape dc=22]] the cage with a DC 22 check, or it can attack the cage's wicker bars, but only with unarmed attacks or with weapons of light Bulk or less. Other creatures can attack the wicker bars as well but can't attempt to Force Open the cage or aid a caged creature's Escape if the guhdggi can resist. Attacks against the cage resolve against the guhdggi's AC, and if the cage takes at least 16 bludgeoning or slashing damage from a single attack or spell, the caged creature gets free.

If the guhdggi dies, its cage crumbles to fragments.

Lurching Skewer.name: 突刺 Lurching Skewer
Lurching Skewer.description:
孤寂魔先魅影野猪行走，然后用其持握的两把矛各进行一次打击。两次打击必须以同一目标为目标。照常将孤寂魔的多重攻击减值应用于每次打击。

The guhdggi Strides, then makes two spear Strikes, one with each of the two spears it wields. Both Strikes must have the same target. Apply the guhdggi's multiple attack penalty to each Strike normally.

Manifest Tool.name: 具现工具 Manifest Tool
Manifest Tool.description:
频率 每小时一次

效果 孤寂魔从自己的思绪中显现出一件工具。如果它的下一个动作是尝试进行一个可能受到所选工具影响的技能检定，它在该技能检定上获得+2物品加值。随后该工具被摧毁。

Frequency once per hour

Effect The guhdggi manifests a tool from its thoughts. If its next action is to attempt a skill check that could be affected by the tool it chose, it gains a +2 item bonus to the skill check. The tool is then destroyed.

Ruin Wielder.name: 持骸者 Ruin Wielder
Ruin Wielder.description:
当孤寂魔持用一件破损的非魔法武器时，它不会承受该武器处于破损状态的任何不利影响。当孤寂魔持用它时，该武器变为一件+1强击武器，并且在成功命中时额外造成1d6心灵伤害。

When a guhdggi wields a broken non-magical weapon, they do not take any of the disadvantages of the weapon being broken. While the guhdggi wields it, the weapon becomes a +1 striking weapon that deals an additional 1d6 mental damage on a successful hit.

Guhdggi.publicNotes:
孤寂魔形成于那些在多次人生中走过同一条朝圣路线之人的、被腐化的转世的灵魂。这类宁多鲁看起来像一只臃肿的青蛙，只是前脚的位置长着细长的人类手臂。它的眼睛看起来鼓胀而失明，却依然能够视物。孤寂魔总是背着一个绑在背上的大号柳条笼子，而数十条绳索与皮带则把一堆破损的武器、工具和物品固定在它的腹部与身体两侧。它行走时，会用前臂夹住两根长矛作为支撑，以一种笨拙踉跄、蹦跳不稳的步态前进。孤寂魔最令人不安的特征，是它的第二张脸——当那张蛙类般的大嘴张开时，便会露出喉咙里一张从一团纠缠的蝴蝶巢中向外窥视的人脸。这张脸长着乌黑、仿佛有生命般的长发，能够抽打出痛苦的鞭痕；当蛙嘴闭合时，这些发丝的末端会从青蛙嘴角垂落出来。

虽然孤寂魔已不再具备像多数类人生物步行那样迅捷的移动能力，但它们依旧热衷于旅行，同时对那些能更轻松做到这一点的人怀有凶恶的嫉妒。不过，可千万别低估孤寂魔那踉跄摇晃的步伐！这种邪魔尤其喜欢潜伏在朝圣道路偏僻的路段伏击旅人，把受害者关进自己的笼子里，并啃食俘虏的心智，以及他们对曾到访过之地的记忆。

孤寂魔体现了反复旅程的循环，以及每一段旅程的终点都是下一段旅程起点这一概念。这一概念的核心在于：没有任何旅程会真正开始或结束——它们只是从上一段旅程中浮现而出。

当一个多次转生的邪恶凡人灵魂被强行从灵魂循环中扯出并遭到腐化时，它就可能经历可怖的变形，成为被称作宁多鲁的邪魔。作为熵增与循环破坏的力量，宁多鲁是丑恶可憎的生物，它们的身体往往呈现扭曲畸变之态，挥舞着虽已破碎却仍能发挥作用的武器，而它们真正的面容往往藏而不露。它们展现出一些你可能会在不死生物身上看到的特征，比如腐烂的血肉或裸露的骨骼，然而宁多鲁确实仍然活着。

每一种宁多鲁都体现着某一特定循环的断裂，无论那是自然世界中的循环，还是社会传统中的循环。对宁多鲁而言，没有什么比吞食一个已经多次转生的生物更美味；而那些理论上即将升入真正觉悟境界的存在，更是最可口的盛宴。被宁多鲁杀死者，自身也会被从循环中撕离——幸运者会前往骨园接受审判，但许多则会反而被腐化，化作更多这种可怖的邪魔。

善解的信徒尤其憎恶宁多鲁，并将它们视为可以想象到的最大威胁之一。宁多鲁最常见于世界上转生循环最为强盛的地区；而且和罗刹与恶鬼一样，它们与物质位面的关联最为紧密。

转世的灵魂

在某些情况下，你会知道被宁多鲁攻击的生物是否拥有转世的灵魂。像轮回裔这样的族裔总是转世的灵魂，而玩家角色的背景故事，甚至其背景，也往往能表明其拥有前世。肆季鬼志中的所有玩家角色都符合转世的灵魂这一条件，因为他们在数十年间一遍又一遍地重历自己的人生。如果你需要为了裁定宁多鲁的能力而判断一个生物的灵魂是否为转世，进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]——若成功，则其拥有转世的灵魂。

灵堕魔半神

最强大的宁多鲁是半神，尽管崇拜它们的教派相当罕见。由于倾向于在死亡后再次转生，像苦迦菩提这样的宁多鲁半神，更准确的称呼其实是“灵堕魔苦行者”。

灵堕魔叛徒

虽然大多数宁多鲁在本性上都是纯粹的混乱邪恶，但传说中也有极其罕见的宁多鲁能够摆脱自身天性并超升，在死后转生为神使或其他更为仁善的精魂，并在此过程中摆脱仁灯如特征。当然，这些“叛徒”在其余宁多鲁眼中，也被视作世上最美味不过的佳肴。

灵堕魔蝴蝶

各种宁多鲁最奇异的共同特征之一，就是那些似乎总在它们周围盘旋、栖息于它们身体上，或周期性地从它们伤口中浮现的血红色蝴蝶。这些令人不安的昆虫，是宁多鲁思想的显现，并象征着它们曾经历却又背弃的无数前世。灵堕魔蝴蝶一旦飞离源头超过几尺，便绝不会维持太久，而会化作迅速消散于空气中的烟雾。

其他灵堕魔

除这几页中介绍的四种之外，还存在许多其他类型的宁多鲁。其他例子包括会复制尸体的阿卡什提斯（啜泣灵堕魔）、被称为影隐熊的社会渗透者（潜伏灵堕魔）、亵渎死者的尸萨吉辛（歪曲灵堕魔），以及强大而残暴的阿耳癸耳宙斯（无头灵堕魔）。

A guhdggi forms from the corrupted reincarnated souls of those who have trod the same pilgrimage route through multiple lives. This type of nindoru looks like a bloated frog with long, slender human arms instead of front feet. Its eyes appear bulbous and blind yet are capable of sight. A guhdggi always carries a large wicker cage strapped to their back, while dozens of cords and straps affix a trove of broken weapons, tools, and items to their belly and flanks. When they walk, they do so with the aid of two long spears clutched in their forearms, stumbling and hopping in an ungainly gait. The most unsettling feature of the guhdggi is its second face, revealed when the frog-like mouth opens to reveal a human face peering from its throat amid a tangled nest of butterflies. This face has long, dark, animated hair capable of inflicting painful lashes, the lengths of which hang from the corner of the frog's mouth when its lips are closed.

While the guhdggi is no longer capable of movement as swift as most humanoids walk, they still enjoy traveling while harboring a ferocious jealousy of those who can do so with greater ease. One would do well not to underestimate the stumbling stagger of a guhdggi, though! The fiend particularly delights in lying in wait along isolated sections of pilgrimage routes to ambush travelers, trapping victims in their cages and feeding upon their captive's mind and memories of previously visited places.

Guhdggis embody the cycles of repeated journeys and the concept that every journey taken ends at the start of the next. Central to this concept is the notion that no journey ever truly begins or ends—they just emerge from the previous one.

When an evil mortal soul that has been reincarnated multiple times is wrenched from the cycle of souls and corrupted, it can undergo a horrific transformation into a fiend known as a nindoru. A force for entropy and the breaking of cycles, nindorus are hideous creatures whose bodies often appear distorted, who wield weapons that have been shattered yet still function, and whose true face is often hidden from view. They display traits one might expect to see in an undead creature, such as decaying flesh or exposed bones, yet a nindoru is very much still alive.

Each nindoru epitomizes the fracture of a specific cycle, be it one from the natural world or from societal traditions. To the nindoru, nothing is more delicious than the consumption of a creature who has reincarnated multiple times, with those who are theoretically about to ascend to true enlightenment presenting the tastiest meal. Those slain by a nindoru are themselves torn from the cycle—the lucky ones move on to the Boneyard for judgment, but many are instead corrupted to form more of these horrific fiends.

Followers of Sangpotshi find nindoru to be particularly abhorrent and count them among the greatest threats imaginable. Most commonly found in regions of the world where the reincarnation cycle is strongest, nindorus are, like rakshasas and oni, associated most strongly with the Material Plane.

Reincarnated Souls

In some cases, you'll know if a creature a nindoru attacks has a reincarnated soul. Ancestries like samsarans are always reincarnated souls, and a PC's backstory or even their background can often indicate the presence of a previous life. All of the PCs in Season of Ghosts qualify as reincarnated souls, as they've relived their lives over and over for decades. If you ever need to determine if a creature's soul is reincarnated for the purpose of adjudicating a nindoru's ability, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]—on a success, it has a reincarnated soul.

Nindoru Demigods

The most powerful nindorus are demigods, although their cults are quite rare. Prone to reincarnation after death, nindoru demigods like Kugaptee are more properly known as "nindoru ascetics."

Nindoru Traitors

While most nindorus are purely chaotic evil in nature, legends tell of exceptionally rare nindorus who manage to escape their own nature and ascend, reincarnating after death into kami or other more benevolent spirits and shedding the nindoru trait as they do so. Of course, these "traitors" are regarded as the most delicious meals imaginable by the nindorus left behind.

Nindoru Butterflies

One of the strangest shared traits of the various types of nindoru are the blood-red butterflies that seem to follow them around, nest on their bodies, or periodically emerge from their wounds. These unnerving insects are physical manifestations of the nindorus' thoughts and symbolize the countless past lives they once lived but turned their backs on. Nindoru butterflies never last long once they flutter more than a few feet from their source, fading away into smoke that quickly dissipates into the air.

Other Nindorus

Many other types of nindorus exist beyond the four presented on these pages. Others include the corpse-copying akashtis (sobbing nindorus), infiltrators of society known as kagekumas (lurking nindorus), the dead defiling shisagishins (crooked nindorus), and the powerful and brutal argyrzeis (headless nindorus).

Meditation Mandala.name: 冥想曼荼罗 Meditation Mandala
Meditation Mandala.description:
当前含有一个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs]{扭曲心智}法术。

这个闪闪发光的魅饰由一颗带有铅质内含物瑕疵的宝石制成。施法者可以将法术施放进自己已灌注，或由一名自愿生物已灌注的反制护符中。该法术的效果不会发生；取而代之的是，法术的力量会储存在护符内，替换其中先前储存的任何法术。该护符只能容纳由法术位施放的法术，不能容纳戏法或专注法术。当护符已灌注时，灌注它的生物会知道其中储存了什么法术，并且当该法术被施放时会自动识别该法术。

启动—反制 R （操作）

触发 你成为护符中所储存法术的目标，或位于其区域内

需求 你有一只空闲的手

效果 你出示护符，并尝试反制该触发法术，使用护符中储存法术的环阶以及 [[/r 1d20+20 #Counteract]]{+20} 的反制调整值。这会消耗护符中储存的法术。

Currently contains a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs]{Warp Mind} spell.

This glittering charm is made of a gemstone flawed with a leaden inclusion. Spellcasters can cast spells into countering charms that they've invested or that are invested by a willing creature. The spell's effect doesn't occur; the spell's power is instead stored within the charm, replacing any spell previously there. The charm can hold only spells cast from spell slots, not cantrips or focus spells. While the charm is invested, the creature who has invested it knows what spell is stored within and automatically identifies that spell when it's cast.

Activate—Counter R (manipulate)

Trigger You are targeted by or within the area of the spell stored within the charm

Requirements You have a free hand

Effect You present the charm and attempt to counteract the triggering spell, using the rank of the spell stored in the charm and a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+20 #Counteract]]{+20}. This expends the spell held in the charm.

Khravgodon.name: 克拉夫戈多恩 Khravgodon

+2 Circumstance to All Saves vs. Disease.name: 对所有对抗疾病的豁免获得+2境况加值 +2 Circumstance to All Saves vs. Disease

Feign Death.name: 假死 Feign Death
Feign Death.description:
触发 克拉夫戈多恩的生命值降至 70 HP 以下

效果 克拉夫戈多恩倒下。它处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，并且可以使用只需心智即可进行的动作，但任何其他动作都会结束这场伪装。

必须成功进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:18|traits:action:seek] 检定以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}，或一次 @Check[medicine|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge] 检定以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}，才能判断出这个生物实际上并没有死亡。

Trigger The khravgodon is reduced below 70 HP

Effect The khravgodon collapses. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and can use actions that require only its mind, but any other action ends the ruse.

A successful @Check[perception|dc:18|traits:action:seek] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @Check[medicine|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} is required to determine that the animal is not, in fact, dead.

Revived Retaliation.name: 复苏反击 Revived Retaliation
Revived Retaliation.description:
触发 当克拉夫戈多恩在装死时，被其触及内的一个生物攻击或惊扰

效果 克拉夫戈多恩对触发该反应的生物进行一次打击。

Trigger The khravgodon is attacked or disturbed by a creature within reach while Feigning Death

Effect The khravgodon Strikes the triggering creature.

Crush Chitin.name: 碾碎甲壳 Crush Chitin
Crush Chitin.description:
需求 克拉夫戈多恩已使一个生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

效果 克拉夫戈多恩啃咬该生物，造成 @Damage[(2d12+9)[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] 豁免），且无视目标对物理伤害的前5点硬度或抗力。若豁免失败，目标的 AC 还会在1轮内承受 -2 环境减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.7OJrBAEah6YFLzcK]{效果：碾碎甲壳}

Requirements The khravgodon has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The khravgodon bites the creature, dealing @Damage[(2d12+9)[piercing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save) that ignores the first 5 of the target's Hardness or resistance to physical damage. On a failed save, the target also takes a -2 circumstance penalty to AC for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.7OJrBAEah6YFLzcK]{Effect: Crush Chitin}

Grasping Tail.name: 攫握之尾 Grasping Tail
Grasping Tail.description:
克拉夫戈多恩在移动时，可以用其尾巴拖拽一个被其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}的大型或更小的生物一同移动。

A khravgodon can drag a Large or smaller creature it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with its tail along with it when it Strides.

Khravgodon.publicNotes:
很少有生物能像克拉夫戈多恩那样扛住沙螯兽的强酸并咬碎它的甲壳。

很少有生物能像负鼠这样，在如此长久的时间里于如此多样的环境中存活下来。

Few creatures can shrug off an ankhrav's acid and crunch its chitin like a khravgodon.

Few creatures have survived as long and in as many environments as the opossum.
Khravgodon.allSaves: +2 circumstance to all saves vs. disease

Hong Meigui.name: 洪玫瑰 Hong Meigui

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Hallucination.name: 镜花水月 Hallucination
Hallucination.description:
目标会持续将某样事物侦测成另一种事物、无法侦测到实际存在的东西，或侦测到实际上并不存在的东西，但这不会改变其信念。你选择这些效果中适用的是哪一种，并决定镜花水月的具体内容。例如，你可以让目标将所有精灵看成人类、无法侦测到其兄弟的存在、即使护身符不在身上也看到自己随身带着心爱的幸运护符，或看见城镇中央有一座高塔。

目标可以首先尝试一次意志豁免，效果如下。此后，每当它@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}或直接与镜花水月交互时，也都可以进行一次意志豁免来识破该镜花水月。例如，目标每次与一名精灵交互、意外撞到其兄弟、试图查看自己的护身符，或研究那座高塔时，都可以尝试识破该镜花水月。在由游戏主持裁定的某些情境下，目标尝试识破时可以获得巨大的环境加值，例如当目标试图攀爬那座并不存在的高塔时。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到它识破为止，但它知道那是怎样的镜花水月。

失败 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到它识破为止。

大失败 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到它识破为止，并且它信任自己错误的感官，对识破所进行的豁免承受 -4 环境减值。

升环（6环） 选择将目标改为至多10个生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为直到你的下一次每日准备。

升环（8环） 选择将目标改为任意数量的生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为无限。

The target consistently detects one thing as another, can't detect something that's there, or detects something that's not there, though it doesn't alter their beliefs. You choose which of these effects applies, and you determine the specifics of the hallucination. For example, you could make the target see all elves as humans, be unable to detect the presence of their brother, see their beloved good luck charm on their person even when it isn't, or see a tower in the center of town.

The target can attempt an initial Will save, with effects below. They also receive a Will save to disbelieve the hallucination every time they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or directly interact with the hallucination. For example, the target could attempt to disbelieve the hallucination each time they interacted with an elf, bumped into their brother accidentally, tried to check their charm, or studied the tower. The target can attempt to disbelieve with a large circumstance bonus in situations determined by the GM, such as if the target attempted to climb the nonexistent tower.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, but it knows what the hallucination is.

Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves.

Critical Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, and it trusts its false senses, taking a -4 circumstance penalty to saves to disbelieve.

Heightened (6th) Choose to either target up to 10 creatures or change the spell's duration to until your next daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) Choose to either target any number of creatures or change the spell's duration to unlimited.

Subconscious Suggestion.name: 潜意识暗示 Subconscious Suggestion
Subconscious Suggestion.description:
你将一个潜意识暗示深植于目标的心智之中，使其在你所指定的触发发生时遵从。你向目标提出一项行动建议。你的指令措辞必须让目标觉得这是合乎逻辑的行动方案，而且不能具有自我毁灭性，也不能明显违背目标的自身利益。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你曾试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是在正常地与它交谈，而不是对它施放法术。

失败 该暗示会留存在目标的潜意识中，直到你下一次准备为止。如果在那之前触发发生，目标会立即遵从你的暗示。该效果的持续时间为1分钟，或者直到目标完成一个有限的暗示，或该暗示变得具有自我毁灭性，或带来其他明显的负面影响。

大失败 如失败，但持续时间为1小时。

升环（9环） 你可以指定至多10个生物为目标。

You implant a subconscious suggestion deep within the target's mind for them to follow when a trigger you specify occurs. You suggest a course of action to the target. Your directive must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target, and it can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The suggestion remains in the target's subconscious until the next time you prepare. If the trigger occurs before then, the target immediately follows your suggestion. The effect has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Phantasmal Killer.name: 幻影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你创造出一个目标所能想象到的最可怖生物的幻影。只有该法术的目标能看见这名杀手，不过你也能看见这个幻象模糊的轮廓，它会疾冲而出发动攻击。杀手的效果取决于目标意志豁免的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到 @Damage[4d6[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标受到 @Damage[(max(8,@item.rank*2))d6[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标恐惧至极，甚至可能因此死去。它必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|traits:incapacitation] 豁免；如果目标失败，则其死亡。若强韧豁免成功，目标受到 @Damage[(max(12,@item.rank*3))d6[mental]] 伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}直到其下个回合结束，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

强化（+1） 失败时的伤害增加 2d6，大失败时的伤害增加 3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(max(8,@item.rank*2))d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a @Check[fortitude|traits:incapacitation] save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes @Damage[(max(12,@item.rank*3))d6[mental]] damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其心智之前将其阻断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}，持续1轮。

大失败 目标陷入麻痹，持续4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它都可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少1轮；若大成功，则立即结束该效果。

升环（7环） 你可以指定至多10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Feast.name: 吸血盛宴 Vampiric Feast
Vampiric Feast.description:
你的接触会从目标身上吸取生命力来强化自己。你对目标造成 6d6 点虚无伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚无伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1 分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Inveigle.name: 诱骗 Inveigle
Inveigle.description:
你赢得了目标的心智，使其将你视为亲近且值得信赖的朋友，并认为你的每一个建议都很合理。目标会对你乐于助人，因此会特意帮助你。和任何其他乐于助人的生物一样，你能要求它做的事也有其限度。如果你要求目标去做完全违背其天性，或对目标及其利益造成无谓伤害的事情，它不仅会拒绝，还可以尝试一次意志豁免来提前结束该效果。由于施法时间和射程的缘故，除非目标是自愿的（也许被说服认为该仪式会产生其他效果）或处于束缚状态，否则通常很难施放这个仪式。如果该生物不愿接受这个仪式，它可以尝试一次意志豁免来抵消该效果。

大成功 该仪式成功，且目标在为结束该效果进行的意志豁免上承受 -4 状态减值。

成功 该仪式成功。

失败 该仪式失败。

大失败 该仪式失败，且目标反而会憎恨你，在持续时间内变为对你敌对。

强化（6环） 只要你持有该生物的一缕头发、一滴血液，或其身体的其他一部分，并将之混入消耗中使用的油料里，你就可以在整个施法过程中对最远 1 英里外的一个生物使用诱骗。基础花费增加至 100 gp。持续时间会比正常情况更短，取决于你使用了该生物身体的多大一部分。血液、毛发、鳞片及类似之物会使该仪式持续 1 周，而手或其他相当大的一部分身体则会使该仪式持续 1 个月。

You win over the target's mind, causing it to see you as a close and trusted friend and look upon your every suggestion as reasonable. The target is helpful toward you, so it will go out of its way to help you. As with any other helpful creature, there are limits to what you can ask of it. If you ever ask the target to do something completely against its nature or needlessly harmful to the target or its interests, not only does it refuse, but it also can attempt a Will save to end the effect early. Because of the casting time and range, it's generally difficult to cast this ritual unless the target is willing (perhaps convinced the ritual will have some other effect) or restrained. If the creature is unwilling to accept the ritual, it can attempt a Will save to negate the effect.

Critical Success The ritual succeeds and the target takes a -4 status penalty to Will saves to end the effect.

Success The ritual succeeds.

Failure The ritual fails.

Critical Failure The ritual fails and the target instead hates you, becoming hostile to you for the duration.

Heightened (6th) You can use inveigle on a creature up to 1 mile away throughout the casting, as long as you have a lock of hair, a drop of blood, or some other piece of the creature's body, which you mix into the oils used in the cost. The base cost increases to 100 gp. The duration is shorter than normal, based on how large a piece of the creature's body you use. Blood, hair, scales, and the like cause the ritual to last 1 week, while a hand or other substantial body part causes the ritual to last 1 month.

Charm.name: 魅惑术 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语如蜜般甜美，而你的容貌仿佛沐浴在梦幻的朦胧之中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友最近威胁过它，或对它使用过敌对动作，则此次豁免获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。当法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己曾被魅惑术，除非它与你的友谊，或你说服它采取的动作，与它的预期相冲突；这意味着你有可能通过普通手段说服目标继续把你当作朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你曾试图魅惑它。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非魅惑术，除非它识别出该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果它原本是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于助人}。它不能对你使用敌对动作。

大失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，且它不能对你使用敌对动作。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延长至你下一次进行每日准备时。

升阶（8环） 持续时间延长至你下一次进行每日准备时，且你的目标最多可以为10个生物。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声无息地动唇说话，但这些话不会从你口中传出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，就和你平常只是动嘴唇时一样；但目标能听见你的话，就像他们正站在你身边一样。目标可以用一个简短回应作为反应动作（），或者如果他们愿意，也可以在他们下个回合作为自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能够看见你且位于射程内才能这么做。如果他们作出回应，他们的回应也会像最初的传讯一样，直接传到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至 500 尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一面魔法力场护盾。这视为使用“举起护盾”动作，使你获得 AC +1 的环境加值，直到你下个回合开始，但它不需要手来使用。

当该法术生效时，你可以以你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{护盾格挡} 反应动作（）。该护盾具有 5 点硬度。你可以使用该法术的反应动作（）来减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使它不造成物理伤害也是如此。在你使用护盾格挡后，该法术结束，并且你在 10 分钟内无法再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该护盾的硬度提高 5 点。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造出一只漂浮的、魔法手，可以是隐形的，也可以如幽灵般显现；它抓住目标物体，并使其缓慢地向任意方向悬浮移动，最多 20 尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动 20 尺。如果法术结束时该物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你可以将一个负载为 1 或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个负载为 1 或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

升阶（7环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个负载为 2 或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、未被持握的松散物体掷向目标，该物体的负载必须为1或更低。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。如果命中，你造成2d6点钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体类型取决于你所掷出的物体。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全部伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet.name: 呼吸感知（精准）60尺 Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet
Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet.description:
僵尸无法感知5英尺外的活体生物，除非借助其呼吸感知。处于所列射程内并屏住呼吸的活体生物，对僵尸而言为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}，持续至其保持屏息为止。要以这种方式屏住呼吸，生物必须空出一只手，完全堵住自己的鼻子或捂住自己的嘴。

A jiang-shi can't perceive living creatures beyond 5 feet except with their breathsense. A living creature within the listed range who holds its breath is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} to the jiang-shi for as long as it holds its breath. To hold its breath in this way, a creature must have one hand free to fully plug its nose or cover its mouth.

Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities.name: 僵尸弱点 Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities
Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities.description:
所有僵尸都具有以下弱点。

  • 厌斥 僵尸不能主动进入距离一面挥舞着的镜子或摇响的手铃10尺以内的范围。生物可以用一个交互动作挥舞镜子或摇响手铃，使该物品生效1轮（类似于在举起盾牌）。如果僵尸非自愿地进入其厌斥之物10尺以内，它会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}状态，并远离其厌斥之物移动，直到其距离该物体达到10尺或更远。在暴露于其厌斥之物1轮后，僵尸可以用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。若成功，它会克服其厌斥 [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6轮}（若大成功，则为1小时）。
  • 苦涩顿悟 当僵尸被提醒起自身堕落的本质，以及其在存在上与活物相隔绝的真相时，它会陷入严重的忧郁。每当僵尸看见一座祭坛，上面有至少1负载献给祖先精魂的食物祭品时，它必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。之后，它会暂时免疫苦涩顿悟1分钟。

大成功 僵尸不受影响。

成功 僵尸陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1轮。

失败 僵尸陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 僵尸陷入呆滞 2并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}，持续1分钟。

All jiang-shi possess the following vulnerabilities.

  • Revulsion A jiang-shi can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of a brandished mirror or the sound of ringing handbells. A creature can Interact with a mirror or handbell to brandish or ring the item for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the jiang-shi involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they are 10 feet or farther from the object. After 1 round of being exposed to the object of their revulsion, a jiang-shi can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Bitter Epiphany A jiang-shi is afflicted by severe melancholia when reminded of their debased nature and the truth of their existential disconnection from living beings. When a jiang-shi sees an altar with at least 1 Bulk of food offerings to ancestor spirits, they must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save. They are then temporarily immune to Bitter Epiphany for 1 minute.

Critical Success The jiang-shi is unaffected.

Success The jiang-shi is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The jiang-shi is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The jiang-shi is stupefied 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute.

One More Breath.name: 再喘一口气 One More Breath
One More Breath.description:
与其他不死生物不同，僵尸在 0 HP 时不会被摧毁。相反，它们会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，并在 1 分钟后以 1 点生命值苏醒。将至少 1 负载的糯米或鸡蛋撒在失去意识的僵尸身上，会将其永久摧毁。如果僵尸是被一把由暮木制成的武器的攻击降至 0 HP，它们会立即被摧毁。

Unlike other undead, a jiang-shi isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, they fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and awaken in 1 minute with 1 Hit Point. Scattering at least 1 Bulk of glutinous rice or hen eggs on an unconscious jiang-shi destroys them permanently. If the jiang-shi was reduced to 0 HP by an attack from a weapon made of duskwood, they're destroyed immediately.

Warped Fulu.name: 扭曲符箓 Warped Fulu
Warped Fulu.description:
僵尸腐化了贴在它们额头上的符箓。僵尸对无需消耗法术位、由魔法物品施放的法术免疫，例如卷轴或魔杖施放的法术。生物可以通过对抗僵尸的察觉DC进行检定，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal}该符箓并将其移除。这会立即终止僵尸对此类效果的免疫。若随后有生物以一个交互动作摧毁被移除的符箓，僵尸也会失去其快速治疗能力。僵尸可以花费连续不断的1小时，用书写工具在一张纸条（或类似物）上书写，从而制作一张替代符箓。

The jiang-shi has corrupted the fulu attached to their brow. The jiang-shi is immune to spells cast from a magic item without expending a spell slot, such as from a scroll or wand. A creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} the fulu to remove it, rolling against the jiangshi's Perception DC. This immediately ends the jiang-shi's immunity to these effects. If a creature then destroys the removed fulu with an Interact action, the jiang-shi also loses their fast healing ability. A jiang-shi can create a replacement fulu by spending 1 uninterrupted hour inscribing a strip of paper (or similar) with a writing instrument.

Drain Qi.name: 汲取气 Drain Qi
Drain Qi.description:
需求 一个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}或自愿的生物位于僵尸的触及内

效果 僵尸通过呼吸汲取受害者的生命能量，也就是气。如果受害者处于抓取状态，则需要进行一次针对受害者强韧DC的 @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude]检定；若处于其他任一状态则自动生效。受害者陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失（状态） 1}，且僵尸恢复 @Damage[12[healing]] 生命值，任何超出的部分转为临时生命值。对已经处于流失（状态）的生物汲取气不会为僵尸恢复任何生命值，但会使受害者的流失（状态）值增加1，当其达到流失（状态）5时，受害者死亡。如果受害者具有施放气法术的能力，它可以花费1聚能点以避免陷入流失（状态）。这只能保护它免受当前这次攻击，而不能防止后续的汲取气尝试。

受害者的流失（状态）值每周降低1。如果该生物将其饮食至少1天限制为糯米，并通过成功进行一次 @Check[athletics|dc:25]检定而花费10分钟跳舞、慢跑或进行其他剧烈身体活动，则其流失（状态）减少1。

Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the jiang-shi's reach

Effect The jiang-shi drains the victim's life energy, or qi, through their breath. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the jiang-shi regains @Damage[12[healing]] HP, gaining any excess as temporary Hit Points. Draining qi from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the jiang-shi but increases the victim's drained condition value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. If the victim has the ability to cast ki spells, it can spend 1 Focus Point to avoid becoming drained. This protects it only from the current attack, not from subsequent attempts to Drain Qi.

A victim's drained condition value decreases by 1 every week. If the creature restricts their diet to glutinous rice for at least 1 day and spends 10 minutes dancing, jogging, or otherwise engaging in vigorous physical activity by succeeding at a @Check[athletics|dc:25] check, it reduces its drained condition by 1.

Rigor Mortis.name: 尸僵 Rigor Mortis
Rigor Mortis.description:
僵尸无视困难地形以及会使其陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}的效果。僵尸不能执行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{伏倒}动作。当其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}时，不会触发通常由移动动作触发的反应动作（），例如借机攻击。

The jiang-shi ignores difficult terrain and effects that would render them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A jiang-shi can't take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{Drop Prone} action. When they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} they don't trigger reactions that are normally triggered by move actions, such as Attacks of Opportunity.

Hong Meigui.publicNotes:
僵尸是来自天夏、以跳跃移动的可怖吸血鬼（特征）。它们与其他吸血鬼（特征）相似——属于亡灵，会汲取生者的生命力，而且只能以特定方式被杀死——但僵尸啜食的是生者的呼吸，也就是所谓的气或炁，而非鲜血。它们拥有独特的力量，包括能偏转魔法的符箓、非凡的跳跃能力，以及对阳光的免疫；同时，僵尸也有独特的弱点，例如除了通过呼吸感知外无法看见活着的生物、厌恶铃铛与镜子，以及几乎令人呆滞的忧郁。值得庆幸的是，大多数僵尸都无法制造吸血鬼（特征）仆从。

被粗暴地从梦魇般的沉眠中惊醒后，地方僵尸会在其领地周围的村庄与墓地中游荡，搜寻能缓解饥渴的食粮。

Jiang-shi are terrifying hopping vampires from Tian Xia. Though similar to other vampires—they are undead, drain vital energy from the living, and can be slain only in specific ways—jiang-shi feast upon the breath of the living, also known as qi or ki, instead of blood. While they possess unique powers, including their magic-deflecting paper fulus, extraordinary jumping ability, and immunity to sunlight, jiang-shi also possess unique vulnerabilities, such as the inability to see living creatures save through breathsense, a revulsion to bells and mirrors, and near-stupefying melancholia. Thankfully, most jiang-shi can't create vampiric spawn.

Roused rudely from their nightmarish slumber, the provincial jiang-shi roams the villages and graveyards around their domain searching for sustenance to slake their hunger.
Hong Meigui.blurb:
女性地方僵尸
Female provincial jiang-shi
Hong Meigui.hp: fast healing 10, void healing, one more breath

Healing Potion (Moderate).name: 治疗药水（中级） Healing Potion (Moderate)
Healing Potion (Moderate).description:
启动 A (操作)

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的酥麻感。当你饮用治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] Hit Points.

Healer's Gloves.name: 医者手套 Healer's Gloves
Healer's Gloves.description:
这双洁白的手套即使在缝合伤口或治疗其他病症时使用，也从不会显出血迹。它们给予你医药检定+1物品加值。

启动——Healer's Touch A（操作）

频率 每天一次

效果 你可以抚慰一名自愿、活着且邻接的生物的伤口，使该生物恢复 @Damage[(2d6+7)[vitality,healing]|shortLabel:true] 生命值。这是一个治疗活力效果。你不能用这种治疗伤害亡灵。

These clean, white gloves never show signs of blood, even when used to stitch up wounds or treat other ailments. They give you a +1 item bonus to Medicine checks.

Activate—Healer's Touch A (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You can soothe the wounds of a willing, living, adjacent creature, restoring @Damage[(2d6+7)[vitality,healing]|shortLabel:true] Hit Points to that creature. This is a healing vitality effect. You can't harm undead with this healing.

Lady Ren's Ring.name: 任女士之戒 Lady Ren's Ring
Lady Ren's Ring.tokenName: 任女士之戒 Lady Ren's Ring

Messenger's Ring.name: 信使戒指 Messenger's Ring
Messenger's Ring.description:
这枚银制图章戒指会变化为与你所侍奉的领主或组织相符的徽记（如果你不侍奉任何其他人，则变为你自己的脸）。它使你在交涉检定上获得 +2 物品加值，并让你能够随意将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{传讯术} 作为奥术先天法术施放。

启动—派遣信使 1 分钟（专注）

频率 每天一次

效果 戒指会依照你的要求施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yhz9fF69uwRhnHix]{动物信使}。该动物是一只魔法生物，从戒指中跃出，其外观符合戒指所代表的领主或组织的标志风格或纹章特征。

This silver signet ring changes to match the insignia of a lord or organization you serve (or your own face, if you serve no one else). It grants you a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks and lets you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} as an arcane innate spell at will.

Activate—Dispatch Messenger 1 minute (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The ring casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yhz9fF69uwRhnHix]{Animal Messenger} to your specification. The animal is a magical creature that springs from the ring, and its appearance suits the iconography or heraldry of the lord or organization represented by the ring.

Lady Ren's Ring.prototypeToken: 任女士之戒 Lady Ren's Ring

Summoning Rune.name: 召唤符文 Summoning Rune

Summon Monster.name: 召唤怪物 Summon Monster
Summon Monster.description:
触发 一个生物进入魔法传感器形成的云团

效果 该陷阱召唤一个特定的1级生物，于创建陷阱时决定。该生物掷先攻，并持续存在[[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6轮}，之后法术结束且该生物消失。如果有人在持续时间到期前解除该陷阱，该生物也会消失。与大多数召唤生物不同，被召唤的生物每轮可以使用3个动作，并且可以使用反应动作。

Trigger A creature enters the cloud of magical sensors

Effect This trap summons a specific 1st-level creature, determined when the trap is created. The creature rolls initiative and remains for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds}, after which the spell ends and the creature disappears. The creature also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. The summoned creature can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

Summoning Rune.disable:
@Check[acrobatics|dc:15|name:Approach Rune]以在不触发陷阱的情况下接近，随后进行@Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Erase Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device]（受训）以抹除符文，或施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（1环；反制 DC 15）以反制该符文

@Check[acrobatics|dc:15|name:Approach Rune] to approach without triggering the trap followed by @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Erase Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to erase the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the rune
Summoning Rune.hazarddescription:
一团隐形的魔法感应器云环绕着一道隐形的墙壁或地板符文，其半径为10足，符文的体型与将被召唤的生物相同。

A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 10-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.
Summoning Rune.reset:
该陷阱每天黎明时重置。

The trap resets each day at dawn.

Bundle-Cutting Reward.name: 割草绳奖励 Bundle-Cutting Reward

Striking.name: 强击 Striking
Striking.description:
强击符文将毁灭性的魔法储存在武器中，使该武器造成的武器伤害骰由一个增加为两个。例如，+1 强击匕首造成的伤害是2d4，而不是1d4。

你可以将已经蚀刻在武器上的强击符文升级为更强的版本，将现有符文的数值提高为新符文的数值。你必须拥有更强符文的配方才能这样做，而此次升级的价格是两种符文价格之间的差额。

A striking rune stores destructive magic in the weapon, increasing the weapon damage dice it deals to two instead of one. For instance, a +1 striking dagger would deal 2d4 damage instead of 1d4 damage.

You can upgrade the striking rune already etched on a weapon to a stronger version, increasing the values of the existing rune to those of the new rune. You must have the formula of the stronger rune to do so, and the Price of the upgrade is the difference between the two runes' Prices.

Ghost Touch.name: 幽冥 Ghost Touch
Ghost Touch.description:
刻有此符文的武器能够伤害没有实体形态的生物。幽冥武器对虚体生物尤其有效，而这类生物几乎总是对幽冥武器具有特定的弱点。

虚体生物可以接触、持握并挥舞幽冥武器（不同于大多数实体物体）。

A weapon etched with this rune can harm creatures without physical form. A ghost touch weapon is particularly effective against incorporeal creatures, which almost always have a specific vulnerability to ghost touch weapons.

Incorporeal creatures can touch, hold, and wield ghost touch weapons (unlike most physical objects).

Bundle-Cutting Reward.hazarddescription:
胜者选择其中之一。

The victor chooses one of these.

Healing Potion (Moderate).name: 治疗药水（中等）
Healing Potion (Moderate).description:
启动 A（操作）

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的酥麻感。当你喝下治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] Hit Points.

Hu Ban-Niang.name: 胡半娘 Hu Ban-Niang

Spider Lily Tattoo.name: 彼岸花刺青 Spider Lily Tattoo
Spider Lily Tattoo.description:
彼岸花刺青将你标记为胡婆婆人脉网络中受信任的一员。这道绯红色刺青会在施加后一天内褪去并变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}，只有在你启动它、获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭（状态）}状态，或死亡时才会再次显现。毁灭值越高，颜色就越鲜艳。

如果你的刺青清晰可见，你对所有能看见该刺青的生物进行威吓检定时获得+1物品加值；但对于那些明白彼岸花刺青真实含义的人（包括柳岸镇的所有居民），你进行交涉检定以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{留下印象}时，会承受–1物品减值。

启动 1 默想（专注）

需求 你的刺青当前不可见

效果 你令刺青变得可见。你可以再次使用此启动使刺青变为不可见，除非你处于毁灭（状态）状态。

启动 f 默想（专注）

频率 每天一次

触发 一个不死生物第一次侦测到你，且你察觉到该不死生物

效果 彼岸花刺青会操纵你的生命力，让你在短时间内看起来像是不死生物。对触发生物的察觉DC尝试一次@Check[deception|defense:perception]检定。若成功，触发的不死生物会认为你也是不死生物——无心智的不死生物很可能会无视你，而有智能的不死生物则可能表现出好奇或困惑。你可以在每轮以单动作继续尝试欺瞒检定来维持该效果，持续最长1分钟。

The spider lily tattoo marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu's network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color.

If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on those who understand the actual meaning of the spider lily tattoo (including all of Willowshore's citizens).

Activate 1 envision (concentrate)

Requirements Your tattoo isn't currently visible

Effect You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the doomed condition.

Activate f envision (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger An undead creature detects you for the first time, and you're aware of the undead creature

Effect The spider lily tattoo manipulates your life force to make you appear to be undead for a short time. Attempt a @Check[deception|defense:perception] check against the triggering undead creature's Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you're undead as well—a mindless undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute.

So Have You Heard?.name: 你听说了没？
So Have You Heard?.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 胡婆婆可以通过 2 小时的工作改变一名玩家角色在柳岸镇的声望。她以目标的 @Check[deception|defense:deception]{欺瞒}、@Check[deception|defense:diplomacy]{交涉} 或 @Check[deception|defense:intimidation]{威吓} 难度等级中最高的一项为目标，尝试一次欺瞒检定。如果目标在柳岸镇的至少一个派系中处于钦佩或尊敬，胡婆婆的检定承受 –1 状态减值；如果目标在两个派系中都处于钦佩或尊敬，则改为 –2。之后，目标会暂时免疫“你听说了没？”1 周。

大成功 在接下来 1 周内，目标在与柳岸镇居民互动时进行基于魅力的技能检定时承受 –2 环境减值。

成功 如同大成功，但减值仅为 –1，且只持续 1 天。

失败 目标不受影响。

大失败 计划适得其反；目标不仅不受影响，而且胡婆婆在 1 个月内无法使用“你听说了没？”。

Frequency once per day

Effect Granny Hu can shift a PC's reputation in Willowshore over the course of 2 hours of work. She attempts a Deception check against the target's @Check[deception|defense:deception]{Deception}, @Check[deception|defense:diplomacy]{Diplomacy}, or @Check[deception|defense:intimidation]{Intimidation} DC, whichever is highest. If the target is admired or revered by at least one faction in Willowshore, Granny Hu takes a –1 status penalty to her check, or –2 if the target is admired or revered by both factions. The target is then temporarily immune to So Have You Heard? for 1 week.

Critical Success The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Charisma-based skill checks when interacting with Willowshore residents for a week.
