Success As critical success, but only a –1 circumstance penalty and for only 1 day.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure The plan backfires; not only is the target unaffected, but Granny Hu can't use So Have You Heard? for 1 month.

Are You Sure About That?.name: 你确定要这样？
Are You Sure About That?.description:
触发 30尺内一个对胡婆婆而言可见、且在过去一周内曾暴露于真要试试看？的生物，说了或做了某些有违胡婆婆利益的事

效果 胡婆婆做出一个微妙的手势，提醒触发的生物想起自己的秘密。该生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:22] 豁免，否则该触发动作被打断。无论结果如何，该生物随后都会在24小时内暂时免疫此能力。

Trigger A creature within 30 feet who's visible to Granny Hu and who has been exposed to Want to Try Me? in the past week says or does something that would be against Granny Hu's interests

Effect Granny Hu makes a subtle gesture, reminding the triggering creature of their secret. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:22] Save or the triggering action is disrupted. Regardless of the outcome, the creature then becomes temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours.

Nerves of Steel.name: 钢铁意志 Nerves of Steel
Nerves of Steel.description:
如果胡婆婆在对抗恐惧效果的豁免中成功，她改为获得大成功。

If Granny Hu succeeds at a save against a fear effect, she gets a critical success instead.

Want to Try Me?.name: 真要试试看？
Want to Try Me?.description:
触发 30尺内一名生物尝试对某个生物使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{胁迫} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{挫败士气}

效果 胡婆婆威胁要揭露触发生物的一个秘密。她对该触发生物的意志DC进行一次 @Check[intimidation|defense:will] 检定。她的名声意味着，即使她实际上并不知道什么秘密，也能威胁玩家角色；但如果她确实知道一个特别危险或羞耻的秘密，她的威吓检定获得+2环境加值。

大成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}，且其胁迫或挫败士气尝试的结果降低一个成功等级。

成功 如同大成功，但为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 该生物不受影响。

大失败 该生物不受影响，其胁迫或挫败士气尝试获得+1环境加值，并在24小时内免疫“真要试试看？”。

Trigger A creature within 30 feet attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature

Effect Granny Hu threatens to expose a secret of the triggering creature. She attempts an @Check[intimidation|defense:will] check against the triggering creature's Will DC. Her reputation means she can threaten a PC even if she doesn't actually know a secret, but if she does know an especially dangerous or shameful one, she gains a +2 circumstance bonus to her Intimidation check.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, and the result of their Coerce or Demoralize attempt is reduced by one degree of success.

Success As success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is unaffected.

Critical Failure The creature is unaffected, gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their Coerce or Demoralize attempt, and is immune to Want to Try Me? for 24 hours.

Hu Ban-Niang.blurb:
女性人类卫兵队长
Female human guard captain
Hu Ban-Niang.allSaves: +1 status vs. fear, nerves of steel

Ugly Cute.name: 丑萌 Ugly Cute

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Dream Message.name: 托梦术 Dream Message
Dream Message.description:
你将一则讯息送入你的目标的梦境中。该讯息是单向的，最多可包含 1 分钟的讲话内容（约 150 字）。如果目标已入睡，他们会立刻收到这则讯息。如果没有，他们会在下次入睡时收到。它一旦被收到，该法术便结束，而你会知道讯息已被送达。

强化（4环） 你可以将最多 10 个你知道名字且亲自见过的生物作为目标。你必须向他们所有人发送相同的讯息；该法术会对每个生物分别结束。

You send a message to your target's dream. The message is one-way, up to 1 minute of speech (roughly 150 words). If the target is asleep, they receive the message instantly. If not, they receive it the next time they sleep. As soon as they receive it, the spell ends, and you know the message was sent.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures you know by name and have met in person. You must send the same message to all of them; the spell ends for each creature individually.

Detect Alignment (At Will, Evil Only).name: 侦测阵营（随意，仅限邪恶）
Detect Alignment (At Will, Evil Only).description:
你的双眼发光，你感知到阵营灵光。选择混乱、邪恶、善良或守序。你侦测该阵营的灵光。除了存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择不侦测你已知具有该阵营的生物或效果。

只有6级或更高的生物——除非是神圣施法者、亡灵，或来自外环的存在——才具有阵营灵光。

高阶化（2环） 你得知每个灵光的位置和强度。

Your eyes glow as you sense aligned auras. Choose chaotic, evil, good, or lawful. You detect auras of that alignment. You receive no information beyond presence or absence. You can choose not to detect creatures or effects you're aware have that alignment.

Only creatures of 6th level or higher-unless divine spellcasters, undead, or beings from the Outer Sphere-have alignment auras.

Heightened (2nd) You learn each aura's location and strength.

Telepathy 60 feet.name: 心灵感应 60 尺 Telepathy 60 feet

Anchored Soul.name: 锚定灵魂 Anchored Soul
Anchored Soul.description:
石蜘蛛与某个特定的定居点相连，且必须始终停留在该定居点边界10英里范围内。

The stone spider is bonded to a specific settlement and must remain within 10 miles of the settlement's border.

Bonded Vessel.name: 绑定容器 Bonded Vessel
Bonded Vessel.description:
石蜘蛛容器的状态决定其最大 HP。未受损时，该容器是一个具有 62 HP（BT 31）的物体。石蜘蛛处于精魂形态时，对其造成伤害不会伤及容器，但对容器造成伤害会对石蜘蛛造成等量伤害。当石蜘蛛栖居于其容器中时，它们是同一个目标，伤害会同时减少石蜘蛛和容器的 HP。若容器处于破损状态，石蜘蛛在栖居其中时仍可战斗且不会承受不良效果；但若容器被摧毁，石蜘蛛会立即被杀死，且无法重组。

The condition of a stone spider's vessel dictates its maximum HP. Undamaged, the vessel is an object with 62 HP (BT 31). When the stone spider is in spirit form, damaging it doesn't hurt the vessel, but damaging the vessel deals an equal amount of damage to the stone spider. When the stone spider Inhabits its Vessel, they're a single target, and damage reduces the HP of both the stone spider and the vessel. If the vessel is broken, the stone spider can still fight while inhabiting it and suffers no ill effect, but if the vessel is ever destroyed, the stone spider is instantly slain and can't reconstitute.

Reconstitution.name: 重构 Reconstitution
Reconstitution.description:
当石蜘蛛的生命值降至0时，它的精魂会消散。若其绑定容器完好无损，石蜘蛛会在[[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days}后于该容器中重新成形，并完全恢复。若该容器处于破损状态，则必须先将其修复，之后石蜘蛛会在[[/gmr 3d4 #days]]{3d4 days}后重新成形。

When the stone spider reaches 0 Hit Points, its spirit dissipates. If its bonded vessel is intact, the stone spider re-forms in this vessel after [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days}, fully healed. If the vessel is broken, it must first be Repaired, after which the stone spider re-forms in [[/gmr 3d4 #days]]{3d4 days}.

Inhabit Vessel.name: 栖身容器 Inhabit Vessel
Inhabit Vessel.description:
蜘蛛接触并与其绑定容器融合，使其活化。它可以花费一个单动作来停止栖身于其容器，该动作具有专注（特征）。当栖身于容器中时，它失去其飞行速度，并获得

免疫 治疗、非致命

抗力 物理 6（钝击除外）

速度 25 尺，攀爬 25 尺

以及以下打击。

  • 近战 1 石质尖牙 +14（灵巧），伤害 2d8+7 穿刺

The spider touches and melds with its bonded vessel, bringing it to life. It can cease Inhabiting its Vessel by spending a single action, which has the concentrate trait. While Inhabiting the Vessel, it loses its fly Speed and gains

Immunities healing, nonlethal

Resistances physical 6 (except bludgeoning)

Speed 25 feet, climb 25 feet

and the following Strike.

  • Melee 1 stone fangs +14 (finesse), Damage 2d8+7 piercing

Spirit Body.name: 魂魄躯体 Spirit Body
Spirit Body.description:
当未栖身于其容器中时，石蜘蛛具有虚体，并获得对所有伤害的抗力 6（力场伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}除外；对非魔法的抗力加倍）。

When not Inhabiting its Vessel, the stone spider is incorporeal and gains resistance 6 to all damage (except force damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch}; double resistance against non-magical).

Spirit Web Trap.name: 精魂网缚 Spirit Web Trap
Spirit Web Trap.description:
被石蜘蛛蛛网攻击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并被粘在最近的表面上，直到它[[/act escape dc=22]]{除非目标成功逃脱}。

A creature hit by the stone spider's web attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=22]]{Escapes}.

Settlement Lore (Regarding their Home Se.name: 定居点学识（关于其家乡定居点）

Ugly Cute.publicNotes:
将蜘蛛尊为抵御害兽、害虫以及普遍邪恶的守护者这一传统，远早于现代络新妇的统治；石蜘蛛所扮演的角色，与石狮相近。石蜘蛛守护野兽常见于城镇与村庄入口附近的基座上，静静蹲踞、一动不动——有些甚至已如此历经数代——以至于许多当地人都已忘记，他们本地的守护者并不只是装饰而已。

The tradition of venerating spiders as wards against vermin, pests, and evil in general far predates the modern jorogumo rule, with stone spiders filling a role similar to stone lions. Stone spider guardian beasts can be found perched on plinths near town and village entrances, standing motionless—for generations in some cases—so that many locals have forgotten their local guardian is anything more than a decoration.
Ugly Cute.blurb:
无性别石蜘蛛
Agender Stone Spider

Supplies for Brewing Magical Tea.name: 冲泡魔法茶所需的补给品 Supplies for Brewing Magical Tea

Well-seasoned Cast Iron Wok.name: 调味良好的铸铁炒锅 Well-seasoned Cast Iron Wok
Well-seasoned Cast Iron Wok.description:
作为用于烹饪餐食的制作检定的专家级工匠工具发挥作用。

你需要这些工具，才能用制作技能将原材料制成物品。专家级工匠工具会给予你的该检定 +1 物品加值。

不同的工作需要不同的工具组，具体由游戏主持决定；例如，铁匠的工具包与木工的工具包就有所不同。如果你穿戴着你的工匠工具，你可以在使用它的动作中将其抽出并放回。

Functions as a sterling artisan’s tool for Crafting checks to cook meals.

You need these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Sterling artisan's tools give you a +1 item bonus to the check.

Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

Iogaka.name: 尤伽喀 Iogaka

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Control Weather.name: 控制天气 Control Weather
Control Weather.description:
你改变天气，使其变得平静并恢复为该季节的正常状态，或根据季节选择至多两种效果。

你无法精确控制这些显现，例如龙卷风的确切路径或闪电打击的目标。

  • 秋季 寒冷天气、雾、温和炎热、雨夹雪
  • 春季 毛毛雨、炎热、飓风、雨夹雪、雷暴、龙卷风
  • 夏天 毛毛雨、暴雨、酷热、冰雹、炎热
  • 冬季 暴风雪、轻度寒冷、严寒、解冻

大成功 你如愿改变天气，并且可以影响更大的区域（至多半径5英里的圆形区域），或更长的持续时间（额外任意数量的d12小时，最多至16d12）。

成功 你如愿改变天气。

失败 你未能如愿改变天气。

大失败 天气以出乎预料的方式改变，由游戏主持决定，但通常会尽可能与你真正的愿望相反（例如，当你希望好天气时，却会出现一场可怕的风暴）。

高阶化（9环） 你可以制造反常季节的天气以及互相矛盾的天气效果，例如严寒与飓风并存。你可以让天气变得平静并恢复为另一季节的正常状态，或从任何季节的列表中选择天气效果。

You alter the weather, making it calm and normal for the season or choosing up to two effects based on the season.

You can't specifically control the manifestations, such as the exact path of a tornado or the targets of lightning strikes.

  • Autumn cold weather, fog, mild heat, sleet
  • Spring drizzle, heat, hurricane, sleet, thunderstorm, tornado
  • Summer drizzle, downpour, extreme heat, hail, heat
  • Winter blizzard, mild cold, extreme cold, thaw

Critical Success You change the weather as desired and can affect a larger area (up to a 5-mile-radius circle), or a longer duration (any number of additional d12 hours, up to 16d12).

Success You change the weather as desired.

Failure You fail to change the weather as desired.

Critical Failure The weather changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, a terrible storm emerges when you would prefer good weather).

Heightened (9th) You can create unseasonable weather and contradictory weather effects, such as extreme cold and a hurricane. You can make the weather calm and normal weather for a different season or choose weather effects from any season's list.

Baleful Polymorph.name: 凶恶变形术 Baleful Polymorph
Baleful Polymorph.description:
你将目标生物变成与该区域相称的一种无害动物，具体效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的身体获得这种无害动物的下等特征。它的内脏在部分转化时翻腾不已，使其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。当它从恶心状态中恢复时，这些特征会恢复正常。

失败 目标会变形1分钟，但保留其心智。如果它在其回合中将其所有动作都用于专注于自己原本的形态，它可以尝试一次意志豁免以立即结束该效果。

大失败 目标的身体与心智都会变成所选的无害动物，持续时间为无限。

You transform the target creature into a harmless animal appropriate to the area, with effects based on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's body gains minor features of the harmless animal. Its insides churn as they partially transform, causing it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. When it recovers from the Sickened condition, its features revert to normal.

Failure The target transforms for 1 minute but keeps its mind. If it spends all its actions on its turn concentrating on its original form, it can attempt a Will save to end the effect immediately.

Critical Failure The target is transformed into the chosen harmless animal, body and mind, for an unlimited duration.

Illusory Scene.name: 幻象场景 Illusory Scene
Illusory Scene.description:
你构筑出一个想象中的场景，其中包含至多10个彼此分离的生物或物体，体型可各不相同，且都必须位于该法术的区域内。这些元素会发出合适的声音与气味，并且在接触时感觉也真实无误。幻象场景中的元素无法说话。不同于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻影生物} 法术，你场景中的生物不具有战斗能力和属性数据。你的场景不包含其周围环境的变化，不过你可以将你的场景放置在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{蜃景} 法术制造的幻象环境中。

当你创造该场景时，你可以选择让它静止不动，或按照一套程序运行。虽然静态场景是固定不动的，但它仍包含基本的自然移动。例如，风吹过一张幻象纸片时，会使其沙沙作响。一个程序最长可达1分钟，并会在结束后重复。例如，你可以创造出两个兽人彼此打斗的场景，而每次重复时，这场打斗都会以相同方式进行。如果你创造一个循环，那么两名战士会在场景开始时和结束时处于同一位置，但你可以将程序衔接得很平滑，使人难以察觉循环是在何时结束、何时开始。任何人若观察该场景超过几分钟，几乎总会注意到它正在循环。你无法在创造出该幻象后再改变这套程序。

任何接触图像任意部分的生物，或使用搜索动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。如果他们与幻象的某一部分交互，他们只会识破那一部分。只有在大成功时，他们才会识破整个场景。

高阶化（6环） 你场景中的生物或物体可以说话。你必须在创建程序时为每个角色说出其具体台词。该法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

高阶化（8环） 如同6环版本，且持续时间为无限。

You form an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} spell.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

Lightning Storm.name: 闪电风暴 Lightning Storm
Lightning Storm.description:
你创造出一团漆黑、隆隆作响的风暴云，并在该法术的区域内召下一道闪电束。闪电束是一条从风暴云顶部垂直劈向下方地面的线，对线内的生物造成4d12点电击伤害（基础反射豁免）。在后续轮中，每轮你第一次维持该法术时，都可以在该区域内再召下一道闪电束。如果你在户外施放该法术，则可以创造两团彼此不重叠的云，而非一团，不过你每回合仍然只能召下一道闪电束。

高阶化（+2） 每道闪电束的伤害增加1d12。

You create a black, rumbling storm cloud and call down one lightning bolt within the spell's area. The bolt is a vertical line from the top of the storm cloud to the ground below, dealing 4d12 electricity damage to creatures in the line (basic Reflex save). On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can call another lightning bolt within the area. If you Cast this Spell outdoors, you can create two non-overlapping clouds instead of one, though you can still call down only one bolt per turn.

Heightened (+2) The damage of each bolt increases by 1d12.

Mariner's Curse.name: 水手的诅咒 Mariner's Curse
Mariner's Curse.description:
你以翻涌而冷酷无情的大海之诅咒加诸于目标。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。将其恶心状态降至0时，此诅咒结束。

失败 目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}，且只要该诅咒仍在，就无法将其恶心状态降到1以下。该诅咒可以通过移除诅咒或类似魔法解除。每当目标处于恶心状态且位于水上并距离岸边至少1英里时，它也会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

大失败 如失败，但目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

You afflict the target with the curse of the roiling, unforgiving sea. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Reducing its Sickened condition to 0 ends the curse.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and can't reduce its Sickened condition below 1 while the curse remains. The curse can be lifted by remove curse or similar magic. Whenever the target is Sickened and on the water at least a mile from shore, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Prying Eye.name: 窥视之眼 Prying Eye
Prying Eye.description:
你在自己于 500 尺内可见的位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}、漂浮的眼睛，其直径为 1 英寸。它以你通常的视觉感官向所有方向视物，并持续将它所见之物传递给你。每轮你第一次维持该法术时，你可以选择将这只眼睛移动至多 30 尺，此时只能看见眼睛前方的事物；或者将它移动至多 10 尺，此时可以看见其周围所有方向的一切。眼睛能离你多远都没有限制，但如果你与这只眼睛不再位于同一存在位面上，法术会立即结束。如果你想通过这只眼睛进行察觉检定，你可以尝试使用搜索动作。对这只眼睛造成的任何伤害都会摧毁它并结束该法术。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, floating eye, 1 inch in diameter, at a location you can see within 500 feet. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses and continuously transmits what it sees to you. The first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can either move the eye up to 30 feet, seeing only things in front of the eye, or move it up to 10 feet, seeing everything in all directions around it. There is no limit to how far from you the eye can move, but the spell ends immediately if you and the eye ever cease to be on the same plane of existence. You can attempt Seek actions through the eye if you want to attempt Perception checks with it. Any damage dealt to the eye destroys it and ends the spell.

Clairvoyance.name: 千里眼 Clairvoyance
Clairvoyance.description:
你在射程内的一个位置创造出一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的漂浮之眼（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外也可以）。这只眼睛不能移动，但你可以如同使用你正常的视觉感官一样，从该点向所有方向看见。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

Hydraulic Torrent.name: 水流爆发 Hydraulic Torrent
Hydraulic Torrent.description:
一股旋转奔涌的激流沿直线显现，猛击其路径上的生物和无人看管的物体，并可能将其向远离你的方向推开。激流造成 8d6 钝击伤害。区域内的每个生物都必须尝试一次基础强韧豁免；无人看管的物体自动失败。豁免失败的生物和物体还会被击退 5 尺（大失败时为 10 尺）。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

A swirling torrent of water manifests along a straight line, battering creatures and unattended objects in its path and possibly pushing them away from you. The torrent deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Fortitude save; unattended objects automatically fail. Creatures and objects that fail are also knocked back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical failure).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一种生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。这个法术调用的是肉体中潜藏的记忆，而不是将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大体完整，此法术才能生效。尸体受到的伤害越多，它的回答就越不准确、越支离破碎，而且它必须有喉咙和嘴才能说话。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过这个法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用其死亡时原本生物的数据进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，并且目标的精魂会对你作祟24小时，骚扰你并使你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的回答可能简短、晦涩且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延时间，以使法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题前结束。

大失败 如同失败，但目标的回答会更直接、较少重复，不过仍然晦涩。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或误导你时承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Clairaudience.name: 千里耳闻 Clairaudience
Clairaudience.description:
你在射程内的一处位置创造出一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的漂浮耳朵（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外也可以）。它无法移动，但你可以通过这只耳朵听见，仿佛在使用你正常的听觉感官。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

Dream Message.name: 托梦术 Dream Message
Dream Message.description:
你将一则讯息送入你的目标的梦境中。该讯息为单向，最多可包含1分钟的讲话内容（约150个词）。如果目标已入睡，他们会立刻收到这则讯息。如果没有，他们会在下一次入睡时收到。一旦他们收到，法术便结束，而你会知道这则讯息已被送达。

升阶（4环） 你可以以至多10个你知道名字且曾亲自见过的生物为目标。你必须向他们所有人发送相同的讯息；该法术会对每个生物分别结束。

You send a message to your target's dream. The message is one-way, up to 1 minute of speech (roughly 150 words). If the target is asleep, they receive the message instantly. If not, they receive it the next time they sleep. As soon as they receive it, the spell ends, and you know the message was sent.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures you know by name and have met in person. You must send the same message to all of them; the spell ends for each creature individually.

Lightning Bolt.name: 闪电束 Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
一道闪电从你的手中向外劈出，造成 4d12 点电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing 4d12 electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Wall of Wind.name: 风墙 Wall of Wind
Wall of Wind.description:
你创造出一道由阵阵狂风构成的屏障，阻碍任何穿过它的事物。由盘旋之风形成的风墙厚5尺、长60尺、高30尺。风墙垂直竖立，但你可以塑造其路径。尽管风墙会扭曲空气，它并不会妨碍视线。风墙具有以下效果。

  • 物理远程攻击的弹药——例如箭矢、弩矢、投石索弹丸，以及其他体型相近的物体——无法穿过风墙。更大的远程武器攻击，如标枪，若其路径穿过风墙，则其攻击掷骰承受-2环境减值。巨型远程武器以及不会制造物理物体的法术效果穿过风墙时不会受到减值。
  • 对于试图经地面穿过风墙而移动的生物而言，风墙属于困难地形。气体，包括处于气态形态的生物，无法穿过风墙。
  • 生物若试图以一个移动动作飞行穿过风墙，则必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物本回合可以正常穿过风墙移动。

成功 该飞行生物本回合可以穿过风墙移动，但风墙视为困难地形。

失败 风墙会阻止该飞行生物的移动，且其当前动作剩余的任何移动都会被浪费。

大失败 如失败，且该生物被推离风墙10尺。

You create a barrier of gusting winds that hinders anything moving through it. The wall of swirling winds is 5 feet thick, 60 feet long, and 30 feet high. The wall stands vertically, but you can shape its path. Though the wall of wind distorts the air, it does not hamper sight. The wall has the following effects.

  • Ammunition from physical ranged attacks-such as arrows, bolts, sling bullets, and other objects of similar size-can't pass through the wall. Attacks with bigger ranged weapons, such as javelins, take a -2 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through the wall. Massive ranged weapons and spell effects that don't create physical objects pass through the wall with no penalty.
  • The wall is difficult terrain to creatures attempting to move overland through it. Gases, including creatures in gaseous form, can't pass through the wall.
  • A creature that attempts to fly through the wall using a move action must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature can move through the wall normally this turn.

Success The flying creature can move through the wall this turn, but the wall is difficult terrain.

Failure The wall stops the movement of the flying creature, and any remaining movement from its current action is wasted.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is pushed 10 feet away from the wall.

Augury.name: 占卜 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放这个法术期间，询问某个特定行动方案的结果。该法术可以预测未来30分钟内的结果，并揭示游戏主持对以下结果中最可能情况的最佳判断：

  • 吉兆 结果会是好的。
  • 凶兆 结果会是坏的。
  • 吉兆与凶兆 结果会是好坏参半。
  • 无事 不会有特别好或坏的结果。

游戏主持进行一次秘密的@Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]检定。在一次失败时，结果总是“无事”。这使得人们无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。如果任何人在额外一次施放占卜时询问与第一次施放占卜相同的话题，游戏主持使用第一次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes:

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results.

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Obscuring Mist.name: 朦胧迷雾 Obscuring Mist
Obscuring Mist.description:
你召来一团迷雾。迷雾内的所有生物都变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，而迷雾外的所有生物对于其中的生物而言也变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。你可以解散这团云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Charm.name: 魅惑术 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语如蜜般甜美，你的面容仿佛笼罩在梦幻般的薄雾中。它必须进行一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友最近曾威胁过它，或对它使用过敌对动作，则此次豁免获得+4环境加值。

你可以撤销该法术。如果你对目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。当法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己曾被魅惑，除非它与你之间的友谊，或你说服它采取的动作，与它的预期相冲突；这意味着你可能可以通过普通手段说服目标继续把你当作朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你曾试图魅惑它。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非魅惑术，除非它辨识出了该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果它原本就是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于助人}。它不能对你使用敌对动作。

大失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，且它不能对你使用敌对动作。

升环（4环） 持续时间持续至你下一次进行每日准备时。

升环（8环） 持续时间持续至你下一次进行每日准备时，且你至多可以指定10个生物作为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Gust of Wind (At Will).name: 风阵（随意）
Gust of Wind (At Will).description:
一阵猛烈的风从你的手掌中喷涌而出，从你施放法术时所在的位置吹向这条线段的另一端。风会熄灭小型非魔法火焰，驱散雾气与薄雾，吹动负载为光或更轻的物体，并推动更大的物体。区域内的大型或更小的生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。之后移动进入这阵狂风中的大型或更小的生物，在进入时也必须尝试该豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物无法逆风移动。

失败 该生物被击倒为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。如果它当时正在飞行，则改为承受大失败的效果。

大失败 该生物被朝风吹拂的方向推离30尺，倒地，并受到2d6点钝击伤害。

A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you cast the spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind.

Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it was flying, it suffers the effects of critical failure instead.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked Prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你制造出一个幻象，让你看起来像是另一名与你具有相同身体形态，且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近的生物。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以乔装成某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物和穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件裙子。手持物品不受影响，而你移除的任何穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{乔装} 这一欺瞒用途做好伪装准备；它会忽略你因将自己伪装成不同类生物而可能承受的任何环境减值，为你提供+4状态加值于欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装，并且即使你未受训，你也可以加上你的等级。你可以撤销该法术。

升环（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音和气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉特征。

升环（3环） 你可以看起来像任何与你体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过某个个体，才能呈现其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音和气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Coven.name: 密会 Coven
Coven.description:
一名风暴鬼婆将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Y3G6Y6EDgCY0s3fq]{水流爆发}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JyT346VmGtRLsDnV]{闪电风暴} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.z2mfh3oPnfYqXflY]{水手的诅咒} 添加到其密会的法术中。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Coven]

A storm hag adds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Y3G6Y6EDgCY0s3fq]{Hydraulic Torrent}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JyT346VmGtRLsDnV]{Lightning Storm}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.z2mfh3oPnfYqXflY]{Mariner's Curse} to her coven's spells.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Coven]

Stormsight.name: 风暴视界 Stormsight
Stormsight.description:
风、降水和云层不会妨碍风暴鬼婆的视觉；她忽略由风暴、薄雾、降水等造成的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽（状态）} 状态。

Wind, precipitation, and clouds don't impair a storm hag's vision; she ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from storms, mist, precipitation, and the like.

Voice of the Storm.name: 风暴之声 Voice of the Storm
Voice of the Storm.description:
风暴鬼婆可以借由风将口头信息或声音传送到任何她见过且风能够到达的地点，半径为50英里。她可以送出轻柔的低语或高声的尖叫，并决定让其清晰可闻，或仅在风声中勉强可辨。无论那里是否有人在场听见，这则信息都会被送达。鬼婆可以用这个能力，以可怕的威胁或令人不安的末日低语，对听见她信息的生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{挫败士气}。

A storm hag can send spoken messages or sounds on the wind to any spot that she has seen and the wind can reach within a 50-mile radius. She can send a quiet whisper or a loud scream, and decides whether it's clearly audible or barely heard above the wind. The message is delivered regardless of whether anyone is present to hear it. The hag can use this ability to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} creatures that hear her message with dire threats or unnerving whispers of doom.

Sickened by Incense.name: 被熏香熏得恶心 Sickened by Incense
Sickened by Incense.description:
如果尤伽喀在其回合开始时邻接已点燃的香，她会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}，并且必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:27] 豁免；若失败，她改为因这香而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心3}。如果她在其回合结束时邻接已点燃的香，她会因其引发的恶心而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到其下个回合结束。

If Iogaka begins her turn adjacent to lit incense, she becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save; on a failure, she instead becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} by the incense. If she ends her turn adjacent to lit incense, she becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of her next turn by the nausea it causes her.

Stormcalling.name: 唤暴 Stormcalling
Stormcalling.description:
风暴鬼婆可以施展一种特殊的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XkDCzMIyc0YOjw05]{控制天气} 仪式，此仪式不需要次级施法者，即可改变其所在位置5英里范围内的天气，持续[[/r 4d12 #Duration Stormcalling]]{4d12小时}。主检定是一次 @Check[occultism|dc:23] 检定，且她的结果不会比失败更差。

风暴鬼婆只能制造飓风、雷暴和龙卷风，但无论当前季节如何，她都可以如此行事。她也可以平息自然天气现象，但绝不会主动这么做。

A storm hag can perform a special @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XkDCzMIyc0YOjw05]{Control Weather} ritual, which requires no secondary casters, to change the weather within 5 miles of her location for [[/r 4d12 #Duration Stormcalling]]{4d12 hours}. The primary check is a @Check[occultism|dc:23] check, and she can't get an outcome worse than a failure.

The storm hag can create only hurricanes, thunderstorms, and tornadoes, but she can do so regardless of the current season. She can also quell natural weather events but never willingly does so.

Wind Mastery.name: 御风精通 Wind Mastery
Wind Mastery.description:
风暴鬼婆不受强风影响，无论其是自然形成还是魔法造成。对她而言，多风环境不构成困难地形。

A storm hag is unaffected by strong winds, natural or magical. Windy conditions are not difficult terrain for her.

Iogaka.publicNotes:
风暴鬼婆是风暴狂暴的化身。这些老巫婆憎恨那些在风呼号、雨鞭笞大地与海洋时，与所爱之人蜷缩在温暖干燥庇护所中的人。风暴鬼婆会运用自己的力量，在她们常居的海岸洞穴或陋屋附近的社区制造浩劫。

这些鬼婆会让自己的声音乘风传播，在降临到凡人头上之前先恐吓他们，随后再以爪击与邪恶魔法扑向猎物。比起同类中的任何其他鬼婆，她们更会猎食年轻人；她们吞食孩童，不仅因为这会给孩子的父母与照料者带来痛苦，也因为鬼婆热爱幼嫩的血肉。

风暴鬼婆的领地有时会与海鬼婆和冬季鬼婆的领地重叠。虽然这可能会形成一个统治她们联合领地的密会，但更多时候会引发敌对。这种争斗只会加深夹在敌对鬼婆纷争之间的无辜者的苦难。

鬼婆是污秽的生物，外表如同衰老干瘪的老妇人，与她们所恐吓的人形生物几乎没有共同之处。她们是充满憎恨的存在，最大的快乐在于腐化并最终毁灭一切美好而高尚的事物。创造出第一批鬼婆的力量已湮没于年代之中，但无数种鬼婆已在漫长年代中出现，每一种都拥有各自传播痛苦与苦难的力量和能力。

Storm hags are the personification of a storm's rage. These crones hate those who huddle together with loved ones in warm, dry shelters while the wind howls and rain lashes the land and sea. Storm hags use their powers to wreak havoc on communities near the coastal caves or hovels where they often live.

These hags send their voices on the wind to terrorize mortals before descending upon them with claws and fell magic. More than any others of their kind, they prey on the young, devouring children as much for the pain it causes their parents and caretakers as for the hags' love of young flesh.

A storm hag's territory sometimes overlaps with that of sea hags and winter hags. While this may result in the formation of a coven that controls their combined territories, more often it leads to rivalries. Such feuds only increase the misery of innocent people caught between the rival hags' feuding.

Foul creatures who appear as wizened old women, hags share little in common with the humanoids they terrorize. They are hateful entities whose greatest joy lies in the corruption and ultimate destruction of anything good and virtuous. Whatever power created the first hags is lost to time, but numerous hag varieties have arisen over the ages, each with their own powers and abilities to spread pain and suffering.
Iogaka.blurb:
女性风暴鬼婆变体
Variant female storm hag

Sojiruh.name: 索闹 Sojiruh

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Shatter.name: 粉碎音波 Shatter
Shatter.description:
高频音波攻击会粉碎附近的一个物体。你对该物体造成 2d10 点音波伤害；若该物体的硬度为 4 或更低，则忽略其硬度。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10，且该法术所忽略的硬度提高 2。

A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

Sound Burst.name: 音爆术 Sound Burst
Sound Burst.description:
刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到正常伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，持续 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入耳聋，持续 1 分钟，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑} 1轮。

升环（3环） 你最多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出由简单声音组成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类同时正常呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你不能制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来都像是处于好得多或差得多的物理状态。施放此法术时，决定你要让该物体看起来破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装得破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。被伪装得更好的完好物品会显得仿佛崭新出厂，并且高度抛光或保养良好。破损物品会显得完好且功能正常。被摧毁的物品无法受到该法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破该幻觉。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、松散且无人持用、负载为1或更少的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——视你掷出的物体而定——等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成正常伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被索闹杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为亡灵。索闹会自动尝试反制任何对其所杀死生物施放的复活术或将其转化为亡灵的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+11 #Counteract]]{+11}，反制阶级 2）。如果杀死该生物的索闹本身被杀死，则该生物可以如常从死亡中被带回，或正常变为亡灵。

Creatures killed by a sojiruh are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The sojiruh automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+11 #Counteract]]{+11}, counteract rank 2). If the sojiruh who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Armor.name: 具现护甲 Manifest Armor
Manifest Armor.description:
索闹在其身体上显现出一层护甲，看起来由交错嵌合的骨骼与柳条编织而成，使其 AC 提升至 21。该护甲是永久性的，但如果索闹受到一次造成钝击、力场或挥砍伤害的打击重击，则这层护甲会坍塌并消失，使其 AC 降回 17。

The sojiruh manifests a layer of armor on its body that appears to be made of interlocking bones and wicker weaves, increasing its AC to 21. The armor is permanent but collapses and vanishes if the sojiruh takes a critical hit from a Strike that inflicts bludgeoning, force, or slashing damage, reducing its AC back to 17.

Ruin Wielder.name: 持骸者 Ruin Wielder
Ruin Wielder.description:
当索闹持用一把破损的非魔法武器时，他们不会承受该武器处于破损状态的任何劣势。只要索闹持用它，该武器就会变为一把+1武器，并且在成功命中时额外造成1d6心灵伤害。

When a sojiruh wields a broken non-magical weapon, they do not take any of the disadvantages of the weapon being broken. While the sojiruh wields it, the weapon becomes a +1 weapon that deals an additional 1d6 mental damage on a successful hit.

Stolen Scream.name: 窃取尖叫 Stolen Scream
Stolen Scream.description:
索闹以其30尺内一个它能看见的生物为目标，然后吸气，发出与该目标尖叫声完全相同的声音。被指定为目标的生物必须进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:21]强韧豁免，之后它会在24小时内暂时免疫该索闹的灵魂尖叫。若该生物因窃取尖叫而陷入惊惧，且它曾有过前世，则索闹恢复@Damage[(2d8+8)[healing]]生命值。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到@Damage[2d6[mental]]伤害。

失败 该生物受到@Damage[4d6[mental]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

大失败 该生物受到@Damage[8d6[mental]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}。

The sojiruh targets a creature within 30 feet that it can see and then inhales, creating a sound identical to that of the target's scream. The targeted creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save, after which they're temporarily immune to that sojiruh's Soul Scream for 24 hours. If the creature becomes frightened as a result of Stolen Scream and has had a past life, the sojiruh restores @Damage[(2d8+8)[healing]] Hit Points.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Sojiruh.publicNotes:
当一个生物为了追求开悟而奉献了多次生命，却在死前背弃这些目标，并刻意将自己从转世轮回中撕离出来时，索闹便会诞生。这样的怪物是最常见的宁多鲁，同时也是善解的信徒最为憎恨的一类，因为这些邪魔中有许多正是源自这一哲学中堕落的成员。

这种宁多鲁迷恋反复转生之灵魂的滋味，并认为这种生命力在肉体仍活着并尖叫时被吞食，味道才最为鲜美。对索闹而言，它所进食之躯体发出的完美尖叫声，就如同晚餐时与佳肴完美搭配的美酒。

索闹的嘴巴被它自己的头发一缕缕缝死。尽管如此，它们依然可以自由说话，空洞回响般的声音会清晰地从封死的嘴唇后传出。只有当它们选择发出尖啸与惨叫时，才会拉伸这些缝线。它们的手臂又长又仿佛断裂，而它们的胸腔几乎只剩下一副肋骨笼，里面塞满了鲜红湿漉的蝴蝶，这些蝴蝶在其肋骨与器官间爬行、攀附。当索闹尖叫时，它胸腔中那些蝴蝶的翅膀便会疯狂振动。

索闹象征着纯净的转世轮回被解体后，陷入腐朽与堕落的状态。

当一个已多次转生的邪恶凡人灵魂被强行从灵魂轮回中扯离并遭到腐化时，它便可能经历可怖的转变，化作被称为宁多鲁的邪魔。作为熵增与循环破坏的力量，宁多鲁是丑恶可憎的生物，其身体常显得扭曲变形，挥舞着虽然已经破碎却仍能使用的武器，而且其真正的面容往往隐藏不见。它们呈现出人们可能会在不死生物身上看到的特征，例如腐烂的血肉或裸露的骨骼，然而宁多鲁却确实依然活着。

每一名宁多鲁都体现着某一种特定循环的破裂，无论那是自然世界中的循环，还是社会传统中的循环。对于宁多鲁而言，没有什么比吞食一个多次转生过的生物更加美味，而那些理论上即将升至真正开悟的存在，更是最可口的盛宴。被宁多鲁杀死者自身也会被从轮回中撕离——幸运者会前往骨园接受审判，但许多则会被腐化，进而化作更多这种可怖的邪魔。

善解的信徒认为宁多鲁尤其令人憎恶，并将其视作最可怕的威胁之一。宁多鲁最常出现在世上转世轮回最为强盛的地区，并且与罗刹和恶鬼类似，它们与物质位面的关联最为紧密。

转世的灵魂

在某些情况下，你会知道被宁多鲁攻击的生物是否拥有转世的灵魂。像轮回裔这样的族裔永远都是转世的灵魂，而玩家角色的背景故事，甚至其背景，也常常可以表明其曾有前世。《肆季鬼志》中的所有玩家角色都符合转世的灵魂，因为他们在数十年间一再重历自己的人生。如果你需要为了裁定宁多鲁的能力而判断一个生物的灵魂是否是转世的，那么进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]——若成功，则它拥有转世的灵魂。

灵堕魔半神

最强大的宁多鲁是半神，尽管崇拜它们的教团相当罕见。它们在死后容易再次转生，像苦迦菩提这样的宁多鲁半神，更准确地说应被称为“灵堕魔苦行者”。

灵堕魔叛徒

尽管大多数宁多鲁在本性上都是纯粹的混乱邪恶，但传说中也有极其罕见的宁多鲁能够挣脱自身本性并获得升华，在死亡后转生为神使或其他更为仁善的精魂，并在此过程中摆脱仁灯如特征。当然，这些“叛徒”会被其他留下来的宁多鲁视为最美味不过的猎物。

灵堕魔蝴蝶

各种不同类型的宁多鲁所共有的最奇异特征之一，便是那些似乎会追随着它们、栖居在它们身体上，或周期性地从其伤口中浮现的血红色蝴蝶。这些令人不安的昆虫，是宁多鲁思想的显现，并象征着它们曾经历却又背弃的无数前世。灵堕魔蝴蝶一旦飞离源头超过几尺，便不会维持太久，而会消散成烟雾，迅速逸散于空气中。

其他灵堕魔

除了这些页面中介绍的四种外，还存在许多其他类型的宁多鲁。其他种类包括会复制尸体的阿卡什提斯（啜泣灵堕魔）、社会的渗透者影隐熊（潜伏灵堕魔）、亵渎死者的尸萨吉辛（歪曲灵堕魔），以及强大而残暴的阿耳癸耳宙斯（无头灵堕魔）。

A sojiruh comes into existence when a creature who has dedicated multiple lives to achieving enlightenment turns their back on these goals and deliberately tears themselves away from the cycle of reincarnation before their death. These monstrous creatures are the most common nindoru and are also the most hated by followers of Sangpotshi, since so many of these fiends rise from fallen members of that very philosophy.

This type of nindoru relishes the flavor of an oft-reincarnated soul and finds this life force tastes best when consumed while the physical body still lives and screams. To sojiruhs, the sound of a perfect scream from the body it feeds upon is akin to the perfect wine pairing with dinner.

A sojiruh's mouth is stitched shut with lengths of its own hair. Despite this, they can speak freely, their hollow-sounding voices issuing clearly from sealed lips. They only stretch these stitches when they choose to shriek and scream. Their arms are long and broken-looking, while their chests are little more than rib cages filled with red wet butterflies that crawl through and cling to the creature's ribs and organs. When a sojiruh screams, the wings of the butterflies in its chest flutter frantically.

Sojiruhs symbolize the cycle of reincarnation come undone from its purity and becoming mired in decay and corruption.

When an evil mortal soul that has been reincarnated multiple times is wrenched from the cycle of souls and corrupted, it can undergo a horrific transformation into a fiend known as a nindoru. A force for entropy and the breaking of cycles, nindorus are hideous creatures whose bodies often appear distorted, who wield weapons that have been shattered yet still function, and whose true face is often hidden from view. They display traits one might expect to see in an undead creature, such as decaying flesh or exposed bones, yet a nindoru is very much still alive.

Each nindoru epitomizes the fracture of a specific cycle, be it one from the natural world or from societal traditions. To the nindoru, nothing is more delicious than the consumption of a creature who has reincarnated multiple times, with those who are theoretically about to ascend to true enlightenment presenting the tastiest meal. Those slain by a nindoru are themselves torn from the cycle—the lucky ones move on to the Boneyard for judgment, but many are instead corrupted to form more of these horrific fiends.

Followers of Sangpotshi find nindoru to be particularly abhorrent and count them among the greatest threats imaginable. Most commonly found in regions of the world where the reincarnation cycle is strongest, nindorus are, like rakshasas and oni, associated most strongly with the Material Plane.

Reincarnated Souls

In some cases, you'll know if a creature a nindoru attacks has a reincarnated soul. Ancestries like samsarans are always reincarnated souls, and a PC's backstory or even their background can often indicate the presence of a previous life. All of the PCs in Season of Ghosts qualify as reincarnated souls, as they've relived their lives over and over for decades. If you ever need to determine if a creature's soul is reincarnated for the purpose of adjudicating a nindoru's ability, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]—on a success, it has a reincarnated soul.

Nindoru Demigods

The most powerful nindorus are demigods, although their cults are quite rare. Prone to reincarnation after death, nindoru demigods like Kugaptee are more properly known as "nindoru ascetics."

Nindoru Traitors

While most nindorus are purely chaotic evil in nature, legends tell of exceptionally rare nindorus who manage to escape their own nature and ascend, reincarnating after death into kami or other more benevolent spirits and shedding the nindoru trait as they do so. Of course, these "traitors" are regarded as the most delicious meals imaginable by the nindorus left behind.

Nindoru Butterflies

One of the strangest shared traits of the various types of nindoru are the blood-red butterflies that seem to follow them around, nest on their bodies, or periodically emerge from their wounds. These unnerving insects are physical manifestations of the nindorus' thoughts and symbolize the countless past lives they once lived but turned their backs on. Nindoru butterflies never last long once they flutter more than a few feet from their source, fading away into smoke that quickly dissipates into the air.

Other Nindorus

Many other types of nindorus exist beyond the four presented on these pages. Others include the corpse-copying akashtis (sobbing nindorus), infiltrators of society known as kagekumas (lurking nindorus), the dead defiling shisagishins (crooked nindorus), and the powerful and brutal argyrzeis (headless nindorus).

Ghost Touch.name: 幽冥 Ghost Touch
Ghost Touch.description:
刻蚀了此符文的武器可以伤害没有实体形态的生物。幽冥武器对虚体生物尤为有效，而这类生物几乎总是对幽冥武器具有特定的弱点。

虚体生物可以接触、持握并挥舞幽冥武器（这与大多数实体物体不同）。

A weapon etched with this rune can harm creatures without physical form. A ghost touch weapon is particularly effective against incorporeal creatures, which almost always have a specific vulnerability to ghost touch weapons.

Incorporeal creatures can touch, hold, and wield ghost touch weapons (unlike most physical objects).

Unwelcoming Facade.name: 冷漠外表 Unwelcoming Facade

Horrifying Vision.name: 骇人幻景 Horrifying Vision
Horrifying Vision.description:
触发 一个小型或更大的生物接近到房屋外部30英尺内

效果 一股恶意充斥着宅邸外60英尺内所有活体生物的心智，带来压倒性的恐惧；每个生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:29] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并对骇人幻景获得24小时的临时免疫。除了此临时免疫外，该生物还可以用一个自由动作尝试一次 @Check[occultism|dc:23] 或 @Check[religion|dc:23] 检定，以注意到尽管立面上只有一张脸，但似乎有数个灵性回响灌注在这栋建筑中。若大成功，该生物会意识到，只有灌注这座宅邸的最强大力量是邪恶的，而其他部分则是非敌对的精魂，被那股单一力量压倒并困住。

成功 该生物会短暂看见宅邸立面扭曲成一张巨大而可怖的面孔的幻景，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。该生物可以如上尝试同样的神秘学或宗教检定，但难度等级提高到33。@Check[occultism|dc:33] @Check[religion|dc:33]

失败 如成功所述，但该生物改为陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}，并在其仍处于惊惧时处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。该生物可以正常尝试神秘学或宗教检定来回忆知识（DC 33）。

大失败 如失败所述，但该生物的惊惧状态在1分钟内无法降至1以下。此外，压倒性的恐惧使该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}；该状态会持续，直到以魔法治愈或该危害被解除。

Trigger A Small or larger creature approaches within 30 feet of the house's exterior

Effect A wave of malice fills the minds of all living creatures outside of the manor within 60 feet with overwhelming fear; each creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Horrifying Vision for 24 hours. In addition to this temporary immunity, the creature can attempt a @Check[occultism|dc:23] or @Check[religion|dc:23] check as a free action to notice that despite there being only one face in the facade, several spiritual echoes seem to infuse the building. On a critical success, the creature realizes that only the most powerful force infusing the manor is evil and that the other elements are non-hostile spirits who are overwhelmed and trapped by that singular force.

Success The creature experiences a brief vision of the manor's facade twisting into an immense, horrific face and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. The creature can attempt the same Occultism or Religion check as above, but the DC increases to 33. @Check[occultism|dc:33] @Check[religion|dc:33]

Failure As failure, but the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it remains frightened. The creature can attempt the Occultism or Religion check to Recall Knowledge normally (DC 33).

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 for 1 minute. In addition, the overwhelming fear causes the creature to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}; this condition persists until it's cured magically or the hazard is disabled.

Unwelcoming Facade.disable:
@Check[occultism|dc:32] 或 @Check[religion|dc:32] 以驱除该作祟，@Check[society|dc:35] 以恰当地接近庄园，表示对其住户在社群中的象征性地位的尊重；出示合法授予进入建筑许可的官方通行证可使这两个难度等级均降低 5（前提是 PCs 从正门接近，而非从其他方向）。

@Check[occultism|dc:27] @Check[religion|dc:27] @Check[society|dc:30]

@Check[occultism|dc:32] or @Check[religion|dc:32] to exorcise the haunt, @Check[society|dc:35] to approach the manor in a proper way that defers to its occupant's symbolic standing in the community; displaying an official pass that legally grants permission to enter the building reduces both of these DCs by 5 (provided the PCs approach the front door and not from another direction).

@Check[occultism|dc:27] @Check[religion|dc:27] @Check[society|dc:30]
Unwelcoming Facade.hazarddescription:
一股令人不安的恶意与邪恶能量从庄园中无形地扩散开来，使那些注视这座建筑的人看到建筑上浮现出一张狞笑的邪恶面孔，正从建筑的构造中怒视着他们。

An unsettling wave of malice and sinister energy ripples invisibly out from the manor, causing those who view the building to see a leering, evil face glaring at them from the structure's architecture.
Unwelcoming Facade.reset:
若未将冷漠外表停用，它会立即重置，并可在紧接着的下一轮再次被触发。

The unwelcoming facade resets immediately if not disabled and can be triggered again the very next round.

Lo Kuon.name: 罗阔恩 Lo Kuon

Glue Bomb (Moderate).name: 黏胶炸弹（中等）
Glue Bomb (Moderate).description:
启动 1 打击

黏胶炸弹是一种无害的爆炸装置，会爆开并喷溅出黏性物质。当你用黏胶炸弹击中一个生物时，该生物的速度在1分钟内承受–15尺的状态减值。你获得攻击掷骰的+1物品加值，且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{脱身} 的难度等级为 [[/act escape dc=19]]{19}。

若大成功，则一个接触坚固表面的生物会被黏在该表面上，并在1轮内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}；而一个通过翼进行飞行的生物，其翼会被缠住，导致其安全地坠落到地面，并在1轮内无法再次飞行。黏胶炸弹对处于水中的生物无效。

目标可以通过脱身，或总共花费3个交互动作小心移除这些黏性物质，以结束任何效果。这些交互动作不必连续进行，其他生物也可以提供这些动作。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.sgQknR94qDt5ILBx]{效果：黏胶炸弹}

Activate 1 Strike

A glue bomb is a harmless explosive mechanism bursting with sticky substances. When you hit a creature with a glue bomb, that creature takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC is [[/act escape dc=19]]{19}.

On a critical hit, a creature in contact with a solid surface becomes stuck to the surface and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round, and a creature flying via wings has its wings tangled, causing it to fall safely to the ground and become unable to Fly again for 1 round. Glue bombs are not effective when used on a creature that is in water.

The target can end any effects by Escaping or spending a total of 3 Interact actions to carefully remove the sticky substances. These Interact actions don't have to be consecutive, and other creatures can provide the actions as well.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.sgQknR94qDt5ILBx]{Effect: Glue Bomb}

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶钉皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这件皮甲用金属饰钉加固，有时还镶有小块金属板，在保留皮甲大部分灵活性的同时，提供更坚实的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Healing Potion (Lesser).name: 治疗药水（次级）
Healing Potion (Lesser).description:
启动 A (操作)

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时会感到一阵刺痛般的麻感。当你饮用治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] Hit Points.

Sling Bullets.name: 投石索弹丸 Sling Bullets
Sling Bullets.description:
这些是小金属球，通常由铁或铅制成，设计用于作为投石索的弹药。

These are small metal balls, typically either iron or lead, designed to be used as ammunition in slings.

Deny Advantage.name: 否决优势 Deny Advantage
Deny Advantage.description:
帮派头目对等级7或以下且处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}、夹击，或使用奇袭者的生物不会成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

The gang leader isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to creatures of 7th level or lower that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, flanking, or using surprise attack.

Evasive Reflexes.name: 闪避反射 Evasive Reflexes
Evasive Reflexes.description:
当帮派头目进行反射豁免且结果为成功时，他们改为获得大成功。

When the gang leader rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

Nimble Dodge.name: 灵巧闪避 Nimble Dodge
Nimble Dodge.description:
触发 帮派头目成为其能看见的攻击者发动的一次攻击的目标

效果 帮派头目对抗此次触发攻击的 AC 获得+2环境加值。

Trigger The gang leader is targeted with an attack by an attacker they can see

Effect The gang leader gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Surprise Attacker.name: 奇袭者 Surprise Attacker
Surprise Attacker.description:
在战斗的第一轮中，尚未行动的生物对帮派头目处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态。

On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the gang leader.

Brutal Rally.name: 残酷集结 Brutal Rally
Brutal Rally.description:
触发 帮派头目对一个生物造成大成功

效果 所有能够看见帮派头目的盟友在帮派头目下个回合开始前的攻击掷骰获得+1环境加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.7x0O2GqWBJiAk5PF]{效果：残酷集结}

Trigger The gang leader rolls a critical hit against a creature

Effect All allies that can see the gang leader gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls until the start of the gang leader's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.7x0O2GqWBJiAk5PF]{Effect: Brutal Rally}

Gang Up.name: 围攻 Gang Up
Gang Up.description:
只要敌人同时处于帮派头目及其一名盟友的近战触及内，该敌人因夹击而在面对帮派头目的近战攻击时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

Any enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the gang leader's melee attacks due to flanking as long as the enemy is within melee reach of both the gang leader and one of the gang leader's allies.

Quick Draw.name: 快速拔取 Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description:
帮派头目进行交互以拔出一把武器，然后用那把武器进行打击。

The gang leader Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
帮派头目对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 生物额外造成 2d6 精准伤害。

The gang leader deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Lo Kuon.publicNotes:
帮派头目指挥亡命徒、杀手、盗贼和打手。帮派头目通常会与一伙强盗帮派或其他罪犯一同出现。

恶棍追求自私而残忍的目标，践踏任何挡在他们道路上的人。

Gang leaders direct cutthroats, killers, thieves, and toughs. The gang leader often appears alongside a bandit gang or other criminals.

Villains pursue selfish and cruel goals, trampling over anyone in their way.
Lo Kuon.blurb:
男性人类帮派头目
Male human gang leader

Spiritual Disruptor.name: 灵性干扰器 Spiritual Disruptor

Manifest.name: 显现 Manifest
Manifest.description:
触发 PC进入这座建筑，或以其他方式与建筑及其内容进行交互

效果 两处标记为A4的位置各显现一个灵性干扰器。随后，这两个危害都掷先攻。

Trigger The PCs enter or otherwise interact with the building and its contents

Effect A spiritual disruptor manifests at both locations marked A4. Both hazards then roll initiative.

Spiritual Disruptor.disable:
@Check[intimidation|dc:23]（专家）以扰乱作祟在现世中的专注并打破与心景的联系，@Check[religion|dc:27]（专家）以将能量从心景中驱逐，或 @Check[occultism|dc:30]（专家）以使作祟的能量回过头来对抗其自身并将其抵消

@Check[intimidation|dc:23] (expert) to disrupt the haunt's concentration in the living world and break the link to the mindscape, @Check[religion|dc:27] (expert) to banish the energy from the mindscape, or @Check[occultism|dc:30] (expert) to turn the haunt's energy back against itself to cancel it out
Spiritual Disruptor.hazarddescription:
一个闪烁不定的人形身影，长着四只金色眼睛，身披红袍黑袖，手持一支燃烧着红色火焰与烟雾的火把，有目的地大步穿过地面，在周围制造出现实的扭曲，使木材弯折腐朽，并让血肉中传来痛苦难当的剧痛。

A flickering humanoid shape with four gold eyes, clad in red robes with black sleeves and wielding a torch that burns with red fire and smoke, strides purposefully across the ground, creating distortions in reality around it that cause wood to twist and decay and send agonizing pain through the flesh.
Spiritual Disruptor.reset:
如果这两个危害都被停用或摧毁，那么在[[/gmr 1d4+2 #Rounds]]轮后，会在仍位于这座正在坍塌的建筑内的一名随机角色邻接处形成一个新的危害。一旦全部三名非玩家角色都被救出或驱邪，这些危害就不会重置。

If both hazards are disabled or destroyed, a new one forms adjacent to a randomly determined character still inside the crumbling building after [[/gmr 1d4+2 #Rounds]] rounds. Once all three NPCs are rescued or exorcised, these hazards don't reset.
Spiritual Disruptor.routine:
（三动作）灵性干扰器每轮的第一个动作总是会在 @Template[emanation|distance:10] 中制造一阵起伏的能量脉冲，使周围的结构看起来迅速老化并发生扭曲，导致该区域内的地面变为困难地形。如果灵性干扰器邻接一个活着的目标，它会尝试用其冒烟的火把进行一次打击，以干扰该目标的生命能量。如果灵性干扰器没有邻接活着的目标，它会朝最近的目标移动。如果它有多个邻接目标，灵性干扰器会优先选择等级较高的目标；若有多个邻接且等级相同的目标，则随机选择其一。

(three actions) The spiritual disruptor's first action each round is always to create a pulse of rippling energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] that causes the surrounding structure to appear to age rapidly and become distorted, causing the ground in this area to become difficult terrain. If the spiritual disruptor is adjacent to a living target, it attempts to disrupt that target's life energy by making a Strike with its smoking torch. If the spiritual disruptor isn't adjacent to a living target, it Strides toward the closest target. If it has multiple adjacent targets, the spiritual disruptor favors higher-level targets, selecting randomly from multiple adjacent equal-level targets.

Familiar Shadow.name: 魔宠之影 Familiar Shadow

Light Vulnerability.name: 光弱点 Light Vulnerability
Light Vulnerability.description:
一个散发魔法光的物体（例如来自 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{光} 法术）在用于攻击该阴影时，被视为具有魔法性质。

An object shedding magical light (such as from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} spell) is treated as magical when used to attack the shadow.

Infest Shadow.name: 侵染暗影 Infest Shadow
Infest Shadow.description:
当魔宠之影拉出其所复制之玩家角色的影子时，那影子会先扭曲翻腾片刻，随后立刻重新滑回角色周围。被侵染的影子似乎会自行扭动翻转，仿佛刻意无视其所附着角色的动作。这个被侵染的影子惯于做出令人分心且尴尬的动作，并使其附着的玩家角色进行欺瞒、交涉和隐秘检定时承受–2状态减值。若玩家角色处于不会投下影子的环境中（例如处于完全黑暗中，或处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态时），这些减值会被压制，但其被侵染的影子一旦再次出现，这些减值也会立刻恢复。若带有被侵染影子的玩家角色获得濒死（状态），该影子会挣脱出来并变成一只暗影孳生体（其运作方式与由普通阴影创造出的暗影孳生体相同）。这只暗影孳生体不会攻击它所孳生自的生物，但其他目标都是它的猎物。若处于濒死（状态）的角色恢复了，其暗影孳生体会立刻死亡，而其影子也会恢复正常——否则，摆脱这种奇异诅咒的唯一方法，就是使用类似移除诅咒的法术。

When a familiar shadow pulls free the shadow of the PC that they duplicate, it twists and writhes for a moment before it immediately slithers back around the character. The infested shadow seems to writhe and twist on its own, as if willfully ignoring the actions of the character to whom it's attached. The infested shadow has a habit of making distracting and embarrassing motions, and imparts a –2 status penalty to its attached PC's Deception, Diplomacy, and Stealth checks. If the PC is in a situation where they aren't casting a shadow (such as when they're in complete darkness or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}), these penalties are suppressed, but return as soon as their infested shadow does. If a PC with an infested shadow gains the dying condition, the shadow breaks free and becomes a shadow spawn (which functions the same as a shadow spawn created by a typical shadow). This shadow spawn won't attack the creature it spawned from, but any other targets are fair game. If the dying character recovers, their shadow spawn immediately dies and their shadow returns to normal—otherwise the only way to be rid of this strange curse is through the use of a spell like remove curse.

Shadow Spawn.name: 暗影孳生体 Shadow Spawn
Shadow Spawn.description:
当一个生物的阴影被窃取阴影强行扯离时，它会变成一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{暗影孳生体}，并受创造它的阴影所命令。这个暗影孳生体不具有窃取阴影，并且会永久且无法治愈地处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}状态。若该暗影孳生体所源自的生物死亡，这个暗影孳生体就会变成一个完整且自主的阴影。若该生物从其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭}中恢复，它的阴影就会回归其身上，而该暗影孳生体则会消散。

When a creature's shadow is pulled free by Steal Shadow, it becomes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{Shadow Spawn} under the command of the shadow that created it. This shadow spawn doesn't have Steal Shadow and is perpetually and incurably @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. If the creature the shadow spawn was pulled from dies, the shadow spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous shadow. If the creature recovers from its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeeblement}, its shadow returns to it and the shadow spawn is extinguished.

Slink in Shadows.name: 潜入阴影之中 Slink in Shadows
Slink in Shadows.description:
阴影可以在一个生物或物体的阴影中@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏}，或在其中结束其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}。

The shadow can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or end its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} in a creature's or object's shadow.

Steal Shadow.name: 窃取阴影 Steal Shadow
Steal Shadow.description:
需求 阴影在其上一动作中以一次影手打击命中了一名活着的生物。

此能力仅对该阴影所显现复制的那名玩家角色生效。

效果 阴影拉扯目标的阴影，使该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。此状态可与来自阴影的其他力竭（状态）累加，最高至力竭4。若这使某生物的力竭值提高至3或更高，则目标的阴影会与其身体分离。由窃取阴影造成的力竭每小时减少1。

Requirements The shadow hit a living creature with a shadow hand Strike on its previous action.

This ability only functions against the PC who the shadow appears to duplicate.

Effect The shadow pulls at the target's shadow, making the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}. This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from shadows, to a maximum of enfeebled 4. If this increases a creature's enfeebled value to 3 or more, the target's shadow is separated from its body. Enfeebled from Steal Shadow decreases by 1 every hour.

Familiar Shadow.publicNotes:
被称为阴影的神秘不死生物潜伏在黑暗之地，并以那些偏离光太远者为食。那些与阴影谈判的人——通常是借助一把发光的武器将它们逼退——可能会得知重大的秘密，因为它们是理想的间谍。

The mysterious undead known as shadows lurk in dark places and feed on those who stray too far from the light. Those who parley with shadows, typically by keeping them at bay with a glowing weapon, may learn great secrets, for they are ideal spies.

Witherweird Runes.name: 枯萎诡符文 Witherweird Runes

Withering Wail.name: 枯萎哀嚎 Withering Wail
Withering Wail.description:
触发 赫山宝以外的某人打开了次要隔层

效果 一张呼啸的幽魂面孔从箱子中显现并发出尖啸，使C4区域内的所有生物都必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:33] 豁免；这声音也会惊动C3a和C6区域中的僵尸，它们会迅速前来调查声音来源。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[7d6[void]] 伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[15d6[void]] 伤害。此外，它们的血肉枯萎衰弱，变得苍老而憔悴——该生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到诅咒被移除。

大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[30d6[void]] 伤害，并如失败一样受到诅咒，但会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}。

Trigger Someone other than Heh Shan-Bao opens the secondary compartment

Effect A howling, spectral face manifests out of the chest and screeches, causing all within area C4 to attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save; the sound also alerts the jiang-shi in areas C3 a and C6, who quickly come to investigate the sound.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[7d6[void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[15d6[void]] damage. In addition, their flesh withers and weakens, leaving them to appear old and decrepit—the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the curse is removed.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[30d6[void]] damage and becomes cursed as failure, but becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Witherweird Runes.disable:
[[/act disable-device dc=37]] 来刮除这些符文并使其魔法无害地消散，@Check[arcana|dc:40] 来破坏该法术并使这些符文干枯后化为惰性粉末随风散去，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（第7环；反制 DC 31）来反制这些符文

[[/act disable-device dc=37]] to scratch out the runes and dissipate their magic harmlessly, @Check[arcana|dc:40] to sabotage the spell and cause the runes to dry up and blow away as inert powder, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the runes
Witherweird Runes.hazarddescription:
储存在以骨粉与女妖之泪绘成的符文中的死灵系魔法，会猛然袭向任何打开次要夹层且并非赫山宝的人。

Necromantic magic stored in runes painted in powdered bone and banshees' tears lash out at anyone other than Heh Shan-Bao who opens the secondary compartment.

Phantom Gecko.name: 魅影壁虎 Phantom Gecko

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你扰乱目标的思维，并以一次心灵冲击使其陷入眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升环（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你将恐惧植入目标心中；其必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑} 状态，持续 1 轮。

强化（3环） 你最多可以指定五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出一种简单声音的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常呼喊。声音从射程内你指定的一个方格中发出。你不能制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Walk the Ethereal Line.name: 游于两界 Walk the Ethereal Line
Walk the Ethereal Line.description:
魅影游走于以太位面与物质位面之间的细微界线之上，从而同时存在于两个位面。

它们可以通过再次使用此能力，转回仅存在于以太位面。

The phantom walks the thin line between the Ethereal and Material Planes in order to exist on both planes simultaneously.

They can shift back to solely the Ethereal Plane by using this ability again.

Susceptible to Death.name: 易于死亡 Susceptible to Death
Susceptible to Death.description:
尽管魅影并非活物，但它们也不是不死生物，而且会特别容易受到死亡效果的影响。

若魅影因死亡效果而使其生命值降至0（例如来自类似 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute} 的法术），便会立刻被送往灵魂之河，在那里它们的灵魂会重新踏上通往来世的正常道路。

Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they undead, and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death.

A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a death effect (such as from a spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute}) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

Phantom Gecko.publicNotes:
根据大多数神学家的说法，灵魂通往死后世界的普通轨迹相当直接。凡人死去时，其灵魂会进入灵魂之河，并最终抵达骨园，在那里接受法拉斯玛的审判。经审判后的灵魂会前往其最终安息的相应领域——天堂、地狱、阿巴顿等等——并在那里成为祈求者。

然而，当一个排队等待审判的灵魂过早脱离灵魂之河，并被转移到以太位面时，情况就会变得复杂。无论是由于鬼婆（特征）之类心怀恶意的闯入者、危险的位面魔法，还是甚至命运所致，这些灵魂都会脱离生死的自然秩序，滞留在某种炼狱般的状态之中。与祈求者不同，这些以太魅影保留着死前生活的记忆；而与幽灵这类精魂不同，魅影并未沾染不死生物那种污秽的影响——至少起初如此，尽管腐化的威胁始终沉重地笼罩着魅影的存在。有些最终屈从于那样的命运，另一些则最终重新回到灵魂之河。在那之前，这些游荡的灵魂自成一类——一种没有真正家园、目标或使命的存在。

许多魅影都不愿继续停留在这种奇异的炼狱状态中，要么是因为它们想继续自己穿越灵魂之河的旅程，要么是因为它们恐惧不死生物的腐化。为了完成自然的灵性循环并接受审判，从而得以前往死后世界，魅影只需要找到重返灵魂之河的方法。然而，这样的追寻绝非易事——以太位面朦胧的迷雾足以让最有经验的旅者也迷失方向，而且还有无数掠食者在这片领域中游荡，搜索那些离群的灵魂，以便将其束缚或吞噬。

The typical trajectory for souls passing to the afterlife is fairly straightforward, according to most theologians. When a mortal dies, their soul enters the River of Souls and eventually reaches the Boneyard, where it is judged by Pharasma. The judged soul moves onto its appropriate domain of final rest-Heaven, Hell, Abaddon, and so forth-where it becomes a petitioner.

Complications arise, however, when a soul in queue for judgment prematurely departs from the River of Souls and is shunted into the Ethereal Plane. Whether as a result of nefarious interlopers like night hags, malignant planar magic, or even fate, these souls become dislodged from the natural order of life and death and linger in a sort of purgatory. Unlike petitioners, these ethereal phantoms retain memories of their life before death, and unlike spirits such as ghosts, phantoms aren't tinged with the foul influences of undeath-at least, not at first, though the threat of corruption hangs heavy over a phantom's existence. Some eventually succumb to that fate, while others eventually rejoin the River of Souls. Until then, these wandering souls are a kind unto themselves-one without a true home, agenda, or purpose.

Many phantoms have no desire to remain in their strange state of purgatory, either because they seek to continue their journey through the River of Souls or because they fear the corruption of undeath. In order to complete the natural spiritual cycle and become judged so they can continue to the afterlife, a phantom must simply find a way back into the River of Souls. Such a quest is no easy feat, however-the hazy mists of the Ethereal Plane can befuddle even the most experienced traveler, and numerous predators prowl the realm in search of stray souls to bind or devour.

False Governor.name: 伪总督 False Governor

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 魅影灾祸 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
末日毁灭的幻象充满区域内每个生物的心智。该幻象造成11d6点精神伤害（基础意志豁免）。若大失败，该生物还必须在一次 @Check[reflex] 豁免中成功，否则它会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂缝中、漂流在海上，或遭遇与其幻象相符的其他命运）。如果它在第二次豁免中失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑（状态）}，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的意志豁免；若成功，它会识破该幻术，并从震慑（状态）中恢复。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a @Check[reflex] save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Wave of Despair.name: 绝望之波 Wave of Despair
Wave of Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作，并且必须在其回合开始时再次尝试一次豁免；若失败，则它会因无法控制地啜泣而在该回合中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

失败 如成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 如失败，且该生物自动减速1，持续1分钟。

升环（7环） 区域增大为60足锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Honeyed Words.name: 甜言蜜语 Honeyed Words
Honeyed Words.description:
谎言从你唇边滑出，如丝绸般顺畅。你在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{说谎}的欺瞒检定，以及对抗用于分辨你是否说真话的察觉检定时，获得+4状态加值，且即使未受训，你也可以加上你的等级。若你的谎言因显得不可信而导致环境减值或难度等级增加，则将该减值减半，或将该增加量减半。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.6vodhSeI3ClMfOGd]{法术效果：甜言蜜语}

Falsehoods pass your lips as smoothly as silk. You gain a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} and against Perception checks to discern if you are telling the truth, and you add your level even if untrained. If the implausibility of your lies prompts a circumstance penalty or a DC increase, reduce that penalty by half or increase it by half.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.6vodhSeI3ClMfOGd]{Spell Effect: Honeyed Words}

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一种生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。这个法术调用的是肉体身体中潜藏的记忆，而非将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大体完整，此法术才能生效。尸体所受的伤害越多，它的回答就越不准确、越像东拼西凑，而且它必须有喉咙和嘴巴才能说话。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过此法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用其死亡时代原本生物的属性进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，而且目标的精魂会在24小时内作祟于你，骚扰你并使你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的回答可以简短、隐晦且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延，使法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题前耗尽。

大失败 如失败，但目标的回答更直接、重复更少，但仍然隐晦。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或误导你时，承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function.
