The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Illusory Creature.name: 幻影生物 Illusory Creature
Illusory Creature.description:
你创造一个大型或更小生物的幻象影像。它会发出相应的声音、气味，并且在接触时也显得真实可信。如果你与该影像之间的距离超过500英尺，法术结束。

该影像不能说话，但你可以使用你的动作通过该生物说话，由法术将你的声音伪装成适当的样子。你可能需要尝试一次欺瞒或表演检定来模仿该生物，由游戏主持决定。如果你试图模仿某个特定人物，并与认识那个人的人互动时，尤其可能需要这样做。

在战斗中，这个幻象每回合可以使用2个动作，而这些动作是在你维持该法术时使用的。它的攻击掷骰使用你的法术攻击调整，它的AC使用你的法术DC。它的豁免调整值等于你的法术DC – 10。它足够实体化，因此可以与其他生物形成夹击。如果该影像被一次攻击命中或豁免失败，法术结束。

该幻象可以通过让目标相信其攻击是真实的来造成伤害，但除此之外，它不能直接影响物理世界。如果幻影生物以一次打击命中，目标受到@Damage[3d4[mental]]伤害。该幻象的打击为非致命。如果这伤害与怪物影像不相称——例如，一个幻象大型龙只造成5点伤害——游戏主持可以允许目标立刻尝试一次察觉检定来识破该法术。若目标认为相关抗力与弱点适用，则它们照常生效，由游戏主持裁定。例如，如果该幻象挥舞一把战锤并攻击一个对钝击伤害具有抗力的生物，那么该生物受到的心灵伤害会减少。然而，幻象伤害不会使再生失效，也不会触发其他要求特定伤害类型的效果。游戏主持应追踪该幻象造成的幻象伤害。

任何接触该影像的生物，或使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。当一个生物识破该幻象时，它恢复此前因该幻象所受伤害的一半（若有），并且此后不再受到它造成的伤害。

升阶（+1） 该影像打击的伤害增加1d4，且你能创造的生物最大体型提高一级（最大为超巨型）。

You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the spell. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[3d4[mental]] damage. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一次精神震荡使其恍惚。该震荡造成 1d6 精神伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四名普通人类同时呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状态好得多或差得多。施放该法术时，选择你想让该物体看起来是破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装成破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。完好的物品若被伪装得更好，会看起来仿佛崭新出厂，并且高度抛光或维护良好。破损物品会显得完好且可正常使用。已毁坏的物品无法受该法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破这个幻觉。

升环（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升环（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声默念话语，但这些话并不会从你口中说出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，就像你平常只是动嘴唇不出声那样；但目标听见你的话时，就仿佛站在你身边一样清晰。目标可以用一个反应动作作出简短回应；如果他们愿意，也可以在自己下一回合以一个自由动作作出回应，但必须能够看见你且位于射程内才能这样做。如果他们回应了，他们的回答也会像最初的传讯那样，直接传到你的耳中。

升环（3环） 该法术的射程提升至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4点心灵伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害，但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心状态中恢复，持续伤害结束，且该法术结束。

大失败 如失败所述，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被恪尸魔杀死的生物很难被复活，或被转化为不死生物。恪尸魔会自动尝试反制任何复活其所杀死生物，或将其转化为不死生物的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+26 #Counteract]]{+26}，反制等级 6）。如果杀死该生物的恪尸魔被杀死，则该生物可以正常地从死亡中复生，或正常地变成不死生物。

Creatures killed by an akashti are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The akashti automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+26 #Counteract]]{+26}, counteract level 6). If the akashti who slew the creature is slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Body.name: 具现身躯 Manifest Body
Manifest Body.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 伪总督在其纤细的骸骨躯架外显现出一个中空的人形身体，其外貌与赫山宝完全一致。当穿着这具显现出的身体时，伪总督失去其爪击打击，且其声音听起来也与赫山宝的一样。如果伪总督不每天花费10分钟维持这层伪造血肉的显现，其显现出的身体便会迅速腐坏。该身体拥有10生命值，且防御与伪总督相同。当该身体被摧毁时，伪总督会毫发无伤地浮现而出，而留下的血肉外壳会散落成一团红色蝴蝶，并迅速消散为红雾。此次浮现极其血腥骇人，所有30尺内目睹此景的生物都必须尝试进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:29]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 3}）；这具有精神和视觉（特征）特征。

Frequency once per day

Effect The false governor has manifested a hollow humanoid body around their slender skeletal frame that looks identical to that of Governor Heh Shan-Bao. While wearing this manifested body, the false governor loses their claw Strike, and their voice sounds like that of Heh Shan-Bao's. The false governor's manifested body decays swiftly if they don't take 10 minutes once per day to maintain the manifestation of the false flesh. The body has 10 Hit Points and the same defenses as the false governor. When the body is destroyed, the false governor emerges unharmed, and the fleshy shell left behind scatters into a cloud of red butterflies that swiftly fade into red mist. This emergence is so grisly and unsettling that all creatures within 30 feet who witness it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} on a critical failure); this has the mental and visual traits.

Stunning Despair.name: 震慑绝望 Stunning Despair
Stunning Despair.description:
伪总督发出数声压倒性的绝望呜咽。30尺内的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免，以避免陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 3}）。伪总督在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用震慑绝望。

The false governor unleashes several overwhelming sobs of despair. Creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure). The false governor can't use Stunning Despair again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4 rounds}.

False Governor.publicNotes:
阿卡什提斯是善于操纵的邪魔，专门捕食沉浸于哀悼中的人；它们会变成一位刚刚去世的挚爱之人的模样，以便潜入家中，然后谋杀并吞食悲痛家庭成员的灵魂。它有时也被称为“拟尸”；恪尸魔显露真身时，看起来像一具包着皮肤的骷髅，手指上长着锋利的利爪，无睑的双眼中不断滴下血泪。它的骷髅头顶部像碗一样敞开，里面栖息着一簇簇深红色的蝴蝶。当恪尸魔躲藏在自己显现出的身体内时，若仔细检查，有时便能看出真相：那个仿佛死而复生的挚爱之人头皮会微微起伏鼓动，因为里面的蝴蝶正在蠕动。阿卡什提斯体现了悲伤这一复杂循环。

已死的入侵者

有时，阿卡什提斯伏击并杀害目标，并非为了沉醉于其所爱之人的悲痛之中，而是为了假扮成对方的模样，从内部渗透进某个组织，腐化原本已建立的情谊纽带。然而，这些阿卡什提斯终究会对欺瞒感到厌倦，并把他们的新同伴引入陷阱，任其遭到屠杀。

Akashtis are manipulative fiends who prey on those in mourning; they assume the form of a recently deceased loved one so they can infiltrate homes, then murder and consume the souls of grieving families. Sometimes called a "copycorpse," an akashti in its true form appears as a skin-covered skeleton with sharp talons on its fingers and tears of blood dripping from its lidless eyes. Its skull appears open like a bowl, and inside nest handfuls of crimson butterflies. When an akashti hides within its manifested body, close investigation can sometimes reveal the truth when the scalp of the supposed beloved one returned to life seems to subtly ripple and bulge as the butterflies within writhe. Akashtis embody the complex cycle of grief.

Deathly Invaders

Sometimes, akashtis ambush and murder targets not to bask in the grief of their loved ones, but instead to assume their form and infiltrate an organization from within to corrupt established bonds of camaraderie. Inevitably, though, these akashtis grow bored with deception and lead their new allies into a trap for slaughter.

Stolen Jewelry.name: 失窃珠宝 Stolen Jewelry
Stolen Jewelry.description:
其余的失窃珠宝总价值为 75 gp，但这两打首饰分别属于柳岸镇的不同居民。

The rest of the stolen jewelry is worth a total of 75 gp, but these two dozen pieces belong to various citizens of Willowshore.

Algriever.name: 灵蜘蛛 Algriever

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Anathematic Reprisal.name: 破戒处罚 Anathematic Reprisal
Anathematic Reprisal.description:
触发 一个生物执行了对你神祇而言属于禁忌的行为。

你惩罚一个冒犯你神祇的生物，借助你目睹他人触犯你神祇禁忌时所感受到的痛苦。只有当一个生物主动实施了某个独特的禁忌行为时，你才能施放此法术。例如，如果制造亡灵对你的神祇而言是禁忌，那么你可以对一个刚刚在你面前制造了亡灵的死灵法师使用破戒处罚，但不能仅因为一个亡灵生物的存在而对其使用。你对目标造成4d6点心灵伤害，但一次基础意志豁免可以减少此伤害。若其失败，它还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1轮。随后，该生物会暂时免疫1分钟。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

Trigger A creature performs an act anathema to your deity.

You punish a creature that transgresses against your deity, drawing upon the anguish you feel upon seeing one of your deity's anathema committed. You can cast this spell only when a creature actively commits a unique act of anathema. For example, if creating undead were anathema to your deity, you could use anathematic reprisal on a necromancer who had just created undead in front of you, but not on an undead creature just for existing. You deal 4d6 mental damage to the target, but a basic Will save can reduce this damage. If it fails, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Crisis of Faith.name: 信仰危机 Crisis of Faith
Crisis of Faith.description:
你攻击目标的信仰，使该生物充满怀疑与心灵动荡，造成 6d6 心灵伤害；如果它能够施放神术，则改为造成 6d8 心灵伤害。其结果由其意志豁免决定。

对许多神祇而言，若无重大理由，对你所信奉的同一神祇的追随者施放此法术属于禁忌。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全部伤害；如果目标能够施放神术，则其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1} 1 轮。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1} 1 轮，且 1 轮内无法施放神术。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6（如果目标是神术施法者，则改为增加 2d8）。

You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal 6d6 mental damage, or 6d8 mental damage if it can cast divine spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.

To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 (or by 2d8 if the target is a divine spellcaster).

Acolyte's Defense.name: 侍僧防御 Acolyte's Defense
Acolyte's Defense.description:
需求 灵蜘蛛与一座圣祠建立了联结

触发 灵蜘蛛视线内的一名生物对其所联结的圣祠造成伤害、亵渎或污损

效果 灵蜘蛛朝该生物移动；此次移动不会触发反应动作。灵蜘蛛将该生物标记为其敌人，并在其以侍僧防御选择新的敌人之前，对该敌人的攻击掷骰获得+2状态加值。

Requirements The algriever is bonded with a shrine

Trigger A creature within sight of the algriever damages, desecrates, or defiles their bonded shrine

Effect The algriever Strides toward the creature; this movement doesn't trigger reactions. The algriever marks the creature as its enemy and gains a +2 status bonus to attack rolls against that enemy until they select a new enemy with Acolyte's Defense.

Shrine Bond.name: 神龛联结 Shrine Bond
Shrine Bond.description:
灵蜘蛛在该地点停留24小时后，会与一处圣祠建立联结。建立联结期间，灵蜘蛛的察觉检定和技能检定获得+2环境加值。

The algriever bonds with a shrine after they spend 24 hours at the site. While bonded, the algriever gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and skill checks.

Algriever Venom.name: 灵蜘蛛毒 Algriever Venom
Algriever Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[will|dc:28]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[2d6[mental]]

阶段 2 2d6精神伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}

阶段 3 2d6精神伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:28]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[mental]]

Stage 2 2d6 mental and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}

Stage 3 2d6 mental and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}

Pilgrim's Ward.name: 朝圣御守 Pilgrim's Ward
Pilgrim's Ward.description:
频率 每月一次

效果 灵蜘蛛触碰一名自愿的生物，并使其心中充满对其所联结圣祠的敬崇。只要目标生物遵守该灵蜘蛛所联结圣祠的典范与禁忌，或直到该灵蜘蛛将朝圣御守授予另一名生物为止，该生物在所有宗教检定和意志豁免上获得+1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.zy4PDhXnaZh6e6iT]{效果：朝圣御守}

Frequency once per month

Effect The algriever touches a willing creature and fills it with reverence for their bonded shrine. As long as the target creature obeys the edicts and anathemas of the algriever's bonded shrine, or until that algriever grants Pilgrim's Ward to a different creature, that creature gains a +1 status bonus to all Religion checks and Will saves.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.zy4PDhXnaZh6e6iT]{Effect: Pilgrim's Ward}

Web Trap.name: 网缚 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被灵蜘蛛的蛛网术打击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}并黏在最近的表面上，直到它[[/act escape dc=28]]{除非目标成功逃脱}。

A creature hit by an algriever's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=28]]{Escapes}.

Algriever.publicNotes:
有些人误把这些蜘蛛般的精魂当成搜刮废弃圣祠的拾荒者，但事实恰恰相反：它们是被遗忘礼拜之所的自封守护者，捍卫被弃信仰的神圣，并照料那些无人看管的场所。有时，哀悼者所肩负的职责会染上悲伤与哀恸，因为它们会哀悼那些曾来到自己所选圣祠礼拜之人的逝去。另一些则满怀挫折与狂暴，把任何误入它们圣祠的人都视为失落的信徒，往好里说也是疏离信仰者，往坏里说则是亵渎者——理应受罚的罪人。

哀悼者对活着的生物几乎没什么兴趣，除非这些生物闯入它们的领地。一旦哀悼者的圣祠遭到侵入，它们便会封锁通路，直到闯入者表示敬意为止。更具攻击性的哀悼者会偷窃旅人的财物，或劫持人质，直到对方满足它们索要供奉的要求。当哀悼者怀疑某人犯下亵渎之举时，任何赋礼都无法平息它们对复仇的渴求。

反应惩罚

哀悼者会遵循与其绑定的圣祠所属神祇或信仰的典范与禁忌，尽管它们在阵营上仍保持中立。无论圣祠有多大，哀悼者都会从圣祠中选择三件中型或更小的物体作为自己防御的焦点，并且可以对任何触碰或扰动这些物体的生物使用侍僧防御。

Some mistake these spiderlike spirits as scavengers looking to loot abandoned shrines, but they're actually the opposite: self-appointed guardians of forgotten places of worship, defending the sanctity of discarded faiths and tending sites that have no caretakers. Sometimes, an algriever's duties are tinged with sadness and grief, as they mourn the loss of those who once attended their chosen shrine. Others are filled with frustration and rage, viewing any who stumble upon their shrine as lapsed faithful at best or blasphemers at worse—sinners who deserve punishment.

Algrievers have little interest in living creatures until they wander into their territory. Once an algriever's shrine has been breached, they block passage until the interlopers pay their respects. Aggressive algrievers steal from travelers or take hostages until their demands for an offering are satisfied. When algrievers suspect someone of committing blasphemy, no gifts can slake their thirst for vengeance.

Reactive Punishment

An algriever follows the edicts and anathemas of the deity or faith of the shrine to which they're bonded, although they remain neutral in alignment. Regardless of how large the shrine is, an algriever chooses three Medium or smaller objects in the shrine as their own focus for defense, and can use Acolyte's Defense against any creature that touches or disturbs those objects.

Divine Prepared Spells.name: 神圣预备法术 Divine Prepared Spells

Divine Wrath.name: 神圣狂怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你引导神性的怒火对抗你的敌人。你对区域内的敌人造成4d10精魂伤害，取决于他们的强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 该生物受到全部伤害并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}；当它恶心时，它也会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一种生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。这个法术调用的是物理身体中潜藏的记忆，而非将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大致完整，法术才能生效。尸体所受的伤害越重，它的回答就越不准确、越支离破碎，而且它必须有喉咙和嘴才能说话。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过这个法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用其死亡时原本生物的数据进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，且目标的精魂会作祟你24小时，困扰你并使你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息，或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的回答可以简短、隐晦且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延时间，使法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题前结束。

大失败 如失败，但目标的回答更直接、重复更少，不过仍然隐晦。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或误导你时承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Holy Light.name: 圣光 Holy Light
Holy Light.description:
你射出一道炽烈的光线，其中夹杂着神圣能量。进行一次远程法术攻击。该光线造成 5d6 火焰伤害。如果目标具有邪秽（特征），则你额外造成 5d6 精魂伤害。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害。

成功 目标承受全部伤害。

如果这道光线穿过一片魔法黑暗，或以受魔法黑暗影响的生物为目标，则圣光会尝试反制黑暗。如果你需要判定这道光线是否穿过一片黑暗区域，请在你自己与该法术的目标之间画一条线。

升阶（+1） 火焰伤害增加 2d6，而对邪秽生物造成的精魂伤害增加 2d6。

You shine a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target has the unholy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, holy light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.

Consecrate.name: 祝圣 Consecrate
Consecrate.description:
区域 以一座固定不动、属于你神祇的祭坛、圣祠或其他设施为中心、半径40足的爆发

你将一处地点祝圣给你的神祇，吟诵赞歌并创造出一片神圣空间。在该区域内，你神祇的崇拜者在攻击掷骰、技能检定、豁免骰和察觉检定上获得+1状态加值，而对你神祇而言属于禁忌的生物（例如对于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{萨伦雷}而言的亡灵）则在这些掷骰上承受-1状态减值。如果你神祇的神圣祝福允许你选择神圣或邪秽，那么你也可以选择使被祝圣的地点成为神圣或邪秽。如果该神祇的祝福必须 是神圣或邪秽，那么你必须使该地点与该祝福一致。你神祇的崇拜者在区域内进行的打击会获得该地点的圣化特征（如果有）。

大成功 祝圣成功，并且其持续时间改为10年而非1年，或覆盖半径加倍的区域。偶尔，在你神祇的眷顾下，这还可能产生更加惊人的效果，例如区域被永久祝圣，或该效果覆盖整座大教堂。

成功 祝圣成功。

失败 祝圣失败。

大失败 祝圣惨烈失败并激怒了你的神祇，对方会降下不悦的征兆。至少1年内，进一步祝圣该地点的尝试都会失败。

升阶（7环） 被祝圣的区域还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{位面封印}法术的效果，但该效果不会尝试反制你神祇崇拜者的传送。花费提高为200 gp × 法术环阶。

Area 40-foot-radius burst around an immobile altar, shrine, or fixture of your deity

You consecrate a site to your deity, chanting praises and creating a sacred space. While within the area, worshippers of your deity gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws, and Perception checks, and creatures anathema to your deity (such as undead for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{Sarenrae}) take a -1 status penalty to those rolls. If your deity's divine sanctification allows you to choose holy or unholy, you can choose to make the consecrated site holy or unholy as well. If the deity's sanctification must be holy or unholy, you must make the site match that sanctification. Strikes made by worshippers of your deity within the area gain the site's sanctification trait, if any.

Critical Success The consecration succeeds, and it either lasts for 10 years instead of 1 or covers an area with twice the radius. Occasionally, with your deity's favor, this might produce an even more amazing effect, such as a permanently consecrated area or the effect covering an entire cathedral.

Success The consecration succeeds.

Failure The consecration fails.

Critical Failure The consecration fails spectacularly and angers your deity, who sends a sign of displeasure. For at least 1 year, further attempts to consecrate the site fail.

Heightened (7th) The consecrated area also gains the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{Planar Seal} spell, but the effect doesn't attempt to counteract teleportation by worshippers of your deity. The cost increases to 200 gp × the spell rank.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。如果你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在10分钟内变为其对应类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是一件神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Peaceful Rest.name: 安宁休息 Peaceful Rest
Peaceful Rest.description:
目标尸体不会腐烂，也不能被转化为亡灵。若尸体受到某个法术影响，而该法术要求尸体必须在一定时间内死亡（例如，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{死者复活}），则安宁休息的持续时间不计入该时间。该法术还会阻止普通虫害与害虫（如蛆虫）啃食尸体。

升阶（5环） 该法术的持续时间为无限，但施放该法术需要额外多花费1个动作，并且需要材料成本（价值 6 gp 的防腐液）。

The targeted corpse doesn't decay, nor can it be transformed into an undead. If the corpse is subject to a spell that requires the corpse to have died within a certain amount of time (for example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}), do not count the duration of peaceful rest against that time. This spell also prevents ordinary bugs and pests (such as maggots) from consuming the body.

Heightened (5th) The spell's duration is unlimited, but the spell takes one more action to cast and requires a cost (embalming fluid worth 6 gp).

Spiritual Weapon.name: 灵能武器 Spiritual Weapon
Spiritual Weapon.description:
一把由纯粹魔法力场构成的武器会显现并攻击你在射程内指定的敌人。这把武器具有幽灵般的外观，并会显现为短棒、匕首，或你神祇偏好的武器。

当你施放该法术时，这把武器会出现在你于射程内选择的一名敌人身旁，并对其进行一次打击。每次你维持该法术时，你都可以将这把武器移动到射程内的一个新目标旁边（若有需要），并用其进行一次打击。灵能武器会使用并计入你的多重攻击减值。

这把武器的打击属于近战法术攻击。无论其外观如何，这把武器都会造成 2d8 点力场伤害。你也可以令其改为造成该武器通常造成的伤害类型，而非力场伤害（如果是多用武器，则可选择其任一种可用伤害类型）。该武器的其他数据或特征均不适用，即使是远程武器也只能攻击邻接的生物。尽管灵能武器进行的是法术攻击，但就触发、抗力等效果而言，它仍然属于武器。

这把武器不占据空间，不提供夹击，也不具有生物通常会有的任何其他属性。该武器除了其打击外不能进行任何其他攻击，而影响武器的专长或法术也不适用于它。

升阶（+2） 这把武器的伤害提高 1d8。

A weapon made of pure magical force materializes and attacks foes you designate within range. This weapon has a ghostly appearance and manifests as a club, a dagger, or your deity's favored weapon.

When you cast the spell, the weapon appears next to a foe you choose within range and makes a Strike against it. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can move the weapon to a new target within range (if needed) and Strike with it. The spiritual weapon uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty.

The weapon's Strikes are melee spell attacks. Regardless of its appearance, the weapon deals 2d8 force damage. You can deal damage of the type normally dealt by the weapon instead of force damage (or any of the available damage types for a versatile weapon). No other statistics or traits of the weapon apply, and even a ranged weapon attacks adjacent creatures only. Despite making a spell attack, the spiritual weapon is a weapon for purposes of triggers, resistances, and so forth.

The weapon doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The weapon can't make any attack other than its Strike, and feats or spells that affect weapons do not apply to it.

Heightened (+2) The weapon's damage increases by 1d8.

Bane.name: 灾祸术 Bane
Bane.description:
你以怀疑充斥敌人的心智。区域内的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要它们仍在该区域内，其攻击掷骰便承受 –1 状态减值。在后续回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术，使该散发的半径增加 10 尺，并迫使区域内尚未受影响的敌人再次尝试一次豁免。

灾祸术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：灾祸术}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你大喊出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标靠近你、跑开（如同它具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}）、放开它手中持有的东西、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或站在原地不动。在它服从你的命令之前，它不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay}，也不能采取任何反应动作。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在它下一个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用一个单动作来遵从你的命令。

大失败 目标在它的下一个回合中必须用尽其所有动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你最多可以指定10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得更多信息。你可以选择忽略那些你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但在外观上并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由游戏主持决定。

升阶（4环） 如同3环，但你还会确定最高环阶魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知其精确位置，但能将来源缩小到一个5足的立方体内（若其大于此范围，则为最近的一个）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Divine Lance.name: 圣枪术 Divine Lance
Divine Lance.description:
你释放一道神圣能量光束。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 2d4 精魂伤害（若大成功，则伤害加倍）。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命能量来治疗活着的生物，或对亡灵造成伤害。如果目标是自愿的活体生物，你恢复其1d8生命值。如果目标是亡灵，你对其造成等量的活力伤害，且它必须进行一次基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时所花费的动作数量决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （专注） 该法术的射程为30尺。如果你正在治疗一个活体生物，则恢复的生命值增加8。

3 （专注） 你将生命能量散布于一个@Template[emanation|distance:30]中。这会以爆发内所有活着的生物和亡灵为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害量增加1d8，且双动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Produce Flame.name: 生火 Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
一小团火焰出现在你的手掌中，你用它猛然挥出，既可以进行近战，也可以进行远程攻击。对你的目标的 AC 进行一次法术攻击掷骰。这通常是一次远程攻击，但你也可以对你徒手触及内的一个生物进行一次近战攻击。

成功时，你造成 2d4 点火焰伤害。大成功时，目标承受双倍伤害，并受到 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] 伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 1d4，大成功时的持续伤害提高 1d4。

A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智以感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否为魔法。你或任何接受你关于该灵光建议的人，在对该物品进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时获得 +2 环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才会侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以指定 10 个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以指定任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Sanctuary.name: 庇护术 Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
你以防护能量护佑一个生物，阻止攻击。试图攻击目标的生物每次都必须进行一次意志豁免。如果目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试进行其此次攻击，以及本回合中针对目标的任何其他攻击。

失败 该生物不能攻击目标，且该动作被浪费。它在本回合中不能进一步尝试攻击目标。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，且在庇护术的剩余持续时间内不能尝试攻击目标。

You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Sigil.name: 印记 Sigil
Sigil.description:
你无害地将你独特的魔法印记放置在目标生物或物体上。该印记大小约为1平方英寸。印记可以是可见或隐形的，你可以通过使用一个交互动作来接触目标，将其从一种状态切换为另一种状态。该印记可以通过5分钟的工作被擦洗或刮除。如果它在生物身上，它会在一周内自然消退。印记消退前的时间会根据你升阶后的等级而增加。

升阶（3环） 印记改为在1个月后消退。

升阶（5环） 印记改为在1年后消退。

升阶（7环） 印记永不消退。

You harmlessly place your unique magical sigil, which is about 1 square inch in size, on the targeted creature or object. The mark can be visible or invisible, and you can change it from one state to another by using an Interact action to touch the target. The mark can be scrubbed or scraped off with 5 minutes of work. If it's on a creature, it fades naturally over the course of a week. The time before the mark fades increases depending on your heightened level.

Heightened (3rd) The sigil instead fades after 1 month.

Heightened (5th) The sigil instead fades after 1 year.

Heightened (7th) The sigil never fades.

Hide Armor.name: 皮甲 Hide Armor
Hide Armor.description:
这种护甲由毛皮、结实的兽皮以及有时经模压的熟皮制成，凭借其多层皮革提供防护，但其笨重会拖慢穿戴者并降低机动性。

A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

Purifying Flames.name: 净化之焰 Purifying Flames
Purifying Flames.description:
驱魔师尝试用其火把对一个生物进行打击，以极高的精准度发起攻击，并使火把的烈焰再度爆发。此次打击的攻击掷骰获得+2状态加值，且命中时会额外造成2d6点火焰伤害，而非仅造成1d6点火焰伤害。被此次攻击命中的亡灵、精魂或转生生物还必须进行一次@Check[will|dc:26]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受此额外效果影响，且部分火焰会反扑到驱魔师身上，对驱魔师造成@Damage[2d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免）。

成功 该生物不受此额外效果影响。

失败 净化之焰使该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，直到其下个回合结束。

大失败 如失败，但改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1分钟。

The exorcist attempts to Strike a creature with their torch, attacking with great precision and causing the torch's fires to flare up. This Strike gains a +2 status bonus to its attack roll and inflicts an additional 2d6 fire damage on a hit instead of just 1d6 fire damage. An undead, spirit, or transmigrated creature hit by this attack must also attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by this additional effect, and some of the fire flares back onto the exorcist, inflicting @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage to the exorcist (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save).

Success The creature is unaffected by this additional effect.

Failure The purifying flames cause the creature to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Torch Wielder.name: 火把持用者 Torch Wielder
Torch Wielder.description:
驱魔师将火把视为轻型钉头锤，命中时额外造成 1d6 点火焰伤害。

The exorcist treats a torch as a light mace that deals an additional 1d6 fire damage on a hit.

Crossbow.name: 弩 Crossbow
Crossbow.description:
这种远程武器在一个带握柄、称为“弩身”的框架上安装了类似弓的结构。弩身带有一种机构，可以将弓弦锁定在适当位置，并连接到一个扳机机构，用于释放张力并射出弩矢。

This ranged weapon has a bow-like assembly mounted on a handled frame called a tiller. The tiller has a mechanism to lock the bowstring in place, attached to a trigger mechanism that releases the tension and launches a bolt.

Scale Mail.name: 鳞甲 Scale Mail
Scale Mail.description:
鳞甲由许多缝在加固皮革衬底上的金属鳞片组成，通常制成长衫的形式，保护躯干、手臂和腿部。

Scale mail consists of many metal scales sewn onto a reinforced leather backing, often in the form of a long shirt that protects the torso, arms, and legs.

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶钉皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这件皮甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还带有小块金属板，在保留皮甲大部分灵活性的同时，提供了更坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但构造相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这种小型带刃武器可单手持用，用于在近身战斗中刺击生物。它也可以被投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Club.name: 短棒 Club
Club.description:
这是一块结实的木头，被塑形或改造后可用来痛击敌人。短棒可以是精雕细刻的武术作品，也可以像树枝或一截木头一样简单。

This is a piece of stout wood shaped or repurposed to bludgeon an enemy. Clubs can be intricately carved pieces of martial art or as simple as a tree branch or piece of wood.

Sap.name: 短棍 Sap
Sap.description:
短棍有一层柔软的包裹物包覆着致密的核心，通常是包着铅条的皮套。它的头部比握柄更宽，以分散打击的力道，因为这种武器的用途是击昏受害者，而不是使其流血。

A sap has a soft wrapping around a dense core, typically a leather sheath around a lead rod. Its head is wider than its grip to disperse the force of a blow, as the weapon's purpose is to knock out its victim rather than to draw blood.

Frost Vial (Lesser).name: 霜冻小瓶（次等）
Frost Vial (Lesser).description:
启动 1 打击

这个小瓶中的亮蓝色液态试剂在暴露于空气中时会迅速吸收热量。霜冻小瓶造成 1d6 点寒冷伤害和 1 点寒冷溅射伤害。若命中，目标的速度在其下个回合结束前受到 –5 足状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.LdmzgBOTjCete4F7]{效果：霜冻小瓶}

Activate 1 Strike

The bright blue liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals 1d6 cold damage and 1 cold splash damage. On a hit, the target takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.LdmzgBOTjCete4F7]{Effect: Frost Vial}

Buckler.name: 圆盾 Buckler
Buckler.description:
这种非常小的盾牌深受决斗家和敏捷、轻甲战士的喜爱。它通常由钢制成，并绑在你的前臂上。只要你的那只手是空着的，或者那只手拿着一个不是武器的轻型物体，你就可以用你的圆盾 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{举起护盾}。

硬度HPBT
363

This very small shield is a favorite of duelists and quick, lightly armored warriors. It's typically made of steel and strapped to your forearm. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} with your buckler as long as you have that hand free or are holding a light object that's not a weapon in that hand.

Shortsword.name: 短剑 Shortsword
Shortsword.description:
这些刀刃有各种各样的形状和风格，但通常长 2 英尺。

These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

Spear.name: 矛 Spear
Spear.description:
一根长长的木杆，末端带有金属尖刺，矛可以单手作为近战武器使用，也可以投掷。

A long metal shaft ending with a metal spike, a spear can be used one-handed as a melee weapon and can be thrown.

Gurglegut.name: 咕噜肚 Gurglegut

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶钉皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这件皮甲用金属饰钉加固，有时还会镶嵌小块金属板，在保留皮甲大部分灵活性的同时，提供更坚实的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Jug of Rice Wine.name: 米酒壶 Jug of Rice Wine
Jug of Rice Wine.description:
酒精是一种常见物质，种类丰富得惊人。一剂酒精的价格取决于具体饮品。在受到酒精影响期间，你无法从酒精导致的恶心（状态）中恢复。

如果你在对抗酒精时的豁免骰失败，且不是初始豁免，则该苦难的阶段不会提升；提升酒精苦难阶段的唯一方式是摄入更多酒精。

启动 A 交互（摄入）

豁免骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:12]

潜伏期 10分钟

阶段 1 对抗恐惧的豁免骰获得+1物品加值（10分钟）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，对抗恐惧效果的豁免骰获得+1物品加值（10分钟）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}、措手不及、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}（10分钟）

阶段 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}（10分钟）

阶段 7 死亡

Alcohol is a common substance available in stunning variety. The Price of a dose of alcohol depends on the specific beverage. You can't recover from the sickened condition from alcohol while affected.

If you fail a saving throw against alcohol other than initial saves, the affliction's stage doesn't increase; the only way to increase the stage of alcohol's affliction is to consume more alcohol.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:12]

Onset 10 minutes

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to saving throws against fear (10 minutes)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, +1 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects (10 minutes)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, off-guard, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (10 minutes)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (10 minutes)

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩所使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Command Onidoshi.name: 命令术 鬼徒武士 Command Onidoshi
Command Onidoshi.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 咕噜肚向D1区域内的单个鬼武士吠出一道命令。该鬼武士可以使用反应动作来尝试对邻近的敌人进行一次近战打击。

Frequency once per round

Effect Gurglegut barks out a command to a single onidoshi in area D1. That onidoshi can use a reaction to attempt a melee Strike against an adjacent foe.

Spit Fire.name: 喷火 Spit Fire
Spit Fire.description:
频率 每天一次

效果咕噜肚喝下他米酒壶中的内容（消耗壶中储存的一口），然后将其喷吐到他的弩上一枚弩矢的燃烧尖端，喷出一片烈焰，充满一个 @Template[cone|distance:20]，对区域内所有生物造成 @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免）。

Frequency once per day

Effect Gurglegut drinks the contents of his jug of rice wine (consuming one of the gulps contained in his jug), then spews it out across the flaming tip of a bolt in his crossbow, filling a @Template[cone|distance:20] with a blast of fire that inflicts @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect] save) to all creatures in the area.

Gurglegut.publicNotes:
独眼怪是栖居于树上的族群，内心始终翻涌着想要吞食他者血肉的欲望。他们的食物中有很大一部分依赖树叶和根茎作物补充，并且拥有相当丰富的农业知识，还天生具有操控植物及其生长的力量。然而说到肉类时，独眼怪拒绝野兽的血肉；他们转而食用其他类人生物。他们不仅觉得其他生物的肉尝起来令人作呕，而且他们的身体也会排斥非类人生物的肉，因为那对他们没有任何营养价值，食用后只会让他们恶心且虚弱。

独眼怪不同寻常的饮食需求，意味着他们几乎总是与邻近文化处于冲突之中。他们通常只与地精维持还算不错的关系，因为地精这个族群较少会仅凭饮食习惯评判他人。其他社群惧怕独眼怪——而且这种惧怕也并非毫无道理——不过除了偶尔外出猎取某人作为下一顿饭外，独眼怪往往还是深居简出。在一些走投无路的地方，面对饥荒或其他自然灾害的社群，甚至可能主动寻求独眼怪的帮助，以受害者作为交换，换取知识或魔法援助，从而让他们的社群免于在饥饿中缓慢而可怕地死去。

独眼怪的独眼有时会让他们被拿来与独眼巨人相比。然而，这两类生物都否认彼此有任何共同族裔，而他们最初也是分别独立出现在世界上截然不同的地区，并拥有明显不同的能力。就独眼怪自己而言，他们相信自己祖先的事迹造就了他们如今的独眼。面对一场威胁其存续的饥荒时，这些祖先各自剜出一只眼睛，作为献给森林中恶意精魂的祭品，恳求对方拯救他们。独眼怪说，这些被他们称作“busaw”的精魂，赐予了他们农业知识、操控植物的力量，以及对智慧血肉的渴求。自那以后，他们将 busaw 尊敬为神祇，并自称为“buso”：即崇拜 busaw 之人。

Busos are tree-dwelling folk with a simmering desire to consume the flesh of others. They to heavily supplement their food with leaves and root crops, possess significant knowledge of agriculture, and boast innate powers over plants and their growth. In regards to meat, however, busos reject the flesh of beasts; they instead consume other humanoids. Not only do they find the taste of other creatures repulsive, but their bodies reject non-humanoid meat since it provides them no nutritional value and consuming it leaves them sickened and weak.

Busos' unusual dietary needs mean they're almost always at odds with neighboring cultures. They typically maintain decent relations only with goblins, who are as a people less prone to judging others based on diet. Other communities fear busos-with some justification-though aside from the occasional forays to harvest someone for their next meal, busos tend to keep to themselves. In some desperate locations, communities faced with famine or other natural disasters might even seek out busos' aid, offering victims in exchange for knowledge or magical assistance that might save their communities from slow and terrible deaths through starvation.

A buso's single eye sometimes leads to them being compared to cyclopes. However, both types of creatures deny any common ancestry, and they first appeared independently in entirely different parts of the world with substantially divergent abilities. For their part, busos believe that their ancestors' deeds gave rise to their single eyes. When faced with a famine that threatened their existence, these ancestors each cut out one of their eyes as an offering to the malevolent spirits of the forest, imploring for their salvation. Busos say that these spirits, whom they call the busaw, gave them their knowledge of agriculture, power over plants, and craving for sentient flesh. Henceforth, they revered the busaw as gods and called themselves buso: those who worship the busaw.
Gurglegut.blurb:
变体雄性独眼怪
Variant male buso

Ogre Spider.name: 食人魔蛛 Ogre Spider

Web Sense.name: 蛛网感知 Web Sense
Web Sense.description:
梦境蜘蛛拥有不精确的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]{震动感知}，以侦测接触其蛛网的生物所产生的振动。

The dream spider has imprecise @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]{Tremorsense} to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

Eerie Flexibility.name: 诡异的灵活性 Eerie Flexibility
Eerie Flexibility.description:
食人魔蛛可以像大型生物一样穿过狭窄空间。当它进行挤压时，可以以其完整速度移动。

An ogre spider can fit through tight spaces as if it were a Large creature. While Squeezing, it can move at its full Speed.

Ogre Spider Venom.name: 食人魔蛛毒液 Ogre Spider Venom
Ogre Spider Venom.description:
强韧 @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]]伤害、笨拙1，以及 虚弱1（1轮）

阶段 4 @Damage[2d6[poison]]伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage, clumsy 1, and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Web Trap.name: 网缚 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被食人魔蛛的蛛网术攻击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并黏在最近的表面上，直到它逃脱（DC 22）。

A creature hit by the ogre spider's web attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it Escapes (DC 22).

Ogre Spider.publicNotes:
这些可怕的生物会长得和大象一样大。它们的眼睛长在宽阔的颚骨上方，这种位置让它们看起来像一张正做着狰狞鬼脸的食人魔面孔。食人魔觉得食人魔蛛的脸既滑稽又可爱，但大多数情况下，食人魔试图把这些蜘蛛当作宠物来养，结果往往是食人魔丧命，而蜘蛛饱餐一顿。

蜘蛛的体型差异极大，不过其中许多都在某种程度上带有毒性。

These terrifying creatures grow as large as elephants. The placement of their eyes above their wide mandibles evokes the grimacing visage of an ogre's leer. Ogres find ogre spider faces simultaneously amusing and adorable, but in most cases, ogres' attempts to keep these spiders as pets result in dead ogres and well-fed spiders.

Spiders range dramatically in size, yet many are to some extent venomous.

Goh.publicNotes:
