Aruka.name: 阿鲁卡 Aruka

Rugged Clothes with Tool Belt.name: 结实衣物（带工具腰带）
Rugged Clothes with Tool Belt.description:
这种护甲只是一层厚重的绗缝布料，但有时人们会因为它极其便宜而使用它。软甲比其他类型的护甲更容易受损和被毁坏。重甲的价格中包含一件软甲内衬，不过当它穿在重甲下面时，会失去舒适特征。如果你的重甲被毁坏，或者你在其他情况下没有穿完整的重甲，你也可以只穿这件软甲内衬睡觉。这样你就能继续维持魔法护甲的已注入状态，并从相关重甲上的任何符文力量中受益，但没有这件软甲内衬，其他人都无法穿戴你的重甲。

This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep magic armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Artisan's Toolkit.name: 工匠工具包 Artisan's Toolkit
Artisan's Toolkit.description:
你需要这些工具，才能用原材料配合制作技能来制造物品。不同的工作需要不同的套装，由游戏主持决定；例如，铁匠的工具包与木工的工具包不同。如果你穿戴着你的工匠工具包，你可以将其抽出并收回，作为使用它的动作的一部分。

You need these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

Assorted Maps.name: 杂项地图 Assorted Maps
Assorted Maps.description:
地图并不常见。你能找到的大多数地图都简单而实用。勘测地图会以极其详尽的方式描绘一个单独地点。这类地图会使你在求生检定和任何回忆知识技能检定上获得 +1 物品加值，前提是这些检定与地图上详细描绘的地点有关。游戏主持决定任何地点有哪些地图可供取得。

Maps are uncommon. Most maps you can find are simple and functional. A survey map details a single location in excellent detail. One of these maps gives you a +1 item bonus to Survival checks and any skill checks to Recall Knowledge, provided the checks are related to the location detailed on the map. The GM determines what maps are available in any location.

Apprentice's Ambition.name: 学徒的野心 Apprentice's Ambition
Apprentice's Ambition.description:
频率 每天一次

需求 一名直属上级正在监督该学徒

效果 该学徒在其下个回合结束前，攻击掷骰、伤害掷骰、豁免骰和技能检定获得 +2 环境加值。

Frequency once per day

Requirements A direct superior is supervising the apprentice

Effect The apprentice gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks until the end of their next turn.

Aruka.publicNotes:
雄心勃勃的学徒在所有城市中都能见到。这些人通常更年轻，并且在学习自己手艺的同时寻求师傅的认可。许多人渴望体现其手艺背后的艺术性，希望有朝一日自己也能成为大师。下方描绘的是一位制图学徒。

技艺是通过多年的努力以及往往枯燥乏味的工作锤炼而成的。工匠是其手艺的大师，能够创造出既实用又美观的作品。

Ambitious apprentices can be found in all cities. These individuals are generally younger and seek the approval of their masters as they learn their craft. Many yearn to exemplify the artistry behind their craft, one day becoming masters themselves. Depicted below is an apprentice cartographer.

Expertise is forged through years of effort and often tedious work. Artisans are masters of their craft, able to create works both practical and beautiful.
Aruka.blurb:
女性狐人学徒
Female kitsune apprentice

Phantom Wolf.name: 魅影狼 Phantom Wolf

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的思绪蒙上迷雾，并以一次精神冲击令其眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造出一种由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类齐声喊叫。声音从射程内由你指定的一个方格中发出。你不能创造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Walk the Ethereal Line.name: 游于两界 Walk the Ethereal Line
Walk the Ethereal Line.description:
魅影游走于以太位面与物质位面之间的细微界线上，从而同时存在于两个位面之中。

它们可以再次使用此能力，转回仅存在于以太位面。

The phantom walks the thin line between the Ethereal and Material Planes in order to exist on both planes simultaneously.

They can shift back to solely the Ethereal Plane by using this ability again.

Susceptible to Death.name: 易于死亡 Susceptible to Death
Susceptible to Death.description:
尽管魅影并非活物，但它们也不是不死生物，并且会对死亡效果表现出独特的脆弱性。

若魅影因死亡效果而导致生命值降至 0（例如来自类似 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute} 的法术），便会立即被送往灵魂之河，在那里，它们的灵魂会继续沿着通往来世的通常道路前行。

Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they undead, and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death.

A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a death effect (such as from a spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute}) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

Vulnerable to Kindness.name: 友善易伤 Vulnerable to Kindness
Vulnerable to Kindness.description:
30尺内任何魅影能看见且听见的生物，都可以用一个具有听觉、专注、语言和心灵（特征）特征的双动作行动向它发出冷静且友善的问候。以这种方式问候魅影的生物必须尝试进行一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:17] 检定。

大成功 魅影受到 @Damage[4d8[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

成功 魅影受到 @Damage[2d8[mental]] 伤害。

失败 魅影受到 @Damage[1d8[mental]] 伤害。

大失败 魅影不受影响，并且在1轮内不会受此弱点影响。

Any creature within 30 feet that the phantom can see and hear can issue a calm and friendly greeting to it as a two-action activity with the auditory, concentrate, linguistic, and mental traits. A creature greeting the phantom in this manner must attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:17] check.

Critical Success The phantom takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The phantom takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage.

Failure The phantom takes @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The phantom is unaffected, and is not affected by this weakness for 1 round.

Pack Attack.name: 群体攻击 Pack Attack
Pack Attack.description:
魅影狼的打击对处于其至少一名盟友触及内的生物额外造成1d4伤害。

The phantom wolf's Strikes deal an additional 1d4 damage to creatures within reach of at least one of its allies.

Phantom Wolf.publicNotes:
据大多数神学家的说法，灵魂前往来世的普通轨迹相当直接。凡人死去时，其灵魂会进入灵魂之河，并最终抵达骨园，在那里接受法拉斯玛的审判。被审判后的灵魂会前往其最终安息的相应领域——天堂、地狱、亚巴顿等等——并在那里成为祈愿者。

然而，当一个排队等待审判的灵魂过早脱离灵魂之河，并被转移到以太位面时，情况就会变得复杂。无论是由于夜鬼婆之类心怀恶意的闯入者、危险的位面魔法，还是命运使然，这些灵魂都会脱离生死的自然秩序，并滞留在某种类似炼狱的状态中。与祈愿者不同，这些灵体魅影保留着死前生活的记忆；而与幽灵等精魂不同，魅影并未沾染不死生物那种污秽的影响——至少起初并非如此，尽管腐化的威胁始终沉重地笼罩着魅影的存在。有些最终屈服于这样的命运，另一些则最终重新汇入灵魂之河。在那之前，这些游荡的灵魂自成一类——没有真正的家园、目标或意义。

许多魅影都不愿继续维持这种奇异的炼狱状态，要么是因为它们寻求继续自己穿越灵魂之河的旅程，要么是因为它们惧怕不死生物的腐化。为了完成自然的灵性循环，并接受审判以继续前往来世，魅影只需找到重返灵魂之河的方法。然而，这样的追寻绝非易事——以太位面朦胧的迷雾足以让哪怕最有经验的旅者也迷失方向，而众多掠食者则在这片领域中潜行，搜索那些离群的灵魂，以将其束缚或吞噬。

The typical trajectory for souls passing to the afterlife is fairly straightforward, according to most theologians. When a mortal dies, their soul enters the River of Souls and eventually reaches the Boneyard, where it is judged by Pharasma. The judged soul moves onto its appropriate domain of final rest-Heaven, Hell, Abaddon, and so forth-where it becomes a petitioner.

Complications arise, however, when a soul in queue for judgment prematurely departs from the River of Souls and is shunted into the Ethereal Plane. Whether as a result of nefarious interlopers like night hags, malignant planar magic, or even fate, these souls become dislodged from the natural order of life and death and linger in a sort of purgatory. Unlike petitioners, these ethereal phantoms retain memories of their life before death, and unlike spirits such as ghosts, phantoms aren't tinged with the foul influences of undeath-at least, not at first, though the threat of corruption hangs heavy over a phantom's existence. Some eventually succumb to that fate, while others eventually rejoin the River of Souls. Until then, these wandering souls are a kind unto themselves-one without a true home, agenda, or purpose.

Many phantoms have no desire to remain in their strange state of purgatory, either because they seek to continue their journey through the River of Souls or because they fear the corruption of undeath. In order to complete the natural spiritual cycle and become judged so they can continue to the afterlife, a phantom must simply find a way back into the River of Souls. Such a quest is no easy feat, however-the hazy mists of the Ethereal Plane can befuddle even the most experienced traveler, and numerous predators prowl the realm in search of stray souls to bind or devour.

Nosoi.name: 疫鸟 Nosoi

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Read Omens.name: 阅读预兆 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥视未来。选择一个你计划在 1 周内进行的特定目标或行动，或者一个你预计可能在 1 周内发生的事件。你会获得一条晦涩的线索或建议，可能有助于应对所选事件，通常会以谜语般的诗句或预兆的形式出现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一种生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。这个法术调用的是肉体身体中潜藏的记忆，而非将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大致完整，此法术才能生效。尸体受到的伤害越多，它的回答就越不准确、越东拼西凑，而且它还必须有喉咙和嘴巴才能说话。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过这个法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用其死亡时原本生物的数据进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，而且目标的精魂会在24小时内作祟于你，骚扰你并使你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的回答可能简短、隐晦且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延时间，让法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题前耗尽。

大失败 同失败，但目标的回答更直接、重复更少，但仍然隐晦。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或误导你时承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).name: 隐形术（随意，自身限定）
Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).description:
幻象使光围绕目标弯曲，使其变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试找到目标，从而使其改为对它们处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态。如果目标进行敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标进行敌对动作，它不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Noise Blast.name: 噪音爆破 Noise Blast
Noise Blast.description:
刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成2d10点音波伤害。每个生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，持续1轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入耳聋，持续1分钟，并且处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10点。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Lifesense 60 feet.name: 生命感应 60 尺 Lifesense 60 feet

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
疫鸟呈现为渡鸦或鸣禽的外观。这不会改变它的速度，也不会改变其打击的攻击调整值和伤害调整值。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The nosoi takes the appearance of a raven or songbird. This doesn't change its Speed or its attack and damage modifiers with its Strikes.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Haunting Melody.name: 萦回旋律 Haunting Melody
Haunting Melody.description:
疫鸟轻吟一首令人着迷的歌曲。每个处于@Template[emanation|distance:60]内的活体或不死生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:18]意志豁免。该效果持续至疫鸟下个回合结束，但疫鸟可以维持它。豁免成功的生物会在24小时内暂时免疫。尽管这是一个心灵效果，此能力仍会影响无心智的不死生物。

引魂使免疫此能力。

失败 该生物陷入对疫鸟的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷}状态。

大失败 该生物对疫鸟着迷，并且必须在其回合中将自己的每个动作都用于尽可能迅速地向疫鸟靠近，同时避开明显的危险。如果一个着迷的生物与疫鸟相邻，它会留在原地且不行动。如果该生物受到攻击，此着迷结束。

The nosoi croons an entrancing song. Each living or undead creature within a @Template[emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save. The effect lasts until the end of the nosoi's next turn, but the nosoi can Sustain it. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours. Despite being a mental effect, this ability affects mindless undead.

Psychopomps are immune to this ability.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the nosoi.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated with the nosoi and must spend each of its actions on its turn to move closer to the nosoi as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a fascinated creature is adjacent to the nosoi, it stays still and doesn't act. If the creature is attacked, the fascination ends.

Shepherd's Touch.name: 牧羊人的接触 Shepherd's Touch
Shepherd's Touch.description:
疫鸟的打击获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}属性符文的益处，并且对活着的生物额外造成 @Damage[1d6[void]] 伤害，或对不死生物额外造成 @Damage[1d6[vitality]] 伤害。

A nosoi's Strikes have the benefit of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune and deal an additional @Damage[1d6[void]] damage to living creatures or @Damage[1d6[vitality]] damage to undead.

Nosoi.publicNotes:
疫鸟看起来像一只戴着厚重皮革瘟疫医生面具的夜鹰、麻雀或其他小型鸟类。它们是骨园的文书、信使和抄写员，见证审判、引导灵魂，并总体上承担维持骨园运转的各种繁杂行政工作。大多数疫鸟都特别健谈，并热衷于讨论它们认为各自被分派的任务有多么重要。

引魂使是骨园中死者的守护者与引路人。骨园是一片广袤的墓冢位面，凡人的灵魂会在此接受审判，随后前往自己永恒的奖励或诅咒之地。引魂使确保死者能够接受自己从凡俗生命中转变的事实，并被妥善分流到合适的来世。它们还保护灵魂，使其免受超自然掠食者的侵害。几乎所有引魂使都会佩戴面具，尤其是在它们很可能与凡人打交道时，不过它们所佩戴的面具种类也和引魂使本身一样千差万别。骨园的法庭使用雷奎安语主持审判，这是一种庄重却富有旋律感的语言，说话时语速缓慢，并带有各种音调变化。

许多引魂使都深度参与骨园庞大的官僚体系。很少有引魂使追求仁慈、正义或个人利益；它们对法莱斯玛及其骨园的职责高于一切。尽管如此，不同的引魂使对自身职责的理解方式并不相同，这可能使它们与凡人，甚至彼此之间发生冲突。

A nosoi resembles a whippoorwill, sparrow, or other small bird wearing a heavy leather plague doctor's mask. They are the clerks, messengers, and scribes of the Boneyard, witnessing judgments, directing souls, and generally performing the administrative grunt work that keeps the Boneyard functioning. Most nosois are particularly chatty and eager to discuss how important they consider their individual assignments to be.

Psychopomps are guardians and shepherds of the dead in the Boneyard, the vast plane of graves where mortal souls are judged and sent on to their eternal rewards or damnations. Psychopomps ensure that the dead come to terms with their transition from mortality and are properly sorted into the appropriate afterlife. They also protect souls from being preyed upon by supernatural predators. Nearly all psychopomps wear masks, especially when they're likely to be interacting with mortals, although the types of masks they wear are as varied as the psychopomps themselves. The courts of the Boneyard preside in Requian, a somber yet melodic language spoken slowly with various tonal shifts.

Many psychopomps are intimately involved with the Boneyard's massive bureaucracy. Few pursue mercy, justice, or personal gain; their duties to Pharasma and her Boneyard are supreme. Nevertheless, individual psychopomps interpret their duties in different ways, which might put them in conflict with mortals or even with each other.

Ithiniak.name: 伊西尼亚克 Ithiniak

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Mirage.name: 蜃景 Mirage
Mirage.description:
你制造一个幻象，使自然地形看起来、听起来、摸起来和闻起来都像是另一种地形。这不会伪装区域内的任何建筑或生物。

任何触碰该幻象的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作来检查它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。

升阶（5环） 你的幻象也可以伪装建筑，或创造虚幻的建筑（但仍然不会伪装生物）。

You create an illusion that causes natural terrain to look, sound, feel, and smell like a different kind of terrain. This doesn't disguise any structures or creatures in the area.

Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (5th) Your image can also disguise structures or create illusory structures (but still doesn't disguise creatures).

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标陷入失明。该效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后，目标在 1 分钟内获得临时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标陷入目盲 1 分钟。

大失败 目标永久陷入目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Cleanse Affliction (Curse Only).name: 净化苦难（仅限诅咒）
Cleanse Affliction (Curse Only).description:
温和的恢复性魔法能够缓解毒素与更复杂病症带来的影响。选择目标身上的一种苦难，例如诅咒、疾病或毒素。若其已进展至第一阶段之后，则将其阶段降低1。对此苦难的同一病例，此降低只能生效一次；当该病例被完全治愈时，此病例结束。虽然这种降低不能再次发生，但此法术的高环版本会在每次施放时尝试反制。

升阶（3环） 若该苦难是疾病或毒素，则尝试反制该苦难。

升阶（4环） 若该苦难是诅咒、疾病或毒素，则尝试反制该苦难。

Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.

Deafness.name: 耳聋术 Deafness
Deafness.description:
目标失去听觉；它必须进行一次强韧豁免。随后，目标会在1分钟内暂时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，持续1轮。

失败 目标陷入耳聋，持续10分钟。

大失败 目标将永久耳聋。

The target loses hearing; it must attempt a Fortitude save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Failure The target is Deafened for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The target is Deafened permanently.

Tangle Vine.name: 缠结藤蔓 Tangle Vine
Tangle Vine.description:
一根藤蔓凭空出现，从你的手中迅速甩出并缠向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{法术效果：缠结藤蔓}

大成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，且其所有速度在1轮内承受–10尺环境减值。它可以尝试 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱}，对抗你的法术DC，以移除该减值和禁足。

成功 目标的所有速度在1轮内承受–10尺环境减值。它可以尝试挣脱，对抗你的法术DC，以移除该减值。

失败 目标不受影响。

升阶（2环） 这些效果持续2轮。

升阶（4环） 这些效果持续1分钟。

A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

Scent Curse.name: 诅咒嗅觉 Scent Curse
Scent Curse.description:
食厄精能够在30尺内嗅出等级等于或低于其自身等级的诅咒存在；这是一种模糊感官。

The imprecasia can smell the presence of curses of a level equal to or lower than their own level within 30 feet; this is an imprecise sense.

Drink Death.name: 饮下死亡 Drink Death
Drink Death.description:
触发 食厄精30尺内的一个生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死（状态）}

效果 食厄精深吸一口气，从该濒死生物的身体中抽出一缕蓝色薄雾，吸入口中。该濒死生物的濒死值减少1，且食厄精恢复 @Damage[(2d10+9)[healing]]生命值。

Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the imprecasia is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Effect The imprecasia inhales, drawing a thin blue streak of vapor out of the dying creature's body into their mouth. The dying creature's dying condition is reduced by 1, and the imprecasia regains @Damage[(2d10+9)[healing]] Hit Points.

Devour Curse.name: 吞噬诅咒 Devour Curse
Devour Curse.description:
食厄精对一个正受诅咒影响的生物身上的诅咒施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{净化苦难}，但施法时间为两动作而非10分钟。若其成功移除该诅咒，它还会从该生物身上抽取生命力，使其陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，除非该生物成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:30]强韧豁免（若大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}）。如果诅咒被移除，食厄精不会消耗这次将移除诅咒作为原能内在法术的使用次数。

以物品为目标

食厄精可以对受诅咒的物品而非生物施放移除诅咒，但不能对其使用吞噬诅咒。它只能对等级等于或低于自身等级的物品这样做；若成功，若该物品等级等于食厄精等级减4或更高，则该物品在24小时内解除诅咒；若其等级低于该值，则永久解除诅咒。

The imprecasia casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} against a curse afflicting a creature, but with a cast of two actions rather than 10 minutes. If they succeed in removing the curse, they also drains vitality from the creature, causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure). If the curse is removed, the imprecasia doesn't expend that use of remove curse as a primal innate spell.

Targeting Items

An imprecasia can cast remove curse on a cursed item rather than on a creature, but they can't use Devour Curse on it. They can only do so on an item that's of a level equal to or less than their own level; on a success, the item is uncursed for 24 hours if it's of a level equal to or higher than the imprecasia's level –4, or uncursed permanently if it's lower level than that.

Homeland's Hostility.name: 家园敌意 Homeland's Hostility
Homeland's Hostility.description:
受到食厄精爪击伤害的生物必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:30] 意志豁免。若失败，它将食厄精60尺内的所有地形视为困难地形。

A creature that takes damage from the imprecasia's claws must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save. On a failure, it treats all terrain within 60 feet of an imprecasia as difficult terrain.

Ithiniak.publicNotes:
食厄精，通常被称为食咒者，是一种独来独往、会被诅咒所散发能量吸引而来的妖精。它们看起来像消瘦的人形生物，长着阴影般的翼、带锋利爪子的细长双手，以及带羽状触角的虫类头部。

某个地区出现食厄精，意味着这片土地正遭受困扰，但它们并不是不受欢迎的生物。恰恰相反，食厄精的下落是令人垂涎的情报，因为它们拥有将物体和生物身上的诅咒彻底吞食的能力。许多背负诅咒重担的人都会去寻找食咒者，而它们大多乐于接受带有毁灭的物品，或出于善意消除某个人身上的诅咒。

食厄精绝不会接受治疗一片受诅咒土地或荒芜地区这种想法。它甚至可能会试图强化一片地区上的苦难，只为确保食物的稳定供应。更大胆的食厄精会追踪受诅咒的家族，跨越数代以他们的不幸为食，直到诅咒终结或血脉断绝。任何试图摧毁这类诅咒的人，都可能发现自己成了食厄精的敌人，因为它正守护着自己的食物来源。

An imprecasia, commonly known as a curse eater, is a solitary fey drawn to the energy emanating from curses. They appear as emaciated humanoid creatures with shadowy wings, long thin hands with sharp claws, and insectile heads with feathery antenna.

An imprecasia's appearance in a region signifies the land is troubled, but they're not unpopular creatures. On the contrary, an imprecasia's whereabouts are coveted information, as they have the ability to fully consume curses on objects and creatures. Many carrying the weight of a curse seek out curse eaters, most of whom will gladly accept doomed objects or charitably destroy an individual's curse.

An imprecasia will never accept the idea of healing a cursed land or blighted region. One might even seek to strengthen the afflictions on a region simply to ensure a regular supply of food. A bolder imprecasia tracks cursed families over generations, feeding off their misfortune until the curse ends or the bloodline dies off. Any who attempt to destroy such curses may find themselves the enemy of an imprecasia defending their source of sustenance.

Yeri.name: 耶里 Yeri

Spewing Bile.name: 喷吐胆汁 Spewing Bile
Spewing Bile.description:
当庞南加兰受到挥砍伤害时，其伤口会向相邻生物喷出胆汁，造成 @Damage[2d10[poison]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:19|basic] 豁免）。

庞南加兰失去其喷吐胆汁和庞南加兰胆汁能力，直到其下一回合结束。

When the penanggalan takes slashing damage, their wound spews bile on adjacent creatures, dealing @Damage[2d10[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:19|basic] save).

The penanggalan loses their spewing bile and penanggalan bile abilities until the end of their next turn.

Elongate Tongue.name: 伸长舌头 Elongate Tongue
Elongate Tongue.description:
庞南加兰的舌头伸长，薄膜被拉伸并变得半透明。直到该回合结束，庞南加兰的长喙舌打击具有10尺触及，且任何目标在对抗该打击时均处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，除非其察觉DC为22或更高，或具有精确感知@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}事物的能力。

The penanggalan's tongue extends, the membrane stretching and becoming translucent. Until the end of the turn, the penanggalan's proboscis tongue Strikes have a 10-foot reach, and any target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the Strike unless it has a Perception DC of 22 or higher or the ability to precisely sense @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} things.

Penanggalan Bile.name: 庞南加兰胆汁 Penanggalan Bile
Penanggalan Bile.description:
休息不会减少庞南加兰胆汁造成的吸取值

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸取 1}（1周）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸取 2}（1周）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸取 3}（1周）

阶段 4 死亡

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

Ride Corpse.name: 骑乘尸体 Ride Corpse
Ride Corpse.description:
庞南加兰将其内脏塞回其类人生物的身体中，使其能够看起来像并像正常人一样四处移动。该身体有 10 生命值，且拥有与庞南加兰相同的防御。

当身体被摧毁时，庞南加兰会毫发无伤地被弹出。该身体会变成一具尸体；如果它既未被庞南加兰控制，也未储存在炼金缸中，便会如常腐烂。

The penanggalan inserts their entrails into their humanoid body, allowing them to appear as and move about like a normal human. The body has 10 Hit Points and the same defenses as the penanggalan.

When the body is destroyed, the penanggalan is ejected unharmed. The body becomes a corpse, and if it is neither controlled by the penanggalan nor stored in an alchemical vat, it decays as normal.

Yeri.publicNotes:
庞南加兰以年轻人的鲜血和内脏为食。当它们噬人的饥渴发作时，庞南加兰会将自己的身体浸泡在一种带有醋味的炼金物质中。一旦没入这种混合液，它们的颈部就会从两侧撕裂开来，使它们的头向上漂浮，并把肺、胃和肠子一并扯出。它们将身体留在醋液浴中，就像蜕壳的螃蟹丢下旧壳一样，然后飞走，去寻找一个充满鲜血与脏腑的受害者。

这些生物在饥饿时固然 grotesque，但庞南加兰在穿着自己的身体时，看起来却年轻而健康。这就是它们存在的本质：它们曾与异界存在勾结，以对年轻人怀有邪恶饥渴为代价，换取了一生的青春。但它们并非不朽。它们会像自己曾经所属的人类一样正常衰老并死去——只是会在这段存在期间始终保持年轻的外貌。

要在人群中发现一只庞南加兰并不容易。它们颈部环绕分离处的淡淡伤痕，可以被解释成瑕疵，也可以藏在一条招摇的项链下面。与此同时，庞南加兰那具被保存起来的身体所散发出的淡淡酸味，虽然古怪，却也并不罕见，毕竟它们常出没于闷热潮湿的热带地区。

Penanggalans feed on the blood and entrails of the young. When their cannibalistic hunger strikes, penanggalans bathe their bodies in an alchemical substance that smells like vinegar. Once submerged in the concoction, their neck rips from side to side, allowing their head to float upward and pull out their lungs, stomach, and intestines. They leave their bodies in the vinegar bath much like a molting crab leaves its old shell, then fly off to find a victim filled with blood and guts.

As grotesque as these creatures are when hungry, the penanggalan appears young and healthy while wearing their body. Such is the nature of their existence: they consorted with otherworldy beings, gaining a lifetime of youth in exchange for an evil hunger for the young. But they are not immortal. They age and die normally like the people they once were-they just retain their youthfulness throughout this existence.

It can be difficult to spot a penanggalan among the populace. The faint scar ringing their neck at the point of separation can be explained away as a blemish, and it can be hidden under a flashy necklace. Meanwhile the faint, sour scent of a penanggalan's preserved body, while peculiar, is not uncommon in the sweaty tropics they frequent.
Yeri.blurb:

Haunting Presence.name: 萦绕之灵 Haunting Presence

Ghostly Menace.name: 幽魂威胁 Ghostly Menace
Ghostly Menace.description:
触发 发生一次作祟遭遇

效果 苦迦菩提以一种可怖的方式显现其存在——突如其来的痛苦尖啸、红色蝴蝶的爆炸性迸发、瞬间令人窒息的腐朽气息，或诸如此类。随机一名玩家角色受到 @Damage[(2d6+3)[mental]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:19|basic] 意志豁免），随后，萦绕之灵消散无踪，只留下心灵创伤与阴影。

Trigger A haunt encounter occurs

Effect Kugaptee's presence makes itself known in a frightening way—a sudden shriek of agony, an explosive burst of red butterflies, a momentarily overwhelming air of decay, or the like. A random PC takes @Damage[(2d6+3)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:19|basic] save), and then the haunting presence vanishes, leaving behind nothing but mental scars and trauma.

Haunting Presence.disable:
@Check[religion|dc:16]以驱除该作祟，或点亮长明灯（会自动解除这些作祟）

Ghostly sounds or glimpses of apparitions move to startle or distract those who walk the streets.

Book of Warding Prayers.name: 护卫祷告之书 Book of Warding Prayers
Book of Warding Prayers.description:
献给@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}。

这本书的书脊饰有外层位面语言的文字，封面上蚀刻着一位神祇的圣徽。护卫祷告之书各自都献给某一位特定神祇，同时也是该神祇的宗教圣徽。

启动 F （专注）

频率 每天一次

触发 你的上一个动作是施放由你的神祇赐予的一个预备神圣法术

效果 你和所有位于 @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] 内的盟友获得10点精魂伤害抗力，持续1分钟。若你施放的法术具有圣洁特征，则你也可以改为赋予对圣洁效果的抗力，而不是对精魂伤害的抗力；若你施放的法术具有邪秽特征，则你也可以改为赋予对邪秽效果的抗力，而不是对精魂伤害的抗力。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.GqXIV46JqB8x8eEN]{效果：护卫祷告之书}

Devoted to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}.

Script in a language of the Outer Planes adorns this book's spine, and a deity's symbol is etched on its cover. Books of warding prayers are each devoted to a particular deity and are also a religious symbol of that deity.

Activate F (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger Your last action was to cast a prepared divine spell granted by your deity

Effect You and all your allies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] gain resistance 10 to spirit damage for 1 minute. You can instead choose to grant resistance to holy effects instead of spirit damage if the spell you cast had the holy trait, or resistance to unholy effects instead of spirit if your spell had the unholy trait.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.GqXIV46JqB8x8eEN]{Effect: Book of Warding Prayers}

Jinkin.name: 蹑影小魔怪 Jinkin

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法任你驱使。只要你维持该法术，你就可以施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择一项。

  • 烹调 冷却、加热，或为 1 磅非生物质料调味。
  • 抬起 将一个无人持握、负载为轻或更低的物体缓慢抬离地面 1 足。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能被用作工具、武器、法器，也不能作为法术的代价。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用 10 轮专注影响一个 1 负载的物体，而更大的物体则每 1 负载需要 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害，也不能导致不利状态。对物体造成的任何实际改变（除上述说明外）都只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
蹑影小魔怪对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物额外造成 1d6 点精准伤害。

The jinkin deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Tinker.name: 修补匠 Tinker
Tinker.description:
一群六只蹑影小魔怪可以协同工作 1 小时，在 60 尺射程内为一个物品施加诅咒。尽管这一过程耗时较长，但也不易察觉，并且可以在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding} 时进行。蹑影小魔怪更喜欢将这种能力用于魔法物品。该诅咒会使该物品变得不可靠（进行 @Check[flat|dc:5] 检定，否则任何用于交互或启动该物品的动作都会被浪费），为使用该物品附加一项怪异的要求，或赋予其他类似程度的诅咒。

A group of six jinkins can work together for an hour to imbue an item with a curse at a range of 60 feet. While this process is lengthy, it's also unobtrusive and can be performed while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding}. Jinkins prefer to use this ability on magic items. The curse makes the item unreliable (@Check[flat|dc:5] check or waste any action to Interact with or Activate the item), adds a bizarre requirement to use the item, or imparts some other curse of a similar caliber.

Jinkin.publicNotes:
蹑影小魔怪是施虐成性的修补匠，会偷窃并破坏物品，并以自己诅咒珍贵物体的能力为傲。它们心怀怨念，一旦觉得自己受了怠慢——例如某个生物竟敢移除它们施加的一道诅咒——便会制定错综复杂的复仇计划。蹑影小魔怪很少满足于制造单纯的混乱；它们同样从折磨与谋杀中获得极大快感，不过比起当场杀死受害者，它们更喜欢把受害者引入那些旨在捕获或使其失能的陷阱之中。深坑是它们偏爱的手段，因为从坠落中幸存下来的受害者，还将面临因饥饿和口渴而缓慢死去的命运；而蹑影小魔怪则聚集在坑边，嘲弄并折磨他们。

小魔怪是残忍的妖精恶作剧者与破坏者，早已完全适应了世间的生活，并为自己富有创意的破坏性找到了鲜明的生态位。几乎所有小魔怪都乐于毁坏或打碎东西，无论那是某种实体之物，如装置或载具，还是联盟或关系之类的无形事物。小魔怪最大的快乐，就是目睹复杂造物的崩塌，且最好是在它们先施以一次轻微而精准推动之后。小魔怪往往会贬低、霸凌，甚至屠杀比自己弱小的同类，尤其是蹑影小魔怪；更强大的小魔怪会轻蔑地称它们为“袋袋”。

Jinkins are sadistic tinkers who steal and sabotage items and take great pride in their power to curse precious objects. They hold grudges and create convoluted plans for revenge when they feel slighted, such as when a creature dares to remove one of their curses. Rarely content to wreak simple mayhem, jinkins also take immense pleasure in torture and murder, though they prefer to lead victims into traps designed to capture or incapacitate rather than just kill them outright. Deep pits are a preferred method, since victims who survive their fall face a slow death from starvation and thirst while jinkins gather at the edge of pits to tease and torment them.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life in the Universe, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. Nearly all gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the slightest, carefully targeted nudge from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom stronger gremlins derisively call "baggies."

Ring of Discretion.name: 谨慎戒指 Ring of Discretion
Ring of Discretion.description:
谨慎戒指会以魔法隐藏你所穿戴的任何护甲和已收入鞘中的武器，方式是要么使其隐形，要么制造出普通衣物的幻象。该戒指除了隐藏武器和护甲之外，不会改变你的外观。一旦你持用受到该戒指影响的武器，该武器就会对旁观者显而易见，并且不再受其影响，直到你将该武器收入鞘中至少 1 分钟。生物可以使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作来检查你并识破这个幻象（[[/act seek dc=15]]{DC 15}），并且每当它以一次攻击命中你时，它都可以不使用动作而尝试这样做。

A ring of discretion magically conceals any armor and sheathed weapons you're wearing by either turning them invisible or creating the illusion of ordinary clothes. The ring doesn't change your appearance beyond concealing weapons and armor. As soon as you wield a weapon affected by the ring, the weapon becomes obvious to onlookers and is no longer affected until you sheathe the weapon for at least 1 minute. A creature can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine you and disbelieve this illusion ([[/act seek dc=15]]{DC 15}), and it can attempt to do so without using an action each time it hits you with an attack.

Twin Bites.name: 双重撕咬 Twin Bites
Twin Bites.description:
双头蛇用它的每个头各进行一次尖牙打击，每次针对不同的目标。两次打击都计入它的多重攻击减值，但在它完成这两次攻击后，减值才会增加。

An amphisbaena makes a fangs Strike with each of its heads, each against a different target. Both Strikes count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after it has made both attacks.

Amphisbaena.publicNotes:
双头蛇是一种极其凶暴、带有剧毒且体型惊人的蝰蛇，在其身体的两端各长着一个头。它的移动方式与更常见的侧风蛇相似，将身体以循环的方式向前抛出，并始终让其中一个头贴在地面上以固定自身。

双头蛇的普通猎物包括兔子、狐狸、各种鸟类、小型鹿类，如果有机会，甚至还会捕食类人生物。它们天性有极强的领地意识，几乎会攻击任何靠近其巢穴的东西，而不管入侵者的体型大小。许多孩子都被告诫不要独自太过深入林地，以免游荡到离双头蛇巢穴太近的地方，成为这种生物的下一餐。

双头蛇的毒液效力极其惊人，若不及时处理，几分钟内就足以放倒一名强壮的矮人。然而，这种毒液在各种治疗药方中也有用途，因此若能采集到，便是很有价值的商品。比如，可能会有人建议孕妇少量饮用经过稀释的毒液，以帮助保住胎儿。将少量毒液与多种草药和油脂混合，可以制成一种能够缓解酸痛的敷剂。因此，双头蛇的形象常出现在许多与治疗和炼金主题相关的场合中，比如酊剂的标签、草药师记录中的注释，以及医药教科书中的插图。

据说，第一条双头蛇是由美杜莎的头被砍下时滴落的血所形成的。这个故事的起源，很可能源于双头蛇对石化有种奇特的免疫力，而这又使得它们有时会被美杜莎当作宠物饲养。饲养双头蛇作为宠物的美杜莎，可能会将这种蝰蛇视为自己最珍爱的伙伴，甚至把它当成自己的孩子。然而，尽管它们有这些传说中的超自然起源，也偶尔会受到特殊对待，双头蛇终究完全是普通的动物，只有最基础的智力，而且没有任何天生的魔法能力。

An amphisbaena is an exceedingly aggressive, venomous viper of remarkable size that bears two heads-one on each end of its body. It moves in a manner similar to that of the more common sidewinder snake, throwing its body forward in a loop and anchoring itself by keeping one head or the other on the ground at all times.

Amphisbaenas' typical prey includes rabbits, foxes, various birds, small deer, and even humanoids if presented the opportunity. Fiercely territorial by nature, they attack just about anything that gets near their lairs, regardless of the intruder's size. Many a child has been warned about going too far into the woods alone, lest they wander too close to an amphisbaena den and become the creature's next meal.

The venom of an amphisbaena is incredibly potent, able to take down a stout dwarf within minutes if left untreated. However, it also has uses in a variety of healing remedies, which makes it a valuable commodity if collected. For example, a pregnant person might be advised to drink the venom in small, dilute doses to help safeguard the pregnancy. Mixing small amounts of the venom with various herbs and oil creates a poultice which dulls aches and pains. As a result, the image of an amphisbaena appears in many contexts associated with healing and alchemical subjects, such as labels for tinctures, annotations in herbalists' records, and illustrations in textbooks of medicine.

The first amphisbaena is said to have formed from the blood that fell as a medusa's head was severed. This story's origin most likely stems from the fact that amphisbaenas are oddly immune to petrification, which in turn leads to them sometimes being kept as pets by a medusa. A medusa who keeps an amphisbaena as a pet might regard the viper as their most treasured companion or perhaps even as their own child. Despite these fabled supernatural origins and the occasional special treatment they receive, however, amphisbaenas are entirely mundane animals with only rudimentary intelligence and no innate magical abilities whatsoever.

Giant Rat.publicNotes:
巨鼠是普通害虫鼠类的巨大版本。它们通常数量众多，但由于无法钻进普通老鼠平时躲藏的那些角落，因此更容易被定位并消灭。它们大多生活在下水道中，从上方街道获取残渣为生，不过也有一些巨鼠家族生活在更偏远的地方，例如潮湿的洞穴、树林或丘陵。老鼠是极其擅长生存的动物，几乎可以在世界上的任何地方发现，不过与寒冷地区相比，它们更偏好温带或温暖的气候。

虽然它的啃咬本身除了对年纪极幼或极老的人之外并不致命，但巨鼠携带着啮齿动物在世界各地传播的腐烂瘟疫——这种疫病完全足以摧毁乡村社区。

老鼠是无处不在的祸害，在世界上几乎每一处定居点的下水道和街道上四处乱窜。虽然一只从脚边飞快窜过的普通老鼠可能会让一般路人吃一惊，甚至感到恐吓，但巨鼠和鼠群要危险得多。

Giant rats are enormous versions of the common vermin. They are typically found in abundant numbers, but since they cannot fit in the nooks where mundane rats typically hide, they are much easier to locate and exterminate. They mostly live in sewers where they can scavenge from the streets above, but some families of giant rats live in more remote locations, such as dank caves, forests or hills. Rats are incredibly adept survivors and can be found nearly anywhere in the world, though they tend to favor temperate or warm climates as opposed to cold regions.

Although its bite alone is not lethal except to the very young or very old, the giant rat carries the putrid plague common to rodents around the world—a pestilence more than capable of ravaging rural communities.

Rats are a ubiquitous menace, scurrying through the sewers and on the streets of nearly every settlement in the world. Though a regular rat darting underfoot might startle or even frighten the average passerby, giant rats and rat swarms are far more dangerous.

Slime Mold.publicNotes:
黏菌看起来像一堆泥土和碎屑，上面覆盖着厚厚一层真菌，散发出淡淡的腐朽恶臭。实际上，这种真菌与黏菌之间是共生关系：它充当体外消化系统，同时获得自身所需的营养。软泥怪会一动不动地静伏，直到活着的猎物进入触及之内，随后便用令人作呕的假足猛然袭击。只需接触一下，黏菌就能让猎物感染一种名为黏液腐疫的可怕传染病，这是一种会痛苦地分解受害者血肉的骇人疾病。起初，这种疾病会显现为疼痛的皮疹与剧痛的关节。然而到了后续阶段，受影响生物的血肉会真的开始液化，化作一道道细流淌下，而这种生物体内的孢子仍会持续作用。一旦死亡发生，尸体很快就会裂开，并释放出一个全新的黏菌。

由于拥有怪异的身体结构，以及分解并摄食种类繁多材料的能力，软泥怪几乎能够适应任何气候，尤其是在魔法或炼金改造的帮助下更是如此。因此，探险者经常会遭遇这些无定形生物的新种类，而它们往往同样可怖。

A slime mold appears as a mound of earth and detritus covered in a thick layer of fungus that exudes a faint stink of decay. The fungus actually shares a symbiotic relationship with the slime mold, serving as an external digestive system while gaining access to the nutrients it needs. The ooze remains perfectly still until living prey passes within reach, then it lashes out with disgusting pseudopods. With a touch, a slime mold can infect its prey with a foul contagion known as slime rot, a horrific disease that painfully breaks down a victim's flesh. At first, the disease manifests as painful rashes and agonized joints. In the later stages, though, the flesh of the affected creature actually begins to liquefy and run in rivulets as the creature's spores continue to work. Death, when it occurs, swiftly causes the resulting body to split open and release a brand new slime mold.

Due to their bizarre physical structures and ability to break down and feed on a wide variety of materials, oozes are able to adapt to nearly any climate, especially when assisted by magical or alchemical tinkering. As a result, explorers frequently encounter new and terrifying varieties of these amorphous creatures.

Air Walk.name: 凌空而行 Air Walk
Air Walk.description:
目标可以如同行走在坚实地面上一样在空气中行走。它可以以这种方式按最大45度角上升和下降。

The target can walk on air as if it were solid ground. It can ascend and descend in this way at a maximum of a 45-degree angle.

Divine Wrath.name: 神圣狂怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你将神性的怒火倾泻向敌人。区域内的敌人根据其强韧豁免，受到4d10精魂伤害。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

大失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}；当其处于恶心状态时，还会同时处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

强化（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Crisis of Faith.name: 信仰危机 Crisis of Faith
Crisis of Faith.description:
你攻击目标的信仰，使该生物充满怀疑与心灵动荡，造成 6d6 心灵伤害；若其能够施放神术，则改为造成 6d8 心灵伤害。其效果由其意志豁免决定。

对许多神祇而言，若无重大理由，对自己所信奉神祇的追随者施放此法术是一种禁忌。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全额伤害；若目标能够施放神术，则其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续 1 轮。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续 1 轮，并且在 1 轮内无法施放神术。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6（若目标是神术施法者，则改为增加 2d8）。

You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal 6d6 mental damage, or 6d8 mental damage if it can cast divine spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.

To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 (or by 2d8 if the target is a divine spellcaster).

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触会从目标体内吸取生命力来强化自身。你对目标造成 6d6 点虚空伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果后）。1 分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Deafness.name: 耳聋术 Deafness
Deafness.description:
目标失去听觉；它必须尝试一次强韧豁免。随后，目标会暂时免疫 1 分钟。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋} 1 轮。

失败 目标陷入耳聋 10 分钟。

大失败 目标将永久耳聋。

The target loses hearing; it must attempt a Fortitude save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Failure The target is Deafened for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The target is Deafened permanently.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开一个法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。若你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在 10 分钟内变成其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标是神器或类似物品，你会自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Sound Burst.name: 音爆术 Sound Burst
Sound Burst.description:
刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋} 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入耳聋 1 分钟，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Spiritual Weapon.name: 灵能武器 Spiritual Weapon
Spiritual Weapon.description:
一把由纯粹魔法力场构成的武器会显现，并攻击你在射程内指定的敌人。这把武器具有幽魂般的外观，并会显现为一根短棒、一把匕首，或你神祇的偏好武器。

当你施放该法术时，这把武器会出现在你于射程内选择的一个敌人旁边，并对其进行一次打击。每次你维持该法术时，你都可以将这把武器移动到射程内的一个新目标旁边（如果有需要），并用其进行一次打击。灵能武器会使用并计入你的多重攻击减值。

这把武器的打击属于近战法术攻击。无论其外观如何，这把武器都造成2d8点力场伤害。你可以令其改为造成该武器通常造成的伤害类型，而非力场伤害（若为多变武器，则可选择其可用伤害类型中的任一种）。该武器的其他数据或特征均不适用，即使是远程武器也只能攻击邻接的生物。尽管灵能武器进行的是法术攻击，但就触发、抗力等而言，它仍然算作武器。

这把武器不占据空间，不提供夹击，也不具有生物会拥有的任何其他属性。该武器除了其打击之外不能进行任何其他攻击，而影响武器的专长或法术也不适用于它。

升阶（+2） 该武器的伤害提高1d8。

A weapon made of pure magical force materializes and attacks foes you designate within range. This weapon has a ghostly appearance and manifests as a club, a dagger, or your deity's favored weapon.

When you cast the spell, the weapon appears next to a foe you choose within range and makes a Strike against it. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can move the weapon to a new target within range (if needed) and Strike with it. The spiritual weapon uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty.

The weapon's Strikes are melee spell attacks. Regardless of its appearance, the weapon deals 2d8 force damage. You can deal damage of the type normally dealt by the weapon instead of force damage (or any of the available damage types for a versatile weapon). No other statistics or traits of the weapon apply, and even a ranged weapon attacks adjacent creatures only. Despite making a spell attack, the spiritual weapon is a weapon for purposes of triggers, resistances, and so forth.

The weapon doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The weapon can't make any attack other than its Strike, and feats or spells that affect weapons do not apply to it.

Heightened (+2) The weapon's damage increases by 1d8.

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你发出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你、逃离你（如同其具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}状态）、放开其手中持有的东西、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或原地站住不动。在服从你的命令之前，它不能延缓，也不能采取任何反应动作（）。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下一回合的第一个动作时，该生物必须使用一个单动作来按你的命令行事。

大失败 目标在其下一回合必须使用其所有动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你至多可以将 10 个生物作为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标心神迷乱，并以一次精神冲击使其眩晕。该冲击造成等于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Divine Lance.name: 圣枪术 Divine Lance
Divine Lance.description:
你释放一道神圣能量光束。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 2d4 点精魂伤害（若造成重击，则伤害加倍）。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Guidance.name: 神导术 Guidance
Guidance.description:
你请求神圣指引，给予目标在持续时间结束前进行的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定 +1 状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择将该加值用于哪一次掷骰。如果目标使用了该加值，则该法术结束。无论如何，目标随后都会暂时免疫 1 小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{法术效果：神导术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

You ask for divine guidance, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚无能量来伤害活物或治疗不死生物。如果目标是活着的生物，你对其造成1d8点虚无伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。如果目标是自愿的不死生物，你恢复等量生命值。你在施放此法术时所花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 （姿势） 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （言语，姿势） 该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个不死生物，恢复的生命值增加8点。

3 （材料，言语，姿势） 你将虚无能量散布于30尺散发内。这会以区域内所有活着的生物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害量增加1d8，且双动作版本的额外治疗增加8点。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道汲取敌人力量的射线从你的手中闪出。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则将其豁免结果按低一级的成功等级来处理。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智以感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何经由你告知其灵光信息的人，对该物品进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时获得 +2 环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将 10 个物体作为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以将任意数量的物体作为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Sanctuary.name: 庇护术 Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
你以防护能量护佑一个生物，阻止敌人的攻击。试图攻击目标的生物每次都必须进行一次意志豁免。如果目标使用了敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试进行其此次攻击，以及本回合中针对目标的任何其他攻击。

失败 该生物不能攻击目标，并浪费该动作。它在本回合中不能进一步尝试针对目标的攻击。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，且在庇护术的剩余持续时间内不能尝试攻击目标。

You ward a creature with protective energy that deters enemy attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一面魔法力场护盾。这视为使用举起护盾动作，使你获得 AC +1 环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，但使用时不需要手。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{护盾格挡} 反应动作（）。该护盾具有 5 硬度。在你使用护盾格挡后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内不能再次施放它。不同于正常的护盾格挡，你可以使用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{力场弹幕} 法术。

法术升阶会提高该护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（3环） 该护盾具有 10 硬度。

升阶（5环） 该护盾具有 15 硬度。

升阶（7环） 该护盾具有 20 硬度。

升阶（9环） 该护盾具有 25 硬度。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Chastise Heretic.name: 惩戒异教徒 Chastise Heretic
Chastise Heretic.description:
触发 辛月看见的60尺内一名生物施放一个神圣法术

效果 辛月尝试以她的法术攻击调整和4级反制等级来反制该触发法术。若该法术被反制，施法者受到 @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] 精神伤害。若辛月反制该法术失败，则该施法者在24小时内暂时免疫此能力的进一步使用。

Trigger a creature within 60 feet who Xin Yue can see casts a divine spell

Effect Xin Yue attempts to counteract the triggering spell using her spell attack modifier and a counteract rank of 4. If the spell is counteracted, the caster takes @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage. If Xin Yue fails to counteract the spell, the caster is temporarily immune to further uses of this ability for 24 hours.

Field of Past Regrets.name: 前尘憾事气场 Field of Past Regrets
Field of Past Regrets.description:
40英尺。气场内所有至少拥有一个前世的生物（包括肆季鬼志中的所有PC）都会回想起自己前世中的失败，并因此更能避免重蹈覆辙，获得对抗精神效果的豁免骰+1状态加值。气场内活着且非宁多鲁的生物在承受精神攻击时，会感受到其所有前世的痛苦，以及自己当前的痛苦，并获得对精神伤害的弱点3。

40 feet. All creatures within the aura who have at least one past life (including all PCs in Season of Ghosts) recall failures in their past lives and are bolstered against repeating them, gaining a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects. Living, non-nindoru creatures within the aura feel the pain of all their past lives, as well as their own current pain when they endure mental attacks, and gain weakness 3 to mental damage.

Profane Reincarnation.name: 亵渎转生 Profane Reincarnation
Profane Reincarnation.description:
频率 每1,000天一次

触发 辛月的生命值降至0

效果 辛月发出一声尖啸，她的亡灵身体裂开，她的短剑变为破损。她立刻以具有精英生物调整的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.season-of-ghosts-bestiary.Actor.TVi4RDeqw7GDsxp0]{索闹}宁多鲁形态转生。

Frequency once every 1,000 days

Trigger Xin Yue is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect Xin Yue utters a shriek as her undead body splits open and her shortsword becomes broken. She's instantly reincarnated as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.season-of-ghosts-bestiary.Actor.TVi4RDeqw7GDsxp0]{Sojiruh} nindoru with the elite creature adjustment.

Near-Death Experience.name: 濒死体验 Near-Death Experience
Near-Death Experience.description:
触发 辛月将一个生物的生命值降至 0，并使其获得濒死（状态）

效果 对这个濒死的生物而言，时间仿佛慢了下来；濒死体验带来的巨大压力迫使其大脑超速运转。目标看见自己的一生在眼前闪过，而抵御死亡的冲动也变得无比强烈。目标的复苏检定难度等级减少 2，但如果其失去濒死（状态），则必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:25] 豁免。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.3HaT8gBo8krdVniF]{效果：濒死体验}

大成功 该生物被这段经历激励，获得快速治疗 5，持续 1 分钟。

成功 该生物被这段经历激励，获得快速治疗 1，持续 1 分钟。

失败 该生物因这段经历而变得消沉，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续 24 小时。

大失败 该生物被这段经历冲击得摇摇欲坠。其陷入呆滞 1，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 1}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.ejnUAEdbvj6uPuNJ]{效果：濒死体验治疗}

Trigger Xin Yue reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points and causes them to gain the dying condition

Effect Time appears to slow down to the dying creature as the immense stress of their near-death experience pushes their brain into overdrive. The target sees their life flash before their eyes, and the urge to resist death grows strong. The target reduces the DC of their recovery checks by 2, but if they lose the dying condition, they must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.3HaT8gBo8krdVniF]{Effect: Near-Death Experience}

Critical Success The creature is empowered by the experience and gains fast healing 5 for 1 minute.

Success The creature is empowered by the experience and gains fast healing 1 for 1 minute.

Failure The creature becomes depressed by the experience and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours.

Critical Failure The creature reels from the experience. They become stupefied 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.ejnUAEdbvj6uPuNJ]{Effect: Near-Death Experience Healing}

Xin Yue.publicNotes:
不死侍僧通常会在某位神祇或其神使消耗少量力量、让一名低阶祭司重返人间时出现。有些祭司生前足够强大，能够凭借自己的意志归来，但力量会大幅衰减。

不死侍僧在亡灵之中算是异类：他们既不是自愿转化而成，严格来说，也不是违背自身意志被转化的。不死侍僧的创造是神祇直接干预的结果，通常既是一种奖励，也是一种诅咒；它会赐予一位忠诚的祭司，而这位祭司之所以未能完成神圣使命，是因为遭遇了超出其控制的情况。

Deathless acolytes typically arise when a deity or their herald expends a minor amount of power to return a low-ranking priest. Some priests are powerful enough in life to return, greatly lessened, of their own volition.

Deathless acolytes are an oddity among undead, neither willingly transformed nor, strictly speaking, transformed against their will. The creation of a deathless acolyte is an act of direct intervention by a deity, typically as a double-edged reward and curse granted to a faithful priest who failed in completing a divine mandate due to circumstances beyond their control.
Xin Yue.blurb: 苦迦菩提的女性变体不死侍僧 Female variant deathless acolyte of Kugaptee

Gallows Tooth.name: 绞刑架之牙 Gallows Tooth
Gallows Tooth.description:
启动 A（操作）

这颗可怖的臼齿悬挂在一根绳索上，绳索穿过其干枯、裸露的根源上方的一个孔洞。当你启动这个护符时，对一个相邻的生物进行一次近战打击。该生物在对此次打击时以及直到你的回合结束前处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

Activate A (manipulate)

This grisly molar hangs from a cord threaded through a hole just above its dried, exposed root. When you activate this talisman, make a melee Strike against an adjacent creature. That creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the Strike and until the end of your turn.

Jade Bauble.name: 翡翠小饰物 Jade Bauble
Jade Bauble.description:
启动 A（专注）

这块玉石通常被雕刻成决斗家的形状，有时也会是多臂生物的形状。当你启动这枚饰物时，它会以魔法吸引敌人的注意。直到你下个回合开始前，位于该护符所附着武器触及范围内的敌人均为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

Activate A (concentrate)

This bit of jade is usually carved in the shape of a duelist, or sometimes a multi-armed creature. When you activate the bauble, it magically draws the attention of foes. Until the start of your next turn, enemies within the reach of the weapon the talisman is affixed to are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

Frost.name: 霜冻 Frost
Frost.description:
这件武器被冰冻寒霜强化。它在成功打击时额外造成1d6点寒冷伤害。若大成功命中，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到你的下个回合结束，除非它通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24|name:Frost Rune|showDC:all]强韧豁免。

This weapon is empowered with freezing ice. It deals an additional 1d6 cold damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24|name:Frost Rune|showDC:all] save.

Silver and Sapphire Ring.name: 银与蓝宝石戒指 Silver and Sapphire Ring

Ren Mei Li's Scroll.name: 任美璃的卷轴 Ren Mei Li's Scroll
Ren Mei Li's Scroll.tokenName: 任美璃的卷轴 Ren Mei Li's Scroll

Scroll of Sending (Rank 5).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R9xqCBblkS5KE4y7]{短讯术}

从卷轴施放法术需要将卷轴持于一只手中，并以该法术正常所需的动作数进行一次施法（行动）来启动它。

该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。由于是你在施放该法术，因此使用你的法术攻击调整和法术DC。该法术还会获得与你根源对应的适当特征（奥术、神圣、异能或原始）。

卷轴制作时已提供任何实体材料成本，因此你在从卷轴施法时无需再提供这些成本。如果该法术需要法器，你必须拥有该法器才能从卷轴施放该法术。

注意：要创建特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从 compendium 或 compendium browser 拖入玩家角色、非玩家角色或战利品角色的物品栏中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R9xqCBblkS5KE4y7]{Sending}

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when casting from a scroll. If the spell requires a locus, you must have that locus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).name: 隐形术（任意使用，仅限自身）
Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).description:
幻象会使光线环绕目标弯曲，使其成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试找到目标，从而使其对它们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}。如果目标进行敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标进行敌对动作，它也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Bean Panic.name: 豆子恐慌 Bean Panic
Bean Panic.description:
恶鬼会奇怪地害怕豆子，尤其是在季节开始变换时。如果一个生物以交互动作向恶鬼扔出一把豆子，恶鬼会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。以这种方式处于惊惧时，其对精魂伤害的弱点增加 5。随后，该恶鬼对豆子恐慌获得 24 小时免疫。

Oni are curiously afraid of beans, especially as the seasons begin to change. If a creature Interacts to throw a handful of beans at the oni, the oni becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. While frightened this way, their weakness to spirit damage is increased by 5. The oni then becomes immune to bean panic for 24 hours.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
山岳恶鬼可以呈现任何中型或大型类人生物的外观。这不会改变其速度，也不会改变其打击的攻击加值和伤害加值，但可能会改变其打击造成的伤害类型（通常变为钝击）。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The mountain oni can take on the appearance of any Medium or Large humanoid creature. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Thundering Iron.name: 雷鸣铁 Thundering Iron
Thundering Iron.description:
恶鬼举起它们的铁棒，以震耳欲聋的轰鸣猛然砸下。它们进行一次铁棒打击。若成功，目标额外受到 1d10 点音波伤害。

目标周围 @Template[emanation|distance:10] 内的每个生物，除了恶鬼之外，也会受到此伤害，并被从目标处推开 5 尺。

The oni lifts their tetsubo and brings it down in a deafening peal. They make a tetsubo Strike. On a success, the target takes an additional 1d10 sonic damage.

Each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the target, other than the oni, take this damage as well and is pushed 5 feet away from the target.

Mountain Oni.publicNotes:
山岳恶鬼是最常见的恶鬼，且常被认为是最不老练的一类。其他恶鬼或许与灵界有更强的联系，但山岳恶鬼对满足自己永不止息的食欲之外的事几乎毫无兴趣。懒惰与暴食是山岳恶鬼常见的恶习，这使它们只要吃得饱，便能与附近村庄共存；但更有野心的山岳恶鬼则常被发现率领食人魔战帮，或策划暴力的土匪劫掠。山岳恶鬼很少独自生活，但那些离群索居者更喜欢劫掠乡野，或剥削村庄并将战利品据为己有。

恶鬼是源自天夏的高大残暴生物，外形类似皮肤色彩鲜艳、长着獠牙与犄角的类人生物。尽管它们常被误认为是邪魔，但最初的恶鬼原本是神使，即守护自然的灵体。这些神使遭受了可怕的创伤：它们因剧烈的灾害或他人的冷酷无情而失去了自己神圣的受监护者，因此转变成了如今这般暴烈的生物。尽管有些人相信，只要通过恰当的仪式崇拜安抚恶鬼，就能使其重新变回神使，但许多这类自命的拯救者最终都倒在恶鬼臭名昭著的蛮横力量、撕裂血肉的利齿以及对风暴的掌控之下。

恶鬼拥有将自己伪装成其他类人生物的能力。它们在伪装上很少有创意，往往会选择一个与自身恶鬼形态相似的特定外观，并始终保持如此。然而，这种简单反而常令人措手不及，因为人们往往以为恶鬼只能变成一种固定的替代形态，而事实绝非如此。

Mountain oni are the most common oni and often considered the least sophisticated. While other oni might have a stronger connection to the spiritual world, mountain oni have little interest in anything beyond satisfying their relentless appetites. Sloth and gluttony are common vices among mountain oni, which can allow them to coexist with nearby villages so long as they're well fed, but more ambitious mountain oni can often be found leading ogre war parties or orchestrating violent bandit raids. It's rare for mountain oni to live solitary existences, but those who do prefer to maraud the countryside or exploit villages and hoard the spoils for themselves.

Oni are large, brutal creatures originating in Tian Xia who resemble humanoids with brightly colored skin, tusks, and horns. Though commonly mistaken for fiends, the first oni were originally kami, tutelary nature spirits. These kami suffered a terrible trauma, losing their sacred wards to dramatic disasters or the callousness of others, and as a result transformed into the violent creatures they are today. While some believe that oni can be spiritually placated through proper ritual worship that transforms them back into kami, many of these would-be saviors fall to oni's notorious brute strength, flesh-rending teeth, and command of storms.

Oni possess the ability to disguise themselves as other humanoids. They are rarely creative in their disguises, often choosing a specific appearance similar to their oni form and sticking with it. This simplicity catches many by surprise, however, as people assume oni are limited to a single alternate form, which is by no means the case.

Arms of the Drowned.name: 溺死鬼的邀请 Arms of the Drowned
Arms of the Drowned.tokenName: 溺死鬼的邀请 Arms of the Drowned

Rising Waters.name: 涨潮之水 Rising Waters
Rising Waters.description:
触发 一名生物游过河流一半以上的距离、在桥神龛中结束其回合，或踏上北侧桥梁

效果 幽魂之臂从河流中升起，抓住并摇晃两座桥。站在桥上的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:20] 豁免，否则会被击倒并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。一股河水在圣祠内向上喷涌，将两群幼水蛭群冲入圣祠中。随后，该作祟与水蛭群掷先攻。

Trigger A creature swims more than halfway across the river, ends their turn in the bridge shrine, or sets foot onto the northern bridge

Effect Ghostly arms rise up from the river to grab and shake both bridges. Creatures standing on the bridge must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A blast of river water sprays up inside the shrine to deposit two brood leech swarms in the shrine. The haunt and the leech swarms then roll initiative.

Arms of the Drowned.disable:
@Check[religion|dc:20]以进行祷告来安抚作祟，或 @Check[intimidation|dc:23]以威胁那些不得安宁的精魂离开

@Check[religion|dc:20] to offer prayers to calm the haunt, or @Check[intimidation|dc:23] to threaten the unquiet spirits away
Arms of the Drowned.hazarddescription:
幽魂之臂从水中升起，紧抓并攫取，而一股布满水蛭的喷涌水流向上喷入中央圣祠。

Ghostly arms rise up from the water to clutch and grab, while a geyser of leech-infested water sprays up into the central shrine.
Arms of the Drowned.reset:
如果玩家角色不在河流中、桥上或圣祠内，则该作祟会在任何此类轮开始时停用并重置；但水蛭群会在圣祠中继续停留10分钟，然后才撤回到下方的水中。

The haunt deactivates and resets at the start of any round in which the PCs aren't in the river, on the bridges, or in the shrines, but the leech swarms remain in the shrine for 10 minutes before retreating back into the water below.
Arms of the Drowned.routine:
（3 动作）幽魂之臂胡乱挥舞，并试图抓取圣祠内或任一桥上的生物。每轮，作祟会使用 3 动作，尝试对桥上或圣祠内的一名玩家角色进行擒拿。如果一名玩家角色处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}，作祟可以使用其一个动作将该玩家角色拖入河流。若一名玩家角色在河流中处于束缚，则有溺水风险。

(3 actions) Ghostly arms flail about and attempt to grab creatures in the shrine or on either bridge. Each round, the haunt uses 3 actions to attempt to grapple a PC on the bridge or in the shrine. If a PC is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, the haunt can use one of its actions to drag a PC into the river. A PC who's restrained in the river risks drowning.
Arms of the Drowned.stealthdetails:
（专家）瞥见下方水中溺亡的幽魂身影。

(expert) to catch glimpses of ghostly figures drowning in the water below.
Arms of the Drowned.prototypeToken: 溺死鬼的邀请 Arms of the Drowned

Watchers of the Cycle.name: 循环的守望者 Watchers of the Cycle
Watchers of the Cycle.description:
本书的前半部分收录了数百则短小的寓言与故事，摘选自各种各样的宗教，并逐一整理为可传授给善解的信徒的教诲。若角色在研究任何与桑博齐或转生术相关的主题时参考此书，则其进行任何善解学识或宗教的回忆知识检定时，获得+1物品加值。本书的后半部分则收录了数个仪式的配方，包括 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yrsgOdj5oqp7lEQY]{食月}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.INEAWirvb8c1eAFD]{终夜守夜}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksJFGSGlNpUhwcsp]{掠夺黑夜}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FQZaQXiKtHdVjSc5]{招待失者}，以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wAJ8mXPYbyAg0qWX]{如蜜冬至}（以上所有仪式都详载于本卷的《冒险工具箱》中）。本书最后几页收录了仪式 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{转生术} 的配方。

The first half of this book contains hundreds of short parables and stories culled from a wide range of religions, each curated for the lessons they can impart to a follower of Sangpotshi. If a character references this book while researching any topic relating to Sangpotshi or reincarnation, they gain a +1 item bonus to any Sangpotshi Lore or Religion checks to Recall Knowledge. The second half of the book contains the formulas for several rituals, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yrsgOdj5oqp7lEQY]{Gnaw at the Moon}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.INEAWirvb8c1eAFD]{Last Night's Vigil}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksJFGSGlNpUhwcsp]{Ransack the Night}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FQZaQXiKtHdVjSc5]{Regale the Lost Ones}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wAJ8mXPYbyAg0qWX]{Sweetest Solstice} (all of these rituals are detailed in this volume’s Adventure Toolbox. The final pages of the book contain the formula for the ritual @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{Reincarnate}.

Collection of the Teachings of Sangpotsh.name: 桑波措教义集 Collection of the Teachings of Sangpotsh
Collection of the Teachings of Sangpotsh.description:
一小批尤为罕见、关于桑博齐教诲的书籍；作为整体，在调查或对与这一哲学相关的主题进行回忆知识时，给予善解学识、忍堕魔学识和宗教检定 +2 物品加值。

A small selection of particularly rare books on the teachings of Sangpotshi that, as a whole, grants a +2 item bonus to Sangpotshi Lore, Nindoru Lore, and Religion checks while Investigating or Recalling Knowledge on topics related to this philosophy.
