Air Wisp.name: 气灵缕 Air Wisp

Accord Essence.name: 协调精华 Accord Essence
Accord Essence.description:
触发 30尺内一名在过去1小时内受益于灵缕共鸣的盟友成为一次攻击的目标

效果 灵缕引爆自身，造成一次元素爆炸。这使得过去1小时内受益于灵缕共鸣的、位于 @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30尺}散发内的盟友获得等同于灵缕当前生命值一半的临时生命值。这些临时生命值持续1小时。

使用此反应动作的灵缕会被永久摧毁，且只能通过 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{祈愿术} 仪式或类似强大的效果恢复。若某项能力会阻止灵缕被摧毁（例如，若灵缕是被召唤而来，本应仅仅被遣散），则协调精华不起作用。

Trigger An ally within 30 feet that benefited from the wisp's resonance in the last hour is targeted by an attack

Effect The wisp detonates themself in an elemental explosion. This grants temporary Hit Points equal to half the wisp's current Hit Points to allies within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} who have benefited from the wisp's resonance in the last hour. These temporary Hit Points last 1 hour.

A wisp that uses this reaction is permanently destroyed, and they can be restored by only a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual or similarly powerful effect. If an ability would prevent the wisp's destruction (for instance, if the wisp is summoned and would merely be dismissed), Accord Essence has no effect.

Resonance.name: 共鸣 Resonance
Resonance.description:
30尺。所有气灵缕都以与其元素协调一致的频率振动，与所有共享该特征的生物和效果共鸣并赋予其力量。

区域内的生物在具有气（特征）的效果的攻击掷骰和伤害掷骰上获得+1状态加值；具有元素和气（特征）特征的生物则在所有攻击掷骰和伤害掷骰上获得此加值。

30 feet. All wisps vibrate at a frequency attuned to their element, resonating with and empowering all creatures and effects sharing that trait.

A creature in the area gains a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for effects with the air trait; a creature with the elemental and air traits gains this bonus to all attack and damage rolls.

In Concert.name: 协同行动 In Concert
In Concert.description:
当气灵缕在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{协助}的检定时掷出大失败，则改为失败；当其掷出成功时，则改为大成功。

When an air wisp rolls a critical failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid}, they get a failure instead, and when they roll a success, they get a critical success instead.

Plane of Air Lore.name: 气之位面传说 Plane of Air Lore

Air Wisp.publicNotes:
气灵缕是漂浮的云团与风暴球体，持续不断地发出轻柔而低语般的嗡鸣。它们顽皮又反复无常，对陌生人怀有强烈的好奇。

灵缕是微小的元素生灵，诞生于元素位面创建之时。最初的灵缕以不断变化的交响之群游荡于内层天体，每次相遇都会彼此交换成员。这些自由灵缕组成的交响群凭借彼此结合的共鸣创造音乐，但当邪恶的元素领主意识到灵缕共鸣的价值后，他们便捕获了整支交响群，将其作为仆役使用。

灵缕会彼此调谐，也会与自己环绕相伴者调谐。这种调谐使它们天生就是支持同伴的盟友。自由灵缕依然游荡于内层天体与宇宙之中，但它们通常很害羞，会对陌生人躲藏起来。不过，对于向它们展现善意的人，它们也乐于提供服务。它们尤其容易被修习元素魔法的施法者吸引；这些灵缕通常会从远处观察，但有时也会接近那些看起来安全的人，成为魔宠或伙伴。

彼此找到对方的自由灵缕几乎会立刻变得亲密无间。当它们发现属于其他元素的灵缕时，更会格外兴奋，完全不见不同位面的元素生物之间有时会表现出的敌意。相反，它们会一同加入一场兴奋的舞蹈，散发出的共鸣依稀回响着远古岁月的交响。

Air wisps are floating spheres of cloud and storm, perpetually humming a light, whispery tone. They're playful and capricious, with great curiosity toward strangers.

Wisps are tiny elemental beings that emerged during the creation of the Elemental Planes. The first wisps roamed the Inner Sphere in shifting symphonies that traded members with their every meeting. These symphonies of free wisps created music out of their combined resonances, but when the wicked Elemental Lords realized the value of the wisps' resonance, they captured whole symphonies for use as servants.

Wisps attune to each other and to those they surround themselves with. This attunement makes them naturally supportive allies. Free wisps still roam the Inner Sphere and the Universe, but they're usually shy and hide themselves from strangers. However, they happily offer their service to those who show them kindness. They especially find themselves drawn to spellcasters who practice elemental magic; these wisps usually watch from afar but sometimes approach those who seem safe to become familiars or comrades.

Free wisps who find one another become close almost immediately. They get especially excited when they find wisps of elements other than their own, showing none of the animosity sometimes exhibited between elementals of different planes. Instead, they join in an excited dance, emitting resonances that faintly echo the symphonies of ancient days.
Air Wisp.blurb:
精英空气灵火
Elite Air Wisps

Battle Axe.name: 战斧 Battle Axe
Battle Axe.description:
这些斧头被明确设计为武器，而非工具。它们通常更轻，斧柄以金属箍或弩矢加固，且刃部更锋利，因此更适合砍断肢体而不是劈木头。

These axes are designed explicitly as weapons, rather than tools. They typically weigh less, with a shaft reinforced with metal bands or bolts, and have a sharper blade, making them ideal for chopping limbs rather than wood.

Vanth.name: 万斯 Vanth

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你瞬间将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见且位于射程内的一处未被占据的空间。若这会使另一生物与你一同被带走——即使你是将其装在异次元容器中携带——该法术会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。此后，你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Translocate (At Will).name: 传送（随意）
Translocate (At Will).description:
你立即将自己以及你正穿戴和持握的任何物品从当前空间传送到你视线内射程中的一个未被占据的空间。如果这会让另一个生物随你一同传送——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器中——该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见目的地，只要你曾经到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。随后你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Holy Light.name: 圣光 Holy Light
Holy Light.description:
你射出一道带有圣能的炽烈光线。进行一次远程法术攻击。该光线造成 5d6 点火焰伤害。如果目标具有邪秽（特征），你会额外造成 5d6 点精魂伤害。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害。

成功 目标承受全部伤害。

如果光线穿过一片魔法黑暗术区域，或以一个受魔法黑暗术影响的生物为目标，圣光会尝试反制该黑暗术。如果你需要判定光线是否穿过一片黑暗术区域，在你与该法术的目标之间画一条线。

升阶（+1） 火焰伤害增加 2d6，且对邪秽生物造成的精魂伤害增加 2d6。

You shine a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target has the unholy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, holy light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.

Locate.name: 定位 Locate
Locate.description:
你得知目标的方向（如果你选择的是特定物体，例如“我母亲的剑”），或者最近目标的方向（如果你选择的是某类物体，例如“剑”）。如果目标是特定物体，你必须曾用自己的感官直接观察过它。如果目标是某类物体，你仍然需要对该类物体有准确的心灵印象。如果你与目标之间隔着铅或流动的水，这个法术就无法定位该物体。这意味着，如果最近的那件物体位于铅或流动的水之后，你可能会找到更远处的同类物体。

升阶（5环） 你可以将目标改为特定生物或族裔，而非物体，但你必须曾见过该生物，或曾近距离见过你想要作为目标的该族裔成员。

You learn the direction to the target (if you picked a specific object, such as "my mother's sword") or the nearest target (if you picked a type of object, such as "swords"). If the target is a specific object, you must have observed it directly with your own senses. If it's a type of object, you still need to have an accurate mental image of the type of object. If there's lead or running water between you and the target, this spell can't locate the object. This means you might find a type of object farther away if the nearest one is behind lead or running water.

Heightened (5th) You can target a specific creature or ancestry instead of an object, but you must have met or seen up close the creature or ancestry you want to target.

Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).name: 隐形术（随意施放，仅限自身）
Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).description:
幻象使光线围绕目标弯曲，使其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态。这使其对所有生物而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}状态，尽管这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其改为对它们处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态。如果目标进行敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标进行敌对动作，它不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Infuse Weapon.name: 灌注武器 Infuse Weapon
Infuse Weapon.description:
万斯的长柄镰刀是其职权象征，并获得了其部分个人力量。这把长柄镰刀会变成一把+1 长柄镰刀，并且当万斯持用它时，它被视为精金制成。若万斯的长柄镰刀被夺走或摧毁，它可以花费 1 小时的工作为一把新的长柄镰刀注入力量。

A vanth's scythe is its symbol of office and gains a measure of its personal power. This scythe becomes a +1 scythe and is treated as if it were adamantine while the vanth wields it. A vanth whose scythe is taken or destroyed can infuse a new one with an hour of work.

Shepherd's Touch.name: 牧羊人的接触 Shepherd's Touch
Shepherd's Touch.description:
万斯的打击以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}属性符文的效果影响虚体生物，并对活着的生物造成 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，对亡灵造成 @Damage[2d6[vitality]] 伤害。

A vanth's Strikes affect incorporeal creatures with the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune and deal @Damage[2d6[void]] damage to living creatures and @Damage[2d6[vitality]] damage to undead.

Vanth's Curse.name: 凡斯的诅咒 Vanth's Curse
Vanth's Curse.description:
频率 每天三次

效果 万斯通过用其长柄镰刀触碰一名生物来赋予其一项诅咒。该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:25] 豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并在24小时内暂时免疫凡斯的诅咒。

成功 目标感到一阵短暂的厄运战栗，并因这种扰乱性的感觉而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1分钟。

失败 目标变得忧郁而消沉，因为它接受了自己不可避免的命运。在1小时内，目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}。每当目标获得濒死（状态）时，其呆滞（状态）值增加1，最大增加至 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 4}。

大失败 如失败，但该效果为永久。

Frequency three times per day

Effect The vanth bestows a curse on a creature by touching it with its scythe. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Vanth's Curse for 24 hours.

Success The target feels a momentary shudder of doom and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute by the distracting sensation.

Failure The target becomes morose and glum as it accepts its own inevitable fate. For 1 hour, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}. Each time the target gains the dying condition, the stupefied condition value increases by 1, to a maximum value of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect is permanent.

Vanth.publicNotes:
作为骨园的保护者、死者严厉而坚定的守护者，万斯是引魂使，它们看起来像长着渡鸦般翅膀、戴着酷似秃鹫头骨面具的骷髅。万斯携带黑色长柄镰刀，与那些试图扰乱灵魂自然进程者作战，并且它们将任何来到骨园的访客都视为潜在的麻烦制造者。它们很少说话，更少显露除对使命冷酷坚守之外的任何情绪。

当引魂使大军开战时，万斯会担任前线士兵。尤其是，夜魔会不断对灵魂之河发动袭击，因此必须持续巡逻。作为不屈不挠的战士，万斯以完美队形飞行。不过这也可能适得其反，因为它们在作战时常常压制自身具备的任何应变能力。

引魂使是骨园中死者的守护者与引导者。骨园是一片广阔的墓冢位面，凡人的灵魂在此接受审判，并被送往其永恒的奖励或谴罚之地。引魂使确保死者能够接受自己从凡俗生命迈向另一阶段的转变，并被妥善归入恰当的来世。它们也会保护灵魂，使其不被超自然掠食者猎食。几乎所有引魂使都会佩戴面具，尤其是在它们可能与凡人接触时，尽管它们佩戴的面具种类如同引魂使本身一样多种多样。骨园的法庭以雷奎安语主持事务，这是一种庄重而富有乐感的语言，说话缓慢，并带有各种音调变化。

许多引魂使都深度参与骨园庞大的官僚体系。很少有引魂使追求仁慈、正义或个人利益；它们对法拉斯玛及其骨园的职责高于一切。尽管如此，不同的引魂使仍会以不同方式理解自己的职责，这可能使它们与凡人，甚至彼此之间发生冲突。

Protectors of the Boneyard, the stern and resolute guardians of the dead, vanths are psychopomps who resemble skeletons with raven-like wings and a mask resembling a vulture's skull. Vanths carry black scythes to fight against those who would disturb the natural progression of souls, and they consider any visitor to the Boneyard a potential troublemaker. They rarely speak and even more rarely show any emotion other than a grim adherence to duty.

When the psychopomp armies go to war, vanths serve as front-line soldiers. In particular, daemons continually stage raids on the River of Souls, requiring constant patrol. Implacable warriors, vanths fly in perfect formation. This can backfire, as they often suppress any adaptability they possess as they wage war.

Psychopomps are guardians and shepherds of the dead in the Boneyard, the vast plane of graves where mortal souls are judged and sent on to their eternal rewards or damnations. Psychopomps ensure that the dead come to terms with their transition from mortality and are properly sorted into the appropriate afterlife. They also protect souls from being preyed upon by supernatural predators. Nearly all psychopomps wear masks, especially when they're likely to be interacting with mortals, although the types of masks they wear are as varied as the psychopomps themselves. The courts of the Boneyard preside in Requian, a somber yet melodic language spoken slowly with various tonal shifts.

Many psychopomps are intimately involved with the Boneyard's massive bureaucracy. Few pursue mercy, justice, or personal gain; their duties to Pharasma and her Boneyard are supreme. Nevertheless, individual psychopomps interpret their duties in different ways, which might put them in conflict with mortals or even with each other.
Vanth.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Zoudou's Tattered Leather-bound Ledger.name: 邹斗的破旧皮装账簿 Zoudou's Tattered Leather-bound Ledger
Zoudou's Tattered Leather-bound Ledger.description:
邹斗随身携带的那本破旧皮装账簿，曾被旧伐木营地的工头用来记录利润和支出，但只有前四分之一的页数写着这些寻常注记。账本的其余部分则密密麻麻地写满了邹斗关于苦迦菩提、鬼墙，以及她逐渐相信位于墙外的“乐土”的笔记与理论。

The tattered leather-bound ledger that Zoudou carries was once used by the lumber camp boss to track profits and expenditures, but only the first quarter of the pages contain these mundane annotations. The rest of the journal is filled with Zoudou’s dense notes and theories about the nature of Kugaptee, the Wall of Ghosts, and the “paradise” she has come to believe lies beyond the wall.

Dragonfire Halfbow.name: 龙火半弓 Dragonfire Halfbow
Dragonfire Halfbow.description:
这把弓以竹材层叠制成，并嵌入从喷吐火焰的巨龙身上采集、切成细条的鳞片，因此具有相当强的拉力。这种设计在弘古很常见，因为较短的弓臂便于骑乘时操控。当持用这把+2强击复合短弓的 wield者处于骑乘状态时，他们将该弓的物品加值应用于对你的坐骑施展命令术的自然检定。

启动 2 交互

频率 每天一次

效果 你将弓拉至最大开弓长度而不搭箭；当你松开弓弦时，这把龙火半弓施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{火球术}（升阶至5环；@Check[reflex|dc:29] 反射豁免），目标为法术射程内由你选择的一点。你和你的坐骑免疫此火球术的效果。

Crafted by layering bamboo with strips of sliced scales harvested from a fire-breathing dragon, this bow has a significant draw strength. This design is commonly seen in Hongal, as the shorter limbs allow for easier maneuvering on horseback. While the wielder of this +2 striking composite shortbow is mounted, they apply the bow's item bonus to Nature checks to Command your mount.

Activate 2 Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You draw the bow back to its maximum draw length without nocking an arrow, and as you release the string, the dragonfire halfbow casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} (heightened to 5th-rank; @Check[reflex|dc:29] save), targeted at a point of your choosing within the spell's range. You and your mount are immune to the effects of this fireball.

Four-Tiger Blade.name: 四虎刃 Four-Tiger Blade
Four-Tiger Blade.description:
当群星一生仅有一次的排列透过一座与世隔绝的铁匠铺屋顶照耀下来时，那名铁匠抓住机会打造了自己的杰作。在两个小时内，他将一团普通钢铁锤炼成一把神圣之刃，在其刃身上刻下星座与护纹，随后在去世前将这件造物的配方分享给了一小群亲近的同伴。

这些武器就是四虎刃，而目前已知仅有十二把——每一把都对应一年中的一个月份。每把武器都是一把+2 强击 幽冥 长剑，挥动时会从其上雕刻的群星处拖曳出一道清晰可见的光之小路。若有人仔细观察刃上闪耀的群星图样，或许会注意到，上面描绘的星座会随着当前夜晚天空中的星象而变化。

启动 2 观想，交互（防护、神圣、失能）

频率 每天一次

效果 尝试对一个你认为被附身的生物进行一次打击。此次攻击不会对该生物造成伤害，但如果目标确实被附身，附身的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:29] 豁免。

大成功 附身的生物不受影响，而你仍然不知道目标是否真的被附身。

成功 附身的生物不受影响，但你会感知到该生物对目标的控制，并确认目标已被附身。

失败 你确认目标已被附身。附身的生物在1分钟内无法控制目标。

大失败 你在反制附身的瞬间确认目标已被附身，使附身的生物离开目标的身体。

启动 r 命令术

触发 你尝试用四虎刃进行一次打击

效果 直到你的下个回合开始时，你获得10点虚无伤害抗力。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.V7cIpoJL9Zm4TiUT]{Effect: Four-Tiger Blade}

When a once-in-a-lifetime alignment of the stars shone through the roof of a secluded blacksmith's forge, the smith took advantage to craft their masterpiece. For two hours, they hammered a lump of ordinary steel into a divine blade, etching constellations and wards down its length, then shared their creation's formula with a small group of close associates before passing away.

These weapons are the four-tiger blades, and currently, only a dozen are known to exist—one associated with each month of the year. Each weapon is a +2 striking ghost touch longsword that leaves a noticeable trail of light originating from the engraved stars when it's swung. Those who pay close attention to the pattern of stars that shine on the blade might note that the depicted constellations change according to those currently in the night sky above.

Activate 2 envision, Interact (abjuration, divine, incapacitation)

Frequency once per day

Effect Attempt a Strike against a creature you believe to be possessed. This attack deals no damage on the creature, but if the target is possessed, the possessing creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save.

Critical Success The possessing creature is unaffected, and you remain unaware of if the target is actually possessed or not.

Success The possessing creature is unaffected, but you sense that creature's control over the target and confirm that the target is possessed.

Failure You confirm that the target is possessed. The possessing creature can't control the target for 1 minute.

Critical Failure You confirm the target is possessed an instant before you counteract the possession, causing the possessing creature to vacate the target's body.

Activate r command

Trigger You attempt a Strike with the four-tiger-blade

Effect Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance 10 to void damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.V7cIpoJL9Zm4TiUT]{Effect: Four-Tiger Blade}

Thundering Fury Dadao.name: 雷霆狂怒大刀 Thundering Fury Dadao
Thundering Fury Dadao.description:
这把巨大而弯曲的刀刃在猛然砸向对手时会发出咆哮，仿佛意图以纯粹的力量将其制服。据说，最初几把雷霆狂怒大刀的材料取自传奇怪兽角雷——一头游荡于闪光沙漠的传说级怪兽——的皮。这把+2强击雷鸣巨剑几乎没有任何装饰，却掩盖不住其致命的高效。

启动 1 观想

频率 每天一次

效果 你将闪电的速度与雷霆的力量灌注入雷霆狂怒大刀。该武器在1轮内获得灵巧与强力特征。你可以将此次启动维持最多1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.XEP4Ox6NZDGgba1r]{Effect: Thundering Fury Dadao}

This massive, curved blade roars when it crashes down on opponents, seemingly intent on subduing them with sheer force. It's said materials for the first thundering fury dadaos came from the hide of Yorak, the Horned Thunder, a legendary kaiju that roams the Shanguang desert. The lack of embellishments on this +2 striking thundering greatsword belies a weapon of deadly efficacy.

Activate 1 envision

Frequency once per day

Effect You infuse the thundering fury dadao with the speed of lightning and the force of thunder. The weapon gains the agile and forceful traits for one round. You can Sustain this activation for up to 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.XEP4Ox6NZDGgba1r]{Effect: Thundering Fury Dadao}

Lumber Storage South.name: 南部木材储存区 Lumber Storage South
Lumber Storage South.tokenName: 南部木材储存区 Lumber Storage South

Hatchet.name: 短斧 Hatchet
Hatchet.description:
这把小斧既可用于近身战斗，也可投掷。

This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

Lumber Storage South.prototypeToken: 南部木材储存区 Lumber Storage South

Cockroach Swarm.name: 蟑螂群 Cockroach Swarm

Swarming Bites.name: 蜂拥噬咬 Swarming Bites
Swarming Bites.description:
虫群空间内的每个敌人受到 @Damage[1d8[piercing]] 伤害（进行一次@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]反射豁免）。

Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[1d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save).

Cockroach Swarm.publicNotes:
虽然蟑螂往往会聚集在狭窄的地方，但受到惊扰的群体有时会倾巢而出，数百乃至数千只虫子会从藏身处急奔而出，汇成一片由闪亮的棕黑色甲壳与无数窸窣爬动的腿脚组成的浪潮。考虑到许多人都觉得蟑螂令人作呕，遭遇这样的虫群即使对最老练的冒险者来说也会令人警觉。它们在受到惊扰时会变得穷追不舍；与这些昆虫平时怯生且无害的天性相反，一旦形成虫群，它们便会追逐激怒它们的生物，并用成千上万带来刺痛的啃咬不断骚扰对方。

While cockroaches tend to gather in cramped spaces, a disturbed colony is sometimes prone to swarming, where hundreds or even thousands of the insects scurry out of their hiding places in a raft of shiny brown and black carapaces on thousands of skittering legs. Given how disgusting many find cockroaches to be, encountering such a swarm can be alarming to even the most seasoned adventurers. The creatures are relentless when disturbed; in contrast to the insects' normally skittish and harmless nature, as swarms they pursue the creature or creatures that provoked them and harry them with thousands of stinging bites.

Hu Lelong.name: 胡乐龙 Hu Lelong

Serving Platter.name: 盛菜盘 Serving Platter
Serving Platter.description:
这种非常小的护盾深受决斗家和敏捷、轻装甲战士的喜爱。它通常由钢制成，并绑在你的前臂上。只要你的那只手是空着的，或者那只手拿着一个不是武器的轻型物体，你就可以用你的圆盾举起护盾。

硬度 HP BT
3 6 3

This very small shield is a favorite of duelists and quick, lightly armored warriors. It's typically made of steel and strapped to your forearm. You can Raise a Shield with your buckler as long as you have that hand free or are holding a light object that's not a weapon in that hand.

Hardness HP BT
3 6 3

Servant's Uniform.name: 仆役制服 Servant's Uniform
Servant's Uniform.description:
普通服装具有基本剪裁且实用，例如农民服饰、僧袍或工作服。

Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

Protective Platter.name: 防护拼盘 Protective Platter
Protective Platter.description:
仆役可以使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.4hfQEMiEOBbqelAh]{举起护盾}动作举起他们的盛菜盘。该餐盘的属性与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1k3AsSW7lpU0kEpY]{圆盾}相同，但需要用一只手来持握。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.4hfQEMiEOBbqelAh]{举起护盾}

The servant can raise their serving platter using the Raise a Shield action. The platter has the same statistics as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1k3AsSW7lpU0kEpY]{Buckler} but requires a hand to hold.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.4hfQEMiEOBbqelAh]{Raise a Shield}

Quick Catch.name: 快速接住 Quick Catch
Quick Catch.description:
触发 一个仆役能够单手持握的物体在仆役的触及内掉落

需求 该仆役至少有一只手空着

效果 仆役在掉落的物体落到地板上或离开其触及之前将其接住。

Trigger An object the servant could hold in one hand is dropped within the servant's reach

Requirements The servant has at least one hand free

Effect The servant catches the dropped object before it hits the floor or leaves their reach.

Raise a Shield.name: 举起护盾 Raise a Shield
Raise a Shield.description:
需求 你正持用一面护盾。

你调整护盾的位置以保护自己。当你已举起护盾时，你获得其列出的 AC 环境加值。你的护盾会一直保持举起，直到你的下个回合开始。

Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You position your shield to protect yourself. When you have Raised a Shield, you gain its listed circumstance bonus to AC. Your shield remains raised until the start of your next turn.

Lore (any one subcategory related to the.name: 学识（任一与其工作相关的子类别，例如酒精学识、烘焙学识或家务学识）

Hu Lelong.publicNotes:
仆役可能是女仆或管家，维持家宅正常运转；也可能是在旅店等场所工作的侍者，负责点单并服务顾客。

社会建立在劳工的肩背之上。

A servant might be a maid or butler, keeping a home in working order, or a server in an establishment like an inn, taking orders and serving customers.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.
Hu Lelong.blurb:
保护欲强的年轻男性人类村民
protective male human young villager

Spark Moth.name: 火花蛾 Spark Moth

Arc Lightning.name: 弧形闪电 Arc Lightning
Arc Lightning.description:
火花蛾化作一道闪电，跃迁至100尺内一件大型金属物体旁，例如一套金属护甲或金属武器。随后，该元素生物在邻接该金属的一个空间内恢复其正常形态。此移动不会触发反应动作。

The spark moth transforms into lightning that arcs to a large piece of metal within 100 feet, such as a suit of metal armor or metal weapon. The elemental then returns to its normal form in a space adjacent to the metal. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Spark Moth.publicNotes:
电光蝙蝠聚集在空气位面中多变的天气周围。

一些元素生物体现了空气的性相，例如烟雾、闪电和雾。

Spark bats congregate around volatile weather in the Plane of Air.

Some elementals embody aspects of air, such as smoke, lightning, and fog.

Lumber Storage North.name: 北侧木材储存区 Lumber Storage North
Lumber Storage North.tokenName: 北侧木材储存区 Lumber Storage North

Saurian Spike.name: 蜥蜴尖刺 Saurian Spike
Saurian Spike.description:
这块锯齿状的骨质生长物逐渐收窄，形成一个尖锐的尖端。其表面布满了某场过往战斗留下的深深沟痕。携带蜥蜴尖刺者常常会感到力量与自信骤然涌现。通过启动此物品所施放的任何法术，其法术攻击调整值为 +15。

  • 护甲你获得 30 尺射程的模糊嗅觉。
  • 武器（听觉、情绪、恐惧、视觉）当你通过启动尖刺来施放一个变形法术时，你的战斗形态显得格外可怖。每个处于 @Template[emanation|distance:30] 内的敌人都必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:27|traits:auditory,emotion,fear,visual] 豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（大失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.AYLthNtyUlWmKqhW]{效果：蜥蜴尖刺 - 护甲}

启动 施放法术

效果你施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MPxbKoR54gkYkqLO]{穿刺爪击}。

启动 施放法术

频率每天一次

效果你施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{恐龙形态}。

This jagged, bony growth narrows to a sharp, pointed tip. Deep groves from some former battle scar its surface. The bearer of a saurian spike often feels a sudden surge in power and confidence. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by activating this item is +15.

  • Armor You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.
  • Weapon (auditory, emotion, fear, visual) When you cast a polymorph spell by activating the spike, your battle form is exceptionally fearsome. Each enemy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:27|traits:auditory,emotion,fear,visual] saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.AYLthNtyUlWmKqhW]{Effect: Saurian Spike - Armor}

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MPxbKoR54gkYkqLO]{Gouging Claw}.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{Dinosaur Form}.

Lumber Storage North.prototypeToken: 北侧木材储存区 Lumber Storage North

Delicate Clay Vial.name: 精致黏土小瓶 Delicate Clay Vial
Delicate Clay Vial.description:
启动 A 打击

这些弹簧驱动的金属罐中装有化学物质与盐类的混合物，能够抽离并瓦解附近的不死生物。

幽灵充能瓶使攻击掷骰获得+1物品加值，造成2d8活力伤害和2点活力溅射伤害；不过和活力伤害通常的规则一样，这种伤害只会伤害不死生物和具有虚空治疗的生物。受到幽灵充能瓶伤害的主要目标会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

幽灵充能瓶被设计成即使接触到灵体物质也会爆炸，因此特别适合用来伤害虚体不死生物。

Activate A Strike

These spring-loaded metal canisters contain a mixture of chemicals and salts that drain and disintegrate nearby undead creatures.

A ghost charge gives a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, deals 2d8 vitality damage and 2 vitality splash damage, though as usual for vitality damage, this damage harms only undead and creatures with void healing. A primary target that takes damage from a ghost charge becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Ghost charges are designed to explode even on contact with a spiritual substance, making them ideal for damaging incorporeal undead.

Viper Swarm.name: 蝰蛇群 Viper Swarm

Venom Spritz.name: 毒液喷溅 Venom Spritz
Venom Spritz.description:
蝰蛇们从它们的尖牙中喷射毒液，以示防御。位于@Template[type:cone|distance:10]内的每个生物都会暴露于蝰蛇群毒液，但其对此毒素进行的初次豁免检定获得+2环境加值。

The vipers spray venom from their fangs in a defensive display. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:10] is exposed to viper swarm venom but gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its initial saving throw against the poison.

Venomous Fangs.name: 剧毒尖牙 Venomous Fangs
Venomous Fangs.description:
蝰蛇群空间内的每个敌人都受到 @Damage[2d8[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] 豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会暴露于蝰蛇群毒液。

Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[2d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). A creature that fails their save is also exposed to viper swarm venom.

Viper Swarm Venom.name: 蝰蛇群毒液 Viper Swarm Venom
Viper Swarm Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]]伤害（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[2d4[poison]]伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭}（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d4[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Viper Swarm.publicNotes:
由闪亮鳞片、发光眼睛和滴着毒液的尖牙构成的可怖团块——蝰蛇群——已经终结了许多不幸冒险者的生命。这些恶名昭彰、极具攻击性的蛇通常在夜间活动，会攻击任何进入其触及范围内的东西，不论是肢体还是武器。它们的毒液是一种强效毒素，会让受害者颤抖虚弱。幸运的人或许会在遭到真正攻击前，先受到一次不带毒液的警告性打击。

各种各样的蛇都能在除极地以外的每一种生态系统中繁盛生存，各自拥有独特的狩猎模式和防御机制。

The frightening mass of shining scales, gleaming eyes, and fangs dripping with venom that constitute a viper swarm has brought an end to many an unlucky adventurer. Normally nocturnal, these notoriously aggressive snakes strike at anything that comes within reach, be it limb or weapon. Their venom is a potent toxin that leaves victims shaky and weak. Those who are lucky may receive a warning strike without venom before being attacked in earnest.

Snakes of some variety thrive in every non-arctic ecosystem, each with their own particular hunting patterns and defense mechanisms.

Snapping Flytrap.name: 猛咬捕蝇草 Snapping Flytrap

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震动感知（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Quick Capture.name: 快速捕捉 Quick Capture
Quick Capture.description:
触发 一个生物击中或接触捕蝇草。

效果 捕蝇草对触发的生物进行一次叶打击。若命中，该生物被那片叶 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{抓住}。

Trigger A creature hits or touches the flytrap.

Effect The flytrap makes a leaf Strike against the triggering creature. If it hits, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in that leaf.

Focused Assault.name: 专注突击 Focused Assault
Focused Assault.description:
捕蝇草用它的两片叶子同时攻击单一目标。捕蝇草进行一次叶打击。若成功，捕蝇草造成一次叶打击的伤害，且除第一片叶子外，每多一片叶子便额外造成1d8点穿刺伤害。若失败，捕蝇草造成一次叶打击的伤害，但不能使用强化擒抱。若大失败，则不造成伤害。这会计入捕蝇草的多重攻击减值，视为等同于捕蝇草叶片数量的攻击次数。

The flytrap attacks a single target with both its two leaves. The flytrap makes one leaf Strike. On a success, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike plus an additional 1d8 piercing damage for every leaf beyond the first. On a failure, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike, but it can't use Improved Grab. It deals no damage on a critical failure. This counts toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty as a number of attacks equal to the number of leaves the flytrap has.

Hungry Flurry.name: 饥饿乱舞 Hungry Flurry
Hungry Flurry.description:
捕蝇草以 -2 减值进行两次叶打击，每次分别针对不同的目标。这些攻击计入捕蝇草的多重攻击减值，但在它完成所有攻击后，多重攻击减值才会增加。

The flytrap makes two leaf Strikes at a -2 penalty, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all its attacks.

Snapping Flytrap.publicNotes:
猛咬捕蝇草通常有两组边缘长着尖齿的叶片，每组宽3足，位于10足长茎秆的末端。

捕蝇草热衷于以类人生物、怪异昆虫和更大的猎物为食。

Snapping flytraps typically have two sets of tooth-edged leaves, each measuring 3 feet wide, at the end of 10-foot-long stalks.

Flytraps eagerly feed on humanoids, monstrous insects, and larger prey.

Noppera-bo Occultist.name: 无脸鬼秘术师 Noppera-bo Occultist
Noppera-bo Occultist.tokenName: 无脸鬼秘术师 Noppera-bo Occultist

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一次心灵冲击使其陷入眩晕。该冲击造成 1d6 点心灵伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6 点。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑} 1轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出一种简单声音的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成 2d4 点心灵伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到全部初始伤害，但不受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标受到全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，则持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d4，且持续伤害增加 1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法听从你的驱使。只要你维持该法术，你就能施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你都可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹调 冷却、加热，或为1磅非生物质料调味。
  • 举起 将一个无人持用、负载为轻或更低的物体缓慢抬离地面1足。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能被用作工具、武器、法器，也不能作为法术的代价。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用10轮专注影响一个1负载的物体，而更大的物体则需要每1负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体造成的任何实际改变（除上述说明外）只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智以感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何接受你关于该灵光建议的人，对该物品进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时获得 +2 环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将 10 个物体作为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以将任意数量的物体作为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一道魔法力场护盾。这视为使用“举起护盾”动作，使你获得 AC +1 的环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，但使用它不需要手。

当该法术生效时，你可以以你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{护盾格挡}反应动作（）。该护盾具有 5 点硬度。你可以使用该法术的反应动作（）来减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使其不造成物理伤害也可以。在你使用护盾格挡后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内不能再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该护盾的硬度提高 5。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Sleep.name: 睡眠术 Sleep
Sleep.description:
区域内的每个生物都会变得昏昏欲睡，并且可能睡着。因该法术而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识} 的生物不会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，也不会放开其手中持有的东西。该法术不会阻止生物因成功的察觉检定而醒来，这限制了它在战斗中的用途。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物的察觉检定受到 -1 状态减值，持续 1 轮。

失败 该生物陷入失去意识。若其在 1 分钟后仍处于失去意识，则会自动醒来。

大失败 该生物陷入失去意识。若其在 1 小时后仍处于失去意识，则会自动醒来。

升阶（4环） 生物在失败时会失去意识 1 轮，或在大失败时失去意识 1 分钟。它们会倒地并放开其手中持有的东西，且不能尝试进行察觉检定来醒来。当持续时间结束时，该生物会进入正常睡眠，而不是自动醒来。

Each creature in the area becomes drowsy and might fall asleep. A creature that falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} from this spell doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or release what it's holding. This spell doesn't prevent creatures from waking up due to a successful Perception check, limiting its utility in combat.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still Unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.

Critical Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still Unconscious after 1 hour, it wakes up automatically.

Heightened (4th) The creatures fall Unconscious for 1 round on a failure or 1 minute on a critical failure. They fall Prone and release what they're holding, and they can't attempt Perception checks to wake up. When the duration ends, the creature is sleeping normally instead of automatically waking up.

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸妖没有视觉，但它们的听觉感官很精确。它们无需呼吸，并且免疫任何需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上会将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用来“饮用”；它们也能以这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

Noppera-bos have no sense of vision, but their sense of hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}状态，他们就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as a noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description:
无脸鬼变成他们在过去24小时内接触过的一名小型或中型类人生物的模样，并获得目标生物的面容和声音。变形期间，无脸鬼对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}时获得+2环境加值，并失去其无面能力和所列出的免疫。无脸鬼可以再次使用该能力来变回原状。

The noppera-bo changes into a version of a Small or Medium humanoid they've touched during the last 24 hours, and gains the target creature's face and voice. While transformed, the noppera-bo gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} that creature and loses its no face ability and listed immunities. The noppera-bo can change back by using this ability again.

Remove Face.name: 移除面容 Remove Face
Remove Face.description:
需求 无脸鬼正在乔装成一个有脸的生物

效果 无脸鬼的面部特征融化为虚无，并恐吓30尺内的一个生物。该生物在@Check[will|dc:18]意志豁免失败时变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（若大失败，则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。

Requirements The noppera-bo is Impersonating a creature with a face

Effect The noppera-bo's facial features melt into nothingness, and they menace a creature within 30 feet. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} on a failed @Check[will|dc:18] save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Steal Face.name: 窃取面容 Steal Face
Steal Face.description:
频率 每天一次

需求 无脸鬼秘术师处于无面状态

效果 无脸鬼秘术师以30尺内的一个生物为目标。该生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:18]强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到其下个回合开始。

失败 无脸鬼秘术师获得目标的脸。目标的脸会消失，直到其下个回合结束。在此期间，它处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{失明}，无法说话、进食或吞咽，也无法嗅闻。目标还必须屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息。

大失败 如同失败，但该效果不会自动结束。目标可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免，且每次如此尝试时，难度等级都会累计降低1。

Frequency once per day

Requirements The noppera-bo occultist is faceless

Effect The noppera-bo occultist targets one creature within 30 feet. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the start of its next turn.

Failure The noppera-bo gains the target's face. The target's face vanishes until the end of its next turn. Until then, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, can't speak or ingest, and can't smell. The target must also hold its breath or begin to suffocate.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect doesn't end automatically. The target can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such attempt.

Noppera-bo Occultist.publicNotes:
一些无脸鬼会运用其天生的魔法，来进一步恐吓受害者。

无脸鬼从背后看起来像普通的人类，甚至可能像是你认识的某个人，直到他们转过身来，露出一张没有五官的脸。

额外学识完美专家

虽然普通无脸鬼残忍成性，并沉迷于惊吓或折磨类人生物的行为，但并非所有无脸鬼都沉沦于邪恶。中立的无脸鬼往往是爱恶作剧的家伙，会用自己的能力来欺骗和戏弄他人；而罕见的善良无脸鬼则会用自己的能力来向他们所敬仰的人表达敬意与崇拜，同时把自己的时间投入到磨炼艺术或制作技艺上。

额外学识无面鬼起源

关于无脸鬼的起源有许多理论——从变形能力出错的化狸，到被诅咒扭曲的类人生物，再到自然诞生的妖怪。甚至还有人推测，这种状态是一种像兽化症那样能够传播的诅咒。大多数无脸鬼都不记得自己的起源，而且他们往往更感兴趣的是假装自己完全是另一个人。

Some noppera-bos harness their natural magic to further frighten victims.

Noppera-bos appear to be regular humans from behind, and might even resemble someone you know, until they turn to reveal a featureless face.

Consummate Professionals

While the typical noppera-bo is cruel and revels in the act of frightening or tormenting humanoid creatures, not all of them wallow in evil. Neutral noppera-bos tend to be pranksters who use their abilities to trick and tease, while the rare good noppera- bos instead use their abilities to honor and idolize those they admire while focusing their own time on developing their skills at art or crafting.

Noppera-bo Origins

There are many theories on the origins of noppera-bos—from tanuki whose change shape ability went wrong, to humanoids who were warped by curses, to naturally spawning yokai. Some even theorize this condition is a transmissible curse like lycanthropy. Most noppera-bos don't recall their origins, and are often more interested in pretending to be someone else entirely.

Skyfang Crystal.name: 天牙水晶 Skyfang Crystal
Skyfang Crystal.description:
天牙水晶看起来是一段柔和发光的蓝色水晶，形状如微微弯曲的尖牙；它通常固定在一小段链条上，因此可以作为项链佩戴，或缠绕在前臂上。它发出的光亮度相当于一支蜡烛；这种光无法被熄灭，但只要用布包裹水晶、将其戴在衣物下面，或放在容器中，就可以轻易遮挡。人们相信，第一批这类魔法水晶是由一条垂死的天空龙创造的；她一生都在与邪恶精魂战斗。她从自己的颌骨上拔下了十二颗最小的牙齿，将它们赠予自己最信任的12位盟友，使他们即使在她逝去之后，也能继续追踪邪恶精魂，并在这么做时受到保护。天牙水晶提供如同无法熄灭的蜡烛般的照明，并且只要你已将其灌注，你便获得心灵抗力10。如果你是邪恶阵营，则在你灌注天牙水晶期间，你处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

启动 2 命令术，交互

频率 每日一次

效果 你将天牙水晶贴在眉心，并念出你所寻找的某个特定邪魔或精魂的名字。如果目标与你处于同一位面，那么当你面朝该被点名生物的大致方向时，天牙水晶会更强烈地脉动发光，让你能够@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{追踪}该生物。此次检定的难度等级等于该生物的意志DC，且你可以使用神秘学、宗教或求生来进行此次检定。只要你正在追踪这个邪魔或精魂，你对该生物产生的效果进行豁免骰时获得+2物品加值。该效果会持续，直到你再次启动天牙水晶来追踪不同的目标为止。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Z7KzhGhAWzgXIEkp]{Effect: Skyfang Crystal}

A skyfang crystal appears as a softly glowing length of blue crystal shaped like a gently curved fang; it's typically affixed to a short length of chain, allowing it to be worn as a necklace or wrapped around a forearm. The light it sheds is equal in strength to that of a candle; it can't be extinguished but can be blocked simply by wrapping the crystal in cloth, wearing it under clothing, or keeping it in a container. The first of these magical crystals was believed to have been created by a dying sky dragon who'd spent her life fighting against evil spirits. She plucked a dozen of her smallest teeth from her jaw and offered them to her 12 most trusted allies so that they could continue to track down evil spirits and remain protected as they did so, even after she was gone. A skyfang crystal provides illumination as a candle that can't be extinguished, and as long as you have it invested, you gain mental resistance 10. If you're evil, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} while you have a skyfang crystal invested.

Activate 2 command, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You touch the skyfang crystal to your brow and utter the name of a specific fiend or spirit you seek. If the target is on the same plane as you, the skyfang crystal pulses stronger with light when you face in the approximate direction of the named creature, allowing you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} that creature. The DC for this check is equal to the creature's Will DC, and you can use Occultism, Religion, or Survival to attempt the check. As long as you're tracking this fiend or spirit, you gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against effects that creature generates. This effect persists until you activate the skyfang crystal again to track a different target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Z7KzhGhAWzgXIEkp]{Effect: Skyfang Crystal}

Spacious Pouch made of Spidersilk (Type.name: 蛛丝制成的宽敞袋（II型）
Spacious Pouch made of Spidersilk (Type.description:
虽然它看起来像是一个用色彩华丽的丝绸饰片或时髦刺绣装饰的布袋，但宽敞袋会通向一个比其外部尺寸更大的魔法空间。袋内所容纳的负载不会改变宽敞袋本身的负载。该袋超次元空间能够容纳的负载量取决于其类型。

你可以对宽敞袋执行交互，将物品存放进去或取出，就像使用普通麻袋一样。虽然这个袋子能容纳大量材料，但某个物体仍然必须能够穿过袋口，才能被存放在里面。

如果袋子超载或破损，它就会破裂并被毁坏，导致其中的物品永远遗失。如果把它翻转过来，里面的物品会毫发无伤地洒出来，但必须先将袋子恢复原状才能再次使用。被放入袋中的活体生物有足够维持10分钟的空气，之后便会开始窒息，并且它可以尝试挣脱，对抗13的难度等级。袋中的物品不会提供任何好处，除非先将其取出。袋中的物品无法被只能侦测同一位面上事物的魔法所侦测。

容量 50 负载

Though it appears to be a cloth bag decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a spacious pouch opens into a magical space larger than its outside dimensions. The Bulk held inside the bag doesn't change the Bulk of the spacious pouch itself. The amount of Bulk the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type.

You can Interact with the spacious pouch to stow items in it or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside.

If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A living creature placed inside the bag has enough air for 10 minutes before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag can't be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane.

Capacity 50 Bulk

Evil-Reflecting Shield.name: 辟邪盾 Evil-Reflecting Shield
Evil-Reflecting Shield.description:
一个明亮的八角形框架环绕着这面圆形的晨银盾牌，其本身被打磨得如镜面般光亮，反射清晰而真实。只要你举起这面标准级晨银盾牌（硬度 5，HP 20，BT 10），你就会获得其对抗具有邪恶或虚能（特征）特征法术的豁免骰的环境加值。

启动 r 命令（幸运）

频率 每天一次

触发 你尝试对一个具有邪恶或虚能（特征）特征的效果进行豁免骰

效果 你的豁免骰结果视为比实际结果高一个成功等级。如果此效果将成功变为大成功，你可以将该效果的部分力量反射为一阵魔法反噬波，回击至触发效果的来源处，前提是该来源在 30 尺内。如此做时，目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

A bright, octagonal frame surrounds this circular dawnsilver shield, which itself is polished to a mirrorlike sheen that reflects clear and true. While you have this standard-grade dawnsilver shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) raised, you gain its circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells with the unholy or void trait.

Activate r command (fortune)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a saving throw against an effect with the unholy or void traits

Effect Your saving throw result is considered one degree better than the actual result. If this effect turns a success into a critical success, you can reflect some of the effect's power as a wave of magical backlash back to the source of the triggering effect, as long as the source is within 30 feet. When you do so, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Fortune Cord.name: 财富绳 Fortune Cord
Fortune Cord.description:
在天夏的许多地区，将钱币铸造成中央带孔以便穿绳并系起、从而更安全且便于交易，是一种传统。这根编织得一丝不苟的红绳便是依照这一传统制成，并且在任何时候都最多能串起100枚钱币。只要你携带着财富绳，你进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{谋生}的技能检定时便获得+2物品加值。

如果你在每日准备中将至多100枚钱币装到财富绳上，那么直到你下一次进行每日准备前，你都可以用两种不同方式启动这件魔法物品，前提是所装载的钱币全都属于同一种类。

启动 1 交互

频率 每天一次

需求 你在财富绳上至少装载了50枚钱币

效果 你将财富绳变形为一根+2强击双节棍，持续1分钟。绳上所装载钱币的种类决定了会显现在这根+2强击双节棍上的额外武器属性符文，如下所示。

铜币：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wm0X7Pfd1bfocPSv]{侵蚀}武器

银币：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NVst7e69agGG9Qwd]{电击}武器

金币：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{炽焰}武器

铂金币：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.M5M1WJ5KzbYfRGsY]{冻寒}武器

启动 2 操作，交互

效果 你挥甩财富绳，使其上装载的10枚钱币脱落并射向100尺内一个你看得见的生物。该生物受到4d6伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]豁免）；伤害类型取决于你所装载钱币的种类。铜币造成@Damage[4d6[acid]]伤害，银币造成@Damage[4d6[electricity]]伤害，金币造成@Damage[4d6[fire]]伤害，铂金币造成@Damage[4d6[cold]]伤害。

In many parts of Tian Xia, it's tradition to mint coins with holes in the centers for the purpose of being able to thread a cord through them and tie them off for security and ease of transaction. This immaculately braided red cord is made in this tradition and can hold up to 100 coins at any given time. As long as you carry a fortune cord, you gain a +2 item bonus to skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}.

If you load up to 100 coins onto a fortune cord as part of your daily preparations, you can Activate the magic item in two different ways until the next time you make your daily preparations, provided all the loaded coins are of the same type.

Activate 1 Interact

Frequency once per day

Requirements you have at least 50 coins loaded onto the fortune cord

Effect You transform the fortune cord into a +2 striking nunchaku for 1 minute. The type of coin loaded onto the cord determines the additional weapon property rune that manifests on this +2 striking nunchaku, as follows.

Copper: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wm0X7Pfd1bfocPSv]{Corrosive} weapon

Silver: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NVst7e69agGG9Qwd]{Shock} weapon

Gold: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming} weapon

Platinum: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.M5M1WJ5KzbYfRGsY]{Frost} weapon

Activate 2 manipulate, Interact

Effect You whip the fortune cord, causing 10 coins loaded onto it to detach and fire at a creature within 100 feet that you can see. That creature takes 4d6 damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save); the damage type depends on the type of coins you've loaded. Copper coins deal @Damage[4d6[acid]] damage, silver coins deal @Damage[4d6[electricity]] damage, gold coins deal @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage, and platinum coins deal @Damage[4d6[cold]] damage.

Purgatory Emissary's Staff.name: 地府鬼差法杖 Purgatory Emissary's Staff
Purgatory Emissary's Staff.description:
这根白蜡木法杖顶端系着一束长长的漂白马尾。纵观天夏历史上不同地区与时代，最重要的朝廷官员历来都会携带这种法杖；此外，炼狱使者法杖也与负责执行惩戒判决的引魂使有着强烈关联。人们认为，这种联系是对来世官僚本质的一种诙谐映射。

当你携带炼狱使者法杖时，引魂使与精魂通常会对你抱有相当程度的敬意。当你持用这根法杖时，你对引魂使或精魂态度进行调整所作的所有技能检定，都会获得+2物品加值。

当作为武器使用时，炼狱使者法杖是一根+2强击幽冥法杖。

启动 施放法术

效果 你消耗法杖中一定数量的充能，以从其法术列表中施放一道法术。

  • 戏法 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{活力鞭笞}
  • 1环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{命令术}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8xRzLhwGL7Dgy3EZ]{庇护术}
  • 2环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{澄明心智}（仅针对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}）, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{目睹无形者}
  • 3环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{圣光}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{真言之环}
  • 4环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FM3SmEW8N1FCRjqt]{死者交谈}
  • 5环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{放逐术}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{真言术}

This ash wood staff is topped by a long tassel of bleached-white horsehair. Historically carried by the most important of court officials throughout various regions and periods of Tian Xia's history, purgatory emissary's staves are also strongly associated with psychopomps serving punitive sentences. It's thought this connection is a comical nod to the bureaucratic nature of the afterlife.

Psychopomps and spirits tend to regard you with a level of respect while you carry a purgatory emissary's staff. While you wield this staff, you receive a +2 item bonus to all skill checks made to adjust a psychopomp's or spirit's attitude.

When used as a weapon, a purgatory emissary's staff is a +2 striking ghost touch staff.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash}
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8xRzLhwGL7Dgy3EZ]{Sanctuary}
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} only), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}
  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{Holy Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth}
  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FM3SmEW8N1FCRjqt]{Talking Corpse}
  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech}

Sensei's Parasol.name: 师父阳伞 Sensei's Parasol
Sensei's Parasol.description:
一位宗师曾对他的弟子说过，在技艺娴熟之人的手中，即便是一把阳伞也能成为致命的武器。次日，弟子兴奋地带来了一把由金属伞骨打造的阳伞，并解释说，这样能降低施展致命威力所需的技艺。宗师叹了口气，看出弟子并未领会其中真意，但还是收下了这份赋礼。毕竟，巧思终究也是一种美德。

自那以后，又有更多的宗师阳伞被打造出来，而且备受追捧。这件武器视为一根+2强击长棍。

启动 1 交互

频率 每天一次

效果 你使阳伞的金属伞骨张开，将其变形成一面@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.pNQJ9PTOEHxEZCgp]{中型坚固盾牌}（硬度13，HP 104［BT 51］）。你可以维持此次启动至多10分钟，此后宗师阳伞会恢复为长棍形态。若它作为护盾破损，则会恢复为未受损的长棍形态。若它作为护盾被摧毁，则会恢复为长棍形态并变为破损。

启动 r 默想

需求 宗师阳伞处于长棍形态且未破损

频率 每天一次

触发 一个生物以一次近战打击未命中你

效果 你将这次未命中的打击改向，使其以触发生物触及内的一个生物或物体为目标。触发生物对新目标重新进行一次打击，以决定这次改向攻击的结果。

A master once said to his pupil that, in the hands of a skilled practitioner, even a parasol can become a deadly weapon. Returning the next day, the pupil excitedly turned over a parasol forged out of metal slats, explaining that it lowered the amount of skill one would need to exert deadly force. The master sighed, seeing that his pupil had failed to see the point, but accepted the gift nonetheless. Ingenuity was, after all, a virtue.

Since then, additional sensei's parasols have been crafted, and they're very sought after. This weapon functions as a +2 striking bo staff.

Activate 1 Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You cause the metal slats of the parasol to open up, transforming it into a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.pNQJ9PTOEHxEZCgp]{Moderate Sturdy Shield} (Hardness 13, HP 104 [BT 51]). You can sustain this activation for up to 10 minutes, after which the sensei's parasol reverts back to bo-staff form. If it's broken as a shield, it reverts to its undamaged bo-staff form. If it's destroyed as a shield, it reverts to bo-staff form and becomes broken.

Activate r envision

Requirements The sensei's parasol is in bo-staff form and isn't broken

Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature misses you with a melee Strike

Effect You redirect the missed Strike to target a creature or object within the triggering creature's reach. The triggering creature rolls a new Strike against the new target to determine the results of the redirected attack.

Ren Mei Li's Gift.prototypeToken: 任美璃的赋礼 Ren Mei Li's Gift

Huo Tian-Zhe.name: 霍天哲 Huo Tian-Zhe
Huo Tian-Zhe.blurb:
谦逊的男性人类发明家
humble male human inventor

Myna's Gift (Saved Two).name: 米娜的赋礼（已拯救两人）
Myna's Gift (Saved Two).tokenName: 米娜的赋礼（已拯救两人）

Healing Potion (Moderate).name: 治疗药水（中等）
Healing Potion (Moderate).description:
启动 A (操作)

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的麻感。当你喝下治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] Hit Points.

Smoke Ball (Greater).name: 烟雾弹（强效）
Smoke Ball (Greater).description:
启动 1（操作）

将这个球砸在地上时，你会立刻在以你空间的一个角落为中心的@Template[burst|distance:20]内制造出一片浓厚、不透明的烟雾屏障。该区域内的所有生物都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，并且对于它们而言，所有其他生物也都是隐蔽的。烟雾持续1分钟，或直到被强风驱散。

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Upon smashing this ball on the ground, you instantly create a screen of thick, opaque smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:20] centered on one corner of your space. All creatures within that area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

Everlasting Adhesive.name: 恒久黏胶 Everlasting Adhesive
Everlasting Adhesive.description:
启动 1分钟（操作）

这种奇特的琥珀色黏胶能将两个表面几乎不可分离地粘合在一起。单个瓶装可覆盖最多1平方足的区域，并且必须一次性全部使用，以在两个表面之间形成单一粘结。如果启动被打断，粘结就会失败，且黏胶会被浪费。

一旦两个表面用恒久黏胶粘合在一起，生物只能通过成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:50] 检定将其分开。被粘合的物体往往会先于黏胶发生破损，除非它们特别坚固，不过若有生物决心将这些物体分开，它可以拆下由恒久黏胶连接的部分，之后再修理这些物体。

只有在生物自愿的情况下，黏胶才能对其生效，而这种粘结可以通过剥去最外层皮肤来解除。

Activate 1 minute (manipulate)

This peculiar amber adhesive bonds two surfaces together almost inseparably. A single flask covers an area up to 1 square foot and must be used all at once to form a single bond between two surfaces. If the activation is interrupted, the bond fails, and the adhesive is wasted.

Once two surfaces are joined with everlasting adhesive, a creature can separate them only with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:50] check. The adhered objects tend to break before the adhesive does unless they're particularly durable, though a creature determined to separate the objects can break off the parts connected by the everlasting adhesive and later Repair the objects.

The adhesive can affect creatures only if they're willing, and its bond can be broken by exfoliating the outermost layer of skin.

Myna's Gift (Saved Two).prototypeToken: 米娜的赋礼（已拯救两人）

Oil of Potency.name: 潜能油 Oil of Potency
Oil of Potency.description:
启动 1 (操作)

当你将这种浓稠黏滑的油涂抹在一件武器或一套护甲上时，该物品会立刻获得魔法潜能。如果该物品是武器，它会暂时变为+1强击武器；如果是护甲，则会暂时变为+1坚韧护甲。此效果持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1OLlwExJz7ii2Lu2]{效果：潜能油}

Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you apply this thick, viscous oil to a weapon or suit of armor, that item immediately becomes magically potent. If the item is a weapon, it temporarily becomes a +1 striking weapon, or, if it's armor, it temporarily becomes +1 resilient armor. This lasts for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1OLlwExJz7ii2Lu2]{Effect: Oil of Potency}

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description:
无面鬼模仿者携带一把+1强击武器，其外观与所模仿的玩家角色偏好的武器完全相同。如果该玩家角色偏好徒手打击，则它会呈现为手部缠带。如果该玩家角色偏好远程武器，那么无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，而是改为使用上方的远程武器规则；否则，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果该玩家角色不偏好任何武器，则无面鬼会将一根短棒作为其虚假武器。该虚假武器只有一部分是真实的，命中时只造成精神伤害；它不会获得原始武器的任何特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损、被缴械或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟重新制造一把虚假武器作为替代品。

A noppera-bo impersonator carries a +1 striking weapon that looks identical to the favored weapon of the PC being impersonated. If the PC favors unarmed strikes, it appears as hand wraps. If the PC favors a ranged weapon, then the noppera-bo impersonator has no melee weapon and instead uses the ranged weapon rules above; otherwise, the noppera-bo impersonator has no ranged weapon. If the PCs favors no weapon, then the noppera-bo wields a club as its false weapon. This false weapon is only partially real and inflicts only mental damage when it hits; it gains none of the original weapon's traits or magical enhancements. If a noppera-bo impersonator's false weapon is broken, disarmed, or set down, it fades away. The noppera-bo impersonator can craft a replacement false weapon by spending 10 minutes to recreate one.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无面鬼没有视觉，但听觉极其敏锐。它们不需要呼吸，并且免疫任何需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上会将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；它们也能以这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

The noppera-bo has no sense of vision, but their hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无面鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}状态，他们就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as the noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonated Abilities.name: 模仿能力 Impersonated Abilities
Impersonated Abilities.description:
无面鬼模仿者获得以下由你选择的一项能力。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.kkP0tagXmAYuSH3u]{效果：被模仿的能力}

  • 指挥者 无面鬼模仿者获得一个他们可以命令的仆从。该生物呈现为被模仿的玩家角色的动物伙伴、幻灵或其他战斗伙伴生物的形态；选择一个4级生物，其能力与被模仿的伙伴生物大致相符。该生物获得仆从（特征）。
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.6U04OKtvRURExkli]{元素攻击}
  • 偷袭 无面鬼模仿者对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}生物额外造成1d6精准伤害。
  • 武器提升 无面鬼模仿者从以下武器特征中选择一项，将其加入他们的虚假武器：灵巧、背刺者、缴械、精准、横扫或绊摔。

The noppera-bo impersonator gains one of the following abilities of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.kkP0tagXmAYuSH3u]{Effect: Impersonated Ability}

  • Commander The noppera-bo impersonator gains a minion that they can command. This creature takes the form of the impersonated PC's animal companion, eidolon, or other fighting companion creature; choose a 4th-level creature that approximates the impersonated companion creature's abilities. This creature gains the minion trait.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.6U04OKtvRURExkli]{Elemental Attack}
  • Sneak Attack The noppera-bo impersonator deals an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.
  • Weapon Perk The noppera-bo impersonator chooses one of the following weapon traits to add to their false weapon: agile, backstabber, disarm, finesse, sweep, or trip.

Nadoya Sanmi.name: 名户屋三美 Nadoya Sanmi
Nadoya Sanmi.blurb: 友善的女性人类家族女族长 friendly female human family matriarch

Murasaki.name: 紫 Murasaki

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法任你驱使。只要你维持该法术，你就可以施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你都可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹调 冷却、加热，或为 1 磅的非生物材料调味。
  • 抬起 将一个无人持用、负载为轻或更低的物体缓慢抬离地面 1 足。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能被用作工具、武器、法器，也不能作为法术的代价。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用 10 轮专注影响一个 1 负载的物体；影响更大的物体则每 1 负载需要 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩 不能造成伤害，也不能导致不利状态。对物体造成的任何实际改变（除上述说明外）都只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
蹑影小魔怪对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}的生物造成额外 1d6 精准伤害。

The jinkin deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Tinker.name: 修补匠 Tinker
Tinker.description:
一群六只蹑影小魔怪可以协同工作 1 小时，在 60 尺射程内为一件物品施加诅咒。虽然这一过程很漫长，但也不易被察觉，并且可以在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏} 时进行。蹑影小魔怪更喜欢将这种能力用于魔法物品。该诅咒会使物品变得不可靠（@Check[flat|dc:5] 检定，否则任何用于交互或启动该物品的动作都会被浪费），为使用该物品附加一个离奇的条件，或赋予某种其他同等程度的诅咒。

A group of six jinkins can work together for an hour to imbue an item with a curse at a range of 60 feet. While this process is lengthy, it's also unobtrusive and can be performed while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding}. Jinkins prefer to use this ability on magic items. The curse makes the item unreliable (@Check[flat|dc:5] check or waste any action to Interact with or Activate the item), adds a bizarre requirement to use the item, or imparts some other curse of a similar caliber.

Murasaki.publicNotes:
蹑影小魔怪是施虐成性的修补匠，会偷窃并破坏物品，并以自己诅咒珍贵物体的能力为傲。它们心怀怨念，一旦觉得自己受了轻慢——例如某个生物胆敢移除它们施加的诅咒——就会制定错综复杂的复仇计划。蹑影小魔怪很少满足于制造单纯的混乱；它们同样从折磨与谋杀中获得极大乐趣，不过它们更喜欢把受害者引入专门设计来捕获或使其失去行动能力的陷阱中，而不是当场直接杀死。深坑是它们偏爱的手段，因为从坠落中幸存下来的受害者，将面对因饥饿和口渴而缓慢死去的结局；而蹑影小魔怪则聚集在坑边，嘲弄并折磨他们。

小魔怪是残忍的妖精恶作剧者与破坏者，早已完全适应了宇宙中的生活，并为自己充满创意的破坏性找到了明确的生态位。几乎所有小魔怪都乐于毁坏或打碎东西，无论是装置或载具这类有形之物，还是联盟或关系这类无形之物。小魔怪最大的快乐，就是看着复杂造物崩溃瓦解，而最好是在它们先施加了一点最轻微、却经过精心瞄准的推动之后。小魔怪往往会贬低、霸凌，甚至屠杀比自己弱小的同族，尤其是蹑影小魔怪；更强大的小魔怪还会轻蔑地称它们为“袋崽”。

Jinkins are sadistic tinkers who steal and sabotage items and take great pride in their power to curse precious objects. They hold grudges and create convoluted plans for revenge when they feel slighted, such as when a creature dares to remove one of their curses. Rarely content to wreak simple mayhem, jinkins also take immense pleasure in torture and murder, though they prefer to lead victims into traps designed to capture or incapacitate rather than just kill them outright. Deep pits are a preferred method, since victims who survive their fall face a slow death from starvation and thirst while jinkins gather at the edge of pits to tease and torment them.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life in the Universe, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. Nearly all gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the slightest, carefully targeted nudge from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom stronger gremlins derisively call "baggies."
Murasaki.blurb:
雌性蹑影小魔怪
Female jinkin gremlin

Minhwan.name: 珉焕 Minhwan
Minhwan.publicNotes:
