Minhwan.blurb:
善良的人类男孩
kindly male human child

Blasting Stone (Moderate).name: 爆裂石（中阶）
Blasting Stone (Moderate).description:
启动 1 打击

当这枚卵石击中一个生物或坚硬表面时，它会伴随着震耳欲聋的巨响爆炸。爆裂石造成 2d4 音波伤害和 2 点音波溅射伤害，且位于石头爆炸空间 10 尺内的每个生物都必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20|name:Moderate Blasting Stone|showDC:all] 强韧豁免，否则会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}，直到其下个回合结束。你在攻击掷骰上获得 +1 物品加值。

Activate 1 Strike

When this pebble hits a creature or a hard surface, it explodes with a deafening bang. A blasting stone deals 2d4 sonic damage and 2 sonic splash damage, and each creature within 10 feet of the space in which the stone exploded must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|name:Moderate Blasting Stone|showDC:all] saving throw with the listed DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the end of its next turn. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

Aiomena.name: 艾欧梅娜 Aiomena
Aiomena.blurb: 耐心的非二元性别精灵游侠 2 patient nonbinary elf ranger 2

Isori's Gift.name: 伊索里之赠礼 Isori's Gift
Isori's Gift.tokenName: 伊索里之赠礼 Isori's Gift

Thousand-Year Dragonroot.name: 千年龙根 Thousand-Year Dragonroot
Thousand-Year Dragonroot.description:
龙根是生长于天夏各地、根部呈淡金色的植物。正如曼德拉草根或人参根有时被认为几乎具有人形一般，这些根看起来仿佛是龙。它们常用于调配治疗药水，但最受追捧的是那些生长了数个世纪的，因为它们可以被惑控成千年龙根。

当你启动千年龙根时，你的身体会闪烁金色光芒，提供如同火把般的照明。你获得40尺飞行速度和火焰抗力5，持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.p1pxUzwgWZ9l9jmD]{效果：千年龙根}

Dragonroots are pale, golden-rooted plants that grow throughout Tian Xia. Just as mandrake roots or ginseng roots are sometimes regarded to have almost humanoid shapes, these roots appear as if they were dragons. They're commonly used in the formulation of healing potions, but the most sought-after have grown for centuries, for they're viable for enchantment into thousand-year dragonroots.

When you activate a thousand-year dragonroot, your body shimmers with golden light, providing illumination as a torch. You gain a fly Speed of 40 feet and fire resistance 5 for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.p1pxUzwgWZ9l9jmD]{Effect: Thousand-Year Dragonroot}

Isori's Gift.prototypeToken: 伊索里之赠礼 Isori's Gift

Rin.name: 凛 Rin

Mindscape Bound.name: 思维空间束缚 Mindscape Bound
Mindscape Bound.description:
凛被束缚于柳岸镇心景之中，并且可以在其边界内的任何地方穿行。

Rin is bound to the Willowshore mindscape and can travel anywhere within its borders.

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当一个幽灵被摧毁时，它会在 [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 天} 后于其所束缚的地点内重新形成，并完全恢复。只有当有人查明它存在的原因，并纠正任何阻止该精魂休息的事物时，幽灵才能被永久摧毁。

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
凛变形成某个特定小型人类的无尾形态。该无尾形态无法被改变，并且与她狐形类人生物的形态相似。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Rin transforms into the tailless form of a specific small human. The tailless form can't be altered and resembles her fox-like humanoid form.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Foxfire Curse.name: 狐火诅咒 Foxfire Curse
Foxfire Curse.description:
被凛的灼烧之触伤害的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:25] 豁免，否则会受到此诅咒影响。在被诅咒生物的得意时刻，它们会被幽魂般的烈焰勾勒出来，并惩罚其盟友。每当该被诅咒生物造成一次重击时，其触及内的每个盟友都会受到 @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] 伤害，因为该生物的傲慢会灼烧他们。

A creature damaged by Rin's burning touch must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:25] save or become affected by this curse. During a cursed creature's moments of triumph, they become limned with spectral flames that punish their allies. Whenever the cursed creature scores a critical hit, each ally within their reach takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] damage as the cursed creature's hubris sears them.

Rin.blurb:
女性狐人幽灵
Female kitsune ghost

Hunting Spider.name: 猎蛛 Hunting Spider

Web Sense.name: 蛛网感知 Web Sense
Web Sense.description:
猎蛛拥有不精确的震动感知，可侦测接触其蛛网的生物所产生的振动。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

The hunting spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

Spring Upon Prey.name: 扑向猎物 Spring Upon Prey
Spring Upon Prey.description:
需求 尚未掷先攻。

触发 当猎蛛位于其网上时，有生物触碰了猎蛛的网。

效果 猎蛛自动察觉该生物，并在掷先攻前进行移动、攀爬，或施展降入蛛网术。

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled.

Trigger A creature touches the hunting spider's web while the spider is on it.

Effect The hunting spider automatically notices the creature and Strides, Climbs, or Descends on a Web before it rolls initiative.

Descend on a Web.name: 降入蛛网术 Descend on a Web
Descend on a Web.description:
猎蛛沿直线向下移动，最多40尺，由一根蛛丝悬吊着。它可以悬挂在网上，也可以脱离蛛丝落下。它通过降入蛛网术下降的距离不计入坠落伤害。

成功打击蛛丝的生物（AC 20，硬度3，5 HP）会将其切断，导致蜘蛛坠落。

The hunting spider moves straight down up to 40 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage.

A creature that successfully Strikes the web (AC 20, Hardness 3, 5 HP) severs it, causing the spider to fall.

Hunting Spider Venom.name: 猎蛛毒 Hunting Spider Venom
Hunting Spider Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]]伤害，且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，且措手不及（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，且措手不及（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and off-guard (1 round)

Web Trap.name: 网缚 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被猎蛛的蛛网术打击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，并黏附在最近的表面上，除非目标成功逃脱。

A creature hit by the hunting spider's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=17]]{Escapes}.

Hunting Spider.publicNotes:
猎蛛是巨型蜘蛛中最常见的种类，尽管不是最大的。

在日常害虫中，几乎没有什么能像臭名昭著的蜘蛛一样引起如此深的恐惧。

Hunting spiders are the most common type of giant spider, though not the largest.

Few everyday vermin inspire as much dread as the infamous spider.

Dorms.name: 宿舍 Dorms

Spiritsight Ring.name: 灵视戒指 Spiritsight Ring
Spiritsight Ring.description:
这枚雕工繁复的象牙戒指上镶嵌的欧泊最终会变得半透明，并在附近有虚体生物时轻挠你的手指。当附近存在虚体生物时，即使它位于坚固物体内部，你最终也能侦测到该生物，不过你未必能立刻做到，而且你无法确定其具体位置。这会作为一种朦胧感官，类似于人类的嗅觉。虚体生物若试图对这种感官隐藏其存在，则如同正常尝试规避特殊感官一样，需以其隐秘检定对抗你的察觉DC，以躲藏避开你的朦胧感官。当你使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作来寻找你30尺内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}状态的虚体生物时，你获得+2物品加值。

The opal set in this intricately carved ivory ring eventually becomes translucent and tickles your finger whenever an incorporeal creature is nearby. When in the presence of a nearby incorporeal creature, even if it's within a solid object, you eventually detect the creature, though you might not do so instantly, and you can't pinpoint the location. This acts as a vague sense, similar to humans' sense of smell. An incorporeal creature trying to hide its presence from this sense attempts a Stealth check against your Perception DC to hide from your vague sense, as normal for attempting to foil special senses. You gain a +2 item bonus when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} incorporeal creatures within 30 feet of you.

Dorms.hazarddescription:
玩家角色若在房间内搜寻时成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定，便会找到这枚戒指。

A PC finds the ring if they succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check while Searching in the room.

Ha Hai-er.name: 哈海儿 Ha Hai-er

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这种小型刃状武器可单手持用，并用于在近身战斗中刺击生物。它也可以被投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Scale Mail.name: 鳞甲 Scale Mail
Scale Mail.description:
鳞甲由许多缝在加固皮革衬底上的金属鳞片构成，通常呈长衫形式，保护躯干、手臂和腿部。

Scale mail consists of many metal scales sewn onto a reinforced leather backing, often in the form of a long shirt that protects the torso, arms, and legs.

Signal Whistle.name: 信号哨子 Signal Whistle
Signal Whistle.description:
吹响时，信号哨子在开阔地形上最远可于半英里外被清晰听见。

When sounded, a signal whistle can be heard clearly up to half a mile away across open terrain.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

+1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed.name: 察觉检定在寻找隐蔽物体时获得+1加值 +1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed objects

Ha Hai-er.publicNotes:
守卫是城镇巡逻队或城市守卫中的普通成员，受过训练以发现麻烦、制服罪犯，并服从命令。

较大的社会依赖那些拥有权威以及解读和执行法律之能力的人。有些人会公正地履行这些职责，但另一些人则严厉而残酷，对任何无力花钱换取宽恕的人施加严酷的惩罚。

Guards are rank-and-file members of a town watch or city guard, trained to look for trouble, take down criminals, and follow orders.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

Hollow Space.name: 空洞空间 Hollow Space

Lacquered Waist Drum.name: 漆面腰鼓 Lacquered Waist Drum
Lacquered Waist Drum.description:
这个沙漏形的鼓有两个鼓面，每个鼓面在敲击时都会发出不同的声音。两种声音一同演奏时产生的共鸣，能有效驱散邪恶的精魂。这个鼓可以作为乐器演奏，使表演获得+2物品加值。

启动 2 交互

频率 每小时一次

效果 你演奏鼓的两个鼓面，产生一阵正能量脉冲，以30尺内一个具有不死（特征）的生物为目标。这对该生物造成 @Damage[5d8[vitality]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免）；如果该不死生物同时具有幽灵特征，则其若豁免失败，便会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

启动 3 交互

频率 每小时一次

效果 你喧闹地演奏鼓的两个鼓面，同时呼喊并舞蹈。这种表演会从你身上产生一道30尺@Template[emanation|distance:30]的正能量脉冲。该区域内所有不死生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受伤害。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[2d8[vitality]]伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[5d8[vitality]]伤害；如果该生物具有幽灵特征，则其会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[10d8[vitality]]伤害；如果该生物具有幽灵特征，则其会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1分钟。

This hourglass-shaped drum has two heads, each of which produces a different sound when struck. When played together, the resonance of the two sounds is effective in repelling evil spirits. This drum can be played as an instrument, granting a +2 item bonus to Performance.

Activate 2 Interact

Frequency once per hour

Effect You play both heads of the drums, generating a pulse of positive energy that targets one creature within 30 feet that has the undead trait. This deals @Damage[5d8[vitality]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:28] save) to that creature; if the undead also has the ghost trait, the ghost becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} if it fails the save.

Activate 3 Interact

Frequency once per hour

Effect You raucously play both heads of the drums, accompanied with shouting and dancing. This display generates a pulse of positive energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] from you. All undead creatures within this area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d8[vitality]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[5d8[vitality]] damage; if the creature has the ghost trait, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[10d8[vitality]] damage; if the creature has the ghost trait, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Hollow Space.hazarddescription:
一名玩家角色在对区域A7c进行10分钟的搜索时，若成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定，便会发现那件穿过地板上的一个洞、掉落到一组搁板后方空洞空间中的物品。

A PC who conducts a 10-minute Search of area A7c, and who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check, reveals the item that fell behind a set of shelves into a hollow space through a hole in the floor.

Cold Iron Chunk.name: 寒铁块 Cold Iron Chunk
Cold Iron Chunk.description:
由冷铁制成的武器对恶魔和妖精都同样致命。冷铁看起来与普通铁无异，但它开采自特别纯净的矿源，并且在塑形时几乎不用热量，甚至完全不用热量。这个过程极其困难，尤其是对于高品级的冷铁物品而言。

Primeval Mistletoe.name: 远古槲寄生 Primeval Mistletoe
Primeval Mistletoe.description:
这枝缀满浆果的冬青与槲寄生小枝不会枯萎或腐烂。它可用作原始法器，且当你佩戴它时，你的自然检定获得+1物品加值。

启动—涂抹 2（操作）

频率 每10分钟1次

效果你从其中一颗浆果中挤出汁液，并将其涂抹在一把主要由木头制成的武器上，以对其施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{符文武器}；或者涂抹到一个生物身上，以对其施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{符文之躯}。

启动—缠缚 2（操作）

频率 每天1次

效果你接触这枝小枝，再接触一棵树，以对自己施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{与植物为一}，在被接触的树上化为一根藤蔓。

This sprig of berry-festooned holly and mistletoe doesn't wilt or rot. It can be used as a primal locus, and it grants a +1 item bonus to Nature checks while you wear it.

Activate—Anoint 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect You squeeze juice from one of the berries and smear it onto a weapon made primarily of wood to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon} on it, or onto a creature to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body} on it.

Activate—Bind 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You touch the sprig, then a tree to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One with Plants} upon yourself, turning into a vine on the touched tree.

Verdant Staff.name: 翠绿法杖 Verdant Staff
Verdant Staff.description:
这根橡树分支会在春季长出叶子，在秋季变色，并在冬季落叶。持用它时，你在辨识植物和真菌的检定中获得 +2 环境加值。

启动 施放法术

效果 你消耗法杖中一定数量的充能，从其列表中施放一个法术。

  • 戏法 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{缠结藤蔓}
  • 1环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{符文之躯}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{符文武器}
  • 2环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{纠缠花草}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{橡木韧性}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{与植物为一}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CXICME10TkEJxz0P]{塑木术}

制作需求 提供上述所有法术在所列各环级各一次的施法。

This oak branch grows leaves in spring that change color in autumn and shed in winter. While wielding it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to identify plants and fungi.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrips @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine}
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One with Plants}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CXICME10TkEJxz0P]{Shape Wood}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.

Willow's Parting Gift.name: 柳的临别赠礼 Willow's Parting Gift
Willow's Parting Gift.tokenName: 柳的临别赠礼 Willow's Parting Gift

Twisting Twine (Lesser).name: 扭转绳线（次等）
Twisting Twine (Lesser).description:
这团麻绳线球会抗拒徒手将其解开的尝试。

启动—解开线团 1 （操作）

频率 每天一次

效果 你将线球投向 20 尺内的一个方格。随后，线绳会解开并活动起来，尝试对该方格中的一个生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}（由你选择），其运动检定总加值为 +9。在你的回合结束时，线绳会自行卷回成一团并返回你手中；如果你没有空着的手，它则会返回你的空间。

This ball of hempen twine resists efforts to unravel it by hand.

Activate—Unravel Twine 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You toss the ball of twine into a square within 20 feet. The twine then unravels and animates, attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} (your choice) a creature in the square with a total of +9 to the Athletics check. At the end of your turn, the twine winds itself back into a ball and returns to your hand; if you don't have a free hand, it returns to your space instead.

Willow's Parting Gift.prototypeToken: 柳的临别赠礼 Willow's Parting Gift

Heh Shan-Bao’s Diary.name: 赫山宝的日记 Heh Shan-Bao’s Diary
Heh Shan-Bao’s Diary.description:
包含赫山宝对他所面临困境的反思、他对在魔法仪式中冒着自己生命危险的恐惧，以及他最终决定修改仪式，并以“如果事情变糟，人人都付出一些，就没有人付出全部”为自我辩解的借口。

Contains Heh Shan-Bao’s reflections on the dilemma he faced, his fears about risking his own life in the magical ritual, and his ultimate decision to modify the ritual with the self-justifying excuse that, if things go bad, “all pay some, and none pays all.”

Steel Shield.name: 钢盾 Steel Shield
Steel Shield.description:
与木制盾牌一样，钢盾也有各种形状和大小。尽管比木制盾牌更昂贵，但它们也耐用得多。

硬度HPBT
52010

Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

HardnessHPBT
52010

Scale Mail.name: 鳞甲 Scale Mail
Scale Mail.description:
鳞甲由许多缝在加固皮革衬底上的金属鳞片组成，通常制成长衫的形式，能够保护躯干、手臂和腿部。

Scale mail consists of many metal scales sewn onto a reinforced leather backing, often in the form of a long shirt that protects the torso, arms, and legs.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓所用的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端带有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Defensive Training.name: 防御训练 Defensive Training
Defensive Training.description:
佣兵执法者在其回合开始时获得一个额外的反应动作，但只能将此反应动作用于护盾格挡。

The mercenary enforcer gains an additional reaction at the start of their turn but can only use this reaction to Shield Block.

Fearful of Ghosts.name: 惧怕幽灵 Fearful of Ghosts
Fearful of Ghosts.description:
这些关于闹鬼废墟的传言让唐入的佣兵打手们紧张不安。在任何与PC进行的战斗开始时，若唐入的恐怖点数阈值至少为2，一名佣兵执法者必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:20] 意志豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（若大失败，则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。一旦唐入的恐怖点数阈值达到7或更高，佣兵执法者每当变为惊惧时，也会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。

All this talk about haunted ruins has the mercenary enforcers at Karahai on edge. At the start of any combat against the PCs while Karahai's Terror Point threshold is at least 2, a mercenary enforcer must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). Once Karahai's Terror Point threshold is 7 or higher, a mercenary enforcer also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} whenever they become frightened.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
佣兵执法者对处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态的生物造成额外 1d6 精准伤害。

A mercenary enforcer deals 1d6 extra precision damage to creatures who are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob.name: 直到达米汗辛哥“达米”马巴邦洛布 Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob
Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob.tokenName: 直到达米汗辛哥“达米”马巴邦洛布 Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob
Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob.blurb:
和蔼的男性人类医生
 kindly male human doctor
Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob.prototypeToken: 直到达米汗辛哥“达米”马巴邦洛布 Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob

Amai.name: 阿迈 Amai

Arcane Innate Spells.name: 奥术内在法术 Arcane Innate Spells

Dispelling Globe.name: 驱散法球 Dispelling Globe
Dispelling Globe.description:
你在自己周围创造一个无法移动的球体，尝试反制任何来自球体外部、其区域或目标进入球体内的法术，如同该球体是一个比其实际法术环阶低1环的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}法术。

如果反制检定成功，它只会阻止该法术本会进入球体的那一部分（因此，如果该法术在球体外也有目标，或者其区域的一部分超出球体之外，那些目标或该区域仍会正常受到影响）。

你必须在一处连续且开阔的空间中形成这个球体，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术失效（不过在法术施放后，生物仍然可以进入球体）。

You create an immobile globe around yourself that attempts to counteract any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into the globe, as if the globe were a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank.

If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area is affected normally).

You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你瞬间将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到你视线内射程内一个未被占据的空间。若这会让另一生物与你一同被带走——即使你是用异次元容器携带它——该法术失效。

升环（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。随后你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dispel Magic (At Will).name: 解除魔法（随意施放）
Dispel Magic (At Will).description:
你解开法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。若你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在 10 分钟内变为其同类的非魔法物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标是神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，带有幻术灵光但在外观上并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由游戏主持判定。

升阶（4环） 如同3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的来源。类似于模糊感官，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5足见方的立方区域内（若其大于该范围，则锁定最近的那一部分）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Alter Dweomer.name: 改变魔法效果 Alter Dweomer
Alter Dweomer.description:
触发 玄法猫成为一个法术的目标，或在一个法术施放时处于其区域内

效果 玄法猫身上的符文状纹路开始发光，并根据触发法术的根源获得一种相关效果。该效果会在玄法猫受到该触发法术影响之前发生。该效果持续1分钟，直到玄法猫再次使用此能力，或直到玄法猫主动终止该效果，以先发生者为准。

  • 奥术 魔法反噬对触发的施法者造成 @Damage[4d6[force]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] 豁免）。
  • 神圣 玄法猫在所有技能检定上获得+1状态加值。
  • 异能 玄法猫变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。除了通常的结束条件外，如果玄法猫进行敌对动作，该效果也会结束。
  • 原始 玄法猫获得10点临时生命值。

Trigger The dweomercat is targeted by a spell or is within the area of a spell as it's cast

Effect The dweomercat's runelike patterns start to glow as it gains an effect related to the tradition of the triggering spell. This effect occurs before the dweomercat is affected by the triggering spell. The effect lasts for 1 minute, until the dweomercat uses this ability again, or until the dweomercat Dismisses the effect, whichever comes first.

  • Arcane Magical feedback deals @Damage[4d6[force]] damage to the triggering spellcaster (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).
  • Divine The dweomercat gains a +1 status bonus to all skill checks.
  • Occult The dweomercat becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This effect ends if the dweomercat uses a hostile action, in addition to the normal end conditions.
  • Primal The dweomercat gains 10 temporary Hit Points.

Dweomer Leap.name: 魔法飞跃 Dweomer Leap
Dweomer Leap.description:
先决条件 玄法猫至少还保留一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{传送} 法术

效果 玄法猫施放传送，然后可以在其传送结束时，对一个与其相邻的生物进行一次近战打击。如果玄法猫在传送结束时与一个处于持续性法术效果影响下的生物相邻，或者与一个自玄法猫上个回合以来施放过法术的生物相邻，则此次不会消耗一次传送的施放次数。

Prerequisites The dweomercat has at least one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} spell remaining

Effect The dweomercat casts translocate, then can make a melee Strike against one creature adjacent to it at the end of its teleport. If the dweomercat ends its teleport adjacent to a creature under an ongoing spell effect or who cast a spell since the dweomercat's last turn, this does not expend a casting of translocate.

Pounce.name: 猛扑 Pounce
Pounce.description:
玄法猫进行魅影野猪行走，并在该移动结束时进行一次打击。如果玄法猫开始此动作时处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}，则直到此能力的打击结算后，它仍保持藏匿。

The dweomercat Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the dweomercat began this action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

Amai.publicNotes:
玄法猫是来自第一世界、拥有魔法天赋的四眼猫科动物，在那里它们猎食其他生物，并以其原始能量为食。在第一世界中，它们会组成群体协同狩猎，不过它们更喜欢独自照料幼崽，用魔法与魔法生物喂养后代。作为充满好奇心的生物，它们有时会出现在宇宙中通往第一世界的帷幕较薄之处，或是魔法已被不可逆转地扭曲的地区。受到那种独特魔法共鸣的吸引，玄法猫希望在那里获得无与伦比的食物来源。

凡是有玄法猫目击报告的地方，不久之后往往就会出现专业捕兽人，盼着抓到一生仅有一次的大猎物。玄法猫的深紫色毛皮深受魔法收藏家追捧，因为流动于毛皮上的纹样看起来仿佛由手工绘成，其间的螺旋与卷曲宛如魔法符文。这些毛皮随后要么被陈列展示，要么被作为材料纳入罕见仪式之中。玄法猫最著名的是其扭曲施加在自身或附近法术那种无形丝线的能力，它们能将其转化为自己的防御魔法，或用来在战场上瞬间传送。

Dweomercats are magically gifted, four-eyed felines from the First World, where they prey upon other creatures and feed on their primal energy. Within the First World, they form packs that hunt together, though they prefer to care for their cubs on their own, raising them on a diet of magic and magical creatures. Curious creatures, they're sometimes encountered in areas of the Universe where the veil to the First World is thin or in regions where magic has been irreparably warped. Drawn there by the unique magical resonance, the dweomercats hope to acquire incomparable sources of food.

Where dweomercats sighting have been reported, specialized trappers will appear soon after, hoping for the catch of a lifetime. A dweomercat's dark purple fur is prized by magical collectors, as the patterns that flow through the fur appear as though they were hand-painted, with spirals and curls resembling magical runes. These coats are then either displayed or included as components in rare rituals. Dweomercats are famous for their ability to twist the metaphorical strings of spells cast on or near them, which they can transform into their own defensive magic or use to instantly teleport across the battlefield.

Scroll of Vampiric Exsanguination (Rank.name: 血族驱命卷轴（6环）
Scroll of Vampiric Exsanguination (Rank.description:
夹在一本名为《魁恩宗师》的书中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{血族驱命}

从卷轴施放法术需要你单手持握卷轴，并以该法术通常所需的动作数进行一次施法（行动）来启动它。

该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。因为由你来施法，所以使用你的法术攻击调整和法术DC。该法术还会获得与你根源相应的特征（奥术、神圣、异能或原始）。

任何实体材料消耗都在卷轴制作时提供，因此你从卷轴施法时无需再提供它们。如果该法术需要法器，你必须有该法器才能从卷轴施法。

注意：要创建某个特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从 compendium 或 compendium browser 拖入玩家角色、非玩家角色或战利品角色的物品栏中。

Tucked into a book titled Grandmasters of Quain.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination}

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when casting from a scroll. If the spell requires a locus, you must have that locus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Elizeth's Reward.name: 伊莉泽丝的奖赏 Elizeth's Reward
Elizeth's Reward.tokenName: 伊莉泽丝的奖赏 Elizeth's Reward

Healing Potion (Lesser).name: 治疗药水（次级）
Healing Potion (Lesser).description:
启动 A (操作)

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的麻感。当你饮用治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] Hit Points.

Vitalizing.name: 活化 Vitalizing
Vitalizing.description:
一把活化武器会脉动着生命能量，对亡灵额外造成 1d6 持续活力伤害。在大成功时，该亡灵还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到你的下个回合结束。

A vitalizing weapon pulses with vital energy, dealing an extra 1d6 persistent vitality damage to undead. On a critical hit, the undead is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn.

Elizeth's Reward.prototypeToken: 伊莉泽丝的奖赏 Elizeth's Reward

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Lightning Bolt.name: 闪电束 Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
一道闪电从你的手中向外劈出，造成 4d12 点电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing 4d12 electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Wall of Thorns.name: 棘墙术 Wall of Thorns
Wall of Thorns.description:
在一分钟的过程中，你使一堵厚实的多刺荆棘丛墙从地面生长出来。你创造一堵厚 5 足、呈一直线、最长可达 60 足且高 10 足的荆棘与刺藤之墙。你必须在一片连续且开阔的空间中创造这堵墙，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术失效。墙体垂直竖立。如果你愿意，这堵墙也可以更短或更矮。墙两侧的一切都对另一侧的生物获得掩蔽，且墙所占据的空间为困难地形。每当一个生物使用一次移动动作进入墙体至少一个空间时，该生物受到 3d4 点穿刺伤害。

墙体每个 10 足×10 足的部分具有 AC 10、硬度 10，以及 20 生命值。它免疫重击和精准伤害。被摧毁的部分可以被自由穿过。

升阶（+1） 墙体每个部分的生命值增加 5，且穿刺伤害增加 1d4。

Over the course of a minute, you cause a thick wall of thorny brambles to grow from the ground. You create a 5-foot-thick wall of brambles and thorns in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall stands vertically. If you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall has cover from creatures on the opposite side, and the wall's spaces are difficult terrain. For every move action a creature uses to enter at least one of the wall's spaces, that creature takes 3d4 piercing damage.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points. It's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section can be moved through freely.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 5, and the piercing damage increases by 1d4.

Floating Flame.name: 浮动火焰 Floating Flame
Floating Flame.description:
你创造出一团无需燃料即可燃烧、并会听从你命令移动的火焰。火焰在出现所在的方格内，对其中每个生物造成 3d6 点火焰伤害，进行一次基础反射豁免。当你维持此法术时，你可以让火焰悬浮移动至多 10 足。随后，它会对其在飞行期间任意时点与其共享空间的每个生物造成伤害。这使用相同的伤害和豁免，且你每次维持时只掷骰一次伤害。特定生物每轮只会受到一次浮动火焰的伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You create a fire that burns without fuel and moves to your commands. The flame deals 3d6 fire damage to each creature in the square in which it appears, with a basic Reflex save. When you Sustain this spell, you can levitate the flame up to 10 feet. It then deals damage to each creature whose space it shared at any point during its flight. This uses the same damage and save, and you roll the damage once each time you Sustain. A given creature can take damage from floating flame only once per round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Web.name: 蛛网术 Web
Web.description:
你在区域内制造出一片黏稠的蛛网，每当生物尝试穿过其中时，都会妨碍其移动。被蛛网填满的方格是困难地形。每个方格都可以通过一次造成至少5点挥砍伤害或1点火焰伤害的攻击或效果来清除蛛网。一个方格的AC为5，且其豁免骰自动失败。

每当蛛网中的生物开始使用一个移动动作，或在一个移动动作中进入蛛网时，它必须对抗你的法术DC尝试一次运动检定或反射豁免，以避免其速度受到环境减值，或变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}。脱离蛛网的生物不再承受来自蛛网的速度环境减值。

大成功 该生物不受影响，且在本回合内不需要再对蛛网尝试进一步的运动检定或豁免骰。如果它使用的是运动检定，则它在离开方格后，会清除它所离开的每一个方格中的蛛网。

成功 该生物在其动作期间不受影响。如果它使用的是运动检定，则它在离开方格后，会清除它所离开的每一个方格中的蛛网。

失败 该生物的所有速度受到–10足环境减值，直到其下个回合开始。

大失败 该生物陷入禁足，直到其下个回合开始，此后其所有速度受到–10足环境减值，持续1轮。它可以尝试挣脱以移除其禁足状态。

升阶（4环） 该法术的区域增至20足爆发，且其射程增至60足。

You create a sticky web in the area that impedes creatures' movement each time they try to move through it. Squares filled with the web are difficult terrain. Each square can be cleared of the web by a single attack or effect that deals at least 5 slashing damage or 1 fire damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws.

Each time a creature in the web begins to use a move action or enters the web during a move action, it must attempt an Athletics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to avoid taking a circumstance penalty to its Speeds or becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. A creature that gets out of the web ceases to take a circumstance penalty to its Speed from the web.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and it doesn't need to attempt further Athletics checks or saving throws against the web this turn. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves after leaving the square.

Success The creature is unaffected during its action. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves after leaving the square.

Failure The creature takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is Immobilized until the start of its next turn, after which it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape to remove its Immobilized condition.

Heightened (4th) The spell's area increases to a 20-foot burst, and its range increases to 60 feet.

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你泼出一团酸液，溅到你的目标和附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若命中，你造成 1d6 点强酸伤害外加 1 点溅射强酸伤害。若大成功，目标还会受到 @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] 伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提高至 2d6，且持续伤害提高至 2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提高至 3d6，持续伤害提高至 3，且溅射伤害提高至 2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提高至 4d6，持续伤害提高至 4，且溅射伤害提高至 3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提高至 5d6，持续伤害提高至 5，且溅射伤害提高至 4。

You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures. Make a spell attack. If you hit, you deal 1d6 acid damage plus 1 splash acid damage. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (3rd) The initial damage increases to 2d6, and the persistent damage increases to 2.

Heightened (5th) The initial damage increases to 3d6, the persistent damage increases to 3, and the splash damage increases to 2.

Heightened (7th) The initial damage increases to 4d6, the persistent damage increases to 4, and the splash damage increases to 3.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases to 5d6, the persistent damage increases to 5, and the splash damage increases to 4.

Grease.name: 油腻术 Grease
Grease.description:
你施放油腻术，选择一个区域或目标。

  • 区域 [4个相连的5英尺方格] 区域内所有坚实地面都覆盖着油脂。每个站在油腻表面上的生物都必须成功通过一次反射豁免，或进行一次对抗你法术DC的特技检定，否则便会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。在法术持续时间内，使用动作移动到油腻表面上的生物必须尝试进行一次反射豁免或特技检定，以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{特技检定才能保持平衡}。进行调整步或爬行的生物无需尝试检定或豁免。
  • 目标 [1件负载1或以下的物体] 如果你对一个无人持用的物体施放此法术，任何想拾起该物体的人都必须成功通过一次对抗你法术DC的特技检定或反射豁免才能这么做。如果你的目标是一个被持用的物体，持有该物体的生物必须尝试一次特技检定或反射豁免。失败时，持有者或挥舞者在所有涉及使用该物体的检定上承受–2环境减值；大失败时，持有者或挥舞者会松开该物品。该物体会落在由游戏主持选择的相邻方格内。如果你对一个穿戴中的物体施放此法术，其穿戴者在对抗试图擒拿他们的尝试时，强韧豁免获得+2环境加值。

You conjure grease, choosing an area or target.

  • Area [4 contiguous 5-foot squares] All solid ground in the area is covered with grease. Each creature standing on the greasy surface must succeed at a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check against your spell DC or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Creatures using an action to move onto the greasy surface during the spell's duration must attempt either a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}. A creature that Steps or Crawls doesn't have to attempt a check or save.
  • Target [1 object of Bulk 1 or less] If you Cast the Spell on an unattended object, anyone trying to pick up the object must succeed at an Acrobatics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to do so. If you target an attended object, the creature that has the object must attempt an Acrobatics check or Reflex save. On a failure, the holder or wielder takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all checks that involve using the object; on a critical failure, the holder or wielder releases the item. The object lands in an adjacent square of the GM's choice. If you Cast this Spell on a worn object, the wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against attempts to grapple them.

Spider Sting.name: 蛛咬术 Spider Sting
Spider Sting.description:
你以魔法复制蜘蛛带毒的螫刺。你对被触及的生物造成1d4穿刺伤害，并使其感染蜘蛛毒液。目标必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到 @Damage[1d4[poison]] 伤害。

失败 目标感染阶段1的蜘蛛毒液。

大失败 目标感染阶段2的蜘蛛毒液。

蜘蛛毒液（毒素）

等级 1

最长持续时间 4轮

阶段1 1d4毒素伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}（1轮）

阶段2 1d4毒素伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}（1轮）

You magically duplicate a spider's venomous sting. You deal 1d4 piercing damage to the touched creature and afflict it with spider venom. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage.

Failure The target is afflicted with spider venom at stage 1.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with spider venom at stage 2.

Spider Venom (poison)

Level 1

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 poison damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 1d4 poison damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Tangle Vine.name: 缠结藤蔓 Tangle Vine
Tangle Vine.description:
一根藤蔓凭空出现，从你的手中弹出并抽向目标，将自己缠绕在目标身上。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{法术效果：缠结藤蔓}

大成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并且其各项速度在1轮内承受–10足环境减值。它可以尝试 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱}，对抗你的法术DC，以移除该减值和禁足状态。

成功 目标的各项速度在1轮内承受–10足环境减值。它可以尝试挣脱，对抗你的法术DC，以移除该减值。

失败 目标不受影响。

强化（2环） 这些效果持续2轮。

强化（4环） 这些效果持续1分钟。

A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description:
无面鬼模仿者携带一把+1 强击武器，其外观看起来与被模仿的玩家角色所偏好的武器完全相同。如果该玩家角色偏好徒手打击，它就会显现为手部缠带。如果该玩家角色偏好远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，而是改为使用上方的远程武器规则；否则，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果该玩家角色不偏好任何武器，则无脸鬼会将一根短棒作为其虚假武器。这把虚假武器只有部分是真实的，命中时只造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原武器的任何特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损、被缴械或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟重塑一把虚假武器来制作替代品。

A noppera-bo impersonator carries a +1 striking weapon that looks identical to the favored weapon of the PC being impersonated. If the PC favors unarmed strikes, it appears as hand wraps. If the PC favors a ranged weapon, then the noppera-bo impersonator has no melee weapon and instead uses the ranged weapon rules above; otherwise, the noppera-bo impersonator has no ranged weapon. If the PCs favors no weapon, then the noppera-bo wields a club as its false weapon. This false weapon is only partially real and inflicts only mental damage when it hits; it gains none of the original weapon's traits or magical enhancements. If a noppera-bo impersonator's false weapon is broken, disarmed, or set down, it fades away. The noppera-bo impersonator can craft a replacement false weapon by spending 10 minutes to recreate one.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸鬼没有视觉，但听觉十分敏锐。它们不需要呼吸，并且免疫需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上会将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用来“饮用”；它们也能以这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

The noppera-bo has no sense of vision, but their hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，它就会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as the noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonated Spellcasting.name: 模仿者施法 Impersonated Spellcasting
Impersonated Spellcasting.description:
无面鬼模仿者获得一组天生法术，与其所模仿的玩家角色所使用的施法根源相匹配。你可以调整这些法术，使其与该模仿更加契合。

The noppera-bo impersonator gains a suites of innate spells, matching the spellcasting tradition utilized by the PC being impersonated. You can adjust the spells to make a more perfect fit for the impersonation.

Kalen Bray.name: 卡伦·布雷 Kalen Bray

Jaws.name: 颚 Jaws
Jaws.description:
需求 该丧尸已使一个生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}。

Requirements The zombie has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Kalen Bray.publicNotes:
蹒跚的丧尸是一种行动迟缓的恐怖存在，在数量更多时尤为危险。

丧尸唯一的欲望就是吞食活人。它们毫无思想，永远蹒跚前行，是死亡的先兆；只有在被摧毁时，丧尸才会停下。

A zombie shambler is a slow-moving horror dangerous in larger groups.

A zombie's only desire is to consume the living. Unthinking and ever-shambling harbingers of death, zombies stop only when they're destroyed.

Very Drunken Jinkin.name: 非常醉的金金 Very Drunken Jinkin
Very Drunken Jinkin.tokenName: 非常醉的金金 Very Drunken Jinkin

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法任你驱使。只要你维持该法术，你就可以施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你都可以从以下四个选项中选择一项。

  • 烹调 使 1 磅非生物材料冷却、加热，或赋予其风味。
  • 抬升 将一个无人持握、负载为轻或更低的物体缓慢抬离地面 1 足。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且人为痕迹明显，并且极其脆弱——它不能被用作工具、武器或法术材料。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体着色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用 10 轮专注影响一个 1 负载的物体，而更大的物体则每 1 负载需要 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体产生的任何实际改变（除上述说明外）都只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Club (Table Leg or Bottle).name: 短棒（桌腿或瓶子）
Club (Table Leg or Bottle).description:
这是一根结实的木头，被塑形或改造用于痛击敌人。短棒可以是精雕细刻的武术作品，也可以像树木的分支或一块木头一样简单。

This is a piece of stout wood shaped or repurposed to bludgeon an enemy. Clubs can be intricately carved pieces of martial art or as simple as a tree branch or piece of wood.

Far Too Drunk.name: 醉得离谱 Far Too Drunk
Far Too Drunk.description:
蹑影小魔怪在使用自己的动作时效率低下，并且在每轮中总会花费一个动作来咯咯怪笑、原地跌跌撞撞，或以其他方式做出无效的滑稽举动。

The jinkins are inefficient with their actions and always spend one action each round to cackle, stumble in place, or otherwise perform ineffective antics.

Very Drunken Jinkin.publicNotes:
蹑影小魔怪是残忍的修补匠，会偷窃并破坏物品，还以自己诅咒珍贵物体的能力为莫大骄傲。它们心怀怨念，每当觉得自己受了冒犯——比如某个生物竟敢移除它们施加的一道诅咒——就会制定错综复杂的复仇计划。蹑影小魔怪很少满足于制造单纯的混乱；它们也从折磨与谋杀中获得极大快感，不过比起直接杀死受害者，它们更喜欢把猎物引入那些旨在捕获或使其失去行动能力的陷阱。深坑是它们的最爱，因为从坠落中幸存下来的受害者，往往会因饥饿和口渴而缓慢死去。蹑影小魔怪喜欢聚集在坑边，嘲弄、戏弄并折磨受害者。

小魔怪是残酷的妖精恶作剧者与破坏者，早已完全适应了在物质位面的生活，并为自己富有创意的毁灭行为找到了鲜明的生态位。所有小魔怪都乐于毁坏或打碎事物，无论是装置或载具这类有形之物，还是联盟或关系这类无形之物。小魔怪最大的快乐，就是看着复杂造物轰然崩塌，最好还是在它们以最轻微、最不起眼且精心瞄准的一推之后发生。小魔怪往往会贬低、霸凌，甚至屠杀自己较弱小的同族，尤其是蹑影小魔怪；小魔怪（以及许多其他人）都会轻蔑地把它们称作“螨怪”。

Jinkins are sadistic tinkers who steal and sabotage items and take great pride in their power to curse precious objects. They hold grudges and create convoluted plans for revenge whenever they feel slighted, such as when a creature dares to remove one of their curses. Rarely content to wreak simple mayhem, jinkins also take immense pleasure in torture and murder, though they prefer to lead victims into traps designed to capture or incapacitate rather than kill outright. Deep pits are favorites, since victims who survive the fall face a slow death from starvation and thirst. Jinkins enjoy gathering at the edge of pits to mock, tease, and torment.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life on the Material Plane, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. All gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the lightest and slightest, carefully targeted push from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom gremlins (and many others) derisively call "mites."
Very Drunken Jinkin.blurb:
异种蹑影小魔怪
Variant jinkins
Very Drunken Jinkin.prototypeToken: 非常醉的金金 Very Drunken Jinkin

Ren Mei Li's Supplies.name: 任美璃的补给品 Ren Mei Li's Supplies
Ren Mei Li's Supplies.tokenName: 任美璃的补给品 Ren Mei Li's Supplies

Gossamer Sash.name: 罗网绶带 Gossamer Sash
Gossamer Sash.description:
启动 1小时（观想，交互，移动）

这条轻盈的绶带由蛛丝制成，完全展开时长20英尺。一端洁白，另一端渐变为紫罗兰色，整条绶带上都缝有以银线绣成的异能标记。当至多4人共同持握罗网绶带，并在午夜至日出之间于神门的任意道路上步行1小时后，他们便会踏入一处拟真思维空间，其显现为一条荒寂的山道，那里栖居着道途侍女；她们对于回答旅人可能提出的问题抱有好感（至少起初如此）。一旦道途侍女回答完他们的问题，或被杀死（以先发生者为准），心景便会结束，而经历过它的人会被送回他们最初启动罗网绶带时所在的道路位置。

Activate 1 hour (envision, Interact, move)

This lightweight sash of spidersilk measures 20 feet long when fully unfurled. White at one end and shading to violet at the other, occult markings in silver thread are stitched along the sash's length. When a gossamer sash is held by up to 4 people and they spend 1 hour walking along any road in Shenmen between midnight and sunrise, they step into an immersive mindscape that appears to be a lonely mountainside road inhabited by path maidens who are (at least initially) favorably disposed toward answering questions the travelers might have. Once the path maidens have answered their questions or are slain (whichever comes first), the mindscape ends, and those who traveled it are returned to the point on the road where they first activated the gossamer sash.

Sanctified Beans.name: 圣化豆 Sanctified Beans
Sanctified Beans.description:
启动 2 交互

这些烘烤过的大豆由祭司祝福，能够抵御各种异界影响，但对虚体邪恶之物——例如幽灵或道途侍女——尤其有效。活着的生物可以安全食用，配上米酒时味道尤为鲜美。当你启动此物品时，选择一个与你相邻并朝其呼气的方格。你以安抚性的烟气充满该方格；在接下来1分钟内，任何在其回合结束时位于该方格中的邪魔、妖精、幽灵、精魂或亡灵生物都会受到 @Damage[(4d8+4)[spirit]|traits:holy]（神圣）伤害（@Check[will|dc:28|basic] 意志豁免）。受到此伤害的虚体生物还必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 强韧豁免，以抵抗如下效果。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，直到你的下一回合开始。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}，随后减速1，持续1轮。

Activate 2 Interact

These roasted soybeans are blessed by a priest to ward against all various forms of otherworldly influence but are most effective against incorporeal evils, such as specters or path maidens. They can be safely eaten by living creatures and taste delicious when paired with rice wine. When you activate this item, choose an adjacent square to exhale into. You fill that square with soothing vapors that harm any fiend, fey, ghost, spirit, or undead creature that ends their turn in that square for the next minute, causing them to take @Damage[(4d8+4)[spirit]|traits:holy] (holy) damage (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save). An incorporeal creature that takes this damage must also attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save to resist being affected as follows.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and is then slowed 1 for 1 round.

Ren Mei Li's Supplies.prototypeToken: 任美璃的补给品 Ren Mei Li's Supplies

Yuni.name: 尤妮 Yuni

Site Bound.name: 场地绑定 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
一个普通幽灵通常只能游荡到距离它被杀害之处或它作祟之地不远的地方。普通的限制是120尺。有些幽灵则不会被地点束缚，而是被束缚于某个房间、建筑、物品，或某个对它而言具有特殊意义的生物。

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
归还她妹妹的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KrmSuQIyu6OEi5ew]{神圣祈祷念珠}并揭示她的命运，能让尤妮得以安息（不过，如果玩家角色们在那之前没有打破柳岸镇心景，她明年还会以幽灵的形态归来）。

当一个幽灵被摧毁时，它会在[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后于其所缚之地重新成形，并完全恢复。只有当某人查明其存在的原因，并纠正任何阻止该精魂休息之事后，幽灵才能被永久摧毁。

Returning her sister's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KrmSuQIyu6OEi5ew]{Holy Prayer Beads} and revealing her fate allows Yuni to move on (although she'll return as a ghost next year if the PCs don't break the Willowshore mindscape before then).

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Frightful Moan.name: 骇人悲叹 Frightful Moan
Frightful Moan.description:
幽灵哀叹自身的命运，迫使 @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30尺}内的每个活着的生物尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:25|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] 意志豁免。失败时，生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}（若为大失败，则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}）。成功时，生物在1分钟内暂时免疫该幽灵的骇人悲叹。

The ghost laments its fate, forcing each living creature within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} to attempt a @Check[will|dc:25|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save. On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure). On a success, a creature is temporarily immune to this ghost's frightful moan for 1 minute.

Tiger Attack.name: 猛虎攻击 Tiger Attack
Tiger Attack.description:
尤妮痛苦地喊叫，一只幽灵老虎出现，撕扯她的身体，随后更多幽灵老虎出现，并对 @Template[emanation|distance:30] 内的所有生物做出同样的行为。该区域内的生物受到 @Damage[4d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] 挥砍伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] 反射豁免）。

Yuni cries out in pain as a ghostly tiger appears to rip and tear at her body, only for additional ghostly tigers to appear and do the same to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. Creatures in this area take @Damage[4d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save).

Yuni.publicNotes:
平民幽灵是一个普通人，认为自己死得不公，通常是由于谋害或背叛。

当一些凡人因悲惨的境遇死去，或带着未了之事而死时，他们可能会继续徘徊于世间。这些痛苦的灵魂会在生前对自己意义重大的地点作祟，不断试图纠正他们所认为的不公或恶行。

The ghost commoner is an ordinary person who believes they died unjustly, usually due to foul play or betrayal.

When some mortals die through tragic circumstances or without closure, they can linger on in the world. These anguished souls haunt a locale significant to them in life, constantly trying to right their perceived wrong or wrongdoings.
Yuni.blurb:
女性人类幽灵
Female human ghost

Longsword.name: 长剑 Longsword
Longsword.description:
长剑，也称为单手剑，既可以是单刃剑，也可以是双刃剑。它们的剑身厚重，长度在3到4英尺之间。

Longswords, also known as arming swords, can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

Padded Armor.name: 软甲 Padded Armor
Padded Armor.description:
这种护甲只是一层厚实的绗缝布料，但有时人们会因为它非常便宜而使用它。软甲比其他类型的护甲更容易受损和被毁。重甲的价格中包含一件软甲内衬，不过当它穿在重甲下面时，会失去舒适特征。如果你的重甲被摧毁，或者你在其他情况下没有穿着整套重甲时，你也可以只穿这件软甲内衬来睡觉。这使你能够继续对魔法护甲进行灌注，并从相关重甲上任何符文的力量中受益，但没有这件软甲内衬，其他人就无法穿戴你的重甲。

This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep magic armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Choker of Elocution (Greater).name: 巧言护喉（高阶）
Choker of Elocution (Greater).description:
这条白金项圈刻有三种语言字母表中的字符，并赋予关于这些语言及其对应文化习俗的知识。

你在社会检定中获得+2物品加值，并获得理解、说出和书写所选语言的能力。

你出色的口才使你在耳聋状态下执行听觉动作时所需进行的纯骰检定难度从5降低至3。

制作需求 你知晓该项圈所赋予的语言。

This platinum choker bears characters from three language's alphabet, and it gives knowledge of those languages and the associated culture's customs.

You gain a +2 item bonus to Society checks and the ability to understand, speak, and write the chosen languages.

Your excellent elocution reduces the DC of the flat check to perform an auditory action while deafened from 5 to 3.

Craft Requirements You know the languages the choker grants.

Sleeves of Storage (Greater).name: 储存袖（高等）
Sleeves of Storage (Greater).description:
这件宽松长袍有着宽大蓬松的袖子，每只袖子中都包含一个异次元空间。这些空间各自如同一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.jaEEvuQ32GjAa8jy]{宽裕腰包（I型）}，可容纳最多20负载的物品（总计40负载），但任何单件物品都不能超过1负载；当袖子接近最大容量时，会稍微变重。你可以在腾出一只手的情况下，以一个交互动作将物品放入或从袖子中取出。

如果一只袖子完全空着，你可以将自己的魔宠放入那个异次元空间中。它最多可以舒适地在你的袖子里存活4小时，之后便会开始窒息。当它在你的袖子里时，它不会受到任何效果影响，也不能成为任何效果的目标，但你无法从任何主人能力中获益。魔宠可以依自己意愿，以一个具有操作与移动特征的单动作离开袖子。你不能将任何其他生物放入你的袖子中；如果你的魔宠体型大于超小型，你也不能将它放入袖子中。如果你的魔宠在袖子里，你就不能再把任何物品放进该袖子。

This loose robe has wide, voluminous sleeves that each contain an extradimensional space. These spaces each function as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.jaEEvuQ32GjAa8jy]{Spacious Pouch (Type I)} that can hold up to 20 Bulk of items (for a total of 40 Bulk), though no individual item can be of more than 1 Bulk; the sleeves grow slightly heavy as you reach maximum capacity. You can add or remove an item from a sleeve with a single hand free as an Interact action.

If a sleeve is completely empty, you can place your own familiar into that extradimensional space. It can survive comfortably in your sleeve for up to 4 hours, after which it begins to suffocate. While in your sleeve, it can't be affected or targeted by any effects, but you don't benefit from any master abilities. A familiar can exit the sleeve of its own volition with a single action that has the manipulate and move traits. You can't place any other creature into your sleeves, nor can you place your familiar in a sleeve if it's larger than Tiny. If your familiar is in your sleeve, you can't place any items in the sleeve.

Heh Shan-Bao’s Journal.name: 赫山宝的日志 Heh Shan-Bao’s Journal
Heh Shan-Bao’s Journal.description:
一本厚重的日志，里面夹满了散页和潦草写就的卷轴——总计为总督关于他所希望能强化丹杉树的仪式的笔记，以及他在每个心景循环中为创造一个能让自己逃回生者世界的转生术仪式而写下的研究。

回到这片心景的行为也让这本日志发生了变化——它仍然包含数十张散页和卷轴，但日志本身已变成一本中阶复原净化典籍。

在新月的夜晚，这本书呈深蓝色，随着月亮渐盈逐渐转为鲜红色。

启动 F（专注、治疗、活力）

频率 每天一次

需求 你的上一个动作是施放一本预备自这本魔典的法术，且该法术移除了你自己或一名盟友身上的有害状态或苦难

效果 选择一个其状态被所需法术移除的生物。根据版本不同，该生物获得2d8点持续1小时的临时生命值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.r1IsOaxM5tgVU29b]{Effect: Tome of Restorative Cleansing}

A thick journal filled with loose pages and scribbled scrolls—the total of the governor's notes on the ritual he hoped would strengthen the Tan Sugi tree as well as those he worked on each mindscape cycle to create a transmigrate ritual to escape back to the living world.

The act of returning to this mindscape has transformed the journal as well—it still contains dozens of loose sheets and scrolls, but the journal itself has become a moderate tome of restorative cleansing.

This book is dark blue on the night of the new moon, gradually shifting to bright red as the moon waxes.

Activate F (concentrate, healing, vitality)

Frequency once per day

Requirements Your last action was to cast a spell prepared from this grimoire, and the spell removed a harmful condition or affliction from yourself or an ally

Effect Choose one creature whose condition was removed by the required spell. Depending on the version, that creature gains 2d8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.r1IsOaxM5tgVU29b]{Effect: Tome of Restorative Cleansing}

Isori.name: 伊索里 Isori

Divine Spontaneous Spells.name: 神术自发法术 Divine Spontaneous Spells

Breath of Life.name: 生命之息 Breath of Life
Breath of Life.description:
触发 射程内一个活着的生物将要死亡。

你的祝福在生物死亡的瞬间使其复苏。你阻止目标死亡，并为目标恢复 5d8 生命值。如果触发该能力的效果是死亡效果，或是不留下任何遗骸的效果，例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}，你不能使用生命之息。

升环（+2） 治疗量增加 1d8。

Trigger A living creature within range would die.

Your blessing revives a creature at the moment of its death. You prevent the target from dying and restore 5d8 Hit Points to the target. You can't use breath of life if the triggering effect was a death effect or an effect that leaves no remains, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}

Heightened (+2) The healing increases by 1d8.

Divine Immolation.name: 神圣焚灭 Divine Immolation
Divine Immolation.description:
神圣烈焰灼烧区域内的生物。生物受到 6d6 火焰伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level -3)d6[persistent,fire]] 伤害。烈焰中的神圣力量也会灼烧精魂；若这对该生物更为不利（由游戏主持裁定），则神圣焚灭造成精魂伤害而非火焰伤害。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害，且不受持续伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害和持续伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害和双倍持续伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d6，持续伤害增加 1d6。

Divine flames scour creatures within the area. Creatures take 6d6 fire damage and @Damage[(@item.level -3)d6[persistent,fire]] damage. The divine power within the flames scorches the spirit as well; a creature takes spirit damage instead of fire damage from divine immolation if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and persistent damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and double persistent damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and persistent damage increases by 1d6.

Fly.name: 飞行 Fly
Fly.description:
目标可以在空中翱翔，获得等同于其速度或 20 尺的飞行速度，以较高者为准。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{法术效果：飞行}

升阶（7环） 持续时间增加至 1 小时。

The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

Crisis of Faith.name: 信仰危机 Crisis of Faith
Crisis of Faith.description:
你侵袭目标的信仰，使该生物充满怀疑与心灵动荡，造成 6d6 心灵伤害；如果它能够施放神术，则改为造成 6d8 心灵伤害。其结果由它的意志豁免决定。

对许多神祇而言，若无重大缘由就对与你信奉同一神祇的追随者施放此法术，乃是禁忌。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受一半伤害。

失败 目标承受全额伤害；如果目标能够施放神术，则其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续 1 轮。

大失败 目标承受双倍伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续 1 轮，且在 1 轮内无法施放神术。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 2d6（若目标为神术施法者，则改为提高 2d8）。

You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal 6d6 mental damage, or 6d8 mental damage if it can cast divine spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.

To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 (or by 2d8 if the target is a divine spellcaster).

Holy Light.name: 圣光 Holy Light
Holy Light.description:
你射出一道炽烈的光线，其中带有神圣能量。进行一次远程法术攻击。光线造成 5d6 火焰伤害。如果目标具有邪秽（特征），则你额外造成 5d6 精魂伤害。

大成功 目标受到双倍伤害。

成功 目标受到全部伤害。

如果光线穿过一片魔法黑暗区域，或以受魔法黑暗影响的生物为目标，圣光会尝试反制黑暗。如果你需要判定光线是否穿过一片黑暗区域，在你与该法术的目标之间画一条线。

升环（+1） 火焰伤害增加 2d6，而对邪秽生物造成的精魂伤害增加 2d6。

You shine a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target has the unholy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, holy light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.

Lightning Bolt.name: 闪电束 Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
一道闪电从你的手中向外迸发，造成 4d12 点电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing 4d12 electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
以一次粗略的精神接触，你试图读取目标的心智。它必须进行一次意志豁免。随后，目标在 1 小时内会暂时免疫你的读心术。

大成功 当你施放该法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放该法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思绪，并且你会得知其智力是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大失败 如同失败，并且在该法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Calm.name: 冷静 Calm
Calm.description:
你强行让区域内的生物冷静下来，抚慰它们进入一种非暴力状态；每个生物都必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 冷静的冲动使该生物的攻击掷骰承受 -1 状态减值。

失败 任何本会影响该生物的情绪效果都会被压制，且该生物不能使用敌对动作。如果目标受到任何其他生物的敌对对待，它将不再受到冷静的影响。

大失败 如失败，但敌对行为不会结束该效果。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

Cleanse Affliction.name: 净化苦难 Cleanse Affliction
Cleanse Affliction.description:
柔和的恢复性魔法会压制毒素和更复杂病症的影响。选择目标身上的一种苦难，例如诅咒、疾病或毒素。如果它已经进展到第一阶段之后，则将其阶段降低一级。此降低对于某一特定苦难实例只能生效一次；当该实例被完全治愈时，该实例结束。虽然这种降低不能再次发生，但此法术的升阶版本会在每次施放时尝试进行反制。

升阶（3环） 如果该苦难是疾病或毒素，则尝试反制该苦难。

升阶（4环） 如果该苦难是诅咒、疾病或毒素，则尝试反制该苦难。

Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标进行一次反制检定。如果你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在 10 分钟内变为其对应类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是一件神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Noise Blast.name: 噪音爆破 Noise Blast
Noise Blast.description:
刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须尝试进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} 1 分钟，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d10 点。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

See the Unseen.name: 目睹无形者 See the Unseen
See the Unseen.description:
你的目光刺穿幻象，发现@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物与精魂。你可以看见隐形生物，如同它们并未隐形一般，尽管它们的特征会显得模糊，使其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态且难以辨认。你还可以看见虚体生物，例如幽灵，若它们在距离物体表面10尺内自物体内部穿出，你会透过这些物体将其视为模糊的形体。更细微的线索还会使你在进行识破幻象的检定时获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 此法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：目睹无形者}

Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一次心灵震击使其恍惚。该震击造成1d6心灵伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，感知魔法的存在。除了魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略那些你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友身上的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，带有幻术灵光但在外观上并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}），通常仍会被正常侦测到。

强化（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由游戏主持判定。

强化（4环） 如同3环，但你还会定位出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同模糊感官一样，你不会得知其精确位置，但可以将来源缩小至5足立方内（若来源大于该范围，则为最近的一个）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Frostbite.name: 霜噬 Frostbite
Frostbite.description:
一团刺骨寒冷的球体在你的目标周围凝聚，冻结其身体。目标受到 2d4 点寒冷伤害，进行一次基础强韧豁免。若大失败，目标还会获得对钝击 1 的弱点，直到你下个回合开始。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.DdqWMj7cuf4S1bgr]{法术效果：霜噬}

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4，且大失败时的弱点增加 1。

An orb of biting cold coalesces around your target, freezing its body. The target takes 2d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target also gains weakness 1 to bludgeoning until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.DdqWMj7cuf4S1bgr]{Spell Effect: Frostbite}

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4 and the weakness on a critical failure increases by 1.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命能量来治疗活着的生物或伤害亡灵。若目标是自愿的活体生物，你恢复其1d8生命值。若目标是亡灵，你对其造成等量的活力伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （专注） 该法术的射程为30尺。若你在治疗一个活体生物，恢复的生命值增加8。

3 （专注） 你将生命能量散布于一个@Template[emanation|distance:30]中。这会以爆发内所有活着的生物和亡灵为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害提高1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗提高8。

You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你制造一个光球，在你选择的颜色下于20足半径内散发明亮光照（并在接下来的20足内提供昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所处的同一空间内制造这团光，你可以将光附着在该生物身上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮于其附近。你可以维持该法术，将这团光移动至多60足；作为此次移动的一部分，你可以将其附着到一个生物身上或使其与生物分离。

你可以解消该法术。如果你在已经有四个光法术生效时再施放该法术，你必须选择一个现存法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光}

强化（4环） 该光球在60足半径内散发明亮光照（并在接下来的60足内提供昏暗光照）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Protection.name: 防护 Protection
Protection.description:
你守护一个生物，使其免受伤害。目标的护甲等级和豁免骰获得+1状态加值。

升环（3环） 你可以选择让这些增益也影响目标周围 @Template[emanation|distance:10] 内的所有盟友。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{法术效果：防护}

You ward a creature against harm. The target gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose to have the benefits also affect all your allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{Spell Effect: Protection}

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何经由你告知该灵光信息的人，在针对该物品进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时获得 +2 环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的环级低于你的阅读灵光法术环级时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升环（3环） 你最多可以将 10 个物体作为目标。

升环（6环） 你可以将任意数量的物体作为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Spirit Link.name: 魂魄链接 Spirit Link
Spirit Link.description:
你与另一名生物形成一道魂魄链接，承受其痛苦。当你施放此法术时，以及在你的每个回合开始时，若目标低于其最大生命值，它恢复 2 点生命值（或其当前生命值与最大生命值之间的差值，若该数值更低）。你失去与目标所恢复的生命值相同数量的生命值。

这是一种灵性转移，因此任何会增加目标恢复生命值或减少你失去生命值的效果都不适用。此转移也会忽略你或目标拥有的任何临时生命值。由于此效果不涉及活力或虚空能量，魂魄链接即使在你或目标是不死生物时也能生效。只要持续时间仍在，你无法从再生或快速治疗中获得任何益处。你可以解消此法术；如果你的生命值降至 0 点，魂魄链接会自动结束。

强化（+1） 每次转移的生命值增加 2 点。

You form a spiritual link with another creature, taking in its pain. When you Cast this Spell and at the start of each of your turns, if the target is below maximum Hit Points, it regains 2 Hit Points (or the difference between its current and maximum Hit Points, if that's lower). You lose as many Hit Points as the target regained.

This is a spiritual transfer, so no effects apply that would increase the Hit Points the target regains or decrease the Hit Points you lose. This transfer also ignores any temporary Hit Points you or the target have. Since this effect doesn't involve vitality or void energy, spirit link works even if you or the target is undead. While the duration persists, you gain no benefit from regeneration or fast healing. You can Dismiss this spell, and if you're ever at 0 Hit Points, spirit link ends automatically.

Heightened (+1) The number of Hit Points transferred each time increases by 2.

Stabilize.name: 稳定伤势 Stabilize
Stabilize.description:
生命能量关上死亡之门。目标失去 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死（状态）}，但在 0 生命值时仍保持 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}。

Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造出一只漂浮的、魔法的手，可以是隐形的或幽灵般的；它抓住目标物体，并使其缓慢地向任意方向悬浮移动，最多 20 尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以使该物体额外移动 20 尺。如果法术结束时该物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你可以将一个负载为 1 或更低的无人照看的物体作为目标。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个负载为 1 或更低的无人照看的物体作为目标。

升阶（7环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个负载为 2 或更低的无人照看的物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Coils of Knowledge.name: 知识盘绕 Coils of Knowledge
Coils of Knowledge.description:
这只娜迦的束缚更偏向灵性而非肉体。被 vicharamuni 的尾巴击中的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:29] 豁免，否则被尾巴 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}，直到其 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱}、娜迦以一个交互动作释放对方，或娜迦死亡为止。

被擒抱者进行挣脱时承受 –4 状态减值，但可以选择进行一次神秘学或宗教检定来挣脱，而非使用通常选项，且不会承受此减值。

The naga's grip is more spiritual than physical. A creature hit by a vicharamuni's tail must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the tail until they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}, the naga releases them with an Interact action, or the naga dies.

A captive takes a –4 status penalty to Escape, but can choose to attempt an Occultism or Religion check to Escape instead of the usual options without taking this penalty

Spiritual Venom.name: 灵性毒液 Spiritual Venom
Spiritual Venom.description:
毗阇罗牟尼可以选择使其毒液对一个生物造成的任何伤害无效。此外，娜迦可以对一个受其毒液影响的生物施放其任意神圣法术，无论射程或效果线如何。

A vicharamuni can choose to negate any damage that its venom does to a creature. In addition, the naga can cast any of its divine spells on a creature that is affected by its venom, regardless of range or line of effect.

Vicharamuni Venom.name: 维查拉穆尼毒液 Vicharamuni Venom
Vicharamuni Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[will|dc:29]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[3d6[spirit]]（1 轮）

阶段 2 3d6 精魂伤害且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸取 1}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:29]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[spirit]] (1 round)

Stage 2 3d6 spirit and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Isori.publicNotes:
觉醒纳迦是仁慈而睿智的教师，会教导人们并守护各地。它们会试图引导并培育周遭世界，感知那些具有超自然意义潜力的凡人或地点。一旦找到目标，这些纳迦便会提供教诲与神圣试炼，将自己的受监护者磨炼得更为强大，并使其对是非善恶有更深刻的理解。尽管在学生眼中，它们常被视为严厉而令人生畏的导师，但受毗遮罗牟尼教导者往往最终会成为伟大的英雄。

觉醒纳迦在引导自己的幼体时也同样细心。纳迦成年后，会先接受最后一场试炼，随后才会被鼓励离开巢穴，去寻找属于自己的自然奇观或前途可期的凡人。有时，数代纳迦会守护同一处地点或同一家族血脉，将这份照料的荣誉代代相传。在这种情况下，亲代纳迦会设法让至少一个孩子选择留下，成为祖传受监护者的守护者，如此一来，父母便能安心，因为它们所保护的地点将继续由其后代守护。
