纳迦是具有魔法力量与敏锐 intellects 的蛇形生物。就外形而言，它们像巨大的蛇，不过常佩戴珠宝和其他饰物，使自己明显有别于动物近亲。纳迦会使用与生俱来的魔法和有毒尖牙，使除了最坚定的敌人之外的所有对手都无法靠近。它们守口如瓶，认为自己在宇宙中的角色神圣不可侵犯，非外界学者所能理解。它们不愿解释自身，也不愿听取结盟的建议，这导致它们与邻近者之间长期冲突不断；在旁人眼中，它们显得冷淡、傲慢，甚至心怀叵测。

纳迦往往对自己所认定的宇宙角色怀有强烈的使命感，即便这一角色会将它们引向暴力或悲剧性的结局。许多人因它们的奉献而认为它们冷酷严厉；它们的威仪令人恐惧，却又带着一种超然出尘的气息。

Awakener nagas are benevolent and wise teachers of people and places. They seek to guide and nurture the world around them, sensing mortals or locales with potential supernatural significance. Once located, these nagas provide instruction and divine trials to forge their wards toward strength and to impart a deeper understanding of right and wrong. Though considered stern and intimidating taskmasters by their students, those taught by a vicharamuni often go on to become great heroes.

Awakener nagas are similarly attentive in guiding their young. Upon reaching adulthood, a naga is provided a final trial before being encouraged to depart the nest and seek out their own natural wonders or promising mortals. Sometimes generations of nagas might guard the same place or family line, passing the honor of such care from parent to child. In such cases, the parent nagas aim to have at least one of their children elect to stay behind and become the guardian of their ancestral ward, giving the parents peace of mind that the site they protect will continue to be guarded by their descendants.

Nagas are serpentine beings with magical powers and keen intellects. Physically, they resemble massive snakes, though they often wear jewelry and other ornaments that clearly separate them from their animal kin. Nagas use their innate magic and poisonous fangs to keep all but the most stalwart foes at bay. They keep their own counsel, viewing their cosmic role to be sacrosanct and beyond the understanding of outside scholars. Their unwillingness to explain themselves or entertain the suggestion of alliances has led to a long history of conflict with their neighbors, who read them as aloof, arrogant, or duplicitous.

Nagas often have a powerful sense of duty to their perceived role within the universe, even if this role leads them to violent or tragic ends. Many see them as harsh and stern due to their devotion, terrifying in their majesty yet possessed of an aura of transcendence.
Isori.blurb: 雄性觉醒纳迦 Male awakener naga

Boar.name: 野猪 Boar

Boar Charge.name: 猪突 Boar Charge
Boar Charge.description:
野猪进行两次魅影野猪行走，然后进行一次獠牙打击。只要它移动了至少20尺，它的攻击检定便获得+2环境加值。

The boar Strides twice and then makes a tusk Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll.

Boar.publicNotes:
野猪是杂食性哺乳动物，因为其肉被视为珍馐而遭到大量狩猎。野猪最有可能在自卫时，或是在冬季月份的交配季节里攻击类人生物；此时雄性会长出额外一英寸厚的组织来保护内脏，以便与竞争对手搏斗。当然，在某些文化中，野猪会被训练得更具攻击性，以承担战兽和守卫的角色。当这类野猪逃回荒野后，就可能成为当地真正的恐怖。

虽然驯养的猪是农场生活的重要组成部分，但野生野猪要危险得多。脾气恶劣的疣猪相对常见，而那些名为巨獠兽的蹒跚远古野兽则较为少见。贪婪的野猪会蹂躏它们栖息的乡间，使其成为农夫尤其头疼的祸害。野猪繁殖力很强，一对野猪很快就能发展成一个庞大的家族。

Boars are omnivorous mammals, hunted heavily because their meat is considered a delicacy. Boars are most likely to attack humanoids either in self-defense or during their mating season in the winter months, when the males grow an extra inch of tissue to protect their organs as they fight off rivals. Of course, in some cultures, boars are trained to become much more aggressive so they can fill the roles of warbeast and guardian. When such boars escape back into the wild, they can become true terrors in the region.

While domesticated pigs are a staple of farm life, wild boars are much more dangerous. Foul-tempered warthogs are relatively common, while the lumbering, primeval beasts known as daeodons are less so. Voracious boars can ravage the countryside in which they live, making them a particular nuisance to farmers. Boars breed freely, and a pair of boars can rapidly grow to a large family.

Kum Soon-Chong.name: 昆舜重 Kum Soon-Chong

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
这种护甲由柔韧的皮革与定型的煮制皮革混合制成，既提供一定的防护，又保有最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓所用的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中通过一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则带有金属头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Expert Subsistence.name: 专家级生存技能 Expert Subsistence
Expert Subsistence.description:
当使用求生进行[[/act subsist statistic=survival]]时，如果追踪者掷骰得到的任何结果比成功更差，则他们获得成功。在成功时，他们可以为自己和额外8个生物提供维持生计所需；而在大成功时，他们可以照料的生物数量是成功时的两倍。

While using Survival to [[/act subsist statistic=survival]], if the tracker rolls any result worse than a success, they get a success. On a success, they can provide subsistence living for themselves and 8 additional creatures, and on a critical success, they can take care of twice as many creatures as on a success.

Master Tracker.name: 大师追踪者 Master Tracker
Master Tracker.description:
追踪者可以在以全速移动时进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{追踪}。

The tracker can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} while moving at full speed.

On the Hunt.name: 狩猎中 On the Hunt
On the Hunt.description:
追踪者将他们正在观察或追踪的一名生物指定为其猎物。

追踪者对该猎物进行[[/act seek]]搜索的察觉检定，以及对该猎物进行[[/act track]]追踪的求生检定，获得+2环境加值。

每轮中，追踪者首次命中被指定的猎物时，会额外造成1d4精准伤害。这些效果会持续，直到追踪者再次使用狩猎中。

The tracker designates one creature they're observing or tracking as their prey.

The tracker gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the prey and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the prey.

The first time the tracker hits the designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d4 precision damage. These effects last until the poacher uses On the Hunt again.

Kum Soon-Chong.publicNotes:
未经训练的眼睛或许只能发现荒野生物留下的一两个踪迹，但只有熟练的追踪者才能辨认出好几种这类迹象，并看出它们彼此之间的关联，把一个接一个地串联起来，形成一条由足迹、粪便、毛发、羽毛和血迹构成的踪迹，通向猎物的巢穴。

探索者往往装备精良、训练有素，能够应对任何类型的危害，并且乐于带领他人进入荒野。

An untrained eye might spot a sign or two of a wild creature's passing, but only a skilled tracker can identify several such signs and discern their relationship to each other, connecting one to the next until they form a trail of prints, scat, fur, feathers, and blood that leads to the quarry's lair.

Explorers are often well-equipped and well-trained for any type of hazard and are eager to lead others into the wild.

Nosois' Vengeance.name: 疫鸟的复仇 Nosois' Vengeance

Summon Vanths.name: 召唤范斯族 Summon Vanths
Summon Vanths.description:
触发 一名PC进入房间并被该危害注意到

效果 该陷阱召唤出四名万斯，它们随后掷先攻，并会持续存在最多1分钟，之后法术结束且万斯消失。被召唤出的万斯每轮可以使用3个动作，并且可以使用反应动作，这点与大多数被召唤的生物不同。

Trigger One of the PCs enters the room and is noticed by the hazard

Effect The trap summons four vanths, who then roll initiative and remain for up to 1 minute before the spell ends and the vanths disappear. The summoned vanths can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

Nosois' Vengeance.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:36]（在不触发危害的情况下迅速摧毁卷轴），@Check[religion|dc:33]（向法拉斯玛和诺索伊为先前的冒犯道歉），或解除魔法（第6等级；反制难度等级29）。

@Check[thievery|dc:36] (to quickly destroy the scroll without triggering the hazard), @Check[religion|dc:33] (to apologize to Pharasma and the nosois for the previous insult), or dispel magic (6th level; counteract DC 29).
Nosois' Vengeance.hazarddescription:
卷轴上的麻雀活了过来，用野口的声音对玩家角色们说话（来自事件11：诺索伊斯的早午餐的一只疫鸟）：“就是他们！他们就是那些连茶都不会好好奉上的亵渎者！把他们送去见夫人！”

The sparrow on the scroll animates, speaking to the PCs in Noguchi's voice (one of the nosois from Event 11: Nosois' Brunch): "They're the ones! They're the blasphemers who can't even properly serve tea! Send them along to the Lady!"

Jerky.name: 肉脯 Jerky

Pack Attack.name: 群体攻击 Pack Attack
Pack Attack.description:
若目标生物处于至少两名该狗的盟友的触及范围内，则该狗的打击额外造成 1d4 伤害。

The dog's Strikes deal 1d4 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the dog's allies.

Jerky.publicNotes:
普通护卫犬深受许多社群喜爱且忠诚可靠。它们常被当作宠物饲养，擅长担任保护者和追踪者，并且在保卫心爱的主人或家人时可以无所畏惧。以下给出的数据适用于许多体重在20到50磅之间的犬种。野狗也可以使用这些数据，但它们未被驯化的天性使其更加难以预测。野化犬可能更加危险，因为与它们的野生近亲不同，野化狗通常缺乏对人类的本能恐惧，而正是这种恐惧阻止了荒野生物与人互动。

狗是值得信赖、忠诚的伙伴，既能充当守护者、追踪动物，也能成为宠物。它们凭借嗅觉侦测猎物或捕食者的能力，以及喜爱陪伴类人生物的天性，成为大多数冒险者的理想宠物。世上有数百种犬类——从会向主人倾注爱意的小型玩赏犬，到肩高接近4英尺、体格强健的大猎犬——几乎凡有人居住之处都能见到它们。体型较大的品种甚至可作为较小型冒险者的坐骑，有些文化还会把狗当作能拖着满载补给的雪橇穿越冰封冻原的驮兽。无论如何，许多冒险者都认为养一只狗很有价值。

The typical guard dog is loyal and beloved by many communities. Often adored as pets, they excel as protectors and trackers, and can be fearless when defending a beloved master or family member. The statistics presented below work well for numerous breeds of dog ranging from 20 to 50 pounds in weight. Wild dogs can also use these statistics, but their untamed nature makes them far more unpredictable. Feral canines are perhaps even more dangerous, for unlike their wild cousins, feral dogs often lack the instinctual fear of humanity that stops wild creatures from interacting with people.

Dogs are trusted and loyal companions that serve as guardians, tracking animals, and pets. Their ability to detect prey or predators via scent and their predilection to accompany humanoids makes them ideal pets for most adventurers. There are hundreds of breeds of dogs in the world—from tiny lapdogs who shower their masters in affection to brawny hounds that stand nearly 4 feet high at the shoulder—and they can be found in nearly any place where people reside. Larger breeds might even be used as mounts for smaller adventurers, and some cultures use dogs as beasts of burden capable of pulling sleds loaded with supplies across the icy tundra. Regardless, many adventurers find value in having a dog.

Provincial Jiang-shi.name: 地方僵尸 Provincial Jiang-shi

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Spirit Blast.name: 灵魂冲击 Spirit Blast
Spirit Blast.description:
你将灵体能量专注起来，并攻击一个生物的精魂，造成16d6精魂伤害，进行一次基础强韧豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高2d6。

You concentrate ethereal energy and attack a creature's spirit, dealing 16d6 spirit damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Vampiric Exsanguination.name: 血族驱命 Vampiric Exsanguination
Vampiric Exsanguination.description:
你通过伸出的双臂汲取其他生物的鲜血与生命力。你对区域内的活体生物造成12d6点虚空伤害，并进行一次基础强韧豁免。

你获得等同于单个生物因该法术所受伤害一半的临时生命值；使用受到伤害最多的那个生物来计算这些临时生命值。1分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

You draw in the blood and life force of other creatures through your outstretched arms. You deal 12d6 void damage to living creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save.

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Shadow Blast.name: 暗影爆破 Shadow Blast
Shadow Blast.description:
你将阴影位面的半真实物质塑造成一次爆破。选择酸蚀、钝击、寒冷、电击、火焰、力场、穿刺、挥砍或音波伤害，并选择一个30足锥形、一个120足内的15足爆发，或一条50足线状区域。爆破对区域内每个生物造成5d8点你所选类型的伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

You shape the quasi-real substance of the Shadow Plane into a blast. Choose acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, slashing, or sonic damage, and choose a 30-foot cone, a 15-foot burst within 120 feet, or a 50-foot line. The blast deals 5d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Enervation.name: 弱能术 Enervation
Enervation.description:
伸出一根手指，你射出一道虚空能量射线，削弱任何被其触及的生物的生命力。线状区域内的每个活体生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] 伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。

大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}。

升阶（+2） 持续虚空伤害在成功时增加 1d8，在失败或大失败时增加 2d8。

Extending a finger, you fire a beam of void energy that weakens the life force of any creature it touches. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Heightened (+2) The persistent void damage increases by 1d8 on a success, or by 2d8 on a failure or critical failure.

Ghostly Tragedy.name: 幽魂悲剧 Ghostly Tragedy
Ghostly Tragedy.description:
这个法术会迫使当地的精魂重演你所知晓并在你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{施放法术}时指明的、最近过去发生的一起暴力事件。你将扮演主要受害者的角色。重演会展现受害者死亡或受伤前最后9分钟，以及其死亡或受伤后1分钟内发生的情景。精魂不会改变形态，因此这无法帮助通过外貌确定行凶者。事件所必需但缺失的生物会在需要时以灵体形态显现，而缺失的物品则会以阴影般的轮廓出现。

场景结束后，场景中每有一个参与的幽灵显影，你就会受到@Damage[2d6[void]]伤害（通常等于除受害者外涉事生物的数量）。任何观察了这场幽灵重现的生物，包括你在内，都可以尝试进行调查该事件的检定，以发现新的线索和信息。

This spell compels local spirits to reenact a violent event of the recent past that you're aware of and name as you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast the Spell}. You take the role of the primary victim. The reenactment plays out the final 9 minutes leading up to the death or injury of the victim and the minute after their death or injury. The spirits don't change form, so this doesn't help determine perpetrators by their look. Spiritual forms of missing creatures necessary for the event manifest as needed, and missing items appear as shadowy outlines.

Once the scene ends, you take @Damage[2d6[void]] damage for each ghostly apparition that participated in the scene (typically equal to the number of creatures involved other than the victim). Any creature that observed the ghostly recreation, including you, can attempt checks to investigate the event to discover new clues and information.

Bind Undead.name: 束缚不死生物 Bind Undead
Bind Undead.description:
你以一句充满力量的话语夺取目标的控制权。它获得仆从（特征）。如果你或一名盟友对目标使用任何敌对动作，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{法术效果：束缚不死生物}

With a word of power, you seize control of the target. It gains the minion trait. If you or an ally uses any hostile actions against the target, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{Spell Effect: Bind Undead}

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗亡灵。如果目标是活着的生物，你对其造成1d8点虚空伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。如果目标是自愿的亡灵生物，你恢复等量的生命值。你施放该法术时花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 （躯体） 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （言语、躯体） 该法术的射程为30足。如果你在治疗一名亡灵生物，则恢复的生命值增加8。

3 （材料、言语、躯体） 你将虚空能量散布为一个30足散发。这以区域内所有活着的生物和亡灵生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害量增加1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet.name: 呼吸感知（精确）60足 Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet
Breathsense (Precise) 60 feet.description:
僵尸无法感知5足之外的活着的生物，除非通过其呼吸感知。处于所列射程内并屏住呼吸的活着的生物，对僵尸而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态，持续到其继续屏住呼吸为止。要以这种方式屏住呼吸，生物必须腾出一只手，完全捏住鼻子或捂住嘴。

A jiang-shi can't perceive living creatures beyond 5 feet except with their breathsense. A living creature within the listed range who holds its breath is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} to the jiang-shi for as long as it holds its breath. To hold its breath in this way, a creature must have one hand free to fully plug its nose or cover its mouth.

Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities.name: 僵尸弱点 Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities
Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities.description:
所有僵尸都具有以下弱点。

  • 嫌恶 僵尸无法自愿进入被挥舞的镜子或手铃铃声10尺以内的范围。一个生物可以用单动作交互镜子或手铃，在1轮内挥舞该物品或摇响它（类似于在举起盾牌）。如果僵尸非自愿地进入其嫌恶之物10尺内，它会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}状态，并从其嫌恶之物旁逃离，直到它距离该物体10尺或更远。在暴露于其嫌恶之物1轮后，僵尸可以用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。若成功，它克服其嫌恶[[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6轮}（若大成功则为1小时）。
  • 苦涩顿悟 当僵尸被提醒其堕落本质，以及其在存在上与活着的生物相割裂的真相时，会陷入严重的忧郁之中。当僵尸看见一座带有至少1负载祖先精魂食物供品的祭坛时，它必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。随后，它会在1分钟内暂时免疫苦涩顿悟。

大成功 僵尸不受影响。

成功 僵尸陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1轮。

失败 僵尸陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 僵尸陷入呆滞 2，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，持续1分钟。

All jiang-shi possess the following vulnerabilities.

  • Revulsion A jiang-shi can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of a brandished mirror or the sound of ringing handbells. A creature can Interact with a mirror or handbell to brandish or ring the item for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the jiang-shi involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they are 10 feet or farther from the object. After 1 round of being exposed to the object of their revulsion, a jiang-shi can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Bitter Epiphany A jiang-shi is afflicted by severe melancholia when reminded of their debased nature and the truth of their existential disconnection from living beings. When a jiang-shi sees an altar with at least 1 Bulk of food offerings to ancestor spirits, they must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save. They are then temporarily immune to Bitter Epiphany for 1 minute.

Critical Success The jiang-shi is unaffected.

Success The jiang-shi is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The jiang-shi is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The jiang-shi is stupefied 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute.

One More Breath.name: 再喘一口气 One More Breath
One More Breath.description:
与其他不死生物不同，僵尸在生命值降至 0 时不会被摧毁。相反，它们会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，并在 1 分钟后以 1 点生命值苏醒。将至少 1 负载的糯米或母鸡蛋撒在失去意识的僵尸身上，会永久摧毁它们。如果僵尸是被暮木制成的武器攻击降至 0 生命值，它们会立刻被摧毁。

Unlike other undead, a jiang-shi isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, they fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and awaken in 1 minute with 1 Hit Point. Scattering at least 1 Bulk of glutinous rice or hen eggs on an unconscious jiang-shi destroys them permanently. If the jiang-shi was reduced to 0 HP by an attack from a weapon made of duskwood, they're destroyed immediately.

Warped Fulu.name: 扭曲符箓 Warped Fulu
Warped Fulu.description:
僵尸腐化了贴在它们额头上的符箓。僵尸免疫由魔法物品施放且不消耗法术位的法术，例如卷轴或魔杖施放的法术。生物可以通过 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} 符箓将其移除，并对抗僵尸的察觉DC进行检定。这会立即终止僵尸对此类效果的免疫。若生物随后以一个交互动作摧毁被移除的符箓，僵尸也会失去其快速治疗能力。僵尸可以通过花费1小时不间断地用书写工具在一张纸条（或类似物）上书写，来制作替代符箓。

The jiang-shi has corrupted the fulu attached to their brow. The jiang-shi is immune to spells cast from a magic item without expending a spell slot, such as from a scroll or wand. A creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} the fulu to remove it, rolling against the jiangshi's Perception DC. This immediately ends the jiang-shi's immunity to these effects. If a creature then destroys the removed fulu with an Interact action, the jiang-shi also loses their fast healing ability. A jiang-shi can create a replacement fulu by spending 1 uninterrupted hour inscribing a strip of paper (or similar) with a writing instrument.

Drain Qi.name: 汲取气 Drain Qi
Drain Qi.description:
需求 一个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，或自愿的生物位于僵尸的触及内

效果 僵尸通过自己的呼吸汲取受害者的生命能量，也就是气。若受害者处于被擒抱状态，则这需要进行一次对抗受害者强韧DC的 @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] 检定；若受害者处于其他任一状态，则自动成功。受害者陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且僵尸恢复 @Damage[13[healing]] 生命值，任何超出的部分转为临时生命值。对已经处于流失（状态）的生物汲取气不会为僵尸恢复任何生命值，但会使受害者的流失（状态）值增加 1，当其达到流失（状态）5 时，受害者死亡。若受害者具有施放气法术的能力，则它可以花费 1 聚能点来避免陷入流失（状态）。这只能保护其免受当前这次攻击影响，无法防止后续的汲取气尝试。

受害者的流失（状态）值每周减少 1。若该生物至少 1 天内将其饮食限制为糯米，并在一次成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:25] 检定中花费 10 分钟跳舞、慢跑或进行其他剧烈身体活动，则其流失（状态）减少 1。

Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the jiang-shi's reach

Effect The jiang-shi drains the victim's life energy, or qi, through their breath. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the jiang-shi regains @Damage[13[healing]] HP, gaining any excess as temporary Hit Points. Draining qi from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the jiang-shi but increases the victim's drained condition value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. If the victim has the ability to cast ki spells, it can spend 1 Focus Point to avoid becoming drained. This protects it only from the current attack, not from subsequent attempts to Drain Qi.

A victim's drained condition value decreases by 1 every week. If the creature restricts their diet to glutinous rice for at least 1 day and spends 10 minutes dancing, jogging, or otherwise engaging in vigorous physical activity by succeeding at a @Check[athletics|dc:25] check, it reduces its drained condition by 1.

Rigor Mortis.name: 尸僵 Rigor Mortis
Rigor Mortis.description:
僵尸无视困难地形，以及会使其陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}的效果。僵尸不能采取@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{伏倒}动作。当其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{跳跃}时，不会触发通常由移动动作所触发的反应动作，例如借机攻击。

The jiang-shi ignores difficult terrain and effects that would render them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A jiang-shi can't take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{Drop Prone} action. When they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} they don't trigger reactions that are normally triggered by move actions, such as Attacks of Opportunity.

Provincial Jiang-shi.publicNotes:
僵尸是来自天夏的可怕跳跃吸血鬼。它们与其他吸血鬼相似——都是亡灵，会从活物身上汲取生命力，而且只能以特定方式被杀死——但僵尸享用的不是鲜血，而是活人的气息，也就是所谓的气或炁。它们拥有独特的力量，包括能偏转魔法的符箓、惊人的跳跃能力，以及对阳光的免疫；但僵尸也有独特的弱点，例如除了通过呼吸感知外无法看见活着的生物、厌恶铃铛和镜子，以及近乎令人呆滞的忧郁。值得庆幸的是，大多数僵尸都无法制造吸血鬼仆从。

被粗暴地从噩梦般的沉眠中惊醒后，地方僵尸会在其领地周围的村庄与墓地中游荡，搜寻足以缓解其饥渴的食粮。

Jiang-shi are terrifying hopping vampires from Tian Xia. Though similar to other vampires—they are undead, drain vital energy from the living, and can be slain only in specific ways—jiang-shi feast upon the breath of the living, also known as qi or ki, instead of blood. While they possess unique powers, including their magic-deflecting paper fulus, extraordinary jumping ability, and immunity to sunlight, jiang-shi also possess unique vulnerabilities, such as the inability to see living creatures save through breathsense, a revulsion to bells and mirrors, and near-stupefying melancholia. Thankfully, most jiang-shi can't create vampiric spawn.

Roused rudely from their nightmarish slumber, the provincial jiang-shi roams the villages and graveyards around their domain searching for sustenance to slake their hunger.
Provincial Jiang-shi.hp: fast healing 10, void healing, one more breath

Heh Shan-Bao (Level 13).name: 赫山宝（13级）

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Phantasmal Calamity (Creates a Flesh-Eat.name: 魅影灾祸（制造一群会啃食血肉的红色宁朵露蝶）
Phantasmal Calamity (Creates a Flesh-Eat.description:
末日毁灭的幻象充斥区域内每个生物的心智。该幻象造成 11d6 心灵伤害（基础意志豁免）。若大失败，该生物还必须在一次 @Check[reflex] 反射豁免中成功，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂隙中、漂流于海上，或遭遇与其幻象相符的其他命运）。如果它第二次豁免失败，则还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑（状态）} 1 分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的意志豁免；若成功，它便识破该幻觉并从震慑（状态）中恢复。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a @Check[reflex] save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Phantasmal Killer (Image Resembles Kugap.name: 幻影杀手（形象类似苦迦菩提）
Phantasmal Killer (Image Resembles Kugap.description:
你创造出一个目标所能想象到的最可怕生物的幻象。只有该法术的目标能够看见这个杀手，尽管你也能看见这个幻象在疾冲上前发动攻击时的模糊轮廓。杀手的效果取决于目标的意志豁免结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到 @Damage[4d6[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标受到 @Damage[(max(8,@item.rank*2))d6[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标惊骇到可能会死去。它必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|traits:incapacitation] 强韧豁免；如果目标失败，它就会死亡。若强韧豁免成功，目标受到 @Damage[(max(12,@item.rank*3))d6[mental]] 伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}直到其下个回合结束，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 4}。此效果具有失能特征。

强化（+1） 失败时的伤害增加 2d6，大失败时的伤害增加 3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(max(8,@item.rank*2))d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a @Check[fortitude|traits:incapacitation] save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes @Damage[(max(12,@item.rank*3))d6[mental]] damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你瞬间将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的射程内一个未被占据的空间。若这会让另一生物随你一同传送——即使你是将其装在超维容器中携带——则该法术失效。

强化（5环） 射程提升至 1 英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。此后，你会暂时免疫 1 小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你扑灭一个濒死生物的生命。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。若这将其杀死，你获得 10 点临时生命值，并在 10 分钟内获得对攻击掷骰和伤害掷骰的 +1 状态加值。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 值增加 1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Shatter.name: 粉碎音波 Shatter
Shatter.description:
高频声波攻击会粉碎附近的一个物体。你对该物体造成 2d10 点音波伤害；若该物体的硬度为 4 或更低，则无视其硬度。

强化（+1） 伤害提高 1d10，且该法术可无视的硬度提高 2。

A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造出一种由简单声音组成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常喊叫的音量。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动唇，但这些话语并不会从你口中说出，而是被直接传送到目标的耳中。其他人听你的话并不会比你平时只动嘴唇时更清楚，但目标听见你的话时，就仿佛他们正站在你身旁。目标可以以一个反应动作（）作出简短回应，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在其下一回合中以一个自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能看见你且处于射程内才能这么做。如果他们回应了，他们的答复会像最初的传讯一样，被直接送入你的耳中。

强化（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Universal Language.name: 通识语言 Universal Language
Universal Language.description:
脑生子所说的任何话，听者都会以其母语感知到。

Anything spoken by the brainchild is perceived by the listener in its native language.

Urban Legend.name: 都市传说 Urban Legend
Urban Legend.description:
可以被识破的能力包括他对物理伤害的抗力、他的骇人气势、他的打击造成的挥砍伤害，以及他的7环天生法术。

脑生子仅靠先于他们而来的名声来维持。无心智生物免疫脑生子，且无法察觉到它们。

脑生子的体型、特征和物品，以及其攻击的外观，都与察觉到它们的敌人所预期的一致。如果敌人预期看到不同的事物，则由脑生子选择显现哪一种。如果任何能够察觉到脑生子的生物相信脑生子拥有下列能力之一，则脑生子便拥有该能力。

生物可以使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{察言观色}（对抗脑生子的欺瞒DC）来尝试识破某一项单独的能力。如果在任何时候，没有任何察觉到脑生子的生物相信该能力存在，脑生子便立即失去该能力。如果敌人预期的具体细节不同，例如一方认为脑生子免疫火焰，另一方认为它免疫预言，则由脑生子选择其中一项来拥有。

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]{震动感知}（不精确）100尺
  • 免疫一种伤害类型、魔法学派或状态
  • 弱点 10，针对一种非精神伤害类型
  • 抗力 10，对物理伤害，但冷铁或银除外
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{骇人气势}（灵光、情绪、恐惧、心灵）100尺，DC 28
  • [[/r 1d6]]{1d6}额外伤害：打击时造成一种某个敌人相信其具备的类型
  • 额外法术 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]{幻痛术}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{暗影爆破}，均为6环

Abilities that can be disbelieved include his resistance to physical damage, his frightful presence, the slashing damage from his Strikes, and his 7th-rank innate spells.

A brainchild is sustained only by the reputation that precedes them. Mindless creatures are immune to a brainchild and can't perceive them.

The brainchild's size, features, and items, as well as the appearance of their attacks, match what the foes perceiving them expect. If foes expect to see different things, the brainchild chooses which to manifest. If any creature that can perceive the brainchild believes the brainchild has one of the abilities below, the brainchild has that ability.

A creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} (against the brainchild's Deception DC) to attempt to disbelieve an individual ability. If at any point no creature perceiving the brainchild believes in the ability, the brainchild loses that ability immediately. If foes expect different particulars, such as one believing the brainchild is immune to fire and another believing they're immune to divinations, the brainchild chooses one to have.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]{Tremorsense} (imprecise) 100 feet
  • Immunity to one damage type, magic school, or condition
  • Weakness 10 to one damage type other than mental
  • Resistance 10 to physical damage, with an exception for either cold iron or silver
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{Frightful Presence} (aura, emotion, fear, mental) 100 feet, DC 28
  • [[/r 1d6]]{1d6} Extra Damage on Strikes, of a type one foe believes in
  • Additional Spells @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]{Phantom Pain} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{Shadow Blast} at 6th rank

Fear of Flutes.name: 恐惧长笛 Fear of Flutes
Fear of Flutes.description:
每轮中第一次有人在赫山宝 30 尺内吹奏长笛时，他必须针对吹笛者的表演难度等级尝试一次 @Check[will|defense:performance] 豁免。如果吹笛者是（由游戏主持裁定）宗教信仰非常虔诚的人，该难度等级增加 4。

大成功 赫山宝不受影响。

成功 赫山宝变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 赫山宝变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 赫山宝变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，直到其下个回合结束。

The first time in any round when someone plays a flute within 30 feet of Heh Shan-Bao, he must attempt a @Check[will|defense:performance] save against the flute player's Performance DC. This DC increases by 4 if the flute player is someone (at the GM's discretion) who's strongly religious.

Critical Success Heh Shan-Bao is unaffected.

Success Heh Shan-Bao becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure Heh Shan-Bao becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure Heh Shan-Bao becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of his next turn.

Persistence of Memory.name: 记忆存留 Persistence of Memory
Persistence of Memory.description:
当一个脑生子被摧毁时，如果仍有任何人完全相信它存在，它就会在[[/br 2d4 #Persistance of Memory]]{2d4天}后回归，并在任意一名信徒100尺内重新成形。

When a brainchild is destroyed, it returns if anyone still fully believes it exists, re-forming within 100 feet of any believer after [[/br 2d4 #Persistance of Memory]]{2d4 days}.

Steal Soul.name: 窃魂 Steal Soul
Steal Soul.description:
触发 赫山宝对一个10级或以下的生物施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dLdRqT6UxTKlsPgp]{死亡丧钟}

效果 若死亡丧钟杀死了目标，目标的眼睛会消失，身体中的所有脂肪都会流失，手腕周围会显现出烧灼的烙印，因为目标的灵魂被虹吸进了腐化的柳岸镇心景。目标无法通过任何手段重返生命，甚至连像 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AuIiqc7jjiy1GZ75]{显现} 这样强大的魔法也不行，直到腐化的柳岸镇心景被摧毁。

Trigger Heh Shan-Bao casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dLdRqT6UxTKlsPgp]{Death Knell} on a 10th-or lower-level creature

Effect If the death knell kills the target, the target's eyes vanish, all fat drains from its body, and burnt brands manifest around the wrists as the target's soul is siphoned into the corrupted Willowshore mindscape. The target can't be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AuIiqc7jjiy1GZ75]{Manifestation}, until the corrupted Willowshore mindscape is destroyed.

Heh Shan-Bao (Level 13).blurb: 男性变体脑生子 Male variant brainchild

Myna Kawaka.name: 八哥 川冈 Myna Kawaka
Myna Kawaka.tokenName: 八哥 川冈 Myna Kawaka
Myna Kawaka.blurb:
忠诚的男性天狗行会首领
devoted male tengu guild leader
Myna Kawaka.prototypeToken: 八哥 川冈 Myna Kawaka

Ouh Ba-Ming.name: 欧跋鸣 Ouh Ba-Ming
Ouh Ba-Ming.blurb:
虔诚的人类女祭司
 devoted female human priest

Endangered Reveler.name: 濒危狂欢客 Endangered Reveler

Power of the Mob.name: 暴民之力 Power of the Mob
Power of the Mob.description:
当三个或更多平民彼此相邻时，每个平民的运动检定、[[/act shove]]、攻击掷骰和伤害掷骰都获得+1环境加值。

When three or more commoners are adjacent to each other, each commoner gets a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act shove]], attack rolls, and damage rolls.

Lore (any one related to their trade).name: 学识（任意一项与其行业相关的）

Endangered Reveler.publicNotes:
许多平民过着辛劳艰苦的生活，努力工作，只为让家人有饭吃、有房住，并享有相对舒适的生活。

社会是建立在劳工的肩背之上的。

Many commoners live hard lives of toil as they work to keep their families fed and housed in relative comfort.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其心智之前将其阻断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}，持续1轮。

大失败 目标陷入麻痹，持续4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它都可以再次尝试一次意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少1轮，或者在大成功时直接结束该效果。

高阶化（7环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Illusory Creature.name: 幻影生物 Illusory Creature
Illusory Creature.description:
你创造一个大型或更小生物的幻象影像。它会产生相应的声音、气味，并且在接触时显得真实可信。如果你与该影像之间的距离超过500尺，法术结束。

该影像不能说话，但你可以使用你的动作通过该生物发声，而法术会将你的声音适当地伪装。你可能需要进行一次欺瞒或表演检定来模仿该生物，由游戏主持决定。如果你试图模仿某个特定人物，并与认识此人的对象互动，这种情况尤其可能发生。

在战斗中，该幻象每回合可以使用2个动作，而它会在你维持该法术时使用这些动作。它的攻击掷骰使用你的法术攻击调整值，它的AC使用你的法术DC。它的豁免调整值等于你的法术DC－10。它足够凝实，因此可以与其他生物形成夹击。如果该影像被一次攻击命中或豁免失败，法术结束。

该幻象可以通过让目标相信其攻击真实存在来造成伤害，但除此之外，它无法直接影响物理世界。如果幻影生物以一次打击命中，目标受到@Damage[3d4[mental]]伤害。该幻象的打击为非致命。如果这伤害与怪物影像不相符——例如，一个大型幻象巨龙却只造成5点伤害——游戏主持可以允许目标立即尝试一次察觉检定来识破该法术。若目标认为相关抗力与弱点适用，则它们会照常适用，由游戏主持裁定。例如，如果该幻象挥舞一把战锤并攻击一个对钝击伤害具有抗力的生物，那么该生物受到的心灵伤害会更少。然而，幻象伤害不会使再生失效，也不会触发其他需要特定伤害类型的效果。游戏主持应追踪该幻象造成的幻象伤害。

任何接触该影像的生物，或使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。当一个生物识破该幻象时，它恢复自己此前因此受到伤害的一半（如果有），并且此后不会再受到它的伤害。

高阶化（+1） 该影像打击的伤害提高1d4，并且你所能创造的生物最大体型提高一级（最大至超巨型）。

You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the spell. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[3d4[mental]] damage. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).

Paranoia.name: 偏执狂乱 Paranoia
Paranoia.description:
你使目标将所有其他生物都视为可怕的威胁。目标会对周围所有生物陷入强烈的偏执狂乱，并且必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标认为它所见到的每个人都是潜在威胁。它会对所有原本并非敌对的生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友善}，即使这些生物先前是它的盟友也是如此。它不会将任何人视为盟友。该法术在1轮后结束。

失败 同成功，但该效果持续1分钟。

大失败 同失败，但目标会认为它所见到的每个人都是不共戴天的死敌。它会按照游戏主持的决定，对所有人使用其反应动作和自由动作，无论这些人先前是否是它的盟友。除此之外，它仍会像平常一样理性行动，并且相比那些没有理会它的生物，它更可能优先攻击那些正在攻击或妨碍它的生物。

强化（6环） 你最多可以将5个生物作为目标。

You cause the target to see all other creatures as dire threats. The target is stricken by intense paranoia toward all creatures around it and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target believes everyone it sees is a potential threat. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally. The spell ends after 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target believes that everyone it sees is a mortal enemy. It uses its reactions and free actions against everyone, regardless of whether they were previously its allies, as determined by the GM. It otherwise acts as rationally as it normally does and likely prefers to attack creatures that are actively attacking or hindering it over those leaving it alone.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的思维，以一道心灵冲击使其陷入眩晕。该冲击造成 1d6 点心灵伤害，进行基础意志豁免。若目标的豁免结果为大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

高阶化（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Dizzying Colors.name: 眩目幻色 Dizzying Colors
Dizzying Colors.description:
你释放出一片旋转翻涌的缤纷色彩，依据生物的意志豁免使其陷入压倒性的感官冲击。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}，持续1轮。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}，持续1轮，且目眩持续1分钟。

大失败 该生物陷入震慑，持续1轮，且失明持续1分钟。

You unleash a swirling multitude of colors that overwhelms creatures based on their Will saves.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, and dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is stunned for 1 round and blinded for 1 minute.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成 2d4 点心灵伤害以及 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害，但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心状态中恢复，持续伤害结束，且该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

高阶化（+1） 伤害增加 2d4，持续伤害增加 1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Soothe.name: 安抚术 Soothe
Soothe.description:
你以恩泽抚慰目标的心智，增强其精神防御并治疗其伤势。当你施放该法术时，目标恢复 1d10+4 生命值，并在持续时间内对抗精神效果的豁免获得 +2 状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{法术效果：安抚术}

升阶（+1） 治疗量增加 1d10+4。

You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个处于射程内、松散且无人持有的、负载为1或以下的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若命中，你造成2d6点钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体类型由你掷出的物体决定。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响这次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description:
无面鬼模仿者携带一把+1强击武器，其外观看起来与被模仿的玩家角色所偏好的武器完全相同。如果该玩家角色偏好徒手打击，它就会表现为手部缠带。如果该玩家角色偏好远程武器，那么无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，而是改为使用上方的远程武器规则；否则，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果该玩家角色不偏好任何武器，则无脸鬼会将一根短棒当作其虚假武器。这个虚假武器只有部分是真实的，命中时只会造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原始武器的任何特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损、被缴械或被放下，它就会消散。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟重新制作一把替代的虚假武器。

A noppera-bo impersonator carries a +1 striking weapon that looks identical to the favored weapon of the PC being impersonated. If the PC favors unarmed strikes, it appears as hand wraps. If the PC favors a ranged weapon, then the noppera-bo impersonator has no melee weapon and instead uses the ranged weapon rules above; otherwise, the noppera-bo impersonator has no ranged weapon. If the PCs favors no weapon, then the noppera-bo wields a club as its false weapon. This false weapon is only partially real and inflicts only mental damage when it hits; it gains none of the original weapon's traits or magical enhancements. If a noppera-bo impersonator's false weapon is broken, disarmed, or set down, it fades away. The noppera-bo impersonator can craft a replacement false weapon by spending 10 minutes to recreate one.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸鬼没有视觉，但它们的听觉感官是精准的。它们不需要呼吸，并且免疫任何需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得养分——传统上，它们会将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；它们也可以用这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

The noppera-bo has no sense of vision, but their hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，它们就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as the noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonated Spellcasting.name: 模仿者施法 Impersonated Spellcasting
Impersonated Spellcasting.description:
无面鬼模仿者获得一组天生法术，与其所模仿的玩家角色所使用的施法根源相匹配。你可以调整这些法术，使其更完美地契合这次模仿。

The noppera-bo impersonator gains a suites of innate spells, matching the spellcasting tradition utilized by the PC being impersonated. You can adjust the spells to make a more perfect fit for the impersonation.

Yu Er’s Parents Thanks.name: 于尔的父母致谢 Yu Er’s Parents Thanks
Yu Er’s Parents Thanks.tokenName: 于尔的父母致谢 Yu Er’s Parents Thanks

Boots of Bounding.name: 跳跃之靴 Boots of Bounding
Boots of Bounding.description:
这双结实皮靴富有弹性的鞋底能缓冲你双足所受的冲击，让每一步都更加轻盈。这双靴子使你的速度获得 +5 足物品加值，并使你进行高跳和跳远的运动检定获得 +2 物品加值。

此外，当你使用跃跳动作时，若进行水平跳跃，你可以多移动 5 足；若进行垂直跳跃，你可以跳高 3 足。

The springy soles of these sturdy leather boots cushion your feet and make each step lighter. These boots give you a +5-foot item bonus to your Speed and a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to High Jump and Long Jump.

In addition, when you use the Leap action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.

Yu Er’s Parents Thanks.prototypeToken: 于尔的父母致谢 Yu Er’s Parents Thanks

Animated Cookware Swarm.name: 活化厨具虫群 Animated Cookware Swarm
Animated Cookware Swarm.tokenName: 活化厨具虫群 Animated Cookware Swarm

Construct Armor (Hardness 3).name: 构装护甲（硬度 3） 3） Construct Armor (Hardness 3)
Construct Armor (Hardness 3).description:
和普通物体一样，活化银餐具虫群具有硬度。该硬度会将虫群受到的任何伤害减少一个等同于其硬度的数值。一旦活化银餐具虫群的生命值降至其生命值上限的一半以下，或在受到大失败的重击伤害时立即，其构装护甲便会破裂，失去硬度，并使其护甲等级降至12。

Like normal objects, an animated silverware swarm has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage the swarm takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated silverware swarm is reduced to fewer than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, removing the Hardness and reducing its Armor Class to 12.

Slice and Pound.name: 切砍与重击 Slice and Pound
Slice and Pound.description:
活化厨具虫群空间内的每个敌人受到 1d6 点@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]{钝击}或 @Damage[1d6[slashing]]{挥砍}伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]反射豁免）。

Each enemy in the animated cookware swarm's space takes 1d6 points of @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning} or @Damage[1d6[slashing]]{slashing} damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save).

Stick a Fork in It.name: 把叉子插进去 Stick a Fork in It
Stick a Fork in It.description:
活化银餐具虫群试图钉住一个生物。

目标必须尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:17]豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 银餐具钉住了目标的部分衣物和道具。只要目标仍位于该虫群的空间内，其速度便承受–10足的环境减值。

失败 同成功，且目标在离开该虫群的空间前也不能跨步。

大失败 目标被银餐具彻底钉住，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，直到它[[/act escape dc=17]]{挣脱}或使用2个交互动作移除所有将其钉住的银餐具为止。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.K3r1lfbtCTf3dFhV]{效果：把叉子插进去}

The animated silverware swarm attempts to pin a single creature.

The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success Silverware pins portions of the target's clothing and gear. The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds as long as it remains in the swarm's space.

Failure As success, and the target also can't Step until it leaves the swarm's space.

Critical Failure The target is thoroughly pinned by the silverware, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it [[/act escape dc=17]]{Escapes} or uses 2 Interact actions to remove all of the silverware pinning them down.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.K3r1lfbtCTf3dFhV]{Effect: Stick a Fork in It}

Animated Cookware Swarm.publicNotes:
众所周知，贵族们会花大价钱让他们的银器活动起来，既方便清洁，也能在晚宴上充当新奇的玩意儿。

许多活动物体都有实用功能，但一旦失去控制，就会变得危险。

Nobles are known to pay great amounts to animate their silverware, both for ease in cleaning and to serve as novelties during dinner parties.

Many animated objects have useful functions but become dangers when uncontrolled.
Animated Cookware Swarm.blurb:
变体活化银餐具虫群
Variant animated silverware swarm
Animated Cookware Swarm.prototypeToken: 活化厨具虫群 Animated Cookware Swarm

Noodles.name: 面条 Noodles

Lithe.name: 轻盈 Lithe
Lithe.description:
鼬鼠将任何它勉强能让头通过的狭窄空间，以及任何更宽的狭窄空间，视为困难地形，并且它无需使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} 就能移动穿过。

A weasel treats any tight space it can barely fit its head in or wider as difficult terrain and doesn't need to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} to move through it.

Noodles.publicNotes:
尽管身材矮小，鼬鼠却是技艺高超的猎人。它们在追逐食物时几乎无所畏惧，经常能杀死体型达到自身五倍的生物。它们偏爱的战术是扑到受害者颈后，用自己的颚进行缠绕挤压，直到目标死去。为了让自己始终吃得饱，鼬鼠猎杀的生物往往超过所需，并把猎物塞进中空的原木或废弃的巢穴里，留待之后食用。

学者们观察到，无论在荒野还是圈养环境中，鼬鼠都会在猎物面前表现出一种古怪的行为。它们会毫无规律地四处乱窜，把自己摔到地上，钻进钻出洞穴，整体看起来完全像是在毫无理智地行动。作为回应，它们的猎物会变得困惑，甚至仿佛遭到催眠，这就给了鼬鼠一个猛冲上前并给予致命一击的机会。

一只普通的鼬鼠体长为12英寸，体重不足1磅。

鼬鼠是轻盈而狡黠的掠食者，既以美丽光滑的毛皮闻名，也以钻入狭窄空间的能力著称。若按体重相较，很少有动物像鼬鼠这般贪食。它们有着永不满足的食欲，每天几乎要吃下相当于自身一半体重的食物，因此总是在不断寻找新的猎物来满足饥饿。

Despite their small stature, weasels are skilled hunters. Nearly fearless in pursuit of food, they frequently kill creatures up to five times their own size. Their preferred tactic is to latch onto the back of their victim's neck and constrict with their jaws until the target dies. To keep themselves well fed, weasels kill more creatures than they need and stuff their victims into hollow logs or empty dens to eat later.

Scholars have observed weasels, both in the wild and captivity, perform a bizarre behavior in front of their prey. They rush about unpredictably, throw themselves to the ground, wriggle into and out of burrows, and generally appear to behave entirely irrationally. In response, their prey becomes confused or seemingly hypnotized, which gives the weasel an opportunity to dash forward and strike a killing blow.

A typical weasel is 12 inches long and weighs less than a pound.

Weasels are lithe, clever predators known for both their beautiful, sleek fur and their ability to crawl into tight spaces. Pound for pound, few animals are as voracious as weasels. Insatiably hungry, they eat almost half their own weight each day, leading them to constantly hunt for new prey to satisfy their hunger.

Midori.name: 青 Midori

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法任你驱使。只要你维持该法术，你就可以施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你都可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹调 冷却、加热，或给1磅非生物材料调味。
  • 举起 将一个未被持用、负载为轻或更低的物体缓慢抬离地面1足。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能被用作工具、武器、法器，或作为法术的代价。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用10轮的专注影响一个1负载的物体，而更大的物体则每1负载需要1分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体造成的任何实际改变（除了上述说明之外）都只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
蹑影小魔怪对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}的生物额外造成1d6点精准伤害。

The jinkin deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Tinker.name: 修补匠 Tinker
Tinker.description:
六只蹑影小魔怪可以一起工作一小时，在60尺射程内为一件物品施加诅咒。尽管这一过程很漫长，但也不引人注意，并且可以在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding}时进行。蹑影小魔怪更喜欢将这一能力用于魔法物品。该诅咒会使物品变得不可靠（@Check[flat|dc:5]检定，否则任何一个用于交互或启动该物品的动作都会被浪费），为使用该物品附加一个古怪的要求，或赋予某种其他类似程度的诅咒。

A group of six jinkins can work together for an hour to imbue an item with a curse at a range of 60 feet. While this process is lengthy, it's also unobtrusive and can be performed while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding}. Jinkins prefer to use this ability on magic items. The curse makes the item unreliable (@Check[flat|dc:5] check or waste any action to Interact with or Activate the item), adds a bizarre requirement to use the item, or imparts some other curse of a similar caliber.

Midori.publicNotes:
蹑影小魔怪是施虐成性的修补匠，会偷窃并破坏物品，还以自己能够诅咒珍贵物体的力量为傲。它们心怀怨念，一旦觉得受了怠慢，就会为复仇制定错综复杂的计划，例如当某个生物竟敢移除它们施加的诅咒时。蹑影小魔怪很少满足于制造单纯的混乱，它们也从折磨与谋杀中获得极大乐趣，不过比起直接杀死受害者，它们更喜欢把受害者引入那些旨在捕获或使其失能的陷阱中。深坑是它们偏爱的手段，因为从坠落中幸存的受害者将因饥饿和口渴而缓慢死去，而蹑影小魔怪则聚集在坑边，对他们嘲弄折磨。

小魔怪是残忍的妖精恶作剧者与破坏者，早已完全适应了宇宙中的生活，并为自己充满创意的毁灭性找到了独特定位。几乎所有小魔怪都乐于毁坏或打碎东西，无论是装置、载具之类的有形之物，还是联盟、关系之类的无形事物。小魔怪最大的快乐，就是看着复杂造物崩溃瓦解，最好还是在它们施以最轻微、却精心瞄准的一推之后。小魔怪往往会贬低、霸凌，甚至屠杀它们较弱的同类，尤其是蹑影小魔怪；更强的小魔怪还会轻蔑地称它们为“袋子货”。

Jinkins are sadistic tinkers who steal and sabotage items and take great pride in their power to curse precious objects. They hold grudges and create convoluted plans for revenge when they feel slighted, such as when a creature dares to remove one of their curses. Rarely content to wreak simple mayhem, jinkins also take immense pleasure in torture and murder, though they prefer to lead victims into traps designed to capture or incapacitate rather than just kill them outright. Deep pits are a preferred method, since victims who survive their fall face a slow death from starvation and thirst while jinkins gather at the edge of pits to tease and torment them.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life in the Universe, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. Nearly all gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the slightest, carefully targeted nudge from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom stronger gremlins derisively call "baggies."
Midori.blurb:
雌性蹑影小魔怪
Female jinkin gremlin

Shinzo.name: 信藏 Shinzo

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Bind Soul.name: 缚魂术 Bind Soul
Bind Soul.description:
你在目标的灵魂能够前往来世之前，强行将其扯离并囚禁于一颗黑色蓝宝石中。当灵魂位于宝石内时，目标无法通过任何手段重获生命，甚至连如祈愿术这般强大的魔法也无能为力。若宝石被摧毁，或宝石上的缚魂术效果被反制，灵魂便会获得自由。该宝石的 AC 为 16，硬度为 10。一个宝石不能容纳超过一个灵魂，任何此类尝试都会浪费该法术。

You wrench the target's soul away before it can pass on to the afterlife and imprison it in a black sapphire. While the soul is in the gem, the target can't be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic such as wish. If the gem is destroyed or bind soul is counteracted on the gem, the soul is freed. The gem has AC 16 and Hardness 10. A gem can't hold more than one soul, and any attempt wastes the spell.

Finger of Death.name: 死亡一指 Finger of Death
Finger of Death.description:
你将手指指向目标，并念出一句杀戮之语。你对目标造成 70 点虚无伤害。如果死亡一指造成的伤害使目标的生命值降至 0，目标会立即死亡。

升环（+1） 伤害增加 10 点。

You point your finger toward the target and speak a word of slaying. You deal 70 void damage to the target. If the damage from finger of death reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target dies instantly.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.

Plane Shift.name: 异界传送 Plane Shift
Plane Shift.description:
你和你的盟友穿越存在位面之间的屏障。目标移动到另一个位面，例如火元素位面、冥界或外层裂隙。你必须对目的地位面有明确的了解，并使用一支由该位面的材料制成的魔法音叉作为法术的焦点。虽然大多数著名位面的音叉都属于非普遍，就像法术异界传送一样，但更隐秘的位面和半位面往往拥有罕见的音叉。该法术极不精确，你会出现在所选目标之一上次旅行到该位面时所在最后地点的1d20x25英里之外。如果对所有目标来说这都是第一次旅行到某个位面，你会出现在该位面上的一个随机地点。异界传送不提供返回旅行的方式，不过再次施放异界传送可以让你返回先前所在的位面，除非存在特殊情况。

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must have specific knowledge of the destination plane and use a magic tuning fork created from material from that plane as a focus for the spell. While the tuning forks for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell plane shift, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare tuning forks. The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20x25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Plane shift doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting plane shift again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

Scrying.name: 探知 Scrying
Scrying.description:
你以魔法窥探你所选择的一个生物。探知的运作方式如同 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{千里眼}，但你接收到的影像没那么精确，不足以用于传送及类似法术。你并非在 500 尺内的固定地点创造一只眼睛，而是创造一只显现在目标正上方的眼睛。你可以通过名字选择目标，或者通过触碰其持有物之一或其身体的一部分来选择目标。如果你未曾亲自见过目标，探知的难度等级降低 2；如果你不知道目标的身份（例如你在犯罪现场发现了某个未知生物的尖牙），则难度等级改为降低 10。探知的效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

大成功 法术失败，且目标暂时免疫 1 周。目标还会瞥见你，并得知你与它之间的大致距离和方向。

成功 法术失败，且目标暂时免疫 1 天。

失败 法术成功。

大失败 法术成功，且如果目标移动，这只眼睛会跟随目标，每轮最多移动 60 尺。

You magically spy on a creature of your choice. Scrying works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}, except that the image you receive is less precise, insufficient for teleport and similar spells. Instead of creating an eye in a set location within 500 feet, you instead create an eye that manifests just above the target. You can choose a target either by name or by touching one of its possessions or a piece of its body. If you haven't met the target in person, scrying's DC is 2 lower, and if you are unaware of the target's identity (perhaps because you found an unknown creature's fang at a crime scene), the DC is instead 10 lower. The effect of scrying depends on the target's Will save.

Critical Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 week. The target also gains a glimpse of you and learns its rough distance and direction from you.

Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Failure The spell succeeds.

Critical Failure The spell succeeds, and the eye follows the target if it moves, traveling up to 60 feet per round.

True Seeing (Constant).name: 真视术（恒定）
True Seeing (Constant).description:
你能看见60尺内事物的真实样貌。游戏主持对区域内的任何幻术或变化术进行一次秘密反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功反制一个变形法术，你就能看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Truespeech (Constant).name: 真言术（恒定）
Truespeech (Constant).description:
目标可以理解所有词语，无论属于何种语言，并且还能说其他生物的语言。当处于由不同生物组成的混合群体中时，每当目标说话时，它都可以选择一个生物，并用该生物能够理解的语言说话，即使目标不知道那是什么语言。

高阶化（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Enervation.name: 弱能术 Enervation
Enervation.description:
伸出一根手指，你射出一道虚无能量光束，削弱任何被其触及的生物的生命力。直线范围内的每个活着的生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] 伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。

大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}。

升环（+2） 持续虚无伤害在成功时增加 1d8，在失败或大失败时增加 2d8。

Extending a finger, you fire a beam of void energy that weakens the life force of any creature it touches. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Heightened (+2) The persistent void damage increases by 1d8 on a success, or by 2d8 on a failure or critical failure.

Detect Alignment (Constant).name: 侦测阵营（恒定）
Detect Alignment (Constant).description:
你的双眼发光，你感知到阵营灵光。选择混乱、邪恶、善良或守序。你侦测到该阵营的灵光。除了存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择不侦测你已知具有该阵营的生物或效果。

只有6级或更高的生物——除非是神圣施法者、亡灵，或来自外环的存在——才具有阵营灵光。

强化（2环） 你得知每个灵光的位置与强度。

Your eyes glow as you sense aligned auras. Choose chaotic, evil, good, or lawful. You detect auras of that alignment. You receive no information beyond presence or absence. You can choose not to detect creatures or effects you're aware have that alignment.

Only creatures of 6th level or higher-unless divine spellcasters, undead, or beings from the Outer Sphere-have alignment auras.

Heightened (2nd) You learn each aura's location and strength.

Pouch of Four Gems.name: 四玉袋 Pouch of Four Gems
Pouch of Four Gems.description:
每个死神都携带着一个小袋，内装四颗黑色蓝宝石，供@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}使用。每颗宝石都能够容纳一个最高等级等同于该死神的灵魂。如果死神死亡，这些宝石也会一并毁坏，而其中所容纳的任何灵魂都会被无害地释放，前往骨园。

Each shinigami carries a pouch containing four black sapphires for use with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}. Each gem is capable of holding a soul of a maximum level equal to that of the shinigami. If the shinigami dies, the gems are destroyed as well, and any souls they contain are released harmlessly to travel to the Boneyard.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时，所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
死神呈现为一个特定的小型或中型类人生物的外观。除了移除其打击的触及特征外，这不会改变其属性。死神的人类形态是死神所独有的，不能用于乔装成某个生物。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The shinigami takes on the appearance of a specific Small or Medium humanoid creature. This doesn't change their statistics, other than to remove the reach trait from their Strikes. The shinigami's human shape is unique to the shinigami and can't be used to Impersonate a creature.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Release Soul.name: 释放灵魂 Release Soul
Release Soul.description:
需求 死神囊袋中的一颗宝石内含有一个来自缚魂术的灵魂

效果 死神捏碎这颗宝石，将灵魂送往骨园，同时释放出一阵死灵能量波。所有位于@Template[emanation|distance:30]内的生物受到 @Damage[18d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:drained,inflicts:sickened] 豁免）；死神选择该伤害是活力伤害还是虚空伤害。因该效果受到伤害且豁免失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸能 1}（若大失败，则改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 4}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸能 2}）。

Requirements One of the gems in the shinigami's pouch contains a soul from bind soul

Effect The shinigami crushes the gem, sending the soul to the Boneyard while releasing a wave of necromantic energy. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[18d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:drained,inflicts:sickened] save); the shinigami chooses whether this damage is vitality damage or void damage. A creature who takes damage from this effect and fails the saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure).

Spirit Touch.name: 精魂接触 Spirit Touch
Spirit Touch.description:
死神的打击可以如同具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}属性符文的效果那样影响虚体生物。

A shinigami's Strikes can affect incorporeal creatures with the effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune.

Shinzo.publicNotes:
即便是如神使这样的不朽存在，也无法免于死亡。当神使或其他同样强大的实体拒绝响应骨园的召唤时，死神便会被召来，让这些顽固的灵魂就范。死神行事精准而迅捷，以高效且冷酷无情地施行死亡的裁决而闻名。

轮回守护者

死神负责调查并处理那些扰乱生命自然流转的大范围现象。他们可能会被派去解决问题，或被告知等待、观察，并仅提供最低限度的协助。虽然大多数死神在这种漫长的守望中都能保持公正，但也有一些绝非毫无情感，最终会动摇并偏向慈悲或残酷。

Even immortals such as kami aren't immune to death. When a kami or equally powerful entity refuses the call of the Boneyard, a shinigami is summoned to bring these stubborn souls to heel. Exact and swift, shinigami are known to dispense the judgment of death efficiently and dispassionately.

Guardians Of The Cycle

Shinigami are responsible for investigating and dealing with widespread phenomena that disrupt the natural flow of life. They might be tasked with solving the issue or be told to wait, observe, and provide minimal assistance. While most shinigami can retain their impartiality during such long vigils, some are far from emotionless and end up wavering toward mercy or cruelty.
Shinzo.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Kugaptee's Tree.name: 苦迦菩提之树 Kugaptee's Tree
Kugaptee's Tree.tokenName: 苦迦菩提之树 Kugaptee's Tree

Pulse of Fear.name: 恐惧脉冲 Pulse of Fear
Pulse of Fear.description:
触发 一名闯入寺院者在E3区域开始其回合

效果 石像猛然活了过来，它的枝条在空气中呼啸抽打，一声骇人的咆哮撕裂了整座寺院——那咆哮仿佛来自地下。寺院内所有闯入者都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免。随后，该作祟进行先攻掷骰。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入惊惧 2，并且处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续直到它不再惊惧。

Trigger An intruder to the monastery begins their turn in area E3

Effect The stone statue lurches to life, its branches whipping through the air as a horrifying roar rips through the monastery—a roar that seems to come from underground. All intruders within the monastery must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is frightened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it remains frightened.

Kugaptee's Tree.disable:
@Check[religion|dc:25]以驱除作祟，或@Check[intimidation|dc:28]以显得在身体与心智上都强大得令人难以抗拒

@Check[religion|dc:25] to exorcise the haunt, or @Check[intimidation|dc:28] to appear overwhelmingly strong of body and mind
Kugaptee's Tree.hazarddescription:
石树雕像的枝条活化、伸展，并抽打入侵者。

The branches of the stone tree statue animate, extend, and lash out at intruders.
Kugaptee's Tree.routine:
（3动作）苦迦菩提之树挥动其枝条，使用中它的三个动作，对触及内的任意生物尝试进行枝条打击。位于触及内但在E3区域外的目标会从周围的拱廊获得掩蔽。该作祟优先选择E3区域内的目标，否则会随机选择其目标。

(3 actions) Kugaptee's tree lashes out with its branches, using its three actions to attempt branch Strikes against any creature in reach. Targets that are within reach but are outside of area E3 have cover from the surrounding archways. The haunt favors targets in area E3 but otherwise selects its targets randomly.
Kugaptee's Tree.prototypeToken: 苦迦菩提之树 Kugaptee's Tree

Animated Axe.name: 活化斧 Animated Axe

Construct Armor.name: 构装护甲 Construct Armor
Construct Armor.description:
像普通物体一样，活化短斧具有硬度。该硬度会将短斧受到的任何伤害减少等同于其硬度的数值。一旦活化短斧的生命值降至低于其一半，或者一旦因大成功受到伤害，其构装护甲就会破裂，且其护甲等级降至 19。

Like normal objects, an animated hatchet has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage the hatchet takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated hatchet is reduced to fewer than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, and its Armor Class is reduced to 19.

Animated Axe.blurb:
活化物体变体
Variant animated object

Predictable Silver Piece.name: 可预测银币 Predictable Silver Piece
Predictable Silver Piece.description:
这枚看似不起眼、饱经风霜的银币，正面刻着一位无名君主的半身像，反面则是一只威严的鸟。你可以在不启动它的情况下掷出这枚硬币，此时它遵循正常的概率规律。

启动—欺瞒命运 1 (操作)

效果 你用拇指摩擦硬币的一面，意图稍微拨动命运之线，随后将硬币抛向空中进行一次掷币。无论这次投掷如何结算——让硬币落到地上、把它拍落在手背上，还是用张开的手掌接住——它最后都会以你摩擦过的那一面朝上落定。

This seemingly unremarkable, weathered silver coin bears the bust of an unnamed monarch on the face and a majestic bird on the tail. You can toss the coin without activating it, in which case it follows the normal laws of probability.

Activate—Cheat Fate 1 (manipulate)

Effect You rub your thumb on one side of the coin with the intent of slightly tweaking the strands of fate, then flip the coin into the air in a coin toss. No matter how the toss is resolved- letting the coin fall to the ground, slapping it down on the back of your hand, or catching it on your open palm-it always lands with the side you rubbed face up.

Oil of Potency.name: 潜能油 Oil of Potency
Oil of Potency.description:
启动 1 (操作)

当你将这种浓稠、黏滞的油涂抹到一件武器或一套护甲上时，该物品立刻获得魔法潜能。如果该物品是武器，它会暂时成为+1强效符文强击武器；如果是护甲，它会暂时成为+1强效符文坚韧护甲。此效果持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1OLlwExJz7ii2Lu2]{效果：潜能油}

Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you apply this thick, viscous oil to a weapon or suit of armor, that item immediately becomes magically potent. If the item is a weapon, it temporarily becomes a +1 striking weapon, or, if it's armor, it temporarily becomes +1 resilient armor. This lasts for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1OLlwExJz7ii2Lu2]{Effect: Oil of Potency}

Lady Ren's Dust.name: 任女士的尘土 Lady Ren's Dust
Lady Ren's Dust.tokenName: 任女士的尘土 Lady Ren's Dust

Dust of Corpse Animation.name: 尸体活化粉尘 Dust of Corpse Animation
Dust of Corpse Animation.description:
启动 2（操作）

这个黑色小袋中装着看似细腻的骨粉。将这些粉末以特殊图案洒在尸体上，可以把它变成一只不死生物。所制造出的不死生物类型取决于尸体的状态，最终会变成骷髅（特征）或丧尸（特征）。如果该不死生物的等级会高于3，则骨粉无法将其活化。你想制造的不死生物，其身体必须具有合适的体型和种类——例如，你必须将骨粉洒在马的骨架上，才能活化出一匹骷髅马。如果在该等级范围内有不止一种合适的不死生物，例如对于一个中型类人生物的骨架来说，可以是骷髅守卫或骷髅圣武士，则由你选择。

被活化的不死生物具有仆从特征，这意味着当你对其下达命令时，它可以使用2个动作。作为启动的一部分，你可以为当前回合下达一次命令。该不死生物会持续活动1分钟，之后倒回尸体形态。与通常规则相同，你最多只能同时控制四个仆从。

Activate 2 (manipulate)

This black pouch contains what appears to be fine bone dust. Pouring the dust in a special pattern over a corpse turns it into an undead creature. The type of undead created depends on the condition of the corpse, resulting in either a skeleton or a zombie. If the undead's level would be greater than 3, the dust fails to animate it. The body must be of an appropriate size and type for the undead you wish to create-for example, you must sprinkle the dust on a horse's skeleton to animate a skeletal horse. If more than one undead in the level range is appropriate, such as skeletal guard or skeletal champion for a Medium humanoid skeleton, you choose.

The animated undead has the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you Command it. You can issue a Command for the current turn as part of the activation. The undead creature remains animated for 1 minute before collapsing back into its corpse form. As usual, you can have a maximum of four minions under your control.

Lady Ren's Dust.prototypeToken: 任女士的尘土 Lady Ren's Dust

Kugaptee's Blessing.name: 苦迦菩提的祝福 Kugaptee's Blessing
Kugaptee's Blessing.tokenName: 苦迦菩提的祝福 Kugaptee's Blessing

Slowed.name: 缓慢 Slowed
Slowed.description:
你的动作更少。缓慢总是带有一个数值。当你在你的回合开始时重新获得动作时，你重新获得的动作数量减少等同于你的缓慢值。由于缓慢在你的回合开始时生效，如果你在你的回合期间变为缓慢，你不会立刻失去动作。

You have fewer actions. Slowed always includes a value. When you regain your actions at the start of your turn, reduce the number of actions you regain by your slowed value. Because slowed has its effect at the start of your turn, you don't immediately lose actions if you become slowed during your turn.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
丧尸永久处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}状态，且不能使用反应动作。

A zombie is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Improved Push 5 feet.name: 改良推击 5 尺 Improved Push 5 feet

Kugaptee's Blessing.publicNotes:
死灵强化赋予了这只丧尸更大的体型与力量。

丧尸唯一的欲望就是吞食活物。它们毫无思考能力，永远蹒跚前行，是死亡的先兆；丧尸唯有在被摧毁时才会停下。

Necromantic augmentations have granted this zombie increased size and power.

A zombie's only desire is to consume the living. Unthinking and ever-shambling harbingers of death, zombies stop only when they're destroyed.
Kugaptee's Blessing.prototypeToken: 苦迦菩提的祝福 Kugaptee's Blessing

Fluffy Whiskers.name: 毛须 Fluffy Whiskers

Lithe.name: 轻盈 Lithe
Lithe.description:
鼬鼠将任何它仅能勉强让头部通过或更宽的狭窄空间视为困难地形，并且不需要@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}就能穿过其中。

A weasel treats any tight space it can barely fit its head in or wider as difficult terrain and doesn't need to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} to move through it.

Fluffy Whiskers.publicNotes:
尽管体型小，鼬鼠却是技艺高超的猎人。它们在追逐食物时几乎无所畏惧，常常能杀死体型达到自身五倍的生物。它们偏好的战术是扑到猎物后颈上，用颚进行缠绕挤压，直到目标死去。为了让自己始终不缺食物，鼬鼠猎杀的生物往往超过所需，并把猎物塞进中空的原木或废弃的兽穴里，留待之后食用。

学者们观察到，无论是在荒野中还是在圈养环境下，鼬鼠都会在猎物面前表现出一种古怪的行为。它们会难以预测地四处乱窜，猛然扑倒在地，在洞穴中钻进钻出，整体上看起来完全像是在胡乱行动。作为回应，它们的猎物会变得困惑，甚至像是被催眠了一样，这就给了鼬鼠一个向前猛冲并施以致命一击的机会。

普通的鼬鼠体长为12英寸，体重不足1磅。

鼬鼠是轻盈而聪明的掠食者，既以美丽光滑的毛皮闻名，也以钻入狭小空间的能力著称。按体重比例来看，很少有动物像鼬鼠这样贪食。它们食欲永不满足，每天几乎要吃下相当于自身体重一半的食物，因此总是在不断寻找新的猎物来满足饥饿。
