Despite their small stature, weasels are skilled hunters. Nearly fearless in pursuit of food, they frequently kill creatures up to five times their own size. Their preferred tactic is to latch onto the back of their victim's neck and constrict with their jaws until the target dies. To keep themselves well fed, weasels kill more creatures than they need and stuff their victims into hollow logs or empty dens to eat later.

Scholars have observed weasels, both in the wild and captivity, perform a bizarre behavior in front of their prey. They rush about unpredictably, throw themselves to the ground, wriggle into and out of burrows, and generally appear to behave entirely irrationally. In response, their prey becomes confused or seemingly hypnotized, which gives the weasel an opportunity to dash forward and strike a killing blow.

A typical weasel is 12 inches long and weighs less than a pound.

Weasels are lithe, clever predators known for both their beautiful, sleek fur and their ability to crawl into tight spaces. Pound for pound, few animals are as voracious as weasels. Insatiably hungry, they eat almost half their own weight each day, leading them to constantly hunt for new prey to satisfy their hunger.

Zombie Shambler.name: 蹒跚的丧尸 Zombie Shambler

Jaws.name: 颚 Jaws
Jaws.description:
需求 该丧尸已使一名生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}。

Requirements The zombie has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
丧尸永久处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，且不能使用反应动作。

A zombie is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Zombie Shambler.publicNotes:
蹒跚的丧尸是一种行动迟缓的恐怖之物，在数量较多时尤其危险。

丧尸唯一的欲望就是吞食活物。它们是不假思索、永远蹒跚前行的死亡先兆，只有在被摧毁时才会停下。

A zombie shambler is a slow-moving horror dangerous in larger groups.

A zombie's only desire is to consume the living. Unthinking and ever-shambling harbingers of death, zombies stop only when they're destroyed.

War Horse.name: 战马 War Horse

Gallop.name: 疾驰 Gallop
Gallop.description:
这匹战马进行两次Stride。在这些移动期间，它的速度获得+10尺环境加值。

The war horse Strides twice. It has a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed during these Strides.

War Horse.publicNotes:
马在许多社会中既是坐骑，也是役畜。它们忠诚且通常性情温顺，对那些希望进行长途旅行的人来说无比宝贵。较小的族群，比如侏儒和半身人，常常使用矮种马作为坐骑，而马则是人类和其他中型类人生物偏爱的坐骑。普通类人生物所遭遇的大多数马都已被驯化，不过在荒野中也能发现大群马群。

Horses serve as mounts and beasts of burden in many societies. They are loyal and typically gentle creatures, and they are invaluable to those looking to travel long distances. Smaller folk, like gnomes and halflings, often utilize ponies as mounts, while horses are the favored steeds for humans and other Medium humanoids. Most horses that the average humanoid encounters are domesticated, though large herds can be found in the wild.

Hongrui's Gratitude.name: 弘蕊酬恩 Hongrui's Gratitude
Hongrui's Gratitude.description:
这件带红兜帽的斗篷是为感谢你缅怀三位在柳岸腹地遭遇悲惨结局的不幸旅人而赠予的。斗篷上装饰着一位盛装表演者的形象，她的两名伙伴分别为她执提灯与撑伞。

启动 3 命令术、观想、交互（塑能、光）

频率 每天一次

需求 你未处于这件斗篷的伞形启动生效期间

效果 你将斗篷向左一挥，使斗篷上执提灯伙伴的形象消失。你身侧会出现一盏漂浮的红色提灯，并始终与你保持一臂距离跟随你，像火把一样在20足半径内发出明亮光照（接着向外20足为昏暗光照）。持续1小时，当这盏提灯的光照生效时，你的交涉检定获得+1物品加值。你可以再次启动这件斗篷以遣散这盏提灯。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.o1Fzi94EODK3fa4A]{效果：弘蕊酬恩（提灯）}

启动 3 命令术、观想、交互（防护）

频率 每天一次

需求 你未处于这件斗篷的提灯启动生效期间

效果 你将斗篷向右一挥，使斗篷上执伞伙伴的形象消失。一把坚不可摧的红色蜡纸伞会出现在你头顶上方并跟随着你，为你遮挡天气效果，例如雨或明亮的阳光。持续1小时，当这把伞生效时，你的求生检定获得+1物品加值。你可以再次启动这件斗篷以遣散这把伞。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.g1EdALRxZmmEkSd7]{效果：弘蕊酬恩（伞）}

Given as thanks for honoring the memories of three unfortunate travelers who met a tragic end in the Willowshore Hinterlands, this red-hooded cloak is decorated with an image of an elaborately dressed performer whose two companions hold a lantern and umbrella for her.

Activate 3 command, envision, Interact (evocation, light)

Frequency once per day

Requirements You don't have the umbrella activation of this cloak active

Effect With a wave of the cloak to the left, you cause the image of the lantern-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. A floating red lantern appears at your side and follows you at an arm's length while casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) like a torch. For 1 hour, while the light from this lantern is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the torch.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.o1Fzi94EODK3fa4A]{Effect: Hongrui's Gratitude (Lantern)}

Activate 3 command, envision, Interact (abjuration)

Frequency once per day

Requirements You don't have the lantern activation of this cloak active

Effect With a wave of the cloak to the right, you cause the image of the umbrella-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. An indestructible red wax paper umbrella appears above you and follows you, shielding you from weather effects, such as rain or bright sunlight. For 1 hour, while this umbrella is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to Survival checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the umbrella.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.g1EdALRxZmmEkSd7]{Effect: Hongrui's Gratitude (Umbrella)}

Oil of Potency.name: 潜能油 Oil of Potency
Oil of Potency.description:
启动 1（操作）

当你将这种浓稠黏滑的油涂抹在一件武器或一套护甲上时，该物品会立即获得魔法潜能。如果该物品是武器，它会暂时变为+1强击武器；如果是护甲，则会暂时变为+1坚韧护甲。此效果持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1OLlwExJz7ii2Lu2]{效果：潜能油}

Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you apply this thick, viscous oil to a weapon or suit of armor, that item immediately becomes magically potent. If the item is a weapon, it temporarily becomes a +1 striking weapon, or, if it's armor, it temporarily becomes +1 resilient armor. This lasts for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1OLlwExJz7ii2Lu2]{Effect: Oil of Potency}

Mesmerizing Opal.name: 迷心蛋白石 Mesmerizing Opal
Mesmerizing Opal.description:
启动 A（专注）

这枚镶有银边的蛋白石坠饰燃烧着虹彩光辉。当你启动它时，进行一次欺瞒检定以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{佯攻}。如果结果为成功，则改为大成功。如果结果为大失败，则改为失败。

Activate A (concentrate)

This silver-bound opal pendant is afire with iridescence. When you activate it, attempt a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}. If the outcome is a success, you get a critical success instead. If the outcome is a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

Potency Crystal.name: 潜能水晶 Potency Crystal
Potency Crystal.description:
启动 F（专注）

触发 你使用所附着的武器进行一次攻击，但尚未掷骰

这块萤石水晶散发着奇异的磷光。当你启动该水晶时，这把武器在此次打击中以及直到本回合结束前成为一把+1强击武器，使攻击掷骰获得+1物品加值，并将伤害提高为两个武器伤害骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.R5ugeFK3MPwkbv0s]{效果：潜能水晶}

Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You make an attack with the affixed weapon, but you haven't rolled yet

This fluorite crystal glows with a strange phosphorescence. When you activate the crystal, the weapon becomes a +1 striking weapon on the Strike and until the end of this turn, gaining a +1 item bonus to the attack roll and increasing the damage to two weapon damage dice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.R5ugeFK3MPwkbv0s]{Effect: Potency Crystal}

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这种小型带刃武器可单手持握，用于在近身战斗中刺击生物。它也可以投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Silk-wrapped Leather Sheath.name: 丝绸包裹的皮制鞘 Silk-wrapped Leather Sheath

Ho Jeong-hui.name: 洪正辉 Ho Jeong-hui
Ho Jeong-hui.blurb:
受欢迎的男性人类城镇卫兵
popular male human town guard

Flaming.name: 烈焰 Flaming
Flaming.description:
带有此符文的武器被摇曳的火焰强化。该武器在成功打击时额外造成 1d6 火焰伤害，且在大成功时再造成 1d10 持续性火焰伤害。

A weapon with this rune is empowered by flickering flame. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 fire damage on a successful Strike, plus 1d10 persistent fire damage on a critical hit.

The Chewer.name: 咀嚼者 The Chewer

Black Apoxia.name: 黑色缺氧症 Black Apoxia
Black Apoxia.description:
目标无法从由黑色缺氧症导致的疲乏（状态）中恢复，直到该疾病被治愈

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良影响（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭 1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}（1天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭 2} 和 疲乏（1天）

阶段 4 死亡

The target can't recover from the fatigued condition caused by black apoxia until the disease is cured

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 dead

Brawling Critical.name: 徒手攻击大成功 Brawling Critical
Brawling Critical.description:
当黑坊主以徒手攻击造成大成功时，目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22] 豁免，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到其下个回合结束。

When the kurobozu scores a critical hit with an unarmed attack, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Sagebane.name: 贤者祸根 Sagebane
Sagebane.description:
当黑坊主以徒手 打击 对一个活体生物造成伤害时，目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1分钟。

黑坊主进一步造成的伤害会将持续时间重置为1分钟，并在豁免失败时使呆滞值增加1，最高至呆滞 4。

When the kurobozu damages a living creature with an unarmed Strike, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

Further damage dealt by the kurobozu resets the duration to 1 minute and increases the stupefied value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of stupefied 4.

Steal Breath.name: 窃息 Steal Breath
Steal Breath.description:
需求 黑坊主邻接一个活着的生物，且该生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识} 状态

效果 黑坊主俯下身，吸出目标的气息，目标必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22] 强韧豁免。无论结果如何，该生物都会暴露于黑色缺氧症，且其气息在1分钟内都带有腐肉恶臭。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物在1分钟内无法说话。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}，并且在1分钟内无法说话。

大失败 如同失败，此外该生物会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识} 并开始窒息。

Requirements The kurobozu is adjacent to a living creature that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

Effect The kurobozu leans over and sucks the breath from the target, who must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. Regardless of the result, the creature is exposed to black apoxia and its breath reeks of carrion for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't speak for 1 minute.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and can't speak for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and begins suffocating.

Stunning Flurry.name: 震慑连击 Stunning Flurry
Stunning Flurry.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 黑坊主进行两次徒手打击。如果两次都命中同一个生物，则为了抗力和弱点的目的，将它们的伤害合并计算，且目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}（大失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}）；此次豁免具有失能特征。

Frequency once per round

Effect The kurobozu makes two unarmed Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure); this save has the incapacitation trait.

The Chewer.publicNotes:
生前违背了其修道誓言的武僧，可能会在死后化作一种被称为黑坊主的亡灵怪物。这些掠食者以凡人的气息为食，用扭曲的四肢爬进卧室，从沉睡的受害者身上窃取生命。这样的进食行为会在受害者身上留下痕迹：其呼吸中带有一股腐烂的恶臭，并染上一种会使人衰弱的疾病，最终导致精疲力竭，直至死亡。

黑坊主保留着其苦修训练的些许残响，使它们能够在战斗中从虚弱的敌人身上吸取气息。它们的恶毒狡猾结合苦修者的纪律性，帮助其策划复杂而漫长的阴谋，以施行其嫉妒的复仇。很少有黑坊主足够具有说服力，能劝诱昔日的同伴违背他们自己的誓言，但这并不妨碍它们不断尝试。

A monk who violated their monastic vows in life might arise after death to become an undead horror known as a kurobozu. These predators feast upon the breath of mortals, creeping on twisted limbs into bedrooms to steal the life from sleeping victims. This act of feeding leaves its mark on the victim in the form of a vile scent of rot on the victim's breath and a debilitating disease that eventually results in exhaustion and finally death.

Kurobozus retain echoes of their ascetic training, enabling them to suck the breath from debilitated foes in the midst of battle. Their malevolent cunning combined with ascetic discipline helps them concoct elaborate and lengthy schemes to enact their jealous revenge. Few kurobozus are convincing enough to persuade their onetime allies to break their own oaths, but this doesn't stop them from making the attempt.
The Chewer.blurb:
变体男性黑坊主
Variant male kurobozu

Awakened Tree.name: 觉醒树木 Awakened Tree
Awakened Tree.publicNotes:
树王与其他强大原始魔法的使用者会赋予树木暂时的知性，以保护森林。被注入一套可运作的本能，以及行动与攻击的能力后，这些觉醒树木会遵从其主人的命令，为保卫家园而战。以下数据也同样适用于通过其他方式获得活动能力的植被，例如来自另一位面的神秘影响、反复无常的妖精精魂，或类似情况。

树人是森林的守护者，也是树木的代表。它们如自己守望的林地一般长寿，因此树人视自己为树木的父母与牧者，而非园丁。因此，树人通常行动缓慢而做事有条不紊，但一旦被迫为保卫林地而战，它们又会变得快得可怕。尽管它们很少主动寻求与短命种族为伴——即便是精灵，在树人眼中也不过转瞬即逝——而且天生不信任变化，但众所周知，树人会容忍那些愿意聆听它们冗长而离题万里的独白、试图从中学习的人，尤其是当这些学生也表现出保护林地的意愿时。对于那些威胁其领域的人，比如急于砍伐木材的樵夫，或打算开辟农田、建立城镇的定居者，树人的愤怒坚定不移且极具毁灭性。或许颇具讽刺意味的是，树人很擅长拆毁他人建造之物——这一特征对它们族群中那些心怀复仇者尤其有用。

Arboreal regents and other wielders of powerful primal magic grant temporary sentience to trees in order to protect the forest. Invested with a workable set of instincts and the ability to mobilize and attack, these awakened trees follow the commands of their master and fight to protect their home. The statistics below work just as well for foliage that has become animate via other methods, such as a mystical influence from another dimension, a capricious fey spirit, or the like.

Arboreals are guardians of the forest and representatives of the trees. As long-lived as the woods they watch over, arboreals consider themselves parents and shepherds of trees rather than their gardeners. Consequently, while arboreals tend to be slow and methodical, they are terrifyingly swift when forced to fight in defense of the woods. Though they rarely seek out the companionship of short-lived folk—even elves are fugacious in the eyes of arboreals—and have an inherent distrust of change, arboreals have been known to tolerate those who seek to learn from their long-winded, rambling monologues, especially if such pupils also express a desire to protect the timberlands. Against those who threaten their realm, such as loggers eager to harvest lumber or settlers aiming to establish croplands or a town, arboreals' wrath is unwavering and devastating. Perhaps ironically, arboreals are gifted at tearing down what others build—a trait that serves vengeful members of their kind well.

The Fang and Key is largely a ceremonial item and has no real intrinsic function of its own other than to serve as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{everlight crystal}.

Pitch Bale.name: 干草捆投掷 Pitch Bale
Pitch Bale.description:
需求 农夫上一动作是一次成功的干草叉打击

效果 农夫将其用干草叉击中的生物移动至多5尺，且目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。目标可以尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:13]豁免以避免陷入倒地；若大成功，则还会完全避免被移动。

Requirements The farmer's last action was a successful pitchfork Strike

Effect The farmer moves the creature they hit with their pitchfork up to 5 feet, and the target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:13] save to avoid falling prone and avoids being moved altogether on a critical success.

Captured Farmer.publicNotes:
世界各地田野、葡萄园和果园中的劳作者，农夫以其坚韧的耐力以及与植物和动物打交道的娴熟技巧而闻名。

社会是建立在劳工的脊背之上的。

Workers of the fields, vineyards, and orchards of the world, farmers are known for their rugged endurance and skill with plants and animals.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.

Thatchling.name: 草人 Thatchling

Distracting Giggle.name: 分神讪笑 Distracting Giggle
Distracting Giggle.description:
15尺。草人的咯咯笑声在心灵深处回响。处于灵气范围内的生物进行意志豁免时承受-1状态减值。

15 feet. The thatchling's giggle echoes in the back of the mind. Creatures within the aura take a –1 status penalty to Will saves.

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当草人被火焰以外的伤害摧毁时，它会尝试一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]。若成功，它会在被摧毁地点120英尺内于[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后重组，并完全恢复。若草人因火焰伤害而生命值降至0，或者阻止该灵魂转世的障碍被移除，则它总是会被永久摧毁。

When a thatchling is destroyed by damage other than fire, it attempts a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a success, it reforms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within 120 feet of where it was destroyed, fully healed. A thatchling is always permanently destroyed if reduced to 0 Hit Points by fire damage or if the obstacle preventing the soul from reincarnating is removed.

Thatchling's Curse.name: 草人诅咒 Thatchling's Curse
Thatchling's Curse.description:
草人将注意力集中在其视线内30足内的单一目标上，然后开始喃喃低语、念叨着毫无意义的话语。目标必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:16] 豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并在24小时内暂时免疫草人诅咒。

成功 目标会短暂地失去方向感，难以朝正确方向移动。目标的速度在1轮内承受–5足状态减值。

失败 同成功，但其速度减值持续1分钟。

大失败 同失败，但其速度减值会持续，直到诅咒被移除，或直到制造该效果的草人被永久摧毁，以先发生者为准。此外，当受诅咒的生物尝试进行求生检定以辨别方向或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{追踪}时，其检定结果的成功等级视为比实际结果差一级，且其不能进行侦查（探索行动）。

The thatchling focuses its attention on a single target within 30 feet that it can see, and then begins muttering and whispering nonsense. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:16] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Thatchling's Curse for 24 hours.

Success The target is momentarily disoriented and has difficulty moving in the right direction. The target takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure As success, but the penalty to its Speeds lasts for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but the penalty to its Speeds lasts until the curse is removed or until the thatchling that created the effect is permanently destroyed, whichever comes first. In addition, when the cursed creature attempts a Survival check to Sense Direction or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track}, they use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their check, and they can't take the Scout exploration activity.

Thicket Walker.name: 灌木行者 Thicket Walker
Thicket Walker.description:
草人无视由荆棘、缠结的草丛和矮丛环境造成的困难地形，即使这些环境被魔法操纵也是如此。

Thatchlings ignore difficult terrain caused by brambles, tangled grass, and undergrowth, even those manipulated by magic.

Thatchling.publicNotes:
普通草人看起来像是一团由干草和细枝扎成的人形束，被一圈圈看似发光的蓝色头发般之物捆在一起。这些下等亡灵无法形成比年幼人类孩童更大的身体。

在神门的乡间，桑博齐的某些分支会警告人们：如果一个本应转生的灵魂被阻止进入灵魂之河、无法重新回到轮回之中，会发生什么。这些灵魂会先变得沮丧、困惑，继而愤怒，因为它们觉得自己应得的身体被剥夺了，于是便强迫植物成为自己的新身体。也有人推测，当一具身体被埋进浅坟时，向下长入遗骸的草根会缠住灵魂并将其捕获。

草人具有智能，也能够说话，但很少这么做——对于那些它们觊觎其生命之人，它们通常没什么可说的。极少数情况下，草人会试图呼喊求助，将某人引诱进高草区域或茂密的矮丛环境之中；但它们在欺瞒方面几乎没有什么本事，因此这种手段并不能有效让它们显得像是真正需要帮助的活着生物。

规则与建议老友

柳岸镇草人的来源很简单：那些本该在死亡后转生的灵魂无法如此，于是便化为了草人。当然，由于每年都会“重置”一切，那些在这一年中死去并变成草人的人，会在每个夏天的第一天再次活着重生，并且对自己先前毁灭的存在毫无记忆。尽管它们依旧受本能驱使去攻击活人，柳岸镇的草人确实会感到一丝悔意——如果游戏主持认为这特别合适，它们对自己生前认识的生物进行攻击掷骰和豁免骰时，可能会承受 –2 环境减值。

额外学识永远无感

草人诅咒会夺走受诅咒者的方向感，以至于神门出现了一整类辱骂话，会把一个人做成某事的能力比作“草人感”。例如，一个很难交到朋友的人，可能会被说成有着“草人的友谊感”；而一个总是把饭做坏的人，则可能会被说成有着“草人的厨房感”。

The typical thatchling appears as a humanoid bundle of dry grass and twigs, held together by coils of what looks like glowing blue hair. These minor undead can't form bodies larger than those of a small human child.

In rural Shenmen, some branches of Sangpotshi warn of what can happen if a soul bound for reincarnation is prevented from entering the River of Souls and rejoining the cycle. These souls become frustrated, confused, and then furious at what they feel is a denial of the body they deserve, and in turn, they force vegetation to serve as their new body. Others theorize that when a body is buried in a shallow grave, the roots of grass growing down into the remains can tangle the soul and capture it.

Thatchlings are intelligent and capable of speaking but rarely do so—they generally have little to say to those whose lives they covet. Rarely, one might attempt to lure someone into an area of tall grass or dense undergrowth by calling out to them for aid, but they have little skill at deception, so such tactics aren't particularly effective at making them seem like actual living creatures in need of help.

Old Friends

The source of Willowshore's thatchlings is the simple fact that the souls who would normally have been reincarnated upon death can't do so, thus rising as thatchlings. Of course, since each year "resets" things, those who died during the year and became thatchlings are reborn alive once more on every first day of summer, with no memories of their previous doomed existence. While still driven by instinct to attack the living, Willowshore's thatchlings do feel a sense of remorse—if the GM judges it especially appropriate, they might take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and saving throws against creatures they knew in life.

Forever Senseless

The thatchling's curse robs the sense of direction from those it falls upon, leading to a whole category of insults in Shenmen that compare someone's ability to get something done to "a thatchling's sense." For example, someone who has a hard time making friends might be said to have "a thatchling's sense of friendship," while someone who constantly ruins meals might be said to have "a thatchling's kitchen sense."

Love Letters.name: 爱情书信 Love Letters
Love Letters.description:
阅读这些信件揭示了三美与胡两家最年轻一代之间一段秘密而萌芽中的关系：三美裕里与胡乐龙。

Reading the letters reveals a secret and blossoming relationship between the youngest generation of the Sanmi and Hu families, Yuli Sanmi and Hu Lelong.

Kohoshi.name: 小星 Kohoshi

Ward.name: 受监护者 Ward
Ward.description:
每位神使都与一个受监护者相绑定：一种特定的动物、植物、物体或地点。神使可以用单动作与其受监护者融合，或从其受监护者中浮现，该动作具有专注（特征）。处于融合状态时，神使可以用其通常的感官以及其受监护者的感官观察周围环境，但不能移动、与其受监护者交流，或控制其受监护者。此外，与其受监护者融合的神使每分钟恢复生命值，仿佛其进行了整整一天的休息。

式神的受监护者通常是一件下等艺术作品或文明的象征，例如里程碑、小路路标、私人花园或微型雕像。

Every kami is bound to a ward: a specific animal, plant, object, or location. A kami can merge with or emerge from their ward as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. While merged, the kami can observe their surroundings with their usual senses as well as the senses of their ward, but can't move, communicate with, or control their ward. Additionally, a kami merged with their ward recovers Hit Points each minute as if they spent an entire day resting.

A shikigami's ward is typically a minor work of art or symbol of civilization, such as a milestone, trail sign, personal garden, or tiny statue.

Flatten.name: 压平 Flatten
Flatten.description:
式神压平到一张纸的宽度。处于压平状态时，它们可以飘浮于风中，获得20足飞行速度，并且无需使用挤压就能穿过细小的裂缝和空隙；但是，它们会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}。式神可以解消此效果。

The shikigami flattens to the width of a sheet of paper. While Flattened, they can float on the wind, gaining a 20-foot fly Speed, and they can slip through small cracks and gaps without needing to Squeeze; however, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. The shikigami can Dismiss this effect.

Kohoshi.publicNotes:
式神由纸制成，能够轻易在扁平的剪纸形态与立体的纸塑玩偶形态之间变换。不同于大多数其他神使——它们由更强大的精魂或神祇与其受监护者相连——式神是下等精魂，甚至凡人的修行者有时也能将其束缚进微小的纸形中，并指派它们守护小型作品，比如花园雕像与花瓶。地主们很喜欢让式神保护自己的花园，无论他们是付钱请一位游方施法者恳请式神前来，还是只是幸运地得到另一位精魂将式神指派到他们的土地上。旅人若偶然见到受式神眷顾的里程碑或路标，往往会相信这样的遭遇是旅途中的好兆头。

就式神自身而言，它们对文明以及居住其中的人形生物抱有复杂的看法。虽然式神会为了保护其受监护者而与入侵者和亵渎者战斗，但如果当地人开始破坏区域或表现出对自然的漠视，这些神使也同样可能直接离开——还会带着自己的受监护者一起走。大多数有能力束缚式神的修行者都不会做出这种不敬之举，但如果神使察觉到这类行径，遍布各地的式神可能会集体放弃契约，在它们离去后留下令人不安的空缺。由此，式神体现了文明扩张与自然世界保存之间那种脆弱的平衡。

并非所有式神都守护花园，因此你可以将式神的铁锹替换为任何一种对式神的任务及其受监护者有用的普通工具。神使挥舞任何这类武器时，使用与其铁锹打击相同的伤害骰、调整值和特征，但应根据新武器适当地更改伤害类型。

神使是来自内海地区遥远东方天夏土地上的神圣自然精魂。它们担任自己所保护的自然物体与地点——也就是其受监护者——的守护者，并且是恶鬼（《开拓者：怪物图鉴》252–255）的古老宿敌。神使能够与其受监护者合而为一，使它们可以暗中监视任何踏上其神圣领地的人。对于那些被它们认定无害的人，神使会置之不理；但对任何被视为威胁者，它们都会警惕地战斗，将其吓退。

Shikigami are made of paper and can easily transform between a flat cutout form and a three-dimensional doll of molded paper. Unlike most other kami, who are bound to their wards by a more powerful spirit or deity, shikigami are minor spirits that even mortal practitioners can sometimes bind into a tiny paper form and task with guarding small works, such as garden statues and vases. Landowners delight in having shikigami protect their gardens, whether they paid a wandering spellcaster to entreat the shikigami or simply had the fortune of another spirit assigning a shikigami to their land. Travelers who come across a shikigami-graced milestone or waypost believe that such encounters are good omens for the journey.

For their part, shikigami have mixed opinions on civilization and the humanoids who dwell therein. While shikigami will fight to protect their ward against invaders and desecrators, these kami are just as likely to leave—their ward in tow—if locals begin to despoil the area or show a disregard for nature. Most practitioners capable of binding a shikigami wouldn't engage in this type of disrespect, but should the kami catch wind of such practices, shikigami across the land might abandon their contracts en masse, leaving behind an uncomfortable vacuum with their exodus. In this way, shikigami exemplify the precarious balance between the expansion of civilization and the preservation of the natural world.

Not all shikigami protect gardens, so you can substitute the shikigami's spade for any sort of mundane tool that's useful to the shikigami's task and their ward. The kami wields any such weapon with the same damage dice, modifiers, and traits listed for their spade Strike, but change the damage type as appropriate for the new weapon.

Kami are divine nature spirits from the lands of Tian Xia, far to the east of the Inner Sea region. They serve as guardians of natural objects and places they protect—their wards—and are ancient enemies of oni (Pathfinder Monster Core 252–255). Kami can merge with their wards, allowing them to surreptitiously watch anyone who treads upon their sacred grounds. Kami leave those who they deem harmless alone, but fight vigilantly to scare away anyone perceived as a threat.

Healing Potion (Minor).name: 治疗药水（下等）
Healing Potion (Minor).description:
启动 A (操作)

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的麻感。当你饮用治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[1d8[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points.

Potency Crystal Talismans.name: 潜能水晶护符 Potency Crystal Talismans
Potency Crystal Talismans.description:
启动 F (专注)

触发 你用所附着的武器进行一次攻击，但你还未掷骰

这块萤石水晶散发着奇异的磷光。当你启动这块水晶时，该武器在此次打击中及直到本回合结束前成为一把+1强击武器，使攻击掷骰获得+1物品加值，并将伤害提高为两个武器伤害骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.R5ugeFK3MPwkbv0s]{效果：潜能水晶}

Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You make an attack with the affixed weapon, but you haven't rolled yet

This fluorite crystal glows with a strange phosphorescence. When you activate the crystal, the weapon becomes a +1 striking weapon on the Strike and until the end of this turn, gaining a +1 item bonus to the attack roll and increasing the damage to two weapon damage dice.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造一个由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四名普通人类同时呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你制造出一个幻象，使你看起来像另一个具有相同身体轮廓的生物，且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）都与你大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以让你乔装成某个特定个体。这个法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物和穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件裙子。手持物品不受影响，而任何你脱下的穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{乔装} 这个欺瞒用途设定伪装；它无视你因将自己伪装成差异较大的生物而可能承受的任何环境减值，给予你在防止他人看穿你的伪装时的欺瞒检定 +4 状态加值，并且即使你未受训，也可以加上你的等级。你可以解除这个法术。

强化（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音和气味，并获得听觉和嗅觉（特征）特征。

强化（3环） 你可以看起来像任何与自己体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过某个个体，才能呈现其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音和气味，并获得听觉和嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、松散且无人持有的 1 负载或以下的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——视你所掷出的物体而定——等于 1d6 加上你的施法能力调整值。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响这次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Distracting Giggle.name: 分神讪笑 Distracting Giggle
Distracting Giggle.description:
15尺。草人的咯咯笑声在脑海深处回响。灵气范围内的生物进行意志豁免时承受–1状态减值。

15 feet. The thatchling's giggle echoes in the back of the mind. Creatures within the aura take a –1 status penalty to Will saves.

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当草人被火焰以外的伤害摧毁时，它会尝试一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]。若成功，它会在被摧毁地点120尺内于 [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天} 后重组，并完全恢复。若草人因火焰伤害而降至0生命值，或阻止灵魂转世的障碍被移除，它总是会被永久摧毁。

When a thatchling is destroyed by damage other than fire, it attempts a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a success, it reforms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within 120 feet of where it was destroyed, fully healed. A thatchling is always permanently destroyed if reduced to 0 Hit Points by fire damage or if the obstacle preventing the soul from reincarnating is removed.

Create Thatchling Spawn.name: 创造草人衍体 Create Thatchling Spawn
Create Thatchling Spawn.description:
活着的类人生物若在受到草人诅咒效果影响期间被红头草人杀死，会在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}后作为一只草人复生。这个衍体受杀死它的红头草人指挥。若一只红头草人同时控制了过多草人（具体数量由游戏主持裁定），其中一些草人可以在其回合开始时通过一次 @Check[will|dc:18] 豁免挣脱控制。若创造该衍体的红头草人被摧毁，该衍体就会成为一只自主行动的草人。

A living humanoid who's slain by a red-hooded thatchling while under the effects of Thatchling's Curse rises as a thatchling after [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. This spawn is under the command of the red-hooded thatchling that killed it. If a red-hooded thatchling controls too many at once (as determined by the GM), some thatchlings can free themselves with a @Check[will|dc:18] saving throw at the start of their turn. If the red-hooded thatchling who created the spawn is destroyed, the spawn becomes an autonomous thatchling.

Howl of Vengeful Fury.name: 复仇怒嚎 Howl of Vengeful Fury
Howl of Vengeful Fury.description:
频率 每小时一次

效果 红头草人先可怜地抽泣，随后释放出一声骇人的尖啸。所有位于 @Template[emanation|distance:30] 内的非草人生物受到 @Damage[2d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免），并在1分钟内免疫所有草人的分神讪笑。区域内的草人获得5点临时生命值，且其打击和豁免骰在1分钟内获得+1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.X1Q1uBiylZoJg3Co]{效果：复仇怒嚎}

Frequency once per hour

Effect The red-hooded thatchling sobs pitifully before unleashing a terrifying scream. All non-thatchling creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[2d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save) and become immune to all thatchlings' distracting giggle for 1 minute. Thatchlings in the area gain 5 temporary Hit Points and a +1 status bonus to their Strikes and saving throws for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.X1Q1uBiylZoJg3Co]{Effect: Howl of Vengeful Fury}

Thatchling's Curse.name: 草人诅咒 Thatchling's Curse
Thatchling's Curse.description:
草人将注意力集中在其30足内一个它看得见的单一目标上，然后开始喃喃低语、念叨毫无意义的话语。目标必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:18] 豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并在24小时内暂时免疫草人诅咒。

成功 目标会暂时迷失方向，难以朝正确的方向移动。目标的各项速度在1轮内承受–5足状态减值。

失败 如成功，但其速度减值持续1分钟。

大失败 如失败，但其速度减值会持续，直到诅咒被移除，或直到制造该效果的草人被永久摧毁为止，两者取其先。此外，当受到诅咒的生物尝试进行求生检定以辨别方向或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{追踪} 时，它使用比其检定结果低一个成功等级的结果，且它不能进行侦查（探索行动）。

The thatchling focuses its attention on a single target within 30 feet that it can see, and then begins muttering and whispering nonsense. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Thatchling's Curse for 24 hours.

Success The target is momentarily disoriented and has difficulty moving in the right direction. The target takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure As success, but the penalty to its Speeds lasts for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but the penalty to its Speeds lasts until the curse is removed or until the thatchling that created the effect is permanently destroyed, whichever comes first. In addition, when the cursed creature attempts a Survival check to Sense Direction or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track}, they use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their check, and they can't take the Scout exploration activity.

Thicket Walker.name: 灌木行者 Thicket Walker
Thicket Walker.description:
草人无视由荆棘、纠结的草丛和矮丛环境造成的困难地形，即使这些是由魔法操控的也一样。

Thatchlings ignore difficult terrain caused by brambles, tangled grass, and undergrowth, even those manipulated by magic.

Fan Hongrui True Form.name: 范宏瑞真身 Fan Hongrui True Form

Fan Hongrui.publicNotes:
当一个注定会成为草人的灵魂在极度痛苦的挣扎中死去时，他们会在死后归来，化作红头草人。这些心怀复仇的草人从远处看仿佛戴着红色兜帽，但走近之后，便会显露出可怖的真相——它们的头其实浸满了鲜血。与其他草人不同，红头草人精于诡计，而且它们还能通过幻术魔法呈现为活着的人形生物，因此更容易引诱毫无防备的人落入伏击。

在神门的乡野间，桑博齐的一些分支会警示人们：若一个注定要转生的灵魂被阻止进入灵魂之河、重新回归轮回，会发生什么。这些灵魂会先变得沮丧、困惑，继而因自己所应得的身体被剥夺而怒火中烧，随后强迫草木充当他们新的身体。另一些人则推测，当尸体被埋入浅坟时，向下长入遗骸的草根可能会缠住灵魂，并将其捕获。

草人具有智能，也能够说话，但它们很少如此——对于那些它们觊觎其生命的人，它们通常无话可说。极少数情况下，某个草人可能会呼喊求助，试图把人引入高草区或茂密的矮丛环境，但它们在欺瞒方面本事不大，因此这种伎俩并不能有效让它们显得像是真正需要帮助的活人生物。

规则与建议老友

柳岸镇草人的来源很简单：那些通常会在死后转生的灵魂无法如此，于是便以草人的形式复起。当然，由于每年都会“重置”一切，所以那些在这一年中死去并变成草人的人，会在每年夏天的第一天再次活着重生，而且对自己此前注定毁灭的存在毫无记忆。尽管它们依然受本能驱使去攻击活人，柳岸镇的草人确实也会感到一丝悔意——如果游戏主持认为特别合适，它们对生前认识的生物进行的攻击掷骰和豁免骰会承受–2环境减值。

额外学识永远无感

草人诅咒会夺走受害者的方向感，这也使得神门出现了一整类用来讥讽人的说法，把某人做成事情的能力比作“草人感”。例如，一个很难交到朋友的人，可能会被说成有“草人的友谊感”；而一个总把饭菜做砸的人，则可能会被说成有“草人的厨房感”。

When a soul doomed to become a thatchling dies in the throes of great anguish, they can return after death as a red-hooded thatchling. These vengeful thatchlings appear to wear red hoods when viewed at a distance, but up close, the grisly truth—that their heads are blood-soaked—is revealed. Unlike other thatchlings, red-hooded thatchlings are skilled at trickery, and their ability to appear as a living humanoid through illusion magic allows them to lure the unexpected into ambushes much more easily.

In rural Shenmen, some branches of Sangpotshi warn of what can happen if a soul bound for reincarnation is prevented from entering the River of Souls and rejoining the cycle. These souls become frustrated, confused, and then furious at what they feel is a denial of the body they deserve, and in turn, they force vegetation to serve as their new body. Others theorize that when a body is buried in a shallow grave, the roots of grass growing down into the remains can tangle the soul and capture it.

Thatchlings are intelligent and capable of speaking but rarely do so—they generally have little to say to those whose lives they covet. Rarely, one might attempt to lure someone into an area of tall grass or dense undergrowth by calling out to them for aid, but they have little skill at deception, so such tactics aren't particularly effective at making them seem like actual living creatures in need of help.

Old Friends

The source of Willowshore's thatchlings is the simple fact that the souls who would normally have been reincarnated upon death can't do so, thus rising as thatchlings. Of course, since each year "resets" things, those who died during the year and became thatchlings are reborn alive once more on every first day of summer, with no memories of their previous doomed existence. While still driven by instinct to attack the living, Willowshore's thatchlings do feel a sense of remorse—if the GM judges it especially appropriate, they might take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and saving throws against creatures they knew in life.

Forever Senseless

The thatchling's curse robs the sense of direction from those it falls upon, leading to a whole category of insults in Shenmen that compare someone's ability to get something done to "a thatchling's sense." For example, someone who has a hard time making friends might be said to have "a thatchling's sense of friendship," while someone who constantly ruins meals might be said to have "a thatchling's kitchen sense."

Imprisoned Villager.tokenName: 被囚禁的村民 Imprisoned Villager

Power of the Mob.name: 暴民之力 Power of the Mob
Power of the Mob.description:
当三个或更多平民彼此相邻时，每个平民在进行[[/act shove]]的运动检定、攻击掷骰和伤害掷骰时获得+1环境加值。

When three or more commoners are adjacent to each other, each commoner gets a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act shove]], attack rolls, and damage rolls.

Lore (any one related to their trade).name: 学识（任一与其行业相关的分支）

Imprisoned Villager.publicNotes:
许多平民过着艰辛劳作的生活，努力工作以让家人得以温饱，并拥有相对舒适的居所。

社会建立在劳工的肩背之上。

Many commoners live hard lives of toil as they work to keep their families fed and housed in relative comfort.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.

Divine Prepared Spells.name: 神圣预备法术 Divine Prepared Spells

Divine Wrath.name: 神圣狂怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你向敌人引导神性的怒火。区域内的敌人根据其强韧豁免，受到4d10精魂伤害。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

大失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}；当其处于恶心状态时，还会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一丝生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。这个法术调用的是肉体身体中潜藏的记忆，而非将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大体完整，该法术才能生效。尸体受到的伤害越多，它的回答就越不准确、越支离破碎，而且它必须有喉咙和嘴巴才能说话。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过这个法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用其死亡时原本生物的数据进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，并且目标的精魂会在24小时内作祟于你，骚扰你并使你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供错误信息或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的回答可能简短、隐晦且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延时间，使法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题前耗尽。

大失败 如失败，但目标的回答更直接且较少重复，不过依然隐晦。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或误导你时，承受 -2 状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Holy Light.name: 圣光 Holy Light
Holy Light.description:
你射出一道炽烈的光线，其中夹带着神圣能量。进行一次远程法术攻击。该光线造成 5d6 火焰伤害。如果目标具有邪秽（特征），则你额外造成 5d6 精魂伤害。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害。

成功 目标承受全部伤害。

如果光线穿过一片魔法黑暗区域，或以受魔法黑暗影响的生物为目标，则圣光会尝试反制黑暗。如果你需要判定光线是否穿过一片黑暗区域，在你与该法术的目标之间画一条线。

升阶（+1） 火焰伤害增加 2d6，对邪秽生物造成的精魂伤害增加 2d6。

You shine a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target has the unholy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, holy light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.

Consecrate.name: 祝圣 Consecrate
Consecrate.description:
区域 以一座固定不动的、属于你神祇的祭坛、圣祠或固定设施为中心，半径40足爆发

你将一处地点祝圣给你的神祇，吟诵赞歌并创造一片神圣空间。当处于该区域内时，你神祇的崇拜者在攻击掷骰、技能检定、豁免骰和察觉检定上获得+1状态加值，而对你的神祇而言属于禁忌的生物（例如对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{萨伦瑞}而言的亡灵）则在这些掷骰上承受-1状态减值。如果你神祇的神圣祝圣允许你选择神圣或邪秽，你也可以选择让该祝圣地点成为神圣或邪秽。若该神祇的祝圣必须为神圣或邪秽，你必须让该地点与该祝圣一致。你神祇的崇拜者在该区域内进行的打击会获得该地点的祝圣特征（若有）。

大成功 祝圣成功，且其持续时间变为10年而非1年，或覆盖半径加倍的区域。偶尔，在你神祇的眷顾下，这可能产生更惊人的效果，例如使该区域被永久祝圣，或让该效果覆盖整座大教堂。

成功 祝圣成功。

失败 祝圣失败。

大失败 祝圣惨烈失败并激怒了你的神祇，祂会降下不悦的征兆。至少在1年内，进一步尝试祝圣该地点都会失败。

升阶（7环） 该祝圣区域还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{Planar Seal}法术的效果，但该效果不会尝试反制你神祇崇拜者的传送。成本提高为200 gp × 法术环阶。

Area 40-foot-radius burst around an immobile altar, shrine, or fixture of your deity

You consecrate a site to your deity, chanting praises and creating a sacred space. While within the area, worshippers of your deity gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws, and Perception checks, and creatures anathema to your deity (such as undead for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{Sarenrae}) take a -1 status penalty to those rolls. If your deity's divine sanctification allows you to choose holy or unholy, you can choose to make the consecrated site holy or unholy as well. If the deity's sanctification must be holy or unholy, you must make the site match that sanctification. Strikes made by worshippers of your deity within the area gain the site's sanctification trait, if any.

Critical Success The consecration succeeds, and it either lasts for 10 years instead of 1 or covers an area with twice the radius. Occasionally, with your deity's favor, this might produce an even more amazing effect, such as a permanently consecrated area or the effect covering an entire cathedral.

Success The consecration succeeds.

Failure The consecration fails.

Critical Failure The consecration fails spectacularly and angers your deity, who sends a sign of displeasure. For at least 1 year, further attempts to consecrate the site fail.

Heightened (7th) The consecrated area also gains the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{Planar Seal} spell, but the effect doesn't attempt to counteract teleportation by worshippers of your deity. The cost increases to 200 gp × the spell rank.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。如果你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在10分钟内变成其对应类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是一件神器或类似物品，你会自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Peaceful Rest.name: 安宁休息 Peaceful Rest
Peaceful Rest.description:
被指定的尸体不会腐坏，也不能被转化为亡灵。如果该尸体受到某个法术的影响，而该法术要求尸体必须在一定时间内死亡（例如，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{死者复活}），则不要将安宁休息的持续时间计入该时间。该法术还会阻止普通的虫子和害虫（如蛆）啃食身体。

升阶（5环） 该法术的持续时间为无限，但施放该法术时需要多花费一个动作，并且需要材料成本（价值 6 gp 的防腐液）。

The targeted corpse doesn't decay, nor can it be transformed into an undead. If the corpse is subject to a spell that requires the corpse to have died within a certain amount of time (for example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}), do not count the duration of peaceful rest against that time. This spell also prevents ordinary bugs and pests (such as maggots) from consuming the body.

Heightened (5th) The spell's duration is unlimited, but the spell takes one more action to cast and requires a cost (embalming fluid worth 6 gp).

Spiritual Weapon.name: 灵能武器 Spiritual Weapon
Spiritual Weapon.description:
一把由纯粹魔法力场构成的武器会实体化，并攻击你在射程内指定的敌人。这把武器具有幽灵般的外观，并显现为一根短棒、一把匕首，或你神祇偏好的武器。

当你施放此法术时，该武器会出现在你于射程内选择的一名敌人旁边，并对其进行一次打击。每次你维持该法术时，你都可以将该武器移动到射程内的一个新目标旁边（如果有需要），并用其进行打击。灵能武器会使用并计入你的多重攻击减值。

该武器的打击属于近战法术攻击。无论其外观如何，该武器都会造成2d8点力场伤害。你也可以使其造成该武器通常造成的伤害类型，而非力场伤害（如果是多用武器，则可选择其任一可用伤害类型）。该武器的其他数据或特征均不适用，即使是远程武器也只能攻击邻接的生物。尽管它进行的是法术攻击，灵能武器在触发、抗力等方面仍视为武器。

该武器不占据空间，不提供夹击，也不具有生物会拥有的任何其他属性。该武器除了其打击外不能进行任何其他攻击，而影响武器的专长或法术对其也不适用。

高环阶（+2） 该武器的伤害增加1d8。

A weapon made of pure magical force materializes and attacks foes you designate within range. This weapon has a ghostly appearance and manifests as a club, a dagger, or your deity's favored weapon.

When you cast the spell, the weapon appears next to a foe you choose within range and makes a Strike against it. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can move the weapon to a new target within range (if needed) and Strike with it. The spiritual weapon uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty.

The weapon's Strikes are melee spell attacks. Regardless of its appearance, the weapon deals 2d8 force damage. You can deal damage of the type normally dealt by the weapon instead of force damage (or any of the available damage types for a versatile weapon). No other statistics or traits of the weapon apply, and even a ranged weapon attacks adjacent creatures only. Despite making a spell attack, the spiritual weapon is a weapon for purposes of triggers, resistances, and so forth.

The weapon doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The weapon can't make any attack other than its Strike, and feats or spells that affect weapons do not apply to it.

Heightened (+2) The weapon's damage increases by 1d8.

Bane.name: 灾祸术 Bane
Bane.description:
你以怀疑充斥敌人的心智。区域内的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要其位于该区域内，其攻击掷骰便承受 –1 状态减值。在之后的回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术，使该散发的半径增加 10 尺，并迫使区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再次尝试一次豁免。

灾祸术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：灾祸术}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你大喊出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标靠近你、逃离你（如同它具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}）、放开它正拿着的东西、倒地，或站在原地不动。在它服从你的命令之前，它不能 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay}，也不能进行任何反应动作（）。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用一个单动作来照你的命令行事。

大失败 目标在其下个回合中必须用尽其所有动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你最多可以指定10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，用以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得更多信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，带有幻术灵光但在外观上并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由游戏主持判定。

升阶（4环） 如3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的源头。就像模糊感官一样，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将源头缩小到一个5足见方的立方体内（若源头更大，则为离你最近的那个立方体）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Divine Lance.name: 圣枪术 Divine Lance
Divine Lance.description:
你释放出一道神圣能量光束。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 2d4 精魂伤害（大成功时伤害加倍）。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 1d4。

You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命能量来治疗活着的生物或伤害亡灵。如果目标是自愿的活体生物，你恢复其1d8生命值。如果目标是亡灵，你对其造成等量的活力伤害，且它必须进行一次基础强韧豁免。施放此法术时你所花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (专注) 该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活体生物，恢复的生命值增加8。

3 (专注) 你将生命能量散布于一个@Template[emanation|distance:30]中。这会以爆发内所有活着的生物和亡灵为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害增加1d8，且双动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Produce Flame.name: 生火 Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
一小团火焰出现在你的手掌中，你可以用它进行近战攻击，或在射程内掷出。对目标的 AC 进行一次法术攻击掷骰。这通常是一次远程攻击，但你也可以对你徒手触及内的一个生物进行一次近战攻击。

成功时，你造成 2d4 点火焰伤害。大成功时，目标受到双倍伤害，并受到 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] 伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 1d4，且大成功时的持续伤害提高 1d4。

A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智以感知魔法灵光。当施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何经你告知该灵光信息的人，在对该物品进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时获得 +2 环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你的目标最多可以是 10 个物体。

升阶（6环） 你的目标可以是任意数量的物体。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Sanctuary.name: 庇护术 Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
你以防护能量护佑一个生物，阻遏针对其的攻击。试图攻击目标的生物每次都必须进行一次意志豁免。如果目标进行了敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试进行其攻击，以及在本回合中针对目标的任何其他攻击。

失败 该生物无法攻击目标，并浪费该动作。它在本回合中不能进一步尝试针对目标的攻击。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，并且在庇护术的持续时间剩余期间内都不能尝试攻击目标。

You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Sigil.name: 印记 Sigil
Sigil.description:
你无害地将你独特的魔法印记放置在目标生物或物体上，该印记的大小约为1平方英寸。这个标记可以是可见或隐形的，你可以通过使用一个交互动作接触目标，将其从一种状态改变为另一种状态。该标记可以通过5分钟的工作擦洗或刮除。如果它在生物身上，它会在一周内自然消退。印记消退前的时间会随着你升环后的等级而增加。

升环（3环） 印记改为在1个月后消退。

升环（5环） 印记改为在1年后消退。

升环（7环） 印记永不消退。

You harmlessly place your unique magical sigil, which is about 1 square inch in size, on the targeted creature or object. The mark can be visible or invisible, and you can change it from one state to another by using an Interact action to touch the target. The mark can be scrubbed or scraped off with 5 minutes of work. If it's on a creature, it fades naturally over the course of a week. The time before the mark fades increases depending on your heightened level.

Heightened (3rd) The sigil instead fades after 1 month.

Heightened (5th) The sigil instead fades after 1 year.

Heightened (7th) The sigil never fades.

Hide Armor.name: 皮甲 Hide Armor
Hide Armor.description:
这种护甲由毛皮、结实的兽皮，有时还有定型的煮制皮革混合制成。它凭借多层皮革提供防护，但其笨重会拖慢穿戴者并降低其机动性。

A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

Purifying Flames.name: 净化之焰 Purifying Flames
Purifying Flames.description:
驱魔师尝试用其火把对一个生物进行打击，以极高的精准度发动攻击，并使火把的烈焰再度爆发。此次打击的攻击掷骰获得 +2 状态加值，且命中时造成额外 2d6 火焰伤害，而非仅造成 1d6 火焰伤害。被此次攻击命中的亡灵、精魂或转生生物还必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:26] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受这项额外效果影响，而且部分火焰会反扑到驱魔师身上，对驱魔师造成 @Damage[2d6[fire]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] 豁免）。

成功 该生物不受这项额外效果影响。

失败 净化之焰使该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，直到其下一回合结束。

大失败 如失败，但其改为陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1分钟。

The exorcist attempts to Strike a creature with their torch, attacking with great precision and causing the torch's fires to flare up. This Strike gains a +2 status bonus to its attack roll and inflicts an additional 2d6 fire damage on a hit instead of just 1d6 fire damage. An undead, spirit, or transmigrated creature hit by this attack must also attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by this additional effect, and some of the fire flares back onto the exorcist, inflicting @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage to the exorcist (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save).

Success The creature is unaffected by this additional effect.

Failure The purifying flames cause the creature to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Torch Wielder.name: 火把持用者 Torch Wielder
Torch Wielder.description:
驱魔师将火把视为一把轻型钉头锤，命中时还会额外造成 1d6 点火焰伤害。

The exorcist treats a torch as a light mace that deals an additional 1d6 fire damage on a hit.

Cao Chen.blurb:
务实的男性人类精英驱魔师
Pragmatic male human elite exorcist

Quintessivore.name: 精粹食者 Quintessivore

Arcane Prepared Spells.name: 奥术准备法术 Arcane Prepared Spells

Black Tentacles.name: 黑色触手 Black Tentacles
Black Tentacles.description:
区域 邻接平坦表面的20足爆发

油腻的黑色触手升起，并试图捕获区域内的生物。对区域内每个生物的强韧DC进行法术攻击掷骰。任何你成功命中的生物都会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}，并受到3d6点钝击伤害。每当一个生物在该区域内结束其回合时，如果触手尚未抓住它，触手便会尝试抓取该生物；而对于任何已被抓取的生物，触手则会造成@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。

触手的挣脱难度等级等于你的法术DC。生物可以攻击一根触手，试图令其松开抓握。其AC等于你的法术DC，且若其受到12点或更多伤害，便会被摧毁。即使被摧毁，额外的触手仍会继续在该区域内生长，直到持续时间结束。你可以解消该法术。

Area 20-foot burst adjacent to a flat surface

Oily black tentacles rise up and attempt to capture creatures in the area. Make spell attack rolls against the Fortitude DC of each creature in the area. Any creature you succeed against is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. Whenever a creature ends its turn in the area, the tentacles attempt to grab that creature if they haven't already, and they deal @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage to any creature already Grabbed.

The tentacles' Escape DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a tentacle in an attempt to release its grip. Its AC is equal to your spell DC, and it is destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage. Even if destroyed, additional tentacles continue to grow in the area until the duration ends. You can Dismiss the spell.

Passwall.name: 穿墙术 Passwall
Passwall.description:
你在所选区域中穿过墙壁制造出一条可见的隧道，以空白空间替换该区域。若墙壁厚度超过10英尺，隧道会在深入10英尺处终止。墙中哪怕只有薄薄一层金属，也会阻止该法术生效。此法术不会降低该结构的完整性。当法术结束时，任何在隧道内的人都会被移送到最近的出口。

升阶（7环） 隧道最深可达20英尺。墙壁中包含你隧道入口的区域看起来完全正常（除非以真视术或类似效果观察），尽管隧道实际存在。隧道的入口如同坚固的墙壁般起作用，但你可以指定一句口令或一个触发，让生物能够自由进入隧道。

You create a visible tunnel through the wall in the chosen area, replacing the area with empty space. If the wall is thicker than 10 feet, the tunnel ends 10 feet in. Even a small layer of metal in the wall prevents this spell from functioning. This spell doesn't reduce the integrity of the structure. When the spell ends, anyone inside the tunnel is shunted to the nearest exit.

Heightened (7th) The tunnel can be up to 20 feet deep. The areas of the wall that contain your tunnel's entrance appear completely normal (unless viewed with true seeing or a similar effect), despite the tunnel's existence. The tunnel's entrance functions as a solid wall, but you can specify a password or a trigger, allowing creatures to enter the tunnel freely.

Clairvoyance.name: 千里眼 Clairvoyance
Clairvoyance.description:
你在射程内的一处位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的漂浮眼睛（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外也可以）。这只眼睛无法移动，但你可以仿佛使用自己正常的视觉感官一般，从该点向所有方向看见。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

Enervation.name: 弱能术 Enervation
Enervation.description:
你伸出一根手指，射出一道虚空能量光束，削弱任何被其触及的生物的生命力。直线范围内的每个活体生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] 伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。

大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 1}。

强化（+2） 持续虚空伤害在成功时增加 1d8，在失败或大失败时增加 2d8。

Extending a finger, you fire a beam of void energy that weakens the life force of any creature it touches. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Heightened (+2) The persistent void damage increases by 1d8 on a success, or by 2d8 on a failure or critical failure.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你扩张目标周围的时间流动，使其动作变慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你至多可以指定10个目标生物。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触会从目标体内汲取生命力来强化自己。你对目标造成 6d6 点虚空伤害。你获得等于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1 分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Comprehend Language.name: 通晓语言 Comprehend Language
Comprehend Language.description:
当你施放法术时，目标能够理解它正在听到或阅读的一种语言的含义。这不能让它理解密码、使用隐喻表达的语言及类似内容（由游戏主持酌情裁定）。如果目标能听到多种语言并且知道这一点，它可以选择要理解哪一种语言；否则，随机选择其中一种语言。

升阶（3环） 目标也能说这种语言。

升阶（4环） 你至多可以以10个生物为目标，且目标也能说这种语言。

The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.

See Invisibility.name: 识破隐形 See Invisibility
See Invisibility.description:
你可以看见@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的生物和物体。它们在你眼中呈现为半透明的轮廓，并且对你而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。

升阶（5环） 该法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：目睹无形者}

You can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects. They appear to you as translucent shapes, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you.

Heightened (5th) The spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

Web.name: 蛛网术 Web
Web.description:
你在区域内制造出一片黏稠的蛛网，使生物每次试图穿过其中时都受到阻碍。被蛛网填满的方格为困难地形。每个方格都可以通过一次造成至少5点挥砍伤害或1点火焰伤害的攻击或效果来清除蛛网。一个方格的AC为5，且其豁免骰自动失败。

每当蛛网中的生物开始使用一个移动动作，或在一个移动动作中进入蛛网时，它必须尝试一次对抗你法术DC的运动检定或反射豁免，以避免其速度受到环境减值，或变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}。生物一旦离开蛛网，便不再承受来自蛛网的速度环境减值。

大成功 该生物不受影响，且本回合内不需要再针对蛛网尝试进一步的运动检定或豁免骰。如果它使用的是运动检定，则它在离开方格时，会清除它离开的每个方格中的蛛网。

成功 该生物在其动作期间不受影响。如果它使用的是运动检定，则它在离开方格时，会清除它离开的每个方格中的蛛网。

失败 该生物的速度受到–10足的环境减值，直到其下个回合开始。

大失败 该生物陷入禁足，直到其下个回合开始；此后，其速度还会受到–10足的环境减值，持续1轮。它可以尝试挣脱以移除其禁足状态。

升阶（4环） 该法术的区域增加为20足爆发，且其射程增加为60足。

You create a sticky web in the area that impedes creatures' movement each time they try to move through it. Squares filled with the web are difficult terrain. Each square can be cleared of the web by a single attack or effect that deals at least 5 slashing damage or 1 fire damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws.

Each time a creature in the web begins to use a move action or enters the web during a move action, it must attempt an Athletics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to avoid taking a circumstance penalty to its Speeds or becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. A creature that gets out of the web ceases to take a circumstance penalty to its Speed from the web.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and it doesn't need to attempt further Athletics checks or saving throws against the web this turn. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves after leaving the square.

Success The creature is unaffected during its action. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves after leaving the square.

Failure The creature takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is Immobilized until the start of its next turn, after which it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape to remove its Immobilized condition.

Heightened (4th) The spell's area increases to a 20-foot burst, and its range increases to 60 feet.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你让目标的思维蒙上迷雾，并以一道精神冲击使其陷入眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，能够感知到魔法的存在。除了魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何其他信息。你可以选择忽略那些你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友身上的魔法物品与持续中的法术。

只有当幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。然而，带有幻术灵光但在外观上并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会知晓该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。如果有多个效果同样强大，则由游戏主持决定你知晓哪一个。

升阶（4环） 如3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。如同模糊感官一样，你不会得知其精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5足见方的立方体内（若其大于此范围，则为最近的那个）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Feather Fall.name: 羽落术 Feather Fall
Feather Fall.description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你使空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓至每轮60尺，且在法术持续时间内的那部分坠落在计算坠落伤害时不计入。如果目标在法术生效期间到达地面，它不会因这次坠落受到伤害。该法术在目标着地后立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Fleet Step.name: 迅捷步伐 Fleet Step
Fleet Step.description:
你的速度获得 +30 足状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{法术效果：迅捷步伐}

You gain a +30-foot status bonus to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{Spell Effect: Fleet Step}

Grim Tendrils.name: 阴森触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的触须从你的指尖蜷曲而出，在空中疾驰。你对直线内的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] 点持续性流血伤害。直线内的每个活体生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半虚空伤害，且不受持续性流血伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍虚空伤害和双倍持续性流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，且持续性流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造出一只单独的魔法手，可以是隐形的或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢移动最多 20 尺。由于你是在使该物体悬浮，你可以将其向任意方向移动。当你维持该法术时，你可以将该物体额外移动 20 尺。如果该物体在法术结束时位于空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你可以将负载为 1 或更低的无人持用物体作为目标。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将负载为 1 或更低的无人持用物体作为目标。

升阶（7环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将负载为 2 或更低的无人持用物体作为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪出。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免，以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则将其豁免结果按低一级成功等级处理。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Ray of Frost.name: 霜冻射线 Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
你发射一道冰冷射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰。该射线造成 2d4 点寒冷伤害。

大成功 目标受到双倍伤害，并在 1 轮内其速度受到 –10 足的状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{法术效果：霜冻射线}

成功 目标受到正常伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You blast an icy ray. Make a spell attack roll. The ray deals 2d4 cold damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

Success The target takes normal damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智以感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法；如果有，你还会得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

强化（3环） 你最多可以将 10 个物体作为目标。

强化（6环） 你可以将任意数量的物体作为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Scroll of Dimensional Anchor (Level 4).name: 次元锚卷轴（4级）
Scroll of Dimensional Anchor (Level 4).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksLCg62cLOojw3gN]{位面系链}

从卷轴施放法术需要你一只手持握卷轴，并以该法术通常所需的动作数进行一次施法（行动）来启动它。

要从卷轴施放法术，该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。因为是由你来施放该法术，所以使用你的法术攻击掷骰和法术DC。该法术还会获得与你根源相应的特征（奥术、神圣、异能或原始）。

卷轴制作时已经提供了所有实体材料成分和费用，因此你在从卷轴施放法术时不需要再提供它们。你必须将该法术所需的任何材料成分替换为姿势成分。如果该法术需要法器，你必须持有该法器才能从卷轴施放该法术。

注意：要创建某个特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从图鉴或图鉴浏览器拖入玩家角色、非玩家角色或战利品角色的物品栏中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksLCg62cLOojw3gN]{Planar Tether}

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Scroll of Fly (Level 4).name: 飞行卷轴（4级）
Scroll of Fly (Level 4).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{飞行}

从卷轴施放法术需要单手持握卷轴，并以施法（行动）启动它，使用该法术通常所需的动作数。

要从卷轴施放法术，该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。因为是你在施放该法术，所以使用你的法术攻击掷骰和法术DC。该法术还会获得与你的根源对应的适当特征（奥术、神圣、异能或原始）。

卷轴制作时已提供任何实体材料成分和花费，因此你在从卷轴施放法术时不需要再提供它们。你必须将该法术所需的任何材料成分替换为姿势成分。如果该法术需要法器，你必须持有该法器才能从卷轴施放该法术。

注意：要创建特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，请将该法术从图鉴或图鉴浏览器拖入玩家角色、非玩家角色或战利品角色的物品栏中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly}

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Instant Suspension.name: 瞬时悬浮 Instant Suspension
Instant Suspension.description:
触发 精粹食者将其15尺内的一名生物的生命值降至0

效果 精粹食者使用悬置灵魂，以该生物为目标。

Trigger The quintessivore reduces a creature within 15 feet of it to 0 Hit Points

Effect The quintessivore uses Suspend Soul, targeting the creature.

Feed on Quintessence.name: 啜饮第五精华 Feed on Quintessence
Feed on Quintessence.description:
在1小时的过程中，精粹食者移除并拆解一个生物的灵魂。该生物必须要么处于被囚禁状态，要么在流程开始前死亡不超过2小时。1小时结束时，精粹食者吞噬该生物灵魂中的精粹。

在接下来的一个月内，它的法术DC和法术攻击掷骰获得+1状态加值，并将6环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{血族驱命} 加入其奥术准备法术。

拆解灵魂会将该生物灵魂的独特性质映射到精粹食者的刃腿中。灵魂可以通过将其与精粹结合而被重构。死去的精粹食者的灵魂会以适用于此用途的纯粹精粹形式逃离其身体。

Over the course of 1 hour, the quintessivore removes and deconstructs the soul of a creature. The creature must either be captive or have been dead for no more than 2 hours before the start of the process. At the end of the hour, the quintessivore consumes the quintessence of the creature's soul.

For the next month, it gains a +1 status bonus to its spell DC and spell attack roll, and it adds 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} to its arcane prepared spells.
