Deconstructing a soul maps the unique properties of the creature's soul into the quintessivore's blade-legs. The soul can be reconstructed by binding it to quintessence. A dead quintessivore's soul flees its body as pure quintessence suitable for this purpose.

Suspend Soul.name: 悬置灵魂 Suspend Soul
Suspend Soul.description:
精粹食者悬置其15尺内一个濒死生物的生命进程。该生物在10分钟内无法减少或增加其生命值或濒死值。该生物可以尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:29] 豁免以避免此效果。如果该生物受到魔法治疗，它可以再次尝试一次豁免；若成功，则该效果结束，并照常受到治疗。

如果精粹食者再次使用悬置灵魂，该效果结束。

The quintessivore suspends the life processes of a dying creature within 15 feet of it. The creature can't decrease or increase its HP or dying value for 10 minutes. The creature can attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save to avoid this effect. If the creature receives magical healing, it can attempt a new save, ending the effect and being healed normally on a success.

The effect ends if the quintessivore uses Suspend Soul again.

Tattered Soul.name: 破碎之魂 Tattered Soul
Tattered Soul.description:
被精粹食者的刃腿打击命中的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:29] 强韧豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸能1}（大失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸能2}）。如果该生物已经处于吸能状态，则免疫此效果。

A creature hit by the quintessivore's blade-leg Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure). If the creature is already drained, it's immune to this effect.

Quintessivore.publicNotes:
精粹食者是狡猾的生物，能够运用奥术魔法，并以如手术刀般锋利的蜘蛛肢刃，像撕裂血肉一样轻易撕裂一个人的灵魂。精粹食者不会立刻杀死猎物——它会把该生物拖回巢穴，用其刀刃般的肢体将受害者的灵魂与身体分离。随后，那些迅捷弹动的利刃会将生物的个体性剥离出来，将灵魂还原为一种称为“精粹”的纯粹灵魂物质，接着由精粹食者将其吞食。

Quintessivores are cunning creatures that wield arcane magic and scalpel-sharp spider limbs that can rend one's soul just as easily as flesh. A quintessivore doesn't immediately kill its prey-it drags the creature to its lair and separates the victim's soul from their body with its bladed limbs. The flicking blades then pull out the creature's individuality, reducing the soul down to pure soul-stuff called quintessence, which the quintessivore then consumes.

Admiring the Moon Reward.name: 咏月诗会奖励 Admiring the Moon Reward
Admiring the Moon Reward.tokenName: 咏月诗会奖励 Admiring the Moon Reward

Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate).name: 认知诱变剂（中效）
Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate).description:
启动 A（操作）

你的思维变得清晰，但物质层面的事物似乎变得虚无缥缈。

增益 你在奥秘、制作、学识、神秘学和社群检定，以及所有进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识} 的检定上获得+2物品加值。你在回忆知识检定中的大失败改为失败。

缺陷 你在武器和徒手攻击掷骰、运动检定和特技检定上承受-2减值。你在陷入负载过重前可携带的负载比正常少2，且你可携带的最大负载减少4。

持续时间 10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ztxW3lBPRcesF7wK]{效果：认知诱变剂（中效）}

Activate A (manipulate)

Your mind becomes clear, but physical matters seem ephemeral.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. Your critical failures on Recall Knowledge checks become failures instead.

Drawback You take a -2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Athletics checks, and acrobatics checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered, and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

Duration 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ztxW3lBPRcesF7wK]{Effect: Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate)}

Serene Mutagen (Moderate).name: 宁静诱变剂（中效）
Serene Mutagen (Moderate).description:
启动 A (操作)

你获得内在的平静，但你会觉得暴力令人反感。

益处 你获得对意志豁免以及察觉、医药、自然、宗教和求生检定的 +2 物品加值。当你尝试对抗心灵效果的意志豁免时，此加值提升为 +3。

缺陷 你的攻击掷骰和进攻性法术的豁免 DC承受 -1 减值，且你的所有武器、徒手攻击和法术伤害每个伤害骰承受 -1 减值。

持续时间 10 分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.yrbz0rZzp8aZEqbv]{效果：宁静诱变剂（中效）}

Activate A (manipulate)

You gain inner serenity, but you find violence off-putting.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Will saves and Perception, Medicine, Nature, Religion, and Survival checks. This bonus improves to +3 when you attempt Will saves against mental effects.

Drawback You take a -1 penalty to attack rolls and save DCs of offensive spells, and a -1 penalty per damage die to all weapon, unarmed attack, and spell damage.

Duration 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.yrbz0rZzp8aZEqbv]{Effect: Serene Mutagen (Moderate)}

Silvertongue Mutagen (Moderate).name: 巧言诱变剂（中效） Silvertongue Mutagen (Moderate)
Silvertongue Mutagen (Moderate).description:
启动 A（操作）

你的容貌特征变得引人注目，声音也变得悦耳而富有号令力，但情绪会蒙蔽你的理智。

益处 你获得欺瞒、交涉、威吓和表演检定的 +2 物品加值。你以这些技能进行的所有大失败改为失败。

缺陷 你在奥秘、制作、学识、神秘学和社群检定上承受 -2 物品减值。选择一项你已受训的技能；在持续时间内，你在该技能上变为未受训。你所有进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识} 的失败都会变为大失败。

持续时间 10 分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.v5Ht1V4MZvRKRBjL]{效果：银舌诱变剂（中效）}

Activate A (manipulate)

Your features become striking, and your voice becomes musical and commanding, though emotion clouds your reason.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation and Performance checks. Your critical failures with any of these skills become failures instead.

Drawback You take a -2 item penalty to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks. Choose one skill in which you are trained; for the duration, you become untrained in that skill. All your failures to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} become critical failures.

Duration 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.v5Ht1V4MZvRKRBjL]{Effect: Silvertongue Mutagen (Moderate)}

Admiring the Moon Reward.hazarddescription:
胜者从这些中选择其一。

The victor chooses one of these.
Admiring the Moon Reward.prototypeToken: 咏月诗会奖励 Admiring the Moon Reward

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Vampiric Feast.name: 吸血盛宴 Vampiric Feast
Vampiric Feast.description:
你的接触会从目标体内汲取生命力来强化自身。你对目标造成 6d6 点虚空伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果后）。1 分钟后，你失去所有剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 2d6 点。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你瓦解一个法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。如果你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在10分钟内变成其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是一件神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Noise Blast.name: 噪音爆破 Noise Blast
Noise Blast.description:
刺耳的噪音猛然爆发，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋} 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入耳聋 1 分钟，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Bane.name: 灾祸术 Bane
Bane.description:
你以疑虑充斥敌人的心智。区域内的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要处于该区域内，其攻击掷骰就会承受 –1 状态减值。此后在后续回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术，使该散发的半径增加 10 尺，并迫使区域内尚未受影响的敌人再次尝试一次豁免。

灾祸术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：灾祸术}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你高喊出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你、逃离（如同它具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}）、放开它正持握的东西、倒地，或站在原地不动。在它服从你的命令之前，它不能 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay}，也不能采取任何反应动作。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在它下个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用一个单动作来遵从你的命令。

大失败 目标必须在它的下个回合中使用其所有动作来遵从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你至多可以以10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命能量来治疗活体或对不死生物造成伤害。如果目标是自愿的活体生物，你恢复其1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量的活力伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。施放该法术时你所花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （专注） 该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活体生物，恢复的生命值增加8。

3 （专注） 你将生命能量散布于一个@Template[emanation|distance:30]中。这会以爆发内所有活体生物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害量增加1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一面魔法力场护盾。这视为使用举起护盾动作，使你获得对 AC 的 +1 环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，但你无需手来使用它。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{护盾格挡} 反应动作。该护盾具有 5 点硬度。你可以使用该法术的反应动作来减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使它不造成物理伤害也是如此。在你使用护盾格挡后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内不能再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 护盾的硬度提高 5。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Void Warp.name: 虚空扭曲 Void Warp
Void Warp.description:
你召唤虚空以伤害生命力。目标受到2d4点虚空伤害，并进行一次基础强韧豁免。若大失败，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到你下个回合开始。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4。

You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description:
无面鬼模仿者携带一把+1强击武器，其外观与被模仿的玩家角色所偏好的武器完全相同。如果该玩家角色偏好徒手打击，它会显现为手部缠带。如果该玩家角色偏好远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，改为使用上方的远程武器规则；否则，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果玩家角色不偏好任何武器，则无面鬼会将一根短棒作为其虚假武器。该虚假武器只有部分真实，命中时只造成心灵伤害；它不会获得原始武器的任何特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损、被缴械或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟重新制作一把替代的虚假武器。

A noppera-bo impersonator carries a +1 striking weapon that looks identical to the favored weapon of the PC being impersonated. If the PC favors unarmed strikes, it appears as hand wraps. If the PC favors a ranged weapon, then the noppera-bo impersonator has no melee weapon and instead uses the ranged weapon rules above; otherwise, the noppera-bo impersonator has no ranged weapon. If the PCs favors no weapon, then the noppera-bo wields a club as its false weapon. This false weapon is only partially real and inflicts only mental damage when it hits; it gains none of the original weapon's traits or magical enhancements. If a noppera-bo impersonator's false weapon is broken, disarmed, or set down, it fades away. The noppera-bo impersonator can craft a replacement false weapon by spending 10 minutes to recreate one.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸鬼没有视觉，但听觉精准。它们不需要呼吸，并且免疫需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上会将双手或无脸的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；它们也可以用这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中获益。

The noppera-bo has no sense of vision, but their hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}状态，它们就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as the noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonated Spellcasting.name: 模仿者施法 Impersonated Spellcasting
Impersonated Spellcasting.description:
无面鬼模仿者获得一组天生法术，与被其模仿的玩家角色所使用的法术根源相匹配。你可以调整这些法术，使其更完美地契合这次模仿。

The noppera-bo impersonator gains a suites of innate spells, matching the spellcasting tradition utilized by the PC being impersonated. You can adjust the spells to make a more perfect fit for the impersonation.

Luo Xi Yang.name: 骆熙旸 Luo Xi Yang
Luo Xi Yang.blurb:
热切的女性人类律师
eager female human lawyer

Haphazard Wood Pile.name: 杂乱的木柴堆 Haphazard Wood Pile
Haphazard Wood Pile.tokenName: 杂乱的木柴堆 Haphazard Wood Pile

Collapse Inward.name: 向内坍塌 Collapse Inward
Collapse Inward.description:
触发 危害内的四名狂欢者中任意一人执行了任何具有移动（特征）的动作

效果 那堆东西向内坍塌到四名狂欢者身上，对他们每人造成 @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] 豁免）。四人还都会受到 @Damage[1d6[persistent,bludgeoning]] 伤害，直到他们被用一次 @Check[athletics|dc:17] 检定从瓦砾中拉出，或能够 [[/act escape dc=17]]。

Trigger Any of the four revelers within the hazard perform any action with the Move trait

Effect The pile collapses onto the four revelers, dealing @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save) to each of them. All four also take @Damage[1d6[persistent,bludgeoning]] damage until they're pulled from the rubble with a @Check[athletics|dc:17] check or can [[/act escape dc=17]].

Collapse Outward.name: 向外坍塌 Collapse Outward
Collapse Outward.description:
触发 从木堆外尝试解除该危害时严重失败，或者有人从木堆外故意触发该危害

效果 木堆向外坍塌，对4名狂欢者造成 @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] 豁免），并对以狂欢者被困的中央10-foot方格为中心、周围10-foot区域内的所有生物造成 @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] 豁免）。

Trigger An attempt to disable the hazard from outside critically fails, or the hazard is intentionally triggered by someone from outside of the wood pile

Effect The pile collapses outward, inflicting @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage to the four revelers (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] save), and @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save) to all creatures in a 10-foot area surrounding the central 10-foot-square where the revelers were trapped.

Haphazard Wood Pile.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:17]（受训）、制作（受训），或 @Check[Engineering Lore|dc:17]（受训）以弄清如何在不让这堆东西坍塌砸到任何人的情况下安全地拆解它。

@Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained), Crafting (trained), or @Check[Engineering Lore|dc:17] (trained) to figure out how to safely dismantle the pile without it collapsing on anyone.
Haphazard Wood Pile.hazarddescription:
沉重而尖锐的木梁彼此倚靠，组成了一个摇摇欲坠、勉强维持平衡的笼子，并系在数根绊线上和承受拉力的木销上。

Beams of heavy and sharp wood rest against one another to form a precariously balanced cage tied to several trip lines and tension-bearing dowels.
Haphazard Wood Pile.stealthdetails:
（受训）以注意到这堆东西在有人拆除它时可能会如何倒下；看见这堆东西的难度等级为 0。

(trained) to notice how the pile might fall on a person disabling it; DC 0 to see the pile.
Haphazard Wood Pile.prototypeToken: 杂乱的木柴堆 Haphazard Wood Pile

Weakened Floor.name: 脆弱的地板 Weakened Floor

Collapse Floor.name: 地板坍塌 Collapse Floor
Collapse Floor.description:
触发 一轮开始时，一个小型或更大的生物正站在A4区域的地板上

效果 整个房间的地板在震耳欲聋的轰鸣声中坍塌，将房间内所有生物向下坠落5英尺，落入一片由泥浆、霉菌和有毒真菌构成的黏稠泥沼中，同时一团孢子云向上喷涌到空中。该房间变为更严重的困难地形。所有原本站在房间地板上的生物都会在下方的污秽中倒地，除非它们成功通过一次@Check[reflex|dc:34]豁免，此时它们双脚着地。随后该危害进行先攻掷骰。

Trigger A round begins with a Small or larger creature standing on the floor in area A4

Effect The floor of the entire room collapses in a thunderous crash, dropping all creatures in the room 5 feet into a soupy morass of mud, mold, and toxic fungus while a cloud of spores spews up into the air above. The room becomes greater difficult terrain. All creatures who were standing on the floor in the room fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in the mess below unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:34] save, in which case they land on their feet. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Weakened Floor.disable:
@Check[crafting|dc:33]（大师）三次，以在不触发孢子云的情况下在地板上打出孔洞，同时减轻地板承受的压力，使其能够行走；@Check[stealth|dc:36]（专家），以在你的回合剩余时间内小心地穿过房间而不触发危害；或者在陷阱被触发后，进行两次 @Check[nature|dc:36]（专家），以在附近的墙壁上打出足够多的孔洞，使孢子散开

@Check[crafting|dc:33] (master) three times to knock holes in the floor without triggering the spore cloud while simultaneously lightening the strain on the floor so it can be walked upon, @Check[stealth|dc:36] (expert) to move carefully through the room for the remainder of your turn without triggering the hazard, or @Check[nature|dc:36] (expert) twice once the trap is triggered to knock enough holes into the nearby walls to cause the spores to disperse
Weakened Floor.hazarddescription:
脆弱的地板在一声巨响中塌陷，将房间里的一切都坠入满是有毒霉菌的泥泞沼泽中。

The weakened floor gives way with a tremendous crash, dropping everything in the room into a muddy morass of toxic mold.
Weakened Floor.reset:
房间里在整整1分钟内没有任何东西移动后，孢子会沉降下来。地板仍然很明显，不会进一步塌陷，但任何穿过霉菌区域而移动的生物都会使孢子再次扬起，从而重新触发该陷阱。

One minute after nothing moves in the room, the spores settle down. The floor remains obvious and won't collapse further, but any creature that moves through the mold causes the spores to plume up again, re-triggering the trap.
Weakened Floor.routine:
（1个动作）每轮在其回合中，如今充满A4区域的孢子会对房间内所有生物造成@Damage[8d6[poison]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic]豁免），因为孢子云会灼烧暴露在外的血肉；屏住呼吸的生物对此次豁免获得+4环境加值。

(1 action) Every round on its turn, the spores that now fill area A4 inflict @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage to all creatures in the room (@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] save) as the cloud burns at exposed flesh; a creature that holds its breath gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this saving throw.

Monk of Kugaptee.name: 苦迦菩提武僧 Monk of Kugaptee
Monk of Kugaptee.tokenName: 苦迦菩提武僧 Monk of Kugaptee

Brawling Critical.name: 徒手搏击大成功或大失败 Brawling Critical
Brawling Critical.description:
当苦迦菩提武僧以拳头打击或具有武僧（特征）的武器打击造成大成功时，目标必须成功进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 豁免，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到该武僧下个回合结束。

When a monk of Kugaptee scores a critical hit with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of the monk's next turn.

Sagebane.name: 贤者祸根 Sagebane
Sagebane.description:
当苦迦菩提武僧以拳头打击或具有武僧（特征）的武器对一个活着的生物造成伤害时，目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 豁免，否则会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1分钟。

苦迦菩提武僧进一步造成的伤害会将持续时间重置为1分钟，并在豁免失败时使呆滞值提高1，最高达到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 4}。

When the monk of Kugaptee damages a living creature with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

Further damage dealt by the monk of Kugaptee resets the duration to 1 minute and increases the stupefied value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Scarlet Apoxia.name: 猩红窒息症 Scarlet Apoxia
Scarlet Apoxia.description:
目标无法从由猩红窒息症导致的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}状态中恢复，直到该疾病被治愈

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良影响（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸 drained 1}和疲乏（1天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸 drained 2}和疲乏（1天）

阶段 4 死亡（因猩红窒息症死亡的生物会在死后24小时转生为一个等级等于或低于其原本等级的宁多鲁，除非其身体得到了适当的葬礼；一旦发生转生，该死去的生物在其所转生成的宁多鲁先被杀死之前，无法恢复其原本的生命）

The target can't recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition caused by scarlet apoxia until the disease is cured

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 dead (a creature that dies of scarlet apoxia reincarnates as a nindoru of equal or lower level 24 hours after death unless the body is given a proper funeral; once reincarnation occurs, the dead creature can't be restored to its original life until after the nindoru it reincarnates into is first slain)

Steal Breath.name: 窃息 Steal Breath
Steal Breath.description:
需求 苦迦菩提武僧邻接于一个活着的生物，且该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}、缓慢、震慑或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态

效果 苦迦菩提武僧俯身吸走目标的气息，目标必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:22]豁免。无论结果如何，该生物都会暴露于猩红窒息症，且其呼吸会在1分钟内散发腐烂野花的恶臭。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物在1分钟内无法说话。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}，且在1分钟内无法说话。

大失败 如失败，此外该生物会失去意识并开始窒息。

Requirements The monk of Kugaptee is adjacent to a living creature that's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, slowed, stunned, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

Effect The monk of Kugaptee leans over and sucks the breath from the target, who must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. Regardless of the result, the creature is exposed to scarlet apoxia and its breath reeks of rotting wildflowers for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't speak for 1 minute.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and can't speak for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature falls unconscious and begins suffocating.

Stunning Flurry.name: 震慑连击 Stunning Flurry
Stunning Flurry.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 苦迦菩提武僧进行两次拳头打击。若两次都命中同一个生物，则为计算抗力和弱点之目的，将它们的伤害合并，且目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] 强韧豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑3}）；此次豁免具有失能特征。

Frequency once per round

Effect The monk of Kugaptee makes two fist Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:incapacitation] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure); this save has the incapacitation trait.

Monk of Kugaptee.publicNotes:
一名生前违背了其修道誓言的武僧，可能会在死后化为一种被称作黑坊主的亡灵恐怖存在。这些掠食者以凡人的气息为食，用扭曲的肢体爬入卧室，从沉睡的受害者身上窃取生命。这种进食行为会在受害者身上留下痕迹，表现为其呼吸中带有腐烂的恶臭，以及一种会最终导致衰竭并最终死亡的严重疾病。

黑坊主保留着其苦修训练的残响，使其能够在战斗中从虚弱的敌人身上吸取气息。它们的恶毒狡猾与苦修纪律相结合，帮助它们策划精密而漫长的阴谋，以实施其嫉妒的复仇。很少有黑坊主足够令人信服，能说服它们昔日的盟友打破自己的誓言，但这并不妨碍它们不断尝试。

A monk who violated their monastic vows in life might arise after death to become an undead horror known as a kurobozu. These predators feast upon the breath of mortals, creeping on twisted limbs into bedrooms to steal the life from sleeping victims. This act of feeding leaves its mark on the victim in the form of a vile scent of rot on the victim's breath and a debilitating disease that eventually results in exhaustion and finally death.

Kurobozus retain echoes of their ascetic training, enabling them to suck the breath from debilitated foes in the midst of battle. Their malevolent cunning combined with ascetic discipline helps them concoct elaborate and lengthy schemes to enact their jealous revenge. Few kurobozus are convincing enough to persuade their onetime allies to break their own oaths, but this doesn't stop them from making the attempt.
Monk of Kugaptee.prototypeToken: 苦迦菩提武僧 Monk of Kugaptee

Elegant Silver Teacups.name: 精致的银制茶杯 Elegant Silver Teacups
Elegant Silver Teacups.description:
每个精致的银制茶杯都是价值 50 gp 的艺术品。

Each of the elegant silver teacups is a work of art worth 50 gp.

Dented Red-and-Gold Chamber Pot.name: 凹陷的红金相间便壶 Dented Red-and-Gold Chamber Pot

Gold-rimmed Monocle.name: 金边单片眼镜 Gold-rimmed Monocle

Fan of Falling Words.name: 落语扇 Fan of Falling Words
Fan of Falling Words.description:
这把可折叠的手持纸扇在初次被发现时看起来空无一物，但如果持用者以一个交互动作展开扇页，其上便会显现一幅由持用者选择的水墨画。若要显示不同的画作，必须先将扇子合拢，再重新打开。持握期间，落语扇使你在表演检定中，于演戏、表演喜剧、演说或歌唱时获得 +2 物品加值。

启动 1 命令术，交互

频率 每天一次

效果 你将自己的言语显现为织锦，使你在扇上描绘的图像从扇页上跃出。该扇会依照你的具体要求施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{蜃景}（@Check[type:will|dc:27] 豁免以识破）。虽然这只需用 3 个动作完成（而非该法术通常所需的 10 分钟施法时间），但该效果没有射程，且其创造的 @Template[type:burst|distance:50] 以你为中心。

This folding handheld paper fan appears blank when first found, but if the wielder unfolds its leaves as an Interact action, they display an ink-brush painting of the wielder's choice. The fan must be closed and opened again to display a different painting. While held, the fan of falling words grants you a +2 item bonus to Performance checks to act or perform comedy, orate, or sing.

Activate 1 command, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You manifest the tapestry of your words, causing the image you depict on the fan to leap off its leaves. The fan casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} to your specifications (@Check[type:will|dc:27] save to disbelieve). While this only takes three actions to perform (as opposed to the spell's normal 10 minutes of casting), the effect has no range, and the @Template[type:burst|distance:50] it creates is centered on you.

Panaceatic Salve.name: 万灵膏药 Panaceatic Salve
Panaceatic Salve.description:
启动 1 交互

这种气味浓烈的草药软膏最初只打算用作止痛药。尽管如此，关于这种万灵膏药的民间传说声称它无所不能，从治疗发热到驱逐吸血鬼都行；如果不说别的，这种名声倒是很容易让人信以为真。当你通过将一剂万灵膏药涂抹在皮肤上来启动它时，你获得 4d8+10 临时生命值，持续 10 分钟。在此持续时间结束时，如果你仍保有至少 1 点这些临时生命值，你可以对你所承受的一项持续中的疾病或毒素苦难尝试一次新的豁免；如果你在此次豁免中失败或大失败，你不会使该苦难的阶段增加。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.QBujqOaTXzqM13Cy]{效果：万灵膏药}

Activate 1 Interact

This pungent herbal ointment was originally only intended for use as an analgesic. That being said, popular folklore around this salve claims it can do anything from curing fevers to repelling vampires, a reputation that, if nothing else, is easy to get swept up in. When you activate a dose of panaceatic salve by rubbing it on your skin, you gain 4d8+10 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes. At the end of this duration, if you still retain at least 1 of these temporary Hit Points, you can attempt a new saving throw against an ongoing disease or poison affliction you're afflicted with; if you fail or critically fail this saving throw, you don't increase the affliction's stage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.QBujqOaTXzqM13Cy]{Effect: Panaceatic Salve}

Potion of Quickness.name: 迅捷药水 Potion of Quickness
Potion of Quickness.description:
启动 A (操作)

饮用这瓶银色药水会使你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{加速术}的效果，持续 1 分钟。

Activate A (manipulate)

Drinking this silver potion grants you the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} for 1 minute.

Healing Potion (Greater).name: 治疗药水（高等）
Healing Potion (Greater).description:
启动 A（操作）

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的麻感。 当你饮用治疗药水时，你恢复[[/r (6d8+20)[healing]]]{6d8+20 生命值}。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain [[/r (6d8+20)[healing]]]{6d8+20 Hit Points}.

Wooden Potion Holder Carved to Look like.name: 雕刻成盘绕巨龙模样的木制药水架 Wooden Potion Holder Carved to Look like a Coiled Dragon

Cherry Wood Case Decorated with Images o.name: 饰有鱼类图像的樱桃木匣 Cherry Wood Case Decorated with Images of Fish

Giant Stag Beetle.name: 巨锹甲虫 Giant Stag Beetle
Giant Stag Beetle.tokenName: 巨锹甲虫 Giant Stag Beetle

Trample.name: 践踏 Trample
Trample.description:
中型或更小，足，@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Medium or smaller, foot, @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Giant Stag Beetle.publicNotes:
巨锹甲虫比一匹马还大，而看到它用巨大的嗡鸣翼飞行——尽管动作缓慢且有些笨拙——会让人不寒而栗。它巨大的颚骨可用于吸引配偶、威吓竞争对手并劝退掠食者，因为它们能造成致命打击。虽然巨锹甲虫是致命的掠食者，但技艺高超的驯兽者仍能将其驯化。在这种情况下，这些甲虫很适合作为驮兽，甚至可以充当坐骑。

巨锹甲虫在沼泽、洞窟群和茂密森林中可能是严重的威胁。不止一个伐木营地曾吸引来一群巨锹甲虫，最终不得不被彻底废弃，只能把所有木材拱手让给这些巨型昆虫。

并非所有甲虫都是那种无害、能被轻易一脚踩死的生物。体型硕大且贪婪的巨型甲虫遍布世界各地的温带与热带地区。它们通常是温和的生物，但在受到威胁或被激怒时，巨型甲虫会变得相当危险。它们强有力的颚骨和坚硬的外骨骼，使其成为难以对付的战斗对手。

The giant stag beetle is larger than a horse, and the sight of one flying (if slowly and somewhat clumsily) on great buzzing wings is unnerving. Its enormous mandibles are used to impress mates, intimidate rivals, and discourage predators, for they can deliver deadly blows. While giant stag beetles are deadly predators, skilled wranglers can domesticate them. In such a capacity, these beetles serve well as beasts of burden or even as mounts.

Giant stag beetles can be a serious menace in marshes, cavern complexes, and heavy forests. More than one logging camp has attracted a cluster of giant stag beetles and had to be completely abandoned, yielding all its lumber to the hunger of the giant insects.

Not all beetles are harmless creatures that can be easily crushed underfoot. Oversized and ravenous giant beetles can be found throughout the temperate and tropical regions of the world. They are often benign creatures, though when threatened or roused, giant beetles are quite dangerous. Their powerful mandibles and tough exoskeletons make for a challenging combatant.
Giant Stag Beetle.prototypeToken: 巨锹甲虫 Giant Stag Beetle

Grim Trophy.name: 阴森战利品 Grim Trophy
Grim Trophy.description:
启动 A（专注）

这件护符有许多形态，最常见的是以某种骇人的方式展示的一块类人生物残肢。当你启动这件阴森战利品时，进行一次威吓检定，对至多两个目标执行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{挫败士气}，并将你的威吓检定结果与这两个目标的DC进行比较。

Activate A (concentrate)

This talisman comes in many forms, most often a severed piece of a humanoid creature displayed in some gruesome manner. When you activate the trophy, make an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} up to two targets, comparing your Intimidation check result to both of their DCs.

Thurible of Revelation (Lesser).name: 启示香炉（次等）
Thurible of Revelation (Lesser).description:
这只启示香炉饰有杉树图案。

这只黄铜香炉悬挂在一段链条上。大多数启示香炉都饰有盘旋的天界语文字，不过也有一些是铁制的，并带有炼狱语或冥地语文字。

启动——焚香 2 (操作)

成本 价值至少 5 gp 的香

效果 你点燃香炉中的香，它会燃烧 1 小时。在此期间，只要你持握着该香炉，你在宗教检定上获得 +1 物品加值，并且当你对具有宗教性质的文字进行解读文书时，任何你掷出的大失败都会改为失败。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lO95TwgihBdTilAB]{Effect: Thurible of Revelation}

This thurible of revelation decorated with images of sugi trees.

This brass censer dangles on a length of chain. Most thuribles of revelation are adorned with swirling Empyrean text, though some are iron and feature Diabolic or Chthonian text.

Activate—Burn Incense 2 (manipulate)

Cost incense worth at least 5 gp

Effect You light the incense inside the censer, and it burns for 1 hour. During that time, as long you are holding the thurible, you gain a +1 item bonus to Religion checks, and any critical failure you roll when you Decipher Writing of a religious nature is a failure instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lO95TwgihBdTilAB]{Effect: Thurible of Revelation}

Yeri's Bracelet.name: 耶里之手镯 Yeri's Bracelet
Yeri's Bracelet.tokenName: 耶里的神圣祈祷念珠 Yeri's Holy Prayer Beads

Yeri's Bracelet.name: 耶里之手镯 Yeri's Bracelet
Yeri's Bracelet.description:
这只手镯上装有一枚描绘着桑博齐轮状徽记的饰物。这只手镯的作用等同于抗力魅惑，可提供对精神伤害 5 的抗力。

这种魅惑通常悬挂在腰带上或佩戴在颈间，使你获得对一种能量伤害 5 的抗力：强酸、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波。每枚魅惑都被制作成防护某一种特定能量伤害，其设计通常会以某种方式体现它所防护的能量类型。例如，寒冷抗力魅惑可能会被雕刻成雪人的形状，而火焰抗力魅惑则会由火山玻璃制成。

This bracelet is fitted with a charm depicting the wheel-like symbol of Sangpotshi. This bracelet functions as a charm of resistance that provides resistance 5 against mental damage.

This charm, normally hung from the belt or worn around the neck, grants you resistance 5 against one type of energy damage: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. Each charm is crafted to protect against a particular type of energy damage, and its design usually embodies the type of energy it protects the wearer from in some way. For instance, a charm of cold resistance could be carved in the shape of a yeti, whereas a charm of fire resistance would be made from volcanic glass.

Yeri's Bracelet.prototypeToken: 耶里的神圣祈祷念珠 Yeri's Holy Prayer Beads

Yen Rui's Poltergeist.name: 严蕊的骚灵 Yen Rui's Poltergeist
Yen Rui's Poltergeist.tokenName: 严蕊的骚灵 Yen Rui's Poltergeist

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will).name: 念动战技（随意）
Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will).description:
随着一阵念动力的冲击，你移动一个敌人或其所携带的某件东西。你可以尝试对目标进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{重新定位}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}，使用法术攻击掷骰而非运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造出一只漂浮的、魔法的手，它可以是隐形的，也可以如幽灵般显现；这只手抓住目标物体，并使其朝任意方向缓慢悬浮移动，最多20尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以令该物体额外移动20尺。如果该物体在法术结束时位于空中，该物体会坠落。

强化（3环） 你可以将一个无人持握且负载为1或以下的物体作为目标。

强化（5环） 射程增加至60尺，且你可以将一个无人持握且负载为1或以下的物体作为目标。

强化（7环） 射程增加至60尺，且你可以将一个无人持握且负载为2或以下的物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Invisible.name: 隐形 Invisible
Invisible.description:
你无法被看见。你对所有人都是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}。生物可以使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 来侦测你；如果某个生物以其察觉检定对抗你的隐秘 DC 成功，你就会对该生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}，直到你使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行} 再次变为无踪。如果你在别人已经能看见你时变为隐形，你起初会对他们处于藏匿状态（而非无踪），直到你成功潜行。处于隐形时，你不能变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}，除非通过特殊能力或魔法。

You can't be seen. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to everyone. Creatures can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to detect you; if a creature succeeds at its Perception check against your Stealth DC, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to that creature until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} to become undetected again. If you become invisible while someone can already see you, you start out hidden to them (instead of undetected) until you successfully Sneak. You can't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} while invisible except via special abilities or magic.

Telekinetic Object.name: 念动力物体 Telekinetic Object
Telekinetic Object.description:
伤害类型取决于被投掷的物体

Damage type depends on object thrown

Site Bound.name: 场地绑定 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
骚灵与某个地点相连，无法离开其被创造或形成之处超过120英尺。有些骚灵则会被束缚在特定的房间、建筑物或类似区域内。

A poltergeist is tied to a location and can't travel more than 120 feet from the place where it was created or formed. Some poltergeists are instead bound to a specific room, building, or similar area

Natural Invisibility.name: 自然隐形 Natural Invisibility
Natural Invisibility.description:
骚灵天生处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态。它只有在使用恐吓时才会变得可见。

A poltergeist is naturally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. It becomes visible only when it uses Frighten.

Rejuvenation.name: 复苏 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当骚灵被摧毁时，它会在 [[/br 2d4 #复苏]]{2d4天}后于其被摧毁之处重组，并完全恢复。只有当有人查明它存在的原因，并纠正任何阻止该精魂休息的事物时，骚灵才能被永久摧毁。

When a poltergeist is destroyed, it reforms, fully healed, where it was destroyed after [[/br 2d4 #Rejuvenation]]{2d4 days}. A poltergeist can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Telekinetic Defense.name: 念动力防御 Telekinetic Defense
Telekinetic Defense.description:
触发 一名生物接近至骚灵10尺内

效果 骚灵对触发该反应的生物进行一次念动力物体打击。

Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the poltergeist

Effect The poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike against the triggering creature.

Frighten.name: 恐吓 Frighten
Frighten.description:
需求 骚灵必须处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态

效果 骚灵变得可见，显现为一个骷髅般、幽灵似的人形。30尺内的每个生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:21]豁免，在失败时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。在大失败时，它还会在其惊惧期间处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态。成功则该生物获得1分钟的暂时免疫。

在其下一回合开始时，骚灵再次变为隐形。

Requirements The poltergeist must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

Effect The poltergeist becomes visible, appearing as a skeletal, ghostlike humanoid. Each creature within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a failure. On a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it's frightened. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

At the start of its next turn, the poltergeist becomes invisible again.

Telekinetic Storm.name: 念动力风暴 Telekinetic Storm
Telekinetic Storm.description:
骚灵以念动力投掷大量小型物体，例如数十件银餐具或书本，可以将其分散袭向多个敌人，或集中指向一个目标。

  • 当此效果分散袭向多个敌人时，骚灵对 @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30尺} 散发内的每个生物以念动力物体进行一次打击，并承受 -2 减值。这些打击对骚灵的多重攻击减值而言视为一次攻击，且在所有这些攻击完成前，该减值不会增加。
  • 当此效果只有一个目标时，骚灵以念动力物体对该目标进行一次打击，且伤害提高至 3d12。在失败时，它造成 @Damage[1d12[untyped]] 伤害；在大失败时，不造成伤害。

The poltergeist telekinetically throws numerous small objects, such as dozens of pieces of silverware or books, either spreading them out among multiple foes or directing them at one target.

  • When this effect is spread out among multiple foes, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike at a -2 penalty against each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet}. These count as one attack for the poltergeist's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.
  • When this effect has only one target, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike against the target, and the damage increases to 3d12. It deals @Damage[1d12[untyped]] damage on a failure, and no damage on a critical failure.

Yen Rui's Poltergeist.publicNotes:
当一个生物死去时，如果由于某种原因其精魂无法或不愿离开其死亡之地，那么该精魂可能会显现为骚灵：一种躁动不安、隐形的精魂，仍然能够操作实体物体。许多骚灵都死于导致极端情感创伤或由极端情感创伤引发的方式。

When a creature dies, and for whatever reason its spirit is unable or unwilling to leave the site of its death, that spirit may manifest as a poltergeist: a restless, invisible spirit that is still able to manipulate physical objects. Many poltergeists perished in a way that resulted from or led to extreme emotional trauma.
Yen Rui's Poltergeist.prototypeToken: 严蕊的骚灵 Yen Rui's Poltergeist

Zataku.name: 座泽 Zataku
Zataku.blurb: 细心的鼠族女渔民 observant female ratfolk fisher

Mago Kai.name: 马戈凯 Mago Kai

Lamellar Breastplate.name: 札甲胸甲 Lamellar Breastplate
Lamellar Breastplate.description:
大多数札甲胸甲由上漆的钢片或其他金属片构成，并以皮绳或丝绳连接在一起。上漆可以防止金属腐蚀。

Slats of lacquered steel or other metal held together with cord, whether leather or silk, make up most lamellar breastplates. The lacquering prevents the metal from corroding.

Temple Bell Ringer.name: 寺钟敲响者 Temple Bell Ringer

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Ghost Killer.name: 杀鬼之人 Ghost Killer
Ghost Killer.description:
马戈凯的背部和胸部刻有复杂的魔法纹身，使他能更轻松地与他的幽灵主人交互。由马戈凯持用的武器和徒手攻击视为幽冥武器，并且他以近战打击攻击虚体生物或转生后的玩家角色时，会额外造成2d6心灵伤害。

Mago Kai had intricate magical tattoos inscribed on his back and chest to interact more easily with his ghostly masters. Weapons and unarmed attacks wielded by Mago Kai function as ghost touch weapons, and he inflicts an additional 2d6 mental damage with melee Strikes against incorporeal creatures or transmigrated PCs.

Mago Kai.blurb:
男性人类战士
Male human fighter

Arboreal Reaper.name: 林木收割者 Arboreal Reaper

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Speak with Plants (Constant).name: 植物交谈（恒定）
Speak with Plants (Constant).description:
你可以向植物和真菌提问并从它们那里得到回答，但该法术不会让它们变得比平时更友善或更聪明。大多数普通的植物和真菌对周围世界都有一种独特的看法，因此它们无法辨认有关生物的细节，也不了解其附近范围之外的世界。狡猾的植物或真菌怪物往往言简意赅且闪烁其词，而不那么聪明的则常会说些无意义的话。

强化（4环） 持续时间为8小时。

You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants and fungi have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant or fungus monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Heightened (4th) The duration is 8 hours.

Vampiric Feast.name: 吸血盛宴 Vampiric Feast
Vampiric Feast.description:
你的接触会从目标体内吸取生命力来强化你自己。你对目标造成 6d6 点虚空伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1 分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Axe Vulnerability.name: 斧类弱点 Axe Vulnerability
Axe Vulnerability.description:
林木收割者额外受到 5 点斧类武器造成的伤害。

An arboreal reaper takes 5 additional damage from axes.

Leech Moisture.name: 汲取水分 Leech Moisture
Leech Moisture.description:
林木收割者静止不动，专注地锁定 50 尺内的单个敌人，汲取目标身体中的水分。这造成 @Damage[10d6[void]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] 基础强韧豁免）。

林木收割者在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Leech Moisture]]{1d4 轮}内不能再次使用汲取水分。

The arboreal reaper grows still and focuses intently on a single foe within 50 feet, draining moisture from the target's body. This deals @Damage[10d6[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save).

The arboreal reaper can't Leech Moisture again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Leech Moisture]]{1d4 rounds}.

Arboreal Reaper.publicNotes:
有些森林带有一种田园诗般的宁静气质，而另一些则明显让人感到不友善，甚至阴森邪恶——这些森林正是林木收割者偏爱的作祟之地。有时，一些行事隐秘、修习恶毒艺术的人会专门寻找这类林地，并声称这里令人不安的氛围有助于他们施展能力；只要不损害其森林的平衡，林木收割者就没有理由干涉这些做法。

所有树妖的外观都会因周围环境而异，但林木收割者总显得隐约有些诡异，无论它们守望的是一片阴沉的林地还是一片热带雨林。它们往往略显畸变、扭曲，并覆有尖刺状的突起；林木收割者有时会在古老废墟或其他永久性建筑周围萌发，随着逐渐成熟并变得更加灵活，它们会分解这些结构，并将其纳入自身。

林木收割者专注于森林生命周期中至关重要的腐朽阶段，在秋季与冬季时尤为活跃。它们的影响常可见于朽木上骤然爆发的蘑菇，或繁茂食肉植物那诱人的叶状体。如同林木典狱官一样，这些林地守护者比起更为沉稳审慎的摄政者或隐退的档案守护者，更快对它们所感知到的威胁做出反应——至少以树妖的标准来看是如此。

树妖是森林中古老、如树木般的守护者，它们培育新生，维持生态系统的平衡，仿佛将广袤荒野视作自己的花园。树妖深思熟虑、行事审慎——直到某种东西威胁到它们的领域，招致它们的怒火。

While some forests have an idyllic, peaceful quality to them, others feel distinctly unfriendly or even sinister-these forests are the favored haunts of arboreal reapers. Sometimes these woodlands are sought out by secretive practitioners of malicious arts who claim the unsettling ambiance aids their abilities; arboreal reapers see no reason to interfere with such practices as long as the balance of their forests isn't harmed.

All arboreals vary in appearance based on their surroundings, but arboreal reapers always seem vaguely eerie, whether they watch over a grim weald or a tropical rain forest. Often slightly warped, twisted, and covered in spiky protrusions, arboreal reapers sometimes sprout around old ruins or other permanent structures, breaking down and incorporating the structures as they mature and become more mobile.

Arboreal reapers focus on the essential decaying phase of a forest's life cycle, becoming especially active in autumn and winter seasons. Their influence can often be seen in the explosion of mushrooms on a rotting log or the enticing fronds of a flourishing carnivorous plant. Like arboreal wardens, these woodland guardians are quicker to react to perceived threats than the more deliberate regents or retiring archives-at least by arboreal standards.

Arboreals are tree-like ancient guardians of forests, nurturing new growth and maintaining a balanced ecosystem as if the vast wilderness were their garden. Arboreals are thoughtful and deliberate - until something threatens their realms and invites their wrath.

Energizing Pill.name: 提神丹 Energizing Pill
Energizing Pill.description:
这种由强效草药特制而成的混合物呈紧实小丸状，可含在口中，并在口中保留1小时。提神丹起初带有苦涩的味道，但含服得越久，其风味就越显复杂与甘甜。它会提升你的反应能力，使你以察觉进行的先攻掷骰获得+2物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.YsgABP1Ya0QJoiKt]{效果：提神丹}

次级效果 r

触发 你将要变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞}

效果 将你刚获得的该状态值降低1；若这使其值降至0，则你不会获得该触发状态。

This special blend of potent herbs comes in the form of a compact ball that allows it to be held in the mouth, where it remains for 1 hour. An energizing pill has a bitter taste at first, but the longer one lets it soak, the more complex and sweet its flavor grows. It heightens your reactions, granting you a +2 item bonus to initiative rolls with Perception.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.YsgABP1Ya0QJoiKt]{Effect: Energizing Pill}

Secondary Effect r

Trigger You would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}

Effect Reduce the value of the condition you just gained by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you don't gain the triggering condition.

Pendant of the Occult.name: 异能吊坠 Pendant of the Occult
Pendant of the Occult.tokenName: 异能吊坠 Pendant of the Occult

Pendant of the Occult.name: 异能吊坠 Pendant of the Occult
Pendant of the Occult.description:
这枚护符是中空的，形状如一只不眨眼的眼睛。它的空腔中通常存放着某种异能文本的残片。佩戴这枚吊坠时，你在神秘学检定上获得 +1 物品加值，并且你可以将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{神导术} 戏法作为异能先天法术施放。

This amulet is hollow and shaped in the form of an unblinking eye. Its cavity typically holds some fragment of occult text. While wearing the pendant, you gain a +1 item bonus to Occultism checks, and you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} cantrip as an occult innate spell.

Pendant of the Occult.prototypeToken: 异能吊坠 Pendant of the Occult

Zheng Peng.name: 郑鹏 Zheng Peng

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这种小型带刃武器可单手持用，用于在近身战斗中刺击生物。它也可以投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Steel Shield.name: 钢盾 Steel Shield
Steel Shield.description:
与木制盾牌一样，钢盾也有各种形状和大小。尽管比木制盾牌更昂贵，但它们也耐用得多。

硬度HPBT
52010

Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

HardnessHPBT
52010

Breastplate.name: 胸甲 Breastplate
Breastplate.description:
尽管被称为胸甲，这种护甲由数块板甲或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.pRoikbRo5HFW6YUB]{Half Plate} 组成，用以保护躯干、胸部、颈部，有时还包括髋部和小腿。它巧妙地提供了板甲的部分防护，同时允许更高的灵活性和速度。

Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.pRoikbRo5HFW6YUB]{Half Plate} armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

Signal Whistle.name: 信号哨子 Signal Whistle
Signal Whistle.description:
吹响时，信号哨子在开阔地形上最远可在半英里外被清楚地听见。

When sounded, a signal whistle can be heard clearly up to half a mile away across open terrain.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩所使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

+1 to Sense Motive.name: 察言观色检定获得+1加值 +1 to Sense Motive

Air of Authority.name: 权威气场 Air of Authority
Air of Authority.description:
10尺。灵光中与执勤官等级相同或更低的生物，在对抗执勤官试图对其进行[[/act coerce]]或[[/act demoralize]]时，其意志难度等级承受 -2 状态减值。

10 feet. Creatures in the aura who are the same or lower level than the watch officer take a -2 status penalty to their Will DC against the watch officer's attempts to [[/act coerce]] or [[/act demoralize]] them.

Bravery.name: 勇武 Bravery
Bravery.description:
当执勤官对一个恐惧效果进行意志豁免并获得成功时，他们改为获得大成功。此外，每当他们获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧} 状态时，其数值减 1。

When the watch officer rolls a success on a Will save against a fear effect, they get a critical success instead. In addition, any time they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition, reduce its value by 1.

Sudden Charge.name: 突袭 Sudden Charge
Sudden Charge.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 执勤官行走两次。如果其移动结束时位于至少一个敌人的近战触及内，则其可以对该敌人进行一次近战打击。

Frequency once per round

Effect The watch officer Strides twice. If they end their movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

Zheng Peng.publicNotes:
执勤官通常带领一小队低阶守卫，在其负责的区域内巡逻，以维持秩序并执行法律。执勤官能把工作完成，尽管他们的手段并不总是温和或仁慈。

较大的社会依赖那些既有权威又有能力解读并执行法律的人。有些人会公正地履行这些职责，但也有些人严酷而残忍，对任何无力花钱换取宽免的人施加严厉的惩罚。

Often leading a small team of lower-ranking guards, watch officers patrol their assigned areas to maintain order and enforce laws. Watch officers get the job done, though their methods aren't always gentle or kind.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

Xungu.name: 蕈菇 Xungu

Telepathy 100 feet (Myceloids and Those.name: 心灵感应 100 尺（仅限菌体人和感染了紫痘的生物）

Spore Pop.name: 孢子爆裂 Spore Pop
Spore Pop.description:
如果菌体人因大失败命中而将生命值降至 0，它会爆开，迫使它立刻孢子迸发，即使它当天已经使用过该能力。

If a myceloid is reduced to 0 HP by a critical hit, it pops, forcing it to immediately Emit Spores, even if it has already used the ability that day.

Emit Spores.name: 孢子迸发 Emit Spores
Emit Spores.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 菌体人向以其自身空间的一个角落为中心的 @Template[burst|distance:10] 喷发孢子。这团云雾会持续至菌体人的下个回合开始。每个处于云雾中或进入其中的生物都会暴露于紫痘。

Frequency once per day

Effect The myceloid expels spores in a @Template[burst|distance:10] centered on a corner of its own space. This cloud lasts until the start of the myceloid's next turn. Each creature that is in the cloud or enters it is exposed to purple pox.

Purple Pox.name: 紫痘 Purple Pox
Purple Pox.description:
菌体人免疫

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

潜伏期 1分钟

阶段 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]]伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1天）

阶段 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]]伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 3}，且该生物会被迫搜索最近的菌体人聚落——这种强迫属于心灵情绪效果（1天）

阶段 3 该生物死亡。在24小时内，其尸体会肿胀并爆裂，释放出一个新的、完全成熟的菌体人。

Myceloids are immune

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Onset 1 minute

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3}, and the creature is compelled to seek out the nearest myceloid colony-this compulsion is a mental emotion effect (1 day)

Stage 3 The creature dies. Over 24 hours, its corpse becomes bloated and bursts, releasing a new, fully grown myceloid.

Spore Domination.name: 孢子支配 Spore Domination
Spore Domination.description:
菌体人以60尺内一名受紫痘影响的生物为目标。该生物必须进行一次@Check[will|dc:22]豁免。

随后，它会在10分钟内暂时免疫孢子支配。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 直到其下个回合结束前，目标对菌体人为乐于助人，且不能对其采取敌对动作。

失败 同成功，但持续1分钟。

大失败 同成功，但持续直到紫痘被治愈。

The myceloid targets one creature affected by purple pox within 60 feet. That creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save.

It is then temporarily immune to spore domination for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success Until the end of its next turn, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful} to myceloids and can't take hostile actions against them.

Failure As success, but for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As success, but until the purple pox is cured.

Xungu.publicNotes:
这些被称为菌体人的可行走真菌生物，因传播致命的紫痘、操控生物的心智，以及吞食类人生物的血肉而恶名昭著。对菌体人族群而言，任何与类人生物的战斗都足以令人兴奋，因为这些新的饵料带来了无数美味的可能性。

菌体人认为，类人生物理想的生命循环共有简单的四个步骤。孩童时期，他们天真而恐惧地四处游荡，对菌体人族群一无所知。成年之后，类人生物会发现自己真正的使命：品尝紫痘，并在菌体人的孢子作用下沦为奴仆。接着，他们死去，孕育出新的菌体人。然后，在成为菌体人的一顿餐食后，他们便被送往来世。食用类人生物的血肉并非必需——菌体人靠任何腐烂物质都能存活——但这无疑是一种享受。

菌体人很少结成同盟，但一旦结盟，它们就会邀请新盟友共进一餐，以此缔结盟约。很少有外来者会欣赏这种款待。

大多数菌体人都有深紫色的菌盖，其上点缀着灰白色的瘤块。它们的颈部和身体类似于坚韧如皮革的真菌菌柄。菌体人的身体上常常还会长出较小的蘑菇，而这些生物会将其视作装饰品，或是特别方便的零食。它们大致和矮人一样高，体格也同样粗壮。

The ambulatory fungus creatures called myceloids are notorious for spreading deadly purple pox, controlling creatures' minds, and devouring humanoid flesh. For a myceloid colony, any battle with humanoids is cause for excitement, as this new fodder presents so many delicious possibilities.

Myceloids consider humanoids to have an ideal life cycle of four simple steps. During childhood, they wander naive and afraid, unaware of myceloid colonies. In adulthood, humanoids discover their true purpose as they taste purple pox and become enslaved by the myceloids' spores. Next, they die, giving rise to a new myceloid. They're then sent on to the afterlife upon becoming a myceloid meal. Eating humanoid flesh is not a necessity-a myceloid can survive on any decaying matter-but it's certainly a pleasure.

Myceloids rarely make alliances, but when they do, they invite their new allies to share a meal to seal the pact. Few outsiders appreciate this hospitality.

Most myceloids have deep purple caps studded with off-white lumps. Their necks and bodies bear resemblance to the stipes of tough, leathery fungi. Smaller mushrooms often grow on a myceloid's body, which the creatures view as either adornments or particularly convenient snacks. They stand roughly as tall as a dwarf, with comparably stout builds.
Xungu.blurb:
无性别菌体人
Agender myceloid

Kappa.name: 河童 Kappa

Head Bowl.name: 头碗 Head Bowl
Head Bowl.description:
河童头顶的凹陷中盛满了水。若将河童头顶的水全部泼出、蒸发或以其他方式移除，则其所有速度都会降至5尺，直到该凹槽再次装满水为止。河童若变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，则必须成功通过一次 @Check[reflex|dc:15] 豁免，否则会洒出其水；河童若变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，则会自动洒出其水。

若河童被擒抱、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}或震慑，另一名生物可以花费一个单动作（具有攻击和操作（特征））来尝试将其碗中的水泼出，并对抗河童的强韧难度等级进行一次运动检定。成功时，该生物会泼出河童的水。

The depression atop a kappa's head is filled with water. Spilling, evaporating, or otherwise removing all the water from the top of a kappa's head reduces all their Speeds to 5 feet until the basin is again filled with water. A kappa who becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:15] save or spill their water, and a kappa who becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} automatically spills their water.

If a kappa is grappled, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or stunned, another creature can attempt to spill the water from their bowl by spending a single action, which has the attack and manipulate traits, to attempt an Athletics check against the kappa's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature spills the kappa's water.

Pull Arm.name: 拉拽手臂 Pull Arm
Pull Arm.description:
河童拉长他们的一只手臂，使该手臂获得 10 足触及。与之相对的另一只手臂会缩短，变得几乎只剩下一只从其甲壳中伸出的手。河童仍然可以用这只缩短的手拿东西，但不能用那只手持用护盾或武器。花费一个单动作拉长其另一只手臂后，河童可以让双臂恢复到原本的长度。

The kappa pulls one of their arms, gaining 10-foot reach with that arm. The opposing arm shrinks to little more than a hand extending from their shell. The kappa can still use their shortened hand to hold things, but they can't use that hand to wield a shield or weapon. By spending a single action to pull their opposing arm, the kappa can return their arms to their original length.

Kappa.publicNotes:
河童天性顽皮，喜欢捉弄毫无防备的旅人。尽管它们通常并非明显怀有恶意，但也会造成不小的麻烦，比如偷走不知情沐浴者的衣物，或从营火旁顺手拿走无人看管的食物。河童也喜欢在力量较量中证明自己的本事，而且尽管它们爱耍花招，仍以恪守诺言、在交谈中保持礼貌的光荣竞争者而闻名。

尽管不同地区的河童在身体特征上略有差异，但它们全都是两栖、形似乌龟的人形生物，长着喙状的嘴、带蹼的手脚，以及从蓝绿色到淡黄色不等的黏滑鳞片。它们常有黑色头发，呈环状生长，以避开头顶中央的凹陷。来自河童家乡湖泊、小溪或河流的水会盛在这个凹陷中，也就是头碗；人们相信这正是它们力量的来源。年幼的河童很容易被哄骗得低头鞠躬，从而不小心把自己头碗里的水倒空。失去这些水会让河童变得无精打采。头碗空着的时间越久，河童就会越虚弱。虽然这对于生活在家乡水域附近的河童来说很少构成严重危险，但对于远走他乡、喜爱冒险的河童而言，却可能致命。

河童并非天生敌对，人们也知道它们会与孤独的孩子交朋友，并通过指路或提供简单的医疗照料来帮助受困的冒险者。尽管如此，许多河童栖居的地方仍会竖有警示牌，提醒人们它们的存在，并鼓励靠近水边的旅人投下一根黄瓜——河童最喜欢的食物——以换取安全通行。有时这些牌子甚至就是河童自己立的，好提高获得美味点心的机会。

Mischievous by nature, kappas delight in playing pranks on unsuspecting travelers. While usually not overtly malicious, they can be a significant nuisance, stealing clothes from unsuspecting bathers or snatching unattended food from campfires. Kappas also enjoy proving their worth in competitions of strength and, despite their propensity for trickery, are known to be honorable competitors who keep their word and remain polite in conversation.

While kappas vary in physical attributes from region to region, they're all amphibious, turtle-like humanoids with beaked mouths, webbed hands and feet, and slimy scales that range in color from bluish green to pale yellow. They often have black hair, arranged in a ring to accommodate the central depression atop their head. Water from a kappa's home lake, stream, or river fills this depression, or head bowl, which is believed to be the source of their strength. Younger kappas are easily tricked into bowing and accidentally emptying the water from their own head bowls. Losing this water makes a kappa lethargic. The longer a kappa's head bowl remains empty, the weaker they grow. While this rarely poses a serious danger for a kappa living near their home body of water, it can prove fatal to a more adventurous kappa wandering afar.

Kappas aren't inherently hostile and have been known to befriend lonely children and lend aid to stranded adventurers by providing directions or minor medical treatment. Still, many areas where kappas dwell feature posted signs warning of their presence that encourage travelers venturing near water to toss in a cucumber—kappas' favorite food—in exchange for safe passage. Kappas sometimes put up these signs themselves to increase the likelihood of receiving a tasty treat.

Myna's Gift (Saved Three).name: 米娜的赋礼（已拯救三人）
Myna's Gift (Saved Three).tokenName: 米娜的赋礼（已拯救三人）

Healing Potion (Moderate).name: 治疗药水（中等） Healing Potion (Moderate)
Healing Potion (Moderate).description:
启动 A（操作）

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时，会感到一阵刺痛般的麻感。饮用治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] Hit Points.

Smoke Ball (Greater).name: 烟雾弹（强效） Smoke Ball (Greater)
Smoke Ball (Greater).description:
启动 1（操作）

当你将这个球砸向地面时，你会立刻制造出一片浓厚、不透明的烟幕，形成一个以你空间的一个角落为中心的@Template[burst|distance:20]。该区域内的所有生物都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，且对它们而言，所有其他生物也都是隐蔽的。烟幕持续1分钟，或直到被强风驱散为止。

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Upon smashing this ball on the ground, you instantly create a screen of thick, opaque smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:20] centered on one corner of your space. All creatures within that area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

Everlasting Adhesive.name: 恒久黏胶 Everlasting Adhesive
Everlasting Adhesive.description:
启动 1分钟（操作）

这种奇特的琥珀色黏胶能将两个表面几乎不可分离地粘合在一起。单瓶最多可覆盖1平方足的区域，且必须一次性全部使用，以在两个表面之间形成单一粘结。如果启动被打断，粘结会失败，黏胶也会被浪费。

一旦两个表面用恒久黏胶粘合在一起，生物只有成功进行一次 @Check[athletics|dc:50] 检定才能将其分开。被粘住的物体通常会先于黏胶本身破裂，除非它们特别坚固；不过，决心要将这些物体分开的生物可以直接掰断那些由恒久黏胶连接的部分，之后再修理这些物体。

这种黏胶只有在生物自愿的情况下才能对其生效，而其粘结可以通过剥除最外层皮肤来破坏。

Activate 1 minute (manipulate)

This peculiar amber adhesive bonds two surfaces together almost inseparably. A single flask covers an area up to 1 square foot and must be used all at once to form a single bond between two surfaces. If the activation is interrupted, the bond fails, and the adhesive is wasted.

Once two surfaces are joined with everlasting adhesive, a creature can separate them only with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:50] check. The adhered objects tend to break before the adhesive does unless they're particularly durable, though a creature determined to separate the objects can break off the parts connected by the everlasting adhesive and later Repair the objects.

The adhesive can affect creatures only if they're willing, and its bond can be broken by exfoliating the outermost layer of skin.

Potion of Quickness.name: 迅捷药水 Potion of Quickness
Potion of Quickness.description:
启动 A（操作）

饮用这瓶银药水会使你获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{加速术} 的效果，持续1分钟。

Activate A (manipulate)

Drinking this silver potion grants you the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} for 1 minute.

Resilient.name: 坚韧 Resilient
Resilient.description:
坚韧符文为护甲注入额外的防护魔法。这使穿戴者的豁免检定获得+1物品加值。

你可以使用升级物品和符文的正常流程，来升级一套护甲上已经蚀刻的坚韧符文。

Resilient runes imbue armor with additional protective magic. This grants the wearer a +1 item bonus to saving throws.

You can upgrade the resilient rune already etched on a suit of armor using the normal process for upgrading items and runes.

Myna's Gift (Saved Three).prototypeToken: 米娜的赋礼（已拯救三人）

Shimmerthief.name: 窃光者 Shimmerthief

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Blur.name: 朦胧术 Blur
Blur.description:
目标的形体看起来模糊不清。它变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于这一效果的性质仍会使目标的位置显而易见，目标不能利用这种隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。

The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你制造出一片黑暗，阻止光线穿透该区域或在其中发出。光不会进入该区域，任何非魔法光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使它们的照明半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制你的黑暗术同环阶或更低环阶的魔法光。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

强化（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉的生物（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过这片黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意）
Darkness (At Will).description:
你制造出一片黑暗，阻止光穿透该区域或在该区域内发出。光不会进入该区域，任何非魔法光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内时都不会发出任何光，即使它们的照明半径本可延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗术同环级或更低的魔法光。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它表现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

强化（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉的生物（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过这片黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Echolocation 120 feet.name: 回声定位 120 尺 Echolocation 120 feet
Echolocation 120 feet.description:
窃光者可以在所列射程内将其听觉作为精确感官使用。

A shimmerthief can use their hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.

Shimmervision.name: 光源视觉 Shimmervision
Shimmervision.description:
窃光者的视觉使其能够在与具有标准视觉的生物相同的距离上感知光源，但无法辨认细节。它们无法用这种视觉侦测光源之外的任何事物。

A shimmerthief's sight allows them to sense sources of light from the same distance as creatures with standard vision but doesn't allow them to make out details. They can't detect anything other than light sources using this vision.

Gleam Theft.name: 窃光 Gleam Theft
Gleam Theft.description:
10尺。窃光者会持续吸收周围的光线。其灵光内的明亮光照变为昏暗光照，而昏暗光照变为黑暗。窃光者可以以带有专注（特征）的单动作压制或启动该灵光。

10 feet. A shimmerthief constantly absorbs ambient light. Bright light in their aura becomes dim light, and dim light becomes darkness. A shimmerthief can suppress or activate this aura as a single action with the concentrate trait.

Drain Light.name: 汲取光照 Drain Light
Drain Light.description:
窃光者以 30 尺内的一个光源为目标，然后尝试以一次法术攻击检定反制它。如果成功，窃光者恢复 @Damage[(2d8+10)[healing]] 生命值（大成功时恢复 @Damage[(4d8+20)[healing]] 生命值）。

The shimmerthief targets a light source within 30 feet, then attempts to counteract it with a spell attack roll. If they succeed, the shimmerthief regains @Damage[(2d8+10)[healing]] Hit Points (@Damage[(4d8+20)[healing]] Hit Points on a critical success).

Lasting Darkness.name: 持久黑暗 Lasting Darkness
Lasting Darkness.description:
频率 每日一次

触发 窃光者将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{黑暗术} 以 2 环法术施放

效果 窃光者的黑暗术的持续时间延长至24小时。

Frequency once per day

Trigger The shimmerthief casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness} as a 2nd-rank spell

Effect The duration of the shimmerthief's darkness increases to 24 hours.

Unnerving Shriek.name: 惊魂尖啸 Unnerving Shriek
Unnerving Shriek.description:
窃光者发出一阵异界哀嚎，迫使60尺内的生物尝试进行一次@Check[will|dc:24]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入惊惧 2，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态，持续至其仍处于惊惧状态时为止。

The shimmerthief releases an unearthly wail, forcing creatures within 60 feet to attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is frightened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it remains frightened.

Shimmerthief.publicNotes:
窃光者是失明的、蜥蜴般的洞穴居民，怀有一种无法满足的渴望，要吞食名为光的罕见美味。这种饥饿驱使它们离开地下巢穴，前往地表觅食，所过之处都会留下片片黑暗。

它们绝非愚笨，却更喜欢避开其他有智能的生物，因为它们知道许多存在都觉得自己令人不适。它们年纪尚轻时便会独立，但也会保护同类，并在可能时以小群体旅行。谨慎的窃光者会尽量避免在繁忙区域吞食光，但这类地方也最具诱惑，因为熙攘的人口意味着更多光源。

替代饮食

一些窃光者会发展出对某些远比光更阴险的能量形态的嗜好，并获得吞食它们的能力，从而能以生命能量或思维能量代替光作为食物。大多数窃光者都将这种行为视为怪物般的行径，并认为这是被流放的理由。具有这类癖性的窃光者是危险的掠食者；它们依然保有吞食光的能力，并会故意制造片片黑暗来困住并猎食受害者。以生命能量为食的窃光者用其颚造成负能量伤害，而以思维能量为食的窃光者则用其颚造成心灵伤害。

Shimmerthieves are blind, lizard-like cave dwellers with an insatiable yearning to consume the rare delicacy of light. This hunger compels them to travel beyond their subterranean lairs to the surface to feed, leaving pockets of darkness behind as they go.

They're far from unintelligent yet prefer to avoid other sapient creatures, aware that many find them off-putting. They become independent at a young age but are protective of their kind, and they travel in small groups when able. Prudent shimmerthieves try to avoid feeding on light in busy areas, but such places are also the most tempting, as bustling populations mean more light sources.

Alternate Diets

Some shimmerthieves develop a taste for and the capacity to consume energy forms far more insidious than light, allowing them to feed on life energy or thought energy instead of light. Such behavior is considered monstrous by most shimmerthieves and a reason for exile. Shimmerthieves with these proclivities are dangerous predators that maintain the ability to feed on light and purposely create pockets of darkness to trap and feed on victims. A shimmerthief that feeds on life energy deals negative damage with their jaws, while one that feeds on thought energy deals mental damage with their jaws.

Escape Fulu.name: 逃脱符箓 Escape Fulu
Escape Fulu.description:
启动 f（专注）

触发 你尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{脱身}。

逃脱符箓是富人中常见的魅惑符，他们佩戴这种护符以防遭到绑架。当你启动此符箓时，在1分钟内，你进行脱身尝试时获得+2状态加值，同时进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}的隐秘检定也获得+2状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.eWDmS4QTwmwPbBTb]{效果：逃脱符箓}

Activate f (concentrate)

Trigger You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

The escape fulu is a charm common among wealthy people, who wear the talisman in case of kidnapping. When you Activate this fulu, for 1 minute, you gain a +2 status bonus to your attempts to Escape as well as to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.eWDmS4QTwmwPbBTb]{Effect: Escape Fulu}

Stumbling Fulu.name: 蹒跚符箓 Stumbling Fulu
Stumbling Fulu.description:
持续时间 1小时

最先创造出蹒跚符箓的狐人建议使用者将符箓塞在目标的腰带下面，以获得最佳效果。当附着有该符箓的生物完成一次移动动作时，该生物必须尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:17]豁免。若失败，符箓所附着的护甲上的某个部件会松开，使穿戴者陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}。若大失败，目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}。笨拙状态会持续，直到目标总共花费1个交互动作，且笨拙状态每高于1点就额外再花费1个交互动作，来把自己的衣物重新整理妥当。符箓一旦启动便会烧毁，其魔法只会持续到它所施加的状态结束为止。

Duration 1 hour

The kitsune who first created a stumbling fulu advised the user to tuck the fulu under the target's belt for maximum effect. When the creature to which the fulu is affixed completes a Stride action, the creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17] save. On a failure, some element of the armor the fulu is affixed to comes undone, making the wearer @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. On a critical failure, the target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. The clumsy condition remains until the target takes a total of 1 Interact action, plus 1 additional Interact action per value of the clumsy condition above 1, to properly reclothe itself. Once the fulu activates, it burns up, its magic lasting only as long as the conditions it has imposed.

Matsuki Shou.name: 松木胜 Matsuki Shou

Carpenter's Toolkit (Sterling).name: 木匠工具包（专家级）
Carpenter's Toolkit (Sterling).description:
你需要这些工具，才能用原材料通过制作技能来制造物品。专家级工匠工具使你在该检定上获得 +1 物品加值。

不同的工作需要不同的工具组，由游戏主持决定；例如，铁匠的工具包与木工的工具包不同。如果你将工匠工具包穿戴在身上，你可以在使用它的动作中将其取出并收回。

You need these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Sterling artisan's tools give you a +1 item bonus to the check.

Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

Cataracts.name: 白内障 Cataracts
Cataracts.description:
松木老人的视力恶化使其基于视觉的察觉检定承受–2环境减值。

Old Matsuki's deteriorating eyesight imposes a –2 circumstance penalty to vision-based Perception checks.

Wood-Grain Speaker.name: 木纹有语 Wood-Grain Speaker
Wood-Grain Speaker.description:
老松木在检查木制物品、结构和树木时获得+2察觉环境加值。他可以用制作来为主要由木材制成的物品进行辨识魔法。此能力不受老松木的白内障影响。

Old Matsuki gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception when examining wood items, structures, and trees. He can use Crafting to Identify Magic for items primarily made of wood. This ability isn't affected by Old Matsuki's cataracts.

You Know, They Say....name: 你知道的，人们说......
You Know, They Say....description:
松木老人可以使用柳岸镇学识来代替奥秘、医药、神秘学或宗教，以带有 –2 减值的方式尝试进行回忆知识检定。对于以这种方式尝试的回忆知识检定，他具有拥有诡异知识专长的效果。

Old Matsuki can use Willowshore Lore in place of Arcana, Medicine, Occultism, or Religion to attempt Recall Knowledge checks with a –2 penalty. He has the effects of the Dubious Knowledge feat for Recall Knowledge checks attempted in this way.

A Drink for Good Luck.name: 来杯好运酒 A Drink for Good Luck
A Drink for Good Luck.description:
频率 每季一次

需求 松木老人手中拿着一杯饮品

效果 松木老人为好运举杯祝酒，然后在饮下饮品前选择30尺内至多六个其他生物。他，以及所有在其下个回合结束前饮用的人，都会被好运灌注。在当前季节结束前，每个目标都可以在一次失败的豁免检定后以自由动作重骰，并采用第二次结果。

Frequency once per season

Requirements Old Matsuki has a drink in hand

Effect Old Matsuki toasts to good fortune, then selects up to six other creatures within 30 feet before he drinks his drink. He, and all creatures that drink before the end of their next turn, become infused with good luck. Once before the end of the current season, each target can reroll a failed saving throw as a free action, taking the second result.

Respect Your Elders!.name: 尊老敬贤！
Respect Your Elders!.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 松木老人会当众斥责一个他看得见且位于30尺内的角色，指责其缺乏尊重，不仅是对他本人或柳岸镇的其他长者不敬，更是对柳岸镇传统的不敬。无论他的训斥是否合理，这番痛斥的目标都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:22] 意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响，且在1周内免疫尊老敬贤！。

成功 该生物会短暂感到羞愧，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续1轮。

失败 羞愧与怀疑不断困扰着该生物，令其分心到陷入呆滞 1，持续1小时。

Frequency once per day

Effect Old Matsuki publicly chastises a character he can see and who's within 30 feet for being disrespectful, not just against him or Willowshore's other elders, but against Willowshore's traditions. Whether or not his reprimands are justified, the target of this tirade must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and immune to Respect Your Elders! for 1 week.

Success The creature feels a momentary bout of shame, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure Feelings of shame and doubt nag at the creature, distracting them enough that they become stupefied 1 for 1 hour.

Wait, Give Me a Moment....name: 等等，给我点时间……
Wait, Give Me a Moment....description:
触发 老松木进行回忆知识检定失败

频率 每天一次

效果 老松木意识到自己的错误，然后以+2环境加值重骰此次触发的检定。

Trigger Old Matsuki fails a check to Recall Knowledge

Frequency once per day

Effect Old Matsuki realizes his error, then rerolls the triggering check with a +2 circumstance bonus.

Matsuki Shou.blurb:
男性人类木匠
Male human carpenter

Oil of Mending.name: 修复油 Oil of Mending
Oil of Mending.description:
启动 1分钟（操作）

一瓶修复油看起来内部有无数半透明的丝线盘旋其中。将这种油涂抹到一件物品上时，会施放一个2环的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{修复术}法术来修复该物品。

Activate 1 minute (manipulate)

A vial of oil of mending appears to have countless translucent threads swirling within. Applying this oil to an item casts a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending} spell to repair the item.

Desertation Documents.name: 弃逃文件 Desertation Documents
Desertation Documents.description:
散落在房间各处的文件表明，尽管伐木营地在最后几个月里仍在进行生产，但龙华崩溃引发的动荡导致了纷争与逃离，最终使这处地点遭到废弃。

The documents strewn about the room indicate that while the lumber camp was still producing in its final months, upheaval from the collapse of Lung Wa was resulting in discord and desertion that ultimately led to the site being abandoned.

Shioli.name: 诗欧莉 Shioli
Shioli.blurb:
心烦意乱的女性艾乌瓦林酿酒师
distraught female aiuvarin brewer

Revenant.name: 亡魂 Revenant

Sense Murderer.name: 感知凶手 Sense Murderer
Sense Murderer.description:
亡魂知晓杀害自己之人的方向（只要双方位于同一位面），但不知道距离。

A revenant knows the direction of their murderer (as long as both are on the same plane), but not the distance.

Self-Loathing.name: 自我厌恶 Self-Loathing
Self-Loathing.description:
如果亡魂看见自己的倒影，或任何其生前对其很重要的物体，它必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:25] 豁免。

大成功 亡魂不受影响，且此后不会再以这种方式受到该倒影或物体的影响。

成功 亡魂因自我厌恶而分心，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮。

失败 亡魂因触发其自我厌恶的源头而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{目眩神迷}，并会尽其所能摧毁它，直到亡魂下个回合结束。

大失败 只要其自我厌恶的源头显而易见，直到其受到攻击，或直到它看见杀害自己的人为止，亡魂便会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}。

If a revenant sees their own reflection or any object that was important to them in life, they must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The revenant is unaffected and can no longer be affected by that reflection or object in this way.

Success The revenant is distracted by self-loathing and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.
