Failure The revenant becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the source that triggered their self-loathing and does everything they can to destroy it until the end of the revenant's next turn.

Critical Failure The revenant becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} as long as the source of their self-loathing is apparent, until they're attacked, or until they see their murderer.

Undying Vendetta.name: 不死复仇 Undying Vendetta
Undying Vendetta.description:
如果亡魂的凶手死去，亡魂会立即被摧毁。无法感知其凶手的亡魂必须每 24 小时尝试一次 @Check[flat|dc:11] 检定，以避免陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}；一旦他们能够感知其凶手，便会立即再度崛起。变成不死生物的凶手不会触发亡魂的毁灭，直到该凶手被彻底摧毁。亡魂对其凶手进行的检定和针对其凶手的难度等级获得 +2 状态加值。

If the revenant's murderer dies, the revenant is immediately destroyed. A revenant that can't sense their murderer must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11] check once every 24 hours to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}; they immediately rise again once they can sense their murderer. A murderer who becomes undead does not trigger the revenant's destruction until the murderer is finally destroyed. The revenant gains a +2 status bonus to checks and DCs against their murderer.

Baleful Shriek.name: 恶毒尖啸 Baleful Shriek
Baleful Shriek.description:
亡魂发出可怕的哀号。@Template[burst|distance:60]内的每个生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:23]豁免。无论其豁免结果如何，受影响的生物随后都会在1小时内对恶毒尖啸免疫。亡魂的凶手不会因该能力的失能（特征）而提升其成功等级。

亡魂在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Baleful Shriek]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用恶毒尖啸。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

失败 该生物陷入惊惧 2，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}1轮。

大失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并麻痹[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。

The revenant wails horribly. Each creature within a @Template[burst|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save. Regardless of the outcome of their saving throw, affected creatures are then immune to Baleful Shriek for 1 hour. The revenant's murderer never improves their degree of success due to this ability's incapacitation trait.

The revenant can't use Baleful Shriek again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Baleful Shriek]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Failure The creature is frightened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and paralyzed for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Revenant.publicNotes:
报怨亡魂是执念深重的亡灵追猎者，因自身遭到谋杀而再度现身，并且只受一件事驱使：向杀害自己的人复仇。通行的看法认为，报怨亡魂只会由那些遭到彻底背叛，或被弃之等死、在痛苦煎熬中死去的人化生而成；但即便如此，这样的受害者也未必会从坟墓中爬起。在其他情况下，如果亡魂并不了解自己死亡时的全部真相，那么即便死因实际上完全可以被视为一场意外，它也仍可能化为报怨亡魂。在这种情形下，所谓的“凶手”是否本无杀意并不重要，因为报怨亡魂不懂怜悯，也永不宽恕。除了为完成复仇目标所必需回想起来的事情之外，报怨亡魂几乎不记得自己生前的任何经历。

Revenants are obsessed, undead stalkers who arise from their own murders and are driven by only one thing: revenge against their killers. The common wisdom is that revenants arise only from individuals who have been utterly betrayed or abandoned to die a grueling death, but even then, such victims might not rise from their graves. In other cases, revenants might even rise from what might legitimately be considered an accident if the revenant doesn't understand the full circumstances of their demise. In such cases, it doesn't matter that the "murderer" may not have intended to kill, for revenants understands no pity and can never forgive. Revenants have little memory of their lives other than anything they might need to recall in order to achieve their goal of vengeance.

Nadoya's Thanks.name: 纳多娅的感谢 Nadoya's Thanks
Nadoya's Thanks.tokenName: 纳多娅的感谢 Nadoya's Thanks

Crying Angel Pendant.name: 泪天使垂饰 Crying Angel Pendant
Crying Angel Pendant.description:
启动 2（专注）

当你启动这枚雪花石膏坠饰时，尝试以医药进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{施行急救}，并在该检定上获得 +1 物品加值。若你成功，且你试图稳定伤势，则目标恢复 1 点生命值，失去濒死（状态）并如常恢复意识。若你成功，且你试图止血，则流血结束。

Activate 2 (concentrate)

When you activate this alabaster pendant, attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} using Medicine with a +1 item bonus to the check. If you succeed, and you were trying to stabilize, the target regains 1 Hit Point, losing the dying condition and becoming conscious as normal. If you succeed, and you were trying to stop bleeding, the bleeding ends.

Nadoya's Thanks.prototypeToken: 纳多娅的感谢 Nadoya's Thanks

The Wisdom of the Seven Sages.name: 七贤的智慧 The Wisdom of the Seven Sages
The Wisdom of the Seven Sages.description:
龙华的一部著名古典论著。

卷轴里夹着一封信。

A famous classical treatise of Lung Wa.

Folded into the scroll is a letter.

Letter from Shan-Bao’s Parents.name: 山宝父母的来信 Letter from Shan-Bao’s Parents
Letter from Shan-Bao’s Parents.description:
卷轴里夹着一封山宝父母写的信，信中表达了他们对儿子的自豪，并坚信他会证明自己是龙座下一位睿智、公正的仆役，不负他们教导给他的一切理想。

Folded into the scroll is a letter from Shan-Bao’s parents expressing their pride in their son and their conviction that he’ll prove to be a wise, fair servant of the Dragon Throne, worthy of all the ideals they taught him.

Assorted Bits of Jewelry.name: 各式珠宝首饰碎件 Assorted Bits of Jewelry

Emerald Grasshopper.name: 翡翠蚱蜢 Emerald Grasshopper
Emerald Grasshopper.description:
启动 A（专注）

需求 你受过运动训练

这只镶嵌着绿宝石的金属蚱蜢通常扣在一套护甲的腿部。

当你启动它时，进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}，最多水平移动40尺，最多垂直移动10尺。

如果你的跳跃结束时没有落在坚实地面上，你会在空中扑腾直到你的回合结束，然后以每轮60尺的速度无害地坠落，直到抵达地面。

Activate A (concentrate)

Requirements You're trained in Athletics

This metal grasshopper studded with emeralds is usually clasped to the legs of a suit of armor.

When you activate it, make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, traveling up to 40 feet horizontally and up to 10 feet vertically.

If you don't end your jump on solid ground, you flutter in the air until the end of your turn, then fall harmlessly at a rate of 60 feet per round until you reach the ground.

+1 Bloodstained Chain Shirt.name: +1血迹斑斑的链衫 +1 Bloodstained Chain Shirt
+1 Bloodstained Chain Shirt.description:
这有时被称为锁子甲袍，是一种由与锁子甲相同的金属环制成的长衫。不过，它比锁子甲轻得多，而且只能保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chain mail. However, it is much lighter than chain mail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Wand of Clear Mind (Rank 2).name: 澄明心智魔杖（2环）
Wand of Clear Mind (Rank 2).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{澄明心智}

这根短杖约有一足长，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中所含的法术相关。

启动 施放法术

频率 每天一次，外加超载

效果 你以所标示的环阶施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次以所列环阶施放该法术。

注意：要创建特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，请将该法术从 compendium 或 compendium browser 拖入玩家角色、非玩家角色或战利品角色的物品栏中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind}

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of the spell at the listed rank.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Writhing Hair.name: 缠怨之发 Writhing Hair

Cyclone of Hair.name: 发缕缠绕 Cyclone of Hair
Cyclone of Hair.description:
触发 一个生物试图与该作祟交互或对其说话

效果 幽魂女子发出尖啸并升入空中，她的头发迅速生长，如蛇般穿过商店，缠上椽梁或织入座位区域。商店内的所有生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:22] 豁免，以避免陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}）。然后，该作祟掷先攻。

Trigger A creature attempts to interact with or speak to the haunt

Effect The ghostly woman shrieks and rises into the air as her hair grows swiftly, snaking through the shop to tangle into the rafters or weave through the seating area. All creatures in the shop must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

Writhing Hair.disable:
@Check[diplomacy|dc:23] 以使烦乱的精魂冷静下来，或 @Check[religion|dc:21] 通过祷告说服精魂放弃这场作祟。如果PC使用日出明里的名字，或以其他方式让作祟知晓他们理解了她的故事，则解除这个作祟的检定获得+2环境加值。

@Check[diplomacy|dc:23] to calm the upset spirit down, or @Check[religion|dc:21] to convince the spirit to abandon the haunting via prayer. If the PCs use Hinode Akari's name or otherwise let the haunt know that they understand her story, checks to Disable this haunt gain a +2 circumstance bonus.
Writhing Hair.hazarddescription:
一名幽灵般的女子静静地飘过商店，拔下头发，让它们蜿蜒爬进椽子里，或钻出去侵扰尚未蒸熟的馒头。

A ghostly woman floats quietly through the shop, plucking hair and sending it slithering into the rafters or out to infest uncooked steamed buns.
Writhing Hair.routine:
（1动作）该作祟随机以商店内1个生物为目标，并优先选择处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}状态的目标。幽灵般的身影移动到受害者身边，开始用她的发卷勒住对方，同时她开始抓挠目标的头发，仿佛要一把把将其扯下来。目标因承受被勒住与头发被硬生生拔下的痛苦感觉而受到 @Damage[(2d8+7)[心灵]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:22|basic] 豁免），尽管他们实际上并没有真的被物理勒住，也没有失去头发。

(1 action) The haunt targets one creature in the shop at random, preferring targets who are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. The ghostly figure moves over to the victim and begins to strangle them with coils of her hair while she begins clawing through the target's hair as if ripping it out by the handful. The target takes @Damage[(2d8+7)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:22|basic] save) from enduring the painful sensations of being strangled and having their hair plucked out, even though they're not actually being physically strangled or losing their hair.

Giant Centipede.name: 巨蜈蚣 Giant Centipede

Giant Centipede Venom.name: 巨蜈蚣毒液 Giant Centipede Venom
Giant Centipede Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]]伤害（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d4[poison]]伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[1d4[poison]]伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 round)

Giant Centipede.publicNotes:
大多数巨蜈蚣（在城市中发现时被称为下水道蜈蚣）会以小群体筑巢，但在外出觅食时则会单独猎食。试图驯化巨蜈蚣，将其用作守护者或宠物的做法通常都会以糟糕的结果告终，但一些地精、狗头人和蹑影小魔怪的群落已经发展出了有效利用这些害虫作为守护者的方法。其他群体则会把蜈蚣烤来吃，常配上辛辣的椒类作为一道鲜香的美味，不过在处理这道菜时必须小心，以免巨蜈蚣的毒液污染其肉质。

蜈蚣是生活在粪便与腐屑中的猎食者和食腐者，是冒险者经常遭遇、且往往深恶痛绝的一种相对常见的威胁。它们沿着长而分节的身体上连接的数十条腿，以惊人的速度四处窜动，用带毒的颚骨发起打击，以凶恶的毒素拖慢并折磨猎物，随后才安顿下来，慢条斯理而令人作呕地进食。

Most giant centipedes (known as sewer centipedes when found in cities) nest in small groups but hunt alone when they seek out food. Attempts to domesticate giant centipedes for use as guardians or pets generally end poorly, but some communities of goblins, kobolds, and mitflits have developed effective methods of utilizing these vermin as guardians. Other groups roast and eat centipedes, often with pungent peppers as a savory delicacy, although care must be taken in preparing the meal to avoid tainting the flesh with the creature's venom.

Hunters and scavengers that live amid dung and detritus, centipedes are a relatively common and often reviled threat faced by adventurers. Scurrying about with surprising speed on the scores of legs attached to their long, segmented bodies, centipedes strike with poisoned mandibles to slow and torment their prey with a vicious toxin before they settle down to feed in slow and disgusting leisure.

Shortbow.name: 短弓 Shortbow
Shortbow.description:
这把较小的弓由一整块木头制成，深受散兵和骑兵青睐。

This smaller bow is made of a single piece of wood and favored by skirmishers and cavalry.

friendly female human cook

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Speak with Plants (Constant).name: 植物交谈（恒定）
Speak with Plants (Constant).description:
你可以向植物提问并从它们那里获得答案，但该法术不会让它们比平时更友善或更聪明。大多数普通植物对周围世界都有一种独特的看法，因此它们无法辨认关于生物的细节，也不知道其近旁之外世界的任何事情。狡猾的植物怪物往往言简意赅且闪烁其词，而较不聪明的那些则常常会发表一些无意义的评论。

You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Wall of Thorns.name: 棘墙术 Wall of Thorns
Wall of Thorns.description:
在一分钟内，你使一堵厚实的荆棘灌木墙从地面生长出来。你创造一堵厚5足、呈一直线、最长60足且高10足的荆棘与灌木墙。你必须在一片连续且开阔的空间中创造这堵墙，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术失效。墙体垂直竖立。若你愿意，墙也可以更短或更低。墙两侧的一切都可获得来自另一侧生物的掩蔽，而墙所占据的空间为困难地形。每当一个生物使用一个移动动作进入墙内至少一个空间时，该生物受到3d4点穿刺伤害。

墙体每个5足×5足的区块具有 AC 10、硬度 10 和 20 生命值。它免疫重击和精准伤害。被摧毁的区块可以被自由穿过。

强化（+1） 墙体每个区块的生命值增加5，且穿刺伤害增加1d4。

Over the course of a minute, you cause a thick wall of thorny brambles to grow from the ground. You create a 5-foot-thick wall of brambles and thorns in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall stands vertically. If you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall has cover from creatures on the opposite side, and the wall's spaces are difficult terrain. For every move action a creature uses to enter at least one of the wall's spaces, that creature takes 3d4 piercing damage.

Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points. It's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section can be moved through freely.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 5, and the piercing damage increases by 1d4.

Tanglefoot.name: 绊足术 Tanglefoot
Tanglefoot.description:
一根覆满黏稠树液的藤蔓凭空出现，从你的手中弹出并缠向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。

大成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足（状态）}状态，并在1轮内其速度获得–10足的环境减值。它可以对抗你的法术DC尝试挣脱，以移除该减值和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足（状态）}状态。

成功 目标在1轮内其速度获得–10足的环境减值。它可以对抗你的法术DC尝试挣脱，以移除该减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{法术效果：缠结藤蔓}

失败 目标不受影响。

强化（2环） 效果持续2轮。

强化（4环） 效果持续1分钟。

A vine covered in sticky sap appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack against the target.

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

Fleeting Existence.name: 短暂存在 Fleeting Existence
Fleeting Existence.description:
这些林鬼只是一次失败驱邪所产生的短暂显现。它们在思维空间中首次显现后经过1分钟便会消失。

These waldgeists are only fleeting manifestations of a failed exorcism. They vanish after 1 minute has passed from their first manifestation in the mindscape.

Lignify.name: 木质化 Lignify
Lignify.description:
林鬼的接触会将血肉转化为木头。被林鬼的木质化之手打击伤害到的活体生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22] 豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速2}）。此后，对木质化的豁免进一步失败会提高缓慢状态。一旦生物因木质化而使其动作减少至0，该生物便会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}，但它们会被转化为木头而非石头。

The touch of a waldgeist transforms flesh into wood. A living creature damaged by the waldgeist's lignifying hand Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure). Further failed saves against lignify increases the slowed condition. Once a creature's actions are reduced to 0 by lignify, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}, except they're transformed into wood instead of stone.

Willowshore Waldgeist.publicNotes:
林鬼会作为自然的化身行动，向污染、滥伐等破坏环境的行为寻求复仇。这些由被毁树木所化成的亡灵精魂，会在它们遭到毁灭的地点形成；若原址已被彻底夷平，则会在附近的林地中出现。它们会成为森林的守护者，掌控其边界内植物的力量。对于任何被发现正在破坏其所系结林地的人，林鬼都毫不留情，会同样带着敌意攻击伐木工、妖精、生物、旅人以及入侵物种。

当灾害降临自然世界时，可能会出现另一类亡灵，与复苏的人形生物截然不同。大多数植物、鱼类、昆虫以及其他动物，并不具备足够复杂的心理结构，无法在没有外力介入的情况下经历返回为亡灵所需的情感宣泄。大规模灭绝就可以成为这种外力。

人形生物将整片森林砍伐殆尽，或海边聚落灭绝某个对其生态系统至关重要的物种，都可能催生出绿辉石亡灵。垂死生物群系所汇聚的集体精神能量与情感痛苦，为这些亡灵提供力量，使其以聚合体或代言者的形式成形。

Waldgeists act as avatars of nature that seek vengeance for environmental abuse, such as pollution and deforestation. These undead spirits of destroyed trees form at the site of their destruction or in a nearby woodland, if the original location was entirely razed. They become guardians of the forest, possessing power over the plants within its boundaries. Waldgeists show no mercy to anyone caught damaging their bonded woodland, attacking loggers, fey, travelers, and invasive species with equal prejudice.

When disaster befalls the natural world, a different kind of undead may rise, entirely unlike risen humanoids. Most plants, fish, insects, and other animals don't possess a psychology complex enough to experience the emotional catharsis required to return as undead without intervention from an outside force. Mass extinction can serve as that outside force.

Humanoids clear-cutting an entire forest or a seaside community wiping out a species critical to their ecosystem can spawn a verdorite. The collective spiritual energy and emotional distress of a dying biome powers these undead, formed as conglomerates or representatives.

Read Omens.name: 阅读预兆 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥视未来。选择一个你计划在 1 周内进行的特定目标或行动，或者一个你预计可能在 1 周内发生的事件。你会得知一条神秘的线索或建议，能够帮助应对所选事件，通常会以谜语或预兆的形式出现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).name: 隐形术（随意施放）（仅限自身）
Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).description:
幻象扭曲目标周围的光，使其成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找该目标，从而使其改为对它们处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标使用敌对动作，它不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以确认魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你已完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但在外观上并不具欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

强化（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由游戏主持判定。

强化（4环） 如同3环，但你还会确定最高环阶魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知其精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到5足立方的范围内（若其大于该范围，则确定最近的5足立方）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且在 1 轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑} 状态。

升阶（3环） 你至多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Cacodaemonia.name: 恶魔祸乱 Cacodaemonia
Cacodaemonia.description:
狂躁邪魔可以与受该病影响的生物在同一位面上的任意距离进行心灵感应交流。

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:17]

阶段 1 携带者（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}（1天）

The cacodaemon can telepathically communicate with the afflicted creature at any distance on the same plane.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:17]

Stage 1 carrier (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 day)

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
• 蜥蜴

    • 速度 20尺
    • 近战 颚 +8（灵巧，娴熟），伤害 1d8+1 穿刺

  • 章鱼

    • 体型 小型
    • 速度 20尺，游泳 30尺

    • 近战 触手 +8（娴熟），伤害 1d8+1 钝击外加 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{抓取}
    • 近战 喙 +8（灵巧，娴熟），伤害 1d6 穿刺外加 2 毒素

  • 蝎子

    • 体型 小型
    • 速度 30尺
    • 技能 运动 +6

Soul Lock.name: 灵魂锁 Soul Lock
Soul Lock.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 狂躁邪魔吞食30尺内一个在过去1分钟内死亡的有感知生物的灵魂。如此做时，狂躁邪魔会在其腹中长出一颗拳头大小的灵魂宝石（硬度 2，HP 8），并且可以在任何时候以一个交互动作将其反刍吐出。摧毁这颗宝石会释放其中的灵魂，但不会让死去的生物复活。如果施法者试图让一个灵魂被困在灵魂宝石中的生物复活，则其会失败，除非其在一次@Check[religion|dc:30]检定中成功。成功会使灵魂宝石粉碎，使该生物如同该法术正常情况般复活。

邪魔可以用一个交互动作吞下其手持的灵魂宝石，将该灵魂打入邪魔的家乡位面。该邪魔获得快速治疗 5，持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.JgJ4Iw8BvJ4tWkah]{Effect: Soul Lock (Healing)}

Frequency once per day

Effect The cacodaemon ingests the soul of a sentient creature within 30 feet that died within the last minute. When they do, the cacodaemon grows a fist-sized soul gem (Hardness 2, HP 8) in their gut and can regurgitate it at any time as an Interact action. Destroying the gem frees the soul within but doesn't return the deceased creature to life. If a caster attempts to return to life a creature whose soul is trapped within a soul gem, they fail unless they succeed at a @Check[religion|dc:30] check. A success causes the soul gem to shatter so the creature is returned to life as normal for the spell.

A fiend can Interact to ingest a soul gem it is holding, condemning the soul to the fiend's home plane. The fiend gains fast healing 5 for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.JgJ4Iw8BvJ4tWkah]{Effect: Soul Lock (Healing)}

Cacodaemon.publicNotes:
这些暴力与恨意的扭曲化身诞生于阿巴顿迷雾中由愤怒而扭曲的灵魂形成的漩涡。狂躁邪魔永远饥渴于凡人的灵魂，并渴望制造痛苦。它们是由利齿、鳍与尖刺构成的咬噬球体，是邪魔种类中最弱小的一类，由各种细微死亡形式混杂而成，却不具备专注于单一致死原因所带来的力量。

邪魔是阿巴顿这片阴郁可怖位面的住民，由对一切生命形式之毁灭的执念所塑造，并奉献于此。它们以尽可能痛苦、尽可能可怖的方式寻求每一个凡人生物的死亡，以侍奉天启骑士。每一种邪魔都代表着一种不同的死亡方式，而它们的力量几乎总是致力于传播那种特定形式的死亡。借由运用这些力量，它们试图将一切存在拖入绝望与悲惨的深坑，并让所有灵魂归于湮灭。

尽管召唤邪魔的凡人通常是想利用这些生物的破坏与腐化之力来达成自己的目的，但邪魔总会寻找方法，在所到之处散播恐惧、怀疑与绝望。邪魔常常将自己的阴谋伪装成其他邪魔的所为，因为它们知道，这种混淆会加剧凡人的恐惧，并使那些凡人无法带来最有效的武器。因此，博学的凡人有时会根据它们的领袖称邪魔为“骑士”，或根据它们最大的产业称其为“灵魂贩子”。

许多邪魔都会引诱凡人过上虚无主义的邪恶生活，以增加自己在原生位面上的数量与力量；而邪魔除此之外，还受到一种对凡人灵魂的超自然饥渴驱使，并使用各种方法——其中尤其包括狂躁邪魔的灵魂宝石——来诱捕灵魂。在阿巴顿以及多元宇宙中其他险恶之地，灵魂同时是珍馐、贸易商品与魔法力量的来源，而邪魔则是这种精神“资源”最贪婪的饕餮者、商人和滥用者之一。

These twisted embodiments of violence and spite are spawned from eddies of angry and warped souls amid Abaddon's mists. Cacodaemons constantly hunger for mortal souls and yearn to create suffering. As gnashing spheres of teeth, fins, and spines, they are the weakest of daemonkind, an amalgam of various petty forms of death without the strength that comes from focusing on a single cause of demise.

Denizens of the bleak and terrible plane of Abaddon, daemons are shaped by and devoted to the destruction of life in all its forms. They seek the death of every mortal being by the most painful and horrible means possible, in service to the Apocalypse Riders. Each kind of daemon represents a different way to die, and their powers are nearly always aimed at spreading that particular form of death. Through the use of these powers, they seek to drag all existence down into a pit of hopelessness and despair, and to commit all souls to oblivion.

While mortals who summon daemons usually seek to use the creatures' destructive and corrupting powers for their own ends, daemons always look for ways to spread fear, doubt, and despair wherever they go. Often, daemons disguise their plots as the workings of other fiends, knowing that such confusion compounds mortals' fear and keeps those mortals from bringing the most effective weapons. As a result, learned mortals sometimes refer to daemons as "riders" after their leaders or "soul mongers" after their largest industry.

While many fiends seek to tempt mortals into lives of nihilistic evil to increase their own numbers and power on their native planes, daemons are further driven by a supernatural hunger for mortal souls and use a variety of methods—not least of which is the cacodaemons' soul gems—to entrap them. On Abaddon and in other forbidding places across the multiverse, souls are simultaneously a delicacy, a trade good, and a source of magical power, and the daemons are among the greatest gluttons, merchants, and abusers of this spiritual "resource."

Reincarnated Xin Yue.name: 转世的灵魂辛月 Reincarnated Xin Yue
Reincarnated Xin Yue.tokenName: 转世的灵魂辛月 Reincarnated Xin Yue

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Shatter.name: 粉碎音波 Shatter
Shatter.description:
高频声波攻击会粉碎附近的一个物体。你对该物体造成 2d10 点音波伤害；若该物体的硬度为 4 或更低，则无视其硬度。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10，且该法术可无视的硬度提高 2。

A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

Sound Burst.name: 音爆术 Sound Burst
Sound Burst.description:
刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋} 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入耳聋 1 分钟，并且处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你将恐惧植入目标心中；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并且处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态，持续1轮。

升环（3环） 你最多可以以五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造出一种由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类同时正常喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你不能创造可辨识的词语或其他复杂声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状况好得多或差得多。施放这个法术时，决定你是要让该物体看起来破旧不堪，还是完美无瑕。被伪装得破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。外观被改善的完好物品会看起来仿佛全新，并且经过高度抛光或精心维护。破损物品会显得完好且功能正常。被摧毁的物品无法受到此法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破这个幻象。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、未被持握的松散物体掷向目标；该物体的负载必须为1或更低。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则根据你所掷出物体的适当类型，造成等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值的钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被索闹杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为亡灵。对于任何将其所杀死的生物施加复活术或转化为亡灵的尝试，索闹都会自动尝试进行反制（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+11 #Counteract]]{+11}，反制环阶2）。如果杀死该生物的索闹本身被杀死，则该生物可以如常从死亡中被带回，或正常变成亡灵。

Creatures killed by a sojiruh are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The sojiruh automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+11 #Counteract]]{+11}, counteract rank 2). If the sojiruh who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Armor.name: 具现护甲 Manifest Armor
Manifest Armor.description:
索闹在其身体上显现出一层护甲，看起来由交错嵌合的骨骼与柳条编织而成，使其 AC 提高至 21。该护甲是永久性的，但如果索闹受到一次造成钝击、力场或挥砍伤害的打击重击，该护甲就会崩塌并消失，使其 AC 降回 17。

The sojiruh manifests a layer of armor on its body that appears to be made of interlocking bones and wicker weaves, increasing its AC to 21. The armor is permanent but collapses and vanishes if the sojiruh takes a critical hit from a Strike that inflicts bludgeoning, force, or slashing damage, reducing its AC back to 17.

Ruin Wielder.name: 持骸者 Ruin Wielder
Ruin Wielder.description:
当索闹持用一件破损的非魔法武器时，他们不会承受该武器处于破损状态的任何不利影响。只要索闹持用它，该武器就会变成一件+1武器，并在成功命中时额外造成1d6点心灵伤害。

When a sojiruh wields a broken non-magical weapon, they do not take any of the disadvantages of the weapon being broken. While the sojiruh wields it, the weapon becomes a +1 weapon that deals an additional 1d6 mental damage on a successful hit.

Stolen Scream.name: 窃取尖叫 Stolen Scream
Stolen Scream.description:
索闹以其30尺内一个它能看见的生物为目标，然后深吸一口气，制造出与该目标尖叫声完全相同的声音。目标生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:21]强韧豁免，之后它会在24小时内暂时免疫于该索闹的灵魂尖叫。如果该生物因窃取尖叫而变为惊惧，且它拥有前世，索闹恢复@Damage[(2d8+8)[healing]]生命值。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到@Damage[2d6[mental]]心灵伤害。

失败 该生物受到@Damage[4d6[mental]]心灵伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

大失败 该生物受到@Damage[8d6[mental]]心灵伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}。

The sojiruh targets a creature within 30 feet that it can see and then inhales, creating a sound identical to that of the target's scream. The targeted creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save, after which they're temporarily immune to that sojiruh's Soul Scream for 24 hours. If the creature becomes frightened as a result of Stolen Scream and has had a past life, the sojiruh restores @Damage[(2d8+8)[healing]] Hit Points.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Reincarnated Xin Yue.publicNotes:
一个索闹会在这样的时候诞生：某个生物曾用多个前世致力于追求开悟，却在死亡前背弃这些目标，并刻意将自己从转世轮回中强行撕离。此类怪物是最常见的宁多鲁，也是善解的信徒最为憎恨的一类，因为许多这样的邪魔，正是从这一哲学中堕落的成员里诞生的。

这种宁多鲁尤其迷恋多次转世之灵魂的滋味，并且认为，当肉体仍活着、仍在尖叫时吞食其生命力，味道才最为鲜美。对索闹而言，它所进食之身体发出的完美尖啸，就如同晚餐时与美酒的绝妙搭配。

索闹的嘴被它自己的一缕缕头发缝死。尽管如此，它们仍能自由说话，那空洞回响般的声音会清晰地从封死的双唇中传出。只有在它们选择发出尖啸与惨叫时，才会扯开这些缝线。它们的双臂细长，仿佛已经折断；而它们的胸口几乎只剩下一副肋笼，里面塞满了潮湿鲜红的蝴蝶，这些蝴蝶在生物的肋骨与器官间爬行、攀附。当索闹尖叫时，它胸腔内那些蝴蝶的翅膀便会疯狂振动。

索闹象征着转世轮回脱离纯净、陷入腐朽与堕落后的模样。

当一个曾多次转世的邪恶凡俗灵魂被强行从灵魂轮回中扯离并遭到腐化时，它就可能经历可怖的变化，化作一种名为宁多鲁的邪魔。作为熵增与循环破坏的力量，宁多鲁是丑恶骇人的生物，它们的身体常呈现扭曲畸变之态，挥舞着已经碎裂却仍能发挥作用的武器，而它们真正的面容往往藏而不露。它们展现出一些你可能会在不死生物身上见到的特征，例如腐朽的血肉或裸露的骨骼，但宁多鲁毫无疑问依然活着。

每一种宁多鲁都体现着某种特定循环的断裂，这种循环可能来自自然世界，也可能来自社会传统。对宁多鲁而言，没有什么比吞食一个多次转生的生物更美味，而那些理论上即将升至真正开悟境界者，更是最可口的盛宴。被宁多鲁杀死的受害者，自身也会被撕离轮回——幸运者会前往骨园接受审判，但更多则会被腐化，进而化作更多这种可怖的邪魔。

善解的信徒认为宁多鲁尤其可憎，并将其视作可以想象到的最大威胁之一。宁多鲁最常出现于世上转世轮回最为强烈的地区，而且和罗刹、恶鬼一样，它们与物质位面的关联最为紧密。

转世的灵魂

在某些情况下，你会知道一个遭宁多鲁攻击的生物是否拥有转世的灵魂。像轮回裔这样的族裔总是转世的灵魂，而玩家角色的背景故事，甚至其背景，也常能表明其前世的存在。《肆季鬼志》中的所有玩家角色都属于转世的灵魂，因为他们数十年来一遍又一遍重历自己的人生。如果你需要为了裁定宁多鲁的能力而判定某个生物的灵魂是否是转世的灵魂，进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]——若成功，则其拥有转世的灵魂。

灵堕魔半神

最强大的宁多鲁乃是半神，尽管崇拜它们的教团相当罕见。它们在死亡后容易再次转生，因此像苦迦菩提这样的宁多鲁半神，更准确的称呼应是“灵堕魔苦行者”。

灵堕魔叛徒

尽管大多数宁多鲁本性上都是纯粹的混乱邪恶，传说中仍有极其罕见的宁多鲁能够摆脱自身天性并获得升华，在死亡后转生为神使或其他更为仁善的精魂，并在此过程中褪去仁灯如特征。当然，在其余宁多鲁看来，这些“叛徒”正是世上最美味可口的猎物。

灵堕魔蝴蝶

各种宁多鲁所共享的最奇异特征之一，便是那些似乎总在它们周围盘旋、栖居于它们身体之上，或不时从其伤口中浮现的血红色蝴蝶。这些令人不安的昆虫，是宁多鲁思想的显现，并象征着它们曾经历却又亲手背弃的无数前世。一旦灵堕魔蝴蝶拍动翅膀离开源头超过几尺，它们便不会存在太久，而是会化作迅速消散于空气中的烟雾。

其他灵堕魔

除了这些页面中介绍的四种之外，还存在许多其他类型的宁多鲁。其他种类包括：会复制尸体的阿卡什提斯（啜泣灵堕魔）、被称为社会渗透者的影隐熊（潜伏灵堕魔）、亵渎亡者的尸萨吉辛（歪曲灵堕魔），以及强大而残暴的阿耳癸耳宙斯（无头灵堕魔）。

A sojiruh comes into existence when a creature who has dedicated multiple lives to achieving enlightenment turns their back on these goals and deliberately tears themselves away from the cycle of reincarnation before their death. These monstrous creatures are the most common nindoru and are also the most hated by followers of Sangpotshi, since so many of these fiends rise from fallen members of that very philosophy.

This type of nindoru relishes the flavor of an oft-reincarnated soul and finds this life force tastes best when consumed while the physical body still lives and screams. To sojiruhs, the sound of a perfect scream from the body it feeds upon is akin to the perfect wine pairing with dinner.

A sojiruh's mouth is stitched shut with lengths of its own hair. Despite this, they can speak freely, their hollow-sounding voices issuing clearly from sealed lips. They only stretch these stitches when they choose to shriek and scream. Their arms are long and broken-looking, while their chests are little more than rib cages filled with red wet butterflies that crawl through and cling to the creature's ribs and organs. When a sojiruh screams, the wings of the butterflies in its chest flutter frantically.

Sojiruhs symbolize the cycle of reincarnation come undone from its purity and becoming mired in decay and corruption.

When an evil mortal soul that has been reincarnated multiple times is wrenched from the cycle of souls and corrupted, it can undergo a horrific transformation into a fiend known as a nindoru. A force for entropy and the breaking of cycles, nindorus are hideous creatures whose bodies often appear distorted, who wield weapons that have been shattered yet still function, and whose true face is often hidden from view. They display traits one might expect to see in an undead creature, such as decaying flesh or exposed bones, yet a nindoru is very much still alive.

Each nindoru epitomizes the fracture of a specific cycle, be it one from the natural world or from societal traditions. To the nindoru, nothing is more delicious than the consumption of a creature who has reincarnated multiple times, with those who are theoretically about to ascend to true enlightenment presenting the tastiest meal. Those slain by a nindoru are themselves torn from the cycle—the lucky ones move on to the Boneyard for judgment, but many are instead corrupted to form more of these horrific fiends.

Followers of Sangpotshi find nindoru to be particularly abhorrent and count them among the greatest threats imaginable. Most commonly found in regions of the world where the reincarnation cycle is strongest, nindorus are, like rakshasas and oni, associated most strongly with the Material Plane.

Reincarnated Souls

In some cases, you'll know if a creature a nindoru attacks has a reincarnated soul. Ancestries like samsarans are always reincarnated souls, and a PC's backstory or even their background can often indicate the presence of a previous life. All of the PCs in Season of Ghosts qualify as reincarnated souls, as they've relived their lives over and over for decades. If you ever need to determine if a creature's soul is reincarnated for the purpose of adjudicating a nindoru's ability, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]—on a success, it has a reincarnated soul.

Nindoru Demigods

The most powerful nindorus are demigods, although their cults are quite rare. Prone to reincarnation after death, nindoru demigods like Kugaptee are more properly known as "nindoru ascetics."

Nindoru Traitors

While most nindorus are purely chaotic evil in nature, legends tell of exceptionally rare nindorus who manage to escape their own nature and ascend, reincarnating after death into kami or other more benevolent spirits and shedding the nindoru trait as they do so. Of course, these "traitors" are regarded as the most delicious meals imaginable by the nindorus left behind.

Nindoru Butterflies

One of the strangest shared traits of the various types of nindoru are the blood-red butterflies that seem to follow them around, nest on their bodies, or periodically emerge from their wounds. These unnerving insects are physical manifestations of the nindorus' thoughts and symbolize the countless past lives they once lived but turned their backs on. Nindoru butterflies never last long once they flutter more than a few feet from their source, fading away into smoke that quickly dissipates into the air.

Other Nindorus

Many other types of nindorus exist beyond the four presented on these pages. Others include the corpse-copying akashtis (sobbing nindorus), infiltrators of society known as kagekumas (lurking nindorus), the dead defiling shisagishins (crooked nindorus), and the powerful and brutal argyrzeis (headless nindorus).
Reincarnated Xin Yue.prototypeToken: 转生者辛月 Reincarnated Xin Yue

Yuli Sanmi.name: 三美裕里 Yuli Sanmi

Serving Platter.name: 盛菜盘 Serving Platter
Serving Platter.description:
这种非常小巧的盾牌深受决斗家和行动敏捷、穿着轻甲的战士喜爱。它通常由钢制成，并绑在你的前臂上。只要你的那只手空着，或者那只手持有一个不是武器的轻型物体，你就可以用你的圆盾使用举起护盾。

硬度 HP BT
3 6 3

This very small shield is a favorite of duelists and quick, lightly armored warriors. It's typically made of steel and strapped to your forearm. You can Raise a Shield with your buckler as long as you have that hand free or are holding a light object that's not a weapon in that hand.

Hardness HP BT
3 6 3

Servant's Uniform.name: 仆役制服 Servant's Uniform
Servant's Uniform.description:
普通服装具有基本剪裁、注重实用性，例如农民衣着、僧袍或工作服。

Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

Protective Platter.name: 防护拼盘 Protective Platter
Protective Platter.description:
仆役可以使用“举起护盾”动作举起他们的盛菜盘。该盘子的属性与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1k3AsSW7lpU0kEpY]{圆盾} 相同，但需要一只手来持握。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.4hfQEMiEOBbqelAh]{举起护盾}

The servant can raise their serving platter using the Raise a Shield action. The platter has the same statistics as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1k3AsSW7lpU0kEpY]{Buckler} but requires a hand to hold.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.4hfQEMiEOBbqelAh]{Raise a Shield}

Quick Catch.name: 快速接住 Quick Catch
Quick Catch.description:
触发 一个仆役能用单手持握的物体在仆役的触及内掉落

需求 该仆役至少有一只手是空着的

效果 仆役在掉落的物体击中地板或离开其触及之前接住它。

Trigger An object the servant could hold in one hand is dropped within the servant's reach

Requirements The servant has at least one hand free

Effect The servant catches the dropped object before it hits the floor or leaves their reach.

Raise a Shield.name: 举起护盾 Raise a Shield
Raise a Shield.description:
需求 你正持用一面盾牌。

你调整盾牌的位置来保护自己。当你已举起盾牌时，你获得其列出的 AC 环境加值。你的盾牌会保持举起状态，直到你下个回合开始时。

Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You position your shield to protect yourself. When you have Raised a Shield, you gain its listed circumstance bonus to AC. Your shield remains raised until the start of your next turn.

Lore (any one subcategory related to the.name: 学识（与其工作相关的任一子类别，例如酒精学识、烘焙学识或家务学识）

Yuli Sanmi.publicNotes:
仆役可能是女仆或男管家，维持家宅正常运转，也可能是旅店等场所的侍者，负责点单并为顾客服务。

社群建立在劳工的肩背之上。

A servant might be a maid or butler, keeping a home in working order, or a server in an establishment like an inn, taking orders and serving customers.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.

Slain Nindoru.name: 被杀死的灵堕魔 Slain Nindoru
Slain Nindoru.tokenName: 被杀死的灵堕魔 Slain Nindoru

Greatsword.name: 巨剑 Greatsword
Greatsword.description:
这把巨大的双手剑几乎和其持用者一样高。它靠近剑柄的下半段剑刃通常会稍微磨钝，以便在近身战斗中握持，从而获得额外的杠杆优势。

This immense two-handed sword is nearly as tall as its wielder. Its lower blade is often somewhat dulled to allow it to be gripped for extra leverage in close-quarter fights.

Slain Nindoru.hazarddescription:
这把银武器应当是一种由其中一名玩家角色偏好的挥砍武器

This silver weapon should be a slashing weapon of a type favored by one of the PCs
Slain Nindoru.prototypeToken: 被杀死的灵堕魔 Slain Nindoru

False Bottom.name: 假底部 False Bottom

Sheet of Fine Spidersilk.name: 优质蜘蛛丝绸布料 Sheet of Fine Spidersilk

Jiang-Shi Bell.name: 僵尸铃 Jiang-Shi Bell
Jiang-Shi Bell.description:
这只华丽的手铃摇响时会发出洪亮的低音，仿佛声音来自一口比手持铃大得多的钟。铃身以银制成，并抛光至可映出倒影的光泽；铃的木柄则雕刻着各种食物的精细图案。你可以与僵尸铃进行交互，将其挥舞来对抗僵尸吸血鬼。若一只僵尸因僵尸铃被挥舞而获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}状态，它必须奔跑直到至少离开20足远。它在任何试图克服对该物体厌恶感的意志豁免上承受-2减值。

启动 2 构想，交互（嗅觉、视觉）

频率 每天一次

效果 你摇响铃铛，在你30足内任一你能看见的位置、一个5足见方区域中的祭坛上，制造出一桌看起来美味可口的食物茶饭的幻象。任何必须靠进食维生的生物，只要位于该幻象食物30足内，就必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:28]豁免，否则便会因食物的色香所分心，并因此被其吸引10分钟，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷}状态。

这些食物的外观可以触发任何僵尸的苦涩顿悟弱点；若食物确实如此，该僵尸在抵抗此弱点效果的意志豁免上承受–2物品减值。

This ornate handbell creates a sonorous low-pitched tone when rung, as if sounding from a much larger bell than one carried in the hand. The bell is crafted of silver and polished to a reflective sheen, while the bell's wooden handle is carved with detailed images of various foodstuffs. You can interact with a jiang-shi bell to brandish it against a jiang-shi vampire. If a jiang-shi gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition as a result of a jiang-shi bell being brandished, they must run until they're at least 20 feet away. They take a -2 penalty to the Will save to any attempt to overcome their revulsion toward this object.

Activate 2 envision, Interact (olfactory, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You ring the bell and create an illusory image of a delicious-looking banquet of food laid out on an altar in a 5-foot-square at any point within 30 feet of you that you can see. Any creature that must eat food to survive that's within 30 feet of the appearance of the illusory food must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:28] save or be so distracted by the food's sight and smell that they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by it for 10 minutes.

This food's appearance can trigger any jiang-shi's Bitter Epiphany weakness; if the food does so, the jiang-shi takes a –2 item penalty to its Will save to resist the effects of this weakness.

False Bottom.hazarddescription:
在箱子内部进行搜索的玩家角色可以通过一次成功的 @Check[perception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定发现假底部。

A PC who Searches inside the chest can spot the false bottom with a successful @Check[perception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check.

Arcane Innate Spells.name: 奥术内在法术 Arcane Innate Spells

Fireball.name: 火球术 Fireball
Fireball.description:
一道轰鸣的爆裂火焰在你指定的位置引爆，造成 6d6 火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你让目标周围的时间流膨胀，减缓其动作。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以将10个生物作为目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Acid Arrow.name: 强酸箭 Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description:
你 conjure 一支酸液箭矢，命中后会持续腐蚀目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。若命中，你造成 3d8 点酸液伤害外加 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] 持续伤害。若大成功，初始伤害翻倍，但持续伤害不翻倍。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加 2d8，持续酸液伤害增加 1d6。

You conjure an arrow of acid that keeps corroding the target after it hits. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Mirror Image.name: 镜影术 Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
三个你的幻象影像在你的空间周围盘旋，可能使那些攻击你的人改为击中其中一个影像，而不是你。任何本会命中你的攻击，都会有一定的随机几率改为命中你的一个影像而非你。如果三个影像都还存在，则有 1/4 的几率命中你（[[/r 1d4]] 掷出 1）。若还剩两个影像，则有 1/3 的几率命中你（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1–2）。若只剩一个影像，则几率为 1/2（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1–3）。

一旦某个影像被命中，它就会被摧毁。如果一次攻击掷骰未能命中你的 AC，但也没有大失败，则会摧毁一个影像，但不会产生额外效果（即使该攻击通常会在失败时产生某种效果）。如果一次攻击掷骰为大成功，且本会命中某个影像，则会摧毁其中一个影像，且该攻击掷骰改为对你成功。当所有影像都被摧毁后，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: 镜影术}

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d4]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on [[/r 1d6]]).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}

Electric Arc.name: 电弧击 Electric Arc
Electric Arc.description:
一道闪电弧从一个目标跃向另一个目标。每个目标受到 2d4 点电击伤害，并进行一次基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Enfeeble.name: 虚弱化 Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description:
你削弱目标的力量，效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}，直到你的下一回合开始。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱3}，持续1分钟。

You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

Force Barrage.name: 力场弹幕 Force Barrage
Force Barrage.description:
你向一个你能看见的生物发射一枚凝固的魔法碎片。它会自动命中，并造成1d4+1点力场伤害。施放该法术时，你每额外使用1个动作，发射的碎片数量便增加1，最多可在3个动作内发射3枚碎片。你为每枚碎片分别选择目标。如果你向同一目标发射多于一枚碎片，则先合并伤害，再应用伤害加值或减值、抗力、弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你每花费1个动作，就额外发射1枚碎片。

You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

Ray of Frost.name: 霜冻射线 Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
你发射出一道冰冷射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰。该射线造成 2d4 点寒冷伤害。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害，并且其速度在 1 轮内受到 –10 足的状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{法术效果：霜冻射线}

成功 目标承受正常伤害。

升环（+1） 伤害提高 1d4。

You blast an icy ray. Make a spell attack roll. The ray deals 2d4 cold damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

Success The target takes normal damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

False Weapon.name: 虚假武器 False Weapon
False Weapon.description:
无面鬼模仿者携带一把+1强击武器，其外观与所模仿的玩家角色所偏好的武器完全相同。如果该玩家角色偏好徒手打击，它就会呈现为手部缠带。如果该玩家角色偏好远程武器，则无面鬼模仿者没有近战武器，改为使用上方的远程武器规则；否则，无面鬼模仿者没有远程武器。如果该玩家角色不偏好任何武器，则无面鬼会将一根短棒作为其虚假武器。这件虚假武器只有部分是真实的，命中时只造成精神伤害；它不会获得原武器的任何特征或魔法强化。如果无面鬼模仿者的虚假武器破损、被缴械或被放下，它就会消失。无面鬼模仿者可以花费10分钟重新制造一件虚假武器作为替代品。

A noppera-bo impersonator carries a +1 striking weapon that looks identical to the favored weapon of the PC being impersonated. If the PC favors unarmed strikes, it appears as hand wraps. If the PC favors a ranged weapon, then the noppera-bo impersonator has no melee weapon and instead uses the ranged weapon rules above; otherwise, the noppera-bo impersonator has no ranged weapon. If the PCs favors no weapon, then the noppera-bo wields a club as its false weapon. This false weapon is only partially real and inflicts only mental damage when it hits; it gains none of the original weapon's traits or magical enhancements. If a noppera-bo impersonator's false weapon is broken, disarmed, or set down, it fades away. The noppera-bo impersonator can craft a replacement false weapon by spending 10 minutes to recreate one.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸鬼没有视觉，但他们的听觉非常敏锐。他们不需要呼吸，并且免疫任何需要呼吸的效果。他们通过皮肤吸收液体来获取养分——传统上是将双手或无脸的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；他们也可以用这种方式从消耗品中获益，例如药水或灵药。

The noppera-bo has no sense of vision, but their hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，它们就会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

As long as the noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonated Spellcasting.name: 模仿者施法 Impersonated Spellcasting
Impersonated Spellcasting.description:
无面鬼模仿者获得一组天生法术，与其所模仿的玩家角色所使用的施法根源相匹配。你可以调整这些法术，使其更完美地契合该次模仿。

The noppera-bo impersonator gains a suites of innate spells, matching the spellcasting tradition utilized by the PC being impersonated. You can adjust the spells to make a more perfect fit for the impersonation.

Will-o'-Wisp.name: 鬼火 Will-o'-Wisp

Glow.name: 发光 Glow
Glow.description:
20尺。

鬼火自身天生处于隐形状态，但会发出有色光芒，在灵气范围内投射明亮光照，并使其变得可见。

20 feet.

A will-o'-wisp is itself naturally invisible, but glows with a colored light, casting bright light in the aura and making it visible.

Magic Immunity.name: 魔法免疫 Magic Immunity
Magic Immunity.description:
鬼火免疫除@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{力场弹幕}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{进退维谷}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{显形光芒}之外的所有法术。

A will-o'-wisp is immune to all spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}.

Feed on Fear.name: 以恐惧为食 Feed on Fear
Feed on Fear.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 15尺内的一名敌人正处于恐惧效果影响下或濒死

效果 鬼火以该生物的恐惧为食。它恢复 @Damage[2d4[healing]]{2d4 生命值}，且如果它处于遁入幽暗状态，它的发光会重新点燃。

Frequency once per round

Requirements An enemy within 15 feet is under a fear effect or dying

Effect The will-o'-wisp feeds on the creature's terror. It regains @Damage[2d4[healing]]{2d4 Hit Points}, and if it has Gone Dark, its glow reignites.

Go Dark.name: 变暗 Go Dark
Go Dark.description:
鬼火熄灭其发光，变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。它可以再次使用这个动作来结束此效果。如果它在隐形时使用其震慑攻击，电弧会让任何观察者确定其位置，使鬼火在它移动之前，对所有观察者都仅为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}。

The will-o'-wisp extinguishes its glow, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. It can end this effect with another use of this action. If it uses its shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine its location, making the will-o'-wisp only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to all observers until it moves.

Will-o'-Wisp.publicNotes:
怀有恶意的彩色光球，鬼火常出没于荒僻的沼泽和森林，在那里它们引诱毫无戒心的旅人步入险境。鬼火能够改变自己散发出的颜色与亮度，并乐于模仿摇曳的提灯或远处的火光，把迷路或辨不清方向的旅人从安全的小路上引开。它们还能将自身的光亮完全熄灭，从而变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}，而且一旦受害者彻底迷失，并意识到远处那团摇晃的光其实根本不会把自己引向安全之地，它们就尤其喜欢这么做。然而，即使在隐形时，鬼火也很少会远离自己的目标，因为它以受害者感受到的惊慌与恐惧为食。

在它的发光之下，鬼火的身体是一团海绵状球体，直径约为1足，重量不足5磅。尽管大多数鬼火都只是半透明、毫无特征的光球，只有在它们制造出的变幻光照中才显出些许轮廓，但也有少数鬼火带有黑色斑驳，近看时会像一颗骷髅。鬼火不需要凡俗的食物，事实上，它们也没有摄取任何物质的能力；它们所需的一切养分都来自附近生物的恐惧。因此，它们喜欢与能够在受害者心中制造恐惧的不死生物协同行动。一个被吓住或击败的鬼火，可能会成为学识与情报的良好来源，不过要从这样一种阴险的怪物那里获得合作，绝非易事。

鬼火栖息于荒凉的沼泽和森林，通常在黄昏及入夜后活动。因此，它们不太愿意把受害者引入那种会立刻致命的区域，例如枯木坠落地带；相反，它们更偏好那些会让受害者长时间受苦的危害，例如污浊或有毒空气的积聚处、流沙地带，以及更大型怪物的巢穴。据鬼火所说，不同类型的恐惧在“风味”上有着微妙差别。那种盘踞在胃底、缓慢啃噬着逐渐意识到自己迷路之人的潜伏恐惧，与面对高大怪物、死亡迫在眉睫时骤然爆发的鲜明惊骇，尝起来截然不同。正因如此，鬼火会尽量变化自己在猎物身上诱发恐惧的方式，以确保自己不会对某几种恐惧的滋味感到厌倦。

Malevolent balls of colored light, will-o'-wisps haunt lonely marshes and forests, where they lure unsuspecting travelers into danger. Will-o'-wisps can vary the color and illumination they shed, and delight in mimicking bobbing lanterns or distant fires to draw lost or disoriented travelers off of safe trails. They can extinguish their illumination entirely to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, and they enjoy doing so once their victims are wholly lost and have realized that the bobbing light in the distance isn't, in fact, leading them to safety. Even invisible, however, a will-o'-wisp rarely ventures far from its target, as it feasts upon the panic and dread felt by its victims.

Beneath its glow, a will-o'-wisp's body is a spongy ball approximately 1 foot in diameter and weighing less than 5 pounds. Although most will-o'-wisps are merely translucent, featureless orbs, gaining definition only in the shifting illumination they create, a few have dark mottling that makes them resemble a skull when viewed closely. Will-o'-wisps have no need for mundane nourishment, and in fact, lack the ability to consume matter of any kind; they find all the sustenance they need in the terror of nearby creatures. For this reason, they like to work alongside undead that produce terror in their victims. Will-o'-wisps are long-lived, if not effectively immortal, and they have good memories. A cowed or defeated will-o'-wisp can be a good source of lore and information, though acquiring such cooperation from such a sinister monster is no easy feat.

Will-o'-wisps inhabit desolate swamps and forests and are generally active at twilight and after dark. They are therefore reluctant to lead victims into immediately fatal areas such as deadfalls, but instead prefer hazards where their victims suffer over a long time, such as pockets of stale or poisonous air, patches of quicksand, and dens of bigger monsters. According to will-o'-wisps, different types of fear have subtle differences in flavor. The lurking dread in the pit of the stomach that gnaws at those who slowly become aware of the fact that they're lost produces a much different taste than the sudden, stark terror of imminent death in the face of a towering monster. Because of this, will-o'-wisps try to vary the ways in which they induce terror in their prey, to ensure they don't tire of certain flavors of fear.

Moonsilver Necklace.name: 月银项链 Moonsilver Necklace
Moonsilver Necklace.description:
与自然谐和者深知生命的无常与灵魂的迁徙。正如月有盈亏，生命之烛也会被点燃与熄灭。制作此物品的仪式需要在直接月光下献祭一只动物，人们相信，以这种方式被献祭的生物会蒙受祝福，得以转生到更美好的来生。佩戴这条银质新月形项链时，你的徒手近战打击视为银武器，并具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}符文的属性。

Those who are in tune with nature understand well the transience of life and the migration of souls. Just as the moon waxes and wanes, so too are the candles of life lit and extinguished. The ritual for creating this item requires an animal sacrifice in direct moonlight, the belief being that creatures sacrificed in this way are blessed to reincarnate into better lives. While wearing this silver, crescent-shaped necklace, your unarmed melee Strikes are silver weapons with the properties of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} rune.

Destroyed Skyfang Crystal.name: 被毁坏的天牙水晶 Destroyed Skyfang Crystal
Destroyed Skyfang Crystal.description:
一块被毁坏的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.vSctvZGoJYTHjpZV]{天牙水晶}，一种用于防护邪魔和亡灵的魔法物品；这块水晶被一股超出其防护能力的强大力量毁坏，如今不过是一件价值 5 gp 的好奇之物。

A destroyed @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.vSctvZGoJYTHjpZV]{Skyfang Crystal}, a magical item used to ward against fiends and undead; this crystal was ruined by a potent force beyond its power to shelter against and is now merely a curiosity worth 5 gp.

Kugaptee's Drakauthix.name: 苦迦菩提的德拉考希克斯 Kugaptee's Drakauthix

Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 孢视（模糊）60尺 Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet
Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet.description:
德拉考希斯散发出一团它用来视物的孢子云。这是一种模糊感官，且仅在没有强烈风流的区域内起作用。孢视在水下不起作用。

The drakauthix exudes a cloud of spores that it uses to see. This is an imprecise sense that functions only in areas without strong wind currents. Sporesight does not function underwater.

Obscuring Spores.name: 遮蔽孢子 Obscuring Spores
Obscuring Spores.description:
每当德拉考希斯受到至少 @Damage[10[slashing]] 伤害时，它都会在一个 @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] 内释放一团棕色孢子云，持续1分钟（或直到被强风驱散）。孢子内的所有生物都会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，而孢子外的所有生物对于孢子内的生物而言也会变为隐蔽。在这团孢子云内，德拉考希斯的孢子视觉会变为精确感官。孢子云不会随德拉考希斯一起移动，也不会因它的移动而被带动。

Whenever the drakauthix takes at least @Damage[10[slashing]] damage, it releases a cloud of brown spores in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] that persists for 1 minute (or until dispersed by a strong wind). All creatures within the spores become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the spores become concealed to creatures within it. Within this cloud of spores, the drakauthix's sporesight becomes a precise sense. The spore cloud does not move with the drakauthix nor is it displaced by its movement.

Reel In.name: 卷回 Reel In
Reel In.description:
德拉考希斯将所有被其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}的生物拉近至距其自身15尺处。

The drakauthix pulls all creatures it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 15 feet closer to itself.

Spore Tendrils.name: 孢子触须 Spore Tendrils
Spore Tendrils.description:
覆盖德拉考希斯身体的触须会向外伸出并侵染邻近的生物，造成@Damage[4d6[poison]]伤害和@Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic]豁免；被德拉考希斯@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}的生物在此次豁免中承受–4环境减值）。

The tendrils that cover the drakauthix's body reach out and infest adjacent creatures, dealing @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save; a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the drakauthix takes a –4 circumstance penalty to this save).

Whirlwind of Hooks.name: 钩旋风 Whirlwind of Hooks
Whirlwind of Hooks.description:
德拉考希斯旋转身躯，鞭打其周围的生物。它对触及内的每个生物进行一次触手打击。这些攻击计入德拉考希斯的多重攻击减值，但在德拉考希斯完成其所有攻击之前，多重攻击减值不会增加。

The drakauthix whirls, whipping creatures around it. It makes a tentacle Strike against every creature within reach. These attacks count toward the drakauthix's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the drakauthix makes all its attacks.

Kugaptee's Drakauthix.publicNotes:
德拉考希斯是一种巨大的真菌，漂浮在幽暗地域最大洞穴的高处，依靠喷射空气与孢子的囊体推进。德拉考希斯是贪婪却行动缓慢的猎食者，偏好从上方伏击多肉的生物，用它带钩的附肢将受害者向上拖拽以进食。德拉考希斯的消化过程完全在体外进行——它会附着在受害者身上，随后其布满孢子的表面会缓慢啃食血肉并向内生长，最后再将被孢子感染的尸体丢弃。当这具受感染的身体撞击下方地面时，便会爆裂并释放出一团孢子云，放出一群被称为孢生幼体的幼崽，它们会立刻窸窣着爬上洞窟墙壁，附着在天花板上继续生长。

德拉考希斯的行为并不比大多数掠食性动物更聪明，它常常利用一种近似共生的食腐方式来确保猎物，借助它常出没的大型洞穴系统中软泥怪与害虫的狩猎方式。当某个相对无心智的生物杀死受害者后，德拉考希斯便会飘降下来，用它的触须钩住新鲜死去的尸体，并将这顿食物卷回。那个刚被偷走食物的无心智软泥怪或其他生物很少会心怀怨念，通常只是滑走去寻找新的猎物，让德拉考希斯安静地消化尸体。当然，德拉考希斯也并不排斥享用更活跃的猎物；若冒险者在探索一片神秘洞穴网络时疏于抬头警戒上方的危险，它也可能发动攻击。

一些栖居于幽暗地域的生物，例如灰矮人，会为了它们的肉而狩猎德拉考希斯；这种肉带有独特的风味，并有辛辣的回味。地下诸族也会以德拉考希斯制墨：他们焚烧其尸体，再将灰烬长时间研磨并压榨，直到一种银色物质凝结出来。

The drakauthix is a massive fungus that floats through the heights of the largest Darklands caverns, propelled by bladders that spray air and spores. A voracious but slow-moving hunter, the drakauthix prefers to ambush meaty creatures from above, using its hooked appendages to pull its victims upward to feed. The drakauthix's digestive process is entirely external-it clings to victims, and its spore-laden surface slowly feeds on and grows through the flesh before the spore-infested carcass is discarded. As the infested body strikes the ground below, it bursts and releases a cloud of spores, unleashing a host of young called sporelings that immediately scuttle up the cavern walls to cling to its ceiling and grow.

The drakauthix behaves no more intelligently than most predatory animals, and often uses a sort of symbiotic scavenger method to secure prey by capitalizing on the hunting methods of oozes and vermin found in the large cave systems it frequents. When a relatively mindless creature kills a victim, the drakauthix drifts down, hooks the freshly slain carcass with its tendrils, and reels in its meal. The mindless ooze or other creature that just had its food stolen rarely holds a grudge and simply slithers off to find a new quarry, letting the drakauthix digest the corpse in peace. Of course, the drakauthix isn't above feasting on more active prey as well, and might attack an adventurer who neglects to look upward for danger when exploring a network of mysterious caves.

Some Darklands-dwelling creatures, such as duergars, hunt drakauthixes for their flesh, which has a unique flavor with a peppery aftertaste. Subterranean races also make ink from drakauthixes by burning their carcasses, then grinding and pressing the ashes for a long time until a silvery substance congeals.
