Ijda.name: 爱怛魔 Ijda

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Shatter.name: 粉碎音波 Shatter
Shatter.description:
高频声波攻击会粉碎附近的一个物体。你对该物体造成 2d10 点音波伤害；如果该物体的硬度为 4 或更低，则无视其硬度。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10 点，且该法术所无视的硬度提高 2。

A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

Touch of Idiocy.name: 愚者之触 Touch of Idiocy
Touch of Idiocy.description:
你钝化目标的心智，效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续 1 分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 3}，持续 1 分钟。

You dull the target's mind, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，以一次心灵冲击使其眩晕。这次冲击造成 1d6 点心灵伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标的豁免大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状态好得多或差得多。施放此法术时，选择你要让该物体看起来破败不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装成破败的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。一个完好的物品若被伪装得更好，会显得仿佛崭新出厂，并且高度抛光或保养良好。一个破损物品会显得完好且可用。被摧毁的物品不能成为此法术的影响对象。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破这个幻觉。

升环（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升环（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成 2d4 点心灵伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到全部初始伤害，但不会受到持续伤害，且法术立即结束。

失败 目标受到全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，则持续伤害结束且法术结束。

大失败 如失败，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升环（+1） 伤害增加 2d4，持续伤害增加 1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

True Strike.name: 真实打击 True Strike
True Strike.description:
对未来的一瞥确保你的下一击精准命中。在你的回合结束前，下一次你进行攻击掷骰时，掷两次攻击并采用较好的结果。该攻击无视攻击掷骰的处境减值，以及因目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}而需要进行的任何纯骰检定。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：真实打击}

A glimpse into the future ensures your next blow strikes true. The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll the attack twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

Aura of Forgetfulness.name: 健忘灵光 Aura of Forgetfulness
Aura of Forgetfulness.description:
30尺。任何在灵光中开始其回合的生物都必须尝试进行一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并在24小时内暂时免疫健忘灵光。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物因难以记起自己原本打算做什么，而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到其下个回合结束。

大失败 如失败，但为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速2}。

30 feet. A creature who begins its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Aura of Forgetfulness for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn, as it has trouble remembering what it intended to do.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被爱怛魔杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为不死生物。对于任何试图对其所杀死的生物施放复活术或将其转化为不死生物的尝试，爱怛魔都会自动进行反制（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+14 #Counteract]]{+14}，反制等级 3）。如果杀死该生物的爱怛魔本身被杀死，那么该生物便可以如常从死亡中归来，或正常变为不死生物。

Creatures killed by a idja are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The idja automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+14 #Counteract]]{+14}, counteract rank 3). If the idja who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest False Memories.name: 具现虚假记忆 Manifest False Memories
Manifest False Memories.description:
爱怛魔从其身体中释放出一团红色蝴蝶云，每一只都携带着虚假的记忆，会感染它们掠过的目标。所有位于爱怛魔 @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10尺散发}内的非宁多鲁生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免。爱怛魔无法在 [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮} 内使用具现虚假记忆。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，直到其下个回合结束。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}，直到其下个回合结束。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1} 并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}，持续 1 分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时重新尝试一次豁免，以结束这些效果。

The ijda releases a cloud of red butterflies from its body, each of which carries a false memory that infects those they brush against. All non-nindoru creatures @Template[emanation|distance:10]{within 10 feet} of the ijda must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. The ijda can't Manifest False Memories for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature is stupefied 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is stupefied 1 and confused for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the effects.

Ruin Wielder.name: 持骸者 Ruin Wielder
Ruin Wielder.description:
当爱怛魔持用一把破损的非魔法武器时，它不会承受该武器处于破损状态的任何不利影响。当爱怛魔持用它时，该武器变为一把 +1 强击武器，并在成功命中时额外造成 1d6 心灵伤害。

When a ijda wields a broken non-magical weapon, they do not take any of the disadvantages of the weapon being broken. While the ijda wields it, the weapon becomes a +1 striking weapon that deals an additional 1d6 mental damage on a successful hit.

Ijda.publicNotes:
爱怛魔是遗忘的生物。它们诞生于那些曾经开悟、却又背弃开悟以及自己在转世轮回中职责的灵魂；它们诅咒自身存在的徒劳无功，并以引导他人走向相同命运为乐。

爱怛魔看起来是高大的人形生物，躯体臃肿，不断迸裂出细小的红色蝴蝶；这些蝴蝶扑扇飞开，还未远去便融化为雾。它们的双臂异常修长，且扭曲折断得如同触手般蠕动，使其在战斗中拥有一种令人不安的风格，其触及甚至超过多数大型生物。它们穿着以发霉稻草制成的衣物与披风，挥舞着破碎的剑，这些断裂的剑刃依然大致悬浮在原本的位置。它们最骇人的特征则是完全没有头颅；取而代之的是头部应在的位置上安放着一只柳条笼，里面充满了翻腾蠕动的蝴蝶云团。然而即便如此，它们依然能够毫无障碍地看见、听见和说话，仿佛头颅仍在原位一般。

爱怛魔生来没有头，甚至没有大脑，它们的心智由头笼中的蝶群以及从身体中迸出的蝴蝶共同承载；而每当这些昆虫逸散、消隐，它们这些健忘的邪魔便失去一个潜在的念头。由于无法学习新事物，它们所采取的任何行动都源于刻印在灵魂中的记忆，或是对其他宁多鲁、以及那些它们已接受为上级的生物所下命令的盲从。它们的移动、言语与反应动作，皆通过一种基于灵魂“认为自己应如何回应外界刺激”的肌肉记忆来进行。因此，如今大多数爱怛魔都充当残暴的守护者，因为它们的遗忘也使其无法入睡。

当一个经历过多次转生的邪恶凡人灵魂被强行从灵魂循环中扯出并遭到腐化时，它就可能发生骇人的转变，化作一种名为宁多鲁的邪魔。作为熵增与循环破裂的力量，宁多鲁是丑恶可憎的生物，它们的躯体往往显得扭曲畸变，手持虽已破碎却仍可使用的武器，而它们真正的面目通常隐藏不见。它们展现出某些你可能会在不死生物身上看到的特征，例如腐烂的血肉或裸露的骨骼，然而宁多鲁确实仍然活着。

每一种宁多鲁都体现着某一特定循环的断裂，无论那循环来自自然世界，还是来自社会传统。对宁多鲁而言，没有什么比吞食一个经历过多次转生的生物更美味；而那些理论上即将升至真正开悟境界者，更是最可口的一餐。被宁多鲁杀死者，其自身也会被撕离循环——幸运者会前往骨园接受审判，但更多则会遭到腐化，化为更多这类可怖的邪魔。

善解的信徒尤其厌恶宁多鲁，并将其视作可想而知最严重的威胁之一。宁多鲁最常见于世界上转世轮回最强烈的地区，并且与罗刹和恶鬼一样，和物质位面的联系最为紧密。

转世的灵魂

在某些情况下，你会知道被宁多鲁攻击的生物是否拥有转世的灵魂。像轮回裔这样的族裔总是转世的灵魂，而玩家角色的背景故事，甚至其背景，也常能表明前世的存在。《肆季鬼志》中的所有玩家角色都符合转世的灵魂条件，因为他们数十年来一次又一次地重历自己的人生。如果你需要为了裁定宁多鲁的能力而判定某个生物的灵魂是否为转世，请进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]——若成功，它就拥有转世的灵魂。

灵堕魔半神

最强大的宁多鲁是半神，不过崇拜它们的教派相当罕见。由于死后倾向于再度转生，像苦迦菩提这样的灵堕魔半神，更准确地说应被称为“灵堕魔苦行者”。

灵堕魔叛徒

尽管大多数宁多鲁本性上都是纯粹的混乱邪恶，但传说中也存在极其罕见的宁多鲁，能够挣脱自身本性并获得升华，在死后转生为神使或其他更为仁善的精魂，并在这一过程中摆脱仁灯如特征。当然，这些“叛徒”会被其余留存下来的宁多鲁视作世上最美味的猎物。

灵堕魔蝴蝶

各类宁多鲁最奇异的共同特征之一，就是那些似乎总在它们周围盘旋、栖息在它们身体上，或周期性地从其伤口中浮现的血红色蝴蝶。这些令人不安的昆虫是宁多鲁思想的显现，象征着它们曾经历却又背弃的无数前世。一旦飞离源头数尺之外，灵堕魔蝴蝶便绝不会持续太久，而会化作迅速消散于空气中的烟雾。

其他灵堕魔

除了这几页中介绍的四种之外，还存在许多其他类型的宁多鲁。其他例子包括模仿尸体的阿卡什提斯（啜泣灵堕魔）、被称为影隐熊的社会渗透者（潜伏灵堕魔）、亵渎死者的尸萨吉辛（歪曲灵堕魔），以及强大而残暴的阿耳癸耳宙斯（无头灵堕魔）。

Ijdas are creatures of forgetfulness. Born from souls who were once enlightened but then renounced it and their role in the cycle of reincarnation, they curse the futility of their existence and find pleasure in leading others to the same fate.

Ijdas appear as towering humanoids, their bodies bloated and constantly bursting with small red butterflies that flitter away before melting into mist. Their arms are overly long and so broken as to writhe more like tentacles, affording them an unsettling combat style with greater reach than most large creatures enjoy. They wear clothing and capes made of moldy straw and wield broken swords whose shattered blades still float roughly in place. Their most unsettling features are their complete lack of heads; instead, where a head should be sits a wicker cage filled with a writhing cloud of butterflies. Yet still, they see, hear, and speak without issue, as if their heads remained in place.

Formed without heads or even brains, an idja's mind is shared among the flocks of butterflies in their head cages or bursting from their bodies, and as each of these insects escapes and fades away, these forgetful fiends lose another potential thought. Unable to learn new things, any actions they take stem from memories etched into their souls or directives they blindly follow from other nindorus or creatures they've come to accept as superiors. Their movements, words, and reactions are all conducted via a type of muscle memory based on how their souls believe they should respond to their external stimuli. As a result, most now serve as brutal guardians, since their forgetfulness also prevents them from being able to sleep.

When an evil mortal soul that has been reincarnated multiple times is wrenched from the cycle of souls and corrupted, it can undergo a horrific transformation into a fiend known as a nindoru. A force for entropy and the breaking of cycles, nindorus are hideous creatures whose bodies often appear distorted, who wield weapons that have been shattered yet still function, and whose true face is often hidden from view. They display traits one might expect to see in an undead creature, such as decaying flesh or exposed bones, yet a nindoru is very much still alive.

Each nindoru epitomizes the fracture of a specific cycle, be it one from the natural world or from societal traditions. To the nindoru, nothing is more delicious than the consumption of a creature who has reincarnated multiple times, with those who are theoretically about to ascend to true enlightenment presenting the tastiest meal. Those slain by a nindoru are themselves torn from the cycle—the lucky ones move on to the Boneyard for judgment, but many are instead corrupted to form more of these horrific fiends.

Followers of Sangpotshi find nindoru to be particularly abhorrent and count them among the greatest threats imaginable. Most commonly found in regions of the world where the reincarnation cycle is strongest, nindorus are, like rakshasas and oni, associated most strongly with the Material Plane.

Reincarnated Souls

In some cases, you'll know if a creature a nindoru attacks has a reincarnated soul. Ancestries like samsarans are always reincarnated souls, and a PC's backstory or even their background can often indicate the presence of a previous life. All of the PCs in Season of Ghosts qualify as reincarnated souls, as they've relived their lives over and over for decades. If you ever need to determine if a creature's soul is reincarnated for the purpose of adjudicating a nindoru's ability, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]—on a success, it has a reincarnated soul.

Nindoru Demigods

The most powerful nindorus are demigods, although their cults are quite rare. Prone to reincarnation after death, nindoru demigods like Kugaptee are more properly known as "nindoru ascetics."

Nindoru Traitors

While most nindorus are purely chaotic evil in nature, legends tell of exceptionally rare nindorus who manage to escape their own nature and ascend, reincarnating after death into kami or other more benevolent spirits and shedding the nindoru trait as they do so. Of course, these "traitors" are regarded as the most delicious meals imaginable by the nindorus left behind.

Nindoru Butterflies

One of the strangest shared traits of the various types of nindoru are the blood-red butterflies that seem to follow them around, nest on their bodies, or periodically emerge from their wounds. These unnerving insects are physical manifestations of the nindorus' thoughts and symbolize the countless past lives they once lived but turned their backs on. Nindoru butterflies never last long once they flutter more than a few feet from their source, fading away into smoke that quickly dissipates into the air.

Other Nindorus

Many other types of nindorus exist beyond the four presented on these pages. Others include the corpse-copying akashtis (sobbing nindorus), infiltrators of society known as kagekumas (lurking nindorus), the dead defiling shisagishins (crooked nindorus), and the powerful and brutal argyrzeis (headless nindorus).

Marvelous Miniature (Ladder).name: 奇妙微缩模型（梯子）
Marvelous Miniature (Ladder).description:
启动 1（操作）

每个奇妙微缩模型都是某个真实生物或物体的极小复制品。该微缩模型由木材、白镴或其他简单材料制成，并在底座下方刻有一枚符文。奇妙微缩模型有时会成套包装；例如，露营套装包含小船、营火和马的微缩模型。启动奇妙微缩模型会使其变形成另一种生物或物体，随后便可像该物体通常那样使用。每个微缩模型只能启动一次，其中大多数会永久变成其说明中描述的物品。

启动后，这个微缩模型会永久变成一架20尺长的木梯。

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Every marvelous miniature is an exceptionally small replica of a real creature or object. The miniature is made from wood, pewter, or other simple materials, and features a rune etched into the underside of the replica's base. Marvelous miniatures sometimes come packaged together; for example, the camping set features the boat, campfire, and horse miniatures. Activating a marvelous miniature causes it to transform into another creature or object, which then can be used as normal for that object. Each miniature can be activated only once, with most of them permanently becoming the item in their description.

When activated, this miniature transforms permanently into a 20-foot-long wooden ladder.

Shining Crossbow Bolt.name: 闪耀弩箭 Shining Crossbow Bolt
Shining Crossbow Bolt.description:
闪光弩矢会发出微弱的发光。发射后，它会在20足半径内发出明亮光照（并在接下来的20足内发出昏暗光照），持续10分钟。若它命中目标，则会黏附在目标上，使目标在相同半径内发光。生物可以用一个交互动作将该弹药移除，但弹药本身会在剩余持续时间内继续发光，或直到被摧毁为止。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Sf6UO6vgCeicggOK]{效果：闪光弩矢}

Shining ammunition gives off a faint glow. When shot, it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet) for 10 minutes. If it hits a target, it sticks, causing the target to shed light in the same radius. A creature can remove the ammunition with an Interact action, but the ammunition itself continues to glow for the rest of the duration or until destroyed.

效果 蝰蛇进行至多10尺的魅影野猪行走、攀爬或游泳（如果相应速度低于10尺，则至多移动该速度）。它必须在一个不处于敌人5尺内的位置结束其移动。此移动不会触发反应动作。

Viper.publicNotes:
这种毒蛇家族的每个成员都拥有细长、可活动的尖牙，能将强效毒液注入猎物体内。不同的蝰蛇会注入不同类型的毒液，可能导致麻痹、剧痛与肿胀、血液凝固，甚至让受害者的心脏骤然停止。

蛇有各种各样的形态，从栖息于丛林、会缠绕猎物的绞杀蛇，到拥有致命啃咬的毒蝰蛇，不一而足。不过，所有蛇都会通过让自己的颚脱臼，并使用强健的肌肉把食物向下送入喉咙和胃里，从而将猎物整个吞下。

Each member of this family of venomous snakes has long, hinged fangs that inject potent venom into their prey. Different vipers inject different types of venom, which might result in paralysis, extreme pain and swelling, blood clotting, or even the sudden stopping of the victim's heart.

Snakes come in an array of forms, from jungle-dwelling constrictors that wrap around their prey to venomous vipers with deadly bites. Regardless, all snakes consume their prey whole by unhinging their jaws and using powerful muscles to move the food down their throats and into their stomachs.

Legerdemain Handkerchief.description:
这条带褶边的银灰色手帕，外观上看只是件时髦的个人卫生工具，但也能被用来秘密地让非常小的物品消失。

启动 1（操作）

需求 这条手帕完全盖住一个可忽略负载的物品

效果 这条手帕会将它所覆盖的物品传送进其异次元空间。手帕的异次元空间一次只能容纳一件物品，因此，任何被收走的物品都会替换掉空间中原本已有的物品。你也可以用这个动作将异次元空间中已有的一件物品排出，而不进行替换。除非持有该物品的生物允许，否则此启动不能对有人持用的物品使用。将手帕盖在一件物品上通常需要一个交互动作。

This frilled, silvery-gray handkerchief is a stylish tool for personal hygiene by all appearances, but it can be used to covertly make very small items vanish.

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Requirements The handkerchief is entirely covering an item of negligible Bulk

Effect The handkerchief transports the item it covers into its extradimensional space. The handkerchief can hold only one item within its extradimensional space at a time, so any item taken is replaced by any item already within the space. You can also use this action to expel an item already within the extradimensional space without replacing it. This activation can't be used on an attended item unless the creature with that item allows it. Placing the handkerchief over an item typically takes an Interact action.

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 魅影灾祸 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
末日般毁灭的异象充满了区域内每个生物的心智。该异象造成11d6点心灵伤害（基础意志豁免）。若大失败，该生物还必须在一次@Check[reflex]反射豁免中成功，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂隙中、漂流在海上，或遭遇其他符合其异象的命运）。如果它第二次豁免失败，它还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑（状态）}，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的意志豁免；若成功，它便会识破该幻觉，并从震慑（状态）中恢复。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a @Check[reflex] save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Spirit Blast.name: 灵魂冲击 Spirit Blast
Spirit Blast.description:
你汇聚灵体能量并攻击一个生物的精魂，造成16d6精魂伤害，目标进行一次基础强韧豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

You concentrate ethereal energy and attack a creature's spirit, dealing 16d6 spirit damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Illusory Scene.name: 幻景 Illusory Scene
Illusory Scene.description:
你塑造出一个想象中的场景，其中包含至多10个彼此独立、体型各异的生物或物体，且它们都必须位于该法术的区域内。这些要素会产生合适的声音与气味，并且在接触时触感也与真实相符。幻景中的要素无法说话。不同于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻影生物} 法术，你场景中的生物不具有战斗能力或数据。你的场景不包括对其周围环境的改变，不过你可以将场景放置在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{蜃景} 法术制造出的幻象环境中。

当你创造该场景时，你可以选择让它保持静止，或按程序运行。尽管静态场景是固定不动的，它仍包含基础的自然移动。比如，风吹动一张幻象纸片时，会让它沙沙作响。一个程序最长可达1分钟，并会在结束后重复。例如，你可以创造出两个兽人彼此搏斗的场景，而这场打斗在每次重复时都会以同样的方式进行。如果你创造一个循环，那么两名战士会在场景开始时与结束时处于同一位置，不过你可以将程序衔接得很平滑，使人难以分辨循环何时结束、何时开始。任何连续观察该场景超过几分钟的人，几乎总会注意到它在循环。你无法在创造出该幻象后更改这个程序。

任何接触图像任意部分的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作进行检视的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。如果他们与幻象的一部分交互，他们只会识破那一部分。只有在大成功时，他们才会识破整个场景。

升阶（6环） 你场景中的生物或物体可以说话。你在创建程序时，必须为每个角色说出其具体台词。该法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

升阶（8环） 如同6环版本，且持续时间为无限。

You craft an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} spell.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

Wave of Despair.name: 绝望之波 Wave of Despair
Wave of Despair.description:
你向区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作，并且必须在其回合开始时再次尝试一次豁免；若失败，则它会因无法控制地抽泣而在该回合中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 同失败，且该生物自动处于减速1，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域增大为60足锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Outcast's Curse.name: 流放诅咒 Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
你以一项诅咒折磨目标，使其存在感变得粗鲁而令人反感。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 持续10分钟，目标每当尝试进行一次欺瞒、交涉、威吓或表演检定时，必须掷骰两次并使用较差的结果，而且他们所遭遇的生物对其的初始态度会变差一级（例如，变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友善}而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{冷淡}）。

失败 同成功，但该效果为永久。

大失败 同失败，且目标所遭遇的生物对其的初始态度会变差两级。

You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你瞬间将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见且位于射程内的一处未被占据的空间。若这会让另一生物与你一同被带走——即使你是将其装在一个异次元容器中携带——则该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置和距离即可。此后，你暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Create Undead.name: 唤起死灵 Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
你将目标转化为一个等级不高于“生物创生仪式”表所允许上限的亡灵生物。这个仪式有许多不同版本，每一种都对应某种特定类型的亡灵（例如一个适用于所有丧尸的仪式、一个适用于骷髅的仪式、一个适用于食尸鬼的仪式，等等），而创造罕见亡灵的仪式同样也是罕见。有些类型的亡灵，例如巫妖，会通过其自身独特的方法形成，无法通过唤起死灵的某个版本来创造。

大成功 目标变为相应类型的亡灵生物。如果它的等级至少比你低4级，你可以使其成为仆从。这会赋予它仆从（特征），意味着当你对其下达命令时，它可以使用2个动作，而对其下达命令是一个具有听觉与专注（特征）的单动作。你至多可以控制四个仆从。如果它具有智能且没有成为仆从，那么该亡灵会因你唤醒了它而对你乐于助人，尽管它仍然是个可怖而邪恶的生物。如果它没有智能且没有成为仆从，你可以给它一个简单命令。它会一心一意地追求该目标，无视你之后的任何命令。

成功 如同大成功，但未成为你仆从的智能亡灵只会对你保持友善，而未成为你仆从的无智能亡灵会放过你，除非你攻击它。它会在当地区域内肆虐，而不是遵从你的命令。

失败 你未能创造出该亡灵。

大失败 你创造出了这个亡灵，但它的灵魂因你污秽的死灵法术而饱受折磨，心中对你只剩憎恨。它会试图毁灭你。

You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in the Creature Creation Rituals table. There are many versions of this ritual, each specific to a particular type of undead (one ritual for all zombies, one for skeletons, one for ghouls, and so on), and the rituals that create rare undead are also rare. Some forms of undead, such as liches, form using their own unique methods and can't be created with a version of create undead.

Critical Success The target becomes an undead creature of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it's intelligent and doesn't become a minion, the undead is helpful to you for awakening it, though it's still a horrid and evil creature. If it's unintelligent and doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Success As critical success, except an intelligent undead that doesn't become your minion is only friendly to you, and an unintelligent undead that doesn't become your minion leaves you alone unless you attack it. It marauds the local area rather than following your command.

Failure You fail to create the undead.

Critical Failure You create the undead, but its soul, tortured by your foul necromancy, is full of nothing but hatred for you. It attempts to destroy you.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出一种简单声音的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你不能制造可辨识的语言或其他复杂声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Know the Way.name: 识途 Know the Way
Know the Way.description:
在你的心眼中，你以魔法重新校准自己的方位。你立刻知道北方位于哪个方向（如果你当前位置存在北方），并且你可以选择一个你在过去24小时内到过的地点，得知它位于哪个方向。

升阶（3环） 你可以选择一个你在过去一周内到过的地点。

升阶（7环） 你可以选择一个你曾到过的地点，无论那是在多久以前。

In your mind's eye, you magically reorient yourself. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location), and you can choose a location you were at within the last 24 hours and learn what direction it lies.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose a location you were at within the last week.

Heightened (7th) You can choose a location you were at regardless of how long ago you were there.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你创造一个光球，在你选择的颜色下，于20足半径内散发明亮光照（并在接下来的20足内提供昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所处的同一空间内创造这团光，你可以将这团光附着在该生物上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮在其附近。你可以维持该法术，使这团光移动最多60足；你可以将其附着到一个生物上或使其与生物分离，作为此次移动的一部分。

你可以解散该法术。如果你在已有四个光法术处于生效状态时施放此法术，你必须选择一个现有法术使其结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

升阶（4环） 光球在60足半径内散发光照（并在接下来的60足内提供昏暗光照）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造出一只漂浮的魔法手，可以是隐形或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并使其缓慢地向任意方向悬浮移动，最多20尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以使该物体额外移动20尺。如果法术结束时该物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你可以将一个负载为1或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至60尺，且你可以将一个负载为1或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

升阶（7环） 射程增加至60尺，且你可以将一个负载为2或更低的无人持握物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、松散且无人持有、负载为1或以下的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若命中，你造成2d6点钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体取决于你掷出的物体。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全部伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Limited Flight.name: 有限飞行 Limited Flight
Limited Flight.description:
行道女拥有等同于其速度的飞行速度，但不能飞到离地面超过10尺的高度；如果她在非坚实表面上方结束其回合，她会消失，并在她最后一个位于坚实地面上方的空间中重新实体化，并变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

A path maiden has a fly Speed equal to her Speed but can't fly higher than 10 feet above the ground, and if she ends her turn above a nonsolid surface, she vanishes and rematerializes on the last space she occupied over solid ground and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality.name: 对抗活力效果的所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

Imprisoning Grave.name: 监禁坟墓 Imprisoning Grave
Imprisoning Grave.description:
30尺。死于行道女灵气范围内的生物的灵魂会被困在其尸体内，直到其身体在灵气范围外停留1分钟。被困期间，该灵魂无法前往来世，但仍可被复活，或被转化为不死生物。

30 feet. The soul of a creature that dies within the path maiden's aura is trapped within its corpse until its body spends 1 minute outside the aura. While trapped, the soul can't move on to the afterlife but can still be brought back to life or transformed into an undead creature.

Scorn Fate.name: 蔑视命运 Scorn Fate
Scorn Fate.description:
行道女以她能看见的一个生物为目标。该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:32] 豁免。若失败，该生物的下一次掷骰会受到诅咒。若该次掷骰的结果为大成功，则改为普通成功。成功变为失败，而失败变为大失败。随后，该生物会在24小时内暂时免疫蔑视命运。

The path maiden targets a creature she can see. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save. On a failure, the creature's next roll is cursed. If the result of the roll is a critical success, it becomes a regular success. A success becomes a failure, and a failure becomes a critical failure. That creature is then temporarily immune to Scorn Fate for 24 hours.

Vengeful Frenzy.name: 复仇狂乱 Vengeful Frenzy
Vengeful Frenzy.description:
行道女以她能看见的60尺内一个生物为目标。目标必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:32]豁免。若失败，目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}，直到其下个回合结束，但它不会因该混乱而攻击道途侍女或自身。

The path maiden targets a creature within 60 feet that she can see. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save. On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of its next turn, but it can't attack path maidens or itself as the result of this confusion.

Pharasma Lore.name: 法莱斯玛学识 Pharasma Lore

Path Maiden.publicNotes:
神门中那些将自己的一呼一吸都奉献给法拉斯玛、却又在临终之际违逆这位女神的崇拜者，有时会在死后转化为道途侍女。所有道途侍女所穿的衣装，都是她们昔日信仰残存的最后痕迹，也是对其耻辱的永久提醒。

行道游民

道途侍女几乎总是以女性形态显现。那些以男性形态显现者，则被称为行道游民。这些亡灵拥有相同的能力，但往往游历得更为广泛；它们所代表的，与其说是背弃了法拉斯玛掌管生与死的职责，不如说是背弃了她作为预言者与命运操弄者的职责。

Worshippers in Shenmen who devote their every breath to Pharasma only to defy the goddess with their last sometimes transform, upon death, into path maidens. The garments all path maidens wear are the last vestiges of their former faith, a permanent reminder of their disgrace.

Path Nomads

Path maidens almost always manifest in feminine forms. Those who manifest in masculine forms are instead known as path nomads. These undead have the same abilities but tend to travel more widely; they represent turning one's back on Pharasma's role as a prophet and manipulator of destiny than of her roles over birth and death.

Sticky Residue.name: 黏性残留物 Sticky Residue
Sticky Residue.description:
5剂与猎蛛毒作用相同的毒素。

这种毒液会侵蚀其目标的防御，帮助蜘蛛更容易捕获猎物。

Sterling Artisan's Tools (Brewing and Se.name: 专家级工匠工具（冲泡与奉茶）
Sterling Artisan's Tools (Brewing and Se.description:
你需要这些工具，才能用原始材料通过制作技能来制造物品。专家级工匠工具让你在该检定上获得+1物品加值。

不同种类的工作需要不同的工具组，由游戏主持决定；例如，铁匠的工具包与木工的工具包就不一样。如果你穿戴着你的工匠工具包，你可以在使用它的动作中将其取出并放回，作为该动作的一部分。

You need these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Sterling artisan's tools give you a +1 item bonus to the check.

Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

Fiendish Reflection.name: 恶魔映像 Fiendish Reflection

Frightening Visage.name: 骇人幻象 Frightening Visage
Frightening Visage.description:
触发 一个生物看向水面

效果 该生物看到自己在水面上的倒影扭曲成自己邪魔化的版本；它必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:20] 豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}（若大失败，则在其保持惊惧期间还会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}）。

Trigger A creature looks at the water

Effect The creature sees its reflection on the water's surface distort into a fiendish version of themselves; they must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as they remain frightened on a critical failure).

Fiendish Reflection.disable:
@Check[religion|dc:20]以驱除该作祟，或 @Check[intimidation|dc:23]将恐惧反过来施加于该作祟并压倒它

@Check[religion|dc:20] to exorcise the haunt, or @Check[intimidation|dc:23] to turn the fear back on the haunt and overwhelm it
Fiendish Reflection.hazarddescription:
这里映在水中的倒影看起来狰狞可怖，宛如邪魔。

Reflections viewed in the water here appear monstrous and fiendish.
Fiendish Reflection.reset:
该作祟会立即重置，并且可以在下一轮再次触发。

The haunt resets immediately and can trigger again the next round.

Kum Meng-Sung.name: 库姆·蒙松 Kum Meng-Sung

Work Clothes (Functions as Leather Armor.name: 工作服（视为皮甲）
Work Clothes (Functions as Leather Armor.description:
这种护甲由柔韧与定型的硬化皮革混合制成，既能提供一定的防护，又保有最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Pitch Bale.name: 干草捆投掷 Pitch Bale
Pitch Bale.description:
需求 农夫上一动作是一次成功的干草叉打击

效果 农夫将其用干草叉击中的生物移动至多5尺，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。目标可以尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:13] 豁免以避免陷入倒地，并在大成功时完全避免被移动。

Requirements The farmer's last action was a successful pitchfork Strike

Effect The farmer moves the creature they hit with their pitchfork up to 5 feet, and the target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:13] save to avoid falling prone and avoids being moved altogether on a critical success.

Kum Meng-Sung.publicNotes:
世界各地田野、葡萄园和果园中的劳作者，农夫以其坚韧的耐力以及驾驭植物和动物的技能而闻名。

社群建立在劳工的背脊之上。

Workers of the fields, vineyards, and orchards of the world, farmers are known for their rugged endurance and skill with plants and animals.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.
Kum Meng-Sung.blurb:
男性人类农夫
Male human farmer

Battle Axe.name: 战斧 Battle Axe
Battle Axe.description:
这些斧头被明确设计为武器，而非工具。它们通常更轻，斧柄以金属箍或螺栓加固，斧刃也更锋利，使其更适合砍断肢体而非劈木。

These axes are designed explicitly as weapons, rather than tools. They typically weigh less, with a shaft reinforced with metal bands or bolts, and have a sharper blade, making them ideal for chopping limbs rather than wood.

Create Undead (Zombie Only).name: 唤起死灵（仅限丧尸）
Create Undead (Zombie Only).description:
你将目标转化为等级不超过表7-1所允许值的不死生物。这个仪式有许多版本，每一种都对应一种特定类型的不死生物（例如一个适用于所有丧尸的仪式、一个适用于骷髅的仪式、一个适用于食尸鬼的仪式，等等），而创造罕见不死生物的仪式本身也同样罕见。某些形式的不死生物——例如巫妖——会以其自身独特的方法形成，无法通过任何版本的唤起死灵来创造。

表7-1：生物创造仪式

大成功 目标会成为相应类型的不死生物。如果它的等级至少比你低4级，你可以让它成为仆从。这会赋予它仆从（特征），意味着当你命令它时，它可以使用2个动作，而命令它是一个具有听觉和专注（特征）的单动作。你至多可以同时控制四个仆从。如果它具有智能且未成为仆从，那么这个不死生物会因你唤醒了它而对你乐于助人，尽管它依旧是个可怖而邪恶的生物。如果它没有智能且未成为仆从，你可以给予它一个简单命令。它会一心一意地追求该目标，忽视你之后的任何命令。

成功 如大成功，但未成为你的仆从的智能不死生物只会对你友善，而未成为你的仆从的无智能不死生物会放过你，除非你攻击它。它会在当地四处肆虐，而不是遵从你的命令。

失败 你未能创造出该不死生物。

大失败 你创造出了这个不死生物，但它的灵魂因你邪恶的死灵法术而备受折磨，心中充满了对你的憎恨。它会试图摧毁你。

You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in Table 7-1. There are many versions of this ritual, each specific to a particular type of undead (one ritual for all zombies, one for skeletons, one for ghouls, and so on), and the rituals that create rare undead are also rare. Some forms of undead, such as liches, form using their own unique methods and can't be created with a version of create undead.

Critical Success The target becomes an undead creature of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it's intelligent and doesn't become a minion, the undead is helpful to you for awakening it, though it's still a horrid and evil creature. If it's unintelligent and doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Animate Dead (Zombie Only).description:
你的魔法挖掘出一具尸体或骷髅，并以死灵生命充盈其中，你强迫死者听从你的命令作战。你召唤一个具有不死（特征）的通用生物，且其等级为 -1；该生物获得被召唤（特征）。法术升阶会提高你能够召唤的生物的最高等级。

升阶（2环） 等级 1。

Your magic dredges up a corpse or skeleton and fills it with necromantic life, and you force the dead to fight at your command. You summon a common creature that has the undead trait and whose level is -1; this creature gains the summoned trait. Heightening the spell increases the maximum level of creature you can summon.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标思绪混乱，并以一次精神冲击令其眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造出一种由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你不能制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你制造出一只漂浮的、魔法的手，可以是隐形或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并使其缓慢地向任意方向悬浮移动，最多 20 尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以使该物体额外移动 20 尺。如果该物体在法术结束时仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以将一个无人持握且负载为 1 或以下的物体作为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个无人持握且负载为 1 或以下的物体作为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个无人持握且负载为 2 或以下的物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Cat at Heart.name: 心中猫 Cat at Heart
Cat at Heart.description:
当一只化猫被杀死时，它会立刻转生为一只普通的家猫，并且永远无法再次变成化猫。

When a bakeneko is killed, they immediately reincarnate into a normal house cat who can never again become a bakeneko.

Feel the Beat.name: 感受节拍 Feel the Beat
Feel the Beat.description:
化猫喜欢跳舞。如果化猫在其回合开始时位于一个音乐源30尺内，它们会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，直到其下个回合开始，因为它们会顺从自己随着曲调节奏移动的强迫冲动，按着节拍摆动尾巴、从一只后腿重踏到另一只后腿，或拍打前爪。

Bakenekos love to dance. If a bakeneko begins their turn within 30 feet of a source of music, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the start of their next turn as they follow their compulsion to move to the rhythm of the tune by swishing their tail in time, stomping from one hind leg to the other, or clapping their front paws.

Flammable.name: 易燃 Flammable
Flammable.description:
由于富含脂肪的饮食，化猫会从皮肤分泌出易燃油脂，并覆盖在它们的毛发上。如果化猫受到任何火焰伤害，它们的整个身体都会燃起火焰，使其变成一颗毛茸茸的火球，直到其下个回合结束为止。以这种方式燃烧时，化猫的打击会额外造成1d6点火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.insc09aslLptd0dN]{效果：易燃}

Thanks to their high-fat diets, bakenekos secrete flammable oils from their skin that coats their fur. If a bakeneko takes any fire damage, their entire body lights up in flame, turning them into a furry fireball until the end of their next turn. While burning in this way, a bakeneko's Strikes inflict an additional 1d6 fire damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.insc09aslLptd0dN]{Effect: Flammable}

Skilled Ritualist.name: 娴熟主祭 Skilled Ritualist
Skilled Ritualist.description:
化猫只能通过 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{唤起死灵} 创造丧尸，但它们可以在没有次要施法者的情况下执行该仪式，并将施法时间缩短为 4 小时。

Bakenekos can only create zombies with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} but can perform the ritual without secondary casters and lower the casting time to 4 hours.

Yami.publicNotes:
化猫会在一只猫的生命因惊人的好运、魔法或其他方式而延长，超出其正常寿命后诞生。随着一年年过去，这种猫科动物会变得越来越怪异——体型增长、变得更加聪明，并获得对魔法的亲和力。最终，它们会变得能够用后腿直立行走、追求新的爱好，并学会语言。尽管智力得到了扩展，许多化猫仍更喜欢在晋升后的最初几十年里，继续像往常一样过日子，做一只（体型特别巨大的）家猫。对一些化猫来说，这么做是因为它们想获得自己还是猫时无法理解的世界知识；而对另一些化猫来说，这只是想在迈向下一阶段之前，继续与现在的家人和所爱之人共度余生。

化猫在一切享乐中最喜欢跳舞，听到音乐时总忍不住点点头、轻拍爪子，或摇摆尾巴打拍子。它们经常让尸体动起来，只是为了看它们跳舞——而这项消遣常常会给附近的聚居地带来麻烦，尤其是在那些亡灵脱离化猫控制时。化猫通常有着顽皮又淘气的举止，虽然它们并非天生邪恶的生物，但它们操纵尸体与驾驭火焰的能力仍然令人畏惧。村民常常会被一只浑身燃火的猫与一具行走的尸体并肩漫步的景象吓得半死，而化猫与邪恶及异能的联系，也使得天夏的一些村庄将所有猫都妖魔化。

猫又

化猫大多将自己那些会动却无心智的丧尸视作消遣之物，不过它们也会把这些丧尸当作守护者，甚至复仇的工具。尽管如此，它们仍会尽力确保自己唤起的亡灵不会被放任四处游荡。实际上，大多数关于“邪恶化猫”的传说，指的都是一种相似但危险得多的生物——猫又；它是化猫的一种6级中型变种，其啃咬会导致一种会严重损害心智的疾病。

A bakeneko comes into existence when the life of a cat is extended past its normal lifespan, whether through incredible fortune, magic, or other means. With each passing year, the feline becomes more and more monstrous—growing in size, becoming more intelligent, and gaining an affinity for magic. Eventually, they become able to walk upright on their rear legs, pursue new hobbies, and learn languages. Despite this expanded intellect, many bakenekos prefer to enjoy the first decades of their ascension continuing their lives as usual as a (particularly oversized) house cat. For some, they do so because they want to acquire knowledge of the world that they couldn't comprehend as cats, but for others, it's just a desire to live out their lives with their current families and loved ones before moving on to what comes next.

Bakenekos enjoy dancing above all other pleasures and can't resist nodding their heads, tapping their paws, or swishing their tails in time to music. They often animate corpses simply to watch them dance—a pastime that often spells trouble for nearby settlements should the undead get free from the bakeneko's control. Bakenekos typically have a playful and mischievous demeanor, and while they aren't inherently evil creatures, they're still feared for their ability to animate corpses and command fire. Villagers are often frightened half to death by the sight of a flaming cat strolling alongside a walking corpse, and bakenekos' association with evil and the occult has caused some villages in Tian Xia to vilify all cats.

Nekomatas

Bakenekos mostly see their animated but mindless zombies as amusements, though they also use them as guardians or even as agents for revenge. Still, they do their best to ensure that undead they animate aren't left to wander free. Most tales of "evil bakenekos" in fact refer to a similar and much more dangerous creature, the nekomata—a level 6 Medium-sized variant of the bakeneko whose bite causes a debilitating disease of the mind.

苦迦菩提的蜈蚣以其速度进行一次移动或进行调整步。于此次移动期间，他可以穿过最窄至10尺的空间，而无需 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{挤压}。

Wand of Environmental Endurance (Rank 2).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5esP2GVzvxWsMgaX]{环境耐受}

这根短杖大约有一足长，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术有关。

启动 施放法术

Sturdy Shield (Minor).description:
凭借更优越的设计与精湛的工艺，这面钢盾比其非魔法对应物拥有更高的硬度，因此更难被打破和摧毁。

With a superior design and excellent craftsmanship, this steel shield has higher Hardness than its non-magical counterparts, making it harder to break and destroy.

The shield has Hardness 8, HP 64, and BT 32.

Loose Floor Stone.tokenName: 松动的地板石块 Loose Floor Stone

Spacious Pouch (Type II).name: 宽敞袋（II型）
Spacious Pouch (Type II).description:
尽管它看起来只是一个以色彩华丽的丝绸饰片或时尚刺绣装饰的布袋，宽敞袋却会通向一个比其外部空间更大的魔法空间。袋内所容纳的负载不会改变宽敞袋本身的负载。这个袋子的异次元空间能够容纳多少负载，取决于它的类型。

你可以对宽敞袋执行交互，将物品存放其中或取出它们，就像使用普通麻袋一样。尽管这个袋子能容纳大量物质，物体仍然必须能够穿过袋口，才能被存放进去。

如果袋子超载或破损，它就会裂开并被毁坏，导致其中的物品永远丢失。如果它被翻了个里朝外，里面的物品会毫发无伤地洒出来，但必须将袋子翻回原状后才能再次使用。被放入袋中的活体生物有足够维持10分钟的空气，之后便会开始窒息，并且它可以尝试进行对抗难度等级13的挣脱。袋中的物品在被先取出之前不会提供任何好处。袋中的物品无法被仅能侦测同一位面上事物的魔法所侦测。

容量 50负载

Though it appears to be a cloth bag decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a spacious pouch opens into a magical space larger than its outside dimensions. The Bulk held inside the bag doesn't change the Bulk of the spacious pouch itself. The amount of Bulk the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type.

You can Interact with the spacious pouch to stow items in it or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside.

If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A living creature placed inside the bag has enough air for 10 minutes before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag can't be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane.

Capacity 50 Bulk

一名玩家角色若花费10分钟搜寻这间储藏室，并成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定，就会在房间西南角的一块松动的地板石块下发现一份藏匿得极其巧妙的宝藏。

A PC who takes 10 minutes Searching this storeroom and succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check discovers a very cleverly hidden treasure under a loose floor stone in the southwest corner of the room

Dragon Turtle Armor.name: 龙龟甲 Dragon Turtle Armor
Dragon Turtle Armor.description:
这件+1坚韧全身板甲以从龙龟甲壳鳞片上剥落的最绚丽碎片打造而成，并依照传统将这一意象融入更厚实、更坚固的背甲之中。穿着这件护甲时，来自夹击你的生物不会使你陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}；此外，当你游泳时，你无视该护甲的速度减值，以及其对进行运动检定以游泳时的检定减值。

This +1 resilient full plate is crafted from the most colorful fragments chipped from scales of a dragon turtle's shell, traditionally incorporating that motif in the form of a thicker, sturdier backplate. While wearing this armor, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} from creatures that flank you, and you ignore the armor's speed penalty when you Swim and its check penalty to Athletics checks to Swim.

Dragon Turtle Artillery.name: 龙龟火炮 Dragon Turtle Artillery
Dragon Turtle Artillery.description:
这根沉重的钢制圆筒一端被锻造成龙龟的头部形状，嘴巴大张。另一端的握把让人能够用双手持握并瞄准这门如同加农炮般沉重的炮管。只要你在船或舰上携带龙龟火炮，任何使该载具倾覆的效果其难度等级增加4。

启动 2 命令术，交互

频率 每天一次

效果 一道 @Template[cone|distance:50] 的蒸汽从炮口喷射而出，对其效果区域内的生物造成 @Damage[10d6[fire]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] 豁免）。这次喷射无视生物因处于水下而通常获得的火焰抗力。

One end of this heavy cylinder of steel has been forged in the likeness of a dragon turtle's head, the mouth gaping wide. Grips at the opposite end allow one to hold and aim this heavy cannon-like barrel with both hands. As long as you're carrying dragon turtle artillery while you're on a boat or ship, the DC for any effect to capsize that vehicle increases by 4.

Activate 2 command, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect A @Template[cone|distance:50] of steam blasts from the mouth of the cannon, dealing @Damage[10d6[fire]] damage to creatures in its area of effect (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save). This blast ignores the fire resistance normally granted to creatures by being underwater.

Any creature that hits the Warty with an unarmed Strike or otherwise touches the toad is exposed to giant toad poison.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

Slurp Something Shiny.description:
疣儿用他的舌头打击，对触及内由目标持有的一件闪亮物体进行一次[[/act disarm]]尝试。

Warty makes a [[/act disarm]] attempt with his tongue Strike against a shiny object held by a target in reach.

Swallow Whole.description:
中型，@Damage[(1d8)[bludgeoning]] 伤害，[[/act escape dc=18]] 破裂 8

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Medium, @Damage[(1d8)[bludgeoning]] damage, [[/act escape dc=18]] Rupture 8

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Tongue Grab.name: 伸舌擒抓 Tongue Grab
Tongue Grab.description:
被疣儿的舌头命中的生物会被巨蟾蜍@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}。该生物并未处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，但它无法移动到巨蟾蜍舌头触及之外。

生物可以用一次成功对 AC 15 的打击切断这条舌头，且此次打击必须造成至少 6 点挥砍伤害。这不会对疣儿造成伤害，但会使他在舌头重新长出来之前无法使用他的舌头打击，而这需要一周时间。

A creature hit by Warty's tongue becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the giant toad. The creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the toad's tongue.

A creature can sever the tongue with a successful Strike against AC 15 that deals at least 6 slashing damage. This deals no damage to Warty, but prevents him from using his tongue Strike until he regrows his tongue, which takes a week.

Warty.publicNotes:
大多数巨蟾蜍生活在干燥的环境中，尤其是沙漠里，并且会急切地吃掉几乎任何比自己小的生物。众所周知，它们会吃巨鼠，然后占据巨鼠的地洞作为巢穴。巨蟾蜍眼后有大型的毒素腺体，使它们能够用毒素覆盖自己的皮肤。因此，它们几乎没有天敌，如果放任不管，种群数量会迅速暴增。虽然大多数人认为巨蟾蜍是危险的害兽，但一些食人魔和丘陵巨人群体会饲养它们，以收集其毒素供消遣使用。

Most giant toads live in dry environments, particularly deserts, and eagerly eat almost any creature smaller than themselves. They're known to eat giant rats, then take over the rats' burrows as homes. Giant toads have large poison glands behind their eyes that enable them to coat their skin with poison. This leads to them having very few natural predators, and populations can quickly explode if left unchecked. While most consider giant toads dangerous pests, some groups of ogres and hill giants cultivate them to collect their poison for recreational use.
Warty.blurb:
变体巨蟾蜍
Variant giant toad

Healing Potion (Minor).description:
启动 A (操作)

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般鲜红的液体，饮用时会带来刺痛般的感觉，因为饮用者的伤口会迅速愈合。当你喝下治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[1d8[healing]] 生命值。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points.
