Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你制造出一种幻象，使你看起来像另一名与你有相同身体形态、且身高（误差在6英寸内）与体重（误差在50磅内）大致相近的生物。这样的伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以乔装成某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物和穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一条裙子。手持物品不受影响，而你移除的任何穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{乔装}这一欺瞒用途做好伪装准备；它会忽略你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值，给予你防止他人看穿你伪装的欺瞒检定 +4 状态加值，并且即使你未受训，你也可以加上你的等级。你可以解散该法术。

升阶（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音和气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环） 你可以看起来像任何与你体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过某个个体，才能呈现其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音和气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你使目标物体在外观和触感上看起来仿佛处于好得多或差得多的物理状态。施放此法术时，选择你想让该物体看起来破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装成破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。被伪装得更好的完好物品会看起来像是全新的一样，并且高度抛光或保养良好。破损物品则会显得完好且功能正常。被摧毁的物品无法受到此法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破这个幻象。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成 2d4 点心灵伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害，但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心状态中恢复，则持续伤害结束，且该法术结束。

大失败 如失败，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升环（+1） 伤害增加 2d4，且持续伤害增加 1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个处于射程内、松散且无人持握的物体掷向目标，该物体的负载必须为 1 或更少。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则你造成等于 1d6 + 你的施法能力调整值的钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体取决于你所掷出的物体。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成正常伤害。

升环（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Bone Morningstar.name: 骨制钉头锤 Bone Morningstar
Bone Morningstar.description:
这种武器有一根短柄，末端是一个布满尖刺的金属球。

This weapon has a short shaft ending in a metal ball studded with spikes.

Immune to Fatigued From the Effects of S.name: 不会因饥饿或口渴的效果而陷入疲乏状态 Immune to Fatigued From the Effects of Starvation or Thirst

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被莫啖魔杀死的生物很难被带回生命或被转化为不死生物。莫啖魔会自动尝试反制任何对其所杀死的生物施放的复活术或将其转化为不死生物的企图（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+7 #Counteract]]{+7}，反制等级 2）。如果杀死该生物的莫啖魔本身被杀死，该生物便可以正常地从死亡中被带回，或正常地变成不死生物。

Creatures killed by a meokdan are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The meokdan automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+7 #Counteract]]{+7}, counteract rank 2). If the meokdan who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Bone Club.name: 具现骨制棍棒 Manifest Bone Club
Manifest Bone Club.description:
需求 莫啖魔未携带骨棒

效果 莫啖魔把手伸进自己的喉咙，探入胃中，拉出一根人类股骨，并将其当作骨棒挥舞。莫啖魔对一个生物进行打击后，骨棒会粉碎，但其锋利的碎片仍大致保持原本的形状；以碎骨棒进行的打击会造成挥砍和流血伤害。在莫啖魔以碎骨棒进行打击后，或者若莫啖魔丢下骨棒，该骨棒就会被摧毁，而莫啖魔可以显现一根新的骨棒。

Requirements The meokdan isn't carrying a bone club

Effect The meokdan reaches down its throat into its stomach and pulls out a human femur that it can wield as a bone club. After the meokdan Strikes a creature, the bone club shatters, but its sharp fragments remain in roughly the same shape; Strikes with a shattered bone club inflict slashing and bleed damage. After the meokdan Strikes with a shattered bone club, or if the meokdan drops the bone club, the club is destroyed, and the nindoru can Manifest a new bone club.

Quick Snack.name: 快速啃食 Quick Snack
Quick Snack.description:
触发 莫啖魔以其啃咬大成功命中一个活着的生物

效果 莫啖魔对该生物进行啃食。

Trigger The meokdan critically hits a living creature with its bite

Effect The meokdan Snacks on the creature.

Snack.name: 啃食 Snack
Snack.description:
莫啖魔尝试对一个相邻生物进行一次啃咬打击，或者咀嚼其所携带的一个手持物品。若该生物是活物，或该物品是食物，莫啖魔会高兴地咕噜作响，并恢复 @Damage[(1d8+8)[healing]] 生命值。若该生物是亡灵或构装体，或该物品不可食用，莫啖魔会因挫败而尖叫，并在其下个回合结束前，对攻击掷骰和豁免骰获得+1状态加值。莫啖魔在1轮内不能再次使用啃食。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.d0aJSi7GI6AhBlAJ]{效果：啃食}

The meokdan attempts a bite Strike against an adjacent creature or chews on a handheld object they're carrying. If the creature is living or the object is food, the meokdan gurgles in delight and restores @Damage[(1d8+8)[healing]] Hit Points. If the creature is undead or a construct, or the object is inedible, the meokdan shrieks in frustration and gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The meokdan can't Snack again for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.d0aJSi7GI6AhBlAJ]{Effect: Snack}

Meokdan.publicNotes:
作为同类中最低等的一类，莫啖魔承受着持续且痛苦的饥饿，因为它们缺乏更强大宁多鲁那种从转世的灵魂中汲取养分的能力。这种饥饿驱使莫啖魔不断寻找食物，并且常常迫使它们去吞食泥土、石块和垃圾——这些东西几乎没有任何营养价值。无论吃下多少东西，莫啖魔的体态始终都瘦得令人痛苦。无论它们有多么饥饿，它们都永远不会饿死。

莫啖魔那瘦骨嶙峋的身躯外形近似人类，浓密纠结的毛发直接从它们的脸上以及整个头部生长出来，只留下莫啖魔那张大张的嘴可见。它们的双臂看起来仿佛已经折断，而且长得不自然地长，手指也同样细长，末端是参差破烂的指甲。它们的皮肤上布满了细小的开放性溃疮。

莫啖魔体现了食物循环的全过程——从吞食，到最终自身也被吞食，不论是被掠食者吃掉，还是被从它们遗骸上生长出来的环境所消耗。

当一个多次转生的邪恶凡人灵魂被强行扯出灵魂循环并遭到腐化时，它就可能经历可怖的转变，化为一种被称作宁多鲁的邪魔。作为熵增与循环破坏的力量，宁多鲁是丑恶的生物，它们的身躯常常显得扭曲变形，挥舞着已经破碎却仍能运作的武器，而它们真正的面容往往隐藏不见。它们会展现出一些人们通常会在不死生物身上见到的特征，例如腐朽的血肉或裸露的骨头，但宁多鲁确确实实仍然活着。

每一种宁多鲁都体现着某一特定循环的断裂，无论那循环来自自然世界还是社会传统。对宁多鲁而言，没有什么比吞食一个多次转生过的生物更美味；而那些理论上即将升入真正觉悟境界者，更是最可口的一餐。被宁多鲁杀死者，其自身也会被撕离循环——幸运者会前往骨园接受裁决，但许多则会遭到腐化，变成更多这类可怖的邪魔。

善解的信徒认为宁多鲁尤其令人憎恶，并将其视为所能想象到的最大威胁之一。宁多鲁最常见于世界上转生循环最强盛的地区，并且与罗刹和恶鬼一样，它们与物质位面的关联最为紧密。

转世的灵魂

在某些情况下，你会知道被宁多鲁攻击的生物是否拥有转世的灵魂。像轮回裔这样的族裔总是转世的灵魂，而玩家角色的背景故事，甚至其背景，往往也能表明其前世的存在。肆季鬼志中的所有玩家角色都符合转世的灵魂条件，因为他们数十年来一次又一次地重历自己的人生。如果你需要为了裁定宁多鲁的能力而判断某个生物的灵魂是否为转世，就进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]——若成功，则它拥有转世的灵魂。

灵堕魔半神

最强大的宁多鲁属于半神，尽管崇拜它们的教派相当罕见。灵堕魔半神在死后往往容易再次转生，像苦迦菩提这样的灵堕魔半神，更准确地说被称为“灵堕魔苦行者”。

灵堕魔叛徒

尽管大多数宁多鲁在本性上都是纯粹的混乱邪恶，传说中仍有极其罕见的宁多鲁能设法摆脱自身本性并获得超升，在死后转生为神使或其他更为仁善的精魂，并在此过程中摆脱仁灯如特征。当然，这些“叛徒”会被其余留下来的宁多鲁视作世上最美味的珍馐。

灵堕魔蝴蝶

各种不同类型的宁多鲁所共有的最奇异特征之一，就是那些似乎会环绕着它们飞舞、栖息在它们身上，或周期性地从它们伤口中浮现的血红色蝴蝶。这些令人不安的昆虫，是宁多鲁思想的物质显现，也象征着它们曾经历过却又背弃了的无数前世。灵堕魔蝴蝶一旦拍动翅膀离开源头数尺以上，便绝不会持续太久，而会化作迅速消散于空气中的烟雾。

其他灵堕魔

除了这几页中介绍的四种之外，还存在许多其他类型的宁多鲁。其他种类包括会复制尸体的阿卡什提斯（啜泣灵堕魔）、被称为影隐熊、渗透社会的潜入者（潜伏灵堕魔）、亵渎死者的尸萨吉辛（歪曲灵堕魔），以及强大而残暴的阿耳癸耳宙斯（无头灵堕魔）。

As the least of their kind, meokdans suffer a constant and painful hunger, for they lack the ability of more powerful nindorus to derive nourishment from a reincarnated soul. This hunger drives the meokdan to constantly seek food and often compels them to eat dirt, stones, and refuse that offer little (if any) nutritional value. Regardless of how much they eat, a meokdan always remains painfully thin in stature. Regardless of how hungry they get, they never starve to death.

A meokdan's emaciated frame appears human in shape, with thick, tangled hair that grows directly from their face as well as the rest of their head, leaving only the meokdan's gaping mouth visible. Their arms appear to be broken and unnaturally long, with equally long fingers tipped with ragged nails. Small, open sores pockmark their skin.

Meokdans epitomize the cycle of food, from consumption to the creature themselves being consumed in the end, be it by predators or the environment growing from their remains.

When an evil mortal soul that has been reincarnated multiple times is wrenched from the cycle of souls and corrupted, it can undergo a horrific transformation into a fiend known as a nindoru. A force for entropy and the breaking of cycles, nindorus are hideous creatures whose bodies often appear distorted, who wield weapons that have been shattered yet still function, and whose true face is often hidden from view. They display traits one might expect to see in an undead creature, such as decaying flesh or exposed bones, yet a nindoru is very much still alive.

Each nindoru epitomizes the fracture of a specific cycle, be it one from the natural world or from societal traditions. To the nindoru, nothing is more delicious than the consumption of a creature who has reincarnated multiple times, with those who are theoretically about to ascend to true enlightenment presenting the tastiest meal. Those slain by a nindoru are themselves torn from the cycle—the lucky ones move on to the Boneyard for judgment, but many are instead corrupted to form more of these horrific fiends.

Followers of Sangpotshi find nindoru to be particularly abhorrent and count them among the greatest threats imaginable. Most commonly found in regions of the world where the reincarnation cycle is strongest, nindorus are, like rakshasas and oni, associated most strongly with the Material Plane.

Reincarnated Souls

In some cases, you'll know if a creature a nindoru attacks has a reincarnated soul. Ancestries like samsarans are always reincarnated souls, and a PC's backstory or even their background can often indicate the presence of a previous life. All of the PCs in Season of Ghosts qualify as reincarnated souls, as they've relived their lives over and over for decades. If you ever need to determine if a creature's soul is reincarnated for the purpose of adjudicating a nindoru's ability, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]—on a success, it has a reincarnated soul.

Nindoru Demigods

The most powerful nindorus are demigods, although their cults are quite rare. Prone to reincarnation after death, nindoru demigods like Kugaptee are more properly known as "nindoru ascetics."

Nindoru Traitors

While most nindorus are purely chaotic evil in nature, legends tell of exceptionally rare nindorus who manage to escape their own nature and ascend, reincarnating after death into kami or other more benevolent spirits and shedding the nindoru trait as they do so. Of course, these "traitors" are regarded as the most delicious meals imaginable by the nindorus left behind.

Nindoru Butterflies

One of the strangest shared traits of the various types of nindoru are the blood-red butterflies that seem to follow them around, nest on their bodies, or periodically emerge from their wounds. These unnerving insects are physical manifestations of the nindorus' thoughts and symbolize the countless past lives they once lived but turned their backs on. Nindoru butterflies never last long once they flutter more than a few feet from their source, fading away into smoke that quickly dissipates into the air.

Other Nindorus

Many other types of nindorus exist beyond the four presented on these pages. Others include the corpse-copying akashtis (sobbing nindorus), infiltrators of society known as kagekumas (lurking nindorus), the dead defiling shisagishins (crooked nindorus), and the powerful and brutal argyrzeis (headless nindorus).

Zoudou The Zealous.name: 狂热者邹斗 Zoudou The Zealous
Zoudou The Zealous.tokenName: 狂热者邹斗 Zoudou The Zealous

Divine Prepared Spells.name: 神圣预备法术 Divine Prepared Spells

Consecrate.name: 祝圣 Consecrate
Consecrate.description:
你将一处场所祝圣给你的神祇，吟诵赞歌并创造一片神圣空间。当处于该区域内时，你的神祇的崇拜者在攻击掷骰、技能检定、豁免骰与察觉检定上获得+1状态加值，而对你的神祇而言属于禁忌的生物（例如对于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{萨伦雷}而言的亡灵）则在这些检定上承受-1状态减值。你的神祇的崇拜者在该区域内进行的攻击会额外造成1点你的神祇某一种阵营类型的伤害（由你选择）；如果你的神祇为绝对中立，则你不会获得此项好处。

大成功 祝圣成功，且其持续时间变为10年而非1年，或者覆盖半径加倍的区域。偶尔，在你的神祇眷顾下，这还可能产生更加惊人的效果，例如一片被永久祝圣的区域，或是效果覆盖整座大教堂。

成功 祝圣成功。

失败 祝圣失败。

大失败 祝圣彻底失败，并激怒你的神祇，祂会降下不悦的征兆。至少在1年内，进一步尝试祝圣该场所都会失败。

升阶（7环） 被祝圣的区域还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{位面封印}法术的效果，但该效果不会尝试反制你的神祇的崇拜者进行的传送。花费提高为200 gp × 法术环阶。

You consecrate a site to your deity, chanting praises and creating a sacred space. While within the area, worshippers of your deity gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws, and Perception checks, and creatures anathema to your deity (such as undead for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]{Sarenrae}) take a -1 status penalty to those checks. Attacks made by worshippers of your deity within the area deal 1 damage of one of your deity's alignment types (your choice); if your deity is true neutral, you don't gain this benefit.

Critical Success The consecration succeeds, and it either lasts for 10 years instead of 1 or covers an area with twice the radius. Occasionally, with your deity's favor, this might produce an even more amazing effect, such as a permanently consecrated area or the effect covering an entire cathedral.

Success The consecration succeeds.

Failure The consecration fails.

Critical Failure The consecration fails spectacularly and angers your deity, who sends a sign of displeasure. For at least 1 year, further attempts to consecrate the site fail.

Heightened (7th) The consecrated area also gains the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XZE4BawIlTf88Yl9]{Planar Seal} spell, but the effect doesn't attempt to counteract teleportation by worshippers of your deity. The cost increases to 200 gp × the spell rank.

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你制造出一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光穿透或从该区域内发出。光不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内时都不会发出任何光，即使其照明半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗术同环阶或更低的魔法光。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它就像一个纯粹黑暗构成的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉的生物（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过这片黑暗看到的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Bane.name: 灾祸术 Bane
Bane.description:
你以怀疑充斥敌人的心智。

区域内的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要它们仍在该区域内，其攻击掷骰便承受 -1 状态减值。

每回合一次，自你施放灾祸术后的下一回合开始，你可以使用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作，将该散发的半径增加 5 尺，并迫使区域内尚未受其影响的敌人再次尝试一次豁免。

灾祸术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：灾祸术}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt.

Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area.

Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bane, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量引入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱亡灵，甚至可能使其逃跑。该效果取决于目标是活物还是亡灵。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等于1d4加你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但若大失败，还会在1轮内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。
  • 亡灵生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标在1轮内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。若大失败，目标还会在1轮内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，除非它成功通过一次意志豁免。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你扰乱目标的心智，并以一道心灵冲击使其眩晕。这道冲击造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的心灵伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Divine Lance.name: 圣枪术 Divine Lance
Divine Lance.description:
你释放一道神圣能量光束。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 2d4 精魂伤害（大成功时伤害加倍）。

升环（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标心中植入恐惧；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并在1轮内 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗不死生物。如果目标是活着的生物，你对其造成1d8点虚空伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。如果目标是自愿的不死生物，你恢复其等量生命值。施放此法术时你花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 （躯体） 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （言语，躯体） 该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗不死生物，其恢复的生命值增加8。

3 （材料，言语，躯体） 你将虚空能量散布于一个30尺散发中。这会以区域内所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害量增加1d8，且双动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命力能量来治疗活物或对亡灵造成伤害。若目标是自愿的活体生物，你为其恢复1d8生命值。若目标是亡灵，你对其造成等量的生命力伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1 （姿势） 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （言语，姿势） 该法术的射程为30尺。若你治疗活体生物，恢复的生命值增加8

3 （材料，姿势，言语） 你将生命力能量散布于30尺散发内。这会以区域内所有活体生物和亡灵为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害量增加1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel vitality energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8

3 (material, somatic, verbal) You disperse vitality energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智以感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何接受你关于该灵光建议的人，在该物品上进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时获得 +2 环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将 10 个物体作为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以将任意数量的物体作为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一面魔法力场护盾。这视为使用举起护盾动作，使你获得对 AC 的 +1 环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，但使用它不需要空出一只手。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{护盾格挡}反应动作（）。该护盾具有5点硬度。在你使用护盾格挡后，该法术结束，并且你在10分钟内不能再次施放它。与通常的护盾格挡不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{力场弹幕}法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（3环） 该护盾的硬度为10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾的硬度为15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾的硬度为20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾的硬度为25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Twisted Knot of Wood (Religious Symbol o.name: 扭曲木结（苦迦菩提的宗教圣徽）
Twisted Knot of Wood (Religious Symbol o.description:
这块木制或银制物品上饰有代表某位神祇的图像。某些神圣施法者，例如牧师，可以使用其神祇的圣徽作为神圣法器，以使用某些能力并施放某些法术。必须用一只手持握圣徽才能使用它。

This piece of wood or silver is emblazoned with an image representing a deity. Some divine spellcasters, such as clerics, can use a religious symbol of their deity as a divine focus to use certain abilities and cast some spells. A religious symbol must be held in one hand to use it.

Telepathy 30 feet.name: 心灵感应 30 尺 Telepathy 30 feet

No Face.name: 无面 No Face
No Face.description:
无脸妖没有视觉，但它们的听觉感官极其敏锐。它们不需要呼吸，并且免疫所有需要呼吸的效果。它们通过皮肤吸收液体来获得养分——传统上是将双手或无面的头浸入液体中，通过渗透作用“饮用”；它们也能以这种方式从消耗品（如药水或灵药）中受益。

Noppera-bos have no sense of vision, but their sense of hearing is precise. They don't breathe and are immune to effects that require breathing. They gain sustenance by absorbing fluids through their skin—traditionally by immersing their hands or faceless head into the fluid to "drink" through osmosis; they can also benefit from consumables, such as potions or elixirs, in this way.

Identity Crisis.name: 身份危机 Identity Crisis
Identity Crisis.description:
频率 每天一次

触发 邹斗成功对一个邻近生物施展窃取面容

效果 当邹斗窃取该生物的面容时，她会以心灵感应撼动该生物的身份认同与自我感。该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:20] 意志豁免。若失败，该生物会怀疑自己的身份，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮。若大失败，则其减速1持续1分钟。

Frequency once per day

Trigger Zoudou successfully Steals the Face of an adjacent creature

Effect As Zoudou Steals the creature's Face, she telepathically draws at the creature's sense of identity and self. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. On a failure, the creature questions their own identity and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round. On a critical failure, they're slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Oath of Anonymity.name: 无面誓约 Oath of Anonymity
Oath of Anonymity.description:
当邹斗有脸时，她无法施放神圣预备法术。

When Zoudou has a face, she can't cast divine prepared spells.

Sensitive Hearing.name: 听觉感官 Sensitive Hearing
Sensitive Hearing.description:
只要无脸鬼处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}状态，他们就会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}状态。

As long as a noppera-bo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Impersonate Shape.name: 乔装变形 Impersonate Shape
Impersonate Shape.description:
无脸鬼变化成一个他们在过去24小时内接触过的小型或中型类人生物的形态版本，并获得目标生物的面容和声音。变形期间，无脸鬼在对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}时获得+2环境加值，并失去其无面能力和所列出的免疫。无脸鬼可以再次使用此能力变回原状。

The noppera-bo changes into a version of a Small or Medium humanoid they've touched during the last 24 hours, and gains the target creature's face and voice. While transformed, the noppera-bo gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} that creature and loses its no face ability and listed immunities. The noppera-bo can change back by using this ability again.

Regain Anonymity.name: 重归无面 Regain Anonymity
Regain Anonymity.description:
需求 邹斗有一张面孔

效果 邹斗融化她正戴着的面孔，并获得 [[/br 3d6 #Temp HP]] 临时生命值。她在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Regain Anonymity]]{1d4轮} 内不能再次重归无面。

Requirements Zoudou has a face

Effect Zoudou melts the face she's wearing and gains [[/br 3d6 #Temp HP]] temporary Hit Points. She can't Regain Anonymity again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Regain Anonymity]]{1d4 rounds}.

Silent Casting.name: 静默施法 Silent Casting
Silent Casting.description:
当邹斗处于无面状态时，她可以用一个额外的姿势成分替代言语成分。

When Zoudou is faceless, she can substitute an additional somatic component for a verbal component.

Steal Face.name: 窃取面容 Steal Face
Steal Face.description:
频率 每天一次

需求 邹斗处于无脸状态

效果 邹斗将30尺内的一个生物作为目标。该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到其下个回合开始。

失败 无脸鬼获得目标的脸。目标的脸会消失，直到其下个回合结束。直到那时，它会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，无法说话或进食，也无法闻到气味。目标还必须屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息。

大失败 如同失败，但该效果不会自动结束。目标可以在其每个回合结束时重新尝试一次新的豁免，且该难度等级在每次此类尝试时都会累计降低1。

Frequency once per day

Requirements Zoudou is faceless

Effect Zoudou targets one creature within 30 feet. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the start of its next turn.

Failure The noppera-bo gains the target's face. The target's face vanishes until the end of its next turn. Until then, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, can't speak or ingest, and can't smell. The target must also hold its breath or begin to suffocate.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect doesn't end automatically. The target can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such attempt.

Zoudou The Zealous.publicNotes:
这些无脸鬼已精通伪装艺术。

无脸鬼从背后看起来与普通人类无异，甚至可能像是你认识的某个人——直到他们转过身来，露出一张毫无五官的脸。

额外学识完美专家

普通的无脸鬼通常残忍成性，并以惊吓或折磨类人生物为乐，但并非所有无脸鬼都沉溺于邪恶。中立的无脸鬼往往是爱恶作剧的捣蛋鬼，会用自己的能力欺骗、戏弄他人；而罕见的善良无脸鬼则会用自己的能力向自己钦佩的人致敬并加以崇拜，同时把自己的时间专注于提升艺术或制作方面的技能。

额外学识无面鬼起源

关于无脸鬼的起源众说纷纭——有的说他们是变形能力出了差错的化狸，有的说他们是被诅咒扭曲的类人生物，也有的说他们是自然诞生的妖怪。甚至还有人认为，这种状态是一种像兽化症那样可以传播的诅咒。大多数无脸鬼并不记得自己的起源，而且通常更热衷于假装自己完全是另一个人。

These noppera-bos have mastered the art of disguise.

Noppera-bos appear to be regular humans from behind, and might even resemble someone you know, until they turn to reveal a featureless face.

Consummate Professionals

While the typical noppera-bo is cruel and revels in the act of frightening or tormenting humanoid creatures, not all of them wallow in evil. Neutral noppera-bos tend to be pranksters who use their abilities to trick and tease, while the rare good noppera- bos instead use their abilities to honor and idolize those they admire while focusing their own time on developing their skills at art or crafting.

Noppera-bo Origins

There are many theories on the origins of noppera-bos—from tanuki whose change shape ability went wrong, to humanoids who were warped by curses, to naturally spawning yokai. Some even theorize this condition is a transmissible curse like lycanthropy. Most noppera-bos don't recall their origins, and are often more interested in pretending to be someone else entirely.
Zoudou The Zealous.prototypeToken: 狂热者邹斗 Zoudou The Zealous

Thurible of Revelation (Moderate).name: 启示香炉（中等）
Thurible of Revelation (Moderate).description:
这只黄铜香炉悬挂在一段链条上。大多数启示香炉都饰有盘旋的天界语文字，不过也有一些是铁制的，并带有地狱语或冥地语文字。

启动—焚香 2 (操作)

成本 价值至少 5 gp 的香

效果 你点燃香炉内的香，它会燃烧 1 小时。在此期间，只要你正持握该香炉，你在宗教检定上获得 +2 物品加值，并且当你对具有宗教性质的文字进行解读文书时，任何你掷出的大成功或大失败都改为失败。

每天一次，当你启动该香炉时，你可以增强它的启示。在那次启动期间，你可以用一个交互动作将香炉举到眼前，通过烟雾窥视，获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{目睹无形者} 的效果，持续 1 轮。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lO95TwgihBdTilAB]{效果：启示香炉}

This brass censer dangles on a length of chain. Most thuribles of revelation are adorned with swirling Empyrean text, though some are iron and feature Diabolic or Chthonian text.

Activate—Burn Incense 2 (manipulate)

Cost incense worth at least 5 gp

Effect You light the incense inside the censer, and it burns for 1 hour. During that time, as long you are holding the thurible, you gain a +2 item bonus to Religion checks, and any critical failure you roll when you Decipher Writing of a religious nature is a failure instead.

Once per day, when you activate the thurible, you can increase its revelations. During that activation, you can hold the thurible up to your eyes with an Interact action to gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} for 1 round by peering through the smoke.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lO95TwgihBdTilAB]{Effect: Thurible of Revelation}

Bands of Force.name: 力场束带 Bands of Force
Bands of Force.description:
这些厚重的金属环饰有透明宝石，会在你的身体上铺展开一层坚不可摧的力场。该力场使你获得 AC 和豁免骰的 +1 物品加值，并作为护甲使你的最大敏捷调整值为 +5。你可以像对待轻甲一样将护符固定在这些金属环上。

启动—返还力场 R（力场，操作）

触发 一个生物以近战打击对你造成严重失败

效果 你使用这些束带的运动调整值 [[/r d20+14]]{+14} 对该生物进行推撞。

Decorated with clear gemstones, these thick metal bands spread an inflexible layer of force over your body. The force grants you a +1 item bonus to AC and saving throws, and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5 as armor. You can affix talismans to the bands as though they were light armor.

Activate—Return Force R (force, manipulate)

Trigger A creature critically misses you with a melee Strike

Effect You Shove the creature using the bands' Athletics modifier of [[/r d20+14]]{+14}.

Celadon Vase Decorated with Phoenixes.name: 饰有凤凰的青瓷花瓶 Celadon Vase Decorated with Phoenixes

Ittan-Momen.name: 一反木绵 Ittan-Momen

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震颤感知（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Mundane Appearance.name: 平凡外表 Mundane Appearance
Mundane Appearance.description:
当不移动时，比如在白天，一反木绵几乎与普通布料无法区分。它在伪装成普通布料时，其欺瞒检定和难度等级自动视为 26。

When not moving, such as during the day, the ittan-momen is nearly indistinguishable from normal cloth. They have an automatic result of 26 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as normal cloth.

Engulf.name: 吞没 Engulf
Engulf.description:
@Check[reflex|dc:18], @Damage[(1d8+2)[bludgeoning]] 伤害, A:脱身 难度等级 18, 破裂 5

一反木绵只能吞没一个生物。只要该生物的头在现实上能够被一反木绵的身体覆盖，它们就可以吞没一个更大体型的生物。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

@Check[reflex|dc:18], @Damage[(1d8+2)[bludgeoning]] damage, Escape DC 18, Rupture 5

The ittan-momen can Engulf only one creature. They can Engulf a creature of a larger size so long as the creature's head can feasibly be covered by the ittan-momen's body.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

Ittan-Momen.publicNotes:
诞生于大块布料的一反木绵在空中飘舞，捕捉着落日最后的余晖。一反木绵能够从任何足够大的布料中觉醒，许多美丽却遭受残酷对待的挂毯都曾引诱毫无戒心的受害者走向非命。

付丧神是由一件百年老物体与一位神使结合而形成的智慧、可移动的物体。付丧神有的无害，有的恶毒，而每个个体的性格都源于其觉醒前曾受到怎样的对待。被悉心照料的物体往往会诞生乐于助人、友善的付丧神，而遭受虐待或被遗弃的物体则会扭曲成恶意而暴力的存在。大多数付丧神生性顽皮，而且往往只想吸引活物的注意。

在那些在文化上强烈相信应当珍惜物品价值的地区，常常能发现付丧神，这种观念帮助物品存续得足够久，从而成为付丧神。拥有大量付丧神的城镇和村庄被称为“无眠城镇”，因为付丧神每夜都会举行庆典，而这些庆典有时会喧闹到让活着的居民无法安然入睡。

Born from large pieces of cloth, ittan-momen flutter in the air, catching the last rays of the setting sun. Ittan-momen can awaken from any sufficiently large cloth, and many beautiful but cruelly-treated tapestries have lured unsuspecting victims to an untimely end.

Tsukumogami are intelligent, mobile objects formed from the union between a 100-year-old object and a kami. Tsukumogami range from harmless to malicious, each individual personality a result of how the object was treated before its awakening. Well-cared-for objects tend to birth helpful, friendly tsukumogami, while mistreated or abandoned objects twist into malevolent and violent beings. Most tsukumogami are, by nature, mischievous, and oftentimes want nothing more than to occupy the attention of living creatures.

Tsukumogami can commonly be found in areas with a strong cultural belief in the value of caring for objects, which helps items survive long enough to become tsukumogami. Towns and villages with large tsukumogami populations are referred to as "sleepless towns" due to the nightly tsukumogami celebrations, which can become so raucous that they prevent the living residents from sleeping peacefully.

The open book under the skull contains Yen Rui’s notes.

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 魅影灾祸 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
末日毁灭的幻象充斥区域内每个生物的心智。该幻象造成11d6点精神伤害（基础意志豁免）。若大失败，该生物还必须在一次 @Check[reflex] 豁免中成功，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂隙中、漂流海上，或其他与其幻象相符的命运）。如果它第二次豁免失败，则还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑（状态）}，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时再次尝试一次意志豁免；若成功，它便会识破该幻象，并从震慑（状态）中恢复。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a @Check[reflex] save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Spirit Blast.name: 灵魂冲击 Spirit Blast
Spirit Blast.description:
你专注汇聚灵体能量并攻击一个生物的精魂，造成16d6精魂伤害，进行一次基础强韧豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

You concentrate ethereal energy and attack a creature's spirit, dealing 16d6 spirit damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Illusory Scene.name: 幻景 Illusory Scene
Illusory Scene.description:
你构筑出一个想象中的场景，其中包含至多10个彼此独立、体型各异的生物或物体，且它们都必须位于该法术的区域内。这些元素会产生恰当的声音与气味，并且在接触时感觉也很真实。幻景中的元素无法说话。不同于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻影生物} 法术，你场景中的生物不具备战斗能力和数据。你的场景不包括对其周围环境的改变，不过你可以将你的场景置于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{蜃景} 法术所创造的幻象环境中。

当你创造该场景时，你可以选择让它保持静态，或按照一套程序运行。静态场景虽然固定不动，但仍包含基本的自然移动。例如，风吹过一张幻觉纸片时，会让它沙沙作响。一个程序最多可长达1分钟，并会在结束时重复。例如，你可以创造一个两名兽人彼此打斗的场景，而每次重复时战斗都会以同样的方式进行。如果你创造一个循环，那么两名战士会在场景开始时和结束时处于同一位置，不过你可以将程序衔接得足够平滑，让人难以分辨循环何时结束、何时开始。任何人若观察该场景超过几分钟，几乎总会注意到它在循环。一旦你创造出该幻象，你便无法再更改这套程序。

任何接触图像任意部分，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作进行检视的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。如果他们与幻象的一部分交互，他们只会识破那一部分。只有在大成功时，他们才会识破整个场景。

升阶（6环） 你场景中的生物或物体可以说话。你必须在创建程序时为每个角色说出具体台词。该法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

升阶（8环） 如同6环版本，且持续时间为无限。

You craft an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} spell.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

Wave of Despair.name: 绝望之波 Wave of Despair
Wave of Despair.description:
你向区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作（）并且必须在其回合开始时再次尝试一次豁免；若失败，则它会因无法控制地啜泣而在该回合中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 同失败，且该生物自动减速1，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域增加为60足锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Outcast's Curse.name: 流放诅咒 Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
你使目标受到一道诅咒，使其存在感变得令人不快且惹人反感。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 持续10分钟，目标每当尝试进行一次欺瞒、交涉、威吓或表演检定时，必须掷骰两次并使用较差的结果，并且他们在遭遇的生物眼中，初始态度会变差一级（例如，变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友善}而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{冷淡}）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.hlgCesYXXHG8r9X4]{法术效果：流放诅咒（成功）}

失败 同成功，但该效果为永久。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QccOlLHtnVEmD67m]{法术效果：流放诅咒（失败）}

大失败 同失败，且目标所遭遇的生物对其初始态度会变差两级。

You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.hlgCesYXXHG8r9X4]{Spell Effect: Outcast's Curse (Success)}

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QccOlLHtnVEmD67m]{Spell Effect: Outcast's Curse (Failure)}

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你将自己以及你穿着和持握的任何物品从当前空间瞬间传送到你能看见的射程内一个未被占据的空间。如果这会让另一生物与你一同传送——即使你正将其携带在一个异次元容器中——该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你无需能够看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道其相对于你的位置与距离即可。此后，你会暂时免疫该法术1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Create Undead.name: 唤起死灵 Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
你将目标转化为一个等级不超过“生物创造仪式”表中所允许值的亡灵生物。此仪式有许多版本，每一种都只对应某一特定种类的亡灵（例如，所有丧尸共用一种仪式，骷髅共用一种，食尸鬼共用一种，等等），而创造罕见亡灵的仪式同样也是罕见。有些亡灵形态，例如巫妖，会以其自身独特的方法形成，无法通过唤起死灵的某个版本来创造。

大成功 目标成为对应类型的亡灵生物。如果它的等级至少比你低4级，你可以让它成为你的仆从。这会使其获得仆从（特征），意味着当你以命令术命令它时，它可以使用2个动作，而命令它是一个具有听觉（特征）与专注（特征）的单动作。你至多可以控制四个仆从。如果它具有智能且未成为仆从，那么该亡灵会因你唤醒了它而对你乐于助人，尽管它仍然是可怖且邪恶的生物。如果它没有智能且未成为仆从，你可以给予它一个简单命令。它会一心一意地追求该目标，无视你之后的任何命令。

成功 如同大成功，但未成为你仆从的智能亡灵只会对你友善，而未成为你仆从的无智能亡灵除非你攻击它，否则会放过你。它会在当地区域肆虐，而不是遵从你的命令。

失败 你未能创造出该亡灵。

大失败 你创造出了该亡灵，但它的灵魂因你的邪恶死灵法术而备受折磨，心中对你只剩仇恨。它会试图毁灭你。

You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in the Creature Creation Rituals table. There are many versions of this ritual, each specific to a particular type of undead (one ritual for all zombies, one for skeletons, one for ghouls, and so on), and the rituals that create rare undead are also rare. Some forms of undead, such as liches, form using their own unique methods and can't be created with a version of create undead.

Critical Success The target becomes an undead creature of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it's intelligent and doesn't become a minion, the undead is helpful to you for awakening it, though it's still a horrid and evil creature. If it's unintelligent and doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Success As critical success, except an intelligent undead that doesn't become your minion is only friendly to you, and an unintelligent undead that doesn't become your minion leaves you alone unless you attack it. It marauds the local area rather than following your command.

Failure You fail to create the undead.

Critical Failure You create the undead, but its soul, tortured by your foul necromancy, is full of nothing but hatred for you. It attempts to destroy you.
