Figment.name: 虚像 Figment
Figment.description:
你创造一个简单的幻觉声音或影像。声音会为该法术添加听觉（特征），且该声音不能包含可理解的词语或复杂的音乐。影像会添加视觉（特征），其尺寸不能大于一个 5 足立方体，且若从 15 足内观察，会显得明显粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你可以借由该幻觉尝试进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{声东击西}，并在此次欺瞒检定中获得 +2 环境加值。若此次尝试对某个生物失败，则该生物会识破这个虚像。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚像}

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

Know the Way.name: 识途 Know the Way
Know the Way.description:
在你的心眼中，你以魔法重新校正自己的方位。你立刻知晓哪个方向是北方（如果你当前位置存在北方），并且你可以选择一个你在过去24小时内到过的位置，获知它位于哪个方向。

升阶（3环） 你可以选择一个你在过去一周内到过的位置。

升阶（7环） 你可以选择一个你曾到过的位置，无论那是多久以前。

In your mind's eye, you magically reorient yourself. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location), and you can choose a location you were at within the last 24 hours and learn what direction it lies.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose a location you were at within the last week.

Heightened (7th) You can choose a location you were at regardless of how long ago you were there.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你创造一个光球，在你选择的颜色下于20足半径内发出明亮光照（并在接下来的20足内提供昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所占据的同一空间内创造该光，你可以将这道光附着在该生物身上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮在其附近。你可以维持该法术以将这道光移动最多60足；作为此次移动的一部分，你可以将其附着到一个生物身上或使其脱离。

你可以解消该法术。如果你在已经有四个光法术处于生效状态时施放此法术，你必须选择其中一个现有法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

升阶（4环） 该光球在60足半径内发出明亮光照（并在接下来的60足内提供昏暗光照）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造出一只漂浮的魔法手，可以是隐形的，也可以是幽灵般的；它抓住目标物体，并使其缓慢地向任意方向悬浮移动，最多 20 足。当你维持该法术时，你可以使该物体额外移动 20 足。如果法术结束时该物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你可以将一个无人持握且负载为 1 或更低的物体作为目标。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至 60 足，且你可以将一个无人持握且负载为 1 或更低的物体作为目标。

升阶（7环） 射程增加至 60 足，且你可以将一个无人持握且负载为 2 或更低的物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、松散且无人持用、负载为1或更低的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则造成2d6点钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体取决于你掷出的物体。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Limited Flight.name: 有限飞行 Limited Flight
Limited Flight.description:
行道女拥有等同于其速度的飞行速度，但不能飞到高于地面 10 足以上；如果她在非坚实表面上方结束其回合，她会消失并在她最后一个位于坚实地面上方的空间中重新显现，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

A path maiden has a fly Speed equal to her Speed but can't fly higher than 10 feet above the ground, and if she ends her turn above a nonsolid surface, she vanishes and rematerializes on the last space she occupied over solid ground and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality.name: 对抗活力时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

Imprisoning Grave.name: 监禁坟墓 Imprisoning Grave
Imprisoning Grave.description:
30尺。一个生物若在行道女的灵光内死亡，其灵魂会被困在自己的尸体内，直到其身体在灵光外停留1分钟为止。灵魂被困期间，无法前往来世，但仍然可以被复活，或被转化为一只不死生物。

30 feet. The soul of a creature that dies within the path maiden's aura is trapped within its corpse until its body spends 1 minute outside the aura. While trapped, the soul can't move on to the afterlife but can still be brought back to life or transformed into an undead creature.

Blasphemous Aura.name: 渎神灵光 Blasphemous Aura
Blasphemous Aura.description:
30尺。当灵光中的一个生物使用具有治疗（特征）的法术或能力时，它必须对抗行道女的法术DC – 3进行一次意志豁免。若失败，该法术或能力恢复的生命值数量减半。若大失败，活力能量会变为虚无能量，对活体目标造成伤害而非治疗它。

30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a spell or ability with the healing trait, it must succeed at a Will save against the path maiden's spell DC – 3. On a failure, the amount of Hit Points restored by the spell or ability is halved. On a critical failure, the vitality energy becomes void energy, harming a living target instead of healing it.

Corrupting Doubt.name: 腐化疑念 Corrupting Doubt
Corrupting Doubt.description:
被行道女的手部打击伤害到的生物必须意志豁免成功，以避免陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1轮（大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速2}）。

A creature damaged by the path maiden's hand Strike must succeed at a Will save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure).

Pharasma Lore.name: 法莱斯玛学识 Pharasma Lore

Path Maiden (Spring's Path).publicNotes:
在神门，那些将自己的一呼一吸都奉献给法拉斯玛、却最终在临终之际违逆这位女神的崇拜者，有时会在死后转化为行道女。所有行道女所穿的衣装，都是她们昔日信仰残留下来的最后痕迹，是她们耻辱的永久提醒。

行道游民

行道女几乎总是以女性形态显现。那些以男性形态显现者，则被称为行道游民。这些亡灵拥有相同的能力，但往往游历更广；她们所体现的，与其说是背弃了法拉斯玛掌管生与死的职责，不如说是背弃了她作为预言者与命运操弄者的职责。

Worshippers in Shenmen who devote their every breath to Pharasma only to defy the goddess with their last sometimes transform, upon death, into path maidens. The garments all path maidens wear are the last vestiges of their former faith, a permanent reminder of their disgrace.

Path Nomads

Path maidens almost always manifest in feminine forms. Those who manifest in masculine forms are instead known as path nomads. These undead have the same abilities but tend to travel more widely; they represent turning one's back on Pharasma's role as a prophet and manipulator of destiny than of her roles over birth and death.

Living Boulder.name: 活巨石 Living Boulder

Earth Glide.name: 掘地潜行 Earth Glide
Earth Glide.description:
活巨石可以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{掘穴}穿过土质物体，包括岩石。当它如此行动时，它以其完整的掘穴速度移动，不会留下隧道或任何经过的痕迹。

A living boulder can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow} through earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, it moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

Rolling Charge.name: 滚动冲锋 Rolling Charge
Rolling Charge.description:
活巨石进行两次行走，然后可以用其颚进行一次打击。此次颚打击获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{击倒}。

The living boulder Strides twice, and can then make a Strike with its jaws. This jaws Strike gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown}.

Living Boulder.publicNotes:
活巨石在土元素位面中翻滚并滑行，收集宝石和金属碎片，直到它们的表面看起来像覆盖着藤壶的船体。活巨石的智力只比许多动物略高，在土元素位面中所扮演的角色，与宇宙中各个世界上的大型群居动物大致相同。

某些土元素会显现为特定类型的物质，无论是巨石、沙子还是水晶。

Living boulders roll and glide through the Plane of Earth, gathering gemstones and metal shards until their surfaces resemble a ship's hull covered in barnacles. Barely more intelligent than many animals, living boulders fill much the same role on the Plane of Earth as the great herd animals found on worlds in the Universe.

Certain earth elementals manifest as specific types of material, be they boulders, sand, or crystals.

Spellguard Shield.name: 护法盾 Spellguard Shield
Spellguard Shield.description:
这面钢盾带有奥秘雕文，用以防御魔法。只要你举起这面钢盾（硬度 6，HP 24，BT 12），你便获得其对以你为目标的法术进行豁免骰的环境加值（以及对 AC 的环境加值），并且如果你拥有该动作，你可以对以你为目标的法术使用护盾格挡。

This shield bears eldritch glyphs to guard against magic. While you have this steel shield (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) raised, you gain its circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells that target you (as well as to AC), and you can Shield Block spells that target you if you have that action.

Warding Bell.name: 守护铃 Warding Bell

Flare Up.name: 再度爆发 Flare Up
Flare Up.description:
守护铃的光从微弱的闪烁增强到足以照亮整个房间。随后，该危害掷先攻。

The warding bell's light increases from a faint flickering to luminous enough that the whole room is brightly lit. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Warding Bell.disable:
在连续三轮内，使用礼仪摇铃器（由马戈凯携带）以交互动作连续摇响铃铛八次，会自动停用该危害；@Check[thievery|dc:36]以熄灭铃内的火焰，@Check[religion|dc:36]以向法拉斯玛祈求熄灭火焰，或使用解除魔法或窃光者的汲取光照（6级；反制 DC 29）

Ringing the bell as an Interact action eight times in succession with the ceremonial ringer (carried by Mago Kai) over the course of three consecutive rounds automatically deactivates the hazard, @Check[thievery|dc:36] to extinguish the flame within the bell, @Check[religion|dc:36] to appeal to Pharasma to extinguish the flame, or dispel magic or a shimmerthief's Drain Light (6th level; counteract DC 29)
Warding Bell.hazarddescription:
在圣祠的中心，悬挂着一口巨大的青铜寺钟。

At the heart of the shrine hangs a massive bronze temple bell.
Warding Bell.reset:
重新激活守护铃需要进行一项复杂的仪式，耗时数日。

Reactivating the warding bell requires a complicated rite taking several days.
Warding Bell.routine:
（1个动作；神圣、情绪、惑控、恐惧、心灵）守护铃发出一阵只有C11区域内的亡灵或转生玩家角色才能听见的命运占卜般铃响；受影响的角色必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:30|traits:divine,emotion,enchantment,fear,mental] 意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并在24小时内暂时免疫守护铃的例行动作。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}，并受到 @Damage[6d6[mental]] 伤害。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}，受到 @Damage[12d6[mental]] 伤害，且只要仍处于惊惧状态，就会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。

(1 action; divine, emotion, enchantment, fear, mental) The warding bell emits a harrowing ring that can be heard only by undead or transmigrated PCs in area C11; affected characters must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30|traits:divine,emotion,enchantment,fear,mental] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to the warding bell's routine for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and takes @Damage[6d6[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, takes @Damage[12d6[mental]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} as long as it remains frightened.

Hua De-ge.name: 华德歌 Hua De-ge

Broom (Functions as a Staff).name: 扫帚（作为法杖使用中） Broom (Functions as a Staff)
Broom (Functions as a Staff).description:
这根长木棍可助人行走，也能施展强力一击。

This long piece of wood can aid in walking and deliver a mighty blow.

Innkeeper's Apron (Functions as Leather.name: 旅店老板的围裙（视为皮甲） Innkeeper's Apron (Functions as Leather Armor)
Innkeeper's Apron (Functions as Leather.description:
这种护甲由柔韧与定型的煮制皮革混合制成，既提供一定的防护，又将灵活性发挥到最大。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Font of Gossip.name: 流言喷泉 Font of Gossip
Font of Gossip.description:
旅店老板的生意让他们对附近发生的事情了如指掌。一个人可以在 30 分钟内向旅店老板@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{打探消息}，而不必走遍整个街区挨家询问。每个人每天只能从同一位旅店老板那里打听一次流言，而且前提是该旅店老板对该人是友善或乐于助人的。无论是谁向旅店老板询问某个话题，只要旅店老板自那之后没有得知更多消息，他们所知道的关于该话题的信息就不会改变。

The innkeeper's business gives them insight into the neighborhood's happenings. A person can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} from an innkeeper in 30 minutes rather than canvassing an entire neighborhood. Each person can learn gossip from an innkeeper only once per day, and only if the innkeeper is friendly or helpful to that individual. Whatever information the innkeeper knows about a given topic doesn't change if someone else asks the innkeeper about that topic, unless the innkeeper has since learned more.

Innkeeper's Advice.name: 旅店老板的建议 Innkeeper's Advice
Innkeeper's Advice.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 旅店老板向除自己之外的单个生物给出一些恰当的建议。持续24小时，当该生物的技能检定或豁免失败时，它可以回想起这条建议并重骰该检定，改为使用第二次结果。一旦该生物使用了此能力，其效果即结束。接受过旅店老板的建议的生物会暂时免疫此能力，持续1个月。

Frequency once per day

Effect The innkeeper gives some pertinent advice to a single creature other than themself. For 24 hours, when that creature fails a skill check or saving throw, they can recall this advice and reroll the check, using the second result instead. Once that creature uses this ability, its effect ends. A creature that receives the Innkeeper's Advice is temporarily immune to the ability for 1 month.

Home Base Brawler.name: 主基地斗士 Home Base Brawler
Home Base Brawler.description:
这位旅店老板知道如何平息爆发的斗殴。当旅店老板在自己的店内战斗时，他们的打击在攻击检定上获得+1环境加值，额外造成1d4伤害，并获得非致命（特征），如果其原本还没有该特征的话。旅店老板可以选择不获得此增益。

The innkeeper knows how to settle fights that break out. When the innkeeper is fighting in their establishment, their Strikes gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll, deal an additional 1d4 damage, and gain the nonlethal trait if they don't already have it. The innkeeper can choose not to gain this benefit.

Hua De-ge.blurb:
男澡堂老板
Male bathhouse owner

Argyrzei.name: 稽折魔 Argyrzei

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Dominate.name: 支配术 Dominate
Dominate.description:
你控制目标，迫使其服从你的命令。如果你下达一个明显会自我毁灭的命令，目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令为止。该效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}，因为它正奋力抵抗你的命令。

失败 你控制目标。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{被控制（状态）}，但它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次意志豁免。若成功，则该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但只有当你对其下达了违背其本性的新的命令时，目标才会获得新的豁免，例如杀死它的盟友。

高阶化（10环） 持续时间为无限。

You take command of the target, forcing it to obey your orders. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Illusory Scene.name: 幻象场景 Illusory Scene
Illusory Scene.description:
你塑造出一个想象中的场景，其中包含至多10个彼此独立、体型各异的生物或物体，且它们都必须位于法术的区域内。这些元素会发出恰当的声音并散发气味，接触起来也感觉真实。幻象场景中的元素无法说话。与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻影生物} 法术不同，你场景中的生物不具备战斗能力和数据。你的场景不包含其周围环境的变化，不过你可以将你的场景放置在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{蜃景} 法术所创造的幻象环境中。

当你创造该场景时，你可以选择让它静止不动，或按程序运行。虽然静态场景是固定不动的，但它仍包含基本的自然移动。比如，风吹动一张幻象纸片时，会让它沙沙作响。一个程序最长可达1分钟，并会在结束后重复。例如，你可以创造一个两名兽人彼此打斗的场景，而每次重复时，这场打斗都会以相同的方式进行。如果你创造了一个循环，那么两名战士会在场景开始时和结束时处于同一位置，但你可以将程序衔接得足够平滑，使人难以分辨循环何时结束、何时开始。任何连续观察该场景超过几分钟的人，几乎都会注意到它在循环。你无法在创造出该幻象后再更改这个程序。

任何接触到影像任意部分的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。如果他们与幻象的一部分发生交互，他们只会识破那一部分。只有在大成功时，他们才会识破整个场景。

高阶化（6环） 你场景中的生物或物体可以说话。你必须在创建程序时，为每个角色说出其具体台词。该法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

高阶化（8环） 如同6环版本，且持续时间为无限。

You craft an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} spell.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

Subconscious Suggestion.name: 潜意识暗示 Subconscious Suggestion
Subconscious Suggestion.description:
你将一个潜意识暗示深植于目标的心灵之中，使其在你指定的触发发生时遵从。你向目标建议一套行动方案。你的指令必须以某种方式措辞，使其对目标来说像是合乎逻辑的行动方案，而且不能是自我毁灭的，也不能明显违背目标自身的利益。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你曾试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是在正常地与它交谈，而不是对它施放法术。

失败 该暗示会保留在目标的潜意识中，直到你下一次进行准备。如果触发在此之前发生，目标会立即遵从你的暗示。该效果的持续时间为1分钟，或者直到目标完成一个有限的暗示，或该暗示变得具有自我毁灭性，或产生其他明显的负面影响。

大失败 如失败，但持续时间为1小时。

高阶化（9环） 你最多可以指定10个生物为目标。

You implant a subconscious suggestion deep within the target's mind for them to follow when a trigger you specify occurs. You suggest a course of action to the target. Your directive must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target, and it can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The suggestion remains in the target's subconscious until the next time you prepare. If the trigger occurs before then, the target immediately follows your suggestion. The effect has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一次心灵冲击使其陷入眩晕。该冲击造成 1d6 点心灵伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

高阶化（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Illusory Disguise (At Will).name: 幻象伪装（随意）
Illusory Disguise (At Will).description:
你制造出一个幻象，使目标看起来像是另一名身体形态相同、且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近的生物。这种伪装通常足以隐藏其身份，但不足以乔装成某个特定个体。该法术会改变其外观与声音，但不会改变举止。你可以改变其衣物和穿戴物品的外观，例如让其护甲看起来像连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，而从该生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{乔装} 这一欺瞒用法设定好伪装；它会无视目标因将自己伪装成差异较大的生物而可能承受的任何处境减值，给予 +4 状态加值于欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿伪装，并允许目标在此类欺瞒检定中即使未受训也能加上其等级。你可以解消该法术。

高阶化（3环） 目标可以看起来像任何同体型的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体，才能复制其外观；你必须听过其声音，才能复制其声音。

高阶化（4环） 你最多可以以10个自愿生物为目标。如果你以多个生物为目标，你可以为每个目标选择不同的伪装，但其中任何一个都不能乔装成特定个体。你可以分别解消每个伪装，或一并全部解消。

高阶化（7环） 如4环，但你可以选择能够乔装成特定个体的伪装。你必须见过该个体，才能复制其外观；你必须听过其声音，才能复制其声音。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状况好得多或差得多。施放此法术时，决定你要让该物体看起来是破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被弄得看起来破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。完好的物品若被弄得看起来更好，则会显得仿佛崭新出厂，并且经过高度抛光或精心保养。破损物品会显得完好且功能正常。已摧毁的物品无法受到该法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破该幻觉。

升环（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升环（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的疼痛折磨着目标，造成 2d4 心灵伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到全部初始伤害，但不受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标受到全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，则持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升环（+1） 伤害增加 2d4，且持续伤害增加 1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造出一只漂浮的魔法之手，可以是隐形的，也可以如幽灵般，抓住目标物体并使其向任意方向缓慢飘浮，最多 20 尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动 20 尺。如果法术结束时该物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你可以将一个负载为 1 或以下的无人照看的物体作为目标。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个负载为 1 或以下的无人照看的物体作为目标。

升阶（7环） 射程增加至 60 尺，且你可以将一个负载为 2 或以下的无人照看的物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动弹射 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个位于射程内、松散且无人照看、且负载为1或以下的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若命中，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——具体取决于你所掷出的物体。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全部伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Cursesense.name: 诅咒感知 Cursesense
Cursesense.description:
稽折魔可以通过它诅咒过的任何银制物品进行视听，只要该物品位于1英里内。

The argyrzei can see and hear through any silver object it cursed, as long as the object is within 1 mile.

Headless.name: 无头 Headless
Headless.description:
稽折魔没有头，但仍然能够像自己有头一样听、说、看和闻。稽折魔免疫斩首效果，例如由锐锋武器造成的那些效果。

An argyrzei is headless but can still hear, speak, see, and smell as if it had a head. The argyrzei is immune to decapitation effects, such as those caused by vorpal weapons.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被稽折魔杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为不死生物。稽折魔会自动尝试反制任何将其所杀死的生物复活或转化为不死生物的企图（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+23 #Counteract]]{+23}，反制等级第7级）。如果杀死该生物的稽折魔自身被杀死，那么该生物就可以正常地从死亡中被带回，或正常地变成不死生物。

Creatures killed by an argyrzei are difficult to bring back to life or to animate as undead. The argyrzei automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+23 #Counteract]]{+23}, counteract level 7th). If the argyrzei who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Infect Silver.name: 染银 Infect Silver
Infect Silver.description:
频率 每天一次

效果稽折魔对一个邻近且不大于2负载的银物体进行专注。该物体变为受诅咒；如果该物体正被携带，其携带者可以通过一次 @Check[will|dc:33] 意志豁免来抵抗该物体变为受诅咒。稽折魔最多可以同时维持五个诅咒；如果它感染第六件银物品，最早受诅咒的物品会失去诅咒。

染疫银

罕见

CURSED

魔法

用法 诅咒银物品

携带染疫银1分钟后，它会纠缠到你身上。你变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，并在诅咒持续期间一直保持如此。只要你仍受诅咒影响，你对抗由宁多鲁斯制造的心灵效果的所有豁免骰都会受到–2状态减值。

Frequency once per day

Effect The argyrzei concentrates on an adjacent silver object that's no larger than Bulk 2. That object becomes cursed; if the object is being carried, the object's carrier can resist the object becoming cursed with a @Check[will|dc:33] save. The argyrzei can maintain up to five curses simultaneously; if it infects a sixth silver item, the oldest cursed item becomes uncursed.

Infected Silver

RARE

CURSED

MAGICAL

Usage curses silver item

After 1 minute of carrying infected silver, it fuses to you. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and remain so as long as the curse persists. As long as you remain cursed, you take a –2 status penalties to all saving throws against mental effects created by nindorus.

Manifest Silver Blade.name: 具现银剑 Manifest Silver Blade
Manifest Silver Blade.description:
需求 稽折魔未携带银刃

效果 稽折魔从自己颈部的断口中拔出一把破损的银武器，将其变形为一把+1强击创伤银手半剑。若这把武器脱离稽折魔的持有，它便会崩解成沙。

Requirements The argyrzei isn't carrying a silver blade

Effect The argyrzei pulls one of the broken silver weapons from the stump of its neck, transforming it into a +1 striking wounding silver bastard sword. This weapon crumbles into sand if it leaves the argyrzei's possession.

Argyrzei.publicNotes:
大多数宁多鲁斯都会被银所伤，但稽折魔不会。相反，稽折魔会把银当作传播疾病与痛苦的手段，并借此帮助它们操纵那些在不知不觉间落入其染疫赋礼诅咒之人们的心智。它们乐于伪装自己，然后将染疫银出售或赠送给受害者。其他灵堕魔尤其畏惧稽折魔对银的掌控，因为它们知道，这些存在能够用它们的银刃造成痛苦的创伤。

稽折魔外表近似人形，但双脚脚尖向后，而且没有头。它们发着红光的断颈里塞满了各式各样的小刀、刃器和金属碎片。这些宁多鲁斯象征着艺术被创造、摧毁，再循环为新艺术的循环。

Most nindorus are harmed by silver, but not the argyrzei. Instead, argyrzeis use silver as a method of spreading sickness and pain, and to help them manipulate the minds of those who unwittingly fall under the curse of their infected gifts. They delight in disguising themselves and then selling or giving infected silver to victims. Other nindorus particularly fear argyrzeis for their mastery over silver, knowing that they're capable of causing painful wounds with their silver blades.

Argyrzeis appear humanoid, but their feet point backwards and they have no heads. Their glowing red neck stumps are stuffed with a wide assortment of knives, blades, and shards of metal. These nindorus represent the cycle of art being created, destroyed, and recycled into new art.

Dami's Extra Thanks.name: 达米的额外致谢 Dami's Extra Thanks
Dami's Extra Thanks.tokenName: 达米的额外致谢 Dami's Extra Thanks

Darkvision Elixir (Lesser).name: 黑暗视觉灵药（次级）
Darkvision Elixir (Lesser).description:
启动 1 （操作）

饮用这瓶灵药后，你在黑暗中的视力会变得更加敏锐。你获得黑暗视觉，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7UL8belWmo7U5YGM]{效果：黑暗视觉灵药（次级）}

Activate 1 (manipulate)

After you drink this elixir, your sight becomes sharper in darkness. You gain darkvision for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7UL8belWmo7U5YGM]{Effect: Darkvision Elixir (Lesser)}

Dami's Extra Thanks.prototypeToken: 达米的额外致谢 Dami's Extra Thanks

Shrine Caretaker.name: 圣坛看护者 Shrine Caretaker

Water Vulnerability.name: 水之弱点 Water Vulnerability
Water Vulnerability.description:
当圣坛看护者受到水系效果造成的伤害时，这个不死生物会因剧痛而备受折磨，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。水无法浇灭圣坛看护者的烈焰。浮现于暴雨中的圣坛看护者在停留于倾盆大雨中期间，视同处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。它们无法自行降低这一恶心状态，但如果在庇护处（例如C3b或C3d区域）结束其回合，则该状态会自动结束。

When a shrine caretaker is dealt damage by a water effect, the undead is wracked by pain, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. Water can't douse the shrine caretaker's flames. A shrine caretaker who emerges into the rainstorm functions as if @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} as long as they remain in the downpour. They can't lower this sickened condition on their own, but it ends automatically if they end their turn in shelter (such as areas C3b or C3d).

Blazing Howl.name: 炽焰嚎叫 Blazing Howl
Blazing Howl.description:
圣坛看护者痛苦地尖叫，使 @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] 内的生物突然燃起火焰，对区域内每个生物造成 @Damage[4d6[fire]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:17|basic] 意志豁免）。豁免大失败的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}；此惊惧状态是一种情绪、恐惧和精神效果。

圣坛看护者在 [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Blazing Howl]]{1d4轮} 内不能再次使用炽焰嚎叫。

The shrine caretaker screams in agony, causing creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] to burst into flame, which deals @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage to each creature in the area (@Check[will|dc:17|basic] save). A creature that critically fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}; this frightened condition is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.

The caretaker can't use Blazing Howl again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Blazing Howl]]{1d4 rounds}.

Shrine Caretaker.publicNotes:
生命终于烈焰之中的生物，可能会以一种名为焚身尸的不死生物形态归来。即使在死后仍持续燃烧，他们也被永恒的痛苦与悲恸吞噬，并因此被驱使着陷入鲁莽的暴力之中。

尽管焚身尸已无法再被火焰真正伤害，但他们会永远承受自己死亡最后时刻的感受，被无尽的灼烧痛苦反复煎熬。许多焚身尸会试图把自己浸入湖泊或河流中，因为他们认为缠绕自身形体的火焰就是痛苦的根源。然而，水带来的阻碍远多于帮助，浸没其中只会进一步加剧他们的痛楚。

焚身尸已不再拥有以痛苦哀号之外的方式交流的能力，但他们依然保留着感官与记忆。然而，他们很少会去依据过去行事，因为痛苦淹没了关于友谊、家人和复仇的念头。随着时间推移，焚身尸会被驱使着将自己的痛苦分享给他人，因为当他们身上的烈焰蔓延到另一个活着的生物身上时，他们会感受到一瞬短暂的解脱。正因如此，焚身尸常常与活物发生冲突，不过那些攻击大型聚居地的焚身尸通常都活不了太久。

有些焚身尸源自死于人体自燃的人，他们会突然变得炽热无比，继而猛然起火。这一神秘过程尚未被完全理解，不过有些学者认为，这是由于火位面的力量发生了变化，在物质位面形成了足以致命的高热点。更为罕见的是，焚身尸也会在具有格外强烈魔法火焰的区域附近出现，例如用于制造魔法武器的熔炉；当火焰点燃生物，使其被活活烧死时，他们便会在短短片刻间超越死亡，转化为不死生物。

无论引发他们烈焰焚身的源头为何，焚身尸所经历的可怖死亡，都会在来世中作祟。他们那被烧焦、熏黑的尸体上燃烧着火焰，持续不断地提醒着他们生命最后的痛苦时刻。烧焦血肉的恶臭预示着他们的到来，每一个焚身尸身后都会拖曳着滚滚黑烟。

Creatures whose lives end in flames can return as undead called combusted. Still burning even in death, they're consumed by everlasting anguish that drives them to reckless violence.

Although combusted can no longer be truly harmed by fire, they endure the final moments of their death eternally, searing them with endless burning pain. Many combusted attempt to douse themselves in lakes or rivers, believing the flames that wreath their forms must be the source of their pain. However, water is more hindrance than help, and being immersed in it only amplifies their agony.

No longer possessing the ability to communicate in anything other than agonized wails, combusted nonetheless retain their senses and memories. Yet they rarely seek to act on their past, for the pain drowns out thoughts of friendships, family, and vengeance. In time, combusted are driven to share their pain with others, for the instant their flames catch fire on another living being, they feel a single, fleeting moment of relief. This relief leads combusted into conflict with living creatures often, although those that attack large settlements rarely survive long.

Some combusted form from those who died via spontaneous combustion, suddenly becoming so hot they burst into flames. This mysterious process isn't fully understood, though some scholars attribute it to shifts in power in the Plane of Fire causing hot spots in the Material Plane powerful enough to kill. Much more rarely, combusted arise around areas with especially intense magical flames, such as forges used to create magic weapons, when the fire sets creatures ablaze, so they burn to death and transcend into undeath in mere moments.

Regardless of the source of their conflagration, the horrifying deaths that combusted suffered haunt them in the afterlife. Their charred, blackened corpses alight with flames are a constant reminder of their final moments in pain. The stench of burning flesh heralds their presence, each combusted leaving black smoke in their wake.

Stingy.name: 刺仔 Stingy

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 震动感知（不精确）60尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet

Forest Scorpion Venom.name: 森林蝎毒 Forest Scorpion Venom
Forest Scorpion Venom.description:

Stingy.publicNotes:
这些巨大而可怖的蛛形纲生物，从头到尾巴根部通常长达8英尺。巨型蝎子是各种沙漠栖居生物偏爱的驮兽和战争野兽，尤其是克霍洛斯。不过，它们更常见于荒野之中。在那里，它们栖息于山腰的洞穴里，或掘穴于浅浅的沙层之下，静待猎物游荡到附近。

作为沙漠、森林、稀树草原和荒地中披覆几丁质甲壳的灾星，蝎子是致命的蛛形纲生物，拥有强力的钳击和痛苦的刺针。几乎在任何气候中都能发现蝎子，它们以耐心的隐秘与纯粹的力量相结合来猎杀猎物。大多数蝎子生活在地下洞穴中，或是独行的猎人，或是大型群落的一部分。这些蛛形纲生物如此令人畏惧而危险，以至于在许多文化中，它们被视作神祇，或被看作同时象征死亡以及防护此等死亡的二元符号。

These massive, terrifying arachnids are typically 8 feet long from head to the base of the tail. Giant scorpions are the favored pack animals and war beasts of various desert-dwelling creatures, particularly kholos. They are most commonly encountered in the wild, however. There they lair in mountainside caves or burrow beneath shallow layers of sand where they lie in wait for prey to wander near.

Chitinous scourges of deserts, forests, savannas, and badlands, scorpions are deadly arachnids with powerful pincers and a painful sting. Scorpions can be found in nearly every climate, where they hunt their prey with a mixture of patient stealth and raw strength. Most scorpions live in underground burrows, either as lone hunters or part of a larger colony. These arachnids are so feared and dangerous that in many cultures, they are treated as deities or dualistic symbols of both death and protection from said death.

War Wraith.publicNotes:
这些由邪恶军阀或嗜血将军遗留下的骇人灵性残迹，是由阴影与死亡构成的高大幽魂。和其他缚灵一样，战争缚灵栖息于世间阴暗之处，但它们更可能远行，以播撒恐惧或积累影响；当穿越洒满斑驳日光的土地时，它们往往会停留在幽暗林间空地或不祥废墟中。战争缚灵通常傲慢自大，鲜少与同类结群，反而更喜欢支配普通缚灵组成的群体。某些格外强大的死灵法师或许能强迫成群的战争缚灵为其效力。不过，若是某个尤其恶毒的目标——例如摧毁一处光与生命的堡垒——也可能使数个战争缚灵为了共同目的而聚集在一起。

战争缚灵的起源

并非每一个战争缚灵都曾经是独立的个体。它们之中有许多会随着时代推移而凝聚成形，在迷失灵魂汇聚之处，由多个缚灵融合而成；这些灵魂的精魄与意识会以某种方式被剥离、撕裂或削弱。这类战争缚灵在思考与交流时，往往并不像一个强大的单一存在，而更像是一阵嘈杂的众声喧哗——这些声音常常彼此冲突，但当它们同意协同工作时，便会真正令人毛骨悚然。在虚空能量汇聚之地，例如虚空或恐惧之岛，战争缚灵经常会以这种方式形成。

These menacing spiritual remnants of wicked warlords or bloodthirsty generals are towering specters of shadow and death. Like other wraiths, war wraiths haunt the shadowy places of the world but are more likely to travel greater distances to sow terror or amass influence, often sticking to dark glades or sinister ruins when journeying across sun-dappled lands. War wraiths tend to be arrogant and rarely form a pack with others of their kind, preferring instead to dominate groups of ordinary wraiths. A particularly powerful necromancer might compel packs of war wraiths into service. However, a particularly malevolent goal—such as eradicating a bastion of light and life—might draw several war wraiths together in a common purpose.

War Wraith Origins

Not every war wraith was once an individual. Many of them coalesce over time, merging from multiple wraiths where lost souls accumulate and have their spirits and consciousnesses shorn apart or undermined in some way. These war wraiths tend to think and communicate not as one potent being, but as a riot of voices—often conflicting but truly bone-chilling when they agree to work in unison. In locations where void energy focuses, such as in the Void or on the Isle of Terror, war wraiths form in this way frequently.

你通过伸出的双臂汲取其他生物的鲜血与生命力。你对区域内的活体生物造成12d6点虚无伤害，进行基础强韧豁免。

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Hallucination.name: 镜花水月 Hallucination
Hallucination.description:
目标会持续将某样事物侦测为另一种事物，无法侦测到实际存在的某物，或侦测到并不存在的某物，但这不会改变其信念。你选择施加以上哪一种效果，并决定镜花水月的具体内容。例如，你可以让目标将所有精灵看作人类、无法侦测到其兄弟的存在、即使并不存在也会在自己身上看到心爱的护符，或在城镇中心看到一座高塔。

目标可以先进行一次初始意志豁免，效果如下。此后，每当其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}或直接与镜花水月交互时，也都会获得一次意志豁免来识破该镜花水月。例如，每当目标与某个精灵交互、不小心撞到其兄弟、试图查看自己的护符，或研究那座高塔时，都可以尝试识破镜花水月。在由游戏主持判定的某些情境下，目标可带有巨大的环境加值来尝试识破，例如目标试图攀爬那座并不存在的高塔时。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到它识破为止，但它知道镜花水月是什么。

失败 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到它识破为止。

大失败 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到它识破为止，并且它信任自己虚假的感官，在识破时进行的豁免获得 -4 环境减值。

升阶（6环） 选择将目标改为至多10个生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为直到你的下一次每日准备。

升阶（8环） 选择将目标改为任意数量的生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为无限。

The target consistently detects one thing as another, can't detect something that's there, or detects something that's not there, though it doesn't alter their beliefs. You choose which of these effects applies, and you determine the specifics of the hallucination. For example, you could make the target see all elves as humans, be unable to detect the presence of their brother, see their beloved good luck charm on their person even when it isn't, or see a tower in the center of town.

The target can attempt an initial Will save, with effects below. They also receive a Will save to disbelieve the hallucination every time they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or directly interact with the hallucination. For example, the target could attempt to disbelieve the hallucination each time they interacted with an elf, bumped into their brother accidentally, tried to check their charm, or studied the tower. The target can attempt to disbelieve with a large circumstance bonus in situations determined by the GM, such as if the target attempted to climb the nonexistent tower.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, but it knows what the hallucination is.

Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves.

Critical Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, and it trusts its false senses, taking a -4 circumstance penalty to saves to disbelieve.

Heightened (6th) Choose to either target up to 10 creatures or change the spell's duration to until your next daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) Choose to either target any number of creatures or change the spell's duration to unlimited.

Phantasmal Killer.description:
你创造出一个目标所能想象到的最可怖生物的幻象。只有该法术的目标能够看见这名杀手，尽管你也能看到幻象那模糊的轮廓飞驰向前发动攻击。杀手的效果取决于目标意志豁免的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到 @Damage[4d6[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标受到 @Damage[(max(8,@item.rank*2))d6[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标恐惧至极，甚至可能因此死亡。它必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|traits:incapacitation] 强韧豁免；如果目标失败，则其死亡。若强韧豁免成功，目标受到 @Damage[(max(12,@item.rank*3))d6[mental]] 伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}直到其下一回合结束，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 4}。此效果具有失能特征。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(max(8,@item.rank*2))d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a @Check[fortitude|traits:incapacitation] save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes @Damage[(max(12,@item.rank*3))d6[mental]] damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}
