Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一道心灵震击使其陷入眩晕。该震击造成 1d6 点心灵伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出一种由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类同时正常喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你不能制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你让目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状况要好得多或差得多。施放此法术时，决定你想让该物体看起来是破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装得破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}而粗劣。完好的物品若被伪装得更好，则会看起来仿佛崭新出厂，并经过高度抛光或精心保养。破损物品会显得完好且可以正常使用。被摧毁的物品不能受此法术影响。与该物品交互的生物可以尝试识破这个幻象。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动口，但话语并不会从你的口中说出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，和你平常只是动口不出声时没有任何区别，但目标却能像站在你身边一样清楚地听见你的话。目标可以用一个反应动作（）做出简短回应；如果他们愿意，也可以在自己下一回合中以自由动作（）回应，但他们必须看得见你且位于射程内才能这么做。如果他们回应，他们的回答也会像最初的传讯一样，直接送到你的耳边。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被煞星魔杀死的生物很难复活，或被转化为亡灵。煞星魔会自动尝试反制任何将其所杀死的生物复活，或将其转化为亡灵的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]{+21}，反制等级6环）。如果杀死该生物的煞星魔本身被杀，那么该生物就可以正常地从死亡中归来，或正常地变成亡灵。

Creatures killed by an shisagishin are difficult to bring back to life or to animate as undead. The shisagishin automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]{+21}, counteract level 6th). If the shisagishin who slew the creature is itself slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Burst From Death.name: 死中暴起 Burst From Death
Burst From Death.description:
需求 尚未掷先攻，且煞星魔正以具现尸壳伪装成一具尸体

触发 一个生物触碰了伪装中的煞星魔，或触碰了安置煞星魔的棺材或其他容器

效果 煞星魔猛烈地舒展开来，显露出其真正形态，撕碎其腐朽的尸壳，并在掷先攻之前尝试对一个相邻目标进行一次爪击。

Requirements Initiative hasn't yet been rolled, and the shisagishin is disguised as a corpse with Manifest Corpse Shell

Trigger A creature touches the disguised shisagishin or a coffin or other container the shisagishin has been placed into

Effect The shisagishin violently unfolds into its true form, shredding its decaying corpse shell, and attempts a claw Strike on an adjacent target before it rolls initiative.

Manifest Corpse Shell.name: 具现尸壳 Manifest Corpse Shell
Manifest Corpse Shell.description:
煞星魔将它的手臂和腿缩入身体，解除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并通过持续10分钟的专注，在自身周围显现出一具腐烂和/或残缺的类人生物尸体。煞星魔可以通过以欺瞒冒充它以前见过的某个特定生物，使这具尸体看起来像是该生物的遗骸。一旦它的尸壳显现完成，在煞星魔下一次行动之前，它看起来就像一具尸体。它在伪装成尸体时的欺瞒检定和难度等级自动获得44的结果。

The shisagishin tucks its arms and legs into its body, drops @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and manifests a decaying and/or mutilated humanoid corpse around itself over the course of 10 minutes of concentration. The shisagishin can cause this corpse to appear to be the remains of a specific creature it has seen before by Impersonating that creature with Deception. Once its corpse shell has manifested, until the next time the shisagishin acts, it appears to be a corpse. It has an automatic result of 44 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a corpse.

Spread Decay.name: 散播腐败 Spread Decay
Spread Decay.description:
煞星魔使任意数量被其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{抓住}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}的生物的血肉迅速开始腐朽。这些生物中的每一个都必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:32]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到@Damage[2d8[void]]伤害。

失败 该生物受到@Damage[4d8[void]]伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。

大失败 该生物受到@Damage[6d8[void]]伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}

The shisagishin causes the flesh of any number of creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by it to swiftly begin to decay. Each of those creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d8[void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d8[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d8[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}

Shisagishin.publicNotes:
煞星魔乐于潜入一个群体之中，然后将自己伪装成某位挚爱之人或备受爱戴的公众人物那具严重腐烂或残缺的遗骸，只为在葬礼期间突然以其真实形态活过来。煞星魔体现了腐朽催生新生的循环。

手作栖息地

煞星魔偏好在本就充满冲突且易发事故的地区游荡，但如果有需要，它也会很乐意亲手制造出这样的地方。它们可能会给水井下毒，把疾病传播给健康的牲畜，甚至与腐败的人类合作，只要这意味着能够自由杀戮。受诅咒的城镇或闹鬼的道路，有时就是这类煞星魔的游乐场。

The shisagishin takes delight in infiltrating a community and then disguising itself as the horribly decayed or mutilated remains of a loved one or adored public figure, only to spring to life in its true form during funeral services. A shisagishin epitomizes the cycle of decay giving rise to new life.

Handmade Habitats

A shisagishin prefers to roam areas already rife with conflict and potential accidents, but it will happily create such a location if needed. They might poison wells, introduce disease to healthy livestock, or even collaborate with corrupt humans if it means the freedom to kill. Cursed towns or haunted roads are sometimes the playground of such a shisagishin.

Fine Lavender Incense Cone.name: 优质薰衣草线香锥 Fine Lavender Incense Cone

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Life's Fresh Bloom.name: 生命花开 Life's Fresh Bloom
Life's Fresh Bloom.description:
你周围的地面绽放出生命，长出闪耀的青草、花朵和小灌木。每个在其回合开始时站在区域内地面上的活体且非灵堕魔生物，恢复1d6生命值，并在其下个回合结束前获得+5足状态加值到其速度。灵堕魔和亡灵若在生命花开的区域内开始其回合，则改为陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}，除非其强韧豁免成功。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.yYDj0G4O3q5iGexx]{法术效果：生命花开}

升阶（7环） 恢复的生命值提高至1d8，且改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升阶（10环） 恢复的生命值提高至1d10，且改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 3}。

The ground around you blooms with life, sprouting sparkling grass, flowers, and small shrubs. Each living and non-nindoru creature that starts its turn standing on the ground in the area recovers 1d6 Hit Points and gains a +5-foot status bonus to its Speed until the end of its next turn. Nindoru fiends and undead that start their turn in the area of life's fresh bloom instead become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} unless they succeed at a Fortitude saving throw.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.yYDj0G4O3q5iGexx]{Spell Effect: Life's Fresh Bloom}

Heightened (7th) Increase the Hit Points restored to 1d8 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (10th) Increase the Hit Points restored to 1d10 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3}.

Remove Curse.name: 移除诅咒 Remove Curse
Remove Curse.description:
你的接触为一名受到诅咒的生物带来喘息之机。你尝试反制一个影响目标的诅咒。若该诅咒来自一件被诅咒的物品或其他外部来源，则成功表示目标生物可以摆脱该被诅咒的物品，但这并不会移除该物品上的诅咒。

Your touch grants a reprieve to a cursed creature. You attempt to counteract one curse afflicting the target. If the curse comes from a cursed item or other external source, a success indicates that the target creature can rid itself of the cursed item, but it doesn't remove the curse from the item.

Remove Disease.name: 移除疾病 Remove Disease
Remove Disease.description:
治疗魔法会从生物的身体中清除疾病。你尝试反制一个正在影响目标的疾病。

Healing magic purges disease from a creature's body. You attempt to counteract one disease afflicting the target.

Restoration.name: 复原术 Restoration
Restoration.description:
复原术魔法能够对抗毒素或妨碍生物发挥最佳状态的状态所带来的影响。当你施放复原术时，选择减少一种状态，或减轻一种毒素的效果。生物每天只能从一次复原术法术中获益，而且对于同一种毒素的同一次暴露，它不能从复原术中获益超过一次来降低其阶段。

  • 减轻毒素 将目标所受的一种毒素的阶段降低1个阶段。这不能将阶段降低到阶段1以下，也不能治愈该苦难。
  • 减少状态 将目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞} 状态的值降低2。你也可以改为将上述状态中的两种各降低1。

升阶（4环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} 加入你可以减少的状态列表中。当你减轻一种毒素时，将其阶段降低2个阶段。你还获得第三个选项，使你可以将目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭} 值降低1。你不能用此来降低永久性的毁灭状态。

升阶（6环） 如同4环复原术，但如果你在施放法术时额外加入一个施法动作和一个材料成分，并在此过程中提供价值100 gp的钻石粉作为代价，则你可以降低永久性的毁灭状态。

Restorative magic counters the effects of toxins or conditions that prevent a creature from functioning at its best. When you cast restoration, choose to either reduce a condition or lessen the effect of a toxin. A creature can benefit from only one restoration spell each day, and it can't benefit from restoration more than once to reduce the stage of the same exposure to a given toxin.

  • Lessen a Toxin Reduce the stage of one toxin the target suffers from by one stage. This can't reduce the stage below stage 1 or cure the affliction.
  • Reduce a Condition Reduce the value of the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition by 2. You can instead reduce two of the listed conditions by 1 each.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} to the list of conditions you can reduce. When you lessen a toxin, reduce the stage by two. You also gain a third option that allows you to reduce the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value by 1. You can't use this to reduce a permanent Doomed condition.

Heightened (6th) As the 4th-rank restoration, but you can reduce a permanent Doomed condition if you add a spellcasting action and a material component while Casting the Spell, during which you provide 100 gp worth of diamond dust as a cost.

Restore Senses.name: 复原感官 Restore Senses
Restore Senses.description:
你尝试反制一个单一效果，该效果使目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋（状态）} 状态，恢复其视觉或听觉。此法术既能反制暂时性的魔法，也能反制魔法造成的永久后果，但它无法治愈由于某种天生状态或效果而不具备该感官的人，例如先天如此，或由于非魔法伤口或毒素所致。

升阶（6环） 该法术的射程增加至30尺，且你最多可以以10个生物为目标。你可以为每个所选生物分别选择要反制的效果。

You attempt to counteract a single effect imposing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} conditions on the target, restoring its vision or hearing. This can counteract both temporary magic and permanent consequences of magic, but it doesn't cure someone who does not have the sense due to some natural state or effect, such as from birth or from a non-magical wound or toxin.

Heightened (6th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, and you can target up to 10 creatures. You can choose the effect to counteract separately for each selected creature.

Divine Lance.name: 圣枪术 Divine Lance
Divine Lance.description:
你释放出一道神圣能量光束。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 2d4 精魂伤害（若造成大成功，伤害加倍）。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命力能量来治疗活体，或对亡灵造成伤害。若目标是自愿的活体生物，你恢复其1d8生命值。若目标是亡灵，你对其造成等量的生命力伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 （躯体） 该法术的射程为接触。

2 （言语，躯体） 该法术的射程为30足。若你在治疗一个活体生物，恢复的生命值增加8

3 （材料，躯体，言语） 你将生命力能量散布于30足散发内。这以爆发中的所有活体和亡灵生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害量增加1d8，而双动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel vitality energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8

3 (material, somatic, verbal) You disperse vitality energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智以感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何接受你关于该灵光建议的人，在对该物品进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时，获得 +2 环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将 10 个物体作为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以将任意数量的物体作为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Sanctuary.name: 庇护术 Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
你以防护能量保护一个生物，阻止敌人的攻击。试图攻击目标的生物每次都必须进行一次意志豁免。如果目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试其此次攻击，以及本回合内对目标进行的任何其他攻击。

失败 该生物不能攻击目标，且该动作被浪费。它本回合内不能进一步尝试对目标进行攻击。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，且在庇护术剩余持续时间内不能尝试攻击目标。

You ward a creature with protective energy that deters enemy attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Stabilize.name: 稳定伤势 Stabilize
Stabilize.description:
生命能量关上死亡之门。目标失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死（状态）}状态，但在生命值为 0 时仍然处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态。

Vitality energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
净化四尊雕像，并在丹杉寺下方的苦迦菩提之墓中击败辛月后，智惠的幽灵便会消散。

当一个幽灵被摧毁时，它会在其所缚之地于 [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 天}后重新形成，并完全恢复。只有当有人查明其存在的原因，并纠正一切阻止该精魂休息之事时，幽灵才能被永久摧毁。

Purifying the four statues and defeating Xin Yue in Kugaptee's Grave below the Tan Sugi monastery allows Zhi Hui's ghost to fade.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Incarnate Skill.name: 先天之技 Incarnate Skill
Incarnate Skill.description:
智惠窥视一名自愿生物的灵魂，并探寻其前世。该生物永久将一项其当前已达专家的技能的熟练度等级，与一项其未受训的技能的熟练度等级互换，两者均由其自行选择。智惠对每个角色只能执行此行动一次。

Zhi Hui peers into a willing creature's soul and searches through their past lives. That creature permanently trades proficiency rank from one skill they're currently expert in with a skill in which they're untrained, both of their choice. Zhi Hui can only perform this activity once per character.

The Peddler of Glories.name: 荣耀小贩 The Peddler of Glories
The Peddler of Glories.tokenName: 荣耀小贩 The Peddler of Glories
The Peddler of Glories.prototypeToken: 荣耀小贩 The Peddler of Glories

Fungus Leshy.name: 真菌莱西 Fungus Leshy

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原能内在法术 Primal Innate Spells

Speak with Plants (Constant, Fungi Only).name: 植物交谈（恒定，仅限菌类）
Speak with Plants (Constant, Fungi Only).description:
你可以向植物和真菌提问并获得答复，但该法术不会让它们变得比平常更友善或更聪明。大多数普通植物和真菌对周围世界都有一种独特的看法，因此它们无法辨认有关生物的细节，也不了解其近旁范围之外的世界。狡猾的植物或真菌怪物很可能言简意赅且闪烁其词，而较不聪明的那些则常会发表一些无意义的评论。

高环（4环） 持续时间为 8 小时。

You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants and fungi have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant or fungus monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Heightened (4th) The duration is 8 hours.

Verdant Burst.name: 翠绿迸发 Verdant Burst
Verdant Burst.description:
当一只真菌莱西死亡时，一股原始能量会从其身体中爆发，对@Template[emanation|distance:30]内的每个真菌生物恢复 @Damage[2d8[healing]] 生命值。该区域会充满真菌，变成困难地形。

如果该地形对这些真菌而言不是适宜的环境，它们会在24小时后枯萎。

When a fungus leshy dies, a burst of primal energy explodes from its body, restoring @Damage[2d8[healing]] Hit Points to each fungi creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This area is filled with fungi, becoming difficult terrain.

If the terrain is not a viable environment for this fungi, they wither after 24 hours.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
真菌莱西变形为一朵巨大的蘑菇或一片真菌群。除此之外，此能力使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{与植物为一} 的效果。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The fungus leshy transforms into a giant mushroom or patch of fungi. This ability otherwise uses the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One with Plants}.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Spore Cloud.name: 孢子云 Spore Cloud
Spore Cloud.description:
真菌莱西可以释放一团孢子云，刺激@Template[emanation|distance:15]内非真菌生物的眼睛和喉咙。每个生物都必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:16|options:area-effect,damaging-effect]豁免，否则受到@Damage[1[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage]伤害。

只要持续伤害仍在继续，该生物的视野就会受限，且只能看见20英尺内的事物。

A fungus leshy can unleash a cloud of spores that irritates the eyes and throats of non-fungus creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Each creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:16|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save or take @Damage[1[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] damage.

A creature has its vision reduced as long as the persistent damage continues and can see only within 20 feet.

Spores.name: 孢子 Spores
Spores.description:
受到真菌莱西的孢子荚打击伤害的生物，必须以与其孢子云能力相同的难度等级（@Check[fortitude|dc:16]）和效果进行一次豁免。

A creature that takes damage from a fungus leshy's spore pod Strike must attempt a saving throw with the same DC (@Check[fortitude|dc:16]) and effect as its Spore Cloud ability

Fungus Leshy.publicNotes:
真菌莱西守卫洞穴、沼泽，以及潮湿阴暗的地方。它们的真菌花园以大多数标准来看都相当怪异，但真菌莱西对自己的作品极为自豪。

莱西是聪慧的植物生物，守卫着原始荒野或大地之力的区域。它们最初由强大的妖精所创造，当熟练的原始魔法实践者——通常是德鲁伊——将一个自然精魂与用当地植被精心培育并塑造出的身体结合时，它们便会显现。创造莱西所需的仪式和材料会因莱西的类型而有所不同。它们通常在具有重大自然意义的区域被赋予生命，例如树人守护者的林地、德鲁伊环、仙灵环，或某处宏伟的自然奇观。

Fungus leshies guard caves, bogs, and damp, dark places. Their fungus gardens are bizarre by most standards, but fungus leshies are extremely proud of their works.

Leshies are intelligent plant creatures who guard areas of primeval wilderness or earthly power. Originally created by powerful fey, they manifest when a skilled practitioner of primal magic—typically a druid—combines a nature spirit with a body carefully grown and crafted from local vegetation. The rites and materials required to create a leshy vary depending on the type of leshy. They are typically given life in an area of great natural significance, such as an arboreal's grove, a druidic circle, a fairy ring, or a great natural wonder.

Crafter's Eyepiece.name: 工匠目镜 Crafter's Eyepiece
Crafter's Eyepiece.description:
这件坚固的金属目镜上蚀刻着方形纹样，设计为佩戴在单眼上。旋转镜片时，会显现出你打算制作或修理的物品的淡淡立体轮廓，并为各个组件部分标上实用的标签。

你在制作检定中获得+1物品加值。当你修理一件物品时，恢复的生命值提高为：成功时为10 + 每级熟练度10点，或大成功时为15 + 每级熟练度15点。

This rugged metal eyepiece etched with square patterns is designed to be worn over a single eye. Twisting the lens reveals a faint three-dimensional outline of an item you plan to build or repair, with helpful labels on the component parts.

You gain a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks. When you Repair an item, increase the Hit Points restored to 10 + 10 per proficiency rank on a success or 15 + 15 per proficiency rank on a critical success.

Taunting Monk's Skull.name: 嘲讽僧侣的头骨 Taunting Monk's Skull
Taunting Monk's Skull.tokenName: 嘲讽僧侣的头骨 Taunting Monk's Skull

Bite Back.name: 反咬一口 Bite Back
Bite Back.description:
触发 骷髅被其触及内的一个生物攻击

效果 骷髅对该生物进行一次颚打击。

Trigger The skull is attacked by a creature within their reach

Effect The skull makes a jaws Strike against that creature.

Behold the Promises of Kugaptee!.name: 看哪，苦迦菩提的寄望！
Behold the Promises of Kugaptee!.description:
骷髅选择60尺内的一个生物，并对其述说：如果将灵魂献给苦迦菩提，他们将被赐予何等虚无。目标必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:24] 意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并在1分钟内暂时免疫。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，持续1轮。

大失败 目标因绝望而 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹} 1轮，随后在额外1轮内陷入措手不及。

The skull chooses one creature within 60 feet and speaks to them about the oblivion they'll be granted if they cede their soul to Kugaptee. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} by despair for 1 round, and is then off-guard for 1 additional round.

Taunting Monk's Skull.publicNotes:
有些无头亡灵在被唤起时，心灵机能大多仍然完好无损。这些狡猾的亡灵常常会挑衅受害者，诱使他们愚蠢地追赶自己或伤害自己。

无头亡灵是脱离身体、漂浮在空中并被转化为亡灵的头。由于制造成本低廉且具有几乎无穷的可定制性，它们是死灵法师“课题仆从”的自然选择。在任何长期由死灵法师盘踞的巢穴中，发现几颗四处游荡的漂浮头颅并不少见；每一颗都展现出截然不同的特征，甚至连制造时的娴熟程度也各不相同。

Some beheaded are raised with their mental faculties mostly intact. These clever undead often provoke their victims into foolishly giving chase or harming themselves.

Beheaded are disembodied floating heads transformed into undead. They are natural candidates for a necromancer's "project minion," due to the inexpensive cost of creation and endlessly customizable nature. In any lair occupied for long by practicing necromancers, it isn't uncommon to find a handful of floating heads roaming about, each exhibiting completely different characteristics and even degrees of expertise in their creation.
Taunting Monk's Skull.blurb:
变体嘲弄颅骨
Variant taunting skull
Taunting Monk's Skull.prototypeToken: 嘲讽僧侣的头骨 Taunting Monk's Skull

Withered Camellia Flower Carefully Prese.name: 放在软垫盒中被仔细保存的枯萎山茶花 Withered Camellia Flower Carefully Preserved in a Cushioned Box
Withered Camellia Flower Carefully Prese.description:
花茎上缠着一条金色的题字丝带，上面有娟秀的字迹写着：“夏天的美德永不褪色。”

The flower’s stem is wrapped in a gold, calligraphed ribbon, upon which a delicate hand has written: “Summer’s virtues never fade.”

Elizeth Candora.name: 伊莉泽丝·坎多拉 Elizeth Candora
Elizeth Candora.tokenName: 伊莉泽丝·坎多拉 Elizeth Candora
Elizeth Candora.blurb: 富有同理心的女性人类法拉斯玛牧师 empathetic female human cleric of Pharasma
Elizeth Candora.prototypeToken: 伊莉泽丝·坎多拉 Elizeth Candora

Point Tracking.name: 点数追踪 Point Tracking
Point Tracking.publicNotes:
使用此角色来追踪诸如声望点之类的资源，方法是将点数追踪效果放置在其上。

当选中此角色的指示物时，这些效果会显示在右上角的效果面板中，并且可以分别通过左键和右键点击来增加和减少。

Use this actor to keep track of resources like Reputation Points by placing Point Tracking effects on it.

The effects will show up in the effect panel in the top right when the token of this actor is selected, and can be incremented and decremented with left and right click, respectively.
Point Tracking.privateNotes:
如果你希望玩家能够看到这些点数，请将此角色的所有权授予他们。但请注意，这也会允许他们修改这些数值。

If you want players to be able to see these points, give them ownership of this actor. Do note though that this will also allow them to modify these values.

So-Jin’s Journal.name: 素珍的日记 So-Jin’s Journal
So-Jin’s Journal.description:
包含一种罕见的炼金武器配方：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.oE3fHS3CUs15bZ4r]{银魂炸弹}。

Contains a rare formula for an alchemical weapon: a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.oE3fHS3CUs15bZ4r]{Silversoul Bomb}.

Powdered Silver and other Alchemical Sup.name: 银粉及其他炼金补给品 Powdered Silver and other Alchemical Supplies
Powdered Silver and other Alchemical Sup.description:
如果用于制作额外的银魂炸弹，则为该制作检定提供 +2 物品加值。

If used to craft additional silversoul bombs, grants a +2 item bonus to the Crafting check.

Silversoul Bomb.name: 银魂炸弹 Silversoul Bomb
Silversoul Bomb.description:
启动 2 交互

这种罕见的炼金炸弹会收集并专注于一处埋葬了数代受爱戴祖先的墓地中萦绕不散的情绪，将这股强大的情绪能量灌注进炸弹内储存的、经炼金制备的银粉中。这股能量会发出柔和的银色辉光；如果装在透明容器中，银魂炸弹还可以当作火把使用，以照亮一片区域。

你获得攻击掷骰的+1物品加值，且该炸弹造成2d4精神伤害、对宁多鲁斯造成1d6持续精神伤害，以及2点精神溅射伤害。生物若受到该炸弹的溅射伤害，且未通过@Check[fortitude|dc:17]强韧豁免，则会因发光的银色微粒附着在其脸上而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，持续1轮。

宁多鲁斯尤其会被银魂炸弹所伤，并承受1d6持续精神伤害。对抗宁多鲁斯时，该炸弹的物品加值也适用于其抵抗目眩或失明的豁免难度等级（@Check[fortitude|dc:18]）。具有银弱点的生物（包括大多数宁多鲁斯）对于银魂炸弹造成的精神伤害也具有等量的弱点，这是因为其内部能量中灌注了银。

Activate 2 Interact

This rare alchemical bomb gathers and concentrates the emotions that linger in a burial ground where generations of beloved ancestors have been interred, infusing that powerful emotional energy into the alchemically prepared powdered silver stored within the bomb. This energy glows with a soft, silver radiance and, if contained in a clear container, allows a silversoul bomb to be used as a torch to illuminate an area.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, and the bomb deals 2d4 mental damage, 1d6 persistent mental damage to nindorus, and 2 mental splash damage. A creature that takes splash damage from the bomb and fails a @Check[fortitude|dc:17] save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round as glowing silver particles cling to its face.

Nindorus are particularly harmed by silversoul bombs and take 1d6 persistent mental damage. Against nindorus, the bomb's item bonus also applies to its save DC to resist being resist being dazzled or blinded (@Check[fortitude|dc:18]). Creatures that have weakness to silver (including most nindorus) have an equal amount of weakness to the mental damage caused by a silversoul bomb, due to the silver infused into the energy within.

Hell Hound.name: 地狱犬 Hell Hound

Hellfire Breath.name: 地狱火吐息 Hellfire Breath
Hellfire Breath.description:
地狱犬吐出烈焰，对@Template[cone|distance:15]内的所有生物造成 @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免）。

地狱犬在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Hellfire Breath]]{1d4轮} 内无法再次使用地狱火吐息。如果地狱犬将要受到火焰伤害或成为火焰效果的目标，它的地狱火吐息会重新充能。

The hell hound breathes flames that deal @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:15] (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The hell hound can't use Hellfire Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Hellfire Breath]]{1d4 rounds}. If the hell hound would take fire damage or be targeted by a fire effect, their Hellfire Breath recharges.

Pack Attack.name: 群体攻击 Pack Attack
Pack Attack.description:
地狱犬的打击对处于至少两名地狱犬盟友触及范围内的生物额外造成1d4伤害。

The hell hound's Strikes deal 1d4 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the hell hounds' allies.

Hell Hound.publicNotes:
地狱犬的外观足以打消任何关于其炼狱起源的疑虑——如燃烧沥青般颜色的血肉、如任何邪魔的干草叉般锋利的牙齿，以及一层永不熄灭的地狱火帷幕，都是其标志性特征。

地狱犬是来自深坑的邪恶异界犬科生物，能够追猎猎物并喷吐超自然的火焰洪流。它们性情暴躁，且很容易表现出攻击性行为。

A hell hound's appearance dismisses any doubts as to their infernal origins—flesh the color of burning pitch, teeth as sharp as any fiend's pitchfork, and a shroud of ever-burning hellfire are all trademark features.

Hell hounds are fiendish, extraplanar canines hailing from the Pit that can hunt down quarry and breathe supernatural gouts of flame. They are temperamental and quick to exhibit aggressive behavior.

Shinzo's Parting Gift.name: 神藏的临别赠礼 Shinzo's Parting Gift
Shinzo's Parting Gift.tokenName: 神藏的临别赠礼 Shinzo's Parting Gift

Phoenix Fulu Holder.name: 凤凰符箓匣 Phoenix Fulu Holder
Phoenix Fulu Holder.description:
这个优雅的木制框架装饰着许多蓬松的红色羽毛，摸上去几乎烫得让人不太舒服。凤凰符箓匣会为任何在其框架中放置一段时间的符箓赋予某种“第二次生命”，同时也让符箓的使用者能够以时髦而引人注目的方式展示这件宝藏。你可以以一个交互动作将任何符箓放入凤凰符箓匣中。

启动 1 交互

频率 每天一次

需求 凤凰符箓匣中存放着一个11级或更低等级的符箓

效果 你从凤凰符箓匣中取出该符箓，紧接着，你所移除的符箓的一道发光影像会在框架中显现。如果先前存放的符箓在接下来的24小时内被消耗，凤凰符箓匣内闪烁的影像就会变成该符箓一个凝实且完全可用的复制品。这个复制出的符箓与原始符箓的功能完全相同，但如果它在形成后的24小时内未被贴附，它就会逐渐消散并消失。

This elegant wooden frame is decorated with numerous downy red feathers that feel almost uncomfortably hot to the touch. A phoenix fulu holder grants a sort of second "life" to any fulu placed for a time within its frame, but also gives the fulu wielder a stylish and eye-catching way of displaying such a treasure. You can place any fulu into a phoenix fulu holder as an Interact action.

Activate 1 Interact

Frequency once per day

Requirements An 11th- or lower-level fulu is stored in the phoenix fulu holder

Effect You take the fulu from the phoenix fulu holder, and an instant later, a glowing image of the fulu you removed manifests in the frame. If the previously stored fulu is consumed within the next 24 hours, the flickering image within the phoenix fulu holder becomes a solid and fully functional duplicate of that fulu. This duplicated fulu functions identically to the original fulu, but if not affixed within 24 hours of its formation, it fades away and vanishes.

Anathema Fulu.name: 禁忌符箓 Anathema Fulu
Anathema Fulu.description:
持续时间 1小时

最初由受天界力量触碰的天景拿非利人用于削弱古魔，禁忌符箓由四个部分组成，分别放置在四个基本方位各一处。激活这些符箓时，从以下特征中选择一种：天界、元素、妖精、邪魔、监察者或亡灵。若具有该特征的生物在区域内开始其回合，则其必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:30] 强韧豁免，否则其会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}，直到其下个回合开始。若大成功，该生物会暂时免疫任何禁忌符箓1小时。无论豁免结果如何，若你随后在区域内对该生物施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{放逐术}，该生物会承受该法术中所述的–2减值，该减值来自加入一个对该生物而言属于禁忌的物体所需的特殊代价。该符箓即视为该物体；你无需额外加入它。若受此减值影响的生物对放逐术进行豁免掷骰，则施法者可以使用一次自由动作（）使结果降低一级。如此做会将整张符箓完全烧毁，并终止其效果。若符箓的任何部分在激活后被移动或摧毁，则效果结束。

Duration 1 hour

First used by celestial-touched nephilim of Tianjing to weaken qlippoth, an anathema fulu comes in four pieces, one placed in each cardinal direction. Choose one of the following traits when activating the fulus: celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, monitor, or undead. If a creature with that trait starts its turn in the area, it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} until the start of its next turn. On a critical success, the creature becomes temporarily immune to any anathema fulus for 1 hour. Regardless of the save result, if you subsequently cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} on such a creature in the area, the creature takes the –2 penalty described in that spell for adding a special cost of an object that's anathema to that creature. The fulu acts as that object; you don't need to add it. If a creature affected by this penalty rolls a saving throw against banishment, the caster can use a free action to force the result one step lower. Doing so burns the whole fulu out, ending the effect. If any of the fulu's pieces are moved or destroyed after activation, the effect ends.

Thousand-Pains Fulu (Needle).name: 千痛符箓（针）
Thousand-Pains Fulu (Needle).description:
持续时间 1分钟

由一名为追寻无尽生命而抛弃道德的外科师所创造，千痛符箓会阻断身体内元素的自然流动。被贴上该符箓的生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]。若失败或大失败，则目标会受到由特定状态触发的持续性伤害，且该状态必须在符箓的持续时间内满足。

拿起这张白色符箓时，会感觉像是你用针刺穿了自己的手。符箓造成@Damage[7d6[piercing]]，因为毛发、指甲和结缔组织会向内刺入。若失败或大失败，则如果目标随后执行一个具有移动（特征）的动作，它会受到@Damage[2d6[persistent,piercing]]。

Duration 1 minute

Created by a chirurgeon who threw away morality in search of endless life, a thousand-pains fulu blocks the natural flow of elements in the body. A creature to which the fulu is affixed must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]. Failure or critical failure primes the target for persistent damage triggered by a specific condition that must be met within the fulu's duration.

Picking up this white fulu feels like you've stabbed your hand with a pin. The fulu deals @Damage[7d6[piercing]] as hair, nails, and connective tissues stab inward. On a failure or critical failure, if the target then takes an action with the move trait, it takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,piercing]].

Potency Crystal (Greater).name: 潜能水晶（高等）
Potency Crystal (Greater).description:
启动 F（专注）

触发 你使用所附着的武器进行一次攻击，但你尚未掷骰

这块萤石水晶以奇异的磷光发光。当你启动该水晶时，这把武器在此次打击中变为一把+2高等强击武器，并在本回合结束前保持如此，使攻击掷骰获得+2物品加值，并将伤害提高为3个武器伤害骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.R5ugeFK3MPwkbv0s]{效果：潜能水晶}

Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You make an attack with the affixed weapon, but you haven't rolled yet

This fluorite crystal glows with a strange phosphorescence. When you activate the crystal, the weapon becomes a +2 greater striking weapon on the Strike and until the end of this turn, gaining a +2 item bonus to the attack roll and increasing the damage to three weapon damage dice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.R5ugeFK3MPwkbv0s]{Effect: Potency Crystal}

Shinzo's Parting Gift.prototypeToken: 神藏的临别赠礼 Shinzo's Parting Gift

Mo Douqiu the Hedonist.name: 享乐主义者莫都求 Mo Douqiu the Hedonist
Mo Douqiu the Hedonist.tokenName: 享乐主义者莫都求 Mo Douqiu the Hedonist

Drink Oil.name: 饮用油剂 Drink Oil
Drink Oil.description:
触发 莫斗秋成为一次炼金炸弹打击的目标

需求 莫斗秋察觉到该攻击，且对此次攻击并非处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态

效果 莫斗秋试图用嘴接住投来的炸弹。他对此次触发的攻击获得 AC +4 环境加值。若该攻击未命中，他便会用嘴接住炸弹，并无害地将其内容一饮而尽，恢复等同于该炸弹物品等级的生命值。

Trigger Mo Douqiu is the target of an alchemical bomb Strike

Requirements Mo Douqiu is aware of the attack and is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to it

Effect Mo Douqiu attempts to catch the flung bomb in his mouth. He gains a +4 circumstance bonus to his AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, he catches the bomb in his mouth and harmlessly drinks down its contents down, regaining Hit Points equal to the bomb's item level.

Drop Corpse.name: 弃尸 Drop Corpse
Drop Corpse.description:
需求 一具悬挂的尸体位于莫斗秋的颚打击触及内

效果 莫斗秋猛然咬住悬吊尸体的绳索并将其咬断，使尸体落到正下方的方格地面上。该空间内的一名生物受到 @Damage[(1d6+3)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] 豁免），并在失败或大失败时被击倒为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

Requirements A hanging corpse is within reach of Mo Douqiu's jaws Strike

Effect Mo Douqiu chomps onto a rope dangling a dead body and bites through it, causing the body to fall to the ground in the square directly below. A creature in that space takes @Damage[(1d6+3)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] save), and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on a failure or critical failure.

Extend Neck.name: 延伸颈部 Extend Neck
Extend Neck.description:
辘轳首伸长其脖子，使其颚打击的触及从10英尺增加到20英尺，直到其下个回合结束。

The rokurokubi extends their neck, increasing the reach of their jaws Strike from 10 feet to 20 feet until the end of their next turn.

Threatening Lunge.name: 威吓猛扑 Threatening Lunge
Threatening Lunge.description:
需求 莫斗秋的脖子当前未处于伸长状态

效果 莫斗秋的头会在打击前贴近到距离目标面部仅一英寸处。他会延伸颈部，尝试对20尺内的一名对手进行[[/act demoralize]]，然后对该对手进行一次颚打击。他的挫败士气检定是视觉而非听觉效果，且如果目标不理解他的语言，他也不会承受减值。

Requirements Mo Douqiu's neck is not currently extended

Effect Mo Douqiu's head comes within an inch of his target's face before striking. He Extends his Neck, attempts to [[/act demoralize]] one opponent within 20 feet, and then makes a jaws Strike against that opponent. His Demoralize check is a visual rather than auditory effect, and he doesn't take a penalty if the target doesn't understand his language.

Mo Douqiu the Hedonist.publicNotes:
辘轳首会在凡人因某种恶行而遭受诅咒时诞生，不过承受诅咒的往往并非犯下过错之人，而是其子女或配偶。诅咒会在个体睡觉时，缓慢地将其转变为辘轳首。起初，他们的脖子会伸长，甚至彻底脱离，让他们的头能够自由游荡，进行一些简单的恶作剧，比如惊吓邻居或动物。沉睡者也许会在第二天清晨从一个朦胧的梦中醒来，梦见自己饮尽了附近提灯中的油，可随后却发现那些提灯竟然真的空了。

随着时间推移，这些怪异行为会发展成愈发恶劣、甚至暴力的罪行。新生的辘轳首只有一小段时间还可能通过驱散诅咒而获救，但没过多久，他们就会被彻底吞噬，再也无法入睡。

大多数辘轳首都会因自身的状态而绝望，试图借酒浇愁，或只是尽量避人耳目。少数邪恶的辘轳首则会接受自己的命运，并试图通过彻底向诅咒屈服来增强力量。这会赋予他们施展强大异能法术的能力，但也必然会让他们更加扭曲，愈发趋向邪恶。

Rokurokubi come into being when mortals are cursed for some misdeed, though often the one who bears the curse is not the one who committed the offense, but instead their child or spouse. The curse slowly transforms the individual into a rokurokubi as they sleep. At first, their neck extends, or even detaches altogether, to let their head roam freely and engage in simple mischief like scaring neighbors or animals. The sleeper may awaken the next morning from a hazy dream of drinking the oil from nearby lanterns, only to find them indeed empty.

Over time, the bizarre acts progress to increasingly mischievous or even violent crimes. There's only a brief period during which the nascent rokurokubi might still be saved by dispelling the curse, but before long, they are fully consumed, never to sleep again.

Most rokurokubi despair at their state, seeking to drown their sorrows in drink or simply stay out of sight. A nefarious few rokurokubi embrace their fate and seek to enhance their power by completely giving in to the curse. This grants them the ability to cast potent occult spells but inevitably twists them even more toward evil.
