industrious female kitsune blacksmith

Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology.name: 丑萌的感谢与道歉 Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology
Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology.tokenName: 丑萌的感谢与道歉 Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology

Ugly Cute's Gift.name: 丑小乖的赠礼 Ugly Cute's Gift
Ugly Cute's Gift.description:
这块从丑萌甲壳上脱落的尖刺石质碎片，戴在手上却相当舒适。虽然比普通铁手套稍显笨重，但它仍可作为+1带刺铁手套使用。

启动 2 命令术，交互

频率 每天一次

效果 你汲取丑萌潜藏的灵性能量，将强劲的力量灌注入这只铁手套。持续1分钟，丑小乖的赠礼获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}属性符文的优势，且在成功打击时额外造成2点力场伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.6enQGnnlgGY6ZWgS]{效果：丑小乖的赠礼}

This spiky, stony fragment shed from Ugly Cute's carapace fits quite comfortably over the hand. Though a little bulkier than the typical gauntlet, it still functions as a +1 spiked gauntlet.

Activate 2 command, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You draw upon Ugly Cute's latent spiritual energy to infuse the gauntlet with forceful power. For 1 minute, Ugly Cute's gift gains the advantages of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune and deals an additional 2 force damage on a successful Strike.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.6enQGnnlgGY6ZWgS]{Effect: Ugly Cute's Gift}

Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology.prototypeToken: 丑萌的感谢与道歉 Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology

Living Rune (Occult).name: 活体符文（异能）

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Visions of Danger.name: 危险幻象 Visions of Danger
Visions of Danger.description:
可怖生物构成的幻象充满了该法术的区域。这些生物看起来像是具有你所选定特定外观的超小型成群怪物，例如地狱苍蝇或活动的锯刃。爆发对每个在其被创造时位于爆发内、进入爆发，或在爆发内开始其回合的生物造成 8d8 心灵伤害（基础意志豁免）。在其意志豁免中获得大成功的生物可以立即尝试识破该幻象。尝试与这些怪物交互，或以搜索动作观察其中之一的生物，都可以尝试识破该幻象。识破该幻象的生物此后不再受到该幻象的伤害。

升阶（+1） 心灵伤害增加 1d8。

An illusion of horrific creatures fills the spell's area. The creatures look like Tiny swarming monsters with a specific appearance of your choice, such as Hellish flies or animated saw blades. The burst deals 8d8 mental damage (basic Will save) to each creature that's inside the burst when it's created, enters the burst, or starts its turn inside the burst. A creature that critically succeeds at its will save can immediately attempt to disbelieve the illusion. A creature that tries to Interact with the monsters or observes one with a Seek action can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. Creatures that disbelieve the illusion take no damage from the illusion thereafter.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 1d8.

Feeblemind.name: 弱智术 Feeblemind
Feeblemind.description:
你极大地削弱了目标的精神能力。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。这个诅咒的效果只能通过移除诅咒或其他以诅咒为目标的效果来移除。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续 1 轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 4}，持续时间为无限。

大失败 目标的智力被永久削弱到连动物都不如，并将其魅力、智力和感知调整值视为 -5。它失去所有需要精神能力的职业能力，包括所有施法能力。如果目标是玩家角色，则其变为由游戏主持控制的非玩家角色。

You drastically reduce the target's mental faculties. The target must attempt a Will save. The effects of this curse can be removed only through remove curse or another effect that targets curses.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The target's intellect is permanently reduced below that of an animal, and it treats its Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom modifiers as -5. It loses all class abilities that require mental faculties, including all spellcasting. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control.

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 魅影灾祸 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
末日毁灭的幻象充斥区域内每个生物的心智。该幻象造成 11d6 心灵伤害（基础意志豁免）。大失败时，该生物还必须在一次 @Check[reflex] 反射豁免中成功，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂缝中、漂流于海上，或遭遇其他与其幻象相符的命运）。如果它第二次豁免失败，则还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑（状态）}，持续 1 分钟。它可以在自己每个回合结束时再次尝试一次意志豁免；若成功，它便识破该幻象，并从震慑（状态）中恢复。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a @Check[reflex] save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

True Seeing (Constant).name: 真视术（恒定）
True Seeing (Constant).description:
你能看见60英尺内事物的真实面貌。游戏主持对区域内的任何幻觉或变化效果进行一次秘密的反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，如果该检定成功反制一个变形法术，你就能看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Vibrant Pattern.name: 绚丽图纹 Vibrant Pattern
Vibrant Pattern.description:
你创造出一道随强度脉动的光之图案。生物在图案内时会处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。此外，若生物在你施放该法术时位于图案内、进入图案、在图案内结束其回合，或对图案使用搜索或交互动作，则必须进行一次意志豁免。当前被该图案 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲（状态）} 的生物不需要再次尝试新的豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物被该图案致为目盲（状态）。如果它离开图案，则在其每个回合结束时都可以再次尝试一次新的豁免，以从目盲（状态）中恢复，最大持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 该生物陷入目盲（状态），持续1分钟。

You create a pattern of lights that pulses with intensity. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while inside the pattern. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it's inside the pattern when you cast it, enters the pattern, ends its turn within the pattern, or uses a Seek or Interact action on the pattern. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} by the pattern doesn't need to attempt new saving throws.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Blinded by the pattern. If it exits the pattern, it can attempt a new save to recover from the Blinded condition at the end of each of its turns, to a maximum duration of 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 minute.

Crushing Despair.name: 极度绝望 Crushing Despair
Crushing Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作，且必须在其回合开始时再次尝试一次豁免；若失败，则它会因无法控制地抽泣而在该回合中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

失败 如成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 如失败，且该生物会自动处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域增大为60足锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Synesthesia.name: 联觉 Synesthesia
Synesthesia.description:
目标的感官突然以意想不到的方式被重新接线，使其将噪音处理为迸发的色彩、将气味处理为声音，等等。这会产生三种效果，且目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。由于这种干扰，目标每次使用一个专注动作时，都必须成功通过一次 @Check[flat|dc:5]，否则该动作失败并被浪费。目标处理视觉输入有困难，使得所有生物和物体对其而言都处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽} 状态。该生物难以移动，使其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙3}，并使其所有速度承受 –10足状态减值。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到影响1轮。

失败 目标受到影响1分钟。

大失败 如失败，且目标在尝试处理这些感官变化时陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}。

升阶（9环） 你的目标最多可以是五个生物。

The target's senses are suddenly rewired in unexpected ways, causing them to process noises as bursts of color, smells as sounds, and so on. This has three effects, and the target must attempt a Will save. Due to the distraction, the target must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] each time it uses a concentrate action, or the action fails and is wasted. The target's difficulty processing visual input makes all creatures and objects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from it. The creature has trouble moving, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3} and giving it a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is affected for 1 round.

Failure The target is affected for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} as it attempts to process the sensory shifts.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to five creatures.

Glyph of Warding (At Will).name: 防护符文（随意）
Glyph of Warding (At Will).description:
你通过将一个敌对法术束缚进一个符记中来制作一个陷阱。在施放此法术时，你还要施放一个较低法术环阶的法术并将其储存在符记中。被储存的法术其施放所需动作必须为3个或更少，具有敌对效果，并且以一个生物为目标或具有区域。你可以为该符记设定一句口令、一个触发条件，或两者都设定。任何移动、开启或触碰目标容器，或进入目标区域，且未说出口令或符合触发条件的生物，都会启动该符记，释放其中的有害法术。

一旦有法术被储存在该符记中，该符记便获得该法术的所有特征。若被储存的法术以一个或更多生物为目标，则它以触发该符记的生物为目标。若其具有区域，则该区域以触发该符记的生物为中心。守护刻符的持续时间会在该符记被触发时结束。该符记视为一个魔法陷阱，在察觉检定以发现它以及巧手检定以解除它时，均使用你的法术DC；这两项检定都要求尝试进行它们的生物受过训练才能成功。

你可以撤销守护刻符。你在同一时间内能够维持生效的守护刻符最大数量，等于你的施法能力调整值。

You craft a trap by binding a hostile spell into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, you also Cast a Spell of a lower spell rank to store in the glyph. The stored spell must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one creature or have an area. You can set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any creature that moves, opens, or touches the target container or enters the target area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful spell within.

Once a spell is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the traits of that spell. If the stored spell targets one or more creatures, it targets the creature that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the creature that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using your spell DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the Thievery check to disable it; both checks require the creature attempting them to be trained in order to succeed.

You can Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding you can have active at a time is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得更多信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友身上的魔法物品与持续中的法术。

只有当幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术环级时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但在外观上并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升环强化（3环） 你会得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同样强，得知哪一个由游戏主持决定。

升环强化（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的源头。和模糊感官一样，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将源头缩小到一个5足见方的立方体内（若源头大于此范围，则为离你最近的那一部分）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Truescript.name: 真言文字 Truescript
Truescript.description:
活体符文无法说话，但它可以将自身形态塑造成复杂的文字与象形图，任何具有阅读书写语言能力的生物都能理解。活体符文也能理解任何书写或口头语言。

A living rune can't speak, but it can sculpt its form into complicated scripts and pictographs that can be understood by any creature with the ability to read written language. A living rune can also understand any written or spoken language.

Backdrop.name: 背景 Backdrop
Backdrop.description:
当一个生物试图对活体符文进行打击且重度失败时，攻击者会击中活体符文背后的表面（如画布、墙壁等）。这可能会对该表面或攻击者的武器造成损坏，由游戏主持酌情裁定。

When a creature attempts to Strike a living rune and critically misses, the attacker hits the surface (a canvas, wall, or so on) behind the living rune. This might damage the surface or the attacker's weapon, at the GM's discretion.

Surface-Bound.name: 缚于地表者 Surface-Bound
Surface-Bound.description:
活体符文只能沿平坦表面移动。如果它所在的表面被摧毁（例如一幅肖像被 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{火球术} 法术击中，或一面墙被砸碎），该符文受到 @Damage[7d6[untyped]] 伤害，并被转移到最近的平坦表面上。如果在 5 尺内没有平坦表面，该符文被摧毁。

A living rune can move only along flat surfaces. If the surface it's on is destroyed (such as a portrait hit by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} spell or a wall being smashed), the rune takes @Damage[7d6[untyped]] damage and is shunted to the nearest flat surface. If there is no flat surface within 5 feet, the rune is destroyed.

Living Rune (Occult).publicNotes:
现存最著名的活体符文是古代瑟西隆符文领主的那些符文；随着瑟西隆在现代重建，它们也再度兴起。不过，也能发现其他活体符文，各自拥有独特的能力。活体符文也可以被制造出来，使其打击造成不同类型的能量伤害。

这些符文由不知名之手制造，且常被遗留在偏僻之处。

魔法本就是一件复杂的事，而当其精妙程度达到某个等级时，法术与自主生物之间的差异便会变得愈发模糊。活体符号是由具现化并强化的魔法构筑而成的生物，由印记、符文和奥秘公式维系在一起。

The most famous living runes are those of the ancient Runelords of Thassilon, resurging as Thassilon rebuilds in the modern era. Other living runes can be found, however, each with its own particular abilities. Living runes can also be crafted to deal different types of energy damage with their Strikes.

These runes are crafted by unknown hands and often left in out-of-the-way places.

Magic is a complex thing to begin with, and at a certain level of sophistication, the differences between a spell and an autonomous creature become increasingly blurry. Living symbols are constructed creatures of reified and reinforced magic, held together by glyphs, runes, and eldritch formulae.

Corpse Sugi.name: 尸杉 Corpse Sugi

Sugi Tree.name: 杉树 Sugi Tree
Sugi Tree.description:
当未处于危险中时，尸杉会花费1分钟将根扎入大地，使自己固定在原地。当尸杉扎根且无法移动时，生物必须主动@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}，并成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:38]检定，才能侦测到尸杉的真实本质。

When it isn't in danger, the corpse sugi spends 1 minute rooting to the earth, becoming planted in place. While the corpse sugi is planted and immobile, creatures must actively @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:38] Check to detect the Corpse Sugi's true nature.

Axe Vulnerability.name: 斧类弱点 Axe Vulnerability
Axe Vulnerability.description:
尸杉会从斧类武器受到额外 10 点伤害。

The corpse sugi takes 10 additional damage from axes.

Thoughtblight.name: 思枯病 Thoughtblight
Thoughtblight.description:
30尺。进入尸杉灵光范围内或在其灵光范围内开始自己回合的非宁多鲁有智力活体生物，其心智会被残酷与痛苦的侵入性思绪所感染，并且必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}状态（若大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}状态）。该状态在生物离开灵光后仍会持续1分钟。豁免成功的生物会暂时免疫思枯病1分钟。

30 feet. The mind of a non-nindoru sapient living creature that enters or starts their turn in the corpse sugi's aura becomes infested with invasive thoughts of cruelty and anguish, and must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure). This condition persists for 1 minute after the creature leaves the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is temporarily immune to thoughtblight for 1 minute.

Take Root.name: 扎根 Take Root
Take Root.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 尸杉已使一个生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}

效果 尸杉将其根系埋入该生物体内，造成 @Damage[(1d6+13)[piercing]] 伤害，并吸取目标的生命力（@Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic] 豁免）。若失败，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}（若其已经处于drained状态，则数值增加 1），且尸杉恢复 10 HP。若这会使一个生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 5}，则该生物死亡。

Frequency once per round

Requirements The corpse sugi has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The corpse sugi buries its roots into the creature, dealing @Damage[(1d6+13)[piercing]] damage and draining the target's life force (@Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic] save). On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or increases the value by 1 if already drained), and the corpse sugi regains 10 HP. If this would make a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 5}, the creature dies.

Corpse Sugi.publicNotes:
尸根是腐烂的亡灵树木，会长出鲜红色的有毒果实，并将枯萎病传播给周围的植物，把健康的树木转化为新的尸根。这些狡猾的杀手通过其根系汲取生物的生命，在受害者进入触及范围内之前，它们会伪装成枯死的树木。

尸根最常由因超自然枯萎病而死的树木腐朽残骸形成，因此在獠牙森林和菲耶拉尼森林中是常见威胁。最强大的尸根则是被用作圣祠和献祭祭坛的古树，它们的根系吸收了那些在枝下被处决者的鲜血、血肉与恐惧。其中一些古老的尸根仍然得到无意间创造出它们的教团的尊敬与奉献。

Corpseroots are rotten, undead trees that grow bright-red poisonous fruit and spread blight to surrounding plants, transforming healthy trees into new corpseroots. These cunning killers drain the life from creatures through their root systems, posing as dead trees until their victims come within reach.

Corpseroots most commonly form from rotten husks of trees that died from supernatural blights, making them common threats in the Fangwood and Fierani forests. The most powerful are ancient trees used as shrines and sacrificial altars, their roots absorbing the blood, flesh, and terror of those condemned under their boughs. Some of these ancient corpseroots still command the respect and devotion of the cults that inadvertently created them.

Vitumniar.name: 维图姆尼亚尔 Vitumniar
Vitumniar.blurb:
脾气乖戾的男性娜迦吉制革工
cantankerous male nagaji tanner

Collection of Silver Ingots, Ivory, and.name: 一批银锭、象牙与丝绸的收藏 Collection of Silver Ingots, Ivory, and Silk

Fire-Jump Ring.name: 火焰跳跃戒指 Fire-Jump Ring
Fire-Jump Ring.description:
这枚黑色金属戒指镶嵌着红宝石，红宝石偶尔会散发出缕缕烟雾。它使你在运动检定上获得 +2 物品加值。

启动—火焰跳跃 2（专注、操作、传送）

频率 每天一次

效果 你行走（或者若你拥有对应速度，则可掘穴或飞行）进入任何足以容纳你的火焰中，包括魔法火焰。你消失在火焰中，且不会因此受到伤害。你能够感知到你消失处 100 尺内所有足够大的火焰，并从其中任意一处火焰中重新出现，出现在火焰内或与其相邻的位置。若你在火焰中结束你的移动，则火焰会如常对你产生效果。

This black, metal ring is inset with rubies that occasionally give off wisps of smoke. It grants you a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks.

Activate—Fire Jump 2 (concentrate, manipulate, teleportation)

Frequency once per day

Effect You Stride (or Burrow or Fly, if you have the corresponding Speed) into any fire large enough to contain you, including magical fires. You vanish into the fire and take no damage from it. You can sense all sufficiently large fires within 100 feet of where you vanish, and you reemerge from any of those fires, either within the fire or adjacent to it. If you end your movement in the fire, it affects you as normal.

Akashti.name: 恪尸魔 Akashti

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Crushing Despair.name: 极度绝望 Crushing Despair
Crushing Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作，并且必须在其回合开始时再次尝试一次豁免；若失败，它会因无法控制地啜泣而在该回合中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 同失败，且该生物自动处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域增大为60足锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Glibness.name: 巧言术 Glibness
Glibness.description:
谎言从你的唇间流出，如丝绸般顺滑。你进行说谎的欺瞒检定，以及对抗用于辨别你是否说真话的察觉检定时，获得+4状态加值，且即使你未受训，你也将你的等级加入其中。若你的谎言因过于不可信而导致环境减值或难度等级增加，则将该减值或增加量减半。

Falsehoods pass your lips as smoothly as silk. You gain a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to Lie and against Perception checks to discern if you are telling the truth, and you add your level even if you're untrained. If the implausibility of your lies prompts a circumstance penalty or a DC increase, reduce that penalty or increase by half.

Talking Corpse.name: 死者交谈 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一种生命的表象，使其能够开口回答向它提出的三个问题。该法术调用的是物理身体中潜藏的记忆，而非将死者的精魂召回，因此尸体必须大体完整，该法术才能生效。尸体受到的伤害越多，它的回答就越不准确、越支离破碎；而且它必须有喉咙和嘴巴，才能发声。如果在过去一周内，曾有人对这具尸体施放过此法术，则该法术自动失败。尸体可以使用原本生物死亡时的数据进行一次意志豁免，以抗拒回答这些问题，结果如下。

大成功 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，而且目标的精魂会在24小时内作祟于你，骚扰你，并使你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息，或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答，但它的回答可能简短、隐晦且重复。它仍然可以误导你，或试图拖延时间，使法术的持续时间在你问完所有问题前耗尽。

大失败 如同失败，但目标的回答更直接且较少重复，不过仍然隐晦。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或误导你时承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Illusory Creature.name: 幻影生物 Illusory Creature
Illusory Creature.description:
你创造一个大型或更小生物的幻象影像。它会产生适当的声音、气味，并且在接触时显得真实可信。如果你与该影像之间的距离超过500英尺，法术结束。

该影像不能说话，但你可以使用你的动作通过该生物发声，法术会将你的声音伪装成适当的样子。你可能需要尝试一次欺瞒或表演检定来模仿该生物，这由游戏主持决定。如果你试图模仿某个特定人物，并与认识那个人的人互动，则尤其可能需要这样做。

在战斗中，该幻象每回合可以使用2个动作；当你维持该法术时，它便使用这些动作。它进行攻击掷骰时使用你的法术攻击调整，其AC使用你的法术DC。它的豁免调整值等于你的法术DC – 10。它具有足够的实体性，可以夹击其他生物。如果该影像被一次攻击命中或豁免失败，法术结束。

该幻象可以通过让目标相信其攻击真实存在来造成伤害，但除此之外，它不能直接影响物理世界。如果幻影生物以一次打击命中，目标受到@Damage[3d4[mental]]精神伤害。该幻象的打击为非致命攻击。如果伤害与怪物的影像不相符——例如，一个幻象大型巨龙却只造成5点伤害——游戏主持可以允许目标立刻尝试一次察觉检定来识破该法术。任何相关抗力和弱点都会在目标认为它们适用时生效，由游戏主持裁定。例如，如果该幻象挥舞一把战锤并攻击一个对钝击伤害具有抗力的生物，则该生物会受到更少的精神伤害。不过，幻象伤害不会使再生失效，也不会触发其他要求特定伤害类型的效果。游戏主持应追踪该幻象造成的幻象伤害。

任何接触该影像的生物，或使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。当一个生物识破该幻象时，它恢复先前因该幻象所受伤害的一半（若有），且此后不再受到其进一步伤害。

升阶（+1） 该影像打击的伤害增加1d4，并且你所能创造的生物最大体型提高一级（最大为超巨型）。

You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the spell. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[3d4[mental]] damage. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一次精神冲击使其恍惚。该冲击造成 1d6 精神伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标的豁免结果为大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出一种由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Item Facade.name: 物品伪装 Item Facade
Item Facade.description:
你使目标物体看起来和摸起来仿佛其物理状况好得多或差得多。施放此法术时，决定你想让该物体看起来是破旧不堪还是完美无瑕。被伪装成破旧的物品会显得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}且粗制滥造。被伪装得更好的完好物品会看起来仿佛崭新出厂，并经过高度抛光或精心保养。处于破损状态的物品则会显得完好且功能正常。被摧毁的物品无法受到此法术影响。与该物品进行交互的生物可以尝试识破该幻觉。

升阶（2环） 持续时间为24小时。

升阶（3环） 持续时间为无限。

You make the target object look and feel as though it were in much better or worse physical condition. When you cast this spell, decide whether you want to make the object look decrepit or perfect. An item made to look decrepit appears @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} and shoddy. An intact item made to look better appears as though it's brand new and highly polished or well maintained. A Broken item appears to be intact and functional. Destroyed items can't be affected by this spell. A creature that Interacts with the item can attempt to disbelieve the illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is 24 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is unlimited.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声默念话语，但这些话并不会从你口中说出，而是会被直接传送到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，和你平常只是动嘴不出声时并无二致，但目标听见你的话时，就仿佛他们正站在你身边一样。目标可以用一个反应动作（）作出简短回应，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在自己下个回合中以一个自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能看见你且位于射程内才能这么做。如果他们作出回应，他们的回应也会像最初的传讯一样，直接传到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成 2d4 点心灵伤害以及 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须尝试进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害，但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心状态中恢复，则持续伤害结束，且该法术结束。

大失败 如失败，但目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d4，且持续伤害增加 1d4。

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

Soul Shred.name: 灵魂撕裂 Soul Shred
Soul Shred.description:
被恪尸魔杀死的生物很难被带回生命，或被转化为不死生物。恪尸魔会自动尝试反制任何对其所杀死生物施放的复活术，或将其转化为不死生物的尝试（反制调整值 [[/r 1d20+19 #Counteract]]{+19}，反制环阶 5）。如果杀死该生物的恪尸魔被杀死，那么该生物便可以正常地从死亡中被带回，或正常地成为不死生物。

Creatures killed by an akashti are difficult to bring back to life or animate as undead. The akashti automatically attempts to counteract any attempt to resurrect or animate as undead any creature that it has killed (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+19 #Counteract]]{+19}, counteract rank 5). If the akashti who slew the creature is slain, the creature can be brought back from death or become undead normally.

Manifest Body.name: 具现身躯 Manifest Body
Manifest Body.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 恪尸魔通过10分钟的专注，在其纤细的骸骨躯架外显现出一具中空的人形身体。若这段时间是在一具死亡未满一周的人形生物尸体10尺内度过，则恪尸魔所显现的身体会与该死去的人形生物生前完全相同，并作为该生物的伪装发挥作用。若恪尸魔能够吞食其所复制身体的一部分，它在进行欺瞒检定以乔装成该生物时获得+4环境加值。穿着显现出的身体时，恪尸魔失去其爪击打击，且其声音听起来也与死去的生物相同；它并不拥有死者的任何记忆或技能，因此在面对审视时，必须依靠欺瞒来维持这场伪装。若恪尸魔不每天花费10分钟来维持这虚假血肉的显现，其显现出的身体会迅速腐坏。该身体有10点生命值，且具有与恪尸魔相同的防御。当该身体被摧毁时，恪尸魔会毫发无伤地浮现，而留下的血肉外壳会散落成一群红色蝴蝶，并迅速消散为红色薄雾。

Frequency once per day

Effect The akashti manifests a hollow humanoid body around its slender skeletal frame over the course of 10 minutes of concentration. If this time is spent within 10 feet of a humanoid body that has been dead for less than a week, the akashti's manifested body looks identical to that of the dead humanoid when they lived and functions as a disguise of that creature. If the akashti can consume a portion of the body it's duplicating, it gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate the creature. While wearing a manifested body, the akashti loses its claw Strike, and its voice sounds like that of the dead creature; it doesn't possess any of the dead creature's memories or skills and must rely on deception to continue the charade in the face of scrutiny. An akashti's manifested body decays swiftly if it doesn't take 10 minutes once per day to maintain the manifestation of the false flesh. The body has 10 Hit Points and the same defenses as the akashti. When the body is destroyed, the akashti emerges unharmed and the fleshy shell left behind scatters into a cloud of red butterflies that swiftly fade into red mist.

Stunning Despair.name: 震慑绝望 Stunning Despair
Stunning Despair.description:
恪尸魔爆发出压倒性的绝望啜泣。30尺内的生物必须尝试进行一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}（大失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑3}）。恪尸魔在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4轮} 内不能再次使用震慑绝望。

The akashti unleashes overwhelming sobs of despair. Creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure). The akashti can't use Stunning Despair again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stunning Despair]]{1d4 rounds}.

Akashti.publicNotes:
阿卡什提斯是善于操纵的邪魔，专门猎食那些沉浸于哀悼中的人；它们会化作一位刚刚死去的挚爱之人的模样，以便潜入家中，随后谋杀并吞噬悲痛家庭成员的灵魂。有时也被称为“拟尸”，恪尸魔在其真实形态下看起来像一具覆着皮肤的骷髅，手指上长着锐利的利爪，无睑的眼中不断滴落血泪。它的骷髅头仿佛像碗一样敞开着，里面栖息着几捧深红色的蝴蝶。当一只恪尸魔躲藏在它显现出的身体之内时，若仔细观察，有时便能看出真相：那位似乎死而复生的挚爱之人头皮会微微起伏鼓胀，因为其中的蝴蝶正在蠕动。阿卡什提斯体现了悲痛那复杂的循环。

已死的入侵者

有时，阿卡什提斯伏击并杀害目标，并不是为了沉浸于其挚爱之人的悲痛之中，而是为了取而代之，伪装成对方并从内部渗透某个组织，腐化既有的同袍情谊。不过，这些阿卡什提斯最终总会对欺瞒感到厌倦，并把他们的新同伴引入陷阱，任其遭到屠杀。

Akashtis are manipulative fiends who prey on those in mourning; they assume the form of a recently deceased loved one so they can infiltrate homes, then murder and consume the souls of grieving families. Sometimes called a "copycorpse," an akashti in its true form appears as a skin-covered skeleton with sharp talons on its fingers and tears of blood dripping from its lidless eyes. Its skull appears open like a bowl, and inside nest handfuls of crimson butterflies. When an akashti hides within its manifested body, close investigation can sometimes reveal the truth when the scalp of the supposed beloved one returned to life seems to subtly ripple and bulge as the butterflies within writhe. Akashtis embody the complex cycle of grief.

Deathly Invaders

Sometimes, akashtis ambush and murder targets not to bask in the grief of their loved ones, but instead to assume their form and infiltrate an organization from within to corrupt established bonds of camaraderie. Inevitably, though, these akashtis grow bored with deception and lead their new allies into a trap for slaughter.

Grasping Currents.name: 攫握激流 Grasping Currents

Ghostly Grasp.name: 幽灵之握 Ghostly Grasp
Ghostly Grasp.description:
触发 一个生物试图通过游泳或载具操作船只来穿过湖面

效果 幽魂之臂向上伸出，试图抓住并紧扣该生物或船只，使触发该作祟的运动或载具操作检定承受–2减值。该作祟随后进行先攻掷骰。

Trigger A creature attempts to cross the lake by swimming or piloting a boat

Effect Ghostly arms reach up to grab and clutch at the creature or the boat, causing a –2 penalty to the Athletics or Piloting check that triggered the haunt. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Grasping Currents.disable:
@Check[religion|dc:23] 以使水中的躁动精魂冷静一小时，或点亮长明灯（自动解除该作祟）

@Check[religion|dc:23] to calm the unquiet spirits in the waters for an hour, or light the Eternal Lantern (automatically disables the haunt)
Grasping Currents.hazarddescription:
一群溺死的精魂试图把某人拖入水中，让其加入他们。

A swath of drowned spirits tries to pull someone down into the water to join them.
Grasping Currents.reset:
攫握激流会迅速积蓄力量，并可在10分钟过去后再次触发。

The grasping currents quickly build up power and can trigger again after 10 minutes have passed.
Grasping Currents.routine:
（1个动作）在其先攻时，攫握激流会尝试对一个正在游泳的生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{擒拿}，或通过以[[/r 1d20+12 #Athletics]]{+12}调整值进行一次运动检定来掀翻一艘划艇。被攫握激流@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}的生物会被拖入水下，并面临溺水风险。要掀翻一艘划艇，这个作祟的运动检定对抗操舵者的运动或航海学识难度等级，以较高者为准。

(1 action) On its initiative, the grasping currents attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a swimming creature or capsize a rowboat by attempting an Athletics check with a [[/r 1d20+12 #Athletics]]{+12} modifier. A creature that's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the grasping currents is pulled underwater and risks drowning. To capsize a rowboat, the haunt's Athletics check is rolled against the pilot's Athletics or Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.
Grasping Currents.stealthdetails:
（受训）以察觉水面下水流中一道怪异、微微发光的涟漪。

(trained) to notice a weird, faintly glowing ripple of the current beneath the water.

Zhen Luoyang.name: 甄洛阳 Zhen Luoyang

Power of the Mob.name: 暴民之力 Power of the Mob
Power of the Mob.description:
当三个或更多平民彼此相邻时，每个平民的运动检定、[[/act shove]]、攻击掷骰和伤害掷骰均获得 +1 环境加值。

When three or more commoners are adjacent to each other, each commoner gets a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act shove]], attack rolls, and damage rolls.

Lore (any one related to their trade).name: 学识（任一与其工作相关的）

Zhen Luoyang.publicNotes:
许多平民过着艰辛劳作的生活，努力工作，以让家人吃饱穿暖，享有相对安稳的生活。

社会是建立在劳工的肩背之上的。

Many commoners live hard lives of toil as they work to keep their families fed and housed in relative comfort.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.
Zhen Luoyang.blurb:
男性人类平民
Male human commone

Mo Douqiu's Keys.name: 莫都求的钥匙 Mo Douqiu's Keys

Phantom Raven.name: 魅影渡鸦 Phantom Raven

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你扰乱目标的心智，并以一次心灵冲击令其陷入恍惚。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的心灵伤害；目标必须尝试进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

强化（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造出由简单声音组成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个人类正常呼喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你不能制造可辨识的词语或其他复杂声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Walk the Ethereal Line.name: 游于两界 Walk the Ethereal Line
Walk the Ethereal Line.description:
魅影游走于以太位面与物质位面之间的细微界线之上，以同时存在于这两个位面。

它们可以通过再次使用此能力，转回仅存在于以太位面。

The phantom walks the thin line between the Ethereal and Material Planes in order to exist on both planes simultaneously.

They can shift back to solely the Ethereal Plane by using this ability again.

Susceptible to Death.name: 易于死亡 Susceptible to Death
Susceptible to Death.description:
尽管魅影并非活物，但它们也不是不死生物，并且会独特地易受死亡效果影响。

若魅影因死亡效果而使其生命值降至 0（例如来自类似 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute} 的法术），它会立刻被送往灵魂之河，在那里，它的灵魂会继续沿着通往来世的正常道路前行。

Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they undead, and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death.

A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a death effect (such as from a spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute}) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

Vulnerable to Kindness.name: 友善易伤 Vulnerable to Kindness
Vulnerable to Kindness.description:
任何位于30尺内且魅影能够看见并听见的生物，都可以用一个带有听觉、专注、语言和心灵（特征）特征的双动作行动，向它发出冷静且友善的问候。以这种方式向魅影问候的生物必须进行一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:15] 检定。

大成功 魅影受到 @Damage[4d8[mental]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

成功 魅影受到 @Damage[2d8[mental]] 伤害。

失败 魅影受到 @Damage[1d8[mental]] 伤害。

大失败 魅影不受影响，并且在1轮内不受此弱点影响。

Any creature within 30 feet that the phantom can see and hear can issue a calm and friendly greeting to it as a two-action activity with the auditory, concentrate, linguistic, and mental traits. A creature greeting the phantom in this manner must attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:15] check.

Critical Success The phantom takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The phantom takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage.

Failure The phantom takes @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The phantom is unaffected, and is not affected by this weakness for 1 round.

Phantom Raven.publicNotes:
大多数神学家认为，灵魂通往来世的普通轨迹相当直接。凡人死后，其灵魂会进入灵魂之河，并最终抵达骨园，在那里接受法拉斯玛的审判。受审后的灵魂会前往其适当的最终安息领域——天堂、地狱、亚巴顿等等——并在那里成为祈愿者。

然而，当一个排队等待审判的灵魂过早脱离灵魂之河，并被转移到以太位面时，情况就会变得复杂。无论是由于鬼婆（特征）之类心怀不轨的闯入者、恶性的位面魔法，还是甚至命运所致，这些灵魂都会脱离生死的自然秩序，滞留于某种类似炼狱的状态。与祈愿者不同，这些以太魅影保留着死前生活的记忆；而与幽灵这类精魂不同，魅影并未沾染不死生物那种污秽的影响——至少一开始并非如此，尽管腐化的威胁始终沉重地笼罩着魅影的存在。有些最终屈服于那样的命运，另一些则终会重新回到灵魂之河。在那之前，这些游荡的灵魂自成一类——一种没有真正归宿、目标或目的的存在。

许多魅影都不愿继续维持这种怪异的炼狱状态，要么是因为它们想继续自己穿越灵魂之河的旅程，要么是因为它们害怕不死生物的腐化。为了完成自然的灵性循环并接受审判，从而继续前往来世，魅影只需要找到回到灵魂之河的方法。然而，这样的追寻绝非易事——以太位面朦胧的迷雾足以让即便最有经验的旅者也迷失困惑，而众多掠食者则在这片领域中徘徊，搜索那些离群的灵魂，以便束缚或吞噬它们。

The typical trajectory for souls passing to the afterlife is fairly straightforward, according to most theologians. When a mortal dies, their soul enters the River of Souls and eventually reaches the Boneyard, where it is judged by Pharasma. The judged soul moves onto its appropriate domain of final rest-Heaven, Hell, Abaddon, and so forth-where it becomes a petitioner.

Complications arise, however, when a soul in queue for judgment prematurely departs from the River of Souls and is shunted into the Ethereal Plane. Whether as a result of nefarious interlopers like night hags, malignant planar magic, or even fate, these souls become dislodged from the natural order of life and death and linger in a sort of purgatory. Unlike petitioners, these ethereal phantoms retain memories of their life before death, and unlike spirits such as ghosts, phantoms aren't tinged with the foul influences of undeath-at least, not at first, though the threat of corruption hangs heavy over a phantom's existence. Some eventually succumb to that fate, while others eventually rejoin the River of Souls. Until then, these wandering souls are a kind unto themselves-one without a true home, agenda, or purpose.

Many phantoms have no desire to remain in their strange state of purgatory, either because they seek to continue their journey through the River of Souls or because they fear the corruption of undeath. In order to complete the natural spiritual cycle and become judged so they can continue to the afterlife, a phantom must simply find a way back into the River of Souls. Such a quest is no easy feat, however-the hazy mists of the Ethereal Plane can befuddle even the most experienced traveler, and numerous predators prowl the realm in search of stray souls to bind or devour.

Mandragora.name: 曼陀罗草 Mandragora

Blood Scent.name: 血之气味 Blood Scent
Blood Scent.description:
曼陀罗草能以30尺的模糊感官闻到有血液的生物，也能以30尺的精确感官闻到有血液的恶魔、妖精和术士。

A mandragora can smell creatures with blood as an imprecise sense at a range of 30 feet, and it can smell demons, fey, and sorcerers with blood as a precise sense at a range of 30 feet.

Vulnerability to Supernatural Darkness.name: 对超自然黑暗的弱点 Vulnerability to Supernatural Darkness
Vulnerability to Supernatural Darkness.description:
每当一株曼陀罗草在魔法黑暗的区域内开始其回合时，它在该回合中会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

Whenever a mandragora begins its turn in an area of magical darkness, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on that turn.

Blood Drain.name: 吸血 Blood Drain
Blood Drain.description:
需求 曼陀罗草已使一个生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

效果 曼陀罗草从它已抓取或束缚的生物身上吸取血液，造成 @Damage[2d6[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] 豁免）。如果该生物是恶魔、妖精或术士，曼陀罗草获得等同于所造成伤害的临时生命值，持续1分钟。被曼陀罗草吸血并因此受到任何伤害的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，直到其接受任意种类或数量的治疗。

Requirements The mandragora has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The mandragora drains blood from the creature it has grabbed or restrained, dealing @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] save). If the creature is a demon, fey, or sorcerer, the mandragora gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt for 1 minute. A creature that takes any damage from having its blood drained by a mandragora is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} until it receives any kind or amount of healing.

Mandragora Venom.name: 曼陀罗草毒液 Mandragora Venom
Mandragora Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

最长持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Piercing Shriek.name: 穿刺尖啸 Piercing Shriek
Piercing Shriek.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 曼陀罗草发出令人不安的尖啸。30尺内的每个非曼陀罗草生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:23] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入恶心 2 并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。只要该生物仍处于恶心状态，该减速状态的数值就不能降低到1以下。

Frequency once per day

Effect The mandragora emits an unsettling shriek. Each non-mandragora creature within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is sickened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. As long as the creature remains sickened, this slowed condition value can't be reduced below 1.

Mandragora.publicNotes:
一株曼陀罗草看起来像是一颗刚从土里拔出的块根，长成了一个畸形孩童的模样，生着一张可怖怪异的面孔和一副骇人地臃肿的身体。这些阴险的小植物通常形成于曼陀罗草根被恶魔之血浇灌之后。在吸收了恶魔之血的异界特性后，根便活化过来，并被迫去寻找鲜血以饱餐一顿，否则就会因干渴而死。

曼陀罗草总是饥肠辘辘，四处寻找食粮，过着如同被阴魂缠身、饱受痛苦的生活，并会为了获取它们渴求的鲜血而做出卑劣又绝望的行径。尽管曼陀罗草更喜欢带有魔法力量的血液，例如独角兽、妖精或术士的血，而且它们也能靠药水、炼金炸弹和魔法灵药维生，但作为最后手段，它们也会勉强接受非魔法生物的血。它们觉得普通血液的味道寡淡而苦涩，并且毫不忌讳向它们吸食的生物当面抱怨这些问题。

普通曼陀罗草通常只有一个人类孩童那么大，但有些会不断生长，甚至长到可与巨人相比的体型。有时，随着它们越长越大，还会长出额外的肢体或粗陋的面孔，最终变成对人类形态的真正可憎拙劣模仿。

A mandragora looks like a freshly pulled tuber that has grown into the malformed shape of a child with a grotesque face and hideously bloated body. These insidious little plants typically form when a mandrake root is watered with a demon's blood. Upon absorbing the otherworldly properties of the demon's blood, the root animates and is forced to seek out blood to feast from, lest it die of thirst.

Always famished and in search for sustenance, mandragoras live haunted, pained lives and perform vile and desperate acts to acquire the blood they crave. Though mandragoras prefer magically infused blood such as that of unicorns, fey, or sorcerers, and they can subsist on potions, alchemical bombs, and magical elixirs, they'll settle for the blood of non-magical creatures as a last resort. They find the flavor of mundane blood to be bland and bitter, and they don't blanch at voicing these complaints to the creatures on whom they feed.

While the typical mandragora is the size of a human child, some continue to grow and grow, even reaching sizes comparable to giants. Sometimes as they get larger, they form additional limbs or rudimentary faces, eventually transforming into truly hideous mockeries of the human form.

Town Guard.name: 城镇卫兵 Town Guard

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这种带刃的小型武器单手持用，用于在近身战斗中刺击生物。它也可以投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Scale Mail.name: 鳞甲 Scale Mail
Scale Mail.description:
鳞甲由许多缝制在加固皮革衬底上的金属鳞片构成，通常呈长衫形式，保护躯干、手臂和腿部。

Scale mail consists of many metal scales sewn onto a reinforced leather backing, often in the form of a long shirt that protects the torso, arms, and legs.

Signal Whistle.name: 信号哨子 Signal Whistle
Signal Whistle.description:
吹响时，信号哨子在开阔地形中最远可于半英里外被清晰听见。

When sounded, a signal whistle can be heard clearly up to half a mile away across open terrain.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，弩矢是弩所使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

+1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed.name: 察觉检定在寻找隐蔽物体时获得 +1 加值 +1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed objects

Town Guard.publicNotes:
守卫是城镇巡逻队或城市卫队中的普通成员，接受过训练以发现麻烦、制服罪犯并服从命令。

较大的社会依赖那些拥有权威以及解读和执行法律能力的人。有些人会公正地履行这些职责，但另一些人则严厉而残酷，对任何无力支付宽恕代价的人施加严苛的惩罚。

Guards are rank-and-file members of a town watch or city guard, trained to look for trouble, take down criminals, and follow orders.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

Great Willow.name: 大柳树 Great Willow

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神术内在法术 Divine Innate Spells

Nature's Pathway.name: 通身入林 Nature's Pathway
Nature's Pathway.description:
你步入一棵活树，其树干大到足以容纳你进入其中，并立即传送到 5 英里内任意一棵同样具有足够大树干的树木中。一旦你进入第一棵树，你会立刻知晓射程内其他足够大的树木的大致位置；如果你愿意，也可以从原本那棵树中退出。你不能携带异次元空间与你一同移动；如果你试图这么做，该法术失败。

升阶（6环） 你离开的树木最远可以在 50 英里外。

升阶（8环） 你离开的树木最远可以在 500 英里外。

升阶（9环） 你离开的树木可以位于同一颗行星上的任何地方。

You step into a living tree with a trunk big enough for you to fit inside it and instantly teleport to any tree within 5 miles that also has a sufficiently large trunk. Once you enter the first tree, you instantly know the rough locations of other sufficiently large trees within range and can exit from the original tree, if you prefer. You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you; if you attempt to do so, the spell fails.

Heightened (6th) The tree you exit can be up to 50 miles away.

Heightened (8th) The tree you exit can be up to 500 miles away.

Heightened (9th) The tree you exit can be anywhere on the same planet.

Speak with Plants (Constant).name: 植物交谈（恒定）
Speak with Plants (Constant).description:
你可以向植物和真菌提问并从它们那里得到回答，但该法术不会让它们变得比平常更友善或更聪明。大多数普通植物和真菌对周围世界都有一种独特的看法，因此它们无法识别关于生物的细节，也不了解其近邻之外世界的任何事情。狡猾的植物或真菌怪物往往言简意赅且闪烁其词，而较不聪明的那些则常会发表愚蠢的评论。

升阶（4环） 持续时间为8小时。

You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants and fungi have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant or fungus monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Heightened (4th) The duration is 8 hours.

One with Plants.name: 与植物为一 One with Plants
One with Plants.description:
你可以变形为一株植物，或与植物物质融合。变形期间，你无法移动，也无法影响植物外的任何事物，但只要法术不需要超出植物之外的效果线，你就可以施放法术。你可以解消这个法术。

  • 与植物融合 该法术的持续时间为10分钟。施放法术时，你必须接触一株有足够体积容纳你和你携带物品的植物，否则法术会被打断。融合期间，你可以听见植物外发生的事，但看不见。如果你在植物内时该植物受到伤害，你会被从植物中排出，并受到10d6伤害。魔法通道会将你排出，但不会造成伤害。如果你曾处于植物之外，法术就会结束。
  • 变成植物 该法术的持续时间为8小时。你变成一株大型植物——通常是一棵树。察觉检定无法揭示你的真实本质，但对抗你的法术DC成功的自然或求生检定会揭示你看起来像是一株对该区域而言异常新出现的植物。处于此形态时，你可以使用你正常的感官观察周围的一切。作为植物时，你的AC为20，并且只有状态加值、状态减值、环境加值和环境减值会影响你。你在反射豁免上的任何成功和大成功都视为失败。

You can either transform into a plant or merge with plant matter. While transformed, you can't move or affect anything outside the plant, but you can cast spells as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the plant. You can Dismiss this spell.

  • Merge with Plants The spell's duration is 10 minutes. While casting the spell, you must touch a plant with enough volume to fit you and your possessions or the spell is disrupted. While merged, you can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the plant. If the plant takes damage while you're inside it, you're expelled from the plant and take 10d6 damage. Magic passage expels you without dealing damage. The spell ends if you're ever outside the plant.
  • Turn into a Plant The spell's duration is 8 hours. You become a Large plant—typically a tree. Perception checks don't reveal your true nature, but a successful Nature or Survival check against your spell DC reveals that you appear to be a plant that is strangely new to the area. While in this form, you can observe everything around you, using your normal senses. As a plant, your AC is 20, and only status bonuses, status penalties, circumstance bonuses, and circumstance penalties affect you. Any successes and critical successes you roll on Reflex saves are failures

Figment.name: 虚像 Figment
Figment.description:
你创造一个简单的幻象声音或影像。声音会为该法术添加听觉（特征），且该声音不能包含可理解的词语或复杂的音乐。影像会添加视觉（特征），其尺寸不能大于一个5足立方，并且若从15足内观看，会显得明显粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你可以尝试借助该幻象进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{声东击西}，并使你的欺瞒检定获得+2环境加值。若此次尝试对某个生物失败，则该生物会识破该虚像。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚像}

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

Spiritual Rope.name: 魂魄之绳 Spiritual Rope
Spiritual Rope.description:
木灵花费1分钟，用附近的材料编织出一条附魔的稻草绳。这条绳子可以缠绕在其他神使生物身上，以保护它们免受邪恶力量的侵害。佩戴魂魄之绳的神使获得对来自邪秽生物和效果的伤害5点抗力，并且在对抗邪秽效果，以及邪秽生物的攻击和效果时，其AC和豁免骰获得+1状态加值。

木灵总是佩戴着一条魂魄之绳，并且同一时间至多还能额外存在另一条魂魄之绳。若再创造出超出这两条之外的新绳，则会释放由该木灵选择的另外两条绳子之一上的魔法。缠绕在木灵以外生物身上的魂魄之绳会在24小时后，或在被带出该木灵的森林时失去其魔法。

The kodama spends 1 minute to fashion an enchanted straw rope out of nearby materials. The rope can be wrapped around other kami creatures to protect them from fell forces. A kami who wears a spiritual rope gains resistance 5 to damage from unholy creatures and effects and a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws against unholy effects and attacks and effects from unholy creatures.

A kodama always wears a spiritual rope, and they can have one other spiritual rope in existence at a time. Creating a new rope beyond these two releases the magic of one of the other two ropes of the kodama's choosing. A spiritual rope around a creature other than a kodama loses its magic after 24 hours or if it's taken outside the kodama's forest.

Telepathy 50 feet.name: 心灵感应 50 尺 Telepathy 50 feet

Ward.name: 受监护者 Ward
Ward.description:
每位神使都与一个受监护者相连：一只特定的动物、一株植物、一个物体或一处地点。神使可以以单动作与其受监护者融合，或从其受监护者中浮现，此动作具有专注（特征）。处于融合状态时，神使可以用其通常的感官以及其受监护者的感官观察周围环境，但不能移动、与其受监护者交流，或控制其受监护者。此外，与其受监护者融合的神使每分钟恢复生命值，仿佛其已休息了整整一天。

木灵的受监护者是一棵特定的树。

Every kami is bound to a ward: a specific animal, plant, object, or location. A kami can merge with or emerge from their ward as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. While merged, the kami can observe their surroundings with their usual senses as well as the senses of their ward, but can't move, communicate with, or control their ward. Additionally, a kami merged with their ward recovers Hit Points each minute as if they spent an entire day resting.

A kodama's ward is a specific tree.

Distracting Gaze.name: 扰乱凝视 Distracting Gaze
Distracting Gaze.description:
30尺。当一个生物在灵气范围内结束其回合时，它必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 豁免。木灵可以通过使用一个单动作来启动或关闭该灵气，该动作具有专注（特征）。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物对木灵陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷}状态。若该生物在灵气范围外结束其回合，此状态结束。

大失败 如同失败，此外，只要该生物仍处于着迷状态，它便会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}。

30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. The kodama can activate or deactivate this aura by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the kodama. This condition ends if the creature ends its turn outside the aura.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it remains fascinated.

Great Willow.publicNotes:
木灵是一种栖居于树木中的神使。木灵常见于天夏古老的森林中，尤其是远离文明的原始森林。比如在岷凯的灵之森中，就有如此之多的树木被木灵附身，以至于旅人穿行于仅仅一英亩的林地时，路旁就可能经过数百，甚至数千个这样的存在。

木灵会竭尽全力保护它们的神圣树木，但对大多数恶鬼或其他毫不在意亵渎森林、或将其作为自然资源采伐的存在来说，单独一个木灵不过是个小小的阻碍。就像森林中的树木一样，木灵在数量众多且与其他神使同在时最为强大；它们能用自己的魔法草绳强化同伴，同时以令人着迷的存在感分散强敌的注意。另一方面，木灵对那些尊重其受监护者的人并无恶意，甚至会允许德鲁伊和其他恭敬有礼的生物居住在它们的领地内。它们甚至可能巧妙地为迷路的旅人指引方向，带其离开森林或回到安全之地。

神使是来自遥远东方天夏大地的神圣自然精魂，天夏位于内海地区以东的远方。它们作为自然物体与地点的守护者而存在，保护着自己的受监护者——并且是恶鬼的古老宿敌（开拓者 怪物图鉴 252–255）。神使能够与自己的受监护者合而为一，使它们得以悄然监视任何踏入其神圣土地的人。对于那些被它们认定为无害的人，神使会置之不理；但若察觉到威胁，它们便会警觉作战，将入侵者驱离。

A kodama is a type of kami who inhabits a tree. Kodama commonly appear in old Tian forests, especially old-growth forests far removed from civilization. In the Forest of Spirits in Minkai, for example, so many trees are possessed by kodama that a traveler might pass by hundreds, if not thousands, of these beings while journeying through a single acre of woodland.

Kodama try their utmost to protect their sacred trees, but a single kodama is a minor obstacle to most oni or others who have no qualms about desecrating forests or harvesting them for natural resources. Like trees in a forest, kodama are most powerful in great numbers and among other kami, whom they can bolster with their magical straw ropes while distracting strong enemies with their mesmerizing presence. On the other hand, kodama bear no ill will toward those who respect their wards, even allowing druids and other deferential creatures to dwell within their bounds. They might even subtly guide lost travelers out of the forest or back to safety.

Kami are divine nature spirits from the lands of Tian Xia, far to the east of the Inner Sea region. They serve as guardians of natural objects and places they protect—their wards—and are ancient enemies of oni (Pathfinder Monster Core 252–255). Kami can merge with their wards, allowing them to surreptitiously watch anyone who treads upon their sacred grounds. Kami leave those who they deem harmless alone, but fight vigilantly to scare away anyone perceived as a threat.
Great Willow.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. evil creatures

Thousand-Year Dragonroot.name: 千年龙根 Thousand-Year Dragonroot
Thousand-Year Dragonroot.description:
龙根是生长于整个天夏、根部呈淡金色的植物。正如曼德拉草根或人参根有时会被视为近似人形一样，这些根看起来仿佛是龙的形状。它们通常用于调制治疗药水，但最令人趋之若鹜的是那些生长了数百年的，因为它们可以被附魔为千年龙根。

当你启动千年龙根时，你的身体会闪烁金色光芒，提供如同火把般的照明。你获得40尺飞行速度和火焰抗力5，持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.p1pxUzwgWZ9l9jmD]{效果：千年龙根}

Dragonroots are pale, golden-rooted plants that grow throughout Tian Xia. Just as mandrake roots or ginseng roots are sometimes regarded to have almost humanoid shapes, these roots appear as if they were dragons. They're commonly used in the formulation of healing potions, but the most sought-after have grown for centuries, for they're viable for enchantment into thousand-year dragonroots.

When you activate a thousand-year dragonroot, your body shimmers with golden light, providing illumination as a torch. You gain a fly Speed of 40 feet and fire resistance 5 for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.p1pxUzwgWZ9l9jmD]{Effect: Thousand-Year Dragonroot}

Brood Leech Swarm.name: 幼水蛭群 Brood Leech Swarm
Brood Leech Swarm.tokenName: 幼水蛭群 Brood Leech Swarm

Blood Draining Bites.name: 吸血噬咬 Blood Draining Bites
Blood Draining Bites.description:
虫群空间内的每个敌人受到 @Damage[2d6[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] 豁免）。反射豁免失败的生物还会受到 @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] 伤害，并暴露于幼水蛭群毒液。

Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). A creature who fails the Reflex save also takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage and is exposed to brood leech swarm venom.

Brood Leech Swarm Venom.name: 幼水蛭群毒液 Brood Leech Swarm Venom
Brood Leech Swarm Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

最长持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}，且速度承受 -5足状态减值（1轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}，且速度承受 -10足状态减值（1轮）。

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and -5-foot status penalty to Speed (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and -10-foot status penalty to Speed (1 round).

Brood Leech Swarm.publicNotes:
大多数体型较小的水蛭物种通常不会成群聚集，但育群水蛭却很容易聚成一片片翻涌蠕动、贪婪扭曲的活毯。当它们聚集到足以形成虫群的数量时，它们会放弃独行水蛭进食方式中的隐秘，转而采取迅捷而无情的进食方式。在这种情况下，它们的轻度毒液能够影响比它们平常猎物大得多的生物。

Most smaller species of leeches do not tend to swarm, but brood leeches are prone to gathering in seething, undulant mats of squirming gluttony. When they gather in sufficient numbers to swarm, they eschew the stealth of a lone leech's feeding methods in favor of swift and merciless feeding. In these situations, their mild venom can affect much larger creatures than their usual prey.
Brood Leech Swarm.prototypeToken: 幼水蛭群 Brood Leech Swarm

Giant Cockroach.name: 巨蟑螂 Giant Cockroach

Scurry.name: 急奔 Scurry
Scurry.description:
触发 巨蟑螂成为一次近战攻击的目标

效果 巨蟑螂对触发攻击的 AC 获得 +2 环境加值。该攻击结算后，巨蟑螂可以魅影野猪行走、攀爬或飞行，移动至多 10 尺。

Trigger The giant cockroach is targeted by a melee attack

Effect The giant cockroach gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. After the attack resolves, the cockroach Strides, Climbs, or Flies up to 10 feet.

Giant Cockroach.publicNotes:
蟑螂是群居生物，除非它们在搜寻食物，否则很少会单独行动。如果冒险者在探索时遇到一只巨蟑螂，他们最好提防其他同类，因为附近很可能有整整一个虫群。

Cockroaches are communal creatures, rarely setting out on their own unless they are searching for food. If an adventurer encounters a single giant cockroach while exploring, they had best take precautions against others, as there is likely an entire colony nearby.

Bright Blue Orchid.name: 亮蓝兰花 Bright Blue Orchid
Bright Blue Orchid.description:
启动 3（操作）

治疗蒸气是一种通过散布注入了多种通常用于治疗与恢复的试剂的薄雾，来加速自然恢复过程的物质。将其从密封容器中释放后，这些蒸气会充满一个 @Template[burst|distance:5]，持续10分钟，并且一次最多能影响四个活着的生物。超过最初四个的任何生物都不会获得益处，不过如果某个生物在持续时间结束前离开，之后进入的新生物可以从薄雾中获益。受这些蒸气影响的生物每2分钟恢复1点生命值。受影响期间，生物对疾病和毒素的豁免还会获得+1物品加值。如果多个治疗蒸气的区域重叠，处于重叠区域内的生物只会受到其中最强效果的影响。强风会驱散薄雾，使其在风吹拂期间失效。

Activate 3 (manipulate)

Healing vapor is a substance that accelerates natural recovery processes by dispersing a mist infused with a variety of reagents typically used for healing and recovery. When deployed from a sealed container, the vapors fill a @Template[burst|distance:5], last for 10 minutes, and can affect up to four living creatures at one time. Any creatures beyond the first four gain no benefit, though if a creature leaves before the duration is over, a new creature that enters can benefit from the mist. A creature benefiting from the vapors regains 1 Hit Point every 2 minutes. While affected, a creature also gains a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. If the areas of more than one healing vapor overlap, only the strongest applies to creatures inside overlapping areas. Strong wind disperses the mist, rendering it ineffective while the wind blows.

Thousand-Pains Fulu (Needle).name: 千痛符箓（针）
Thousand-Pains Fulu (Needle).description:
持续时间 1分钟

由一位为追寻无尽生命而抛弃道德的外科师所制成，千痛符箓会阻断身体内元素的自然流动。被贴上该符箓的生物必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]。失败或大失败会使目标准备好承受由特定状态触发的持续性伤害，而该状态必须在符箓的持续时间内满足。

拿起这张白色符箓时，感觉就像你用针刺穿了自己的手。符箓造成 @Damage[7d6[piercing]]伤害，毛发、指甲与结缔组织会向内刺入。在失败或大失败时，若目标随后进行了带有移动（特征）的动作，则其受到 @Damage[2d6[persistent,piercing]]。

Duration 1 minute

Created by a chirurgeon who threw away morality in search of endless life, a thousand-pains fulu blocks the natural flow of elements in the body. A creature to which the fulu is affixed must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]. Failure or critical failure primes the target for persistent damage triggered by a specific condition that must be met within the fulu's duration.

Picking up this white fulu feels like you've stabbed your hand with a pin. The fulu deals @Damage[7d6[piercing]] as hair, nails, and connective tissues stab inward. On a failure or critical failure, if the target then takes an action with the move trait, it takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,piercing]].

Unlived Life.name: 未曾活过的生命 Unlived Life
Unlived Life.tokenName: 未曾活过的生命 Unlived Life

Meant to Live.name: 注定要活下去 Meant to Live
Meant to Live.description:
每当未生者会因活力能量受到伤害时，它反而会恢复等于该数值一半的生命值。

Whenever an unrisen would take damage from vitality energy, it instead heals half that number of Hit Points.

Resurrection Vulnerability.name: 复活弱点 Resurrection Vulnerability
Resurrection Vulnerability.description:
拥有能够使死者恢复生命的预备或自发法术的生物（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{生命之息} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{死者复活}）可以消耗一个适当的法术位，以一个2动作行动摧毁30尺内的一个未生者。如果该未生者在对抗该生物法术DC的意志豁免中成功，则此次尝试失败。

A creature with a prepared or spontaneous spell that can restore the dead to life (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}) can expend an appropriate spell slot as a 2-action activity to destroy an unrisen within 30 feet. The attempt fails if the unrisen succeeds at a Will save against the creature's spell DC.

Rise Again.name: 再度崛起 Rise Again
Rise Again.description:
如果未生者因火焰伤害、解离，或其复活弱点以外的方式而生命值降至 0，它会在其下个回合开始时重返不死状态。它拥有 100 生命值，并在其被摧毁的空间内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。未生者在 1 小时内不能再次通过此能力返回。

If the unrisen is reduced to 0 Hit Points by means other than fire damage, disintegration, or its resurrection vulnerability, it returns to unlife at the start of its next turn. It has 100 Hit Points and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in the space in which it was destroyed. The unrisen can't be returned by this ability again for 1 hour.

Agonized Howl.name: 痛苦嚎叫 Agonized Howl
Agonized Howl.description:
未生者因其受诅咒的存在而痛苦嚎叫。位于@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内的生物受到@Damage[9d8[mental]|options:area-damage]伤害，并进行一次@Check[will|dc:30|basic]意志豁免。未生者在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Agonized Howl]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用痛苦嚎叫。

The unrisen howls in pain at its cursed existence. Creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[9d8[mental]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[will|dc:30|basic] save. The unrisen can't use Agonized Howl again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Agonized Howl]]{1d4 rounds}.

Awful Approach.name: 可怕的接近方式 Awful Approach
Awful Approach.description:
频率 每10分钟一次

效果 未生者重塑其怪诞的形态以迅速移动。它进行两次魅影野猪行走。在此次移动期间，任何能看见未生者的活体生物都必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}）；这是一项心灵和视觉效果。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The unrisen reshapes its grotesque form to move swiftly. It Strides twice. Any living creature that can see the unrisen during this movement must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure); this is a mental and visual effect.

Death Grip.name: 死亡之握 Death Grip
Death Grip.description:
需求 未生者已使一个活着的生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}

效果 未生者试图摧毁其受害者的生命力，使其与未生者共享相同的命运。该生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:30] 豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 1}。在该诅咒持续期间，该生物从同时具有治疗和命能（特征）特征的效果中只能恢复一半的生命值；如果它死亡，任何使其死而复生的尝试都会使其作为未生者归来。如果该生物的毁灭值降至 0，则该诅咒自动结束。

Requirements The unrisen has a living creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The unrisen attempts to destroy its victim's life force so it shares in the unrisen's fate. The creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. While the curse lasts, the creature regains only half as many HP from effects with both the healing and vitality traits; if it dies, any attempt to raise it from the dead causes it to return as an unrisen. The curse ends automatically if the creature's doomed value is reduced to 0.

Unlived Life.publicNotes:
未生者是由碎裂的骨骼、腐烂的器官与朽败的血肉扭曲拼合而成的畸形聚合体，诞生于复活术等仪式发生灾难性失误之时。必须万分小心，因为如果这类仪式彻底失败，就可能产生未生者——许多仪式师都曾惊恐地领教过这一点。

未生者几乎没有智力，只能感知到其有缺陷的创造持续施加于自身的痛苦，以及对生者的怨恨。它们通常会先攻击那些参与了失败仪式的施法者，然后再向周围的其他所有人发难。尽管未生者扭曲的形体已经完全看不出原本复活目标的模样，但它无言的嚎叫却常常与死者的声音惊人地相似。如果未生者在能够再度崛起之前被摧毁，它就会化为一小撮带金属光泽的蓝绿色盐粒，被称为本质盐。

An unrisen is a mangled conglomeration of splintered bones, decaying organs, and rotting flesh, created when a ritual such as resurrect goes catastrophically wrong. Immense care must be taken, for if such a ritual fails utterly, an unrisen can be the result—as many a ritualist has learned to their horror.

Unrisen are barely intelligent, aware only of the agony constantly inflicted by their flawed creation and their resentment for the living. They tend to attack the casters involved in the botched ritual first before lashing out at everyone else around them. Though an unrisen's twisted form is unrecognizable as the intended target of the resurrection, its wordless howls are often disturbingly similar to the deceased's voice. If an unrisen is destroyed before it can rise again, it's reduced to a handful of metallic blue-green salts referred to as essential salts.
Unlived Life.prototypeToken: 未曾活过的生命 Unlived Life

Lantern Making Reward.name: 制作天灯奖励 Lantern Making Reward
Lantern Making Reward.tokenName: 制作天灯奖励 Lantern Making Reward

Elixir of Life (Lesser).name: 次级生命灵药
Elixir of Life (Lesser).description:
启动 A（操作）

生命灵药会加速活体生物的自然治疗过程和免疫系统。饮用这瓶灵药后，你恢复 @Damage[(3d6+6)[healing]] 生命值，并在 10 分钟内对疾病和毒素的豁免骰获得 +1 物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lPRuIRbu0rHBkoKY]{效果：生命灵药}

Activate A (manipulate)

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creature's natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain @Damage[(3d6+6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lPRuIRbu0rHBkoKY]{Effect: Elixir of Life}

Lantern Making Reward.prototypeToken: 制作天灯奖励 Lantern Making Reward

Psychopomp's Boon.tokenName: 招魂者的恩赐 Psychopomp's Boon
Psychopomp's Boon.hazarddescription:
选择该玩家角色最能充分使用的物品：一瓶@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.c21stU5rhN4F2fZl]{生命药水（中阶）}

，一个内含@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.aSRUX4WGfalK4A5J]{潜能水晶（高阶）}的小袋、一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.TWSdWjp6dpodZkeV]{灵性战号（中阶）}，或一张出自该玩家角色魔法根源的实用5环法术卷轴。

Choose the item that the PC will gain the most use out of: a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.c21stU5rhN4F2fZl]{Elixir of Life (Moderate)}

, a pouch containing a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.aSRUX4WGfalK4A5J]{Potency Crystal (Greater)}, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.TWSdWjp6dpodZkeV]{Spiritual Warhorn (Moderate)}, or a scroll of a useful 5th-rank spell from that PC’s magical tradition.

Lumber Lord's Axe.name: 木业大亨之斧 Lumber Lord's Axe
Lumber Lord's Axe.description:
这件不起眼的工具挂在勤勉劳工的腰带上也毫不显眼。木制握柄上因多年使用而磨出的凹槽，以及打磨得并不规则的斧刃，都让它显得备受珍爱；而无论如何清洗或试图去除气味，新近劈砍木材的浓烈香气总会萦绕在斧刃之上。持握或携带这把+2强击冷铁真菌与植物灾祸术战斧的生物会感到一种必须说真话的责任，并且其进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{说谎}尝试时承受–4状态减值。

启动 1分钟（交互）

频率 每天一次

效果 你擦拭并磨利这把斧头，随后它的气味变得更加强烈，斧刃会在1小时内转变为你选择的标准级精金或标准级黎明银；在此持续时间结束后，樵夫之斧会恢复为冷铁。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.8WnFg5HMKX8JEDLl]{效果：木业大亨之斧}

This unassuming tool wouldn't look out of place on the belt of an industrious laborer. Grooves worn into the wooden handle over years of use and an irregularly sharpened blade give it the distinct impression of being cherished, and the potent scent of freshly chopped wood always clings to the axe's blade despite any attempt to clean it or remove the odor. A creature that holds or carries this +2 striking cold iron fungus and plant bane battle axe feels an obligation to tell the truth and receives a –4 status penalty to its attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}.

Activate 1 minute (Interact)

Frequency once per day

Effect You polish and sharpen the axe, after which its scent grows even more powerful and the axe's blade transforms into your choice of standard-grade adamantine or standard-grade dawnsilver for 1 hour; then after this duration, the woodcutter's axe reverts to cold iron.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.8WnFg5HMKX8JEDLl]{Effect: Lumber Lord's Axe}
