Willowshore’s Hinterlands.name: 柳岸镇腹地 Willowshore’s Hinterlands
Willowshore’s Hinterlands.text:
柳岸镇腹地

对页展示了一张柳岸镇心景的地图。如果你在使用《肆季鬼志：玩家指南》，玩家手中已经有这片地区的地图。如果你没有使用这本指南，可以考虑为团队提供一张由你自行设计的地图，帮助他们辨明方位。直到@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{第三章}，玩家角色们才会开始分散开来并探索这些地区；但从那之后，他们将经常在腹地的道路与荒野间穿行，以跟进线索、追寻机会，或前往重要地点。

没有道路的森林六角格属于困难地形，南部腹地那些崎岖多石的原野也是如此。这些地区栖息着许多危险的野生动物和怪物，但这些危险不会随着玩家角色们一同提升强度。一般来说，柳岸镇腹地中的大多数遭遇，都是以玩家角色为2级这一前提来呈现的，因为这片地区的大部分探索都发生在第三章。该章还提供了一张游荡怪物表，可用于为旅行或露营过夜增添变化（见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05exploringthe00]{此处}）。

在后续幕次中，玩家角色们会周期性地面对更危险的遭遇。你应避免让这些后续幕次中的遭遇在玩家角色们达到预期等级之前被触发。同样，也要克制住“强化”游荡怪物表的冲动——虽然这样做确实能让这些遭遇继续对玩家角色构成挑战，但也会损害真实感，使这片地区显得危险程度越来越高，高到像柳岸镇这样的城镇根本无法繁荣，甚至难以存续。一旦你进入第二幕，最好的做法是要么干脆停止使用游荡怪物，要么仅以叙述方式描述这些遭遇，而不要强迫玩家角色们去实际进行这些越来越简单的战斗。这样既能帮助玩家感受到自己的角色正在变得更强，也有助于随着战役推进而加快游戏节奏。

对页地图上标出了两组不同的遭遇。其中，位于腹地中央、被思维空间边界环绕的那部分遭遇，详见第三章（起始于@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d1willowshor00]{此处}），涵盖区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d1willowshor00]{D1}至@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d13theroadto00]{D13}。而位于区域D13西北方、沿朝圣者之路展开的那些遭遇，则详见第二幕的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{第6章}，涵盖区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b1tormentedk00]{B}至@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e1grandgate000]{E}。如果其他章节中的某个遭遇引用了腹地中的一处地点，则会标明对应的章节与幕次，以便导航查找。

关于环绕整片腹地的思维空间边界的完整细节，可从@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05themindscape00]{此处}开始查阅。关于鬼墙的细节见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05wallofghosts00]{此处}，而关于如何突破它的细节则见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08throughthewa00]{此处}。

Willowshore’s Hinterlands

A map of the Willowshore mindscape appears on the facing page. If you’re using the Season of Ghosts Player’s Guide, the players have a map of the region. If you aren’t using this guide, consider providing a map of your own design for the group to use to help them orient themselves. The PCs won’t begin to spread out and explore these regions until @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{Chapter 3}, but after this point, they’ll often be traveling the roads and wilds of the hinterlands to follow up on clues, pursue opportunities, or travel to important locations.

Forest hexes without roads are difficult terrain, as are rough and rocky fields in the southern hinterlands. These regions harbor many dangerous wild animals and monsters, but these perils won’t scale up in power along with the PCs. As a general rule, most of the encounters in Willowshore’s Hinterlands are presented with the assumption that the PCs are 2nd level, since the bulk of the region’s exploration takes place in Chapter 3. That chapter also presents a wandering monster table for use in spicing up travel or nights spent camping (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05exploringthe00]{Here}).

In later acts, the PCs will periodically face encounters that are more dangerous. You should avoid having these later act encounters trigger before the PCs are the expected level. Likewise, resist the temptation to “power up” the wandering monster table—while doing so does keep these encounters a challenge for the PCs, it can damage verisimilitude by making the region feel increasingly too dangerous for a town like Willowshore to thrive in, much less survive in. Once you’ve moved on to Act 2, it’s best if you either just stop using wandering monsters, or simply describe these encounters narratively without forcing the PCs to play through increasingly simple combats. This can help the players to feel like their characters are growing in power, but also helps to speed gameplay as the campaign progresses.

The map on the facing page has two different sets of encounters marked. Those within the central portion of the hinterlands surrounded by the mindscape’s border comprise encounters that are detailed in Chapter 3 (beginning @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d1willowshor00]{Here}) and comprise areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d1willowshor00]{D1}–@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d13theroadto00]{D13}. Those that take place along the Pilgrim’s Path to the northwest of area D13 are detailed in Act 2, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{Chapter 6} and comprise areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b1tormentedk00]{B}–@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e1grandgate000]{E}. In the event an encounter in a different chapter references a location in the Hinterlands, the chapter and act will be included to aid in navigation.

Full details on the Mindscape Border that encircles the entire hinterlands can be found beginning @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05themindscape00]{Here}. Details on the Wall of Ghosts appear @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05wallofghosts00]{Here}, and details on breaking through it appear @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08throughthewa00]{Here}.

The Willowshore Rumormill.name: 柳岸镇的传闻集散地 The Willowshore Rumormill
The Willowshore Rumormill.text:
柳岸镇的传闻集散地

一旦玩家角色在 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{第2章} 结束时恢复了柳岸镇的秩序，并赶走了占据此地的怪物，这座城镇就会迅速恢复正常——或者说，尽可能接近“正常”的状态。请记住，尽管柳岸镇的人民已经在心景中重复经历这一年一度的循环超过一个世纪，但每次重复开始后的最初几周总是最艰难的，因为镇民们必须重新学习这个全新现实的规则。

在《肆季鬼志》冒险路径中，玩家角色会逐渐认识柳岸镇的许多居民。其中有些人他们会很早就遇见，而另一些人的重要身份可能要到很久之后才会显露出来。当玩家角色忙于各自的任务时，柳岸镇的居民们也照常过着自己的日常生活。虽然这些活动的性质会随着四季而变化，但有一件事始终不变——那就是这个小镇居民对闲聊八卦与传播传闻的热衷。

玩家角色可以通过许多方式听到传闻——例如在镇上花几个小时，用一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:15|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] 检定来打探消息；又或者帮助了某位当地人之后，对方急于回报这份恩情，便以老练的忠告相赠，作为一种“奖励”；又或者只是待在本地商店或食肆里时顺带听来的闲话。有些有助于推动剧情发展的传闻会直接写进冒险文本中，但你也可以使用下表中这类无关紧要的传闻，为玩家角色增添一些本地风味，并提前暗示那些要到年中较晚时候才会在战役中真正发挥作用的非玩家角色的存在。传闻后标注（T）表示其为真，（F）表示其为假。

d20 传闻
1–3 去年春天，松家里来过不下六位不同的女客——也许他终于打算找个老婆了？（F）
4–6 第一长夜期间去年制作天灯比赛的赢家尤素珍，曾用一个幽灵帮她把提灯做得格外明亮。（F）
7–9 亚弥这只顽皮的野猫有时会被人看见住在蔚青茶馆附近，但它可不只是只猫而已。（T）
10–11 有个朋友的朋友又在林地里看见那只巨锹甲虫了；看来它的地盘离城镇越来越近啦！真让人怀疑是不是有人一直在喂它……（F）
12–13 每到冬季，总有人声称在林地里见到狐狸幽灵。我才不信——以前不信，以后也不会信。那些老说见到她的猎人和捕兽人，不过是在博人注意罢了。（F）
14–15 如果你在林地里看到鹤，别去招惹它。见到它们是好运，杀了它们可就要倒霉了！（T）
16–17 那些关于朝圣之径尽头那座古老寺院闹鬼的故事？全都是真的——所以现在才没人再去了！（T）
18–19 大柳树是个脾气阴郁的神使，不过有时也会把赋礼赐给那些讨它欢心的人。（T）
20 给玩家角色提供一则你自创的、荒唐透顶的传闻，内容是关于另一名玩家角色据称在镇上的所作所为。（F）

The Willowshore Rumormill

Once the PCs restore order to Willowshore and drive out the occupying monsters at the end of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{Chapter 2}, the town swiftly returns to normal—or as close to “normal” as it can get. Remember that even though the people of Willowshore have repeated the mindscape’s annual cycle for over a century, the first few weeks of each repetition are the hardest as the townspeople must re-learn the rules of their new reality.

During the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path, the PCs will come to know many of Willowshore’s citizens. Some of them they’ll meet early while others might not have their important roles revealed until much later. As the PCs go about their missions, the citizens of Willowshore pursue their day to day activities. While the nature of these efforts changes with each season, one thing remains constant—the popular pursuit of small-town gossiping and rumormongering.

The PCs can hear rumors in many ways—as the result of spending a few hours Gathering Information in town with a @Check[diplomacy|dc:15|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] check, as a “reward” for aiding a local who becomes eager to repay those services with sage advice, or simply as a side-effect of hanging out in a local shop or eatery. Certain rumors that help to propel the storyline forward are built into the adventure text itself, but you can use idle rumors like those listed in the following table to give the PCs a bit of local flavor and to foreshadow the existence of NPCs whose role in the campaign won’t really kick in until later in the year. A (T) following a rumor indicates it’s true, while an (F) indicates it’s false.

d20 Rumor
1–3 Matsu has had no fewer than six different lady visitors to his home last spring—perhaps he’s finally looking for a wife? (F)
4–6 Last year’s lantern making winner during First Long Night, You So-Jin, used a ghost to help make her lantern glow extra bright. (F)
7–9 Yami, a playful feral house cat sometimes seen living near the Ceruleant Teahouse, is more than just a cat. (T)
10–11 A friend of a friend spotted that giant stag beetle out in the woods again; seems like it’s territory is getting closer and closer to town! Makes you wonder if someone’s been feeding it... (F)
12–13 Every winter, sightings of the Fox Ghost out in the woods happen. I don’t believe it—never have, never will. The hunters and trappers who keep seeing her are just looking for attention. (F)
14–15 If you see a crane out in the woods, leave it alone. They’re good luck to see, but bad luck to kill! (T)
16–17 Those stories about the old monastery at the far end of the Pilgrim’s Path being haunted? All true—that’s why no one visits anymore! (T)
18–19 Great Willow is a moody kami, but he gives gifts sometimes to those who please them. (T)
20 Present the PC with a custom-created and completely outrageous rumor about one of the other PCs’ supposed actions in town. (F)

Wooded Clearing.name: 林间空地 Wooded Clearing
Wooded Clearing.text:
W38. 林间空地

每年在肆季鬼志开端举行的重演节结束时，组织者都会选择一处不同的地点，把他们选中的被绑者带过去。这个地点离城镇从来不远，却总是隐蔽在视线之外。今年，玩家角色就是那些被绑者，他们被带到了城镇以东林地中的这片小空地。战役便从这里开始。

W38. Wooded Clearing

At the end of each year’s Reenactment Festival at the start of the Season of Ghosts, the organizers choose a different place to bring their chosen abductees. This location is never far from town, but always out of sight. This year, the PCs are those abductees, and they are brought to this small clearing in the woods just east of town. It is here that the campaign begins.

The Great Willow.name: 大尊柳 The Great Willow
The Great Willow.text:
W37. 大尊柳

柳岸镇坐落于一片地理上被称为三山的山地区域脚下，这片地区因拥有三座主要山峰而得名。智惠大师在她的回忆录中写道，她在其中最低那座山的山顶发现了一棵体型异常巨大的古老柳树。在与守护这棵树的木灵神使结为朋友后，智惠大师得知了关键情报，并最终因此前往西方的谭杉林。由于这份知识，这位被称为“大柳树”的木灵多年来一直受到柳岸镇与来访朝圣者的高度崇敬，直到柳岸镇总督为了保护城镇免受苦迦菩提影响而进行那次决定命运的尝试却以失败告终的那一天。

当三山地区化作心景时，大柳树也被卷入其中，并与这片地区其余居民一同重生。每当心景重置时，大柳树都会感到自己与现实又“疏远”了一点，变得越来越分心，也越来越与这个世界脱节。它知道自己是这片地区唯一的神使，而随着每一次新循环到来，它也愈发坚信自己同样是世上最后一位神使。

大尊柳 荒野 6

  • 无归属

大柳树（阴郁的无性别木灵），察觉DC 26，意志 DC 24

货物 采集来的食物与非金属原材料

W37. The Great Willow

Willowshore rests at the foot of a mountainous region known geographically as the Trimountains, named due to the three major peaks in the area. In her memoir, Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} noted how on the summit of the lowest of these mountains she found an ancient willow tree of unusual size. After befriending the kodama kami who protected the tree, Master Zhi Hui learned vital information that eventually led her to the Tan Sugi grove to the west. For this knowledge, the kodama of the so-called “Great Willow” received much reverence from both Willowshore and visiting pilgrims for many years, until the day Willowshore’s governor failed in his fateful attempt to protect the town from Kugaptee’s influence.

When the Trimountain region became a mindscape, Great Willow was drawn in and was reborn along with the rest of the region’s inhabitants. Each time the mindscape resets, Great Willow feels just a bit more “distant” from reality, growing more and more distracted and detached from the world. They’re aware of the fact that they’re the only kami in the region, and with each new cycle, grow more and more convinced they’re also the last kami in the world.

The Great Willow Wilderness 6

  • Unaffiliated

Great Willow (morose agender kodama), Perception DC 26, Will DC 24

Wares foraged foods and non-metallic raw materials

Bones of the Forgotten.name: 遗忘者之骨 Bones of the Forgotten
Bones of the Forgotten.text:
W36. 遗忘者之骨

柳岸镇和许多偏远村落一样，也有自己的一套法律。严重罪行会被处以流放；若此人的技能或知识仍有用处，则会被囚禁。处决相当罕见，因为被流放进幽魂之森本身往往就等同于死刑。

尤其恶劣的罪犯会在头皮上被刺下罪印，而在死后，这个纹记会通过雕刻转移到骨头上，这意味着即便死去并腐朽之后，这个印记仍会留存。带有罪印的尸体——无论来自柳岸镇、其他村落，还是如龙华这样的帝皇势力——都只能埋葬在这片杂草丛生、无人打理的区域。

过去这里的坟墓没有标记，但近来竖起了几根木桩，上面挂着纸手里剑，似乎是在无声地抗议：埋在下面的人可能死得并不公正。又或者，这是为了阻止一个愤懑而满怀复仇之心的幽灵出现。

W36. Bones of the Forgotten

Willowshore, like many remote villages, has its own set of laws. Grievous crimes are punished via exile, or imprisonment if the individual’s skill or knowledge was needed. Executions were rare, as being exiled into the Specterwood was often a death sentence in itself.

Particularly vile criminals had a Mark of Crime tattooed onto their scalp, and after death, this tattoo was transferred to the bones through carving, meaning even in death and decomposition, the mark remained. Bodies with a Mark of Crime—be it from Willowshore, another village, or an imperial force such as Lung Wa—can only be buried in this overgrown and unkept area.

While graves were unmarked in the past, a few wooden posts have been erected recently and paper shuriken hung off them, seemingly in silent protest that the ones buried beneath might have died an unjust death. Or perhaps this is an attempt to stave off the rise of a bitter, vengeful ghost.

The Leshy’s Salon.name: 蕈人茶铺 The Leshy’s Salon
The Leshy’s Salon.text:
W35. 莱希沙龙

柳岸腹地

柳岸镇周边地区传统上是一片风景如画的荒野，除了少数几个广为人知的危险区域外，通常都可安全探索。可惜对PC而言，腹地的安全已成往事，因为在这片地区的心景版本中，幽灵和怪物潜伏其间。不久之后，这件事应该就会成为镇上居民间的通俗常识。对柳岸腹地的探索在本冒险中扮演着关键角色——其中许多遭遇的细节记载于 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{第三章}。

当地的莱西不记得自己是什么时候来到这片地区的，只知道那是在柳岸镇建立之前很久。他们直到定居点扩张到让此事无可避免时，才正式加入柳岸镇。在盟友家族的帮助下，贪婪的伐木领主被挡在外面，莱西们建立起自己的茶园生意，背着长方形竹制背篓，里面装着泡好的茶和茶具，沿路叫卖。有些会高声喊出口号，另一些则敲打简朴的木鱼，提醒顾客他们到了。这些流动商人很快就成了柳岸镇生活中的一道风景与日常组成部分。

莱希沙龙 农场 3

  • 无隶属

山巅草（不拘礼法的无性别莱西制茶师 3），察觉DC 19，意志DC 19，制作 +9

商品 黏土陶制茶具、茶叶

W35. The Leshy’s Salon

Willowshore Hinterlands

Willowshore’s immediate surroundings are traditionally an idyllic wilderness, one that’s relatively safe to explore save for a few well-known dangerous areas. Unfortunately for the PCs, the hinterlands’ safety is a thing of the past, for here in the mindscape version of the region, ghosts and monsters lurk. It shouldn’t be long before this becomes common knowledge among the town locals. Exploration of the Willowshore hinterlands plays a key role in the adventure—details on many of its encounters are found in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{Chapter 3}.

The local leshies don’t recall when they came to the region, just that it was long before Willowshore was founded. They didn’t officially join Willowshore until the expansion of the settlement made it inevitable. With allied families keeping the greedy lumber lords away, the leshies built their own tea farm business, taking to the roads with brewed tea and tea ware stashed in rectangular bamboo backpacks. Some would shout slogans, while others used a simple temple block to inform customers of their arrival. These traveling merchants soon became an attraction and staple of Willowshore life.

The Leshy’s Salon Farm 3

  • Unaffiliated

Mountain Summit Grass (irreverent agender leshy teamaker 3), Perception DC 19, Will DC 19, Crafting +9

Wares clay pottery tea ware, tea leaves

Kawaka’s Home.name: 川冈的家 Kawaka’s Home
Kawaka’s Home.text:
W34. 川冈的家

柳岸镇的大多数居民都住在自己的营业场所里，或至少住在附近。云纸坊的主人八哥 川冈也不例外；他住在造纸坊上层的一套小房间里，而这里——他的家宅——自从几年前父母去世后，便一直空着无人居住。

W34. Kawaka’s Home

Most of Willowshore’s citizens live in or at least near to their place of business. The owner of Cloud Paper House, Myna Kawaka is no exception; he lives in a small suite of rooms on an upper floor of the paper mill, and has left this, his family home, unoccupied since his parents’ deaths a few years ago.

Spider Gate.name: 蜘蛛门 Spider Gate
Spider Gate.text:
W33. 蜘蛛门

在一次采伐丹杉的尝试引发屠杀之后，柳岸镇的镇长向为村庄入口设置一盏新提灯的要求让了步。原本的计划是由柳岸镇的木匠建造一座可悬挂提灯的鸟居或天枢门，但一位龙华贵族提出免费赠送一只原本安置在他花园中的石制守护蜘蛛，因为它已经与花园的装饰不再相称。

当这座巨大的雕像运抵时，大多数柳岸镇居民都觉得这是他们见过最丑的东西。不过，他们仍然认为这座雕像寄宿着一位守护精魂，因此对它十分敬重。随着时间推移，村民们接受了这位独特的入口守护者，甚至还称它为他们“丑萌”的吉祥物。虽然这位守护精魂并不情愿接受这个称呼，但整座村庄的骤然死亡曾让它在一个多世纪里郁郁寡欢；直到它自己死去，与它曾发誓要保护的柳岸镇的人民重聚后，这段经历才被它遗忘。丑萌用尖牙衔着的提灯只是普通提灯，不像晨步桥上的长明灯，但柳岸镇的人民同样珍视它，并竭力让它始终保持点亮。

W33. Spider Gate

After the slaughter caused by an attempt to harvest the Tan Sugi, Willowshore’s governor caved to the demand for a new lantern for the entrance of the village. While the original plan was for the carpenters of Willowshore to build a tori gate or Tian-shu gateway on which lanterns could be hung, a Lung Wa aristocrat offered a free stone guardian spider from his garden instead, since it no longer fit in with the garden’s decorations.

Most Willowshorers thought the giant statue was the ugliest thing they’d ever seen when it arrived. Nevertheless, they assumed the statue housed a guardian spirit and respected it accordingly. In time, villagers accepted their unique entrance guardian, even calling it their “ugly but cute” mascot. While the guardian spirit is reluctant to accept that title, the sudden death of the whole village left it forlorn for over a century, an experience it forgot when it died and reunited with the people it vowed to protect. The lantern Ugly Cute holds in its fangs is a regular lantern, unlike the Eternal Lantern found at Dawnstep Bridge, but the people of Willowshore value it just as much and strive to keep it lit at all times.

The Mushroom House.name: 蘑菇屋 The Mushroom House
The Mushroom House.text:
W32. 蘑菇屋

这座偏远的砖砌农舍散发着腐朽与粪肥的气味。不过，人人都知道，农舍里生长的不只是蘑菇。只要价格合适，蘑菇屋几乎什么都能种出来。卢达·巴马是一位精神矍铄的年迈半身人女性，也是这个非法市场的头，她是在胡婆婆明确许可下经营这里的。

蘑菇屋 非法市场 3

  • 北岭

卢达·巴马（善于操纵的女性半身人走私者 3）察觉DC 20，意志 DC 18，制作 +10

服务 玩家角色可以为卢达担任“收账人”，使用威吓来谋生。

货物 冒险道具、药物、毒素、纹身

W32. The Mushroom House

This remote brick farmhouse smells of decay and manure. Everyone knows that mushrooms aren’t the only things growing in the farmhouse, though. For the right price, the Mushroom House can grow almost anything. Luda Bama, a spry, elderly halfling woman, is the head of this illicit market, which she runs with the explicit permission of Granny Hu.

The Mushroom House Illicit Market 3

  • Northridge

Luda Bama (manipulative female halfling smuggler 3) Perception DC 20, Will DC 18, Crafting +10

Services A PC can act as a “collector” for Luda, using Intimidation to Earn Income.

Wares adventuring gear, drugs, poisons, tattoos

Dock.name: 码头 Dock
Dock.text:
W31. 码头

在大坝建成后，柳岸镇位于木筏湖的旧码头被封堵，因此需要在木棉河河口修建一座新码头。新码头规模更大、占地更广，由拉朱尔·萨穆德拉负责运营和管理；木棉河-杜月江瓦市正是因其造船技艺而专门雇用了他。

柳岸镇码头 码头 3

  • 北岭

拉朱尔·萨穆德拉（沉静的男性娜迦吉造船匠 3）察觉DC 19，意志DC 19，制作 +10

服务 队伍可以以每天 5 cp 的价格租用一艘@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.vehicles.Actor.l0RfYgabnbNoHnkS]{划艇}，或以 15 gp 直接购买一艘。拉朱尔还为他的划艇提供做工精良的手工船桨。这些船桨使使用划艇进行载具操作检定时获得 +1 物品加值，售价为 50 gp。

货物 划艇租赁与销售

W31. Dock

After the construction of the dam, Willowshore’s old dock in Woodraft Lake was blocked off, thus requiring the construction of a new dock at the mouth of the Ceiba River. The new dock is larger and more expansive, and is operated and managed by Rajul, who was hired by the Ceiba-Duyue Exchange specifically for his boatbuilding skills.

Willowshore Dock Dock 3

  • Northridge

Rajul Samudra (serene male nagaji shipwright 3) Perception DC 19, Will DC 19, Crafting +10

Services The party can rent a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.vehicles.Actor.l0RfYgabnbNoHnkS]{Rowboat} for 5 cp a day or purchase one outright for 15 gp. Rajul also offers excellent handcrafted oars for his rowboats. These oars grant a +1 item bonus to Piloting checks with rowboats and cost 50 gp.

Wares riverboat rentals and sales

Fisheries.name: 渔场 Fisheries
Fisheries.text:
W30. 渔场

淡水鱼是柳岸镇的重要食物来源。当地人传统上会一次捕获整群鱼，将超过一定体型的鱼腌制保存，并把小鱼养在自家后院的池塘里。如今，这种做法已经扩大了规模，不过渔民们还没达到能让这里的养鱼池无限期维持下去的程度。

多年来，座泽一直是柳岸镇首屈一指的养鱼人；她感知天气变化的能力，让她在这一行里拥有得天独厚的优势。

渔夫农场与码头 行会 3

  • 北岭

座泽（警觉的女性鼠族渔夫 3）察觉DC 19，意志DC 19，自然 +9

服务 如果玩家角色受到北岭的喜爱，他们可以参考座泽的天气预报，在1天内对抗天气效果的检定和豁免获得+1环境加值。他们每周只能从该效果中受益1次。

货物 风干或熏制的鱼和虾、肥料、捕鱼道具、昆虫鱼饵

工作 玩家角色可以在渔场巡查捕食者，或检查竿钓渔夫使用的简易码头是否受损，从而以求生检定进行谋生。

W30. Fisheries

Freshwater fish is an important food source for Willowshore. Locals traditionally capture entire schools of fish, preserve those above a certain size, and raise small ones in their backyard ponds. Today, this practice has been expanded, though the fishers have yet to reach a point where the fishery ponds here can be maintained indefinitely.

Zataku has been Willowshore’s foremost fish keeper for many years; her ability to sense weather changes gives her the perfect edge in her occupation.

Fisher’s Farms and Docks Guild 3

  • Northridge

Zataku (observant female ratfolk fisher 3) Perception DC 19, Will DC 19, Nature +9

Services If the PCs are liked by Northridge, they can confer with Zataku’s weather forecasts to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks and saves against weather effects for 1 day. They can benefit from this effect once per week.

Wares Dried or smoked fish and shrimp, fertilizer, fishing gear, insect bait

Work A PC can patrol the fisheries for predators or inspect the simple docks used by the pole fishers for damage, allowing them to Earn Income with Survival checks.

Trade Office.name: 贸易栈 Trade Office
Trade Office.text:
W29. 贸易栈

当总督和善保最初在柳岸镇上任时，他下令在此修建数座新仓库和一处贸易栈，希望将镇上的产业以及与沿海要塞唐入之间的联系，发展成更有利润可图的事业。依照胡婆婆的建议，善保亲自挑选了当地供奉国府幸的牧师金久元，担任瓦市经理一职。久元不情不愿地接受了这份工作，因为他知道，凭胡婆婆手上掌握的把柄，只要她开口，他就无法拒绝替她在账目上稍微动点手脚，或对送往、来自蘑菇房的几件包裹睁一只眼闭一只眼。胡婆婆本人则住在这里的一间私人套房中。

木棉河-杜月江瓦市 贸易栈 5

  • 北岭

金久元（耐心的男性人类国府幸牧师 5）察觉DC 23，意志DC 23，制作 +12

服务 久元的书法技艺出众，这项技能让他在制作符箓和卷轴时更具优势。他可以用4小时制作持续一个月的符箓，并在2天内制作持续一年的符箓。他也能在2天内制作卷轴。

货物 饮料、神圣卷轴、食物与香料、符箓、矿石原料、纺织品

工作 玩家角色可以在这里帮助整理物流，并使用社群检定来谋生。

W29. Trade Office

When Governor Heh Shan-Bao originally took office in Willowshore, he ordered several new warehouses and a trade office to be built here, hoping to expand the town’s industry and connection with the coastal fortress of Karahai into something more profitable. On Granny Hu’s advice, Shan-Bao handpicked the local @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AIcDyoff265z9285]{Kofusachi} priest, Kim Gu-won, to take the post of Exchange Manager. Gu-won reluctantly accepted the job, knowing that with what Granny Hu has on him, he wouldn’t be able to refuse if she asked him to shift a few numbers here and there or ignore a few packages going to or coming from the Mushroom House. Granny Hu herself lives in a private suite of rooms here.

The Ceiba-Duyue Exchange Trade Office 5

  • Northridge

Kim Gu-won (patient male human cleric of Kofusachi 5) Perception DC 23, Will DC 23, Crafting +12

Services Gu-won is exceptional at calligraphy, a skill that gives him an advantage in crafting fulus and scrolls. He can craft fulus that last a month with 4 hours of work and fulus that last a year in 2 days. He can also craft scrolls in 2 days.

Wares beverages, divine scrolls, foods and spices, fulus, raw mineral, textiles

Work A PC can help organize logistics here and use Society checks to Earn Income.

Mother’s Coil.name: 慈母之环 Mother’s Coil
Mother’s Coil.text:
W28. 慈母之环

在传统上，柳岸镇的人们将魔法视为神圣祝福的显现、人与精魂世界之间的联系，或仅仅是手法与心智的把戏。直到一位年迈的娜迦吉法师——苏萨杜斯的安贾尔——到来后，大多数人才真正开始理解魔法也是一种可以被研究与学习的学问。大约在十五年前抵达此地时，安贾尔发现柳岸镇的天气对他们的干鳞症颇为温和，因此从一位打算迁居城市的农夫手中买下了一块土地。一夜之间，一座纳迦卓风格、由深色玄武岩建成的高塔拔地而起，令村民们惊叹不已。

尽管许多村民对魔法感到好奇，但大多数人都觉得钻研这一主题艰深难近，更不用说并不实用了。因此，安贾尔只有一名学徒，十兵卫——一个被他们抚养长大的孩子。她曾被一对不负责任的“父母”遗弃在柳岸镇；那两人伪装成富有的商人，却在账单未付时逃之夭夭。安贾尔对他们将孩子置于险境的行为愤怒不已，而其那林尼瓦提信仰也促使这位年迈的法师将惊恐万分的十兵卫收留，并视如己出。

尽管安贾尔于去年去世令人惋惜，十兵卫仍决心通过养父母留下的书籍继续钻研奥秘艺术。

慈母之环 法师高塔 3

  • 无隶属

井川十兵卫（勤学的女性人类法师 3）察觉DC 19，意志 DC 19，奥秘 +10，制作 +10

服务 十兵卫在战役开始时只知道如何制作1级和2级法术卷轴，以及1级魔杖。每周，她都会将一件非消耗性的、等级等同于PC等级的魔法物品加入自己已知的魔法物品配方列表中。PC每周最多可以请求她研究一种特定配方一次。

货物 奥秘与异能卷轴、魔法物品与法术的配方、魔杖

W28. Mother’s Coil

Magic was seen traditionally in Willowshore as a manifestation of divine blessing, one’s connection to the Spirit World, or just a trick of the hand and mind. Most folks didn’t quite understand it as a topic studied and learned until the arrival of Anjal of Thulsadus, an old nagaji wizard. Arriving about fifteen years ago, Anjal found the weather of Willowshore to be gentle on their dryscale condition and thus bought a plot of land from a farmer looking to relocate to the city. Overnight, a Nagajor-styled tower of dark basalt appeared, much to the awe of the villagers.

Though curious about magic, most villagers find studying the topic to be formidable and unapproachable, not to mention impractical. Thus, Anjal had only one apprentice, Jubei, a child they raised after she was abandoned in Willowshore by a pair of irresponsible “parents” who posed as well-off merchants but then fled without paying their bills. Infuriated that they endangered a child, Anjal’s Nalinivatian beliefs prompted the old wizard to take the terrified Jubei in as their own.

While Anjal’s death last year was tragic, Jubei is determined to continue studying the arcane arts through the books her adopted parent left behind.

Mother’s Coil Wizard’s Tower 3

  • Unaffiliated

Igawa Jubei (studious female human wizard 3) Perception DC 19, Will DC 19, Arcana +10, Crafting +10

Services Jubei begins the campaign knowing only how to craft 1st-level and 2nd-level spell scrolls and 1st-level wands. Each week, she adds one non-consumable magical item of the PCs’ level to her known list of magical item recipes. The PCs can Request her to research a specific recipe up to once per week.

Wares arcane and occult scrolls, formulas and recipes for magic items and spells, wands

The Hand of Spring.name: 春之手 The Hand of Spring
The Hand of Spring.text:
W27. 春之手

在直到达米汗辛哥大夫到来之前，柳岸镇的医疗照护很大程度上依赖民间偏方、草药汤剂，以及云游四方的祭司。人人都简称他为达米。达米结合针灸、提纯化学品与外科手术来提供照护。尽管他的治疗方式并非柳岸镇居民所习惯的那一套，达米仍逐渐建立起相当的声誉——人们认为他是一位心地仁慈的大夫，比起金钱收益更关心自己的病人。

春之手 诊所 4

  • 无隶属

达米汗辛哥“达米”马巴邦洛奥布（和善的男性人类大夫 4）察觉DC 22，意志 DC 22，制作 +12，医药 +14

服务 除了向PC出售或制作治疗物品外，达米每天还能尝试进行未受训和受训的医药检定，为至多8名不同的病人治疗，每人每次治疗收费5铜币。

货物 炼金治疗物品，医者工具补给，非魔法治疗物品

W27. The Hand of Spring

Willowshore relied heavily on home remedies, herbal droughts, and traveling priests for medical care until the arrival of Doctor Damihansig, whom everyone calls Dami for short. Dami uses a mix of acupuncture, purified chemicals, and surgery to provide care. Though his treatments aren’t what Willowshore is used to, Dami has developed quite a reputation for being a charitable doctor who cares more about his patients than monetary gain.

The Hand of Spring Clinic 4

  • Unaffiliated

Damihansig “Dami” Mababangloob (kindly male human doctor 4) Perception DC 22, Will DC 22, Crafting +12, Medicine +14

Services Other than selling or making healing items for the PCs, Dami can attempt untrained and trained Medicine checks to treat up to 8 different patients a day, charging 5 cp per person per treatment.

Wares alchemical healing items, healer’s kit supplies, non-magical healing items

Second Best.name: 第二佳作坊 Second Best
Second Best.text:
W26. 第二佳作坊

约五年前，霍天哲随他那位来自唐入的铁匠父亲来到柳岸镇，协助维护柳岸镇大坝。这个在城市长大的儿子原以为，自己终于可以教教那些“乡下的二流铁匠”该怎么把事情办妥。可没过多久，天哲就意识到，自己的本事甚至比不上永焰铁坊里最年轻的学徒，而他那些设计花哨的农用器具，到了真正的农田里，与其说是精妙机械，不如说更像玩具。受此打击后，天哲请求父亲留在柳岸镇，好让自己学着成为一名“有用的铁匠”。天哲的父亲虽对这突如其来的请求满心不情愿，最终还是接受了，并给了儿子一小把金币去订做新的店招。为了提醒自己，天哲大胆地把自己的工坊命名为“第二佳作坊”。

在过去五年里，天哲的作品赢得了一些忠实顾客，而他对机械的了解也打动了雍武秀，使这位老铁匠将大坝的维护工作交托给他。

第二佳作坊 铁匠 4

  • 无隶属

霍天哲（谦逊的男性人类发明家 4）察觉DC 18，意志 DC 18，制作 +12

服务 天哲除了常规金属物品外，还能制作炼金弹药和炸弹。

货物 冒险工具、炼金弹药、炼金炸弹、发条装置，以及简易护甲、金属武器和盾牌，

W26. Second Best

When Huo Tian-Zhe arrived in Willowshore with his blacksmith father from Karahai about five years ago to assist with the maintenance of Willowshore’s dam, the urban-born son thought he was about to show the “second-rate smiths of the countryside” how to get things done. Quickly, Tian-Zhe realized his own skills were subpar to even the youngest apprentice of the Eternal Blaze and that his fancily-designed farm gadgets were more toys than machines of marvels out in the actual farm fields. Humbled, Tian-Zhe asked his father to stay in Willowshore so he could learn to be a “smith of use.” Begrudgingly accepting the abrupt request, Tian-Zhe’s father nevertheless gave his son a handful of gold to order a new shop sign. As a reminder to himself, Tian-Zhe boldly named his workshop “Second Best.”

In the last five years, Tian-Zhe’s products have garnered some loyal customers, and his knowledge of machinery won over Yong Wu-Xiu such that the old smith tasked him with the maintenance of the dam.

Second Best Smith 4

  • Unaffiliated

Huo Tian-Zhe (humble male human inventor 4) Perception DC 18, Will DC 18, Crafting +12

Services Tian-Zhe can craft alchemical ammunition and bombs in addition to regular metal items.

Wares adventuring tools, alchemical ammunition, alchemical bombs, clockwork gadgets, and simple armor, metal weapons, and shields,

Woodcarver’s Guild.name: 木雕师行会 Woodcarver’s Guild
Woodcarver’s Guild.text:
W25. 木雕师行会

柳岸镇较新的商家，尤其是与木雕相关的，多半位于商贸街沿线那些两层高的红砖建筑中。为了确保木材寡头不会偏袒任何人，木雕师们联合起来成立了一个行会，让年轻学徒在学艺期间有机会到不同的商店实习。云梦昂是木雕师现任民选的行会首领，正是这种培养方式的产物。尽管她的工作备受赞誉，也一心投入这条街上众多门面工匠的培养，但云梦昂其实更想成为画家或珠宝匠。

木雕师行会 行会 4

  • 北岭

云梦昂（天赋出众的女性人类行会首领 4）察觉DC 22，意志DC 20，制作 +12

商品 艺术品、木制物品、木质宗教象征物

服务 木雕师行会可以应请求为PC制作任何非魔法、非武器的木制或硬木物品。若PC提供制作该物品所需的原材料，云梦昂也可以制作绘画作品和珠宝。一旦行会获得桃木补给（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05opportunitie00#collecting-peachwood]{Collecting Peachwood}），角色就可以制作桃木纸，从而让云梦昂能够制作符箓（包括罕见的地区性符箓，见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20willowshoref00]{Here}）。

W25. Woodcarver’s Guild

Willowshore’s newer businesses, particularly those associated with woodcarving, are mostly found in one of the two-storied red-brick buildings along Mercantile Street. To ensure the lumber lords would never favor anyone, the woodcarvers came together to form a guild, through which young apprentices have the opportunity to intern at different shops during their apprenticeship. Mong-Un, the woodcarver’s current elected guild leader, is a product of such training. Though heaped with praises for her work and devoted to the training of the many artisans whose shops front this street, Mong-Un would rather be a painter or jewelry maker.

Woodcarver’s Guild Guild 4

  • Northridge

Yun Mong-un (talented female human guild leader 4) Perception DC 22, Will DC 20, Crafting +12

Wares artwork, wood items, wooden religious symbols

Services The woodcarver’s guild can craft any non-magical, non-weapon wood or hardwood items for the PCs upon request. Mong-Un can also craft painted artworks and jewelry if the PCs provide the raw materials necessary for the item. Once the guild has peachwood supplies (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05opportunitie00#collecting-peachwood]{Collecting Peachwood}), the characters can craft peachwood paper, which allows Yun Mong-un to craft fulus (including the rare regional fulus @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20willowshoref00]{Here}).

Ho Jeong-hui’s Home.name: 洪正辉的家 Ho Jeong-hui’s Home
Ho Jeong-hui’s Home.text:
W24. 洪正辉的家

洪正辉（受欢迎的男性人类城镇卫兵 2）最近攒够了薪水里的钱，搬进了这间小屋。在这里，他终于能花时间烹饪那些气味浓烈（但十分美味）的晚餐，而不会在营房里惹恼同袍卫兵。不过更重要的是，这里给了他所需的隐私，让他能花时间招待那些被他吸引而来的、人数不多却热情十足的访客。作为柳岸镇最炙手可热的单身汉之一，他的名声确保了几乎没有人会忽视他发出的邀约。

W24. Ho Jeong-hui’s Home

Ho Jeong-hui (popular male human town guard 2) recently moved into this small home after saving up enough money from his salary. Here, he gets to spend time cooking the pungent (but delicious) dinners he loves so much without vexing fellow guards in the barracks. Though more importantly, he has the privacy he needs to spend time entertaining the small but eager cast of visitors who catch his eye. His reputation as one of Willowshore’s most eligible bachelors ensures that few invitations to his home are ignored.

Abandoned Estates.name: 废弃庄园 Abandoned Estates
Abandoned Estates.text:
W23. 废弃庄园

这两座被废弃的木材大亨庄园在被彻底搜刮一空后，偶尔被人拿来当作发泄怒气的房间或进行胆量挑战的场所。东侧庄园后方的一小片树林中坐落着一座供奉 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{黛丝娜} 的废弃圣祠（区域 W23b），许多人都在质疑，是否该有人将这位女神迎入家中，而不是让她继续在庄园废墟中无人照料。

W23. Abandoned Estates

These two abandoned lumber lords’ estates, after being thoroughly picked clean, were left to serve as the occasional rage room or dare challenge. An abandoned shrine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{Desna} sits in a small copse of trees behind the eastern estate (area W23b), and many have questioned if someone should accept the goddess into their home instead of leaving her bereft in the estate ruins.

The Cerulean Teahouse.name: 青天茶馆 The Cerulean Teahouse
The Cerulean Teahouse.text:
W22. 青天茶馆

柳岸镇的木材业老板们一向自视甚高，与“平民百姓”来往的想法令他们颇为不快。贵族青麦莱的解决办法，就是在靠近这些木材大亨宅邸的地方建起这座精致的建筑。

青天茶馆凭借其奢华的餐饮与表演，很快红火了起来。然而，新鲜感一过，生意也迅速冷清下来。尽管如此，麦莱仍坚持经营，先是将茶馆的重心转向承办茶饭，接着与The Leshy’s Salon合作，将这里作为门面，最后又把它改成了灵活经营的住宿兼早餐旅店。就在麦莱终于还清这处产业贷款后的几天，龙华崩溃的消息传到了柳岸镇。

到了那时，麦莱决定就此收手并宣布退休，但她试图将茶馆的控制权交给家人的努力却遇到了麻烦，因为很明显，她的亲属中没有人愿意搬到柳岸镇。当麦莱在前一个冬季初去世时，这家产业的归属仍未确定，因为她从未提交过遗嘱。等到玩家角色在本幕探索这间茶馆时，他们会发现麦莱留下的一件奇特遗物，而随着时间推移，这将使他们成为这间茶馆的新主人。

W22. The Cerulean Teahouse

Willowshore’s lumber bosses thought very highly of themselves, and the idea of mingling with the “common folk” rankled them. Aristocrat Qing Mai-Lai’s solution was the establishment of this fine structure, close to the lumber lords’ estates.

The Cerulean Teahouse took off quickly, thanks to its offerings of extravagant food, drinks, and performances. However, once the novelty wore off, business quickly died. Still, Mai-Lai persevered, first by changing the teahouse’s focus to banquet catering, then by collaborating with The Leshy’s Salon as a storefront, and finally as a flexible bed-and-breakfast. Just days after Mai-Lai finally paid off the loan on the property, news of Lung Wa’s collapse reached Willowshore.

Mai-Lai called it quits at that point and announced her retirement, but her attempts to pass on control of the Teahouse to family met with complications when it became apparent none of her relations wanted to move to Willowshore. When Mai-Lai passed away early in the previous winter, ownership of the business was undetermined, for Mai-Lai never submitted a will. When the PCs explore the teahouse in this act, they’ll find a curious remnant left behind by Mai-Lai that, in time, will result in them becoming the teahouse’s new owners.

Mama Bao’s.name: 包妈妈的 Mama Bao’s
Mama Bao’s.text:
W21. 包妈妈的

中村玉茗，人们亲切地称她为“包妈妈”，多年来一直经营着这家小小的包子铺——这里是许多本地人的心头好。餐馆轻松的氛围与舒适感，完全弥补了菜单选择有限的不足。

包妈妈的商店 餐馆 4

  • 北岭

中村玉茗（友善的女性人类厨师 4）察觉DC 21，意志DC 23，烹饪学识 +14

货物 包子

工作 只要队伍至少受到北岭的喜爱，一名烹饪学识至少达到专家的玩家角色就可以在这里帮忙。该玩家角色在进行食物学识检定以谋生时，获得 +1 环境加值。

W21. Mama Bao’s

Nakamura Yu Ming, known affectionately as “Mama Bao,” has run this small steamed bun shop for years—it’s a favorite stop for many locals. The relaxing ambiance and comfort of the restaurant more than make up for the limited menu offerings.

Mama Bao’s Shop Restaurant 4

  • Northridge

Nakamura Yu Ming (friendly female human cook 4) Perception DC 21, Will DC 23, Cooking Lore +14

Wares steamed buns

Work As long as the party is at least liked by Northridge, a PC who is at least expert in Cooking Lore can help out here. The PC gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Food Lore checks made to Earn Income.

Luo and Laws.name: 骆氏状所 Luo and Laws
Luo and Laws.text:
W20. 骆氏状所

龙华的法律在一次又一次被谋求私利的统治者修订后，变得充满矛盾；这让像骆熙旸这样的独立律师得以靠着试图理清这些法条而过上体面的生活。受邀来到此地时，那些木材领主曾向她保证，乡村生活压力会小得多，因此熙旸只带着最基本的10卷《帝国法典汇编》前来。可这位律师很快发现，柳岸镇的法律问题即便不比她先前在司泽城遇到的更复杂，也至少同样棘手，于是她的图书馆规模不断扩大，最终达到了她旧居藏书的两倍。

骆氏状所 律师事务所 4

  • 无隶属

骆熙旸（热切的女性人类律师 4）察觉DC 23，意志DC 21，交涉 +12，法律学识 +14，社会 +12

服务 若熙旸处于乐于助人态度，玩家角色便可在办事书房中查阅她那包罗万象的藏书、案例研究与档案；在进行与柳岸镇相关的回忆知识检定以展开研究时，获得+1环境加值。

工作 熙旸总是需要人手协助整理文件、誊写合同与裁断争端。玩家角色可以在此使用交涉或法律学识来谋生。

W20. Luo and Laws

Lung Wa’s laws, after being revised time and time again by self-serving rulers, are a bag of contradictions, allowing independent lawyers, such as Luo Xi Yang, to make a decent living attempting to make sense of them. Promised by the lumber lords who invited her here that rural life would be less stressful, Xi Yang arrived with only the essential 10-volume Imperial Compendium. Quickly, the lawyer discovered that Willowshore’s legal issues were as complicated, if not more so, than what she’d previously encountered in the city of Sze, and thus her library grew to a size that doubled the one in her former home.

Luo & Laws Law Office 4

  • Unaffiliated

Luo Xi Yang (eager female human lawyer 4) Perception DC 23, Will DC 21, Diplomacy +12, Law Lore +14, Society +12

Services If Xi Yang is helpful, the PCs can make use of her eclectic collection of books, case studies, and records to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks associated with Willowshore while researching in the office.

Work Xi Yang is always in need of help with filing documents, scribing contracts, and adjudicating disagreements. A PC can Earn Income here with Diplomacy or Law Lore.

Downtown Willowshore.name: 柳岸镇镇区 Downtown Willowshore
Downtown Willowshore.text:
W19. 柳岸镇镇区

柳岸镇镇区仍然是镇上主要的活动枢纽。东北方曾矗立着镇长的宅邸与办事书房，那里同时也是村中的银行与宝库——但如今，这整片区域都成了一处神秘空地。镇长和他的宅邸究竟遭遇了什么，是玩家角色最终会在这条冒险路径中解开的重大谜团之一。空地以南是帝皇兵营。十字路口北侧、空广场对面，是村中每周上演蜀戏的戏台。附近道路两侧分别坐落着柳岸镇最繁忙的商铺之一树雀居，以及柳岸镇唯一的公共浴场乐河童浴场。

关于柳岸镇镇区更详细的探索，见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{第2章}，不过以下四处设施构成了该区域最重要的地点。

七彩鸣雀剧场 戏剧 5

  • 北岭

大野一真（善于交际的男性狐人导演 5）察觉DC 22，意志 DC 20，交涉 +13，表演 +13，莎琳传说 +12

工作 每月一次，玩家角色可以尝试进行一次 @Check[performance|dc:25] 检定，为大野一真的某部作品试镜角色。成功时，该玩家角色在该月内以表演进行谋生检定时，其任务等级上限等于柳岸镇的等级或该玩家角色的等级，两者取较高者。

树雀居 Business 3

  • 南岸

名户屋三美（友善的女性人类家族女族长 3）察觉DC 18，意志 DC 20，制作 +10

服务 多亏三美家族事先筹划，柳岸镇储备了足够的食物，能让村子以最低生存水平维持到冬季。如果玩家角色至少受到南岸喜爱，他们就可以免费住在这里并享受这项便利。

Wares 酒精、谷物、腌制食品、口粮

乐河童浴场 Business 1

  • Unaffiliated

华·德格（健谈的男性半身人浴场老板 1）察觉DC 17，意志 DC 17，交涉 +8

服务 一旦浴场修复完成，玩家角色便可免费使用这里的设施。每天一次，在温水中浸泡 1 小时能增强玩家角色的免疫系统——在接下来 24 小时内，对该玩家角色进行治疗疾病的尝试获得 +1 物品加值。

浴场老板德哥几乎知道镇上所有流言蜚语，但他对这些事向来守口如瓶。只要玩家角色是在为了正当理由打探消息，且德哥对他们至少友善，与他交谈就能让玩家角色在进行打探消息检定时掷两次骰并取较好结果。这是一个幸运效果，每周可以使用一次。

守卫办事书房 Barracks 3

  • 北岭

郑鹏（坚忍寡言的男性人类执勤官 3）察觉DC 18，意志 DC 18，威吓 +9

Wares 护甲、道具维护装备、武器

工作 只要队伍至少受到北岭喜爱，玩家角色就可以在这里协助整顿守卫纪律。这样做可以让其使用威吓来进行谋生。

W19. Downtown Willowshore

Downtown Willowshore remains a major hub of activity in town. To the northeast once stood the governor’s home and office, which also served as the village’s bank and treasury—but today, this entire area is a mysterious empty lot. What happened to the governor and his estate is one of the great mysteries the PCs will eventually solve during this Adventure Path. South of this empty lot lie the imperial barracks. To the north of the crossroad, opposite an empty square, is the stage for the village’s weekly Shu Opera performance. Nearby, on opposite sides of the road are one of Willowshore’s busiest stores, the Treesparrow’s Rest, and Willowshore’s only public bathhouse, the Happy Kappa.

See @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{Chapter 2} for a more detailed exploration of downtown Willowshore, but the following four establishments comprise the most important locations in the area.

The Seven-Colored Songbird Theater 5

  • Northridge

Kazuma Oono (gregarious male kitsune director 5) Perception DC 22, Will DC 20, Diplomacy +13, Performance +13, Shelyn Lore +12

Work Once a month, a PC can audition for a role in one of Kazuma Oono’s productions by attempting a @Check[performance|dc:25] check. On a success, the task level limit for Earn Income checks using Performance for that PC during that month is equal to Willowshore’s level or the PC’s level, whichever is higher.

Treesparrow’s Rest Business 3

  • Southbank

Nadoya Sanmi (friendly female human family matriarch 3) Perception DC 18, Will DC 20, Crafting +10

Services Thanks to the Sanmi family’s pre-planning, Willowshore has enough food stores to support the village on a subsistence level of living until winter. If the PCs are at least liked by Southbank, they can stay here free of charge to take advantage of this.

Wares alcohol, grains, preserved foods, rations

The Happy Kappa Business 1

  • Unaffiliated

Hua De-ge (chatty male halfling bathhouse owner 1) Perception DC 17, Will DC 17, Diplomacy +8

Services Once the bathhouse has been restored, the PCs can use the facilities free of charge. Once per day, a 1-hour soak in the warm waters helps to bolster the PC’s immune system—attempts to Treat Disease on that PC during the next 24 hours gain a +1 item bonus.

The bathhouse’s proprietor, De-ge, knows just about every bit of gossip in town, though he keeps his mouth shut about it. Providing the PCs are collecting information for a good cause and De-ge is at least friendly, chatting with him allows the PCs to roll Gather Information checks twice and take the better result. This is a fortune effect and can be used once per week.

Guard Office Barracks 3

  • Northridge

Zheng Peng (stoic male human watch officer 3) Perception DC 18, Will DC 18, Intimidation +9

Wares armor, gear maintenance equipment, weapons

Work As long as the party is at least liked by Northridge, a PC can help to keep guards in line here. Doing so allows one to Earn Income using Intimidation.

Willowshore Dam.name: 柳岸镇大坝 Willowshore Dam
Willowshore Dam.text:
W18. 柳岸大坝

柳岸镇的大坝是一项工程奇迹。它的主体由严丝合缝的深灰色大理石板建成，并雕刻出经过精密计算的弧度。大坝有两扇巨大的木门，可以关闭或开启，以降低湖水水位。转动控制这些门的轮盘时，会自动响起铃声，提醒下游的人们撤离到安全处。

W18. Willowshore Dam

Willowshore’s dam is a minor engineering marvel. Its main body is constructed out of precisely fitted slabs of dark-gray marble, carved with a carefully calculated curvature. The dam has two giant wooden gates that can be closed or opened to lower the level of the lake. Turning the wheel that controls the gates automatically causes a bell to ring, signaling those downriver to move away to safety.

Woodraft Lake.name: 木筏湖 Woodraft Lake
Woodraft Lake.text:
W17. 木筏湖

龙华任命到柳岸镇的第一任总督曾试图通过各种工程壮举来驯服臭名昭著的木棉河。这项努力的一部分，再加上木材湿储存的需求，促成了柳岸大坝的建造——以及随之形成的木筏湖。

起初，许多人抗议这项工程，因为新形成的湖泊会淹没一些房屋和农田——其中还包括村里供奉难病夫人的圣祠。几次监禁过后，所有抱怨都平息了。大坝如期完工。那位总督因此获得晋升，并不久后离开了柳岸镇，但还没来得及享受这份升迁，就在一个阳光明媚的日子里被山崩掩埋。虽然这个故事的真实性颇为可疑，但此后的历任总督从未阻止柳岸镇的村民将这片湖视为苦寡妇的圣祠。

W17. Woodraft Lake

The first governor appointed to Willowshore by Lung Wa made an effort to tame the notorious Ceiba River through various engineering feats. Part of that effort, plus the demand for wet storage for wood, led to the construction of the Willowshore Dam—and by extension, Woodraft Lake.

Many protested the construction at first, as the resulting lake would submerge some homes and farmlands—including the village’s shrine to Lady Nanbyo. A few imprisonments later, all complaints ceased. The dam was completed in due time. While the governor earned themself a promotion and left Willowshore soon after, they didn’t get to enjoy it for long before a landslide buried them on a bright sunny day. While the story’s veracity is somewhat dubious, subsequent governors have never stopped Willowshore’s villagers from treating the lake as a shrine to the Widow of Suffering.

Nine Ear Shrine.name: 九耳神社 Nine Ear Shrine
Nine Ear Shrine.text:
W16. 九耳神社

这间泥墙小屋从外面看像是一座粮食储藏棚。其内部向下延伸10英尺，通往地下一个石砌的封闭空间；空间中央坐落着一尊15英尺高的九尾狐大理石雕像。它的颈部垂挂着一条由干草制成的大型魂魄之绳。地下室的墙壁装饰着彩绘浮雕，描绘了@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.M3eb94Nd6uXti2IK]{大吉津}的故事。

十五年前，欧家的一位绝望母亲在家族被一名腐败守卫押去处决时，将自己的婴儿藏在了这里。等守卫们发现少了这个孩子时，一大群狐狸已经包围了这座神社。守卫们不愿冒犯神圣之怒，于是撤退了。家族的盟友很快赶来救走婴儿，而就在那时，狐狸们也消失了。

那个婴儿——噢，巴明——在远房亲戚的照料下长大。尽管她展现出欧家崇敬自然的倾向，巴明仍希望通过侍奉大吉津来报答这份救命之恩。虽然有些人质疑她的动机，但大多数柳岸镇居民都支持她的奉献。

九耳神社 神殿 3

  • 南岸

噢，巴明（虔诚的女性人类祭司 3）察觉DC 18，意志DC 20，制作 +5（受训），宗教 +8

服务 只有当巴明的态度达到乐于助人时，她才会提供自己的服务。她可以制作最高2级的符箓（珍宝密库 76–79）、来自神圣或原始法术列表的1级法术卷轴，以及@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.clyXfh0aVXgij2Hb]{狼之牙}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Yew9oddFsH0KeDLh]{猎手之灾}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.jdDDqv9LbEYX2wAE]{猿猴徽章}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nXStoLxPrrP2b6WB]{青铜牛垂饰}护符。

货品 符箓、卷轴、护符

W16. Nine Ear Shrine

This mud-wall hut looks like a grain storage hut on the outside. Its interior descends 10 feet underground into an enclosed space lined with stone, in the middle of which sits a 15-foot-tall marble statue of a nine-tailed fox. A large spiritual rope made of hay hangs off its neck. The walls of the basement are decorated with painted carvings that depict stories of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.M3eb94Nd6uXti2IK]{Daikitsu}.

Fifteen years ago, a desperate mother of the Ouh family hid her baby here as the family was rounded up for execution by a corrupt guard. By the time the guards knew about the missing offspring, a large skulk of foxes had surrounded the temple. Unwilling to tempt divine wrath, the guards retreated. Allies of the family soon arrived to rescue the baby, at which point the foxes vanished.

That baby, Ouh Ba-Ming, grew up under the care of distant relatives. While she shows signs of the Ouh family’s inclinations toward the veneration of nature, Ba-Ming wishes to return her life debt by serving Daikitsu. While some question her intentions, most Willowshorers support her dedication.

Nine Ear Shrine Temple 3

  • Southbank

Ouh Ba-Ming (devoted female human priest 3) Perception DC 18, Will DC 20, Crafting +5 (Trained), Religion +8

Services Ba-ming only provides her services if her attitude is helpful. She can craft fulus up to 2nd level (Treasure Vault 76–79), 1st-level spell scrolls from the divine or primal spell list, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.clyXfh0aVXgij2Hb]{Wolf Fang}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Yew9oddFsH0KeDLh]{Hunter's Bane}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.jdDDqv9LbEYX2wAE]{Monkey Pin}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nXStoLxPrrP2b6WB]{Bronze Bull Pendant} talismans.

Wares fulus, scrolls, talismans

Rebel’s Leatherworks.name: 里氏制革厂 Rebel’s Leatherworks
Rebel’s Leatherworks.text:
W15. 里氏制革厂

柳岸镇对皮革与兽皮制品的需求一直很高，主要是因为这家本地工坊一直难以维持足够的人手来跟上这类需求。制革厂的老板维图姆尼亚尔在这些困境持续期间，脾气变得愈发乖戾暴躁——而具有讽刺意味的是，这些困境归根结底正是由他的坏脾气造成的。

里氏制革厂 制革厂 1

  • 无隶属

维图姆尼亚尔（脾气乖戾的男性娜迦吉制革工 3）察觉DC 18，意志 DC 20，制作 +10

货物 兽皮与皮革物品

工作 若一名玩家角色至少受到南岸与北岭的喜爱，便可以在此协助制作皮革制品，并可尝试一个等级等于柳岸镇等级 +1 或更低的任务。

W15. Rebel’s Leatherworks

Demand for leather and hide goods has been high throughout Willowshore, primarily as a result of this local workshop’s struggles with keeping enough employees in order to keep up with said demand. Vitumniar, the leatherworks’ owner, has only grown more surly and short-tempered as these struggles continue—struggles ironically caused by his bad attitude in the first place.

Rebel’s Leatherworks Tannery 1

  • Unaffiliated

Vitumniar (cantankerous male nagaji tanner 3) Perception DC 18, Will DC 20, Crafting +10

Wares hide and leather items

Work A PC who’s at least liked by Southbank and Northridge, can help craft leather goods here and can attempt a task of a level equal to Willowshore’s level +1 or less.

Cloud Paper House.name: 云纸坊 Cloud Paper House
Cloud Paper House.text:
W14. 云纸坊

在柳岸镇工业区仍然开门营业的三家商铺中，云纸坊是唯一称得上“兴旺”的一家。这在很大程度上要归功于它的主人八哥 川冈的辛勤工作与勤勉付出——他不仅支持并保护自己的雇员，还积极调整工坊的经营重心，以满足城镇不断变化的需求，或为这家作坊生产的各类纸制品开发新的用途。

云纸坊 造纸坊 3

  • 南岸

八哥 川冈（虔诚的男性天狗行会首领 3）察觉DC 20，意志DC 20，制作 +10

货品纸张和纸制品，如法术书和配方簿

工作柳岸镇需要大量纸张来修好那些推拉门。若一名玩家角色至少受到南岸的喜爱，便可在此协助制作纸张，并在以制作进行谋生的检定中获得+1物品加值。

W14. Cloud Paper House

Of the three businesses that remain open in Willowshore’s industrial district, Cloud Paper House is the only one that could be called “thriving.” This is in no small part due to the hard work and diligence its owner, Myna Kawaka has put into not only supporting and protecting his employees, but in pivoting to adjust the focus of the factory to either meet the town’s changing needs or to develop new roles for the wide range of paper products this establishment produces.

Cloud Paper House Paper Mill 3

  • Southbank

Myna Kawaka (devoted male tengu guild leader 3) Perception DC 20, Will DC 20, Crafting +10

Wares paper and paper products such as spellbooks and formula books

Work Willowshore is going to need a lot of paper to fix all those sliding doors. A PC who’s at least liked by Southbank can help craft paper here and gains a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to Earn Income.

Jadeite Essentials.name: 玉液琼浆 Jadeite Essentials
Jadeite Essentials.text:
W13. 玉液琼浆

这家独特的店铺过去同时经营着两项彼此扶持的生意——一间蒸馏酒坊和一处玻璃吹制工坊。可惜的是，在最近那场袭击中，大部分蒸馏装备都被怪物摧毁了，令店主诗欧莉一时不知接下来该怎么办，甚至开始考虑是否要收拾行装返回神门邻近精瑛，与那里的家人团聚。

玉液琼浆 蒸馏酒坊 2

  • 北岭

诗欧莉（心烦意乱的女性艾乌瓦林酿酒师 2）察觉DC 19，意志 DC 19，酒精学识 +10，制作 +8

货物 酒精、精油与香水、玻璃器皿及玻璃制品

工作 由于蒸馏装备大多已被怪物摧毁，这处工坊如今只剩下内部的玻璃吹制设施。若一名至少受到北岭喜爱的玩家角色在此帮忙制作玻璃器皿，则其进行制作检定以谋生时，获得 +1 物品加值。

W13. Jadeite Essentials

This unique establishment once housed two different businesses that supported each other—a distillery and a glassblowing facility. Unfortunately, much of the distilling equipment was destroyed by the monsters during the recent attack, leaving owner Shioli not quite sure what to do next and considering the option of pulling up stakes and heading back to Jinin to reunite with family there.

Jadeite Essentials Distillery 2

  • Northridge

Shioli (distraught female aiuvarin brewer 2) Perception DC 19, Will DC 19, Alcohol Lore +10, Crafting +8

Wares alcohol, essential oils and perfume, glassware and glass items

Work With the distilling equipment mostly destroyed by the monsters, all that’s left of the plant is its in-house glassblowing facilities. A PC who’s at least liked by Northridge can help craft glassware here and gains a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to Earn Income.

Industrial District.name: 工业区 Industrial District
Industrial District.text:
W13—W15. 工业区

柳岸镇的龙华木材业老板还经营着许多其他与林地中取得的材料相关的生意。许多工业工人专程来到柳岸镇从事这份工作，把家人和朋友留在了身后。

木材业老板离开后，赫总督夺取了控制权，并命令工人继续工作。工人们因自己对此事毫无选择而愤懑不已，近来一直在深夜聚集，由资深纸匠兼书册装订匠川冈带领，商讨该如何与总督谈判，好让想离开的人得以离开，并让选择留下的人获得公平报酬。因此，川冈被视为工业区非官方的“行会首领”。

随着龙华的垮台，许多曾在此地兴旺一时的商店都已关门，现只剩下三家仍在以不同程度继续营业，下面将分别作更详细的介绍。

W13—W15. Industrial District

Willowshore’s Lung Wa lumber bosses had a host of other businesses related to materials taken from the woods. Many industrial workers came to Willowshore explicitly for this work, leaving family and friends behind.

After the lumber bosses left, Governor Heh seized control and ordered the workers to continue working. Upset that they had no choice in the matter, the workers have been gathering late at night under the guidance of Kawaka, a senior paper and bookmaker, to discuss how they should negotiate with the governor to release those who want to leave and fairly pay those who elect to stay. As a result, Kawaka is viewed as an unofficial “guild master” of the Industrial District.

With the collapse of Lung Wa, many of the businesses that once thrived here closed up shop, leaving only three in various levels of activity, each of which is presented in greater detail below.

Matsu’s Home.name: 马苏的家 Matsu’s Home
Matsu’s Home.text:
W12. 马苏的家

松（退休的人类厨师 1）算得上是南岸当地一个颇有名气的人物——这位爱交际的老人似乎很乐于把自己塑造成那种声音洪亮、脾气乖戾、总怀念着“旧日好时光”的老头子的老套形象。事实上，松知道自己最好的日子已经过去了，而作为一个终身未娶、也从未抽出时间经营社交生活（更不用说组建家庭）的人，日子每过去一天，他就越发为自己所认为被虚掷的青春感到后悔。

W12. Matsu’s Home

Matsu (retired human chef 1) is something of a notorious local establishment in Southbank—a gregarious elderly man who seems to enjoy leaning in to the cliche of the loud and cranky oldster who longs for the “good old days.” In truth, Matsu knows his best days are behind him, and as a lifelong bachelor who never found the time to focus on a social life (much less build a family), each passing day brings him more regret for what he regards as a wasted youth.

Dawnstep Bridge.name: 晨步桥 Dawnstep Bridge
Dawnstep Bridge.text:
W11. 晨步桥

早年间，晨步桥不过是一连串漂浮的木制平台，配有引导绳索，以便人们过桥，或在需要让河上船只通过时收回部分桥段；但随着大笔资金涌入城镇，一座真正的石桥建成了，也让城镇两岸之间的联系更加稳固。桥墩将桥身支撑在下方水面以上七英尺处，这样的高度足以让从旧伐木营地顺流漂下的原木进入木筏湖，但也阻止了大于木筏或小艇的船只通行——柳岸镇的人民很快便不再介意这一不便，因为他们逐渐体会到了这条更加坚固的两岸通道所带来的好处。

W11. Dawnstep Bridge

In the early days, Dawnstep Bridge was little more than a series of floating wooden platforms with guidelines to aid in crossing or in retracting sections to allow for river traffic to pass, but by the time money began pouring into town, the construction of a proper stone bridge helped create a stronger link between the town’s two shores. The bridge’s pilings support the bridge seven feet above the water below, enough room for logs floated downriver from the lumber camp to float into Woodraft Lake, but prevented the passage of watercraft larger than rafts or skiffs—an inconvenience that the people of Willowshore swiftly got over as they grew to appreciate the benefits the much more solid link between shores provided.

Eternal Lantern.name: 长明灯 Eternal Lantern
Eternal Lantern.text:
W10. 长明灯

三福青楼建立之后（但在它变成旅店之前），柳岸镇的人口规模已经增长到按神门的标准可被视为一座城镇，这意味着在城镇内靠近入口、重要的十字路口或桥梁处，必须始终维持一盏点亮的提灯。这些地点若缺少点亮的提灯，便意味着这座城镇已被废弃，而人们相信这会招来害虫、幽灵、野兽，以及更糟的东西。在柳岸镇，一件名为长明灯的下等神器承担着这一职责——这是智惠大师本人珍视的传家宝。@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}这盏提灯在这场冒险的第一幕中扮演重要角色，并且能为玩家角色们提供持久的加值（见第40页）。

W10. Eternal Lantern

After the Thrice-Blessed Brothel was established (but before it became an inn), Willowshore’s population had grown enough in size to be considered a town by Shenmen standards, meaning that a lit lantern must be maintained at all times within the town near the entrance, at a major crossroads, or at a bridge. The lack of a lit lantern at one of these locations suggests that the town is abandoned, which is believed to invite the likes of vermin, ghosts, beasts, and worse. In Willowshore, a minor artifact known as the Eternal Lantern serves this purpose—a treasured heirloom from Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} herself. This lantern plays a major role in Act 1 of the adventure, and can grant long-lasting bonuses to the PCs (see page 40).

Lady of Souls.name: 司魂娘娘 Lady of Souls
Lady of Souls.text:
W9. 司魂娘娘

当龙华最初扩张进入柳岸镇时，他们最关切的问题之一，就是降低亡灵暴动的可能性。他们通过建造一座供奉@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}的大教堂解决了这个问题。

伊莉泽丝·坎多拉是一位来自过峡的第二代塔尔丹裔，现任此地的女祭司。伊莉泽丝小时候曾造访过柳岸镇和丹杉寺，当时的她从未想过，自己成为一名法拉斯玛牧师后，竟会获得机会永久回到这个她仍记忆犹新的村庄。她将这场巧合视为法拉斯玛亲手安排的命运，因此始终尽职而勤勉地侍奉。她喜欢独自在墓地里与自己的长笛相伴，经常在那里吹奏，帮助安抚那些新近下葬者的灵魂。

魂流圣母堂 神殿 5

  • 无隶属

伊莉泽丝·坎多拉（富有同理心的女性人类法拉斯玛牧师 5）察觉DC 25，意志DC 25，制作 +13，表演 +13，宗教 +13

服务 由于大教堂在怪物攻击期间受损，伊莉泽丝在本幕中只能提供最高2环的神圣卷轴。等到夏天结束、第二幕进入秋天后，伊莉泽丝每4天可以按正常价格制作或铭刻一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{幽冥}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.r28DjJEjF6jvCcfb]{仁慈}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DKWuJb2rSgiotOG7]{+1强效符文}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DxCuJKynlnMQZHgp]{强击}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LwQb7ryTC8FlOXgX]{活化}武器符文。在此之前，如果玩家角色向她提出请求，伊莉泽丝可以制作以下物品：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.HHELOoN5GVonUiIa]{泪天使垂饰}、镇魂炸药（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LNd5u19GqC51ngby]{次级}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wf94e8YNhZdIvWc9]{中级}），以及治疗药水（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.2RuepCemJhrpKKao]{下等}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.e0vSAQfxhHauiAoD]{次级}）。

货物 消耗性宗教物品，神圣卷轴

W9. Lady of Souls

One of Lung Wa’s chief concerns when they first expanded into Willowshore was to reduce the likelihood of an undead uprising. They solved it by building a cathedral to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}.

Elizeth Candora, a second-generation Taldan from Goka, is the current priestess here. Having once visited Willowshore and the Tan Sugi monastery as a child, Elizeth never imagined that becoming a cleric of Pharasma would lead to an opportunity for her to permanently return to the village she so vividly recalls. She sees this coincidence as fate arranged by Pharasma’s hands and therefore serves dutifully and diligently. She’s fond of spending time alone in the graveyard with her flute and often plays the instrument there to help soothe the spirits of those recently buried therein.

Her Fluvial Lady of Souls Temple 5

  • Unaffiliated

Elizeth Candora (empathetic female human cleric of Pharasma 5) Perception DC 25, Will DC 25, Crafting +13, Performance +13, Religion +13

Services As the cathedral was damaged during the monster attack, Elizeth can only provide divine scrolls up to 2nd-level during this act. Once summer ends and fall begins in Act 2, Elizeth can create or inscribe the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.r28DjJEjF6jvCcfb]{Merciful}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DKWuJb2rSgiotOG7]{+1 Potency}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DxCuJKynlnMQZHgp]{Striking}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LwQb7ryTC8FlOXgX]{Vitalizing} weapon runes once every 4 days at normal cost. Before that, Elizeth can create the following items if the PCs Request her help: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.HHELOoN5GVonUiIa]{Crying Angel Pendant}, ghost charges (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LNd5u19GqC51ngby]{Lesser} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wf94e8YNhZdIvWc9]{Moderate}), and healing potions (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.2RuepCemJhrpKKao]{Minor}and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.e0vSAQfxhHauiAoD]{Lesser}).

Wares consumable religious items, divine scrolls

Milling Houses.name: 磨坊 Milling Houses
Milling Houses.text:
W8. 磨坊

柳岸镇有许多磨坊，其中两座以水力驱动，三座以风力驱动，还有10座由人力或役用牲畜驱动。丰富的磨坊运作确保即使有一两座磨坊因例行维护或故障停运，也绝不会危及村子的需求。

在磨坊工作强度很大，而且由于每天的需求不同，工时也可能不规律。磨坊工人的领袖春虎以鼓励维持士气，顶住不合理的要求，保持工钱稳定，还会提供午夜点心。

磨坊 商业 4

  • 南岸

乔春虎（支持性的男性人类磨坊工人 4）察觉DC 20，意志DC 20，阿巴达尔学识 +10，制作 +12

货品 脱壳谷物、谷粉、石制物体

工作 磨坊总是在寻找额外人手帮忙让磨盘持续转动。玩家角色可以在这里使用运动来谋生。

W8. Milling Houses

Willowshore has numerous milling houses, including two powered by water, three by wind, and 10 powered by people or draft animals. The abundance of milling operations ensures that losing one or two mills to routine maintenance or malfunction never jeopardizes the village’s needs.

Working at the mills is intense, and the hours can be irregular due to the demand each day. The millers’ leader, Chung-hu, keeps morale high with encouragement, pushing back against unreasonable demands, keeping wages stable, and midnight snacks.

Milling Houses Business 4

  • Southbank

Choe Chung-hu (supportive male human miller 4) Perception DC 20, Will DC 20, Abadar Lore +10, Crafting +12

Wares De-husked grain, grain flour, stone objects

Work The mills are always looking for extra hands to help keep the stones turning. A PC can use Athletics to Earn Income here.

Silvermist Lodges.name: 银雾斋 Silvermist Lodges
Silvermist Lodges.text:
W7. 银雾斋

银雾斋分布在镇南的三处庭院中。在每一处地点（区域 W7a–W7c），旅舍的木制工艺都顺应木材本身的纹理，使这些建筑呈现出一种与精灵建筑相关的有机风格。早年柳岸镇初次尝试实现自给自足时，八位精灵冒险者在此定居；考虑到他们更长的寿命，他们寻求的是一份短期契约。尽管这最初的八位精灵如今已无人仍住在柳岸镇，他们却留下了许多子嗣与后代，其中包括艾欧梅娜。她如今在中央庭院（区域 W7b）经营这些旅舍。

银雾斋 狩猎旅舍 2

  • 南岸

艾欧梅娜（耐心的非二元性别精灵游侠 2）察觉DC 21，意志DC 19，制作 +7，自然 +8，求生 +8

商品 动物部件，陷阱材料

W7. Silvermist Lodges

The Silvermist Lodges are split between three compounds south of town. At each location (areas W7a–W7c), the lodges’ woodwork conforms to the grain of the wood, giving the buildings an organic look associated with elven architecture. In the days when Willowshore first tried to become self-sufficient, eight elven adventurers settled here, seeking a short-term contract given their longer life spans. Though none of these original eight elves live in Willowshore anymore, they left many offspring and descendants behind, including Aiomena, who now runs the lodges from the central compound (area W7b).

Silvermist Lodges Hunting Lodge 2

  • Southbank

Aiomena (patient nonbinary elf ranger 2) Perception DC 21, Will DC 19, Crafting +7, Nature +8, Survival +8

Wares animal parts, snare supplies

Thrice-Blessed Inn.name: 三福客栈 Thrice-Blessed Inn
Thrice-Blessed Inn.text:
W6. 三福客栈

柳岸镇的三福客栈起初是三福青楼，由侍奉@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AIcDyoff265z9285]{国府幸}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AlL9GtlTldbqNoVm]{卡莉丝翠雅}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.gxwmzxUWBOhdgFSN]{希琳}的三位牧师所创立。昔日青楼为了保护隐私而装设的厚重百叶窗——以及三位不同神祇的祝福——都成了极佳的防御，在遭受攻击时帮助保护这栋建筑。

在龙华崩溃前的几年前，政治上的复杂纠葛迫使青楼的主人奥蒂丝妈妈关闭了这家店。在柳岸镇本地律师骆熙旸的协助下，她得以援引一条鲜为人知的法律，避免被驱逐，并获准将这栋建筑继续作为旅店经营。这座昔日的青楼非常适合同时为大量人群提供住宿与食物，因此对于那些在怪物入侵后家园受损、正等待修缮完成的人来说，这里是再合适不过的住处。

三福客栈 宿舍 4

  • 南岸

受尊敬的奥蒂丝妈妈（精明的性别流动艾乌瓦林旅店老板 4级），察觉DC 20，意志 DC 20，交涉 +12，卡莉丝翠雅学识 +10，柳岸镇学识 +10

服务 玩家角色可以花费1 gp雇用客栈的一名雇员来协助一次打探消息检定——如此一来，该玩家角色进行打探消息检定时获得+1状态加值。任何缺乏住宿或食物的玩家角色，只要没有严重冒犯受尊敬的奥蒂丝妈妈本人，就可以在柳岸镇从怪物入侵中恢复期间于此获得维生水平的食宿。

W6. Thrice-Blessed Inn

Willowshore’s Thrice-Blessed Inn began as the Thrice-Blessed Brothel, and was founded by three clerics of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AIcDyoff265z9285]{Kofusachi}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AlL9GtlTldbqNoVm]{Calistria}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.gxwmzxUWBOhdgFSN]{Shelyn}. The former brothel’s heavy shutters for privacy—and the blessing of three different gods—are great defenses that help protect the building during attacks.

Political complications forced the brothel’s owner, Mother Otis, to shut down the establishment only a few years before Lung Wa’s collapse. With the aid of Willowshore’s local lawyer, Luo Xi Yang, she was able to rely upon an obscure law that prevented their eviction and allowed them to continue to operate the building as an inn. Well suited for housing and feeding large numbers of people all at once, the former brothel is perfect for those who lost their homes until repairs in the wake of the monster invasion are completed.

Thrice-Blessed Inn Living Quarters 4

  • Southbank

Reverent Mother Otis (canny genderfluid aiuvarin innkeeper 4), Perception DC 20, Will DC 20, Diplomacy +12, Calistria Lore +10, Willowshore Lore +10

Services A PC can hire one of the inn’s employees to assist in a Gather Information check at a cost of 1 gp—doing so grants the PC a +1 status bonus to their check to Gather Information. Any PCs who lack lodging or food can receive subsistence levels of living here while Willowshore recovers from the monster invasion unless they’ve greatly offended Reverent Mother Otis personally.

Matsuki Estate.name: 松木宅邸 Matsuki Estate
Matsuki Estate.text:
W5. 松木宅邸

“老松木”曾师从丹杉寺院的首席木匠。辞别师父后，他带领家人建起了一座大型宅邸，供他们二十四口人共同居住。这位迷信的家长随后确保外墙以含有祝福盐和圣水的石灰岩加固，这帮助宅邸经受住了怪物入侵。

松木宅邸 宿舍 5

  • 南岸

松木胜（怀旧的男性人类木匠 5）察觉DC 22（视觉为20），意志 DC 22，制作 +13，柳岸镇学识 +16

W5. Matsuki Estate

“Old Matsuki” once apprenticed to the head carpenter of the Tan Sugi monastery. After taking leave from his master, he led his family to construct a large estate to house all two dozen of them. The superstitious patriarch then made sure that the outer walls were bolstered with limestone containing blessed salts and holy water, which helped the estate weather the monster invasion.

Matsuki Estate Living Quarters 5

  • Southbank

Matsuki Shou (nostalgic male human carpenter 5) Perception DC 22 (20 if visual), Will DC 22, Crafting +13, Willowshore Lore +16

Abadar Shrine.name: 阿巴达尔神龛 Abadar Shrine
Abadar Shrine.text:
W4. 阿巴达尔神龛

这座饰有黄昏木镶边的神龛内供奉着一尊3足高的石灰岩@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.d56paSkcwvll2OhR]{阿巴达尔}雕像，其一手持铲，另一手持泥刀。据说，这尊雕像最初先被送往过峡，在大银行举行仪式以迎请阿巴达尔的神圣祝福，随后才被渡运回柳岸镇。

W4. Abadar Shrine

This duskwood-trimmed shrine houses a 3-foot-tall limestone statue of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.d56paSkcwvll2OhR]{Abadar} that holds a shovel in one hand and a trowel in the other. The statue was reportedly taken to Goka first to ritualistically invite Abadar’s divine blessings at the Grand Bank before being ferried back to Willowshore.

Graveside Manners.name: 墓畔礼仪 Graveside Manners
Graveside Manners.text:
W3. 墓畔礼仪

柳岸镇的居民在早期会实行火葬，以防止出现不死生物。这片古老墓园中的墓穴安放着许多早期定居者的骨灰瓮。如今，只有少数几个家族还将墓畔礼仪用作墓地。多亏了墓园的看守者素锦，墓碑上始终不见地衣与苔藓。

素锦曾是时常造访丹杉寺的一名朝圣者。寺院倒塌后，她在柳岸镇定居并开了这家商店。她初到镇上时，古怪的习惯与不同寻常的信念，曾让一位尤其令人不快的本地祭司（如今早已不在人世）在毫无证据的情况下指控她是死灵法师；但随着时间推移，她凭借自己医药的疗效赢得了镇民的认可。

墓畔礼仪 草药店 4

  • 南岸

尤素珍（神秘的女性精灵草药师 4）察觉DC 21，意志 DC 21，制作 +14（大师）

服务 PC可以以每天 1 sp 的价格租用素锦扩建后的炼金术师实验室，用来制作他们自己的炼金物品

商品 炼金灵药和工具、炼金试剂、新鲜与干燥草药

W3. Graveside Manners

Willowshore’s residents practiced cremation in its early days to prevent undeath. The tombs in this old cemetery house the urns of many of those early settlers. Today, only a few families use Graveside Manners as a burial ground. The headstones remain free of lichen and moss, thanks to the graveyard’s keeper, So-Jin.

Once a pilgrim who frequented the Tan Sugi monastery, So-Jin settled in Willowshore after the monastery’s collapse and opened this shop. When she first arrived in town, her strange habits and unusual beliefs compelled one particularly unpleasant local priest (a man now long gone) to accuse her (with no evidence) of being a necromancer, but in time she won the town over with the effectiveness of her medicine.

Graveside Manners Herbal Store 4

  • Southbank

You So-Jin (mysterious female elf herbalist 4) Perception DC 21, Will DC 21, Crafting +14 (Master)

Services The PCs can rent usage of So-Jin’s expanded alchemist’s lab for 1 sp per day to craft their own alchemical items

Wares alchemical elixirs and tools, alchemical reagents, fresh and dried herbs

Willowshore Stables.name: 柳岸镇马厩 Willowshore Stables
Willowshore Stables.text:
W2. 柳岸镇马厩

柳岸镇马厩是镇上为家养动物、宠物和牲畜提供兽医照料的设施。柳岸镇长期将牲畜用作驮兽，这影响了当地的饮食文化，使许多人避免食用牛肉。

当怪物在夏日第一天入侵柳岸镇时，柳岸镇马厩及其满是牛群的诱人牧场显然是个不可能被忽视的目标。到黎明时，牧场大部分围栏都已被毁，几乎所有牛和耕牛都逃进了荒野。主人昆舜重和他十几岁的儿子孟松一直忙着设法修复一切。在昆舜重能够为其他动物提供帮助之前，这些问题都是他必须先解决的。（PC可以在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{第3章}帮助牧场。）

柳岸镇马厩 马厩 3

  • 南岸

昆舜重（富有爱心的男性人类兽医3）察觉DC 19，意志 DC 16，自然 +10

服务 一旦牧场修复完成，昆舜重便可以用自然代替医药，对具有动物特征的生物执行未受训或受训的医药动作，例如对目标进行治疗伤口。他每天最多可以治疗六只动物，每次治疗费用为1银币。

货物 动物租赁、坐骑护甲、鞍囊、陆地载具

W2. Willowshore Stables

Willowshore Stables is the town’s veterinary facility for household animals, pets, and livestock. Willowshore’s use of livestock as beasts of burden influenced the local food culture, causing many to avoid eating beef.

When monsters invaded Willowshore on the first day of summer, the Willowshore Stables and its tempting fields of cattle were an impossible target to ignore. By dawn, most of the ranch’s fences were destroyed and nearly all of the cattle and oxen had fled into the wilderness. The owner, Kum Soon-chong, and his teenage son, Meng-sung, have been scrambling to get things fixed. These are problems Soon-chong must solve first before he can provide help to other animals. (The PCs can help ranch in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{Chapter 3}.)

Willowshore Stables Stables 3

  • Southbank

Kum Soon-chong (caring male human veterinarian 3) Perception DC 19, Will DC 16, Nature +10

Services Once the ranch is repaired, Soon-chong can treat creatures with the animal trait using Nature in place of Medicine to perform Medicine untrained or trained actions, such as Treat Wounds, on the target. He can treat up to six animals per day, and each treatment per day costs 1 sp.

Wares animal rentals, barding, saddle bags, land vehicles

Eternal Blaze Ironworks.name: 永焰铁工坊 Eternal Blaze Ironworks
Eternal Blaze Ironworks.text:
W1. 永焰铁工坊

在寺院建造的年代，永焰铁工坊负责打造各类金属物品，包括炊具、木工工具，以及铰链、锁和箱子钥匙之类的小型金属零件。

大约十年前，雍武秀从她父亲手中继承了这门生意。她以“打下了铁锅匠”之名为人所知；在柳岸镇不景气的那些年里，武秀走遍天夏，一边谋生，一边学习新的技艺。除了精通打造武器和护甲外，她还掌握了加工冷铁和银等非常规金属的技术，不过她很少将此事告诉任何人。

永焰铁工坊 铁匠 3

  • 南岸

雍武秀（勤勉的女性狐人铁匠 3）察觉DC 21，意志DC 21，制作 +13

服务 除了常规金属物品外，武秀也能用冷铁或银来制作物体，但通常只会为至少对她态度友善的人这么做——她在自己的熔炉里藏有价值250 gp的冷铁和250 gp的银，可用于制作。

货物 金属制品、冒险道具（尤其是炊具）、金属护甲、金属武器、金属盾牌

W1. Eternal Blaze Ironworks

In the days of the monastery’s construction, the Eternal Blaze Ironworks was responsible for creating metal items from cookware, woodworking tools, and small metal parts, such as hinges, locks, and keys for chests.

Yong Wu-Xiu inherited the business from her father about a decade ago. Known as the Iron Pot Blacksmith, Wu spent Willowshore’s unprosperous years traveling throughout Tian Xia, both to earn a living and to learn new techniques. Other than mastering how to make weapons and armor, she also picked up the skill of working unconventional metals such as cold iron and silver, though she rarely shares this fact with anyone.

Eternal Blaze Ironworks Blacksmith 3

  • Southbank

Yong Wu-Xiu (industrious female kitsune blacksmith 3) Perception DC 21, Will DC 21, Crafting +13

Services In addition to regular metal items, Wu-Xiu can also craft objects out of cold iron or silver but generally does so only for those she’s at least friendly with—she has 250 gp of cold iron and 250 gp of silver on hand hidden in her forge that she can use to craft with.

Wares metalworks, adventuring gear (especially cookware), metal armor, metal weapons, metal shields

Location Support.name: 地点支持 Location Support
Location Support.text:
地点支持

以下页面中介绍的部分地点末尾附有一个简短的数据表，总结了该地点的名称、等级（用于决定谋生任务的DC——请记得每当柳岸镇自身等级提升时，也要相应提高这些DC，详见对页 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02peopleofwill00#growing-the-town]{小镇成长}）、货物与服务，以及在该地点工作或居住的重要非玩家角色信息。这些地点还具有两种特征之一——南岸或北岭。

玩家角色可以通过将负责该地点的非玩家角色的态度调整为乐于助人，来获得这些地点的支援。玩家角色第一次获得带有这些特征之一的地点支援时，会从对应派系获得1点声望点；但如果他们在该派系中已经达到钦佩或尊敬，则不会获得额外点数。（想要获得更多声望点，则需要在冒险过程中采取特定行动。）

服务：许多非玩家角色或地点可以制作特定物品。请求某位非玩家角色制作一个物品，等同于以全额价格购买该物品，但需等待4天。

态度：除非另有说明，非玩家角色对玩家角色的初始态度为冷淡。如果某位玩家角色被某个派系喜爱，则所有相关且原本为冷淡的非玩家角色，其初始态度都会变为友善。如果某位玩家角色被某个派系尊敬，则所有相关且原本为冷淡或友善的非玩家角色，其初始态度都会变为乐于助人，并自动给予其地点的支援。

工作：这些地点中的一部分会为谋生休整期行动提供加值。除非另有说明，在柳岸镇进行任何谋生尝试时，任务等级必须等于或低于柳岸镇的等级（在冒险路径开始时为4级）。请注意，成为相关派系中的钦佩或尊敬对象，可以提高这一任务等级上限；提升柳岸镇的定居点等级同样也能提高该上限。

Location Support

Some of the locations presented on the following pages end with a short stat block that summarizes the location’s name, level (for the purpose of determining DCs for Earn Income tasks—remember to adjust these up whenever Willowshore itself increases its level, as detailed in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02peopleofwill00#growing-the-town]{Growing the Town} on the facing page), wares and services, and information about significant NPCs who work or live there. These locations also have one of two traits—Southbank or Northridge.

The PCs can gain the support of these locations by adjusting the attitude of the NPC who runs the site to be helpful. The first time a PC gains the support of a site with one of these traits, they earn 1 Reputation Point with the matching faction unless they’re already admired or revered by that faction, in which case no additional points are earned. (Earning Reputation Points beyond this requires specific actions taken during the course of the adventure itself.)

Services: Many NPCs or locations can craft specific items. Requesting an NPC to craft an item is equivalent to buying an item at full price with a four-day delay.

Attitudes: Unless otherwise specified, an NPC’s initial attitude toward the PCs is indifferent. If a PC becomes liked by a faction, all indifferent associated NPCs shift their initial attitude to friendly. If a PC becomes revered by a faction, all indifferent or friendly associated NPCs shift their initial attitude to helpful and automatically grant the support of their site.

Work: Some of these locations allow bonuses to Earn Income downtime activities. Unless otherwise indicated, any attempt to Earn Income in Willowshore must be of a task level equal to or less than Willowshore’s level (level 4 as the Adventure Path begins). Note that this maximum task level can be increased by becoming admired or revered with the associated faction, and also by raising Willowshore’s settlement level.

Willowshore’s Rivers and Creeks.name: 柳岸镇的河流与溪流 Willowshore’s Rivers and Creeks
Willowshore’s Rivers and Creeks.text:
柳岸镇的河流与溪流

木棉河流经柳岸镇中心，河水向东奔流，最终汇入更大的渡月河。木棉河的水深在20到25英尺之间变化，但在柳岸镇大坝以西，河上仅有平底小船及类似的小型划艇通行。木棉溪则更浅，水深很少超过6英尺。有关这些水道的更多信息，见发生在其中或其附近的遭遇。

Willowshore’s Rivers and Creeks

The Ceiba River flows through the center of Willowshore, its waters running to the east to eventually flow into the larger Duyue River. While the depth of the Ceiba varies between 20 and 25 feet, west of Willowshore Dam, the only watercraft on the river are skiffs and similar small rowboats. Ceiba Creek is even more shallow, rarely more than six feet deep. Additional information on these waterways appears in the encounters that take place within or nearby them.

Willowshore Locations.name: 柳岸镇地点 Willowshore Locations
Willowshore Locations.text:
柳岸镇地点

接下来的页面详细介绍了柳岸镇中的重要建筑和关键人物，编号与第10页地图上的地点相对应。未标注的建筑都是木制结构，可能会根据其所处位置而用作商店、住宅、农舍、储藏室或其他杂项用途。游戏过程中，请追踪你放入这些未标注建筑中的任何新地点——这是让你们这桌的柳岸镇版本真正独一无二的绝佳方式！

Willowshore Locations

Significant buildings and important people found in Willowshore are detailed on the following pages, with numbers corresponding to the locations on the map on page 10. Unlabeled buildings are wooden structures that might be shops, homes, farmhouses, storerooms, or other miscellaneous usage depending on their location. As you play, keep track of any new locations you place in these unlabeled buildings—this is an excellent way to make your table’s version of Willowshore truly your own!

Building Reputation.name: 建立声望 Building Reputation
Building Reputation.text:
建立声望

随着PC帮助镇民，他们的声望也会不断提升。所有非玩家角色都会根据队伍目前在其派系中的声望，拥有一个默认的初始态度。

一开始，队伍在两个派系中的声望点均为0。随着他们在这场战役中完成目标，他们会获得声望点——或者在更少见的情况下失去声望点。下表进一步总结了声望带来的影响，并使用以下类别。

默认态度：这表示当PC首次遭遇与该派系相关的某个非玩家角色时，该非玩家角色的默认态度。无派系归属的非玩家角色默认态度始终为冷淡。注意，对PC变得敌对的非玩家角色并不会一见面就攻击他们（除非受到挑衅），而是会单纯拒绝与PC做生意或来往。

社交DC修正：这一列中的调整值会应用于与该派系非玩家角色进行任何社交遭遇技能检定的DC。社交遭遇的基础DC始终会写在遭遇文本中。

谋生：这些级别提供的环境加值和减值适用于所有与该派系地点或非玩家角色相关、用于谋生的检定。当PC受到钦佩时，他们与该派系进行谋生时可尝试的最高任务等级提高1；当他们受到尊敬时，最高任务等级则提高2。

声望 点数 默认态度 社交DC修正 谋生加值/减值
尊敬 31或更多 乐于助人 –10 +3（视为高2级）
钦佩 15到30 友善 –5 +2（视为高1级）
喜爱 5到14 友善 –2 +1
忽视 –4到4 冷淡 0 —
厌恶 –5到–14 不友善 +2 –1
仇恨 –15到–29 不友善 +5 –3
狩猎 –30或更少 敌对 +10 无法谋生

Building Reputation

As the PCs aid the townspeople, their reputation grows. All NPCs have a default starting attitude based on the party’s current reputation with their faction.

At the start, the party has 0 Reputation Points with both factions. As they accomplish goals during this campaign, they’ll gain points—or, more rarely, lose points. The table below summarizes the effects of reputation further, using the following qualities.

Default Attitude: This indicates the default attitude of an NPC associated with the faction when the PCs first encounter that NPC. Unaffiliated NPCs always have a default attitude of indifferent. Note that NPCs who become hostile to the PCs don’t attack them on sight (unless provoked), but instead, they simply refuse to do business or associate with the PCs.

Social DC Mod: The modifier in this column is applied to the DC of any social encounter skill check with an NPC of that faction. The base DCs for social encounters are always included in the encounter text.

Earn Income: The circumstance bonuses and penalties granted by these tiers apply to all checks attempted to Earn Income associated with locations or NPCs of the faction. When the PCs are admired, they increase the maximum task level they can attempt to Earn Income at with that faction by 1, and when they’re revered, they instead increase the maximum task level by 2.

Reputation Points Default Attitude Social DC Mod Earn Income Bonus/Penalty
Revered 31 or more Helpful –10 +3 (treat as 2 levels higher)
Admired 15 to 30 Friendly –5 +2 (treat as 1 level higher)
Liked 5 to 14 Friendly –2 +1
Ignored –4 to 4 Indifferent 0 —
Disliked –5 to –14 Unfriendly +2 –1
Hated –15 to –29 Unfriendly +5 –3
Hunted –30 or less Hostile +10 Can’t Earn Income

People of Willowshore.name: 柳岸镇的人民 People of Willowshore
People of Willowshore.text:
柳岸镇的人民

一个多世纪以来，遇害镇民的灵魂一直在一个每年都会让时间自我循环的心景中重复同一年。对这些居民——包括玩家角色——而言，这场冒险开始于7108年的夏天伊始，也就是龙华覆灭后仅仅两年。当前的热门话题包括木材巨头近期的出走、络新妇夺取全国统治权的消息，以及即将到来的肆季鬼志的准备。

柳岸镇之名

柳岸镇的人民来自多种多样的文化与国家，因此，镇中的非玩家角色、传说与学识，其灵感也取材于广泛的现实亚洲文化来源。虽然柳岸镇中的个别非玩家角色可能采用受现实亚洲国家启发的命名习惯，但这座城镇本身的名字则以英语中的复合词形式呈现。这是一种刻意为之的设计，意在捕捉一种属于广泛亚洲文化、却不由任何单一文化主导的地方感。

许多柳岸镇居民会根据自己家族最初何时在镇上定居来认同身份，而这通常也会影响他们住在木棉河的哪一岸。第一批镇民，要么是在寺院工作的人，要么是由寺院出资安置到柳岸镇定居的人。这些人起初住在河的南岸，因此被称为南岸人。另一方面，在龙华接管之后到来的人，则定居在河流北岸；由于那里有显眼的斜坡，因此被称为北岭。这些定居者包括为木材老板工作的人、希望便于取得木材的商家，以及帝皇守卫。

尽管如今柳岸镇中的这两个派系会使用南岸与北岭这两个名称，一个人的立场却并不单纯由其居住或工作的地点决定。南岸的人较为传统，热衷于维系柳岸镇的文化，并以朴素方式靠土地生活。与此同时，北岭的人更关注现代的务实主义与城镇发展。许多北岭居民对络新妇统治神门一事持开放态度，而南岸人则出于原则认为络新妇是邪恶怪物，最好敬而远之。

尽管存在分歧，双方都一致认为应将柳岸镇的生存与安全置于首位。也有不少居民持有既不偏向任何一方的看法，并认为自己不属于任何派系。总体而言，柳岸镇重视倾尽所能地付出。在很多方面，这个村子别无选择，尤其是在这场冒险的事件不断演变之际。

下方的数据表展示了这场战役开始时的柳岸镇状况。随着这条冒险路径继续推进，由于玩家角色对抗侵扰此地区之邪恶势力的工作，柳岸镇的等级会不断成长——更多细节请见“小镇成长”边栏。

请注意，柳岸镇数据表中的人口数字，计算的是玩家角色完成 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{第2章}、一切终于开始“恢复正常”之后的镇上人口。若你的玩家角色在 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh]{第1章} 和第2章期间，设法从死亡中救下了出乎意料多的当地人，你可以随意略微提高这一总人口数；但玩家角色在前两章中遭遇的尸体与受害者，都是未被计入这些总数的可怜灵魂。若这并非心景所承受的最终循环（要么因为苦迦菩提浮现到现实世界并将一切吞噬，要么因为玩家角色成功阻止这名邪魔并让柳岸镇回归现实），这些受害者会在一年后复活。

小镇成长

到了 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{第三章} 开始时，柳岸镇是一个4级定居点，而且刚刚经历了一场残酷的怪物袭击。帮助镇民恢复元气、让柳岸镇重新“站起来”，是这场战役中反复出现的主题。随着玩家角色完成各幕中详述的里程碑事件，他们实际上会提高柳岸镇的等级。虽然这不会影响城镇的人口总数，但会提高镇上可购买物品的底线，也会提高在镇上通过挣钱所得可接取的大多数任务等级的底线最大值。随着玩家角色帮助振奋士气并协助当地人重新站稳脚跟，柳岸镇的非玩家角色也会变得更强。每当柳岸镇获得高于4级的等级时，将柳岸镇内所有非玩家角色的DC与技能调整值各提高1。此外，每当柳岸镇等级提升时，各地点的等级也会提高1，这使玩家角色在挣钱所得时能够承接更高等级的任务。

柳岸镇获得等级的速度不会像玩家角色那样快。城镇周期性的等级提升，与其说代表城镇本身规模的扩大，不如说是在体现玩家角色重振士气、帮助当地人从近期事件中恢复，从而让柳岸镇回到一切恶化之前的旧日高度。
