Blessing the Coins.name: 祝福钱币 Blessing the Coins
Blessing the Coins.text:
祝福钱币

为了点亮长明灯，玩家角色必须将三枚经过祝福的铜币放入提灯的燃料槽中。要祝福一枚铜币，玩家角色必须前往柳岸镇城镇范围内的几座圣祠之一，并进行以下行动。

祈请圣龛祝福

  • 专注
  • 探索
  • 操作

需求 你手持一枚未受祝福的铜币，且位于柳岸镇的一座圣祠旁边。

你向一座圣祠献上祷告，并恳求与其相关的神祇祝福一枚铜币。将铜币放在圣祠前，然后在圣祠前花费10分钟祷告。进行一次@Check[religion|dc:15]或神祇学识检定，或一次与该神祇教义相关的DC 17技能检定——每座圣祠都有两项可选的替代技能，详见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03shrinelocati00]{柳岸镇的圣祠表}。如果你信奉该神祇，则将你的检定结果的成功等级提高一级。

大成功 神祇祝福了这枚铜币，同时也以额外的神圣能量与启示灌注于你。你恢复@Damage[1d8+8[healing]]生命值，并且在接下来24小时内可以将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{神导术}作为神圣法术施放1次。此后，你在祈请圣龛祝福中获得的所有大成功都视为普通成功。

成功 神祇祝福了这枚铜币。

失败 你失败了，并且在24小时内不能再次尝试在这座特定的圣祠祈请祝福。

大失败 你激怒了神祇。这枚铜币消失，你在1周内不能再次尝试在这座圣祠祈请祝福，并且你陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}状态，持续1小时。

Blessing the Coins

In order to light the Eternal Lantern, the PCs must place three blessed copper coins into the lantern’s fuel receptacle. To bless a copper coin, the PCs must seek out one of several shrines found in Willowshore’s town limits and perform the following activity.

Invoke Shrine Blessing

  • Concentrate
  • Exploration
  • Manipulate

Requirements You are holding an unblessed copper coin and are adjacent to one of Willowshore's shrines.

You offer prayers to a shrine and implore its associated deity to bless a copper coin. Place the copper coin before the shrine, then spend 10 minutes in prayer before the shrine. Attempt a @Check[religion|dc:15] or Deity Lore check or a DC 17 skill check associated with the deity's teachings—two alternate skills are available for each shrine, as detailed in the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03shrinelocati00]{Willowshore's Shrines table}. If you worship the deity in question, increase the result of your check by one degree of success.

Critical Success The deity blesses the copper coin but also imbues you with additional divine energy and insight. You heal @Damage[1d8+8[healing]] Hit Points and can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} once in the next 24 hours as a divine spell. You treat all further critical successes at Invoking Shrine Blessing as regular successes instead.

Success The deity blesses the copper coin.

Failure You fail, and can't attempt to invoke a blessing at this specific shrine again for 24 hours.

Critical Failure You anger the deity. The copper coin vanishes, you can't attempt to invoke a blessing at this shrine again for 1 week, and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 hour.

The Worst Puzzle.name: 最糟糕的谜题 The Worst Puzzle
The Worst Puzzle.text:
最糟糕的谜题 微不足道 1

正如胡婆婆所怀疑的那样，她的三个孙辈和他们一个爱惹麻烦的朋友，在重演节的夜晚于蘑菇屋附近的一处木材干燥场（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w32themushro00]{W32}）里自己办了一场聚会。他们喝得不省人事，直接在场里过了一夜；到了第二天早晨，一群蹑影小魔怪发现了他们，便决定残忍地把这些年轻人困起来，然后这些小魔怪再转去城镇的其他地方。

最糟糕的谜题 微不足道 1

@UUID[Actor.UVGcrrlk3ejOlNOy]{受困狂欢者 (4)} @UUID[Actor.bX3fzfr47WnGjiT0]{杂乱的木柴堆}

生物：当PC到达时，他们发现4名濒危狂欢客被困在木材干燥场中央的一小片区域里；蹑影小魔怪把那里布置成了一个危险的陷阱。4人听见PC接近时，会高声求救，同时也警告PC小心——“到处都是绊线和触发装置！那些可恶的小东西可没少下功夫！”这4名本地人蜷缩在几堆木料中间，而在他们四周，沉重的木梁和削尖的木桩被布置在由绊线和受力木销构成的 tangled web 之中，令人不寒而栗。

危害：只要这4名村民尽量保持不动，他们在这个危害的中心就还是安全的。若想让他们脱困，PC必须解除蹑影小魔怪搭建的陷阱；否则，这些平民很可能会受到伤害术。

奖励：每有1名幸存的狂欢客，PC获得20 XP；如果4人全部幸存，PC还会获得北岭1点声望点。

The Worst Puzzle Trivial 1

As Granny Hu suspected, three of her grandchildren and one of their troublemaking friends held their own party on the night of the Reenactment Festival in a lumber drying yard near the Mushroom House (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w32themushro00]{W32}). They passed out and spent the night in the yard, and that morning, a group of jinkins found them and decided to cruelly trap the youths before the gremlins moved on to other parts of town.

The Worst Puzzle Trivial 1

@UUID[Actor.UVGcrrlk3ejOlNOy]{Endangered Revelers (4)} @UUID[Actor.bX3fzfr47WnGjiT0]{Haphazard Wood Pile}

Creatures: When the PCs arrive, they find the four endangered revelers trapped in a small area at the center of a lumber drying yard that the jinkins rigged into a dangerous trap. As the four hear the PCs approach, they call out for help but also warn the PCs to watch out—“There’s all sorts of trip lines and triggers set! Those nasty little creatures made sure of that!” The four locals huddle in the middle of several stacks of lumber, and an unnerving amount of heavy timbers and sharpened stakes have been arranged all around them within a tangled web of trip lines and tension-bearing wood dowels.

Hazard: As long as the four villagers remain relatively still, they’ll be safe at the heart of this hazard. In order for them to escape, the PCs must disarm the trap the jinkins built, otherwise the commoners are likely to come to harm.

Reward: The PCs gain 20 XP for each surviving reveler, and 1 Reputation Point with Northridge if all four survive.

Clash at the Clinic.name: 诊所冲突 Clash at the Clinic
Clash at the Clinic.text:
A2. 诊所冲突 Low 1

柳岸镇唯一的诊所——春之手（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w27thehandof00]{W27}）——已经成了一个临时避难所，收容那些不属于任一派系的镇民。有些人来到这里是因为受了伤，比如井川十兵卫（来自慈母之环的法师学徒，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w28mothersco00]{W28}）和霍天哲（来自第二佳作坊的工匠，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w26secondbes00]{W26}）。十兵卫在逃离一台蹑影小魔怪装置时严重扭伤了脚踝，而天哲则因一次炼金爆炸反噬而留下了一大片烧伤。

使用春之手的地图来进行这场遭遇。当PC接近时（区域 A2a），可以明显听见嘶嘶声、低吼声，以及战斗的砰砰声从庭院（区域 A2b）传来。透过将庭院与外侧小路隔开的木格栅，他们能清楚看见数只巨蜈蚣正在攻击一只人类大小的幽灵壁虎。

A2. 诊所冲突 Low 1

@UUID[Actor.pPxs70qB838Wn1YC]{巨蜈蚣 (3)} @UUID[Actor.DOL44mzpaqGxmhLn]{魅影壁虎}

生物：尽管达米医生已有所防范，巨蜈蚣还是被吸引到了这一带。这只幽灵壁虎，是长期守护诊所的一位守护灵的显现。当PC接近时，壁虎正竭力对付两只蜈蚣，但另外三只会在他们一靠近时便从格栅的缝隙中爬出，攻击PC（位于区域 A2a）。

这些蜈蚣会战斗至死。尽管魅影壁虎本身并不是灌注于心景中的邪恶的显现，它仍会将PC视为潜在的入侵者。一旦PC击败了在A2a区域攻击他们的三只蜈蚣，壁虎就会在A2b区域解决掉最后那只蜈蚣，然后试图以挫败士气来威吓PC。它不会主动发起攻击，而在最后一只蜈蚣被杀死后1轮，达米医生会从西侧建筑（区域A2c）中浮现，脱口喊道：“别杀它！”希望能阻止PC攻击魅影壁虎。如果在所有蜈蚣都被杀死后，PC有整整1轮没有采取任何敌对动作，魅影壁虎便会渐渐消失，返回以太位面。

与医生交谈： @UUID[Actor.6BT2JpPWi2191MLF]{达米的感谢} @UUID[Actor.ogwwP9izSObpJFqv]{达米的额外致谢} @UUID[Actor.zSekgt0ROU35Tf3Y]{达米的毒素}
如果PC帮助击败巨蜈蚣，达米医生会给他们两瓶次级解毒剂以示感谢。如果他们还设法让壁虎免于被杀，他还会额外送上一瓶次等黑暗视觉灵药。他手头还有五瓶次等黑暗视觉灵药；如果PC有兴趣，还可以向他购买或以物易物换取更多。只要怪物还在城镇里，他还愿意在PC来诊所时免费为他们治疗伤口。

如果PC提到他们打算重新点亮长明灯，达米医生就会向他们开放自己供奉齐仲的圣祠（区域 A2d），让他们去寻求这位神祇的祝福。另外，十兵卫会告诉PC，慈母之环中有一座供奉安贾尔的莲华天女的圣龛（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w28mothersco00]{W28}）。

至于胡婆婆对他安全的担忧，达米医生只是挥了挥手，不以为意，表示自己对她的姿态与政治盘算毫无兴趣。尽管遭到了蜈蚣袭击，他依然觉得自己的诊所很安全，并拒绝离开这里，还指出转移伤员可能弊大于利。如果PC真想帮忙，就该致力于夺回柳岸镇。

最后，如果PC提到要用毒药或药物对付晨步桥上的独眼怪，达米医生会阴沉地点点头，承认自己能帮上忙，尽管他也明确表示自己平时并不赞成下毒。他会提供PC一剂昏睡毒素，并警告他们务必小心，只能把它用在那个怪物身上（他平时会少量备着这种毒素，用来安抚那些剧痛难忍的病人）。

奖励：如果PC让魅影壁虎活了下来，他们会获得如同击败它一样的全部XP。

A2. Clash at the Clinic Low 1

Willowshore’s only clinic, the Hand of Spring (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w27thehandof00]{W27}), has become an impromptu haven for townsfolk who are unaffiliated with either faction. Some, such as Igawa Jubei (a wizard’s apprentice from Mother’s Coil, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w28mothersco00]{W28}) and Huo Tian-Zhe (a tinkerer from Second Best, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w26secondbes00]{W26}) are here due to injuries. Jubei badly sprained her ankle escaping from a jinkin contraption, while Tian-Zhe sports a large burn wound from a backfired alchemical explosion.

Use the map for Hand of Spring to play out this encounter. As the PCs approach (area A2a), sounds of hissing, growling, and the thumping of a battle are apparent, coming from the courtyard (area A2b). They can plainly see several giant centipedes attacking a ghostly gecko the size of a human by peering through the wooden lattice separating the courtyard from the exterior path.

A2. Clash at the Clinic Low 1

@UUID[Actor.pPxs70qB838Wn1YC]{Giant Centipede (3)} @UUID[Actor.DOL44mzpaqGxmhLn]{Phantom Gecko}

Creatures: Despite Doctor Dami’s precautions, giant centipedes have been attracted to the area. The ghostly gecko is the manifestation of a guardian spirit that has long protected the clinic. As the PCs approach, the gecko does its best against two centipedes, but three more clamber through gaps in the lattice to attack the PCs as soon as they approach (at area A2a).

The centipedes fight to the death. While the phantom gecko itself isn’t a manifestation of the evil infusing the mindscape, it still regards the PCs as potential intruders. Once the PCs defeat the three centipedes that attack them in area A2a, the gecko finishes off its last centipede in area A2b and then threatens the PCs by attempting to Demoralize them. It doesn’t initiate an attack, and one round after the last centipede is slain, Doctor Dami emerges from the western building (area A2c) and blurts out, “Don’t kill it!” with the hope of preventing the PCs from attacking the phantom gecko. If a round passes without any hostile action from the PCs after all the centipedes have been slain, the phantom gecko fades back into the Ethereal Plane.

Speaking to the Doctor: @UUID[Actor.6BT2JpPWi2191MLF]{Dami's Thanks} @UUID[Actor.ogwwP9izSObpJFqv]{Dami's Extra Thanks} @UUID[Actor.zSekgt0ROU35Tf3Y]{Dami's Poison}
If the PCs help defeat the centipedes, Doctor Dami gives them two lesser antidotes in thanks. If they managed to spare the gecko from being killed as well, he also gives them a lesser darkvision elixir. He has five more vials of lesser darkvision elixirs, should the PCs be interested in buying or bartering for more. He also offers to use Treat Wounds on the PCs whenever they come to the clinic at no cost, so long as the monsters are still in town.

If the PCs mention their intention to relight the Eternal Lantern, Doctor Dami opens his shrine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.giAsBYiL2omr0x2L]{Qi Zhong} (area A2d) for them to seek the god’s blessing. Also, Jubei informs the PCs about the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.gsFaxWHbZmc1moY6]{Nalinivati} shrine in Mother’s Coil (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w28mothersco00]{W28}).

As for Granny Hu’s concerns for his safety, Doctor Dami dismisses that concern with a wave of the hand, noting his disinterest in her posturing and politics. Despite the centipede attack, he still feels safe in his clinic and refuses to abandon it, noting that moving the wounded may do them more harm than good. If the PCs really want to help, they should work toward reclaiming Willowshore.

Finally, if the PCs mention a plan to poison or drug the buso at Dawnstep Bridge, Doctor Dami nods grimly and admits he can help, although he makes it clear that he doesn’t normally condone poisoning. He supplies the PCs with a dose of lethargy poison, warning them to be careful with it and to use it only against the monster (he keeps this small supply of the poison on hand to soothe patients who are in great pain).

Reward: If the PCs let the phantom gecko live, they receive full XP as if they defeated it.

The Trapped Hunter.name: 被困的猎人 The Trapped Hunter
The Trapped Hunter.text:
A1. 被困的猎人 严重 1

如果玩家角色同意去寻找一位银雾旅舍成员，转达松木老人希望猎人尽快追踪丑萌的请求，那么玩家角色需要在南岸花费1小时进行搜寻；之后，每位参与搜寻的玩家角色都可以尝试一次 @Check[perception|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 或一次 @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定。若成功，他们会找到一处小农庄，那里正发生着一场古怪的骚动。

生物：一对名叫青与紫的蹑影小魔怪，再加上两只心怀恶意的动物（一只名叫面条的鼬鼠和一只名叫麻雀的渡鸦），困住了一位银雾猎人——一名叫澄香的女性。她被这些生物的声音诱骗来调查这座农庄，把它们误听成了哭泣的孩子。在被小魔怪们于农舍西南侧公共房间中布置的弹射矛陷阱重创后，澄香爬进了卧室（区域 A1a）并把门堵住了。

这四个家伙现在正聚集在西南建筑的入口附近，对澄香高声嘲弄。“蓝如破晓！紫而神妙！快如幼鹿！合在一起，我们就是算盘姐妹！”两只蹑影小魔怪叫喊道。它们那荒唐的押韵一结束，便爆发出一阵咯咯怪笑，这时面条补充道：“意思就是，我们是来偷光你所有牛的！”麻雀则停在入口上方的屋顶上，用尖细的声音冲着澄香叫唤，仿佛在引诱一只被困住的猫出来似的：“来呀，小猫咪，小猫咪！快出来拿点好吃的！”

这四个爱恶作剧的折磨者对和玩家角色战斗其实并没有太大兴趣。相反，它们想通过强行带走动物来“结交朋友”，并把澄香误认为是这座农庄的牧场主。若有任何玩家角色拥有动物伙伴、魔宠、坐骑或幻灵，这群家伙就会盯上其中看起来最强大的那个，一边用显然不可信的食物承诺，一边公然威胁，试图让那只动物加入它们。

A1. 被困的猎人 严重 1

@UUID[Actor.VLVw77FyEkhBM3og]{Midori} @UUID[Actor.oBy8cJvJblCMd8xW]{Murasaki} @UUID[Actor.Uwfc3kP631bILlPx]{Noodles} @UUID[Actor.7iu3BpmtW0fFAoUu]{Sparrow} @UUID[Actor.1or0C3ZqZm9dC54P]{Sumika}

虽然玩家角色当然可以和算盘姐妹开战，但这是一次危险的遭遇。如果某位玩家角色在攻击前先向这四个家伙喊话，这群古怪的家伙会高兴地咯咯大笑。青朝队伍假模假样地敬了个礼，紫则说道：“哦！所以你们是一群挺爱说话的家伙喽？觉得自己有本事在和算盘姐妹的比拼里胜出吗？”麻雀也尖声挖苦道：“我看未必！我看未必！未必吧，你说呢？”一旦明显有访客到来，澄香就会撑起身子，从房间窗户往外看，在轻轻挥手吸引玩家角色注意后，用口型朝他们说道“救救我！”

虽然直接攻击这些折磨者当然能帮助澄香脱身，但玩家角色也可以改而与算盘姐妹进行一场“机智之战”。允许玩家进行任何他们想进行的交谈，然后让他们各自依意愿尝试一次 @Check[deception|dc:13]、@Check[diplomacy|dc:13] 或 @Check[intimidation|dc:13] 检定。若超过半数的玩家角色成功，他们就能让算盘姐妹陷入困惑并分散其注意力。你还应允许每位玩家角色尝试一次秘密的 @Check[society|dc:17|traits:secret] 或 @Check[farming-lore|dc:15|traits:secret] 检定，以意识到这四个家伙犯了个错误——如果他们指出，意为“盗牛贼”的词是“abactor”，而不是“abacus”，这四个家伙会立刻因此陷入拌嘴与争吵之中，让玩家角色自动赢得这场机智之战。

如果玩家角色成功分散了算盘姐妹的注意力，澄香就能从窗户爬出来，一瘸一拐地逃往安全处。玩家角色随后可以跟上她，把那群还在拌嘴的生物抛在后面，趁它们来不及发动攻击前离开。否则，算盘姐妹会逐渐不耐烦，并决定攻击玩家角色。在战斗中，每个成员若生命值降到4点以下，都会惊恐地尖叫并逃命。

若青和紫在此次遭遇中存活下来，她们（可能还会带上面条）或许会在之后再次登场；见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog06thewal.JournalEntryPage.06e13guesthous00]{E13}。

营救猎人： @UUID[Actor.2JY79N5rcJU8e8I8]{澄香的感谢}
获救后，澄香会以足够制作两个缚灵陷阱的补给作为谢礼，外加可用于制作另外两个由玩家角色自选的1级普通陷阱的材料。如果她得知点亮长明灯的计划，她会建议玩家角色前往银雾最西侧猎人旅舍中的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.wjXNXFWBLbJaeZQR]{克忒菲斯} 圣祠（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w7silvermist00]{W7a}）。

如果玩家角色转达松木老人希望猎人们去寻找丑萌的请求，澄香会点头表示理解，并承诺很快就会把这个消息传达给她的同伴。如果玩家角色提供治疗，澄香有信心能自行安全返回松木宅邸，但如果玩家角色提出护送她，她也不会拒绝。

奖励：无论玩家角色以何种方式解决这次遭遇，都应给予他们如同在战斗中击败算盘姐妹一样的完整XP奖励。

A1. The Trapped Hunter Severe 1

If the PCs agree to seek out a Silvermist lodge member to deliver Old Matsuki’s request for a hunter to track Ugly Cute when possible, the PCs will need to spend an hour Searching in Southbank, after which each PC who took part in the Search can attempt a @Check[perception|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] or a @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check. On a success, they find their way to a small farm where a strange commotion is taking place.

Creatures: A pair of jinkins by the names of Midori and Murasaki, plus two mean-spirited animals (a weasel named Noodles and a raven named Sparrow), have trapped one of the Silvermist hunters, a woman named Sumika. She was tricked into investigating this farm by the creatures’ voices, which she mistook for crying children. After being critically wounded by a spring-loaded spear trap the gremlins rigged in the farmhouse’s southwest communal room, Sumika crawled into the bedroom (area A1a) and barricaded the door.

The four are now gathered near the entrance to the southwest building, calling out taunts to Sumika. “Blue like the dawn! Purple and miraculous! Swift like a fawn! Together, we are the Abacus Sisters!” cry out the two jinkins. As their nonsense rhyme concludes and they fall into a fit of cackling, Noodles elaborates, “That means we’re here to steal all your cattle!” Sparrow remains perched on the roof above the entrance, calling out to Sumika as if trying to lure out a trapped cat with a high-pitched, “Here, kitty, kitty! Come on out and get a treat!”

These four mischievous tormentors aren’t particularly interested in fighting the PCs. Rather, they seek to “befriend” animals by taking them by force and have mistaken Sumika for this farm’s rancher. If any PCs have a companion animal, familiar, mount, or eidolon, the group fixates on the most powerful-looking of them, using a combination of obviously untrustworthy promises of food and outright threats to try to get the animal to join them.

A1. The Trapped Hunter Severe 1

@UUID[Actor.VLVw77FyEkhBM3og]{Midori} @UUID[Actor.oBy8cJvJblCMd8xW]{Murasaki} @UUID[Actor.Uwfc3kP631bILlPx]{Noodles} @UUID[Actor.7iu3BpmtW0fFAoUu]{Sparrow} @UUID[Actor.1or0C3ZqZm9dC54P]{Sumika}

While the PCs can certainly fight the Abacus Sisters, this is a dangerous encounter. If instead a PC calls out to the four before attacking, the strange group cackles in delight. Midori gives the party a mock salute, and Murasaki says, “Oh! So you’re a chatty bunch then? Think you’ve got the wits to win out against the Abacus Sisters?” Sparrow chirps out a snarky, “I doubt it! I do! I doubt it! Don’t you?” Once it becomes obvious there are visitors, Sumika leans up to peer out of a window in the room and mouths the words “Help me!” to the PCs after waving a hand to quietly attract their attention.

While attacking the tormentors can certainly help Sumika make her escape, the PCs can instead engage with the Abacus Sisters in a “battle of wits.” Allow the players to engage in any sort of conversation they wish, then have each of them attempt a @Check[deception|dc:13], @Check[diplomacy|dc:13], or @Check[intimidation|dc:13] check, as they see fit. If more than half of the PCs are successful, they confuse and distract the Abacus Sisters. You should also allow each PC to attempt a secret @Check[society|dc:17|traits:secret] or a @Check[farming-lore|dc:15|traits:secret] check to realize a mistake the four made—if they point out that the word “abactor” is the one that means “one who steals cattle,” not “abacus,” the four immediately fall to bickering and arguing among themselves about the revelation, allowing the PCs to automatically win the battle of wits.

If the PCs manage to distract the Abacus Sisters, Sumika can clamber out through the window to limp away to safety. The PCs can then follow, leaving the bickering creatures behind before they can attack. Otherwise, the Abacus Sisters grow impatient and decide to attack the PCs. In combat, each member squeals in fear if reduced to fewer than 4 Hit Points and flees for their life.

If Midori and Murasaki survive this encounter, they (potentially along with Noodles) might be encountered again later; see area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog06thewal.JournalEntryPage.06e13guesthous00]{E13}.

Rescuing the Hunter: @UUID[Actor.2JY79N5rcJU8e8I8]{Sumika's Thanks}
Once rescued, Sumika thanks the PCs with enough supplies to craft two spirit traps along with additional materials to craft two other common 1st-level snares of the PCs’ choice. If she learns about the plan to light the Eternal Lantern, she suggests the PCs visit the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.wjXNXFWBLbJaeZQR]{Ketephys} shrine at the westernmost Silvermist hunting lodge (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w7silvermist00]{W7a}).

If the PCs convey Old Matsuki’s request that the hunters seek out Ugly Cute, Sumika nods in understanding and promises to deliver that information to her allies soon. If the PCs provide healing, Sumika is confident that she can make her way back to the Matsuki estate safely on her own but won’t turn down an offer by the PCs to escort her.

Reward: Reward the PCs full XP as if they defeated the Abacus Sisters in combat, no matter how they resolve this encounter.

First Missions.name: 首次任务 First Missions
First Missions.text:
首次任务

在PC们着手处理更重大的任务——对付柳岸镇镇区的那些生物，或设法重新点亮长明灯——之前，镇上的长老们为他们准备了以下任务，供他们尝试完成。

First Missions

Before the PCs get to the larger task of confronting the creatures in downtown Willowshore or seeking to relight the Eternal Lantern, the town’s elders have the following missions for them to attempt.

Additional Requests.name: 额外请求 Additional Requests
Additional Requests.text:
额外请求

胡婆婆的首要目标是夺回镇区的营房，以取回其中的军械库，但她相信自己的女婿、现任守卫队长郑鹏，能够独自支撑上一周。因此，只有在玩家角色赶在她之前抵达并解放营房时，她才会提及这项任务。

虽然她勉强承认松木老人交给玩家角色的任务很重要，但她觉得还有其他事情更加紧迫。胡婆婆请求玩家角色先帮助处理以下事项，再去管阿寿的任务。

查看医生的情况：尽管胡婆婆邀请达米汉西格·马巴邦洛布医生（简称“达米医生”）到她所在的贸易栈来，医生还是拒绝放弃自己的诊所——春之手。作为柳岸镇唯一的医生，胡婆婆想确保等这一切结束后，村子里仍然有一位医者——而如果她还能亲自为医生的安全承担一部分责任，那就更好了（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03a2clashatthe00]{诊所冲突}）。

失踪的孙辈：从更私人的层面来说，胡婆婆正担心自己几个失踪的孙辈。有人最后一次见到他们，是在重演节当晚，他们正前往蘑菇屋附近北边的晾晒场（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w32themushro00]{W32}）。胡婆婆猜想，他们当时是在那里举办自己的私人聚会，结果不知怎么就没法回家了（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03theworstpuzz00]{最糟糕的谜题}）。

奖励：玩家角色与胡婆婆接触后，给予他们 40 XP。

Additional Requests

Granny Hu’s primary objective is to retake the downtown barracks for its armory, but she trusts her son-in-law and current guard captain, Zheng Peng, to be able to hold his own for a week. Therefore, she only mentions this quest to the PCs if they manage to reach and liberate the barracks before she does.

While she begrudgingly agrees that the missions given to the PCs by Old Matsuki are important, there are other tasks that she feels are more pressing. Granny Hu asks the PCs to help with the following first before they look to Shou’s tasks.

Checking the Doctor: Despite Granny Hu’s invitation to Dr. Damihansig Mababangloob (“Doctor Dami” for short) to join her at the trade office, the doctor refused to abandon his clinic, the Hand Of Spring. Being the only doctor in Willowshore, Granny Hu wants to ensure that when this is all over, the village still has a physician—and if she can personally claim some of the responsibility for the doctor’s safety, so much the better (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03a2clashatthe00]{Clash at the Clinic}).

Missing Grandchildren: On a more personal level, Granny Hu is worried about some of her missing grandchildren. They were last seen heading toward the northern drying yards near the Mushroom House (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w32themushro00]{W32}) on the evening of the Reenactment Festival. Granny Hu speculates they hosted their own private party there and somehow ended up unable to return home (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03theworstpuzz00]{The Worst Puzzle}).

Reward: Grant the PCs 40 XP for making contact with Granny Hu.

Meeting Granny Hu.name: 会见胡太婆 Meeting Granny Hu
Meeting Granny Hu.text:
会见胡太婆

新的贸易栈（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w29tradeoffi00]{W29}）确实就是@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21grannyhubann00]{胡婆婆}和大多数北岭难民逃去的地方。附近有几座仓库已经改成了供本地居民暂住的临时避难所，但PC与之交谈的每个人都会把他们指去这座贸易栈，这里名叫木棉河-杜月江瓦市。

场景注释氛围

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.s74EKIg52mIxhfNp]{室内}

在贸易栈里，胡婆婆正仔细审视着一张柳岸镇地图，用一套并用八步棋的棋子标记怪物目击地点，以及人们可能受困的位置。PC们的到来让她和她目前的得力助手——@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AIcDyoff265z9285]{国府幸}牧师金久元——都大吃一惊。胡婆婆追问PC们是怎么渡河的，担心他们可能被迫与怪物做了交易。等PC们解释完后，胡婆婆摇着头轻笑，笑这支队伍鲁莽却勇武。她让他们坐下，向她讲讲一路上的经历，同时装作关心南边那些乡亲的情况。

胡婆婆虽然很不情愿，却也不得不同意松木老人关于接下来必须采取的三个最重要步骤；但如果PC们先来找她，她会主动热切地提出以下任务，并给出略有不同的建议。

入侵的怪物：胡婆婆听说过一些传闻，说入侵柳岸镇的怪物的“头脑”是某个（或某种）名叫莫斗秋的存在。她认为对方要么是拥有异能的人类，要么是某种类人的妖怪。她觉得北岭更能自给自足，因此在她看来，恢复晨步桥的通行，不如击败那些如今控制着柳岸镇镇区的生物来得重要。

丑萌：胡婆婆的确从一些幸存者那里听说，那尊蜘蛛石像失踪了，但她觉得石像“自己醒了过来”这种说法只是荒唐的迷信。如果真有原因，她怀疑这尊石像可能是被魔法赋予了行动能力，或者也许是闹鬼了。由于它为何能移动的源头尚不清楚，她警告大家不要想当然地认定丑萌是友善的，不过她也不认为这是什么必须优先处理的重大威胁。

未点亮的提灯：胡婆婆虽然只模糊知道一些关于长明灯的传说，但久元可以讲述智惠大师如何用受@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AlL9GtlTldbqNoVm]{卡莉丝翠雅}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AIcDyoff265z9285]{国府幸}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.gxwmzxUWBOhdgFSN]{希琳}祝福过的钱币点亮提灯，并建议去寻找她们的圣祠祈求祝福，也许会是最好的策略。

Meeting Granny Hu

The new trade office (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w29tradeoffi00]{W29}) is indeed where @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21grannyhubann00]{Granny Hu} and most of Northridge’s refugees have fled to. Several of the nearby warehouses have been converted into temporary shelters for locals, but everyone the PCs speak to directs them to the trade office, called the Ceiba-Duyue Exchange.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.s74EKIg52mIxhfNp]{Indoors}

At the trade office, Granny Hu scrutinizes a map of Willowshore, using game pieces from an Eight Paces set to mark where monsters have been sighted and where people might be trapped. The PCs’ arrival comes as quite a shock to her and her current right-hand aide, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AIcDyoff265z9285]{Kofusachi} cleric Kim Gu-won. Granny Hu questions how the PCs managed to cross the river, fearing they might have been forced to strike a bargain with the monsters. Once the PCs explain, Granny Hu shakes her head and chuckles at the party’s foolish bravery. She asks them to sit and update her on what they’ve been through, feigning concern for the folks in the south.

Granny Hu is forced to reluctantly agree with Old Matsuki about the three most important steps that must be taken next, but if the PCs come to her first, she eagerly suggests the following tasks on her own, providing somewhat different advice.

The Invading Monsters: Granny Hu has heard rumors that the “brain” of the monsters that invaded Willowshore is someone (or something) named Mo Douqiu. She believes he might either be a human with occult powers or some sort of human-like yokai. She sees Northridge as being more self-sufficient, and restoring access to Dawnstep Bridge is, to her, less important than defeating the creatures that now control downtown Willowshore.

Ugly Cute: Granny Hu did hear from some survivors that the spider statue has gone missing, but she finds the idea of the stone statue “waking up on its own” to be ridiculous superstition. If anything, she suspects the statue might have been animated by magic, or perhaps it has become haunted. Since the source of its mobility is unknown, she warns against assumptions that Ugly Cute is friendly, though she doesn’t see it as a foremost threat that needs to be handled.

The Unlit Lantern: While Granny Hu only vaguely knows the legend of the Eternal Lantern, Gu-won can recount how Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} lit the lantern with coins blessed by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AlL9GtlTldbqNoVm]{Calistria}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.AIcDyoff265z9285]{Kofusachi}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.gxwmzxUWBOhdgFSN]{Shelyn} and suggests that seeking their shrines for blessings might be the best tactic.

Crossing the Water.name: 渡水 Crossing the Water
Crossing the Water.text:
渡水 Moderate 1

只要怪物仍控制着晨步桥（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w11dawnstepb00]{W11}），在北岭与南岸之间通行就相当棘手，因为木筏湖与木棉河的水域构成了显著阻碍。

木棉河：木棉河的水深在20到25英尺之间，两岸几乎没有浅滩——这一特点也使这条河历来非常适合运输木材。玩家角色可以通过成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] 检定游过河水，或乘坐划艇并通过载具操作检定横渡（见开拓者 GM Core 第212页，但请注意，载具操作检定大失败会导致船只倾覆并沉没）。务必提醒玩家有关肆季鬼志的第三条惯例——“附近有幽灵时，应避免进入水体。”在这里，进入水体既可能意味着亲自下水，也可能意味着尝试驾船过水。虽然这里并没有实际的游戏机制来支撑这种暗示性的危险，但你只需提醒玩家这个迷信，就能让他们对渡河感到些许不安与紧张。

柳岸镇大坝：这座大坝（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w18willowsho00]{W18}）目前是开启状态。角色可以花费10分钟，在任一岸边与大坝的机械装置交互，并成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:15] 或 @Check[engineering-lore|dc:13] 检定来将其关闭。每次尝试关闭（或开启）大坝时，都要进行一次遭遇的纯骰检定（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03randomencoun00]{随机遭遇}）；若大失败，则表示机械装置卡住，除非花上数日工作修理，否则无法再次开启或关闭。

大坝关闭后，东侧木棉河的水深会降至10英尺，游泳或驾驶船只的难度等级在2小时内减少5；此后，木筏湖的水位会上涨到足以漫过大坝泄洪道，水域便恢复到先前的深度与流速。若在此时开启大坝，河流深度会恢复正常，并使横渡它的相关检定在15分钟内增加5。

玩家角色也可以把大坝本身视为一座临时桥梁，但其表面湿滑且有狭窄地段，因此角色必须在紧张的5分钟横越过程中，成功通过五次 @Check[acrobatics|dc:17|traits:move,skill,action:balance|name:Balance] 检定才能保持平衡。

渡水 Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.vYxo1QtbmrQNTjc3]{攫握激流}

木筏湖：尽管木筏湖（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w17woodraftl00]{W17}）的水域较为平静（游泳和驾驶船只的检定减少5），但死去镇民的尸体漂浮在水中，有些是怪物随意抛弃在此，更悲惨的则是惊惧之人试图渡水失败后的结果。这些死亡，再加上诡异薄雾与猩红月光的影响，导致湖泊变得闹鬼。在长明灯点亮之前，任何试图横渡湖泊的行为都会触发以下危害。

寻找船只

在晨步桥上的独眼怪被击败之前，划艇或许是横渡木棉河最安全的方式，但在南岸寻找一艘并不容易，因为大多数与船运相关的城镇基础设施都位于河北岸。更糟的是，镇上许多划艇都已被具有破坏性的蹑影小魔怪损坏。角色若沿着南岸搜索10分钟，并成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:13|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定，就能找到一艘破损的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.vehicles.Actor.l0RfYgabnbNoHnkS]{划艇}；若大成功，则能找到一艘完好的划艇。

更大的船只和驳船停泊在北岸各处，但这些载具可能超出了低等级队伍的驾驶能力。幸运的是，角色只要花10分钟搜索，就能在河北岸自动找到一艘可用的划艇。

载具规则见开拓者 GM Core（第210–213页）。

Crossing the Water Moderate 1

As long as monsters retain control of Dawnstep Bridge (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w11dawnstepb00]{W11}), traveling between Northridge and Southbank is tricky, as the waters of Woodraft Lake and the Ceiba River present a significant barrier.

Ceiba River: The Ceiba River varies between 20 and 25 feet deep with very little shallows along either shore—a feature that traditionally made the river very well suited for the transport of lumber. A PC can Swim the river’s waters with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] check or cross in a rowboat via Piloting checks (see page 212 in Pathfinder GM Core, but note that a critical failure on a Piloting check results in a capsize and the boat sinking). Make sure to remind the players of the third practice of the season of ghosts—that one should “avoid entering bodies of water when a ghost is nearby.” In this case, entering a body of water could mean physically entering it or even attempting to pilot a boat across water. While there are no game mechanics in play to back up this implied danger, you can make your players a bit uneasy and nervous about crossing the river simply by reminding them of this superstition.

Willowshore Dam: The dam (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w18willowsho00]{W18}) is currently open. A character can close it as a 10-minute activity to Interact with the dam’s mechanisms on either shore by succeeding at a @Check[athletics|dc:15] or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:13] check. Each attempt to close (or open) the dam incurs a flat check for an encounter (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03randomencoun00]{Random Encounters}), and a critical failure indicates the mechanism has become stuck and can’t be opened or closed again until it’s repaired with several days of work.

Once the dam is closed, the waters of the Ceiba River to the east lower to a depth of 10 feet, and the DC to Swim or Pilot a boat is reduced by 5 for 2 hours, after which the water level of Woodraft Lake rises enough to drain over the dam’s spillways, reverting the waters to their former depth and speed. Opening the dam at this point increases the river depth back to normal and increases checks to cross it by 5 for 15 minutes.

A PC can treat the dam itself as an improvised bridge, but its slick surface and narrow spots mean that to do so requires that PC to succeed at five @Check[acrobatics|dc:17|traits:move,skill,action:balance|name:Balance] checks to balance during an intense 5-minute crossing.

Crossing the Waters Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.vYxo1QtbmrQNTjc3]{Grasping Currents}

Woodraft Lake: While the waters of Woodraft Lake (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w17woodraftl00]{W17}) are calmer (reduce checks to Swim and Pilot by 5), the bodies of dead townsfolk float in the waters, either tossed here unceremoniously by monsters or, more tragically, the results of failed attempts by frightened people trying to cross the waters. These deaths, combined with the influence of the eerie mists and crimson moonlight, have caused the lake to become haunted. Any attempt to cross the lake before the Eternal Lantern is lit runs afoul of the following hazard.

Finding a Boat

Until the buso at Dawnstep Bridge is defeated, rowboats are perhaps the safest way to cross the Ceiba River, but finding one on the southern shoreline isn’t particularly easy since most of the urban infrastructure for boating exists along the river’s northern banks. Worse, many of the rowboats in town have been damaged by destructive jinkins. A character who Searches for 10 minutes along the southern bank and succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:13|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check can find a broken @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.vehicles.Actor.l0RfYgabnbNoHnkS]{Rowboat}, while with a critical success, they locate an undamaged rowboat.

Larger boats and barges are moored at various places along the northern shore, but these vehicles are likely beyond the capacity of a low-level party to pilot. Fortunately, characters can automatically find a functional rowboat on the river’s northern bank after taking 10 minutes to Search.

See Pathfinder GM Core for vehicle rules (pages 210–213).

Making Contact: Northridge.name: 建立联系：北岭人 Making Contact: Northridge
Making Contact: Northridge.text:
建立联系：北岭人

柳岸镇新建的贸易栈（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w29tradeoffi00]{W29}）及其仓库在数周前就已完工。再加上它们位于柳岸镇中心偏东、距离较远，因此成了极好的临时避难所。渔场（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w30fisheries00]{W30}）甚至连蘑菇房（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w32themushro00]{W32}）也都敞开大门，收容涌入的村民。与松木宅邸相比，聚集在贸易栈的难民较少，一方面是因为镇中心的非玩家角色被困住了，另一方面则是因为有些本地人刻意与胡婆婆保持距离；但与那些躲在贸易栈里的人取得联系，依然是从怪物手中夺回柳岸镇的重要一步。

Making Contact: Northridge

Willowshore’s new trade office (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w29tradeoffi00]{W29}) and its warehouses were completed weeks ago. This, plus the fact that they’re located a fair distance to the east of central Willowshore, makes them perfect makeshift shelters. The fisheries (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w30fisheries00]{W30}) and even the Mushroom House (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w32themushro00]{W32}) have also opened their doors to accommodate the influx of villagers. Compared to the Matsuki estate, there are fewer refugees at the trade office, both because the NPCs downtown are trapped and because several locals have intentionally distanced themselves from Granny Hu, but making contact with those holed up at the trade office is still an important step toward reclaiming Willowshore from the monsters.

Meeting Old Matsuki.name: 会见老松木 Meeting Old Matsuki
Meeting Old Matsuki.text:
会见老松木

松木宅邸里一片忙碌。许多房间都已清空，并改造成工坊、医疗站或宿舍。唯一相对平静的一角是在茶饭厅。这里，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21oldmatsukish00]{老松木}正与柳岸镇南部的其他几位重要人物同坐，耐心听取不断传来的各种报告。

场景笔记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.s74EKIg52mIxhfNp]{室内}

当他注意到PC们时，老松木暂停了当前的会谈，招呼PC们过去，并为众人准备了热食和饮料。趁着PC们休整时，老松木询问他们在森林中醒来后发生了什么。听完PC们讲述自己的经历后，他深表同情，并鼓励所有有家人失踪的人保持希望。如果PC们觉得自己家中已经不够安全，老松木也愿意提供住处。

待PC们稍微放松一些后，老松木请求他们协助夺回柳岸镇。具体来说，他提到了以下四个可由PC们处理的目标。至于这些任务的尝试顺序，则由PC们自行决定。

联系北岭：由于怪物盘踞在晨步桥上，前往北岭的便捷通路已经被切断。老松木承认自己与胡婆婆之间有些嫌隙，但与她建立联系并向北岭提供可用的协助仍然十分重要。若PC们觉得自己能够胜任，老松木建议他们去贸易栈寻找胡婆婆（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03makingcontac01]{建立联系：北岭人}）。

丑萌：老松木提到，有几名难民声称看见一只马一般大小、由石头构成的蜘蛛在迷雾中大步穿行；他相信柳岸镇的石之守护者已经苏醒，正为了保卫城镇而行动。PC们只要去确认那座失踪的雕像，便能验证这一推测。他原本打算招募来自银雾斋（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w7silvermist00]{W7}）的猎人去追踪丑萌，以便为这头守护野兽提供援助，但眼下那些猎人正忙于在街道上营救镇民。若PC们能联系上一位猎人，老松木请他们将这一消息转告对方（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03a1thetrapped00]{被困的猎人}）。

入侵的怪物：老松木警告PC们注意晨步桥上的独眼怪与蹑影小魔怪（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w11dawnstepb00]{W11}；见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03liberatingth00]{解放桥梁}）。他转述幸存者的报告称，蹑影小魔怪似乎害怕与独眼怪并肩作战，因此，直接挑战独眼怪，或是特意点名向它发起挑战，也许能让PC们在不必同时应付那些小魔怪的情况下击败这头怪物。他还指出，那头独眼怪似乎嗜酒如命；如果PC们认为自己能骗过这头怪物，就可以带着掺毒的酒作为献礼去接近它，好让战斗变得更容易。若PC们有意采取这一方案，老松木建议他们去春之手（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w27thehandof00]{W27}）走一趟（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03a2clashatthe00]{诊所冲突}）。

未点亮的提灯：老松木怀疑，影响柳岸镇的诡异天气，其根源与长明灯已经遁入幽暗这一事实有关。他知晓长明灯的历史，于是向PC们讲述了智惠大师最初如何用三枚受祝福的铜钱点燃长明灯的故事。为了重新点亮长明灯，并终结这诡异的迷雾与令人不安的猩红月光，PC们必须造访三座不同的圣祠，向三位神祇各奉上一枚铜钱，以获得祂们的祝福。老松木只需10分钟就能教会PC们如何进行祷告；他还会提供三枚铜钱，作为PC们献上的信物（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03blessingthec00]{祝福钱币}）。一旦PC们集齐三枚受祝福的钱币，就应立刻赶往晨步桥，重新点亮长明灯（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03lightthenigh00]{点亮夜晚}）。

柳岸镇镇区：最后，老松木很快便确认，夺回镇区当然同样非常重要，但他也警告PC们此时不要进入柳岸镇镇区，因为报告显示，城镇这一片区域已经尤其受到怪物侵扰。待上述四项任务完成后（尤其是在长明灯重新点亮之后），应对镇区的计划才能继续推进。

奖励：PC们与老松木建立联系后，授予他们40 XP。

Meeting Old Matsuki

The Matsuki estate is a blur of activity. Many rooms have been cleared and converted into workshops, medical stations, or sleeping quarters. The only pocket of relative calm is in the banquet hall. Here, sitting with other major figures of south Willowshore, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21oldmatsukish00]{Old Matsuki} listens patiently to all the reports coming in.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.s74EKIg52mIxhfNp]{Indoors}

When he notices the PCs, Old Matsuki pauses his current meeting and beckons the PCs to join him, providing warm food and drinks for the party. While the PCs recuperate, Old Matsuki asks them what happened after they woke up in the forest. After the PCs recount their experience, he is sympathetic and encourages anyone with missing family members to stay optimistic. He offers lodgings if the PCs feel their homes aren’t secure enough to stay in.

Once the PCs have had a chance to relax a bit, Old Matsuki asks for their help in retaking Willowshore. In particular, he mentions the following four topics as goals for the PCs to tackle. The order in which they attempt these quests is left to the PCs to decide.

Contacting Northridge: With monsters encamped on Dawnstep Bridge, easy access to Northridge is denied. Old Matsuki admits he has his differences with Granny Hu, but making contact with her and providing available aid to Northridge is important. If the PCs feel up to the task, Old Matsuki suggests seeking Granny Hu out at the trade office (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03makingcontac01]{Making Contact - Northridge}).

Ugly Cute: Old Matsuki notes that several refugees claim to have seen a horse-sized spider made of stone striding through the mist, and he believes Willowshore’s stone guardian has awakened to defend the town; the PCs can confirm this theory by reporting the missing statue. He plans on recruiting the hunters from the Silvermist Lodges (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w7silvermist00]{W7}) to track down Ugly Cute to provide aid to the guardian beast, but currently, the hunters are busy saving townsfolk in the streets. If the PCs can contact one of the hunters, Old Matsuki asks them to convey this information to them (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03a1thetrapped00]{The Trapped Hunter}).

The Invading Monsters: Old Matsuki warns the PCs about the buso and jinkins on Dawnstep Bridge (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w11dawnstepb00]{W11}; see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03liberatingth00]{Liberating the Bridge}). He shares survivor reports that the jinkins appear to be afraid of fighting beside the buso, and that directly confronting the buso or calling it out specifically for a challenge might be one way to defeat the monster without having to contend with the gremlins simultaneously. He also notes that the buso seems taken with drink, and he suggests that if the PCs think they can trick the monster, they could approach it with an offering of poisoned wine to make it easier to defeat. Old Matsuki suggests paying a visit to the Hand of Spring (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w27thehandof00]{W27}) if the PCs are interested in pursuing this option (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03a2clashatthe00]{Clash at the Clinic}).

The Unlit Lantern: Old Matsuki suspects that the cause of the strange weather affecting Willowshore is tied to the fact that the Eternal Lantern has gone dark. He knows the history of the Eternal Lantern and shares with the PCs the story of how Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} first lit the lantern using three blessed copper coins. To relight the lantern and bring an end to the strange mist and unsettling crimson moonlight, the PCs must obtain the blessing of three gods by visiting three different shrines and offering a copper coin to receive the blessing. It only takes 10 minutes for Old Matsuki to teach the PCs how to perform the prayer; he provides the PCs with three copper coins as tokens to offer (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03blessingthec00]{Blessing the Coins}). Once the PCs have three blessed coins, they should make haste to Dawnstep Bridge to relight the Eternal Lantern (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03lightthenigh00]{Light the Night}).

Downtown Willowshore: In closing, and while he’s quick to confirm that retaking downtown is very important, Old Matsuki warns the PCs against entering downtown Willowshore at this time, for reports indicate that this part of town has become particularly infested with monsters. Once the four tasks above have been accomplished (in particular, the lighting of the Eternal Lantern), plans for dealing with downtown can proceed.

Reward: Grant the PCs 40 XP for making contact with Old Matsuki.

Making Contact: Southbank.name: 建立联系：南岸 Making Contact: Southbank
Making Contact: Southbank.text:
建立联系：南岸

由于怪物入侵，南柳岸镇的许多镇民在黎明前撤到了松木宅邸（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w5matsukiest00]{W5}）或三福客栈（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w6thricebles00]{W6}）避难，只有在别无选择时，他们才会鼓起勇气前往自己的工坊和商店。因此，那些平时会在河流以南出现的大多数非玩家角色，通常都会在宅邸或客栈中躲避，直到长明灯被点亮为止。如果玩家没有想到要自行前往松木宅邸拜访，那么一位友方非玩家角色很快就该提出这个建议——或者你也可以直接让所有PC都尝试进行社群或柳岸镇学识检定，并将这个建议告诉掷骰结果最高的角色。

Making Contact: Southbank

Many of the townsfolk in South Willowshore retreated to the Matsuki estate (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w5matsukiest00]{W5}) or the Thrice-Blessed Inn (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w6thricebles00]{W6}) in the predawn hours due to the monstrous invasion, only braving their workshops and stores if they had no other choice. As a result, most NPCs who are usually found south of the river are generally sheltering at the estate or the inn until the Eternal Lantern is lit. If the players don’t think of paying a visit to the Matsuki estate on their own, an allied NPC should suggest it before long—or you can simply have the PCs all attempt Society or Willowshore Lore checks and give this suggestion to whichever character rolls highest.

Returning Home.name: 返回家园 Returning Home
Returning Home.text:
返回家园

一个或所有玩家角色都可能在城镇里有自己的家或家人，因此他们也许会感到担心，并希望回家确认一切是否安全。如果你的玩家在使用《肆季鬼志：玩家指南》，他们可能已经为自己的住处选好了对应的建筑。

你可以从任意你选择的地图中挑选建筑来代表玩家角色的家园；或者，你也可以自行设计地图，甚至请玩家协助绘制他们家中的地图。每个家中都有一项小危险在等待着——在柳岸镇的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03randomencoun00]{随机遭遇}表上掷 [[/r 1d12]]，以决定玩家角色在家中会面对什么（或者，你也可以直接从这些选项中挑选威胁，并根据每位玩家角色的背景在主题上进行搭配）。如果现场有朋友或家人存在，只要玩家角色能够解决家中的状况，他们就应当是安全的（不过可能会被危险吓得不轻）。

宝藏：玩家角色每造访一处家园，都可以找回一些物资——要么是该玩家角色留下的物品，要么是朋友或家人赠予的礼物。如果你在使用《肆季鬼志：玩家指南》，玩家在创建角色、并为自己在城镇中的住处作出选择时，就已经有机会从以下宝藏组选出一项。否则，你可以从下列列表中为玩家角色选择一项宝藏作为奖励，但除非队伍中有超过4名玩家角色，否则不要重复奖励。

  • @UUID[Actor.mmymLAkn6BxKfcv9]{第一之家}
    两瓶下等治疗药水，以及一件由该玩家角色自选、价值不超过 2 gp 的通用冒险道具。
  • @UUID[Actor.W9P30CgccOAZixkh]{第二个家}
    一枚可预测银币，以及一瓶含有1次剂量潜能油的小瓶。
  • @UUID[Actor.6kd0a00CZtadgAyn]{第三家园}
    一份制作警报陷阱的材料、10 sp，以及两个次级幽灵充能瓶。
  • @UUID[Actor.Q4C0JMv8PywRl3Rt]{第四家园}
    一块冷铁。

奖励：如果玩家角色造访了他们所有的家园，则授予他们10 XP。

Returning Home

One or all of the PCs might have homes or family in town, in which case they might be concerned and wish to return home to ensure all is safe. If your players are using the Season of Ghosts Player’s Guide, they might have already selected buildings for their homes.

Use buildings from any map of your choice to represent the PC’s homestead; alternatively, you can create maps of your own design or even recruit the aid of the players in creating maps of their homes. In each home, a minor peril awaits—roll [[/r 1d12]] on the Willowshore @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03randomencoun00]{Random Encounters} table to determine what the PCs face in their homes (alternatively, you can simply pick threats from these options, matching them thematically to each PC’s history). If any friends or family are present, they should be safe (but perhaps rattled by the danger), provided the PCs can solve the situation found within.

Treasure: For each home the PCs visit, they can recover some supplies—either items left behind by the PC, or gifts from friends or family. If you’re using the Season of Ghosts Player’s Guide, the players themselves will have had the chance to pick one of the following sets of treasure during character creation when they selected their homes in town. Otherwise, choose a treasure from the following list for the PCs as a reward, but don’t duplicate rewards unless there are more than 4 PCs in the party.

  • @UUID[Actor.mmymLAkn6BxKfcv9]{First Home}
    Two minor healing potions and one piece of common adventuring gear worth 2 gp or less of the PC’s choice.
  • @UUID[Actor.W9P30CgccOAZixkh]{Second Home}
    One predictable silver piece and a vial with one dose of oil of potency.
  • @UUID[Actor.6kd0a00CZtadgAyn]{Third Home}
    Supplies for an alarm snare, 10 sp, and two lesser ghost charges.
  • @UUID[Actor.Q4C0JMv8PywRl3Rt]{Fourth Home}
    One chunk of cold iron.

Reward: Grant the PCs 10 XP if they visit all of their homes.

Willowshore Features.name: 柳岸镇特征 Willowshore Features
Willowshore Features.text:
柳岸镇特征

柳岸镇的大多数门都是推拉门，只有户外厕所上的门例外（那些是带铰链的木门）。外部推拉门由实木制成，提供标准掩蔽，并且角色成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] 检定后即可强行打开。室内推拉门或房间隔断不提供掩蔽，但会提供隐蔽，并且角色成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:5|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] 检定后即可强行打开。你可以用一个交互动作在许多室内门的纸面上戳一个洞向内窥视，但你必须通过一次隐秘检定，才能不被另一侧的生物察觉。武器和弹药都能轻易穿透室内门。

Willowshore Features

Most doors in Willowshore are sliding doors, with the exception of those found on outhouses (which are hinged wooden doors). Exterior sliding doors are made of solid wood, grant standard cover, and can be Forced Open by a character who succeeds at a @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] check. Indoor sliding doors or room partitions provide no cover, do provide concealment, and can be Forced Open by a character who succeeds at a @Check[athletics|dc:5|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] check. You can poke a hole in the paper of many interior doors to peek inside as an Interact action, though you must pass a Stealth check to remain undetected by creatures on the other side. Weapons and ammunition can easily pierce through interior doors.

Random Encounters.name: 随机遭遇 Random Encounters
Random Encounters.text:
随机遭遇

玩家角色在城镇中以探索模式旅行时，每经过四到八小时一次（或如某个遭遇的文本所指示），进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:10] 检定。每有一名正在人耳目的玩家角色或正在侦察的玩家角色，此难度等级增加 1；但每有一名正在疾行或正在搜寻的玩家角色，此难度等级降低 2。随机遭遇出现的频率每日至多一次。

成功时，玩家角色会遇到一次随机遭遇。如果结果是魅影，但玩家角色在白天时身处户外，则视为没有遭遇。当玩家角色在夜晚旅行时，在柳岸镇随机遭遇表上掷骰时获得 +5 调整值，将高于 20 的结果按 20 处理。

与所有随机遭遇一样，你应避免使用过度——你希望这些遭遇帮助营造出城镇中不安全、令人不安的氛围，而不是让单纯从一个地方移动到另一个地方这件事变成一场折磨。每张游戏桌对这类额外遭遇的接受程度都不同，所以不要害怕调整这些遭遇的频率（甚至它们的威胁等级），以契合你们游戏的偏好。

一旦长明灯被点亮，这些随机遭遇便会结束。

d20 掷骰 遭遇 威胁
1–2 1 @UUID[Actor.y5YgKcEykcOKGQlP]{巨蟑螂} 微不足道 1
3–4 @UUID[Actor.FiB6WdhAjxuMWV05]{萦绕之灵} 微不足道 1
5–6 1 @UUID[Actor.G92kyODOgw9u6yGN]{蹑影小魔怪} 微不足道 1
7–8 1 @UUID[Actor.8asvo7Li4K4rfkW3]{蜘蛛群} 微不足道 1
9–10 @UUID[Actor.FiB6WdhAjxuMWV05]{萦绕之灵} 微不足道 1
11–12 @UUID[Actor.FiB6WdhAjxuMWV05]{萦绕之灵（2）} 低度 1
13–14 1 @UUID[Actor.G92kyODOgw9u6yGN]{蹑影小魔怪} 和 1 @UUID[Actor.kNZii0Kz5EclXOpy]{蝰蛇} 低度 1
15–16 3 @UUID[Actor.vrZuNziqZsQBmZVN]{魅影渡鸦} 低度 1
17–18 1 @UUID[Actor.2LKqnJCxIrW5Xy8s]{魅影野猪} 低度 1
19–20+ 2 @UUID[Actor.EhuhCIknwwTKScfv]{魅影狼} 中度 1

攻击性野生动物：巨蟑螂和蜘蛛群通常都很胆怯，但由于苦迦菩提不断增长的影响，这些生物变得更具攻击性，这些害虫会战斗至死。如同在 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03strangeaggre00]{奇异攻击性} 中一样，成功通过一次秘密的 @Check[nature|dc:15|traits:secret] 或 @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret] 检定的角色，会注意到这些生物竟如此暴力是多么反常。而且也如同那个遭遇中的蜈蚣一样，这些野生动物凶残且会说话——但它们说话基本只是为了发出威胁或嘲弄受害者；它们对真正的交谈毫无兴趣。

萦绕之灵：如果玩家角色同时遭遇两个萦绕之灵，那么会有两个不同的角色成为幽魂威胁的目标。

蹑影小魔怪：与这些小魔怪的遭遇，要么是单独一只蹑影小魔怪，要么是蹑影小魔怪和它们的宠物蝰蛇。蹑影小魔怪如果被削减到少于 5 生命值便会逃跑，但宠物蝰蛇会战斗至死。许多这样的蹑影小魔怪从当地居民那里偷来了普通物品，并以奇怪的方式把它们穿戴在身上，或者正在毁坏这些物品。在这场冒险中遭遇到的所有蹑影小魔怪都说通用语，而不是萨克伏洛斯语。

魅影：这些生物是玩家角色在冒险路径如此早期阶段最有可能面对的、最接近真正幽灵的存在。它们既是苦迦菩提影响的显现，也是柳岸镇集体恐惧的体现。因此，这些魅影可能会在某位玩家角色移开视线时呼唤其名字，或者在某位玩家角色进入一片水域时出现，又或者在某人胆敢于夜里吹口哨时现身。对玩家角色来说最重要的一点是：通过使用第一条习俗，并以友善的问候来对待这些魅影，玩家角色可以让它们失去力量，甚至消散形体。如果玩家角色在遭遇魅影后没有自行想到这个策略，则允许他们尝试一次秘密的 @Check[religion|dc:15|traits:secret] 或 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:secret] 检定来意识到这一战术。这些魅影呈现为真实动物的幽灵般、苍白绿色版本，但有着诡异发光的眼睛，并且会说通用语。遭遇到魅影时，它们比起战斗更热衷于恐吓玩家角色，而且在它们受到攻击之前，只会使用其先天异能法术或进行威吓检定来挫败士气。一旦魅影遭到攻击，它就会以近战打击还击。这些四处游荡的魅影无法追逐猎物进入建筑物，而且如果在任意一轮结束时，它们看不到街道上任何位于户外的有效目标，便会消失并返回以太位面。

Random Encounters

Once every four to eight hours as the PCs travel in town using exploration mode (or as directed in an encounter’s text), attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10] check. Each PC who’s Avoiding Notice or Scouting increases this DC by 1, but each PC who’s Hustling or Searching decreases the DC by 2. A random encounter should occur no more often than once per day.

On a success, the PCs come across a random encounter. If the result is a phantom but the PCs are outdoors during the day, treat it as no encounter. When the PCs are traveling at night, add a +5 modifier when rolling on the Willowshore Random Encounters table, treating results above 20 as a 20.

As with all random encounters, you should avoid overdoing them—you want these encounters to help establish that things are unsafe and unsettling in town, not turn the mere act of moving from one place to the next into a slog. Each table’s appetite for additional encounters like these will vary, so don’t be afraid to adjust the frequency of these encounters (or even their threat levels) to suit your game’s preferences.

These random encounters end once the Eternal Lantern has been lit.

d20 Roll Encounter Threat
1–2 1 @UUID[Actor.y5YgKcEykcOKGQlP]{Giant Cockroach} Trivial 1
3–4 @UUID[Actor.FiB6WdhAjxuMWV05]{Haunting Presence} Trivial 1
5–6 1 @UUID[Actor.G92kyODOgw9u6yGN]{Jinkin} Trivial 1
7–8 1 @UUID[Actor.8asvo7Li4K4rfkW3]{Spider Swarm} Trivial 1
9–10 @UUID[Actor.FiB6WdhAjxuMWV05]{Haunting Presence} Trivial 1
11–12 @UUID[Actor.FiB6WdhAjxuMWV05]{Haunting Presences (2)} Low 1
13–14 1 @UUID[Actor.G92kyODOgw9u6yGN]{Jinkin} and 1 @UUID[Actor.kNZii0Kz5EclXOpy]{Viper} Low 1
15–16 3 @UUID[Actor.vrZuNziqZsQBmZVN]{Phantom Ravens} Low 1
17–18 1 @UUID[Actor.2LKqnJCxIrW5Xy8s]{Phantom Boar} Low 1
19–20+ 2 @UUID[Actor.EhuhCIknwwTKScfv]{Phantom Wolves} Moderate 1

Aggressive Wildlife: Giant cockroaches or spider swarms are normally skittish, but these creatures have become more aggressive from Kugaptee’s growing influence, and these vermin fight to the death. As in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03strangeaggre00]{Strange Aggression}, a character who succeeds at a secret @Check[nature|dc:15|traits:secret] or @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret] check notes how strange it is for these creatures to be so violent. And as with the centipedes in that encounter, these wild animals are vicious and can speak—but do so mostly to issue threats or taunt their victims; they have no interest in actual conversations.

Haunting Presence: If the PCs encounter two haunting presences simultaneously, then two different characters are targeted by Ghostly Menace.

Jinkin: Encounters with these gremlins are either with a lone jinkin or with a jinkin and their pet viper. A jinkin flees if reduced to fewer than 5 Hit Points, but a pet viper fights to the death. Many of these jinkins have stolen mundane objects from locals and either wear them in strange ways or are in the process of destroying the object. All of the jinkins encountered in this adventure speak Common rather than Sakvroth.

Phantoms: These creatures are the closest thing to actual ghosts the PCs are likely to face this early in the Adventure Path. These are manifestations of Kugaptee’s influence as much as they are of Willowshore’s collective fears. As such, these phantoms might call out a PC’s name when they’re looking away, or might appear as the result of a PC entering a body of water or daring to whistle at night. The most important thing for the PCs to note is that by using the first practice and addressing these phantoms with friendly greetings, the PCs can cause them to lose their power and even discorporate. Allow the PCs to attempt a secret @Check[religion|dc:15|traits:secret] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:secret] check to realize this tactic if they don’t come up with it themselves after encountering a phantom. These phantoms appear as ghostly, pale green versions of the real animal, but have eerie glowing eyes and can speak Common. Phantoms, when encountered, are more eager to frighten the PCs than to fight, and until they’re attacked, they’ll only use their innate occult spells or Intimidation checks to Demoralize. Once a phantom is attacked, it fights back with its melee strikes. These wandering phantoms can’t pursue victims into buildings, and they vanish back into the Ethereal Plane at the end of any round in which they see no viable targets outside on the streets.

Back to Town.name: 返回城镇 Back to Town
Back to Town.text:
返回城镇

一旦玩家角色抵达柳岸镇，他们的目标应当是探索这座被怪物占据的城镇，积累资源与声望，并努力点亮长明灯，以抵消迷雾与月光的影响。

如果玩家需要指引，你可以让海儿请求他们护送她前往松木宅邸（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03makingcontac00]{建立联系：南岸}）或去找胡婆婆（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03makingcontac01]{建立联系：北岭人}）——无论选哪一处，都会让队伍接触到柳岸镇的两位长者之一。任何在镇上有家人、朋友或住处的玩家角色，也可能想回到那里——这种情况下请见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03returninghom00]{返回家园}。

玩家角色也可以自行开始探索柳岸镇镇区，但这片区域如今潜伏着大批入侵的怪物，最好还是先让玩家角色与其中一位长者建立联系。如果队伍坚持前往镇区，请转至 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{第2章}。虽然那里的遭遇更具挑战性，但仍然是为1级玩家角色平衡设计的。

Back to Town

Once the PCs reach Willowshore, their goal should be to explore the monster-infested town, build up their resources and reputation, and work toward lighting the Eternal Lantern so they can neutralize the effects of the mist and moonlight.

If the players need guidance, you can have Hai-er ask them to escort her to either the Matsuki estate (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03makingcontac00]{Making Contact - Southbank}) or to Granny Hu (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03makingcontac01]{Making Contact - Northridge})—either will put the party in contact with one of Willowshore’s two elders. Any PC who has family, friends, or a home in town might wish to return there as well—see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03returninghom00]{Returning Home} in this case.

The PCs can also begin exploring downtown Willowshore on their own, but this area is where the bulk of the invading monsters now lurk, and it’s best if the PCs first make contact with one of the elders. If the party persists in heading downtown, proceed to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{Chapter 2}. While encounters there are more challenging, they’re still balanced for 1st-level PCs.

Eastern Watchtower.name: 东侧瞭望塔 Eastern Watchtower
Eastern Watchtower.text:
东侧瞭望塔

从失踪的蜘蛛雕像处继续向西前行约一英里后，玩家角色抵达柳岸镇的东侧瞭望塔。空气中弥漫着血腥味，四具尸体横陈在地。两具属于城镇卫兵，他们的双腿肿胀，面容凝固着痛苦的表情。另外两具则看起来像是体型微小、蓝灰色皮肤的人形生物，长着尖牙和巨大的耳朵，似乎是被剑砍死的。

若一名玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[nature|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定来回忆知识，便能辨认出这两具微小人形尸体是蹑影小魔怪。任何检查那两名人类卫兵并成功通过一次 @Check[medicine|dc:13] 检定的角色，都会意识到他们死于腿部蛇咬注入的毒素。若一名玩家角色搜索该区域，便会在附近的草丛中发现两条死去的蝰蛇。

生物：在警卫塔上方，一名叫哈海儿的城镇卫兵设法逃过一死。她一见到玩家角色，就要求他们至少背出肆季鬼志中的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03easternwatch00#the-eight-practices]{八条戒律} 里的四条，以证明他们不是怪物伪装而成。这八条戒律列在下方边栏中，也收录于《肆季鬼志：玩家指南》。若你没有使用该指南，或玩家记不清这些戒律，角色可以通过成功的 @Check[religion|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]、@Check[society|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 或 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定来回忆知识，从而回想起随机掷出的两条戒律（大成功时为四条，失败时为一条，大失败则一条也想不起来）。玩家角色也可以通过成功的 @Check[diplomacy|dc:15|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] 检定对她留下印象，将她的态度从不友善至少转变为冷淡，从而让海儿放松下来。

八条戒律

柳岸镇的人民会在肆季鬼志期间遵守这八条信条。这些信念被视为抵御下等邪恶或爱恶作剧的精魂注意的防护，因此在初期也能用来对付困扰柳岸镇的魅影。不过，它们对队伍在后续冒险中将面对的更强大不死生物或真正的幽灵通常收效甚微，而任何知晓这些戒律的本地人或玩家角色也都会明白这一点。

1. 不要把幽灵叫作幽灵；如果非要称呼它们，也要用友善的问候。

2. 不要拍别人的头或肩膀。

3. 附近有幽灵时，避免进入水体之中。

4. 不要吃插着两根细棍状物的食物。

5. 白天不要倚靠墙壁。

6. 夜晚不要吹口哨。

7. 夜晚不要把洗好的衣物晾在外面。

8. 如果你在夜里听见身后有人叫你的名字，不要回头。

一旦她被说服，如果她的态度原本还没到冷淡，便会转变为冷淡；随后她会如释重负地从塔上爬下来迎接玩家角色。虽然她不认识他们中的任何人，但她显然记得昨天傍晚，春虎叔和他那群戴着鬼怪纸面具的同伴在重演节结束时，把玩家角色抬去了林地。她也证实，不久之后——恰好在她开始值守的时候——那群人从林地返回了，却没有带回玩家角色。直到午夜过后很久，那些“可怕的蓝色小怪物”才带着它们驯养的蛇，从南边的林地里冒出来。另外两名当值卫兵设法击败了那些生物，却随后死于蛇咬。自那以后，海儿就一直留在瞭望塔里，饱受恐惧与愧疚交织的折磨，而笼罩柳岸镇的浓雾更是让她愈发害怕。若之前没有玩家角色回忆起关于懒阿斗的那首童谣，她可以讲给他们听。

她警告玩家角色，镇子方向一直有尖叫、咆哮和其他可怕的声音在空中回荡，但自黎明起，一切就都归于寂静了。如果玩家角色告诉她丑萌的雕像不见了，她会难以置信。海儿更愿意继续留在塔里，“直到这诡异的雾散去”，并承诺如果发现任何危险就会敲响塔钟。若已经过去超过24小时，她的食物就所剩无几，并会动身前往镇里——她在这场遭遇中的命运由游戏主持决定。

在玩家角色离开瞭望塔前，海儿还有一些建议要告诉他们。

“回家去吧，去看看朋友和家人，确认大家都平安无事。如果不是这场雾，我也会这么做。法拉斯玛保佑我们，我希望我女儿没事。虽然我拜托了胡婆婆照看她，可我还是担心。还有我丈夫……希望他现在在松木宅邸里平安无事。那个地方几乎就是座堡垒！”

所有玩家角色都知道，“胡婆婆”指的是胡半娘，而松木宅邸则是寿的家——不过人们更常叫他“松木老人”。这两人分别是柳岸镇北岭和南岸派系的精神领袖。玩家角色可以邀请海儿加入他们，不过她起初会因为对周遭异变的恐惧，以及对岗位的责任感而有所抗拒。如果能让她的态度至少变为友善，她就会同意与玩家角色同行。她会鼓励他们去拜访胡婆婆（这样她也能确认自己女儿的情况）或前往松木宅邸（寻找她的丈夫）——若玩家角色在天黑前忽略了这两个选项之一，她就会自己动身去与女儿团聚。只要她与玩家角色同行，海儿就会用她的弩在战斗中提供支援；只有在弹药耗尽后，她才会靠近进行近战。若她的生命值降至6点以下，她就会陷入恐慌并逃跑，希望先找个安全的地方躲藏起来，然后再去寻找自己的女儿。一旦她与女儿或丈夫中的任何一人团聚，她便不再与玩家角色同行。

@UUID[Actor.PyCdl79pLeQbhSDg]{哈海儿} 生物 1

  • 人类
  • Humanoid

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.jlVLrlDxDn6eCo6C]{哈亥尔的补给品}
哈海儿会从瞭望塔中为队伍提供两件可能有用的下等魔法补给品——一件奇妙微缩梯和一枚闪耀弩箭。这里还存放着一小桶提灯油，如果玩家角色想去点亮丑萌那处废弃栖位东侧的提灯，也可以带上。

奖励：如果玩家角色与哈海儿成为朋友，则给予他们如同在战斗中击败哈海儿一样的 XP。若他们帮助她与家人团聚，则队伍获得北岭人声望与南岸声望各1声望点。

场景笔记声望追踪

@UUID[Actor.sOoLKv6nUesBfTyK]{点数追踪} @UUID[Item.ncrOOOY5hyJIX14r]{北岭人声望} @UUID[Item.JP2qia0jUHA0VTtK]{南岸声望}

将这些效果添加到点数追踪角色中，以追踪声望点。

Eastern Watchtower

After traveling about a mile further west from the missing spider statue, the PCs reach Willowshore’s eastern watchtower. The tang of blood fills the air, and four bodies lie sprawled on the ground. Two belong to town guards, their legs swollen and expressions of pain frozen on their faces. The other two bodies appear to be tiny blue-gray humanoids with sharp teeth and giant ears, seemingly slain by sword blows.

A PC who succeeds at a @Check[nature|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge identifies the two tiny humanoid bodies as jinkin gremlins. Any character who examines the two human guards and succeeds at a @Check[medicine|dc:13] check realizes they perished from poison delivered from snake bites to the legs. A PC who Searches the area reveals two dead vipers in the grass nearby.

Creatures: Up in the guard tower, a town guard named Ha Hai-er managed to escape death. When she sees the PCs, she demands they recite at least four of the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03easternwatch00#the-eight-practices]{Eight Practices} of the season of ghosts to prove they aren’t monsters in disguise. These eight practices are listed in the sidebar below and in the Season of Ghosts Player’s Guide. If you’re not using the guide, or if the players have trouble remembering the practices, a character can recall two randomly rolled practices with a successful @Check[religion|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge], @Check[society|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge], or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge (or four on a critical success, one on a failure, and none on a critical failure). A PC can also get Hai-er to relax by Making an Impression with a successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:15|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] check to shift her attitude from unfriendly to at least indifferent.

The Eight Practices

The people of Willowshore follow these eight tenets during the season of ghosts. These beliefs are held as protections against the attentions of minor evil or mischievous spirits and, as such, can be used against the phantoms that plague Willowshore early on. However, they’re generally ineffective against more powerful undead or actual ghosts the party will face in later adventures, and any local or PC who knows these practices would know this as well.

1. Do not call a ghost a ghost; instead, address them with friendly greetings if you must.

2. Do not pat people on the head or shoulders.

3. Avoid entering bodies of water when a ghost is nearby.

4. Do not eat food that has two stick-like objects protruding from it.

5. Do not lean against walls during the day.

6. Do not whistle at night.

7. Do not leave laundry out at night.

8. If you hear someone call your name from behind you at night, do not turn around.

Once she’s convinced, her attitude shifts to indifferent if it wasn’t there already, and she clambers down from the tower to greet the PCs with relief. While she doesn’t know any of them personally, she certainly remembers yesterday evening when Uncle Chung-hu and his crew in their ghostly paper masks carried the PCs out to the woods at the culmination of the Reenactment Festival. She also confirms they returned from the woods without the PCs a short time later, just at the beginning of her watch. It was well after midnight that those “horrible little blue monsters” came out of the woods to the south with their trained serpents. The other two guards on duty managed to defeat the creatures but then perished to snake bites. Hai-er has remained in the watchtower, plagued by a mix of fear and guilt ever since, and the dense fog that has descended on Willowshore frightens her all the more. If no PC recalled the rhyme about Lazy Adou earlier, she could share it with them.

She warns the PCs that screams, roars, and other frightening sounds have been echoing through the air from town, but that since dawn, things have been silent. She’s incredulous if the PCs tell her Ugly Cute’s statue is missing. Hai-er prefers to stay here in the tower “until this weird fog lifts,” and she promises to ring the tower bell if she spots any danger. If more than 24 hours have passed, she is running low on food and will make her way into town—her fate is left to the GM to determine in this encounter.

Hai-er has some advice for the PCs before they leave the watchtower.

“Go home, check on friends and family, make sure everyone is all right. That’s what I would do if not for this fog. Pharasma bless us, I hope my daughter is okay. Even though I asked Granny Hu to babysit, I worry. And my husband... hopefully he’s safe at the Matsuki estate right now. That place is nearly a fortress!”

All PCs know that “Granny Hu” refers to Hu Ban-niang, and the Matsuki estate is Shou’s home—though he’s more commonly called “Old Matsuki.” These two individuals are the spiritual leaders of Willowshore’s Northridge and Southbank factions, respectively. The PCs can invite Hai-er to join them, though she initially resists due to a combination of her fear of what’s happening all around her and her dedication to her post. If she can be made at least friendly, she agrees to accompany the PCs. She encourages them to either visit Granny Hu (so she can check on her daughter) or the Matsuki estate (to track down her husband)—if the PCs neglect either of these options before nightfall, she’ll set off to reunite with her daughter on her own. As long as she’s accompanying the PCs, Hai-er provides support in combat with her crossbow, closing to melee only once she runs out of ammunition. If reduced to fewer than 6 Hit Points, she panics and flees, hoping to find somewhere safe to hide before moving on to seek out her daughter. Once she’s reunited with either her daughter or husband, she no longer accompanies the PCs.

@UUID[Actor.PyCdl79pLeQbhSDg]{Ha Hai-er} Creature 1

  • Humanoid

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.jlVLrlDxDn6eCo6C]{Ha Hai-er's Supplies}
Ha Hai-er provides the party with two minor magical supplies from the watchtower that might be of use to them—a ladder marvelous miniature and a single shining crossbow bolt. A small cask of lantern oil is stored here as well, should the PCs wish to light the lantern to the east at Ugly Cute’s abandoned perch.

The Spiderless Gate.name: 无蛛之门 The Spiderless Gate
The Spiderless Gate.text:
无蛛之门

穿过渡月河上的桥后，玩家角色来到柳岸镇东侧的入口。这里曾有一尊守护蜘蛛的石像，立于道路旁的一座圣祠中；但当玩家角色靠近时，雾中有些不对劲——蜘蛛石像不见了，只剩下一座空荡荡的圣祠。柳岸镇东侧入口的提灯原本由蜘蛛的尖牙衔着，如今却侧倒在草丛中。

允许玩家角色进行一次 @Check[society|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 或 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定，以回忆知识，了解关于石蜘蛛雕像的信息，详见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w33spidergat00]{W33}。同一次检定也会让他们想起，长明灯——柳岸镇最初的入口提灯——位于晨步桥附近（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w10eternalla00]{W10}）。

失踪的蜘蛛：这尊被当地人半带怜爱地称作“丑萌”的石蜘蛛有一匹马那么大，由整块石头制成，因此不太可能只是被人轻易偷走。它曾栖立的岩石上看不出任何凿刻或损坏痕迹，但周围地面却布满了深深的沟痕。若玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] 检定，便能确认这些痕迹与这尊雕像若曾活化并沿道路向东而去时留下的痕迹一致。随后，这些痕迹进入河流，变得无法继续追踪。玩家角色此刻还无从知晓真相，但在之后的冒险中，他们将会得知丑萌遭遇了什么——参见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05searchingfor00]{寻找丑萌}，位于 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{第三章}。

未点亮的提灯：这盏入口提灯里没有灯油。即使再次点燃，这盏提灯也无法驱散迷雾与月光；但如果玩家角色为其添满灯油（若他们此时没有灯油，可以在下一个遭遇中找到提灯油），他们对抗猩红月光的豁免骰获得 +2 物品加值，而血雨的纯骰检定提升为 @Check[flat|dc:18]。

奖励：若玩家角色点亮提灯，给予他们 20 XP。

The Spiderless Gate

After crossing the bridge over the Duyue River, the PCs arrive at the eastern entrance to Willowshore. Here, a stone statue of a guardian spider once stood in a shrine next to the road, but as the PCs approach, something looks off in the mist—the spider statue is missing, with only an empty shrine left behind. Willowshore’s eastern entrance lantern, once held in the spider’s fangs, now lies on its side in the grass.

Allow the PCs a @Check[society|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge about the stone spider statue, as detailed in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w33spidergat00]{W33}. The same check also reminds them that the Eternal Lantern—Willowshore’s original entrance lantern—is located near Dawnstep Bridge (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w10eternalla00]{W10}).

The Missing Spider: The stone spider somewhat affectionately known by the locals as “Ugly Cute” is the size of a horse and made of solid stone, which makes it unlikely that someone simply made off with it. No sign of chiseling or damage to the rock on which it once perched upon is evident, but large furrows scar the ground surrounding it. With a successful @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] check, a PC confirms these marks are consistent with tracks the statue would’ve left if it animated and headed east down the road. The tracks then enter the river and become impossible to follow. The PCs have no way of knowing it at the moment, but later in the adventure, they’ll discover what happened to Ugly Cute—see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05searchingfor00]{Searching for Ugly Cute} in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{Chapter 3}.

The Unlit Lantern: The entrance lantern is empty of oil. While this lantern won’t drive back the mist and moonlight if it’s lit again, if the PCs refill it (they can find lantern oil in the next encounter if they don’t have any at this time), they gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against the crimson moonlight, and the flat check for blood rain increases to @Check[flat|dc:18].

Reward: Give the PCs 20 XP for lighting the lantern.

Maze of Mist, Rain of Blood.name: 迷雾迷宫，血雨 Maze of Mist, Rain of Blood
Maze of Mist, Rain of Blood.text:
迷雾迷宫，血雨

当玩家角色沿着兽径前进时，天气变得愈发古怪。雾气穿过树林翻涌而来，等到玩家角色走出森林、踏上一条熟悉的河畔道路时，已然凝成了真正的浓雾——而距他们离开醒来的那片空地，不过才过去10分钟。

前方，透过这片异常浓雾望见渡月河上的桥，着实令人宽慰，因为这座桥确认了玩家角色已经抵达柳岸镇最东侧的边缘。然而，当他们穿过桥时，浓雾却依旧不散。允许每名玩家角色尝试一次秘密的@Check[society|dc:13|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:13|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定来回忆知识。大失败时，玩家角色会错误地想起一个古老传说，声称夏雾会带来夏季疾病。成功时，玩家角色会想起一首古老的童谣，暗示柳岸镇的长明灯已经熄灭。关于这首童谣，见下方的提灯诗。

懒阿斗偷得半日闲，

那天没把灯火燃。

结果酿成大祸端，

群鬼嬉闹出人间！

迷雾朦胧，血月高悬，

皆因他就此撒手不管。

提灯诗

只要柳岸镇的长明灯仍然熄灭，白昼与夜晚都会变得更加危险而令人不安。白天，整座城镇始终笼罩在一种被称为蜃景雾的浓雾之中。到了夜晚，雾气会消散，但代价则是绯红的月光与血雨倾泻大地。

蜃景雾：这片诡异浓雾厚重到足以遮蔽500英尺以外的视野。从100英尺以外看到的生物皆为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。此外，雾气会扭曲周边视野，使人不时在视线边缘瞥见一些古怪的形体移动、变换。因此，在蜃景雾中进行的所有基于视觉的察觉检定都会承受–1状态减值，而所有用以辨别方向的求生检定难度等级都会提高5。

场景备注氛围

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.ffY3ybPo0ZvpfCUL]{迷雾都市} @UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.2089R8LUFfxhJMM0]{迷雾本性}

绯红之月：到了夜晚，蜃景雾会散去，天空恢复为局部多云。当月亮从云层间显露时，它会散发出一种诡异的绯红色泽。此效果具有情绪、恐惧和心灵特征。生物每在这轮绯月之下度过1小时，在该小时开始时都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:15|traits:emotion,fear,mental]豁免，以避免其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}状态值增加。

大成功 该生物因月亮导致的惊惧状态值减少1。若因此将该值降至0，则该生物在当晚剩余时间内暂时免疫绯红之月的效果。

成功 该生物因月亮导致的惊惧状态值不会增加。

失败 该生物的惊惧状态值增加1，最多增加到4。该惊惧状态会持续至黎明，或直到足够多的大成功结果将其值降至0为止。

大失败 如同失败，但该状态值增加2。

场景备注宏 / 氛围

@UUID[Macro.DxD2BgVlVgehVnuO]{启用血月} @UUID[Macro.Jz8MIw7gUsCW19TY]{重置柳岸镇} | @UUID[Macro.u7NLULMdAcyTWq1c]{启用降雨} @UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.nezy4qHmtlstrXAe]{雨}

将@UUID[Scene.KjhqnhLwdTc2JUZV]{柳岸镇}场景的光照更改为绯红色。

邪异的动物

柳岸镇的野生动物异常具有攻击性，这一点本就应当让任何在一次秘密的@Check[nature|dc:15|traits:secret]或@Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret]检定中成功的玩家角色感到担忧（成功时，该玩家角色会意识到，像巨蜈蚣这样的生物竟会如此迅速地表现出攻击性，并且在面对更强大的敌人时也不选择逃跑，尤其还是在白天，这有多么反常）；但它们那令人不安的说话能力，则立刻揭示出有某种超自然力量正在作祟。若玩家角色通过一次@Check[occultism|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或@Check[religion|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定来回忆知识，就会知道这些动物正以某种方式受到一位邪恶精魂的影响。这些动物——以及在这场冒险中于心景里遭遇的许多其他具攻击性的动物——都是苦迦菩提对这片区域施加影响的实体显现。它们不寻常的智慧（它们的智力调整值为+0，且会说通用语）以及残酷、施虐的性格，是这名邪魔在此心景轮回中存在增强所带来的副作用，但除此之外，它们在数据上与同类的标准版本并无不同。

血雨：每次日落、绯红之月升起时，进行一次@Check[flat|dc:14]。成功时，云层覆盖加重（这并不会免除每小时为对抗绯红之月而进行意志豁免的必要），并且在夜里的某个时刻（由游戏主持决定），某种看似鲜血的液体会降落在柳岸镇。这场“血”雨仿佛会用一层血污覆盖一切。任何目睹血雨的玩家角色都必须立刻尝试一次针对绯红之月效果的豁免；若其正处于雨中，则此次豁免承受–4环境减值。若某玩家角色因这次豁免而使其惊惧状态值增加，则其会陷入@Condition[fleeing]，持续1分钟，并且必须尝试逃往室内地点。血雨会在几分钟后结束，余下的夜晚则重新转为阴天。落下的雨水会在血雨结束后恢复为普通的水。

解决这些显现：玩家角色可以在晨步桥点燃长明灯，借此终止这些由苦迦菩提影响所引发的诡异显现（见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03lightthenigh00]{点亮夜晚}）。如果玩家角色没有想起那首古老童谣，你可以让他们从一位由你选择的、被救下的非玩家角色那里得知这首童谣。

Maze of Mist, Rain of Blood

As the PCs travel down the game trail, the weather grows stranger. Mist rolls in through the trees, growing into a full-fledged fog by the time the PCs step out of the forest and onto a familiar riverside road, a mere 10 minutes after they left the clearing they awoke in.

Up ahead, the sight of the Duyue River bridge through the unusual fog is a welcome sight, for this bridge confirms that the PCs have arrived at the easternmost edge of Willowshore. As they cross the bridge, though, the fog persists. Allow each PC to attempt a secret @Check[society|dc:13|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:13|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge. On a critical failure, a PC misremembers an old legend that claims summer fog brings summer sickness. On a success, a PC recalls an old nursery rhyme that suggests Willowshore’s Eternal Lantern has been extinguished. See the lantern poem below for this rhyme.

Lazy Adou took a break, and

did not light the lamp that day.

This proved to be a big mistake, for

then the ghosts came out to play!

Hazy mist and moon of blood,

all because he just gave up.

Lantern Poem

As long as Willowshore’s Eternal Lantern remains extinguished, day and night are more dangerous and unsettling. During the day, the town is constantly bathed in a thick fog known as mirage mist. The mist dissipates at night, but at the cost of crimson moonlight and blood rain bathing the land.

Mirage Mist: The eerie fog is thick enough to obscure visibility beyond a range of 500 feet. Creatures viewed from more than 100 feet away are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. In addition, the mist distorts peripheral vision, causing one to periodically notice strange shapes moving and shifting about at the limits of their vision. All vision-based Perception checks attempted within mirage mist suffer a –1 status penalty as a result, and all DCs for Survival checks to Sense Direction are increased by 5.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.ffY3ybPo0ZvpfCUL]{Mist Urban} @UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.2089R8LUFfxhJMM0]{Mist Nature}

Crimson Moon: At night, the mirage mist clears and the sky reverts to partially overcast. When the moon is glimpsed through the clouds, it shines with an eerie crimson hue. This effect has the emotion, fear, and mental traits. At the start of any hour a creature spends under this crimson moon, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:15|traits:emotion,fear,mental] save to avoid having the value of its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition increase.

Critical Success The creature reduces its moon-induced frightened condition by 1. If this reduces the value to 0, the creature is temporarily immune to the crimson moon’s effects for the rest of the night.

Success The creature’s moon-induced frightened condition doesn’t increase.

Failure The creature’s frightened condition value increases by 1, to a maximum value of 4. This frightened condition persists until dawn, or until enough critical success results reduce the value to 0.

Critical Failure As failure, but the condition’s value increases by 2.

Scene NotesMacros / Ambience

@UUID[Macro.DxD2BgVlVgehVnuO]{Enable Blood Moon} @UUID[Macro.Jz8MIw7gUsCW19TY]{Reset Willowshore} | @UUID[Macro.u7NLULMdAcyTWq1c]{Enable Rain} @UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.nezy4qHmtlstrXAe]{Rain}

Change the @UUID[Scene.KjhqnhLwdTc2JUZV]{Willowshore} Scene lighting to crimson.

Sinister Animals

The fact that Willowshore’s wildlife is unusually aggressive should concern any PC who succeeds at a secret @Check[nature|dc:15|traits:secret] or @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret] check (on a success, that PC realizes how unusual it is for creatures like giant centipedes to be so quickly aggressive and to avoid fleeing upon facing superior foes, especially during daylight hours), but the addition of their disturbing ability to speak reveals immediately that something supernatural is afoot. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[occultism|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[religion|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge knows these animals are being influenced in some way by an evil spirit. These animals—along with many other aggressive animals encountered in the mindscape during this adventure—are physical manifestations of Kugaptee’s influence over the region. Their unusual intellect (they have Int +0 and can speak Common) and cruel, sadistic personalities are a side effect of the fiend’s increased presence in this cycle of the mindscape, but they otherwise have standard statistics for their kind.

Blood Rain: Every sunset as the crimson moon rises, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:14]. On a success, the cloud cover increases (this doesn’t negate the need to make hourly Will saves against the crimson moon), and at some point during the night (as decided by the GM), what appears to be blood rains down on Willowshore. This “blood” seemingly coats everything with a layer of gore. Any PC who witnesses the blood rain must immediately attempt a save against the effects of the crimson moon, taking a –4 circumstance penalty to the save if they’re out in the rain. A PC whose frightened condition increases as the result of this saving throw becomes fleeing for 1 minute and must attempt to escape to an indoor location. The blood rain ends after a few minutes, transitioning back to overcast skies for the remainder of the night. Fallen rain reverts to normal water once the blood rain ends.

Resolving the Manifestations: The PCs can stop these eerie manifestations of Kugaptee’s influence by lighting the Eternal Lantern at Dawnstep Bridge (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03lightthenigh00]{Light the Night}). If the PCs don’t recall the old rhyme, you can have them learn of the rhyme by a rescued NPC of your choice.

Strange Aggression.name: 奇异攻击性 Strange Aggression
Strange Aggression.text:
奇异攻击性 微不足道 1

柳岸镇周边的林地里不乏危险的掠食者，但在离城镇这么近的地方，这类威胁通常都微乎其微。当PC们动身返回城镇时——或者如果他们决定先在空地上等待一段时间——附近矮丛环境中传来的窸窣声吸引了他们的注意。

奇异攻击性 微不足道 1

@UUID[Actor.h319yBCL0AmUKXAB]{巨蜈蚣（2）}

生物：苦迦菩提日益增长的影响使柳岸腹地的野生动物变得异常凶暴，还会以超自然的方式发声，正如PC们现在所发现的那样。就在他们听见那阵窸窣声片刻之后，两只巨蜈蚣从矮丛环境中急窜而出。这些亮橙色的生物在发现PC们时，起初会发出令人不安的嘶嘶声；但当它们急奔上前攻击时，这些嘶声开始组成词语：“肉……血肉……骨头……手指……头发……皮肤……眼睛……”随着战斗推进，巨蜈蚣的低语逐渐变成简短的句子，让人明显意识到，它们正断断续续地吐出自己希望很快就能啃食的PC们身体部位。

当战斗结束后，让PC们有机会解读这些巨蜈蚣所采取的奇怪举动，详见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03mazeofmistra00#sinister-animals]{“不祥动物”}侧栏。

Strange Aggression Trivial 1

The woodlands surrounding Willowshore have their share of dangerous predators, but this close to town, those threats are usually minimal. As the PCs head back to town—or if instead they decide to wait for a time in the clearing—the sound of something rustling in the nearby undergrowth attracts their attention.

Strange Aggression Trivial 1

@UUID[Actor.h319yBCL0AmUKXAB]{Giant Centipedes (2)}

Creatures: Kugaptee’s growing influence causes wildlife in the Willowshore hinterlands to grow unusually aggressive and supernaturally vocal, as the PCs now discover. A few moments after they hear the rustling, two giant centipedes scuttle out from the undergrowth. The bright orange creatures initially make unnerving hissing sounds upon spotting the PCs, but as they scurry forth to attack, these hisses begin forming words: “meat... flesh... bones... fingers... hair... skin... eyes...” As the fight progresses, the centipedes’ whispering grows into short sentences, making it apparent that they’re gasping out the parts of the PCs they hope to soon feed upon.

As the combat concludes, allow the PCs a chance to interpret the strange actions taken by the giant centipedes, as detailed in the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03mazeofmistra00#sinister-animals]{Sinister Animals} sidebar.

The First Day of Summer.name: 夏日第一天 The First Day of Summer
The First Day of Summer.text:
夏日第一天

本冒险假定PC们从森林空地向西旅行，穿过渡月河上的桥，沿道路进入柳岸镇，在接近城镇时经过石蜘蛛和东侧瞭望塔。接下来的几页将把这段旅程呈现为一系列遭遇；但如果你的玩家选择偏离这条预设路线，就可按需使用@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow]{柳岸镇}的地志。你应尽量尽早将他们本可从前四场遭遇中获得的信息（富有攻击性的野生动物、奇怪的迷雾和绯红之月、失踪的石蜘蛛，以及哈海儿的故事）纳入他们进入柳岸腹地的旅程中，这样PC们对后续事件仍能有一些背景了解。

The First Day of Summer

This adventure assumes the PCs travel west from the forest clearing, over the Duyue River bridge and up the road into Willowshore, passing by the stone spider and the eastern watchtower as they approach town. This journey is presented on the following pages as a series of encounters, but if your players choose to diverge from this assumed path, use the gazetteer of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow]{Willowshore} as needed. You should strive to include the information they would’ve gained from the first four encounters (the aggressive wildlife, the strange mist and crimson moon, the missing stone spider, and Ha Hai-er’s tale) into their journey into the hinterlands as soon as possible so that the PCs still have some context for events to follow.

Getting Started.name: 冒险开始 Getting Started
Getting Started.text:
冒险开始

当你准备开始这场战役时，告诉玩家们：当他们在夏日第一天醒来时，发现自己身处诡异的境况之中。前一晚的记忆渐渐回笼，他们记得自己在重演节最热闹的时候，被镇上的人从城镇里拖了出来；那时他们仍戴着红色眼罩，沉睡在那些“绑匪”为他们放置的草席卷中。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.Xe84RQtKEyZoQ1yp]{林地}
