每年，重演节的组织者都会选择一个不同的地点，将这些“被绑走的人”丢在离城镇不远、却又没有任何文明地带视觉线的地方。允许玩家角色尝试 @Check[survival|dc:10] 或 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:10] 检定——任何成功者都会意识到，他们其实是在柳岸镇以东的一处空地醒来（柳岸镇地图上的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w38woodedcle00]{W38}），而附近有一条兽径向西延伸，通回城镇。如果没有玩家角色尝试这项检定，那么这条小路也很容易被注意到；而且它一路下坡，通往河流声传来的方向，这就足以让人推测它很可能会通往家乡。

今天早晨的天气，对神门初夏时节来说相当普通——天空半阴，清晨空气中带着一丝清冷；到了正午，玩家角色原本可能会觉得这股凉意将让位于更舒适、却不至于闷热的暖意。然而，随着白天渐深，云层却只变得愈发不祥，随后开始下起雨来。

PC所知事项

如果你使用的是《肆季鬼志》@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog22sogpgh]{玩家指南}，玩家应当已经知道以下三个关键点。如果没有使用，或者你希望提醒他们一些关键要素，请确保他们在这场冒险开始前知晓以下内容。

什么是肆季鬼志？ 肆季鬼志是初夏时节的一段时期，在这段时间里，幽魂之森中的灵异事件、精魂与不死生物活动都会增加。虽然其成因尚不明确，但这些幽灵常常会引诱人们走向死亡。

什么是重演节？ 在柳岸镇，人们会在春季最后一天举行宴会，庆祝这一时节结束；随后，镇上会重演人们被“鬼魂”掳走的情景（这些“鬼魂”由戴着纸面具的村民扮演）。接着，镇民会假装陷入集体恐慌：指定的哭丧者高声哀号，其他人则演出一场搜索与救援行动。人们相信，这场闹剧能骗过真正的鬼魂，让它们以为已经有谁在这座定居点作祟过了，从而转去寻找别的、能让它们施加痛苦的更“合适”的村庄。玩家角色记得自己扮演的是被掳走者：他们必须蒙着眼、裹在草席里过夜，直到早晨由当年负责重演节的本地负责人出面“赎回”。

玩家角色身上有什么物品？ 在林地中过夜是有风险的，因此玩家角色事先获得了准备时间。他们目前携带着自己的全部物品，并且有在创建角色时已经选择好的所有伙伴陪同。

如果玩家们还没有这么做，给他们一个机会介绍自己的角色。如果玩家角色选择了出自《肆季鬼志》玩家指南的背景，他们就会自带一些合理理由，说明自己为何会被选中扮演重演节中的被掳者，也会与其他玩家角色或柳岸镇之间存在一些潜在联系。

在玩家角色交谈片刻后，他们会注意到有些不对劲。今年这场仪式的主要组织者、磨坊主乔春虎曾说过，他会在日出时带着食物前来“赎回”玩家角色，并带他们回家。这一步其实并非必要；它更像是一顿送来的早餐，用来感谢那些帮助完成这场重演的人。玩家角色知道，即使没人来完成这场“赎金交付”，他们也可以自己回到柳岸镇，就好像他们安全地“从绑匪手中逃脱”了一样。然而，春虎的缺席十分奇怪，因为这位磨坊主很少食言。

如果玩家角色动身返回城镇，记得询问每位玩家角色使用哪种探索行动。如果他们反而决定先在空地上等待一会儿，他们可以用调查或侦测魔法等行动探索此地，检查是否有什么异常之处。无论他们如何选择，接下来发生的“奇异攻击性”遭遇都会在此时展开。

Getting Started

When you’re ready to start this campaign, inform the players that as they wake on the first day of summer, they do so in strange circumstances. Memories of the previous night return, and they can recall being dragged from town by townsfolk during the height of the Reenactment Festival, still wearing their red blindfolds and asleep in straw mat bundles placed by their “abductors.”

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.Xe84RQtKEyZoQ1yp]{Woods}

Each year, the organizers of the Reenactment Festival choose a different place to drop off their abductees in a location not far from town, yet without any immediate line of sight to civilization. Allow the PCs to attempt @Check[survival|dc:10] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:10] checks—anyone who succeeds realizes that they’ve instead awoken in a clearing east of Willowshore (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w38woodedcle00]{W38} on the map of Willowshore), and that a nearby game trail leads west back toward town. If no PC attempts this check, the trail is easy to notice, and the fact that it leads downhill toward the sound of a river is enough to suggest that it likely leads back toward home.

The weather this morning is typical for Shenmen in the early summer—partially overcast with a crisp early morning chill to the air that, by noon, the PCs might expect to give way to a more pleasant but not overbearing heat. As the day draws on, the clouds only grow more ominous, and rain begins to fall.

What the PCs Know

If you’re using the Season of Ghosts @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog22sogpgh]{Player's Guide}, the players should already know the following three key points. If not, or if you wish to remind them of some key elements, make sure they know the following before starting this adventure.

What is the season of ghosts? The season of ghosts is a time during early summer when Specterwood sees an increase in hauntings, spirits, and undead. While the cause is uncertain, these ghosts often lure folks to their deaths.

What is the Reenactment Festival? In Willowshore, following a feast to celebrate the end of the season on the last day of spring, the town reenacts people being snatched away by “ghosts” (played by villagers in paper masks); the townsfolk then pretend to plunge into collective panic as designated wailers mourn loudly, while others play out a search and rescue effort. This farce is believed to trick real ghosts into thinking that someone has already haunted the settlement and thus convince them to seek a happier village to inflict misery upon. The PCs recall playing the role of the abductees, who must spend the night blindfolded and wrapped in straw mats until they’re “ransomed” in the morning by the local in charge of that year’s Reenactment Festival.

What items do the PCs have? Staying overnight in the woods is risky, and the PCs were given time to prepare in advance. They currently have all of their items and are accompanied by any companions they already selected during character creation.

Give the players a chance to introduce their characters if they haven’t done so already. If the PCs chose backgrounds from the Season of Ghosts Player’s Guide, they’ll have built-in reasons why they were among those selected for the role of abductee for the Reenactment Festival, as well as some potential links to the other PCs or Willowshore.

After the PCs talk for a bit, they notice something is amiss. The main organizer of the ritual this year, the miller Choe Chung-hu, said he would arrive by sunrise with food to “ransom” the PCs and lead them back home. This step isn’t essential; it’s more of a breakfast delivery to thank those who helped with the reenactment. The PCs know that they can go back to Willowshore without this ransom being delivered, as if they safely “escaped from their kidnappers.” However, Chung-hu’s absence is strange since the miller seldom goes back on his word.

If the PCs head back to town, remember to ask each PC what Exploration Activity they use. If instead they decide to wait a while in the clearing, they can explore the location with activities such as Investigate or Detect Magic to check for anything out of place. Regardless of their choice, the “Strange Aggression” encounter that follows takes place at this time.

To Light the Night.name: 点亮长夜 To Light the Night
To Light the Night.text:
第1章： 点亮长夜

在帝国纪年7223年早冬时节，一位名叫马戈凯的木材大亨在翻阅祖先的日志时发现了一些耐人寻味的记载——其中提到，在一座名为柳岸镇的偏远城镇附近，藏着一片非同寻常的杉树林。

到了春季的第一周，凯与他的一群代理人前往柳岸镇，准备估价并调查一片据找回的日志所述、已经一百多年未曾采伐的地区。这支探险队抵达后，发现那里已成一片荒草蔓生、闹鬼的废墟，但依然潜力十足。这个地方能否被重新开辟为伐木营地？就在他们开始筹划时，废墟中仅存的一名守护者——一只石蜘蛛守护野兽——袭击了这群未来的伐木工。数人丧命后，马戈凯击败了石蜘蛛，并决定队伍应向东撤退，在遭受损失后先行休整。他在海滨要塞唐入安顿下来，开始为一次更有组织的重建行动做准备，集结清理柳岸镇废墟、将其从闹鬼往昔中夺回所需的补给、士兵与驱邪师。

马戈凯并不知道，他与手下在柳岸镇废墟中遭遇的闹鬼现象，并不仅仅来自不得安息的精魂。这些异象，其实是来自一处心景版柳岸镇中的灵性回响与影响；那处心景诞生于115年前，当时城镇总督曾试图施展一场复杂仪式，意图保护城镇免受名为苦迦菩提的远古邪魔影响，但最终失败。那次失败导致柳岸镇所有人死亡，并使他们的灵魂被困在一个心景之中。而近来，柳岸镇石蜘蛛守护精魂死于马戈凯手下之手，则引发了一连串事件，甚至可能使马戈凯夺回柳岸镇为己所用的目标彻底无法实现。

在往年，心景每年循环的终点都会将一切重置回上一年的夏日第一天，所有被困于心景中的人也会再次从自己的床上醒来，对上一年发生的事毫无记忆。但在春末最后几天“丑萌”死去之后，异变发生了。由于失去了守护野兽提供的灵性防护，苦迦菩提的影响增长得更快了。它在柳岸腹地更深处的地区外围塑造出一层幽魂外壳，并在心景中显现为可怖的“幽魂之墙”。随着苦迦菩提从死亡沉眠中缓缓苏醒，这名邪魔的思想也以实体形式显现，让各类可怖怪物在心景中四处滋生。其中许多怪物侵入了柳岸镇，在春末数日间席卷城镇，瓦解了镇民为即将到来的肆季鬼志所做的准备，并摧毁了镇中许多建筑。尤其有三只生物成为这些显现怪物的头目——贪食的独眼怪咕噜肚、虚荣的一反木绵灰屠夫，以及放纵享乐的辘轳首莫斗秋——而它们横行霸道的统领，正是城镇陷落的关键原因。

在这场灾难过去几天后，心景回溯到夏日第一天，但一切都已永远改变，因为这些自苦迦菩提思想中诞生的新显现，并不会像心景其他部分那样一同重置。115年来头一次，柳岸镇的人民醒来时，发现城镇已被怪物盘踞、遭受浩劫蹂躏——却完全不记得这一切究竟是如何发生的。

当循环重置时，“丑萌”发现自己再一次活了过来，但这一次，他被困在心景本身之中。石蜘蛛立刻行动起来，向入侵的怪物发起攻击并奋力反击。随着太阳升起，玩家角色在一处熟悉的森林空地上醒来，同时还保有前一夜的记忆，而这些记忆很快将与他们即将面对的现实产生冲突。他们接下来的去向，可能会导向心景的毁灭，以及柳岸镇那些被困住的灵魂重返生命——又或者，在长久拖延之后，迎来前往骨园的真正死亡。

Chapter 1: To Light the Night

During the winter of early 7223 ic, a lumber baron named Mago Kai discovered something intriguing while looking back through his ancestor’s journals—mentions of a grove of incredible sugi trees said to be hidden near a remote town called Willowshore.

During the first week of spring, Kai and a group of his agents traveled to Willowshore, ready to appraise and investigate a region that, according to the recovered journals, hadn’t been harvested in well over a hundred years. The expedition arrived to find an overgrown and haunted ruin, but it was still full of potential. Could the place be reclaimed as a lumber camp? As they began planning, one of the ruin’s remaining guardians—a stone spider guardian beast—attacked the group of prospective loggers. Several people perished before Mago Kai defeated the stone spider, and he decided the group should retreat east to recuperate after their losses. He settled into the coastal fortress of Karahai and began to prepare for a more organized reconstruction effort, gathering the supplies, soldiers, and exorcists needed to cleanse Willowshore’s ruins and reclaim it from its haunted past.

Unbeknownst to Mago Kai, the haunting effects he and his people experienced in the ruins of Willowshore were from more than merely unquiet spirits. These phenomena were the spiritual echoes and influences that reached out from within a mindscape version of Willowshore that came into existence 115 years before, when the city’s governor attempted (and failed) to perform a complex ritual meant to protect the town from the influence of an ancient fiend named Kugaptee. That failure resulted in the deaths of everyone in Willowshore, and left their souls trapped in a mindscape. The more recent death of the town’s stone spider guardian spirit at the hands of Mago Kai’s people set into motion a series of events that might make Mago Kai’s goal of reclaiming Willowshore for his own use impossible.

In previous years, the end of the mindscape’s annual cycle reset everything back to the previous year’s first day of summer, and all those trapped within the mindscape woke again in their beds with no memories of the previous year’s events. But with Ugly Cute’s death during the final days of spring, something strange happened. Without the spiritual protection afforded by the guardian beast, Kugaptee’s influence grew even more quickly. It created a ghostly shell around the deeper regions of Willowshore’s hinterlands, manifesting in the mindscape as a frightening “Wall of Ghosts.” As Kugaptee slowly woke from his death slumber, the fiend’s thoughts manifested in physical form, infesting the mindscape with all manner of monstrous creatures. Many of these monsters invaded Willowshore and overran the town in the final days of spring, disrupting the townsfolk’s preparations for the upcoming season of ghosts and devastating many of the town’s structures. Three of these creatures in particular—a gluttonous buso named Gurglegut, a vain ittan-momen named Gray Butcher, and a hedonistic rokurokubi named Mo Douqiu—became ringleaders for these manifested monstrosities, and their bullying leadership proved key to the town’s fall.

When the mindscape reverted back to the first day of summer a few days after this catastrophe, things had changed forever, for these new manifestations born from Kugaptee’s thoughts didn’t reset with the rest of the mindscape. For the first time in 115 years, the people of Willowshore woke to a town infested with monsters and savaged by mayhem—but without any memories of how these events had come to pass.

Ugly Cute found himself alive once again when the cycle reset, but this time he was trapped in the mindscape itself. The stone spider quickly went into action, attacking and fighting back against the invading monsters. With the rising of the sun, the PCs awaken in a familiar forest clearing along with memories of the previous night that are at odds with the reality they shall soon face. Where they go from here could lead to the mindscape’s destruction and the return of Willowshore’s trapped souls to life—or to their true deaths after a long-delayed trip to the Boneyard.

Act 1.2: Reclaiming Willowshire.name: 第一幕 1.2：夺回柳郡 Act 1.2: Reclaiming Willowshire

Bathhouse Foyer.name: 澡堂前厅 Bathhouse Foyer
Bathhouse Foyer.text:
B13. 澡堂前厅

乐河童浴场的前厅一如往常那般温馨舒适，不过地板湿漉漉的，像是刚刚拖洗过。空气中弥漫着一种明显类似碱液的消毒剂气味。

当五只浑身沾满马匹血肉的河童若无其事地走进这间澡堂清洗时，澡堂那位有疑病症的老板德哥明白，最好把这些怪物般的访客当作贵宾来招待。不过，等他们在沐浴间安顿下来后，他立刻开始清理他们留下的血脚印，并给前厅消毒，然后躲进了更衣室（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b14bathhouse00]{B14}）。

B13. Bathhouse Foyer

The Happy Kappa’s foyer is as homely as it’s always been, though the floor is damp as if recently mopped. A distinct lye-like smell of some disinfectant hangs in the air.

When a group of five kappas, covered in horse-gore, casually strolled into this bathhouse to clean up, the bathhouse’s hypochondriac owner, De-ge knew it was best to treat the monstrous visitors as respected guests. Once they were settled into the baths, though, he immediately set about cleaning their bloody footprints and disinfecting the foyer before hiding in the locker room (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b14bathhouse00]{B14}).

Backyard Storage.name: 后院储物间 Backyard Storage
Backyard Storage.text:
B12. 后院储物间

这间后院储物间装有铸铁门，几乎像银行金库一样坚固，只有一扇圆形小窗可让外面的空气流通进来。后院的小菜园里长满了黄瓜。

生物：纳多娅和三美家的其余家人接到命令，除非灰屠夫或蹑影小魔怪传唤他们，否则必须一直待在这里。当PC们遇到这家人时，纳多娅会询问@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b11mudwallho00]{B11}区域里的蹑影小魔怪是否还在那里，以及玉梨和“另一个年轻人”是否安全。如果PC们还没有清理该区域，她会请求他们去处理，并救出那两人。

宝藏：@UUID[Actor.glTZmc0Dbilj1yeH]{纳多娅的感谢}
如果来自@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b10sanmihous00]{B10}区域的小魔怪已经被赶走，纳多娅会出于感激送给PC们一枚泪天使垂饰护符。 在后院里，还有一排新鲜黄瓜——只要得到纳多娅的允许，PC们想拿多少都可以。

奖励：如果PC们护送三美家人安全通过晨步桥，他们将获得20 XP和1点南岸声望点。

B12. Backyard Storage

Built almost like a bank vault with its cast-iron doors, this backyard storage has only a single round window that allows in air from the outside. The small vegetable garden in the backyard has an abundance of cucumbers.

Creatures: Nadoya and the rest of the Sanmi family have been ordered to stay here unless Gray Butcher or the jinkins call on them. When the PCs meet the family, Nadoya asks if the jinkins in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b11mudwallho00]{B11} are still there and whether Yuli and “the other young man” are safe. If the PCs haven’t cleared the area, she asks them to do so and save the two.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.glTZmc0Dbilj1yeH]{Nadoya's Thanks}
If the gremlins from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b10sanmihous00]{B10} have been evicted, Nadoya gives the PCs a crying angel pendant talisman in gratitude. Out in the backyard, there’s also a row of fresh cucumbers—the PCs can take as many as they want with Nadoya’s permission.

Reward: The PCs gain 20 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Southbank if they see the Sanmi family to safety past the Dawnstep Bridge.

Mudwall House.name: 泥墙屋 Mudwall House
Mudwall House.text:
B11. 泥墙屋 Moderate 1

这栋房子有双层泥墙，可以调节冷热并隔绝声音——但显然还不足以压下屋内那阵高声喧闹的尖细嗓音。

生物：这里曾是寡居的名户屋三美的住处，如今却已被小魔怪占据。一群六只蹑影小魔怪逼得名户屋三美和桑米家族的大多数家人只能住进后院储物间（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b12backyards00]{B12}），同时指定三美裕里（富有创意的女性人类年轻村民）与胡乐龙（有保护欲的男性人类年轻村民）做它们的贴身侍从。这对秘密恋人早在PC到来前不久便想出了一条反抗俘虏者的计划：不断怂恿它们越喝越醉。如今，这里的蹑影小魔怪已经被灌下的米酒彻底喝高了。由梨与乐龙原本希望这些小魔怪会昏睡过去，好让他们有机会逃走（或者更准确地说，私奔），但这种希望正在逐渐破灭，因为这些小魔怪喝得越醉，反而闹得越凶。其中有两只蹑影小魔怪尤其起劲，正拿着一堆失窃珠宝玩抛接游戏（更准确地说，是“扔出去、掉地上、再慌忙捡起来”的游戏）。

当PC进入时，他们会发现这些蹑影小魔怪正在把屋里弄得一团糟，而由梨与乐龙则缩在一个角落里发抖。这些醉醺醺的蹑影小魔怪把PC误认为恶鬼，一见到他们就立刻争着想引起队伍注意，边喊着“噢！恶鬼来啦！”边更加卖力地搞破坏，还不断叫嚷“看我！”或“瞧这个！”

泥墙屋 Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.RvxqKciwytdawfpb]{烂醉蹑影小魔怪 (6)} @UUID[Actor.i5Ygd16VV8NqZ7Na]{Yuli Sanmi} @UUID[Actor.JWT8JfQoCEodLmL3]{Hu Lelong}

这些蹑影小魔怪全都因醉酒而带有弱化的生物调整。若一名角色成功通过一次@Check[intimidation|dc:17]检定，就能逼得全部六只蹑影小魔怪逃出这栋房子。否则，要让这些蹑影小魔怪停止破坏此地，唯一的方法就是要么等它们自己醉倒（但那得花上足够久的时间，久到其中一只会先把这里点着，从而将内部彻底烧毁），要么攻击它们。一旦战斗开始，这些醉酒的蹑影小魔怪就会兴奋地尖叫，并且愚蠢地战斗至死。

苦命鸳鸯：如果这些醉酒的蹑影小魔怪被击败，乐龙会问PC是否愿意让他拿走那些小魔怪拿来玩的一条项链。如果PC追问原因，他会笨拙地说谎，声称自己想把它交给自己的叔叔（守卫队长郑鹏）或胡婆婆，以分辨谁才是它真正的主人。PC可以通过一次成功的@Check[diplomacy|dc:13]或@Check[intimidation|dc:13]检定逼他说出真相：他想筹些钱，好支援自己和恋人私奔。他拒绝透露恋人就是由梨，不过PC或许已经能从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b10sanmihous00]{B10} 的信件中得知此事（而任何对乐龙或由梨进行一次成功的@Check[perception|dc:13|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive]察言观色检定的人也都会看出来）。

这段恋情也解释了乐龙为何会出现在镇中心：怪物袭击时，他正偷偷来此探访，因此被困在这里。不论他们是否拿到资助，由梨与乐龙都下定决心要远走高飞，希望他们的家人会以为他们在入侵中丧命了。PC是要阻止还是放任这对年轻恋人私奔，全由他们决定；但如果他们被允许逃走，PC之后可以在荒野中的猎人小屋（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d6huntershut00]{D6}）再次遇见他们。由梨会记得取走区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b10sanmihous00]{B10} 的信件，或者在离开前请求PC把这些通信带还给他们。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.DvjLaZbukPhBGGoh]{失窃珠宝}
在这些失窃珠宝中，一名PC发现了一条属于自己家人的易于辨识的项链，并可以将其取回。这条项链价值10 gp，但蹑影小魔怪在自己醉到连怎么修补都不记得之前，先给它下了诅咒。只要佩戴或携带这条项链，此人身上就会散发出腐烂大蒜般的恶臭，使其交涉与隐秘检定承受–1物品减值。

其余失窃珠宝总价值为75 gp，但这二十四件首饰都属于柳岸镇的不同居民。

奖励：若PC击败这些蹑影小魔怪，或以正常方式将它们赶走，则给予PC相应XP，但总计最多80 XP，以反映它们造成的威胁较低。如果PC采取行动归还失窃珠宝，他们将获得北岭的1点声望点。如果PC积极鼓励，甚至协助这对年轻恋人私奔，他们将失去南岸的1点声望点；而名户屋三美一旦得知这段关系，在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{第三章}开始时，她对PC的态度会自动变为不友善。

B11. Mudwall House Moderate 1

This house has a double-layered mud wall that regulates heat, cold, and sound—though it isn’t up to the task of dampening the rabble of high-pitched voices within.

Creatures: Once home to the widowed Nadoya Sanmi, this house is now infested with gremlins. A group of six jinkins forced Nadoya and most of the Sanmi family to live in the backyard storage room (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b12backyards00]{B12}) while designating Yuli Sanmi (creative female human young villager) and Hu Lelong (protective male human young villager) to be their personal attendants. The two secret lovers hatched a plan shortly before the PCs arrive to fight back against their captors by encouraging them to get increasingly drunk, and now the jinkins here are quite blasted on the rice wine they’ve been plied with. Yuli and Lelong’s hopes that the gremlins would pass out and allow them the chance to escape (or rather, elope) are diminishing, for the gremlins have only grown rowdier as they got drunker. Two jinkins in particular are playing a game of catch with a collection of stolen jewelry (more accurately, a game of “toss, drop, and then scramble to pick back up”).

As the PCs enter, they find the jinkins making a mess of the place while Yuli and Lelong cower in a corner. The drunken jinkins mistake the PCs for oni when they arrive and immediately begin to vie for the attention of the party, crying out, “Ooh! The oni are here!” and then doing their best to up their destructive antics, crying out “Look at me!” or “Watch this!”

Mudwall House Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.RvxqKciwytdawfpb]{Very Drunken Jinkins (6)} @UUID[Actor.i5Ygd16VV8NqZ7Na]{Yuli Sanmi} @UUID[Actor.JWT8JfQoCEodLmL3]{Hu Lelong}

The jinkins all have the weak creature adjustments as a result of their drunkenness. A character who succeeds at a @Check[intimidation|dc:17] check compels all six jinkins to flee the house. Otherwise, the only way to get the jinkins to stop wrecking the place is to either wait for them to pass out (which will take long enough for one of them to light the place on fire, thereby destroying the interior completely) or to attack them. Once a fight starts, the drunk jinkins howl in delight and, foolishly, fight to the death.

Star-Crossed Lovers: If the drunken jinkins are defeated, Lelong asks if the PCs would let him take one of the necklaces the gremlins were playing with. If the PCs inquires why, he clumsily lies, claiming that he wants to let his uncle (guard captain Zheng Peng) or Granny Hu sort out who the rightful owner is. The PCs can press the truth of out him with a successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:13] or @Check[intimidation|dc:13] check: he wants funds to support an elopement for himself and his lover. He refuses to reveal Yuli is the lover, though the PCs might already know from the letters in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b10sanmihous00]{B10} (as will anyone who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:13|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] check to Sense Motive with either Lelong or Yuli).

This romance also explains why Lelong is downtown: he was secretly visiting when monsters attacked, trapping him here. Regardless of whether they receive the funds, Yuli and Lelong are steadfast about running away, hoping their families will think they died during the invasion. Whether the PCs stop or allow the young couple to elope is up to them, but if they’re allowed to run away, the PCs can encounter them later at the Hunter’s Hut in the hinterlands (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d6huntershut00]{D6}). Yuli remembers to retrieve the letters from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b10sanmihous00]{B10} or asks the PCs to return the correspondences to them before they leave.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.DvjLaZbukPhBGGoh]{Stolen Jewelry}
Among the stolen jewelry, one of the PCs discovers a recognizable necklace that belongs to their family, and they can reclaim it. This necklace is worth 10 gp, but the jinkins cursed it before they got too drunk to remember how to Tinker. As long as the necklace is worn or carried, it makes a person stink of rotting garlic, imparting a –1 item penalty to Diplomacy and Stealth checks.

The rest of the stolen jewelry is worth a total of 75 gp, but these two dozen pieces belong to various citizens of Willowshore.

Reward: Grant the PCs XP for defeating the jinkins or chasing them off normally, to a maximum total of 80 XP to account for the lesser threat they posed. If the PCs take steps to return the stolen jewelry, they gain 1 Reputation Point with Northridge. If the PCs actively encouraged or even aided the young couple in their elopement, they lose 1 Reputation Point with Southbank, and Nadoya’s attitude automatically becomes unfriendly at the start of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{Chapter 3} as she finds out about the relationship.

Sanmi Household.name: 桑米家族 Sanmi Household
Sanmi Household.text:
B10. 桑米家族

这处家宅中几乎所有值钱的东西都被洗劫一空，从全部炊具到他们放在古董抽屉里的衣物与贵重物品，无一幸免。

如果PC们搜索这个房间，并成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:20|traits:secret,action:search|name:搜索]检定，他们会在梳妆柜抽屉下方的一个隐藏隔间里发现一叠信件（@UUID[Actor.sBfmm8I2Cm470xIl]{隐藏隔间}）。阅读这些信件会揭示出桑米家族与胡家最年轻一代之间一段秘密且逐渐萌芽的关系，也就是三美裕里与胡乐龙。

一旦PC们发现这些便条，允许他们尝试一次@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:回忆知识]检定或一次@Check[society|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:回忆知识]检定，以回忆知识得知，极其传统的桑米家族不会赞成这段关系。这些便条在解决区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b11mudwallho00]{B11}中的情况时，可能会派上用场。

B10. Sanmi Household

This family home has been thoroughly robbed of nearly everything of worth, from all their cookware to whatever clothing or valuables they had in their antique drawers.

If the PCs Search this room and succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:secret,action:search|name:Search] check, they discover a stack of letters hidden in a compartment beneath a dresser drawer (@UUID[Actor.sBfmm8I2Cm470xIl]{Hidden Compartment}). Reading the letters reveals a secret and blossoming relationship between the youngest generation of the Sanmi and Hu families, Yuli Sanmi and Hu Lelong.

Once the PCs discover these notes, allow them to attempt a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check or @Check[society|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge that the highly traditional Sanmi family wouldn’t approve of this relationship. These notes might prove useful in resolving the situation in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b11mudwallho00]{B11}.

Treesparrow’s Rest.name: 树雀居 Treesparrow’s Rest
Treesparrow’s Rest.text:
B9. 树雀居

这间临街店面里的米、黍或荞麦袋子与箱子都没有受损。搁板上的豆酱、米酒或腌菜坛罐也同样完好无损。

这间粮店的前门没有上锁。PC可以把这里当作进行10分钟休息的地方（可能会进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qc0VsZ0UesnurUUB]{比如说小憩一刻}行动），但如果他们停留超过1小时，就有可能遭遇一只从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b11mudwallho00]{B11} 穿过后院游荡过来的蹑影小魔怪，它正在四处寻找可供破坏的东西。

B9. Treesparrow’s Rest

None of the sacks or chests of rice, millet, or buckwheat in this storefront have been damaged. The pots and vases of fermenting bean paste, rice wine, or pickled vegetables on the shelves also remain untouched.

The front doors of the grain shop are unlocked. The PCs can use this place to take a 10-minute rest (potentially taking a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qc0VsZ0UesnurUUB]{Take a Breather} activity), though if they stay longer than an hour, they risk facing a jinkin who wanders over from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b11mudwallho00]{B11} through the backyard on the hunt for something to ruin.

Infested Stables.name: 虫害马厩 Infested Stables
Infested Stables.text:
B8. 虫害马厩 Low 1

腐肉与烂肉的气味凝滞不散。里面横陈着十几匹马。大多数都在死去时双眼圆睁，共同承受着生命最后时刻的痛苦。

虫害马厩 Low 1

@UUID[Actor.JNWxfQmsosE4fWpK]{蟑螂群}

生物：一群蟑螂把尸体被剖开的体腔当成了巢穴。它们一旦在马厩里侦测到生物，便会汇聚成群并发动攻击。尽管这群虫群在长明灯被点亮后会失去其残酷的群体意识（以及说话的能力），它们依然饥饿难耐，并会战斗至死。

B8. Infested Stables Low 1

The smell of offal and rotten meat stagnates. Inside lay a dozen horses. Most died with their eyes wide open, sharing the pain of their last moments.

Infested Stables Low 1

@UUID[Actor.JNWxfQmsosE4fWpK]{Cockroach Swarm}

Creatures: A swarm of cockroaches made their home inside the corpses’ eviscerated cavities. They converge into a swarm and attack as soon as they detect a creature in the stables. While this swarm loses its cruel hive mind (along with the ability to speak) once the Eternal Lantern is lit, it remains ravenous and fights to the death.

Training Yard.name: 训练场 Training Yard
Training Yard.text:
B7. 训练场

一串带血的脚印从马厩延伸出来，穿过这处沙地训练场北侧的门。

如果PC成功通过一次 @Check[survival|dc:9|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] 检定来追踪这串痕迹，他们最终会来到乐河童浴场（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b15mostlyhap00]{B15}），那里的河童们正惬意地沐浴着。

B7. Training Yard

A trail of bloody prints extends from the stables out through the northern gates of the sandy training yard.

If the PCs Track this trail with a successful @Check[survival|dc:9|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] check, they end up at the Happy Kappa (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b15mostlyhap00]{B15}), where the kappas are enjoying a good bath.

Armory.name: 军械库 Armory
Armory.text:
B6. 军械库

通往这一区域的门锁得很严实。没有任何缝隙或窗户可供向内窥视。

军械库大门上的锁质量上乘，需要五次成功的 @Check[thievery|dc:30|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] 检定才能开锁，不过这些门也可以用藏在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b4prison000000]{B4} 的钥匙打开。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.qFIXf0T7EUPSL2rm]{军械库}
这间军械库内有十二套标准鳞甲和十二套镶钉皮甲，另有 10 把弩、一桶 100 支弩矢、十二把匕首、六根短棒以及四根警棍。除了这些普通物品之外，这里的补给还包括四个次等寒霜瓶、一把寒铁匕首、一面寒铁小圆盾、一把银制短剑，以及一把+1 矛。

B6. Armory

The doors to this area are locked tight. There are no cracks or windows to peek inside.

The locks on the door to the armory are of good quality, which requires five successful @Check[thievery|dc:30|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] checks to Pick the Lock, but the doors can also be unlocked by the key hidden in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b4prison000000]{B4}.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.qFIXf0T7EUPSL2rm]{Armory}
This armory contains a dozen standard suits of scale mail and studded leather armor each, along with 10 crossbows, a barrel of 100 bolts, a dozen daggers, six clubs, and four saps. In addition to these mundane items, the supplies here include four lesser frost vials, a cold iron dagger, a cold iron buckler, a silver shortsword, and a +1 spear.

Outdoor Prison Cell.name: 户外监牢囚室 Outdoor Prison Cell
Outdoor Prison Cell.text:
B5. 户外监牢囚室

这个竹制笼子被用作关押犯下轻罪者的囚室。

生物：四名村民被扔进这里“悔过”，否则就有被送去茶馆的风险，这条信息他们可以告诉PC。PC可以通过两种方式解救这些村民：成功进行一次 @Check[athletics|dc:22|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] 检定以强行打开笼子，或将笼子砸开（AC 16，硬度 5，HP 20）。或者，他们也可以使用来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b4prison000000]{B4} 的钥匙打开铁制笼门。

@UUID[Actor.ZkBlrAL6nOMVjuH2]{被囚禁的村民 (4)} 生物 –1

  • 中型
  • 人类
  • 类人

奖励：如果PC救出囚犯并护送他们到安全地点，则给予PC 20 XP以及在南岸的1声望点。

B5. Outdoor Prison Cell

This bamboo cage serves as a holding cell for those who commit petty crimes.

Creatures: Four villagers have been thrown in here to “repent” or risk being sent to the teahouse, a piece of information they can share with the PCs. The PCs can free these villagers by either breaking through the bamboo with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:22|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] check to Force Open the cage or by smashing the cage open (AC 16, Hardness 5, HP 20). Alternately, they can unlock the iron cage door using the keys from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b4prison000000]{B4}.

@UUID[Actor.ZkBlrAL6nOMVjuH2]{Imprisoned Villagers (4)} Creature –1

  • Medium
  • Human
  • Humanoid

Reward: If the PCs rescue the prisoners and escort them to safety, grant the PCs 20 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Southbank.

Prison.name: 监狱 Prison
Prison.text:
B4. 监狱

这间昏暗肮脏的房间便是柳岸镇牢房所在之处。七间牢房都有铁栏杆和砖墙。

生物：当怪物入侵时，10名守卫被俘并关进了这里的七间牢房中，守卫队长郑鹏则被单独锁在最东北侧的牢房里。虽然每间牢房的锁都只是普通品质（四次成功的@Check[thievery|dc:25|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock]即可开锁），但郑鹏预先藏好牢房和军械库备用钥匙的应急计划终于派上了用场。当玩家角色到达时，他会朝他们喊话，告诉他们牢房的备用钥匙藏在房间西南角一块松动砖块下面。他请求玩家角色取回钥匙，立刻释放他和其他守卫。若没有他的帮助，玩家角色在搜索这间房间时，可以通过一次成功的@Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search]检定发现藏起来的钥匙。

郑鹏描述道，有一个看起来像人类的身影——一个光头、牙齿尖利、披着兜帽斗篷的男人，而且他的脖子似乎能扭转到远超常理的角度——与几只蹑影小魔怪一同组织了对兵营的袭击。他不知道那男人和他的小魔怪们在袭击后去了哪里。

在恢复之前，郑鹏和他的守卫们都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}状态，生命值为1，并因遭受折磨而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱3}；此外，他们也全都没有武器和护甲。

@UUID[Actor.dMbrraAblnkaazSJ]{郑鹏} 生物 3

  • 中型
  • 人类
  • 类人生物

@UUID[Actor.xOHpHLI3Cb5R8xcS]{城镇卫兵 (10)} 生物 1

  • 中型
  • 人类
  • 类人生物

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.HiAo9BtbmXPhEnfU]{角落} @UUID[Actor.YsV46C0wpDNnFaQS]{郑的钥匙}
郑鹏将军械库钥匙交给玩家角色，并邀请他们从房间里取走任何有助于解放市中心行动的所需物品。

奖励：如果玩家角色救出这些守卫，他们获得40 XP以及来自北岭的1点声望点。

B4. Prison

This dingy room is where Willowshore’s prison cells are located. The seven cells have iron bars and brick walls.

Creatures: When the monsters invaded, 10 guards were captured and thrown into the seven cells here, with guard Captain Zheng Peng, locked away in the northeastern-most cell on his own. While each of the cells has a lock of average quality (four @Check[thievery|dc:25|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] successes can Pick the Lock), Zheng Peng’s contingency plan of hiding backup keys to the cells and armory finally pays off. When the PCs arrive, he calls over to them and informs them that a spare set of keys for the cells are hidden under a loose brick in the southwest corner of the room. He asks the PCs to retrieve the keys and release him and the other guards at once. Without his aid, a PC who Searches this room can discover the hidden keys with a successful @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check.

Zheng Peng describes how one human-looking figure—a bald man with sharp teeth who wore a hooded cloak and whose neck seemed capable of rotating more than it should—organized the attack on the barracks along with several jinkins. He’s unaware of where the man and his gremlins headed after the attack.

Until they recover, Zheng Peng and his guards are all @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, at 1 Hit Point, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} from their torments; they’re also all unarmed and unarmored.

@UUID[Actor.dMbrraAblnkaazSJ]{Zheng Peng} Creature 3

  • Medium
  • Human
  • Humanoid

@UUID[Actor.xOHpHLI3Cb5R8xcS]{Town Guards (10)} Creature 1

  • Medium
  • Human
  • Humanoid

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.HiAo9BtbmXPhEnfU]{Corner} @UUID[Actor.YsV46C0wpDNnFaQS]{Zheng's Key}
Zheng gives the PCs the armory key and invites them to take whatever they need from the room to aid them in their attempt to liberate downtown.

Reward: The PCs gain 40 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Northridge if they rescue the guards.

Guard House Courtyard.name: 卫兵房庭院 Guard House Courtyard
Guard House Courtyard.text:
B3. 卫兵房庭院

这座小型下沉式庭院被盛放的紫藤花棚遮蔽，从上方难以看见。

这座庭院过去是守卫们放松休息的地方，不过许多人都指出，他们更希望这片地方能有些实际用途。

B3. Guard House Courtyard

This small sunken courtyard is hidden from above by a canopy of wisteria in full bloom.

This courtyard used to be a place for guards to relax, though many have pointed out how they would much rather have a practical use for the space.

Imperial Guard Office.name: 帝国卫队办公室 Imperial Guard Office
Imperial Guard Office.text:
B2. 帝国卫队办公室

这间办公室看起来像是被飓风席卷过一样，文件散落得满屋都是。房间里几乎没剩下什么家具。

这间办公室里的家具被用来在晨步桥上搭建咕噜肚的王座了，只剩下一只摇摇欲坠的书架、一张书桌，以及几把破椅子，和如今散落在地板各处的罪犯档案一起留在这里。

B2. Imperial Guard Office

The office looks like a hurricane has been through it, with documents strewn about the room. Very few furnishings remain in the room at all.

The furniture from this office was used to build Gurglegut’s throne on Dawnstep Bridge, leaving only one flimsy bookshelf, a desk, and a couple of broken chairs behind among the criminal records now scattered all over the floor.

Empty Lot.name: 空地 Empty Lot
Empty Lot.text:
B1. 空地

总督庄园——就在昨天还是市中心最耀眼的明珠——如今已经消失无踪。唯一表明这片空地上曾经有过一栋建筑的迹象，便是那两尊曾守卫庄园入口的石狮。它们都已遭到污损与破坏。

赫总督连同他的整座庄园一起，被困在一个平行心景之中。每当柳岸镇心景重置时，镇上的人们都不得不再次应对他们失踪的领袖以及他消失的庄园这一发现。关于这一谜团之后给城镇带来的更多后果，见第一幕开头，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{第三章}。

B1. Empty Lot

The Governor’s Manor, just yesterday the crowning jewel of downtown, has vanished. The only indication that there was once a building in this empty lot are the two guardian stone lions that once guarded the entrance of the manor. Both have been defaced and damaged.

Governor Heh became trapped in a parallel mindscape, along with his entire manor. Each time Willowshore’s mindscape resets, the townspeople must contend all over again with the discovery of their missing leader and his vanished manor. See the start of Act 1, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil]{Chapter 3} for a few additional repercussions to the town in the wake of this mystery.

Downtown Locations.name: 市中心地点 Downtown Locations
Downtown Locations.text:
市中心地点

书中提供了柳岸镇镇区（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w19downtownw00]{W19}）的一般详情，但那些信息描述的是较为安全时期的情况。如今，镇区的街道空无一人。暴力的痕迹无处不在——街道与墙壁上飞溅的血迹、排水沟里的破损武器，以及被砸毁的门窗。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.AV28Lyw8ARMP1tny]{被占领的柳岸镇}

镇区地图上的许多地点（见封二）都没有数字编号。这些未标注的建筑要么是空置住宅、废弃商店，要么是部分完工的建筑。它们可以为PC们提供藏身之处或庇护所。如果你的某位玩家将一栋镇区建筑选作了自己的家，那么在与该玩家一起确定哪栋建筑属于他们之后，使用 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03returninghom00]{返回家园} 来处理该遭遇。

Downtown Locations

General details on downtown Willowshore (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w19downtownw00]{W19}) are provided, but that information relates to the area during safer times. Currently, the streets of downtown are empty. Evidence of violence lies everywhere—splashes of blood on the streets and walls, broken weapons in gutters, and smashed doors and windows.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.AV28Lyw8ARMP1tny]{Occupied Willowshore}

Many of the locations on the map of downtown (see inside front cover) lack numerical codes. These unlabeled buildings are either empty homes, abandoned shops, or partially completed structures. They can provide the PCs with hiding spots or shelter. If one of your players has selected a downtown building as their home, then use @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh.JournalEntryPage.03returninghom00]{Returning Home} to resolve that encounter after working with that player to determine which building is theirs.

Liberating Downtown.name: 解放市中心 Liberating Downtown
Liberating Downtown.text:
解放市中心

无论PC与谁结盟，请求都是一样的——必须解放柳岸镇镇区。PC很可能已经击败了三个怪物头目之一（咕噜肚，这个团伙里的“打手”），但另外两个（灰屠夫和莫斗秋）已稳稳盘踞在镇区，要击败他们会更加困难。

随着咕噜肚被击败，且长明灯被点亮，灰屠夫和莫斗秋意识到他们对柳岸镇的控制已开始变得不稳。灰屠夫开始在镇区的街道上巡逻，PC随时都可能遭遇他们。若要面对莫斗秋（作为怪物们的幕后主使），PC必须潜入他选作自己堡垒的建筑——破败的青天茶馆。

@UUID[Actor.ZKqa4lSnhV2XmtnH]{守护灵的支援}
无论PC是与胡婆婆还是松木老人结盟，他们的守护灵都不会让他们在毫无支援的情况下进入镇区。在PC处理@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh]{Chapter 1}中的各场遭遇期间，他们的守护灵收集了十瓶 初级治疗药水和八枚潜能水晶护符，并将这些物品交给PC，由他们自行决定如何使用。

Liberating Downtown

Whomever the PCs ally with, the request is the same—downtown Willowshore must be liberated. It’s likely that the PCs have already defeated one of the three monster ringleaders (Gurglegut, the “muscle” of the group), but the other two (Gray Butcher and Mo Douqiu) are firmly ensconced in downtown and will be more difficult to defeat.

With Gurglegut defeated and the Eternal Lantern lit, Gray Butcher and Mo Douqiu realize that their grip on Willowshore has grown tenuous. Gray Butcher takes to patrolling downtown’s streets, and the PCs could encounter them at any time. To confront Mo Douqiu (who serves as the mastermind of the monsters), the PCs must infiltrate the building he has chosen as his fortress—the ruined Cerulean Teahouse.

@UUID[Actor.ZKqa4lSnhV2XmtnH]{Patron's Support}
Regardless of whether the PCs ally with Granny Hu or Old Matsuki, their patron doesn’t send them into downtown without support. While the PCs were handling the encounters in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog03toligh]{Chapter 1}, their patron gathered up a supply of ten minor healing potions and eight potency crystal talismans and delivers the items to the PCs for them to use as they see fit.

Reclaiming Willowshire.name: 夺回柳郡 Reclaiming Willowshire
Reclaiming Willowshire.text:
第2章： 夺回柳岸镇

一旦长明灯被点亮，诡异的超自然迷雾与月光被驱散，柳岸镇大部分地区的怪物与危险也会随之平息。一直躲在家中或聚集在安全区域的居民谨慎地走出来，然而柳岸镇的人民依然惊惧。此前从未发生过这样的事，而镇上的领袖们也正忙于让居民感到舒适、安全与冷静。不过，镇上仍有一个显著区域处于危险之中：柳岸镇镇区依旧被怪物控制，任何被困在那里的居民仍是囚徒，甚至可能遭遇更糟的命运。更令人不安的是，如今迷雾已经散去，白昼之光照出了某件真正令人震惊的事。总督庄园曾坐落于柳岸镇镇区东北角落，如今却消失了！

此时，玩家角色应该已经见过柳岸镇最有影响力的两位长者：“胡婆婆” (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21grannyhubann00]{胡半娘}，代表北岭) 与“老松木” (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21oldmatsukish00]{松木胜}，代表南岸)。这两位非玩家角色都在本冒险结尾处有完整介绍，其中包括影响数据表，玩家角色可以使用这些数据表来获得额外好处。两人都希望玩家角色尽其所能解放柳岸镇镇区，而长者们则专注于在这段艰难时期保护各自辖区民众的安全。玩家角色选择与哪位长者合作由他们自己决定，但他们选择支援哪个派系，将有助于决定柳岸镇在本战役余下篇章中的未来。

Chapter 2: Reclaiming Willowshore

Once the Eternal Lantern is lit and the eerie supernatural mists and moonlight are banished, the monsters and perils in most of Willowshore abate as well. Citizens who have been hiding in their homes or gathering in safe zones emerge cautiously, yet the people of Willowshore remain frightened. Nothing like this has happened before, and the town’s leaders have their hands full keeping the citizens comfortable, safe, and calm. One notable part of town is still in danger, though: downtown Willowshore remains controlled by monsters, and any citizens who were trapped there remain prisoners or worse. More disturbing, now that the mists are gone, the light of day reveals something truly unsettling. The governor’s manor, once situated at the northeastern corner of downtown Willowshore, has vanished!

At this point, the PCs should have met with Willowshore’s most influential elders, “Granny Hu” (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21grannyhubann00]{Hu Ban-niang}, representing Northridge) and “Old Matsuki” (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21oldmatsukish00]{Matsuki Shou}, representing Southbank). Both of these NPCs have full write-ups at the end of the adventure, including influence stat blocks the PCs can use to gain additional benefits. Both want the PCs to do what they can to liberate downtown while the elders focus on keeping their constituents safe during these troubled times. Which elder the PCs choose to work with is up to them, but their choice of which faction to support will help decide Willowshore’s future throughout the remainder of this campaign.

Concluding the Chapter.name: 本章总结 Concluding the Chapter
Concluding the Chapter.text:
本章总结

当三个怪物头目都被击败，且长明灯再次被点亮后，本章便告结束。柳岸镇中剩余的怪物会逃回周边的荒野，但如果你愿意，也可以让其中一些躲藏到城镇里的其他地方，让PC在冒险继续时有额外的任务需要处理。

场景笔记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.x5igH32eFlcD1P5V]{柳岸镇}

Concluding the Chapter

This chapter ends once the three monstrous ringleaders are defeated and the Eternal Lantern is once again lit. The remaining monsters in Willowshore flee back into the surrounding wilderness, but if you want, some of them could end up hiding somewhere else in town, giving the PCs additional tasks to deal with as the adventure continues.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.HgqDtdyAVJFT3Dr1.PlaylistSound.x5igH32eFlcD1P5V]{Willowshore}

Second Floor.name: 二楼 Second Floor
Second Floor.text:
C4. 二楼 微不足道 1

这里曾是一处可让客人享用茶水、安静交谈的放松区域，如今房间里的家具和墙壁都已遭到破坏，布满深深的抓痕。东北侧的墙上还被砸出了一个洞。

青天茶馆的二楼离地10英尺高，通往上方的楼梯因年久失修而会发出噪音。任何攀爬楼梯的人都会自动令楼梯嘎吱作响，并惊动栖身于此的生物。尝试以隐秘方式通过楼梯时会承受–4物品减值。

二楼 微不足道 1

@UUID[Actor.osxHAxPAbowaFn1b]{刺仔}

生物：莫斗秋最后一只宠物，一只名叫刺仔、体型如人、颜色暗绿夹杂脏黄的森林蝎子，栖居于此。这只森林蝎子比疣儿狡猾得多。如果察觉到入侵者，刺仔不会立刻爬下楼梯加入战斗，而是会先躲藏在此处的椽梁间，希望在让PC们探索此地几轮后，再突然扑下发动攻击。当战斗开始时，刺仔以隐秘进行先攻检定，并会战斗至死。

C4. Second Floor Trivial 1

Once a relaxing area in which guests could enjoy tea and quiet conversation, the furniture and walls of this room have been vandalized and bear deep scratches. A hole has been smashed into the wall to the northeast.

The second floor of the Cerulean Teahouse is 10 feet aboveground, and the stairs leading up are noisy from lack of maintenance. Someone who climbs the stairs automatically causes them to creak and alerts the creature that dwells up here. Attempts to traverse the stairs via Stealth suffer a –4 item penalty.

Second Floor Trivial 1

@UUID[Actor.osxHAxPAbowaFn1b]{Stingy}

Creatures: Mo Douqiu’s final pet, a dull green and dirty yellow human-sized forest scorpion named Stingy, dwells here. The forest scorpion is far more subtle than Warty. If alerted to intruders, Stingy doesn’t immediately clamber down the stairs to join the fight but instead Hides in the rafters here, hoping to drop on the PCs and attack unexpectedly after allowing them a few rounds to explore the place. When combat begins, Stingy rolls for initiative with Stealth and fights to the death.

Private Banquet Hall.name: 私人宴会厅 Private Banquet Hall
Private Banquet Hall.text:
C3. 私人宴会厅 Moderate 1

这间曾经布置考究的宴会室，如今已变成肮脏污秽的巢穴，四处散落着未洗的餐具、食物污渍，以及看起来像是多场骇人屠杀过后的残迹。被剥了皮或被部分消化到难以辨认的尸体，成堆地倒在角落里，或从上方木梁上系着的绳索间摇晃。房间中央有一堆肮脏污秽的靠垫和毯子，像鸟巢般堆成一团。

生物：莫斗秋是个毫不掩饰的享乐主义者，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c1publicfloo00]{C1}区域或楼上@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c4secondfloo00]{C4}区域传来的战斗声，还不足以让他对玩家角色作出反应；但只要南墙上的拉门一被打开，这只辘轳首便重重叹一口气，承认自己得亲自处理这些入侵者了。

一旦与玩家角色碰面，莫斗秋便会从房间中央那堆肮脏靠垫上稍稍坐直身子，随后漫不经心地说，虽然他没叫人来表演，但他接受这份“新娱乐”。他又往后一靠，等着玩家角色“开始他们的表演”，同时又抱起另一大壶酒猛灌。如果有人问他所谓的表演是什么意思，莫斗秋会简短地这样回答。

“跳舞！唱歌！打架！什么够娱乐都行！活着不就是为了这个吗，所以给我活得像样点！不然，就派上你的用场，去喂疣儿吧。也就是说，把你的宝藏留在这里，让那只饿坏的小东西把你一口吞下去。反正大多数人拿来当蟾蜍饲料更有价值。”

如果玩家角色询问他为什么入侵柳岸镇，莫斗秋会回答：

“因为这镇子无聊透顶！每个人都日复一日地工作，只为了勉强糊口。年年如此，一遍又一遍做着同样的事。拼命工作，就只是为了活下去。要是你看到所有人永远陷在同一种可怕的老套日常里，难道不会也想给这一切添点乐子吗？”

如果玩家角色质疑他的理念，并指出他造成的暴力与伤害，这只辘轳首会说：

“但这算是变化，对吧？没有什么比被扔进恐怖故事正中央更能改变一个人了！人们都喜欢那些吓人的故事，你知道的，那为什么不亲自活上一回呢？”他爆发出一阵震耳大笑，然后问道：“承认吧。你们难道玩得不开心吗？！”

再继续和莫斗秋交谈下去，也只会围绕同样的话题打转；这只辘轳首明显乐于见到恣意破坏，也乐于把恐惧与痛苦灌输给他人。他几乎像是在故意激怒玩家角色，好让他们先动手。莫斗秋不会发动第一次攻击，但一旦战斗开始，他便会命令自己剩余的宠物起来护卫他。其中包括疣儿（如果那只巨蟾蜍还活着）和刺仔（如果那只蝎子还活着）；不过如果玩家角色已经击败了这两只动物，莫斗秋仍可以依靠他的宠物鼬鼠毛须，让它从自己的袖子里爬出来，从肩头跃下，与他并肩作战。由于他喜欢高谈阔论，又迟疑着不愿先开战，这只辘轳首以社群进行先攻掷骰。

私人宴会厅 Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.tSkFiv7gwtb8xEaA]{享乐主义者莫都求} @UUID[Actor.WZzYaUwCfKNV4U1q]{毛须}

莫斗秋偏好以挫败士气玩家角色为核心的战术，尤其是使用威吓猛扑。他甚至不介意在战斗中“浪费”一个动作，只为了咯咯怪笑，或是从一只清酒碟里拖泥带水地狠狠干上一大口。莫斗秋沉醉于暴力之中，会战斗至死。他甚至会边死边笑，最后带着一副失控扭曲的笑容死去。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.kb81yBug06ZyJjSE]{私人宴会厅} @UUID[Actor.vpTjs5jRg5a21TCm]{莫斗秋}
虽然莫斗秋毁掉了茶室里大多数有价值的物品，但仍有一件东西逃过了他的注意——一条不知为何没被弄脏、而且状态还相对完好的戏法手帕。莫斗秋身上还带着通往@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c2pantrypris00]{C2}区域门锁的钥匙。

奖励：若击败莫斗秋，为玩家角色在柳岸镇的每个派系各授予1点声望点。如果玩家角色还确保将这间房中的所有尸体从梁上取下，并恭敬地加以遮盖或以其他方式整理妥当，好让镇上其余人能体面地见到他们，并为其准备合宜的葬礼，则该队伍在每个派系中再各获得1点声望点。

C3. Private Banquet Hall Moderate 1

This once-elaborate banquet room has become a den of filth, littered with unwashed dishes, food stains, and what looks to be the aftermath of many grisly slaughters. Bodies flayed or partially digested to the point of being unrecognizable lie heaped in corners or sway from ropes tied to wooden beams above. A pile of filthy, soiled cushions and blankets lies in a nest-like heap in the middle of the room.

Creatures: Mo Douqiu is an unabashed hedonist, and it’ll take more than the sounds of battle in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c1publicfloo00]{C1} or upstairs in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c4secondfloo00]{C4} to get him to respond to the PCs, but as soon as the sliding doors on the south wall are opened, the rokurokubi gives a heavy sigh, conceding that he’ll need to handle the intruders himself.

Once confronted by the PCs, Mo Douqiu shifts into a more upright position on the filthy cushions he’s sprawled on in the middle of the room, then casually notes that while he didn’t call for performers, he accepts the “new entertainment.” He sits back to wait for the PCs to “start their performance” as he begins chugging yet another large jug of alcohol. If asked what he means by a performance, Mo Douqiu curtly states the following.

“Dance! Sing! Fight! Whatever is entertaining! It’s what living is all about, so LIVE! Otherwise, make use of yourself and go feed Warty. As in, leave your treasure here and let that hungry critter just gobble you down. Most people are better as toad food anyway.”

If the PCs ask why he invaded Willowshore, Mo Douqiu replies:

“Because this town is the most boring place ever! Everyone’s working day in, day out, just to make ends meet. Every single year, doing the same thing over and over again. All that work just to survive. Wouldn’t you want to liven this up too if you see everyone forever mired in the same dreadful routine?”

If the PCs question his philosophy and point out the violence he’s caused, the rokurokubi says:

“But it was a change, right? Nothing changes you more than being thrown into the middle of a horror story! People love those terrifying tales, you know, so why not live through one?” He breaks into a roaring laugh, then asks, “Admit it. Haven’t you been having fun?!”

Any further conversation with Mo Douqiu’s proceeds along the same line, with the rokurokubi showing a distinct delight for wanton destruction and instilling fear and distress in others. It’s almost as if he wants to provoke the PCs into starting a fight. He won’t make the first attack, but once combat begins, he commands his remaining pets to rise to his defense. This includes Warty (if the giant toad still lives) and Stingy (if the scorpion still lives), but if the PCs have already defeated these two animals, Mo Douqiu can still rely upon his pet weasel, Fluffy Whiskers, to clamber out of his sleeves, launch off his shoulders, and fight at his side. As a result of his philosophizing and hesitance to start the fight, the rokurokubi rolls for initiative with Society.

Private Banquet Hall Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.tSkFiv7gwtb8xEaA]{Mo Douqiu the Hedonist} @UUID[Actor.WZzYaUwCfKNV4U1q]{Fluffy Whiskers}

Mo Douqiu favors tactics focused on Demoralizing the PCs, particularly by using Threatening Lunge. He’s not above “wasting” an action during combat to cackle or take a long, sloppy gulp from a dish of sake. Reveling in the violence, Mo Douqiu fights to the death. He even laughs as he dies, ending with an unhinged grin on his face in death.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.kb81yBug06ZyJjSE]{Private Banquet Hall} @UUID[Actor.vpTjs5jRg5a21TCm]{Mo Douqiu}
While Mo Douqiu has ruined most of the objects of value in the teahouse, one item—a somehow-unsoiled and in relatively good condition legerdemain handkerchief—has escaped his attention. Mo Douqiu also carries the keys to the locks on the doors to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c2pantrypris00]{C2}.

Reward: For defeating Mo Douqiu, grant the PCs 1 Reputation Point with each of Willowshore’s factions. If the PCs also ensure all the bodies in this room are removed from the beams and respectfully covered or otherwise made presentable to the rest of the town so they can be prepared for proper funerals, grant the party 1 additional Reputation Point with each faction.

Pantry Prison.name: 储藏室监狱 Pantry Prison
Pantry Prison.text:
C2. 储藏室监狱

通往这个房间的两扇门都用重型挂锁锁着。莫斗秋带着这些锁的钥匙；否则，角色可以通过进行三次 @Check[thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick the Lock] 检定来撬锁。或者，角色也可以分别对每扇坚固的门进行一次 @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open|name:Force Open] 检定来强行打开。

这间食品储藏间里几乎没什么存货，剩下的补给也早已腐坏。房间里弥漫着一股氨气的臭味。

这股刺鼻的氨气味来自食品储藏间里几种腐坏原料缓慢发生的反应——任何在此房间内结束其回合的角色都必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:15] 强韧豁免，否则便会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

生物：莫斗秋几乎不用这间房当食品储藏间，反而将其改成了一处临时监狱，用来关押他和他那些怪物爪牙目前为止抓到的12名村民。这12名男女都惊恐万分，手脚都被一圈圈绳索捆住，担心自己性命不保。囚犯们安静却满怀希望地看着任何PC，因害怕惊动莫斗秋而不敢呼救。12人目前都处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏} 状态。

@UUID[Actor.rkTSYIcQYB0CtWxW]{被囚禁的村民 (12)} 生物 –1

  • 中型
  • 人类
  • 类人生物

奖励：如果PC们释放了这些俘虏，给予他们40 XP，以及与每个派系各1点声望点。

C2. Pantry Prison

Both doors to this room are locked with heavy-duty padlocks. Mo Douqiu carries the key to these locks; otherwise, a character can open them with three @Check[thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick the Lock] checks to Pick the Lock. Alternately, a character can Force Open these sturdy doors with a single @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open|name:Force Open] check each.

This pantry is poorly stocked, with any remaining supplies having spoiled long ago. The stink of ammonia lingers in the room.

The pungent smell of ammonia comes from a slow reaction of several spoiled ingredients in the pantry—a character who ends their turn in this room must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Creatures: Mo Douqiu has little use for this room as a pantry and instead has turned it into an impromptu prison to hold the 12 villagers he and his monstrous agents have captured so far. All 12 of these men and women are terrified, bound hand and foot with coils of rope and fearful for their lives. The prisoners look quietly but hopefully at any PCs, too afraid to cry out for help in fear of alerting Mo Douqiu. All 12 are currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

@UUID[Actor.rkTSYIcQYB0CtWxW]{Imprisoned Villagers (12)} Creature –1

  • Medium
  • Human
  • Humanoid

Reward: Grant the PCs 40 XP and 1 Reputation Point with each faction if they free these captives.

Public Floor.name: 公共楼层 Public Floor
Public Floor.text:
C1. 公共楼层 Low 1

这间房间曾经精美上漆的木墙如今布满暴力破坏的痕迹，到处都是刻痕与刮擦。青天茶馆的前台柜台上满是破碎的壶、瓶子和杯子。一张桌子被掀翻在侧，当时摆在上面的餐具也一并散落。另一张桌子仍立在东南角落，这张桌子却诡异地摆放整齐、布置妥当，仿佛正在等待客人到来。楼梯通向东北方向的楼上阳台。北墙一侧有高出两尺的木制平台，几级台阶通往其上，平台边有数扇推拉门紧闭，只有西北角落例外——那里一处壁龛中放着两座未点燃的炉灶，旁边还有一扇较小的木门。

这里已被废弃数月，而莫斗秋的到来也没给青天茶馆带来任何好处。这里的大部分破坏都是他的蹑影小魔怪爪牙造成的，不过它们后来已经离开了。莫斗秋平时待在私人宴会厅（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c3privateban00]{C3}），但他曾动过念头，想与如今栖身在西边旧伐木营地中的一些无脸妖会面（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog06thewal]{第4章}）。西南方那张布置好的桌子正是为这样一场会面而准备的，但在他尚不能确定自己已完全控制柳岸镇之前，这名辘轳首还没有向无脸妖发出邀请。

生物：莫斗秋让他的宠物巨蟾蜍疣儿在这间房间里自由游荡。当长明灯 尚未点燃时，疣儿满口脏话，喜欢用他的舌头去捣弄任何引起他兴趣的东西（尤其是闪亮的东西）；但一旦玩家角色点亮提灯，苦迦菩提对这只巨蟾蜍的影响就会减弱（尽管他仍然对闪亮的东西很感兴趣）。疣儿依然忠于莫斗秋，但会更满足于把时间花在楼梯旁睡觉，那楼梯通向上方阳台。如果被入侵者惊醒，他就会兴奋地呱呱叫着，笨重地向前扑去发起攻击。

公共楼层 Low 1

@UUID[Actor.mmI62LfQ2mvhj7Xa]{疣儿}

只要外面发出动静的只有疣儿，莫斗秋就会以为这只巨蟾蜍只是在胡闹，并从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c3privateban00]{C3} 里喊道：“安静点，疣儿！我一会儿就给你弄点吃的！”就连玩家角色在这间房间中战斗的明显声响，也不足以惊动这名辘轳首——只有当他们进入他的房间时，他才会作出反应。

除非有人命令他停下，否则不明就里的疣儿会战斗至死。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.6ROWduPklUTF6Bdr]{前台柜台}
如果玩家角色在前台柜台搜索至少几分钟，他们就会自动发现一些文书，清楚表明这家茶馆的财务困境早在龙华衰落之前就已经开始了。这些文件中还包括一份题为“庆麦来的最后遗嘱”的文书；玩家角色知道，麦莱是青天茶馆的最后一任主人。如果玩家角色想将茶馆作为生意来经营，那么这份文件就是他们让自己对茶馆的主张合法化的关键。更多信息见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05opportunitie00#the-teahouse-owners-will]{茶馆主人的遗嘱}。

C1. Public Floor Low 1

The once finely lacquered wooden walls of this room bear evidence of violence, covered now with gouges and scrapes. The front counter of the teahouse is a mess of broken pots, bottles, and cups. A table has been turned on its side, along with whatever dishes were on it at the time. Another table still stands in the southeast corner, this one strangely well placed and set, as if expecting guests. Stairs lead up to an upstairs balcony to the northeast. Steps lead up two feet to an upraised wooden platform running along the northern wall, where several sliding doors stand closed save for the northwest corner, in which two unlit stoves sit in an alcove near a smaller wooden door.

Abandoned for months, Mo Douqiu’s arrival did no favors to the Cerulean Teahouse. His jinkin minions did most of the damage here, although they’ve moved on since then. While Mo Douqiu spends his time in the private banquet hall (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c3privateban00]{C3}), he has entertained the notion of potentially meeting with some of the noppera-bos who now dwell in the lumber camp to the west (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog06thewal]{Chapter 4}). The set table to the southwest has been prepared for just such a meeting, but until he can be sure he has full control of Willowshore, the rokurokubi hasn’t yet contacted the noppera-bos with his invitation.

Creatures: Mo Douqiu lets his pet giant toad, Warty, wander about this room freely. While the Eternal Lantern was unlit, Warty had a foul-mouthed personality and enjoyed using his tongue to mess with anything that caught his interest (particularly shiny things), but once the PCs light the lantern, Kugaptee’s influence over the giant toad diminishes (although he retains his interest in shiny things). Warty remains loyal to Mo Douqiu, but is more content to spend his time sleeping near the stairs leading up to the balcony. If he’s awoken by intruders, he begins to croak eagerly and lumbers forward to attack.

Public Floor Low 1

@UUID[Actor.mmI62LfQ2mvhj7Xa]{Warty}

As long as Warty is the only one making noise out here, Mo Douqiu assumes the giant toad is just being frisky and yells out from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c3privateban00]{C3}, “Settle down, Warty! I’ll get you some food in a bit!” Even the obvious sound of PCs fighting in this room fails to rouse the rokurokubi—he’ll only respond to them once they enter his chamber.

Unless commanded to heel, Warty, not knowing any better, fights to the death.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.6ROWduPklUTF6Bdr]{Front Counter}
If the PCs Search the front counter for at least a few minutes, they automatically discover paperwork that lays bare the fact that the teahouse’s financial troubles began long before Lung Wa collapsed. The papers also include a document titled “The Last Will and Testament of Qing Mai-Lai”; the PCs know Mai-Lai was the last proprietor of the Cerulean Teahouse. This document is key to the PCs legitimizing their claim over the teahouse if they want to run it as a business. See @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05opportunitie00#the-teahouse-owners-will]{The Teahouse Owner’s Will} for more information.

Cerulean Teahouse.name: 青天茶馆 Cerulean Teahouse
Cerulean Teahouse.text:
青天茶馆

青天茶馆（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w22thecerule00]{W22}）位于市中心正北方，从市中心地图沿西北街道再前进约100英尺即可抵达。PC们可能早在他们从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b4prison000000]{B4} 或 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b5outdoorpri00]{B5} 解救囚犯时，就会得知这座被遗弃的茶馆正被莫斗秋当作“总部”使用。然而，如果他们在解放市中心的过程中没有发现这一消息，务必让他们从某人那里得知，因为在莫斗秋被击败之前，柳岸镇都无法摆脱怪物势力的影响。当然，他们也可能只是在探索柳岸镇时，意外闯入莫斗秋的地盘。无论他们是如何来到茶馆的，他们都会发现其中潜藏着恐怖之物，因为莫斗秋可以说是三名怪物头目中最为可怕的一个。

Cerulean Teahouse

The Cerulean Teahouse (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w22thecerule00]{W22}) is located just north of downtown and can be approached by heading up the northwestern street from the downtown map for about 100 more feet. The PCs might learn that the abandoned teahouse is being used as Mo Douqiu’s “headquarters” as early as when they free prisoners from areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b4prison000000]{B4} or @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b5outdoorpri00]{B5}. However, if they don’t discover this news through the course of liberating downtown, make sure they learn about it from someone since Willowshore won’t be free of monstrous influence until Mo Douqiu is defeated. Of course, they might also simply stumble into Mo Douqiu’s domain accidentally while they’re exploring Willowshore. However they come to the teahouse, they’ll find horrors within, for Mo Douqiu is arguably the worst of the three monstrous ringleaders.

A Parade of Cookware.name: 厨具游行 A Parade of Cookware
A Parade of Cookware.text:
厨具游行 Moderate 1

虽然莫斗秋和咕噜肚都已将特定地点宣称为自己的领域，但第三个怪物头目却还没有真正安顿下一个“家”。相反，这个形似屠夫围裙、名叫灰屠夫的一反木绵付丧神，正率领着一群因苦迦菩提的影响而活化的叮当作响厨具，穿行于柳岸镇的街道之间。

生物：灰屠夫的厨具游行会在何时与玩家角色遭遇，由你决定。当这场遭遇开始时，玩家角色会先听到游行的声音，然后才看见它——数百件厨具彼此碰撞发出的喧响，再加上灰屠夫跑调的哼唱与歌唱，根本不可能错过。灰屠夫是一只由屠夫围裙诞生的一反木绵付丧神。祂体内怀着一种恶毒的残忍，那是经年累月浸染于鲜血与痛苦中而生的恶意；祂率领着一群活化的切肉刀、嫩肉锤、水壶、平底锅、筷子等器具，在小巷与街道上叮当作响地列队前行。

如果灰屠夫注意到玩家角色，这只一反木绵就会命令游行停下，并朝队伍厉声喝问：“来者何人？”给他们一个解释自己的机会。玩家角色在作答时，可以尝试对灰屠夫进行“说谎”或“留下印象”（灰屠夫在这场遭遇开始时的态度为不友善）。如果玩家角色将灰屠夫的态度改善至冷淡或更好，这只一反木绵就会命令玩家角色加入游行 15 分钟，作为他们庆祝柳岸镇新统治者的“使命”。在这场沿着柳岸镇街道来回折腾、令人精疲力竭的游行之后，每名玩家角色都必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:15] 豁免，以避免陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}。无论结果如何，一旦他们的使命完成，灰屠夫就会把他们丢在后头，自行离去。

厨具游行 Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.XL1a1FkujCi3ij2x]{灰屠夫} @UUID[Actor.Uvh3rWOqENlqsv0A]{活化厨具虫群 (2)}

如果玩家角色拒绝加入，他们的无礼会激怒灰屠夫，祂会命令活化厨具发动攻击。在这场战斗中，灰屠夫会先在后方观望；但如果玩家角色击败了两群虫群，这只一反木绵便会懊恼地叹口气，然后猛扑上来，打算亲自收拾残局。

如果玩家角色曾与灰屠夫完成过一次游行，那么他们第二次遇见这支队伍的时间应不超过 1 小时。这一次，灰屠夫看到玩家角色居然还在街上“闲晃磨蹭”，会感到恼火与烦躁，并直接发动攻击。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.gBc1GctQWfpgcukT]{灰屠夫}
灰屠夫将若干宝藏藏在祂围裙身体的口袋里。这些宝藏包括两瓶潜能油、两个迷魂欧泊护符、一对潜能水晶护符，以及一把置于丝绸包裹的皮制鞘中的+1 银匕首（这只鞘价值 10 gp）。

奖励：击败灰屠夫后，给予玩家角色在每个派系中各 1 点声望点。

A Parade of Cookware Moderate 1

While Mo Douqiu and Gurglegut both claimed specific locations as their domains, the third monstrous ringleader hasn’t quite yet settled on a “home.” Instead, the butcher-apron-resembling ittan-momen named Gray Butcher has been leading swarms of clattering cookware that have become animated by Kugaptee’s influence through the streets of Willowshore.

Creatures: The timing of when Gray Butcher’s parade of cookware encounters the PCs is left to you. When this encounter begins, the PCs hear the parade before they spot it, as the sound of hundreds of pieces of cookware clattering together, combined with Gray Butcher’s off-key humming and singing, is impossible to miss. Gray Butcher is an ittan-momen tsukumogami born from a butcher’s apron. They carry within themself a malicious cruelty born from a century of exposure to blood and pain as they lead a swarm of animated cleavers, meat tenderizers, kettles, pans, chopsticks, and more on a clattering procession along alleys and streets.

If Gray Butcher notices the PCs, the ittan-momen orders a stop to the parade and shouts a stern “Who goes there?” at the party, giving them a chance to explain themselves. The PCs can attempt to Lie or Make an Impression on Gray Butcher (who begins the encounter unfriendly) when they answer. If the PCs improve Gray Butcher’s attitude to indifferent or better, the ittan-momen orders the PCs to join the parade for 15 minutes as their “duty” to celebrate Willowshore’s new rulers. After this exhausting trip back and forth through the streets of Willowshore, each PC must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] save to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. Regardless, Gray Butcher leaves them behind once their duty is fulfilled.

A Parade of Cookware Moderate 1

@UUID[Actor.XL1a1FkujCi3ij2x]{Gray Butcher} @UUID[Actor.Uvh3rWOqENlqsv0A]{Animated Cookware Swarms (2)}

If the PCs refuse to join, their impertinence enrages Gray Butcher, who orders the animated cookware to attack. During this fight, Gray Butcher hangs back, but if the PCs defeat both swarms, the ittan-momen sighs in frustration before swooping in to finish the job.

If the PCs perform one parade with Gray Butcher, it should be no more than an hour before they encounter the group a second time. This time, Gray Butcher is frustrated and annoyed to see the PCs are still “lollygagging” on the street and attacks.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.gBc1GctQWfpgcukT]{Gray Butcher}
Gray Butcher has several treasures stashed away in the pockets of their apron body. This treasure consists of two vials of oil of potency, two mesmerizing opal talismans, a pair of potency crystal talismans, and a +1 silver dagger in a silk-wrapped leather sheath (the sheath is worth 10 gp).

Reward: For defeating Gray Butcher, grant the PCs 1 Reputation Point with each faction.

Shelyn Shrine.name: 莎琳圣坛 Shelyn Shrine
Shelyn Shrine.text:
B17. 希琳圣祠

有人颇有远见地将这座献给永恒玫瑰的圣祠用木板封了起来。透过木板的缝隙，可以看出里面那尊希琳的陶瓷雕像完好无损。

如果PC想为他们的钱币寻求@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.gxwmzxUWBOhdgFSN]{希琳}的祝福，他们首先需要通过五次成功的@Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open]检定来强行打开这些木板。如果他们这样做了却没有恢复圣祠的封板，怪物会在24小时后注意到这座圣祠并将其摧毁（导致PC从圣祠在一枚铜币上获得的任何祝福结束）。虽然圣祠还可以及时重建，但这次破坏行为会让PC从每个派系各失去2点声望点。

B17. Shelyn Shrine

Someone had the foresight to board up the shrine to the Eternal Rose. Through the cracks of the board, it’s apparent that the ceramic statue of Shelyn inside is intact and well.

If the PCs seek @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.gxwmzxUWBOhdgFSN]{Shelyn}’s blessing for their coins, they’ll need to Force Open the boards first with five successful @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] checks. If they do so and don’t restore the shrine’s barricade, monsters notice the shrine 24 hours later and destroy it (causing any blessing the PCs got from the shrine on a copper coin to end). While the shrine can be rebuilt in time, this vandalism costs the PCs 2 Reputation points from each faction.

Public Stage.name: 公共舞台 Public Stage
Public Stage.text:
B16. 公共阶段 Severe 1

这座露天舞台后墙上的壁画已经严重剥落并遭到污损。

公共阶段 Severe 1

@UUID[Actor.g6gxVjIHPXPIfPw6]{蹑影小魔怪（3）}

生物：当PC首次靠近这处舞台时，三只蹑影小魔怪正在屋顶上打闹，穿着它们从后台偷来的戏服并拿着道具。发现PC后，这三只小魔怪欢呼大叫，要求PC观看它们临时上演的一出戏，内容是嘲笑柳岸镇居民的怯懦与愚蠢。这场表演充满侮辱而且恶意十足，但这些蹑影小魔怪投入其中，只要观众继续看下去，它们就会一直演下去。如果它们察觉PC要离开区域，就会冲着“忘恩负义的观众”大喊，并开始朝PC投掷松动的屋瓦。不过，一旦任何一只蹑影小魔怪真的受到伤害，三只都会惊叫起来，并彻底逃离城镇。

B16. Public Stage Severe 1

The mural on the back wall of this open-air stage has been heavily chipped and defaced.

Public Stage Severe 1

@UUID[Actor.g6gxVjIHPXPIfPw6]{Jinkins (3)}

Creatures: When PCs first approach this stage, three jinkins are roughhousing on the roof, wearing costumes and props they stole from backstage. Upon spotting the PCs, the two gremlins cheer and shout, demanding the PCs watch them perform an impromptu play about the cowardice and foolishness of Willowshore’s citizens. The performance is insulting and mean-spirited, but the jinkins are invested enough that they’ll keep at it as long as their audience keeps watching. If they notice the PCs are about to leave the area, they call out to the “ungrateful audience” and begin hurling loose shingles at the PCs. As soon as any of the jinkins actually take damage, though, all three scream in surprise and flee the town entirely.

Mostly Happy Kappas.name: 大多快乐的河童 Mostly Happy Kappas
Mostly Happy Kappas.text:
B15. 大多快乐的河童 Extreme 1

这处以树篱围起的露天院子里，有两口以石块砌边、热气蒸腾的浴池。

生物：并非所有被吸引到柳岸镇的怪物都天生邪恶，但即便是这5只正在池中放松的河童，也绝非心地善良。杀死马厩（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b8infestedst00]{B8}）里那些马的并不是它们，但它们还是为这顿新鲜大餐而欣喜不已。在那里把自己弄得一团糟后，它们便转移到这里来清洗和放松。

5只河童组成的队伍，对1级玩家角色来说甚至超过了极端遭遇的范畴，但这里本来就不是设计成一个战斗遭遇的。河童们一看到玩家角色，便邀请整个队伍一起入浴。无论玩家角色是否接受，它们都承认柳岸镇发生的事“令人遗憾”，但坚持声称自己不是问题的根源。河童们透露，是一只名叫莫斗秋的辘轳首把它们邀请到这里来，请它们帮忙接管柳岸镇。它们承认，吃掉马匹内脏的确是自己，不过杀死那些动物的是蹑影小魔怪——它们也坦承，莫斗秋给出的这份贿赂足以让它们决定与其同伙。自那以后，它们已经开始感到后悔了。河童们尤其意识到，一旦镇上的守卫者重新集结，这样的入侵只会给自己带来悲惨与伤害，因此此时它们还会礼貌地朝玩家角色点头示意。

大多快乐的河童 Extreme 1

@UUID[Actor.edclGnYWtl1fU7yo]{河童（5）}

它们起初态度冷淡；如果玩家角色能以一次成功的 @Check[diplomacy|dc:17|action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] 检定来留下印象，使河童变得友善，那么河童就会同意和平离开城镇，返回葫芦湖（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d2gourdlake000]{D2}）；否则，它们会一直留在这里，直到莫斗秋被击败为止。如果玩家角色身上带有黄瓜（也许是来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b12backyards00]{B12} 的奖励），允许每位玩家角色都有机会尝试一次 @Check[arcana|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 或 @Check[nature|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定，以回忆知识得知黄瓜是河童最喜欢的食物。在任何试图留下印象的过程中向河童献上黄瓜，都会使此次掷骰结果的成功等级提高一级。如果它们变得敌对，或者玩家角色发动攻击，河童们就会一边愤怒地咒骂，一边愤然喷着口水逃跑，而不是还手战斗。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.TTTgAKNlZmQ2BMjU]{河童的提示}
如果玩家角色以友善的方式说服河童离开，它们会给玩家角色一颗价值50 gp的珍珠作为小费（仿佛玩家角色是浴场的雇员一样）。如果玩家角色真的与这5只河童对峙并将其杀死，他们也可以把这颗珍珠作为宝藏拿走。

奖励：如果玩家角色通过使河童变得友善而说服它们离开，则给予他们60 XP。

B15. Mostly Happy Kappas Extreme 1

A pair of stone-lined baths of steaming water sit within this open-air, hedge-walled yard.

Creatures: Not all the monsters drawn into Willowshore are inherently evil, but even the five kappas who are relaxing in the pools are hardly kindhearted. While they weren’t the ones who killed the horses in the stables (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b8infestedst00]{B8}), they still delighted in the fresh meal. After making a mess of themselves there, they relocated here to wash up and relax.

A group of five kappas is beyond an extreme encounter for 1st level PCs, but this isn’t intended to be a combat encounter. As they spot the PCs, the kappas invite the party to join them in the bath. Whether or not the PCs do, they concede that what has happened in Willowshore is “unfortunate” but maintain that they aren’t the source of the problem. The kappas reveal that they were invited here by a rokurokubi named Mo Douqiu who asked for help taking over Willowshore. They confirm that they were the ones who ate the horses’ innards, though it was the jinkins who killed the animals—admitting this bribe from Mo Douqiu was enough to get them to join with him. Since then, they’ve begun to regret things. Particularly, the kappas realize that such an invasion can only bring woe and harm to themselves once the town’s defenders rally, giving the PCs polite nods at this time.

Mostly Happy Kappas Extreme 1

@UUID[Actor.edclGnYWtl1fU7yo]{Kappas (5)}

Initially indifferent, if the PCs can make the kappas friendly with a successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:17|action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] check to Make an Impression, the kappas agree to leave town peacefully and return to Gourd Lake (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d2gourdlake000]{D2}); otherwise, they’ll remain until Mo Douqiu is defeated. If the PCs have any cucumbers on them (perhaps as a reward from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04b12backyards00]{B12}), allow each PC a chance to attempt a @Check[arcana|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[nature|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge that cucumbers are a kappa’s favorite food. Offering cucumbers to the kappas during any attempt to Make an Impression improves the result of the roll by one degree of success. If they’re made hostile, or if the PCs attack, the kappas curse and sputter in indignation and flee rather than fight back.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.TTTgAKNlZmQ2BMjU]{Kappa's Tip}
If the PCs convince the kappas to leave on friendly terms, they give the PCs a pearl worth 50 gp as a tip (as if the PCs are bathhouse employees). In the unlikely event that the PCs confront and kill the five kappas, they can claim this pearl as treasure.

Reward: If the PCs convince the kappas to leave by making them friendly, grant them 60 XP.

Bathhouse Lockers.name: 澡堂储物柜 Bathhouse Lockers
Bathhouse Lockers.text:
B14. 澡堂储物柜

这间储物间井然有序，每个格子里都放着拖鞋和毛巾。所有储物柜都开着，只有一个例外。

生物：德哥慌乱中想找地方躲起来，便硬把自己塞进了一个储物柜，结果卡住了。他正努力保持冷静，但恐慌越来越强烈——每当一名玩家角色在这个房间开始其回合时，他们都可以尝试进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:10] 检定，以听见那只关着的储物柜里传来的窸窣挪动声和轻微呜咽声。储物柜门可以用一次 @Check[athletics|dc:17|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] 检定强行打开，也可以用一次 @Check[thievery|dc:15|traits:manipulate,skill,action:disable-a-device|name:Disable a Device] 检定解除而不伤到德哥；但任何试图对储物柜造成伤害的行为（AC 13，硬度 5，HP 24 [BT 12]）都会将对储物柜造成伤害的一半也转移给德哥，他会痛得嚎叫起来，哀求袭击者停手并离开。

如果他被救出来，德哥会十分感激，但他表示自己已经受够了市中心，想前往一个更干净卫生的地方，例如春之手诊所（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w27thehandof00]{W27}）。他恳求玩家角色带他去那里。

他还会告诉玩家角色，他的“客人”还在这里——那五只河童穿过中间那扇门，往西边的浴池去了，到现在还没有浮现。他确信只要说上几句客气话就能让它们离开，但他太害怕，不敢去面对它们，因此请求玩家角色代劳。

@UUID[Actor.nzFjwNK9VxDZFiXq]{德哥} 生物 1

奖励：如果玩家角色护送德哥前往诊所，则给予玩家角色20 XP。

B14. Bathhouse Lockers

This locker room is orderly, with slippers and towels in each cubby. All the lockers are open, save for one.

Creatures: In his panic to hide, De-ge squeezed himself into a locker but ended up stuck. He’s trying to remain calm, but his panic is growing—every round a PC starts their turn in this room, they can attempt a @Check[perception|dc:10] check to hear the sound of shuffling and soft whimpering within the closed locker. The locker door can either be Forced Open with a @Check[athletics|dc:17|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] check or Disabled with a @Check[thievery|dc:15|traits:manipulate,skill,action:disable-a-device|name:Disable a Device] check without harm to De-ge, but any attempt to damage the locker (AC 13, Hardness 5, HP 24 [BT 12]) transfers half the damage inflicted to the locker to De-ge as well, who howls in pain and begs for his assailants to stop and go away.

If he’s freed, De-ge is grateful, but he expresses he’s had enough of downtown and wants to head to a more sanitized place, such as the Hand of Spring clinic (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w27thehandof00]{W27}). He begs the PCs to bring him there.

He also informs the PCs that his “guests” are still here—the five kappas went through the middle door toward the baths to the west and have yet to emerge. While he’s certain that a few polite words would get them to leave, he’s too afraid to face them and asks the PCs to do it instead.

@UUID[Actor.nzFjwNK9VxDZFiXq]{De-ge} Creature 1

Reward: Grant the PCs 20 XP if they escort De-ge to the clinic.

Act 1.3: The Willowshore Curse.name: 第一幕 1.3：柳岸镇的诅咒 Act 1.3: The Willowshore Curse

Who Leads Willowshore?.name: 谁来领导柳岸镇？
Who Leads Willowshore?.text:
谁来领导柳岸镇？

被困在柳岸镇、总督失踪、又始终笼罩在怪物随时可能卷土重来的恐惧之下，而且大家除了彼此之外再无依靠，这一切都使城镇中北岭与南岸两大派系之间的紧张局势不断升级。夏天第三个月的某个夜晚，这种紧张终于彻底爆发，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21oldmatsukish00]{老松木}当众向@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21grannyhubann00]{胡婆婆}发起挑战，争夺柳岸镇的领导权。

长老们决定依照柳岸镇用来解决公共争端的传统，通过由各自选出的代表进行决斗来决定领导权归属。两人将决斗日期定在七天之后，随后各自离去，留下在场众人开始议论纷纷：谁会代表谁出战、谁又仍对谁怀有怨念，甚至还有人猜测，是否会有第三方介入北岭与南岸之间的冲突。随着消息在城镇中传开，人们逐渐心生恐惧，因为大家意识到，这场决斗很可能演变成一场血腥屠杀。没过多久，一位与玩家角色关系密切的非玩家角色会来请求他们平息局势、坚定地站在某一派一边，或是让他们自己作为集体第三候选人出面。由谁来接触队伍由你决定，但这个人应当是玩家信任的人。

距离决斗还有七天，玩家角色有时间决定自己将站在哪一边。老松木和胡婆婆都邀请玩家角色在当天结束前与他们交谈。两人都明白，那些重新点亮长明灯之人的支持，将极大巩固各自派系对领导权的主张，即使某位玩家角色并不希望直接参与决斗本身。为了说服两位长老中的一位退让，让另一位担任领导者，玩家角色必须在该长老处达到7点影响点。玩家角色也有可能在冒险过程中就已经与一位或两位长老达到了这一数值；若是如此，他们只需决定在赫总督的命运最终查明之前，谁应成为柳岸镇的临时镇长即可。每位长老的影响数据表都列在本书末尾其对应的非玩家角色条目中。

如果玩家角色未能解决这个问题，那么你应当选择由哪位长老赢得领导权，并选取队伍较不支持的那一位。若你愿意，而且玩家角色对决斗本身很感兴趣，你甚至可以允许他们担任其中一位长老的代表，使用决斗规则（Pathfinder GM Core 202–203）。

奖励：如果玩家角色说服其中一位长老向另一位让位，并和平解决此事，则给予玩家角色80 XP，以及该长老成为城镇领袖之派系的2点声望点。

Who Leads Willowshore?

Being stuck in Willowshore with a missing governor, under a fear that the monsters could return at any moment, and with only each other for company causes tension to escalate between the town’s two factions of Northridge and Southbank. One evening during the third month of summer, this tension finally snaps as @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21oldmatsukish00]{Old Matsuki} very publicly challenges @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21grannyhubann00]{Granny Hu} for Willowshore’s leadership.

The elders resolve to settle the question of leadership via a duel between chosen champions, drawing upon a Willowshore tradition for solving public disputes. The two set the date for this duel as seven days hence and part ways, leaving the rest of those present to begin gossiping about who might be representing whom and who yet holds a grudge against another, and even wondering if a third party might step into the conflict between Northridge and Southbank. As word spreads through town, dread grows as folks realize that a duel will likely lead to a bloodbath. Soon enough, an NPC close to the PCs asks them to de-escalate the situation, to stoutly stand with one of the factions, or to put themselves forward as a collective third candidate. Which NPC approaches the party is left to you to decide, but it should be someone the players trust.

With seven days before the duel, the PCs have time to make a decision as to where they stand. Both Old Matsuki and Granny Hu extend invitations to the PCs to speak to them by the end of the day. Both know the support of those who relit the Eternal Lantern will go a long way toward establishing their faction’s claims of leadership, even if a PC doesn’t wish to be directly involved in the duel itself. In order to convince one of the two elders to step aside and let the other assume the leadership role, the PCs must reach 7 Influence Points with that elder. It’s possible that the PCs have already reached this level with one or both elders during play, in which case they can solve the issue by making the decision of who should be Willowshore’s interim governor until Governor Heh’s fate can finally be determined. Each elder’s influence stat block appears in their NPC entry at the end of this book.

If the PCs fail to solve this problem, then you should select which elder wins the leadership, picking the one that the party is less in favor with. At your option, if the PCs are intrigued by a duel, you could even allow them to serve as one of the elders’ champions, using the rules for dueling (Pathfinder GM Core 202–203).

Reward: If the PCs convince one of the elders to cede to the other and achieve a peaceful resolution, grant the PCs 80 XP and 2 Reputation Points with the faction whose elder becomes the town’s leader.

Speaking with Ugly Cute.name: 与丑小乖说话 Speaking with Ugly Cute
Speaking with Ugly Cute.text:
与丑小乖说话

一旦 PCs 击败这些元素生物，丑小乖便会用八条腿重新站起身来，身形有些摇晃，身体上也布满缺口与裂痕（剩余 5 生命值），但他们确实还活着。这只石蜘蛛感谢 PCs 的帮助，并打算留在这处峡谷中直到恢复为止（石蜘蛛对治疗的免疫不适用于在此地通过休息获得的治疗），不过他们也很想从 PCs 那里了解柳岸镇的近况。丑小乖知道他们每个人的名字，而当得知他们已经肩负起守护城镇的职责时，更是欣喜不已。

在交谈中，丑小乖是一位精神饱满、迫切想好好聊一聊的守护精魂。和 PCs 一样，丑小乖并没有意识到自己在现实世界中已经死去；而且尽管他们的死亡发生在（以 PCs 的视角来看）115 年后的未来，丑小乖仍认为自己度过的那 115 年更像是一场梦境或幻象，而非真实经历，因此不应向 PCs 提供任何关于这段时间流逝的线索或见解；这一揭示将在这条冒险路径未来的某一幕中发生。当 PCs 与丑小乖交谈时，请务必通过丑小乖的评论或对 PCs 问题的具体回答，传达以下要点。

  • 丑小乖透露，他们曾与一群无面怪物对峙；那些怪物正在折磨柳岸镇郊外的人们。他们攻击并追赶那些生物，却最终迷失方向、身受重伤，只得返回这里休养。他们为自己离开城镇而道歉，同时也对 PCs 正在帮助守护柳岸镇感到宽慰与欣喜。
  • 丑小乖声称自己见过异象：柳岸镇在某种怪物入侵后被遗弃，逐渐崩塌为废墟，最终被森林重新吞没。正是这一异象让它得以苏醒，并在冒险开始时前来援助 PCs。
  • 尽管丑小乖不认为重演节是诅咒的源头，但导致诅咒的事情确实发生在仪式本身进行到最高潮之时。
  • 包围柳岸镇的迷雾，是这座城镇走向毁灭的开端——那是某种未知力量降于这片地区的诅咒，而丑小乖感知到，这诅咒与他们曾对抗过的那些无面怪物有关。那些无面怪物已经占据了城镇以西的一处旧伐木营地，靠近木棉河源头。也许在那里能找到有关诅咒的线索？再往西去，丑小乖能感知到一股更强大的邪恶源头，但由于那里超出了他们能从柳岸镇出发前往的范围，他们自己也无法观察那个源头。

谈话结束后，丑小乖会告诉 PCs，他们打算回到柳岸镇东缘的蜘蛛门岗位上去。在那里，这位守护精魂会安顿下来，负责警戒与观察，而将城镇的主动防御留给 PCs。如果丑小乖在这种内省式的守护中获得了任何新的启示，他们会再次苏醒来提醒队伍。

@UUID[Actor.AxXh7yuCqXIP7U16]{Ugly Cute} 生物5

  • 大型
  • 天界语
  • Holy
  • 虚体

无性别石蜘蛛

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.uAPxF3uakY7mWUnW]{Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology}
为了感谢营救，也为了对自己抛下 PCs 去追赶那些无面绑架者一事表示歉意，丑小乖赠予 PCs 一块自己石质甲壳的碎片，这能帮助 PCs 获得用于保护柳岸镇的工具。

奖励：作为营救丑小乖的奖励，给予 PCs 如同在战斗中击败他们一样的 XP。此外，一旦丑小乖回到蜘蛛门的岗位上，他们还会同时在两个阵营中各获得 2 声望点。

Speaking with Ugly Cute

Once the PCs defeat the elementals, Ugly Cute rises up on their eight legs, a bit wobbly and bearing plenty of chips and cracks to their body (with 5 Hit Points remaining), but still very much alive. The stone spider is thankful for the PCs’ help and intends to remain here in the gorge until they recover (the stone spider’s immunity to healing doesn’t apply to healing gained from rest in this location), but they’re eager to learn from the PCs how things are faring in Willowshore. Ugly Cute knows them all by name and is delighted to find out they’ve taken up the mantle of protectors of the town.

During conversation, Ugly Cute is a chipper guardian spirit who’s starving for a proper chat. Like the PCs, Ugly Cute doesn’t realize they died in the real world, and even though their death occurred (from the PCs’ perspective) 115 years in the future, Ugly Cute believes that the past 115 years it spent were something more like a dream or a vision than an actual experience, and shouldn’t give the PCs any clues or insights into this passage of time; this revelation will take place in a future act of the Adventure Path. As the PCs and Ugly Cute speak, make sure to convey the following points, either as comments by Ugly Cute or as specific answers to the PCs’ questions.

  • Ugly Cute reveals that they confronted a group of faceless monsters who were tormenting people in Willowshore’s outskirts. They attacked and pursued the creatures, but ended up lost and wounded and had to return here to recover. They apologize for abandoning the town, and they express relief and delight that the PCs are helping to protect Willowshore.
  • Ugly Cute claims to have had visions of an abandoned Willowshore left to crumble into ruins reclaimed by the forest after some sort of monstrous invasion, and it was this vision that allowed it to awaken and come to the PCs’ aid at the start of the adventure.
  • While Ugly Cute doesn’t think that the Reenactment Festival was the source of the curse, whatever caused the curse did take place during the height of the ceremony itself.
  • The mists surrounding Willowshore are the beginning of the town’s doom, a curse brought upon the region by an unknown force—and one that Ugly Cute senses is tied to the faceless monsters who they confronted. These faceless monsters have claimed an old lumber camp to the west of town, near Ceiba River’s source. Perhaps clues about the curse can be found there? Further west, Ugly Cute can sense a stronger source of evil, but they haven’t been able to observe this source themself as it lies beyond the range it can travel from Willowshore.

Once the conversation is over, Ugly Cute tells the PCs they intend to return to their post at Spider Gate on the eastern edge of Willowshore. There, the guardian spirit will settle in to watch and observe, leaving the active defense of the town to the PCs. If Ugly Cute has any revelations during their time of introspective guardianship, they’ll waken again to alert the party.

@UUID[Actor.AxXh7yuCqXIP7U16]{Ugly Cute} Creature 5

  • Large
  • Celestial
  • Holy
  • Incorporeal

Agender Stone Spider

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.uAPxF3uakY7mWUnW]{Ugly Cute's Thanks & Apology}
In thanks for the rescue, and as an apology for abandoning the PCs to chase down the faceless abductors, Ugly Cute gifts the PCs a piece of their stony carapace, which can help supply the PCs with tools to protect Willowshore.

Reward: For rescuing Ugly Cute, grant the PCs XP as if they’d defeated them in combat. In addition, they earn 2 Reputation Points with both factions once Ugly Cute resumes their post at Spider Gate.

Rescuing Ugly Cute.name: 营救丑小乖 Rescuing Ugly Cute
Rescuing Ugly Cute.text:
营救丑小乖 中等 2

丑小乖在心景中苏醒，并与该区域内数只无脸妖发生冲突后，追赶那些逃跑的怪物向南一段时间，随后追上并摧毁了这些生物。石蜘蛛在战斗中受了损伤，但也因自己所处的这个陌生新现实而愈发苦恼。丑小乖没有回到自己的岗位，而是本能地回到了那些石头“诞生”的地方——尖牙峡。在这里，丑小乖能够借助孕育自己的岩石，缓慢修复自己的身体。从那以后，这只守护野兽便尤其执着于无脸妖和鬼墙，并将时间分配在尖牙峡中思索，以及在镇子南面和西面的区域巡逻、搜寻无脸妖的源头；丑小乖相信，它们与降临在这片土地上的“诅咒”有关。

一旦PC接近区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10} 1六角格以内，追踪丑小乖就会变得更容易（降为@Check[survival|dc:10|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:追踪]），但无论他们是否成功，在进入该区域后不久，他们都会遇上一些此地危险的居民。

此次遭遇发生在一片开阔的岩地上。

生物：正如苦迦菩提的影响在柳岸镇肆虐，并为南部柳树林带来滋生泛滥一样，这位古老邪魔与毁灭和腐朽的关联，也与这片地区长久以来作为雕塑和建筑所用原材料来源地的传统发生了冲突。结果便是数只活巨石的显现，它们在峡谷中刮擦、磨蚀着前行。

营救丑小乖 中等 2

@UUID[Actor.neZX16GagSV8zxYh]{活巨石（2）}

PC们进入峡谷后不久便会遭遇其中两只活巨石，发现它们正在一堆奇怪的石丘上碾磨爬行。虽然这些元素生物使用与标准活巨石相同的数据，但它们的性情却截然不同——它们拥有远超普通活巨石的智力，虽然自己不会说话，却能听懂阿克罗语。活巨石聪明到会享受残虐的乐趣，自从石蜘蛛退到这里后，它们就一直兴致勃勃地折磨并追赶丑小乖。随着PC们靠近，这两只活巨石移动并发起攻击，同时揭示出它们方才爬行其上的那些石头，实际上正是丑小乖！

在此次遭遇的持续时间内，丑小乖始终遍体鳞伤，几乎无法移动，因为它已被活巨石逼近毁灭边缘。如果PC们难以击败这两个元素生物，你可以让丑小乖出手扭转局势，但最好还是让PC们成为这里的英雄！活巨石会战斗直到被摧毁为止；每当其中一只死亡时，它都会裂开，释放出小团红色蝴蝶云，随即迅速化作烟雾消散。

Rescuing Ugly Cute Moderate 2
