After Ugly Cute woke into the mindscape and clashed with several noppera-bos in the area, they chased the fleeing monsters south for a time before catching up to and destroying the creatures. The stone spider was damaged in the fight, but was also increasingly distraught over the strange new reality they found themself in. Rather than return to their post, Ugly Cute instinctively returned to the place where their stones were “born,” the Gorge of Fangs and Teeth. Here, Ugly Cute was able to draw upon the stones of their creation to slowly repair their body. Since then, the guardian beast has been particularly obsessed over the noppera-bos and the Wall of Ghosts, and has split their time between thinking things over in the Gorge and patrolling the region south and west of town, searching for the source of the noppera-bos, who Ugly Cute believes have something to do with the “curse” that has settled over the land.

Once the PCs approach within 1 hex of area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10}, it becomes easier to Track Ugly Cute (dropping to a @Check[survival|dc:10|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]), but regardless of their success, they’ll run into some dangerous denizens of the region soon after entering the area.

This encounter takes place in an open area of rocky ground.

Creatures: Just as Kugaptee’s influence wreaked havoc on Willowshore and brought infestation to the southern willow grove, the ancient fiend’s association with destruction and decay clashed against the long traditions held in this region as being a source for raw materials used to create sculptures and structures. The result was the manifestation of several living boulders that rasp and scour through the gorge.

Rescuing Ugly Cute Moderate 2

@UUID[Actor.neZX16GagSV8zxYh]{Living Boulders (2)}

The PCs encounter two of these living boulders soon after they enter the gorge, finding them grinding and crawling over a strange mound of stones. While these elemental creatures have the same statistics as the standard living boulder, their personalities are much different—they possess a far greater intellect than the typical living boulder, and while they cannot speak themselves, they understand Aklo. Smart enough to enjoy the pursuit of cruelty, the living boulders have had a delightful time tormenting and chasing Ugly Cute ever since the stone spider retreated here. As the PCs draw near, the two living boulders move to attack, revealing that the stones they’d been crawling upon are, in fact, Ugly Cute!

For the duration of this encounter, Ugly Cute remains battered and barely able to move, having been taken near to the point of destruction by the living boulders. If the PCs have trouble defeating the two elementals, you can have Ugly Cute step in to save the day, but it’s best if the PCs are the heroes here! The living boulders fight until they’re destroyed, cracking open to release small clouds of red butterflies that swiftly fade into smoke on each of their deaths.

Searching the Hinterlands.name: 在腹地搜寻 Searching the Hinterlands
Searching the Hinterlands.text:
在腹地搜寻

这么做效率不高，但玩家角色也可以直接在腹地进行探索，并通过搜索来寻找丑小乖经过的迹象。想在柳岸镇以东、以北或以西找到丑小乖留下的证据会自动失败；但每当一名玩家角色在柳岸镇以南的腹地某个六角格中花费4小时进行搜寻时，就进行一次@Check[flat|dc:16]（或者，如果该玩家角色是在尖牙峡或与该区域相邻的任意六角格中搜寻，则进行一次@Check[flat|dc:3]）。成功后，该玩家角色可以尝试一次@Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]来追踪，以发现丑小乖经过的迹象。一旦找到这些迹象，任何人都可以通过成功的@Check[survival|dc:16|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]来追踪丑小乖的踪迹。积累足够多的成功后，这条踪迹会直接通往区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10}。

及时介入

有一种能自动触发发现丑小乖踪迹的方法：当玩家角色尚未达到3级时，如果他们开始接近旧伐木营地（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d11lumbercam00]{D11}）或幽魂之墙。如果玩家角色来到区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d11lumbercam00]{D11}一格六角范围内，或即将抵达幽魂之墙，他们应自动发现丑小乖的踪迹。他们可以沿着这条踪迹向南追踪至区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10}；但如果他们无视它并继续前往伐木营地，那么你应改为让丑小乖先找到他们。在这种情况下，这名石头守卫会以警告玩家角色注意营地中的居民来开始此次遭遇，而不是直接接近他们，不过除此之外，你可以像“营救丑小乖”中那样处理这次会面（只是无需从残忍的活巨石手中救下石蜘蛛）。通过这种方式，你可以利用丑小乖来拖延玩家角色抵达伐木营地（其详情见于@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog06thewal]{第4章}）的时间，直到他们大概已经准备好面对那里存在的威胁。

Searching the Hinterlands

It’s inefficient, but the PCs could simply explore the hinterlands and Search for signs of Ugly Cute’s passage. Attempts to find evidence of Ugly Cute east, north, or west of Willowshore automatically fail, but each time a PC spends 4 hours Searching a hex in the hinterlands south of Willowshore, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:16] (or, if the PC is Searching in the Gorge of Fangs and Teeth or any hex that borders this region, a @Check[flat|dc:3]). On a success, that PC can attempt a @Check[survival|dc:15|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] to Track to discover signs of Ugly Cute’s passage. Once these signs are found, anyone can Track Ugly Cute’s trail with a successful @Check[survival|dc:16|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]. With enough successes, the trail leads directly to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10}.

A Timely Intervention

One way to automatically trigger the discovery of Ugly Cute’s trail is if the PCs begin to draw close to the old lumber camp (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d11lumbercam00]{D11}) or the Wall of Ghosts while they aren’t yet 3rd level. If the PCs come within a hex of area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d11lumbercam00]{D11}, or are about to reach the Wall of Ghosts, they should automatically discover Ugly Cute’s trail. They can Track this trail south to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10}, but if they ignore it and continue on toward the lumber camp, you should have Ugly Cute find them instead. In this case, the stone guardian begins the encounter by warning the PCs about the denizens of the camp rather than closing with it, but otherwise, you can play this meeting out the same way as Rescuing Ugly Cute does (although without the need to rescue the stone spider from cruel living boulders). In this way, you can use Ugly Cute as a way to delay the PCs’ arrival at the lumber camp (itself detailed in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog06thewal]{Chapter 4}) before they’re likely ready to face the threats found therein.

Consulting Silvermist.name: 咨询银雾 Consulting Silvermist
Consulting Silvermist.text:
咨询银雾

当玩家角色造访银雾斋（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w7silvermist00]{W7}）时，如果玩家角色在本幕前面救过澄香，可以考虑让她成为与他们会面的猎人。无论玩家角色见到的是谁，答案都一样：追踪丑萌的尝试始终毫无线索；暴雨，以及猎人们从怪物入侵中恢复时流逝的那段时间，都没有带来任何帮助。澄香（或玩家角色联系的其他人）沉思道，就连老猎人的诀窍——“回到猎物的老家”以重新拾起踪迹——也不起作用。尽管他们已经多次返回蜘蛛门（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w33spidergat00]{W33}），却始终没有发现新的线索。

此时，允许玩家角色尝试一次 @Check[hunting-lore|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 或 @Check[nature|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定来回忆知识。成功时，一名玩家角色会注意到，蜘蛛门与其说像是丑萌的老巢，不如说更像是一个岗哨；照此逻辑，如果丑萌选择逃往巢穴，它就不会返回那里。大成功时，一名玩家角色灵光一闪——丑萌是由本地开采的石料“诞生”而来，那么这个生物的“老家”岂不是应该更接近于其构成部分最初被采掘出来的源头？如果没有玩家角色想到这一点，若队伍在接下来的几天里仍未自行取得进展，你也可以让澄香或另一名猎人意识到这种可能性，并联系玩家角色提出请求，请他们帮忙。

若以一次成功的 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 或 @Check[society|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定来回忆知识，玩家角色还会想起，丑萌的材料最初是从南方的尖牙峡开采而来（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10}）。

Consulting Silvermist

When the PCs visit the Silvermist Lodges (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w7silvermist00]{W7}), consider having Sumika be the hunter who meets with them if the PCs rescued her earlier in the act. Regardless of whom the PCs meet with, the answer is the same: attempts to track Ugly Cute have yielded no leads; the rainstorms and the amount of time that passed while the hunters were recovering from the monster invasion did them no favors. Sumika (or whoever the PCs contact) muses that even the old hunter’s trick of “returning to the quarry’s home” to try to pick up the trail anew hasn’t worked. Despite several visits back to Spider Gate (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w33spidergat00]{W33}), no fresh clues have manifested.

Allow the PCs to attempt a @Check[hunting-lore|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[nature|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge at this point. On a success, a PC notes that Spider Gate is less akin to Ugly Cute’s home, but more like a posting, so following this logic, Ugly Cute wouldn’t return there if they chose to flee to a lair. On a critical success, a PC has a flash of insight—Ugly Cute was “born” from locally quarried stone, so wouldn’t the creature’s “home” be akin to the source from which its components were originally harvested? If no PC comes up with this insight, feel free to have Sumika or another hunter realize this possibility and contact the PCs with a request to help after several days have passed if the party hasn’t made progress on their own.

With a successful @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[society|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge, a PC also remembers that Ugly Cute’s materials were originally quarried from the Gorge of Fangs and Teeth to the south (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d10gorgeoffa00]{D10}).

Searching for Ugly Cute.name: 寻找丑萌 Searching for Ugly Cute
Searching for Ugly Cute.text:
寻找丑萌

柳岸镇的守护精魂失踪了——那只被亲切地称作“丑萌”的石蜘蛛，多年来一直守望着城镇东侧边缘——这件事乍看之下，或许不像失踪的总督或诡异的迷雾那样迫切需要追查；但在这三项任务中，只有追查丑萌的下落，才能为玩家角色提供一个可靠线索，借以扭转笼罩这片土地的“诅咒”。

当玩家角色第一次经过丑萌被遗弃的岗哨时，地上的痕迹表明这只蜘蛛自己站了起来，朝附近的河流走去，之后，那条踪迹就变得无法继续追踪了。与玩家角色合作的镇上长者告诉他们，自从长明灯被点亮以来，来自银雾斋的追踪者们就一直在寻找线索，但至今仍未发现任何关于丑萌的踪迹。尽管如此，如果玩家角色想亲自开始追查这位失踪守护者的下落，那么先去见见斋中的猎人们，仍然是合乎逻辑的第一步。

Searching for Ugly Cute

The vanishing of Willowshore’s guardian spirit—the stone spider affectionately called “Ugly Cute” who has stood vigil for many years at the eastern edge of town—might not seem as urgent a mystery to follow up on as the missing governor or the strange mists, but tracking down Ugly Cute is the only mission of the three that will give the PCs a solid lead for reversing the “curse” that has settled over the land.

When the PCs first passed by Ugly Cute’s abandoned post, tracks on the ground suggested that the spider got up and walked away toward the nearby river, after which that particular trail became impossible to follow. The town elder the PCs are working with informs them that trackers from the Silvermist Lodges have been looking for clues ever since the Eternal Lantern was lit, but so far, no trace of Ugly Cute has been found. Still, meeting with hunters from the lodges is a logical first step if the PCs want to start tracking down the missing guardian themselves.

Returning to Great Willow.name: 重返大尊柳 Returning to Great Willow
Returning to Great Willow.text:
重返大尊柳

大柳树能够感知到蕈菇已被击败，并准备在队伍下次造访它的山丘顶端时，以愉快得多的态度迎接归来的玩家角色。如今这位木灵已变得乐于助人；如果任何玩家角色正受蕈菇带来的紫痘折磨，大柳树会提出帮助该角色恢复（它会通过尝试一次自然检定来治疗疾病）。得知树林中并没有其他木灵在场的消息后，大柳树颇感失望，但既然那里没有尸体，也没有木灵遭到伤害的迹象，它便将此视为仍有希望的理由。

作为对玩家角色们所提供帮助的回报，大柳树确认柳岸镇周边地区似乎受到了诅咒。它感知不到附近还有其他木灵，而当玩家角色们击败蕈菇返回时，大柳树已经开始冥想这道诅咒的边界。它可以向玩家角色们提供一个关于他们被困区域范围的粗略估计，将其描述为一个以柳岸镇为中心、向各个方向延伸约10到16英里的区域。更重要的是，大柳树提到，西方似乎还有某种更为强大的存在——这位木灵感知到了鬼墙，但并不确定那究竟是什么。虽然大柳树揭示的这些信息都无法帮助玩家角色们击败影响他们的“诅咒”，但应当能让他们对自己受困区域的规模有所概念。不过，有一点大柳树可以确认——似乎没有办法穿越迷雾，因此至少暂时而言，应当优先将目标放在让定居点变得更加自给自足上。

在《肆季鬼志》的后续剧情中，大柳树在玩家角色们造访山丘顶端时都会继续对他们保持乐于助人的态度；你可以视需要利用这位木灵，为队伍提供接下来该做什么的建议，或给出线索，让事情重新回到正轨。

Returning to Great Willow

Great Willow can sense when Xungu is defeated and is ready to receive the returning PCs in a much more pleasant manner upon the party’s next visit to their hilltop. The kodama is now helpful, and if any of the PCs are suffering from purple pox caught from Xungu, Great Willow offers to help the character recover (they do so by attempting a Nature check to Treat Disease). The news that no kodama were present in the grove disappoints Great Willow, but they take the fact that there were no bodies or evidence that the kodama were harmed as a reason for hope.

In return for the aid the PCs provided, Great Willow confirms that the region surrounding Willowshore appears to be cursed. They can sense no other kodama in the vicinity, and by the time the PCs return from defeating Xungu, Great Willow has already started to meditate upon the curse’s boundaries. They can give the PCs a rough estimate of the size of the region they’re trapped in, describing it as a region about 10 to 16 miles or so in every direction from Willowshore. More importantly, Great Willow mentions that something even more potent seems to lie to the west—the kodama is sensing the Wall of Ghosts, but isn’t sure what it might be. While none of Great Willow’s revelations will help the PCs defeat the “curse” that affects them, it should give them an idea of the scope of the region they’re trapped in. One thing Great Willow can confirm, though—there seems to be no way to go beyond the mists, so for the time being, goals to become more self-sufficient as a settlement should be prioritized.

For the rest of Season of Ghosts, Great Willow remains helpful to the PCs on their visits to the hilltop; you can use the kodama to give the party advice on what to do next or to provide clues as needed to get things back on track as you see fit.

Into the Infestation.name: 深入虫害 Into the Infestation
Into the Infestation.text:
深入虫害 Moderate 2

这片受虫害侵染的柳树林位于蜻蜓溪西岸，柳岸镇以南（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d7infestedgr00]{D7}）。

沿溪的道路在这里渐渐变成一条小路，通向这片曾经风景如画的柳树林，但如今，枝叶间已蔓生着一层层灰色与淡黄色的真菌。原本应是灌木丛生长的地方，现在却长满了颜色更鲜艳的斑点蘑菇和疣状毒菌。

尽管看上去令人不适，而且无疑会伤害这里的柳树与其他植被，占据了这片林地的真菌整体上大多无害——只有一个重大的例外。这个遭遇发生在森林中一片开阔却被真菌侵染的空地上。

生物：当柳岸镇心景的这一轮回开始时，一场真菌入侵蔓延到了这片柳树林。这里曾是本地人亲近自然、追求浪漫的地方，而苦迦菩提的影响像寄生虫一样附着在那些正能量情绪上，最终导致了危险真菌的大量涌现。这些真菌大多显现为黏菌怪，并立刻滑行散入周边荒野（如今也会不时作为游荡怪物遭遇到），但其中有一个名叫蕈菇的菌体人仍留在这里。

蕈菇是苦迦菩提影响所直接造成的实体结果，虽然他们记得自己“统治”这片林地已有数十年，但在这一心景轮回开始之前，他们其实并不存在。这个菌体人大部分时间都在巡逻这片受侵染区域的边缘，寻找可捕获的肉食来准备餐点。面对玩家角色时，蕈菇起初比起暴力更偏向于耍诈。作为来自苦迦菩提思想的显现，蕈菇说的是通用语而非萨克弗罗斯语，但这并不妨碍他们在看见玩家角色后，讲述一段凄惨的故事（虽然他们自己并不知道那是假的），说自己是如何被赶出地下菌落的。这个菌体人解释说，曾居住在这里的木灵欢迎蕈菇进入他们的家园，但后来他们全都消失了，现在蕈菇又只剩下孤身一人。接着，蕈菇会请求其中一名玩家角色留下过夜，与他们共进一餐，这样他们就不会感到孤单。菌体人还解释说，他们有一些“秘密”要分享，但若同时面对太多人，他们会不好意思开口。

当然，这些说法全都是谎言，而对玩家角色来说幸运的是，蕈菇并不是个特别高明的骗子。如果队伍答应这个请求，那么一旦蕈菇和那名玩家角色单独相处，他们就会向对方坦白，所谓的秘密其实是他们真的很饿，而他们要“分享”的那顿饭，就是蕈菇吃掉这名玩家角色——菌体人会立刻发动攻击，希望压制住这名落单的玩家角色。

深入虫害 Moderate 2

@UUID[Actor.dqFdd9XhC9awkWYE]{蕈菇}

当蕈菇讲述这段故事时，他们会尝试进行一次 +0 欺瞒检定来进行说谎，但即便这段故事成功对抗了每名玩家角色的察觉DC，玩家仍应自行决定要怎么做。如果被当场指出是在说谎，蕈菇会懊恼地哼一声，然后说道：“唉，那我想我只好满足于一场茶饭，而不是啃食了！”接着发动攻击，打算抓住并吃掉整个队伍。蕈菇发动攻击时会试着捕获玩家角色，希望把战斗拖长，好让玩家角色死于紫痘，因为长了痘的肉更美味。这应当给队伍时间去营救被抓住的玩家角色，或者（如果整个队伍都被抓住了）让非玩家角色赶来救他们。无论如何，蕈菇都会战斗至死；而对于逃跑的玩家角色，他们只会追赶几轮，随后便返回受侵染的柳树林。

奖励：随着蕈菇死去，林地中的真菌侵染会立刻开始消退，蘑菇与霉菌纷纷缩小、融化并蒸发。仅仅一个小时后，这片林地就会完全恢复。此时，任何正遭受紫痘折磨的玩家角色，在对抗由蕈菇造成的该苦难时，所有豁免骰都视为自动成功（不过，受苦难影响的玩家角色仍应掷骰，以判定自己是否获得大成功或大失败）。

Into the Infestation Moderate 2

The infested willow grove is located on the western bank of Dragonfly Creek, south of Willowshore (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d7infestedgr00]{D7}).

The creek-side road diminishes to a trail here as it approaches the once-idyllic grove of willow trees, but today, the foliage has become overgrown with sheets of gray and pale yellow fungi. More colorful spotted mushrooms or warty toadstools grow where underbrush once did.

While unpleasant looking and certainly harmful to the willow trees and other foliage here, the fungus that has taken over this grove is largely harmless—with one significant exception. This encounter takes place in an open but fungus-infested clearing in a forest.

Creatures: When this cycle began in the Willowshore mindscape, a fungal invasion spread through this patch of willow trees. Once a place where locals came to enjoy nature and pursue romance, Kugaptee’s influence clung to those positive emotions like a parasite, resulting in an influx of dangerous fungi. The fungi mostly manifested as slime molds that immediately slithered out into the surrounding hinterlands (and that can now be periodically encountered as wandering monsters), but one, a myceloid named Xungu, remains here.

Xungu is a direct physical result of Kugaptee’s influence, and while they have memories of “ruling” this grove for decades, they didn’t exist before this mindscape cycle began. The myceloid spends most of their time patrolling the perimeter of the infested patch, looking for meat to catch to prepare for meals. Faced with the PCs, Xungu is initially more duplicitous than violent. As a manifestation from Kugaptee’s thoughts, Xungu speaks Common rather than Sakvroth, but this doesn’t stop them, upon spotting the PCs, from recounting a pitiful (if unknowingly false) tale of how they were chased out from their underground colony. The myceloid explains how the kodama who dwelled here welcomed Xungu into their home, but then they all vanished, and now Xungu is all alone again. Xungu then asks one of the PCs to stay overnight and share a meal so that they won’t feel lonely. The myceloid explains they have “secrets” to share but are bashful about sharing with too many people at once.

All of these claims are falsehoods, of course, and fortunately for the PCs, Xungu isn’t a particularly skilled liar. If the party agrees to this request, once Xungu and the PC are alone, they reveal to the PC that the secret is that they’re really hungry and that the meal they’ll “share” will be Xungu eating the PC—the myceloid attacks at once, hoping to overpower the lone PC.

Into the Infestation Moderate 2

@UUID[Actor.dqFdd9XhC9awkWYE]{Xungu}

When Xungu tells this story, they attempt a +0 Deception check to Lie, but even if this story is successful against every PC’s Perception DC, the players should still make their own decisions as to what to do. Called out as a liar, Xungu huffs in frustration, then says, “Well, I suppose I’ll have to settle for a banquet instead of a snack!” and attacks, intending to capture and eat the entire party. When Xungu attacks, they try to capture PCs, hoping to draw things out long enough for PCs to perish from purple pox, since poxy meat is tastier. This should give the party time to rescue a captured PC or (if the whole party gets caught) for NPCs to come rescue them instead. Xungu fights to the death, in any event, and pursues fleeing PCs for only a few rounds before returning to the infested grove.

Reward: With Xungu’s death, the fungus infestation in the grove immediately begins to recede, with mushrooms and mold shrinking, melting, and evaporating. After just an hour, the grove is restored fully. At this point, a PC who’s suffering from purple pox treats all saving throws against the affliction caused by Xungu as automatic successes (afflicted PCs should still roll the save to determine if they achieve a critical success, though).

Talking with Great Willow.name: 与大尊柳交谈 Talking with Great Willow
Talking with Great Willow.text:
与大尊柳交谈

一旦玩家角色取得大尊柳的配合，这位木灵便稍微放松下来，同意与玩家角色交谈。祂们说话时声音细小，几乎像孩童一般，但语速缓慢且极有条理，仿佛会谨慎斟酌每一个用词。随着这一年一次次重复，大尊柳的心智也变得愈发破碎（尽管祂们并不明白、也不记得原因），而如今，与他人说话这一行为对这位木灵而言，需要有意识地保持专注。

如果被问及树根上生长的真菌，大尊柳会稍稍有些不快，随后冷静下来，说道：“是我去南边探望一位朋友时带回来的感染。我正在努力对抗它，但我担心我的朋友。”

如果玩家角色询问他们在试图前往唐入时遭遇的那片迷雾边界，大尊柳会理解地点点头，如下回答。

“是的，我也感觉得出来。那是个诅咒。一个强大的诅咒。我能感觉到它的边缘环绕在四周。我们现在被关在一个笼子里。当它在夏日第一天发生时，我很困惑。我孤身一人。我听不见朋友们的声音。我跳跃去探望我最亲近的朋友，可祂不在那里，取而代之的是一朵脾气恶劣的蘑菇，我只好一路逃回这里。独自一人。我不知道该怎么办。当这诅咒笼罩四周时，我不敢再离开这棵树，但我可以从这里寻找它的边界。我会告诉你们更多，但在那之前，我得先知道我的朋友是安全的。你们要去把她从那朵愤怒的蘑菇手中救出来，然后我就会帮忙。”

每到夏日第一天，当心景一年的循环重置时，大尊柳都会察觉到环境发生了变化，却每次都弄不清其原因。而每一年，祂们都会使用通身入林，从自己那棵柳树的受监护者处前往柳岸镇以南将近5英里的一片柳树林，去查看驻留在那里的柳树林神使的状况——这位神使与大尊柳不同，并没有被卷入心景之中。今年，情况变得更糟了：苦迦菩提的影响使得一场敌对真菌的滋生在这片树林中爆发。

当大尊柳使用通身入林前往这片树林时，祂们发现那里已被真菌侵占，而居住于此的木灵却不见踪影（这些木灵避免了被卷入心景——见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05visitinggrea00#the-last-kodama]{The Last Kodama}）。面对一个敌对真菌的攻击性威胁，又因当天唯一一次施展通身入林的机会已经用掉，大尊柳不得不狼狈地徒步返回这座山丘顶上的家园——而在此过程中，祂们也把侵入性的真菌孢子一路带了回来。

奖励：如果一名玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[nature|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 自然检定来回忆知识，他们就可以与大尊柳分享一些有助于对抗真菌侵染的技巧。即使没有这份协助，大尊柳也会在玩家角色返回前清除这场侵染，但祂们仍会感激这番建议——因此给予队伍20 XP作为这次帮助的奖励。

Talking with Great Willow

Once the PCs secure Great Willow’s cooperation, the kodama relaxes somewhat and agrees to talk to the PCs. They speak in a tiny, almost childlike voice, but in a slow and very methodical manner, as if taking care with their word selection. Great Willow’s mind has grown increasingly fractured with each repetition of the year (even though they don’t understand or remember why), and the act of speaking with others requires deliberate concentration for the kodama these days.

If asked about the fungus growing on the tree roots, Great Willow bristles a bit, then calms and says, “An infection I brought back from a visit to check on a friend to the south. I am fighting it back, but I fear for my friend.”

If the PCs ask about the misty border that they faced when they attempted to reach Karahai, Great Willow nods in understanding, replying as follows.

“Yes. I sense it too. It is a curse. A powerful one. I can feel its edges all around. We are in a cage now. When it happened on the first day of summer, I was confused. I was alone. I could not hear my friends’ voices. I jumped to visit my closest friend and they were not there, but a foul-tempered mushroom was, and I had to run away all the way back to here. Alone. I don’t know what to do. I dare not leave this tree again when this curse is all around, but I can look for its edges from here. I will tell you more, but before I do, I need to know my friend is safe. You will go to save her from the angry mushroom, and then I will help.”

Every first day of summer, when the mindscape’s yearly cycle resets, Great Willow senses the change to the environment but is, each time, at a loss as to its cause. And every year, they use nature’s pathway to travel from their willow tree ward to a willow grove nearly 5 miles to the south of Willowshore to check up on the kami of a grove of willow trees located there—a kami who, unlike Great Willow, wasn’t pulled into the mindscape. This year, things have changed for the worse: Kugaptee’s influence allowed an infestation of hostile fungi to bloom in this grove.

When Great Willow used nature’s pathway to travel to the grove, they found the place infested with fungi, with no sign of the kodama who dwelt there (these kodama avoided being drawn into the mindscape—see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05visitinggrea00#the-last-kodama]{The Last Kodama}). Faced with aggression from a hostile fungus and having used their only casting of nature’s pathway for the day, Great Willow was forced to make the undignified trek back home to their ward atop this hill on foot—and in so doing, tracked invasive fungal spores with them.

Reward: If a PC succeeds at a @Check[nature|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge, they can share some helpful techniques with Great Willow on how to fight back against the fungal infestation. Without this aid, Great Willow still removes the infestation by the time the PCs return, but they’re grateful for the suggestion—grant the party 20 XP for the help.

Visiting Great Willow.name: 造访大尊柳 Visiting Great Willow
Visiting Great Willow.text:
造访大尊柳 重度 2

柳岸镇的大尊柳（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w37thegreatw00]{W37}）坐落于俯瞰城镇的一座山丘之上，是一处可见的地标，也是许多本地居民引以为豪的象征。据说，智惠师傅在寻找丹杉时造访的第一个地方就是这里。多年来，这棵树作为镇上的象征之一始终屹立不倒，然而从来没有任何道路或小路通往山顶。所有人都知道，树中栖居着一个精魂，一位自称大尊柳的神使，守望着整座城镇；但很少有人觉得打扰它、或可能惹恼它，是明智之举。因此，造访大尊柳的情况往往极为少见，只有在柳岸镇需要来自灵界的建议时才会发生——比如如今这座定居点正面临的时刻。

除了向大尊柳寻求智慧之外，长老们还建议玩家角色组织镇民准备一份供品带去献给树木，希望借此博得这位精魂在保护柳岸镇时的 favor。至少，带上供品应当能让与这位精魂交谈变得更容易。长老们建议带上葡萄酒或清酒；任何在一次 @Check[nature|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 或 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:14|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 回忆知识检定中成功的玩家角色，也能得出同样结论。若玩家角色在这次检定中大成功，则会意识到更好的供品是一条定制、手工编制的扭绳——注连绳——木灵可以将其垂挂在树枝上，或在它们自己制作魂魄之绳时加以利用。

葡萄酒或清酒可以在镇上买到，但如果玩家角色决定献上注连绳，最好由他们中的一人亲手制作这条编绳，因为若这份礼物不是出自制作者本人之手，木灵很可能会觉得受到了冒犯。注连绳不必特别长——玩家角色花费 3 gp 的材料，并在 1小时行动中成功通过一次 @Check[crafting|dc:16] 检定，就能制作出合适的供品（大失败表示材料毁坏，不能在下一次尝试中重复使用）。

前往大尊柳需要穿过约 1 英里的较稀疏森林，但由于途中有时必须攀行陡坡，这段路程视为困难地形。以 25 尺速度移动的队伍，大约 20 分钟就能从柳岸镇抵达大尊柳。随着玩家角色接近山顶，森林逐渐稀疏，化作一片空地。

山顶周围的森林渐渐变得稀疏，在顶峰留下了一片直径八十尺的空地。空地中央的山丘顶端生长着大尊柳——在这片森林的大部分区域中，唯一的一棵柳树。它高近九十尺，就同类而言也相当巨大。然而，大尊柳在柳岸镇历史中备受崇敬，更多还是因为据说栖居其中的那位精魂。至少已有好几年没人来过大尊柳了，但即使站在空地边缘，也能明显看出树木似乎有些不对劲，因为某种灰色的真菌生长物似乎已经侵染了它下方的根系。

生物：当玩家角色进入空地时，大尊柳从树中浮现，在它的根系之间摆出防御姿态，高举双拳。它向玩家角色发出质问，要求他们解释为何胆敢靠近。注意，进入树木及其木灵 30 尺内的玩家角色将处于大尊柳扰乱凝视的射程内。

当玩家角色说明来意后，允许他们尝试一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:24|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] 留下印象检定，以对起始态度为不友善的大尊柳留下印象。如果玩家角色表明他们带来了献给大尊柳的供品，则难度等级降低 10，变为 @Check[diplomacy|dc:14|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression]。如果玩家角色带来的供品是手工制作的注连绳，那么他们此次检定的结果还会提高一个成功等级。

如果大尊柳仍保持不友善，它会要求玩家角色立刻离开，并“明天再来”；如果玩家角色照做了，他们就必须带来一份全新的供品。每次他们返回时，留下印象的难度等级降低 2。

如果大尊柳变为敌对，它会狂怒尖啸，指责玩家角色是“诅咒的源头”，并发动攻击。大尊柳与其说是想杀死玩家角色，不如说是想吓退他们；如果玩家角色呼吁休战，它就会脱离战斗。它不会追击越过空地边缘的玩家角色；若其生命值降至 30 以下，它会撤退回树中并与之融合。如果玩家角色逃跑后在日后再次返回，则对大尊柳留下印象的难度等级提高 2。

如果大尊柳变得冷淡或友善，它会冷静下来并同意与玩家角色交谈，如下文“与大尊柳交谈”所述。

在玩家角色解决南边真菌侵染的问题前，大尊柳无法被变为友善（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05intotheinfes00]{深入虫害}）。

@UUID[Actor.xYiOzfdmf5NPIw9g]{大尊柳}生物5

  • 小型
  • 神使
  • 精魂
  • 木

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.QcuXRcsJJZsAZlBk]{柳的临别赠礼}
如果玩家角色让大尊柳变为友善，那么当他们准备离开时，这位心怀感激的木灵会赠予他们一份临别赠礼——一团由超自然柔韧的柳枝编成的次级扭结细绳。

最后的木灵

大尊柳尚未意识到、但很快就会像此前每一个心景循环中那样意识到的一点是：它是这片区域唯一仍存在的木灵。由于靠近赫总督的仪式所带来的副作用，它与柳岸镇的居民一同死去，如今也被困在这里。这个地区中其他木灵朋友都已在真实世界中离去，只留下大尊柳孤身一人（它们也都在为大尊柳的消失而哀悼）。如果玩家角色在本战役第 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog13willow]{4 幕}开始时成功让柳岸镇的人民回归现代年代，那么大尊柳也会一并恢复；但在那之前，随着《肆季鬼志》这条冒险路径推进，这位木灵会变得越来越孤僻、越来越消沉。

Visiting Great Willow Severe 2

Willowshore’s Great Willow (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w37thegreatw00]{W37}) sits atop a hill overlooking town, a visible landmark and a source of pride among many locals. Said to be the first place Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} visited on her search for the Tan Sugi, the tree has endured through the years as one of the town’s symbols, yet no road or trail has ever been laid to the hill’s summit. Everyone knows that a spirit dwells within the tree, a kami who calls themself Great Willow and who watches over the town, yet few feel it’s wise to disturb or potentially annoy the spirit. As such, visits to Great Willow tend to happen rarely, and only at times when Willowshore needs advice from the spirit world—times such as those now facing the settlement.

In addition to seeking wisdom from Great Willow, the elders suggest to the PCs that they organize an offering from the townspeople to bring to the tree, in hopes of currying the spirit’s favor in protecting Willowshore. At the very least, bringing an offering should help make conversing with the spirit easier. The elders suggest an offering of wine or sake, as can any PC who succeeds at a @Check[nature|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:14|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge. A PC who critically succeeds at this check realizes an even better offering would be a custom-made, hand-crafted twisted rope—a shimenawa—that a kodama could use to drape over the tree’s branches or to aid in their own creation of spiritual ropes.

Wine or sake can be purchased in town, but if the PCs decide to offer a shimenawa, it’s best for one of them to craft the braided rope themselves, as the kodama will likely be insulted if such a gift is delivered by hands that didn’t craft it. The shimenawa need not be particularly long—a PC can craft an appropriate offering with an expenditure of 3 gp on materials and a successful @Check[crafting|dc:16] check as a 1-hour activity (a critical failure indicates the materials are ruined and can’t be reused on another attempt).

It’s about a 1-mile walk through relatively light forest to reach the Great Willow, but since the terrain involves navigating a steep slope at times, this trip is considered difficult terrain. A party that moves at a speed of 25 feet can make the trip from Willowshore to the Great Willow in about 20 minutes. As the PCs approach the hilltop, the forest thins into a clearing.

The forest thins around the hilltop, leaving an eighty-foot-diameter clearing at its summit. Atop the hill in the center of the clearing grows the Great Willow—the only willow tree present in much of the forest. Looming at a height of nearly ninety feet, the Great Willow is also quite large for its kind. Yet the reason the Great Willow has held such a place of reverence in Willowshore’s history has more to do with the spirit said to dwell within it. At least a few years have passed since anyone has visited the Great Willow, but even from the clearing’s edge, it’s apparent that something seems amiss with the tree, for some sort of gray fungal growth has seemingly infested its lower roots.

Creatures: As the PCs enter the clearing, Great Willow emerges from the tree to adopt a defensive pose among its roots, fists upraised. They call out a challenge to the PCs, demanding they explain why they dare approach. Note that PCs who come within 30 feet of the tree and its kodama will be in range of Great Willow’s Distracting Gaze.

When the PCs explain themselves, allow them a chance to attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:24|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] check to Make an Impression on Great Willow, whose starting attitude is unfriendly. If the PCs reveal that they have an offering for Great Willow, the DC drops by 10 to @Check[diplomacy|dc:14|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression]. If the offering the PCs bring is a handmade shimenawa, then they also increase the result of their check by one degree of success.

If Great Willow remains unfriendly, they demand the PCs leave at once and “come back tomorrow”; if the PCs do so, they’ll need to bring a brand new offering. Each time they return, the DC to Make an Impression is reduced by 2.

If Great Willow becomes hostile, they shriek in rage, accuse the PCs of being “the source of the curse,” and attack. Great Willow doesn’t aim to kill PCs as much as to frighten them away and breaks off from combat if the PCs call for a truce. They won’t pursue the PCs beyond the edge of the clearing, and they retreat to the tree to merge with it if reduced to fewer than 30 Hit Points. If the PCs flee and then return at a later date, the DC to Make an Impression on Great Willow increases by 2.

If Great Willow is made indifferent or friendly, they calm down and agree to speak to the PCs, as detailed below under Talking with Great Willow.

Great Willow can’t be made friendly until the PCs solve the fungus infestation situation down south (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05intotheinfes00]{Into the Infestation}).

@UUID[Actor.xYiOzfdmf5NPIw9g]{Great Willow}Creature 5

  • Small
  • Kami
  • Spirit
  • Wood

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.QcuXRcsJJZsAZlBk]{Willow's Parting Gift}
If the PCs made Great Willow friendly, once they prepare to leave, the grateful kodama gives them a parting gift—a lesser twisting twine made of supernaturally supple woven willow branches.

The Last Kodama

What Great Willow doesn’t yet realize, but will soon enough (as they’ve done so in every mindscape cycle before), is that they’re the only kodama present in the region. As a side effect of their proximity to Governor Heh’s ritual, they perished along with the citizens of Willowshore and are now trapped here as well. Great Willow’s other kodama friends throughout the region have gone on in the real world, leaving Great Willow alone (each of them mourning Great Willow’s disappearance as well). If the PCs succeed at restoring the people of Willowshore to the modern age at the beginning of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog13willow]{Act 4} of this campaign, Great Willow will be restored as well, but until then, the kodama grows more and more withdrawn and depressed as the Adventure Path progresses.

The Mists.name: 迷雾 The Mists
The Mists.text:
迷雾

尽管镇长连同他的庄园和仆役一并失踪令人担忧，但很快，柳岸镇居民最主要的忧虑就变成了他们发现一种奇异的迷雾正在阻止任何人离开柳岸镇太远。这个城镇相对能够自给自足，但如果没有贸易，即将到来的冬季将会很难熬。当这种神秘迷雾成为城镇新的现实后，这里的人们将需要能够仰望的英雄——而玩家角色正适合在未来几个月里承担这一角色。眼下，镇上的长老们对玩家角色有一个非常明确的请求：他们希望查明环绕柳岸镇的这种效果究竟延伸到什么程度。这些奇异的迷雾只是阻止人们前往海岸和唐入吗？还是说它们完全包围了这片地区——如果是，又包围到了什么程度？

虽然单纯通过探索这种“诅咒”的边界，并沿着迷雾绕地区一周前进，也是一种测定其触及范围的方法，但那将是一场漫长且可能危险的跋涉，要穿越没有路径的荒野。相反，玩家角色所偏好的那位镇上长老建议他们去拜访矗立在镇北山顶上的大柳树。那里栖居着一位本地精魂，其与周边荒野的联系应当能为当前发生之事提供宝贵见解。

沿边界前行

心景的迷雾边界只有在有人实际穿过它时才会显现，此时旅行者会短暂地陷入困惑与迷失方向，随后又从最初穿越边界的位置重新踏回心景。由于若不反复重复这一过程，就没有可供追踪的视觉线索，因此通过探索来绘制心景边界会是一项重复且复杂的工作。一旦某位玩家角色抵达一片有边界穿过的六角区域，他们便可以花费4小时，通过彻底探索并反复折返、一次又一次与边界交互的过程，在该六角区域内绘制出边界的路径。因此，一位玩家角色在变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}之前，一天的工作中最多可以绘制两个相邻六角区域的边界。

请注意，幽魂之墙在心景西侧也构成了一道额外边界，而且它完全是一道实体且可见的屏障——关于这一地点特征以及玩家角色可以如何与之交互的更多信息，见第60页。

The Mists

While the disappearance of the governor and his manor and staff is worrisome, the discovery that a strange mist is preventing anyone from traveling too far from Willowshore quickly becomes the major concern of its citizens. The town is relatively self-sufficient, but without trade, the coming winter will be difficult. While the new reality of this mysterious mist settles in on the town, its people will need heroes to look up to—a role the PCs are primed to fill in the coming months. For now, the town elders have a very specific request for the PCs: they’d like to determine the extent of the effect that surrounds Willowshore. Do these strange mists merely prevent travel to the coast and to Karahai? Or do they completely encircle the region—and if so, to what extent?

While simply exploring the limits of the “curse” and following the mist in a circuit around the region is one way to determine its reach, this would be a long, potentially dangerous slog through trackless wilderness. Instead, the town elder favored by the PCs suggests they pay a visit to the Great Willow that stands on the hilltop just north of town. There dwells a local spirit whose connection to the hinterland wilderness should allow them to provide valuable insight into what’s going on.

Following the Border

The mindscape’s misty border doesn’t manifest until one physically crosses it, at which point the traveler spends a few moments confused and disoriented, only to step back into the mindscape at the point they crossed the border in the first place. Since there’s no visual cue to follow without repeating this process, mapping out the mindscape’s borders by exploring is repetitive and complicated. Once a PC reaches a hex through which the border runs, they can map out the border’s path through that hex by spending 4 hours Searching that hex through a process of exhaustive exploration and backtracking to interact with the border over and over. A PC can thus map out the border of two adjacent hexes in a day’s work before becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Note that the Wall of Ghosts, which serves as an additional border along the mindscape’s western side, is very much a physical and visual barrier—see page 60 for more information about this feature and how the PCs can interact with it.

Songs at Canary Inn.name: 玉鸟客栈的歌曲 Songs at Canary Inn
Songs at Canary Inn.text:
玉鸟客栈的歌曲 中等 2

当玩家角色接近玉鸟客栈的废墟时，他们会听见一个甜美的声音唱着一首关于蝴蝶与梦境的歌。越靠近客栈，歌声就越清晰。一旦玩家角色看见破败的客栈，对他们读出以下内容（注意，第二段包含对这些生物的描述——如果玩家角色的行动会影响这些生物的活动，务必按需调整这段文字）。

场景注记声音

@UUID[Playlist.zLGowtHaJW7U2VZM.PlaylistSound.exPXrONS2vLVacTT]{歌唱}

此次遭遇使用玉鸟客栈地图。

森林道路在这里通向一处岔路，岔路北边坐落着几栋部分烧毁的单卧房建筑。这半打平房曾共同组成玉鸟客栈，但如今大多数建筑都已烧成瓦砾，不过周围的林地已从大火中恢复。最北边的那栋建筑看起来大体还算完好。

那栋建筑正南方的空地上坐着三个身影。其中两个穿着长长的灰色兜帽斗篷，背对着来者而坐，全神贯注地望着第三个身影——那是个穿着红色兜帽斗篷的小孩，正唱着一首关于蝴蝶与梦境的歌；然而那旋律比起这首歌原本轻灵的主题，却显得格外哀婉低沉。

生物：那名红兜帽孩子是范洪瑞，她借助幻象伪装法术掩盖了自己作为草人的真实模样。当玩家角色靠近时，允许他们进行 @Check[perception|dc:22] 检定，以看穿这层魔法伪装，并意识到这个孩子其实是一个浑身血污、由枯草扎成、靠缕缕幽灵灵质维系在一起并能活动的塑像。另两个身影则是普通草人，它们生前分别是范洪瑞同行的伙伴戚弘信与南哲弘班。从背后看，它们像是穿斗篷的小型类人生物；但一旦它们对玩家角色作出反应（或从正面被看见），其真正的超自然本质便无可错认。

场景注记效果

将 @UUID[Item.ZIXn4CFpQ9ySzVPr]{范宏瑞真身} 效果拖到她身上以关闭其伪装

虽然这些草人对生者满怀嫉恨与怒意，但它们并不会一见到玩家角色就发动攻击。相反，一旦范洪瑞注意到他们，她便停下歌声，沉默地打量着这支队伍。另两个草人则伴随着草叶窸窣的声响猛地站起，分立在她两侧，准备保护她。

范洪瑞很好奇玩家角色为何来到这里。如果有任何玩家角色携带乐器，或明显是位表演者，她会指着那名角色，用哀伤的声音问道：“你们是来为我们表演的吗？已经很久没有别人来给我们演出了。”如果有玩家角色为她表演，该玩家角色必须尝试一次 @Check[performance|dc:17] 检定。

大成功 这场表演抚平了草人的怒火，并让它们想起生命之美，而不会引发嫉妒或失落之情。范洪瑞的幻象消散，显露出她真正的模样；她感谢表演者送上的美好馈赠，随后询问玩家角色为何前来拜访。她允许每名玩家角色向她提出一个问题，而她会尽己所能回答。

成功 范洪瑞的怒意被稍稍安抚。她不会解除自己的幻象，但仍会询问玩家角色为何前来拜访。她允许整个队伍提出一个问题，而她会尽己所能回答。

失败 这场表演未能打动她，范洪瑞的神情愈发阴沉——她警告队伍不该来这里，必须立刻离开。如果玩家角色不马上照做，草人便会发动攻击。

大失败 还没等表演结束，草人们便已发出讥讽的窃笑，并立刻发动攻击。

如果范洪瑞被安抚到愿意回答问题，你可以按情况自由作答。她对笼罩柳岸镇的思维空间一无所知；但若被问及总督，她的神情会阴沉下来，并说他是龙华的走狗，也是个体的敌人。她并不知道龙华已经崩溃，也不知道赫总督已经失踪；但如果她得知他已经下落不明，便会说道：“掌权者只要时间足够，总会滥用或抛弃自己的责任——你们该庆幸，你们的总督选择了离开，而不是给你们的城镇带来更糟的东西。”

在她回答完问题后，如果某名玩家角色在表演检定中取得大成功，她会如释重负地叹息一声——她和另外两个草人随之渐渐消散，芦苇般的身体也随之瘫倒在地。如果柳岸镇心景最终得以重置，这三个会在来年归来；但在那之前，这三个草人都不会再生。反之，如果玩家角色仅取得成功，她便会要求队伍立刻离开——任何留下的人都会遭到攻击。

玉鸟客栈的歌曲 中等 2

@UUID[Actor.ZcDfbztikxszO9uG]{范洪瑞} @UUID[Actor.k8gFEY6O5PdKBCEL]{草人（2）}

如果草人发动攻击，三者都以察觉掷先攻，并在其回合开始时先施展“咯咯分神”。范洪瑞会留在远处，对玩家角色使用念动弹射，而另外两个草人则移动进入近战。如果其中任一草人被摧毁，或有玩家角色在近战中缠住范洪瑞，她就会释放复仇怒嚎。草人会战斗至被摧毁为止，但不会追击逃跑的玩家角色超过距离废墟半英里的范围。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.X9LtEF98l2AMbaMS]{弘蕊酬恩} @UUID[Actor.ne1myAHotXIWtfLL]{浅坟}
那场悲剧性的大火摧毁玉鸟客栈后，两名叛军的尸体被草草埋进了庭院中央的浅坟里，位置正是玩家角色初次到访时三名草人所在之处（范洪瑞的尸体则始终没有找到）。若有玩家角色在该区域搜索，并在一次 @Check[perception|dc:16|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定中成功，就会注意到焦黑土壤中的异常之处，并认出那是浅坟。

如果玩家角色掘开尸体，他们会发现两具骸骨——那是戚弘信与南哲弘班仅存的遗骸。如果玩家角色确保这两具遗体得到妥善安葬，那么在本次心景循环期间，这三个草人将不会再次再生。

奇怪的是，一件曾属于范洪瑞的红斗篷也躺在坟中。如果玩家角色确保遗体得到妥善安葬，其中一名玩家角色（最好是那位尝试进行表演检定的人）会突然感到一阵感激之情，并明白范洪瑞希望他们收下她的斗篷，以答谢这份善意。同样地，如果某名玩家角色在表演检定中取得大成功，当草人消散时，那名玩家角色会感到一股冲动，想去掘开坟墓并取走那件斗篷作为报酬。

如果范洪瑞将这件斗篷赠予玩家角色作为谢礼，它会作为一件名为弘蕊酬恩的独特魔法物品生效。如果玩家角色在未获她感激的情况下取走斗篷，它就会变成受诅咒的物品；若穿戴超过 1 分钟，其负载会骤然增加至 5，随后与该玩家角色纠缠在一起（关于受诅咒物品的更多信息，见开拓者 GM Core第 306 页）。这个诅咒可以用正常方式解除，但只要那两具骸骨获得恰当而有敬意的安葬，它也会立刻消散，届时这件斗篷便会变成弘蕊酬恩。

奖励： 如果玩家角色让这三个草人得到安息，除了他们在战斗中击败它们本应获得的奖励外，再额外授予 40 XP。此后，柳岸镇心景中将不再遭遇草人，任何随机遭遇若结果为草人，都视为未发生遭遇。此外，整片区域整体上也会显得不那么闹鬼。这会改善镇民的士气，而玩家角色将获得来自北岭与南岸的 1 声望点。

虽然对玩家角色而言，这条调查线索最终走入死胡同，但镇上的长者仍鼓励他们继续追查另外两条线索，并希望他们最终能够帮助解开总督失踪之谜。

Songs at Canary Inn Moderate 2

As the PCs approach the ruins of Canary Inn, they’ll hear a sweet voice singing a song about butterflies and dreams. The closer they get to the inn, the clearer the song gets. Once the PCs come in sight of the ruined inn, read them the following (note that the second paragraph includes descriptions of the creatures—make sure to adjust this text as necessary if the PCs’ actions would impact the creatures’ activities).

Scene NotesSound

@UUID[Playlist.zLGowtHaJW7U2VZM.PlaylistSound.exPXrONS2vLVacTT]{Singing}

Use the Canary Inn map for this encounter.

The forest road comes to a junction here, just north of which sit several partially burned single-bedroom structures. These half-dozen bungalows once comprised the Canary Inn, but today most of the buildings are burned to rubble, although the surrounding woodland has recovered from the fire. The northernmost structure seems mostly intact.

Three figures sit in the clearing just south of that structure. Two of the figures wear long gray hooded cloaks and sit facing away, their attention rapt on the third figure who stands before them—a young child wearing a red-hooded cloak whose song about butterflies and dreams floats along on a melody that feels much more maudlin and downbeat than its whimsical topic would suggest.

Creatures: The red-hooded child is Hongrui, who has disguised her thatchling reality using an illusory disguise spell. As the PCs approach, allow them @Check[perception|dc:22] checks to see through the magical disguise and to realize the child is, in fact, a blood-soaked, mobile effigy made of dried grass held together by wisps of ghostly ectoplasm. The other two figures are regular thatchlings who, in life, were Hongrui’s traveling companions Chi Hongxin and Nanzhe Hongban. Viewed from behind, they appear as Small cloaked humanoids, but once they react to the PCs (or are viewed from the front), their true supernatural nature is impossible to miss.

Scene NotesEffect

Drag on the @UUID[Item.ZIXn4CFpQ9ySzVPr]{Fan Hongrui True Form} Effect to turn off her disguise

While the thatchlings are filled with jealous anger toward the living, they don’t attack the PCs on sight. Instead, once Hongrui notices them, she stops her song and regards the party silently. The other two thatchlings scramble to their feet with the sound of rustling grass to stand at either side, ready to defend her.

Hongrui is curious to find out why the PCs are here. If any of the PCs carry a musical instrument or are otherwise obviously a performer, she points to that character and asks in a forlorn voice, “Are you here to entertain us? It’s been so long since we’ve had others to perform for us.” If a PC does perform for her, that PC must attempt a @Check[performance|dc:17] check.

Critical Success The performance soothes the thatchlings’ anger and reminds them of the beauty of life in a way that doesn’t evoke feelings of jealousy or loss. Hongrui’s illusion fades to reveal what she actually is, and she thanks the performer for the beautiful gift before asking why the PCs have come to visit her. She allows each PC to ask her one question that she’ll answer to the best of her ability.

Success Hongrui’s anger is soothed somewhat. She doesn’t lower her illusion but still asks the PCs why they’ve come to visit her. She allows the party to ask one question that she’ll answer to the best of her ability.

Failure The performance fails to impress, and Hongrui’s expression grows darker—she warns the party that they shouldn’t be here and should leave at once. If the PCs don’t comply immediately, the thatchlings attack.

Critical Failure The thatchlings begin giggling in mockery well before the performance ends and attack at once.

If Hongrui is soothed enough that she answers questions, feel free to reply to questions as you see fit. She knows nothing about the mindscape surrounding Willowshore, but if asked about the governor, her expression darkens and she says he was a lapdog of Lung Wa and an enemy to the individual. She has no idea that Lung Wa has collapsed, or that Governor Heh has vanished, but if she learns that he has gone missing, she says, “Those in power will always abuse or abandon their responsibility, given time—be grateful your governor chose to leave you rather than inflict upon your town something worse.”

Once she has answered their questions, if a PC achieved a critical success on the Performance check, she sighs in relief—she and the other thatchlings fade away, their reed bodies collapsing to the ground. If the Willowshore mindscape is allowed to eventually reset, the three return next year, but until then, these three thatchlings won’t rejuvenate. If instead the PCs only achieved a success, she asks the party to leave at once—those who remain are attacked.

Songs at Canary Inn Moderate 2

@UUID[Actor.ZcDfbztikxszO9uG]{Fan Hongrui} @UUID[Actor.k8gFEY6O5PdKBCEL]{Thatchlings (2)}

If the thatchlings attack, all three roll Perception for initiative and begin to Giggle Distractingly as their turn begins. Hongrui remains at range, using telekinetic projectile against the PCs while the other two thatchlings move into melee. If either of those thatchlings are destroyed, or if a PC engages Hongrui in melee, she unleashes a Howl of Vengeful Fury. The thatchlings fight until they’re destroyed but don’t pursue fleeing PCs further than a half mile from the ruins.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.X9LtEF98l2AMbaMS]{Hongrui’s Gratitude} @UUID[Actor.ne1myAHotXIWtfLL]{Shallow Grave}
After the tragic fire destroyed Canary Inn, the bodies of two of the rebels were given unceremonious shallow graves in the middle of the courtyard, exactly where the three thatchlings were located when the PCs first visit (Hongrui’s body was never recovered). A PC who Searches in this area and succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:16|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check notices irregularities in the charred soil that they recognize as shallow graves.

If the PCs exhume the bodies, they’ll find two skeletons—all that remains of Hongxin and Hongban. If the PCs see that these two bodies are given proper burials, the three thatchlings don’t rejuvenate again during this mindscape cycle.

Curiously, a red cloak that once belonged to Hongrui lies in the graves as well. If the PCs see to it that the bodies receive proper burials, one PC (the one who attempted the Performance check, preferably) feels a sudden sense of gratitude and understands that Hongrui wants them to take her cloak as thanks for the kindness. Likewise, if a PC critically succeeded at the Performance check, when the thatchlings fade, that PC feels the urge to exhume the grave and claim the cloak as a reward.

If Hongrui offers the cloak to the PCs as thanks, it functions as a unique magic item called Hongrui’s Gratitude. If the PCs claim the cloak without her gratitude, it becomes cursed, suddenly increasing to 5 Bulk if worn for longer than 1 minute at which point it fuses with the PC (see Pathfinder GM Core page 306 for more information about cursed items). This curse can be lifted normally but also fades as soon as the two skeletons are given a proper, respectful burial, whereupon the cloak becomes Hongrui’s Gratitude.

Reward: If the PCs bring rest to the three thatchlings, grant them 40 XP in addition to what they would’ve earned for defeating them in combat. Thatchlings are no longer encountered in the Willowshore mindscape, and any random encounter resulting in a thatchling is treated as no encounter. Additionally, the region feels slightly less haunted overall. This improves the townsfolk’s morale and the PCs gain 1 Reputation Point with Northridge and Southbank.

While this line of investigation ends at a dead end for the PCs, the town elder encourages them to pursue the other two leads and hopes that they might ultimately help solve the mystery of the vanished governor.

Ghosts in the Grass.name: 草丛中的幽灵 Ghosts in the Grass
Ghosts in the Grass.text:
草丛中的幽灵 低阶 2

鸿芮死亡时的确切遭遇将她扭曲成了一种不死生物——@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21redhoodedtha00]{红头草人}。早在柳岸镇心景形成之前，她就一直将那些无法转生术的人的灵魂转化为草人，而这些草人如今愈发频繁地在柳岸腹地的森林中作祟。玩家角色甚至可能在长老们联系他们调查此事之前，就已经在森林里遇到过其中一些精魂。

一旦长老们请玩家角色前往玉鸟客栈的废墟（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d4canaryinn000]{D4}），他们就需要沿着小路或穿越森林向西北行进，因为连接玉鸟客栈与柳岸镇的主干道在葫芦湖以东、心景边缘处已经中断。长老们建议沿着渡月河东岸的道路向北前进，然后转上更靠东的一条老猎人小路，尝试抵达客栈。长老们还指出，如果结果证明玉鸟客栈位于“诅咒”边缘之外，那就说明他们关于此事与赫总督失踪有关的推测是错误的。

草丛中的幽灵 低阶 2

@UUID[Actor.k8gFEY6O5PdKBCEL]{草人（3）}

生物： 无论玩家角色选择哪条路线，在前往玉鸟客栈的途中都会遭遇一群草人。这场遭遇发生在一处道路较宽的地段，或是森林中的一片空地；那里有一大片高草生长的开阔地。当玩家角色穿过该区域时，他们会听见一阵怪异的咯咯笑声，或者也可能听见一句轻声呢喃的“救救我”——那声音听起来与其说是在求助，不如说更像是在威胁——隐约盖过风声或细雨声。无论玩家角色是否调查，藏在草丛中的三只草人都会急奔而出并攻击他们，一直战斗到被摧毁为止。

在这场遭遇结束后，让玩家角色尝试进行 @Check[religion|dc:14|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定，以回忆知识并了解草人的相关信息。请记住，虽然这些怪物在本幕中是新登场的，玩家也不熟悉它们，但在神门，关于草人的传闻和故事本就是当地民间传说的一部分。若此次检定获得大成功，某个角色就会明确知道：草人以草编成的替代躯体惧怕火焰，而草人的出现也意味着附近地区同样存在一只红头草人——一种能够制造草人后代的不死生物。

Ghosts in the Grass Low 2

The exact circumstances of Hongrui’s death twisted her into an undead creature—a @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21redhoodedtha00]{Red-Hooded Thatchling}. Since even before the formation of Willowshore’s mindscape, she has been converting the souls of those unable to reincarnate into the thatchlings that increasingly haunt the forests of the Willowshore hinterlands. The PCs might even have encountered some of these spirits out in the forest before being contacted by the elders to investigate this situation.

Once the PCs are asked by the elders to travel to the ruins of Canary Inn (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d4canaryinn000]{D4}), they’ll need to make the journey northwest using trails or traveling through the forest, as the primary road that connects Canary Inn to Willowshore is interrupted just east of Gourd Lake by the edge of the mindscape. The elders suggest following the road up north along the east bank of the Duyue River, then taking one of the old hunter’s trails further east to try to reach the inn. If it turns out that Canary Inn lies beyond the edge of the “curse,” the elders note, then that suggests their theory of the link to Governor Heh’s disappearance is false.

Ghosts in the Grass Low 2

@UUID[Actor.k8gFEY6O5PdKBCEL]{Thatchlings (3)}

Creatures: Regardless of the route the PCs take, they encounter a group of thatchlings during their journey to the Canary Inn. This encounter takes place in an area where a wide spot in the road or a clearing in the forest allows for a large clearing of tall grass to grow. As the PCs pass through the area, the sound of strange giggling, or perhaps even a single whispered cry of “help me” that sounds more like a threat than a call for aid, becomes apparent just over the sound of wind or soft rainfall. Whether or not the PCs investigate, the three thatchlings hiding in the grass scurry out to attack them, fighting until destroyed.

In the aftermath of the encounter, allow the PCs to attempt @Check[religion|dc:14|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] checks to Recall Knowledge about thatchlings. Remember that while these monsters are newly introduced in this act and that players are unfamiliar with them, in Shenmen, rumors and stories of thatchlings are a part of local folklore. With a critical success at this check, a character certainly knows that thatchlings, with their surrogate bodies made of grass, are vulnerable to fire and that the presence of thatchlings suggests a red-hooded thatchling—an undead capable of creating thatchling spawn—is present in the region as well.

The Missing Governor.name: 失踪的总督 The Missing Governor
The Missing Governor.text:
失踪的总督

与迷雾或丑萌不同，要开始搜寻失踪的总督，并没有明显的切入点。对他宅邸旧址那块地的检查毫无收获——甚至没有任何迹象表明那里曾经有过一座建筑，这也进一步印证了当前流行的看法：无论是什么掳走了那座宅邸，必定都是一股极其强大的超自然力量。

由于缺乏任何明显线索，胡婆婆和松木老人都得出结论：某种对总督怀有怨念的超自然力量，必定在这场神秘失踪中扮演了某种角色。两位长者都想不出镇上有谁同时具备做出这种事所需的力量与动机，但随后，他们想起了前年年末附近发生的一件事——那时，赫总督下令逮捕过一些逃犯。

失去一切是什么感觉

这件事发生在三年前，即7105年的冬季。赫总督收到司泽传来的文书，要他留意一些“危险逃犯”；据称，这些人曾试图诅咒帝皇家族。当其中一名逃犯——名叫范洪瑞的歌者——出现在柳岸镇，自称是在为一位被蛇咬伤的朋友寻求协助时，总督试图逮捕她。

范洪瑞施展魔法，分散并打伤了他的守卫，随后逃走。守卫一恢复，赫总督便带领他们追赶那名女子。他们追踪她到了玉鸟客栈——那是柳岸镇东北方路边的一处歇脚地——但在随后那场紧张的对峙中，突然爆发了火灾。官方说法认为这场火是那名逃犯引起的，但也有不少人声称，是总督和他的守卫为了逼迫那名逃犯及其同伙现身，才放了这把火。

不过，有一点无人否认：当建筑燃烧时，洪瑞唱出的最后几句话似乎让赫总督感到不安，因为她曾许诺：“所有侍奉龙华的人，很快都会知道失去一切是什么感觉！”

当时，这看起来不过是一个罪犯临死前的誓言；但事后回看，随着龙华在一年内崩溃，玩家角色的赞助人不禁怀疑，那誓言中蕴含的魔法，或许比他们原先以为的更多。无论如何，范洪瑞的两名同伴的尸体后来被找到，并埋葬在那座毁坏建筑附近，但始终没人找到她的遗骸。

虽然两位长者也承认，这件事与三年后赫总督的失踪之间的联系显得颇为牵强，但这是他们目前能想到的、最接近解释真相的线索了。他们请求玩家角色前往玉鸟客栈，调查现场——哪怕只是为了确认，这个离奇故事与总督的失踪真的只是巧合。

The Missing Governor

Unlike the mists or Ugly Cute, there are no obvious starting points to begin the search for the missing governor. Examinations of the plot on which his manor once stood lead nowhere—nothing even indicates that a building once stood there, lending weight to the prevailing theory that whatever snatched away the manor was a powerful supernatural force indeed.

With the lack of any obvious leads, both Granny Hu and Old Matsuki came to the conclusion that some supernatural force with a grudge against the governor must have had some role in the mysterious vanishing. Neither elder knows anyone in town who has the right combination of power and motivation to pull something like this off, but then they recall an event that happened near the end of the previous year, when Governor Heh had some fugitives arrested.

How it Feels to Lose It all

This event took place three years ago, in the winter of 7105. Governor Heh received a missive from Sze to be on the lookout for “dangerous fugitives” said to have attempted to curse the imperial family. When one of these fugitives, a singer named Fan Hongrui, showed up in Willowshore claiming to be searching for aid in dealing with a friend’s snakebite, the governor attempted to arrest her.

Fan Hongrui used magic to distract and injure his guards and then fled. As soon as the guards recovered, the governor led them in pursuit of the woman. They tracked her to Canary Inn, a roadside shelter to the northeast of Willowshore, but in the tense standoff that followed, a fire erupted. Officially, the fire is believed to have been triggered by the fugitive, but there are more than a few who claim the governor and his guards started the blaze in an attempt to force the fugitive and her allies out into the open.

What none contest is that the final words Hongrui sung out as the building burned seemed to unsettle Governor Heh, for she promised that “All those who serve Lung Wa will soon know how it feels to lose it all!”

At the time, it seemed little more than the dying oath of a criminal, but in hindsight, with Lung Wa collapsing within a year, the PCs’ patron wonders if there was more magic to the oath than they suspected. In any case, the bodies of Fan Hongrui’s two accomplices were recovered and buried near the ruined building, but her remains were never found.

While the elders admit the connection to Governor Heh’s disappearance three years later seems tenuous, it’s the closest thing they’ve come up with to explain what could have happened. They ask the PCs to travel to Canary Inn to investigate the site, if only to confirm this strange story is merely a coincidence to the governor’s disappearance.

Investigating the Curse.name: 调查诅咒 Investigating the Curse
Investigating the Curse.text:
调查诅咒

虽然柳岸镇中有许多本地居民的请求，足以让PC们忙个不停，但这个城镇当前面临的最重要问题，还是肆季鬼志开始时降临在柳岸镇上的奇怪“诅咒”。在PC们尝试前往唐入却失败并返回后的几天里，两位镇中长者——胡婆婆和松木老人——共同请他们前往司魂娘娘，也就是供奉@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}的本地神殿会面。

在这里，两位长者暂且搁下彼此的私人嫌隙，先感谢PC们迄今为柳岸镇提供的服务——随后请求他们继续调查，查明究竟是什么原因导致这座城镇受到诅咒。柳岸镇遭到怪物入侵无疑是这场诅咒的一种表现，但随着长明灯被点亮，再加上PC们的行动，这个问题似乎已经大致得到了解决。然而，正如长者们指出的那样，城镇还面临着另外三个谜团：赫总督及其宅邸的消失、笼罩四野并阻止人们出行的诡异迷雾，以及名为丑萌的石蜘蛛失踪一事。

长者们请求PC们调查这三件事——处理顺序无关紧要，尽管总督失踪一事显然最为紧迫。毕竟，如果能找到赫总督，也许他会更清楚到底发生了什么！接下来的页面将分别把这些谜团呈现为一组组供PC们探索的遭遇。

Investigating the Curse

While there are plenty of requests from locals to keep the PCs busy in Willowshore, the most important thing facing the town is the strange “curse” that descended on Willowshore at the onset of the season of ghosts. A few days after the PCs return from their failed attempt to reach Karahai, they’re asked by both town elders—Granny Hu and Old Matsuki—to meet with them at the Lady of Souls, the local temple of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}.

Here, the two elders set aside their personal grievances to thank the PCs for the services they’ve provided to Willowshore so far—and to then request that they continue their work to determine what has caused the town to become cursed. While the monstrous invasion of Willowshore was certainly an aspect of this curse, it seems to have been largely solved by lighting the Eternal Lantern and as a result of the PCs’ actions. Yet, as the elders point out, there are three other mysteries facing the town: the vanishing of Governor Heh and his estate, the strange mists that surround the hinterlands and prevent travel, and the disappearance of the stone spider known as Ugly Cute.

The elders ask the PCs to investigate all three of these developments—the order in which they’re tackled is irrelevant, although the disappearance of the governor seems to be the most pressing matter. If Governor Heh can be found, perhaps he’ll know more about what’s going on, after all! Each of these mysteries is presented on the following pages as its own set of encounters for the PCs to explore.

Opportunities.name: 机会 Opportunities
Opportunities.text:
机会

随着玩家角色变得越来越有名，他们将会获得许多机会。这些任务、悬赏与请求在此进行了概述，大致按照可获得的先后顺序排列，但你可以根据自己游戏的推进情况自由混合搭配这些请求。未在本幕中进行的机会，始终可以留到接下来的幕中使用！

这里的每个机会都以简略格式呈现。它们原本旨在于探索模式中解决，但如果其中一些内容给了你灵感，也可以自由扩展，让它们能够在遭遇模式中解决。其中数个机会会使用胜利点来处理局势——关于如何累积胜利点的规则，见《Pathfinder GM Core》第184页。

失踪的船只

请求者 拉朱尔·萨穆德拉（柳岸镇码头，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w31dock0000000]{W31}）

任务 拉朱尔·萨穆德拉气喘吁吁地找到玩家角色，报告说河童刚刚从柳岸镇码头偷走了两艘船，并顺流而下逃走了。他请求玩家角色设法追上它们，把船带回来。

挑战 河童把船带到了葫芦湖南岸（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d2gourdlake000]{D2}），所以玩家角色一到达该区域，就能与这些河童窃贼对峙。船只本身漂浮在离岸十几尺的水面上，几只河童正在上面嬉闹。一位河童长老会走近玩家角色，为年轻河童们的恶作剧道歉，并请求队伍通过“相扑摔跤审判”来给年轻河童一个教训。

为了完成这场教训，玩家角色必须在五场相扑摔跤中至少赢下三场。每场比赛由一名玩家角色尝试一次 @Check[athletics|dc:17] 检定，以蛮力取胜，或尝试一次 @Check[deception|dc:17] 检定，诱使河童鞠躬或以其他方式让它洒出头碗中的水。运动检定大失败表示该玩家角色拉伤了肌肉，并在24小时内变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}。欺瞒检定大失败表示该玩家角色出了洋相，并在本次竞赛中未来进行的所有欺瞒检定上承受 –2 环境减值。

如果爆发暴力冲突，或者玩家角色未能至少赢下三场比赛，河童们就会嘶叫咒骂着逃入水中，丢下船只——但它们很可能几天后又会再来偷船。

这些河童中有些可能正是玩家角色在 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{第2章} 中遇到过的那些。如果玩家角色当时以和平方式解决了那次遭遇，那么他们只需在五场相扑摔跤中至少赢下一场，就足以完成上述教训。

奖励 如果玩家角色赢下了足够多的比赛，河童们就会吸取教训，不再偷船。给予玩家角色40 XP，以及北岭1点声望点。

修缮牧场

请求者 昆舜重（柳岸镇马厩，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w2willowshor00]{W2}）

任务 帮助这里的主人修复柳岸镇马厩，它在怪物入侵期间遭到了严重破坏。

挑战 每天一次，每名玩家角色都可以选择花费8小时，使用 @Check[survival|dc:15] 检定追踪并带回逃进附近荒野的牲畜，或者使用 @Check[crafting|dc:15] 检定帮助修理牧场的围栏。这些检定会获得胜利点。

奖励 一旦玩家角色获得10点胜利点，柳岸镇马厩的服务便会重新开放；玩家角色获得10 XP以及南岸1点声望点。

迁移黛丝娜圣祠

请求者 乔春虎（磨坊，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w8millinghou00]{W8}）

任务 春虎请求玩家角色帮助他为目前荒置在城镇废弃庄园区域（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w23abandoned00]{W23b}）中的黛丝娜圣祠寻找一个新家。

挑战 一位名为 @UUID[Actor.Yhph6WPW4ErtIP6s]{小星} 的式神神使守护着这座圣祠。玩家角色必须成功通过一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:19] 检定，说服小星允许他们搬迁圣祠。之后，玩家角色必须尝试 @Check[athletics|dc:15] 检定来实际搬运其部件，或尝试 @Check[religion|dc:16] 检定，以确保圣祠的构件保持完好。每次此类检定都需耗时4小时，并累积胜利点。若玩家角色在未获得小星许可的情况下尝试搬迁圣祠，则这些检定承受 –2 环境减值。黛丝娜的崇拜者在此次挑战中进行的所有检定都获得 +2 环境加值。

奖励 一旦玩家角色获得5点胜利点，圣祠就会被迁至磨坊（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w8millinghou00]{W8}），由春虎照料；玩家角色获得20 XP以及南岸1点声望点。

调查老村庄扩展

请求者 松木胜（松木宅邸，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w5matsukiest00]{W5}）

任务 松木老人已经开始担心，如果柳岸镇的人民真的被某种诅咒困住，他们将没有足够的食物撑过冬季。他请求玩家角色前往北方一座废弃村庄，确认那里是否仍可到达——如果可以，就去探索那里并收集足够的信息，让村民能够在那里种植应急作物。

挑战 玩家角色前往老村庄扩展（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d8oldvillage00]{D8}），途中可能遭遇一次随机遭遇。这座废弃村庄位于心景迷雾边界的内侧边缘。玩家角色抵达后，可以通过花费4小时，然后尝试 @Check[nature|dc:16] 或 @Check[farming-lore|dc:16] 检定，调查周边农田并评估其是否适合利用；或者尝试 @Check[society|dc:18] 检定，规划在废墟中开垦新作物的最佳方法，以此累积胜利点。

奖励 达到8点胜利点就足以将该地点确立为柳岸镇的补充农业区域。这将在第二幕带来后果。给予玩家角色20 XP以及南岸1点声望点。

铁匠的麻烦

触发 本冒险进入第二个月。

请求者 雍武秀（永焰铁工坊，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w1eternalbla00]{W1}）

任务 与北岭结盟的帝皇守卫已经开始向永焰铁工坊施压，要求它放下其他工作，专注于免费制作武器和护甲，以便在柳岸镇看起来可能与外界隔绝的情况下武装守卫。雍武秀请求玩家角色前往柳岸镇守卫办事书房（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w13w15indust00]{W15}）与郑鹏交涉。或者，他们也可以尝试说服雍武秀，让她相信支持城镇守卫是个好主意。

挑战 无论玩家角色决定去找郑鹏还是雍武秀，这都不会是一场简单迅速的讨论。若要说服两者之一向另一方的需求让步，玩家角色必须通过与所选非玩家角色进行数次、每次2小时的讨论来累积胜利点。他们可以用关于柳岸镇所面临危险的故事来恐吓雍武秀（甚至直接威胁她服从郑鹏的要求），进行 @Check[intimidation|dc:21] 检定；或者诉诸郑鹏的社群意识（并且也许承诺自己会更积极地参与保卫柳岸镇），进行 @Check[diplomacy|dc:18] 检定。

奖励 达到6点胜利点，就足以说服该非玩家角色接受玩家角色偏好的解决方案。玩家角色因此获得20 XP，以及1点声望点：若他们支持雍武秀，则为南岸；若他们支持郑鹏，则为北岭。

收集桃木

触发 本冒险进入第二个月。

请求者 云梦昂（木雕师行会，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w25woodcarve00]{W25}）

任务 梦昂请求玩家角色收集掉落的桃木枝条，好让她制作适合绘制罕见符箓的纸张。

挑战 传统上，制作桃木纸的材料都是依赖进口，因为当地普遍相信区域内的三片树林有助于保护柳岸镇免受邪灵影响；但如今补给线已被切断，玩家角色必须前往这三片树林，为梦昂取得材料。她可以告诉玩家角色这三片本地树林的位置（在柳岸腹地地图上以“P”标示）。柳岸镇中没有人拥有正确采伐桃木所需的高级木工技艺或工具，因此梦昂请求玩家角色不要动那些树，只收集已经掉落的枝条。虽然这些落枝不具备经过妥善处理的桃木那种同样内在的超自然特性（因此价值也较低）（见《失落预兆：天夏角色指南》129页），但这些落枝仍然是梦昂制作符箓时可行且有用的材料。

为了收集材料，一名玩家角色必须在该区域尝试谋生，以确定所收集落枝的价值。玩家角色必须尝试一次 @Check[nature|dc:18|traits:downtime,skill|name:Earn Income] 或 @Check[survival|dc:18|traits:downtime,skill|name:Earn Income] 检定来谋生，且这可以视为最高4级任务 （难度等级由等级决定）。若大失败，则在明年之前都无法再尝试从这片树林中收集材料（而玩家角色此时尚不知晓，这会让这片树林在战役剩余期间都失去作用）。

奖励 只要材料尚未耗尽，玩家角色就可以继续收集落枝。第一次成功收集并上交总计价值10 gp的材料时，给予他们20 XP以及北岭1点声望点。为了感谢这份支持，云梦昂愿意教授玩家角色任意一种 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20willowshoref00]{罕见符箓} 的配方，并且还会给予每名玩家角色价值8 gp的这些符箓作为谢礼。在柳岸镇于 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog13willow]{第4幕} 开始时回归现代时代之前，任何人都无法尝试采集经过妥善处理的桃木。

茶馆主人的遗嘱

触发 玩家角色在青天茶馆的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c1publicfloo00]{C1} 区域发现“庆麦来的最后遗嘱”，或者夏季的第三个月开始。

请求者 骆熙旸（Luo & Laws，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w20luoandlaw00]{W20}）

任务 如果玩家角色自行发现了这份文件，他们一读懂其中需求后，就可以立刻开始这项挑战。否则，在夏季第三个月的第一天，这份文件落到骆熙旸手中后，她会主动来找玩家角色。她会将文件展示给玩家角色，并指出“柳岸镇最新的英雄们”应当拥有优先尝试满足文件需求、取得青天茶馆所有权的机会。

挑战 阅读文件可知，性情古怪的贵族青麦莱希望确保自己的继承人具备足够的胆识与奉献精神，能够在她去世后继续经营茶馆，因此为继承设下了一项略带危险的要求。由于如今已无后代存世，茶馆的所有权将在法律上转移给第一个满足文件需求的个人或团体：取回“我投入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.6O4UGWcYERDEugzk]{文业王}双眼中的两颗珍珠”。

一名角色若成功通过一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:14|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定，或一次 @Check[social|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定，就会知道镇北的两口小池塘在本地被称为“文业双眼”。如果没有任何玩家角色联想到这一点，熙旸（或你选择的另一名非玩家角色）可以提醒他们。为了满足遗嘱中这一奇特条款，必须从这两口池塘中取回珍珠。

为了取回一颗珍珠，一名玩家角色必须先成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:16] 检定到达池塘（详见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d9eyesoffume00]{D9}），然后花时间在水中搜索一颗珍珠。（注意：在搜索文命义右眼，即区域D9b之前，必须先处理栖息在其岸边的两只猎蛛。）每次寻找珍珠的尝试都需要4小时的搜寻、一项 @Check[athletics|dc:10|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] 检定（用于在搜索期间成功在水下游泳），以及一项 @Check[perception|dc:15] 检定（只有在游泳的运动检定至少成功时才能尝试）来发现珍珠。每重复进行一次察觉检定来发现珍珠，该检定的难度等级都会降低2。

更多信息见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d9eyesoffume00]{D9}。

奖励 每颗珍珠价值10 gp。如果玩家角色找回了两颗珍珠，他们就有资格将青天茶馆作为一项生意据为己有并经营；关于重开茶馆及其经营规则，是《肆季鬼志》第2幕中详细呈现的一项重要追求，见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00]{第2幕}。玩家角色在成功取得青天茶馆所有权后，获得40 XP。

茶园虫害

触发 玩家角色完成茶馆主人的遗嘱后一周。

请求者 山巅草（莱希沙龙，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w35theleshys00]{W35}）

任务 一旦玩家角色接管青天茶馆的消息传开，莱希沙龙的莱西制茶师山巅草就会带着一个提议来找他们。一种令人头疼的疫病正在莱希沙龙的植物间蔓延，这些莱西希望得到帮助以阻止其扩散。

挑战 识别这种疫病并治疗这种苦难，需要仔细检查、修枝、除草，以及将受污染的土壤轮换为新土。一旦玩家角色开始着手处理，他们就可以通过花费8小时，然后尝试 @Check[nature|dc:18] 检定或 @Check[farming-lore|dc:16] 检定来取得进展，并累积胜利点。

奖励 一旦玩家角色达到10点胜利点，他们便已将莱希沙龙中的疫病彻底清除。给予他们20 XP。此外，在莱希沙龙赢得的感激之情，将有助于队伍在经营青天茶馆时获得茶叶供应，具体见下一幕。

Opportunities

As the PCs become better known, they’ll be presented with many opportunities. These tasks, bounties, and requests are summarized here, presented roughly in order of availability, but you should feel free to mix and match these requests as you see fit to match your game’s progression. Opportunities not pursued in this act can always be used in upcoming acts!

Each of these opportunities is presented in abridged format. They’re meant to be resolved in exploration mode, but if some of them inspire you, feel free to expand upon them so that they can be resolved in encounter mode. Several of these opportunities use Victory Points to resolve situations—see page 184 of the Pathfinder GM Core for rules on how to accumulate Victory Points.

Missing Boats

Requester Rajul Samudra (Willowshore Dock, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w31dock0000000]{W31})

Task Rajul breathlessly approaches the PCs with a report that kappas just stole two boats from Willowshore Dock and fled downriver with them. He asks the PCs to try to catch up with them and get the boats back.

Challenge The kappas bring the boats to the southern shores of Gourd Lake (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d2gourdlake000]{D2}), so as soon as the PCs reach that area, they can confront the kappa thieves. The boats themselves float a dozen feet offshore while several kappas play on them. A kappa elder approaches the PCs to apologize for the youngsters’ pranks, and asks the party to teach the younger kappas a lesson through “trial by sumo wrestling.”

In order to teach the lesson, the PCs must win at least three out of five sumo wrestling matches. Each match is resolved by a PC attempting a @Check[athletics|dc:17] check to use brute force or a @Check[deception|dc:17] check to trick a kappa into bowing or otherwise causing it to spill the water in its head bowl. A critical failure on an Athletics check indicates that PC has strained a muscle and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 24 hours. A critical failure on a Deception check indicates that PC made a fool of themselves and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all future Deception checks they attempt in this contest.

If violence breaks out, or if the PCs fail to win at least three matches, the kappas hiss and curse and flee into the water, abandoning the boats—but they’ll likely just steal the boats again a few days later.

Some of these kappas might be those the PCs encountered in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai]{Chapter 2}. If the PCs resolved that encounter on peaceful terms, then the PCs must only win at least one of the five sumo wrestling matches to teach the above lesson.

Reward If the PCs win enough matches, the kappas learn their lesson and will no longer steal boats. Grant the PCs 40 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Northridge.

Fixing the Ranch

Requester Kum Soon-chong (Willowshore Stables, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w2willowshor00]{W2})

Task Help the proprietor repair Willowshore Stables, which was heavily damaged during the monster invasion.

Challenge Once per day, each PC can either spend 8 hours chasing down and returning livestock that fled into the nearby wilderness with @Check[survival|dc:15] checks, or helping to repair the ranch’s fencing with @Check[crafting|dc:15] checks. These checks earn Victory Points.

Reward Once the PCs gain 10 Victory Points, services at Willowshore Stables become available again; the PCs earn 10 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Southbank.

Moving Desna’s Shrine

Requester Choe Chung-hu (Milling Houses, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w8millinghou00]{W8})

Task Chung-hu asks the PCs to help him find a new home for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{Desna} shrine currently languishing in the Abandoned Estates part of town (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w23abandoned00]{W23b}).

Challenge A Shikigami Kami named @UUID[Actor.Yhph6WPW4ErtIP6s]{Kohoshi} guards this shrine. The PCs must succeed at a @Check[diplomacy|dc:19] check to convince Kohoshi to let them move the shrine. The PCs must then either attempt @Check[athletics|dc:15] checks to physically move parts of it, or @Check[religion|dc:16] checks to ensure the shrine’s components remain intact. These checks each take 4 hours and accumulate Victory Points. The PCs take a –2 circumstance penalty to these checks if they attempt to move the shrine without Kohoshi’s permission. A worshipper of Desna gains a +2 circumstance bonus to all checks they attempt during this challenge.

Reward Once the PCs gain 5 Victory Points, the shrine is relocated to the Milling Houses (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w8millinghou00]{W8}), where Chung-hu will attend to it; the PCs earn 20 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Southbank.

Investigate the Old Expansion

Requester Matsuki Shou (Matsuki Estate, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w5matsukiest00]{W5})

Task Old Matsuki has already started to worry that if the people of Willowshore are trapped by some sort of curse, they won’t have enough food to last the winter. He asks the PCs to head north to an abandoned village and determine if it can still be reached—and if so, to explore it and gather enough information so that villagers can plant emergency crops there.

Challenge The PCs travel to the old village expansion (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d8oldvillage00]{D8}), potentially facing a random encounter. The abandoned village lies just within the mindscape’s fog border. Once the PCs arrive, they can accumulate Victory Points by spending 4 hours and then attempting @Check[nature|dc:16] or @Check[farming-lore|dc:16] checks to investigate the surrounding fields and appraise their viability for use, or @Check[society|dc:18] checks to plan out the best methods for starting new crops in the ruins.

Reward Reaching 8 Victory Points is enough to secure the location as a supplemental agricultural site for Willowshore. This will have repercussions in Act 2. Grant the PCs 20 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Southbank.

Smith Troubles

Trigger The adventure has entered its second month.

Requester Yong Wu-Xiu (Eternal Blaze Ironworks, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w1eternalbla00]{W1})

Task Imperial guards allied with Northridge have begun pressuring Eternal Blaze Ironworks to set aside other work to focus on crafting weapons and armor, free of charge, to help arm guards now that it looks like Willowshore might be cut off from the rest of the world. Wu-Xiu asks the PCs to speak to Zheng Peng at Willowshore’s Guard Office (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w13w15indust00]{W15}). Alternatively, they could try to convince Wu-Xiu that supporting the town’s guards is a good idea.

Challenge Whether the PCs decide to speak to Zheng Peng or Yong Wu-Xiu, it won’t be a simple and quick discussion to sway one or the other. To convince one of the two to capitulate to the other’s needs, the PCs must accumulate Victory Points by spending several 2-hour discussions with the NPC of their choice. They can either frighten Yong Wu-Xiu with stories of the dangers facing Willowshore (or even threaten her into complying with Zheng Peng’s requests) with @Check[intimidation|dc:21] checks or appeal to Zheng Peng’s sense of community (and perhaps promise to serve a more active role in helping to defend Willowshore themselves) with @Check[diplomacy|dc:18] checks.

Reward Reaching 6 Victory Points is enough to convince the NPC to acquiesce to the solution favored by the PCs. This earns them 20 XP and 1 Reputation Point with either Southbank (if they sided with Yong Wu-Xiu) or Northridge (if they sided with Zheng Peng).

Collecting Peachwood

Trigger The adventure has entered its second month.

Requester Yun Mong-un (Woodcarver’s Guild, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w25woodcarve00]{W25})

Task Mong-un asks the PCs to gather fallen peachwood branches so she can craft paper suitable for creating rare fulus.

Challenge Traditionally, supplies for making peachwood paper are imported since there’s a strong local belief that the three regional groves help to protect Willowshore from the influence of evil spirits, but with supply lines cut off, the PCs must visit these three groves to secure supplies for Mong-un. She can indicate to the PCs where the three local groves are located (they’re indicated with a “P” on the Willowshore Hinterlands). No one in Willowshore has the advanced carpentry skill or tools required to properly harvest peachwood, so Mong-un asks the PCs to leave the trees alone and simply harvest what fallen branches they can. While these fallen branches don’t carry the same intrinsic supernatural quality (and thus, value) that properly treated peachwood does (see Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide 129), the fallen branches remain a viable and useful component to Mong-un’s fulu production.

To harvest supplies, a PC must attempt to Earn Income in the area to determine the value of fallen branches gathered. A PC must attempt a @Check[nature|dc:18|traits:downtime,skill|name:Earn Income] or @Check[survival|dc:18|traits:downtime,skill|name:Earn Income] check to Earn Income, and it can be up to a 4th-level task (with a DC set by level). On a critical failure, no further attempts to harvest supplies from this grove can be attempted until next year (which, unknown to the PCs at this time, renders this grove useless for the remainder of the campaign).

Reward The PCs can continue to harvest fallen branches as long as the supplies hold out. The first time they manage to harvest and hand over a total of 10 gp in supplies, grant them 20 XP and 1 Reputation Point with Northridge. In thanks for this support, Yun Mong-un offers to teach the PCs the formula for any of the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20willowshoref00]{Rare Fulus} and also gives each PC 8 gp worth of these fulus as thanks. Until Willowshore returns to the modern era at the start of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog13willow]{Act 4}, no attempt to harvest properly treated peachwood can be made.

The Teahouse Owner’s Will

Trigger The PCs discover “The Last Will and Testament of Qing Mai-Lai” in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog04reclai.JournalEntryPage.04c1publicfloo00]{C1} of the Cerulean Teahouse, or the third month of summer begins.

Requester Luo Xi Yang (Luo & Laws, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w20luoandlaw00]{W20})

Task If the PCs discover this document on their own, they can begin its challenge as soon as they read it and understand the requirement. Otherwise, on the first day of the third month of summer, Luo Xi Yang approaches the PCs after the document has come into her hands. She presents the document to the PCs, noting that “Willowshore’s newest heroes” should have the first chance to fulfill the document’s requirements to take ownership of the Cerulean Teahouse.

Challenge A reading of the document reveals that eccentric aristocrat Qing Mai-Lai wanted to ensure her heirs would have the gumption and devotion needed to continue running the teahouse once she passed away, and set a somewhat dangerous requirement for its inheritance. With no descendants surviving today, ownership of the teahouse will legally transfer to the first person or group that fulfills the document’s requirement: to recover the “two pearls I’ve thrown into @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.6O4UGWcYERDEugzk]{Fumeiyoshi's} eyes.”

A character who succeeds at a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:14|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check or @Check[social|dc:16|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] knows that two small ponds north of town are known locally as the “Eyes of Fumeiyoshi.” Xi Yang (or another NPC of your choice) can point this out to the PCs if none of them make the connection. In order to comply with the will’s unusual stipulation, the pearls must be retrieved from these pools.

To retrieve a pearl, a PC must succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:16] to reach the pond (as detailed in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d9eyesoffume00]{D9}) and must then spend time searching the waters for a single pearl. (Note that before a search of the Right Eye of Fumeiyoshi, area D9b, the two hunting spiders that dwell on its shores must be dealt with.) Each attempt to find a pearl takes 4 hours of Searching, a @Check[athletics|dc:10|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] check (to successfully Swim underwater during the search), and a @Check[perception|dc:15] check (which can only be attempted if the Athletics check to Swim was at least a success) to discover the pearl. The DC of the Perception check to discover the pearl decreases by 2 each time the Perception check is repeated.

See area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05d9eyesoffume00]{D9} for more information.

Reward Each of the pearls is worth 10 gp. If the PCs recover both of them, they become eligible to claim the Cerulean Teahouse as a business to run; rules for restoring the teahouse and running it are a significant pursuit presented in detail in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00]{Act 2} of Season of Ghosts. Grant the PCs 40 XP once they have successfully claimed ownership of the Cerulean Teahouse.

Tea Farm Infestation

Trigger A week has passed since the PCs completed The Teahouse Owner’s Will.

Requester Mountain Summit Grass (The Leshy’s Salon, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w35theleshys00]{W35})

Task Once word spreads that the PCs have taken ownership of the Cerulean Teahouse, the leshy tea maker Mountain Summit Grass approaches them with a proposition. A frustrating blight has been spreading through the Leshy’s Salon’s plants, and the leshies could use help in stopping its progress.

Challenge Identifying the blight and treating the affliction requires careful examination, pruning, weeding, and rotation of tainted soil for fresh soil. Once the PCs get started, they can accumulate Victory Points by spending 8 hours and then attempting @Check[nature|dc:18] checks or @Check[farming-lore|dc:16] checks to make progress.

Reward Once the PCs achieve 10 Victory Points, they’ve scoured the blight from the Leshy’s Salon. Grant them 20 XP. In addition, the gratitude earned at the Leshy’s Salon will aid the party in supplying tea when running business at the Cerulean Teahouse, as detailed in the next act.

Wall of Ghosts.name: 幽魂之墙 Wall of Ghosts
Wall of Ghosts.text:
幽魂之墙

思维空间最西北端的区域之外，是一片无法穿透的浓稠白雾地带。这片白雾横贯此地，形成了一道垂直的墙壁，看起来高耸入空中 50 尺。时不时地，雾中会泛起一些扭曲形体的涟漪，看上去像是无声尖叫着的人形幽灵，仿佛被困在雾中。能够飞行并试图从墙上方飞越的玩家角色，会发现自己确实能看见更西方的林木山地景色，但只要试图接近下方墙体所在位置 10 尺以内，前方就会有更多迷雾再度爆发。这就是幽魂之墙——一道直接源自苦迦菩提邪恶力量的防御屏障，用以保护通往其坟墓的道路。

移除幽魂之墙是第二幕的重要部分。眼下，任何试图进入幽魂之墙的玩家角色都会发现，自己不仅会被掉头送回，并从进入的位置重新现身（与他们在别处试图越过思维空间边界时的情况相同），还会暴露在一股压倒性的恐惧与骇怖感中，因为墙中的幽灵会穿流过他们的身体，以恐怖与强烈、迫近的毁灭感污染他们的心智。受影响的玩家角色必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:24] 中成功。若失败，他们会在从幽魂之墙中返回原处时陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}；若大失败，则会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并在惊惧持续期间处于逃跑状态。

关于幽魂之墙以及其后方之物的更多详情，见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08throughthewa00]{第二幕：落叶任飘零}。

Wall of Ghosts

The northwesternmost reaches of the mindscape lie beyond an impenetrable field of opaque white mist that cuts through the region, forming a vertical wall that appears to rise 50 feet into the air. Now and then, the distorted shapes of what look like silently screaming humanoid ghosts ripple through the mist, as if trapped within the fog. A PC who can fly and who attempts to soar above the wall finds that they can look further west upon the view of the forested mountains, but any attempt to approach within 10 feet of the wall’s position below causes more mist to flare up before them. This is the Wall of Ghosts—a defensive barrier that sprang directly from Kugaptee’s sinister power to protect the approach to his grave.

Removing the Wall of Ghosts is an important part of Act 2. For now, any PC who attempts to enter the Wall of Ghosts finds they are not only turned around to reemerge where they entered (in the same manner as if they press beyond the mindscape’s border elsewhere), but are also exposed to an overwhelming sense of fear and horror as the ghosts in the wall flow through them, tainting their mind with terror and feelings of overwhelming, impending doom. Affected PCs must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:24]. On a failure, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} upon emerging from the Wall of Ghosts back where they started, and on a critical failure, they’re @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and fleeing as long as they remain frightened.
