Preparing for the Feast.text:
准备宴会

信藏建议玩家角色当然要邀请大柳树和小星，同时还建议他们花上一两天，向城镇里其他神使献上供品并加以祷告，好让他们知晓即将到来的宴会；除此之外，他便将准备工作完全交给玩家角色处理。他还建议把宴会定在这周的最后一天举行，这样消息能传开，也能让玩家角色有时间筹备。他答应在宴会结束后的第二天回来，并带来一些特别的赋礼供众人使用，以提升他们的茶馆；之后（等玩家角色完成他们想处理的其他事务后），他便任由他们按计划行事，自己离开了城镇。

在接下来的一周中，每位玩家角色都可以进行三次准备宴会，但这么做会使该玩家角色没有时间执行任何休整期行动。玩家角色可以在这三次准备宴会行动中自由搭配具体采用的方法，可从装饰、食物与茶水准备，或发出邀请中选择。通过此行动获得的点数应以方便玩家追踪的方式记录下来——让他们知道，每个类别都需要达到4点，才能成功办好庆典的该性相。他们获得的点数越多，宴会的成功程度就越高。

准备宴会

  • 探索
  • 操作
  • 移动

你花时间为宴会筹备茶馆，可以用神使会欣赏的方式加以装饰，或为宴会收集并布置所需资源。或者，你也可以花时间在城镇中四处走访，向当地神使献上祷告与礼物，告知他们都已受邀参加宴会。为了增添节庆气氛，让每位玩家描述其角色是如何装饰、准备或发出邀请的——若某位玩家角色想出了特别有趣或逗乐的描述，你可以酌情给予其此次检定+1状态加值作为奖励。

若要装饰茶馆，尝试进行一次 @Check[art-lore|dc:17] 或 @Check[performance|dc:19] 检定。此次检定的结果会为队伍赢得装饰点数。

若要为茶饭本身做准备，尝试进行一次 @Check[food-lore|dc:17] 或 @Check[drink-lore|dc:17] 或 @Check[crafting|dc:19] 检定。此次检定的结果会为队伍赢得宴席点数。

若要邀请神使，尝试进行一次 @Check[religion|dc:17] 或 @Check[diplomacy|dc:19] 检定。此次检定的结果会为队伍赢得娱乐点数。

若大柳树已受邀，消息便会传开。在邀请大柳树之后，所有筹备宴会的检定都会获得+1环境加值。

大成功或大失败 玩家角色依所选技能获得1点对应点数，此外还能在三种类别中的任意一种额外获得1点。

成功 玩家角色依所选技能获得1点对应点数。

大成功或大失败 玩家角色依所选技能失去1点对应点数。

Preparing for the Feast

Shinzo suggests the PCs invite Great Willow and Kohoshi, of course, and also suggests they spend a day or two making offerings and giving prayers to the town’s other kami to let them know of the upcoming feast, but he otherwise leaves the preparation entirely in the PCs’ hands. He also suggests they hold the feast on the last day of the week, to let word spread and to give the PCs time to prepare. He promises to return the day after the feast finishes with some special gifts for the party to use to enhance their teahouse, then (once the PCs have completed any other transactions they wish) leaves them to their plans and departs from town.

During the following week, each PC can Prepare for the Feast three times, but doing so prevents that PC from having the time to perform any downtime activities. A PC can mix and match what specific method they use to prepare for their three Prepare for the Feast activities, choosing from decorating, food and tea preparation, or invitations. Points earned by this activity should be tracked in a way that allows the players to keep track of them—let them know that they need to reach 4 points in a category in order to pull off that aspect of the celebration successfully. The more points they earn, the greater the party’s success will be.

Prepare for the Feast

  • Exploration
  • Manipulate
  • Move

You spend time preparing the teahouse for the feast, either by decorating it in a way the kami will appreciate or by gathering and staging resources for the feast. Alternatively, you spend time out in town offering prayers and gifts to the local kami to let them know that they’ve all been invited to the feast. To add to the festive flair, ask each player to describe how their character decorates, prepares, or makes invitations—a PC who comes up with a particularly fun or amusing description can be rewarded with a +1 status bonus to their check at your option.

To decorate the teahouse, attempt a @Check[art-lore|dc:17] or a @Check[performance|dc:19] check. This check’s results earn the party Decoration Points.

To prepare for the banquet itself, attempt a @Check[food-lore|dc:17] or @Check[drink-lore|dc:17] or a @Check[crafting|dc:19] check. This check’s results earn the party Banquet points.

To invite the kami, attempt a @Check[religion|dc:17] or a @Check[diplomacy|dc:19] check. This check’s results earn the party Entertainment Points.

If Great Willow has been invited, word spreads. Every check to Prepare for the Feast after Great Willow is invited gains a +1 circumstance bonus.

Critical Success The PCs gain 1 point as appropriate for the skill chosen, plus an additional 1 point for any of the three categories.

Success The PCs gain 1 point as appropriate for the skill chosen.

Critical Failure The PCs lose 1 point as appropriate for the skill chosen.

Shinzo’s Suggestion.name: 信藏的建议 Shinzo’s Suggestion
Shinzo’s Suggestion.text:
信藏的建议

神秘商人信藏在这周的第一天一大早来到青天茶馆，可能会耐心地等在前门外，在那里支起他的小车，好让玩家角色早晨第一次出门时就能看到他。他热情地向玩家角色打招呼，他那只“渡鸦”翼正好奇地蹲在车顶上看着，并祝贺众人最近取得的成功。若你觉得玩家角色错过了在第6章或第7章得知某些重要信息的机会，信藏可以作为引入这些信息的途径，但他此行真正的目的，是赞赏玩家角色在准备迎冬上的进展——尤其是他们在建立希望与鼓舞士气方面所付出的努力。

说到这里，信藏提出了一个建议。他指出，根据他的经验，精神上的安康与身体上的安康同样重要——即便城镇成功为冬季完全备好了食物与居所，也不代表居民们就一定能兴旺安泰。提振镇民的精神固然有帮助，但同样重要的是，也要提振这座城镇真正的精魂们的精神！

信藏进一步解释说，他说的是这片地区存在的神使。玩家角色已经见过居住在这片区域的唯一一位木灵神使——大柳树——而且他们也可能见过式神神使小星，后者守护着镇上的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{黛丝娜}圣祠。不过信藏指出，柳岸镇各处还栖居着更多的式神神使，它们静静藏身于并保护着雕像、艺术作品、花园和路牌之中。若玩家角色能专门为镇上的神使们准备一场特别的盛宴，它们的喜悦必定会对柳岸镇的精神健康产生奇效。

Shinzo’s Suggestion

The mysterious merchant Shinzo arrives at the Cerulean Teahouse early on the first day of the week, potentially waiting patiently outside the front door where he sets up his cart for the PCs to find him when they first step outside in the morning. He greets the PCs warmly, his “raven” Yix watching curiously from the top of his cart, and congratulates the party on their recent successes. If you feel the PCs missed a chance to learn something important in Chapters 6 or 7, Shinzo can be a method to introduce that information, but his real purpose for the visit is to admire the PCs in their progress for preparing for winter—particularly their efforts to build hope and morale.

To this point, Shinzo makes a suggestion. He notes that, in his experience, spiritual well-being is just as important as physical well-being—even if the town manages to fully prepare its food and shelter for winter, that doesn’t mean that its citizens shall thrive. While lifting the townsfolk’s spirits will help, it’s just as important to lift the spirits of the town’s actual spirits as well!

Shinzo explains further that he’s speaking of the kami present in the region. The PCs have already met the only kodama kami to dwell in the area, Great Willow, and might also have met the shikigami kami, Kohoshi, who guards the town’s @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{Desna} shrine, but Shinzo notes that many more shikigami dwell throughout Willowshore, quietly hiding within and protecting statues, works of art, gardens, and road signs. If the PCs were to create a special feast specifically for the town’s kami population, their delight will surely work wonders for Willowshore’s spiritual health.

Week 10: Feast of the Kami.name: 第10周：神灵庆宴 Week 10: Feast of the Kami
Week 10: Feast of the Kami.text:
第10周：神灵庆宴

随着柳岸镇中的超自然事件不断加剧，而且玩家角色很可能已经挺过了 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{第6章} 与 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{第7章} 中出现的危险，这一事件很可能会为队伍提供一个受欢迎的机会，让他们从现实中日益阴森可怖的恐怖中放松下来并恢复状态。尽管这一天或许会是秋季最后一个“美好”的日子，在严酷的冬季开始以比喻意义上的方式叩门之前，本周第一天朝比奈信三来到城镇，应该会为整体氛围定下较为轻松的基调——至少能持续几天。请注意，此事件默认玩家角色已经重建了青天茶馆。如果他们还没有重建，那么此事件不会发生，而队伍因选择让这处备受当地人喜爱的场所继续沦为废墟，将失去2点希望点。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.iuhjjuLADK3seQ8k]{神灵庆宴}

Week 10: Feast of the Kami

With the supernatural events building in Willowshore, and with the good chance that the PCs have already endured the dangers presented in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{Chapter 6} and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{Chapter 7}, this event offers the party a likely welcome opportunity to relax and recover from the growing grim horrors of their reality. Even if it promises to be the last “good” day of fall before the harshness of winter begins to metaphorically knock at the door, Asahina Shinzo’s arrival in town on the first day of this week should set the mood for a lighter tone—at least for a few days. Note that this event assumes the PCs have rebuilt the Cerulean Teahouse. If they haven’t yet, then this event doesn’t occur, and instead the party’s choice to leave the beloved local institution in ruins causes them to lose 2 Hope Points.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.iuhjjuLADK3seQ8k]{Feast of the Kami}

Week 9: Kimchi’s Ascent.name: 第9周：泡菜爬高高 Week 9: Kimchi’s Ascent
Week 9: Kimchi’s Ascent.text:
第9周：泡菜爬高高

当玩家角色在进行休整模式活动时，他们从一位镇民那里听说，村里的一只猫泡菜把自己困在树上了。这只毛茸茸的橙白相间的猫一路追着一只松鼠，爬到了城镇外一棵树的最高枝头上，还不停大声喵喵叫，附近的村民都能听见。从地面上很容易看见这只猫，但她在30英尺高的地方，村民们要去帮她实在太危险了。

如果玩家角色决定救泡菜，那么玩家角色不太可能直接飞上去救她，所以爬树是最好的办法，这需要一次成功的@Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb]检定来攀爬。玩家角色一旦到达猫所在的位置，就必须成功通过一次@Check[athletics|dc:19]检定来擒拿这只惊惧的动物（若大失败，则表示该玩家角色会从树上摔下来！）。由于她不断扭动挣扎，还会挥舞爪子，尝试从树上攀爬下来时会承受–2环境减值，除非这只猫被装进袋子或类似的东西里固定住。拥有动物共感的角色可以用一次成功的@Check[diplomacy|dc:19]检定安抚泡菜，并引导她自己下来。其他救猫的方法也可能有效，由你酌情判定，可使用其他难度等级19的技能检定。一旦回到坚实地面上，泡菜就开心地喵喵叫了几声，然后掉头跑回城里去了。

奖励：如果玩家角色救下泡菜，队伍获得1点希望点。如果发生意外而导致泡菜死亡，队伍失去1点希望点。同样地，如果没有玩家角色尝试救援，一名本地青年会尝试这么做，然后在半路失足滑落，手里还抱着泡菜。那名青年和猫是否在坠落中幸存，由你决定，但无论如何，这也会让队伍失去1点希望点。

如果他们救下泡菜，则给予玩家角色10 XP。

Week 9: Kimchi’s Ascent

While the PCs are going about their downtime, they hear from one of the townsfolk that one of the village cats, Kimchi, has gotten herself stuck up in a tree. The fluffy orange-and-white cat chased a squirrel up to the highest branches of a tree just outside of town and has been meowing loudly enough for nearby villagers to hear. The cat is easy to spot from the ground, but she’s 30 feet up, and it’s too dangerous for the villagers to try and help her.

If the PCs decide to save Kimchi, it’s unlikely that a PC will be able to fly up to save her, so climbing the tree is the best bet, which requires a successful @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check to Climb. Once a PC reaches the cat, they must succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:19] check to grapple the frightened animal (with a critical failure indicating the PC falls out of the tree!). Due to her squirming and claws, attempts to Climb down the tree take a –2 circumstance penalty unless the cat is secured in a bag or something similar. A character with Animal Empathy can calm Kimchi and guide her down on her own with a successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:19] check. Other methods of rescuing the cat could work as well with other DC 19 skill checks, at your discretion. Once she’s back on solid ground, Kimchi meows happily and then turns tail and runs into town.

Reward: If the PCs save Kimchi, the party earns 1 Hope Point. If disaster strikes and Kimchi dies, the party loses 1 Hope Point. Likewise, if no PC attempts the rescue, a local youth makes the attempt, then slips and falls halfway down with Kimchi in their hands. Whether or not the youth and cat survive the fall is left to you to decide, but regardless, this also costs the party 1 Hope Point.

Grant the PCs 10 XP if they save Kimchi.

Week 8: Stable Fire.name: 第8周：马厩失火 Week 8: Stable Fire
Week 8: Stable Fire.text:
第8周：马厩失火

柳岸镇马厩在夏天时已经诸事不顺，而对它的主人昆舜重（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w2willowshor00]{柳岸镇马厩}）来说，不幸的是，秋天还带来了更多危险。就在本周将近结束时，一股黑烟开始从柳岸镇马厩的主谷仓中升起。玩家角色应该很快就能发现这股浓烟，至少也会被街上传来的“着火了！”喊声吸引注意。

只要玩家角色反应够快，他们就应该能及时赶到柳岸镇马厩帮忙。到了这时，火势已经吞没了谷仓，而雇员们已设法将牲畜赶进牧场，从而救下它们。然而，火焰如今威胁着要蔓延进牧场，甚至可能进一步烧进镇里。玩家角色可以通过采取“扑灭谷仓大火”行动来协助灭火。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.y3wK3OJE2af6Uijq]{谷仓火灾}

扑灭谷仓大火

  • 探索
  • 操作
  • 移动

你协助扑灭这场威胁要吞噬柳岸镇马厩的火灾；若放任不管，它还有可能蔓延到镇上的其他地方。要灭火，可尝试一次 @Check[athletics|dc:19] 检定，主动对抗烈焰，比如加入接力传水队，或开辟防火带以遏制火势；或者进行一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:21] 检定，组织镇民，让他们能更高效地运用灭火技巧。若你拥有可能有助于灭火的魔法法术，你也可以用它们来帮忙——消耗至多三个经游戏主持认可、对灭火有帮助的法术，然后进行一次奥秘、自然、神秘学或宗教检定（依你的施法根源而定）。若你使用了三个法术，此检定的难度等级为17；若使用了两个，则为19；若使用了一个，则为21。

@Check[Arcana,Nature,Occultism|dc:17|traits:exploration,manipulate,move|name:Fight Barn Fire] @Check[Arcana,Nature,Occultism|dc:19|traits:exploration,manipulate,move|name:Fight Barn Fire] @Check[Arcana,Nature,Occultism|dc:21|traits:exploration,manipulate,move|name:Fight Barn Fire]

大成功 你灭火的努力带来了极大帮助。队伍获得2胜利点。此外，你令人印象深刻的表现还为队伍赢得1希望点。

成功 你的灭火行动帮助镇民遏止了火势。队伍获得1胜利点。

失败 你已尽力帮忙，却没能作出什么特别有用的贡献。更糟的是，你在过程中被烧伤，受到 @Damage[3d6[fire]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] 反射豁免）。

大失败 灾害！你灭火的尝试反而导致火势蔓延！更糟的是，你在过程中严重烧伤，受到 @Damage[3d10[fire]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] 反射豁免）。队伍失去1胜利点。

如果玩家角色在扑灭谷仓大火时设法获得至少3胜利点，他们和镇民便能迅速控制住火势，取得一次辉煌的成功。如果玩家角色获得0、1或2胜利点，火势会蔓延到田地里并损坏围栏，之后才被扑灭，结果为一次中等成功。如果玩家角色最终得到–1或更少的胜利点，火焰还会吞没主建筑，并在镇民控制住火势、防止其继续蔓延之前，将包括田地在内的一切烧毁，结果为一次惨痛的成功，队伍因此失去2食物点数和2安全点。

火被扑灭后，玩家角色可以花1小时调查废墟，调查这座严重烧毁的谷仓。调查会发现一条诡异的证据——一具烧焦的天狗骸骨，骷髅头上刻着罪印，而其头部似乎曾被重刃从颈部斩下，尽管骷髅头和骨架表面上仍完整地躺在原处。允许玩家角色进行一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:17] 检定（或通过一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:17|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] 来打探消息）；若成功，他们会想起一名叫宁诺的纵火犯曾在柳岸镇制造过一段短暂的恐怖统治，后来她因罪行被捕并处决——她被斩首，骷髅上还刻下了罪印，以表明她将在来世遭受的惩罚，之后被埋葬在镇西北方的遗忘者之骨中的一处无名坟墓里。若玩家角色随后前往那片墓地，他们只需花10分钟调查，就能定位到一座似乎是从内部被挖开的无名坟墓——这又是一个不安灵体因现世驱邪尝试而重返人世的例子，但眼下看来，它不过是折磨柳岸镇的那道诡异诅咒的又一种“症状”。

奖励：若玩家角色在灭火时获得至少3胜利点，则给予他们80 XP；若他们发现了这场火灾背后那令人不安的谜团，再额外给予40 XP。若他们获得了3胜利点，还会从南岸获得1声望点。不过，若他们获得的胜利点少于0，则会失去南岸的1声望点。

Week 8: Stable Fire

Willowshore Stables had a rough time of things during the summer, and unfortunately for its proprietor Kum Soon-chong (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w2willowshor00]{Willowshore Stables}), fall has more peril in store. Near the end of this week, a plume of dark smoke starts to rise from the main barn of Willowshore Stables. The PCs should spot this smoke quickly or, at the very least, have their attention drawn to it by calls of “Fire!” in the streets.

As long as the PCs react quickly, they should be able to reach Willowshore Stables in time to help. By this point, the fire has engulfed the barn and the employees have managed to save the livestock by leading them into the pasture. However, the fire now threatens to spread into the pasture and potentially further into town. The PCs can assist in putting out the fire by taking the Fight Barn Fire activity.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.y3wK3OJE2af6Uijq]{Barn Fire}

Fight Barn Fire

  • Exploration
  • Manipulate
  • Move

You help fight the fire that threatens to consume Willowshore Stables and, if left untended, that can potentially spread into the rest of town. To fight the fire, attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:19] check to actively fight the flames by joining a bucket brigade or creating fire breaks to contain the fire, or a @Check[diplomacy|dc:21] check to organize townsfolk to help them be more efficient about their firefighting techniques. If you have magical spells that might help to fight the fire, you can use them to do so—expend up to three spells that the GM agrees would be helpful in fighting fires, then attempt an Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion check (as is appropriate for your spellcasting tradition). The DC of this check is 17 if you used three spells, 19 if you used two, and 21 if you used one.

@Check[Arcana,Nature,Occultism|dc:17|traits:exploration,manipulate,move|name:Fight Barn Fire] @Check[Arcana,Nature,Occultism|dc:19|traits:exploration,manipulate,move|name:Fight Barn Fire] @Check[Arcana,Nature,Occultism|dc:21|traits:exploration,manipulate,move|name:Fight Barn Fire]

Critical Success Your efforts to fight the fire are enormously helpful. The party gains 2 Victory Points. In addition, your impressive efforts earn the party 1 Hope Point.

Success Your firefighting efforts help the townsfolk stem the blaze. The party gains 1 Victory Point.

Failure You did your best to assist but weren’t able to contribute anything particularly helpful. Worse, you got burned in the process and take @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save).

Critical Failure Disaster! Your attempt to fight the fire caused the flames to spread! Worse, you got badly burned in the process and take @Damage[3d10[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save). The party loses 1 Victory Point.

If the PCs manage to achieve at least 3 Victory Points as they Fight the Barn Fire, they and the townsfolk manage to get the blaze under control quickly with a triumphant success. If the PCs achieve 0, 1, or 2 Victory Points, the fire spreads into the field and damages the fences before it’s put out, resulting in a moderate success. If the PCs end up with –1 or fewer Victory Points, the fire engulfs the main building as well and burns it all down, field included, before the townsfolk contain the fire and keep it from spreading, resulting in a tragic success that costs the party 2 Food Points and 2 Security Points.

After the fire is out, the PCs can investigate the badly burnt barn by spending an hour Investigating the ruins. The investigation turns up an eerie bit of evidence—a charred tengu skeleton with a mark of crime etched on the skull, whose head seems to have been severed at the neck by a heavy blade, even though the skull and skeleton lie in place apparently intact. Allow the PCs a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:17] (or a @Check[diplomacy|dc:17|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] to Gather Information); on a success, they recall the short-lived reign of terror an arsonist named Nin Nok went on in Willowshore before she was captured and executed for her crimes—she was beheaded, and a mark of crime was etched on her skull to indicate her punishment in the afterlife before she was buried in an unmarked grave in the Bones of the Forgotten northwest of town. If the PCs then visit that graveyard, it takes only 10 minutes of Investigating to locate an unmarked grave that appears to have been dug up from within—another example of restless spirits coming back from death as a result of exorcism attempts in the living world, but for now, it seems like simply one more “symptom” of the eerie curse afflicting Willowshore.

Reward: Grant the PCs 80 XP if they achieve at least 3 Victory Points fighting the fire and an extra 40 XP if they discover the unnerving mystery behind the fire. They also earn 1 Reputation Point with Southbank for earning 3 Victory Points. If they earned less than 0 Victory Points, though, they lose 1 Reputation Point with Southbank.

Week 7: An Icy Grasp.name: 第7周：冰冷攫握 Week 7: An Icy Grasp
Week 7: An Icy Grasp.text:
第7周：冰冷攫握 低阶4

五十年前，吴（毁灭男性渔夫3）因偷偷溜去玩耍、将自己年幼的弟弟留在无人照看的情况下，失去了自己唯一的手足；弟弟被木棉河吞没。数十年来，自己在弟弟意外溺亡中所承担的责任所带来的羞愧始终如影随形地纠缠着吴；但当现代驱魔师开始从生者世界施展魔法，对付柳岸镇的作祟时，这份羞愧显现为一种非常真实的作祟。

吴找到玩家角色时神情惊惶、满心恐惧，讲述说当天早些时候，他下水去把自己的小艇拉回岸边时，有几只手抓住了他的脚踝。他坚信，那些手属于自己弟弟的精魂；弟弟回来，是要因为他当年任由弟弟溺死而把他拖走。吴描述这场作祟，并含泪讲述自己对弟弟之死所怀有的愧疚时，让每位玩家角色进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:19|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] 检定，以意识到导致这场作祟的，或许正是吴自己的羞愧。在大成功时，某位玩家角色会推测，使用交涉来试着让吴冷静下来，并让他原谅自己，可能是结束这场作祟最简单的方法。

第7周：冰冷攫握 低阶4

@UUID[Actor.4TOkx9RSH8FmaLSl]{吴的耻辱}

作祟：吴的猜测不算完全错，但问题并不在于他弟弟的精魂——而在于吴自己的羞愧。当他带着玩家角色回到家附近河边、当年事故发生的地点时，尽管玩家角色试图调查，却没有新的作祟显现。吴松了一口气，也踏进河里，结果作祟立刻再次袭击了他。玩家角色必须迅速行动，才能救下这位年迈渔夫，使其不至于溺水身亡。

奖励：如果玩家角色解除或摧毁这场作祟，队伍获得1点希望点；除非吴死亡，此时队伍改为失去1点希望点。

Week 7: An Icy Grasp Low 4

Fifty years ago, Goh (doomed male fisher 3) lost his only sibling to the Ceiba River when he left his younger brother unsupervised while he snuck away to play. Shame for his role in his brother’s accidental drowning has haunted Goh for decades, but when the modern exorcists begin to work their magic against Willowshore’s haunts from the living world, this shame manifests as a very real haunting.

Goh approaches the PCs, shaken and scared, with a story of hands grabbing his ankles earlier in the day after he got into the water to pull his skiff ashore. He’s convinced that these hands belong to his brother’s spirit, returned to carry him away for letting his brother drown. As Goh describes the haunt and tearfully recounts the shame he feels for his role in his brother’s death, allow each PC a @Check[perception|dc:19|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] check to realize that it might be Goh’s own shame that’s causing the haunt. On a critical success, a PC theorizes that using Diplomacy to try to calm Goh down and to forgive himself could be the simplest way to end the haunt.

Week 7: An Icy Grasp Low 4

@UUID[Actor.4TOkx9RSH8FmaLSl]{Goh's Shame}

Haunting: Goh isn’t far off from the truth, but it’s not his brother’s spirit that’s the problem here—it’s Goh’s own shame. When he leads the PCs back to the spot on the river near his home where the incident occurred, no new haunting manifests despite the PCs’ attempts to investigate. Relieved, Goh steps into the river as well, only to immediately be attacked by the haunting once more. The PCs must move quickly to save the elderly fisherman from drowning.

Reward: If the PCs disable or destroy the haunt, the party earns 1 Hope Point unless Goh perishes, in which case the party instead loses 1 Hope Point.

Week 6: The Faceless Ghost.name: 第6周：无面鬼 Week 6: The Faceless Ghost
Week 6: The Faceless Ghost.text:
第6周：无面鬼 低级 4

洪正辉（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w24hojeonghu00]{洪正辉的家}）素来被认为是柳岸镇最炙手可热的单身汉之一。日落后一小时，他正在家中准备一顿迟来的晚餐，这时看见窗外有一个身影。他抓起一把剑走到屋外，准备去面对那道身影，还以为只是个鬼鬼祟祟的游荡者或恶棍。然而他看到的却都不是，而这场遭遇吓得他连忙逃跑，去向玩家角色寻求协助。

见到玩家角色后，这名仍惊魂未定的守卫描述道：他起初以为那是一件又长又黑的长袍，后来才发现那其实是一个由迷雾与烟尘构成、隐约呈人形的轮廓；而当那东西转身面对他时，它所佩戴的那张毫无五官的石质面具让他恐惧万分。他请求玩家角色前往他的住处（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w24hojeonghu00]{W24}），调查潜伏在他院子里的“无面鬼”；在玩家角色调查之前，他坚决不肯回家。

第6周：无面鬼 低级 4

@UUID[Actor.6J4FxMi8HejSvOJw]{蛋脸鬼}

生物：正辉所面对的那个身影，是又一个因现代人试图驱除柳岸镇灵异事件而被迫有所行动的躁动精魂。不过这一次，那精魂其实是个真正的亡灵生物：一只蛋脸鬼。玩家角色在听完这场骇人遭遇的经过后，若成功通过一次 @Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 回忆知识，便能认出这生物究竟是什么。

蛋脸鬼会被吸引到正辉家中，是因为他很受欢迎。它每晚都会回来，在那一带鬼鬼祟祟地徘徊，并会在每次日出时消失。如果玩家角色没能在三天内击败这个亡灵，那么它就会去寻找无论躲到哪里去的正辉；若没有玩家角色留下来保护他，那么次日人们就会发现他那张无面的尸体，之后蛋脸鬼会选定魅力调整值最高的玩家角色作为下一个受害者。

奖励：如果玩家角色击败了该生物，队伍获得1点希望点，以及北岭的1点声望点。若洪正辉先一步死亡，则队伍失去1点希望点，以及北岭的1点声望点。

Week 6: The Faceless Ghost Low 4

Ho Jeong-hui (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w24hojeonghu00]{Ho Jeong-hui’s Home}), known as one of Willowshore’s most eligible bachelors, was cooking a late dinner at home an hour after sunset when he saw a figure outside his window. He grabbed a sword and headed outside, ready to confront the figure, expecting a prowler or miscreant. What he found was neither, and his encounter sent him fleeing to ask the PCs for aid.

Upon reaching the PCs, the still-shaken guard describes what he at first took for a long, dark robe to be a vaguely humanoid shape made of mist and smoke, and when it turned to face him, the featureless stone mask it wore filled him with fright. He asks the PCs to head to his home (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w24hojeonghu00]{W24}) and investigate the “faceless ghost” that’s lurking in his yard, refusing to go back home until the PCs have investigated.

Week 6: The Faceless Ghost Low 4

@UUID[Actor.6J4FxMi8HejSvOJw]{Dalgyal Gwishin}

Creatures: The figure Jeong-hui confronted was another restless spirit driven into action by the attempts in the modern era to exorcise the hauntings in Willowshore. In this case, though, the spirit is an actual undead creature: a dalgyal gwishin. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] to Recall Knowledge after hearing the story of the frightening encounter recognizes the creature for what it is.

The dalgyal gwishin was drawn to Jeong-hui’s home as a result of his popularity. It returns to skulk about the place every night, vanishing with every sunrise. If the PCs don’t defeat the undead within three days, it seeks out Jeong-hui wherever he might have gone into hiding and, if no PC remains behind to protect him, his faceless corpse is discovered the next day, after which the dalgyal gwishin chooses the PC with the highest Charisma modifier as their next victim.

Reward: If the PCs defeat the creature, the party earns 1 Hope Point and 1 Reputation Point with Northridge. If Ho Jeong-hui dies first, the party loses 1 Hope Point and 1 Reputation Point with Northridge.

Week 5: The Missing Corpse.name: 第5周：失踪的尸体 Week 5: The Missing Corpse
Week 5: The Missing Corpse.text:
第5周：失踪的尸体

一天早晨，伊莉泽丝·坎多拉（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w9ladyofsoul00]{司魂娘娘}），魂流圣母堂的首席女祭司，私下请求玩家角色占用一点时间。前一晚，一位年迈的村民因流感去世；而就在当天夜里稍晚些时候，尸体失踪了，“就像它自己走掉了一样”。她怀疑是照看坟边居的精灵草药师尤素珍，用某种“炼金调配物”让尸体动了起来，但她并没有任何确凿证据。她希望玩家角色调查这具失踪尸体究竟发生了什么事，并提出以神殿的赠礼作为破解谜团的交换。

如果玩家角色花费10分钟在魂流圣母堂内调查，那么成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:19|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]检定的角色会发现一串似乎正向北延伸的蹒跚脚印。这些踪迹可以通过一次成功的@Check[survival|dc:20|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]检定来追踪，进而将玩家角色带到木棉河的南岸，位于晨步桥以西约200英尺处——这些踪迹似乎直接通入了河中。如果玩家角色花费10分钟调查对岸，并成功通过一次@Check[survival|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]检定，他们便能再次接上这些踪迹；那串蹒跚的脚印从河里浮现到泥地上，并朝西北方向延伸。若第三次成功通过一次@Check[survival|dc:20|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]检定，玩家角色就会一路将这些脚印追踪穿过镇子，最终来到一个万万没想到的地方：青天茶馆！

尤素珍与这桩谜案毫无关系（如果玩家角色指控她，她会变得恼火，对队伍的态度下降一个等级）。真正的犯人不是别人，正是那只在玩家角色茶馆里住下的猫又亚弥。数月以来，这只对死灵术充满好奇的猫又一直克制着自己唤起一具丧尸的冲动，但她的决心终于崩溃了。她使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{唤起死灵}，让一位老年妇人的尸体动了起来——那位老妇人生前常常会留些食物给亚弥。亚弥认为自己的行为是在报答恩情，但她也明白当地人可能不会这么看，于是她让那只蹒跚的丧尸一直藏在茶馆后方的灌木丛里。

如果玩家角色成功将丧尸追踪到他们茶馆后方的灌木丛，他们会发现它深藏在枝叶中，蹲伏着，耐心等待亚弥回来——当它被发现时，会抬头看向玩家角色，但不会移动，只有在先遭到攻击时才会反击。无论如何，只要玩家角色发现了这只丧尸，亚弥便会迅速走上前来，站到她的丧尸身边，然后决定是时候坦白自己在这场闹剧中的角色了。

如果玩家角色此前已经与亚弥交好（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00#befriend-yami]{与亚弥交好}），他们可能早就已经发现了她的秘密；但无论如何，亚弥都会请求玩家角色让她“留下”这只丧尸，并解释说它在月光下跳舞跳得很好（她甚至还会命令这只丧尸跳一段舞来做示范）。亚弥明白，如果玩家角色希望让这只丧尸重新回归死亡并把它带回教会，她也能理解；但她仍固执地希望玩家角色能让她留下它。若要说服亚弥放弃她的丧尸，玩家角色必须成功通过一次@Check[diplomacy|dc:21]或@Check[intimidation|dc:21]检定。如果玩家角色此前已经与亚弥交好，则将此次检定结果的成功等级提升一级。

如果玩家角色摧毁了这只丧尸，或违背亚弥的意愿将它带走，又或者他们是用威吓逼她同意的，那么这只猫又便会变得阴郁乖戾，并离开柳岸镇。你也可以选择让玩家角色在未来再次遇见她，并有机会弥补关系；或者让她回来折磨玩家角色，以作报复。

如果玩家角色没能成功追踪到这只丧尸，那么他们迟早会在某个深夜撞见亚弥在茶馆后方让这只丧尸跳舞；到那时，玩家角色应当能根据伊莉泽丝给他们的描述，认出这具亡灵尸体。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.RbSPe4sD93QOZEK5]{伊莉泽丝的奖赏}
如果玩家角色找到尸体并将其归还给伊莉泽丝，队伍除了事先承诺的奖励外，还会获得1点希望点——4瓶次级治疗药水和1枚活化属性符文石。伊莉泽丝也想知道是谁偷走了尸体，或是谁让尸体动了起来，但只要归还的尸体处于未被活化的状态，她就不会过多追问细节。如果玩家角色在归还失踪尸体的同时还维持了与亚弥的友谊，队伍将额外获得1点希望点。

奖励： 若玩家角色发现并带回失踪的尸体，给予他们80 XP。

Week 5: The Missing Corpse

One morning, Elizeth Candora (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w9ladyofsoul00]{Lady of Souls}), the head priestess of Her Fluvial Lady of Souls, requests a moment of the PCs’ time in private. An elderly villager died from the flu the previous night; the corpse went missing sometime later that same evening, “as if it just walked away on its own.” She suspects that You So-Jin, the elven herbalist who minds Graveside Manners, animated the body with some sort of “alchemical concoction” but doesn’t have any proof one way or the other. She wants the PCs to investigate what happened to the missing body and offers gifts from the temple in exchange for solving the mystery.

If the PCs spend 10 minutes Investigating Her Fluvial Lady of Souls, a character who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:19|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate] check spots what appears to be a set of shambling footprints leading north. The trail can be Tracked with a successful @Check[survival|dc:20|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] check, which leads the PCs to the south bank of the Ceiba River, about 200 feet west of Dawnstep Bridge—the trail seems to have led right into the river. If the PCs spend 10 minutes Investigating the opposite shore, with a successful @Check[survival|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate] check, they can pick up the trail again; the shambling prints emerge from the river into mud and head northwest. By succeeding at a third @Check[survival|dc:20|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] check, the PCs track the prints through town to, of all places, the Cerulean Teahouse!

So-Jin has nothing to do with this mystery (and if the PCs accuse her of it, she grows frustrated and her attitude toward the party shifts down one degree). The actual perpetrator is none other than Yami, the bakeneko who has taken up residence in the PCs’ teahouse. For many months, the necromantically-curious bakeneko has resisted the urge to animate a zombie, but her resolve finally broke down. She used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} to animate the corpse of an elderly woman who often left food out for Yami while she lived. Yami sees her animation as repaying a favor but understands that locals might not see it the same way, so she had the zombie shambler remain in hiding in the bushes behind the teahouse.

If the PCs successfully track the zombie to the bushes behind their teahouse, they find it deep in the shrubbery, crouched down and waiting patiently for Yami to return—it glances up at the PCs when discovered but doesn’t move, attacking only if it’s attacked first. As soon as the PCs discover the zombie, in any event, Yami quickly approaches to stand next to her zombie, then decides it’s time to confess her role in the shenanigan.

If the PCs have already befriended Yami (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00#befriend-yami]{Befriend Yami}), they might have already discovered the truth about her, but regardless, Yami asks the PCs to let her “keep” the zombie, explaining that it dances well in the moonlight (and even orders the zombie to dance as a demonstration). Yami understands if the PCs want the zombie to be returned to death and brought back to the church, but stubbornly hopes the PCs will let her keep it. To convince Yami to let her zombie go, the PCs must succeed at a @Check[diplomacy|dc:21] or @Check[intimidation|dc:21] check. If the PCs have already befriended Yami, they improve the result of this check by one degree of success.

If the PCs destroy the zombie or otherwise take her away against Yami’s wishes, or if they use Intimidation to get her to agree, the bakeneko grows surly and abandons Willowshore. At your option, the PCs might encounter her again in the future and have a chance to make amends, or she might return to torment the PCs to get revenge.

If the PCs don’t manage to track the zombie, it should just be a matter of time before they catch Yami making the zombie dance for her out behind the teahouse late one night, at which point the PCs should be able to recognize the undead corpse by the description given to them by Elizeth.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.RbSPe4sD93QOZEK5]{Elizeth's Reward}
If the PCs find and return the corpse to Elizeth, the party earns 1 Hope Point in addition to the promised rewards—four lesser healing potions and a vitalizing property runestone. Elizeth also wants to know who stole the corpse or animated it, but as long as the corpse is returned in an unanimated state, she won’t press much for details. If the PCs managed to return the missing corpse while maintaining Yami’s friendship, the party earns 1 additional Hope Point.

Reward: Grant the PCs 80 XP for discovering and returning the missing corpse.

Week 4: Haunted Hair.name: 第4周：闹鬼的头发 Week 4: Haunted Hair
Week 4: Haunted Hair.text:
第4周：闹鬼的头发 低阶 4

中村玉茗（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w21mamabaos000]{包妈妈的}）被人亲切地称作“包妈妈”，是柳岸镇镇区附近一家小包子铺的老板。随着本周开始，她发现自己店铺的天花板上垂下了一团团头发，而且无论她清理多少次，这些头发每天早晨都会再次出现。起初，她还以为罪魁祸首是某个爱恶作剧的神使，或是拿她寻开心的孩子们——至少在今天之前，她一直都是这么想的；可就在今天，她的顾客们咬开包子后，全都只能把混在馅料里的成团头发吐出来。心烦意乱的包妈妈只得关掉店铺，前去向玩家角色求助，请他们回到她的店里过夜，看看能不能抓住元凶，解开这桩诡异的谜团。

玩家角色到达包妈妈的店铺后，很快就能确认，前一晚准备好的所有包子里都被混进了头发。一次 @Check[perception|dc:14] 可以确认，这些发丝长度都差不多，而且都来自同一个头。通过一次 @Check[society|dc:17] 或 @Check[medicine|dc:17]，角色会注意到这些头发保养良好、没有受损，但似乎是从头皮连根拔起，而不是被刀刃割下。头发的源头，是一个因现代驱邪师试图净化柳岸镇而不得安息、因此受到惊扰的精魂。

作祟于包妈妈店里的幽灵，属于日出明里——这名年轻女子离开柳岸镇，想去寻找充满冒险的人生，却在启程仅仅两天后，于城外遇上了包妈妈的祖父，人生就此戛然而止。他听说司泽城里的一位人偶师会高价收购长发来制作人偶，于是便杀害了明里，将她头上的每一根头发都连根拔下，再把这些头发卖给那位人偶师，换来足够让家人熬过冬季的钱，并开了一家小包子铺。

第4周：闹鬼的头发 低阶 4

@UUID[Actor.h0Pjx3rzAZGBWMD1]{缠怨之发}

危害：明里在自己遇害之处徘徊了数十年，但当驱邪师开始对现代的柳岸镇施展魔法时，她的精魂受到了足以令其发作的惊扰，于是开始迁怒于自己凶手那毫不知情的孙女。尽管她的故事令人唏嘘，明里的萦绕之灵起初更像是一种令人不安的麻烦，而非真正的威胁，但当玩家角色在店中过夜时，情况就变了。因此，玩家角色成为店铺开始闹鬼后第一批在此过夜的人。

午夜过后一小时，一名长发年轻女子的幽灵形体会穿过其中一扇门，飘进店里，然后开始将自己的头发连根拔下。她捧起一把把头发，而那些发丝会像虫子一样在空中蠕动，钻进明天要做的包子里，并在椽梁间缠结成诡异的编织纹样。如果玩家角色不采取行动，这个作祟会在1分钟后完成它那怪诞的仪式，随后消散。见到这幅幽影后，玩家角色可以尝试一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:21] 检定（或者可以在次日尝试一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:21|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:打探消息] 检定来打探消息），以回忆起一个旧故事：曾有人在葫芦湖附近发现一名年轻女子的尸体，她头上的每一根头发都被从头皮上拔了下来。后来人们确认，这名女子是本地一位名叫日出明里的草药师。如果玩家角色把这个故事告诉包妈妈，她会脸色发白，随即在震惊中咒骂出声，因为一切线索都拼凑了起来。她会透露，在尸体被发现前几晚，她祖父突然发了一笔横财，并用那笔钱开了这家包子铺。他曾告诉她的父母，这笔钱来自把“一批旧假发卖给了司泽的一位人偶师”，但如今包妈妈回想起来，只记得祖父当时言辞闪烁，因此怀疑起那可怕的真相。

奖励：如果玩家角色击败或解除这个作祟，队伍获得1点希望点。若玩家角色发现了这个作祟背后的故事，包妈妈承诺会设法让日出明里的记忆得到纪念，以此为她祖父的残忍行径赎罪，而队伍再获得1点希望点。此外，由于帮助了镇区中的一家商店，若玩家角色击败或解除这个作祟，他们还会获得来自北岭的1点声望点。

Week 4: Haunted Hair Low 4

Nakamura Yu Ming (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w21mamabaos000]{Mama Bao’s}), known affectionately as “Mama Bao,” is the owner of a small steamed bun shop near downtown Willowshore. As this week begins, she starts finding clumps of hair dangling from the ceiling of her shop that reappear each morning no matter how often she cleans them up. At first, she assumed the culprit was a mischievous kami or children playing pranks on her—at least until today, when her customers all bit into their steamed buns only to spit out clumps of hair mixed in with the bun fillings. Distraught, Mama Bao closes her shop and seeks out the PCs for help, asking them to come back to her shop to help solve the strange mystery by spending the night and seeing if they can catch the culprit.

Upon arriving at Mama Bao’s shop, the PCs can swiftly confirm that all of the buns prepared the evening before have had hair mixed in with their fillings. A @Check[perception|dc:14] confirms that the hair strands are all around the same length and came from the same head. With a @Check[society|dc:17] or @Check[medicine|dc:17], a character notes that the hair is well-maintained and undamaged but appears to have been plucked from the scalp at the root and not cut with a blade. The source of the hair is a spirit whose rest has been agitated by exorcists in the modern world attempting to cleanse Willowshore.

The ghost haunting Mama Bao is that of Hinode Akari, a young woman who left Willowshore in search of a life of adventure, only to have her life cut short when she ran into Mama Bao’s grandfather outside of town just two days into her journey. He had heard that a doll maker in the city of Sze paid handsomely for long hair to use for his dolls, so he killed Akari, plucked each strand of hair from her head, and sold it to the doll maker for enough money to last his family through the winter and open a small steamed bun shop.

Week 4: Haunted Hair Low 4

@UUID[Actor.h0Pjx3rzAZGBWMD1]{Writhing Hair}

Hazard: Akari lingered for decades where she had been murdered, but when exorcists begin to work their magic on modern Willowshore, her spirit becomes agitated enough to lash out at her killer’s unsuspecting granddaughter. Despite her tragic story, Akari’s haunting presence is initially more of an unnerving inconvenience than an actual threat, but that changes when the PCs stay overnight in the shop. The PCs are thus the first to spend the night in the shop after it becomes haunted.

An hour after midnight, the ghostly form of a young woman with long hair drifts into the shop through one of the doors, then proceeds to pull out her hair by the roots. She holds out handfuls of hair, and they slither through the air like worms to infest tomorrow’s steamed buns and to form strange, braided patterns tangled in the rafters. If the PCs take no action, the haunt completes its uncanny rite after a minute before it fades away. After seeing the spectral image, a PC can attempt a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:21] check (or can attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:21|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] check the next day to Gather Information) to recall an old story about a young woman’s corpse that was found near Gourd Lake with every hair on her head plucked from her scalp. The woman was later identified as a local herbalist named Hinode Akari. If the PCs mention this tale to Mama Bao, she grows pale and then curses in shock as the pieces fall into place. She reveals that a few nights before the body was found, her grandfather came into a sudden windfall of money which he used to build the steamed bun shop. He told her parents that the money came from selling “an old collection of wigs to a puppet maker in Sze,” but now Mama Bao recalls how evasive her grandfather had been and suspects the awful truth.

Reward: If the PCs defeat or disable the haunt, the party earns 1 Hope Point. If the PCs discovered the haunt’s story, Mama Bao promises to see to it that Hinode Akari’s memory is honored in order to atone for her grandfather’s cruelty, and the party earns 1 additional Hope Point. In addition, for helping a downtown business, the PCs earn 1 Reputation Point with Northridge if they defeat or disable the haunt.

Shinzo’s Visit.name: 信藏的来访 Shinzo’s Visit
Shinzo’s Visit.text:
信藏的来访

神秘商人朝比奈信三会在节日期间来到镇上造访，同行的还有他那只古怪的渡鸦伙伴翼。和上一幕一样，信藏应当显得高深莫测却又友善；虽然他不会直接参与任何节日活动，但看起来确实很享受旁观镇民们的欢庆。和之前一样，他那辆载满补给的车应根据玩家角色们的兴趣来调整。你可以列出一份物品清单供玩家角色们挑选，在他的车上放置十来件等级不高于队伍等级的物品；或者你也可以允许玩家为物品“下订单”，并在信藏下次来访时购买。

不过，在第一长夜期间，信藏会真正融入节日活动，并将他的物品以九折出售（这个折扣不适用于玩家角色们预订的物品）。

玩家角色们或许会想到请信藏协助为柳岸镇运来食物补给，但面对这一请求，这位神秘商人只会带着悲伤的微笑解释说，他无力提供如此援助所需的大量资源（事实上，要向柳岸镇提供这种程度的支援，恰好稍微超出了那些限制——正是这些限制使他无法向身陷险境的凡人给予过多协助；这让他十分懊恼，却也无能为力）。

Shinzo’s Visit

The mysterious merchant Asahina Shinzo pays a visit to town during the festival along with his strange raven companion, Yix. As in the previous act, Shinzo should be enigmatic but friendly, and while he won’t directly take part in any of the festivities, he does seem to enjoy watching the townsfolk’s revels. As before, his cart of supplies should be tailored to serve the PCs’ interests. You can create a list of items for the PCs to shop through, filling his cart with a dozen items of a level no higher than the party’s level, or you can allow the players to “place orders” for items that will be available for purchase upon Shinzo’s next visit.

During First Long Night, though, Shinzo gets into the festivities and offers his items for sale at a 10% discount (this discount doesn’t apply to items the PCs place orders for).

The PCs might think to ask Shinzo for aid in bringing supplies of food for Willowshore, but to this request, the mysterious merchant only smiles sadly, explaining he doesn’t have the capacity to provide the significant amount of resources that would be required for such assistance (in fact, providing this level of support to Willowshore is just a step beyond the restrictions that bar him from giving too much aid to mortals in peril—a restriction that frustrates him but that he can do nothing about).

On the Night of the Festival.name: 庆典之夜 On the Night of the Festival
On the Night of the Festival.text:
庆典之夜

第一长夜在秋分时举行，而这一天恰好是一周的最后一天。这是让你的玩家角色与他们最喜欢的柳岸镇非玩家角色进行一些角色扮演互动的好机会。阅读@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl]{第一长夜}，以帮助向玩家角色呈现节日，也可以分别花些时间与每位玩家角色确定他们想在节日期间如何穿着打扮。

请注意，本书对第一长夜的描述默认庆祝活动发生在现代，也就是在络新妇统治一个世纪左右之后。然而，对于处于神门这一新秩序黎明时间线中的玩家角色来说，这些传统几乎没有什么变化。对柳岸镇的人民而言，其中尤其针对络新妇的担忧，应当改为对困扰城镇的诅咒的担忧，甚至可能有人希望一次成功的第一长夜能以某种方式帮助解除诅咒。

节日主要在柳岸镇镇区的镇广场举行，但整个城镇各处也会有规模较小的庆祝活动、事件与宴席。大部分庆祝活动会在晚上6点到午夜这6小时内展开。在这段时间里，每位玩家角色都可以各参加一次第一长夜期间举办的三项@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17traditionalc00]{传统比赛}。

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17admiringthem00]{咏月诗会：} @UUID[Actor.a0rifkCPNhKWyhWX]{咏月诗会奖励}
如果至少有1名玩家角色在咏月诗会比赛中获得4点胜利点，则队伍获得1点希望点。任何在咏月诗会中获得6点胜利点的玩家角色，都会因其胜利获得一瓶炼金灵药，从以下三个选项中选择其一：一瓶中等心智突变药剂、一瓶中等宁心突变药剂或一瓶中等巧舌突变药剂。

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17bundlecuttin00]{割草绳：} @UUID[Actor.AO5gV1JCW2fBDiPc]{割草绳奖励}
如果至少有1名玩家角色在割草绳比赛中获得4点胜利点，则队伍获得1点希望点。任何在割草绳中获得6点胜利点的玩家角色，都会因其压倒性胜利赢得一枚强击武器符文或幽触武器符文，可自行选择其一。

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17lanternmakin00]{制作天灯：} @UUID[Actor.yMia3XbY4pPcJoMC]{制作天灯奖励} @UUID[Actor.hkB6tLKigqZ3xLVm]{制作天灯特等奖}
如果至少有1名玩家角色在制作天灯比赛中获得4点胜利点，则队伍获得1点希望点。任何在制作天灯中获得6点胜利点的玩家角色，都会因其压倒性胜利赢得三瓶次等生命灵药。与另外两项比赛不同，制作天灯比赛是单一项目，因此只能有一位特等奖得主。如果没有玩家角色获得至少6点胜利点，则获胜者为来自@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w3gravesidem00]{墓畔礼仪}的尤素珍。如果有玩家角色获得6点或更多胜利点，则获得胜利点最多的玩家角色成为特等奖得主。若出现平局，则特等奖由双方平分。特等奖本身是一个丝绸小袋，内装数颗珍珠与宝石，总价值100 gp。

奖励：无论玩家角色赢得多少场比赛，队伍只要参与第一长夜就会获得1点希望点，以及120 XP。如果玩家角色至少赢得1项比赛，他们便获得1点可分配给自选派系的声望点。如果他们赢得全部三项比赛，则同时获得南岸和北岭各1点声望点。

On the Night of the Festival

First Long Night takes place during the fall equinox, which happens to occur on the last day of the week. This is an opportunity for your PCs to get some roleplaying time in with their favorite Willowshore NPCs. Read through @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl]{First Long Night} to help present the festival for the PCs, perhaps taking time with each PC to determine how they wish to dress for the festival.

Note that the description of First Long Night of this book assume the celebration takes place in the modern era, after a century or so of jorogumo rule. Few changes to these traditions take place for the PCs, though, who exist in a timeline at the dawn of this new order in Shenmen. For the most part, fears about jorogumo in particular for the people of Willowshore should instead be fears about the curse afflicting the town, perhaps with some even hoping that a successful First Long Night will help lift the curse in some way.

The festival primarily takes place on the town square in downtown Willowshore, but smaller celebrations and events and feasts occur throughout the town. The bulk of the celebrations play out over a 6-hour span from 6:00 p.m. to midnight. During this time, the PCs can each take part once in the three @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17traditionalc00]{Traditional Contests} held during First Long Night.

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17admiringthem00]{Admiring the Moon:} @UUID[Actor.a0rifkCPNhKWyhWX]{Admiring the Moon Reward}
If at least one PC earns 4 Victory Points in the Admiring the Moon contest, the party earns 1 Hope Point. Any PC who earns 6 Victory Points while Admiring the Moon wins an alchemical elixir for their victory, chosen from the following three options: a moderate cognitive mutagen, a moderate serene mutagen, or a moderate silvertongue mutagen.

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17bundlecuttin00]{Bundle-Cutting:} @UUID[Actor.AO5gV1JCW2fBDiPc]{Bundle-Cutting Reward}
If at least one PC earns 4 Victory Points in the Bundle-Cutting contest, the party earns 1 Hope Point. Any PC who earns 6 Victory Points while Bundle-Cutting wins their choice of a striking weapon rune or a ghost touch weapon rune for their overwhelming victory.

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog17firstl.JournalEntryPage.17lanternmakin00]{Lantern Making:} @UUID[Actor.yMia3XbY4pPcJoMC]{Lantern Making Reward} @UUID[Actor.hkB6tLKigqZ3xLVm]{Lantern Making Grand Prize}
If at least one PC earns 4 Victory Points in the Lantern Making contest, the party earns 1 Hope Point. Any PC who earns 6 Victory Points while Lantern Making wins three lesser elixirs of life for their overwhelming victory. Unlike the other two contests, the Lantern Making contest is a single event that can have only one grand prize winner. If no PC earns at least 6 Victory Points, then the winner is You So-Jin of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w3gravesidem00]{Graveside Manners}. If a PC earns 6 or more Victory points, the PC who earns the most Victory Points is the grand prize winner. In the event of a tie, the grand prize is split evenly. The grand prize itself is a silk pouch containing several pearls and gems worth a total of 100 gp.

Reward: Regardless of how many contests the PCs win, the party earns 1 Hope Point for taking part in First Long Night as well as 120 XP. If the PCs win at least 1 contest, they gain 1 Reputation Point to the faction of their choice. If they win all three contests, they gain 1 Reputation Point to both Southbank and Northridge.

Week 3: First Long Night.name: 第3周：第一长夜 Week 3: First Long Night
Week 3: First Long Night.text:
第3周：第一长夜

第一长夜是神门乡野地区最令人期待的节日之一，柳岸镇自然也不例外——尤其是在眼下，镇民们确实很需要这样一个可以庆祝并暂时从自身所处的不安局势中分心的日子。仅在本周内，每位玩家角色都可以选择进行以下休整模式行动，来帮助城镇为第一长夜做准备，并有可能获得更多希望点。

协助节庆准备

  • 休整模式
  • 操作
  • 准备

你花这一周时间帮助镇民为第一长夜做好准备，方式包括为庆典囤粮、清扫并布置市中心的镇广场以举办活动，或帮忙制作供当地居民在庆典期间穿戴的服装和其他配饰。要进行协助节庆准备，进行一次 @Check[food-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations]、@Check[games-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations]、@Check[labor-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations]、@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations]、@Check[crafting|dc:19|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations] 或 @Check[society|dc:21|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations] 检定。

大成功 你为节日所做的准备不但高效而且很有帮助，也十分令人愉快。在第一长夜期间，你在为解决自己参与的任何竞赛的效果而进行的所有技能检定中获得+1环境加值。队伍获得2点希望点。

成功 你的协助帮助柳岸镇为第一长夜做了充分准备。队伍获得1点希望点。

失败 你已尽力帮忙，但没能做出什么特别有帮助的贡献。

大失败 你试图帮忙却弄巧成拙，比起真正提供协助更像是在碍手碍脚，使镇民间弥漫着懊恼情绪。在第一长夜期间，由于你因担心再犯令人难堪的错误而紧张，你在为解决自己参与的任何竞赛的效果而进行的所有技能检定中承受–1环境减值。队伍失去1点希望点。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.0N8xNGUTThSRU1zC]{节日}

Week 3: First Long Night

First Long Night is one of the most anticipated holidays in rural Shenmen, and Willowshore is no exception—particularly now when the townsfolk could really use a day of celebration and distraction from the unsettling situation they find themselves in. During this week only, each PC has the option of taking the following downtime activity to help the town prepare for First Long Night and, potentially, earn more Hope Points.

Aid Festival Preparations

  • Downtime
  • Manipulate
  • Preparation

You spend the week helping townsfolk get ready for First Long Night, either by preparing food for the celebration, cleaning and preparing downtown’s town square to host the event, or helping to craft outfits and other accessories for locals to wear during the festivities. To Aid Festival Preparations, attempt a @Check[food-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations], @Check[games-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations], @Check[labor-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations], @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:17|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations], @Check[crafting|dc:19|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations], or @Check[society|dc:21|traits:downtime,manipulate,preparation|name:Aid Festival Preparations] check.

Critical Success Your time preparing for the festival is not only efficient and helpful, but also highly enjoyable. During First Long Night, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all skill checks to resolve the effects of any contests you take part in. The party gains 2 Hope Points.

Success Your assistance has helped Willowshore prepare well for First Long Night. The party gains 1 Hope Point.

Failure You did your best to assist but weren’t able to contribute anything particularly helpful.

Critical Failure Your attempts to help backfire, with you getting in the way more than actually providing assistance, spreading frustration through the townsfolk. During First Long Night, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to all skill checks to resolve the effects of any contests you take part in as a result of being nervous about making more embarrassing mistakes. The party loses 1 Hope Point.

Week 2: A Slithering Situation.name: 第2周：蛇患麻烦 Week 2: A Slithering Situation
Week 2: A Slithering Situation.text:
第2周：蛇患麻烦 微不足道 4

一名神色紧张的男子走近其中一位玩家角色，自我介绍说他叫松（第16页），并解释自己遇上了一个需要真正英雄才能解决的问题，但他似乎对继续说下去有些顾虑。只要玩家角色没有嘲笑他或恐吓他，他很快就会说出自己的麻烦——一窝蝰蛇在他家茅厕的粪坑里安了家，而他前不久在里面方便时差点被咬，险些遭受缓慢而痛苦的死亡。松脸红结巴地恳求玩家角色除掉蝰蛇群，并提出如果他们愿意帮忙，就支付2 gp并请他们吃一顿晚饭。松的家位于区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w12matsushom00]{W12}。

第2周：蛇患麻烦 微不足道 4

@UUID[Actor.LQyA6WEksE2szg7M]{蝰蛇群}

生物：当玩家角色来到茅厕时，松小心翼翼地打开门锁，随后立刻逃开，躲到自家窗边从安全处观察事态发展。玩家角色处理蝰蛇群时，他会时不时喊上几句“请千万小心！”以及“你们比我强多了！”之类的话。蝰蛇群已经从粪坑里爬了出来，门一打开，它们就会发动攻击。

如果你愿意，可以从一开始就用战斗来解决这个事件；不过你也可以先询问玩家角色，看看他们是否有什么狡猾的计划，能把这些蛇引出茅厕或赶出去。此处是否成功取决于一次DC 19技能检定的结果——具体使用哪项技能，应由你根据玩家角色计划的性质来决定。若是试图用诱饵把蛇引出来，可能需要自然检定；若是想用烟把它们熏出来，则可能需要求生检定。若是发明某种复杂装置把蛇舀出来，则可能需要制作检定；而拥有动物共感或能够与动物交谈能力的人，则也许可以通过交涉检定说服这些蛇离开。若失败，蝰蛇便会发动攻击，而你应以战斗来处理这场遭遇。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.BoiA91hH8G1chIPF]{马苏的赋礼}
如果玩家角色杀死蝰蛇，或在不损坏松家财物的前提下，将这些蝰蛇从松家的茅厕迁移到一个危害较小的地点，那么除了先前承诺的奖励外，他们还会获得1点希望点。松是个单身汉，而且厨艺出众，所以他承诺的那顿饭本身就应算得上一份相当可观的奖励。晚餐结束时，松会拿出一件他多年来一直上锁藏好的家人宝藏送给玩家角色——他觉得玩家角色比自己更配得上它，毕竟他连自家茅厕里的几条蛇都对付不了。他将这件宝藏，一枚幽冥符文，连同发自肺腑的感谢一并赠予玩家角色。

奖励：无论玩家角色如何处理这些蝰蛇，只要他们解决了蛇患，就给予他们80 XP。

Week 2: A Slithering Situation Trivial 4

A nervous-looking man approaches one of the PCs and introduces himself as Matsu (page 16), explaining that he has a problem that needs true heroes, but he seems wary about saying more. As long as the PC doesn’t mock or intimidate him, he reveals his problem soon enough—a nest of vipers has taken up residence in the pit of his outhouse, and he narrowly escaped a slow and painful death after he was nearly bitten while conducting his business inside. Blushing and stammering, Matsu begs the PCs to get rid of the viper swarm and offers 2 gp and an invitation to dinner if they can help. Matsu’s home is located at area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w12matsushom00]{W12}.

Week 2: A Slithering Situation Trivial 4

@UUID[Actor.LQyA6WEksE2szg7M]{Viper Swarm}

Creatures: When the PCs arrive at the outhouse, Matsu gingerly unlocks the door then flees to watch the events from the safety of his window. He occasionally shouts out things like “please be careful!” and “you’re doing better than I could!” while the PCs deal with the viper swarm. The viper swarm has made its way out of the pit, and they attack as soon as the door opens.

You can resolve this event with combat from the start if you wish, but you can also ask the PCs if they have any cunning plan for luring or chasing the snakes out of the outhouse. Success here is gauged by the result of a DC 19 skill check—the skill in question should be determined by you, depending on the nature of the PCs’ plan. An attempt to lure the snakes out using bait could require a Nature check, while an attempt to smoke them out might require a Survival check. The invention of a complex device to scoop the snakes out might need a Crafting check, and someone with Animal Empathy or the ability to speak to animals might be able to convince the snakes to leave with a Diplomacy check. On a failure, the vipers attack, and you should resolve the encounter with combat.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.BoiA91hH8G1chIPF]{Matsu's Gift}
If the PCs kill or relocate the vipers from Matsu’s outhouse to a less dangerous location without damaging his property, they earn 1 Hope Point in addition to the promised rewards. Matsu is a bachelor and an excellent cook, so his promised meal should be a significant reward all on its own. As dinner concludes, Matsu presents the PCs with a family treasure he has kept locked up and hidden for years—he figures the PCs are more deserving of it than he is since he can’t even take care of a few snakes in his outhouse. He presents the PCs with this treasure, a ghost touch rune, with a heartfelt thank-you.

Reward: Regardless of how the PCs deal with the vipers, grant them 80 XP for getting rid of the snakes.

Week 1: An Offering for Daikitsu.name: 第 1 周：向大吉津献供 Week 1: An Offering for Daikitsu
Week 1: An Offering for Daikitsu.text:
第1周：向大吉津献供

一个名叫珉焕（善良的男性人类儿童 1）的孩子一直在森林里照料一只受伤的狐狸。昨天，他去探望那只狐狸时，却沮丧地发现，狐狸已经离开了他为它搭建的临时藏身处。他失落地回到了家，而在那天夜晚，他梦见一只白狐用鼻子轻触他的头。珉焕醒来后深信，那只狐狸是女神@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.M3eb94Nd6uXti2IK]{大吉津}的使者，来告诉他，自己在保护那只受伤狐狸这件事上做得很好。

在这次事件中，珉焕会接近其中一名玩家角色，害羞地询问自己该向大吉津献上什么赋礼（他很快补充说，得是不太花钱的东西），并表示如果玩家角色帮他挑选一份合适的供品，他愿意帮玩家角色一个忙。若以一次成功的@Check[religion|dc:15|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]来回忆知识（大吉津的崇拜者将其结果的成功等级提高一级），玩家角色就会知道，把某种简单但美味的食物作为供品——尤其是稻荷寿司——留在城镇里的九耳神社，是可以被接受的。由你决定，玩家角色提出的任何其他建议（包括他们自己送给珉焕、价格更高的赋礼）也同样有效。

奖励：如果玩家角色真诚地帮助珉焕为大吉津挑选一份赋礼，他们获得1点希望点和80 XP。

Week 1: An Offering for Daikitsu

A child named Minhwan (kindly male human child 1) has been taking care of an injured fox in the forest. Yesterday, he went to visit the fox only to discover to his dismay that the fox had abandoned the makeshift shelter he had built for it. Dejected, he returned home, and that night, he dreamed of a white fox touching its nose to his head. Minhwan woke with the conviction that the fox was a messenger of the goddess @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.M3eb94Nd6uXti2IK]{Daikitsu} telling him he had done a good job protecting the injured fox.

Minhwan approaches one of the PCs during this event and shyly asks what gift he should offer to Daikitsu (something that doesn’t cost a lot of money, he’s quick to add) and offers to do the PCs a favor if they help him pick out a good offering. With a successful @Check[religion|dc:15|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to Recall Knowledge (worshippers of Daikitsu increase their result by one degree of success), a PC knows that an offering of some sort of simple but tasty food, particularly inarizushi, left at Nine Ear Shrine in town would be acceptable. At your option, any other suggestions the PCs have (including pricier gifts of their own imparted to Minhwan) work just as well.

Reward: If the PCs help Minhwan pick out a gift for Daikitsu in earnest, they earn 1 Hope Point and 80 XP.

Willowshore Events.name: 柳岸镇事件 Willowshore Events
Willowshore Events.text:
柳岸镇事件

随着日子一天天过去，秋季迅速迈向冬季，柳岸镇每周都会发生需要队伍注意的事件。这些事件在探索模式中展开，且解决所需时间不到一天。处理这些事件并不会影响队伍进行任何每周休整期行动的能力。最好先解决一周的休整期行动，再继续处理该周的事件。下方列出了这些事件发生的完整时间轴，而事件本身的细节则会在本章稍后介绍。若某事件发生时，PC正好在那一整周都不在城里，则该事件应在他们返回后的第二天发生，之后其他“积压”的事件每隔一天发生一次，直到重新赶上每周日程——唯一的例外是第一长夜，它总是在第3周发生。如果PC因为整周都不在城里而错过了这个事件，他们就会失去一个获得希望点的最佳机会。

魑魅魍魉

当PC为冬季做准备并照料茶馆时，奇怪的流言开始在村民之间流传，骇人的事件也打断了他们的日常劳作。随着周次推进，这些超自然事件会变得越来越常见，并逐渐取代那些较为寻常的每周事件。每当这些超自然事件中的一个发生时，将PC已累积的希望点减少1点，因为这些令人不安的事件会侵蚀士气，并在镇上传播恐惧。

镇上的居民将这些事件视为折磨城镇的诅咒正变得愈发强大的证据，而你不应阻止PC也这样相信。事实上，其中一些事件源于现代世界中的驱灵尝试，其主导者正是木材大亨@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21magokai0000000]{马戈凯}；他试图驱逐盘踞在现代柳岸镇的精魂。PC将在下一幕中他们将会得知所有发现这一真相，并加以反击。

Willowshore Events

As the days unfold and fall hurtles toward winter, weekly events occur in Willowshore that demand the party’s attention. These events play out in exploration mode and take less than a day to resolve. Playing out these events doesn’t impact the party’s ability to pursue any weekly downtime activities. It’s best to resolve a week’s downtime activities first before moving on to that week’s event. A timeline of when these events occur appears below, while details of the events themselves appear later in this chapter. If an event takes place during a week when the PCs are out of town, that event should occur a day after their return, with any other “backed-up” events taking place every other day until you catch back up to the weekly schedule—the one exception to this is First Long Night, which always takes place on week 3. If the PCs miss this event by being out of town that whole week, they’ll miss out on one of the best opportunities they have to earn Hope Points.
