Spirits and Hauntings

As the PCs make their preparations for winter and tend to the teahouse, strange rumors begin to spread among the villagers and frightening events interrupt their daily chores. These supernatural events grow more common as the weeks go by, replacing the more mundane weekly events. Each time one of these supernatural events occurs, reduce the number of Hope Points the PCs have accumulated by 1, as these unsettling events erode morale and spread fear through town.

The townsfolk see these events as evidence that the curse afflicting the town is growing in power, and you shouldn’t dissuade the PCs from believing the same. In fact, some of these events are the results of attempts in the modern world, led by lumber baron @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21magokai0000000]{Mago Kai}, to exorcise the spirits that linger in modern Willowshore, a truth the PCs will discover (and fight back against) in the next act.

Researching the Curse.name: 研究诅咒 Researching the Curse
Researching the Curse.text:
研究诅咒

在上一幕中，玩家角色探索了柳岸腹地，与超自然盟友建立了联系，并听到了“苦迦菩提”这个名字。他们还亲身体验了如今封锁这片地区的奇异边界，以及城镇西方那道更令人不安、若隐若现的幽魂之墙。这些发现带来的疑问远多于答案，但随着秋天开始，玩家角色已经掌握了足够的信息，可以正式开始研究困扰他们所有人的奇异诅咒本质。

为了调查诅咒并确定可以采取哪些步骤来解除它，或者至少弄清该如何解除它，玩家角色必须花费休整模式来调查这一主题，并使用详见 开拓者 GM Core 第190–191页的研究规则。通常，研究会在探索模式中进行，但面对这个更加晦涩且难以理解的主题时，玩家角色必须通过休整模式来寻求答案。尝试研究该诅咒的玩家角色需要花费一周休整时间（但由于这不具有准备特征，因此玩家角色可以在进行任何带有准备的休整模式行动时同时进行研究）。

柳岸镇有三项重要资源可供玩家角色用来研究诅咒（坟边居的尤素珍、慈母之环的伊川十兵卫，以及木灵大柳树），如果他们精通魔法知识，也可以选择单独调查。若队伍在上一幕中找回了邹斗的笔记，也可以对其进行研究。你应确保玩家知晓下文列出的所有潜在研究途径，以便他们能够选择最符合自己角色专长的求知路线。

柳岸镇的诅咒 研究 4

尤素珍 你花一周时间与尤素珍谈论柳岸镇的历史，并发现许多本地人早已遗忘之事；最大RP 2

研究检定 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[diplomacy|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

伊川十兵卫 你花一周时间在慈母之环借助伊川十兵卫的帮助调查这一主题，与她交谈，或翻阅她收藏的书籍；最大RP 2

研究检定 @Check[library-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[arcana|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

大柳树 柳岸镇北方那棵高耸柳树旁的奇异灵能守卫，曾在上一幕中帮助判断诅咒影响的范围。你花一周时间数次往返大柳树，通过请教神使来进一步了解诅咒；最大RP 2

研究检定 @Check[nature|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

单独调查 你花一周时间独自研究一般性诅咒的本质，使用自己的典籍与参考材料收藏，或镇上他人持有的图书馆；最大RP 4

研究检定 @Check[sangpotshi-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[occultism|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

研究邹斗的笔记 若你能读懂阿克罗语和冥地语，你就可以研究邹斗的笔记，了解那只无脸鬼关于幽魂之墙发现了什么；如果两个不同角色各自会说其中一种语言，他们便可以合作研究这些笔记，但他们每周合计只能进行一次检定（如果伊川十兵卫已被影响到乐于助人，她可以作为这两名角色中的一人）；最大RP 3

研究检定 @Check[academia-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[religion|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]（若两名角色合作，则这两个DC都增加2）

2 研究点 诅咒在柳岸腹地北、南、东三面的边界都很微妙，若不直接穿过，便很难与之交互；而西面的幽魂之墙则是一道可见的屏障，带有可辨识的灵性要素——因此，它很可能是更容易尝试移除的障壁。此外，丹杉寺的遗迹就位于这道墙后不远处；若这个地点仍可抵达，那么其中的学识与图书馆对于进一步了解诅咒本身将极其宝贵。丹杉寺始建于7020年，也就是柳岸镇建立的同一年，但该寺于7062年被废弃，其大量学识也就此失落或被遗忘。

4 研究点 栖居在废弃木场中的无脸鬼崇拜着某个名为“苦迦菩提”的存在。它究竟是谁还需要更多研究，但玩家角色确实得知，苦迦菩提与一种被称为宁多鲁斯的罕见怪物类别有关——这是一类因转生轮回遭受腐化而诞生的邪魔，而这不仅是无脸鬼感兴趣的话题，也曾是过去在丹杉寺礼拜的武僧们关注的内容。此时，玩家角色可以尝试回忆知识，以了解一般性的宁多鲁斯信息（关于这项追查的更多细节，见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo.JournalEntryPage.18nindorus000000]{宁多鲁斯}）。

6 研究点 苦迦菩提是一只强大的宁多鲁，数百年前曾在丹杉寺所在地被一位名叫谭隋靖的英雄击败。古老传说称，谭隋靖也在那场战斗中殒命，并转生为那棵高耸的杉树——它曾是丹杉寺的核心焦点。也许关于苦迦菩提的更多信息——包括这场诅咒是否与这只强大的宁多鲁有关——至今仍留存在那座废弃寺院的墙内？

8 研究点 在丹杉寺被废弃之前，寺中的武僧每日都会举行仪式，以确保杉树健康生长；但如今此地已沦为废墟，诅咒最可能的源头似乎就是苦迦菩提的影响正向这片地区渗出——尤其考虑到寺院本身似乎就隐藏在一层属于自己的受诅咒帷幕中。若再花一些时间继续研究，并借鉴无脸鬼在上一幕中试图利用的方法，玩家角色或许能够开发出一种专门的仪式，使他们得以穿过幽魂之墙。

10+ 研究点 玩家角色成功研究出 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{打开鬼墙} 仪式；此时，他们可以在自己方便的时候使用该仪式，尝试放倒幽魂之墙（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08throughthewa00]{穿过鬼打墙}）。他们现在也明白，自己已经学会了镇上所能获得的一切有关诅咒的知识，而更多信息无疑位于幽魂之墙另一边的丹杉寺遗迹中。因完成这项研究，给予玩家角色120 XP。

在研究中获得帮助

玩家角色在研究诅咒时，可能根本没有合适的技能或语言组合来达到10+研究点。若这一点变得明显，他们就可以转向镇上的其他专家，例如尤素珍、伊川十兵卫、大柳树，甚至是在信藏某次进镇时寻求他的帮助，最终完成他们的工作并彻底研究出该仪式。玩家角色不会因这种解决方式获得XP，而且这不应在秋季的最后一个月之前可用，这也可能使完成第二幕的时间线变得更加复杂。

Researching the Curse

In the previous act, the PCs explored Willowshore’s hinterlands, made contacts with supernatural allies, and heard the name “Kugaptee.” They also had firsthand experience with the strange boundary that now contains the region and the more disturbing Wall of Ghosts that looms to the west of town. These discoveries posed more questions than answers, but as fall begins, the PCs have enough information to begin properly researching the nature of the strange curse that afflicts them all.

To investigate the curse and determine what steps can be taken to lift it, or at least learn how to lift it, the PCs must spend downtime investigating the topic, making use of the Research rules detailed on pages 190–191 of Pathfinder GM Core. Normally, Research resolves in exploration mode, but for this more obscure and hard to understand topic, the PCs must use downtime to seek answers. A PC who attempts to Research the curse takes a week of downtime (but as it doesn’t have the preparation trait, a PC can Research simultaneously to any preparation downtime activity they attempt).

Willowshore has three important resources that the PCs can work with to research the curse (You So-Jin of Graveside Manners, Igawa Jubei of Mother’s Coil, and the kodama Great Willow), or they can go at it alone if they’re skilled in magical knowledge. Zoudou’s notes, if the party recovered them in the previous act, can also be researched. You should make sure the players are aware of all of the potential avenues of research detailed below so that they’ll be able to pick the route to knowledge that their characters are most skilled at.

The Willowshore Curse Research 4

You So-Jin You spend the week talking with You So-Jin about Willowshore’s history and discover things that many locals have forgotten; Maximum RP 2

Research Checks @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[diplomacy|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

Igawa Jubei You spend the week investigating the topic with the aid of Igawa Jubei at Mother’s Coil, speaking with her or sifting through her collection of books; Maximum RP 2

Research Checks @Check[library-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[arcana|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

Great Willow The strange spiritual guardian of the towering willow tree north of Willowshore helped to determine the extent of the curse in the previous act. You spend the week making several trips to and from Great Willow to gain further insight into the curse by consulting with the kami; Maximum RP 2

Research Checks @Check[nature|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

Solo Investigations You spend the week researching the nature of curses in general on your own, either using your own collection of tomes and reference materials or libraries held by others in town; Maximum RP 4

Research Checks @Check[sangpotshi-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[occultism|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

Studying Zoudou’s Notes If you can read Aklo and Chthonian, you can study Zoudou’s notes to learn what the noppera-bo discovered about the Wall of Ghosts; if two different characters each speak one of these languages, they can work together to study the notes, but only one check between them can be made per week (Igawa Jubei can serve as one of these two characters if she’s been made helpful); Maximum RP 3

Research Checks @Check[academia-lore|dc:17|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[religion|dc:19|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] (if two characters work together, increase both of these DCs by 2)

2 Research Points The curse borders along the Willowshore hinterlands to the north, south, and east are subtle and hard to interact with without stepping directly through them, whereas to the west, the Wall of Ghosts is a visible barrier with recognizable spiritual elements—as such, it’s likely an easier barrier to attempt to remove. Further, the ruins of the Tan Sugi monastery lie not far beyond this wall, and if this site can still be reached, the lore and libraries found within will be invaluable in learning more about the curse itself. Construction on the Tan Sugi monastery began back in 7020, the same year Willowshore was founded, but the monastery was abandoned in 7062, and much of its lore was lost or forgotten.

4 Research Points The noppera-bo who dwelt in the abandoned lumber worshipped something named “Kugaptee.” Who this was requires more research, but the PCs do learn that Kugaptee was associated with a rare category of monsters known an nindorus—fiends that rise from corruptions to the cycle of reincarnation, which was not only a topic of interest to the noppera-bo, but among the monks who once worshipped at the Tan Sugi monastery. At this point, the PCs can attempt to Recall Knowledge about nindorus in general (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo.JournalEntryPage.18nindorus000000]{Nindorus} for more details on this pursuit).

6 Research Points Kugaptee was a powerful nindoru defeated hundreds of years ago by a hero named Tan Sui-Jing at the site of the Tan Sugi monastery. The old legend says Tan Sui-Jing also perished in the battle and that she reincarnated into the towering sugi tree that served as the focal point of the Tan Sugi monastery. Perhaps more information about Kugaptee—including the possibility that the curse might be associated with the powerful nindoru—still resides within the abandoned monastery walls?

8 Research Points Before the Tan Sugi monastery was abandoned, the monks performed daily rituals to ensure the health of the sugi trees, but now that the place has fallen into ruin, the most likely source of the curse seems to be Kugaptee’s influence seeping out into the region—particularly given the fact that the monastery appears to be hidden inside a cursed shroud of its own. By spending a more time researching and drawing upon methods the noppera-bo were attempting to utilize in the previous act, the PCs could develop a specialized ritual that might allow passage through the Wall of Ghosts.

10+ Research Points The PCs successfully research the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{Open the Wall of Ghosts} ritual and, at this point, can use the ritual to attempt to bring down the Wall of Ghosts at their leisure (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08throughthewa00]{Through the Wall of Ghosts}). They also now understand that they’ve learned everything about the curse that they can in town, and that more information surely lies beyond the Wall of Ghosts at the ruins of the Tan Sugi monastery. Grant the PCs 120 XP for completing this research.

Getting help with Research

It’s possible that the PCs just won’t have the right mix of skills or languages to reach 10+ Research Points while researching the curse. If this becomes apparent, then they can turn to other experts in town, such as You So-Jin, Igawa Jubei, Great Willow, or even Shinzo on one of his trips to town to finally complete their work and fully research the ritual. The PCs earn no XP for this solution, and it shouldn’t be something that’s available until the last month of fall, potentially complicating the timeline for completing Act 2.

Increasing Security.name: 保障安全 Increasing Security
Increasing Security.text:
保障安全

为了让柳岸镇的建筑与道路为冬季做好准备，玩家角色需要累积安全点。如果玩家角色帮助胡婆婆成为柳岸镇的新领袖，那么在她的协助与影响下，玩家角色起始时拥有3点安全点；否则，他们起始时拥有0点安全点。

郑鹏是柳岸镇的城镇卫兵队长，玩家角色很可能在前一幕中把他从他自己的监狱里救了出来。那段经历持续让郑鹏保持谦逊，因此他更愿意着眼未来，而非沉湎过去。凭借他对防御措施的了解，以及他对柳岸镇民兵的影响力，镇中长者招募他来领导为这个没有增援的冬季做准备的工作，帮助城镇与镇民做好应对。他建议玩家角色，帮助冬季准备的最佳方式就是进行“协助镇民”和“加固建筑”休整期行动。

奖励：玩家角色首次获得12点安全点时，获得40 XP。

协助镇民

  • 休整模式
  • 准备

你花费一周时间帮助柳岸镇的人民为冬季做准备。这可能包括体力劳动，例如劈柴以增加城镇的木柴储备，或协助清理枯树与枝干以防止倒木事故。或者，你也可以通过提供娱乐、帮助工人们在辛苦劳作一天后放松，来维持镇上劳动者的士气。最后，你还可以运用你对柳岸镇及其历史的了解，提醒人们过去哪些做法在冬季行之有效，哪些则不然。要进行协助镇民，请尝试一次 @Check[athletics|dc:17]、@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:19] 或 @Check[performance|dc:21] 检定。

大成功 你确实大大振奋了镇上的士气，市民们发现你的帮助既实用又鼓舞人心。队伍获得2点安全点。你也可以改为获得1点安全点和1点希望点。

成功 你的协助让镇民完成了比他们独自行动时更多的工作。队伍获得1点安全点。

失败 这项工作被证明比预期更加复杂、困难且令人疲惫。队伍不获得安全点。

大失败 意料之外的挫折或毁灭性的事故抵消了大量工作成果，并且可能打击士气。队伍失去1点安全点。如果这是本周“协助镇民”第一次掷出大失败，队伍还会失去1点希望点。

加固建筑

  • 休整模式
  • 准备

你花费一周时间投入修缮并加固建筑的工作，为即将到来的冬季做准备。或者，你也可以运用你的制作技能来协助指挥这些工作，或处理精细的修理与改良。最后，你还可以运用自己的知识，提出加强城镇基础设施的方案，或建议尚未尝试过的冬季准备方法。要进行加固建筑，请尝试一次 @Check[architecture-lore|dc:17]、@Check[engineering-lore|dc:17]、@Check[crafting|dc:19] 或 @Check[athletics|dc:21] 检定。

大成功 工作进展得比你预期还要顺利！队伍获得2点安全点。

成功 工作按计划推进，没有发生任何事故或挫折。队伍获得1点安全点。

失败 虽然建筑的加固工作仍在继续，但施工过程中暴露出了潜在且意料之外的损坏，或其他未曾预见的修缮需求。队伍不获得安全点。

大失败 一场危险事故妨碍了进度，可能是屋顶坍塌、脚踝扭伤，或是使用工具时造成的痛苦失误。队伍因事故造成的损害失去1点安全点，而进行此次检定的角色现在必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 强韧豁免，以避免在1周内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}（或直到该状态被魔法治愈）；玩家角色选择其获得哪一种苦难。如果强韧豁免大失败，则该玩家角色同时获得这两种状态。

Increasing Security

To prepare Willowshore’s buildings and roads for winter, the PCs accumulate Security Points. If the PCs helped Granny Hu to become Willowshore’s new leader, her aid and influence allows the PCs to start with 3 Security Points; otherwise, they begin with 0 Security Points.

Zheng Peng is Willowshore’s captain of the town guard, a man the PCs likely rescued from his own jail in the previous act. That experience continues to be a source of humility for Zheng Peng, so he’s eager to focus on the future rather than dwell on the past. With his knowledge of defensive measures and his influence over Willowshore’s militia, the town elder has recruited him to lead the efforts at preparing the town and its people for a winter without reinforcement. He advises the PCs that the best way they can help prepare for winter is to pursue the Aid Townsfolk and Reinforce Buildings downtime activities.

Reward: The PCs earn 40 XP upon earning 12 Security Points for the first time.

Aid Townsfolk

  • Downtime
  • Preparation

You spend the week helping the people of Willowshore prepare for winter. This could entail physical labor, such as chopping wood to build up the town’s supply of firewood or helping to harvest dead trees or branches to prevent deadfalls. Alternatively, you could work to keep the town’s workers’ spirits up by providing entertainment or helping them to relax after a hard day’s work. Finally, you can draw upon your knowledge of Willowshore and its history to remind folks what has and hasn’t worked well in previous winters. To Aid Townsfolk, attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:17], @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:19], or @Check[performance|dc:21] check.

Critical Success You’ve really helped to bolster the town’s spirits, and the citizens find your aid to be as inspiring as it is helpful. The party gains 2 Security Points. You can choose instead to gain 1 Security Point and 1 Hope Point.

Success Your assistance helps the townsfolk accomplish more than they could’ve on their own. The party gains 1 Security Point.

Failure The work proves to be more complicated, difficult, and tiring than expected. The party gains no Security Points.

Critical Failure An unforeseen setback or devastating accident undoes a lot of the work, potentially damaging morale. The party loses 1 Security Point. If this is the first time a critical failure was rolled for Aid Townsfolk this week, the party also loses 1 Hope Point.

Reinforce Buildings

  • Downtime
  • Preparation

You spend the week lending your labors to the efforts to repair and reinforce buildings to prepare for the upcoming winter. Alternatively, you could lend your skill at crafting to help direct those efforts or to handle delicate repairs or improvements. Finally, you could use your knowledge to come up with solutions to bolster the town’s infrastructure or to suggest unexplored methods of winter preparation. To Reinforce Buildings, attempt a @Check[architecture-lore|dc:17], @Check[engineering-lore|dc:17], @Check[crafting|dc:19], or @Check[athletics|dc:21] check.

Critical Success The work went better than you expected! The party gains 2 Security Points.

Success Work proceeds on schedule without any accidents or setbacks. The party gains 1 Security Point.

Failure While reinforcements on the buildings continue, the work has revealed underlying and unexpected damage or other unanticipated repair needs. The party gains no Security Points.

Critical Failure A dangerous accident hinders progress, be it a collapsing roof, a twisted ankle, or a painful mistake made while using a tool. The party loses 1 Security Point from the damage caused by the accident, and the character who attempted this check must now attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] saving throw to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 week (or until the condition is healed magically); the PC chooses which affliction they gain. If the Fortitude save is a critical failure, the PC gains both conditions.

Gathering Food.name: 筹措食粮 Gathering Food
Gathering Food.text:
筹措食粮

为了在冬季来临前为柳岸镇储备食物，玩家角色需要累积食物点数。如果玩家角色曾帮助老松木成为柳岸镇的新领袖，那么在他的协助与影响下，玩家角色起始拥有 3 点食物点数；否则，他们起始拥有 0 点食物点数。

名户屋三美在柳岸镇镇区经营着树雀居，这是一家有点类似杂货铺的店，专门经营干货、腌藏食品和酒精。由于名户屋对食物保存有着广博的知识，镇上的长老招募她来协助统筹城镇的食物储存工作。她建议玩家角色，想要为冬季筹措食物，最好的办法就是进行协助收获和协助狩猎这两个休整期行动。至于这些食物最终储存在何处、由谁负责看管安全，以及冬季降临柳岸镇后如何分发给居民，这些都不是玩家角色需要操心的事。

某些超自然能力和法术的确能帮助人们果腹，但除非这些能力能够创造出可长期保存的食物，否则即使拥有这些选项的许可，对应对即将到来的冬季也帮助不大（尽管在食物短缺的紧急情况下，它们或许会派上用场——见第三幕中的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10weeklyattrit00]{此处}）。由你裁定，如果某位玩家角色拥有一种能力，能够以不只是影响自己或队伍的规模提供较长期保存的食物（例如，拥有木卫哨兵冲击许可的动能使），则他可以使用该能力来尝试进行协助收获或协助狩猎（以看起来更合适的行动为准），并以一次 @Check[nature|dc:19] 检定替代标准的 @Check[nature|dc:21] 检定选项。

奖励：玩家角色第一次获得 12 点食物点数时，获得 40 XP。

囤粮

在柳岸镇以及天夏的大部分地区，食谱并不是依靠精确单位衡量的科学，而是每个家庭和每个人都各不相同的独特根源。父母会用“一撮”“一把”以及炊具上那些含糊不清的刻线来描述菜肴的分量。因此，尽管经验丰富的村民会向年轻人提供诀窍与建议，他们仍总是被鼓励去“遵循家的味道”，凭眼力与口味来调整原料。像腌渍或保存食物这样繁重的食物准备工作，往往是一种社交活动，能让时间过得更快，也让工作显得没那么辛苦。准备好的菜肴会被装进又大又沉的陶罐里，埋入地下，直到冬季食用时再取出。泡菜、味噌、洋葱和萝卜，都是以这种方式准备的常见食物。

协助收获

  • 休整模式
  • 操作
  • 移动
  • 准备

你花费这一周协助农夫收割谷物、稻米、水果和蔬菜，方式可以是在田间劳作、提供后勤方面的专业意见，或运用你对自然世界的见解。若玩家角色在前一幕中成功确保了柳岸镇北方的老村庄扩展，作为补种晚季作物的附加地点，则所有进行协助收获的检定获得 +1 环境加值，且每周第一次进行协助收获时，其成功等级提升一级。要进行协助收获，尝试一次 @Check[farming-lore|dc:17]、@Check[athletics|dc:19] 或 @Check[nature|dc:21] 检定。

大成功本周的收成不仅极为丰盛，而且从附近荒野中额外采集到的食物也让收获更加可观。队伍获得 2 点食物点数。

成功庄稼收获顺利，并收集到了相当数量的盈余。队伍获得 1 点食物点数。

失败作物产量不算亮眼；足够短期内供人食用，但不足以额外储存起来。

大失败灾害！作物遭受虫害、长满霉菌，或干脆已经腐坏。队伍失去 1 点食物点数。

协助狩猎

  • 专注
  • 休整模式
  • 移动
  • 准备

你花费这一周协助猎人和渔夫追踪猎物、检查陷阱并捕鱼，方式可以是运用你在林地求生方面的技能、提供专业建议，或单纯贡献你对自然世界的了解。尝试一次 @Check[fishing-lore|dc:17]、@Check[hunting-lore|dc:17]、@Check[survival|dc:19] 或 @Check[nature|dc:21] 检定。

大成功你收集到了数量可观的食物，同时没有对这片区域过度狩猎。队伍获得 2 点食物点数。

成功你捕获并保存了相当数量的猎物与鱼类，但这片区域的产出也开始变得稀少；本周剩余时间内，任何人都不能进行协助狩猎。队伍获得 1 点食物点数。

失败你只找到少量动物，也只捕到几条鱼；足够补充本周食物所需，但不足以增加城镇储备。

大失败你的狩猎与捕鱼尝试以灾害告终：管理不善的狩猎和过度捕鱼让生态系统不堪重负——更糟的是，先前收集的一部分鱼和猎物被发现已经感染或腐坏，必须销毁。本周剩余时间内，任何人都不能进行协助狩猎。队伍失去 1 点食物点数。

Gathering Food

To prepare Willowshore’s food stores for winter, the PCs accumulate Food Points. If the PCs helped Old Matsuki to become Willowshore’s new leader, his aid and influence allows the PCs to start with 3 Food Points; otherwise, they begin with 0 Food Points.

Nadoya Sanmi runs Treesparrow’s Rest in downtown Willowshore, a sort of grocery store that specializes in dry goods, preserved food, and alcohol. Due to Nadoya’s extensive knowledge of food preservation, the town elder has recruited her to aid in organizing the town’s food storage efforts. She advises the PCs that the best way they can help to gather food for winter is to pursue the Aid Harvest and Aid Hunt downtime activities. Where this food ends up being stored, who’s in charge of keeping it secure, and how it gets distributed to the populace once winter comes to Willowshore aren’t things the PCs need to concern themselves with.

Certain supernatural abilities and spells can help to feed people, but unless those abilities create lasting food, access to these options doesn’t do much to help prepare for the coming winter (although they might aid in the case of a food shortage emergency—see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10weeklyattrit00]{Here} in Act 3). At your discretion, if a PC has access to an ability that could provide for longer lasting food at a scale beyond simply affecting themselves or the party (such as a kineticist with access to the timber sentinel impulse), they can use this ability to attempt to Aid Harvest or Aid Hunt (whichever activity seems most appropriate) by attempting a @Check[nature|dc:19] check instead of the standard @Check[nature|dc:21] check option.

Reward: The PCs earn 40 XP upon earning 12 Food Points for the first time.

Preparing Food

In Willowshore and much of Tian Xia, recipes aren’t an exact science with unit measurements, but rather a tradition unique to each family and individual. Parents describe measurements for their dishes in pinches, handfuls, and obscure lines on the earthenware used to cook their meals. So while experienced villagers might offer tips and advice to the younger ones, they’re always encouraged to “follow the flavor of home” and adjust ingredients by eye and taste. Intensive food preparation, like pickling or preserving food, is often a social affair that makes the time pass more quickly and the work seem less arduous. The prepared dishes are preserved in large, hefty clay pots and buried in the ground until they’re ready for consumption during the winter. Kimchi, miso, onions, and radishes are some of the more common foods prepared in this way.

Aid Harvest

  • Downtime
  • Manipulate
  • Move
  • Preparation

You spend the week helping farmers to harvest grain, rice, fruits, and vegetables, either by working in the fields, providing logistical expertise, or offering insights from your knowledge of the natural world. If the PCs successfully secured the old village expansion north of Willowshore as a supplementary site for last-minute crops in the previous act, then all checks to Aid Harvest gain a +1 circumstance bonus, and the first roll in any given week to Aid Harvest is improved by one degree of success. To Aid Harvest, attempt a @Check[farming-lore|dc:17], @Check[athletics|dc:19], or @Check[nature|dc:21] check.

Critical Success Not only is this week’s harvest wildly successful, but supplemental foraging from the nearby wilds brought in even more food. The party gains 2 Food Points.

Success The crop harvest is a success, with a fair amount of surplus gathered. The party gains 1 Food Point.

Failure The crop yield is unimpressive; it’s enough to help feed folks in the short term, but not enough to set aside anything for stores.

Critical Failure Disaster! The crop was infested with pests, riddled with fungus, or simply became spoiled. The party loses 1 Food Point.

Aid Hunt

  • Concentrate
  • Downtime
  • Move
  • Preparation

You spend the week helping hunters and fishers to stalk game, check traps, and catch fish, either by using your skill at woodland survival, providing expert advice, or simply by lending your knowledge of the natural world. Attempt a @Check[fishing-lore|dc:17], @Check[hunting-lore|dc:17], @Check[survival|dc:19], or @Check[nature|dc:21] check.

Critical Success You gather an impressive amount of food while not overhunting the area. The party gains 2 Food Points.

Success You catch and secure a fair amount of game and fish, but the area’s bounty becomes scarce; no one can Aid Hunt for the rest of the week. The party gains 1 Food Point.

Failure You find only a few animals and catch a few fish; it’s enough to supplement food for the week, but not enough to build up the town stores.

Critical Failure Your attempt to hunt and fish ends in disaster, with poorly managed hunts and overfishing overtaxing the ecosystem—and even worse, some of the fish and game previously gathered is revealed to be infected or spoiled and must be destroyed. No one can Aid Hunt for the rest of the week. The party loses 1 Food Point.

Restoring the Teahouse.name: 重开茶馆 Restoring the Teahouse
Restoring the Teahouse.text:
重开茶馆

茶具

一旦青天茶馆完成重建与修复，若玩家角色想要真正举办茶会或主持活动，就必须设法取得茶具，因为建筑里残存的器具都已毁坏。茶具可以在镇上购买，视为一套 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.y34yjumCFakrbtdw]{工匠工具包}（4 gp），或在莱希沙龙购买一套 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.0QgniSjpzksm5riV]{Sterling Artisan's Toolkit}（50 gp）。在此情况下，优质工匠工具包提供的物品加值适用于所有主持仪式和制作魔茶的检定。当然，有才能的玩家角色也可以选择自己制作茶具！

本幕默认玩家角色已经掌控了青天茶馆——如果他们还没有，不妨让镇上的长者将这处产业作为对他们在前一幕中所作所为的奖励，授予整个队伍。

青天茶馆依然屹立，但即使在夏日第一天之初沦为一头纵欲怪物的私人地盘之前，它也早已因数月无人照料而破败不堪。如今，这里需要修理、翻新与整顿，才能再次向公众开门营业。茶馆的招牌饱经风吹雨打，已经几乎不可见；下雨时，雨水会从门缝以及墙壁和屋顶的破洞中渗入；而每到傍晚，刺骨的冷风更会透进屋内。

尽管如此，这栋建筑的主体依然稳固。只要修好，这间茶馆不仅能重新成为本地深受喜爱的生意，也能作为玩家角色的一处行动据点。

亚弥

当玩家角色继承这间茶馆时，他们也一并继承了亚弥——一只灰色的野家猫。她曾与茶馆的上一任主人一同生活，但在夏天期间躲了起来。青麦莱，也就是茶馆的前任主人，有一次穿过村子时，在一堆渐冷的篝火余烬中发现了还只是幼猫的她。起初她以为这只猫是黑色的，于是给她取名“亚弥”，但等好好清洗过后，这只猫其实显露出浅灰色的毛皮，背上有一道黑色条纹，腹部的毛则更浅。尽管如此，“亚弥”这个名字还是保留了下来，而这只猫也成了麦莱最忠诚的伙伴之一，平时会从阴影中守望着茶馆，偶尔也会跳上客人的腿上取暖。在本幕中，玩家角色第一次来到此地时，其中一人应注意到亚弥已经回到了茶馆——他们可以通过一次成功的 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 回忆知识检定认出这只猫（如果没有任何玩家角色认出来，那么他们来到茶馆的第一位访客肯定会认出她）。

玩家角色和其他村民都不知道，亚弥并不像表面看起来那么简单。事实上，她是一只猫又——一种当猫活得异常长久时觉醒而成的魔法生物。在将柳岸镇拖入心景的那些事件发生之前，亚弥就已经开始向猫又转变。随着心景中的岁月不断重复，她变得越来越强大，却依旧维持着同样小巧的猫咪形态；与此同时，她对村民们的喜爱之情也依然未变，因为无论每一年的轮回如何不同，村民们始终都善待着她。和村民一样，亚弥也不记得前几次轮回中发生过什么，但她确实意识到，按自己的年龄与阅历来说，她远比应有的程度更加强大——而这种感觉也随着一年又一年过去变得愈发明显。

@UUID[Actor.lSXJXrlkiYcsYvDP]{亚弥}生物 3

  • 小型
  • 野兽

以下休整期行动可用于复原青天茶馆。

修缮重建

  • 休整模式
  • 操作
  • 准备

你花费一周时间清扫、修理并整修青天茶馆。尝试一次 @Check[crafting|dc:19]、@Check[architecture-lore|dc:21] 或 @Check[labor-lore|dc:21]，或 @Check[athletics|dc:24] 检定。若你额外花费 10 gp 购置辅助资源，则将此次检定结果的成功等级提升一级。一旦玩家角色总共获得 5 点复原点数，青天茶馆便算彻底修复完成，他们也不能再进行此行动；他们获得 80 XP 以及双方阵营各 1 点声望点。

大成功 你取得了极佳进展，玩家角色获得 2 点复原点数。

成功 你取得正常进展，玩家角色获得 1 点复原点数。

失败 你未能取得任何进展。

大失败 出现挫折！你不小心损坏了建筑，玩家角色失去 1 点复原点数。

与亚弥交好

  • 专注
  • 休整模式
  • 准备

亚弥这只“本地猫”在整个夏天都躲在荒野中，如今才回到茶馆。起初她对玩家角色十分警惕，不会让任何人靠近。玩家角色可以尝试一次 @Check[nature|dc:14] 检定来与亚弥交好。一旦某位玩家角色在与亚弥交好时取得一次大成功，便不能再尝试这项准备行动。

大成功 亚弥喜欢上了整个队伍，不过尤其偏爱掷出这次大成功的那位玩家角色。之后不能再进行与亚弥交好的掷骰。每周结束时，那位特别受亚弥喜欢的玩家角色应尝试一次 @Check[flat|dc:11]；若成功，亚弥会给该玩家角色带来一份礼物（在下方“小暗的礼物”表中掷骰）。玩家角色获得 80 XP 和 1 点希望点。

成功 亚弥对队伍产生了好感，愿意让人摸她、抱她，但依然会偶尔莫名其妙地保持距离。

失败 亚弥依旧警惕，但没有被吓跑。

大失败 亚弥发出嘶声，跑回荒野躲上好几天；在本周剩余时间以及下周，你都不能尝试与亚弥交好。

小暗的礼物

掷骰 礼物
1 一颗土豆 (@UUID[Actor.4lP5by9s4h2L0geP]{小暗的赋礼})
2 某人的贴身衣物 (@UUID[Actor.lMqn0CvzlgQKT6s4]{小暗的赋礼})
3 1 枚金币 (@UUID[Actor.gdzqXG6DidGafIMS]{小暗的赋礼})
4 一张写着关于该玩家角色俳句的羊皮纸（这首俳句每次得到此礼物时都不同，且每一首都是亚弥秘密写下的）(@UUID[Actor.2ktgLXCrx5teMUVQ]{小暗的赋礼})
5 一个翡翠猫护符*(@UUID[Actor.x7GuKRaIDbqgoktS]{小暗的赋礼})
6 一只下等军械库护腕* (@UUID[Actor.A9Jl1FRa2EWvxe4q]{小暗的赋礼})
7 镶有祖母绿的银匕首（价值 100 gp）*(@UUID[Actor.wsO97tAcBzocwe2F]{小暗的赋礼})
8 一根粉碎跃击魔杖* (@UUID[Actor.R3g8PilMWws1Jl6p]{小暗的赋礼})
此礼物只能掷出一次；之后若再次掷到此礼物，视为 1 枚白金币。

主持仪式

  • 专注
  • 休整模式
  • 操作
  • 准备

需求 青天茶馆已完全修复，而且你拥有一套可用的茶具。

你花费一周时间准备为付费顾客举办一场茶道，并在工作周的最后一天为来宾主持仪式，提供茶水、简单点心与妙趣横生的交谈。花费 10 gp 购买消耗品。若你改为花费 100 gp 购买消耗品，则将失败视为成功。尝试一次 @Check[performance|dc:19] 检定或一次 @Check[society|dc:21] 检定。

大成功 仪式取得压倒性的成功！你赚到了一些钱，获得 15 gp。队伍获得 2 点希望点。

成功 茶道举办成功！队伍获得 1 点希望点。

失败 这场茶道令人失望。若本周有其他玩家角色尝试主持仪式，那次尝试会承受 –1 环境减值。

大失败 这场仪式成了灾害。本周内无人能够再次主持仪式，而下周任何主持仪式的尝试都会在检定上承受 –1 环境减值。队伍失去 1 点希望点。

Restoring the Teahouse

Tea Ware

Once the Cerulean Teahouse is rebuilt and restored, the PCs must secure tea ware if they wish to actually perform tea parties or host events, as what supplies remain in the building are in ruins. Tea ware can be purchased in town as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.y34yjumCFakrbtdw]{Artisan's Toolkit} (4 gp) or as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.0QgniSjpzksm5riV]{Sterling Artisan's Toolkit} (50 gp) from Leshy’s Salon. The item bonus granted from a sterling artisan’s toolkit in this case applies to all checks to Host Ceremony and to Craft magic tea. Talented PCs might elect to Craft their own tea ware, of course!

This act assumes that the PCs have secured control of the Cerulean Teahouse—if they haven’t yet, consider having the town elder award the party ownership of the location as part of a reward for their actions in the previous act.

The Cerulean Teahouse still stands, but it was in rough shape after months of neglect even before it became the personal domain of a hedonistic monster during the first days of summer. Today, the place is in need of repair, refurbishing, and renewal before it can once again open its doors to the general public. The teahouse’s sign has weathered and is barely visible, water leaks in through the doors and holes in the walls and roof when it rains, and a cold draft chills the bones in the evenings.

Still, the building’s core is sound, and once repaired, the teahouse can serve well as a base of operations for the PCs in addition to bringing back a beloved local business.

Yami

When the PCs inherit the tea shop, they also inherit Yami, a gray feral house cat who lived alongside the previous owner of the tea shop but went into hiding during the summer. The teahouse’s previous owner, Qing Mai-Lai, found the cat as a kitten, curled up in the cooling embers of a campfire while she was walking through the village. Thinking the cat was black, she named it Yami, but upon giving it a proper cleaning, the cat turned out to be light gray with a black strip on her back and lighter fur on her belly. The name Yami stuck, and the cat became one of Mai-Lai’s most loyal companions, watching over the teahouse from the shadows while occasionally warming the laps of guests. Yami’s return to the teahouse should be noted by one of the PCs the first time they visit the location during this act—which they can do with a successful @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge to recognize the cat (and if no PC does so, their first visitor to the teahouse certainly will).

Unbeknownst to the PCs and the other villagers, Yami is more than she appears. In truth, she’s a bakeneko—a magical creature awakened when a cat lives an unusually long life. Before the events that thrust Willowshore into its mindscape, Yami had already started her transition into a bakeneko. With the mindscape’s repeating years, she has only grown stronger while retaining the same small cat form, yet she retains her feelings of admiration for the villagers (who have always treated her kindly no matter how differently events have played out each yearly cycle). Yami, like the villagers, doesn’t recall the events of previous cycles, but she does recognize she’s much more powerful than she should be given her age and experience—a feeling that grows stronger with each passing year.

@UUID[Actor.lSXJXrlkiYcsYvDP]{Yami}Creature 3

  • Small
  • Beast

The following downtime activities can be pursued to restore the Cerulean Teahouse.

Repair and Restore

  • Downtime
  • Manipulate
  • Preparation

You spend the week cleaning, repairing, and restoring the Cerulean Teahouse. Attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:19], @Check[architecture-lore|dc:21] or @Check[labor-lore|dc:21], or @Check[athletics|dc:24] check. If you expend 10 gp on resources to help, increase the result of your check by one degree of success. Once the PCs earn a total of 5 Restoration Points, the Cerulean Teahouse is fully restored and they can no longer pursue this activity; they earn 80 XP and 1 Reputation Point with both factions.

Critical Success You make excellent progress, and the PCs gain 2 Restoration Points.

Success You make normal progress, and the PCs gain 1 Restoration Point.

Failure You fail to make any progress.

Critical Failure Setback! You’ve accidentally damaged the building, and the PCs lose 1 Restoration Point.

Befriend Yami

  • Concentrate
  • Downtime
  • Preparation

Yami, the “local cat” who returns to the teahouse after hiding in the wild all summer, is initially wary of the PCs and doesn’t allow anyone to approach at first. A PC can attempt a @Check[nature|dc:14] check to befriend Yami. Once a PC achieves a Critical Success at Befriending Yami, this preparation activity can no longer be attempted.

Critical Success Yami takes a liking to the entire party, but particularly to the PC who rolled this critical success. No further rolls can be attempted to Befriend Yami. At the end of each week, the PC who Yami particularly likes should attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]; on a success, Yami brings that PC a gift (roll on the “Yami’s Gifts” table below). The PCs earn 80 XP and 1 Hope Point.

Success Yami takes a liking to the party and allows people to pet her and hold her, but she remains randomly standoffish.

Failure Yami remains wary but isn’t chased off.

Critical Failure Yami hisses and runs into the wild for several days; you can’t attempt to Befriend Yami for the rest of this week or the next week.

Yami's Gifts

Roll Gift
1 A potato (@UUID[Actor.4lP5by9s4h2L0geP]{Yami's Gift})
2 Someone’s undergarments (@UUID[Actor.lMqn0CvzlgQKT6s4]{Yami's Gift})
3 1 gold piece (@UUID[Actor.gdzqXG6DidGafIMS]{Yami's Gift})
4 Piece of parchment with a haiku written about the PC (this haiku changes each time this gift is given, and each is written by Yami in secret) (@UUID[Actor.2ktgLXCrx5teMUVQ]{Yami's Gift})
5 A jade cat talisman*(@UUID[Actor.x7GuKRaIDbqgoktS]{Yami's Gift})
6 A minor armory bracelet* (@UUID[Actor.A9Jl1FRa2EWvxe4q]{Yami's Gift})
7 Silver dagger with an inlaid emerald (worth 100 gp)*(@UUID[Actor.wsO97tAcBzocwe2F]{Yami's Gift})
8 A wand of crushing leaps* (@UUID[Actor.R3g8PilMWws1Jl6p]{Yami's Gift})
This gift can only be rolled once; treat further rolls of this gift as 1 platinum piece.

Host Ceremony

  • Concentrate
  • Downtime
  • Manipulate
  • Preparation

Requirements The Cerulean Teahouse is fully repaired, and you have a functional set of tea ware.

You spend the week preparing to host a tea ceremony for paying customers, then perform the ceremony for attendees on the last day of the workweek, providing them with tea, light snacks, and scintillating conversation. Spend 10 gp on supplies. If, instead, you spend 100 gp on supplies, treat a failure as a success. Attempt a @Check[performance|dc:19] check or a @Check[society|dc:21] check.

Critical Success The ceremony is an overwhelming success! You make a bit of money and earn 15 gp. The party gains 2 Hope Points.

Success The tea ceremony is a success! The party gains 1 Hope Point.

Failure The tea ceremony was disappointing. If another PC attempts to Host a Ceremony this week, that attempt suffers a –1 circumstance penalty.

Critical Failure The ceremony was a disaster. No one can Host a Ceremony again this week, and any attempt to Host a Ceremony next week suffers a –1 circumstance penalty to the check. The party loses 1 Hope Point.

Bolstering Hope.name: 振奋希望 Bolstering Hope
Bolstering Hope.text:
振奋希望

为了振奋城镇的希望，玩家角色们需要累积希望点。他们最常见的获取方式是在城镇事件期间，但也可以通过将青天茶馆恢复到可运作状态来进一步提升希望。不同于其他准备点数值，由于他们在上一幕中的行动成果，玩家角色们在本幕开始时已经累积了 3 点希望点。

奖励：玩家角色们在首次获得 12 点希望点时获得 40 XP。

Bolstering Hope

To bolster the town’s hope, the PCs accumulate Hope Points. The most common way the PCs will be able to do so is during the town events, but they can further build up hope by restoring the Cerulean Teahouse to working order. Unlike other Preparation Point values, the PCs begin this act with 3 Hope Points already accumulated as a result of their actions in the previous act.

Reward: The PCs earn 40 XP upon earning 12 Hope Points for the first time.

Preparing for Winter.name: 准备迎冬 Preparing for Winter
Preparing for Winter.text:
准备迎冬

柳岸镇声望

与柳岸镇中两个政治派系——南岸与北岭——建立声望的规则，见前一幕以及 开拓者 游戏主持核心 第200页。本幕开始时，玩家角色很可能已经至少受到柳岸镇其中一个派系的钦佩；而在本幕期间，他们还应有额外机会赚取足够的额外声望点，以便在本幕结束前成为其中一个派系所尊敬的对象。声望，以及玩家角色积累的任何准备点数，最终都将帮助决定在 肆季鬼志 第三幕中，柳岸镇的人民会有怎样的境遇。

为了准备过冬，玩家角色必须努力积累三种不同类别的胜利点（开拓者 游戏主持核心 第184页）；在本冒险中，这些胜利点被称为准备点数，并进一步细分如下：希望点代表镇民的态度与士气，食物点数记录柳岸镇储备的食粮，而安全点记录城镇在熬过冬季方面的基础设施与物资。玩家角色在本幕中于这些类别上积累的点数多少，将决定柳岸镇在下一幕即将到来的可怕事件中能坚持得如何。与此同时，玩家角色也可以在设法进一步了解他们共同身陷的处境时，研究困扰这座城镇的诅咒。

玩家角色积累这三类胜利点的所有方法，都会以带有准备特征的特殊休整期行动来进行。

本幕中的休整模式以周为单位衡量，每周最多可以有四名玩家角色各自尝试一项准备休整期行动。如果你的队伍有超过四名玩家角色，额外的玩家角色可以协助其他玩家角色的准备。若愿意，一名玩家角色每周还可以额外进行一项非准备的休整期行动，可从标准休整期行动中选择，例如制作、谋生或重训，也可以尝试研究检定来调查诅咒。

玩家角色何时能够开始 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{第6章}，取决于他们在调查诅咒时积累的研究点（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07researchingt00]{此处}）；但一旦他们决定开始第6章，那么在追求本幕第二与第三章节目标所花费的任何一周——无论是部分还是完整的一周——期间，他们都无法进行休整期行动。由于大多数队伍演完那些章节时，在探索与遭遇模式中通常只需一到两周，他们理应仍有充足时间来积累准备点数。

准备奖励

玩家角色第一次在三类准备点数中的每一类都达到12点时，队伍获得40 XP；如果三类都至少达到12点，总计可获得120 XP。此外，每当玩家角色在这三类中的任意一类达到12点时，他们便获得1点可分配给自选派系的声望点。

场景注记点数追踪效果

@UUID[Item.RLbK3MpjS4T3GIAZ]{希望点} @UUID[Item.NpYuhkiadwwrgvQd]{食物点数} @UUID[Item.7MiVl5eleJ4t54cv]{安全点}

将这些添加到 @UUID[Actor.sOoLKv6nUesBfTyK]{点数追踪}角色中，以记录准备点数。

当玩家角色准备迎冬时，他们每周还会遭遇需要参与处理的事件——详见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07willowshoree00]{柳岸镇事件}。尤其要让玩家知道，第一长夜将在第三周结束时举行。关于这一节日的完整细节见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07week3firstlo00]{第一长夜}。在本幕第三周，第一长夜的筹备会为玩家角色提供一种额外获取希望点的方式。

记录准备点

以可视化的方式记录玩家角色在本章中积累的点数，让玩家能够持续直观看到他们的进展。一旦你开始 肆季鬼志 第三幕，随着冬季一周周推进，这三类点数都会被“花费”掉。

希望点：队伍在本幕开始时拥有3点希望点。在三类准备点数中，希望点是在游戏过程中最有可能被周期性减少的数值。告诉玩家，只要他们的希望点为正值，镇民就会保持生产力，且士气高昂。这个数值越高越好，但没有一个玩家角色应当明确知晓并以之为目标的特定数字。如果某周开始时希望点为负值，则所有为了获取准备点数而进行的技能检定都会承受–1环境减值，因为来自镇民的协助与合作会减少。玩家角色可以通过完成每周城镇事件、经营并扩建他们的茶馆（见本页 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00]{重开茶馆}），或者参与任何第一长夜的庆典与活动（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07week3firstlo00]{第3周—第一长夜}）来获取希望点。

食物点数：如果松木老人担任柳岸镇镇长，他的远见会让城镇在这方面先占优势，队伍起始时拥有3点食物点数；否则，队伍起始时拥有0点食物点数。收获季此刻才刚开始，而柳岸镇的大多数居民还没有开始储存食物。让玩家知道，如果玩家角色能在秋末前确保至少12点食物点数，柳岸镇就能达到熬过冬季所需的最低食物储备量——但获得超过12点的储备，显然将有助于应对意外事件，并为城镇提供一层宝贵的、抵御潜在饥荒的缓冲。玩家角色可以通过进行每周休整期行动来提升食物点数（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07gatheringfoo00]{筹措食粮}）。

安全点：如果胡婆婆担任柳岸镇领袖，她早已让自己的手下着手巩固城镇防御，队伍起始时拥有3点安全点；否则，队伍起始时拥有0点安全点。在柳岸镇准备过冬，包括修补屋顶、为墙体与建筑做好防寒防风处理、训练人们如何应对火灾与水患演练等紧急情况，以及其他市政层面的准备。让玩家知道，如果玩家角色能在秋末前赚取至少12点安全点，柳岸镇便能应对一个普通冬季——但额外的点数在处理突发紧急状况时也会很有用。玩家角色可以通过进行每周休整期行动来提升安全点（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07increasingse00]{保障安全}）。

Preparing for Winter

Willowshore Reputation

Rules for building up reputation with the two political factions in Willowshore known as Southbank and Northridge appear in the previous act as well as on page 200 of Pathfinder GM Core. It’s likely that the PCs are at least admired by one of Willowshore’s factions when this act begins, and they should have additional opportunities during this act to earn enough additional Reputation Points to become revered by one of the factions by this act’s conclusion. Reputation, along with any Preparation Points the PCs accumulate will ultimately help determine how the people of Willowshore fare in the third act of Season of Ghosts.

In order to prepare for winter, the PCs must work to accumulate three different categories of Victory Points (Pathfinder GM Core 184), referred to in this adventure as Preparation Points that are further subcategorized: Hope Points represent the townsfolk’s attitude and morale, Food Points track Willowshore’s food stores, and Security Points track the town’s infrastructure and supplies for enduring the winter. The amount of points the PCs accumulate during this act for these categories will determine how Willowshore endures the dreadful events to come in the next act. At the same time, the PCs can research the curse afflicting the town as they work to learn more about the situation they all find themselves in.

All of the methods by which the PCs can accumulate these three kinds of Victory Points play out as special downtime activities that have the preparation trait.

Downtime in this act is measured in weeks, with up to four individual PCs being able to attempt one preparation downtime activity each week. If your group has more than four PCs, the additional PCs can Aid other PCs’ preparations. A PC can also pursue one additional non-preparation downtime activity each week if they wish, choosing from standard downtime activities like Craft, Earn Income, or Retraining as well as attempting Research checks to research the curse.

The point at which the PCs can begin @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{Chapter 6} is determined by their accumulation of Research Points while investigating the curse (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07researchingt00]{Here}), but once they decide to begin Chapter 6, they won’t be able to pursue downtime activities during any week—partial or full—they spend in pursuit of this act’s second and third chapter goals. Since most parties shouldn’t need more than one or two weeks to play out those chapters in exploration and encounter mode, they should have plenty of time to build up Preparation Points.

Preparation Awards

The first time the PCs reach 12 points in each of the three categories of Preparation Points, the party earns 40 XP, for a total of 120 XP if they earn at least 12 points in all three categories. In addition, each time the PCs reach 12 points in one of these three categories, they gain 1 Reputation Point to the faction of their choice.

Scene NotesPoint Tracking Effects

@UUID[Item.RLbK3MpjS4T3GIAZ]{Hope Points} @UUID[Item.NpYuhkiadwwrgvQd]{Food Points} @UUID[Item.7MiVl5eleJ4t54cv]{Security Points}

Add these to the @UUID[Actor.sOoLKv6nUesBfTyK]{Point Tracking} actor to keep track of Preparation Points.

As the PCs prepare for winter, they’ll also face weekly events that they’ll need to take part in—see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07willowshoree00]{Willowshore Events} for more details. In particular, let the players know that First Long Night will take place at the end of week three. Full details on this festival are covered in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07week3firstlo00]{First Long Night}. During week three of this act, preparations for First Long Night give the PCs an additional way to earn Hope Points.

Tracking Preparation Points

Keep track of the points the PCs accumulate during this chapter in a visual way so that the players have a constant visual reminder of their progress. Once you begin the third act of Season of Ghosts, all three of these categories of points are “spent” as winter’s weeks proceed.

Hope Points: The party starts this act with 3 Hope Points. Of the three categories of Preparation Points, Hope Points are the most likely value to be periodically reduced during play. Inform the players that as long as they have a positive value for Hope Points, the townsfolk are productive and morale is high. The higher the value they can build, the better, but there isn’t a specific number the PCs should know to aim for. If a week begins with negative Hope Points, all skill checks to earn Preparation Points take a –1 circumstance penalty as aid and cooperation from townsfolk diminishes. The PCs can earn Hope Points by completing weekly town events, by building up their teahouse (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00]{Restoring the Teahouse} on this page), or by taking part in any of the First Long Night festivities and events (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07week3firstlo00]{Week 3 - First Long Night}).

Food Points: If Old Matsuki serves as mayor of Willowshore, his foresight gives the town a leg up here, and the party starts with 3 Food Points—otherwise, the party starts with 0 Food Points. The harvest season is only now beginning, and most of Willowshore’s citizens haven’t yet started to store food. Let the players know that if the PCs can secure at least 12 Food Points by the end of fall, Willowshore will reach the minimum amount of food stores needed to endure the winter—but earning more than 12 points will certainly help against unforeseen events and give the town a valuable cushion against potential starvation. The PCs can build up Food Points by pursuing weekly downtime activities (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07gatheringfoo00]{Gathering Food}).

Security Points: If Granny Hu serves as Willowshore’s leader, she already has her agents working at shoring up the town’s defenses, and the party starts with 3 Security Points—otherwise, the party starts with 0 Security Points. Preparing for winter in Willowshore involves repair work to roofs, weatherproofing walls and buildings, training in how to respond to emergencies with things like fire and flood drills, and other civic preparations. Let the players know that if the PCs can earn at least 12 Security Points by the end of fall, Willowshore will be prepared for an average winter—but that additional points will be useful in dealing with unexpected emergencies. The PCs can build up Security Points by pursuing weekly downtime activities (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07increasingse00]{Increasing Security}).

Willowshore in the Fall.name: 柳岸镇的秋日 Willowshore in the Fall
Willowshore in the Fall.text:
柳岸镇的秋日

困扰了夏季数月的反常频繁暴雨，终于在秋季有所缓和，取而代之的是清爽的秋日气候——至少在第一个月里，还能享受到几天真正晴朗的日子。随着时光推移，白昼逐渐变短，天空也愈发阴沉。每周大约会有两次、每次持续数小时的小雨；随着树叶开始变色，呼啸的风也越来越常见，不过总体来说，这一幕中的天气应当还算可以忍受，甚至称得上宜人。在最后几周里，白天依旧阴天沉沉，而随着冬季临近，晨露也被一层薄薄的霜冻所取代。

场景笔记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.kjCdhgE9DC3lLJaG]{柳岸镇} @UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.ZURyPThe4OMZxZJd]{室内}

Willowshore in the Fall

The unseasonably frequent rainstorms that plagued the summer months finally eases up during fall, giving way to a crisp autumn that, at least for the first month, offers some actually sunny days to enjoy. As time marches on, the days grow shorter and more overcast. Light rain might fall for a few hours twice a week or so, and blustery breezes grow more common as the leaves begin to turn, but overall, the weather during this act should certainly be bearable, if not actually pleasant. In the final few weeks, days remain overcast and a thin layer of frost replaces the morning dew as winter looms.

Getting Started.name: 冒险开始 Getting Started
Getting Started.text:
冒险开始

柳岸镇已入秋。树叶渐染，夏日的连绵雨水被清爽的秋风取代；然而，尽管这个异常多雨的夏天终于结束，威胁此地的怪物也已被击败，镇民们却并未因此感到多少宽慰。新的领导已经就位，但自夏日第一天起便失踪的赫山宝总督——以及他的宅邸——究竟遭遇了什么，仍令人困惑不解。然而，更令人忧心的是笼罩这片地区的奇异诅咒：它阻止任何人离开柳岸镇太远，也似乎让邻近聚居地的人无法前来探访。只有一位神秘的商人，一个名叫信藏的古怪男子，似乎能够自由来往于柳岸镇；可就连他自己也不知道原因，对这道诅咒的本质也一无所知。随着时日步入秋季，有一件事已变得再清楚不过：若柳岸镇的人民想熬过即将到来的冬季，就必须储存食物、做好防备，好让镇民能够撑过接下来季节性的风暴。

谁来领导柳岸镇？

在上一幕接近尾声时，谁该接替柳岸镇失踪总督的问题已经有了答案。虽然柳岸镇的人民都认为这项任命只是暂时的，并希望失踪的赫山宝总督很快归来，但这件事并不会发生——至少不会以当地人所期望的方式发生。本战役其余部分默认玩家角色支持的是松木老人或胡婆婆之一来担任这个职位，但在你的游戏中，也可能是另一位非玩家角色（甚至玩家角色之一）承担了这一职责。不过，究竟是谁在管理柳岸镇，其实并不重要；因此在本冒险中，这名角色都会被称作“镇上长老”或“总督”。如果在你的游戏中是某位玩家角色领导柳岸镇，那就从镇上与队伍结盟的重要非玩家角色中选一位，在本冒险中改由其担任顾问与任务发布者的角色。

当地人虽然可以继续囤积柴火、腌制和发酵食物以便长期储存、加固建筑抵御严寒，并把谷物妥善收存起来，但若没有援助，也没有鼓舞，他们靠自己终究能做的有限。所幸对柳岸镇而言，面对这场困境的并不只有镇民——他们身边还有一群英雄，能帮助他们为最坏的情况做好准备！

这一幕从秋季的第一天开始。给队伍一些时间，从上一幕的事件中休息并恢复；但当你准备开始这一幕时（最好是在秋季第一天后的几天内），镇上长老会联系队伍，邀请他们前往柳岸镇贸易栈会面，商讨小镇眼下的未来。

当玩家角色抵达时，迎接他们的是如今担任柳岸镇总督的镇上长老，以及那位在领导权竞逐中落败的长老、郑鹏（代表城镇卫兵，以及柳岸镇在实际上为冬季做好准备的需要），还有名户屋三美（代表柳岸镇的农夫，以及囤积食物和补给的需要）。

如果你愿意，可以把这场会议完整地角色扮演出来；但若想更快开始冒险，概述下列要点也很有帮助。会议开始时，总督先感谢玩家角色至今为帮助柳岸镇所做的一切，随后指出，眼下的工作其实才刚刚开始。长老请玩家角色继续研究困扰小镇的诅咒本质，但也补充说，目前更重要的是确保柳岸镇已为冬季做好准备；距离食物和住所成为最关键资源，只剩下三个月时间。鉴于这一需要，镇上长老请求玩家角色从以下三个方面提供协助。

  • 镇民士气：镇上长老指出，镇民们对未来愈发担忧与恐惧，因此，凡是玩家角色能做来鼓舞人心、传播希望的事，都会受到感激。一个极好的办法是重建并向公众重新开放青天茶馆，让它恢复为人们传统上放松与相聚的场所（见第94页“重开茶馆”）；不过，在本月第22天参加第一长夜的庆典，或许更能有效提振人心（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07week3firstlo00]{第3周 - 第一长夜}）。除了这两种选择外，玩家角色也应准备好在镇民需要时提供帮助与协助，以提升士气。
  • 食物储备：名户屋三美指出，只要柳岸镇的人民仍被困在诅咒之中，建立食物储备就至关重要。她提出了几项玩家角色可以从事的行动，以帮助柳岸镇准备迎冬（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07gatheringfoo00]{筹措食粮}）；但她也对一个简单的事实深感忧虑：柳岸镇向来依赖贸易来补充粮食供应，而如今这条路行不通了，镇上的农夫和猎人将很难满足接下来的需求。
  • 风暴准备：郑鹏告诉玩家角色，他已要求城镇卫兵协助进行修缮工作并加强建筑的防风暴能力；但如果玩家角色也能用其他方式帮忙，确保柳岸镇为即将到来的冬季做好准备，他将不胜感激（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07increasingse00]{保障安全}）。夏季的暴雨虽已十分过量，但与柳岸镇在未来几个月预期将面对的强风、雷电、倾盆大雨，乃至周期性的暴风雪相比，仍根本不算什么。

玩家角色若能查明任何有关困扰小镇之诅咒的情报，都会有所帮助；如果他们还能找出任何解除诅咒的线索，镇上长老希望尽快得知——但不能因此耽误以上三项更紧迫的事务（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07researchingt00]{研究诅咒}）。凭借玩家角色在上一幕结束时从邹斗那里夺回的账本，他们已经掌握了一条极好的下一步线索；不过，要解读邹斗的笔记，还需要时间与工作。如果玩家角色在文本上遇到困难，镇上长老建议他们特别去拜访三个地点寻求帮助：坟边居的草药师尤素珍（她在柳岸镇居住的时间比任何人都长，或许注意到了别人忽略的事），慈母之环的法师伊川十兵卫（柳岸镇收藏旧文献最多的地方就在那儿），以及大柳树（上一幕中曾帮助玩家角色确定地区诅咒范围的木灵）。

此后不久，会议便告结束，让玩家角色可以按自己认为合适的方式开始准备迎冬。除了第一长夜会在秋季第三周的最后一天举行之外，玩家角色处理这些任务的顺序完全由他们自行决定——聪明的玩家角色不会只专注于某一类事务，而会将精力分散到各个方面。本章余下内容将涵盖玩家角色在这些努力期间会面对的各种休整期行动。即便在玩家角色于 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{第6章} 和 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{第7章} 中得知如何击败幽魂之墙，并踏上前往丹杉寺的旅程之后，他们仍可继续进行本章中的休整期行动，直到秋末、这一幕结束为止。

Getting Started

It’s fall in Willowshore, and as the leaves begin to turn, the summer rains are replaced by crisp autumn breezes, yet the end of the unusually rainy summer and the defeat of the monsters that had menaced the region bring the townsfolk little comfort. New leadership has been put in place, but the mystery of what happened to Governor Heh Shan-Bao (and his manor, for that matter), missing since the first day of summer, continues to perplex. However, even more worrisome is the strange curse that surrounds the region, one that prevents anyone from traveling too far from Willowshore and also seems to prevent anyone from neighboring settlements from visiting. Only one mysterious merchant, a strange man named Shinzo, seems able to come and go to Willowshore, and even he is unsure of why and has no insight into the curse’s nature. As the days march forward into fall, one thing becomes clear: if the people of Willowshore are to survive the coming winter, food must be stored and reinforcements must be made so that the townsfolk can survive the seasonal storms to come.

Who Leads Willowshore?

Near the end of the previous act, the question of who should replace Willowshore’s missing governor is answered. While the people of Willowshore assume this appointment will be temporary and hope that missing governor Heh Shan-Bao will return soon, such an event will not be occurring (at least, not in the way the locals hope). The rest of this campaign assumes that the PCs supported either Old Matsuki or Granny Hu for the position, but in your game, another NPC (or perhaps even one of the PCs themselves) might have taken on the role. Who exactly runs Willowshore is largely irrelevant, though, and in this adventure, that character is referred to as the “town elder” or “governor” If a PC leads Willowshore in your game, choose a significant NPC in town the party has allied with to instead play the role of adviser and quest giver throughout this adventure.

While the locals can continue to stockpile firewood, pickle and ferment food for long-term storage, fortify structures against the cold, and store grain for safekeeping, there’s only so much they can do on their own without aid and without inspiration. Fortunately for Willowshore, the townsfolk aren’t alone in this plight—they have a band of heroes at their side to help prepare them for the worst!

This act begins on the first day of fall. Give the party time to rest and recover from the events of the previous act, but when you’re ready to begin this one (preferably within a few days of the first day of fall), the party is contacted by the town elders with an invitation to meet at the Willowshore Trade Office to discuss the town’s immediate future.

When the PCs arrive, they’re greeted by the town elder who now serves as Willowshore’s governor, along with the elder who lost that bid for leadership, Zheng Peng (representing the town guard and Willowshore’s need to physically prepare for winter), and Nadoya Sanmi (representing Willowshore’s farmers and the need to stockpile food and supplies).

While you can roleplay out this meeting if you want, summarizing the important points listed below can help get the adventure started quickly. The meeting begins with the governor thanking the PCs for all they’ve done to help Willowshore so far but then noting that the work has only begun. The elder asks the PCs to continue to research the nature of the curse afflicting the town, but adds that it’s more important to make sure that Willowshore is ready for winter at this point; the town has only three months before food and shelter become its most important resources. In light of this need, the town elder asks the PCs to aid in the following three ways.

  • Townsfolk Morale: The town elder observes that the townsfolk are growing worried and fearful of the future, so whatever the PCs can do to keep spirits high and spread hope will be appreciated. An excellent way to do so would be to rebuild and reopen the Cerulean Teahouse to the public as a traditional place to relax and gather (see Restoring the Teahouse on page 94), but taking part in the festivities for First Long Night on the 22nd day of the month might be an even better way to keep spirits high (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07week3firstlo00]{Week 3 - First Long Night}). Beyond these two options, the PCs should also be ready to provide help and aid to the townsfolk as needed in order to improve morale.
  • Food Stores: Nadoya Sanmi notes that as long as the people of Willowshore remain trapped in the curse, food stores are important to build. She suggests several activities the PCs can pursue to help Willowshore prepare for winter (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07gatheringfoo00]{Gathering Food}), but remains very concerned by the simple fact that Willowshore has always relied on trade to supplement its food supplies, and without that option available, the town’s farmers and hunters are going to be hard-pressed to meet the upcoming demand.
  • Storm Preparation: Zheng Peng tells the PCs that he has asked the town guard to help with repair work and storm-proofing of buildings, but he would be grateful if the PCs can help in other ways to ensure Willowshore is ready for the coming winter (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07increasingse00]{Increasing Security}). While the summer’s rainstorms were excessive, they’re still nothing compared to the powerful winds, thunder and lightning, torrential downpours, and even periodic snowstorms that Willowshore expects to face in the coming months.

Anything the PCs can learn about the curse afflicting the town will help, and if they can determine any clues as to how to lift the curse, the town elder wants to hear about such information as soon as possible—but not at the expense of the three more immediate concerns above (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07researchingt00]{Researching the Curse}). With the ledger the PCs recovered from Zoudou at the end of the previous act, they’ve got an excellent lead on where to go next, but interpreting Zoudou’s notes will take time and work. If the PCs struggle with the text, the town elder suggests the PCs pay a visit to three locations in particular for aid: the herbalist You So-Jin at Graveside Manners (who has lived in Willowshore longer than anyone else and might have insights others have missed), the wizard Igawa Jubei at Mother’s Coil (where the largest amount of old texts in Willowshore are stored), and Great Willow (the kodama who helped the PCs in the previous act determine the scope of the region’s curse).

The meeting adjourns soon thereafter, allowing the PCs to begin the work of preparing for winter as they see fit. With the exception of First Long Night, which take places on the last day of the third week of fall, the order in which the PCs work on these tasks is left to them—wise PCs don’t focus on one category but instead spread their efforts across them all. The remainder of this chapter covers the wide range of downtime activities the PCs will face during these efforts. Even after the PCs learn how to defeat the Wall of Ghosts and make their journey to the Tan Sugi monastery in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl]{Chapter 6} and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{Chapter 7}, they can continue to pursue the downtime activities in this chapter up until the end of fall, when this act ends.

Turning of the Seasons.name: 四季流转 Turning of the Seasons
Turning of the Seasons.text:
第5章： 四季流转

帝国纪年7020年，也就是两个多世纪前，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}大师是@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐}的追随者，她来到这片地区，寻找幽魂之森深处一片传说中的杉树林。据传，其中最高大的一棵杉树，是一位名叫谭隋靖的古代英雄的转生灵魂；他曾击败名为苦迦菩提的强大邪魔。智惠希望能亲眼见证这一壮丽的生命轮回显现。当她抵达时，那片偏远林地中涌动的力量令她震撼不已，她立刻明白，中央那棵高耸入云的巨树具有重大的精神意义。在树根下冥想了10天后，她决定必须在林中建立一座寺院，好让其他人也能前来朝圣，并长久驻留于此，协助保护这片圣地免受伤害。

柳岸镇也于同年建立，因为智惠需要一处居所，安置那些协助修建寺院的人。在最初几年里，谭杉林（正如智惠开始称呼这处地点时所用的名字）几乎没有什么建设工作推进，因为建立柳岸镇占据了朝圣者们的大部分心力。随着柳岸镇逐渐发展，智惠则专注于开辟这座新城镇与圣地之间的道路。她明白，尽管穿越崎岖地形前往林地的旅程，仓促之人不到一天便能走完，但急于赶路会让旅人失去摆脱日常纷扰的机会。因此，智惠大师希望修筑一条朝圣之径，让人们以三天时间，在耐心的内省与自我反思中完成这段旅程。

于是，智惠大师亲自穿行林间，以明确的意志选择每一步落脚之处。她一路行经林地，攀上陡坡、翻越峻岭，穿过一片片看似毫无差别、极易令人迷失方向的森林地带，又沿着一座镜面般平静的大湖湖岸前行，最终抵达谭杉林。开辟这条道路——铺设石道、修建步桥，以及建造供途中歇脚的小型圣祠与建筑——她和她的追随者们足足花了将近一整年才完成。

丹杉寺的建立又花费了数年之久。每一根木材、每一块石料，都经过细致审慎的挑选与安放。整整10年后，寺院才终于落成；而在这段时间里，智惠大师的弟子也日渐增多。对他们而言，智惠的神导术就像一片秋叶轻轻落入心间——温柔，却承载着丰盛人生的分量，而且始终让弟子能够自由选择自己的道路。待到寺院建成时，已有数十名朝圣者每年跋涉来到柳岸镇，踏上前往丹杉寺的旅程。

然而，在智惠于7054年因自然原因去世后不久，纷争便悄然侵入丹杉寺信众的生活。来到寺院的新来者越来越少，随后局势逆转，武僧们开始离开，转往别处寻求开悟。而所有武僧始终都不知道、甚至从未怀疑的是，就在智惠大师去世之际，他们之中有一人堕落了。这名武僧名叫@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月}，而他前世的记忆异常清晰。辛月的悲痛深重到足以让苦迦菩提的影响渗入他的灵魂；苦迦菩提的遗骸正埋藏于寺院之下，却几乎不为寺中众人所知。武僧之间日益滋长的纷争，主要正是辛月暗中操纵的结果。

到7060年时，寺院中所剩无几的武僧都已被苦迦菩提腐化。当辛月将自己献祭给这名邪魔，却又在其他武僧眼前转生时，他们觉得自己终于窥见了丹杉寺真正的真相——这里并非静思与安宁之地，而是一座囚禁着伟大力量的笼墓；那力量若得他们侍奉，便会赐予他们奖励，而它已被囚禁于此数百年之久。

这些堕落的武僧切断了与柳岸镇的联系。在接下来的两年中，柳岸镇的人民都以为寺院已被废弃；而事实上，辛月和他的追随者们一直在设法寻找释放苦迦菩提出坟墓的方法。若只是简单砍倒生长在苦迦菩提遗骸之上的杉树，只会让这邪魔的灵魂回归浩瀚众界——辛月从自己的幻象中得知，苦迦菩提真正想要的，是转生到凡世之中；而要做到这一点，那棵杉树就必须保持完好，作为他新化身的原始材料。苦迦菩提想要利用自己昔日敌人谭隋靖留下的残余，作为其转生入世的方法。然而，要实现这一目标，辛月和武僧们必须花费数十年冥想与祷告派，以为此铺平道路。

7062年，一队来自司泽城的伐木工来到柳岸镇，寻找一片藏匿的杉树林。他们沿路向上，前往丹杉寺，打算砍伐那里的树木，却被武僧们尽数屠杀。随后，伐木工的尸体被用来施行一次召唤宁多鲁邪魔的大型仪式，接着这些邪魔被派往柳岸镇，传达警告。它们披着被杀伐木工的尸体，挥舞着他们破损的武器，由此形成的恐怖事件被称作断刃之夜；从那一天起，柳岸镇的人民便惊恐地确保，再也没有人胆敢前往丹杉寺。

事情就这样持续着，直到赫山宝总督试图清除侵入谭隋靖杉树中的腐化。那场仪式最终失败，导致镇上所有人——以及丹杉寺中的人——全数死亡。当心景形成时，寺院周边地区，包括通往寺院的整条朝圣之径，都被幽魂之墙吞没，而居住其中的武僧们死后又化作不死生物。作为心景的一部分，辛月和他的追随者们知道自己一直在一遍又一遍地重复这些岁月，却无力挣脱。因此，关于心景本质的许多秘密与真相正等待柳岸镇的英雄们去发掘；然而，在幽魂之墙另一侧的丹杉寺中等待他们的种种威胁，将是他们至今面对过最危险的考验。

Chapter 5: Turning of the Seasons

In 7020 ic, just over two centuries ago, Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}, a follower of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi}, traveled to the region in search of a legendary grove of sugi trees deep in the Specterwood. Rumors held that the tallest of these trees was the reincarnated spirit of an ancient hero named Tan Sui-Jing, who defeated a powerful fiend named Kugaptee, and Zhi Hui hoped to see this magnificent example of the cycle of life with her own eyes. When she arrived, the power she felt in the remote grove astounded her, and she knew that the towering tree at the center was of great spiritual significance. After meditating at the tree’s base for 10 days, she decided she needed to build a monastery in the grove so that others could make the pilgrimage, then remain there to help preserve the site from harm.

Willowshore was founded that same year, as Zhi Hui needed a place to live for those who would help build the monastery. For the first few years, little work was done at the Tan Sugi grove (as Zhi Hui had taken to calling the site), as the establishment of Willowshore took up most of the pilgrims’ focus. While Willowshore grew, Zhi Hui focused on creating the path between the new town and the sacred site. She knew that while the journey to the grove through the rugged terrain could be traversed by the hasty in less than a day, rushing the trip robbed the traveler of the chance to shed the distractions of day-to-day life, and so Master Zhi Hui sought to create a pilgrim’s trail that would be traversed over the course of three days of patient introspection and self-reflection.

Thus, Master Zhi Hui traversed a path through the forest, choosing each footstep with intention. As she made her way through the woods, she found herself climbing up and over steep slopes, winding through seemingly identical stretches of forest where one could easily lose their way, and skirting the shore of a large lake with a mirrorlike surface before reaching the Tan Sugi grove. The creation of this path—the laying of its stones, the building of a footbridge, and the construction of small shrines and buildings to serve as way stations—would take her and her followers the better part of a year to complete.

The creation of the Tan Sugi monastery took several more years. Every timber and every stone was chosen and placed with careful consideration. It would be 10 years before the monastery was completed, but in that time, Master Zhi Hui’s disciples grew. To them, Zhi Hui’s guidance was like a single autumn leaf alighting upon their minds—gentle yet arriving with the weight of a well-lived life, and always allowing the disciple the freedom to choose their own path. By the time the monastery was completed, dozens of pilgrims were making yearly treks to Willowshore to undertake the journey to the Tan Sugi monastery.

But soon after Zhi Hui passed away from natural causes in 7054, discord crept into the lives of the adherents of the Tan Sugi monastery. The arrival of newcomers to the monastery dwindled, then reversed as monks began leaving in search of enlightenment elsewhere. What none of the monks would ever learn or even suspect is that upon Master Zhi Hui’s death, one of their own fell from grace. This monk was named @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue}, and the memories of their past lives remained unusually strong. Xin Yue’s grief poisoned them enough to allow the influence of Kugaptee, whose remains lay buried and unguessed at by most of the monastery’s occupants, to creep into his soul. It was largely the subtle manipulations of Xin Yue that helped discord to flourish among the monks.

By 7060, what few monks remained at the monastery had become corrupted by Kugaptee, and when Xin Yue offered themself as a sacrifice to the fiend, only to reincarnate before the other monks’ very eyes, they felt that the truth of the Tan Sugi monastery had been revealed—this place wasn’t one for quiet reflection and peace, but a cage-tomb in which a great power that would give them all rewards for service had been imprisoned for centuries.

These corrupted monks cut ties with Willowshore, and for the next two years, the people of Willowshore assumed that the monastery had been abandoned when, in fact, Xin Yue and their followers now spent their time exploring a way in which they could free Kugaptee from his grave. Simply chopping down the sugi tree that grew over Kugaptee’s remains would only release the fiend’s soul into the Great Beyond—Xin Yue knew from his visions that what Kugaptee wanted was to instead reincarnate into the mortal realm, and to do so, the sugi tree needed to remain intact to serve as the raw materials for his new incarnation. Kugaptee wished to use what remained of his old enemy, Tan Sui-Jing, as his method of reincarnation into the world. In order to achieve such a goal, though, Xin Yue and the monks needed to spend decades in meditation and prayer to prepare the way.

In 7062, a group of woodcutters sent from the city of Sze came to Willowshore seeking a hidden sugi grove. They marched up the path to the Tan Sugi monastery, intent on harvesting its trees, only to be slaughtered by the monks. The bodies of the woodcutters were then used to perform a grand conjuration of nindoru fiends, which were subsequently sent down to Willowshore with a warning. Wearing the bodies of the slaughtered woodcutters and wielding their broken weapons, the resulting horror became known as the Night of Broken Blades, and from that date onward, the people of Willowshore frightfully ensured that no one else would ever dare visit the Tan Sugi monastery.

And so things went, until Governor Heh Shan-Bao made his disastrous attempt to remove the corruption growing into Tan Sui-Jing’s sugi tree, a ritual that backfired and resulted in the deaths of everyone in town—and in the Tan Sugi monastery as well. When the mindscape was created, the region surrounding the monastery, including the entirety of the pilgrim’s path leading to it, became engulfed within a Wall of Ghosts, and the monks who dwelled within died and rose as undead. As part of the mindscape, Xin Yue and their followers know that they’ve been repeating the years over and over but have been powerless to break free. Many secrets and revelations about the nature of the mindscape thus lie in wait for Willowshore’s heroes to discover, yet the threats they’ll encounter in the Tan Sugi monastery beyond the Wall of Ghosts will be the greatest dangers they’ve yet faced.

Act 2.2: The Enlightened Path.name: 第 2.2 幕：开悟之道 Act 2.2: The Enlightened Path

The Final Day.name: 最后一天 The Final Day
The Final Day.text:
最后一天

如果玩家角色们没有击败尤伽喀，那么第三天的暴风雨天气会持续到这一幕的剩余时间（或者至少持续到她被击败为止）。不过，本冒险默认玩家角色们击败了她，因此当玩家角色们在旅程的最后一天醒来时，迎接他们的是晴朗的蓝天。尽管天空放晴，气温依然寒冷，并且随着白天推进而进一步下降，感觉越来越像冬季而非秋季。当玩家角色们接近寺院时，转到@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{Chapter 7}。

The Final Day

If the PCs didn’t defeat Iogaka, then the stormy conditions of the third day continue for the remainder of this act (or at least until she’s defeated). This adventure assumes the PCs defeat her, though, and when the PCs wake on the final day of their journey, they do so to clear blue skies. Despite the clear skies, the temperature remains cold, dropping further as the day goes on and feeling more and more like winter than fall. As the PCs approach the monastery, turn to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{Chapter 7}.

Mountain Shrine.name: 山岳神龛 Mountain Shrine
Mountain Shrine.text:
D3. 山岳神龛 中等 5

这场遭遇发生在傍晚，玩家角色抵达山岳神龛时正值日落；它使用山岳神龛的地图。随着玩家角色接近，一声雷鸣与一道电光中，风暴愈发猛烈。风暴对远程攻击施加的减值提高至–2，且现在也会施加于察觉检定（@UUID[Item.VCLublg5hicujGO9]{天气：风暴}）。

一道瀑布从五十尺高的悬崖上倾泻而下，注入下方的河流。奔流的水声在呼啸的狂风与急促的雨声中显得有些模糊。一座摇摇欲坠的木桥可供人跨越河流，而一条狭窄的阶梯则从道路旁蜿蜒而上，通往北面的陡坡。

当智惠大师初次登上这座山时，她被倾泻入这片湖泊的壮丽瀑布所吸引，也为此地之美深深打动。鉴于河流在许多关于生死循环的神话与寓言中都具有象征意义，这里便成了设立朝圣之径第三座圣祠的完美地点，与桥神龛的位置相呼应。不过，与那座神龛不同，此处这片河水汇聚并停驻的小湖，象征的并非从生到死的循环；它要求朝圣者沉思每一段生命本身都是值得享受的事物，同时也为朝圣者提供了一个绝佳之地，让他们在劳累攀登一整天后沐浴洗涤。若某位玩家角色在宗教上达到专家，或信奉@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐}，则会自动从本地学识中知晓此事；其他人则可以尝试一次 @Check[religion|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 以回忆知识。

真正的山岳神龛从朝圣之径上是看不见的。玩家角色虽然可以通过成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] 检定，攀爬被雨水浸透的悬崖前往神龛，但更容易的路线是从 D3b 区域的台阶上去，抵达 D3c 区域的湖岸。湖泊（D3d 区域）平均深20尺，而角色若成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] 检定，便可以在风暴翻腾的湖水中游泳。不会游泳的生物会向南移动20尺，朝着 D3a 区域北侧的瀑布漂去；若生物越过瀑布，便会坠落50尺落入下方水中，并因坠落受到 @Damage[15[bludgeoning]] 伤害。

在 D3c 与 D3e 区域之间的湖岸两侧，立柱上固定着滑轮，一根绳索连接其间。D3f 区域的一处洞穴里有六张供朝圣者睡卧的芦苇垫，另有几条毛巾和几把刷子，方便沐浴使用；而真正的山岳神龛（D3g 区域）则坐落在一座25尺高的石制圣祠之中。木筏上的生物可以尝试以下行动，沿着绳索移动木筏。

移动木筏 2

你通过拉拽木筏上的绳索，尝试将木筏沿湖岸向东或向西移动。进行一次 @Check[athletics|dc:15] 检定。木筏上的其他生物可以协助此次检定。

大成功 木筏移动25尺。

成功 木筏移动15尺。

失败 木筏移动5尺。

大失败 木筏没有移动。

生物：距离寺院如此之近，苦迦菩提的影响更加强烈，而他怒火的直接显现如今将这座圣祠据为巢穴：一名名为尤伽喀的风暴鬼婆。正是这个残忍的生物曾折磨河童圆光（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b1tormentedk00]{B1}），而且也是沿朝圣之径一路折磨玩家角色的恶劣天气之源。风暴鬼婆将山岳神龛视作自己的私人领地——一个她可以俯瞰下方山谷，并沉醉于自己常常召来的风暴荣光中的地方。玩家角色闯入这片领地，对她而言是深切而私人的冒犯。

山岳神龛 中等 5

@UUID[Actor.BQpABYrqhgvvOPXs]{尤伽喀} @UUID[Actor.JeE0By58Vd0AjU9R]{火花蛾（2）}

凭借她透过风暴视物的能力，除非玩家角色行动隐秘并避免使用木筏横渡湖面，否则她会从神龛中的位置发现玩家角色。如果玩家角色正试图乘木筏穿过湖面，她会等他们划到约三分之一的位置后，对他们施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{闪电束}，这样她就能让几个玩家角色与对岸的滑轮一同落入法术区域。闪电束造成的猛烈伤害会自动摧毁滑轮，使木筏开始向南漂向 D3a 区域的瀑布。每轮结束时，木筏会再漂近20尺，逐步逼近坠落边缘。只要固定在 D3e 区域的绳索仍然完好，玩家角色仍可继续尝试移动木筏，但该行动的难度等级提高为 @Check[athletics|dc:25|name:Move the Raft]。当然，在第二轮时，尤伽喀会移动到 D3e 区域的木桩旁，并用她的爪击劈砍绳索；该绳索的AC为17，且有15生命值。若她毁掉绳索，则木筏会失控地漂向瀑布，除非木筏上的某位玩家角色有办法推动或固定它。若木筏冲下瀑布，它会被摧毁——任何与木筏一同跌下瀑布的玩家角色，都会像从50尺高处坠落到坚硬表面上一样承受正常坠落伤害，而不是落水伤害，因为他们会在下坠过程中撞上岩石和船体碎片；不过，成功通过一次 @Check[reflex|dc:20] 豁免的坠落玩家角色可以较为平稳地落入水中，因此只承受此次坠落的一半伤害。

尤伽喀身边有一对火花蛾相伴。她会派出这些飞蛾攻击湖中的玩家角色，而自己则用狂风冲击对付他们；但只要有玩家角色与她近战交锋，她就会把飞蛾召回身边护卫自己。尤伽喀会战斗至死，但若玩家角色逃走，她不会追出附近区域。若尤伽喀被杀，雷暴会立刻开始减弱，并在一小时内衰退成细微小雨；到第二天清晨，便会让位于晴朗的蔚蓝天空。

场景注记音效

@UUID[Playlist.kcrfM86DAcpOfBrs.PlaylistSound.M5txTumUDf7T8Cbc]{闪电束}

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.pBcz5eRZMMc2znXA]{洞穴} @UUID[Actor.cHPAa9IKSOln2d9N]{圣祠}
洞穴（D3f 区域）是个相对舒适而干燥、适合夜间休息的地方。除了帮助在湖水中沐浴的毛巾和擦洗刷外，一处小壁架上还放着四块活力香皂。而在圣祠（D3g 区域）中，一个饰有杉树图案的次等揭示香炉放置在中央的石台上。尤伽喀已经往香炉里塞满了淤泥和死鱼，因此在使用前必须先将其清理干净。

启悟奖励： @UUID[Item.FUm3BqhNfrdJ3fuS]{山岳圣祠启悟}
如果玩家角色击败尤伽喀、在湖水中沐浴，然后在此地过夜休息，他们醒来时会迎来一个寒冷却晴朗的日子。若木筏在前一晚被摧毁，那么它会神秘地完全恢复功能。此外，直到本幕结束前，所有玩家角色都会从圣祠获得对所有强韧豁免骰的+1物品加值。玩家角色若从山岳神龛获得启悟，则授予他们40 XP。

D3. Mountain Shrine Moderate 5

This encounter takes place in the evening, with the PCs arriving at the Mountain Shrine just as the sun is setting; it uses the map for the Mountain Shrine. As the PCs approach, the storm intensifies with a peal of thunder and a flash of lightning. The penalty to ranged attacks imposed by the storm increases to –2 and now also applies to Perception checks (@UUID[Item.VCLublg5hicujGO9]{Weather: Storm}).

A waterfall pours over a fifty-foot-high cliff into the river below, the sound of the cascading water somewhat obscured by the howl of the wind and the pounding of the rain. A rickety wood bridge allows passage over the river, while a narrow set of steps winds up off the path into the escarpments to the north.

When Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} first ascended this mountain, she was drawn to the majestic waterfalls that cascade into this lake and was taken by the site’s beauty. In light of rivers’ symbolism in so many myths and parables about the cycle of life and death, this seemed the perfect place to set up the Pilgrim’s Path’s third shrine, to parallel the Bridge Shrine’s position. Unlike that shrine, though, the presence of the small lake here, where river waters gather and linger, does not symbolize the cycle of life to death; it asks the pilgrim to contemplate each life as something to be enjoyed and also gives the pilgrims a perfect place to bathe and wash at the end of a tiring day of climbing. A PC who’s an expert in Religion or who follows @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi} knows this from local lore automatically, while others can attempt a @Check[religion|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] to Recall Knowledge.

The actual Mountain Shrine isn’t visible from the Pilgrim’s Path. While the PCs could Climb the rain-soaked cliffs up to the shrine with successful @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] checks, an easier route is to take the steps at area D3b up to the lakeshore at area D3c. The lake (area D3d) averages 20 feet deep, and a character who succeeds at a @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] check can Swim in the storm-tossed waters. A creature who doesn’t swim moves 20 feet south toward the waterfall just north of area D3a; a creature who goes over the waterfall plummets 50 feet into the water below, taking @Damage[15[bludgeoning]] damage from the fall.

A rope is strung between two pulleys affixed to poles on either side of the lakeshore between areas D3c and D3e. A cave at area D3f contains six reed mats for pilgrims to sleep on, along with several towels and brushes to aid in bathing, while the actual Mountain Shrine (area D3g) sits inside a 25-foot-high stone shrine. A creature on the raft can move it along the rope’s length by attempting the following activity.

Move the Raft 2

You attempt to move the raft to the east or west between the lakeshores by tugging on its ropes. Attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:15] check. Other creatures on the raft can Aid this check.

Critical Success The raft moves 25 feet.

Success The raft moves 15 feet.

Failure The raft moves 5 feet.

Critical Failure The raft doesn’t move.

Creatures: This close to the monastery, Kugaptee’s influence is stronger still, and a direct manifestation of his wrath now claims the shrine as her home: a storm hag named Iogaka. The same cruel creature who tormented the kappa Enko (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b1tormentedk00]{B1}), Iogaka is also the cause of the foul weather that has plagued the PCs on their journey along the Pilgrim’s Path. The storm hag sees the Mountain Shrine as her personal domain—a place where she can look out over the valley below and bask in the glory of the storms she often conjures into being. The PCs’ intrusion into this domain is a deep and personal insult.

Mountain Shrine Moderate 5

@UUID[Actor.BQpABYrqhgvvOPXs]{Iogaka} @UUID[Actor.JeE0By58Vd0AjU9R]{Spark Moths (2)}

With her ability to see through the storm, unless the PCs are stealthy and avoid using the raft to cross the lake, she spots the PCs from her position in the shrine. If the PCs are attempting to cross the lake on the raft, she waits for them to get 1/3 of the way over before she casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{Lightning Bolt} at them so that she’ll catch a few PCs in the spell as well as the pulley on the opposite shore. The violent damage caused by the lightning bolt automatically destroys the pulley, causing the raft to begin drifting south toward the waterfall to area D3a. At the end of each round, the raft drifts 20 feet closer to plummeting over the edge. As long as the rope anchored at area D3e remains intact, a PC can continue to Move the Raft, but the DC for the activity increases to @Check[athletics|dc:25|name:Move the Raft]. Of course, on the second round, Iogaka moves to the post at area D3e and slashes at the rope with her claw; the rope has AC 17 and 15 Hit Points. If she destroys the rope, the raft floats uncontrollably toward the falls unless one of the PCs on board has some means of propelling it or anchoring it. If the raft goes over the falls, it is destroyed—any PC who goes over the falls with it takes normal falling damage as if they fell 50 feet onto a hard surface rather than water, as a result of striking rocks and parts of the boat on the way down, although a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save allows the falling PC to land more softly in the water and thus only take half damage from the plummet.

Iogaka is accompanied by a pair of spark moths. She sends the moths out to attack the PCs in the lake while she uses wind blasts against them, but as soon as a PC confronts her in melee, she calls the moths back to her side to defend her. Iogaka fights to the death but won’t pursue the PCs beyond the immediate area if they flee. If Iogaka is slain, the thunderstorm immediately begins to abate, and within an hour, it has reduced in power to a light drizzle that, by the next morning, gives way to a clear blue sky.

Scene NotesSFX

@UUID[Playlist.kcrfM86DAcpOfBrs.PlaylistSound.M5txTumUDf7T8Cbc]{Lightning Bolt}

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.pBcz5eRZMMc2znXA]{Cave} @UUID[Actor.cHPAa9IKSOln2d9N]{Shrine}
The cave (area D3f) is a relatively comfortable and dry place to rest for the night. In addition to the towels and scrubbing brushes to aid bathing in the lake waters, four bars of invigorating soap sit on a small ledge. Over in the shrine (area D3g), a lesser thurible of revelation decorated with images of sugi trees sits on the central stone platform. Iogaka has filled the thurible with mud and dead fish, so it must be cleaned out before it can be used.

Enlightenment Reward: @UUID[Item.FUm3BqhNfrdJ3fuS]{Mountain Shrine Enlightenment}
If the PCs defeat Iogaka, bathe in the lake’s waters, and then spend the night resting in this area, they awaken to a cold but clear day. If the raft was destroyed the previous night, it has been mysteriously and fully restored to functionality. In addition, the PCs all gain a +1 item bonus from the shrine to all Fortitude saving throws until the end of this act. Grant the PCs 40 XP for achieving enlightenment from the Mountain Shrine.

A Whisper in the Woods.name: 林中低语 A Whisper in the Woods
A Whisper in the Woods.text:
D2. 林中低语 低阶 5

这场遭遇发生在下午，正当太阳开始落到西边群山之后时，并使用林中道路地图。

生物：山中道路上陡峭的斜坡与坡地在这里暂时趋于平缓，蜿蜒穿过平坦却林木茂密的地形，但这一路段却格外阴森，因为道路两侧树木的分支上挂着数十颗腐烂程度各异的人类头，皆以头发悬垂。随着PC们靠近，这些头开始低语、嘶嘶作响，腐烂的嘴唇微微抽动，轻柔而充满威胁的声音在空气中盘旋。诸如“你们很快就会加入我们。”“我们欢迎你们成为我们的家人。”“加入我们的声音，与苦迦菩提合而为一。”之类令人不安的话语，不断嘲弄着PC们。

林中低语 低阶 5

@UUID[Actor.s5RfTcgA0CRm0ODD]{嘲讽僧侣的头骨}

其中有一颗头与其他的尤其不同；这颗头几乎只剩下一颗骷髅，而且悬挂在道路中央，正面朝着PC们。只要有人接近到距离这颗骷髅30尺内，它就会升到空中，命令术PC们停下并折返，同时告诉他们：“这里不欢迎你们；你们缺乏与伟大的库嘎普缇合而为一所需的真正洞见！”这是一个早已死去的武僧的头骨，如今被活化为一颗格外强大的嘲弄颅骨；若PC们不肯回头，它就会尝试对他们施展挫败士气。若有人接近到它10尺内，或试图从它身边通过，它便会发动攻击；它头发所连着的那几片皮革般的头皮碎片也会因此从上方的分支上猛然扯裂脱落。这颗嘲讽僧侣的头骨能够吐出不洁的灵浆污泥，并会战斗直到被摧毁为止。

D2. A Whisper in the Woods Low 5

This encounter takes place in the afternoon, just as the sun is starting to dip behind the mountains to the west, and uses the Forested Path map.

Creatures: The steep inclines and slopes of the mountain path taper off here for a while, winding through flat but densely forested terrain, but this stretch of pathway becomes particularly grim as dozens of human heads in varying states of decay hang by their hair from tree branches on either side of the road. As the PCs draw near, the heads begin to whisper and hiss, decaying lips twitching as soft, menacing voices swirl in the air. Unnerving phrases like, “You will join us soon,” or “We welcome you to our family,” or “Join our voices and become one with Kugaptee,” taunt the PCs.

A Whisper in the Woods Low 5

@UUID[Actor.s5RfTcgA0CRm0ODD]{Taunting Monk's Skull}

One head in particular is different than the others; this one is little more than a skull, and it hangs in the middle of the path, facing the PCs. As soon as anyone approaches within 30 feet of the skull, it rises up into the air and commands the PCs to stop and turn back, informing them, “You are not welcome here; you lack the true insight needed to be one with Great Kugaptee!” This is the skull of a long-dead monk, now animated as a particularly powerful taunting skull, and it attempts to Demoralize the PCs if they don’t turn back. It attacks if anyone comes within 10 feet of it or attempts to pass it, the fragments of leathery scalp from which its hair extends to the branch above ripping free as it does so. Capable of spitting unholy ectoplasmic sludge, the taunting monk’s skull fights until it is destroyed.

A Voice in the Fog.name: 雾中的声音 A Voice in the Fog
A Voice in the Fog.text:
D1. 雾中的声音 低级 5

这场遭遇发生在玩家角色离开园圃圣祠一小时后，并使用山中道路地图。

生物：雾气变得愈发浓重，道路也变得更加陡峭。让每位玩家角色都尝试一次察觉检定。掷骰结果最高的玩家角色瞥见了一个似乎微微亮着的提灯，但片刻之后，那光亮便熄灭了，雾气也将这景象吞没。

在道路上方被瞥见的那个身影，是一只刚刚遁入幽暗的鬼火。此时，道路西侧边缘是一处30尺高的悬崖，坠落下去便是下方的森林；树梢高度大致与道路齐平。当玩家角色靠近时，鬼火发出一声尖叫，听起来像是一名惊惧女子的声音，随后飞到壁架下方的地面上。它再次发光，因此对上方壁架上的玩家角色来说，那光芒看起来就像枝叶间摇曳的提灯光亮。鬼火用颤抖的声音朝上喊道，哭喊着说：“救救我！我摔下来了！我觉得我的腿断了！”为它进行一次欺瞒检定，对玩家角色说谎。

雾中的声音 低级 5

@UUID[Actor.imLw1FbzrHXKTn7J]{鬼火}

这只鬼火希望引诱一名玩家角色离开道路，下到它的掌控范围内；如果有正在攀爬的玩家角色坠落，那就更理想了。成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:20|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] 检定的角色可以沿着崖壁向下攀爬。一旦有玩家角色靠近它的光亮，这只怪物就会立刻发动攻击，并以欺瞒掷先攻。如果玩家角色没有上当，鬼火会先遁入幽暗，然后飞上壁架发动攻击，并以隐秘掷先攻。与大多数鬼火不同，这只生物在变得可见时，显现出的不是一张骷髅般的面孔，而是一小团发光的血红色蝴蝶——这是它诞生自苦迦菩提梦境的副作用。它会战斗至死。

D1. A Voice in the Fog Low 5

This encounter takes place an hour after the PCs leave the Garden Shrine and uses the Mountain Path map.

Creatures: The fog grows thicker and the path grows steeper. Have each PC attempt a Perception check. The PC who rolls the highest catches a glimpse of what appears to be a dimly lit lantern, but a moment later, the light is extinguished and the fog swallows the vision up.

The figure glimpsed up the path is a will-o’-wisp that has just Gone Dark.
