At this point, the western edge of the path is a 30-foot cliff that drops into the forest below; the tops of the trees are about equal with the path. As the PCs approach, the will-o’-wisp screams out in what sounds like the voice of a frightened woman, then flies down to the ground below the ledge. It lights up again, so that to the PCs on the ledge above, the glow looks like the flickering of a lantern through the branches. The will-o’-wisp calls up in a trembling voice, crying out, “Help me! I fell! I think I broke my leg!” Roll a Deception check to Lie to the PCs.

A Voice in the Fog Low 5

@UUID[Actor.imLw1FbzrHXKTn7J]{Will-o'-Wisp}

The will-o’-wisp hopes to lure one PC down off the path and into its clutches; if a climbing PC falls, so much the better. Climbing down the cliffside is possible for a character who succeeds at a @Check[athletics|dc:20|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check. The monster attacks as soon as a PC approaches its light, rolling Deception for initiative. If the PCs don’t fall for the ruse, the will-o’-wisp Goes Dark and then flies up to attack on the ledge, rolling Stealth for initiative. Unlike most will-o’-wisps, this creature appears as a small mass of glowing, blood-red butterflies when it becomes visible, rather than as a skull-like face—a side effect of its genesis from Kugaptee’s dreams. It fights to the death.

The Third Day.name: 第三天 The Third Day
The Third Day.text:
第三天

黎明时分，雨势渐歇，但一阵浓雾卷来，并持续了当天前半段时间。过了正午，风势渐起，吹散了雾气。随着下午逐渐过去，频繁的阵风会熄灭手持的烈焰，并使物理远程攻击承受 –1 环境减值（@UUID[Item.NslNsr8m4doy1F0G]{天气：风}）。等到PC们抵达山岳神龛时，大雨再次倾盆而下，而PC们将面对一场雷暴。参见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08d3mountainsh00]{D3}。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.IcMQs5bqFUW3hOTs]{浓雾} @UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.nezy4qHmtlstrXAe]{雨} @UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.UGTtO5R4VbSOPooG]{雷暴}

这一天的旅行变得愈发需要上下攀行，沿途有数处之字形回转和陡坡需要通过。道路两侧依旧是森林，不过峭壁和岩架也时常逼近路旁。待雾气散去后，向东望去时便能瞥见柳岸镇。再往远处看，笼罩内陆荒野的朦胧雾霭，让这片地区显得仿佛被困在一只由乌云构成的巨碗之下，令人不寒而栗。

The Third Day

The rain lets up with the dawn, but a thick fog rolls in and persists for the first part of the day. Past noon, the wind picks up and disperses the fog. As the afternoon wears on, frequent gusts of wind can snuff out handheld flames, and impose a –1 circumstance penalty to physical ranged attacks (@UUID[Item.NslNsr8m4doy1F0G]{Weather: Wind}). By the time the PCs reach the Mountain Shrine, the rain returns in force, and the PCs face a thunderstorm. See area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08d3mountainsh00]{D3}.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.IcMQs5bqFUW3hOTs]{Dense Fog} @UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.nezy4qHmtlstrXAe]{Rain} @UUID[Playlist.jXKZ6O8NnYJaazKE.PlaylistSound.UGTtO5R4VbSOPooG]{Thunderstorm}

Travel increasingly becomes vertical during this day’s trip, with the path having several switchbacks and steep slopes to navigate. The forest remains on either side of the path, although cliffsides and ledges often encroach. Once the fog has dispersed, the view to the east allows glimpses of Willowshore. Beyond that, the haze surrounding the hinterlands gives the region the unnerving appearance of being trapped under a bowl made of dark clouds.

Garden Shrine.name: 园圃圣祠 Garden Shrine
Garden Shrine.text:
C3. 园圃圣祠 中等 5

这场遭遇发生在傍晚，玩家角色抵达园圃圣祠时正值日落；使用园圃圣祠的地图。

林中道路在此处出现了一片断口，路旁是一片洒满灰烬的空地。靠近道路处坐落着一间部分烧毁的木屋，一条5英尺宽的岩石步道绕过废墟，通向后方一座杂草丛生的花园。这里，一株被焚毁的橡树焦黑残骸高高耸立，而在这片焦土空地的尽头，则坐落着一座小型石制圣祠。岩石道路一路通向那里，最后这一段两侧立着三对未点燃的石制提灯。

当@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}大师走过这段旅程时，曾欣喜地发现此处一片风景宜人的空地上生长着野花、浆果和野萝卜。花卉之美，以及果实与根茎蔬菜的鲜美滋味，使这里成为建立圣祠的绝佳地点，朝圣者可以在此享用简单餐食，思索一日旅行结束后享受美味餐点的价值，同时也提醒自己不可在饮食上放纵过度。任何在宗教上达到专家的玩家角色，或信奉@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐}的玩家角色，都会自动从地方学识中知道这些；其他人则可尝试一次@Check[religion|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定来回忆知识。

这条5英尺宽的石路（区域C3a）绕过木屋（区域C3b），通向后院中的一座小花园（区域C3c与C3d）。石路提供稳固落脚点，但任何走下道路的人都会发现，覆满灰烬的泥地属于困难地形。位于区域C3c、夹道而立的六盏石制提灯原本是用来焚烧圆锥形熏香的，其结构足以提供防护，让熏香即使在暴雨中也能持续燃烧。

玩家角色初到此地时，这里看起来像是不久前才遭火焚。木屋（区域C3b）烧毁严重，但屋顶仍残留了足够部分，至少能提供一些雨中的遮蔽。园圃圣祠本身位于后方的石制建筑中（区域C3d），其中内容物在火灾中完好无损。这里还存放着用于维护和修缮的额外物资。玩家角色可以用这些物资修补主屋的屋顶与墙壁，花费1小时工作并成功通过一次@Check[crafting|dc:18]检定即可（失败则表示这些物资在尝试中被毁坏）。完成这些修缮后，玩家角色便能舒适地在区域C3b中过夜；否则，次日醒来时，潮湿会使他们陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}，除非他们成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:15]豁免。

生物：不同于桥神龛（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b3bridgeshri00]{B3}）与山岳神龛（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08d3mountainsh00]{D3}），园圃圣祠曾有看护者负责照料。曾有四名看护者居住于此，他们是圣祠的照料人，非常乐于在通往丹杉寺院的大致中途点，为旅人提供舒适的休憩之所。这些看护者喜欢为朝圣者提供餐食与便利，但在寺院被废弃后，这群人仍选择留下，以隐士的方式生活，偶尔为稀少的过路旅人提供庇护。直到7062年，一切才告终——当时那些伐木工前去寻找丹杉寺院。看护者们试图劝退他们，却没能成功……而当那些伐木工在当晚沿路返回、化为亡灵怪物时，他们点燃了园圃圣祠。

园圃圣祠 中等 5

@UUID[Actor.oqbHWrUNTjCbeGmK]{圣坛看护者（4）}

圣祠的看护者死于那场火灾，如今以亡灵的形式存在。玩家角色一进入区域C3b，他们便会从灰烬中升起，在肉体燃烧的感觉驱使下痛苦呼号，并发动攻击。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.psCcz5htBhSFHIGf]{园圃圣祠} @UUID[Actor.6O9IZRG3Cr0C7KYK]{香炉}
搜索圣祠（区域C3d）会发现修缮物资，以及一个装有十二枚薰衣草熏香锥的陶罐。成功通过一次@Check[nature|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或@Check[religion|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定来回忆知识的玩家角色会知道，据说薰衣草熏香能够刺激食欲。每一枚熏香锥价值25 gp。若玩家角色搜索圣祠并成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search]检定，还会发现一个制作精巧的银与橡木香炉， 它能保护其中的熏香，使其不被风雨熄灭。这个香炉价值50 gp，外形如龙首，烟雾会从它的鼻孔中袅袅飘出。

如果玩家角色将这种熏香各放入区域C3c的每一盏石制提灯中并点燃，整个区域便会笼罩在一种冷静的氛围中。若区域C3b中的焚身尸尚未被遭遇，这些熏香会使他们在任何战斗中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}状态。

一旦点燃，这些熏香锥便会在提灯中持续燃烧，直到本幕结束。

启蒙奖励： @UUID[Actor.y9JYS9xak3tg6jSg]{根系} @UUID[Item.p8njZzf4ZZXcz6VW]{园圃圣祠启蒙}
如果玩家角色点燃六盏提灯中的全部熏香，并在此过夜，他们会发现灰烬之上已长出一层新鲜的绿草。与此同时，六朵亮蓝兰花也在被焚毁的橡树根系间绽放。若玩家角色靠近橡树，他们会被一股冲动驱使，想要摘下全部六朵花。这些花朵一旦被摘下，便会化作消耗品物品，可如同一剂次等治疗蒸汽般被启用。

无论玩家角色是否摘下这些花，他们都会从圣祠获得对所有意志豁免的+1物品加值，持续到本幕结束。若玩家角色从园圃圣祠获得启蒙，给予他们40 XP。

C3. Garden Shrine Moderate 5

This encounter takes place in the evening, with the PCs arriving at the Garden Shrine just as the sun is setting; it uses the map for the Garden Shrine.

The forested path reaches a break here, next to an ash-strewn clearing astride the path. A partially burned wooden cottage sits near the path, while a five-foot-wide rock walkway winds around the ruins to an overgrown garden beyond. Here, the scorched remnants of a burned oak tree loom tall, while at the far end of the charred clearing sits a small stone shrine. The rock pathway leads up to it, with this last stretch flanked by three pairs of unlit stone lanterns.

While traversing this leg of the journey, Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} was delighted to find a grove of wildflowers, berries, and wild radishes growing in an idyllic clearing here. The floral beauty and the delicious taste of the fruits and root vegetables made an excellent spot for a shrine, where pilgrims could enjoy a simple meal and contemplate the values of enjoyable repasts at the end of a day of travel while also ensuring that they did not overindulge in food or drink. Any PC who’s an expert in Religion or who follows @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi} knows this from local lore automatically, while others can attempt a @Check[religion|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge.

The 5-foot-wide stone path (area C3a) leads around the cottage (area C3b) to a small garden in the backyard (areas C3c and C3d). The stone path offers solid footing, but anyone who steps off the path finds that the ash-caked mud is difficult terrain. The six stone lanterns that flank the path at area C3c are meant to burn cone-shaped incense, and offer enough protection to allow such burning even in a rainstorm.

When the PCs first arrive, the place appears to have burned relatively recently. The cottage (area C3b) is badly burned, but enough of the roof remains intact to offer at least some shelter from the rainstorm. The garden shrine itself is located in the stone building in the back (area C3d), the contents of which survived the fire intact. Additional supplies for upkeep and repair were stored here. A PC can use these to patch up the roof and walls in the main cottage with a successful @Check[crafting|dc:18] check and an hour’s work (failure indicating that the supplies were ruined in the attempt). Once these repairs are made, the PCs can sleep in area C3b comfortably; otherwise, when they awaken the next day, the damp causes them to rise @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] save.

Creatures: Unlike the Bridge Shrine (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b3bridgeshri00]{B3}) and the Mountain Shrine (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08d3mountainsh00]{D3}), the Garden Shrine once had keepers to tend to it. Four caretakers dwelled here, shrine tenders who took great delight in providing travelers with a comfortable place to stay at the approximate halfway point to the Tan Sugi monastery. The caretakers enjoyed providing meals and comforts for pilgrims, but after the monastery was abandoned, the group opted to stay on, living as hermits who would periodically offer shelter to the odd traveler. This all came to an end in 7062, when the woodcutters sought out the Tan Sugi monastery. The caretakers tried to turn the woodcutters away but were unsuccessful... and when the woodcutters returned along the path that evening as undead monsters, they lit the Garden Shrine on fire.

Garden Shrine Moderate 5

@UUID[Actor.oqbHWrUNTjCbeGmK]{Shrine Caretakers (4)}

The shrine’s caretakers died in that fire and now exist as undead. They rise up from the ashes as soon as the PCs enter area C3b, crying out in pain as the sensation of their bodies burning drives them to attack.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.psCcz5htBhSFHIGf]{Garden Shrine} @UUID[Actor.6O9IZRG3Cr0C7KYK]{Incense Burner}
A search of the shrine (area C3d) uncovers the repair supplies, along with a clay pot containing a dozen cones of lavender incense. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[nature|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[religion|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge knows that lavender incense is said to stimulate the appetite. Each cone of incense is worth 25 gp. A PC who Searches the shrine and succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check also discovers a cunningly crafted silver and oak incense burner that shields the incense within from being extinguished by wind and rain. This incense burner is worth 50 gp and is shaped like a dragon’s head, so that the smoke wafts from its nostrils.

If the PCs place a cone of this incense in each of the stone lanterns at area C3c and light them, a feeling of calm settles over the area. If the combusted at area C3b haven’t yet been encountered, the incense causes them to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} during any combats.

Once lit, the cones of incense continue to burn in the lanterns for the remainder of this act.

Enlightenment Reward: @UUID[Actor.y9JYS9xak3tg6jSg]{Roots} @UUID[Item.p8njZzf4ZZXcz6VW]{Garden Shrine Enlightenment}
If the PCs light incense in all six of the lanterns and then spend the night here, they find a fresh layer of green grass has sprung up from the ashes. A half-dozen bright blue orchids have likewise bloomed among the roots of the burned oak tree. If the PCs approach the oak tree, they are overcome with the urge to pluck all six of the flowers. Each of these flowers, upon being plucked, becomes a consumable item that can be activated as if it were a dose of lesser healing vapor.

Whether or not the PCs pluck the flowers, they all gain a +1 item bonus from the shrine to all Will saving throws until the end of this act. Grant the PCs 40 XP for achieving enlightenment from the Garden Shrine.

The Girl in the Tree.name: 树上的女孩 The Girl in the Tree
The Girl in the Tree.text:
C2. 树上的女孩 低阶 5

这场遭遇发生在日落前数小时，使用“林中道路”地图。

生物：当玩家角色旅行时，他们听见道路边一棵枯树底部的大树洞里传来一名年轻女子的啜泣声。那声音夹杂着抽噎与哭喊：“姐姐！你在哪里？姐姐，救救我！”

这些哀切的求救声来自一名看似年轻的人类女子，名叫耶里，此刻正蜷缩在空心树底部。7098年（从玩家角色的视角来看，是10年前），耶里的姐姐尤妮怂恿她偷偷溜出城镇，沿着朝圣之径前行，去查看那座废弃寺院，以此作为一场激将。她们愚蠢地在下午离开城镇，也没有沿着道路慢慢前行。夜幕降临时，两姐妹遭到一个可怖怪物的袭击——一只庞南加兰。在那场战斗中，两人失散了。尤妮最终一路抵达废弃寺院，并在那里迎来自己的结局（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2}）；而耶里则被庞南加兰杀死。

当柳岸镇心景形成时，苦迦菩提的影响将耶里的灵魂拉了回来，并把她变成了杀死她的那种东西——庞南加兰。每天，耶里都会从一场她以为自己正被“飞头”追赶的噩梦中醒来，然后到朝圣之径附近寻找栖身之处，等待姐姐归来。然而每到夜晚，她都会屈从于自己的新本性，从自己的身体里滑出，并在林地中猎杀受害者。她死去的那棵空心树像多数庞南加兰使用醋浴那样，起着防腐保存的作用，而每次醒来时，她都会忘记自己究竟是什么。

以耶里的模样出现时，这只庞南加兰看起来只是个相貌平平的人类女子，穿着肮脏的衣服，无论走到哪里都紧紧抓着一串念珠不放。如果有人问起那些珠子，她会说那是母亲留给她的遗物，也是她唯一能借以怀念母亲的东西，一直都能带给她安慰。她把那件高领外套紧紧裹在身上；如果玩家角色问起，她会声称自己觉得冷。不过，若有玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:22] 检定，就会瞥见一道淡淡的伤疤环绕她的整个脖颈。一旦玩家角色开始与她交互，他们可以尝试进行一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20] 或 @Check[society|dc:25] 检定，以认出她是10年前失踪的人。

树上的女孩 低阶 5

@UUID[Actor.FSNsRYYrZZAkpI6Z]{耶里}

伪装起来的怪物恳求玩家角色帮助护送她前往废弃寺院，并说她的姐姐尤妮正在那里等她。如果玩家角色同意并护送她，那么在夜幕降临后不久，她的真正本性就会占据上风，她的头会从身体上脱离；当玩家角色准备夜间休息时，她会发动攻击。如果玩家角色拒绝护送她去寺院（无论是把她丢下，还是试图护送她返回柳岸镇），或者如果他们当面指出她已经失踪了整整十年，她就会愈发痛苦不安，直到最后她的怪物本性彻底接管，她的头与身体分离，并当场发动攻击。一旦她开始攻击，她就会战斗至死。

场景注记效果

将 @UUID[Item.81DaM7bFuyCIC4ce]{耶里真形态} 效果拖到她身上以关闭她的伪装

奖励： @UUID[Actor.cpzbP3nJ7aUfa90Q]{耶里之手镯}
庞南加兰一被杀死，她的身体便崩解成尘土，留下一道耶里身为人类时的幽灵影像。随着身影逐渐消散，她请求玩家角色去找到她的姐姐尤妮，“也救救她。”随后，耶里的幽灵形态彻底消失，只留下一只手镯，上面镶着一个描绘有 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐} 车轮状徽记的魅惑。这个手镯可作为一个抗力护符使用，提供对心灵伤害的抗力 5。

C2. The Girl in the Tree Low 5

This encounter takes place a few hours before sunset, and uses the Forested Path map.

Creatures: As the PCs travel, they hear the sound of a young woman sobbing coming from a large hollow at the base of a dead tree at the edge of the road. The sounds are interrupted by hiccuping sobs and cries of “Big sister! Where are you? Big sister, help me!”

These plaintive calls for help come from what appears to be a young human woman named Yeri, who now huddles in the hollow tree’s base. In 7098 (10 years ago, from the PCs’ perspective), Yeri’s big sister, Yuni, convinced her to sneak out of town and walk along the Pilgrim’s Path on a dare to check out the abandoned monastery. Foolishly, they left town in the afternoon and didn’t bother to walk the path slowly. As night fell, the two sisters were attacked by a horrifying monster—a penanggalan. In the fight, the two women were separated. Yuni eventually made her way to the abandoned monastery where she met her fate (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2}), while Yeri was slain by the penanggalan.

When the Willowshore mindscape came to be, Kugaptee’s influence drew back Yeri’s soul and transformed her into the very thing that slew her—a penanggalan. Every day, Yeri wakes from what she believes was a nightmare of being chased by a “flying head,” then seeks shelter near the Pilgrim’s Path to wait for her sister to return. Every night, however, she succumbs to her new nature, slithers out of her body, and hunts the woodlands for victims. The hollow tree she died in serves as a preservative force in the same manner most penanggalans use baths of vinegar, and each time she wakes she forgets what she is.

As Yeri, the penanggalan appears as a plain-looking human woman dressed in filthy clothes and clutching a string of beads tightly wherever she goes. If asked about the beads, she says she inherited them from her mother, and as the one thing she has to remember her by, they’ve always brought her comfort. She keeps her high-collared jacket wrapped tightly around herself, claiming that she’s cold if the PCs ask, but a PC who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:22] check catches a glimpse of a faint scar that curls all the way around her neck. Once the PCs begin to interact with her, they can attempt a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20] or a @Check[society|dc:25] check to recognize her as someone who went missing 10 years ago.

The Girl in the Tree Low 5

@UUID[Actor.FSNsRYYrZZAkpI6Z]{Yeri}

The disguised monster begs the PCs to help escort her to the abandoned monastery, saying that her big sister Yuni is waiting for her there. If the PCs agree and escort her, soon after night falls, her true nature takes over and her head detaches from her body; she attacks as the PCs prepare to rest for the night. If the PCs refuse to escort her to the monastery (be it by leaving her behind or trying to escort her back to Willowshore), or if they confront her with the fact that she’s been missing for a decade, she grows increasingly distraught until finally her monstrous nature takes over and her head detaches, driving her to attack on the spot. Once she attacks, she fights to the death.

Scene NotesEffect

Drag on the @UUID[Item.81DaM7bFuyCIC4ce]{Yeri True Form} effect to turn off her disguise

Reward: @UUID[Actor.cpzbP3nJ7aUfa90Q]{Yeri's Bracelet}
As soon as the penanggalan is slain, her body crumbles to dust, leaving behind a ghostly image of Yeri as a human. As she fades away, she asks the PCs to find her sister Yuni “and save her too.” Yeri’s ghostly form then fades entirely, leaving behind a bracelet fitted with a charm depicting the wheel-like symbol of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi}. This bracelet functions as a charm of resistance that provides resistance 5 against mental damage.

Hungry Foliage.name: 饥饿植被 Hungry Foliage
Hungry Foliage.text:
C1. 饥饿植被 Low 5

这场遭遇发生在正午前几小时，并使用湖边道路地图。

饥饿植被 Low 5

@UUID[Actor.w4cMEYdLNsIGExc0]{曼德拉草（2）}

生物：苦迦菩提的死亡梦境影响的不只是动物生命，也影响了心景中的植物生命。在这段道路旁，靠森林一侧有一对扭曲、破损的木瘤，看似正静静躺着，实际上却是嗜血的曼德拉草。当PC们靠近时，这些可怖的植物会抽搐着活过来；当它们舒展开自己略带人形的轮廓时，便狂热地低声重复着“苦迦菩提”这个词。再加上它们那变形扭曲的身躯，这应当会让PC们想起他们很可能在前一幕于旧伐木营地中遭遇过的那座供奉苦迦菩提的怪异圣祠。这些曼德拉草会战斗至死。

场景注记宏

@UUID[Macro.uP7USCiZANNgWNDH]{揭示曼陀罗草}

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.44SXNgKaR1jwTnJd]{被杀死的曼陀罗草}
每当一株曼陀罗草被杀死时，它都会在裂成两半、露出核心处的一块结晶血块之前，最后一次高喊苦迦菩提之名。每一块这样的血块都是一枚恐惧宝石护符。

C1. Hungry Foliage Low 5

This encounter takes place a few hours before noon, and uses the Lakeside Path map.

Hungry Foliage Low 5

@UUID[Actor.w4cMEYdLNsIGExc0]{Mandragoras (2)}

Creatures: Kugaptee’s death dreams have influenced not just the animal life, but the plant life in the mindscape as well. At this point along the path, a pair of twisted, broken burls of wood resting on the forest side of the path are in fact bloodthirsty mandragoras. The hideous plants twitch to life as the PCs approach, and as they unfold into their vaguely human shapes, they feverishly whisper the word, “Kugaptee.” Coupled with their distorted frames, this should remind the PCs of the strange shrine to Kugaptee that they likely encountered in the lumber camp in the previous act. The mandragoras fight to the death.

Scene NotesMacro

@UUID[Macro.uP7USCiZANNgWNDH]{Reveal Mandragoras}

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.44SXNgKaR1jwTnJd]{Slain Mandragoras}
Each time a mandragora is slain, it cries out Kugaptee’s name one last time before splitting in half to reveal a clot of crystallized blood at its core. Each of these clots is a fear gem talisman.

The Second Day.name: 第二天 The Second Day
The Second Day.text:
第二天

阴云愈发昏暗，到了中午，雨开始落下。这场雨会扑灭小型烈焰，使察觉检定承受–1环境减值，并逐渐带来不适（@UUID[Item.3gSA40OFOjamNrKS]{天气：雨}）。当PC们在一天结束时接近园圃圣祠时，每人都必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:18] 豁免，以抵抗因降雨而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}。那些采取了充分预防措施以避免在阴冷雨中旅行所带来的不适的角色（例如施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5esP2GVzvxWsMgaX]{Environmental Endurance}，或穿着 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.SLQgdLk5K9JV4ACF]{冬衣}）会自动在此次豁免中成功。入夜后，雨势加剧为倾盆大雨，使察觉检定的减值增加至–2，并使60尺外的生物变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}（@UUID[Item.5AbRQ2qUL8IiC20b]{天气：倾盆大雨}）。

这一天前半段的路程沿着镜湖湖岸前进，随后沿着西杉川的北岸行进。到了后半天，道路开始蜿蜒上升，但还未真正进入山地地形。周围的森林也变得越来越杂乱茂密。

The Second Day

The overcast clouds grow darker, and by noon, rain starts to fall. This rain douses small flames, imparts a –1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks, and increasingly causes discomfort (@UUID[Item.3gSA40OFOjamNrKS]{Weather: Rain}). As the PCs approach the Garden Shrine at the end of the day, each must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} by the rainfall. Characters who took significant precautions to avoid the discomfort of traveling in the chill rain (such as by casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5esP2GVzvxWsMgaX]{Environmental Endurance} or wearing @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.SLQgdLk5K9JV4ACF]{Winter Clothing}) automatically succeed at this saving throw. Once evening sets in, the rain worsens to a downpour, increasing the Perception check penalty to –2 and causing creatures further than 60 feet away to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} (@UUID[Item.5AbRQ2qUL8IiC20b]{Weather: Downpour}).

The first half of the day’s walk is along the shore of Mirror Lake and then along the northern bank of the West Sugi River. By the second half of the day, the path begins to wind upward in elevation but doesn’t quite enter truly mountainous terrain. The surrounding forest becomes more and more overgrown.

Bridge Shrine.name: 桥神龛 Bridge Shrine
Bridge Shrine.text:
B3. 桥神龛 中等 5

这场遭遇发生在傍晚，玩家角色抵达桥神龛时正值日落时分。它使用朝圣之径桥梁地图。

小路通向河岸边，一座二十尺宽的绳桥悬挂在下方缓缓流动的河面上方六码左右。河中央立着一座六角形木制圣祠，其屋顶既可遮风避雨，也在中央留出一个观景孔，让身处圣祠中的人能够凝视下方的流水。几只长柄舀子斜靠在中央孔洞的栏杆旁，用来舀取河水饮用，旁边还放着半打看起来很脆弱的陶瓶。中央孔洞周围共铺着六张藤席，供人睡在河面之上。

大师 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠} 最初沿镜湖北半边开辟道路时，需要在北杉川注入湖中的地方架设一座桥。她没有建造宏伟的大桥，而是在河上的一点搭起了一座简朴的绳桥，并在中央竖起一座六角木亭来帮助固定桥体。这座亭子便是朝圣之径三座圣祠中的第一座——旅人可以在过桥途中于此避风歇脚，并透过平台中央的开口凝视下方河流，以沉思水流之道。

智惠认为，在镜湖岸边度过的时光能让人有机会自我观察与反思。她希望朝圣者在摆脱他人的干扰与日常琐事之后，能够从自己的倒影中看见真正的自己，看见卸下重负后的本相。为此，每位朝圣者都会吟诵一段重复的祷词，以祈请轮回之循环，随后在轻柔流淌的水面上方入睡。任何在宗教上达到专家的玩家角色，或追随 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐} 的玩家角色，都能自动从本地传闻中知晓此事；其他人则可以尝试进行一次 @Check[religion|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:回忆知识] 检定来回忆知识。

任何在一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:回忆知识] 检定中成功回忆知识的玩家角色都会想起，这座圣祠早在十年前的一场洪水中被冲走了；然而如今它却矗立在这里，看上去维护良好，却依然遭到废弃。

这里的河水有 10 尺深，角色可以通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:游泳] 来在河中游泳。

桥神龛 中等 5

@UUID[Actor.y562LBc0r0z2Blp4]{育群水蛭群 (2)} @UUID[Actor.HWtCD42iNa7c0ljo]{溺死鬼的邀请}

生物：两群嗜血成性的育群水蛭栖息在圣祠下方的水中，这团不断扭动的掠食者通常只会威胁进入水里的目标，但在弥漫于圣祠中的作祟影响下，这些育群水蛭会变得危险得多。一旦水蛭群猛然涌入圣祠，它们就会显露出另一种令人不安的特质：当它们在地板上翻滚蠕动时，会反复组成“苦迦菩提”这个词。育群水蛭一旦开始战斗，便会战至死亡，不过它们不会追逐猎物超出地图边缘。

危害：无论玩家角色决定停下休息还是继续过桥，在他们抵达中央圣祠后不久（或者，只要有游泳的玩家角色到达河道中央），下方河面的水就会开始剧烈翻腾。最初看起来像是河水鼓泡翻涌到水面，但很快就会化作一幕梦魇般的景象：数以百计的幽魂之臂从湖底深处攀爬而出。溺亡者的精魂积聚在这片水域中，在苦迦菩提的影响下变得狂怒。这些手臂向两侧伸出，抓住桥面的木板，同时也会从圣祠中央的孔洞里探出，或越过外围栏杆升起，以便更好地抓向玩家角色。

就在这次作祟启动的同时，一股水柱会从圣祠中央的孔洞中喷出，把两群育群水蛭都抛进圣祠内，使它们能够攻击中央结构中的玩家角色。

场景注记音效

@UUID[Playlist.kcrfM86DAcpOfBrs.PlaylistSound.R45UNuhZVL66clwa]{溺死鬼的邀请}

启悟奖励： @UUID[Actor.KzJEE1VlV9Cz6DrW]{舀子} @UUID[Item.jccZj7Xyr8EjPzEc]{桥梁神殿启悟}
如果玩家角色击败了作祟和水蛭群，并在圣祠中过夜，他们醒来时会神清气爽，却发现那些舀子已经神秘地盛满了河水。若他们靠近这些舀子，也会被一种奇异的冲动驱使，想用它们将六只陶瓶装满；这样做会使这六只瓶子中的每一只都变成中等镇魂炸药。

无论玩家角色是否制造出这些炼金炸弹，他们都会从这座圣祠获得 +1 物品加值，加在直到本幕结束前的所有反射豁免骰上。此外，因从桥神龛获得启悟，给予玩家角色 40 XP。

B3. Bridge Shrine Moderate 5

This encounter takes place in the evening, with the PCs arriving at the Bridge Shrine just as the sun is setting. It uses the Pilgrim’s Path Bridge map.

The path leads up to a river’s edge, where a twenty-foot-wide rope bridge hangs a half-dozen feet over the slowly flowing river surface below. A hexagonal wooden shrine stands in the center of the river, its roof providing shelter from the elements while also offering a viewing portal in the center to allow those in the shrine to contemplate the flow of water below. Several long-handled dippers for bringing up drafts of river water for drinking lean against the central hole’s railing, along with a half-dozen delicate-looking clay vials. A total of six wicker mats lie around this central hole, affording places to sleep above the river.

Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}’s original path along the northern half of Mirror Lake required the construction of a bridge over the North Sugi River, where it flows into the lake. Rather than build something grandiose, she had a simple rope bridge constructed over a point in the river, then erected a hexagonal wooden pagoda at the center to help anchor the bridge. This pagoda is the first of the Pilgrim’s Path’s three shrines—a place where travelers could take shelter mid-crossing and gaze through an opening at the platform’s center to contemplate the river’s flow below.

Zhi Hui felt that time spent along the shore of Mirror Lake provided an opportunity for self-observation and reflection. She hoped that pilgrims, when stripped of the distractions of others and the mundane problems of daily life, might see in their reflections a true vision of who they are when unburdened. To aid in this, each pilgrim would chant a repetitive prayer meant to invoke the cycle of reincarnation, then retire to sleep above the gently flowing waters. Any PC who’s an expert in Religion or who follows @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi} knows this from local lore automatically, while others can attempt a @Check[religion|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge.

Any PC who succeeds at a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge remembers that the shrine washed away a decade ago during a flood, yet here it stands, looking well-cared for but still abandoned.

The river here is 10 feet deep, and a character can Swim in the river with a @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim].

Bridge Shrine Moderate 5

@UUID[Actor.y562LBc0r0z2Blp4]{Brood Leech Swarms (2)} @UUID[Actor.HWtCD42iNa7c0ljo]{Arms of the Drowned}

Creatures: Two swarms of blood-ravenous brood leeches dwell in the water under the shrine, a tangle of writhing predators that normally would pose a threat only to those who enter the water, but combined with the haunting that infuses the shrine, these brood leeches are likely to become much more dangerous. Once the leech swarms surge up into the shrine, they display an additional unnerving quality; as they seethe on the floors, they form the word “Kugaptee” over and over as they swarm about. Once the brood leeches begin combat, they fight to the death, though they won’t pursue prey beyond the edges of the map.

Hazard: Whether the PCs decide to stay and rest or continue across the bridge, shortly after they arrive at the central shrine itself (or as soon as a swimming PC reaches the halfway point across the river), the surface of the river below starts rippling violently. What at first appears to be water bubbling up to the surface quickly resolves into a nightmarish vision of hundreds of ghostly arms scrambling up out of the water from the lake’s depths. Spirits of the drowned have accumulated in these waters, driven to fury by Kugaptee’s influence. These hands reach up on either side to grab onto the bridge’s planks, but also rise through the hole at the center of the shrine or up over its outer railings, the better to snatch at the PCs.

At the same time that this haunt activates, a plume of water sprays up through the central hole in the shrine, tossing both swarms of brood leeches up into the shrine and allowing them to attack PCs in the central structure.

Scene NotesSFX

@UUID[Playlist.kcrfM86DAcpOfBrs.PlaylistSound.R45UNuhZVL66clwa]{Arms of the Drowned}

Enlightenment Reward: @UUID[Actor.KzJEE1VlV9Cz6DrW]{Dippers} @UUID[Item.jccZj7Xyr8EjPzEc]{Bridge Shrine Enlightenment}
If the PCs defeat the haunt and the leech swarms, then spend the night in the shrine, they awaken refreshed but find that the dippers have mysteriously filled with water from the river. Should they approach the dippers, they are also filled with the strange urge to use them to fill the six clay vials; doing so causes each of the six vials to become a moderate ghost charge.

Whether or not the PCs create these alchemical bombs, they all gain a +1 item bonus from the shrine to all Reflex saving throws until the end of this act. In addition, grant the PCs 40 XP for achieving enlightenment from the Bridge Shrine.

Serpent Ambush.name: 巨蛇伏击 Serpent Ambush
Serpent Ambush.text:
B2. 巨蛇伏击 低阶 5

这场遭遇发生在午后时分。这场遭遇使用湖边道路地图。

巨蛇伏击 低阶 5

@UUID[Actor.GXD32AEKyWiklTim]{双头蛇（2）}

生物： 柳岸镇以西的荒野素以危险闻名，而在玩家角色开始旅程后不久，他们就遭到这样的危险伏击：一对双头蛇。两只怪物分别潜伏在道路两侧，一只藏匿在森林地板上的杂物中，另一只则埋伏在湖边的浅水中。当玩家角色从它们之间经过时，这两只怪物便会发动攻击，并战斗至死。

如果玩家角色正在护送圆光，其中一头野兽会攻击他，除非玩家角色采取措施保护他。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.lcWo3ru9KtGgOMM2]{恩科的馈赠}
如果玩家角色护送圆光到达湖边，并且他在这场战斗中幸存，这名河童会感激地扑通一声跳进湖里，如释重负地叹了口气，然后告诉玩家角色“就在这里等几分钟”。他在水下游了一阵，5分钟后返回，带回一些他知道卡在附近一艘沉船里的宝物。他将这些物品——一把+1 强击银制短剑和一根插在下等百炼盾上的环境忍耐魔杖——赠予他们，以感谢他们的善意。

奖励：如果玩家角色成功护送圆光到水边，给予他们 40 XP。

B2. Serpent Ambush Low 5

This encounter takes place in the mid-afternoon. Use the Lakeside Path map for this encounter.

Serpent Ambush Low 5

@UUID[Actor.GXD32AEKyWiklTim]{Amphisbaenas (2)}

Creatures: The wilderness west of Willowshore is known for its dangers, and it isn’t long after the PCs begin their journey that they’re ambushed by such a peril in the form of a pair of amphisbaenas. The two monsters lie in wait on either side of the path, one hidden among the detritus of the forest floor and another in the shallow water at the lake’s edge. As the PCs pass between them, the monsters attack, fighting to the death.

If the PCs are escorting Enko, one of the beasts attacks him unless the PCs take steps to defend him.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.lcWo3ru9KtGgOMM2]{Enko's Gift}
If the PCs escorted Enko to the lake and he survives this fight, the kappa gratefully splashes into the lake and sighs in relief, then tells the PCs to “wait right there for a few minutes.” He swims underwater, then returns 5 minutes later with treasures he knew had been lodged in a sunken boat nearby. He gives them these items—a +1 striking silver shortsword and a wand of environmental endurance carried on a minor sturdy shield—as thanks for their kindness.

Reward: If the PCs successfully escort Enko to the water, grant them 40 XP.

Tormented Kappa.name: 受折磨的河童 Tormented Kappa
Tormented Kappa.text:
B1. 受折磨的河童 低阶 5

这场遭遇发生在玩家角色开始旅程后不久，并使用林中道路地图。

生物：玩家角色开始跋涉约30分钟后，他们会发现一名落单的河童正以蜗牛般的速度沿着道路前行，方向与玩家角色一致。这名河童名叫圆光，他曾被一名名为尤伽喀的风暴鬼婆欺骗；当她让圆光跪伏在地乞命时，圆光把自己头碗里的水洒了出来。尤伽喀被这河童逗得十分开心，便一把抓起惊恐万分的圆光，带着残忍而得意的咯咯笑声飞上天空，把他丢在了幽魂之墙附近，远离任何水源。

圆光一直在艰难地往镜湖的家中赶路，想用自己5尺的速度回去把头碗重新装满水，但每当微风拂过时，他还是会惊恐地喊叫并挥舞双臂。这阵“微风”其实是尤伽喀借助她的风暴之声能力传来的声音；她不断向圆光低声施以折磨，承诺每次只要他回到家，她就会一次又一次把他抓起来，丢到“世界的尽头”。

一看见玩家角色，圆光就立刻伏倒在地，乞求饶命。他为自己挡了玩家角色的路而连连道歉，并可怜兮兮地爬到道路一旁让他们通过，但他不会攻击，甚至连看都不敢看任何玩家角色一眼。圆光惊惧而戒备；因此，他的初始态度为不友善。若态度变为敌对，他也不会攻击，而只会因恐惧而昏厥。若态度至少变为冷淡，圆光就会解释自己的困境，希望玩家角色不是尤伽喀的爪牙。时不时地，又会有更多低声讥嘲传入圆光耳中，让他惊恐地叫出声来。若一名玩家角色凑近细听，便可通过一次成功的@Check[perception|dc:15]检定听见尤伽喀折磨他的低语。幸运的是，这名风暴鬼婆无法知道圆光是否刚刚遇到了盟友——她的风暴之声能力是单向的。

圆光唯一的愿望就是回家；如果玩家角色提出护送他，他简直不敢相信自己竟有如此好运。事实上，在重新回到水中之前，他始终都会保持戒备与紧张；一旦回到水里，他对玩家角色的态度就会变为友善。若玩家角色在抵达湖边前就帮他把头碗灌满水，他就会变得乐于助人。若没有这份怜悯，玩家角色如果想在夜幕降临前赶到镜湖（以及桥神龛），可能就得背着他走；以如此缓慢的速度，在心景扭曲距离的效果下，玩家角色一天之内无法走完那么远的路。

如果玩家角色帮助了圆光，他会一遍又一遍地向他们道谢，几乎到了荒谬的地步。如果提到尤伽喀，圆光也会警告玩家角色，那位“暴风母”是一头可怕而骇人的怪物，能掷出闪电，并释放出足以将血肉从骨头上剥离的狂风冲击。圆光不清楚尤伽喀最近为何开始折磨他，但如果他至少是友善的，就会告诉玩家角色：她对焚香的气味怀有一种特别而古怪的厌恶——这是一个弱点，不过圆光也提醒说，考虑到尤伽喀对风的精通，这个弱点很难被利用。

圆光被困在心景之中，对于这诅咒的本质并没有什么见解，只知道诅咒的边界是沿着朝圣者之路延伸的。虽然他哀叹自己再也不能在湖里来回畅游了，但他已经适应了如今这种新的生活——尽管孤独。

@UUID[Actor.2IVaUeniTciZmadu]{圆光}生物 2

B1. Tormented Kappa Low 5

This encounter takes place soon after the PCs begin their journey and uses the Forested Path map.

Creatures: About 30 minutes after the PCs begin their trek, they find a lone kappa trudging at a snail’s pace down the path in the same direction the PCs are heading. This kappa, whose name is Enko, was tricked by a storm hag named Iogaka into spilling the water in his head bowl when she told him to beg for his life on his hands and knees. Thoroughly entertained by the kappa, Iogaka picked the terrified Enko up and flew into the air with him in her clutches, cackling with cruel delight and dropping him off near the Wall of Ghosts, far from any source of water.

Enko has been painstakingly making his way back home in Mirror Lake using his 5-foot speed to refill his head bowl with water, but now and then cries out in fear and waves his arms as a slight breeze wafts by. This “breeze” is Iogaka’s voice, carried via her voice of the storm ability, and she issues tormenting whispers to Enko as she promises to pick him up and drop him off “at the edge of the world” over and over whenever he gets back to his home.

Upon spotting the PCs, Enko drops down on his hands and knees and begs for mercy. He apologizes for getting in the PCs’ way and crawls pitifully to the side of the path to let them pass, but doesn’t attack or even look a PC in the eye. Enko is frightened and wary; as a result, his initial attitude is unfriendly. If made hostile, he doesn’t attack but instead just faints from fear. If made at least indifferent, Enko explains his plight, hoping that the PCs aren’t Iogaka’s agents. Now and then, more whispered taunts reach Enko’s ears, causing him to cry out in fear. A PC who leans in close can hear Iogaka’s torments with a successful @Check[perception|dc:15] check. Fortunately, the storm hag has no way to tell that Enko might have just met allies—her voice of the storm ability is one-way only.

Enko only wants to get back home, and if the PCs offer to escort him, he can’t believe his luck. In fact, he remains wary and nervous until he’s back in the water, at which point his attitude toward the PCs becomes friendly. If the PCs refill his head bowl with water before reaching the lake, he becomes helpful. Without this mercy, the PCs might need to carry him if they want to make it to Mirror Lake (and the Bridge Shrine) by nightfall; at such a slow speed, the mindscape’s distance-distorting effects don’t allow the PCs to cover that much ground in a day.

If the PCs assist Enko, he thanks them over and over to the point of near absurdity. If the topic of Iogaka comes up, he also warns the PCs that the “storm mother” is a terrible and frightening monster who can hurl lightning and blasts of wind that can strip flesh from bone. Enko isn’t sure why Iogaka took to tormenting him recently, but if he’s at least friendly, he’ll tell the PCs that she’s got a particular and strange distaste for the scent of burning incense—a weakness that Enko warns is tough to take advantage of, given Iogaka’s mastery over wind.

Enko is trapped in the mindscape and has no insights into the nature of the curse other than to note that the edges of the curse follow the Pilgrim’s Path. Though he laments that he can’t do laps across the lake anymore, he has acclimated to his new (if lonely) life.

@UUID[Actor.2IVaUeniTciZmadu]{Enko}Creature 2

The First Day.name: 第一天 The First Day
The First Day.text:
第一天

当PC们前往桥神龛时，天气清冷多云。PC们知道，从鬼墙（区域A）到桥神龛（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b3bridgeshri00]{B3}）的实际距离约为5英里，但这段沿朝圣之径的旅程本就是要缓慢前行，好让旅人在日落时分抵达圣祠。一天行程的前半段，道路蜿蜒穿过茂密的树林；而下午走过的路线则沿着镜湖湖岸弯曲延伸。在这里，当PC们眺望湖面时，他们能一直看到对岸，以及更远处的群山。然而，若游泳者继续向湖中前进，超过几百英尺之后，便会回到柳岸镇心景的边缘。

当PC们沿朝圣之径继续前行时，还有一件事应当注意：这条道路竟保存得异常完好。这条路曾经行人如织，但在寺院被废弃后的46年里，道路早已杂草丛生，并且越来越与周围的林地难以区分。然而，当PC们行走其上时，朝圣之径却显现出它半个多世纪前仍在使用时的模样。

The First Day

As the PCs make their way toward the Bridge Shrine, the weather is crisp and cloudy. While the PCs know that the physical distance from the Wall of Ghosts (area A) and the Bridge Shrine (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08b3bridgeshri00]{B3}) is about 5 miles, this leg of the journey along the Pilgrim’s Path was intended to be taken slowly, so that the traveler arrived at the shrine at sunset. For the first half of the day spent traveling, the path winds through dense forest, while the route traveled in the afternoon curves along the shore of Mirror Lake. Here, as the PCs look out over the lake, they can see all the way to the opposite shore to the mountains beyond. Traveling further than a few hundred feet out into the lake, however, brings a swimmer back to the edge of the Willowshore mindscape.

One thing the PCs should note as they travel further down the Pilgrim’s Path is how strangely preserved it appears. The road was once well-traveled, but in the 46 years since the monastery was abandoned, the road became overgrown and increasingly indistinguishable from the surrounding woodland. As the PCs travel it, though, the Pilgrim’s Path appears as it did while it was in use over half a century ago.

Walking the Path.name: 行走道路 Walking the Path
Walking the Path.text:
行走道路

无论玩家角色打算离开多久，心景都会受到传统四日旅程的影响。为了抵达那座毁坏的寺院，玩家角色必须花费这四天三夜，遵循朝圣之径的传统前行。可以考虑让信藏在玩家角色出发前不久造访柳岸镇，好让他们有最后一次购买补给的机会；如果某位玩家角色此前有“订购”的物品，那么这些物品此时都应当可以取得，无论他们原本预计还要等待多久。

一旦玩家角色穿过鬼打墙并开始他们的旅程，他们很快就会意识到，这里的现实甚至比柳岸腹地还要受限。朝圣之径（以及在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{Chapter 7}中详述的丹杉寺院建筑群）是心景中唯一可进入的地区。若某个角色离开朝圣之径，进入周围林木茂盛的群山中旅行，那么在失去对小路的视线后不久，他们就会发现自己又回到了朝圣之径上，仿佛在没有察觉方向改变的情况下被调转了回来。这甚至也会影响飞行；若某个角色飞到高于120英尺的地方，他们会发现自己逐渐偏转并重新向下，但在此之前，他们会注意到，大约半英里外树梢上方的清晰视觉线会被雾气遮蔽。只要玩家角色留在朝圣之径上，他们就可以不受阻碍地向任一方向旅行。

另一个奇特之处在于，沿着朝圣之径的旅行无法加快。无论队伍移动得多快或多慢，他们都会在旅行8小时后抵达下一个路标圣祠（或者在第四天旅行时抵达寺院本身）。如果玩家角色朝柳岸镇的方向往回走，这种距离扭曲会更加明显，因为无论他们沿着这条道路已经走了多少天，回到鬼墙入口都绝不会花超过1小时。先前经过的圣祠会在返程中神秘地被跳过，而下一次队伍进入朝圣之径时，他们必须从头开始这段跋涉，依次再次造访每一座圣祠。值得注意的是，每座圣祠的状态都会保持为玩家角色上次造访时的模样；遭遇不会“重置”，留在圣祠中的物品或对其做出的改动也都会持续存在。

任何经历这些诡异现象的玩家角色都可以尝试一次@Check[occultism|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定来回忆知识；若成功，他们会得出结论：朝圣之径是困住柳岸镇及其腹地的同一种诅咒的一个更受限制的版本，而他们也会意识到，道路上正在发生的事，可能意味着在丹杉寺中有着关于这一诅咒本质的更深层启示等待发现。

朝圣之径沿途的天气与更广阔的柳岸镇心景并不同步，而是会随着旅程中的日期而变化。如果玩家角色撤退回柳岸镇，然后重新开始沿路上行，他们会在旅程的每一天再次经历同样的天气。

除非另有说明，否则朝圣之径周围的森林都属于困难地形。柳岸腹地的地图展示了这条小路的路线，以及旅途中数个遭遇发生的位置。

Walking the Path

Regardless of how long the PCs intend to be away, the mindscape is influenced by the traditional four-day journey. To reach the ruined monastery, the PCs must spend those four days and three nights following the Pilgrim’s Path traditions. Consider having Shinzo pay a visit to Willowshore just before the PCs set out in order to give them a last chance to purchase supplies; if a PC had items on “order,” then they should be available at this time, regardless of how much time they expected to have to wait.

Once the PCs step through the Wall of Ghosts and begin their trip, they soon realize that reality is even more confined here than in the Willowshore hinterlands. The Pilgrim’s Path (and the Tan Sugi monastery complex detailed in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther]{Chapter 7}) are the only regions accessible in the mindscape. A character who leaves the Pilgrim’s Path and travels into the surrounding wooded mountains finds themselves returning to the Pilgrim’s Path not long after losing sight of the trail, having been turned around without noticing the change in direction. This even affects flight; a character who flies higher than 120 feet finds themselves veering back downward, but not before noting that fog obscures clear line of sight over the treetops beyond a half mile or so. As long as the PCs remain on the Pilgrim’s Path, though, they can travel unimpeded in either direction.

Another curiosity is that travel along the Pilgrim’s Path can’t be rushed. No matter how fast or how slow the party moves, they reach the next waypoint shrine after 8 hours of travel (or the monastery itself on the fourth day of travel). This distortion of distance is even more noticeable if the PCs travel back toward Willowshore, for no matter how many days along the Path they’ve traveled, returning to the Wall of Ghosts entrance never takes more than an hour. Previously passed shrines are mysteriously skipped on a return trip, and the next time the party enters the Pilgrim’s Path, they must start their trek over from the beginning, revisiting each shrine in succession. Notably, the status of each shrine remains as it was the last time the PCs visited; encounters don’t “reset,” and items left or alterations made to the shrines persist.

A PC who experiences any of these strange effects can attempt a @Check[occultism|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge; on a success, they come to the conclusion that the Pilgrim’s Path is a more constrained version of the same curse that contains Willowshore and its hinterlands, and they realize that what’s happening on the Path could indicate that a deeper revelation about the nature of the curse awaits discovery at the Tan Sugi monastery.

The weather along the Pilgrim’s Path isn’t in sync with that in the greater Willowshore mindscape, and instead changes by the day along the journey. If the PCs retreat to Willowshore and start their walk up the Path over again, they experience the same weather on each day of the journey.

Unless otherwise indicated, the forest surrounding the Pilgrim’s Path is difficult terrain. The map of the Willowshore hinterlands shows the route that the path takes as well as where several of the encounters occur during the journey.

The Pilgrim’s Path.name: 朝圣之径 The Pilgrim’s Path
The Pilgrim’s Path.text:
朝圣之径

随着完成施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{打开鬼墙}的仪式，PC们如今可以自由踏上传统上从柳岸镇前往丹杉寺的步行之旅。不过在他们启程之前，先确保玩家们熟悉一些有关寺院和朝圣之径的通俗常识。这些信息也同样收录于《肆季鬼志：玩家指南》中。

通俗常识

丹杉寺由一位名叫@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐}、法号为@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}的武僧于7020年创建，寺院围绕着一棵据说具有神秘力量的古老杉树而建。柳岸镇最初建立的目的，是为了支援修建寺院以及通往寺院的那条漫长小路的人们；这条路也被称作朝圣之径。智惠于7054年圆寂，而随着寺中武僧们逐渐离去，柳岸镇的重心也转向了木材业。到了7060年，寺院已被彻底废弃；但在7062年，一群伐木工试图砍伐生长于那里的古老杉树时，悲剧降临了。那些伐木工带着破损的武器和残破撕裂的身躯回到了柳岸镇；尽管这些亡灵伐木工在天亮前就被击败，仍有数十名镇民死于他们那伤痕累累的工具之下。如今，这场事件被铭记为断刃之夜，而在此后46年里，几乎没有多少访客再踏上前往那座荒废寺院的旅程。那里被视为遭受诅咒、闹鬼，甚至更糟的地方；然而镇上仍有一些人忍不住会去猜想，那片废墟中是否还遗留着某些宝藏与学识。

寺院位于西方数十英里外一处与世隔绝的山谷中，四周环绕着陡峭山地。往返该地唯一安全的路线就是朝圣之径。尽管从柳岸镇沿朝圣之径前往寺院的最后一段路程只有13英里徒步距离，但传统上，那些寻求知识的人会缓慢地完成这段跋涉，并沿途在三座圣祠各停留一夜，总共过夜三次。这三座圣祠——一座位于湖中漂浮平台上，一座靠近一株古老的枯树，还有一座坐落在俯瞰下方道路的偏僻岩石高处——分别象征着旅者的前世、来世与今生。通过将这段短途徒步变成一次持续数日的冥想之旅，寻求知识与启迪之人便会培养出一种更适合领受丹杉寺武僧教诲的心境。

The Pilgrim’s Path

With the completion of the ritual to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{Open the Wall of Ghosts}, the PCs are free to undertake the traditional walk from Willowshore to the Tan Sugi monastery. Before they set off on the journey, though, make sure the players are familiar with commonplace lore about the monastery and the Pilgrim’s Path. This information is presented to the PCs in the Season of Ghosts Player’s Guide as well.

Common Knowledge

The Tan Sugi monastery was founded by a @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi} monk named @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} in 7020 and was built around an ancient sugi tree said to have mystic properties. Willowshore was originally founded to support those who built the monastery and the long trail that leads to it, also known as the Pilgrim’s Path. Zhi Hui passed away in 7054, and as the monks of the monastery began to drift away, Willowshore shifted focus to the lumber industry. By 7060, the monastery had been fully abandoned, but when a group of woodcutters attempted to harvest the ancient sugi trees that grew there in 7062, tragedy struck. The woodcutters returned to Willowshore with broken weapons and torn bodies, and while the undead woodcutters were defeated by morning, dozens of townsfolk perished to their battered tools. The event is remembered today as the Night of Broken Blades, and few visitors have made the journey to the ruined monastery in the 46 years since. The place is regarded as cursed, haunted, or worse, yet there are those in town who can’t help but wonder what treasures and lore might still lie abandoned in the ruins.

The monastery is located in a secluded valley many miles to the west, surrounded by steep mountains. The only safe route to and from the site is the Pilgrim’s Path. While the last stretch of the trip to the monastery from Willowshore along the Pilgrim’s Path is only a 13-mile hike, traditionally those who would seek knowledge made the trek slowly, pausing to spend the night three times at three shrines along the way. These shrines—one on a floating platform in a lake, one near an ancient dead tree, and one on a secluded, rocky perch overlooking the path below—represented the traveler’s past lives, their future lives, and their current life. By turning the short hike into a multiday meditative trip, the seeker of knowledge and enlightenment adopts a mindset better suited to receiving the teachings of the monks of the Tan Sugi monastery.

Planting the Soul Seed.name: 种下灵魂种子 Planting the Soul Seed
Planting the Soul Seed.text:
种下灵魂种子 低阶 5

一旦玩家角色们杀死了秃鹫和恶念魔，他们就可以从秃鹫临死前丢下心脏的地面上取回那颗被啃咬得有些残破的心脏。心脏里传出微弱的声音呼喊着“救救我”，这应当会促使玩家角色们这样做；而一旦有角色将其拾起，将这颗心脏送回区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08a2tansuijing00]{A2} 尸体的箱子中的冲动便会充满其脑海。

种下灵魂种子 低阶 5

@UUID[Actor.1J6BM3TWythOKBVA]{苦迦菩提的愤怒}

危害：心脏一被取走，心景的氛围便发生变化。夜晚降临，令雾气弥漫的森林陷入黑暗之中，末日将至与被窥视的感觉也愈发强烈。此时，苦迦菩提虽已死去却仍在做梦的心智开始更积极地对抗队伍，使以下危害在整个心景中显现。

场景备注音效

@UUID[Playlist.kcrfM86DAcpOfBrs.PlaylistSound.0O2KkeZV97joZxCt]{骇魂咆哮}

种下种子：与穗静身体相邻的一名玩家角色可以用一个交互动作将她的心脏放回去。这样做会让苦迦菩提的愤怒发出痛苦而挫败的嚎叫，随后听起来就像那个看不见的巨人正在逃跑，渐渐远去。穗静的身体沉入石中，接着一棵巨大的杉树从地面生长而出，吞没石头，并将所有相邻角色无害地推开。随着这棵树长到将近百尺高，它的枝条舒展开来，驱散了迷雾……随后现实逐渐淡去，玩家角色们发现自己已经回到了柳岸镇西北方、幽魂之墙附近的朝圣之径上。如今，穿过墙壁的那条迷雾隧道已经可以轻松通行。在此后整个战役的剩余时间里，穿过这条隧道都会让玩家角色们踏上朝圣之径，如本章其余部分所述。

奖励：玩家角色们获得朝圣之径的许可后，给予他们 60 XP。

Planting the Soul Seed Low 5

Once they’ve slain the vulture and cacodaemons, the PCs can retrieve the somewhat gnawed-upon heart from the ground where the vulture dropped it as it died. The sound of a faint voice calling out “save me” from the heart should encourage the PCs to do so, and once a character has picked it up, the urge to return the heart to the corpse’s chest in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08a2tansuijing00]{A2} fills their mind.

Planting the Soul Seed Low 5

@UUID[Actor.1J6BM3TWythOKBVA]{Kugaptee's Anger}

Hazard: As soon as the heart is taken, the ambiance of the mindscape shifts. Night falls, plunging the foggy forest into darkness, and the feelings of doom and of being watched intensify. At this time, Kugaptee’s dead but dreaming mind takes a more active role in opposing the party, causing the following hazard to manifest throughout the mindscape.

Scene NotesSFX

@UUID[Playlist.kcrfM86DAcpOfBrs.PlaylistSound.0O2KkeZV97joZxCt]{Terrifying Roar}

Planting the Seed: A PC who’s adjacent to Sui-Jing’s body can return her heart as an Interact action. Doing so causes Kugaptee’s Anger to howl in pain and frustration, then to sound as if the unseen giant were fleeing into the distance. Sui-Jing’s body sinks into the stone, and then an immense sugi tree grows up out of the ground, consuming the stone and harmlessly pushing any adjacent characters aside. As the tree grows to a height of nearly a hundred feet, its branches unfurl and drive away the fog... and then reality fades and the PCs find themselves back on the Pilgrim’s Path northwest of Willowshore near the Wall of Ghosts. Now, the foggy tunnel through the wall can be traversed with ease. For the remainder of the campaign, stepping through this tunnel sets the PCs onto the Pilgrim’s Path, as detailed in the remainder of this chapter.

Reward: Grant the PCs 60 XP for gaining access to the Pilgrim’s Path.

The Soulthief’s Nest.name: 窃魂者之巢 The Soulthief’s Nest
The Soulthief’s Nest.text:
A3. 窃魂者之巢 Low 5

这片空地中有一堆高达十尺的倒木，堆积成一座腐烂的土丘。腐朽的木料上溅满鲜血，中央的开口散发出一股污秽腐臭的恶臭。

窃魂者之巢 Low 5

@UUID[Actor.1kPkJWXmgiyZAWvn]{食心秃鹫} @UUID[Actor.i0pkcYhNLaxmMozr]{恶念魔 (3)}

生物：苦迦菩提对这处心景的影响显现为一只饥肠辘辘、拥有智慧的秃鹫；它蜷伏在自己的巢中，啃咬并啄食穗静的心脏。幸运的是，她的灵魂十分坚韧。秃鹫注意到PC们接近时，愤怒地咆哮起来，并用嘶哑的嗓音命令他们立刻离开，否则他们自己也会被添进它这顿美餐之中！随后它便发动攻击，而就在它动手的同时，三团血块从那颗心脏上猛然撕裂而出，化作尖声厉叫的恶念魔，看起来像是一张张扭曲的人脸——仔细观察后会发现，这些面孔与区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08a2tansuijing00]{A2}那具尸体的脸颇为相似，只是这些脸长着发光的黄色眼睛，口中布满锋利的牙齿。

如果PC们不立刻离开，秃鹫和恶念魔就会发动攻击；它们几乎毫无兴趣与任何人交谈。一旦战斗开始，它们会在整个心景中追逐PC们，并战斗至死。不过，它们无法离开心景；如果PC们逃回柳岸镇，它们就会返回此处。由你酌情决定，PC们在回来完成这件事之前，可能会不断遭受秃鹫啄食他们心脏的诡异噩梦。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.c128mFG0wnilFMQj]{秃鹫巢穴}
秃鹫的巢里满是它的脏羽毛，其中有两根带有魔法效果。要发现这些魔法羽毛，需要通过一次@Check[nature|dc:15]检定或一次@Check[perception|dc:18]检定。每根魔法羽毛都视作一枚阴森战利品护符。

A3. The Soulthief’s Nest Low 5

A ten-foot-high deadfall of trees lies in a rotting mound in this clearing. Blood spatters the decaying timbers, and an opening in the center emits a foul, rotten stink.

The Soulthief's Nest Low 5

@UUID[Actor.1kPkJWXmgiyZAWvn]{Heart-Eating Vulture} @UUID[Actor.i0pkcYhNLaxmMozr]{Cacodaemons (3)}

Creatures: Kugaptee’s influence over this mindscape manifests as a ravenous, intelligent vulture that hunkers in its nest while it chews and pecks at Sui-Jing’s heart. Fortunately for the PCs, her soul is tough and resilient. The vulture snarls in anger as it notices the PCs approaching and demands in a raspy voice that they leave at once, lest they find themselves added to its fine meal! It then attacks, and as it does, three clots of blood rip free from the heart and transform into shrieking cacodaemons that look like distorted human faces—close inspection reveals the faces to be similar to that of the corpse at area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08a2tansuijing00]{A2}, save that these faces possess glowing yellow eyes and mouths filled with sharp teeth.

If the PCs don’t leave at once, the vulture and cacodaemons attack; they have little interest in talking to anyone. Once a battle begins, they pursue the PCs throughout the mindscape and fight to the death. They can’t exit the mindscape, though, and return here if the PCs flee back to Willowshore. At your discretion, the PCs might endure strange nightmares of a vulture eating their hearts until they return to finish this job.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.c128mFG0wnilFMQj]{Vulture's Nest}
The vulture’s nest is filthy with its feathers, two of which have magical effects. Spotting these magic feathers requires a @Check[nature|dc:15] check or a @Check[perception|dc:18] check. Each magic feather functions as a grim trophy talisman.

Tan Sui-Jing’s Grave.name: 谭隋靖之墓 Tan Sui-Jing’s Grave
Tan Sui-Jing’s Grave.text:
A2. 谭隋靖之墓

这条泥土小路在一片宽五十尺的空地前到了尽头。另有一条较小的小路通向北边的林地，而空地中央放着一块巨大的石板。一具女性尸体躺在石板上，她的胸口是一个血肉模糊的巨大破洞。她的左臂似乎指向北方的小路。卷曲盘绕的雾气从尸体胸口的洞中翻腾而出，蜿蜒上升，汇入周围的迷雾。尸体下方，石板上表面的深深沟痕似乎组成了一个词，尽管很难确定那究竟写的是什么。

岩石上的尸体看起来才刚死不久。她的心脏不见了，但要辨认这名死去女子的身份，需要进行一次@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]，或一次@Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]，或一次@Check[society|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]来回忆知识。成功的角色会知道，这具尸体属于谭隋靖——传说中的女英雄；据说近千年前，她曾在丹杉寺建起之地击败过一名强大的邪魔。

当玩家角色观察从尸体胸口升起的雾气触须时，若成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:15]检定，就能发现有些扭曲、无声尖叫的人形面孔从那洞口中升起，随后消散并融入周围的雾气之中。最后，一旦有玩家角色攀上石板或从高处观察它，任何懂得阿克罗语的人都能读出刻在石头上的词：“苦迦菩提。”

在这片心景中，生长在苦迦菩提之墓上方的树从未扎根，因为谭隋靖的灵魂已被撕扯而去。尸体伸出的手为玩家角色指明了方向，那是谭隋靖临死前试图为可能前来复仇之人留下的线索。若成功通过一次@Check[medicine|dc:15]或@Check[perception|dc:20]检定，玩家角色便能判断，这道致命伤是由一只大型带爪的手撕开胸膛造成的。

血迹飞溅着延伸向东北；谭隋靖的心脏（以及她的灵魂）被区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08a3thesoulthi00]{A3}中的那只古怪秃鹫带走了。若成功通过一次@Check[survival|dc:25|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]，玩家角色就能追踪小路上滴落的血迹，带领同伴找到秃鹫所在的位置；不过他们也可以直接沿着北边的小路前往秃鹫巢穴。

尽管已极度虚弱，谭隋靖灵魂的残响依然留存在这片心景中；她的声音可以在低语之间被听见，并为玩家角色提供指引。在调查穗静的尸体时，玩家角色会听见一个低语的声音在说：“找到种子。”调查这片空地且成功通过一次@Check[survival|dc:18|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]检定的玩家角色，会在落叶与泥地中发现脚印。他们可以追踪这些足迹，找到那只秃鹫栖息的树。若他们失败了，也可以花费10分钟搜索周边，找到一条秃鹫使用的小路，通往它的巢穴。

A2. Tan Sui-Jing’s Grave

The dirt trail comes to an end at a fifty-foot-wide clearing. A smaller trail leads into the woods to the north, while at its center sits a large slab of stone. A woman’s corpse lies atop the slab, her chest a gaping, gory hole. Her left arm seems to point toward the northern path. Curling coils of fog writhe up from the hole in the corpse’s chest, slithering up and merging into the fog that surrounds it. Under the body, deep furrows on the upper surface of the stone seem to form a word, although it’s difficult to be sure what it says.

The corpse on the rock appears only recently dead. Her heart is missing, but identifying the dead woman requires a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or a @Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[society|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge. A character who succeeds knows that that the body is that of Tan Sui-Jing, a legendary heroine said to have defeated a powerful fiend nearly a thousand years ago at the site where the Tan Sugi monastery was built.

A PC who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:15] check while observing the tendrils of fog that rise out of the corpse’s chest can spot distorted and silently screaming humanoid faces rising up from the hole before they fade and merge with the surrounding fog. Finally, once a PC climbs up onto the slab or observes it from a height, the word carved into the stone can be read by anyone who understands Aklo: “Kugaptee.”

In this mindscape, the tree that grew above Kugaptee’s grave never took root, for Tan Sui-Jing’s soul has been ripped away. The corpse’s outstretched hand points the way for the PCs, and was Tan Sui-Jing’s dying attempt to provide a trail for her would-be avengers. With a successful @Check[medicine|dc:15] or @Check[perception|dc:20] check, a PC can tell that the grievous wound’s source was a large, clawed hand that ripped through the chest.

Splatters of blood lead northeast; Tan Sui-Jing’s heart (as well as her soul) was carried away by the strange vulture in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08a3thesoulthi00]{A3}. With a successful @Check[survival|dc:25|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track], a PC can Track the drips of blood left on the trail can lead their group to the vulture’s location, but they can also simply follow the northern trail to the vulture’s nest.

Although greatly weakened, an echo of Tan Sui-Jing’s soul persists in this mindscape; her voice can be heard among the whispers and provides guidance to the PCs. While investigating Sui-Jing’s body, the PCs make out a voice whispering, “Find the seed.” PCs investigating the clearing and who succeed at a @Check[survival|dc:18|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track] check find footprints in the leaves and mud. They can Track these prints to the tree used by the vulture. If they fail, they can take 10 minutes to Search the vicinity and find a trail used by the vulture that leads to its lair.

Entrance.name: 入口 Entrance
Entrance.text:
A1. 入口

只要PC没有解决这个小型心景中的处境，这个20英尺宽的出入口就会保持不变；若试图从其他任何地方穿过鬼墙离开，其效果如同PC在开展仪式之前尝试进入鬼墙一样。

如果PC离开这个心景，无论他们是从哪里进入的，都会从通往柳岸镇的道路上的鬼墙中走出。再次进入鬼打墙时，他们可以选择从这个地点走回心景，或者在别处重新施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{打开鬼墙}，制造一个临时传送门返回此处。

A1. Entrance

The 20-foot-wide entrance and exit from this mindscape remains static as long as the PCs leave the situation within this small mindscape unresolved; attempts to exit through the Wall of Ghosts anywhere else function as if the PCs attempted to enter the wall before performing the ritual.

If the PCs exit this mindscape, they step out of the Wall of Ghosts on the road leading back to Willowshore regardless of where they entered. On return trips into the Wall of Ghosts, they can either step back into the mindscape at this point or recast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{Open the Wall of Ghosts} elsewhere to create a temporary portal back to this location.

Into the Wall of Ghosts.name: 进入鬼打墙 Into the Wall of Ghosts
Into the Wall of Ghosts.text:
进入鬼打墙

尽管仪式为玩家角色打开了鬼墙，但这道超自然屏障仍持续抗拒他们进入，并积极阻止他们开始沿着朝圣之径前行。如果玩家角色打算继续他们向西的旅程，就必须直面鬼墙内的邪恶力量。

当玩家角色完成仪式、踏入鬼墙，并踏上显现出来的朝圣之径时，迷雾再次将他们包围，切断了他们的撤退之路，把他们困在一片看似被浓雾笼罩的林地之中——然而，这片林地有些地方显得很不对劲。这里的地形完全错了，道路蜿蜒穿过的是一片森林山谷，而不是林木覆盖的丘陵。若玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20] 或 @Check[religion|dc:22] 或 @Check[society|dc:22] 检定，便能确认这里的地形与丹杉寺废墟所在之处相符，尽管看不出寺院的任何踪迹。若大成功，他们还知道这片森林比预期年轻将近1,000年，来自寺院建成之前的时代。此外，这片区域内森林的灵性氛围也显得不太对。雾气弥漫的矮丛环境中传来被注视的感觉，没有任何动物鸣叫，甚至连微风拂动都没有，再加上一种无处不在的大祸临头之感，使四周充满了令人不安的氛围。

队伍进入了另一处心景，这里与他们刚刚离开的那一处截然不同，并深受已死去的苦迦菩提之梦影响。在这一版本的朝圣之径中，那颗曾是谭隋靖灵魂、并发芽长成后来将苦迦菩提封存于其坟墓中的杉树的种子，被移走了，而他的存在弥漫于整片森林。这处心景让玩家角色有机会见证关于大杉树、苦迦菩提，以及进一步说，丹杉寺背后历史的一幕剪影。

接下来的遭遇使用鬼打墙内地图。无论玩家角色在这里停留多久，时间看起来都像是傍晚时分，但浓雾遮蔽了上方天空的视野。穿过超过60尺雾气观察到的生物会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。试图穿过环绕这片区域的更浓迷雾，会使角色从与进入时相反的方向自雾中现身。

离开道路穿过茂密森林时的移动会受到困难地形阻碍。

Into the Wall of Ghosts

While the ritual opens the Wall of Ghosts for the PCs, the supernatural barrier continues to resist their entry and actively works to prevent them from beginning their walk along the Pilgrim’s Path. The PCs must confront the sinister forces within the Wall of Ghosts directly if they intend to continue their journey west.

When the PCs complete the ritual, step into the Wall of Ghosts, and set foot onto the revealed Pilgrim’s Path, the fog surrounds them again, cutting off their retreat and trapping them in what appears to be a fog-shrouded woodland—yet something about the woods seems strange. The terrain is all wrong, with the road winding through a forested valley rather than forested hills. With a successful @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20] or @Check[religion|dc:22] or @Check[society|dc:22] check, a PC confirms that the terrain matches where the Tan Sugi monastery ruins stand, though no sign of the monastery is apparent. With a critical success, they know that the forest is nearly 1,000 years younger than expected, from an era before the monastery was built. In addition, the spiritual atmosphere of the forest within this area feels off. The sensation of being watched from the foggy undergrowth, the lack of any animal calls or even a soft breeze, and a pervasive feeling of impending doom make for an unnerving atmosphere all around.

The party has entered another mindscape, unique from the one they’ve just exited, that’s heavily influenced by the dead Kugaptee’s dreams. In this version of the Pilgrim’s Path, the seed that was Tan Sui-Jing’s soul and that sprouted the sugi tree that would contain Kugaptee in his grave was removed, and his presence permeates the forest. This mindscape gives the PCs the opportunity to witness a snapshot of the history behind the great sugi tree, Kugaptee, and, by extension, the Tan Sugi monastery.

Use the Within the Wall of Ghosts map for the following encounters. Regardless of how long the PCs remain here, it seems to be late afternoon, but thick fog obscures sight of the sky above. Creatures viewed through more than 60 feet of fog are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. Attempts to step through the thicker fog surrounding the region result in the character emerging from the fog in the opposite direction from where they entered it.

Movement through the thick forest off the paths is hindered by difficult terrain.

Performing the Ritual.name: 开展仪式 Performing the Ritual
Performing the Ritual.text:
开展仪式

施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{打开鬼墙} 需要价值 60 gp 的米粒和香。如果玩家角色至少受到柳岸镇某个派系的钦佩，那么城镇会提供仪式所需的米和香；否则，他们就得自己在城镇里购买这些昂贵的材料。

仪式必须在距离鬼墙 40 足以内施放，但沿着墙体长度的具体位置由玩家角色自行决定。施放这个仪式需要一整天；在这一天里，玩家角色不应被敌人打扰，尽管你没必要让玩家知道他们在施放仪式期间会很安全！

如果玩家角色成功施放仪式，一股巨大的波纹效果会席卷鬼墙。这道波纹会将成群的幽魂身影向后推开，逼入更深的迷雾之中，并移除这道墙原本对周围地形造成的那种诡异消音效果。

在此次冒险路径的剩余部分中，只要一名 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{打开鬼墙} 的施法者（无论是主施法者还是副施法者）接近到距离鬼墙 40 足以内，雾墙中就会打开一条半径 10 足、如隧道般的缺口。这条通道让旁观者能够看见一条有些荒草蔓生的道路蜿蜒伸入前方迷雾笼罩的森林——这就是朝圣之径。如果玩家角色是在通往柳岸镇外的道路上开展仪式，那么看起来会像是道路周围的雾中打开了一条隧道；但如果玩家角色是在鬼墙的其他位置开展仪式，那么这条道路就会像是突然从雾墙边缘开始。无论玩家角色在哪里开展仪式，当他们踏入这条雾中隧道时，就踏上了朝圣之径。隧道会在他们身后保持开启，如果他们再从墙中退出来，无论他们最初是从鬼墙的哪个位置进入，都会重新出现在通往柳岸镇的朝圣之径上。

奖励：如果玩家角色在施放仪式的尝试中大失败，最终与两只幽灵交战，则照常为这场战斗给予他们 XP，除非他们已经是 5 级。无论如何，一旦玩家角色成功施放打开鬼墙，就给予他们 80 XP。

Performing the Ritual

Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{Open the Wall of Ghosts} requires rice grains and incense worth 60 gp. If the PCs are admired by at least one of Willowshore’s factions, then the town supplies the rice and incense needed for the ritual; otherwise, they’ll need to purchase the costly components themselves in town.

The ritual must be cast within 40 feet of the Wall of Ghosts, but the exact location along the wall’s length is up to the PCs. Casting the ritual takes a day; the PCs shouldn’t be interrupted by foes during this day, although you don’t need to let the players know that they’ll be safe during the casting of the ritual!

If the PCs are successful in casting the ritual, an immense rippling effect washes through the Wall of Ghosts. This ripple pushes the swarming ghostly figures away, deeper into the mists, and removes the weird sound-dampening effect the wall had on the surrounding terrain.

For the remainder of the Adventure Path, any time one of the casters of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{Open the Wall of Ghosts} (be they a primary or secondary caster) approaches within 40 feet of the Wall of Ghosts, a 10-foot-radius tunnel-like gap opens in the fog bank. This tunnel allows onlookers to see a somewhat overgrown road winding into the foggy forest beyond—this is the Pilgrim’s Path. If the PCs cast the ritual along the road leading out of Willowshore, it’ll look like a tunnel in the fog has opened around the road, but if the PCs cast the ritual elsewhere along the Wall of Ghosts, the road will seem to start abruptly at the edge of the fog wall. No matter where the PCs cast the ritual, when they step into this fog tunnel, they set foot onto the Pilgrim’s Path. The tunnel remains open behind them, and if they step back out of the wall, they reappear on the Pilgrim’s Path leading back to Willowshore regardless of where along the Wall of Ghosts they entered.

Reward: If the PCs critically fail in their attempt to cast the ritual and end up fighting two ghosts, grant them XP as normal for this fight unless they’re already 5th level. Regardless, once the PCs successfully cast Open the Wall of Ghosts, grant them 80 XP.

Through the Wall of Ghosts.name: 穿过鬼打墙 Through the Wall of Ghosts
Through the Wall of Ghosts.text:
穿过鬼打墙

鬼墙阻止人们进入丹杉寺，但一旦PC研究出打开鬼墙仪式，他们就能穿透这道超自然屏障。关于鬼墙的描述，以及那些未先施行此仪式便试图穿过者会遭遇什么的规则，见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05wallofghosts00]{此处}。

PC何时完成对柳岸镇诅咒本质的研究并开发出打开鬼墙仪式，取决于他们自己；但一旦完成，他们就可以在方便的时候尝试打开鬼墙。本段内容默认他们是在第二个月期间这样做。鬼墙沿着西侧的心景一路延伸，但穿过鬼墙的道路只有一条——也就是通往柳岸镇西北方、所谓的“朝圣之径”。无论PC在鬼墙的哪一处施行仪式，当他们穿过这道超自然屏障后，都会发觉自己来到了另一侧的朝圣之径上。

场景注记宏

@UUID[Macro.q6Aq46b4KfzM4gbR]{打开鬼墙}

当PC接近鬼墙时，野生动物的声响、风拂过树枝的沙沙声，甚至连他们自己的脚步声，都诡异地变得安静下来——这是苦迦菩提影响日益增强所带来的副作用。对于那些上次靠近鬼墙时没有经历过这种令人不安的环境音“减弱”现象的PC来说，这可能会让他们感到忧虑。当他们走到能够看见鬼墙的位置时，朗读或转述以下内容。

一堵奔涌倾泻的银色迷雾之墙向南北两侧延伸，远至目力所及之处，并高高升入半空与周围林地之中，足有五十英尺高。这迷雾仿佛自地面升起，看上去几乎像一幅幽灵般的泡沫水幕，向上流动后又逐渐消散。然而，这还远非这堵墙最令人不安的特质，因为在迷雾之中，幽灵般的身影翻涌浮动，时隐时现。时不时会有一个靠近边缘，伸出手臂，或将面孔贴上雾幕——而这些举动会让那些肢体与面容扭曲成野性而怪异的类人生物可怖模样，随后又被迷雾中某股看不见的力量猛地拽回朦胧深处。

Through the Wall of Ghosts

The Wall of Ghosts prevents access to the Tan Sugi monastery, but once the PCs research the Open the Wall of Ghosts ritual, they can pierce this supernatural barrier. A description of the Wall of Ghosts, as well as rules for what happens to those who attempt to pass through without first performing this ritual, are presented @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog05thewil.JournalEntryPage.05wallofghosts00]{Here}.

The timing of when the PCs complete their research into the nature of Willowshore’s curse and develop the Open the Wall of Ghosts ritual depends on them, but once they do so, they can attempt to open the wall at their leisure. This act assumes they do this during the second month. The Wall of Ghosts runs the length of the mindscape to the west, but only one road leads through the wall—the so-called “Pilgrim’s Path,” which exits Willowshore to the northwest. Regardless of where along the Wall of Ghosts the PCs perform the ritual, when they make their way through the supernatural barrier, they find themselves on the Pilgrim’s Path on the far side.

Scene NotesMacro

@UUID[Macro.q6Aq46b4KfzM4gbR]{Open the Wall of Ghosts}

As the PCs approach the Wall of Ghosts, the sounds of wildlife, the rustle of wind through tree branches, and even the sound of their own footsteps grow eerily quiet—a side effect of Kugaptee’s growing influence. This might concern PCs who didn’t experience an unsettling “dampening” of ambient sound the last time they drew near to the Wall of Ghosts. As they step into view of the wall, read or paraphrase the following.

Stretching as far as the eye can see to the north and south, a cascading wall of silvery mist rises fifty feet into the air and the surrounding woods. The mist seems to rise up from the ground, looking almost like a ghostly sheet of foamy water as it flows upward before fading away. Yet, this aspect is far from the most unsettling quality of the wall, for within the mist, ghostly shapes churn and float into and out of sight. Every now and then, one draws close enough to the edge to reach out an arm or to press a face against the mist—acts that distort those limbs and visages into feral, monstrous caricatures of humanoids, before some unseen force within the mist yanks them back into the foggy depths.

The Enlightened Path.name: 开悟之道 The Enlightened Path
The Enlightened Path.text:
第6章： 开悟之道

何时开始第6章取决于两个因素——PC在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07researchingt00]{研究柳岸镇诅咒}后，获得至少10点研究点并创制出“打开鬼墙”仪式，以及PC达到5级。由于第5章中获得的大多数XP奖励都来自每周事件，PC很可能要到秋季第二个月过了相当一段时间后才会接近5级；@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{打开鬼墙}仪式正是为此作了安排，它要求必须在娥眉月或新月之日施放，这意味着在本幕中任何一个月的后半段都可以施放（尤其是第3周和第4周、第7周和第8周，以及第11周和第12周）。如果你的游戏时间安排更适合让PC在某个月的前半段施放该仪式，只需将仪式的要求改为必须在盈月或满月期间施放，或者干脆完全省略这一要求。

你可能会发现，玩家并未意识到，要查明柳岸镇究竟发生了什么，他们最有希望的线索其实位于鬼墙之外的丹杉寺，尤其是当队伍更担心自己无法前往海岸、联系柳岸镇最重要的贸易伙伴——海岸要塞唐入时。在这种情况下，可以利用镇上的长老、神秘商人信藏，或任何与PC建立了羁绊的其他非玩家角色，推动他们去调查鬼墙，因为就对抗诅咒而言，西边那座古老寺院拥有的资源肯定比柳岸镇更多。

Chapter 6: The Enlightened Path

The timing of when to begin Chapter 6 depends on two factors—the PCs’ creation of the Open the Wall of Ghosts ritual after earning at least 10 Research Points while @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07researchingt00]{Researching the Willowshore Curse} and the PCs being 5th level. Since most of the XP awards earned in Chapter 5 come as the result of weekly events, it’s likely that the PCs won’t near 5th level until well into the second month of fall; the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PvkEzzCaDT07DcJb]{Open the Wall of Ghosts} ritual accounts for this with its requirement that it be cast on a day with a crescent or new moon, which means that it can be cast during the last half of any month (notably, week 3 and 4, week 7 and 8, and week 11 and 12) of this act. If the timing of your game is such that it’d work better for the PCs to cast the spell in the first half of a month, simply change the ritual’s requirement so that it must be cast during a waxing or full moon, or just omit the requirement entirely.

You might find that your players don’t realize that their best hope for discovering what’s going on in Willowshore lies beyond the Wall of Ghosts at the Tan Sugi monastery, especially if a group is more concerned about being unable to head toward the coast and contact Willowshore’s most important trade partner, the coastal fortress of Karahai. In this case, use the town elder, the mysterious merchant Shinzo, or any other NPC that the PCs have bonded with to push them toward investigating the Wall of Ghosts, since the old monastery to the west will certainly have greater resources than Willowshore does as far as combating curses goes.

Act 2.3: In the Ruins of Wisdom.name: 第二章 2.3：智慧废墟之中 Act 2.3: In the Ruins of Wisdom

Return to Willowshore.name: 返回柳岸镇 Return to Willowshore
Return to Willowshore.text:
返回柳岸镇

既然苦迦菩提带来的直接威胁已经解决，而玩家角色们也已收集到进一步研究心景所需的重要书籍与文件，那么除了返回柳岸镇、度过秋季最后几周之外，已经没有别的事可做了。关于玩家角色们如何进一步研究心景并发现赫山宝下落的信息，会出现在下一幕的开头；下一幕始于冬季的第一天。

当玩家角色们在终结苦迦菩提的威胁后返回柳岸镇时，他们的名声会提升。他们在柳岸镇的两个派系中各获得 2 点声望点。柳岸镇的人民也都急切想听听玩家角色们的冒险经历，以及他们对诅咒了解到的内容；但如果让镇民得知城镇并非受到诅咒，而是被困在一个心景之中，这个消息可能会让他们感到困惑，甚至不安，尤其是在显而易见玩家角色们其实还没有找到解决办法的时候。如果玩家角色们对寺院里发生的事保密，他们会失去 4 点希望点，并且由于他们的隐瞒滋生了担忧与挫败感，他们在每个派系中还会各失去 4 点声望点。如果玩家角色们决定说明发生了什么，他们可以选择说谎（使用 @Check[deception|dc:22|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie]）或实话实说（使用 @Check[diplomacy|dc:22]），此时其中一名玩家角色必须进行一次直到它逃脱技能检定。其他玩家角色可以协助这次检定。成功时，他们获得 1 点希望点（若为大成功则获得 2 点希望点）；失败时，他们失去 1 点希望点（若为大失败则失去 3 点希望点）。

尽管玩家角色们也许会认为，柳岸镇中的灵异事件是由苦迦菩提的影响所造成，但这一假设是错误的；而秋季最后几周将会揭示，更多超自然事件仍将接踵而至。至于究竟是别的什么东西在引发这些作祟，这一真相仍然是个谜，而玩家角色们将在战役的下一幕中直面并调查这一谜团，最终他们将发现，柳岸镇的前任镇长也被困在了属于他自己的心景之中。而迄今为止最重大、最惊人的发现——那位镇长失败的仪式不仅创造了一个心景，还杀死了整个城镇，并将其中的居民困在里面长达一个多世纪——也将很快随着寒冷冬月将柳岸镇纳入掌中而昭然若揭！

场景注释宏

@UUID[Macro.qMjiMOWIstGMjrXk]{更换季节}

更改 @UUID[Scene.KjhqnhLwdTc2JUZV]{柳岸镇} 与 @UUID[Scene.6LzSSdZgPfQ2K0dL]{柳岸腹地} 场景中的季节。

Return to Willowshore

Now that the immediate threat posed by Kugaptee has been resolved and the PCs have gathered the important books and documents they’ll need to research the mindscape further, there’s nothing more to do other than return to Willowshore and finish the last several weeks of fall. Information for how the PCs can further research the mindscape and discover the whereabouts of Heh Shan-Bao appears at the start of the next act, which begins on the first day of winter.

When the PCs return to Willowshore after ending the Kugaptee threat, their fame grows. They earn 2 Reputation Points with both of Willowshore’s factions. The people of Willowshore are eager to hear about the PCs’ adventures and what they’ve learned about the curse as well, but the knowledge that the town isn’t cursed but trapped in a mindscape could confuse or even distress the townsfolk, especially when it becomes apparent that the PCs haven’t actually found a solution for the problem. If the PCs keep what happened at the monastery secret, they lose 4 Hope Points and also lose 4 Reputation Points with each faction since their secrecy breeds concern and frustration. If the PCs do speak about what happened, they can either Lie (with @Check[deception|dc:22|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie]) or tell the truth (with @Check[diplomacy|dc:22]), in which case one PC must attempt a DC 22 skill check. The other PCs can Aid this check. On a success, they earn 1 Hope Point (or 2 Hope Points on a critical success); on a failure, they lose 1 Hope Point (or 3 Hope Points on a critical failure).

While the PCs might believe that Kugaptee’s influence caused the hauntings in Willowshore, this assumption is wrong, and as the final weeks of fall will reveal, there are still more supernatural events to come. The revelation that something else entirely is causing these haunts remains a mystery that the PCs shall confront and investigate in the next act of the campaign, culminating in their discovery that Willowshore’s ex-governor has become trapped in a mindscape of his own. And the greatest and most staggering discovery yet—that the governor’s failed ritual not only created a mindscape, but killed the entire town and trapped its inhabitants within for over a century—will soon be made clear as the cold months of winter take Willowshore into its grasp!

Scene NotesMacro

@UUID[Macro.qMjiMOWIstGMjrXk]{Change Season}

Changes the Season on the @UUID[Scene.KjhqnhLwdTc2JUZV]{Willowshore} and @UUID[Scene.6LzSSdZgPfQ2K0dL]{Willowshore Hinterlands} Scenes.

Concluding the Act.name: 终幕结束 Concluding the Act
Concluding the Act.text:
终幕结束

一旦PC们击败最后一个宁多鲁，一声咆哮便撕裂了洞窟。一个由血色雾气与阴影构成、闪烁不定的形体从洞穴中央盘旋升起，高高耸立在PC们面前；那形状始终无法真正固定为某一种模样，数条缠绕的长茎顶端生着恶魔般的头颅，数只手臂向外伸出。紧接着，片刻之后，整个洞窟仿佛突然在PC们周围收缩。强烈的眩晕感袭来，仿佛他们猛然被提到了空中一般，令众人胃里一阵翻腾；与此同时，四周的根系变得更小，却也更多。根系缠上苦迦菩提的形体，将其层层包裹，压住了那声咆哮。又过了片刻，PC们发现自己置身于一个狭窄、布满根系的洞窟中，空间勉强只够他们全都站立。苦迦菩提手指的痕迹已荡然无存，而辛月死去的人类身体（以及她的道具）正静静躺在地上，终于得到了安宁。邪魔的坟墓已被修复，他对柳岸镇造成的直接威胁也不复存在。

通往上方区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e15treasurec00]{E15} 的楼梯变短了许多。当PC们回到地表时，他们发现寺院依然残破不堪，但所有亡灵、怪物、作祟和宁多鲁的踪影都已消失。更重要的是，丹杉树如今健康地矗立在寺院核心，再也看不到蛛网或病变的条纹。智惠的幽灵最后一次出现在PC们面前，感谢他们的付出。这次交谈将是PC们最后一次有机会与她说话，因此应给他们足够的时间，从她那里得到任何最后的答案。尤其是，PC们现在应当知道，柳岸镇并未受到诅咒，而是一个循环往复的心景——在镇长试图施行一场本想进一步保护所有人免受苦迦菩提侵害的仪式却失败之后，这个城镇便一遍又一遍地重复着同一年。如今，PC们已经纠正了寺院中的问题，来自苦迦菩提的威胁已被消除，但他们仍被困在这个心景中，且不知道同一年究竟已经重复了多久。如果PC们尚未探索藏匿的图书馆（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11} ）并取回其中珍贵的书籍，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}也可以带领他们前往那里。

当PC们与智惠说完话后，她的精魂便渐渐消散，暂时与丹杉树融为一体。如果心景重置，一切都会重新开始；但如果PC们能够打破心景，智惠的灵魂终将前往来世。

Concluding the Act

Once the PCs defeat the final nindoru, a roar rips through the cavern. A shimmering form made from bloody mist and shadows coils up from the center of the cave to tower over the PCs, a shape that never quite settles on one form, reaching out with multiple arms and demonic heads atop coiling stalks. And then, a moment later, the entire cavern suddenly seems to shrink around the PCs. A sense of vertigo, as if suddenly being lifted up into the air, causes stomachs to lurch while the surrounding roots grow smaller but more numerous. The roots wrap around the form of Kugaptee, shrouding it and cutting off the roar. A moment later, the PCs find themselves in a cramped, root-filled cavern barely large enough for them all to stand in. No sign of Kugaptee’s fingers remains, and Xin Yue’s dead human body (and her gear) lies on the ground, finally at peace. The fiend’s grave has been restored, and the immediate threat he poses to Willowshore is no more.

The stairs leading back up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e15treasurec00]{E15} are much shorter. When the PCs return to the surface, they find the monastery still in ruins, but the presence of all the undead, monsters, haunts, and nindorus has vanished. More importantly, the Tan Sugi tree now stands healthy at the monastery’s core, with no spiderwebs or diseased streaks in sight. Zhi Hui’s ghost appears before the PCs one last time, thanking them for their service. This exchange will be the last opportunity the PCs have to speak to her, so allow them enough time to get any final answers from her they can. In particular, the PCs should know now that Willowshore isn’t cursed but is a cyclic mindscape that keeps repeating the same year over and over after the town’s governor tried (and failed) to perform a ritual meant to further protect everyone from Kugaptee. Now that the PCs have put things right in the monastery, the threat from Kugaptee has been removed, but they remain trapped in this mindscape with no knowledge of how long they’ve repeated the same year. If the PCs haven’t explored the hidden library (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11}) and recovered its valuable books, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} can lead them to this location as well.

Once the PCs have finished speaking to Zhi Hui, her spirit fades away, merging (for now) with the Tan Sugi tree. If the mindscape resets, everything starts over, but if the PCs can break the mindscape, Zhi Hui’s soul will finally travel to the afterlife.

Kugaptee’s Grave.name: 苦迦菩提之墓 Kugaptee’s Grave
Kugaptee’s Grave.text:
E16. 苦迦菩提之墓 重度 6

发光的红色液体细流沿着地板蜿蜒流淌，在房间中央汇聚成一汪池水，照亮了这处潮湿、阴冷、高三十英尺的洞穴。那液体看起来像血，但它是从几条巨大的树根上滴落下来的；这些树根自天花板垂下，或从墙壁中凸出，给人一种稀薄树液的印象。这种发光物质在洞穴中央积成一个直径十英尺的池子，围绕着四根巨大的石指与一根拇指；每根指尖都长着一枚红色水晶利爪。这些手指从地面中探出，仿佛某座被埋葬的雕像正从地下向上伸手，要将液体聚拢到自己的掌心之中。

从区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e15treasurec00]{E15}蜿蜒而下的楼梯井向地下延伸近60英尺，最终抵达这处洞穴。若成功进行一次@Check[nature|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]以回忆知识，玩家角色便能辨认出这些树根属于一棵杉树；但即便它们是上方区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e13thetansug00]{E13}那棵高达100英尺的丹杉树之根，它们看起来也庞大得过了头。整个房间都是谭隋靖与苦迦菩提远古冲突的超自然显现，将一切都化作了放大到超乎现实的复制品。就像这些根系一样，从地面伸出的苦迦菩提石化手指——每根都有5英尺高——也比他生前拥有的手指大得多。

从树根滴落的液体是新鲜温热的鲜血，这同样是那场远古冲突的另一种显现：苦迦菩提正从谭隋靖的转生者生命中榨取力量，将血液吸入下方那具仍大半埋在地下的尸体之中。地图上显示的树根并未触及地板，因此玩家角色可以轻松在其下方地面上移动。

生物：寺院腐化的主要策划者，以及苦迦菩提影响下最核心的受害者，正站在房间中央那池鲜血之中，血液没到她的胫部。此人便是@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月}。从夏日第一天后的几周开始，在过去几个月里，她几乎一直在此进行不间断的祷告，以引导苦迦菩提的精魂重返生命。若无人阻止，她的工作将导致上方谭杉树腐坏倒塌，并使苦迦菩提苏醒；但愿玩家角色能在隆冬降临、那一刻真正到来之前阻止这一过程。她身边有六名苦迦菩提武僧侍立，分散在房间各处，痴迷地注视着她的工作继续进行。

当辛月注意到玩家角色时，她会如此说道。

“啊，是啊。我一直在等你们。伟大的苦迦菩提早已预言，很快就会有一群把自己当英雄的镇民来到这里。你们来得正好，倒也省了我派人去找你们的麻烦。伟大的苦迦菩提正在他的墓中苏醒，但他还需要更多时间，才能彻底吞噬穗静的灵魂。你们的血肉、你们的鲜血，还有你们的生命，都会加快这个过程。能被选中扮演这样的角色，你们该感到荣幸。既然你们如此好心，直接来到苦迦菩提面前死在我手里，那我理当先自我介绍。我名叫辛月，而我将成为斩断你们与那名为生死轮回之陷阱联系的刀刃。”

辛月唯一的目标就是促成苦迦菩提复活。若玩家角色让她说完上面的台词，她就以交涉掷先攻；若他们在她说完前就攻击她，她则以察觉掷先攻。她知道，唤醒苦迦菩提意味着彻底摧毁并吞噬他们被困其中的心景，而一想到自己的灵魂将与她所崇拜的邪魔融为一体，她就感到极度愉悦。

苦迦菩提之墓 重度 6

@UUID[Actor.HH7pl57fPYEcb82I]{辛月} @UUID[Actor.mqTFTmYQoUKUyj2e]{莫啖魔 (6)}

与这房间中的全部七名敌人同时作战，难度甚至远超一次极限6级遭遇；但若玩家角色已净化全部四座雕像，并得到智惠的帮助，他们这一边也并非毫无援手。一旦战斗开始，寺院创建者的幽灵便会在玩家角色身旁显现，随后她高举双臂，化作流入谭杉树根系中的灵性能量。那些巨大的根系顿时狂乱苏醒，盘绕而下，缠绕挤压并碾碎六只黑坊主，让辛月不得不独自面对玩家角色——这令她愤怒又懊恼。

玩家角色击败辛月之后，战斗其实才完成了一半。她的身体猛然裂开，随之发生亵渎转生。当她转生为一只索吉鲁赫宁铎罗时，苦迦菩提石化的手指突然弯曲抽搐。智惠痛苦的尖叫撕裂了整个洞穴；与此同时，树根仿佛开始枯萎腐朽，而那六具被压碎的黑坊主尸体也同样发生转生，各自裂开，释放出一只墨丹宁铎罗。前后相接的这两场战斗，分别构成一次低级6级遭遇和一次中等6级遭遇。由你酌情决定，若玩家角色在最终战中需要帮助，你可以让智惠的幽灵再次显现，但她只能对玩家角色施放治疗法术。

E16. Kugaptee’s Grave Severe 6

Glowing rivulets of red fluid wind along the floor to pool in the center of the room, illuminating this damp, cold thirty-foot-high cavern. The fluid looks like blood but drips from several enormous tree roots that hang down from the ceiling or protrude from the walls, giving the impression of runny sap. This glowing substance accumulates in a ten-foot-diameter pool in the middle of the cave, surrounding what appear to be four immense stone fingers and a thumb, each tipped with a red crystal talon. These digits protrude from the ground, as if some buried statue were reaching up from below to gather the liquid in the palm of its hand.

The winding stairwell from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e15treasurec00]{E15} descends nearly 60 feet below ground before reaching this cavern. With a successful @Check[nature|dc:18|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] to Recall Knowledge, a PC identifies the tree roots as those of a sugi tree, but even if they’re the roots of the 100-foot-tall one in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e13thetansug00]{E13} above, they seem far too immense. This entire chamber is a supernatural manifestation of the ancient clash between Tan Sui-Jing and Kugaptee that transformed everything into a larger-than-life replica. As with the roots, Kugaptee’s petrified fingers that extend from the ground, each standing 5 feet tall, are much larger than those he possessed in life.

The fluid dripping from the tree roots is fresh, warm blood, another manifestation of the ancient clash as Kugaptee leeches Tan Sui-Jing’s reincarnated life of its power, absorbing the blood into his still mostly-buried corpse below. The tree roots shown on the map don’t reach the floor, allowing the PCs to move over the ground below them with ease.

Creatures: The primary architect of the monastery’s corruption and the central victim of Kugaptee’s influence stands shin-deep in the pool of blood in the center of the room.
