This individual is @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue}, and she has spent almost the entirety of the past several months, starting a few weeks after the first day of summer, in a constant cycle of prayer here as she works to guide Kugaptee’s spirit back to life. Left unopposed, her work results in the corrupting collapse of the Tan Sugi tree above and Kugaptee’s awakening, but hopefully the PCs put a stop to this process before that event comes to pass in the dead of winter. She’s attended by six monks of Kugaptee, who gather around the room and watch raptly as her work continues.

When Xin Yue notices the PCs, she addresses them as follows.

“Ah, yes. I’ve been expecting you. Great Kugaptee foretold that townsfolk playing at being heroes would arrive soon. Your arrival is timely and saves me the hassle of sending for you. Great Kugaptee stirs in his grave, but he needs more time to finish the consumption of Sui-Jing’s soul. Your flesh, your blood, and your lives will quicken this process. You should feel honored to be chosen such a role. Since you’ve been so kind as to come directly to Kugaptee to die by my hand, it’s only proper that I introduce myself. I am Xin Yue, and I shall be the blade that severs you from the trap you know as the cycle of life and death.”

Xin Yue’s singular goal is to bring about the revival of Kugaptee, and if the PCs allow her to finish her speech above, she rolls for initiative with Diplomacy; if they attack her before she finishes, she rolls with Perception. She knows that waking Kugaptee means the complete destruction and consumption of the mindscape they’re trapped in, and she draws extreme pleasure from the idea that her soul will become one with the fiend she worships.

Kugaptee's Grave Severe 6

@UUID[Actor.HH7pl57fPYEcb82I]{Xin Yue} @UUID[Actor.mqTFTmYQoUKUyj2e]{Meokdans (6)}

A fight against all seven foes in this room is well beyond even an Extreme 6 encounter, but the PCs have help on their side, assuming they’ve purified all four statues and have the aid of Zhi Hui. Once combat begins, the ghost of the monastery’s founder manifests at the PCs’ side, then raises up her arms and transforms into spiritual energy that flows up into the Tan Sugi tree’s roots. The immense roots thrash to life and coil down to constrict and crush the six kurobozus, leaving Xin Yue to face the PCs on her own—much to her frustration and rage.

Once the PCs defeat Xin Yue, the combat is only half complete. Her body splits open as her Profane Reincarnation takes place. While she reincarnates as a sojiruh nindoru, Kugaptee’s petrified fingers suddenly flex and shudder. Zhi Hui’s scream of agony rips through the cavern as the tree roots appear to wither and decay, and the crushed bodies of the six kurobozus reincarnate as well, each splitting open to release a meokdan nindoru. Back-to-back, these combats entail a Low 6 encounter and a Moderate 6 encounter. At your discretion, if the PCs need aid in the final fight, you can have Zhi Hui’s ghost manifest again, but only to cast healing spells on the PCs.

Treasure Chamber.name: 宝藏室 Treasure Chamber
Treasure Chamber.text:
E15. 宝藏室

空荡荡的搁板、荒芜的平台、其上摆放着朴素无饰的武器与护甲架，还有敞开着、积满灰尘的宝箱，都暗示着这里曾经收藏过怎样的宝藏。只有西墙附近的一个箱子依然紧闭。南面的双开门上雕刻着一道螺旋符文，并被涂成了红色。

南门上的螺旋符文，任何至少受训于宗教或善解学识的人都能辨认出那是警告；或者成功通过一次 @Check[society|dc:20] 检定的人也能识别出来。如果玩家角色尚未净化上方寺院中的全部四尊雕像，苦迦菩提的影响就依然强烈，一道力场墙会阻挡通往门扉的道路。不过，一旦他们净化了四尊雕像，这道屏障便会消失，玩家角色也能轻松打开大门。门后，一道漫长而蜿蜒的楼梯盘旋向下，没入黑暗之中，在抵达区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16} 之前完整却舒缓地绕行一圈。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.guGa5KSWZIm5WewF]{箱子}
尽管这间宝藏室看起来像是很久以前就被洗劫一空，但任何成功通过一次 @Check[sangpotshi-lore|dc:17] 或 @Check[religion|dc:20] 检定的玩家角色都知道，在供奉桑博齐的寺院中，这种刻意布置成空无一物的宝库并不少见。武僧们并不囤积财富，而是常常在设有防御的区域建造像这样的假宝库，以强调物质财富对他们而言几乎没有意义。

不过，这种信念并不怎么适用于那些继承了寺院的堕落武僧；在心景形成之前，他们一直把从误入其掌控的受害者那里搜刮来的部分更有价值的宝藏保存在这里。那只关闭的箱子中装有1,600 cp、430 sp、54 gp、价值120 gp的各式珠宝首饰碎件、一枚翠绿蚱蜢护符、一件沾满血迹的+1链甲衫，以及一根澄明心智魔杖。

E15. Treasure Chamber

Empty shelves and barren platforms that hold unadorned weapon and armor racks, along with open, dust-filled treasure chests, provide hints to the possible treasures once held here. Only one chest near the west wall remains closed. A double door to the south is carved with a spiraling rune that has been painted red.

The spiraling rune on the southern door can be identified as a warning by anyone who’s at least trained in Religion or Sangpotshi Lore, or by someone who succeeds at a @Check[society|dc:20] check. If the PCs haven’t purified all four of the statues in the monastery above, Kugaptee’s influence remains strong, and a wall of force bars access to the doors. Once they’ve purified the four statues, though, this barrier vanishes, and the PCs can open the doors with ease. Beyond, a long, winding stairwell spirals down into the darkness, making a complete but lazy revolution before reaching area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.guGa5KSWZIm5WewF]{Chest}
While it might look like this treasure chamber was looted long ago, any PC who succeeds at a @Check[sangpotshi-lore|dc:17] or a @Check[religion|dc:20] check knows that such intentionally empty treasuries aren’t unknown in monasteries devoted to Sangpotshi. Rather than hoard wealth, the monks often built false treasuries like this room in defended areas to drive home the fact that material wealth had little meaning to them.

This belief doesn’t so much apply to the corrupted monks who inherited the monastery, and they’ve been keeping some of the more valuable treasures they’ve collected from victims who stumbled into their clutches before the mindscape formed. Within the closed chest are 1,600 cp, 430 sp, 54 gp, 120 gp in assorted bits of jewelry, an emerald grasshopper talisman, a bloodstained +1 chain shirt, and a wand of clear mind.

Storage Room.name: 储藏室 Storage Room
Storage Room.text:
E14. 储藏室 中等 6

这间宽敞的地下室或许曾经用于存放园艺装备、成桶的肥料、木材和修理工具，但如今这里更像是一间屠宰场。整个房间里到处散落着野兽和类人生物被肢解的尸体与飞溅的内脏，而腐肉的恶臭让人连呼吸这冰冷的空气都成了一件痛苦的苦差事。

武僧们曾将这片宽敞空间用作储存材料和季节性装备的区域，但当寺院被废弃后，大部分物品都被带走或捐赠了。自从接管此地以来，苦迦菩提邪教徒一直把这间厅室当作多年间被他们献祭之人的弃尸场。寒冷的温度让腐败速度稍稍放缓，却也恰好让这里变得更加令人作呕。

储藏室 中等 6

@UUID[Actor.bdOAkorJbVOqobUp]{苦迦菩提武僧} @UUID[Actor.sipFaaLMxLg8iB2b]{地狱犬 (3)}

生物：除了作为弃置尸骸的场所外，这间厅室也是通往苦迦菩提之墓路线的入口，因此，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月}不想让这里无人看守。一名黑坊主——曾经是这座寺院的厨师——如今在此守卫，身边还跟着辛月最喜爱的宠物：三只垂涎欲滴的地狱犬，看起来比起狗更像是燃烧着的野狐。PC们到达时，这名黑坊主正拿一颗被啃得满是牙印的人类骷髅陪地狱犬玩“捡回来”的游戏来自娱自乐。一看到PC们，地狱犬立刻龇牙低吼，威胁意味十足，但黑坊主伸出一只腐烂的手制止了它们的攻击，随后宣告道：“打扰别人消磨闲暇时光可是很没礼貌的。你们为什么来这儿？我又为什么不该把你们喂给我的宠物呢？”

如果PC们没有立刻攻击，他们会发现这个无名的黑坊主其实颇愿意交谈。下方列出了对PC们可能提出的一些问题的回答，但在答了几个之后，黑坊主就会感到厌倦，打个响指，命令地狱犬扑向队伍。一旦战斗开始，它们就会战斗到被摧毁为止。

“你是谁？”“我记不起来了，不过这不重要。我依辛月的意志行事，而她则侍奉伟大的库嘎普缇。”

“这里为什么有这么多尸体？”“剩菜。食物。装饰。尸体还能有什么别的用途？不过，如果你是想问在这些身体变成尸体之前我们拿来做什么，嗯，辛月需要新鲜的血肉和温热的鲜血来满足苦迦菩提，为他提供力量，让他能从自己的坟墓中复起。你们是来主动献上自己的肉和汁水的吗？”

“辛月是谁？”“她是我们的中心，我们的理由，我们的目的。伟大的库嘎普缇命令我们跟随她，所以我们就跟随她。自从我们来到这里后，她只做两件事：杀戮，以及把灵魂献给苦迦菩提。我想是这样。她可相当令人不快。你一定会觉得，这话从我这样的人嘴里说出来格外可怕。等你见到她时就会明白了。”

“苦迦菩提是谁？”“哦！你想见苦迦菩提？我们可以安排你们见面。只要站着别动……”（说到这里，苦迦菩提武僧命令地狱犬发动攻击。攻击来得太过突然，使这些生物的先攻掷骰获得+2环境加值。）

囚犯：当辛月在寺院大体被废弃后接管此地时，她和她的追随者把这间厅室里的一些储藏壁龛改造成了临时监狱，用来关押抓来的祭品，通常是误入废墟的流浪猎人或探险者。

当心景形成时，这间房里唯一的囚犯——一个名叫卡伦·布雷的小贼——和其他武僧一起死去了，但他并没有作为黑坊主复起。相反，他变成了一具保留着生前记忆的丧尸——而且每当心景循环重置时，那些记忆也都会保留下来。在过去的115年里，卡伦早已记不清一切究竟重置了多少次，而他受损的记忆也彼此混杂在一起，以至于他只觉得自己已经在这里“永远”地腐烂下去了。

卡伦生前来自艾巴萨罗姆，而他来到神门的唯一目的，就是搜刮物品并卖给遍布内海地区的收藏家。在听说这座被废弃的寺院后，他赶来勘察此地，结果却被辛月的武僧们抓住。起初，武僧们打算几周后拿他去献祭，但在卡伦被捕一周后心景便形成了，他新的不死生物状态让他不再适合作为祭品，于是他们便干脆把他丢在这里，任其真正地腐烂。

卡伦有太多次逃出囚室却又被宁多鲁斯屠杀的记忆，因此他早已放弃了逃跑。他后来明白，最好的办法就是一动不动，“装死”。当PC们击败黑坊主和它的地狱犬后，卡伦会从麻木状态中苏醒过来，从西北角最里面的壁龛里向PC们喊话；他正被镣铐锁在地板上。“哎呀，这可新鲜了！不是怪物的人？你们又是谁？”

卡伦会对PC们说谎，声称自己是个猎人，在一场风暴中到这片废墟里避难，却被住在这里的邪恶武僧们抓住；随后他会请求PC们击败如今盘踞在上方废墟中的怪物，好让自己终于能够脱身。凭着那些模糊的记忆，他可以给PC们一些令人抓狂又混乱的线索——告诉他们，他和住在这里的武僧们是在“很多很多年前”同时变成不死生物的，但他记不起原因。事实上，在PC们到来之前，他甚至已经开始相信世上所有生命都已灭绝。

卡伦是邪恶的，但并不算特别危险；如果PC们帮助他脱身，他也不会在这片地区制造太多额外麻烦——相反，他会去林地里过上一种潜伏藏匿的生活，最终惹上一只怪物，被对方彻底解决。他并不在意自己不死生物的外观，还说：“这没什么是几件新衣服和一张面具藏不住的。”作为交换，只要PC们答应放他出来，他就会告诉PC们他藏在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e8storage00000]{E8}的那批宝藏的位置。

@UUID[Actor.RslmqUYHooPfdhDu]{卡伦·布雷}生物 2

  • 中型
  • 不死生物
  • 邪恶
  • 丧尸

E14. Storage Room Moderate 6

This large basement might have once been used to store gardening equipment, barrels of fertilizer, lumber, and repair tools, but today it’s more like a slaughterhouse. The entire room is littered with the dismembered corpses and splattered internal organs of beasts and humanoid creatures, and the stink of decaying flesh makes breathing the cool air an agonizing chore.

The monks once used this large space as a storage area for materials and seasonal equipment, but most of the items were taken or donated when the monastery was abandoned. Since taking over, the Kugaptee cultists have been using this chamber as a dumping ground for sacrificial victims they’ve gone through over the years. The cold temperature slows decay just enough to make things truly awful in here.

Storage Room Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.bdOAkorJbVOqobUp]{Monk of Kugaptee} @UUID[Actor.sipFaaLMxLg8iB2b]{Hell Hounds (3)}

Creatures: In addition to being a dumping ground for carcasses, this chamber provides access to the route leading to Kugaptee’s Grave, and as such, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue} didn’t want to leave the place unguarded. A kurobozu, once the monastery’s cook, now watches over this chamber, attended by Xin Yue’s favorite pets—a trio of slavering hell hounds that look more like burning feral foxes than they do dogs. As the PCs arrive, the kurobozu is entertaining themself by playing fetch with the hell hounds, using a well-chewed human skull for the game. Upon spotting the PCs, the hell hounds immediately bare their teeth and growl menacingly, but the kurobozu holds out a rotting hand to stay their attack, then proclaims that “it’s rude to interrupt someone’s idle moments. Why are you here? Why should I not feed you to my pets?”

If the PCs don’t immediately attack, they’ll find this nameless kurobozu somewhat eager for conversation. Potential answers to some questions the PCs might pose are listed below, but after answering a few, the kurobozu grows weary and, with a snap of their fingers, sics the hounds on the party. Once combat begins, they fight until destroyed.

Who are you? “I can’t remember, but it doesn’t matter. I serve at Xin Yue’s whim, and she serves the great Kugaptee.”

Why are there so many corpses here? “Leftovers. Food. Decoration. What other use do corpses have? If you mean what are we doing with the bodies before they become corpses, though, well, Xin Yue needs fresh flesh and warm blood to sate Kugaptee, to provide him with strength so that he may rise from his grave. Are you here to volunteer your meat and juices?”

Who is Xin Yue? “She is our focus, our reason, our purpose. Great Kugaptee bid us to follow her so we do. She has only killed and offered souls to Kugaptee since we arrived. I think. She’s quite unpleasant to be around. You must think that’s quite disturbing coming from someone like me. You’ll understand when you meet her.”

Who is Kugaptee? “Oh! You wish to meet Kugaptee? We can arrange a meeting. Just hold still...” (At this, the monk of Kugaptee orders the hounds to attack. The suddenness of the attack grants the creatures a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.)

Prisoner: When Xin Yue took over after the monastery was mostly abandoned, she and her followers used of some of this chamber’s storage alcoves as improvised prisons for captured sacrifices, usually wandering hunters or explorers who stumbled upon the ruins.

When the mindscape formed, this room’s sole prisoner, a small-time thief named Kalen Bray, perished along with the other monks, yet he didn’t rise as a kurobozu. Instead, he rose as a zombie who retained his memories from life—and each time the mindscape cycle resets, those memories remain. Over the past 115 years, Kalen has lost track of just how many times things have reset, and his damaged memories have merged so that he simply believes he’s languished here “forever.”

In life, Kalen hailed from Absalom, and he came to Shenmen solely to plunder items to sell to collectors throughout the Inner Sea Region. After hearing of the abandoned monastery, he made his way over to survey the grounds, only to be captured by Xin Yue’s monks. The monks initially intended to sacrifice him in a few weeks, but when the mindscape formed a week after Kalen’s capture, his new undead state rendered him useless for such a purpose, and so they’ve simply left him here to literally rot.

Kalen has so many memories of escaping his cell only to be slaughtered by nindorus that he’s long since given up trying to escape. He’s since learned that it’s best to remain still and “play dead.” Once the PCs defeat the kurobozu and their hell hounds, Kalen stirs from his torpor and calls out to the PCs from the northwesternmost alcove, where he’s chained to the floor with manacles. “Well, this is new! People who aren’t monsters? Who might you be?”

Kalen Lies to the PCs, claiming to have been a hunter who took shelter in these ruins during a storm only to be captured by the evil monks who live here, and asks the PCs to defeat the monsters that now live in the ruins above so he can finally escape. With his vague memories, he can give the PCs some maddening and confusing clues—telling them that he and the monks who dwell here became undead at the same time “many, many years ago,” but he can’t remember why. In fact, until the PCs’ arrival, he’d come to believe that all life had perished in the world.

Kalen is evil but not particularly dangerous, and if the PCs help him escape, he won’t cause much additional mischief in the region—instead taking to a life lurking in the woods and eventually running afoul of a monster that finishes him off. He’s not bothered by his undead appearance, stating, “It’s nothing some new clothes and a mask can’t hide.” In return for promising to let him out, he reveals to the PCs the location of the stash of treasure he hid in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e8storage00000]{E8}.

@UUID[Actor.RslmqUYHooPfdhDu]{Kalen Bray}Creature 2

  • Medium
  • Undead
  • Unholy
  • Zombie

The Tan Sugi.name: 谭杉 The Tan Sugi
The Tan Sugi.text:
E13. 谭杉 中等 6

一棵高达一百英尺的巨大杉树耸立于这片荒芜蔓生的庭院之上，将整座寺院笼罩在它的阴影里。腐朽与坏死形成的湿亮盘曲物自数条树根向上蔓延，缠绕着树干；上方许多枝干间则挂满了巨大的蛛网。树干侧面离地约四英尺处嵌着一把大号银刃斧头；伤口中渗出的黑色树液结成了硬壳般的细流，仍在闪着微光，沿着树干向下流淌。

这棵异常巨大的杉树生长于谭隋靖与苦迦菩提交战后身死之处。正是她为了阻止那邪魔死后再度转生，而让自己转生成的那一棵树。自根系向上蔓延的腐坏，起始于下方一间地下密室（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}）；过去115年来，这一过程每年都会重置，但由于马戈凯在现实世界的干预，苦迦菩提日益增强的影响加快了这一进程——若玩家角色不加以阻止，到仲冬时，丹杉树将会倒下，苦迦菩提也将逃脱；这一事件会摧毁整个心景，将困于其中的灵魂（包括玩家角色）吸纳进苦迦菩提体内，并把这强大的邪魔释放到现代世界中。苦迦菩提逃入现代世界会带来何种后果，已超出本冒险的范围，但本书的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog16contin]{延续战役} 中对此有简要讨论。

有些玩家角色可能会想到把这棵杉树砍倒，但那只会加速终局，导致与任由树木腐朽同样的毁灭性后果，降临在柳岸镇（以及玩家角色自己）身上（如上所述）。虽然这样做能阻止苦迦菩提立刻在现代世界中重生，但也不过是将这一如今已不可避免的结果稍作延后。若玩家角色执意推行这般自我毁灭的计划，他们应当收到幻象，或者来自 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠} 的警告，告诉他们：若想为解除柳岸镇诅咒保留一线希望，这棵杉树就必须活着。

成功通过一次 @Check[nature|dc:20] 检定的玩家角色会注意到，侵蚀这棵树的病变会在几个月内将其杀死，而源头似乎来自地下某处。

当玩家角色靠近这棵树时，让他们进行秘密 @Check[perception|dc:24] 检定。成功者会注意到，在靠近树干、约75英尺高的数根枝杈间，有一团蛛网里闪烁着淡淡蓝光（入夜后，该难度等级降为 @Check[perception|dc:17]）。若大成功，一名玩家角色会发现这光芒的来源是一个被蛛网半裹住的木雕头颅。

要攀爬这棵杉树，玩家角色必须成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb]。

生物：笼罩这棵杉树的蛛网源头，是苦迦菩提思绪的另一种显现——一只巨大而可怖的食人魔蛛。然而，这只巨蛛并不是此地唯一的栖居者。玩家角色第一次进入庭院时，这只蜘蛛潜伏在上方枝叶间，位于50英尺高处，可见，但暂时一动不动。下方则有一个令人不安的身影蹲伏在树根之间，一边啃咬树皮，一边发出咀嚼声——那是一名衣衫褴褛的不死生物狐人。此人曾是辛月最忠诚的追随者之一，是一位擅长园艺的武僧；当他在心景中转生为黑坊主时，忘记了自己的名字，也忘了前世的大部分经历。如今，这名不死武僧只是简单地称自己为咀嚼者，因为他主动承担起啃咬杉树根系、试图加快其腐坏的任务。到目前为止，他的努力收效甚微，但若仔细观察，仍能在根系间发现数处遭到感染的区域，那正是他啃咬过的地方。

谭杉 中等 6

@UUID[Actor.Y5zDh5oQrdwzR3My]{咀嚼者} @UUID[Actor.EGr8S808E890Cmft]{食人魔蛛}

咀嚼者注意到玩家角色时，会直起身来，把嘴里的树皮碎屑吐掉，然后邀请他们一起享用他的“盛宴”，并说道：“牙齿越多，这棵可怜的树倒下得就越快——你们总不至于残忍到让它继续受苦吧？”咀嚼者很乐意与玩家角色交谈，但除了确认这棵树是由一位昔日伟大女英雄的遗骸长成之外，并无多少内情可透露。只要这棵树仍在生长，她的灵魂就会一直被困于生死轮回之外。这名不死武僧希望以这番说辞争取玩家角色的协助；若遭到反驳，他很快就会变得不耐烦并怒火中烧。咀嚼者很快就会被迫发动攻击，届时他会拔出自己的庙剑，战斗直到被摧毁。战斗一开始，食人魔蛛也会从树上爬下，加入战斗。虽然咀嚼者不会追击逃跑的玩家角色，但食人魔蛛会；它会利用自己的诡异的灵活性，在寺院中追逐队伍。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.lHjir7rIumzg0Vui]{树干}
嵌在树干中的那把斧头，原本属于7062年来到寺院的伐木工首领；他只来得及挥出一斧，便遭到屠杀。成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:22] 检定的玩家角色可以把这把斧头拔出来。多年来，谭隋靖的影响进一步赋予了这把斧头魔法力量，如今它是一把+1 幽冥 强击 银质战斧，但在下方苦迦菩提之墓中的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月} 被击败之前，这把武器带有一个令人不安的怪癖——每次将它拔出时，使用者脑海中都会涌现出想把斧头埋进朋友骷髅里的冲动；若未能成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:20|traits:emotion,fear,mental] 豁免，使用者就会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（此怪癖具有情绪、恐惧和心灵特征，并会在辛月被击败后立刻消失）。

卡在75英尺高蛛网中的发光雕像头部，是区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e5pharasmass00]{E5} 中那尊 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛} 雕像遗失的头颅。待咀嚼者与食人魔蛛被击败后，那光芒会增强，使任何察觉到它的难度等级降低10。只要有玩家角色接触那颗头颅，光芒就会立刻消失，但同时会让该玩家角色心中生出强烈冲动，想把头颅送回雕像上——该角色在任何净化那尊雕像的检定上获得+2物品加值。

E13. The Tan Sugi Moderate 6

A massive, one-hundred-foot-tall sugi tree towers over this overgrown courtyard, bathing the monastery in its shadow. Glistening coils of rot and decay spread up from several of the tree’s roots to wind along its trunk, while many branches above are thick with immense spiderwebs. A large silver-bladed axe lies embedded in the side of the tree trunk about four feet off the ground; crusty rivulets of black sap glisten and run down from the wound.

This unusually enormous sugi tree grows at the site of Tan Sui-Jing’s death following her battle with Kugaptee. It’s the very one that she reincarnated into in order to keep the dead fiend from reincarnating himself. The decay spreading up from the roots starts in an underground chamber below (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}); while it has reset every year for the past 115 years, Kugaptee’s growing influence as the result of Mago Kai’s meddling in the real world has accelerated the process—if the PCs don’t put a stop to it, by midwinter, the Tan Sugi tree will fall, and Kugaptee will escape, an event that will destroy the entire mindscape, absorb the souls trapped within (including the PCs) into Kugaptee, and release the powerful fiend into the modern world. The implications of Kugaptee’s escape into the modern world are beyond the scope of this adventure but are discussed briefly in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog16contin]{Continuing the Campaign} of this book.

The notion of chopping down the sugi tree might come to some of the PCs, but this pursuit would only hasten the end, resulting in the same devastation to Willowshore (and to the PCs) that allowing the tree to decay would (as detailed above). While doing so would prevent Kugaptee from being immediately reborn into the modern world, this only delays that now inevitable outcome. If the PCs insist on pursuing such a self-destructive plan, they should receive visions, or perhaps warnings from @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}, that the sugi tree must live if there’s to be any hope in lifting Willowshore’s curse.

A PC who succeeds at a @Check[nature|dc:20] check notes that the affliction sickening the tree will kill it in a few months, and its source seems to be coming from somewhere underground.

As the PCs approach the tree, allow them to make secret @Check[perception|dc:24] checks. Those who succeed notice something shimmering with a faint blue glow in a clot of spiderwebs among several branches about 75 feet up near the tree’s trunk (after dark, this DC drops to @Check[perception|dc:17]). With a critical success, a PC notices that the source of this glow is a wooden statue head wrapped partially in spiderwebs.

To Climb the sugi tree, a PC must succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb].

Creatures: The source of spiderwebs that shroud the sugi tree is another manifestation of Kugaptee’s thoughts—an immense and frightening ogre spider. However, the enormous spider isn’t the only occupant in the area. The first time the PCs enter the courtyard, the spider lurks in the branches above, visible at a height of 50 feet but motionless for the moment. Down below, squatting among the tree’s roots as he gnaws and chews at the bark, is an unsettling figure—an undead kitsune dressed in rags. This individual was one of Xin Yue’s most loyal followers, a horticulturist monk who forgot his name as well as much of his previous life when he was reborn in the mindscape as a kurobozu. Now, the undead monk simply refers to himself as the Chewer, for he has taken it upon himself to gnaw at the sugi’s roots in an attempt to quicken its decay. So far, his efforts have had minimal results, but closer inspection reveals several infected areas among the roots where he has been chewing.

The Tan Suhi Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.Y5zDh5oQrdwzR3My]{The Chewer} @UUID[Actor.EGr8S808E890Cmft]{Ogre Spider}

The Chewer straightens up and spits bits of bark out of his mouth as he notices the PCs, then invites them to join him at his “meal,” noting that “more teeth will bring down this forlorn tree more quickly—surely you aren’t cruel-minded enough to let it continue to suffer?” The Chewer is delighted to speak to the PCs but doesn’t really have much to reveal to them other than to confirm that this tree grew from the remains of a great heroine from the past. As long as the tree still grows, her soul remains trapped and outside of the cycle of life. The undead monk hopes to use this line of reasoning to recruit the aid of the PCs and quickly grows impatient and angry if he’s contradicted. It shouldn’t be long before the Chewer is compelled to attack, at which point he draws his temple sword and fights until destroyed. Once combat begins, the ogre spider clambers down from the tree to join the fight as well. While the Chewer won’t pursue fleeing PCs, the ogre spider will, taking advantage of its eerie flexibility to chase the party through the monastery.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.lHjir7rIumzg0Vui]{Trunk}
The axe embedded in the tree trunk belonged to the leader of the woodcutters who came to the monastery back in 7062; he was slaughtered after making only one swing with the axe. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[athletics|dc:22] check can pull the axe free. Over the years, Tan Sui-Jing’s influence has further enhanced this axe with magical properties, and it’s now a +1 ghost touch striking silver battle axe, but until @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue} is defeated in Kugaptee’s grave below, this weapon bears an unsettling quirk—each time it’s drawn, unsettling urges to bury the axe in the skull of a friend invade the user’s mind, causing the user to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|dc:20|traits:emotion,fear,mental] save (this quirk has the emotion, fear, and mental traits and vanishes as soon as Xin Yue is defeated).

The glowing statue head lodged in a web 75 feet up is the missing head to the statue of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e5pharasmass00]{E5}. Once the Chewer and the ogre spider are defeated, the glow increases, reducing any DC to notice it by 10. The glow fades as soon as a PC touches the head but fills that PC with the urge to return the head to the statue—that character gains a +2 item bonus to any checks to purify that statue.

Burial Garden.name: 葬园 Burial Garden
Burial Garden.text:
E12. 葬园 中等 6

这间房间里的空气感觉潮湿且异常温暖。房间中央摆着一排四个长二十尺、装满泥土的木制种植箱，每个种植箱里都长满了病恹恹的杂草、潮湿的真菌和湿亮的藤蔓。东侧有一张矮桌，四周摆着发霉的坐垫，东北角附近有一扇小木门；靠近这扇门的地方立着一尊雄鹿雕像，其上缠满了潮湿、带病的藤蔓。

东北侧的门通往下方的储藏室（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e14storagero00]{E14}）。

在寺院被废弃之前，这个大房间是武僧们种植食物、栽培花卉和处理遗体的地方。对于丹杉寺的武僧而言，像谭隋靖那样转生为植物这一概念，代表着一种特定形式的开悟；因此当一名武僧去世时，他们会被埋葬在这里的种植箱中，好让他们的遗骸能够滋养那些他们的精魂希望转生而成的植物。一旦身体腐朽得只剩下骨头，这些骨头就会在一场漫长而复杂的仪式中受到敬奉；仪式包括将遗骸掘出、磨成粉末，然后再撒回泥土中。通过这种方式，武僧们希望能增强谭隋靖对苦迦菩提之墓（理想情况下是永恒的）守望。对有些人来说，这也许是种阴森的传统；但对这些武僧而言——他们相信一旦精魂离开身体，新的身体就在前方等待——死亡后留下的遗骸不过是过去的遗物。这个地方曾经有强大的魔法效果，帮助这里的植物即使在室内也能生长繁茂，但寺院被废弃后，这些效果很快就消散了。

寺院的废弃，以及它落入那些被苦迦菩提腐化之人手中的结局，在这个房间中以实体形式显现：曾经生长于此的美丽、健壮且富有营养的植物，如今已被病态的杂草和寄生真菌所取代。这个房间里的空气潮湿而黏稠，充满恶臭的孢子；在这个房间中于其回合开始时的非植物或非真菌生物，必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}）。这是一个嗅觉和毒素效果；如果一个角色在这次豁免中大成功，则其会在接下来24小时内暂时免疫该效果。

这尊雄鹿雕像是必须被净化的四尊雕像之一，只有如此才能获得进入苦迦菩提之墓的许可，并与 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}的幽灵交谈；但在此过程开始之前，必须先击败这个房间中的危险真菌。

葬园 中等 6

@UUID[Actor.qe6TeAuJRX2zPaS2]{真菌莱西 (6)} @UUID[Actor.HG9HAFwYEPEWFw5l]{黏菌怪 (2)}

生物：一旦玩家角色开始穿过房间，种植箱中生长的数团真菌便会开始颤动，接着猛然活动起来。它们因苦迦菩提如梦般的死亡而获得生命，并被宁多鲁这位半神的施虐欲与残忍所灌注；这些真菌怪物站起身来发动攻击，急切地想要杀死玩家角色，并把他们的身体拖入泥土中，作为更多供自己生长的肥料。这些生物由两只黏菌怪和六只残忍的真菌莱西组成；前者是无心智的掠食者，却仍带着令人不安的残酷感发动攻击，偏好寻找生命值较低的目标；后者每一只都将骨头的碎片与残块嵌入自己畸形的、几乎只能勉强看出类人轮廓的身体之中。除了潮湿真菌组织挪动时发出的声音外，这些生物在战斗中始终诡异地保持沉默，而且它们不会追击离开这间房间的敌人。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.QYcPdXc1CPMTj1GP]{花园}
如果玩家角色杀死这些真菌，那么一名花费10分钟搜索这个房间的玩家角色，会发现一些武僧们遗留下来的宝藏：一株缠在其中一只真菌莱西残骸上的远古槲寄生，以及一根躺在雄鹿雕像后方地面上、被几条散发恶臭的藤蔓盖住的翠绿法杖。

奖励：如果玩家角色净化了雄鹿雕像，给予他们40 XP。

E12. Burial Garden Moderate 6

The air in this chamber feels humid and unusually warm. A row of four twenty-foot-long wooden planter boxes filled with earth sit in the middle of the room, each overgrown with diseased-looking weeds, damp fungi, and glistening vines. A low table with moldy cushions around it sits to the east, near a small wooden door to the northeast; a statue of a stag covered with damp, diseased vines stands near this door.

The northeast door leads down to the storeroom (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e14storagero00]{E14}).

Before the monastery was abandoned, this large room served the monks as a place to grow food, cultivate flowers, and dispose of the dead. To the monks of the Tan Sugi monastery, the concept of being reincarnated as a plant, as Tan Sui-Jing was, represented a specific form of enlightenment, and when a monk died, they were buried in the planter boxes here so their remains could nurture the plants their spirits hoped to reincarnate into. Once a body was reduced to bones, those bones were honored in a long, complex ritual that included the remains being exhumed, powdered, and then sprinkled back into the soil. In this way, the monks hoped to bolster Tan Sui-Jing’s (hopefully eternal) vigil over Kugaptee’s grave. Perhaps a grim tradition to some, to the monks (who believed that once the spirit moved on from the body, a new body awaited them), the remains left behind after death were simply a relic of the past. This place once had potent magical effects to help give the plants here a place to grow and thrive despite being indoors, but those effects quickly faded once the monastery was abandoned.

The abandonment of the monastery and its fall to those corrupted by Kugaptee manifests within this chamber physically, for the beautiful, hearty, and nutritious plants that grew here have been replaced by diseased weeds and parasitic fungi. The air in this room is humid and thick with foul-smelling spores; a non-plant or non-fungus creature that begins its turn in this room must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). This is an olfactory and poison effect, and if a character critically succeeds at the saving throw, they’re temporarily immune to it for 24 hours.

The stag statue is one of the four statues that must be purified in order to gain access to Kugaptee’s grave and speak to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}’s ghost, but before this process can be started, the dangerous fungi in this chamber must be defeated.

Burial Garden Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.qe6TeAuJRX2zPaS2]{Fungus Leshies (6)} @UUID[Actor.HG9HAFwYEPEWFw5l]{Slime Molds (2)}

Creatures: Once the PCs begin to move through the room, several clots of fungi growing throughout the planter boxes begin to shudder and lurch into motion. Given life by Kugaptee’s dreaming death and infused with the nindoru demigod’s sadism and cruelty, these fungal monsters rise up and attack, eager to murder the PCs and drag their bodies into the dirt to be used as yet more fertilizer for them to grow in. The creatures consist of two slime molds (mindless predators that still attack with an unsettling sense of cruelty, preferring to seek out lower Hit Point targets) and six cruel fungus leshies, each of which incorporates fragments and pieces of bone into their malformed, barely-humanoid-looking bodies. Apart from the wet sound of shifting fungal matter, all these creatures remain eerily silent as they fight, and they don’t pursue foes out of this room.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.QYcPdXc1CPMTj1GP]{Garden}
If the PCs kill the fungi, a PC who spends 10 minutes Searching the room uncovers a few treasures left behind by the monks: a primeval mistletoe tangled up in the remains of one of the fungus leshies, and a verdant staff lying under several nasty-smelling vines on the ground behind the stag statue.

Reward: If the PCs purify the stag statue, grant them 40 XP.

Hidden Library.name: 藏匿的图书馆 Hidden Library
Hidden Library.text:
E11. 藏匿的图书馆 严重 6

书架沿着这间房间的大部分墙壁排列，房间中央放着一张低矮的圆桌，周围环绕着坐垫。一具骷髅瘫伏在桌上，手中握着书写羽毛笔，头骨下压着一本摊开的书。

这具骷髅属于闫瑞，她是丹杉寺最后一位忠诚的武僧。她奋战到最后，试图抵抗苦迦菩提的腐化，却最终被逼入这间房间，而其余武僧则死在附近的图书馆里。她设法维持了魔法护，防止他人进入图书馆，但她没料到叛徒们竟会直接锁上门，将她封死在里面，把这间房间变成她的墓穴。她最终死于干渴，但在那之前，她已尽己所能，确保自己关于苦迦菩提的研究被记录下来。

藏匿的图书馆 严重 6

@UUID[Actor.cqYzLo7R7P0f9Lqu]{严蕊的骚灵（3）}

生物：闫瑞的灵魂如今栖居于此，但她并未显现为幽灵，而是凭借自己强大的魔法能力浸透了这间藏匿的图书馆中存放的每一本文本。她如今作为房间中一个无形的存在而存在，无法离开，但力量足以阻止苦迦菩提的信徒进入。必要时，她可以在这间房间中实体显现以保护这里——将这些显现视为三个精英骚灵，但她不太可能需要这么做来抵御玩家角色对这间房间的威胁。

玩家角色进入房间后不久，闫瑞便会向他们打招呼。她的声音无形无体，仿佛同时从房间四面八方低语而来。她会尽力安抚玩家角色对她可能是邪恶幽灵或作祟的恐惧，并承诺如果他们告诉她来意，她就能提供帮助。她会在玩家角色说话时安静倾听，并尽可能提供指引，敦促玩家角色继续净化那些雕像，向他们说明寺院的布局（她不知道现在各个房间里潜藏着什么危险，但至少能告诉玩家角色其他受腐化雕像的位置），并承诺他们可以在这里休息恢复，因为寺院中的邪恶不会打扰他们的睡眠。你可以用闫瑞来回答玩家角色可能提出的其他问题。其中一些回答可能与 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠} 能给出的答案相似（第364页）；或者，你也可以让闫瑞坦承自己并不知情，然后建议玩家角色继续净化雕像，这样他们就能亲自向智惠提出这些问题。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.nPZZarpBXhLc6Dlq]{骷髅} @UUID[Actor.HYVG5wJpk4duYOkl]{书架}
头骨下方摊开的书中记有闫瑞的笔记；如果玩家角色没有与她交谈，而是决定摧毁这些骚灵，那么他们仍可借此获得上述信息。

这间房间中存放的大多数书籍和卷轴都与 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐} 的教诲有关，但其中还有一小部分特别罕见的书籍，构成了一组意义重大的藏书。作为整体，这批藏书在调查或对与这一哲学相关的主题进行回忆知识时，能为善解学识、忍堕魔学识和宗教检定提供+2物品加值；整套藏书共计12负载，价值600 gp。不过，对玩家角色而言，这批藏书最大的价值在于下一幕中他们可以借此了解柳岸镇心景的真相。

若要彻底搜索这里的书架，需要花费1小时；但如果玩家角色与闫瑞关系友善，她会将以下重要物品作为谢礼赠予他们，让这些物品自行从书架上飘出。这些宝藏包括一本 次等滋补清洁书卷、数张卷轴（纠缠命运卷轴、生命新绽卷轴、预言家之运卷轴、神圣雨云卷轴、明日黎明卷轴，以及镜墙术卷轴；这些新法术的详细内容见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20newspells00000]{冒险工具箱}），以及一本大书，题为《循环的守望者》。这本书的前半部分收录了数百则简短寓言与故事，取材自各种不同宗教，并经过筛选整理，以传授对善解的信徒有益的教训。如果角色在研究任何与桑博齐或转生有关的主题时参考此书，他们进行善解学识或宗教检定来回忆知识时，可获得+1物品加值。本书的后半部分包含数个仪式的配方，包括 食月、终夜守夜、掠夺黑夜、招待失者 和 如蜜冬至（这些仪式的详细内容见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20newspells00000]{冒险工具箱}，自第310页起）。本书最后几页则记载了仪式 转生术 的配方。《循环的守望者》价值90 gp。

奖励：如果玩家角色与闫瑞交谈并成功得知她所知的信息，则给予他们120 XP。

转生

如果玩家角色从 循环的守望者 中学会了 转生术，他们就能够如常使用这一仪式，让死者在新身体中复活。如此一来，转生后的生物依然是柳岸镇心景的一部分，不会因此洞悉心景的本质，而且他们所谓的“活着”也只是局限于作为被困在心景中的灵魂这一语境之下，就像玩家角色自这条冒险路径开始以来一直所处的状态一样。在这条冒险路径的后续内容中，关于转生术的知识将变得极其重要，因为玩家角色将利用这一知识研究一种方法，从而能够解除柳岸镇心景，并让一切回归现代、鲜活的世界。

E11. Hidden Library Severe 6

Shelves line most of this room’s walls, while a low round table sits in the middle of the room, surrounded by sitting cushions. A skeleton lies slumped over the table, a writing quill in hand and an open book under the skull.

The skeleton belongs to Yen Rui, the last loyal monk of the Tan Sugi monastery. She’d fought to the end to resist Kugaptee’s corruption, only to be forced into this room while the remaining monks perished in the nearby library. She managed to maintain magical wards to prevent entry into the library, but she hadn’t expected the traitors to simply lock the doors, sealing her in and turning this chamber into her crypt. She perished of thirst, but not before she did her best to ensure her research on Kugaptee was recorded.

Hidden library Severe 6

@UUID[Actor.cqYzLo7R7P0f9Lqu]{Yen Rui's Poltergeists (3)}

Creatures: Yen Rui’s spirit dwells here now, but rather than manifest as a ghost, her potent magical abilities infused every single text stored in this hidden library. She now exists as a disembodied presence in the room, unable to leave yet empowered well enough to prevent Kugaptee’s faithful from entering. If she must, she can manifest physically in this room to protect it—treat these manifestations as three elite poltergeists, but it’s unlikely she’ll need to do so to defend the room against the PCs.

Yen Rui greets the PCs soon after they enter the room, speaking in a disembodied voice that seems to whisper from all corners of the room at once. She does her best to soothe the PCs’ fears that she might be a sinister ghost or haunt, promising that she can help if they tell her what they’re here for. She listens quietly as the PCs speak and provides what guidance she can, urging the PCs to continue to purify the statues, giving them advice on the monastery’s layout (she doesn’t know what dangers await in the rooms now but can, at the very least, tell the PCs where the other corrupted statues are), and promising that they can rest and recuperate here knowing that the evils in the monastery won’t interrupt their sleep. You can use Yen Rui to answer other questions the PCs might have. Some of these responses might be similar to answers that @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} can give (page 364); alternatively, you can have Yen Rui admit ignorance but then suggest the PCs continue purifying statues so they can ask these questions of Zhi Hui herself.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.nPZZarpBXhLc6Dlq]{Skull} @UUID[Actor.HYVG5wJpk4duYOkl]{Book Shelves}
The open book under the skull contains Yen Rui’s notes, giving the PCs access to the information above if, instead of speaking to her, they decide to destroy the poltergeists.

The majority of the books and scrolls stored in this room concern the teachings of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi}, but a smaller selection of particularly rare books makes up a significant collection that, as a whole, grants a +2 item bonus to Sangpotshi Lore, Nindoru Lore, and Religion checks while Investigating or Recalling Knowledge on topics related to this philosophy; the collection in all is 12 Bulk and worth 600 gp. This collection’s greatest value to the PCs, though, is their use in the next act when learning the truth about the Willowshore mindscape.

A full search of the shelves here takes an hour, but if the PCs are on friendly terms with Yen Rui, she presents the following important items to the PCs as thanks, causing them to float off their shelves. These treasures include a lesser tome of restorative cleansing, several scrolls (a scroll of entangle fate, a scroll of life’s fresh bloom, a scroll of prophet’s luck, a scroll of sacred nimbus, a scroll of tomorrow’s dawn, and a scroll of wall of mirrors; all of these new spells are detailed the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20newspells00000]{Adventure Toolbx}), and a large book bearing the title Watchers of the Cycle. The first half of this book contains hundreds of short parables and stories culled from a wide range of religions, each curated for the lessons they can impart to a follower of Sangpotshi. If a character references this book while researching any topic relating to Sangpotshi or reincarnation, they gain a +1 item bonus to any Sangpotshi Lore or Religion checks to Recall Knowledge. The second half of the book contains the formulas for several rituals, including gnaw at the moon, last night’s vigil, ransack the night, regale the lost ones, and sweetest solstice (all of these rituals are detailed the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20newspells00000]{Adventure Toolbox}, starting on page 310). The final pages of the book contain the formula for the ritual reincarnate. Watchers of the Cycle is worth 90 gp.

Reward: If the PCs speak with Yen Rui and manage to learn what she knows, grant them 120 XP.

Reincarnation

If the PCs learn reincarnate from Watchers of the Cycle, they’ll be able to use the ritual normally to bring the dead back to life in a new body. When they do, the reincarnated creature remains a part of the Willowshore mindscape and receives no insight into the nature of the mindscape, and they’re “alive” only in the context of being a trapped soul within the mindscape, just as the PCs have been since the start of this Adventure Path. Later in this Adventure Path, knowledge of reincarnate will become incredibly important, as the PCs will use this knowledge to research a method by which they can undo the Willowshore mindscape and return everything to the modern, living world.

Library.name: 图书馆 Library
Library.text:
E10. 图书馆 中等 6

这间图书馆的墙壁已被熏得焦黑，烧毁后化为灰色的破烂搁板残片上滴落着肮脏的雨水，落在因屋顶塌陷而暴露的地板上。书籍与卷轴都被撕得粉碎，所有家具也全都被掀翻。

这座曾属于丹杉寺的图书馆，如今在烧焦的瓦砾中只剩下寥寥几本书。武僧们曾花费数十年扩充寺院的图书馆，将其打造为宗教知识的宝库，但当辛月与她的追随者带着她们豢养的地狱犬在此与最后几名仍存的武僧对峙时，这一切都被毁灭了。随后发生的大火让房间沦为废墟，寺院中最后那些未被腐化的武僧尽数死去，也让@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月}更加确信自己做出了正确的选择。

通往藏匿的图书馆（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11}）的暗门，可以由在门大致位置使用搜索的玩家角色发现，或通过花费10分钟搜索房间并成功进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:搜索]检定来找到，除非玩家角色们已经净化了 至少两尊雕像；若是如此，当他们接近到离门20尺内时，门便会柔和地发光，使其被自动发现。门在发光时没有上锁；否则，玩家角色必须要么以一次成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:27|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:强行打开]检定强行打开这扇门，要么以一次成功的 @Check[thievery|dc:25|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:开锁]检定开锁。

图书馆 中等 6

@UUID[Actor.jcCnDDp13OAELZiL]{爱怛魔 (2)}
生物：一对步履蹒跚的爱怛灵堕魔在这间房间中蹒跚徘徊，时不时用它们的破损武士刀拨弄灰烬，举起一张破败的纸页凝视片刻，然后将其丢弃，或只是茫然望向远方。它们对玩家角色的到来毫无反应，直到自己遭到攻击（此时它们会战斗至死）、被搭话，或被人接近。在后两种情况下，其中一只爱怛魔会继续无视玩家角色，而另一只则会以低沉、空洞的声音问道：“你们记得吗？这里曾经有什么？你们记得吗？谁曾在这里？”玩家角色可以通过编造故事来对这些邪魔说谎，也可以尽自己所知尝试说出真相。无论哪种情况，他们都必须尝试进行一次 @Check[deception|dc:22] 或 @Check[diplomacy|dc:22] 检定。

大成功 宁多鲁斯被这些揭示震住了，其中一只会透露房间中那本护卫祷告之书的位置（见下文“宝藏”），并说道：“那你们肯定也记得这个，对吧？”宁多鲁斯不会发动攻击，除非玩家角色在他们初次见面时先动手；但若玩家角色稍后再次回到这间房间，这些邪魔会立刻攻击，因为它们已经忘记了先前的遭遇。若玩家角色在离开前攻击宁多鲁斯，这些分心的邪魔在进行先攻时掷纯骰检定，而非进行察觉检定。

成功 如大成功，但这些邪魔不会提及宝藏。

失败 这些邪魔晃动它们空空如也的笼子脑袋，然后悲伤地说道：“如果你们不记得，为什么还要对我们说谎？也许你们临死前的尖叫会揭示真相！”随后它们发动攻击。

大失败 如失败，但玩家角色那漏洞百出的叙述让这些邪魔愤怒至极，因此在战斗开始后的前两轮中，它们处于迅捷状态；它们只能将额外动作用于魅影野猪行走或打击。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.G67uVoAaG7eTgO5s]{瓦砾}
虽然图书馆已经彻底破败不堪，但并非所有东西都在大火中毁掉了。勤勉的玩家角色若花费至少10分钟在瓦砾中搜寻，便会在一层灰烬之下发现一本献给@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}的护卫祷告之书。

E10. Library Moderate 6

The walls of this library have been charred black, and the tatters of burned and ash-grayed shelves drip dirty rainwater onto the floor where the roof has caved in. Books and scrolls have been shredded to pieces, and all of the furniture has been overturned.

Few books remain in the burned rubble of what once was the Tan Sugi monastery’s library. The monks spent decades building up the monastery’s library as a storehouse of religious knowledge, but all of that was destroyed when Xin Yue and her followers confronted the last few remaining monks here with their pet hell hounds. The resulting fire left the room in ruins, the final non-corrupted monks in the monastery dead, and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue} with the conviction that she’d made the right choice.

The secret door to the hidden library (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11}) can be found by a PC who Seeks in the door’s approximate location or spends 10 minutes to Search the room and succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check, unless the PCs have purified at least two of the statues, in which case the door glows softly once they approach within 20 feet of it, making its discovery automatic. The door is unlocked if it’s glowing; otherwise, a PC must either Force Open the door with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:27|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] check or Pick the Lock with a successful @Check[thievery|dc:25|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] check.

Library Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.jcCnDDp13OAELZiL]{Ijda (2)}
Creatures: A pair of lumbering ijda nindorus shamble through this room, periodically sifting through the ashes with their broken katanas, lifting up a ruined page to peer at it before discarding it or simply staring into the distance. They don’t react to the PCs’ arrival until they’re attacked (in which case they fight to the death), addressed, or approached. In the latter two cases, one of the ijdas continues to ignore the PCs while the other asks in a deep, hollow-sounding voice, “Do you remember? What was here? Do you remember? Who was here?” The PCs can Lie to the fiends by making up a story, or they can attempt to tell the truth as far as they know. In either case, they must attempt a @Check[deception|dc:22] or @Check[diplomacy|dc:22] check.

Critical Success The nindorus are astounded at the revelations, and one of them reveals the location of the hidden book of warding prayers in the room (see Treasure, below), saying, “Then surely you must remember this?” The nindorus don’t attack unless the PCs do during their first meeting, but if the PCs return later to this room, the fiends attack at once, having forgotten the encounter already. If the PCs attack the nindorus before leaving, the distracted fiends roll flat checks for initiative rather than Perception checks.

Success As critical success, but the fiends don’t mention the treasure.

Failure The fiends shake their empty cage-heads, then mournfully say, “If you don’t remember, why lie to us? Perhaps your dying screams will reveal the truth!” before they attack.

Critical Failure As failure, but the PCs’ fumbling narrative so enrages the fiends that for the first two rounds of combat, they’re quickened; they can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.G67uVoAaG7eTgO5s]{Rubble}
While the library is in a complete state of disrepair, not everything was destroyed in the fire. Diligent PCs who spend at least 10 minutes Searching through the rubble uncover a book of warding prayers devoted to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} under a layer of ashes.

Dorms.name: 宿舍 Dorms
Dorms.text:
E9. 宿舍 Moderate 6

两排狭窄、看起来很不舒服的双层床是这间房里唯一的陈设，不过其中几张床已被压碎，又被推到东北角屋顶破洞下方，形成了一个由瓦砾堆成、看起来湿漉漉的巢。床上的床单和薄床垫都已发霉，气味难闻。北边有三只半塌的衣柜，歪斜地靠在墙边。

这片区域曾是武僧们的主要宿舍。武僧们在这些床上轮班休息，因为武僧人数比床位更多；他们也用北边的衣柜存放自己少得可怜的私人物品。就连寺院的创立者，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}，也是睡在这里，与其他人同住。

生物：如今栖居在这片废墟中的宁多鲁斯里，体型最大的一只孤寂魔就住在这里，它把几张床压碎，做成了那个看起来湿漉漉的巢。这只生物大多数时候都窝在自己的巢里打滚，偶尔起身，慢吞吞地走出寺院，在周围林地里闲逛，再沿着朝圣之径一路踏行到山岳神龛，然后返回。每次外出时，它都会为自己过去几个月里在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7}烹煮的炖汤收集更多原料。由你决定，如果玩家角色在击败孤寂魔之前离开寺院，他们可能会在路上遭遇游荡仁灯如。

孤寂魔身边侍奉着五只阿谀献媚的莫啖魔，它们为它按摩身体两侧和腿部，还不停乞求食物。它们表现好的时候，孤寂魔会喂它们一些那锅味道恶劣的炖汤；但通常莫啖魔们都不够乖，只能靠啃食零碎瓦砾将就。

一旦发现玩家角色，孤寂魔会从巢中起身，招手示意玩家角色靠近，并请他们分享旅途中的故事。宁多鲁是真心想听每位玩家角色讲一个故事，但每当玩家角色开始讲述时，允许角色们为整个队伍进行一次@Check[perception|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive]检定来察言观色。成功时，玩家角色会注意到宁多鲁斯舔着嘴唇，并竭力掩饰肚子发出的咕噜声。

最终，孤寂魔会让玩家角色去区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7}“把晚餐拿来”，打算与他们分享这顿闹鬼的饭食。如果玩家角色一路把锅搬到这里都没有打开，那么锅仍保有其闹鬼特性，但如果由孤寂魔来打开，它就不会触发。然而，任何接受并吃下一份的非宁多鲁生物，仍会受到@Damage[5d6[poison]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic]豁免）。用餐之后，孤寂魔会分享一则它自己游荡时的故事，提到它在寺院里漫步的经历。你可以借此机会，向玩家角色揭示寺院中一处他们尚未发现的隐藏危险或宝藏。

宿舍 Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.8rc8nf8rTES8Rwta]{孤寂魔} @UUID[Actor.mqTFTmYQoUKUyj2e]{莫啖魔（5）}

如果玩家角色以故事取悦宁多鲁，并在不发动攻击的情况下享用了这顿有毒的饭食，这只邪魔就会拍拍自己的肚子，用几乎有些失望的语气说：“你们真是很棒的客人；可惜我们现在也不得不把你们全都吃掉了。”它们会立刻发动攻击，但由于吃得太撑，又被那难喝的混合物灌得有点醉，孤寂魔在战斗开始时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}状态。莫啖魔们则因为这顿美餐而欣喜若狂，在战斗的前两轮中处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速1}状态，因为它们花了太多时间打着嗝、咕噜作响地向厨师大加赞美，以表达满足之情。

一旦战斗开始，宁多鲁斯便会战至死。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.Pmx28vdIDhOmGuEd]{宿舍}
武僧们离开时带走了大部分私人物品，但其中一名武僧忘记取走一枚灵视戒指，那枚戒指被他藏在自己床垫下方一处小裂口里。若玩家角色在房间内进行搜寻，并成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search]检定，便会找到这枚戒指。

E9. Dorms Moderate 6

Twin rows of narrow, uncomfortable-looking bunks are this room’s only decoration, although several have been crushed and then pushed together under a hole in the roof to the northeast, forming a damp-looking nest made of rubble. The sheets and thin mattresses on the bunks are moldy and smell awful. To the north, three partially collapsed dressers are slumped against the wall.

This area served as the main living quarters for the monks. The monks rested in these beds, sleeping in shifts since there were more monks than beds, and used the dressers to the north to store their meager personal belongings. Even the founder of the monastery, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}, slept here with the others.

Creatures: One of the largest of the nindorus dwelling in the ruins today, a guhdggi, has taken up residence here, crushing several of the beds into the damp-looking nest. The creature spends most of their time wallowing in their nest, periodically getting up to lumber out of the monastery to walk around in the surrounding woods and trod Pilgrim’s Path up to the mountain shrine and back. During these excursions, they gather more ingredients for the stew they’ve been cooking in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7} for the past few months. At your discretion, if the PCs leave the monastery before they defeat the guhdggi, they could encounter the wandering nindoru along the path.

The guhdggi is attended by a group of five simpering meokdans who massage their flanks and legs, constantly begging for food. When they’re good, the guhdggi feeds them some of the foul-tasting stew, but usually, the meokdans aren’t good and have to settle for eating bits of rubble.

Upon spotting the PCs, the guhdggi rouses from their nest and waves the PCs over, asking them to share stories of their journeys. The nindoru is legitimately eager to hear a tale from each PC, but each time the PCs start a story, allow the characters to attempt a @Check[perception|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] check to Sense Motive for the group as a whole. On a success, the PCs note the way the nindorus lick their lips and do their best to hide the rumbling in their stomachs.

Eventually, the guhdggi asks the PCs to go “fetch dinner” from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7}, intending to share the haunted meal with them. If the PCs carry the pot all the way here without opening it, the pot retains its haunted nature but doesn’t trigger if the guhdggi opens it. However, any non-nindoru who accepts and eats a serving still takes @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save). After this meal, the guhdggi shares one of their own tales of wandering, mentioning their strolls through the monastery. You can use this as an opportunity to reveal to the PCs one of the hidden dangers or treasures in the monastery that they haven’t yet found.

Dorms Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.8rc8nf8rTES8Rwta]{Guhdggi} @UUID[Actor.mqTFTmYQoUKUyj2e]{Meokdans (5)}

If the PCs humor the nindoru with stories and partake of the poison meal without attacking, the fiend rubs their belly and, in an almost disappointed voice, says, “You’ve been such great guests; it’s a shame that we’ll have to eat you all now too.” They attack at once, but gorged and slightly drunk on the foul concoction, the guhdggi begins the fight @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}. The meokdans are so ecstatic about the fine meal that they’re @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for the first two rounds of combat, as they take too much time to compliment the chef with belches and gurgles of satisfaction.

Once combat begins, the nindorus fight to the death.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.Pmx28vdIDhOmGuEd]{Dorms}
The monks took most of their personal effects with them when they left, but one of the monks forgot a spiritsight ring that they’d hidden in a small tear under their mattress. A PC finds the ring if they succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check while Searching in the room.

Storage.name: 储存 Storage
Storage.text:
E8. 储藏室

厚厚的灰尘覆盖着这间食品储藏间里的搁板和储物容器。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.YIiNO31W9RalcQBQ]{储藏室} @UUID[Actor.lgdHpG7TBVzDDGcw]{松动的地板石块}
这里储存的大部分食物早已腐烂殆尽，但若有一名玩家角色花费 1 分钟在此搜寻，就会找到大量茶叶，其中包括一罐价值 150 gp 的稀有茶叶罐。在制作魔茶时，若使用一部分这种稀有茶叶来抵消所消耗的原材料，则制作检定获得 +1 物品加值。若将其全部用于为区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e6refectory000]{E6} 中的不死生物举行茶道，则主持仪式的检定获得 +2 物品加值。

若一名玩家角色花费 10 分钟搜寻这间储藏室，并成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定，就会在房间西南角一块松动的地板石块下发现一处藏匿得极其巧妙的宝藏——一个II 型宽敞腰包，其中装有数量惊人的珠宝、小雕像及其他精美艺术品，总价值达 200 gp。这个袋子原本属于一名叫卡伦·布雷的盗贼；如今他作为一名不死生物囚犯，仍“生活”在寺院地下室的储藏室（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e14storagero00]{E14}）。在被抓获前，他把这个装满自己从柳岸镇民居中偷来的全部财富的袋子藏在了这里。当玩家角色发现这处赃物藏匿点时，若有玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[society|dc:15] 或 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15] 检定，就会认出这些失窃物品正是今年早些时候、春季最后一天前后约一个月内失踪的那些东西。

奖励：如果玩家角色将这些失窃物品归还给柳岸镇的镇民，则给予他们 60 XP 和 2 希望点。

E8. Storage

Thick layers of dust cover the shelves and containers stored in this pantry.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.YIiNO31W9RalcQBQ]{Storage} @UUID[Actor.lgdHpG7TBVzDDGcw]{Loose Floor Stone}
Most of the food stored here has long since rotted away, but a PC who spends a minute Searching here finds a large supply of tea leaves, including a tin of rare tea worth 150 gp. Using some of this rare tea to cover the raw materials consumed when crafting magic tea grants a +1 item bonus to the Crafting check. Using all of it to perform a tea ceremony for the undead in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e6refectory000]{E6} grants a +2 item bonus to the check to Host Ceremony.

A PC who takes 10 minutes Searching this storeroom and succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check discovers a very cleverly hidden treasure under a loose floor stone in the southwest corner of the room—a type II spacious pouch that contains an astounding amount of jewelry, statuettes, and other fine art, worth a total of 200 gp. The bag itself belonged to a thief named Kalen Bray, who now “lives on” as an undead prisoner in the monastery basement storage room (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e14storagero00]{E14}). He stashed this bag containing all the stolen wealth he’d pilfered from homes in Willowshore here before he was captured. When the PCs discover this stash, a PC who succeeds at a @Check[society|dc:15] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:15] check recognizes the stolen objects as things that went missing a month or so before the last day of spring earlier in the year.

Reward: If the PCs return the stolen items to the townsfolk of Willowshore, grant them 60 XP and 2 Hope Points.

Kitchen.name: 厨房 Kitchen
Kitchen.text:
E7. 厨房 Trivial 6

这间厨房的东南部有一座陶土炉灶。炉灶上方的烹煮锅盖着一只带污渍的锅盖，里面正咕嘟冒泡，下方炉膛中的火仍在燃烧。其余地方则散落着毁坏的桌子和搁板，横陈在地板上。

武僧们曾在此烹煮餐食，通常由米饭、花园里种植或从森林中采来的青菜，以及汤或炖菜组成。来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e9dorms0000000]{E9} 的古狄忍堕魔正在慢炖一大锅原本由胡乱切碎、未剥皮的洋葱、几整瓣大蒜、一根被它用爪击切开的萝卜，以及一只倒霉黑坊主的肝脏和肠子组成的炖煮物——那黑坊主只是恰好在错误的时间出现在错误的地点。宁多鲁每发现一种新食材，就会把它加入这锅炖煮物中；它一边啜饮如今已腐败酸馊的浆液，一边吞食受害者的灵魂，并不时用这些东西赏赐给那些受它支配、正“饥饿”着的莫啖魔。

厨房 Trivial 6

@UUID[Actor.5P2jOuVbvr3dzaKV]{邪秽饥渴}

危害：如果玩家角色掀开炖锅的盖子，一颗煮熟的眼球就会从这锅恶臭、受作祟侵染的混合物中瞪视着他们。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.l7lKM6DUpbuKqOhC]{厨房}
如果该作祟被击败，锅中的液体会迅速蒸发，留下黏性残留物；角色可在花费1分钟工作并成功通过一次 @Check[crafting|dc:22] 检定后采集它，制成5剂效果等同于猎蛛毒的毒素。若失败，则角色只能制成1剂；若大失败，则一剂也制不成，且还会暴露于该毒素之下。此外，还能从此房间的器具中收集到一套用于煮茶与奉茶的纯银工匠工具包。

E7. Kitchen Trivial 6

A clay furnace occupies the southeast portion of this kitchen. A cooking pot atop the furnace bubbles under a stained lid, a fire burning in the hearth below it. Elsewhere, ruined tables and shelves lie scattered on the floor.

The monks cooked their meals here, usually consisting of rice, greens grown in the garden or foraged from the forest, and soup or stew. The guhdggi nindoru from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e9dorms0000000]{E9} is in the process of slow-cooking a vat of stew originally consisting of poorly chopped, unpeeled onions, several whole cloves of garlic, a radish sliced up with its claws, and the liver and intestines of an unfortunate kurobozu who was in the wrong place at the wrong time. The nindoru adds to the vat of stew each time they come across a new ingredient, slurping down the now-rancid slosh alongside the souls of their victims and, periodically, rewarding the “starving” meokdans who he lords over.

Kitchen Trivial 6

@UUID[Actor.5P2jOuVbvr3dzaKV]{Unholy Hunger}

Hazards: If a PC pulls the lid off the stew, a boiled eyeball stares up at them from the foul-smelling, haunted concoction.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.l7lKM6DUpbuKqOhC]{Kitchen}
If the haunt is defeated, the fluid in the pot quickly evaporates, leaving behind a sticky residue that a character can harvest after 1 minute of work and with a successful @Check[crafting|dc:22] check to produce 5 doses of poison that functions the same as hunting spider venom. On a failure, a character produces only one dose, and on a critical failure, they produce no doses but are exposed to the poison. In addition, a sterling artisan’s toolkit for brewing and serving tea can be gathered from the utensils in this room.

Refectory.name: 斋堂 Refectory
Refectory.text:
E6. 斋堂 重度 6

这间斋堂里堆满了几张毁坏的桌子和破损的长凳。这间房间或许曾经是个适合轻松用餐的优雅场所，但如今只让人感到寒冷而空荡。

武僧们曾经每天两次在这里一同进食。如今，桌子和坐垫全都被这些同样的武僧毁掉了；作为不死生物，他们知道自己进食的日子已经一去不返。脏污的碗碟散落在少数仍然立着的桌上，更多的则散落在地板上。

生物：三名不死生物武僧无精打采地站在这间房内，忧伤地凝视着这间曾带给他们同袍情谊的房间——即便是在他们为了苦迦菩提背叛师兄弟姐妹之后也是如此。三名黑坊主在PC进入时抬起头来，问道：“你们明白能够吃东西是多么令人愉悦的一件事吗？”这三名不死生物继续追问PC们他们最喜欢的食物，不断要求更多细节；如果他们得知有任何一名PC懂茶，便会要求其从食品储藏间（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e8storage00000]{E8}）取来材料，在厨房（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7}）为他们沏茶，然后回到这里为他们奉上。

如果PC们这么做，他们就必须进行@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00#host-ceremony]{主持仪式}，才能将茶正确地呈给三名黑坊主。如果PC们大成功，黑坊主显然对这茶感到满意，尽管他们根本尝不出味道；而在他们吞下之后，茶水会直接从他们胸口的孔洞里漏出来。这些生物会感谢PC们的慈悲，并补充道：“我们知道你们在寻找净化此地的方法，为了报答你们的善意，也让我们略尽绵薄之力。我们用那名闯入者的魔法斧头砍下了你们那位死亡女神的头，并把头放到了杉树上方的枝桠间，尽可能远离她的身体，放在我们所能触及的最远处。若你们想纠正我们对她雕像的亵渎，就得把它取回来。”说完，三名黑坊主便崩解为尘。若成功，黑坊主只会向PC们道谢，然后崩解为尘，不会提供这条建议。

斋堂 重度 6

@UUID[Actor.bdOAkorJbVOqobUp]{苦迦菩提武僧（3）}

如果PC们在还没准备好向三名不死生物奉茶时就回到这个房间，或者他们在尝试进行主持仪式时失败，三名黑坊主便会痛苦地尖叫并发起攻击，战斗直到被摧毁为止（不过他们不会从这间房内追击敌人）。

奖励：如果PC们通过茶道令黑坊主满意，则给予他们如同在战斗中击败这些生物一样的XP。

E6. Refectory Severe 6

Several ruined tables and broken benches lie in heaps within this refectory. The chamber might have once been a fine and relaxing place to take a meal, but now it feels cold and empty.

The monks once ate together twice a day here. Presently, the tables and seat cushions have all been ruined by the same monks who, as undead, know that their days of eating are behind them. Dirty bowls and plates are scattered across the few tables that still stand, while more lie scattered on the floor.

Creatures: A trio of undead monks stand listlessly in this chamber, mournfully staring at a room that once brought them camaraderie, even after they betrayed their brothers and sisters for Kugaptee. The three kurobozus look up as the PCs enter and ask, “Do you realize what a pleasure it is to be able to eat?” The two undead continue to ask the PCs about their favorite meals, pushing them for more and more details; if they learn that any of the PCs knows about tea, they ask them to fetch supplies from the pantry (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e8storage00000]{E8}), brew them some tea in the kitchen (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7}), and then return here to serve them.

If the PCs do so, they must @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog07turnin.JournalEntryPage.07restoringthe00#host-ceremony]{Host Ceremony} to properly present the tea to the three kurobozus. If the PCs critically succeed, the kurobozus are obviously satisfied with the tea, even though they can’t taste it, and after they swallow, the tea simply leaks out through holes in their chests. The creatures thank the PCs for their compassion and also mention, “We know you seek to purify this place, and in thanks for your kindness, let us offer some as well. We used the interloper’s magical axe to cleave the head of your death goddess free then placed the head in the upper boughs of the sugi tree, as far from her body as we could reach. You’ll need to retrieve it if you wish to rectify our desecration of her statue.” With that, the three kurobozus crumble to dust. On a success, the kurobozus simply thank the PCs and crumble to dust without offering this advice.

Refectory Severe 6

@UUID[Actor.bdOAkorJbVOqobUp]{Monks of Kugaptee (3)}

If the PCs return to this room without being ready to serve tea to the three undead, or if they fail in their attempt to Host Ceremony, the three kurobozus cry out in anguish and attack, fighting until destroyed (although they don’t pursue foes from this chamber).

Reward: If the PCs satisfy the kurobozus with a tea ceremony, grant them XP as if they’d defeated the creatures in combat.

Pharasma’s Shrine.name: 法莱斯玛的圣祠 Pharasma’s Shrine
Pharasma’s Shrine.text:
E5. 法莱斯玛的神殿 低阶 6

这间原本空荡荡的房间南侧，一尊气度庄严的女子木雕端坐于低矮的台座上，摆出冥想姿势。雕像周围堆满了骨头、枯叶和成块的木乃伊化血肉；它缺失的头颅看起来像是被一击斩落。沾着血迹、发霉的绳索被紧紧缠绕在雕像上，其间还绑附着更多陈旧骨骸与干肉碎片。

丹杉寺的武僧们遵循@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐}的教诲，但出于对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法莱斯玛}在宇宙生命与死亡循环中所扮演角色的尊重，他们仍在此处立起了这尊雕像。宁多鲁斯却毫无这份敬意，在它们出现在寺院后的第一个夏日，便玷污了这尊雕像。玩家角色若以成功的@Check[religion|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]回忆知识，便能辨认出这尊无头雕像描绘的是法莱斯玛；若大成功，则还能确认这种亵渎方式意在象征对她掌管生死之权的根本否定，表明在它们看来，她对这一真相视而不见，也无力改变自己的道路。

这尊雕像是四尊必须净化的雕像之一；唯有如此，才能获得进入苦迦菩提之墓的许可，并与智惠的幽灵交谈。在开始这一过程之前，必须先击败这间房内的生物，并将雕像遗失的头颅（位于区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e13thetansug00]{E13}）放回它断裂的颈项之上。一旦成功净化雕像，头颅便会以魔法自行接合，仿佛从未被斩落过一般。

场景注记宏

@UUID[Macro.xmmRfbitBY6ViuKM]{归还头颅}

生物：当玩家角色进入时，三个看似身穿长袍的武僧模样的生物正跪在雕像前，仿佛在祷告。实际上，这些“武僧”是索吉鲁赫宁铎罗；它们并非在祷告，而是在冥思法莱斯玛存在于多元宇宙中的徒劳无意义，并准备以仪式重新用它们放在面前地上的新绳圈捆缚雕像。若这些邪魔注意到玩家角色，它们便会起身转向众人，缝合的嘴唇不安地抽动着，向玩家角色致意。索闹们急于弄清玩家角色为何来到这座圣祠，并试图说服他们“死后生命”不过是神话而已。“死亡之后，只有我们！”它们如此说道，并主动提出杀死玩家角色来证明自己的说法。你可以借这些邪魔透露一些关于寺院的情报（例如，留下来的武僧如今都已成了不死生物、它们由一位名叫@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月}的人领导，甚至寺院创立者的幽灵也被囚禁于此），但这些邪魔很快就会厌倦交谈，转而向玩家角色发出挑战。

挑战很简单：玩家角色要绕中央庭院跑一圈，从这里前往@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e1grandgate000]{宏伟之门}区域，再到@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7}区域、@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e6refectory000]{E6}区域、@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e3mainhall0000]{E3}区域、@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e4infirmary000]{E4}区域，最后回到这里。宁多鲁斯知道这些区域中很可能有危险阻碍玩家角色通行，但它们仍告诉众人：只要哪怕有一名玩家角色能在宁多鲁斯完成重新捆缚这尊被亵渎的法莱斯玛雕像之前跑完整个路线，它们就会给予对方一件贵重宝藏作为奖励。

法莱斯玛的神殿 低阶 6

@UUID[Actor.Bilhe9obVVB9UFFx]{索闹灵堕魔（3）}

宁多鲁斯并不在乎玩家角色是否老老实实地跑这场比赛，还是用了什么花招；若玩家角色在这项挑战期间离开，那么当他们回到这个房间时，会发现三个宁多鲁斯甚至还没开始重新捆缚雕像。它们会用“宝藏”来欢迎玩家角色归来——那是宁多鲁的“智慧”：“你们已按我们的挑战跑完一圈，但正如你们的生死循环一样，这循环本身毫无意义、空洞虚无，根本不值得信赖。”说完，三个宁多鲁斯便发动攻击。若玩家角色拒绝赛跑，它们也会发动攻击，并以窃取尖叫展开战斗。宁多鲁斯会战斗至死，并在整座寺院中追击敌人。

奖励：若玩家角色净化了法莱斯玛的雕像，给予他们40 XP。

E5. Pharasma’s Shrine Low 6

A wooden statue of a regal-looking woman sits in a meditative pose atop a low dais to the south of this otherwise empty room. Bones, dead leaves, and chunks of mummified flesh lie in heaps around the statue, whose missing head appears to have been hewn off by a single blow. Bloodstained, moldy ropes have been wrapped tightly around the statue, amid which many more old bones with bits of dried meat have been affixed.

The monks of the Tan Sugi monastery followed the teachings of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi}, but they erected this statue of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} here out of respect for the role she plays in the cosmic cycle of life and death. The nindorus hold no such respect and defiled this statue on the very first day of summer after they appeared in the monastery. With a successful @Check[religion|dc:10|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] to Recall Knowledge, a PC can identify the headless statue as depicting Pharasma; with a critical success, they confirm that the nature of the statue’s defiling is meant to represent a fundamental rejection of her power over life and death, indicating that she’s blind to the truth of it and powerless to change her ways.

The statue is one of the four that must be purified in order to gain access to Kugaptee’s grave and speak to Zhi Hui’s ghost. Before this process can be started, the creatures in this chamber must be defeated, and the statue’s missing head (found in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e13thetansug00]{E13}) must be placed atop the stump of the statue’s neck. Upon successfully purifying the statue, the head magically reattaches itself, as if it had never been hewed free in the first place.

Scene NotesMacro

@UUID[Macro.xmmRfbitBY6ViuKM]{Return Head}

Creatures: When the PCs enter, creatures who appear to be three robed monks kneel before the statue, as if in prayer. These monks are, in fact, sojiruh nindorus, and rather than praying, they’re meditating on the futility of Pharasma’s presence in the multiverse and preparing to ritualistically rebind the statue in a fresh coil of rope they’ve placed on the ground before themselves. If the fiends notice the PCs, they rise up and turn to face them, their stitched mouths twitching unnervingly as they greet the PCs. The sojiruhs are eager to find out why the PCs have come to the shrine and work to convince them that the idea of life after death is a myth. “After death, there is only us!” they promise, offering to kill the PCs to prove their points. You can use these fiends to reveal bits of information about the monastery (such as that the monks who remained are now all undead, that they’re led by someone named @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue}, or even that the ghost of the monastery’s founder is imprisoned here), but it shouldn’t be long before the fiends grow weary of conversation and issue a challenge to the PCs.

The challenge is simple. The PCs are to run a circle around the central courtyard, moving from this room to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e1grandgate000]{Grand Gate}, then to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e7kitchen00000]{E7}, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e6refectory000]{E6}, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e3mainhall0000]{E3}, area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e4infirmary000]{E4}, and finally back here. The nindorus know that dangers are likely to oppose the PCs’ passage through many of these areas but nonetheless tell the PCs that if even one of them can make their way through this circuit before the nindorus can complete the rebinding of Pharasma’s defiled statue, they’ll reward them with a valuable treasure.

Pharasma's Shrine Low 6

@UUID[Actor.Bilhe9obVVB9UFFx]{Sojiruhs (3)}

The nindorus don’t care if the PCs actually run the race honestly or cheat; should the PCs leave during this challenge, upon returning to this room, they’ll find the three nindorus haven’t even started rebinding the statue. They welcome back the PCs with “treasure” in the form of nindoru wisdom: “You have run a circuit as we challenged you to, yet as with your cycle of life and death, the cycle itself is meaningless, hollow, and not to be trusted.” With that, the three nindorus attack. They attack as well if the PCs refuse to race, opening combat with Stolen Scream. The nindorus fight to the death, pursuing foes throughout the monastery.

Reward: If the PCs purify Pharasma’s statue, grant them 40 XP.

Infirmary.name: 医务室 Infirmary
Infirmary.text:
E4. 医务室 Moderate 6

这间房间北侧的门被撕开了一个大洞。破烂的行军床、损坏的椅子和桌子，以及其他碎片散落在地板上，墙壁上还被划出了又深又长的裂痕。浓重的腐臭气味弥漫着整个房间，而破损的搁板则在西墙边堆成一团。

医务室 Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.bdOAkorJbVOqobUp]{苦迦菩提武僧（2）}

生物： 武僧们曾用这间房间来治疗病患和伤者，无论是同门武僧，还是需要协助的旅人。这个原本朴素的医务室，如今已被两名曾在此工作的武僧彻底搅得一片狼藉。在加入 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月} 对苦迦菩提的崇拜后，这两名武僧在心景吞没这片地区后化为黑坊主亡灵。两名苦迦菩提的亡灵武僧会在PC进入时踉跄着朝他们走来，但不会立刻攻击。相反，他们会齐声嘶哑地说道：“你们是来加入苦迦菩提的吗？你们是来挣脱生命这座监狱的吗？”这些亡灵渴望将PC献祭给他们的邪魔神祇，一旦显然看出队伍并不打算献上自己，便会迅速发动攻击。他们会在整座寺院内追击敌人，但会避开 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2} 区域，因为他们仍然畏惧并敬重那里的幽灵。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.9QM7HQKoZsnDpkga]{碎片}
橱柜和搁板都已破烂不堪，但仍可在碎片中找到两瓶中效治疗药水、一套专家级医疗工具，以及一双医者手套。

E4. Infirmary Moderate 6

A large hole has been torn into this room’s northern door. Shredded cots, ruined chairs and tables, and other debris adorn the floor, and deep, long gashes have been carved into the walls. A thick rancid smell permeates the chamber, while battered shelves lie in a heap against the western wall.

Infirmary Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.bdOAkorJbVOqobUp]{Monks of Kugaptee (2)}

Creatures: The monks once used this room to treat the sick and injured, be they fellow monks or travelers in need of aid. What was once a simple infirmary has been thrown into complete disarray by two of the monks who once worked here. After joining @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue} in the worship of Kugaptee, these two rose in undeath as kurobozus after the mindscape engulfed the region. The two undead monks of Kugaptee lurch toward the PCs as they enter but don’t attack at once. Instead, they rasp out in unison, “Have you come to join Kugaptee? Are you here to escape the prison of life?” The undead are eager to sacrifice the PCs to their fiendish god and swiftly attack as soon as it becomes apparent the party doesn’t intend to offer themselves up. They pursue foes throughout the monastery but avoid area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2}, as they still fear and respect the ghost there.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.9QM7HQKoZsnDpkga]{Debris}
The cabinets and shelves are in tatters, but two moderate healing potions, a set of expanded healer’s tools, and a pair of healer’s gloves can be found in the debris.

Main Hall.name: 主大厅 Main Hall
Main Hall.text:
E3. 主大厅 Moderate 6

这间露天厅室高达60英尺。墙壁上等距排列的拱门可让人望见周围的庭院，而在这些拱门之间，则雕刻并绘制着幽魂之森群山与森林的精美图景，只是色彩已渐渐褪去。厅室中央矗立着一尊50英尺高的石树雕像，枝桠向外伸展，覆盖整个房间。雕像四周的地面上摆着一圈圈发霉的坐垫。

这座开放式建筑曾是来到寺院的访客们首先停留之处。这尊巨大的石树雕像是丹杉树的半尺寸复制品，真正的丹杉树生长在北面不远处的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e13thetansug00]{E13}。武僧们将石块运至此处，雕成这尊塑像，再以魔法将其结合在一起，让朝圣者们能够在这棵神圣之树的近似化身前冥想并触碰它，因为只有武僧才被允许进入真正的杉树生长的北侧庭院。

这尊杉树雕像是必须净化的四尊雕像之一，净化后才能获得进入苦迦菩提之墓的许可，并与@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}的幽灵交谈；但在这一过程开始之前，必须先击败树中的作祟。

主大厅 Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.nBZYrLLAsuHwKjtW]{一反木绵 (4)} @UUID[Actor.VnIjJNtx29XGDofD]{苦迦菩提之树}

生物：这间厅室中最危险的威胁是雕像本身（见“危害”），但腐化雕像的同一种邪恶能量也在这些腐朽的坐垫间显现出其他实体。其中四个坐垫包裹着的并非长满真菌的布料，而是一反木绵付丧神；当危害触发时，这些怪物会从自己覆盖的潮湿填充物中猛然挣脱，攻击PC。它们会在整座寺院内追击敌人，并战斗至死。

危害：当苦迦菩提的影响渗入寺院时，此地的雕像原本作为场地的灵能守卫，起初吸收并净化了大量邪恶能量。随着时间推移，这股能量持续不断地涌入，最终满溢并腐化了雕像。如今，整个厅室都充斥着极其强烈的邪恶能量，强到甚至连灵堕魔都不愿进入，而雕像也已因苦迦菩提的存在而化为作祟之所。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.ngFhNTGn08ZJO8Xp]{主大厅}
一面护法盾遗落在雕像东侧发霉的坐垫之间，那是几年前一名倒霉的掠夺者留下的；他来到寺院时，心景尚未形成。

奖励：如果PC净化了这尊杉树雕像，给予他们40 XP。

E3. Main Hall Moderate 6

This open-air chamber has a sixty-foot ceiling. In between regularly spaced archways in the walls that allow views into the surrounding courtyard, intricate depictions of the hills and forests of Specterwood are carved and painted in fading colors. A fifty-foot-tall stone statue of a tree rises in the center of the chamber, its branches extending over the room. Circular rows of moldy cushions lie on the ground around the statue.

This open structure was the first stop for visitors to the monastery. The giant stone tree statue is a half-sized replica of the Tan Sugi tree, which grows not far to the north in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e13thetansug00]{E13}. The monks carved this statue from stone blocks hauled into place and bound together with magic so that pilgrims could meditate before and touch a close approximation of the sacred tree since only the monks were permitted to enter the northern courtyard where the actual tree grew.

The sugi statue is one of the four statues that must be purified in order to gain access to Kugaptee’s grave and speak to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}’s ghost, but before this process can be started, the haunt within the tree must be defeated.

Main hall Moderate 6

@UUID[Actor.nBZYrLLAsuHwKjtW]{Ittan-Momen (4)} @UUID[Actor.VnIjJNtx29XGDofD]{Kugaptee's Tree}

Creatures: The most dangerous peril within this chamber is the statue itself (see Hazards), but the same fell energies that have corrupted the statue manifest other entities among the moldering cushions. Four of these cushions are wrapped not in fungus-riddled cloth, but ittan-momen tsukumogami, and these monsters rip free from the damp stuffing they cover to attack the PCs once the hazard triggers. They pursue foes throughout the monastery and fight to the death.

Hazards: When Kugaptee’s influence seeped into the monastery, the statue here served as a spiritual guardian of the grounds and initially absorbed and purified much of the evil energy. Over time, the continuous influx of this energy overflowed and corrupted the statue. Now, the entire chamber brims with evil energy so strong that even the nindoru fiends are reluctant to enter, and the statue has become haunted by Kugaptee’s presence.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.ngFhNTGn08ZJO8Xp]{Main Hall}
A spellguard shield left behind by an ill-fated looter who visited the monastery a few years before the mindscape formed lies among the moldy cushions just east of the statue.

Reward: If the PCs purify the sugi statue, grant them 40 XP.

Courtyard.name: 庭院 Courtyard
Courtyard.text:
E2. 庭院 Low 6

一条看起来被污染的小溪蜿蜒连接着这座杂草丛生的庭院中六个以上的小池塘。区域各处零星生长着杉树，它们的树干与枝条上附着着某种霉菌或苔藓般的黑色增生物，其间点缀着小型石制圣祠；而曾经连接南侧门楼与北侧较大建筑之间道路的桥梁，如今已成废墟。

这座庭院中茂密的杂草形成困难地形。池塘和溪流中曾栖息的鱼与青蛙早已死亡或被吃掉，而3英尺深的水看起来被绿色淤泥污染，沿岸凝结成带泡沫的褐色硬壳。

一尊3英尺高的木灵神使石像立于庭院东北部的E2a区域。这尊雕像覆盖着厚重且恶臭的黑色霉菌，是必须净化的四尊雕像之一；唯有如此，才能获得进入苦迦菩提之墓的许可，并与@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}的幽灵交谈。

生物：在7098年（从玩家角色视角来看，即当前年份的十年前），两姐妹曾试图踏上朝圣之径，却分别遭遇了可怕的命运。妹妹耶里的厄运详见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08c2thegirlint00]{C2}区域；而姐姐尤妮一路走到了寺院庭院，却在那里遭到一只早已死去的老虎袭击并杀害。那只老虎曾被堕落的武僧们作为宠物兼守卫豢养。

庭院 Low 6

@UUID[Actor.SWLdQD9yQOQ4hPRg]{尤妮} @UUID[Actor.lC5iiouooyONCzUy]{恶魔映像}

当尤妮的精魂以幽灵之身归来，并将这座庭院留给她作为作祟之地时，那些堕落武僧欣喜不已。直到今天，她仍被困于此，但在有人接近到30英尺内之前，她会一直藏匿在庭院西南角E2b区域的小圣祠中。届时，她那被猛虎撕裂的幽魂身形会从她被残害之处的地面升起，先发出骇人悲叹，再发动攻击。她无法离开E2区域，但只要敌人仍在视线内，她就会继续用远程手段攻击。

如果某位玩家角色携带着来自@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08c2thegirlint00]{C2}区域、属于耶里的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.EkZVXMdtqTTgahiJ]{抗力魅惑术}，那么尤妮的幽灵在战斗第一轮后不会继续攻击。取而代之的是，在第二轮她的回合中，她会接近携带该饰物的玩家角色并说：“把我妹妹的手镯还给我！那不是你的！”若该玩家角色拒绝，尤妮便会恢复攻击，并在每个回合都要求归还手镯。

如果玩家角色将抗力魅惑术交给尤妮，幽灵便会停止攻击，以她那虚体双手不可能地捧住手镯。她凝视那饰物片刻，然后问道：“我的小妹妹在哪里？”如果玩家角色如实相告，尤妮会悲伤地哭喊，但随后感谢玩家角色的坦诚；她会把饰物还给他们，并说道：“这现在该属于你们了。谢谢你们帮助耶里得到安宁。”随后，她也会渐渐消散，归于虚无。如果玩家角色成功对她说谎，谎称耶里的命运，她也会如此；但若尤妮识破了谎言，那饰物就会从她手中坠落到地上，而她会在重新燃起的狂怒中发起攻击，直到被摧毁为止。

危害：这里溪流与池塘中的污水会使饮用者在未通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:15]强韧豁免后陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。大多数地方的水都因污秽而浑浊，唯独中央例外——那里曾有一座木桥横跨水面（E2c区域）。此处的水色黑而清澈，映照力极强——也闹鬼得很。

奖励：如果玩家角色净化了木灵神使雕像，给予他们40 XP。

E2. Courtyard Low 6

A polluted-looking creek connects over a half-dozen small ponds in this weed-tangled courtyard. Sugi trees, their trunks and branches bearing dark growths of some sort of mold or moss, grow fitfully amid small stone shrines throughout the area, while the bridge that once connected the pathway between the gatehouse to the south and a larger building to the north lies in ruins.

The thick weeds in this courtyard creates difficult terrain. Any fish or frogs that the pond and creeks once housed have long since died or been eaten, and the 3-foot-deep water looks to be polluted with green silt that forms into a foamy brown crust along the edges.

A 3-foot-tall stone statue of a kodama kami stands in the northeast section of the courtyard at area E2a. Coated with thick, foul-smelling black mold, this statue is one of the four that must be purified in order to gain access to Kugaptee’s grave and speak to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}’s ghost.

Creatures: In 7098 (a decade prior to the current year from the PC’s perspective), two sisters attempted to walk the Pilgrim’s Path, only to each meet horrific fates. The doom that came to the younger sister, Yeri, is detailed in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08c2thegirlint00]{C2}, but her older sister, Yuni, made it all the way to the monastery courtyard before she was attacked and killed by a now-long-dead tiger kept by the corrupted monks as a pet and guardian.

Courtyard Low 6

@UUID[Actor.SWLdQD9yQOQ4hPRg]{Yuni} @UUID[Actor.lC5iiouooyONCzUy]{Fiendish Reflection}

The corrupted monks were delighted when Yuni’s spirit came back as a ghost and left this courtyard for her as a place to haunt. She remains trapped here to this day but stays hidden within the small shrine located in area E2b in the southwest corner of the courtyard until someone approaches within 30 feet. At this point, her tiger-torn ghostly figure rises up from the ground where she was mauled to unleash her Frightful Moan before attacking. She can’t leave area E2 but continues to attack with her ranged options as long as her enemies remain in sight.

If one of the PCs carries Yeri’s @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.EkZVXMdtqTTgahiJ]{Charm of Resistance} from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog08theenl.JournalEntryPage.08c2thegirlint00]{C2}, Yuni’s ghost doesn’t continue her attack after the first round of combat. Instead, on her turn on the second round, she approaches the PC who carries the charm and says, “Give me my sister’s bracelet! That isn’t yours!” If the PC refuses, Yuni returns to attacking, demanding the return of the bracelet each turn.

If a PC gives the charm of resistance to Yuni, the ghost ceases to attack as she cradles the bracelet impossibly in her incorporeal hands. She gazes at the charm for a moment, then asks, “Where is my little sister?” If the PCs tell the truth, Yuni cries out in sadness but then thanks the PCs for their honesty; she returns the charm to them, saying, “You deserve this now. Thank you for helping Yeri find peace,” before she too fades away to nothingness. She does this as well if the PCs successfully Lie to her about Yeri’s fate, but if Yuni sees through the lie, the charm falls through her hands to the ground, and she attacks in a renewed fury, fighting until destroyed.

Hazards: The polluted water in the creek and ponds here causes a drinker to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} if they fail a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] save. The water is murky with filth in most places, save for the middle, where a wooden bridge once crossed over it (area E2c). Here, the water is dark, clear, and very reflective—and very haunted.

Reward: If the PCs purify the kodama statue, grant them 40 XP.

Grand Gate.name: 宏伟之门 Grand Gate
Grand Gate.text:
E1. 宏伟之门

朝圣之径通向嵌建在寺院南墙中的一座木制门楼前。木门的竹栅上装饰着破碎的符箓，一只孤零零的风铃悬挂在一根从门顶探出的摇摇欲坠的柱子上，在风中叮当作响。

在 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠} 大师死后的那些年里，大多数武僧离开了寺院，他们每个人都在门上贴了一张非魔法符箓。对一些人来说，这一行为是为了平息他们因遗弃寺院而感到的愧疚。对另一些人来说，这是一个无声的愿望，希望有人能追随他们而来，延续寺院的传统与教诲。无论如何，那些在寺院中定居下来的生物并不需要这些东西，便在将此地据为己有时把它们全都撕碎，只留下破败的残片悬挂在那里，仿佛是在嘲弄。

大门紧闭着，但可以轻松打开，进入后方空荡荡的门楼。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.fjLoZbudvuxVK4UN]{门}
宁多鲁斯处理这些符箓时很懒散，认为根本不会有人真能来到这座寺院，因此有三张魔法符箓——一张逃脱符箓和两张蹒跚符箓——幸免于毁坏。

E1. Grand Gate

The Pilgrim’s Path leads to the front of a wooden gatehouse built into the monastery’s southern wall. Shredded fulus adorn the bamboo bars of the wooden gate, and a lone wind chime jingles in the wind as it dangles from a rickety post protruding over the top of the gate.

As most of the monks left the monastery in the years following Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}’s death, they each left a non-magical fulu affixed to the gate. For some, this act was a way to settle the guilt they felt for abandoning the monastery. For others, it was a silent wish for someone to come after them and continue the monastery’s traditions and teachings. Regardless, the creatures who took up residence in the monastery had no need for such things and shredded them all as they claimed the grounds as their own, leaving up the ruined remains hanging in mockery.

The gates are closed but can be opened with ease, allowing access into the empty gatehouse beyond.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.fjLoZbudvuxVK4UN]{Gate}
The nindorus were lazy in dealing with the fulus, believing no one would actually make it to the monastery to begin with, and as a result, three magical fulus—an escape fulu and two stumbling fulus —survived the destruction.

Monastery Features.name: 修道院特性 Monastery Features
Monastery Features.text:
修道院特性

丹杉寺院是一处阴郁的建筑群，坐落在树林中巨大杉树的阴影下。惨叫与幽灵般的低语随风起伏，摇曳树枝持续不断的吱呀声更增添了诡异的氛围。玩家角色可以按任意顺序探索寺院，但必须完成散布各处的四尊雕像的净化，才能获得前往地下层的许可；在那里，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月}正在苦迦菩提之墓前劳作。

尽管寺院中的宁多鲁斯与亡灵乐于折磨@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{桑博齐}的追随者、杀害生者并吞食他们的灵魂，但距离他们上一次迎来访客，已经过去了许多年。因此，这里栖居的存在并不总会一见到玩家角色就立刻投入战斗，其中许多还会先进行一番令人不安的交谈，然后才不可避免地发动攻击。

这座寺院由木材建成，铺设石制地板。柱廊步道内部的天花板高度为15英尺，而较大的厅室中，这一高度升至40英尺（中央主大厅内则为60英尺）。寺院内没有人造光源，但在白天，步道光线明亮，厅室则由阳光照亮，处于昏暗光照中。寺院外侧没有窗户；朝向庭院的窗户目前全都装有遮板，且没有玻璃。穿过开启的窗户移动视为经过困难地形。

寺院建筑与柱廊顶部装饰着外挑而陡峭的屋檐线。玩家角色可以通过成功的@Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb]检定攀爬这些外墙，但要从墙面转移到挑檐并登上屋顶则相当棘手，需要其成功通过一次@Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb]检定。

柱廊墙壁与内部建筑上的开口让中型或更小的生物能够轻松通行。大型生物在这些区域中移动时，将其视为高等困难地形。

Monastery Features

The Tan Sugi monastery is a gloomy compound set in the shadow of the grove’s giant sugi tree. Screams and ghostly whispers rise and fall with the wind, and the steady creaking of swaying tree branches augments the eerie ambiance. The PCs can explore the monastery in any order but must complete the purification of all four statues scattered throughout to gain access to the subterranean level where @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue} toils before Kugaptee’s grave.

While the monastery’s nindorus and undead enjoy tormenting followers of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog18sangpo]{Sangpotshi}, killing the living and consuming their souls, ages have passed since they’ve last had visitors. As such, those who dwell here don’t always jump at the first opportunity to engage in combat with the PCs, and many of them will engage in unsettling conversation before, inevitably, they attack.

The monastery is made of wood with stone floors.
