Ceiling height within the colonnaded walkways is 15 feet, while in the larger chambers, this height rises to 40 feet (or 60 feet in the central main hall). The monastery has no artificial light sources, but during the day, walkways are brightly lit and the chambers are dimly lit by sunlight. There are no windows facing out of the monastery; those facing into the courtyards are all currently shuttered and have no glass. Moving through an open window counts as difficult terrain.

Overhanging, steep rooflines adorn the tops of the monastery’s buildings and colonnades. A PC can Climb these external walls with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check, but transitioning from the wall to the overhang and onto the roof is tricky and requires them to succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check.

Openings in the colonnade walls and internal buildings allow easy access for Medium or smaller creatures. Large creatures moving through these areas treat them as greater difficult terrain.

Fourth Purification.name: 第四净化 Fourth Purification
Fourth Purification.text:
第四净化

当最后一座雕像被净化后，寺院中染病的树木（谭杉本身除外）恢复健康，庭院中的蔓生杂草也会枯萎，使得穿过区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2} 时不再属于困难地形。南侧庭院（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2}）中的水变得纯净，不再显现恶魔映像；宝库中苦迦菩提之墓入口上方的屏障（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e15treasurec00]{E15}）消散，而 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠} 也可以在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16} 的最终战斗中协助玩家角色。

智惠再次显现，感谢玩家角色的帮助，但也警告他们：若想彻底消除苦迦菩提的影响，他们必须进入寺院下方的陵墓，并击败 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{辛月}——正是她最初放任这场腐化扩散。智惠可以随意显现，并在任意一座雕像处停留，想停留多久都可以。她会回答玩家角色想问的任何问题。她也会在自己能力范围内为玩家角色施放法术。玩家角色可以在寺院中这些雕像所在之处安全地休息。更多详情见她的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{非玩家角色条目}。

Fourth Purification

When the final statue is purified, the monastery’s sickened trees (with the exception of the Tan Sugi itself) become healthy, and the overgrown weeds in the courtyards wither so that passage through area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2} isn’t difficult terrain. The water in the southern courtyard (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2}) becomes pure and no longer shows fiendish reflections, the barrier over the entrance to Kugaptee’s Grave in the treasury (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e15treasurec00]{E15}) fades, and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} can aid the PCs in their final fight in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}.

Zhi Hui manifests again and thanks the PCs for their service but warns them that, in order to fully remove Kugaptee’s influence, they must travel into his grave below the monastery and defeat @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21xinyue00000000]{Xin Yue}, the one who allowed this corruption to spread in the first place. Zhi Hui can manifest at will and remain as long as she wishes at any of the statues. She’ll answer any questions the PCs wish to ask. She also offers to cast spells on the PCs as she’s able. The PCs can rest safe and secure at any of these statue sites in the monastery. See her @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{NPC Entry} for further details.

Third Purification.name: 第三次净化 Third Purification
Third Purification.text:
第三次净化

净化第三尊雕像会使苦迦菩提对寺院的控制进一步削弱。压在玩家角色身上的那种巨大而阴影般的重负感随之消散。他们意识到，自从进入这片废墟以来，自己一直在灵性层面受到一股压倒性灵能存在的压迫，而如今这种压迫终于消失了。如果风暴仍在肆虐，因为玩家角色尚未击败风暴鬼婆尤伽喀，那么风暴现在就会结束（而且尤伽喀本人也会从心景中消失）。周围森林中的鸟鸣与虫声渐渐高涨，为这片地区带回了一丝自然的气息，尽管在废墟之内，一切仍旧反常地阴沉。智惠的幽灵再次显现，这一次她能停留得够久，在消散前回答三个问题；不过她这次是平静地消逝，而不是像被无形的利爪撕碎那样消失。

Third Purification

Purifying the third statue causes Kugaptee’s hold on the monastery to weaken even further. The sensation of a great shadowy weight lifts from the PCs. They realize that they’d been spiritually oppressed by an overwhelming psychic presence ever since entering the ruins, only to find it now gone. If the storm still rages because the PCs haven’t yet defeated the storm hag Iogaka, the storm ends now (and Iogaka herself vanishes from the mindscape). The sound of birds and insects builds in the surrounding forest, bringing a hint of nature back to the region, although within the ruins, things remain unnaturally grim. Zhi Hui’s ghost manifests again, and this time she can remain long enough to answer three questions before fading away, but she fades peacefully rather than appearing to be ripped apart by unseen talons.

Second Purification.name: 第二次净化 Second Purification
Second Purification.text:
第二次净化

净化第二尊雕像会使通往藏匿的图书馆（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11}）的暗门不仅解锁，而且在下次玩家角色接近其中任意一扇时，会发出柔和的光辉。@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}再次显现，再次向队伍致谢，并鼓励他们继续前进，净化剩下的两尊雕像。这一次，她有时间回答两个问题，随后才会被撕裂；但在消散之际，她呼喊道：“找出藏匿的图书馆……我的朋友，闫瑞，能够帮忙……”

Second Purification

Purifying the second statue causes the secret doors to the hidden library (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11}) to not only unlock, but to glow with a soft radiance the next time the PCs approach either of them. @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui} manifests again, thanking the party once more and encouraging them to keep going and purify the remaining two statues. She has time to answer two questions this time before she’s ripped apart, but as she goes, she cries out, “Seek the hidden library... my friend, Yen Rui, can help...”

First Purification.name: 首次净化 First Purification
First Purification.text:
首次净化

净化第一尊被腐化的雕像后，大师@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}的幽灵得以暂时在玩家角色面前显现。此前，她一直被困在苦迦菩提之墓（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}）之中。她从雕像中浮现出来，身影凄然消沉；当她望向众人时，脸上的神情渐渐缓和，化为如释重负与感激。她用轻柔而缥缈的声音向玩家角色说道。

“感谢你们的这份善意。我已经太久太久无法看穿那吞没一切的黑暗，但它依然在拉扯着我。我无法停留太久，但还能支撑到回答你们一个问题。要知道，这里还有其他雕像。净化它们，我便能进一步协助你们。”

智惠的幽灵能停留足够久，回答玩家角色向她提出的一个问题，随后苦迦菩提的影响便会将她重新拖回那个自她死后便一直囚禁着她的灵性地牢之中。关于她可能会回答哪些问题，请参见她的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{非玩家角色条目}。一旦她回答完这个问题，或几分钟过去后，她就会痛苦地尖叫起来，仿佛被撕成血淋淋的碎片，随后彻底消失，被拉回苦迦菩提之墓（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}）。

First Purification

Purifying the first of the corrupted statues allows Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}’s ghost, which up until this point has been trapped within Kugaptee’s grave (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}), to temporarily manifest before the PCs. She emerges from the statue, a forlorn and despondent figure whose expression softens to relief and gratitude as she gazes upon the party. She addresses the PCs in a soft, ephemeral voice.

“Thank you for this kindness. It has been so long since I’ve been able to see beyond the engulfing darkness, but it still pulls at me. I will not be able to remain for long, but I can remain long enough to answer a question you may have for me. Know that there are other statues. Cleanse them and I can aid you further.”

Zhi Hui’s ghost can remain present long enough to answer one question the PCs might have for her before Kugaptee’s influence draws her back into the spiritual oubliette in which she has been imprisoned since her death. See her @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{NPC Entry} for a list of answers she’ll have for potential questions asked of her. Once she answers her question, or once a few minutes have passed, she cries out in pain and appears to be ripped to bloody shreds before she vanishes entirely, pulled back into Kugaptee’s grave (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e16kugaptees00]{E16}).

Purifying the Monastery.name: 净化修道院 Purifying the Monastery
Purifying the Monastery.text:
净化修道院

寺院中的四尊雕像已被苦迦菩提和宁多鲁斯亵渎并腐化。为了阻止苦迦菩提的影响泛滥至柳岸镇，并进入寺院的地下区域，玩家角色必须净化这四尊雕像。随着玩家角色将每尊雕像恢复原状，苦迦菩提对寺院的控制也会减弱。

这些雕像可以按任意顺序净化，而净化某尊雕像都会在寺院内触发对应事件，不论被恢复的是哪一尊。每当一尊雕像被净化，苦迦菩提对这片废墟的掌控就会进一步削弱，而寺院创建者、被压制且徘徊不去的精魂——大师@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}——会变得更加强大，也更有能力协助玩家角色。

这些雕像位于庭院（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2}）、主大厅（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e3mainhall0000]{E3}）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法莱斯玛的}神殿（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e5pharasmass00]{E5}）以及葬园（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e12burialgar00]{E12}）。每净化一尊雕像，便会发生下述事件。要净化一尊雕像，玩家角色必须执行以下行动；其他玩家角色可以使用“净化圣像”允许的任意技能，在此行动中进行协助。

请注意，对于某些团队而言，净化这些雕像这一思路可能并不明显，尤其是在第一尊雕像被净化前，智惠的幽灵还无法直接与玩家角色接触。如果你的团队属于这种情况，他们可以在噩梦或梦境中获得提示（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09resting0000000]{休息}），或者你也可以在他们于探索寺院废墟时至少遇见四尊雕像中的两尊后，直接允许玩家角色自动意识到这是一个可行选项。

净化圣像

  • 专注
  • 探索

需求 雕像所在遭遇区域内所有敌对生物均已被击败。

你花费10分钟向雕像的守护精魂献上祷告，清理或修复雕像所受的伤害，或移除其上的恶意结痂与超自然印记。尝试一次@Check[religion|dc:20]检定、一次@Check[crafting|dc:22]检定，或一次@Check[thievery|dc:24]检定。

大成功 该雕像被净化。

成功 该雕像被净化，但在此过程中，一阵被逐出雕像的、减弱的纯粹憎恨爆发出来抽打着你。你受到@Damage[2d6[mental]]精神伤害（@Check[will|dc:22|basic]豁免）。

失败 该雕像仍未被净化。一阵灵能狂怒向你猛击，对你以及所有曾尝试协助你净化圣像的人造成@Damage[5d6[mental]]精神伤害（@Check[will|dc:22|basic]豁免）。

大失败 如失败，但造成@Damage[10d6[mental]]精神伤害，且1小时内无人能再次尝试净化这尊特定雕像。

Purifying the Monastery

Four statues in the monastery have been desecrated and corrupted by Kugaptee and the nindorus. To stem Kugaptee’s influence from overflowing into Willowshore and to reach the underground area of the monastery, the PCs must purify these four statues. As the PCs restore each statue to its original state, Kugaptee’s hold on the monastery weakens.

The statues can be purified in any order, and purifying a statue triggers a corresponding event within the monastery regardless of which statue is restored. As each statue is purified, Kugaptee’s hold over the ruins diminishes, and the oppressed, lingering spirit of the monastery’s founder, Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}, grows more powerful and more able to assist the PCs.

The statues are located in the courtyard (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e2courtyard000]{E2}), the main hall (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e3mainhall0000]{E3}), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma's} shrine (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e5pharasmass00]{E5}), and the burial garden (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e12burialgar00]{E12}). As each is purified, the events below take place. To purify a statue, a PC must perform the following activity; other PCs can Aid in this activity using any of the skills allowed by Purify Statue.

Note that for some groups, the idea of purifying these statues might not be obvious, especially since Zhi Hui’s ghost can’t directly contact the PCs until the first of the statues is purified. If your group falls into this category, they could receive hints as part of nightmares or dreams (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09resting0000000]{Resting}), or you could just allow the PCs to automatically realize this is an option once they’ve encountered at least two of the four statues while exploring the monastery ruins.

Purify Statue

  • Concentrate
  • Exploration

Requirements All hostile creatures in the encounter area where the statue is located are defeated.

You spend 10 minutes offering prayers to the statue’s guardian spirits, cleaning or repairing damage done to the statue, or removing malignant encrustations and supernatural markings. Attempt a @Check[religion|dc:20] check, a @Check[crafting|dc:22] check, or a @Check[thievery|dc:24] check.

Critical Success The statue is purified.

Success The statue is purified, but as you do so, a weakened blast of pure loathing lashes out as it’s driven from the statue. You take @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:22|basic] save).

Failure The statue remains unpurified. A blast of psychic rage lashes out at you, inflicting @Damage[5d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:22|basic] save) to you and anyone who attempted to Aid your attempt to Purify the Statue.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[10d6[mental]] damage, and no one can attempt to Purify this particular Statue again for 1 hour.

Resting.name: 休息 Resting
Resting.text:
休息

整个寺院都应当让 PCs 感到不安全，而在他们发现藏匿的图书馆（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11}）之前，如果有休息的需要，最好还是从这些遗迹中撤退。一旦 PCs 走过朝圣之径，那些奇异的扭曲现象就会消退，而沿着这条道路徒步 3 英里返回山岳神龛，便是夜间休息最安全的撤退地点。至于寺院中的敌人是否会在这种情况下主动寻找 PCs 并攻击他们，则由你自行决定；但至少，任何在遗迹内入睡的人都应承受可怕的噩梦：梦见自己被活埋、悲惨的转世，或因背叛而遭受痛苦且骇人的死亡。将这些噩梦视为每名 PC 都成为一个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} 法术的目标（@Check[will|dc:23] 豁免）。这些噩梦会在 PCs 净化寺院中的四尊雕像后结束（见下文），此后，在遗迹中休息仍往往会引发噩梦，但不再具有先前那种令人衰弱的效果。如果你的玩家一开始没有意识到净化寺院内的雕像也是一种可行选择，你可以利用这些噩梦，在 PCs 心中种下这样做的暗示，把它作为一种潜在手段，来对抗那笼罩在遗迹之上的诡异邪恶影响。

Resting

The entire monastery should feel unsafe to the PCs, and until they discover the hidden library (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog09inther.JournalEntryPage.09e11hiddenlib00]{E11}), it’s best to retreat from the ruins should the need to rest arise. Once the PCs have walked the Pilgrim’s Path, the strange distortions fade, and the 3-mile hike along the path back to the Mountain Shrine is the safest place to retreat to for a night’s rest. Whether or not enemies from the monastery seek out the PCs to attack them if they do so is left for you to decide, but at the very least, those who sleep within the ruins should endure harrowing nightmares of being buried alive, of tragic reincarnations, or of painful and grisly deaths from betrayals. Treat these nightmares as if the PCs were each targeted by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} spell (@Check[will|dc:23] save). These nightmares end once the PCs purify the four statues in the monastery (see the following section), after which resting in the ruins still tends to cause bad dreams, but not to the debilitating effect they manifested before. If your players don’t realize that purifying the statues found within the monastery is even an option in the first place, you can use these nightmares to plant the suggestion to do so in the PCs’ minds as a way to potentially fight back against the eldritch, evil influence that has settled over the ruins.

Tan Sugi Monastery.name: 丹杉寺 Tan Sugi Monastery
Tan Sugi Monastery.text:
丹杉寺

丹杉寺的建造方式既致敬了最初将智惠大师带到这片地区的杉树，也与它们相得益彰。寺院坐落于一座林木茂密的休眠破火山口中，围绕着这一地区最高大的一棵树而建——正是那棵从谭隋靖的身体中生长出来、扎根于她的宿敌宁多鲁苦迦菩提坟墓之上的树。寺院的建造者清理掉了几棵树木，但将这棵高大的杉树以及另外九棵较小的杉树纳入了寺院的设计之中，随后又以自然主题装饰环绕林间空地的步道与木制建筑。寺院的木墙与石质地基上雕刻着植物、动物和各类精魂的形象，南侧庭院中还点缀着几座小圣祠，为来访的精魂提供栖身之所。寺院南侧的一道门迎接着访客，但如今铺设于庭院各处的小径大多已被浓密而带刺的杂草吞没。构成寺院的六座木制建筑都覆有高耸的层叠屋顶，拱起至40英尺的高度；但中央那棵杉树接近100英尺之高，远远超过这一高度，巍然俯瞰着整片建筑群。

这座寺院的设计不仅是为了容纳武僧居住，也是供朝圣者前来冥想的场所。中央道路通往主大厅，武僧与访客每日都在此聚集祈祷与冥想，而另外五座附属建筑则作为武僧的宿舍和其他设施。智惠大师最初建造这座寺院时，希望在林间空地各处打造出供人观察、冥想与自省的空间，形成丹杉寺所独有的格局。

如今，这座寺院已成废墟。曾经维护良好的庭院如今杂草丛生。泥泞与落叶散布在步道上，屋顶和墙壁上的破洞让雨水侵入，损坏了大部分建筑的内部。在他们的领袖死后，虔诚的武僧们离开了寺院；留下来的人则落入苦迦菩提的影响之下，而当这片地区被转化为心景时，那些武僧也一并死去。然而，与PC和柳岸镇的居民不同，这些武僧化作了苦迦菩提的亡灵仆从，如今听命于统治这片废墟的灵堕魔。

Tan Sugi Monastery

The Tan Sugi monastery was constructed in a way that honors and complements the sugi trees that first brought Master Zhi Hui to the region. Nestled in a thickly forested dormant caldera, the monastery was built around the tallest tree in the region—the same tree that grew from Tan Sui-Jing’s body over the grave of her nemesis, the nindoru Kugaptee. The monastery’s creators cleared away several trees but incorporated this tall sugi tree, as well as nine smaller ones, into the monastery’s design then proceeded to decorate the walkways and wooden buildings surrounding the grove with motifs of nature. Depictions of plants, animals, and various spirits were carved into the wooden walls and stone foundations of the monastery, and small shrines dot the southern courtyard to provide shelter for visiting spirits. A gate at the southern side of the monastery welcomes visitors, but the pathways laid throughout the grounds are now mostly overgrown by thick, spiky weeds. The six wooden buildings that make up the monastery have tall tiered roofs that arch to a height of 40 feet, but at nearly a hundred feet, the central sugi tree more than doubles this height, looming properly over the entire compound.

The monastery was designed not only to house monks but also as a place for pilgrims to come and meditate. The central path leads to the main hall, where monks and visitors gathered daily to pray and meditate, while five outbuildings served the monks as living quarters and other facilities. When Master Zhi Hui first built the monastery, she wanted to create spaces throughout the grove for observation, meditation, and introspection unique to the Tan Sugi monastery.

Today, the monastery is in ruins. The once well-maintained courtyards are overgrown with weeds. Mud and fallen leaves litter the walkways, and holes in the roofs and walls have allowed the rain to damage most of the buildings’ interiors. After the devout monks abandoned the monastery in the wake of their leader’s death, those who remained fell under Kugaptee’s influence, and when the region was transformed into a mindscape, those monks died as well. Unlike the PCs and the citizens of Willowshore, though, the monks rose as undead minions of Kugaptee and now serve at the whims of the nindoru fiends who rule the ruins.

In the Ruins of Wisdom.name: 智慧废墟之中 In the Ruins of Wisdom
In the Ruins of Wisdom.text:
第7章： 智慧废墟之中

旅程的最后一段中，蜿蜒的朝圣之径在一处山峰附近越过最后一道山脊，随后向下延伸，进入一片宽阔的环形山谷——因为丹杉寺便建造在一座小型、早已沉寂的火山那古老且林木茂密的破火山口之中。大约在日落前一小时（也就是玩家角色抵达这座废墟寺院之前），他们会来到朝圣之径的尽头；那里有一座小圣祠，立在一座朴素木拱门旁边，俯临着他们过去几日一直行走的道路。随着玩家角色靠近，空气中的寒意突然消退。令人安心的秋日暖意笼罩了这片区域，歌唱的鸟儿与蝉鸣声充满四周，就连周围森林的气息也变得更加鲜明而舒缓。

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{智惠}大师的精魂感知到了玩家角色的靠近。尽管她的幽灵目前仍被困在寺院之中，但玩家角色既然已经走完了朝圣之径，她便有机会依照他们在三座圣祠中达成启悟的数量来给予奖励。

少于三座圣祠：玩家角色会感到某种无形的力量对他们颇为失望。他们明白，自己应当沿路撤退，去那些错过的圣祠中寻求启悟。当他们返回这些圣祠时，以额外的幻象或来自彼方的神秘催促形式，给予他们更多关于如何达成启悟的洞见。若他们愿意，也可以继续朝寺院前进，但将无法获得任何额外好处。

三座圣祠全部完成：如果玩家角色已在三座圣祠全部达成启悟，他们会感受到一种欢迎与自豪，但同时也会明确无误地察觉到前方潜伏的危险。除了这些感受之外，玩家角色还会生出一股调查道路旁那座小圣祠的冲动。如果他们这样做，便会在圣祠中发现数件强大的魔法物品——这些是由智惠力量显化于此的礼物，方式与苦迦菩提更强大的存在在心景中显化出如此多怪物的方式十分相似。

本战役的冒险工具箱为这些@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20pilgrimagegi00]{朝圣礼物}提供了数种不同选项。为每位玩家角色各选择一件适合其能力、主题与兴趣的物品作为奖励——玩家角色应会本能地认出哪件礼物是为自己准备的。或者，你也可以将冒险工具箱中提供的物品作为模板，自行设计定制的礼物。

Chapter 7: In the Ruins of Wisdom

The final leg of the journey sees the winding Pilgrim’s Path rise over one final crest near a mountain peak before descending down into a wide, circular valley—for the Tan Sugi monastery is built within the ancient, forested caldera of a small and long dormant volcano. About an hour before sunset (and the PCs’ arrival at the ruined monastery), they’ll come to the end of the Pilgrim’s Path, where a small shrine stands next to a plain wooden arch that looms over the route they’ve been following for the past few days. As the PCs approach, the chill in the air suddenly abates. As a comforting fall warmth settles over the area, the sound of singing birds and chirping cicadas fills the air, and even the scent of the surrounding forest grows more vibrant and soothing.

Master @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21zhihui00000000]{Zhi Hui}’s spirit senses the PCs’ approach, and while her ghost remains trapped within the monastery for now, the fact that the PCs have walked the Pilgrim’s Path gives her a chance to reward them, depending on how many of the three shrines the PCs have managed to achieve enlightenment at.

Fewer than Three Shrines: The PCs feel that some unseen force is disappointed in them. They understand that they should retreat along the path to seek enlightenment at the shrines they missed. Upon returning to these shrines, give them more insight into how to achieve enlightenment in the form of additional visions or mysterious urgings from beyond. They can continue to progress toward the monastery instead if they wish but do so without any additional benefits.

All Three Shrines: If the PCs have achieved enlightenment at all three shrines, they feel a sense of welcoming pride but also an unmistakable sense of peril at what lies ahead. In addition to these feelings, the PCs also experience an urge to investigate the small shrine alongside the path. If they do so, they find within the shrine several potent magic items—gifts manifested here by Zhi Hui’s power, in much the same way that Kugaptee’s greater presence has manifested so many monsters in the mindscape.

This campaign’s Adventure Toolbox presents several different options for these @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20pilgrimagegi00]{Pilgrimage Gifts}. Choose one of these items for each PC that’s appropriate for their abilities, themes, and interests as their reward—the PCs should instinctively recognize which gift is intended for each of them. Alternatively, you can use the items presented in the Adventure Toolbox as templates to create customized gifts of your own design.

Act 3.1: Oblivion of Truth.name: 第三幕 3.1：真相湮灭 Act 3.1: Oblivion of Truth

End of the Dream.name: 梦境的终结 End of the Dream
End of the Dream.text:
梦境的终结 严重 7

尽管PC们可能想对总督那悲惨的恳求作出反应，但他们不会有时间这么做。一旦他交出自己的日志（或者在战斗中被击败后，转而哀求苦迦菩提带走他），赫山宝的身体便会猛然抽动、剧烈挣扎，陷入痉挛。片刻之后，伴随着布料撕裂般的声响，他的身体猛地裂开，一团猩红色的蝴蝶从他空洞的躯壳中喷涌而出，充斥他周围的空气。

如果这一幕发生在总督庄园里，并以镇民们猛砸庄园大门为背景，那么那些门会被猛然撞开，野箆坊冒名者会蜂拥而入，他们身后还跟着一大群嚎叫尖叫的镇民。如果这一幕发生在别处，那么这些冒名者和尖叫的镇民会突然从周围扑向PC们，视情况从小巷、门后，甚至林地中涌出。苦迦菩提残留在赫山宝心景中的影响知道，PC们能够完成总督做不到的事，而这股影响会试图在这里阻止他们。

场景注释氛围

@UUID[Playlist.TmxsF1RiQJ0m8o5M.PlaylistSound.st2Q3xsAFhE8Ko9O]{Howling Crowd}

生物：本冒险默认这场战斗发生在总督庄园里，但如果发生在别处，你需要提供一张与周围环境相符的地图，也许可以使用前一幕中某个先前出现过的城镇地点地图，或重新利用庄园的地图。

梦境的终结 严重 7

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21nopperaboimp00]{无面鬼模仿者 (4)} | @UUID[Actor.vFNg9BATB9crqnDn]{奥术} @UUID[Actor.aYR61sI47XlE9ul8]{神圣} @UUID[Actor.2NmupNwbuAt5GcWy]{武战}@UUID[Actor.UgfzkrEkFrdeegD0]{异能} @UUID[Actor.vmOACyFUJqWHY8YD]{原始} @UUID[Actor.n9L4akwW1KlBXQQd]{熟练}

此时，四名无面鬼模仿者会走上前来挑战PC们——那些嚎叫尖叫的镇民会留在后方，为他们的“英雄”——那些无脸鬼——呐喊助威，但不会参与战斗。每当其中一名无脸妖被杀死时，都会炸散成一团短暂存在的红色蝴蝶。最后一名被击败后（或者PC们被杀死后），PC们周围的心景便会渐渐消退，它在这一轮循环中的使命已经完成，而他们则会回到柳岸镇心景中——也就是他们最初施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}的地方。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.Sl4VZHQv6huLUvlu]{显现}
赫山宝的日志（以及他的高等雄辩项圈、+1 强击 长剑、+1 抗力 布甲和高等储存护袖）会在PC们返回他们自己的思维空间时一同显现。回到这个思维空间的行为也改变了这本日志——其中仍然有数十张散页和卷轴（这些文件包含了PC们在下一章所需的重要研究，以及复活术的配方），但日志本身已经变成了一本中级复原净化典籍。

奖励：若PC们直面总督并取得他关于转生仪式的笔记，则给予PC们120 XP。此外，如果PC们是在赫山宝自愿帮助的情况下获得这些帮助的，则给予PC们如同在战斗中击败了他一样的XP。

End of the Dream Severe 7

Though the PCs might wish to react to the governor’s tragic plea, they won’t have time to do so. Once he hands over his journal (or alternatively, once he begs Kugaptee to take him after being defeated in combat), Heh Shan-Bao’s body lurches and thrashes as he goes into convulsions. A moment later, his body rips open to the sound of tearing fabric, and a cloud of crimson butterflies erupts from his hollow shell to fill the air around him.

If this takes place in the manor with the backdrop of townsfolk hammering on the doors to the manor, those doors smash inward and the noppera-bo impersonators surge through with a mass of howling, shrieking townsfolk behind them. If this take place elsewhere, then the impersonators and shrieking townsfolk suddenly rush at the PCs from their surroundings, surging out of alleys or from doors or even the woods as appropriate. Kugaptee’s remaining influence in Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape knows that the PCs can achieve what the governor couldn’t, and that influence attempts to stop them here.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.TmxsF1RiQJ0m8o5M.PlaylistSound.st2Q3xsAFhE8Ko9O]{Howling Crowd}

Creatures: This adventure assumes this fight takes place in the governor’s manor, but if it takes place elsewhere, you’ll need to provide a map to match the surroundings, perhaps pulling one from a previous city location featured in an earlier act or repurposing the map of the manor.

End of the Dream Severe 7

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21nopperaboimp00]{Noppera-bo Impersonators (4)} | @UUID[Actor.vFNg9BATB9crqnDn]{Arcane} @UUID[Actor.aYR61sI47XlE9ul8]{Divine} @UUID[Actor.2NmupNwbuAt5GcWy]{Martial}@UUID[Actor.UgfzkrEkFrdeegD0]{Occult} @UUID[Actor.vmOACyFUJqWHY8YD]{Primal} @UUID[Actor.n9L4akwW1KlBXQQd]{Skilled}

At this point, the four noppera-bo impersonators step forward to challenge the PCs—the howling and shrieking townsfolk remain behind and cheer on their “heroes,” the noppera-bos, but don’t take part in the fight. When slain, each of these noppera-bos bursts into a cloud of short-lived red butterflies. As soon as the final one is defeated (or as soon as the PCs are slain), the mindscape around the PCs fades, its purpose for this cycle fulfilled, and they return to the Willowshore mindscape where they cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} in the first place.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.Sl4VZHQv6huLUvlu]{Manifestation}
Heh Shan-Bao’s journal (along with his greater choker of elocution, +1 striking longsword, +1 resilient padded armor, and his greater sleeves of storage) manifest along with the PCs when they return to their own mindscape. The act of returning to this mindscape has transformed the journal as well—it still contains dozens of loose sheets and scrolls (these documents contain the important research the PCs will need in the next chapter, in addition to the formula for resurrect), but the journal itself has become a moderate tome of restorative cleansing.

Reward: For confronting the governor and obtaining his notes on the transmigrate ritual, grant the PCs 120 XP. In addition, if the PCs received Heh Shan-Bao’s help willingly, grant the PCs XP as if they’d defeated him in combat.

Asking for Help.name: 寻求帮助 Asking for Help
Asking for Help.text:
寻求帮助

最终，PC们应该会谈到他们来这里的真正原因——寻求帮助，以逃离他们所有人都被困住的心景。若直接请求协助脱离，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}会颓然垮下肩膀，深吸一口气，颤抖着长长叹息一声，然后承认一件他一直害怕说出口的事。

“也许确实有办法。我们已经死了。苦迦菩提杀了我们所有人。也就是说，是我杀了我们所有人。但我们的灵魂并没有前往来世。我们被困在这里，困在由苦迦菩提的梦境与我们自身恐惧锻造而成的笼子里。

“但只要有合适的工具，任何笼子都能被打开。可惜，那些工具在我触及之外。我看得见它们，却无法使用它们。” 他的眼中第一次燃起希望，并伸出一只戴着手套的手。

“不过，也许……你们可以完成我未竟之事？对。对！你们不是苦迦菩提。你们的灵魂与心智仍然属于自己。你们仍然可以转生迁魂回到生者的领域，仍然可以通过转生术自死亡中归来。完成我开始的一切吧！只要你们找到方法，我们就都能脱身！”

说完，赫总督从他的高等储存袖中取出一本厚重的日志，里面夹满了散页和潦草书写的卷轴——那是他关于自己原本希望强化丹杉树的仪式的全部笔记，以及他在心景每一次循环中，为创造一个能逃回生者世界的转生仪式而写下的研究记录。

总督把笔记交出来后，最后又问了一次：“你们不会残忍对待黑豆，对吧？她无法选择自己的主人。她什么错都没有做。”

Asking for Help

Eventually, the PCs should get around to the reason they’ve come here in the first place—to ask for help in escaping the mindscape they’ve all been trapped in. Asked directly for aid in escaping, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} slumps in defeat, takes a deep breath and exhales a long, shuddering sigh, and then admits something he has been afraid to say this whole time.

“There might just be a way. We’re dead. Kugaptee slew us all. That is to say, I slew us all. But our souls didn’t move on to the afterlife. We became trapped here, in cages forged from Kugaptee’s dreams and our own fears.

“But with the right tools, any cage can be opened. Alas, those tools lie beyond my reach. I can see them, but I can’t use them.” His eyes turn hopeful for the first time, and he holds out one gloved hand.

“Perhaps, though... you could finish what I’ve started? Yes. Yes! You aren’t Kugaptee. Your souls and minds remain your own. You can still transmigrate back to the living realm, still reincarnate back from death. Finish what I started! We can all escape if you find the way!”

With that, Governor Heh reaches into his greater sleeves of storage and withdraws a thick journal filled with loose pages and scribbled scrolls—the total of his notes on the ritual he hoped would strengthen the Tan Sugi tree as well as those he worked on each mindscape cycle to create a transmigrate ritual to escape back to the living world.

Once the governor hands over his notes, he asks one final time, “You won’t be cruel to Black Bean, will you? She didn’t choose her master. She didn’t do anything wrong.”

Know and Despair.name: 知晓与绝望 Know and Despair
Know and Despair.text:
知晓与绝望

如果玩家角色赢得了总督的信任，他就会同意在自己的宅邸中与他们交谈；如果他们还没到那里，他还会主动提出立刻带他们过去。赫总督将玩家角色带到宅邸东南角的会客室，请他们与自己一同坐在长桌旁的坐垫上。在这间看起来未曾使用过、毫无生气的会客室环境中，他那凌乱的外观，以及失去了往日精准优雅的行动方式，都显得更加明显。尽管宅邸里看不见任何仆役，桌上却早已摆好了食物与饮品，包括丰盛的热肉菜、热茶，以及大量酒精；而总督对此并不感到意外。若有人询问，他只会耸耸肩，说：“我的仆役已经不在了，但在这个地方，我的需求仍会得到照料。”仿佛这样就足以说明一切——事实上，正是心景本身在按需维持他的饮食。

他双手颤抖着为桌边每个人斟饮（这或许是他对玩家角色出乎意料的一种尊重）后，一声突如其来、细小的猫叫打破了沉默，一只小黑猫从一堆枕头筑成的窝里探出头来。猫的出现终于让总督开了口，他的声音变得轻柔，还微微发颤。

“你们还记得我的猫，黑豆吗？多好的一只猫啊。多小的一只猫。你们不会残忍地对待黑豆，对吧？她会替你们抓老鼠。她还可以陪孩子们玩。”

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}随后转向食物，摆出几只小饭碗，每只碗中央都直直插着黑色筷子。他把它们重重地放在每个茶杯旁边，随后突然走到长桌主位坐下。总督的猫又细细叫了一声，从它那柔软的小宫殿里窜进男人的怀中，而总督迟疑了一下，才伸手抚摸这只毛茸茸的生物。

玩家角色应当会自动认出，配着香或直立筷子的米饭是献给亡者的供品。再加上他先前为玩家角色奉茶的敬重之举，他们可以尝试进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] 察言观色的察觉检定——若成功，他们会意识到，总督对待他们的方式，并不是把他们当作活人，而是当作幽灵。总督正以非常明显的方式，向玩家角色传达一个未说出口的信息；但由于他的精神状态已经崩坏，除非先有人发问，否则他很难把任何事情清楚地说出来。随着谈话继续，太阳开始落山（无论这场谈话始于一天中的什么时刻），玩家角色还能听见前门处越来越响的刮擦与撞击声。赫山宝对此置若罔闻，除非玩家角色试图调查；若他们这么做，他就会厉声要求英雄们别管那件事，除非他们想死。看起来，总督设下的护不知为何已经减弱，使得外面的镇民开始试图闯进来。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.TmxsF1RiQJ0m8o5M.PlaylistSound.2eBD8ZQAMj7hPoRh]{Pounding at the Manor Walls}

无论这场对话会持续多久，它都应涵盖下方大多数谈话要点，其中也包括供你朗读的建议台词。

柳岸镇之死：如果玩家角色质问总督关于米饭供品、驱逐不死生物的符箓，或以其他方式询问心景及如何脱身，赫山宝会先苦笑一声，再作回答。“你们还没明白吗？你们肯定早就起疑了。我的符箓、镇民怪异的行为、围绕着我们这片领域的不可通行屏障——这一切都只指向同一件事。我们全都只不过是饿鬼。”如果玩家角色因为本地禁忌而反对赫总督使用“幽灵”这个词，男人会发出阴沉的笑声，接着猛拍桌面，把茶杯震得作响。“别这么天真了！你以为说几句友善的问候就能让你免于坟墓吗？你们现在还会避免在夜晚吹口哨或洗衣服吗？你们是怕自己被冒犯了，然后把自己吃掉吗？嗯？不……我们全都死了。我们如今已无息可泣。那个时代已经过去了。自春天最后一天起，我们就已经死了。自苦迦菩提把我们全都杀死的那一刻起。”

毁灭的原因：“苦迦菩提从谭杉下方的墓穴中发作了。人们怎么说来着？‘把鳗鱼的头砍掉，它还是会啃咬。’”总督抿了一口茶，随后盯着杯中的液体看了片刻。“你们知道他在下面吗？你们肯定至少怀疑过吧。柳岸镇是个古怪的地方。谁能想到这样一个偏僻村镇会有如此神圣的传承，或者会藏着如此不可测度的邪恶？”

苦迦菩提的苏醒：如果玩家角色问是什么激怒了苦迦菩提，赫山宝会停顿片刻，羞愧地低下头，然后急促地吸了一口气才回答：“是我。多么可怕的事情，全是我做的。尽管恨我吧。让你们的狂暴把你们从幽灵变成复仇恶灵，把所有威胁我们城镇的人统统吞噬掉！”

接着，总督陷入一阵失控的大笑。等他冷静下来后（很可能要到某位玩家角色采取措施让他冷静时才会如此），赫山宝才收敛神情，用低沉沙哑的声音解释道。

“我太愚蠢了。我想保护柳岸镇不受苦迦菩提侵害，想在络新妇找到他之前把他藏起来。像苦迦菩提这样强大的邪恶，不可能被消灭，只能被封印。他挣脱出来的部分越多，就越会试图吞噬我们。只要那棵神树仍因他的毒素而恶心，迟早就会有某个蜘蛛女人被吸引到苦迦菩提之墓。她们的想法和我一样，你明白吗？她们喜爱强大的仆役和美丽的人。嗯，我是个罪孽深重的人，但跟络新妇相比，我还差一千桩罪。你们从未爱过我，也从未爱过我的帝国，但你们根本不知道，当络新妇到来时，她们会对你们做什么。

“我试图治疗谭杉，帮助它继续囚禁那个邪魔，但就连在死亡之中，苦迦菩提也强大到不是我所能战胜的。我以为自己可以像控制普通精魂那样控制他，但他远远超出了我所能想象的一切。多么壮丽的存在啊！多么壮丽的邪恶啊！若是一位纯心无垢、了无尘缘的女祭司，或许还有一丝机会。可我在他面前什么都不是。他吞噬了我，里里外外，每一部分。现在你们明白了吗？我就是苦迦菩提，就是那个屠杀了你们所有人的野兽。我就是那个把你们囚禁在这里的恶徒！”

怪物与灵异事件：“苦迦菩提或许杀了你们，但他自己依旧死着、也依旧被囚禁着，他的舌头正饥渴地朝你们的鲜血垂涎摆动。他脑子里只有一件事：吞食那些被他尝过味道的人。那些没有脸的玩偶和在我们城镇中肆虐的嘶鸣生物，不过是他的第一步。当你们鲁莽地来到这里时，苦迦菩提用牙齿从你们的灵魂上扯下了一小块，并把它变成了一个仆役。即便现在，你们的双重身也正在猛砸这座宅邸的大门，急着夺走你们的脸据为己有。那就是你们离开这里后将要面对的东西。那就是命运为你们准备好的结局。你们明白了吧……像我们这样的幽灵，也一样会死……”

我们来自一个与你不同的心景：在回答之前，赫总督停顿了一下，随后难以置信地摇了摇头。“荒唐。你们一直都在这里。死亡会对心智做些事情，你们知道的。没关系，我明白。”无论玩家角色说什么，在他们与他相处的这短暂时间里，都无法说服山宝，让他相信这个心景并不是因他的失败而浮现出的唯一一个。

那我们现在该怎么办？“你们为什么要来问我？一切都已经太迟了，不可能再得到原谅。我们全都死了。到头来，我什么都没能保护。我作为总督失败了。作为救世主失败了。作为一个人类也失败了。你们原本是希望我还能救你们吗？希望我的魔法能让你们起死回生？还是说，你们想跟我做个了断？”

现在，玩家角色必须做出选择：要么与总督开战，要么向他解释他们目前的处境并请求他的帮助。虽然山宝因自身承受的压力而在言语上可能显得咄咄逼人，但除非先遭到攻击，否则他不会动手。

Know and Despair

If the PCs win the governor’s trust, he’ll agree to speak with them in his manor, offering to escort them there at once if they aren’t there already. Governor Heh leads the PCs to the manor’s meeting room in the southeast corner, asking them to be seated with him on the cushions that surround one of the long tables. His disheveled appearance and the way he moves without his former precise grace are all the more apparent here in the sterile environment of what looks like an unused meeting room. Despite the lack of any servants in the manor, a spread of food and drink, including hearty meat dishes, hot tea, and plenty of alcohol, waits on the table, a development the governor accepts without surprise. If asked, he shrugs and says, “My servants are gone, but my needs are attended nonetheless in this place,” as if that’s all that needs to be said—in truth, the mindscape itself keeps him nourished as needed.

After pouring for everyone at the table with shaking hands (perhaps an unexpected display of respect toward the PCs), the sudden, tiny squeak of a small black cat breaks the silence as the feline peeks out from a nest of pillows. The cat’s appearance causes the governor to finally speak, his voice now soft and trembling slightly.

“You remember my cat, Black Bean? Such an excellent cat. Such a little cat. You wouldn’t be cruel to Black Bean, would you? She would hunt mice for you. She could play with the children.”

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} then turns to the food, setting out small bowls of rice, black chopsticks plunged upright in the center of all of them. He places them down sharply next to each teacup before abruptly sitting down at his place at the head of the table. The governor’s cat squeaks again, scampering from its soft palace into the man’s lap, and the governor hesitates before petting the fuzzy creature.

The PCs should automatically recognize that rice with incense sticks or upright chopsticks is meant as an offering for the dead. This, combined with his earlier act of respect by serving tea to the PCs, allows them to attempt a @Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] check to Sense Motive—on a success, they realize the governor is treating them not as if they were alive, but as if they were ghosts. The governor is being very blatant in his unspoken message to the PCs, but due to his ruinous state of mind, he has difficulty explaining anything verbally unless asked first. As the conversation progresses, the sun sets (regardless of the time of day when the discussion began), and the PCs can hear the increasing sound of scraping and pounding at the front doors. Heh Shan-Bao ignores it unless the PCs attempt to investigate, at which point he demands the heroes leave it alone unless they want to die. It appears that the governor’s wards have somehow weakened, allowing the townsfolk outside to begin trying to break in.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.TmxsF1RiQJ0m8o5M.PlaylistSound.2eBD8ZQAMj7hPoRh]{Pounding at the Manor Walls}

Regardless of how long it takes to play out, the conversation with the governor should cover most of the talking points below, which include suggested dialogue for you to read aloud.

Willowshore’s Death: If the PCs question the governor’s offering of rice, the undead-repelling fulus, or otherwise inquire about the mindscape or how to escape it, Heh Shan-Bao chuckles ruefully before he answers. “Haven’t you figured it out? You must have suspected. My fulus, the townspeople’s strange behavior, the impassible barriers around our domain, they all point to the same thing. We are all nothing more than hungry ghosts.” If the PCs protest Governor Heh’s use of the word “ghost” due to local taboo, the man laughs bleakly, then slams his hand on the table, rattling the teacups. “Don’t be so naive! Do you think that friendly greetings will save you from the grave? Do you still avoid whistling or doing laundry at night? Are you scared you’ll get offended and eat yourselves? Huh? No... we’re all dead. We have no breath to cry now. That time is behind us. We’ve been dead since the last day of spring. Since Kugaptee killed us all.”

Cause of Destruction: “Kugaptee lashed out from his grave beneath the Tan Sugi. What’s it they say? ‘Cut off the head of an eel, and it can still bite.’” The governor sips from his cup of tea, then stares into the liquid for a moment. “Did you know he was down there? Surely you must have at least suspected. Willowshore is a strange place. Who would have thought a backwater village would have such a saintly legacy, or hide such an unfathomable evil?”

Kugaptee’s Awakening: If the PCs ask what provoked Kugaptee, Heh Shan-Bao pauses a moment, hanging his head in shame before taking a brisk breath to answer: “I did. What a terrible thing I’ve done. Go ahead, hate me for it. Let your rage turn you from ghosts into vengeful spirits, and devour all who threaten our town!”

The governor then lapses into unhinged laughter. After calming down (likely not until a PC takes steps to calm him), Heh Shan-Bao sobers and explains, his voice low and ragged.

“It was foolish. I wanted to protect Willowshore from Kugaptee, to hide him before the jorogumo found him. An evil as powerful as Kugaptee can’t be stopped, only sealed. The more of him that shakes loose, the more he will try to consume us. And so long as that sacred tree remains sickened by his poisons, one of the spider women will be drawn to Kugaptee’s grave eventually. They think like me, do you understand? They love powerful servitors and beautiful people. Well, I’m a sinful man, but I’m a thousand sins short of jorogumo. You never loved me or my empire, but you have no idea what the jorogumo will do to you when they arrive.

“I sought to heal the Tan Sugi, to help it keep the fiend imprisoned, but even in death, Kugaptee was too powerful for me to overcome. I thought I could control him like a mere spirit, but he was beyond what I could have possibly imagined. What a magnificent being! What magnificent evil! A pure-hearted priestess, free of earthly attachments, might have stood a chance. I was nothing to him. He devoured me, every part, inside and out. Do you see now? I am Kugaptee, the beast that slaughtered you all. I am the villain who keeps you imprisoned here!”

The Monsters and Hauntings: “Kugaptee might have killed you, but he’s still dead and imprisoned, his tongue lolling hungrily toward your blood. He thinks of nothing but consuming those he has tasted. Those faceless dolls and hissing creatures that plague our town are his first step. When you rashly came here, Kugaptee pulled a tiny piece of your soul away with his teeth and turned it into a servitor. Even now, your doubles hammer at the doors to this manor, eager to take your faces for their own. That’s who waits for you when you leave this place. That’s what fate has in store for you. You see... ghosts like us can die, too...”

We came from a different mindscape than yours: Before he replies, Governor Heh pauses, then shakes his head in disbelief. “Nonsense. You’ve been here all along. Death does things to the mind, you know. It’s okay. I understand.” Nothing the PCs might say can convince Shan-Bao in the short time they have with him that this mindscape isn’t the only one that rose as a result of his failure.

What do we do now? “Why would you ask me? It is too late for forgiveness. We’re all dead. In the end, I couldn’t protect anything. I failed as a governor. I failed as a savior. I failed as a human being. Were you hoping I could somehow save you? That my magic could bring you back to life? Or do you want to have it out?”

The PCs now have a choice to either fight the governor or to explain their current situation and ask for his help. Though he can be verbally belligerent due to his stressful situation, Shan-Bao won’t fight unless attacked first.

Fighting the Governor.name: 与总督作战 Fighting the Governor
Fighting the Governor.text:
与总督作战 中等 7

与总督作战 中等 7

@UUID[Actor.2nzFpUAKC7MMxWka]{赫山宝}

如果PC与他进入战斗，赫山宝会尽其所能反击。若是在宅邸外与他对峙，他的目标是脱离战斗并逃回家中寻求安全；但如果是在宅邸内遭到攻击，他就会战至死为止。话虽如此，赫山宝是一名学者，而不是战士。如果被迫卷入暴力冲突，他更倾向于保持距离。战斗开始时，他会先尽可能多地使用自己的防御卷轴，然后再使用更具攻击性的卷轴。只有当他的卷轴全都耗尽后，他才会诉诸剑术。

总督会战斗至死，因为他知道，一旦自己的心景重置，他就还有一次实现目标的机会。然而就在他死去时，他的灵魂失去了对自身人性的最后一丝把握，他高声向苦迦菩提呼喊，断断续续地说道：“我将我的灵魂献给你，苦迦菩提！将我从那本属于我的命运中解脱出来吧！”片刻之后，宁多鲁的存在会如 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10endofthedrea00]{梦境的终结} 中所述那样作出反应。

Fighting the Governor Moderate 7

Fighting the Governor Moderate 7

@UUID[Actor.2nzFpUAKC7MMxWka]{Heh Shan-Bao}

If the PCs engage him in combat, Heh Shan-Bao fights back as best he can. If confronted outside of his manor, his goal is to escape the fight and make it back to the safety of his home, but if attacked in the manor, he fights to the death. That said, Heh Shan-Bao is a scholar, not a fighter. He prefers to keep his distance if forced into a violent conflict. At the start of a fight, he uses as many of his defensive scrolls as possible before using his more offensive scrolls. Only when all of his scrolls have been consumed does he resort to swordplay.

The governor fights to the death, knowing that he’ll have another chance to achieve his goal once his mindscape resets. As he dies, though, his soul loses the last grip he has on his own humanity, and he calls out to Kugaptee, gasping out, “I offer thee my soul, Kugaptee! Unbind me from that which was my fate!” A few moments later, the nindoru’s presence reacts as detailed in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10endofthedrea00]{End of the Dream}.

Manor Interior.name: 庄园内部 Manor Interior
Manor Interior.text:
庄园内部

总督庄园由木材建成。外墙厚实坚固，但内墙由纸制成，并饰有田园乡村生活或荒野风光的景象。在心景形成之前，庄园中原本有几名守卫和一些宝藏，但如今这些都已不见，使得这座建筑感觉几乎像是某种展示品，而非供人居住的家。

庄园里没有等待着PC的危险，因此让他们按照地图随意探索即可。如果他们在白天探索，将不会发现任何值得注意的东西。入夜后，赫总督一注意到他们到来，便会在庭院中迎接他们，要求他们立刻离开。他会准备战斗，但不会主动发起战斗；只有当PC先攻击他、开始破坏他的家，或以其他方式采取任何敌对动作时，他才会攻击。

Manor Interior

The governor’s manor is made of wood. External walls are thick and solid, but internal walls are made of paper and decorated with scenes of idyllic country life or wilderness landscapes. While the manor had several guards and treasures before the mindscape’s formation, today these are missing, leaving the structure feeling almost as if it were a display of some sort, not a home meant to be lived in.

There are no dangers awaiting the PCs in the manor, so allow them to explore as they see fit, using the map. If they explore during the day, they’ll find nothing of interest. After dark, Governor Heh greets them in the courtyard once he notices their arrival, demanding they leave at once. He prepares for a fight but won’t initiate combat, attacking only if the PCs first attack him, begin to damage his home, or otherwise take any hostile action.

Breaking Into the Manor.name: 闯入庄园 Breaking Into the Manor
Breaking Into the Manor.text:
闯入庄园

如果PC无法获得总督准许进入庄园，他们可以设法闯入这栋建筑；一旦他们弄清楚该如何彻底解除或避开庄园护，就能取得他们所需的关键信息（例如使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{传送} 传送进庄园）。

庄园内部看起来干净整洁，却又怪异地毫无生气、空空荡荡。如今，赫总督是这座庄园里唯一的住户；他的仆役和守卫都早已各自前往来世，他们是柳岸镇少数没有被困在心景中的居民。

此时，只要PC提出任何合情合理的论点或要求，都应自动成功说服赫山宝坐下来交谈；因此，假如PC没有主动挑起战斗，就继续进行 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10knowanddespa00]{知晓与绝望}。

Breaking Into the Manor

If the PCs are unable to get the governor’s permission to enter the manor, they could attempt to break into the building to get the critical information they need once they figure out how to disable or avoid the manor wards entirely (by using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} to teleport into the manor, for example).

Within the manor, things appear clean and tidy but strangely sterile and empty of life. Governor Heh is the only inhabitant of his manor these days; his servants and guards have simply passed on to their individual afterlives, the few citizens of Willowshore who escaped being trapped in a mindscape.

At this point, any well-reasoned argument or demand voiced by the PCs should automatically succeed at convincing Shan-Bao to sit down and talk, so assuming the PCs don’t start a fight, proceed with @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10knowanddespa00]{Know and Despair}.

Manor Wards.name: 庄园护 Manor Wards
Manor Wards.text:
庄园护卫 严重 7

总督明白，夜晚来临后局势会变得更加危险，而苦迦菩提的影响在日落后也会更加强大。他也知道，自己因仪式失败而被困在这处心景中，但他并未意识到，柳岸镇的人民是以平行心景中的形式“幸存”下来的。相反，随着每一轮时代循环展开，赫山宝愈发相信，柳岸镇居民所剩下的，只有那些栖居于他心景中的“幽灵”——这些幻影白天无知地重复着日常职责，到了夜晚却变得愤怒而充满复仇心，向他的庄园进军。

饱受愧疚折磨的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}，会在每次循环重启时，用非魔法的符箓和其他护符在自己庄园的外墙上布下护卫。随着每一年推进，这些护卫的数量都会增加，以至于在每轮循环结束时，整座庄园几乎都被这些纸条与飘扬的祷文裹得如同木乃伊一般。尽管这些单独的符箓本身并不是魔法物品，但它们累积起来的效果会借用赫总督的心灵来保护他的庄园。

如果玩家角色设法绕过这处危害并进入庄园，继续进行@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10breakinginto00]{闯入庄园}。

庄园护卫 严重 7

@UUID[Actor.3I4bwqook4CXmQ52]{庄园护卫}

危害：这些护卫不仅会阻止玩家角色使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}直接进入他的庄园，还会在他们抵达心景后保护总督庄园不受玩家角色侵入。玩家角色一旦接近庄园5尺以内，就会发现自己无法继续前进；当他们触发这道魔法护卫时，就仿佛被一堵隐形墙实实在在地挡住了。与庄园墙壁保持5尺以上距离的玩家角色，可以用10分钟行动来调查这些护卫，然后尝试一次@Check[occultism|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或@Check[religion|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定来回忆知识。成功时，玩家角色会判断出，这些护卫本是为了阻挡不死生物、邪恶精魂，以及来自其他界域的超自然生物靠近；但他们无法解释这些护卫为何也会对他们生效（除了一种可能：由于玩家角色是来自另一处心景的访客，这些护卫将他们也视作精魂）。

奖励：如果赫山宝在玩家角色手上用印文写下能让他们自由穿过护卫的封印文字，则在他们绕过这处危害时，为玩家角色授予经验值。

Manor Wards Severe 7

The governor understands that things grow more dangerous at night and that Kugaptee’s influence is stronger after the sun sets. He also knows that he has become trapped in this mindscape as the result of his failed ritual but doesn’t realize that the people of Willowshore “survived” in a parallel mindscape. Instead, as each cycle of time plays out, Shan-Bao comes to believe more and more that all that remains of Willowshore’s citizens are the “ghosts” that inhabit his mindscape—phantasms who by day ignorantly repeat their daily duties but who grow angry and vengeful at night as they march upon his manor.

Tormented by his guilt, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} covers the outer walls of his manor with wards in the form of non-magical fulus and other charms every time the cycle repeats. As each year plays out, the number of these wards increases, so that by the end of each cycle, the manor is all but mummified in these strips of papers and fluttering prayers. While these individual fulus aren’t themselves magic items, the cumulative effect of them draws upon Governor Heh’s psyche to protect his manor.

If the PCs manage to bypass this hazard and enter the manor, proceed with @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10breakinginto00]{Breaking Into the Manor}.

Manor Wards Severe 7

@UUID[Actor.3I4bwqook4CXmQ52]{Manor Wards}

Hazard: Beyond preventing the PCs from using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} to enter his manor directly, these wards also protect the governor’s manor from the PCs once they arrive in the mindscape. A PC who approaches within 5 feet of the manor finds they can’t proceed any further, as if they were physically blocked by an invisible wall when they trigger the magical ward. A PC who remains more than 5 feet from the manor’s walls can Investigate the wards as a 10-minute activity, then attempt a @Check[occultism|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[religion|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge. On a success, the PC determines these wards are meant to bar the approach of undead, evil spirits, and supernatural creatures from other realms, but they have no explanation as to why the wards work against them (other than that it’s possible these wards interpret the PCs as spirits because they’re visitors from a different mindscape).

Reward: Award the PCs XP for bypassing the hazard if Heh Shan-Bao inks their hands with the seal script that allows them to pass freely through the wards.

The Governor Escapes.name: 总督逃脱 The Governor Escapes
The Governor Escapes.text:
总督逃脱

如果 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}一路成功回到自己的庄园，他就会把自己锁在里面，并且只要玩家角色还明显留在镇上，就拒绝出来。到这时，玩家角色必须设法克服庄园护卫才能闯入庄园，或者他们也可以撤退，等将来再试着与他取得联系。

The Governor Escapes

If @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} makes it all the way back to his manor, he locks himself in and refuses to exit for as long as the PCs remain obviously in town. At this point, the PCs will need to overcome the manor wards to break into the manor, or they can retreat and try to contact him again in the future.

The Governor Caught.name: 总督被抓住了 The Governor Caught
The Governor Caught.text:
总督被抓住了

如果玩家角色在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}到达他的宅邸之前追上了他，他会瘫下身子，做好与他们一战的准备（见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10fightingtheg00]{与总督作战}），但不会主动发起战斗。如果玩家角色不攻击他，他就同意与他们交谈，但坚持要他们在他的宅邸里说，而不是在空旷处。他先开口要毛笔和墨汁，接着又心不在焉地搜寻自己的袖子，自己把这些东西取了出来，然后在每名玩家角色的手背上草草画下一个符号。他解释说，这道印记能让他们进入他的宅邸，而不必害怕他在墙边设下的护卫。只要玩家角色仍留在心景中，或者直到某名玩家角色花费一个交互动作把它擦掉为止，这道印记就会一直存在。

如果玩家角色希望在会面前继续探索，赫山宝会告诉他们务必要在日落前到达他的宅邸，并反复叮嘱他们不要洗掉或抹花这道墨迹标记，然后才退回家中。

奖励：如果玩家角色在总督到达宅邸前抓住了他，给予他们120 XP。

The Governor Caught

If the PCs catch up to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} before he reaches his manor, he slumps and prepares himself for a fight (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10fightingtheg00]{Fighting the Governor}) but doesn’t initiate combat. If the PCs don’t attack him, he agrees to talk to them but insists they speak in his manor rather than out in the open. He asks for a brush and ink before absentmindedly searching his sleeves and retrieving those items himself, then scrawls a symbol on the back of each PC’s hand. He explains that this seal will allow them to enter his manor without fear from the wards he created around his walls. This seal persists as long as the PCs remain in the mindscape or until a PC takes an Interact action to wipe it off.

Should the PCs wish to continue exploring before the meeting, Heh Shan-Bao tells them to be sure to arrive at his manor before the sun sets, insisting multiple times they don’t wash off or smear the ink marking, before retreating to his home.

Reward: If the PCs catch the governor before he reaches his manor, grant them 120 XP.

Dead Man Walking.name: 行尸走肉 Dead Man Walking
Dead Man Walking.text:
行尸走肉 Moderate 7

尽管持续不断的恐惧、愧疚与折磨已经让@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}总督变成了一个因创伤而崩溃、与昔日判若两人的可怜人，但他在囚禁期间并未虚度时日。与玩家角色不同，山宝明白自己和柳岸镇的所有居民都已经死去，只是又在这个心景中“重生”，并被困在生死之间。怀着这一认知，赫山宝每年都会尝试设计一场@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生术}仪式，好让自己逃出心景，并在活人的世界中转生。从那之后，他希望利用自己的魔法知识复活镇民、疏散柳岸镇，然后召集帮手来举行仪式，以更安全地封印苦迦菩提。当然，这一切的出发点都很高尚，但他永远不可能成功。

与玩家角色一样，由于赫总督的记忆会在他的心景每次年度循环重置时一并重置，所以他并不知道自己已经将这些行为重复了115次。若有超过一年的时间来构建仪式，也许他终究能完成这场转生仪式的研究；但即便如此，他也只会以幽魂般的精魂形态出现在活人的世界。幸运的是，为了他的理智着想，这个真相始终没有被总督察觉；而当玩家角色来到他的心景时，他正外出为自己最新一轮的仪式实验收集材料。

任何居民都能为玩家角色指出总督的去向——他经常进镇采购或收集材料，这并不是什么秘密，而今天他办事正好去了春之手。或者，如果玩家角色花一小时探索柳岸镇，你也可以直接让他们看见总督正结束拜访、走在回家路上。如果你想避免玩家角色与庄园的护发生冲突，也可以让他们在接近庄园时自动在街上遇见总督。若你将这一事件安排在镇上的其他地点开始，可能需要调整下方追逐中部分障碍的风味描述。

半路截击

玩家角色也许会推断出赫山宝的目的地，并决定直接前往他的庄园在那里拦截，在他抵达时伏击他。让每位玩家角色都尝试一次对抗山宝察觉DC 25的@Check[stealth|dc:25]检定，以便出其不意。若他发现玩家角色埋伏在此，总督会再次逃跑（可能引发一场新的追逐），并尽可能长时间避免回家。到了黄昏，绝望会逼得他即便明知玩家角色在埋伏，也要尝试冲进自己的庄园。允许玩家角色用单独1轮来克服“最后冲刺”障碍。若他们未能克服，总督便会从他们身边溜过，进入庄园。

生物：对玩家角色来说，赫山宝是个众所周知的人物，虽然他们一眼就能认出他，但也立刻能看出眼前这个人已不是他们记忆中的那位。山宝原本总是梳理得一丝不苟、盘起的官式发髻，如今散乱披垂，蓬头垢面。他那件黑色外袍布满细小裂口，边缘还被烧焦，看起来更像一件破烂睡袍，而非最初那件时髦、绣有银纹的华服。他那副萦绕着惊惶的神情，仿佛始终在与歇斯底里、无法控制的大笑，或因恐惧而尖叫的冲动作斗争。

总督立刻认出了玩家角色，并很快意识到他们并不是居住在这个心景中的那种普通仿造人影。不幸的是，赫总督的第一反应是偏执狂乱，因为他认为玩家角色是某种与苦迦菩提有关的邪恶存在。更不幸的是，那些伪装成英雄的野箆坊冒名者也非常乐意强化这种先入之见。总督试图甩开玩家角色，引着他们在镇中展开一场追逐。

本遭遇使用开拓者 GM Core第192页详述的追逐规则进行。这是一场“追上目标”类型的追逐，由玩家角色追赶总督。由于他们是追击者，玩家角色在先攻顺序中第二行动，而赫总督从障碍2：齐仲之怒开始追逐。在每轮结束时，总督都会自动前进到下一个障碍，无需为克服障碍进行任何检定。追逐中的每一轮都会经过10分钟。

若玩家角色在总督离开某个障碍前追上该障碍，则追逐以@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10thegovernorc00]{总督被抓住了}结束。若玩家角色在追逐第5轮结束前未能追上总督，则追逐以@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10thegovernore00]{总督逃脱}结束。

1：总督在哪里？障碍 7

追逐点数 7；克服 @Check[society|dc:21]或@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:19]，快速辨认出他的官服；@Check[stealth|dc:23]，在他注意到你之前潜行接近；@Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive]，通过察言观色判断他的动机，并看出他打算溜走

追逐开始时，玩家角色得知总督此刻正在春之手采购，并试图在不暴露自己的情况下接近他。

2：齐仲之怒障碍 7

追逐点数 3；克服 @Check[qi-zhong-lore|dc:21]或@Check[religion|dc:21]，以正确的祷告安抚那只守护魅影壁虎精魂；@Check[diplomacy|dc:23]，因亵渎圣祠之举而向达米医生郑重道歉；@Check[crafting|dc:25]，迅速修复损坏

如果玩家角色在前一个障碍中大获成功，并在追逐第一轮就赶到这里，他们会在总督意识到自己被追赶前抓住他。但如果他已经离开，那么玩家角色会发现春之手一片混乱：达米医生惊慌失措，正和助手们一起试图安抚一只暴怒的魅影壁虎。这个生物是春之手的魔法守护者；在赫总督于诊所庭院内砍毁一座供奉@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.giAsBYiL2omr0x2L]{齐仲}的小纸圣祠后，它便陷入狂乱并显现出来。总督知道此举会制造混乱，也希望借此为自己抢出更多时间，领先跑回庄园。

3：冲过人群障碍 7

追逐点数 4；克服 @Check[intimidation|dc:23]，喝令商人们让路；@Check[acrobatics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:balance|name:Balance]，沿桥栏保持平衡通过，从无车流阻碍之处前进；@Check[athletics|dc:27]，一路推撞着挤过人群。任何拥有飞行速度、攀爬速度，或具备无视人群制造的困难地形能力的玩家角色，在这些检定上获得+4环境加值。

总督像是预先知道人群的每一个动作般，从一群正在讨价还价、堵住狭窄溪流桥面的商人中间滑了过去。玩家角色则会在桥上和街道上遭遇拥堵的交通，商人与其他恼怒的旅人形成了密集人群，令人难以穿行。

4：他往哪边去了？障碍 7

追逐点数 4；克服 @Check[arcana|dc:23]或@Check[occultism|dc:23]，侦测幻象中的缺陷；@Check[survival|dc:25]，追踪真正总督留下的踪迹；@Check[perception|dc:27]，察觉幻象背后的现实。任何在一次@Check[will|dc:28]豁免中成功识破该幻象的玩家角色，在这些检定上获得+4环境加值。若该幻象被驱散，则每位玩家角色都获得此加值。

在绝望之下，赫总督使用了一张@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{幻象场景}卷轴，在柳岸镇镇区的街道与小巷中制造出多个自己的版本四处游荡。这些复制体以不同时间间隔在区域中移动，但这个仓促施展的幻象并不完美，玩家角色可以运用自己的魔法知识，意识到发生了什么，并看出这些仿造体中的破绽。

5：最后冲刺障碍 7

追逐点数 3
克服 @Check[diplomacy|dc:23]或@Check[deception|dc:23]，说服总督他们不是冒名者；@Check[athletics|dc:25]，追上并扑倒总督；@Check[intimidation|dc:27]，用一声威胁性的呼喝逼他当场停下。速度至少为35的玩家角色在该运动检定上获得+2环境加值，而速度至少为50者（或能传送到他前方者）则在该检定上获得+4环境加值。

庄园入口已然在望，总督突然开始冲刺，拼命想赶到自己那座受符箓保护的家中寻求安全。

Dead Man Walking Moderate 7

Though the constant fear, guilt, and torment have left Governor @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} a traumatized wreck of his former self, he hasn’t spent his captivity idle. Unlike the PCs, Shan-Bao understands that he and all the people of Willowshore died, only to be “reborn” within this mindscape and become trapped between life and death. With this knowledge in mind, Heh Shan-Bao attempts to engineer a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate} ritual every year that will allow him to escape the mindscape and reincarnate into the living world. From there, he hopes to use his magical knowledge to resurrect the townsfolk, evacuate Willowshore, and then recruit help to perform the ritual to seal Kugaptee more safely. This is all noble in intent, of course, but he will never be able to succeed at this.

As with the PCs, since Governor Heh’s memories reset each time his mindscape’s yearly cycle resets, he isn’t aware that he has repeated these actions 115 times. With more than a year to build his ritual, perhaps he could eventually complete his work on the transmigrate ritual, but even then, he would simply appear in the living world as a ghostly spirit. Fortunately for his sanity, this truth continues to elude the governor, and when the PCs arrive in his mindscape, he’s out gathering supplies for his latest ritual experiments.

Any resident can direct the PCs to the governor—it’s no secret that he often makes trips into town to shop or gather supplies, and that today his errands have brought him to the Hand of Spring. Alternatively, if the PCs spend an hour exploring Willowshore, you can simply have them spot the governor as he’s walking back home from the visit. If you want to prevent having the PCs clash against the manor’s wards, feel free to have them automatically encounter the governor on the street as they approach the manor. You might wish to adjust the flavor of some of the obstacles in the chase below if you start this event somewhere else in town.

Head Off at the Pass

The PCs might deduce Heh Shan-Bao’s destination and decide to cut him off there, going directly to his manor to ambush him on arrival. Have each PC attempt a @Check[stealth|dc:25] check against Shan-Bao’s Perception DC of 25 to surprise him. If he spots the PCs lying in wait, the governor flees again (potentially triggering a new chase) and avoids returning home for as long as possible. At dusk, desperation forces him to make an attempt to run into his manor even if the PCs are lying in wait. Allow the PCs a single round to overcome the Last-Ditch Run obstacle. If they fail to overcome it, Shan-Bao slips by them into the manor.

Creatures: To the PCs, Heh Shan-Bao is a well-known figure, and while they all recognize him on sight, they can immediately tell this man isn’t the same man they remember. Shan-Bao’s hair, normally pulled up into a perfect courtly style, now hangs loose and unkempt. His black outer robe is covered in tiny rips and is burned at the edges, looking more like a ragged dressing gown than the fashionable, silver-embroidered garment it originally was. His haunted expression seems to be constantly fighting off frenzied, uncontrollable laughter or an urge to scream in fright.

The governor immediately recognizes the PCs and quickly realizes they aren’t the typical facsimiles of people that inhabit this mindscape. Unfortunately, Governor Heh’s immediate reaction is one of paranoia, as he assumes the PCs are sinister beings somehow related to Kugaptee. Even more unfortunately, the noppera-bo impersonators who are posing as the heroes are all too happy to reinforce that preconception. The governor attempts to evade the PCs, leading them on a chase throughout town.

This encounter plays out using the chase rules detailed on page 192 of Pathfinder GM Core. This is a “chase down” type of chase in which the PCs pursue the governor. The PCs go second in initiative since they’re the pursuers, with Governor Heh starting the chase at obstacle 2: Qi Zhong’s Ire. At the end of each round, the governor automatically progresses to the next obstacle without needing to roll any checks to overcome the obstacle. Each round of the chase takes 10 minutes to pass.

If the PCs reach an obstacle before the governor has left it, the chase ends with @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10thegovernorc00]{The Governor Caught}. If the PCs don’t manage to catch up to the governor before the end of round 5 of the chase, the chase ends with @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10thegovernore00]{The Governor Escapes}s.

1: Where is the Governor?Obstacle 7

Chase Points 7; Overcome @Check[society|dc:21] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:19] to quickly identify his official robes, @Check[stealth|dc:23] to sneak up on him before he notices you, @Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] to Sense his Motive and intention to slip away

The chase begins as the PCs learn that the governor is currently shopping at the Hand of Spring and attempt to approach without giving themselves away.

2: Qi Zhong’s IreObstacle 7

Chase Points 3; Overcome @Check[qi-zhong-lore|dc:21] or @Check[religion|dc:21] to placate the guardian gecko spirit with the proper prayers, @Check[diplomacy|dc:23] to respectfully apologize to Doctor Dami for the sacrilege to the shrine, @Check[crafting|dc:25] to quickly repair the damage

If the PCs wildly succeed at the previous obstacle and manage to reach this one on the chase’s first round, they’ll catch the governor before he realizes they’re after him. If he has moved on, however, the PCs find the Hand of Spring in chaos, with Doctor Dami in a panic as he and his assistants work to calm down an irate phantom gecko. This creature, a magical guardian of the Hand of Spring, has manifested in a frenzy after Governor Heh slashed at a small paper shrine devoted to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.giAsBYiL2omr0x2L]{Qi Zhong} in the clinic’s courtyard, knowing this act would create mayhem and hoping it would give him time to get a head start on the race back to his manor.

3: Plowing Through CrowdsObstacle 7

Chase Points 4; Overcome @Check[intimidation|dc:23] to make the merchants step aside, @Check[acrobatics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:balance|name:Balance] to balance across the bridge railing where no traffic is in the way, @Check[athletics|dc:27] to shove your way through the crowd. Any PC who has a fly Speed, climb Speed, or the ability to bypass difficult terrain created by crowds gains a +4 circumstance bonus to these checks.

The governor slips through a throng of haggling merchants who are blocking the way on a bridge that crosses a narrow creek, as if he knows every movement the crowd is going to make in advance. The PCs are met with congested traffic on the bridge and streets, with the merchants and other frustrated travelers forming dense crowds that are difficult to navigate.

4: Which Way Did He Go?Obstacle 7

Chase Points 4; Overcome @Check[arcana|dc:23] or @Check[occultism|dc:23] to detect flaws in the illusion, @Check[survival|dc:25] to follow the real governor’s trail, @Check[perception|dc:27] to notice reality behind the illusion. Any PC who succeeds at a @Check[will|dc:28] save to disbelieve the illusion gains a +4 circumstance bonus to these checks. Every PC gains this bonus if the illusion is dispelled.

In a fit of desperation, Governor Heh uses a scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{Illusory Scene} to create multiple versions of himself wandering around the streets and alleyways of downtown Willowshore. These copies move through the area at different intervals, but the rushed illusion is imperfect, and the PCs can use their knowledge of magic to realize what’s going on and spot the flaws in the facsimiles.

5: Last-DitchObstacle 7

Chase Points 3
Overcome @Check[diplomacy|dc:23] or @Check[deception|dc:23] to convince the governor that they aren’t impostors, @Check[athletics|dc:25] to run the governor down, @Check[intimidation|dc:27] to force him to stop in his tracks with a yelled threat. A PC who has a Speed of at least 35 gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the Athletics check, while those with a Speed of at least 50 (or who can teleport ahead of him) gain a +4 circumstance bonus to this check.

With the entrance to his manor in sight, the governor breaks into a sprint, desperate to reach the safety of his fulu-warded home.

Your Face is Mine.name: 你的脸是我的 Your Face is Mine
Your Face is Mine.text:
你的脸属于我

玩家角色和@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}并不是这片心景中仅有的真实居住者——还有另一群完全能自主控制自身动作的存在潜伏在它的边界之内。一群无脸妖栖居于此，它们由苦迦菩提死去的梦境显化而来，并被外来者的闯入所吸引。每名玩家角色各对应一只无脸鬼，而每一只都拥有其对应玩家角色的外观——唯一显著的例外是它们没有脸。眼下，这些无脸妖会避开玩家角色，除非出于自卫被迫反击，或是玩家角色在追赶总督时失败（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10thegovernore00]{总督逃脱}），否则它们不会发动攻击。它们目前更感兴趣的是观察玩家角色，以便日后更准确地模仿他们的举止。

使用这些无脸妖来进一步强化总督心景中的诡异氛围。无脸妖目前会避开玩家角色，但镇民们可能会被它们弄糊涂。对这些半真实的村民而言，玩家角色与他们的无脸鬼复制体完全一模一样，因此可能会有本地人对某位玩家角色打招呼说“哦，欢迎回来！”或“你是不是忘了什么？”这类互动应当让人感觉他们仿佛刚刚才见过那名玩家角色，尽管这次遭遇可能其实是该玩家角色第一次和那位本地人说话。

你的脸属于我

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21nopperaboimp00]{无面鬼模仿者} | @UUID[Actor.vFNg9BATB9crqnDn]{奥术} @UUID[Actor.aYR61sI47XlE9ul8]{神圣} @UUID[Actor.2NmupNwbuAt5GcWy]{武战}@UUID[Actor.UgfzkrEkFrdeegD0]{异能} @UUID[Actor.vmOACyFUJqWHY8YD]{原始} @UUID[Actor.n9L4akwW1KlBXQQd]{娴熟}

生物：玩家角色此时不应能够追踪并攻击他们的无脸鬼复制体，但执着的玩家角色可以强行提前触发这场遭遇。如果发生战斗，附近心景中的镇民会像真正的镇民看到自己的邻居遭到怪物般的复制体袭击时那样作出反应，但他们会把无脸妖当作“真正”的人，而不是玩家角色。

每个无面鬼模仿者都会将其攻击集中在它所模仿的那名玩家角色身上。关于无面鬼模仿者的完整详情，以及如何将它们定制得与你的玩家角色相匹配，请见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21impersonator00]{此处}。

Your Face is Mine

The PCs and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} aren’t the only real occupants of this mindscape—one more set of beings that are fully in control of their actions lurk within its borders. A group of noppera-bos dwell here, manifested from Kugaptee’s dead dreams and attracted by the intrusion of a foreign presence. There’s one noppera-bo for each PC, and each has the appearance of their associated PC—with the notable exception of the lack of a face. For the moment, these noppera-bos avoid the PCs and don’t attack unless they’re forced to in self-defense or if the PCs fail at pursuing the governor (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10thegovernore00]{The Governor Escapes}). They’re more interested in observing the PCs for now, the better to accurately mimic their behavior later on.

Use these noppera-bos to further accentuate the eerie atmosphere of the governor’s mindscape. The noppera-bos avoid the PCs for now, but the townsfolk might be confused by them. To the half-real villagers, the PCs and their noppera-bo duplicates are truly identical, which might result in a local greeting a PC with an “Oh, welcome back!” or a “Did you forget something?” These interactions should imply that they just met the PC in question even though this encounter might be the PC’s first time speaking with that particular local.

Your Face is Mine

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21nopperaboimp00]{Noppera-bo Impersonator} | @UUID[Actor.vFNg9BATB9crqnDn]{Arcane} @UUID[Actor.aYR61sI47XlE9ul8]{Divine} @UUID[Actor.2NmupNwbuAt5GcWy]{Martial}@UUID[Actor.UgfzkrEkFrdeegD0]{Occult} @UUID[Actor.vmOACyFUJqWHY8YD]{Primal} @UUID[Actor.n9L4akwW1KlBXQQd]{Skilled}

Creatures: The PCs shouldn’t be able to track down and attack their noppera-bo duplicates at this time, but persistent PCs can force an early encounter. If a fight results, nearby mindscape townsfolk react in the same manner that the real townsfolk would if they saw their neighbors attacked by monstrous doubles, but they treat the noppera-bos as the “real” people instead of the PCs.

Each noppera-bo impersonator focuses its attacks on the PC it imitates. Full details for noppera-bo impersonators and how to customize them to match your PCs appear @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21impersonator00]{Here}.

Ill Omens.name: 凶兆 Ill Omens
Ill Omens.text:
凶兆

尽管总督的心景表面上一切如常，苦迦菩提的邪恶灵光却无法被掩盖——在这里，这头邪魔的影响依然强大。若玩家角色花更多时间在这个版本的柳岸镇中徘徊与探索，你可以使用下表中的不祥征兆与萦绕时刻来令玩家感到不安。

[[/r 1d10]] 结果
1 某人啃咬下一口又大又熟的柿子。顺着其嘴角与下巴流下的汁液气味甜得发腻，外观却完全像是鲜血；无论怎样指责或劝说，都无法让那人意识到这一点。
2 一名玩家角色向前行走时，感觉有什么像绷紧的发丝一样的东西猛地抽过他们的脸颊，并受到 @Damage[(1)[slashing]] 伤害。他们脸上出现一道薄如剃刀的伤口，仿佛那根头发锋利得足以划出血来。
3 一名玩家角色感觉有什么异常柔软的东西拂过皮肤。一团蚕虫从高处某处掉落下来，在下坠途中砸中了该玩家角色。毛虫们像蛆虫一样无助地在地上扭动，因为冬季根本没有桑树可供它们进食。
4 一名玩家角色所站附近的一栋建筑上，缓缓浮现出一道神秘的黑色阴影，仿佛墙壁正从内部被烧灼。调查后找不到任何起火迹象，然而空气中却依旧残留着 unmistakable 的烟臭味。
5 一名玩家角色听见脚下传来一声清脆的碎裂声。调查后发现，他们的鞋里或皮肤中嵌着破损的牙齿碎片，除了带来一阵不安外，并未造成任何持续性的伤害。
6 某人正将河鱼切碎，准备把它们发酵成鱼酱。这些鱼长着呆滞的人类眼睛，嘴里还有明显的人类牙齿，但正在切鱼的人似乎完全没有注意到这一点，即便有玩家角色指出来也是如此。
7 一只深红色的蝴蝶从附近某个意想不到的地方浮现，比如从一杯茶中飞出，或是一名玩家角色打喷嚏时从其口中飞出。蝴蝶会在队伍周围扑扇几轮，随后落到地上，融化成一摊血迹。
8 一阵怪异寒冷的微风掠过区域；当它吹过队伍时，一名玩家角色（随机决心）听见充满威胁的低语，许诺死亡与毁灭——发出这些低语的声音似乎属于另一名玩家角色。
9 光线变暗，仿佛有云飘过上方的太阳或月亮，然而天空中似乎并无任何对应的现象。玩家角色们突然感到寒意刺骨，胃里也涌起可怖的饥饿啃咬感，片刻之后，光线与这些感觉又恢复正常。
10 当至少两名玩家角色正在交谈时，其中一名玩家角色会听见另一名玩家角色把某个词说成了“苦迦菩提”。说出这句话的玩家角色，以及其他正在旁听的玩家角色，完全听不到这个词。听见这个名字的玩家角色在接下来的一小时里都会心神不宁，确信自己正被监视着。

Ill Omens

While the governor’s mindscape plays at normalcy, Kugaptee’s evil aura can’t be hidden—here, the fiend’s influence remains strong. If the PCs take more time to wander and explore this version of Willowshore, you can use the ominous signs and haunting moments on the following table to unnerve the players.

[[/r 1d10]] Result
1 Someone bites into a large, ripe persimmon. The torrent of juice that flows down their mouth and chin smells overwhelmingly sweet but looks exactly like blood; no amount of accusation or persuasion can make the person cognizant of this fact.
2 A PC feels something like a taut strand of hair snap across their cheek while walking forward and takes @Damage[(1)[slashing]] damage. A razor thin cut appears on their face, as if the hair was sharp enough to draw blood.
3 A PC feels something oddly soft brush their skin. A ball of silkworms has fallen from somewhere on high and struck the PC on the way down. The caterpillars writhe helplessly on the ground like maggots, as there are no mulberry trees in winter to feed them.
4 A mysterious black shadow slowly appears on a building that a PC is standing near, as if the walls were being burnt from the inside. An investigation reveals no sign of any fire, yet the unmistakable stink of smoke lingers in the air nonetheless.
5 A PC hears a sharp crunching noise beneath their feet. An investigation reveals the broken fragments of teeth embedded in their shoes or skin, leaving no lasting damage other than a sense of disquiet.
6 A person minces river fish to prepare them for fermentation into fish paste. The fish have glassy human eyes and prominent human teeth in their mouths, but the person doing the mincing doesn’t seem to notice, even if a PC points this out to them.
7 A crimson butterfly emerges from an unexpected nearby location, such as from a cup of tea or out of a PC’s mouth when they sneeze. The butterfly flutters around the party for a few rounds before it drops to the ground and melts into a bloodstain.
8 A strangely cold breeze rustles through the area; as it blows across the party, one PC (determined randomly) hears threatening whispers promising death and doom—the voice delivering the whispers seems to be that of a different PC.
9 The light dims as if a cloud were passing over the sun or moon above, yet no corresponding event in the skies seems apparent. The PCs feel a sudden chill in their bones and the hideous gnaw of hunger in their stomachs, only for the light and sensations to return to normal a moment later.
10 While at least two PCs are having a discussion, one of the PCs hears a different PC say the name “Kugaptee” in place of another word. The PC who spoke, and any other PCs listening in, do not hear this word at all. The PC who heard the name spends the rest of the hour unnerved, certain they’re being watched.

Seeking out Heh Shan-Bao.name: 寻找和善保 Seeking out Heh Shan-Bao
Seeking out Heh Shan-Bao.text:
寻找赫山宝

弱化死亡

尽管玩家角色在赫山宝的心景中，可能会觉得自己和在柳岸镇心景中时一样具有实体、真实存在，但事实并非完全如此。在这个心景里，他们比之前更接近以精魂的形式存在，但直到本章结尾，他们才会意识到真相。不过，若有玩家角色在赫山宝的心景中死亡，便会得到一条重要线索：该玩家角色不会真正死去，而是其身体会从心景中消失，并在他们自己的柳岸镇中醒来，显现在最初施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}时所处的同一地点。该玩家角色醒来时会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 1}，并仅剩1生命值，但除此之外，其余状态都与死亡试图在总督的心景中带走他们之前相同。

一旦玩家角色发现@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}，他们便可以在任何时间或地点自由施放该仪式。在他们这么做之前，“无息可泣”的剧情无法推进到第9章中预定发生的冬季事件之后。施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}时，主要技能检定的难度等级为27，次要技能检定的难度等级为22。如果玩家角色至少受到柳岸镇某个派系的钦佩，则该派系每周可资助一次施放该仪式的费用。如果某个派系崇敬他们，则该派系每天可资助一次费用。（如果你的团队有超过四名角色，则增加心景转移可传送的目标数量，以涵盖队伍中的每一位成员，而不是强迫玩家角色为了运送整个队伍而多次施放该仪式。）

Scene Notes音效

@UUID[Playlist.0GuH1kstxWaqGSJx.PlaylistSound.PqkA73gCCn7sSZhv]{心景转移}

赫山宝被送入的那个心景，几乎是玩家角色版本柳岸镇的复制品，只有少数几个关键区别。赫山宝的心景比玩家角色来时的那个要小得多——这个心景的边界只环绕城镇范围，而不是向外延伸数里，覆盖柳岸镇周围的腹地。

玩家角色心景中已被修复或毁坏的建筑，在赫山宝的心景中并未改变；因此，青天茶馆在这里依然是一片废墟，而云纸坊仍然屹立不倒。更重要的是，在这个心景中，总督庄园仍位于柳岸镇镇区原本的位置。根据玩家角色是在何处施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}的，他们从自己的柳岸镇过渡到这个新心景时，变化可能几乎无法察觉，也可能难以忽视——周围环境会突然重新化为残破废墟，或恢复到正常状态，或者看起来只是异常相似。同样地，当玩家角色离开柳岸镇时原本在附近的人，等他们抵达总督心景时，也可能已经不在那里了。

请注意，玩家角色必须位于柳岸镇境内，才能成功使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}进入赫山宝的心景。他庄园上的护（第163页）会阻止玩家角色出现在建筑内部，因此如果玩家角色试图在那座庄园曾经所在的空地上施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}，那么当他们在新心景中显现时，会出现在空地边缘。

事实上，当玩家角色探索这个版本的柳岸镇时，很快就会意识到某些地方不太对劲。原因既阴森又悲惨：当赫山宝的仪式失败并催生出这些心景时，他的心智、身体与灵魂已被苦迦菩提彻底吞噬。玩家角色刚刚进入的这个心景，源自总督在惊惶中残存的最后意识火花——他的心智正在奋力维持自身的个体性，免得被苦迦菩提完全吸收。

当玩家角色抵达总督的心景时，他们的第一印象应当是故乡一个宜人的日子。初冬的空气里仍残留着一丝潮湿的暖意，草丛中还能听见蟋蟀鸣叫。街道上弥漫着甜美的线香气味、木柴烟味和烹饪食物的香气。居民们看起来都心情极佳，只要玩家角色与他们接触，他们都会表现得非常友善，不过比起和英雄交谈，他们更优先照常过自己的日常生活。事实上，镇民们似乎有些友善得过了头——即便是平日里最爱争吵的居民，如今也更像是在打趣，而非争执，他们惯常的挖苦中也没有任何真正的怨气。或许最令人不安的是，镇上没有任何人似乎认得玩家角色。相反，他们把这些人当作来到柳岸镇的受欢迎却陌生的访客。

Scene Notes氛围

@UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.qpwb9j7dRnHA64DZ]{黑暗的柳岸镇}

随着白昼逐渐走向黄昏，这整片伪装也开始变薄。柳岸镇的居民变得僵硬迟滞，目光呆滞、答话空洞，拖着步子过着他们的日常生活，进行着日常对话。成群的红色蝴蝶会落在随机的人身上，以及总督庄园的墙壁上，聚成一簇簇。镇上的一些小东西——比如商店招牌或较小的圣祠——会仿佛被从存在中抹去一般消失。街道上的气味变得异常浓郁甜美，让接触到这些气味的人遭受无法满足且不合时宜的饥渴折磨。赫山宝的“乐园”正在被啃食。

到了夜幕降临时，一切伪装都会消失。镇民们变得毫无反应，摇摇晃晃地聚集到总督庄园周围，贪婪地凝视着它的门窗，但他们似乎无法靠近那些大量装饰在墙上的线香与护符箓。他们就那样静止而沉默地等待，直到黎明第一道曙光出现，才走回各自家中睡下。几小时后，他们醒来，对日落之后发生的一切都毫无记忆，仿佛前一晚根本不曾存在。

Seeking out Heh Shan-Bao

Softened Death

While the PCs might feel as physically solid and present in Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape as they did in the Willowshore mindscape, that isn’t quite the case. In this mindscape, they’re closer to existing as spirits than before, but they won’t realize the truth until the end of this chapter. A PC who dies in Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape receives an important clue, though, for rather than dying, that PC’s body vanishes from the mindscape and awakens back in their own Willowshore, manifesting there at the same location they were in when @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} was first cast. The PC becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and has 1 Hit Point upon awakening but is otherwise in the same condition they were before death attempted to take them in the governor’s mindscape.

Once the PCs discover @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift}, they’re free to cast the ritual at any time or place they wish. Until they do so, the plot of “No Breath to Cry” can’t progress beyond the winter events scheduled to take place in Chapter 9. The DC of the primary skill check for casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} is 27, while the DC for its secondary skill checks is 22. If the PCs are at least admired by one of Willowshore’s factions, that faction can subsidize the cost of casting the ritual up to once per week. If a faction reveres them, that faction can subsidize the cost up to once per day. (If your group features more than four characters, increase the number of targets mindscape shift can transport to cover every member of the group rather than forcing the PCs to cast the ritual multiple times to transport the entire party.)

Scene NotesSFX

@UUID[Playlist.0GuH1kstxWaqGSJx.PlaylistSound.PqkA73gCCn7sSZhv]{Mindscape Shift}

The mindscape into which Heh Shan-Bao was transported is a near duplicate of the PCs’ version of Willowshore, except for a few key differences. Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape is much smaller than the one the PCs come from—this mindscape’s borders wrap around the boundaries of the town, rather than extending miles outward into the hinterlands surrounding Willowshore.

Buildings that have been restored or destroyed in the PCs’ mindscape aren’t altered in Heh Shan-Bao’s—as such, the Cerulean Teahouse remains in ruins here, while Cloud Paper House is still standing. More importantly, the governor’s manor remains in its place in downtown Willowshore in this mindscape. Depending on where the PCs cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift}, their transition from their Willowshore into this new mindscape might be either impossible to notice or to ignore as the surroundings suddenly appear to fall back into ruin or return to their normal state, or else look exceptionally similar. Likewise, anyone present in the vicinity when the PCs leave Willowshore might not be there when they arrive in the governor’s mindscape.

Note that the PCs must be within Willowshore to successfully use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} to enter Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape. The wards on his manor (page 163) prevent the PCs from appearing within the structure, so if the PCs attempt to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} while within the empty lot his manor once stood upon, they’ll appear at the edge of the lot once they manifest in the new mindscape.

In fact, as the PCs explore this version of Willowshore, they soon realize that something seems to be off. The reason is both grim and tragic: when Heh Shan-Bao failed in his ritual and spawned these mindscapes, he was entirely devoured—mind, body, and soul—by Kugaptee. The mindscape the PCs have just entered sprang from the last flickers of the governor’s panicked consciousness, as his mind struggles to maintain its individuality before Kugaptee absorbs him entirely.

When the PCs arrive in the governor’s mindscape, their first impression should be one of a lovely day in their hometown. The early winter air still holds a trace of damp warmth, and crickets can be heard chirping in the grass. The streets smell sweet with incense, wood smoke, and the scent of cooking food. The residents all seem to be in excellent moods and are very friendly whenever the PCs engage with them, though they prioritize their daily routines over conversation with the heroes. In fact, the townsfolk seem a little too friendly—even the most quarrelsome residents are now more playful than argumentative, and their standard jibes lack any true acrimony. Perhaps most unsettling of all is the fact that none of the townsfolk seem to recognize the PCs. Instead, they treat them as welcome but unknown visitors to Willowshore.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.qpwb9j7dRnHA64DZ]{Dark Willowshore}

As day progresses toward nightfall, this whole facade begins to thin. Willowshore’s residents become stilted, trudging through their daily lives and conversations with glassy stares and vacant answers. Swarms of red butterflies land in clusters on random people and the walls of the governor’s manor. Small bits of the town, like shop signs or lesser shrines, vanish as if they’ve been erased from existence. The smells of the streets become unnaturally luscious, leaving those exposed to them plagued with unquenchable and inappropriate hungers. Heh Shan-Bao’s “paradise” is being eaten.

At nightfall, all pretense drops. The townsfolk become unresponsive and shuffle to surround the governor’s manor, staring hungrily at its doors and windows, though they seem unable to approach the incense and warding fulus that heavily adorn its walls. There they wait, still and silent, until the first light of dawn, at which point they walk back to their homes and go to sleep. A few hours later, they wake, recalling nothing past sundown, as if the evening before had never been.

Another Willowshore.name: 另一座柳岸镇 Another Willowshore
Another Willowshore.text:
另一座柳岸镇

这些事件结束后，PC们和柳岸镇终于迎来片刻喘息，因为马戈凯的驱邪师暂时不再理会这座破败的城镇——不过，这次喘息不过是一次战略性撤退。无论他们的仪式结果如何，驱邪师们都已经意识到，有某种东西正在干扰他们净化城镇的尝试。与其在存在未知且可能危险变量的情况下继续冒险行动，驱邪师们决定在进一步尝试驱魔之前，更加彻底而谨慎地调查柳岸镇废墟中的超自然存在。随着冬季一周周过去，他们的行动以及其他事件仍会继续在柳岸镇上演——这些事件在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto]{Chapter 9}中有更详细的说明，并会随着时间推移按日程发生。关于冬季事件时间线，请参见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11winterevents00#winter-timeline]{冬季时间线}。

不过，更重要的是，PC们现在终于可以自由追查他们在上一幕中发现的线索了。他们从自己在丹杉寺中的冒险，以及与智惠幽灵的交谈中得知，他们和柳岸镇中的所有其他人都被困在一个不断重复同一年的心景之中，而这个心景是在柳岸镇先前的总督@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}试图施行一场仪式，以保护柳岸镇不受苦迦菩提影响时失败后形成的。上一幕以PC们恢复这层防护并消除苦迦菩提的直接威胁告终，但这几乎没有揭示、甚至没有澄清他们和柳岸镇其余居民究竟该如何逃回现实世界。为了了解更多，PC们必须使用研究（子系统）（Pathfinder GM Core 190）来调查并研究柳岸镇的思维空间。PC们进行这项研究没有时间限制，但他们花费的天数越多，在本幕中应对其他事件的时间就越少。

柳岸镇的思维空间 研究 7

单独调查 你花费一天时间翻阅从丹杉寺藏匿的图书馆收集来的书籍与卷轴；最大RP 8

研究检定 @Check[academia-lore|dc:21|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[library-lore|dc:21|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]，或 @Check[arcana|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]、@Check[nature|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]、@Check[occultism|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]，或 @Check[religion|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

集思广益 你花费一天时间与柳岸镇其他博学的当地人讨论理论并调查可能的解决办法；最大RP 4
