研究检定 @Check[arcana|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]、@Check[nature|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]、@Check[occultism|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]，或 @Check[religion|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]，或 @Check[diplomacy|dc:25|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

2 研究点 赫山宝总督为了提供对抗苦迦菩提影响的防护而施行的仪式失败了；这反而导致了如今困住PC们的心景诞生，也让那邪魔的影响变得更加强大。

4 研究点 在PC们于第二幕后取得胜利之后，苦迦菩提已不再直接威胁心景；然而，心景依然存在，而且超自然威胁仍笼罩着柳岸镇，这证明背后还有更大的效果在起作用。赫山宝总督很可能是在他的庄园中施行了那场仪式，而当仪式失败时，他和庄园一起被转移进了他们自己的心景之中；那个心景与柳岸镇其余部分并行存在。

6 研究点 通常而言，要进入或离开心景，必须使用一种名为心景之门的复杂仪式。虽然凭借城镇中的资源以及从丹杉寺收集来的资料，还不足以发现这一完整仪式的全部奥秘，但只要再多做一些研究，就有可能设计出一个类似但更具针对性的仪式，用来开启通往赫山宝心景的大门，因为它在形而上层面上与柳岸镇自身的心景十分接近。假以时日，也许在赫山宝的帮助下，或借助他庄园内很可能仍保存着的参考资料，还能将完整的心景之门仪式研究出来，从而真正逃离柳岸镇的心景，返回现实世界！

8 研究点 PC们发现了@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}仪式，它可以让人前往赫山宝的心景并从中返回。PC们获得120 XP。

Another Willowshore

Once these events are complete, the PCs and Willowshore receive a break as Mago Kai’s exorcists leave the ruined town alone for the time being—though this reprieve is merely a strategic retreat. Regardless of the outcomes of their rituals, the exorcists have realized that something is interfering with their attempts to purify the town. Rather than risk continuing their efforts with an unknown and potentially dangerous variable in play, the exorcists decide to investigate the supernatural presence in the ruins of Willowshore more diligently and carefully before proceeding with additional exorcism attempts. Their efforts, as well as other events, continue to play out in Willowshore as the winter weeks proceed—these events are detailed further in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto]{Chapter 9} and play out on a scheduled as time passes. See @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11winterevents00#winter-timeline]{Winter Timeline} for a timeline of winter’s events.

Of more importance, though, is the fact that the PCs are now free to pursue their investigation of the leads they uncovered in the previous act. They know from their adventures in the Tan Sugi monastery and their discussions with Zhi Hui’s ghost that they and everyone else in Willowshore are trapped in a mindscape that keeps repeating the same year over and over, and that this mindscape formed after the town’s previous governor, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao}, tried (and failed) to perform a ritual to protect Willowshore from Kugaptee’s influence. The previous act ended with the PCs restoring that protection and removing Kugaptee’s immediate threat, but this did little to reveal or even clarify how they and the rest of Willowshore might escape back into the real world. To learn more, the PCs must investigate and research the Willowshore Mindscape using the research subsystem (Pathfinder GM Core 190). The PCs have no time limit for this research, but the more days it takes them to finish, the less time they’ll have to deal with other events that take place during this act.

The Willowshore Mindscape Research 7

Solo Investigations You spend the day looking through the collection of books and scrolls gathered from the hidden library in the Tan Sugi monastery; Maximum RP 8

Research Checks @Check[academia-lore|dc:21|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[library-lore|dc:21|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], or @Check[arcana|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], @Check[nature|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], @Check[occultism|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], or @Check[religion|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

Brainstorming Solutions You spend the day discussing theories and investigating possible solutions with other learned locals in Willowshore; Maximum RP 4

Research Checks @Check[arcana|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], @Check[nature|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], @Check[occultism|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], or @Check[religion|dc:23|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], or @Check[diplomacy|dc:25|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

2 Research Points Governor Heh Shan-Bao’s failed ritual to offer protection from Kugaptee’s influence backfired; it resulted in the creation of the mindscape the PCs are now trapped in and allowed the fiend’s influence to grow stronger.

4 Research Points After the PCs’ triumphs in Act 2, Kugaptee no longer directly threatens the mindscape, yet the fact that it remains and that supernatural threats still loom over Willowshore confirm there’s a greater effect at play. Governor Heh Shan-Bao likely performed the ritual in his manor, and when it failed, he and the manor were shunted into their own mindscape, which exists in parallel to the rest of Willowshore.

6 Research Points Normally, to enter or exit a mindscape, one must use a complex ritual called mindscape door. While this full ritual’s intricacies are beyond discovery using the resources in town and gathered at the Tan Sugi monastery, it should be possible with a little more study to come up with a similar but more focused ritual capable of opening a door into Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape because of its metaphysically close proximity to Willowshore’s own. In time, and perhaps with Heh Shan-Bao’s aid or by using references likely still contained within his manor, the full mindscape door ritual might be researched, allowing for a full escape from Willowshore’s mindscape back into the real world!

8 Research Points The PCs discover the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} ritual, which allows travel to and from Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape. The PCs earn 120 XP.

Wrapping Up.name: 收尾 Wrapping Up
Wrapping Up.text:
收尾

混乱平息后，镇民们仍心有余悸地戒备了好几分钟，等待看接下来还会发生什么可怕的事。当入侵的势力似乎已经退去——至少暂时如此——柳岸镇的工业区开始重新有了动静，人们陆续现身，趁机先评估损失，然后投入那并不起眼却不得不做的工作：一点点把自己的生活重新拼凑起来。若有人最终失去了至亲，偶尔仍能听到悲痛的哭号，但这场余波过后的整体氛围，取决于玩家角色在多大程度上减轻了灾害带来的破坏。若毁坏与伤亡极其惨重，柳岸镇便沉默而阴郁，人们只能在悲泣与哀号的伴随下收拾生活的残骸。若玩家角色成功遏制了灾害，城镇的气氛则更显不屈，年长的居民会高声抱怨，咒骂那些看不见的始作俑者。

如果三名非玩家角色全部获救，队伍获得3点希望点，并且他们在柳岸镇两个派系中的声望各提高1。玩家角色获得120 XP。

如果只有两名非玩家角色获救，队伍获得1点希望点，并使他们在柳岸镇其中一个派系中的声望提高1（由队伍选择）。玩家角色获得80 XP。

如果只有一名非玩家角色获救，队伍既不获得也不失去希望点。玩家角色获得40 XP。

如果没有任何非玩家角色获救，队伍失去2点希望点，并且在柳岸镇每个派系中的1点声望点。

如果云纸坊倒塌，玩家角色失去1点安全点，且造纸坊不能再作为玩家角色的工作地点，也无法再用来购买纸张与纸制品。即使建筑只是受损，此类用途同样无法使用；但如果玩家角色花费4点安全点，则经过2周的修缮后，该建筑可以恢复。

@UUID[Actor.4EyPHYXJyP7hFKyM]{米娜的赋礼} @UUID[Actor.NYcGFeauCDToaCDr]{米娜的赋礼（救出两人）} @UUID[Actor.fMacvK39aRl0TUiy]{米娜的赋礼（救出三人）} @UUID[Actor.UpsaboiTp5my3pGC]{于尔父母的感谢} @UUID[Actor.n7DOFprbrQUzkeGj]{镇民的奖励}
次日，云纸坊的主人八哥 川冈（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w14cloudpape00]{W14}）会前来拜访玩家角色。若他们至少救出了三名被困者中的一人，他会赠送他们1个高等烟雾棒和4瓶中效治疗药水以表谢意；若他们至少救出了两人，则再赠送1瓶恒久黏胶和额外4瓶中效治疗药水；若他们救出了全部三人，则再赠送1瓶迅捷药水和1块带有坚韧护甲符文的符文石。这些奖励可以累计获得。若英雄们还完好无损地找回了果冻先生，于尔的父母会亲自向他们致谢，并赠送一双跳跃之靴，同时感叹若失去了这个玩具，要找到一模一样的替代品会有多么困难。

如果玩家角色在两只林鬼消失前就将它们全部击败，镇民们会更加安心（反之，若这些精魂是自行消失的，人们心中便会 lingering 它们随时可能回来的恐惧）。镇上的长者会筹集资源，并在一天后以一对皮制力场束带和一个价值150 gp、饰有凤凰的青瓷花瓶作为奖励赠予队伍。

如果玩家角色在战斗后染上了熟悉阴影的诅咒，却没有自行解除诅咒的方法，可以考虑让信藏免费为队伍送来几张4环净化苦难卷轴，并解释说他隐约觉得他们会用得上。

无端谋杀

赫山宝的柳岸镇镇民并不敌对，但他们确实令人不安。如果有玩家角色攻击任何一位居民，将他们全都视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.Actor.APn9B54hhRtr0oCQ]{平民} 处理。遭到攻击的居民会惊恐尖叫，并在可能的情况下撤退；但若被逼入绝境，他们也会反抗。若被杀死，村民会瘫倒在地，而他们的面孔会褪去，变成一张空白、没有五官的椭圆脸。除此之外，若仔细检查，就会发现他们的装备其实只是廉价的道具。其他镇民除非自己也遭到攻击，否则不会对眼前的暴力做出反应。玩家角色或许会怀疑这些镇民是无脸妖；其实并不是（他们只不过是由思维空间维持的类思想形体），但这当然可以为玩家角色很快将在总督庄园面对的无脸妖作铺垫！

Wrapping Up

The townsfolk remain wary for several minutes after the chaos has been dealt with, waiting to see what horrible thing might happen next. When it seems that the invading force is gone—at least for the time being—Willowshore’s industrial district stirs as people emerge, taking the chance to assess the damage before getting down to the unglamorous work of putting their lives back together. A few can be heard wailing if their loved ones ultimately vanished, but the overall tone of the aftermath depends on how well the PCs managed to mitigate the damage. If the destruction and loss was extensive, Willowshore is silent and somber, collecting the wreckage of their lives with screams of grief as their only accompaniment. If the PCs did well in containing the disasters, the town is more defiant, with older residents loudly complaining and insulting the unseen forces that caused it all.

If all three NPCs were rescued, the party earns 3 Hope Points and increases their reputation with both of Willowshore’s factions by 1. The PCs earn 120 XP.

If only two NPCs were rescued, the party earns 1 Hope Point and increases their reputation with one of Willowshore’s factions (the party’s choice) by 1. The PCs earn 80 XP.

If only one NPC was rescued, the party neither gains nor loses Hope Points. The PCs earn 40 XP.

If no NPCs were rescued, the party loses 2 Hope Points and 1 Reputation Point with each of Willowshore’s factions.

If Cloud Paper House collapses, the PCs lose 1 Security Point, and the paper mill can no longer be used as a work site for PCs or to purchase paper and paper products. It likewise remains unavailable for such use if it only suffered damage, but if the PCs spend 4 Security Points, the building can be repaired after 2 weeks of work.

@UUID[Actor.4EyPHYXJyP7hFKyM]{Myna's Gift} @UUID[Actor.NYcGFeauCDToaCDr]{Myna's Gift (Saved Two)} @UUID[Actor.fMacvK39aRl0TUiy]{Myna's Gift (Saved Three)} @UUID[Actor.UpsaboiTp5my3pGC]{Yu Er’s Parents Thanks} @UUID[Actor.n7DOFprbrQUzkeGj]{Townsfolks' Rewards}
The next day, Myna Kawaka (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w14cloudpape00]{W14}), the owner of Cloud Paper House, visits the PCs and gives them a greater smokestick and four moderate healing potions in thanks if they saved at least one of the three trapped people, a vial of everlasting adhesive and four additional moderate healing potions if they saved at least two, and a potion of quickness and a runestone bearing a resilient armor rune if they saved all three. These rewards are cumulative. If the heroes also recovered Mr. Jelly intact, Yu Er’s parents personally thank them with a pair of boots of bounding before lamenting how difficult it would’ve been to find an identical replacement for the toy.

If the PCs defeated both waldgeists before they vanished, the townsfolk are further relieved (whereas if the spirits are allowed to vanish on their own, fears that they might return at any time linger). The town elder gathers resources and, one day later, presents the party with a reward in the form of a pair of leather bands of force and a celadon vase decorated with phoenixes worth 150 gp.

If the PCs became infested with the familiar shadows’ curse after the battle but have no method of removing curses themselves, consider having Shinzo deliver a few 4th-rank scrolls of cleanse affliction to the party for free, explaining that he had a feeling they could use them.

Unprovoked Murder

The townsfolk of Heh Shan-Bao’s Willowshore aren’t hostile, but they’re certainly unsettling. If a PC attacks any of the citizens, treat them all as if they were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.Actor.APn9B54hhRtr0oCQ]{Commoners}. Attacked residents shriek in terror and retreat if able, but they fight if cornered. If slain, the villager collapses to the ground and their face fades to a blank, featureless ovoid. Furthermore, their equipment turns out to consist of cheap props on closer examination. Other townsfolk don’t react to the sight of violence unless they’re attacked themselves. The PCs might suspect these townsfolk are noppera-bos; they aren’t (they’re little more than thoughtforms maintained by the mindscape), but they can certainly foreshadow the presence of the noppera-bos the PCs will soon face at the governor’s manor!

Event 3. Tomorrow’s Shadows.name: 事件 3. 明日之影 Event 3. Tomorrow’s Shadows
Event 3. Tomorrow’s Shadows.text:
事件3：明日之影 低阶 7

一旦两只林鬼被击败，现世中的驱邪师便会从废墟撤退，返回唐入向马戈凯汇报他们的成功或失败，但他们干预所引发的后果还远未结束。在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10event2unnatu00]{事件2：非自然暴动}结束约10分钟后，每位玩家角色都会感到一阵奇异的寒意——一种经典的感觉，有些人会形容为“仿佛刚有人从你的坟墓上走过”。

生物：片刻之后，朦胧的黑色形体从每位玩家角色的影子中升起，轮廓逐渐凝聚成各个角色如烟雾般扭曲的幽灵。这些身影是玩家角色自身灵异事件的回响，正穿过心景的边界，从未来反向延伸回他们身边。当这些阴影般的身影痛苦呼号时，玩家角色从那扭曲的外形中认出了自己。随后，这些阴影生物发起攻击。

明日之影 低阶 7

@UUID[Actor.Ce9789tqv5KRxq58]{熟悉阴影（4）}

这些诡异身影在大多数方面都如同普通阴影，只有一点例外：它们没有从敌人身上生成阴影的能力。取而代之的是，它们拥有一种不同寻常的能力，可以侵染它们所复制之人的影子，详见数据表。由于它们窃取并侵染影子的能力只对那些与自己外形对应的玩家角色生效，这些熟悉阴影会将攻击集中在对应的玩家角色身上，完全无视区域内的其他人，除非它们已经杀死了自己所复制的那名玩家角色。

本次遭遇默认有四只熟悉阴影攻击队伍；可按需调整数量，使每位玩家角色都要面对属于自己的阴影。这些阴影会战斗至被摧毁为止，但当最后一只也被消灭后，一阵如释重负的感觉会涌上每位玩家角色心头——至少此时此刻，这一场最新的危险已经过去了。

Event 3. Tomorrow’s Shadows Low 7

Once the two waldgeists are defeated, the exorcists in the living world retreat from the ruins to report to Mago Kai at Karahai on their successes or failures, but the repercussions of their meddling aren’t quite over. About 10 minutes after @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10event2unnatu00]{Event 2. Unnatural Uprising} ends, each of the PCs feels a strange chill—the classic sensation some describe as feeling as if “someone just walked over your grave.”

Creatures: A moment later, nebulous black forms rise up from each PC’s shadow, their shapes coalescing as a smoky, distorted ghosts of each character. These figures are echoes of the PCs’ own hauntings, which are extending back to them from the future through the mindscape’s borders. As these shadowy figures cry out in pain, the PCs recognize themselves in their distorted shapes. Then the shadowy creatures attack.

Tomorrow’s Shadows Low 7

@UUID[Actor.Ce9789tqv5KRxq58]{Familiar Shadows (4)}

Each of these strange figures functions as a typical shadow for the most part, with the exception that they lack the ability to spawn shadows from their foes. Instead, they have the unusual ability to infest the shadows of those whose forms they duplicate, as detailed in the stat block. As their ability to steal and infest shadows only functions against PCs whose shapes they duplicate, these familiar shadows focus their attacks on those particular PCs, ignoring others in the area entirely unless they have already slain the PC they duplicated.

This encounter assumes four shadows attack the party; adjust these numbers as needed so each PC faces their own shadow. The shadows fight until destroyed, but once the last of them is finished off, a sense of relief washes over each PC—a feeling that, for now at least, this latest danger has passed.

Event 2. Unnatural Uprising.name: 事件 2. 非自然暴动 Event 2. Unnatural Uprising
Event 2. Unnatural Uprising.text:
事件2. 非自然暴动 中等 7

一旦非玩家角色们被从建筑中救出，且灵性扰乱者已经消失，玩家角色们便有时间休息和恢复。10分钟过去后，或者玩家角色一决定离开该区域时（两者取先发生者），又一股红烟从街道上升起，马戈凯的驱邪师们在现世重新集结，并开始第二次尝试驱逐这一地区中那些相当顽强的精魂。

非自然暴动 中等 7

@UUID[Actor.hJEmfJJOQm9FImqP]{柳岸镇林鬼（2）}

生物：这一次，驱邪师们集中力量的目标不再是灵性能量的特定节点（以现世中镇民们徘徊不去的精魂为表现），而是要驱逐一大团侵染该区域的泛化灵性能量（以废墟中无知性生命不断累积的损失为表现）。浓烟从街道东端的A5区域翻涌而起，短暂的一瞬间里，又有几个金眼红衣的幻影显现出来，随后又消失无踪——因为这场大规模驱邪在现实世界中失败了。

然而在心景中，他们的尝试却造成了非常真实的结果，将这股灵性能量从现世强行挤出，送入心景，在那里它灌注进了现代柳岸镇云纸坊废墟上生长出的植物与树木之中。自然秩序遭受的这种腐化从那个世界显现在心景的A5区域，两只林鬼随之出现——它们扭曲变形，看起来像是畸形的小型柳树，树干上长着尖叫的动物面孔。这些虚体精魂立刻向前涌来，毫不费力地漂浮着用垂落的根系攻击玩家角色，穿行空中，几乎像幽灵般的水母。虽然这些变种林鬼比普通林鬼大得多，而且它们与云纸坊之间的灵性纠缠使其木质化能力变成了能将血肉转化为纸张的形式，但它们并没有同类正常个体那么强大。

Event 2. Unnatural Uprising Moderate 7

Once the NPCs have been rescued from the building and the spiritual disruptors are gone, the PCs have time to rest and recover. After 10 minutes have passed, or as soon as the PCs decide to leave the area (whichever comes first), another plume of red smoke rises into the air from the street as Mago Kai’s exorcists regroup in the living world and begin a second attempt to exorcise the rather robust spirits in the region.

Unnatural Uprising Moderate 7

@UUID[Actor.hJEmfJJOQm9FImqP]{Willowshore Waldgeists (2)}

Creatures: This time, the exorcists focus their efforts not on specific pinpoints of spiritual energy (represented by the lingering spirits of townsfolk in the living world), but instead on banishing a large mass of generalized spiritual energy infesting the area (represented by the accumulated loss of non-sapient life in the ruins). Smoke wells up at the eastern end of the street at area A5, and for a brief moment, several more of the gold-eyed, crimson-clad phantasms appear, only to vanish as the attempt to perform the mass exorcism fails in the real world.

Here in the mindscape, though, their attempt has a very real result, forcing this spiritual energy out of the living world and into the mindscape, where it infuses the very plants and trees that have grown over the ruins of Cloud Paper House in modern Willowshore. This corruption of the natural order manifests from that world into the mindscape at area A5 as two waldgeists appear—distorted shapes that resemble deformed, miniature willow trees with screaming animal faces growing from their trunks. These incorporeal spirits immediately surge forward and float effortlessly to attack the PCs with dangling roots, drifting through the air almost like ghostly jellyfish. While these variant waldgeists are much larger than typical waldgeists and their spiritual entanglement with Cloud Paper House has adjusted their Lignify ability into one that transforms flesh into paper, they aren’t quite as powerful as normal specimens of their kind.

Event 1. Structural Collapse.name: 事件 1：建筑坍塌 Event 1. Structural Collapse
Event 1. Structural Collapse.text:
事件1. 建筑坍塌 中等 7

地图展示了云纸坊的一部分，其中包括一大片正在缓慢坍塌的区域，以及其正对的街道和附近的建筑。这个事件，以及接下来的两个事件，都发生在这个地点。

建筑坍塌 中等 7

@UUID[Actor.EcvTHGd4tW4unX88]{阿鲁卡} @UUID[Actor.5ntnQwWZmqDkJPwp]{于尔} @UUID[Actor.vgV2eqTlalwGWFFj]{甄洛阳} @UUID[Actor.CMlumtTEaGVq9wNU]{灵性扰乱者（2）}

被困在建筑中的三名非玩家角色都需要救援，而现实世界中正在进行的驱邪尝试也在此处显现出了额外的危害。废墟中的三名非玩家角色各自面临不同的困境，玩家角色必须完成相应任务，才能将他们送到安全地带。如果某个玩家角色必须把某名非玩家角色背出去，阿鲁卡和甄洛阳的负载都为6，而于尔的负载为3。要让一名非玩家角色（或玩偶）避开危害、抵达安全地带，他们必须到达废墟建筑南侧的街道；之后他们会逃向东侧或西侧（或者被人带走）。围观的人群会照料他们，并确保他们被安全带到能够恢复的地方。

在这场遭遇中，若这三名非玩家角色被降至0生命值，允许他们使用玩家角色的濒死规则。任何在这场遭遇中死亡的6级或以下生物都会彻底消失：他们的灵体会从柳岸镇心景中被驱离，前往浩瀚众界中的来世；但这一结果不应让玩家角色或柳岸镇的其他居民察觉——在他们看来，这只会像是该角色的身体突然无影无踪地消失了。7级或更高的生物（例如玩家角色）若在此处被杀，则超出了这些驱邪师的放逐能力范围；如果他们被此区域的危害杀死，他们的身体（以及灵魂）仍会被困在心景之中。

危害：现实世界中柳岸镇废墟里的驱邪，在这里显现为一对灵性干扰器危害。该事件开始时，这些危害位于标记为A4的两个区域。

如果玩家角色花费超过6轮才解决局面，并且至少仍有一个危害处于激活状态，那么建筑结构会进一步坍塌，对建筑内的所有目标造成@Damage[(2d6+6)[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] 豁免）。此效果之后每过6轮重复一次，直到所有非玩家角色都被救出为止。如果发生这次坍塌时建筑内已经没有活着的角色，那么整座建筑会完全倒塌，而灵性扰乱者也会消失。在玩家角色成功救出所有仍被困者后的1轮，这一事件会自动发生。

A1. 阿鲁卡：阿鲁卡是一名体格结实的狐人女性。天花板在她四周塌落时，她原本正在搬运木料，结果被撞倒在地，一条腿还被倒塌的桌子压住。由于她的另一形态是一名人类女性而不是狐狸，所以她试图通过变形逃脱的努力都徒劳无功。每轮轮到她时，她都会以+3加值尝试一次运动检定来挣脱；如果成功脱困，她就会尽自己所能一瘸一拐地朝街道和安全地带前进。

若要挣脱或强行打开瓦砾，她或与其相邻的玩家角色必须在 @Check[athletics|dc:23|traits:attack,skill,action:escape|name:Escape]（挣脱）或 @Check[athletics|dc:23|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open]（强行打开）检定中成功。 或者， 也可以通过摧毁瓦砾来救出她（AC 15，硬度10，生命值30 [BT 15]）；如果瓦砾处于破损状态，则挣脱和强行打开检定的难度等级降为18。阿鲁卡目前有2生命值，并因伤势而处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 2}；如果她被治疗至满生命值，就会失去缓慢2状态。成功进行一次 @Check[medicine|dc:20|traits:exploration,healing,manipulate,skill,action:treat-wounds|name:Treat Wounds]检定来 治疗伤口的玩家角色，也可以移除她的缓慢状态，但除非玩家角色拥有战斗医疗专长，否则他们大概没有奢侈到能花10分钟来采用这一方案。在那种情况下，他们可以按相同的难度等级，用该选项尝试移除她的缓慢状态。

A2. 于尔：于尔是个五岁的小女孩，偷偷爬到椽梁上的阁楼去玩。建筑开始坍塌时，她从阁楼地板跌了下来，但很幸运地落进了地上的一大团纸浆里，只受了些皮外擦伤。不过，她现在非常难过，因为她最喜欢的玩偶“果冻先生”还披着斗篷挂在她头顶天花板破洞处伸出的一根断裂竹竿上。这个玩偶是个塞满稻草、长着六肢的人形玩偶，戴着面具，披着斗篷；只要成功进行 @Check[nature|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或 @Check[society|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,search,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]回忆知识检定，玩家角色就能认出它是在模仿嬛郭那位神秘的塔尔杰（详见《开拓者 遗族志：神话怪物》第96–101页）。

于尔的一位父母冲进来想把她带走，但小女孩抗拒不从，害怕地哭喊着，伸手去够果冻先生。果冻先生挂在离地20英尺高的地方。可以通过一次对AC 24的远程攻击把玩偶打落。如果远程打击命中，攻击者还必须随后成功通过一次@Check[flat|dc:16]，才能把玩偶打下来；如果远程打击是大成功，则自动将其打落。像 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.60sgbuMWN0268dB7]{念动弹射}这样用来把玩偶向下掷落的魔法手段，可以自动将其取回。玩家角色也可以利用松动的支撑物攀爬坍塌中的墙壁，在成功进行一次 @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb]检定后够到玩偶，而与其相邻的玩家角色可以用一个交互动作自动拾起玩偶。

取回果冻先生时必须十分小心，以免扯破它的斗篷或扯出一些填充物——每次尝试取回玩偶时，进行该尝试的生物都必须成功通过一次@Check[reflex|dc:22]豁免或 @Check[thievery|dc:22]检定，才能避免损坏玩偶。一旦玩偶已经受损，之后就不再需要为避免进一步损坏而进行检定——撕破了就是撕破了。

如果果冻先生完好无损并被还给于尔，她会立刻冷静下来。如果果冻先生在救援中受损，于尔会爆发一场惊天动地的闹腾，因为她的朋友受伤而伤心欲绝。拥有修理工具包的玩家角色可以用一个三动作行动并成功进行一次 @Check[crafting|dc:25]检定，迅速把玩偶补好（如果他们拥有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{快速修理}专长，则即使没有修理工具包，也可以用一个单动作自动完成），或者他们也可以对玩偶施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{修复术}或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4ZGte0i9YbLh4dRi]{物品伪装}来修好它。无论哪种方式，于尔的父母都会对玩家角色救下果冻先生而千恩万谢。玩家角色也可以不去取回果冻先生，转而用说谎、请求、甚至胁迫让于尔冷静下来，只要成功通过一次难度等级25的检定即可 （@Check[deception|dc:25|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie], @Check[diplomacy|dc:25|traits:action:request,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental|name:Request]，或 @Check[intimidation|dc:25|traits:auditory,concentrate,emotion,exploration,linguistic,mental,skill,action:coerce|name:Coerce]）。

A3. 甄洛阳：这位身手矫健的老人当时正给自己在纸坊工作的侄子（此时正在围观人群中惊慌失措地看着这场灾难展开的年轻人）送自制午饭，混乱就在这时降临。建筑刚开始坍塌时，一阵碎片当头砸下，把他打得失去意识，还把他埋在一层碎裂的灰泥和尘土下面。为了在他仍被掩埋时找到他，玩家角色必须进行搜索，并成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search]检定。

洛阳在本事件开始时处于失去意识状态，倒地躺在地上。每轮轮到他时，他都可以以+6强韧豁免加值尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20]豁免。成功时，他会醒来，踉跄着站起身，并以5英尺速度一瘸一拐地朝安全地带前进。对他伤势的处理方式与阿鲁卡相同（见A1）；若如此处理，他会恢复完整的25英尺速度。

Event 1. Structural Collapse Moderate 7

The map shows a portion of Cloud Paper House, including a significant section that’s in the process of slowly collapsing, along with the facing street and nearby buildings. This event, as well as the next two, all take place in this location.

Structural Collapse Moderate 7

@UUID[Actor.EcvTHGd4tW4unX88]{Aruka} @UUID[Actor.5ntnQwWZmqDkJPwp]{Yu Er} @UUID[Actor.vgV2eqTlalwGWFFj]{Zhen Luoyang} @UUID[Actor.CMlumtTEaGVq9wNU]{Spiritual Disruptors (2)}

The three NPCs trapped in the building are in need of rescue, and additional hazards have manifested as a result of the exorcism attempts taking place in the living world. Each of the three NPCs in the ruins faces their own difficulty, and the PCs must perform tasks to get them to safety. If a PC has to carry out an NPC, Aruka and Zhen Luoyang are both Bulk 6, while Yu Er is Bulk 3. For an NPC (or doll) to be safe from the hazard, they must reach the street south of the ruined building, after which they flee (or are carried) to the east or west. The crowd of onlookers takes care of them and ensures they make it safely to a place where they can recover.

In this encounter, allow the three NPCs to follow the PC rules for dying if they’re reduced to 0 Hit Points. A creature of 6th level or lower that dies in this encounter vanishes entirely, their spirit exorcised from the Willowshore mindscape to move on to the afterlife in the Great Beyond, but this outcome shouldn’t be apparent to the PCs or to Willowshore’s other inhabitants—to them, it should simply look as if the character’s body has suddenly vanished without a trace. Creatures of 7th level or higher (such as the PCs) who are slain here are beyond the power of these exorcists to banish, and their bodies (and souls) remain trapped in the mindscape if they’re killed by this area’s hazard.

Hazards: The exorcism in the ruins of Willowshore in the living world manifests here as a pair of spiritual disruptor hazards. At the start of this event, the hazards are located at the two areas marked A4.

If the PCs take longer than 6 rounds to resolve the situation and at least one hazard remains active, more of the structure collapses, causing @Damage[(2d6+6)[bludgeoning]] damage to all within the building (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] save). This repeats every 6 rounds until all of the NPCs are rescued. If this collapse takes place while there are no living characters within the building, the entire structure collapses, and the spiritual disruptors vanish. This event occurs automatically 1 round after the PCs manage to rescue all of those still trapped.

A1. Aruka: Aruka is a solidly built kitsune woman who was hauling logs when the ceiling fell all around her, knocking her to the ground and pinning her leg under a collapsed table. Since her alternate form is of a human woman and not a fox, her attempts to change shape to escape have proven fruitless. On her turn each round, she attempts an Athletics check to Escape with a +3 bonus; if she manages to get free, she hobbles her way toward the street and to safety as best she can.

To Escape or Force Open the rubble, she or an adjacent PC must succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:23|traits:attack,skill,action:escape|name:Escape] (Escape) or @Check[athletics|dc:23|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] (Force Open) check. Alternatively, the rubble can be destroyed to free her (AC 15, Hardness 10, HP 30 [BT 15]); if the rubble is broken, the DC for checks to Escape and Force Open drops to 18. Aruka currently has 2 HP and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} by her wound; if she’s healed to full HP, she loses the slowed 2 condition. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[medicine|dc:20|traits:exploration,healing,manipulate,skill,action:treat-wounds|name:Treat Wounds] check to Treat Wounds also removes her slowed condition, but the PCs likely don’t have the luxury of spending 10 minutes to pursue this option unless they have the Battle Medicine feat. In that case, they can attempt to remove her slowed condition using that option against the same DC.

A2. Yu Er: Yu Er is a five-year-old girl who snuck into a loft in the rafters to play. When the building began to collapse, she fell through the loft floor but was lucky enough to fall into a mass of paper pulp on the ground and only suffered superficial scrapes. However, she’s quite distressed that her favorite doll, Mr. Jelly, remains hanging by its cape from a snapped bamboo pole protruding from the hole in the ceiling above her. The doll is a straw-stuffed, six-limbed humanoid wearing a mask and a cape that, with a successful @Check[nature|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[society|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,search,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge, a PC can identify as a caricature of Hwanggot’s mysterious Taljjae (detailed on pages 96–101 of Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth).

One of Yu Er’s parents races in to collect her, but the girl resists, crying in fear and reaching up for Mr. Jelly. Mr. Jelly is snagged at a height of 20 feet off the ground. The doll can be knocked loose via a ranged attack against AC 24. If a ranged Strike hits, the attacker must then succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:16] to knock the doll loose; if the ranged Strike is a critical hit, it’s automatically knocked loose. Magical solutions like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.60sgbuMWN0268dB7]{Telekinetic Projectile} used to hurl the doll downward can automatically recover it. A PC can Climb up the crumbling wall using the loose supports to reach the doll with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check, and an adjacent PC can pick up the doll automatically as an Interact action.

Care must be taken when retrieving Mr. Jelly to avoid ripping his cape or some of his stuffing out—each time an attempt is made to retrieve the doll, the creature making the attempt must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:22] save or @Check[thievery|dc:22] check to avoid damaging the doll. Once the doll has been damaged, no further checks to avoid further damaging it are necessary—what’s torn is torn.

If Mr. Jelly is intact and returned to Yu Er, she calms down immediately. If Mr. Jelly was damaged during the rescue, Yu Er throws an epic tantrum, devastated that her friend got hurt. A PC who has a repair toolkit can quickly patch the doll up as a three-action activity that requires a successful @Check[crafting|dc:25] check (or automatically as a single action even without access to a repair toolkit if they have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{Quick Repair} feat), or they can fix the doll by casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4ZGte0i9YbLh4dRi]{Item Facade} on it. Either way, Yu Er’s parents thank the PCs profusely for saving Mr. Jelly. A PC can instead Lie, Request, or even Coerce Yu Er into calming down without retrieving Mr. Jelly by succeeding at a DC 25 check (@Check[deception|dc:25|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie], @Check[diplomacy|dc:25|traits:action:request,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental|name:Request], or @Check[intimidation|dc:25|traits:auditory,concentrate,emotion,exploration,linguistic,mental,skill,action:coerce|name:Coerce]).

A3. Zhen Luoyang: This spry, elderly man was delivering a homemade lunch to his nephew (a panicked young man in the crowd watching the disaster unfold) who works in the mill when chaos struck. When the building first began to collapse, a blast of debris showered down on him and left him senseless, and it also buried him under a layer of crumbled plaster and dust. In order to locate him while he remains buried, a PC must Search and succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check.

Luoyang is unconscious when this event begins, lying prone on the ground. Each round on his turn, he can attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save with a +6 Fortitude save bonus. On a success, he wakes, hobbles to his feet, and limps at a speed of 5 feet toward safety. His wounds can be treated in the same way as for Aruka (see A1), in which case he regains his full Speed of 25 feet.

Red Smoke, Gold Eyes.name: 红烟，金眸 Red Smoke, Gold Eyes
Red Smoke, Gold Eyes.text:
红烟，金眸

在上一幕的最后一周里，柳岸镇的一位居民神秘失踪了。人们找不到这名失踪居民的任何踪迹；他们已被马戈凯麾下的一名驱魔师驱逐，其灵魂也已前往来世，在骨园接受审判。这场失踪的性质应当令玩家角色既忧虑又好奇，因此，上一幕建议将这次失踪安排在秋季的最后一天发生。

还没等玩家角色和柳岸镇的人民有机会调查这场神秘失踪，或者开始研究柳岸镇心景以及如何才能最好地联系上失踪的镇长，另一场失踪事件便开始了——但这一次，马戈凯的驱魔师们行动得更加激进。数十名这样的驱魔师身穿骇人的服装，挥舞着用来驱赶那些在现世柳岸镇废墟中作祟精魂的火焰，开始穿行于城镇之间。随着他们行动，柳岸镇各处升起一股股红色烟柱，仿佛神秘的隐形火焰正吞没这些区域中的建筑；然而，这些地点实际上并没有真正起火。真正等待着众人的，是驱魔师们设计出的危险危害——玩家角色必须击败这些危害，才能阻止更多柳岸镇居民失踪。

这场事件发生在上午接近中段，且时间点应在玩家角色已经全部集合之后。最好让事件在他们行经柳岸镇镇区附近时开始，这样他们就能看见木筏湖南岸的云纸坊（区域 W14）升起诡异的红色烟柱；否则，惊惧的非玩家角色会迅速找到玩家角色，提醒他们发生了这场怪事。如果玩家角色立刻动身前去调查现场，他们应能及时赶到，并顺利开始这一事件。

当玩家角色接近时，任何认为造纸工坊升起浓烟是失火所致的担忧都应被打消，因为根本看不见火焰；那些烟柱的绯红色泽显得格外不自然。当玩家角色抵达现场时，数十名聚集在街道上的惊惧镇民会告诉他们，这栋建筑的部分区域正单纯地化为烟雾消失，导致整座结构开始坍塌。有三名平民被困在这座正缓慢崩塌的建筑内，这个消息理应促使玩家角色迅速展开救援。

在现实世界中，云纸坊如今已成了一片几乎无法支撑自身重量的废墟，但它仍是湖南岸少数尚未彻底倒下的建筑之一。在这里，凯的驱魔师们决定进行他们第一次真正重要的驱逐废墟中精魂的尝试；随着他们的工作持续推进，现实世界中的废墟开始“渗入”心景之中，导致建筑的更多部分单纯地消失，使整栋建筑逐步坍塌。

从该区域升起的红烟，是驱魔师们仪式的显现；这场仪式涉及燃起篝火，并使用火把、火焰与骇人的服装来驱逐“邪恶精魂”。当玩家角色第一次进入受影响的区域时（见第154页地图），他们会短暂而不安地瞥见其中一名身着骇人装束的驱魔师——朗读或转述以下内容。

四只发光的金色眼睛在烟雾中骤然燃亮，向前移动，却没有身体或双腿承载它们。一个怪诞的红色面容仅仅一瞬间从它们周围的空气中渗出，发黄的尖牙从口中扭曲狰狞地探出，旋即骤然消失。黑色袖子在一具深红身体周围翻卷，在成股倾泻的布料中滑入现实，又泄出滚滚熏香烟云，随后坍成灰烬，被风吹散。再往前几步，金色眼睛也随之熄灭。刺鼻的烟味依然残留，而坍塌建筑另一头的呼救声仍不断回荡。

这名驱魔师的幻象消失得太快，任何人都来不及看清更多细节，但若以 @Check[religion|dc:23|traits:secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 检定来回忆知识，玩家角色会注意到，这个穿着怪异的人影似乎正在执行某种仪式，但很可能不过是受此地强大魔法影响而产生的一道虚像。若大成功，玩家角色会推断，这个人影的影像也许是从另一个心景中投射而来……或许正是镇长@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{赫山宝}被困住的那个？

直到进入@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{第10章}相当后面的阶段，玩家角色才应意识到，这道影像其实是一名来自现实世界、但位于115年后未来的驱魔师投影；不过，一旦玩家角色真的在现世遭遇这些驱魔师，你就应确保他们明白，这些代理者与玩家角色在柳岸镇仍被困于其心景时，于街道上所面对的那些超自然力量，其实正是同一批存在。

Red Smoke, Gold Eyes

During the final week of the previous act, one of Willowshore’s citizens mysteriously vanished. No trace of the missing resident will be found; they’ve been exorcised by one of Mago Kai’s exorcists, and their soul has moved on to the afterlife to be judged in the Boneyard. The nature of this disappearance should worry and intrigue the PCs, and as such, the previous act suggested timing this vanishing so it takes place on the last day of fall.

Before the PCs and the people of Willowshore have a chance to look into this mysterious disappearance or start researching the Willowshore mindscape and how best they can contact the town’s missing governor, another vanishing event begins—but this time, Mago Kai’s exorcists are more aggressive in their work. Dozens of these exorcists, dressed in frightening costumes and wielding fire meant to scare off the spirits that haunt the ruins of Willowshore in the living world, begin to work their way through the town. As they do, plumes of red smoke rise from various sites in Willowshore, as if strange, invisible flames were engulfing the buildings in these areas; however, no actual fires appear at these sites. What do await are dangerous hazards engineered by the exorcists—hazards the PCs must defeat before even more of Willowshore’s citizens vanish.

This event takes place mid-morning at a time after the PCs have all gathered together. It’s best for the event to begin as they are traveling near downtown Willowshore so that they can spot the eerie plumes of red smoke that start to rise from the Cloud Paper House (area W14) on the southern shore of Woodraft Lake; otherwise, frightened NPCs quickly seek the PCs out to alert them of the strange event. If the PCs set off to investigate the site at once, they should arrive in time to begin this event without issue.

Any fears that the smoke rising from the paper-making factory are the consequence of a fire should be put to rest as the PCs approach, for no flames are visible; the crimson color of the plumes appears particularly unnatural. When the PCs arrive at the scene, dozens of frightened townsfolk who have gathered in the streets tell them that parts of the building have simply been vanishing into smoke, causing the structure to begin to collapse. Three civilians are trapped inside the slowly collapsing building, news that should spur the PCs to attempt a swift rescue.

In the real world, Cloud Paper House is now a ruin that can barely support its own weight, but it’s one of the few buildings still standing along the lake’s southern shore. Here, Kai’s exorcists have decided to pursue their first significant attempt to banish spirits from the ruins, and as their work proceeds, the real-world ruins begin to “seep” into the mindscape, causing the building to collapse as more of its parts simply vanish.

The red smoke rising from the area is a manifestation of the exorcists’ ritual, which involves the burning of a bonfire and the use of torches, fire, and frightening costumes to drive out “evil spirits.” When the PCs first enter the afflicted area (presented on the map on page 154), they catch a brief but unsettling glimpse of one of these exorcists in their frightening attire—read or paraphrase the following.

Four glowing golden eyes blaze into existence in the smoke, moving forward without a body or legs to carry them. A monstrous red visage bleeds into air around them for just a moment, yellowed fangs twisting gruesomely out of its mouth before abruptly vanishing. Black sleeves billow around a crimson body, slipping into reality in torrents of cloth and leaking rolling clouds of incense before collapsing into ash and blowing away in the wind. A few paces more, and the golden eyes wink out. The acrid smell of smoke remains, and calls for help continue to ring out from the collapsing building beyond.

The vision of this exorcist is gone too quickly for anyone to see more, but with a @Check[religion|dc:23|traits:secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge, a PC notes that the strangely dressed figure seemed to be performing some sort of ritual, but was likely little more than a figment created by the powerful magic afflicting the area. With a critical success, the PC surmises that the image of the figure might have been projected from another mindscape entirely... perhaps the one that Governor @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} is trapped in?

The realization that this image was a projection of an exorcist from the real world 115 years in the future shouldn’t come until well into @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{Chapter 10}, but once the PCs do encounter these exorcists in the living world, you should ensure they realize that these agents are one and the same with the supernatural forces the PCs have faced on the streets of Willowshore while it remains entrapped in its mindscape.

Repercussions.name: 后果 Repercussions
Repercussions.text:
后果

任何类别的准备点数都不能被减少到零以下，但每经过一周，只要至少有一个类别因此被完全耗尽，就会给柳岸镇的人民带来严重的后果。

没有希望：柳岸镇的人民意志消沉且惊惧，他们很少离开家门。为了购买物品和服务，将柳岸镇视为1级定居点。每当你通常会减少希望点数时，改为将PC与柳岸镇两个派系的声望各减少2点。

没有食物：柳岸镇的人民正在挨饿。每当你通常会减少希望点数时，改为将柳岸镇的人口减少[[/r 2d6]]。

没有安全：柳岸镇的人民毫无防备。每当你通常会减少安全点数时，改为将柳岸镇的人口减少[[/r 1d6]]。

Repercussions

No category of Preparation Points can be reduced below zero, but every week that passes where at least one category is completely depleted in this way has dire repercussions for the people of Willowshore.

No Hope: The people of Willowshore are despondent and frightened, and they rarely exit their homes. Treat Willowshore as a level 1 settlement for the purposes of purchasing items and services. Each time you would normally reduce Hope Points, instead reduce the PCs’ reputation with both of Willowshore’s factions by 2.

No Food: The people of Willowshore are starving. Each time you would normally reduce Hope Points, instead reduce Willowshore’s population by [[/r 2d6]].

No Security: The people of Willowshore are defenseless. Each time you would normally reduce Security Points, instead reduce Willowshore’s population by [[/r 1d6]].

Weekly Attrition.name: 每周损耗 Weekly Attrition
Weekly Attrition.text:
每周损耗

随着时间流逝，镇上的居民因日益恶劣的天气和可怕的超自然事件而变得愈发阴郁、精神愈加疲惫，消耗越来越多的食物储备，并在天气的阻挠下竭力维持房屋的修缮。每周结束时，对柳岸镇的准备点数进行如下调整。

  • 希望点减少 [[/r 1d4]]。
  • 食物点数减少 1。
  • 安全点减少 1。

Weekly Attrition

As time passes, the townsfolk grow gloomier and more mentally exhausted by the increasingly harsh weather and frightening supernatural events, consume more and more of their food stores, and scramble to keep their homes repaired as the weather works against them. At the end of every week, make the following adjustments to Willowshore’s Preparation Points.

  • Reduce Hope Points by [[/r 1d4]].
  • Reduce Food Points by 1.
  • Reduce Security Points by 1.

Preparation Points.name: 准备点数 Preparation Points
Preparation Points.text:
准备点数

叫替补上场！

本冒险中的事件有时会提及居住在柳岸镇、并曾在前几幕中登场的非玩家角色。然而，肆季鬼志对非玩家角色来说有时可能相当致命，因此在本冒险这一部分中被赋予职责的一些非玩家角色，可能在你的游戏里已经死去。若是如此，只需用一位合适的在世替代者来替换这名死去的非玩家角色，或者新编一位能与PC们交谈的村民——也许是这名已故非玩家角色的家人或朋友。

在第二幕期间，PC们花了数周时间为即将到来的冬季做准备。随着“第三幕：无息可泣”于冬季的第一天开始，准备的时刻已经过去了。希望柳岸镇已经准备就绪！本幕通过三类准备点数来追踪村庄的状态：希望点数、食物点数和安全点数。

当你开始本幕时，务必让玩家知晓他们积累的希望点数、食物点数和安全点数总数。本幕中的事件将要求消耗这些点数，既包括每周固定消耗，也包括特定遭遇与事件导致的消耗，具体如后文所述。

Preparation Points

Call the Understudy!

Events in this adventure sometimes reference NPCs who live in Willowshore and who have appeared in previous acts. Season of Ghosts can be lethal for NPCs, however, and some of the NPCs given roles in this part of the adventure might be dead in your game. If so, simply swap the deceased NPC with an appropriate living substitute, or make up a new villager to converse with the PCs—perhaps a family member or friend of the dead NPC in question.

During Act 2, the PCs spent weeks preparing Willowshore for the coming winter. As “Act 3: No Breath to Cry” begins on the first day of winter, the time for preparation has passed. Hopefully, Willowshore is ready! This act tracks the village’s status via three categories of Preparation Points: Hope Points, Food Points, and Security Points.

When you begin this act, make sure the players are aware of the total number of Hope Points, Food Points, and Security Points they’ve accumulated. The events of this act will require the expenditure of these points, both on a regular weekly basis and as the results of specific encounters and occurrences, as detailed on the following pages.

Willowshore in the Winter.name: 冬日的柳岸镇 Willowshore in the Winter
Willowshore in the Winter.text:
冬日的柳岸镇

在这一幕中，清爽的秋日和日渐稀少的晴朗午后都已成为过去。神门的冬季寒风凛冽、气候严寒，暴雨与雷暴频繁。降雪虽然罕见，却并非闻所未闻，而今年，在柳岸镇心景的范围之内，雪将以某种有些出人意料的强度降下。虽然天气还不会冷到让湖泊与河流结冰，但寒意会强烈到任何在夜间被困于室外的人，都将极有可能因暴露在风霜之下而丧命。

场景笔记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.gfm2uOw7FTb4po3S]{柳岸镇} @UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.hcOE3Y4scm0wvt1j]{室内} @UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.64W4hCezS4mJFerz]{腹地} @UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.1p1iJlqwTDWo7RHc]{林地}

日渐减少的人口

在第一幕前两章中详述的最初怪物入侵之后，柳岸镇起初有225名居民；但随着战役推进，这一人口数字会缓慢下降，因为非玩家角色会不断死去——要么是遭遇中运气不佳的结果，要么是在脚本事件中丧生。城镇的实际人口不会对其统计数据产生影响，但追踪这一不断下降的数字，是在玩家之间营造并维持紧迫感的绝佳方式。随着这场冒险继续进行，某些事件，或是食物与安全保障的缺失，都会使总人口进一步下降。发生这种情况时，请记录柳岸镇的最终人口，因为这会影响这条冒险路径的结局。

Willowshore in the Winter

Crisp autumn days and increasingly sparse sunny afternoons are a thing of the past in this act. Winters in Shenmen are blustery and cold, boasting frequent rainstorms and thunderstorms. Snow is rare but not unknown, and this year, it will fall with somewhat unexpected force within the confines of the Willowshore mindscape. While it won’t grow cold enough for the lakes and rivers to freeze, the chill will be intense enough that anyone trapped outside overnight will be in grave peril of dying from exposure to the elements.

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.gfm2uOw7FTb4po3S]{Willowshore} @UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.hcOE3Y4scm0wvt1j]{Indoors} @UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.64W4hCezS4mJFerz]{Hinterlands} @UUID[Playlist.gTnkl7DUH19mzyJj.PlaylistSound.1p1iJlqwTDWo7RHc]{Woods}

A Declining Population

After the initial monstrous invasion detailed in the first two chapters of Act 1, Willowshore begins with a population of 225 people, but as the campaign goes on, that population slowly declines as NPCs perish—either as the results of poor luck in encounters or in scripted events. The town’s actual population has no effect on its stats, but keeping track of this declining number can be a great way to foster and maintain a sense of urgency among the players. As this adventure goes on, certain events or lack of food or security will cause this population total to decline even further. As it does, keep track of Willowshore’s final population, as it will impact the Adventure Path’s conclusion.

Getting Started.name: 冒险开始 Getting Started
Getting Started.text:
冒险开始

《肆季鬼志》冒险路径的上一幕以玩家角色得知自己被困在一个循环往复的心景中作结，这个心景每年都会在春季的最后一天重置。借助他们从丹杉寺找回的文献，玩家角色如今终于拥有了开始研究一项仪式所需的最后工具，这项仪式将让他们得以脱离柳岸镇心景并返回现实世界。

当你准备开始“第三幕：无息可泣”时，请继续进行@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10redsmokegold00]{红烟，金眸}中详述的事件。马戈凯的代理人正在现实世界中驱逐柳岸镇废墟里的鬼魂，而在玩家角色与这些代理人最初的遭遇结束后，他们应当意识到，威胁柳岸镇的超自然危险并不只是源自苦迦菩提的影响。为了查明这一谜团的真相，他们应当竭尽全力在赫山宝的心景中与他取得联系——无论那地方究竟在哪里！

Getting Started

The previous act of the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path ended with the PCs learning that they’re trapped within a cyclic mindscape that resets every year on the last day of spring. With the texts they’ve recovered from the Tan Sugi monastery, the PCs now have the final tools they need to begin researching a ritual that will allow them to escape the Willowshore mindscape and return to the real world.

Once you’re ready to begin “Act 3: No Breath to Cry,” proceed with the events detailed in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10redsmokegold00]{Red Smoke, Gold Eyes}. Mago Kai’s agents are attempting to exorcise ghosts from the ruins of Willowshore in the living world, and after the PCs’ initial encounters with these agents conclude, they should realize that the supernatural threats facing Willowshore stem from more than just Kugaptee’s influence. To get to the bottom of this mystery, they should make every effort to contact Governor @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0000]{Heh Shan-Bao} in his mindscape—wherever that might be!

Oblivion of Truth.name: 真相湮灭 Oblivion of Truth
Oblivion of Truth.text:
第8章： 真相湮灭

柳岸镇已经被困在一个永无止境的循环中超过一百年了，但镇上的居民并非在自己一无所知的折磨中充当无心智的参与者。这个循环每次的展开方式都不尽相同。各种超自然事件、不同的选择，以及单纯的运气变化，都会让不同的居民在每次循环中偶然发现自身存在的真相，并尝试脱身。尽管他们已经有过一百多次机会，至今却没有任何人获得成功。更糟的是，每当心景回到夏日第一天时，他们的一切进展都会被彻底重置，导致柳岸镇的人民忘记自己学到的一切，也失去所有关于这些发现的实体证据。

而这一次，在心景的第115次循环期间，情况有所不同。现世发生的事件改变了心景中的既有局面，而一群新的英雄——PC们——已经对将他们困于此地的“诅咒”有了惊人的发现。不过，虽然他们如今已经知道自己被困在一个心景之中，却仍未知晓自己处境的终极真相——他们全都已经死了。一直困扰柳岸镇的“灵异事件”，其实是活着的驱邪师所为；他们试图驱散这些幽魂般的镇民，以便当地的森林能够被安全采伐。一旦柳岸镇的精魂被解缚并送往@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}，马戈凯和他的伐木营地就能进驻，并开始将木材运回神门的首都。

如今，PC们已拥有从丹杉寺遗迹中寻回的资源，可以开始探究春末最后一夜究竟发生了什么；但随着一个格外难熬的冬季残酷地逼近这座城镇，他们必须明智地运用自己的时间与资源。

Chapter 8: Oblivion of Truth

The town of Willowshore has been trapped in an unending cycle for over a hundred years, but its inhabitants aren’t mindless participants in their own unknowing torment. The cycle never plays out in quite the same way. Various supernatural events, choices made differently, and simple turns of luck allow different citizens to stumble upon the truth of their existence each cycle and make attempts to escape. Despite having had more than a hundred opportunities to do so, none have found success thus far. It doesn’t help that their progress is completely reset every time the mindscape reverts to the first day of summer, causing the people of Willowshore to forget everything they’ve learned and lose all physical evidence of their discoveries.

This time around, during the mindscape’s 115th cycle, things are different. Events in the living world have changed the status quo in the mindscape, and a new group of heroes, the PCs, have made incredible discoveries about the “curse” that has kept them trapped. But while they now know they’re held within a mindscape, they have yet to learn the ultimate truth of their situation—they’re all dead. The “hauntings” that have been plaguing Willowshore are the work of living exorcists attempting to banish the ghostly townsfolk so that the local forest can be safely harvested. Once the spirits of Willowshore have been unmoored and sent on to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, Mago Kai and his logging camp can move in and begin sending lumber back to Shenmen’s capital.

Now armed with resources recovered from the ruins of the Tan Sugi monastery, the PCs can begin the process of learning what actually happened on the last night of spring, but with the cruelty of a particularly harrowing winter looming over the town, they’ll need to spend their time and resources wisely.

Act 3.2: Face-to-Face with Death.name: 第3幕第2场：直面死亡 Act 3.2: Face-to-Face with Death

Between Life and Death.name: 生死之间 Between Life and Death
Between Life and Death.text:
生死之间 重度 8

当玩家角色施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生术} 时，烈焰在他们周围燃烧，将他们封在陶土外壳中炙烤，他们感到脑海中响起一个不祥的声音，与赫总督的声音极为相似——那声音命令他们向自己的欲望屈服，被强烈到足以让他们挣脱死亡魔爪的情绪所吞没。让玩家描述此时推动其角色行动的最强烈情感。除了作为一次角色扮演机会外，这些情绪也能帮助引导玩家角色在现代神门获得幽灵力量时作出选择（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20hauntingthel00]{萦扰生者}）。

当仪式结束、玩家角色从陶土外壳中浮现时，他们并没有进入生者的世界——相反，他们是在一条雕刻石制的走廊中醒来。

这间阴沉、长三十尺宽六十尺的石墙房间两端各有一扇木制拉门。木门上精雕着一个畸形巨人残忍殴杀人们的图景。尽管墙壁和天花板相对平整，石质地板上却交错分布着浅浅的裂痕。房间中央是一座覆盖着香炉、蜡烛及其他器具的仪式祭坛。

若玩家角色成功进行一次 @Check[arcana|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 或 @Check[occultism|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] 回忆知识检定，便会意识到他们是浮现在一个夹在柳岸镇与生者世界之间的心景中；这里如同一个形而上的“碎屑收集器”，专门拦住那些未被苦迦菩提完全吞噬的灵魂。

这些拉门具有硬度 5 和 20 生命值（BT 10）。门上的雕刻留下了许多孔洞，所以它们关闭时并不能完全阻挡视觉线，而是为另一侧的目标提供高等掩蔽。整个边境地带是一个封闭循环：B1、B2、B3 和 B4 区域中的走廊会无缝延续到其对应位置，使整张地图自我相连。

玩家角色能感受到生者世界对他们的感召，而每经过一轮，祭坛上方那闪烁的灵光都会变得更加清晰，逐渐转化为通往晨步桥的传送门。但在那道传送门完全成形之前，玩家角色必须击败栖居于这片心景中的宁多鲁斯。

场景注释宏

@UUID[Macro.Kpb494oaT9HBq20S]{半开启传送门} @UUID[Macro.FnxYz1My8Hsh2Uf3]{完全开启传送门}

生死之间 重度 8

@UUID[Actor.0yBS3zFGEvoeQB1L]{影隐熊（3）}

生物：玩家角色一站起身，光线似乎便开始闪烁，不安的低语充斥空气；那些声音讥讽地下达宣告，嘲弄玩家角色抛下柳岸镇前往生者世界，说他们留在身后的人感到遭到背叛，也说他们永远无法重新赢得那些人的信任。这些低语是由三只影熊忍咄噜喷吐进这片心景中的谎言，它们显现在地图上每个标记为 B5 的位置。它们以察觉进行先攻，然后朝中央房间前进以攻击队伍——它们已显现出包袱，因此其速度降低至 15 尺。

一旦其中一只影隐熊发现玩家角色，宁多鲁便会使用脱卸包袱，猛然向前扑出并发动攻击。若生命值降至 50 以下，一只影隐熊便会施放传送以撤退回其起始点，显现一个新的包袱来获得 AC 加值，然后再次开始潜行猎杀玩家角色。

穿过传送门：当最后一只影熊忍咄噜被杀死后，祭坛上方的传送门会闪烁并凝实。玩家角色可以在任何时候踏入其中；当他们这么做时，他们便完成了转生仪式，并开始 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{第10章}。因这一重大成就，给予玩家角色 80 XP。

任何在此次遭遇中死亡的玩家角色实际上都不算真正被杀死，除非整个队伍全灭。只要至少有一名玩家角色存活并踏过传送门，所有玩家角色都会在第10章开始时于柳岸镇的废墟中醒来，但那些在此次遭遇中死亡的角色会处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 1}。

Between Life and Death Severe 8

As the PCs cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate}, and as the flames burn around them and bake them in their clay shells, they feel a baleful voice in their minds that resembles Governor Heh’s—the voice orders them to give in to their desires, to be consumed by emotions strong enough that they can rip themselves free from the clutches of death. Have the players describe the most powerful feelings that motivate their characters at this time. In addition to serving as a roleplaying opportunity, these emotions can help guide the PCs when choosing the ghostly powers they gain in modern-day Shenmen (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20hauntingthel00]{Haunting the Living}).

When the ritual ends and the PCs emerge from their clay shells, they don’t emerge into the living world—instead, they wake inside a hallway of carved stone.

Two wooden sliding doors cap the ends of this drab, thirty-by-sixty-foot stone-walled chamber. The wooden doors are ornately carved with depictions of a misshapen giant brutally bludgeoning people to death. Despite the relatively smooth walls and ceilings, the stone floor is crisscrossed with shallow gashes. In the center of the chamber is a ritual altar covered in incense, candles, and other accoutrements.

With a successful @Check[arcana|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[occultism|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge, a PC realizes they’ve emerged in a mindscape wedged between Willowshore and the living world that acts as metaphysical “crumb catcher” for souls not fully consumed by Kugaptee.

The sliding doors have Hardness 5 and 20 HP (BT 10). Their carvings leave a great many holes, so they don’t entirely block line of sight when closed, instead providing greater cover to those on the opposite side. The entire borderland is a closed loop: corridors in areas B1, B2, B3, and B4 continue seamlessly into their counterparts, connecting the map to itself.

The PCs can feel the living world calling to them, and during each round that passes, the shimmering aura above the altar grows clearer as it transforms into a portal to Dawnstep Bridge. But before that portal is fully formed, the PCs must defeat the nindorus that dwell in this mindscape.

Scene NotesMacros

@UUID[Macro.Kpb494oaT9HBq20S]{Partially Open Portal} @UUID[Macro.FnxYz1My8Hsh2Uf3]{Fully Open Portal}

Between Life and Death Severe 8

@UUID[Actor.0yBS3zFGEvoeQB1L]{Kagekumas (3)}

Creatures: As soon as the PCs stand, the light seems to flicker and unsettling whispers fill the air, voices that issue mocking decrees about the PCs abandoning Willowshore for the living world, of how the people they left behind feel betrayed, and of how they’ll never be able to regain their trust. These whispers are lies spewed into the mindscape by three kagekuma nindorus that manifest at each location labeled B5 on the map. They roll Perception for initiative, then make their way toward the central chamber to attack the party—they already have bundles manifested, so their Speed is reduced to 15 feet.

Once one of the kagekumas spots a PC, the nindoru Sheds its Bundle to lurch forth quickly and attack. If reduced to fewer than 50 Hit Points, a kagekuma casts translocate to retreat to its starting point, manifests a new bundle to gain an AC bonus, and begins stalking the PCs again.

Through the Portal: Once the last of the kagekuma nindorus are slain, the portal atop the altar flickers and solidifies. The PCs can step through at any point; as they do so, they complete their transmigration and begin @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{Chapter 10}. Grant the PCs 80 XP for this momentous achievement.

Any PC who dies in this encounter isn’t actually slain unless the whole party dies. As long as at least one PC lives and steps through the portal, all of the PCs wake in the ruins of Willowshore at the start of Chapter 10, but those who died in this encounter are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Transmigrating.name: 转生 Transmigrating
Transmigrating.text:
转生

玩家角色施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生术}的时机，取决于他们何时得知这项仪式。他们在这么做之前应至少达到8级——游戏内要求必须等待榊木板条准备完成，目的就是让玩家角色有足够时间经历@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto]{第9章}中的全部事件，除了@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event13inter00]{事件13}之外，如此他们才有机会获得所需的经验值。

玩家角色应该已经得知，在现世之中，长明灯的光已经熄灭，而这使他们只能施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生术}的4环版本。即使他们知道这一限制，或已经得知火焰被带去了唐入，从柳岸镇心景过渡到现世的过程中仍还有一个意外在等着他们。苦迦菩提的影响依然强大，他会抗拒玩家角色死亡被逆转一事，把他们拖入另一个小得多的心景之中，试图在他们继续前进之前先杀死他们。

Transmigrating

The timing of when the PCs cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate} depends on when they learn the ritual. They should be at least 8th level before they do so—the in-game requirement of needing to wait for the sakaki slats to be prepared is intended to give the PCs enough time to play through all of the events in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto]{Chapter 9} save for @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event13inter00]{Event 13} so that they’ll have the chance to earn the experience they need.

The PCs should’ve learned that the light of the Eternal Lantern has been extinguished in the living world, and that this limits them to casting only the 4th-level version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate}. Even if they know this limitation or have learned that the flame has been taken to Karahai, the transition from Willowshore’s mindscape to the living world has one more surprise in store. Kugaptee’s influence remains strong, and he fights against the reversal of the PCs’ deaths by plunging them into another, much smaller, mindscape in an attempt to kill them before they can proceed.

Event 16. One Kind Favor.name: 事件 16。一个友善的帮助 Event 16. One Kind Favor
Event 16. One Kind Favor.text:
事件16：一个善意的帮助 中等 8

这个事件可以在你希望的任何时候发生，但在你决定它将要发生之前的几天或几周里，另一场闹鬼的传闻开始传播。当你准备开始这个事件时，镇上的长老会来找玩家角色，请他们去调查这些传闻。

根据传言，一个黑发白眼的幽灵出现在了本地的一处墓地里。她在夜里一动不动、悄无声息地站着，直到黎明到来时消失。某些保守的村民虽然对这个幽灵的处境一无所知，却很快断言她一定是罪有应得，才会落得死后不得安宁的下场；但即便如此，他们也不想让这个幽灵继续在城镇附近徘徊。

如果玩家角色在天黑后前去调查，他们就会发现那个如传闻所说在墓地徘徊的身影。除非玩家角色问她想要什么，否则这个精魂会无视他们；一旦有人这么问，她便默默示意他们跟上，然后滑向森林深处。如果玩家角色试图攻击这个幽灵，她只会直接消失，并在第二天夜里毫发无伤地再次出现在墓碑之间。

幽灵的旅程：跟随这个幽灵需要玩家角色在夜晚穿过森林前进。这个幽灵并不沿着林间小道行进，也不会因岩石或树枝而放慢速度，她走的路线格外难行，玩家角色也能看出这条路线异常迂回。幽灵移动时带着一种毫不迟疑的确定感，偶尔还会对自己轻轻点头，仿佛在无声地计算步数，但她选择的路径看起来几乎毫无道理可言。每当她的路线接近河流时，她总会沿着水边漂浮前进。

为了跟上这个幽灵，一名玩家角色必须尝试一次 @Check[survival|dc:22] 或 @Check[perception|dc:25] 检定。队伍中的其他玩家角色可以协助这次检定。若成功，队伍便能在她迂回前行的情况下依然保持步伐。若失败，每名玩家角色都必须强行军才能跟上，而等到幽灵终于抵达目的地时，他们都会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}。

旅程开始约三小时后，幽灵抵达一条干涸的河床。她把玩家角色带到那里，然后指向岸边一片铺满砂砾的区域。如果玩家角色带有合适的工具，他们就可以在这里挖掘；如果没有，他们就可能只能徒手挖掘，或者重复这段旅程并带着铲子返回。使用合适工具挖掘需要两次成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:21] 检定，或一次大成功。徒手挖掘则会将难度提高至 @Check[athletics|dc:25]。大失败会导致正在挖掘的玩家角色陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}。在地下约3英尺深处，是裹在粗麻布裹尸布中的人类骸骨。

一旦玩家角色取出了这些骸骨，幽灵便会带他们返回最初出现的那座墓地，这一次她走的是一条直路（全程只需30分钟）。回到起点后，她再次指向自己原本站立的那片泥土，显然是在期待玩家角色把这些骸骨重新埋葬在那里。如果玩家角色不埋葬这些骸骨，这个幽灵便会亲自跟着他们，出现在他们的镜子里，站在他们的床边，在他们睡觉时注视着他们，并在各种随机时刻现身分散他们的注意力。

一个善意的帮助 中等 8

@UUID[Actor.zuDhmclOm1uM89af]{被遗忘的魂魄} @UUID[Actor.gjs9pmhe7TabalI9]{报怨亡魂（4）}

生物：在旅程结束后的任何时候，玩家角色都可以攻击这个幽灵；如果他们这么做，她就会反击直到被摧毁，但会在 [[/r 2d4]] 天后重新恢复，再次出现在墓地中（如果玩家角色移动了她的骸骨，则会出现在骸骨附近）。只有最终将她的骸骨埋在她所指示的地方，这个无名幽灵才能得到安息。

然而，埋葬骸骨并不是件简单的事，因为幽灵选定的地点早已是四个死去多年的罪犯的坟墓——正是他们当初害死了她，并将她的遗骸沉入河中。这四个罪犯会从自己的坟墓里爬出来攻击玩家角色，气喘吁吁地喊着“不是我们干的”“我们没杀她”或者“那只是个意外！”之类的话。可这些辩解很快就会变成威胁，比如“你也会死得一样惨！”或者“杀你也一样轻松！”这些报怨亡魂会同时攻击幽灵和玩家角色；但如果幽灵被摧毁，他们的不死复仇也不会因此终结，因为她那不得安宁的精魂只会在几天后再次归来。在这种情况下，其中一名玩家角色（最好是那个看起来对幽灵的困境最有同情心或最支持她的人）会成为这些报怨亡魂憎恨的目标，而他们会无视队伍中的其他所有人，专门攻击那名玩家角色。

如果玩家角色击败这些报怨亡魂，幽灵会双膝跪地，因挫败而抽泣不止。只有当玩家角色埋葬她的骸骨后，她的哭泣才会停止；到那时，她会如释重负地叹息一声，并优雅地向玩家角色鞠上一躬。她生前是谁、又为何被谋杀，这些仍是谜团——你可以让玩家角色最终查明真相，也可以干脆让它永远保持神秘。

奖励：如果玩家角色埋葬了这个幽灵的骸骨，给予他们经验值，视同他们在战斗中击败了她。

Event 16: One Kind Favor Moderate 8

This event can take place whenever you wish, but in the days or weeks before you decide it will be taking place, rumors of another haunting spread. When you’re ready to begin this event, the town elder seeks the PCs out to ask them to investigate these rumors.

According to hearsay, a ghost with black hair and white eyes has appeared in a local cemetery, standing completely still and silent during the night until she vanishes with the dawn. While certain conservative villagers are quick to proclaim the ghost must deserve her restless death (despite knowing nothing about the circumstances of the ghost’s situation), even they don’t want the ghost hanging around the town.

Should the PCs investigate after dark, they find the figure haunting the cemetery as described. The spirit ignores the PCs unless they ask her what she wants, at which point she silently beckons them to follow her and glides off into the woods. If the PCs try to attack the ghost, she simply vanishes, appearing unharmed amid the gravestones the next night.

The Ghost’s Journey: Following the ghost requires the PCs to work their way through the forest during the night. The ghost does not stick to forest paths and is not slowed by rocks or branches, taking a particularly onerous route, and the PCs can tell that the route is unusually circuitous. The ghost moves with unerring certainty, occasionally nodding to herself as if silently counting the steps, but the path she chooses seems to make little sense. Whenever her path comes near a river, she always floats along the water’s edge.

In order to keep up with the ghost, one PC must attempt a @Check[survival|dc:22] or a @Check[perception|dc:25] check. Other PCs in the group can Aid this check. On a success, the party manages to maintain pace with her despite her meandering. On a failure, each of the PCs must hustle to keep up and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} by the time the ghost finally reaches her destination.

About three hours after the journey begins, the ghost reaches a dry riverbed. The ghost leads the PCs to it, then points to a gravelly patch on the shore. If the PCs have the proper tools, they can dig here—if not, they may have to dig by hand or repeat this journey and return with shovels. Digging with the proper tools requires two successful @Check[athletics|dc:21] checks or one critical success. Digging by hand increases the DC to @Check[athletics|dc:25]. A critical failure results in the PCs who are digging becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. About 3 feet beneath the earth are human bones wrapped in a burlap shroud.

Once the PCs have retrieved the bones, the ghost leads them back to the cemetery she started at, this time taking a direct route (a journey that takes only 30 minutes). When she returns to where she started, she points again at the dirt where she was originally standing, clearly expecting the PCs to rebury the bones there. If the PCs do not bury the bones, the ghost begins to follow them personally, appearing in their mirrors, standing over their beds and watching them while they sleep, and appearing to distract them at random moments.

One Kind Favor Moderate 8

@UUID[Actor.zuDhmclOm1uM89af]{Forgotten Spirit} @UUID[Actor.gjs9pmhe7TabalI9]{Revenants (4)}

Creatures: The PCs can attack the ghost at any time after the journey; if they do so, she fights back until destroyed, only to rejuvenate [[/r 2d4]] days later to once again appear in the cemetery (or near her bones, if the PCs have moved them). Only by finally burying her bones where she’s indicated will the nameless ghost find peace.

Burying the bones isn’t a simple task, though, for the site the ghost has chosen already serves as the graves for four long-dead criminals—the ones responsible for killing her in the first place and sinking her remains in the river. These four criminals dig up out of their graves to attack the PCs, gasping out phrases like, “It wasn’t us,” “We didn’t kill her,” or “It was an accident!” These excuses swiftly give way to threats like, “You’ll die just as well!” or “Killing you is just as easy!” The revenants attack the ghost and the PCs alike, but if the ghost is destroyed, their undying vendetta doesn’t release them, for her unquiet spirit simply returns in a few days. In this case, one of the PCs (preferably the one who seems to have been the most empathetic or supportive of the ghost’s plight) becomes the target of the revenants’ hatred, and they attack that PC to the exclusion of all others in the party.

If the PCs defeat the revenants, the ghost drops to her knees and sobs in frustration. Her sobs end only when the PCs bury her bones, at which point she sighs in relief and gives the PCs a graceful bow. Who she was in life and why she was murdered is a mystery that you can allow the PCs to eventually solve—or you can simply let it remain a mystery.

Reward: If the PCs bury the ghost’s bones, grant them XP as if they’d defeated her in combat.

Event 15. Reprisal.name: 事件15：报复 Event 15. Reprisal
Event 15. Reprisal.text:
事件15：报复 低阶 8

苦迦菩提或许再次被囚禁，但他的影响依然强烈。其存在的一种体现方式，就是一个巨大掠食者的显现——它直接由这个死去邪魔的思绪塑成，并被派去追踪玩家角色，为他们在上一幕中的行为实施报复。

报复 低阶 8

@UUID[Actor.lYUvYbH8m1Y6ulg2]{苦迦菩提的蜈蚣}

生物： 这场遭遇可能发生在玩家角色穿越腹地旅行时，也可能始于这只生物从更深的林地中隆隆爬出，来到城镇边缘。一只将近百尺长的亮橙色蜈蚣从矮丛环境中爬出，盘起身躯并发动攻击——目标可能是玩家角色，也可能是镇边的建筑。就像玩家角色在这场战役中最先遭遇的那些蜈蚣一样，这头巨兽会一边战斗一边咆哮出词语：“肉……血肉……骨头……手指……头发……皮肤……眼睛……”当它发现玩家角色时，它的话语就会改变，并用那迟缓低沉的嗓音轰然吼出几句完整的话：“你们必须付出代价！苦迦菩提将会崛起！受死吧！”

如果你让苦迦菩提的蜈蚣攻击城镇，而不是在玩家角色身处荒野时攻击他们，那么这只庞然大物会毫无偏差地窸窣爬向玩家角色当前所在之处。若队伍立刻采取行动迎接挑战，他们应该能在这只怪物造成太多伤害前赶到；但如果他们拖得太久（或者被迫逃跑），蜈蚣的行动就可能对柳岸镇造成足够严重的伤害，使其安全点减少[[/r 1d4]]。

Event 15: Reprisal Low 8

Kugaptee may be imprisoned once more, but his influence remains strong. One way his presence can be felt is through the manifestation of an enormous predator, formed directly from the dead fiend’s thoughts and sent to track down the PCs to enact revenge for their actions in the previous act.

Reprisal Low 8

@UUID[Actor.lYUvYbH8m1Y6ulg2]{Kugaptee's Centipede}

Creature: This encounter can take place while the PCs are traveling through the hinterlands, or it could begin as the creature trundles into the town’s outskirts from deeper in the woods. A bright orange centipede that’s nearly a hundred feet long crawls out of the undergrowth to coil upon itself and attack—either PCs or buildings at the edge of town. As with the very first centipedes the PCs encountered in this campaign, this behemoth roars words out as it fights: “Meat... flesh... bones... fingers... hair... skin... eyes...” When it spots the PCs, its words change, and in its lumbering voice, it thunders out a few complete sentences. “You must pay! Kugaptee will rise! Time to die!”

If you have Kugaptee’s Centipede attack town rather than attack the PCs while they’re out in the wilderness, the massive creature scuttles unerringly toward wherever the PCs are currently located. If the party acts immediately to meet the challenge, they should be able to reach the monster before it does too much damage, but if they take too long (or if they’re forced to flee), the centipede’s actions can inflict enough damage to Willowshore that its Security Points are reduced by [[/r 1d4]].

Event 14. The Trees Live.name: 事件14：树木活了 Event 14. The Trees Live
Event 14. The Trees Live.text:
事件14：树木活了 中等 8

这可以发生在玩家角色们外出游荡于柳岸镇周边森林中的任何时候。

生物：柳岸镇伐木工留下的遗产，不仅存在于城镇中的废弃庄园与锯木厂里。自然与森林的精魂记忆深刻，并非所有精魂都能轻易被供品与仪式安抚。柳岸镇的一些森林守护者痛恨村民们过去对荒野造成的破坏，而玩家角色们也只是因为纯粹的坏运气，误入了它们栖居的一片灌木丛。或者，也可能是一名非玩家角色失踪，玩家角色们受命前去追踪其下落——沿着这名非玩家角色留下的踪迹前进，最终也会来到这片同样的灌木丛。

树木活了 中等 8

@UUID[Actor.dAGayypNZzq40ghO]{林木收割者（2）} @UUID[Actor.YGHerllkN24395fJ]{觉醒树木}

这片怒意显现为一对树妖收割者和一棵觉醒树木。当玩家角色们遭遇这些树妖时，这些愤怒的植物不会立刻攻击——相反，它们会要求玩家角色们为多年来柳岸镇的人民对林地造成的一切痛苦与伤害作出交代。树妖最初的态度为不友善，但如果能使它们变为冷淡，它们就会放玩家角色们离开而不发生战斗。如果它们绑走了一名非玩家角色，只有当玩家角色们能让它们的态度至少变为友善时，它们才会释放受害者。任何调整树妖态度的失败尝试，都会自动使它们转为敌对并发动攻击；一旦战斗开始，它们便会战至死亡。

奖励：如果玩家角色们以和平方式解决此事，则如同在战斗中击败这些生物一样给予他们XP。更重要的是，树妖们会对玩家角色们刮目相看；一周后，一批来自自然终老树木的枯木会出现在城镇边缘，被整齐地堆放起来。这份优质木材的赠礼会为城镇提供意外的资源，用于修复风暴造成的损害，并给予玩家角色们2安全点。

Event 14: The Trees Live Moderate 8

This can take place at any point while the PCs are out wandering in the forest surrounding Willowshore.

Creatures: The legacy of Willowshore’s lumber harvesters lives on in more than the abandoned estates and mills within the town. The spirits of nature and the forest have long memories, and not all are easily placated by offerings and rituals. Some of Willowshore’s forest guardians despise the villagers for the damage they once did to the wilds and, by a sheer stroke of bad luck, the PCs wander into a thicket of them. Alternatively, an NPC could go missing and the PCs are called upon to track them down—following the NPC’s trail leads to this same thicket.

The Trees Live Moderate 8

@UUID[Actor.dAGayypNZzq40ghO]{Arboreal Reapers (2)} @UUID[Actor.YGHerllkN24395fJ]{Awakened Tree}

This thicket of anger manifests as a pair of arboreal reapers and an awakened tree. When the PCs encounter the arboreals, the angry plants don’t immediately attack—they instead demand an accounting for all the pain and damage done to the woodlands by the people of Willowshore over the years. The arboreals’ initial attitude is unfriendly, but if they can be made indifferent, they let the PCs go without a fight. If they abducted an NPC, they’ll only release their victim if the PCs can make them at least friendly. Any failed attempt to adjust the arboreals’ attitude automatically shifts them to hostile and causes them to attack; once a fight begins, they battle to the death.

Reward: If the PCs achieve a peaceful solution, grant them XP as if they’d defeated the creatures in combat. More importantly, the arboreals are impressed by the PCs, and one week later, a delivery of deadwood from trees that have come to a natural end of life appears at the edge of town, neatly stacked. This gift of fine wood provides the town with unexpected resources to repair storm damage and grants the PCs 2 Security Points.

Other Winter Events.name: 其他冬季事件 Other Winter Events
Other Winter Events.text:
其他冬季事件

在冬季期间，当玩家角色们等待有机会进入下一阶段时，你可能会觉得有些时刻需要增添一些刺激或获取XP的机会。在这些情况下，你可以使用以下事件之一，让这个冬季更有生气。

Other Winter Events

You might find moments during winter while the PCs are waiting for the chance to move on to the next step could use some additional excitement or XP opportunities. In these cases, you can use one of the following events to liven up the winter.

Parting Ways.name: 分道扬镳 Parting Ways
Parting Ways.text:
分道扬镳

当影响遭遇在第6轮后结束时，若玩家角色未能累计至少6点影响点，任美璃会因自己受到的怠慢而怒不可遏并发动攻击。同样，如果玩家角色在任何时候对她动手，她也会攻击（例如，当她对其中一人施放如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{流放诅咒} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{读心术} 这样的法术时，玩家角色发动攻击）。

如果玩家角色拥有7到12点影响点，任美璃会试图“收下”所有被她看中的俊美男子，以及她在玩家角色中赠予了项圈的任何人。每名潜在受害者都可以尝试一次 @Check[deception|dc:28] 或 @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] 检定来说服她放弃这个打算。若他们失败了，她会坚持要在离开时把他们一并带走。若他们依旧拒绝，她会先尝试用魔法魅惑他们，若失败则诉诸暴力。

分道扬镳 极限 9

@UUID[Actor.lKgG84Maepjro99O]{任美璃}

如果爆发战斗，与一个13级生物交战对8级玩家角色来说甚至超出了极限遭遇的范畴。由于这一事件很可能发生在 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{第10章} 完成之后，玩家角色也许已经达到9级，甚至可能是10级，但即便如此，对抗一个13级生物仍然十分危险。在战斗中，任美璃会在她的第一回合施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{召唤动物} 来召来一只 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.4ISm82EYQeOndynw]{巨型狼蛛}，随后爬上天花板，并使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{暗示术} 和网缚来分隔玩家角色。接着，她会试图制服并捕获那些特别冒犯了她，或是吸引了她目光的玩家角色。对后者，她会在自己的打击上承受–2环境减值，以造成非致命伤害。若她的生命值降至45点或更低，她会尝试逃回自己的轿子，然后离开城镇。若被杀死，她会翻倒在背上，蜘蛛腿向内蜷缩，呈现出一幕怪诞景象，随后彻底消散，她那由思维构成的身体化作蒸汽。类似地，若她们的女主人被击败，她的四名思维体人类仆役也会一同消散。若她尚未将其赠出，玩家角色可以找回她的信使戒指和尸体活化粉尘，但硬木箱（见下文“宝藏”）则无处可寻。

如果玩家角色在遭遇结束时拥有超过12点影响点，这名络新妇会暗自对整个过程感到满意，不会要求任何玩家角色跟她一同回去，不过她会暗示，待到春末纳贡之时，她打算把他们中的部分或全部带去她的宫殿。她不再多言，回到自己的轿子中，由她的仆役将她抬到城镇边缘，随后他们全都消散于无形。当然，任何此时被她带走的玩家角色，如今都可以毫无后果地返回自己原本的生活。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.4XeiNtVFiMN4bZqt]{硬木箱}
如果玩家角色累计了至少12点影响点，当队伍在城镇边缘消散时，会留下一个硬木箱。箱中装有六颗月长石，每颗价值25 gp、一件高等人格面具和一件荒寂坠饰。此外，她那些幻影仆役佩戴的四个银项圈也会留下来。若玩家角色不在场见证她离开，一名村民会偶然发现这批宝藏，并在几天后将其带给玩家角色。

这些宝藏，以及任女士在影响遭遇中发放的任何奖励（包括她要求某位玩家角色佩戴的任何银项圈），都会在遭遇结束后继续存在，尽管络新妇本人不过是由心景显化出的思维体。

奖励： 若任女士未发生战斗便离开城镇，给予玩家角色160 XP和 [[/r 1d4]] 希望点。

Parting Ways

When the influence encounter ends after round 6, if the PCs failed to accrue at least 6 Influence Points, Ren Mei Li is enraged by the poor treatment she has received and attacks. Likewise, she attacks if at any time the PCs lash out at her (such as if they attack when she casts a spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{Outcast's Curse} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} on one of them).

If the PCs have 7 to 12 Influence Points, Mei Li attempts to “collect” any pretty men that caught her eye and anyone to whom she gave a collar among the PCs. Each potential victim can attempt a @Check[deception|dc:28] or @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] check to dissuade her of her intentions. Should they fail, she insists on taking them with her when she leaves. Should they still decline, she’ll first attempt to magically charm them, then resort to violence if that fails.

Parting Ways Extreme 9

@UUID[Actor.lKgG84Maepjro99O]{Ren Mei Li}

If combat breaks out, a fight against a level 13 creature is beyond an extreme encounter for 8th-level PCs. Since this event likely plays out after @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{Chapter 10} is completed, the PCs may already be 9th level, or perhaps even 10th level, but even then, such a fight against a level 13 creature is dangerous. During combat, Ren Mei Li spends her first turn casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} to call up a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.4ISm82EYQeOndynw]{Giant Tarantula}, then climbs to the ceiling and uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} and web trap to separate the PCs. She then attempts to incapacitate and capture any PCs that either particularly offended her or drew her eye. Against the latter, she’ll take a –2 circumstance penalty with her strikes to deal nonlethal damage. If reduced to 45 or fewer Hit Points, she attempts to flee back to her palanquin and then out of town. If slain, she rolls onto her back and her spider legs curl inward in a grotesque display before fading away entirely, her thoughtform body vaporizing. Likewise, her four thoughtform human servants fade away if their mistress is defeated. The PCs can recover her messenger’s ring and the dust of corpse animation if she hasn’t already gifted them, but the hardwood chest (see Treasure, below) is nowhere to be found.

If the PCs have more than 12 Influence Points at the end of the encounter, the jorogumo is secretly pleased with the proceedings and doesn’t demand that any of the PCs return with her, although she hints that, come time to tithe on the last day of spring, she intends to take some or all of them with her to her palace. Without another word, she returns to her palanquin and her servants carry her to the edge of town, where all of them fade away into nothingness. Any PCs she has taken with her at this point, of course, are now free to return to their lives without repercussion.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.4XeiNtVFiMN4bZqt]{Hardwood Chest}
If the PCs accrued at least 12 Influence Points, a hardwood chest is left behind when the procession fades away at the edge of town. The chest contains six moonstones worth 25 gp each, a greater persona mask, and a desolation locket. Additionally, the four silver collars worn by her phantasmal servants remain behind. If the PCs aren’t there to witness her exit, a villager happens across the treasure and brings it to the PCs in a few days.

This treasure, along with any rewards Lady Ren gave out during the influence encounter (including any silver collars she demanded a PC wear), persist after the encounter is over, even though the jorogumo herself was merely a thoughtform manifested by the mindscape.

Reward: If Lady Ren leaves town without a fight, grant the PCs 160 XP and [[/r 1d4]] Hope Points.

Influence Rounds.name: 影响轮 Influence Rounds
Influence Rounds.text:
影响轮

这场遭遇的六轮如下进行。

第 1 轮（1 分钟）这一轮从任美璃到来并向队伍致意开始。她预期自己会收到一份礼物，如果玩家角色没有立刻奉上，她就会索要。价值至少 50 gp 的礼物才符合她的标准，并会立刻让玩家角色获得 1 影响点。价值低于这个数额的礼物（或者根本没有礼物）她也会收下，但会虚情假意地评论说，这样的供奉对于这样一个出身低微的城镇来说已经完全可以接受了。不过，把公主一开始的标准定得太高也是有风险的。如果礼物价值超过 100 gp，玩家角色获得 2 影响点，但在第 2 轮期间所有影响检定的难度等级都提高 1。

这一轮只会进行 1 分钟，因此可以在这一轮尝试发现检定，但不能进行影响检定。

第 2 轮（30 分钟）寒暄过后，任女士要求有人陪同她穿过城镇，让她看看四周景色。她乘坐肩舆，由脖子上戴着银项圈的仆役抬着——和先前到来的信使一样，这些仆役（以及他们的银项圈）并不是真正活着的生物，而只是任女士心灵的沉默延伸。络新妇公主并未携带武器，而且显然认为自己根本不可能遭到袭击，不过即使没有同伴，任女士依然极其危险。

任女士在穿行这片区域时会打量镇民。她要求所有村民都向她俯身，以表示自己的地位较低，哪怕（或者说尤其是）他们因为年老或其他身体限制而不易弯腰也是如此。她很乐意伸出一条蜘蛛腿，强行按着别人低头。

一路上，她还会对城镇评头论足。她那些尖酸刻薄的话其实都是含沙射影的侮辱——除非柳岸镇的安全点少于 6，否则还算有所掩饰；若少于 6，她就会公开嘲笑受损的建筑、动物粪便或失修的道路（导致失去 1 希望点）。

第 3 轮（10 分钟）任女士会跟随玩家角色前往他们为接待她而选择的地点，但无论选了哪里，她都会公开质疑他们的决定：如果玩家角色带她去茶馆，她会问他们为何不去总督庄园；如果带她去总督庄园，她又会评论说茶馆看起来明明更讨人喜欢。若在她落座前没有先奉上一杯热茶，这位络新妇便会指出这种怠慢，并怀疑他们是否就是这样对待贵客的。这是任女士设下的一个圈套——在门口奉上热饮，是一条非常古老的礼仪，在龙华帝国时期就已经不再流行了。若玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[society|dc:24] 或 @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] 检定，便知道这一事实，但任女士会对别人指出她错了或过时了这件事感到些微不快。

第 4 轮（30 分钟）如果有人向任女士献上葡萄酒或任何其他酒精饮品，她都会拒绝，转而要求喝茶。茶正在准备时，她会询问茶壶与茶杯的历史，显然期待听到一番分量十足的回答，不过若没人答得出来，她也不会当场发作。

茶端上来后，任女士会再耍一次手段，质问为何侍者在为她奉茶时没有跪下。若玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[society|dc:24] 或 @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] 检定，便知道虽然这在礼仪上技术性地说没错，但实际上只有婚礼时才会这样做。和之前一样，她会对别人指出她有误这件事感到些微不快。

在这一轮中，一名玩家角色可以通过一次成功的 @Check[crafting|dc:24] 或 @Check[tea-lore|dc:24] 检定来影响任女士。这不计入他们本轮的行动。如果他们放弃这次检定或检定失败，络新妇就会假装被热茶烫到嘴唇，把茶摔到地上，然后指控玩家角色故意把茶泡得太烫。玩家角色必须要么成功通过一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] 检定来平息此事，要么做出允许备茶者受罚的样子——若两者都没做到，就会失去 2 影响点。一次 @Check[deception|dc:28] 检定可以伪造这场惩罚；否则，任女士会递给奉茶者一个银项圈，命令其戴上。

第 5 轮（30 分钟）任女士享用为她准备的茶点与食物时，如果英雄们表现得太好，她反而会变得不悦。如果玩家角色进行到这一轮，而任女士还没能折磨或惩罚至少一人，那么此后所有影响检定的难度等级都提高 1（可与其他任何难度等级提升累加）。

第 6 轮（1 小时）任女士会问她是否能期待一些餐后娱乐。每名玩家角色都可以立刻进行一次免费的影响检定，可使用表演、用特技翻腾、用运动展示力量，或任何他们能合理说明、足以满足这位挑剔观众标准的其他技能。在大成功时，任女士会高兴得要求表演者在今年晚些时候前去她家中拜访，并送给他们一个银项圈。

Influence Rounds

The six rounds of this encounter play out as follows.

Round 1 (1 minute) This round plays out as Ren Mei Li arrives and greets the party. She expects to be presented with a gift, demanding one if the PCs don’t offer it immediately. A gift worth at least 50 gp meets her standards and immediately grants the PCs 1 Influence Point. A gift worth less than that (or no gift at all) is accepted with an insincere comment that such an offering is perfectly acceptable for such a lowborn town. There’s a risk to setting the princess’s initial standards too high, however. If the gift is worth more than 100 gp, the PCs gain 2 Influence Points, but the DCs of all Influence checks during round 2 increase by 1.

This round takes only a minute to play out, and as a result, Discovery checks can be attempted during this round but Influence checks can’t.

Round 2 (30 minutes) After the greetings, Lady Ren asks to be escorted through town so she can take in the sights. She’s carried in a palanquin by servants who wear silver collars around their necks—like the messenger who arrived earlier, these servants (and their silver collars) aren’t actual living creatures but merely silent extensions of Lady Ren’s psyche. The jorogumo princess is unarmed and clearly considers it inconceivable that she might be attacked, though even without allies, Lady Ren is still extremely dangerous.

Lady Ren takes stock of the townsfolk as she travels through the area. She expects all of the villagers to stoop before her in order to indicate their lower status, even (or especially) if they can’t easily bend due to age or other physical limitations. She’s quite happy to reach out a spider leg and force someone to bow.

As they go, she comments on the town. Her snarky remarks are thinly veiled insults—unless Willowshore has fewer than 6 Security Points, in which case she openly mocks the damaged buildings, animal excrement, or unkempt roads (resulting in a loss of 1 Hope Point).

Round 3 (10 minutes) Lady Ren follows the PCs to the location they’ve chosen to receive her, though she openly questions their decision, no matter what it is: if the PCs take her to the tea house, she asks why they don’t go to the governor’s manor, while if brought to the governor’s manor, she comments that the tea house looked far more inviting. If allowed to be seated without first being given a cup of hot tea, the jorogumo comments on the slight and wonders if this is how they treat their honored guests. This is a ploy on Lady Ren’s part—offering a hot drink at the door is a very old piece of etiquette that fell out of favor during Imperial Lung Wa. With a successful @Check[society|dc:24] or @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] check, a PC is aware of this fact, but Lady Ren takes slight offense at being told she’s incorrect or outdated.

Round 4 (30 minutes) Lady Ren refuses wine or any other alcohol if offered, instead requesting tea. She asks about the history of the tea pot and cup while the tea is prepared, clearly expecting a significant answer but not acting out if one isn’t provided.

When served tea, Lady Ren attempts another ploy, asking why her servers didn’t kneel to serve her. With a successful @Check[society|dc:24] or @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] check, a PC knows that while this is technically correct etiquette, it’s only done for weddings. As before, she takes slight offense at being told she’s incorrect.

For this round, one PC can attempt to Influence Lady Ren with a successful @Check[crafting|dc:24] or @Check[tea-lore|dc:24] check. This doesn’t count as their action for the round. If they forgo this check or fail, the jorogumo pretends to burn her lips on the tea and throws it to the ground before accusing the PCs of making the tea too hot on purpose. The PCs must either succeed at a @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] check to smooth the incident over or make a show of allowing the tea preparer to be punished—failure to do either results in a loss of 2 Influence Points. A @Check[deception|dc:28] check can fake the punishment; otherwise, Lady Ren offers a silver collar to the tea server, demanding they put it on.

Round 5 (30 minutes) While enjoying the tea and food prepared for her, Lady Ren grows cross if the heroes perform too well. If the PCs reach this round and Lady Ren hasn’t managed to torment or punish at least one person, the DCs of all further Influence checks are raised by 1 (cumulative with any other DC increases).

Round 6 (1 hour) Lady Ren asks if she can expect any post-meal entertainment. Each PC can immediately attempt a free Influence check using Performance, Acrobatics to tumble, Athletics to display a feat of strength, or any other skill they can justify to meet the standards of such a fussy audience. On a critical success, Lady Ren is so pleased she demands the performer visit her at her home later in the year, and she gives them a silver collar.

Influencing Ren Mei Li.name: 影响任美璃 Influencing Ren Mei Li
Influencing Ren Mei Li.text:
影响任美璃

任美璃没有带任何护卫前来，以显示她的自信与优越感；她认为带着守卫只会显得自己软弱且缺乏信心。她以自己真正的形态傲慢现身，并要求玩家角色先带她四处看看，再送她去他们决定举行会面的地点；镇中的长老陪同他们，但在这次事件中几乎无事可做、无话可说，因为他很清楚，这件事只有玩家角色能够处理。
