这场影响遭遇会持续6轮，每一轮都会包含可能使情况更加复杂的额外要素；这6轮的列表见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11influencerou00]{此处}。

任美璃

  • 中型
  • 类人生物

令人生畏的络新妇公主

察觉 +18

意志 +18

发现 @Check[jorogumo-lore|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[diplomacy|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[society|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[perception|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover]

影响技能 @Check[performance|dc:22|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[diplomacy|dc:24|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[occultism|dc:26|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[deception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[intimidation|dc:30|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]

影响 4 任女士因为玩家角色如此善于施加影响、破坏了她的游戏而变得恼火。每名玩家角色都应尝试一次@Check[diplomacy|dc:24]。如果没有任何玩家角色在此次检定中成功，她就会对一名随机玩家角色施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{流放诅咒}（@Check[will|dc:34]豁免）。如果玩家角色发动攻击，见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11partingways000]{分道扬镳}。

影响 8 任女士解释说，如今络新妇掌权后，柳岸镇将会发生怎样的变化。首先，她要求向络新妇进贡，且必须在每年春末的肆季鬼志仪式期间缴纳；这项要求不容谈判。其次，她要求所有居住在村中或进入村庄的天狗立刻被处决。第三，她宣布所有镇民都不再被允许阅读或书写，所有书籍都必须上交给络新妇保管。最后，村中的所有钱币和桃木都必须被销毁，以免金钱腐化凡人的内心。她宽宏大量地允许小镇在春季最后一天、首次贡品到期前，完成所有这些需求。

由于任女士只是一个心景复制体，而且这片心景每年春末都会重复出现，最简单的做法就是全心全意地赞同她，等她离开后再无视她的法令——这会让她很满意，之后所有针对她的影响检定都获得+1状态加值。若玩家角色愿意，也可以尝试与她谈判。她愿意这样做，但有一个例外，那就是向络新妇进贡——没有这样的供奉，任女士就无法保证她的同族不会加害。若玩家角色选择谈判，任美璃此时会同意移除她提出的三项非进贡要求中的一项，由玩家角色自行选择。

影响 12 @UUID[Actor.9aNWoy10kwDSkvoB]{任女士之戒}
任女士询问有关丹杉的事情。玩家角色可以毫无风险、毫无损失地声称自己一无所知，因为任女士并不指望这些乡野之人能知道什么有用的事。玩家角色也可以选择用真相满足她的好奇，或用谎言向她大讲特讲（与其他情况不同，她的减值在这里不适用）。从任女士的举止中可以明显看出，她对这棵树以及它可能关联之物怀有不祥的兴趣。如果玩家角色告诉她真相，她会明确表示希望这棵树受到保护，并赠予玩家角色一枚信使戒指，以便在出现任何问题时使用。

如果玩家角色在影响 8 时选择谈判，任美璃会同意移除她所要求的三项非进贡条件中的第二项。

影响 16 @UUID[Actor.WI67Nu8en7gpWs8R]{任女士的尘土}
尽管希望渺茫，玩家角色还是成功让任美璃女士相信，她自身的存在也和他们一样正处于危险之中。违背她的本性，她给了他们一袋内含四份尸体活化粉尘 的粉末，用以帮助保护小镇。

如果玩家角色在影响 8 时选择谈判，任美璃会同意移除她所要求的三项非进贡条件中的第三项。

抗力 任美璃厌恶桃木和天狗。任何一者的明显存在都会冒犯她；她要求将桃木物品烧毁，并立刻处决任何天狗（例如八哥 川冈或松）。任何是天狗或明显持有桃木物品的人，都会使所有影响她的DC提高2。幸运的是，任女士并不要求亲眼见证这两项任务中的任何一项，因此只要装作逮捕一名天狗或把那件冒犯她的物品拖走处理，就足以安抚她。如果玩家角色拒绝，之后所有针对她的影响检定DC都会提高2。

她也嫉妒迷人而漂亮的女性。此类玩家角色进行影响尝试时，DC提高2。玩家角色若以她的察觉DC成功进行一次欺瞒检定来伪装自己，便可消除此妨碍；自愿毁伤自己的脸也同样可以。

弱点 富有魅力、外表英俊的男性进行影响尝试时，DC降低2。然而，若这样一名男性在影响她时大失败，任女士会宣称他将在她离开时跟她一起走，然后给他一个银项圈佩戴（见@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11partingways000]{分道扬镳}）。

任女士很喜欢镇上蜘蛛守护者的蛛形态，尽管她尽力不表现出来。与丑萌相关的交谈会使影响她的DC降低2。然而，如果告诉任女士这只蜘蛛被称作“丑”，会激起她明显的轻蔑冷笑，并使该收益在之后失效。

背景 在美璃数不清的姐妹中，她是仅有的五个熬过第一年的幸存者之一。按络新妇的标准来看，这已算是一个大家庭。虽然任女士知道自己比不上神门中最强大的那些络新妇，但她希望为自己开辟出一片安全而舒适的领地。

外观 美璃举止优雅，留着一头盘成雅致发式的黑色长发，其间点缀着花朵与发簪。她身着刺绣长袍，并尽力不让自己类人部分的身体沾上一丝尘土。

Personality 这个古老版本的任美璃女士，是一个玩弄猎物的怪物。她打算把倒霉的农民卷入无解的社交困境之中，然后将惩罚作为这场病态游戏的一部分施加在他们身上。

减值 任女士对最终着眼于阴司察夕那丝绸宫廷中的背叛与权谋并不陌生。每当一名玩家角色未能对她公然说谎时（不包括出于奉承的善意谎言和更为微妙的欺骗），她都会立刻对其施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{读心术}（@Check[will|dc:34]豁免）。如果该玩家角色此次豁免失败，她就能预判对方接下来的手段，使其下一次影响检定的结果自动降低一个等级。若大成功，该玩家角色会立刻如同成功进行了一个发现检定般，获知关于她的一条信息。

银项圈

任女士的银项圈看上去或许不过是些虚荣的小饰物，但信藏，或任何在络新妇学识或柳岸镇学识上达到专家及以上的玩家角色，都能认出它们远比表面看起来更有价值。归属于络新妇的凡人会被银项圈标记；项圈可以锁在凡人的脖子上，使其无法取下。任女士本打算在带着她的战利品回家后这么做，但显然因为她一离开柳岸镇便不复存在而受阻。如今在现代神门，这些项圈非常抢手，因为它们表明佩戴者被允许自由旅行、被允许阅读和书写，并且能够与外来者自由贸易。玩家角色可以在第4幕重返生者生活时佩戴这些项圈，以获取显而易见的社交优势。每个项圈价值50 gp，且可按全价出售。

Influencing Ren Mei Li

Ren Mei Li arrives without any bodyguards as a show of her confidence and superiority, believing that bringing a guard makes her look weak and unconfident. She imperiously arrives in her true form and requests the PCs show her around before taking her to wherever they’ve decided to host the meeting; the town elder accompanies them but has little to do or say during this event, knowing full well that this matter is something only the PCs can handle.

This influence encounter plays out over the course of 6 rounds, each of which includes additional elements that might complicate things; a list of the 6 rounds starts @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11influencerou00]{Here}.

Ren Mei Li

  • Medium
  • Humanoid

Intimidating jorogumo princess

Perception +18

Will +18

Discovery @Check[jorogumo-lore|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[diplomacy|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[society|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[perception|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover]

Influence Skills @Check[performance|dc:22|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[diplomacy|dc:24|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[occultism|dc:26|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[deception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[intimidation|dc:30|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]

Influence 4 Lady Ren becomes annoyed that the PCs are ruining her game by being so influential. Each PC should attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:24]. If no PC succeeds at this check, she casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{Outcast's Curse} (@Check[will|dc:34] save) on a random PC. If the PCs attack, see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11partingways000]{Parting Ways}.

Influence 8 Lady Ren explains how things will change in Willowshore now that jorogumo are in charge. Firstly, she demands tithes to the jorogumo, to be paid every year during the season of ghosts ritual at the end of each spring; this stipulation is nonnegotiable. Secondly, she demands all tengu who live in or enter the village be executed immediately. Thirdly, she declares that all townsfolk are no longer permitted to read or write, and all books must be turned over to the jorogumo for safekeeping. Finally, all coins and peachwood in the village are to be destroyed, so as to avoid the temptation of money corrupting the hearts of mortals. She graciously allows the town until the first tithe is due on the last day of spring to meet these all of these requirements.

Since Lady Ren is a mindscape duplicate, and since the mindscape repeats every year at the end of spring, the easiest thing is to agree with her wholeheartedly and then ignore her decrees once she leaves—this pleases her, and all future Influence checks against her gain a +1 status bonus. If they wish, the PCs can attempt to negotiate. She’s willing to do so, but the one exception is the tithes to the jorogumo—Lady Ren can’t offer safety from her kin without such an offering. If the PCs choose to negotiate, Mei Li agrees to remove one of the three non-tithe stipulations of the PCs’ choice at this time.

Influence 12 @UUID[Actor.9aNWoy10kwDSkvoB]{Lady Ren's Ring}
Lady Ren inquiries about the Tan Sugi. The PCs can plead ignorance without any risk or loss, as Lady Ren doesn’t expect the rural folk to know anything of use. The PCs can also choose to indulge her curiosity with the truth or regale her with falsehoods (unlike other instances, her Penalty doesn’t apply here). It’s obvious from Lady Ren’s behavior that she has a sinister interest in the tree and what it might be associated with. If the PCs tell her the truth, she makes it clear that she wishes the tree to be protected and gives the PCs a messenger’s ring in case any issues arise.

If the PCs chose to negotiate at Influence 8, Ren Mei Li agrees to remove a second of the three non-tithe stipulations she demanded.

Influence 16 @UUID[Actor.WI67Nu8en7gpWs8R]{Lady Ren's Dust}
Against all odds, the PCs have convinced Lady Ren Mei Li that her own existence is just as much in danger as their own. Against her nature, she gives them a bag containing four doses of dust of corpse animation to help protect the town.

If the PCs chose to negotiate at Influence 8, Ren Mei Li agrees to remove the third of the three non-tithe stipulations she demanded.

Resistances Ren Mei Li hates peachwood and tengu. The obvious presence of either offends her; she demands that peachwood items are burned and any tengu (such as Myna Kawaka or Matsu) be executed immediately. Anyone who is a tengu or in clear possession of a peachwood item increases all DCs to Influence her by 2. Fortunately, Lady Ren doesn’t demand to witness either of these tasks personally, so making a show of arresting a tengu or hauling off the offending item is enough to placate her. If the PCs refuse, all future Influence check DCs against her increase by 2.

She’s also jealous of charming and pretty women. Influence attempts performed by such PCs increase the DC by 2. A PC who succeeds at a Deception check to disguise themself against her Perception DC can negate this impediment, as can willingly scarring their own face.

Weaknesses Influence attempts by charismatic, attractive men decrease the DC by 2. However, on a critical failure made to Influence by such a man, Lady Ren declares he will come with her when she leaves, then gives them a silver collar to wear (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11partingways000]{Parting Ways}).

Lady Ren is delighted by the arachnid form of the town’s spider guardian, though she tries her best not to show it. Conversation relating to Ugly Cute reduces the DC to Influence her by 2. However, informing Lady Ren that the spider is known as “ugly” provokes an open sneer and negates the benefit going forward.

Background Of Mei Li’s countless sisters, she was one of only five to survive their first year. This is considered a large family by jorogumo standards. While Lady Ren knows she isn’t a match for the most powerful jorogumo in Shenmen, she hopes to carve out a secure and comfortable territory for herself.

Appearance Mei Li is graceful, with long black hair worn up in an elegant style, adorned with flowers and pins. She’s dressed in an embroidered robe and does her best to never let any part of her humanoid body touch dirt.

Personality This ancient version of Lady Ren Mei Li is a monster toying with her prey. She intends to catch hapless peasants in impossible social situations and then punish them as part of a sick game.

Penalty Lady Ren is no stranger to the betrayals and the politicking of the silken courts of Yin-Sichasi. Any time a PC fails to outright lie to her (excepting white lies for flattery and more subtle deceptions), she immediately casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} on them (@Check[will|dc:34] save). If a PC fails this save, she can anticipate their next tactic, automatically reducing the result of their next Influence check by one step. On a critical success, the PC immediately learns one piece of information about her as though they’d succeeded at a Discovery check.

Silver Collars

While Lady Ren’s silver collars might seem like little more than vain trinkets, Shinzo or a PC who’s an Expert or better in Jorogumo Lore or Willowshore Lore recognizes them as far more valuable. Mortals who belong to a jorogumo are marked by a silver collar, which can be locked around the mortal’s neck so that it can’t be removed. Lady Ren intended to do so when she returned home with her prizes but was obviously stymied by ceasing to exist when she left Willowshore. These collars are avidly sought in modern Shenmen, for they indicate that the wearer is permitted to travel freely, is allowed to read and write, and can trade freely with outsiders. The PCs can wear these collars to reap the obvious social advantages when they return to life in Act 4. Each collar is worth 50 gp and can be sold for full price.

Preparing for the Visit.name: 为来访做准备 Preparing for the Visit
Preparing for the Visit.text:
为来访做准备

一旦玩家角色得知任美璃女士即将来访，他们就只有大约8小时来为她的到来做好准备。如果他们向柳岸镇的其他人征求建议，胡婆婆会明确表示，端上的茶和点心必须无可挑剔，而且要符合时令；但她也警告说，任女士很可能会提出一些不合理的要求，只是为了炫耀自己的权势。松木老人则建议把这位公主灌醉，或者如果做不到，至少要确保所有迎接她的人都穿着华美，同时让自己的面容保持朴素或加以遮掩。玩家角色可以尝试一次@Check[diplomacy|dc:22|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information]，或者通过@Check[society|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]来回忆知识；若成功，某位玩家角色会注意到，络新妇厌恶天狗，憎恨桃木，试图确保神门的居民始终与世隔绝且不识字，并且往往会出于嫉妒而吃掉俊美的年轻男子、毁伤漂亮的女子。若大成功，该玩家角色还知道，他们应当在任美璃抵达时为她准备一份至少价值50 gp的礼物。

本冒险默认玩家角色会准备一处他们已经投入资源维护的地点，例如青天茶馆，来接待任美璃。为此，他们必须完成“为贵胄做准备”行动。

玩家角色也有可能会对与络新妇这样的怪物合作感到愤懑。在这种情况下，他们的非玩家角色盟友会警告他们，无论他们个人怎么看，络新妇都是一股强大的政治力量，而且看起来她们注定会变得更加强大。在这种情况下，最好先放下分歧，与来访的公主合作；但如果玩家角色拒绝好好配合，那么等到@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11partingways000]{Part Ways}时，视为他们没有从任美璃那里获得任何影响点。

为贵胄做准备

  • 探索

玩家角色中的一人花费8小时准备一处选定地点，以接待任女士。其他玩家角色可以协助这次检定，但如果没有任何玩家角色尝试进行这次准备检定，则视同他们在此行动中大失败。该玩家角色必须进行一次@Check[crafting|dc:24]、@Check[society|dc:24]或@Check[tea-lore|dc:24]检定。如果玩家角色选择的地点并非在整个战役过程中逐步建设起来的，则这次检定承受–4环境减值。

大成功 在此次遭遇期间，玩家角色进行的所有影响检定获得+1环境加值。

成功 玩家角色准备好了地点，但为了布置妥当，不得不动用了储备物资。食物点数减少1点。

失败 如同成功，但食物点数减少[[/r 1d4+1]]点。

大失败 如同失败，但由于准备得过于寒酸，玩家角色在此次遭遇期间进行的所有影响检定承受–2环境减值。

Preparing for the Visit

Once the PCs learn that Lady Ren Mei Li is coming to visit, they have only about 8 hours to get things ready for her arrival. If they ask others in Willowshore for advice, Granny Hu makes it clear that the tea and snacks served must be both impeccable and seasonally appropriate, but she warns that Lady Ren will probably make a few unreasonable demands just to flex her power. Old Matsuki suggests getting the princess drunk or, failing that, making sure everyone greeting her is beautifully dressed while keeping their faces plain or obscured. The PCs can attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:22|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] or to Recall Knowledge with @Check[society|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]; on a success, a PC notes that jorogumo despise tengu, hate peachwood, seek to ensure that the citizens of Shenmen are kept isolated and illiterate, and tend to eat beautiful young men and maim pretty women out of jealousy. On a critical success, the PC also knows they should prepare a gift worth at least 50 gp for Lady Ren when she arrives.

This adventure assumes the PCs prepare a site they’ve already put resources into maintaining, such as the Cerulean Teahouse, to receive Lady Ren. To do so, they must complete the Prepare for Royalty activity.

It’s possible that the PCs might take umbrage to the idea of working with a monster like a jorogumo. In this case their NPC allies warn them that regardless of their personal views, the jorogumo are a powerful political force, and it seems like they’re destined to grow more powerful. It’s best, in this case, to set aside their differences and work with the visiting princess, but if the PCs refuse to play nice, treat it as if they earned no Influence points with Ren Mei Li when the time comes to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11partingways000]{Part Ways}.

Prepare for Royalty

  • Exploration

One of the PCs spends 8 hours preparing a chosen site to host Lady Ren. Other PCs can Aid this check, but if no PC even attempts the check to prepare, then treat it as if they’d critically failed at this activity. The PC must attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:24], @Check[society|dc:24], or @Check[tea-lore|dc:24] check. This check takes a –4 circumstance penalty if the site the PCs choose hasn’t been built up over the course of the campaign.

Critical Success The PCs gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all Influence checks during this encounter.

Success The PCs prepare the site but had to dip into the stores to get everything set up. Reduce Food Points by 1.

Failure As success, but reduce Food Points by [[/r 1d4+1]].

Critical Failure As Failure, but the shabby job causes the PCs to take a –2 circumstance penalty to all Influence checks during this encounter.

Event 13. Interview with a Spider.name: 事件13：与蜘蛛的会面 Event 13. Interview with a Spider
Event 13. Interview with a Spider.text:
事件13：与蜘蛛的会面 中等 8

正如死神信藏先前警告的那样，络新妇公主任美璃的一个“版本”最终会来到城镇，但很可能要到PC们完成@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{第10章}很久之后才会发生，因为她的来访发生在本幕的第71天，也就是第72天农历新年开始的前一天。如果由于你的游戏时间安排，PC们此时仍在进行第10章，那么你应当让这一事件发生在PC们返回柳岸镇之后、但在他们开始施放5环版本的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生术}前一天。

任美璃是琅蕾夫人宫廷中的众多高阶成员之一。有关琅蕾夫人夺取神门的传言已经传到了柳岸镇，但请记住，从PC们的视角来看，这一变故只发生在一年前，而到目前为止，络新妇女王还没有将注意力转向柳岸镇。在现世中，派往柳岸镇的先遣侦查者发现那里已是一片死寂，而当他们向任美璃回报后，她便亲自前往这片废墟展开调查。

虽然任美璃最终在现场除了可供劫掠、作为献给琅蕾夫人的供品的大量宝藏外，并未发现任何值得注意的东西，但她针对柳岸镇毁灭原因所做的异能研究，却将她的心灵复制到了心景之中，而她自己对此并不知情。PC们在下一幕中也会遭遇任美璃，而他们在此处如何处理第一次会面，可能会让他们在返回现世后占得优势。

任美璃的来访始于日出时分一个陌生人进入镇中。这个英俊的年轻男子戴着银项圈，前去寻找柳岸镇的镇长老，告知对方这座城镇如今已处于琅蕾夫人的统治之下；她的一位公主——任女士——将在今晚抵达；而柳岸镇应当做好准备迎接这位新来的王族。这位古怪的使者明确表示，任美璃期待获得王室规格的欢迎，尽管柳岸镇过于偏僻贫穷，根本不可能在如此短的时间内办到。这一举动是任美璃残酷的游戏——她打算一次又一次地让村民无法满足她的要求，从而将他们逼入绝望与恐慌之中，最后再因他们的失败而惩罚他们。无论如何，这位神秘来客在带来消息后不久便会消散，因为他本身不过是络新妇公主的一个先驱思念体。

这则消息让镇长老措手不及——不仅仅是遇见陌生人本身就令人震惊，听到神门如今已由一只络新妇统治的确认消息更是骇人。镇长老非常清楚，PC们是唯一有可能安抚这位公主或对其构成威胁的人，因此很快联系他们，告知他们今晚将要发生的事。假如PC们一直在为青天茶馆的维护投入心力，镇长老会觉得那里是接待任女士的最佳地点，不过若PC们提出建议，其他选择或许也行得通。

请注意，虽然任美璃在即将到来的拜访中会以真正的络新妇之身现身，但这名使者，以及陪同她的其余仆役，都不过是她心灵的显现，并非独立的生物。与其说他们是活着的生物，不如说他们更像是可见的幻影仆从。

Event 13: Interview with a Spider Moderate 8

As the shinigami, Shinzo, previously warned, a “version” of the jorogumo princess Ren Mei Li eventually comes to town, but likely not until well after the PCs have completed @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{Chapter 10}, for her visit takes place on the 71st day of the act, one day before the lunar new year begins on day 72. If, due to the timing of your game, the PCs are still playing through Chapter 10 at this time, you should have this event take place after the PCs return to Willowshore but a day before they begin casting the 5th-level version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate}.

Ren Mei Li is one of many high-ranking members of Lang Loi’s court. Rumors of Lang Loi’s takeover of Shenmen have reached Willowshore, but remember that from the PCs’ perspective, this development only happened a year ago, and so far, the jorogumo queen hasn’t yet turned her attention to Willowshore. In the living world, the advance scouts sent to Willowshore found the place dead, and when they reported back to Ren Mei Li, she traveled to the ruins to investigate them herself.

While Ren Mei Li eventually found nothing of note on-site other than a fair amount of treasure to loot as offerings to Lady Lang Loi, her occult research into the cause of Willowshore’s doom copied her psyche into the mindscape, though she’s unaware of this. The PCs will encounter Ren Mei Li in the next act as well, and how they handle their first meeting here might give them an advantage once they return to the world of the living.

Ren Mei Li’s visit begins with the arrival of a stranger in town at sunrise. This handsome young man wears a silver collar and seeks out Willowshore’s town elder to inform them that the town is now under the rulership of Lady Lang Loi; that one of her princesses, Lady Ren, shall be arriving this very evening; and that Willowshore should make itself ready to receive the new royalty. The strange messenger makes it clear that Ren Mei Li expects to receive a royal welcome, despite Willowshore being far too rustic and poor to provide such a thing on short notice. This move is a cruel game on Ren Mei Li’s part—she intends to drive the villagers into despair and panic as they inevitably fall short of her demands again and again before finally punishing them for their failures. In any event, the mysterious visitor fades away soon after bringing the news, himself merely a precursor thoughtform of the jorogumo princess.

This news catches the town elder off guard—not only is it a shock to encounter a stranger, but hearing confirmation that Shenmen is now ruled by a jorogumo is frightening indeed. The town elder is keenly aware that the PCs are the only people who might actually placate or threaten the princess and quickly contacts them to let them know what’s coming that evening. Assuming the PCs have put effort into the upkeep of the Cerulean Teahouse, the town elder feels it’s the best place to receive Lady Ren, but other options might work at the PCs’ suggestion.

Note that while Ren Mei Li appears in the upcoming visit as an actual jorogumo, this messenger, as well as the rest of the servants who accompany her, are little more than manifestations of her psyche and are not individual creatures. They are more akin to visible phantasmal minions than they are to living creatures.

Ending the Seance.name: 结束通灵仪式 Ending the Seance
Ending the Seance.text:
结束通灵仪式

一旦驱邪师们完成仪式（且所有PC的影响轮都已用尽），曹辰会念出最后一段祷文，然后用他的火把轻轻敲击上方的铃。铃声因这样轻微的一击而显得出乎意料地震耳欲聋，PC们会被猛然抛回他们在柳岸镇中开始降神仪式时所在的位置。回返之际，他们一阵眩晕，必须尝试进行一次 @Check[will|dc:24] 豁免，以抵抗陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}）。随后，他们发现，在过去几分钟里，他们一直失去意识地躺在地板上，毫无反应。这样的发展可能已经惊动了附近的镇民；而当PC们醒来时，他们很可能要面对铺天盖地的疑问。PC们可以随心回答，但必须谨慎行事，并进行一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:24] 检定；失败会使镇民担心自己可能会成为这些驱邪师下一个召来的对象，而柳岸镇失去 [[/r 1d4]] 希望点。

场景注记音效

@UUID[Playlist.0GuH1kstxWaqGSJx.PlaylistSound.1v8fZOWDIQO6erYk]{Ending the Seance}

PC们回来后会意识到，不知为何，他们在降神仪式期间见到的那口铃已经灌注了柳岸镇长明灯的光芒，这证实了那盏提灯在生者的世界中必然已经熄灭。只要这种情况持续，他们就只能施放4环版本的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生术}。

奖励：如果PC们与至少一名驱邪师总共获得了4点影响点，给予他们80 XP。若他们在全部三名驱邪师之间获得了全部12点可能的影响点，则改为给予英雄们120 XP。

Ending the Seance

Once the exorcists finish (and all of the PCs’ influence rounds have been spent), Cao Chen utters a final prayer and then taps the bell above softly with his torch. The sound of the bell ringing out is unexpectedly overwhelming given such a small tap, and the PCs are hurled back to wherever they were in Willowshore when the seance began. As they return, they’re sent reeling and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure). They then discover that, for the past several minutes, they’ve been lying unconscious and unresponsive on the floor. This development might have shocked nearby townsfolk and, when the PCs awaken, they likely face a deluge of questions. The PCs can answer as they wish but must do so delicately with a @Check[diplomacy|dc:24] check; failure causes the townsfolk to worry that they might be the next to be conjured by these exorcists, and Willowshore loses [[/r 1d4]] Hope Points.

Scene NotesSFX

@UUID[Playlist.0GuH1kstxWaqGSJx.PlaylistSound.1v8fZOWDIQO6erYk]{Ending the Seance}

Once the PCs return, they realize that, somehow, the bell they saw during the seance has been infused with the light from Willowshore’s Eternal Lantern, confirming that the lantern must be unlit in the living world. As long as this remains the case, they’ll only be able to cast the 4th-level version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate}.

Reward: If the PCs gained a total of 4 Influence Points with at least one exorcist, grant them 80 XP. If they gained all 12 possible Influence Points among all three exorcists, award the heroes 120 XP instead.

Running the Seance.name: 主持通灵会 Running the Seance
Running the Seance.text:
主持通灵会

这场降神仪式使用影响力子系统（Pathfinder GM Core 187）来进行，每一轮持续数分钟。一轮开始时，由陈向玩家角色提出一个问题（在他眼中，他们只是彼此无法分辨的、模糊闪烁的形体）。每一轮都按以下步骤进行。

步骤 1：陈提出该轮的问题（列于 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11runningthese00#seance-questions]{降神仪式问题}），并随机决定一名玩家角色必须作答（该玩家角色一旦被选中过，之后的轮次中不应再次被选中）。该玩家角色必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:26] 豁免。成功时，小队中的任意一名玩家角色都可以随意回答这个问题；失败时，被指定的玩家角色必须尽可能如实回答该问题。若某名玩家角色被迫如实回答，先询问该玩家想如何作答，再将其答案调整为与下文所列被迫回答的内容在主题上相符。

如果玩家角色在任何回答中提到了苦迦菩提，陈会陷入沉思，思考问题的规模。很明显，他并不识破玩家角色的话，但由于他更倾向于放逐玩家角色和苦迦菩提双方，而不是帮助玩家角色以某种方式重返生命，因此这条信息不会改变玩家角色可能面对的命运。

如果某名玩家角色没有被迫作答，则可由一名玩家角色尝试以一次 @Check[deception|dc:24]、@Check[diplomacy|dc:24] 或 @Check[intimidation|dc:24] 检定来回答（其他玩家角色可以协助这次检定），以决定他们回答的效果。成功时，在步骤 2 中该轮进行的所有影响与发现检定都获得 +2 状态加值（若为大成功，则改为 +4 状态加值）。大失败时，这些检定反而承受 –2 状态减值。

步骤 2：祭司们会花上一点时间吟诵并集中他们的专注，然后才进入下一个问题（或者，若这已经是最后一轮，则集中于结束通灵仪式）。在这段时间里，玩家角色意识到他们与驱邪师之间的灵性联系是双向的，他们能够感知每位祭司的思想。每名玩家角色都可以尝试对自己选择的那位驱邪师进行影响或发现其相关信息。当一名驱邪师被成功影响时，玩家角色的存在会使其说出不合时宜的话，或做出出乎意料的举动，从而向玩家角色泄露比他们本意更多的信息。每位驱邪师会泄露什么内容，取决于队伍在其身上累计了多少影响点，详见下方三个影响数据表。

降神仪式问题

祭司们在降神仪式中向玩家角色提出的四个问题如下——请注意，玩家角色回答了什么、如何回答，并不会太大幅度改变这一幕的走向，但在每个问题之后进行步骤 2 时，当他们反过来对付祭司们时，这些回答能为玩家角色带来优势。

第 1 轮：“你们是谁？”被迫如实回答的玩家角色必须说出自己的名字和其他玩家角色的名字，告知驱邪师他们各自在队伍中的职责，并透露他们是柳岸镇的居民。

第 2 轮：“你们想要什么？”被迫如实回答的玩家角色必须说出类似“我们寻求重返生命”这样的话。若该玩家角色愿意，可以在这个回答上补充更多内容。他们可以借此机会提到，他们想要阻止苦迦菩提逃离死亡。

第 3 轮：“你们为什么还没有离去？”被迫回答的玩家角色必须回答：“我们不能；我们被困在这里了。”同时，他们还可以补充说明自己在心景中所面对危险的更多情况，只要这些内容在玩家角色所知范围内尽可能属实即可。玩家角色可以提到，是苦迦菩提的意志困住了他们。

第 4 轮：“你们是怎么死的？”被迫回答的玩家角色会透露：“当我们的总督试图通过一场仪式囚禁邪魔苦迦菩提却失败时，我们被杀死了。”并可按自己的意愿加以润饰。

Running the Seance

The seance plays out using the influence subsystem (Pathfinder GM Core 187), with each round lasting for a few minutes. A round begins with Chen asking a question of the PCs (who, to him, appear as vague shimmering forms that are indistinguishable from one another). Each round, follow these steps.

Step 1: Chen asks that round’s question (listed in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11runningthese00#seance-questions]{Seance Questions}), and a randomly determined PC is compelled to reply (once selected, that PC shouldn’t be selected on future rounds). That PC must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. On a success, any PC in the group can reply to the question however they want, but on a failure, the targeted PC must reply to the question as truthfully as they can. If a PC is compelled to reply truthfully, ask that player how they would like to answer, then adjust that answer to match, thematically, the compelled answers listed further below.

If the PCs mention Kugaptee in any of their answers, Chen becomes pensive, considering the scope of the problem. It’s clear that he doesn’t disbelieve the PCs, but since his inclination is to banish both the PCs and Kugaptee, rather than helping the PCs somehow restore themselves to life, this information won’t change the PCs’ potential fate.

If a PC isn’t compelled to answer, one PC can attempt to answer with a @Check[deception|dc:24], @Check[diplomacy|dc:24], or @Check[intimidation|dc:24] check (the other PCs can Aid this check) to determine the result of their reply. On a success, all checks attempted to Influence and Discover that round during step 2 gain a +2 status bonus (or a +4 status bonus on a critical success). On a critical failure, these checks instead take a –2 status penalty.

Step 2: The priests spend a few moments chanting and focusing their concentration before moving on to the next question (or, if this is the final round, focusing on ending the seance), during which the PCs realize the spiritual link between them and the exorcists works both ways, and they can sense each priest’s thoughts. Each PC can attempt to Influence or Discover information about the priest of their choice. When an exorcist is successfully Influenced, the PCs’ presence causes them to say something out of turn or take an unanticipated action that reveals more to the PCs than they intend. What every exorcist reveals depends on the number of Influence points the party has accumulated with each one of them, as detailed in the following three Influence stat blocks.

Seance Questions

The four questions the priests ask the PCs during the seance are as follows—note that what and how the PCs reply won’t change the course of this act much, but they can give the PCs advantages when they turn the tables on the priests during step 2 following each question.

Round 1: “Who are you?” A PC compelled to answer truthfully must give their name and the names of the other PCs, inform the exorcists of each of their roles in the party, and reveal that they’re citizens of Willowshore.

Round 2: “What do you want?” A PC compelled to answer truthfully must say something to the effect of, “We seek to come back to life.” Allow the PC to add more to this answer if they wish. They can use this opportunity to mention they seek to oppose Kugaptee’s escape from death.

Round 3: “Why haven’t you moved on?” A compelled PC must answer, “We cannot; we are trapped here,” along with any additional clarifications about the dangers they’ve been facing in the mindscape, as long as they’re truthful to the best of the PCs’ knowledge. A PC can mention that Kugaptee’s will has trapped them.

Round 4: “How did you die?” A compelled PC reveals, “We were slain when our governor failed at a ritual to imprison the fiend Kugaptee,” embellishing that however they wish.

Influence 2 “Fear not, my students. We are perfectly safe here. Without a focused purpose, these century-old phantoms can no more affect the material world than a fish can light a fire.”

Influence 4 “I sense your strength, spirits, but our holy bell, infused with light from your own Eternal Lantern, prevents your fell influence and magic from seeping through to our world. As long as this bell shines in Karahai, you cannot harm us. We have time to be patient and methodical, so you would do well to simply comply and answer our questions truthfully.”

Pan Fenfang

  • Medium
  • Human
  • Humanoid

Nervous exorcist with a secret

Perception +16

Will +18

Discovery @Check[occultism|dc:21|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[perception|dc:23|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[religion|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover]

Influence Skills @Check[deception|dc:21|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[intimidation|dc:23|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[religion|dc:25|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]

Influence 2 “Like most stubborn spirits, these ghosts simply refuse to listen to reason, Master Cao. We must accept that this will be a difficult job and get back to it. Spending time talking is time wasted.” The use of his name prompts a scowl from Cao Chen.

Influence 4 “You have been dead for far too long, spirits. There is nothing that can return you to life beyond the most sinister forms of magic, and we will not permit that. Make peace with your fate and pray that @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} shows mercy for your sins when you stand before her in the Boneyard and are judged.” As she speaks, her face flashes doubt, and the PCs catch a deeper glimpse into her mind—seeing the crimson butterflies that seem to flutter therein. With a successful @Check[occultism|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge, a PC realizes this exorcist is unknowingly influenced by nindorus.

Weakness Fenfang is hiding something from the other two exorcists. Disillusioned with Mago Kai’s methodical approach to purging spirits from Willowshore, Fenfang sought out other sources of divine power. What she believes to be the spirit of Tan Sui-Jing appeared and offered her just that. Unfortunately, this apparition was actually a projection of Kugaptee, drawn to answer her prayers. Fenfang now belongs to a small cult of nindoru followers within the ranks of the exorcists. They still believe that their cause is just, but they haven’t yet come forward about their new patron, as the nindoru keeps whispering in their ears that they must keep this development secret from Mago Kai. While the PCs aren’t sure as to the exact nature of her secret, once they mention the influence of nindorus in the region, Fenfang grows more nervous and all of her Discovery and Influence Skill DCs are reduced by 1. If the PCs mention Kugaptee, these skill DCs are instead all reduced by 2.

Sha “Shagua” Guanghao

  • Medium
  • Human
  • Humanoid

Young and brash exorcist

Perception +14

Will +16

Discovery @Check[occultism|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[perception|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover]

Influence Skills @Check[deception|dc:20|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[diplomacy|dc:24|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]

Influence 2 “But master, if the bell and the light keeps the spirits trapped, why can’t we just ignore them and get to harvesting all the trees in the region?” This question draws an exaggerated eye-roll and a motion to shush from Cao Chen.

Influence 4 “If you try anything funny, Lord Mago will come in here with his magic bell ringer and banish you away! Like this—hwahhh!” Guanghao mimics forcefully ringing a bell and then is slapped on the back of the head by Fenfang, after which Cao Chen says, “That’s not how it works! Did you even read the codex scroll like I told you?”

Event 12. The Seance.name: 事件 12。降神仪式 Event 12. The Seance
Event 12. The Seance.text:
事件12：降神仪式 中等 8

当灵异事件被证明比马戈凯的驱邪师们预料的更加顽强且强大时（这是因为玩家角色从心景内部进行了反击），他们转而采取了一个不那么激进的计划。在第一次驱离精魂的尝试失败大约一个月后，他们如今试图举行一场降神仪式，与其沟通，希望借此进一步了解那些在废墟中作祟的幽灵。

这一事件应当发生在玩家角色开始@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{第10章}之前的某个时间，因为它让队伍第一次真正有机会了解他们在施展转生术时将会面对什么。

生物：由于接连受挫（而这些挫折正是玩家角色造成的），马戈凯的驱邪师们回到了返回柳岸镇的废墟，并举行一场降神仪式来寻求答案。资深驱邪师曹辰主持这场仪式，与他同行的还有两名助手，潘芬芳和沙“傻瓜”广浩。祭司们在唐入的圣祠（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c11shrine00000]{C11}）中进行这场降神仪式。

场景注记氛围

@UUID[Playlist.h82ztCVRXELKQI8K]{降神仪式}

当降神仪式开始时，玩家角色突然感觉自己被猛地拽离，穿过一层层现实，仿佛正以极快的速度飞掠柳岸镇、森林，然后进入一间没有窗户的小房间。房间里燃烧的火把发出昏暗光芒，其中大部分空间都被一口从天花板悬挂下来的巨大青铜庙钟占据。五个装着彩色鸟儿的小笼子被摆成一个大圆，圆圈内部地面上放着数量与玩家角色人数相等的卷轴。忽明忽暗却又莫名熟悉的光芒自上方的钟体洒下，照亮那些卷轴，并将玩家角色困在圆圈之中。在这场遭遇中，除下文提到的内容外，玩家角色不能采取任何动作。

允许每名玩家角色尝试一次@Check[perception|dc:24]检定；成功者会意识到自己是从柳岸镇被拉向东方，进入了唐入海岸要塞内某处的一间密室。接着，每名玩家角色都可以尝试一次@Check[occultism|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或@Check[religion|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定，以回忆知识，注意到他们出现在某种降神仪式的中心，而他们头顶上的庙钟是一件能够防护幽灵的强大圣物。他们还可以判断出，这口钟的存在会干扰任何来自精魂或不死生物源头的魔法。

片刻之后，三名祭司的幽灵影像显现出来，他们都穿着与本幕第一次遭遇中相同的黑袖绯红长袍，只是这一次没有戴上那种骇人的四眼面具。曹辰是一名中年秃顶的人类男子，芬芳是一名右脸颊带着旧伤疤的中年人类女性，而广浩则是一名留着修整整齐胡须的年轻人类男子。

Event 12: The Seance Moderate 8

When the hauntings proved to be more tenacious and powerful than Mago Kai’s exorcists expected (as a result of the PCs fighting back from within the mindscape), they turned to a less aggressive plan. About a month after their first failed attempt to drive off the spirits, they now seek to perform a seance to communicate with them in hopes of learning more about the ghosts that haunt the ruins.

This event should take place at some time before the PCs begin @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{Chapter 10} since it gives the party their first real chance to learn about what to expect when they transmigrate.

Creatures: Confounded at their setbacks (caused by the PCs), Mago Kai’s exorcists return to Willowshore’s ruins and engage in a seance to get some answers. Senior exorcist Cao Chen leads the ceremony and is joined by two of his assistants, Pan Fenfang and Sha “Shagua” Guanghao. The priests perform the seance in Karahai’s shrine (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c11shrine00000]{C11}).

Scene NotesAmbiance

@UUID[Playlist.h82ztCVRXELKQI8K]{Seance}

When the seance begins, the PCs suddenly feel themselves yanked away through layers of reality, as if flying at great speed through Willowshore, the forest, and then into a small windowless room that’s dimly lit by burning torches and mostly occupied by a massive bronze temple bell that hangs from the ceiling. Five small cages containing colorful birds are set in a large circle, and a number of scrolls equal to the number of PCs lie on the ground inside this circle. Flickering but strangely familiar-looking light radiates down from the bell above to illuminate those scrolls, containing the PCs within the circle. The PCs can’t take any actions other than those mentioned below during this encounter.

Allow each PC to attempt a @Check[perception|dc:24] check; those who succeed realize they’ve been pulled east from Willowshore into a chamber somewhere within the coastal fortress of Karahai. Next, each PC can attempt a @Check[occultism|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[religion|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge to note that they’ve appeared in the center of a type of seance, and that the temple bell above them is a powerful holy item that wards against ghosts. They can also tell the bell’s presence can interfere with any magic coming from spiritual or undead sources.

A moment later, the ghostly images of the three priests appear, each wearing the same black-sleeved crimson robes they wore in this act’s first encounter, but this time without the frightening four-eyed masks. Cao Chen is a middle-aged bald human man, Fenfang is a middle-aged human woman who bears an old scar on her right cheek, and Guanghao is a young human man with a well-trimmed beard.

Tea with the Nosois.name: 与疫鸟共饮茶道 Tea with the Nosois
Tea with the Nosois.text:
与疫鸟共饮茶道

如蜜冬至

在上一幕中，玩家角色可能发现并学会了一项名为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wAJ8mXPYbyAg0qWX]{如蜜冬至} 的仪式，该仪式只能在冬至期间施放。如果玩家角色学会了这项仪式，他们便可以将其纳入陶灯节中。

施放如蜜冬至获得大成功时，可获得4食物点。

该仪式成功时，可获得1食物点。

大失败会使城镇中毒。这会失去2d6准备点数，其中至少一半必须从希望点中扣除，剩余部分则从希望点、食物点或安全点中扣除（由玩家角色选择）。

冬季在本幕第21天正式开始后的几天里（并且假设玩家角色没有把它们赶走），四只疫鸟来到青天茶馆接近玩家角色。它们对村民的困境已生出更多同情。然而，疫鸟仍认为正确的做法是尽快解决这片不自然的心景，并且已经相信，最好的办法就是协助马戈凯的驱邪师。经过一番内部商议后，这些引魂使决定先来接触玩家角色，听听这些英雄究竟有何说法——同时也顺便用甜点和茶填饱肚子。作为客人，疫鸟的态度会略显轻慢，因为它们认为玩家角色明显违反了神圣律法。尽管举止如此，若能好好招待这些引魂使，英雄们便可能获得情报，甚至在之后赢得它们的帮助。

招待这些惹人厌的鸟是件需要多方面兼顾的事情。按顺序执行以下步骤，但允许玩家角色自行决定如何分担劳工。某一方面的失误，可以通过另一方面的出色表现来弥补。

  • 步骤1：一名玩家角色必须以 @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] 或 @Check[crafting|dc:24] 检定来准备茶。其他玩家角色可以用茶学识或制作检定来协助此次检定，或使用运动（表示该角色在茶道开始前将茶叶研磨成细粉）。
  • 步骤2：除了通常的仪式餐食和甜点外，疫鸟还要求一大堆甜麻糬。一名玩家角色必须准备这份点心，可以通过以 @Check[athletics|dc:22] 检定捶打熟米，或以 @Check[crafting|dc:24] 检定准备餐食；其他玩家角色可以协助此次检定。
  • 步骤3：茶道应当由一名在 @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] 或 @Check[society|dc:24] 检定中成功的角色完美执行；其他玩家角色可以协助此次检定。
  • 步骤4：尽管疫鸟自己毫无礼仪可言，主人这边仍必须维持体面。参与其中的一名玩家角色必须尝试一次 @Check[deception|dc:24] 或 @Check[diplomacy|dc:24] 检定；其他玩家角色只能以交涉来协助此次检定。

判定结果：统计玩家角色在这四次检定中的成功次数；每出现一次大成功就额外计1次成功，每出现一次大失败就扣除1次成功。

  • 1次或更少成功：疫鸟被冒犯得无以复加，一言不发地离开了。在本幕最后一章中，它们会协助驱邪师击退玩家角色的幽魂入侵（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c9purificati00]{C9}）。
  • 2或3次成功：玩家角色未能用这场平庸的茶道打动疫鸟。这些鸟只是失去了兴趣，随后离开柳岸镇——局势不会明显恶化，但英雄们的努力也不会得到任何收获。
  • 4或5次成功：玩家角色呈现了一场成功的茶道，而疫鸟也因此放松下来，开始毫不知耻地闲聊。它们在对话开头花了大量时间谈论信藏，大声评论这位死神对亡者过于心软、过于纵容。它们还兴高采烈地告诉玩家角色，信藏仍在因冒犯法拉斯玛而受罚，而且这项惩罚阻止了他直接干涉凡人的命运。每只疫鸟都信心十足地宣称自己知道信藏究竟做了什么才会得罪坟墓女士，但它们的说法却彼此完全不同——有一只声称信藏为了自己的利益滥用权能，另外几只则坚持认为他饶过了一个本不该活下来的凡人、放跑了一只强大的邪魔，或是爱上了一名人类。

    • 茶道结束时，疫鸟会支付玩家角色茶资作为交换（见下方“宝藏”），并承诺只要柳岸镇的居民不再做出任何冒犯法拉斯玛之事，它们就不再为难玩家角色。

  • 6次或更多成功：玩家角色呈现了一场大成功的茶道。疫鸟会如上文成功茶道所述那样闲聊并支付报酬，但它们还会因为格外满意而提出日后若有机会愿意帮上一把，并暗示玩家角色“若你们有朝一日在活人的世界中行走，并碰巧遇见法拉斯玛的任何圣祠，不妨花点时间净化自己。”这指向唐入区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c9purificati00]{C9} 中一次获得意外帮助的机会。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.HIkFzolLNDjikUel]{疫鸟的报酬}
如果玩家角色在奉茶时达成4次或更多成功，这些引魂使会先彼此争论几分钟，纠结究竟该由谁来“付账”，每一只都宣称要由自己埋单。最后它们妥协，决定平摊报酬，然后又为谁该出多少继续争执。最终，它们在羽毛间一阵翻找，掏出一堆小玩意儿作为酬劳。这些物品包括一枚绞刑架之牙、一件翡翠小饰物、一枚价值800 gp的银与蓝宝石戒指，以及一枚冻寒武器符文石。

奖励：如果玩家角色在招待疫鸟时达成4次或更多成功，给予他们120 XP。若少于此数，但仍至少有1次成功，则给予他们60 XP。

Tea with the Nosois

Sweetest Solstice

In the previous act, the PCs might have discovered and learned a ritual called @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wAJ8mXPYbyAg0qWX]{Sweetest Solstice}, which can only be cast during the winter solstice. If the PCs learn this ritual, they can include it in the Claylight Festival.

A critical success at casting sweetest solstice grants 4 Food Points.

A success at the ritual grants 1 Food Point.

A critical failure poisons the town. This costs 2d6 Preparation Points, at least half of which must be subtracted from Hope Points, with the remainder being subtracted from either Hope, Food, or Security Points (the PCs’ choice).

A few days after winter officially begins on the 21st day of the act (and assuming the PCs haven’t chased them off), the four nosois approach the PCs at the Cerulean Teahouse, having become more sympathetic to the villagers’ struggle. The nosois still feel the proper course of action is to resolve the unnatural mindscape as fast as possible, however, and have come to believe that the best method of doing so is to aid Mago Kai’s exorcists. After some internal deliberation, the psychopomps have decided to approach the PCs to see what the heroes have to say for themselves first—and to fill their stomachs with sweets and tea while doing so. The nosois can be slightly dismissive as customers, considering the PCs to be in blatant violation of divine law. Despite their demeanor, treating the psychopomps well can net the heroes information and possible favors down the line.

Entertaining the obnoxious birds is a multi-pronged affair. Perform the following steps in order, but allow the PCs to split the labor between themselves as they see fit. Failings in one area can be compensated for by excelling in another.

  • Step 1: One PC must prepare the tea with a @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] or @Check[crafting|dc:24] check. Other PCs can Aid this check with a Tea Lore or Crafting check or with Athletics (representing that character grinding the tea leaves into fine powder before the ceremony starts).
  • Step 2: In addition to the usual ritual meal and sweets, the nosois demand a mountain of sweet mochi. One PC must prepare this treat, either by pounding the cooked rice with a @Check[athletics|dc:22] check or by preparing the meal with a @Check[crafting|dc:24] check; other PCs can Aid this check.
  • Step 3: The ceremony should be performed flawlessly by a character who succeeds at a @Check[tea-lore|dc:22] or @Check[society|dc:24] check; other PCs can Aid this check.
  • Step 4: Despite the nosois’ own lack of etiquette, decorum must be kept on the hosts’ side. One of the participating PCs must attempt a @Check[deception|dc:24] or @Check[diplomacy|dc:24] check; other PCs can Aid this check only with Diplomacy.

Determine the Results: Total the PCs’ successes from these four checks, awarding an extra success for each critical success and deducting one for each critical failure.

  • 1 or fewer successes: The nosois are so offended that they leave without a word. In the final chapter of this act, they aid the exorcists in repelling the PCs’ ghostly incursion (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c9purificati00]{C9}).
  • 2 or 3 successes: The PCs fail to impress the nosois with their lackluster ceremony. The birds simply lose interest and depart Willowshore—the situation doesn’t become notably worse, but the heroes don’t gain anything for their efforts either.
  • 4 or 5 successes: The PCs present a successful tea ceremony, and the nosois relax enough to shamelessly gossip. They spend much of their early conversation speaking about Shinzo, loudly opining that the shinigami is too soft and indulgent toward the dead. They also gleefully inform the PCs that Shinzo is still being punished for an infraction against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} and that his punishment prevents him from directly interfering with the fates of mortals. Each nosoi confidently declares they know what Shinzo did to offend the Lady of Graves, but they all have a completely different story—one claims that Shinzo abused his powers for his own benefit, while others insist he spared a mortal life he shouldn’t have, let a powerful fiend escape his grasp, or fell in love with a human.

    • At the end of the ceremony, the nosois pay the PCs in exchange for the tea (see Treasure below) and promise to trouble the PCs no further so long as the residents of Willowshore don’t do anything else to offend Pharasma.

  • 6 or more successes: The PCs present a critically successful tea ceremony. The nosois gossip and pay as detailed above for a successful tea ceremony, but they are also so pleased they offer to help out later when they have the chance, suggesting the PCs “take the time to purify themselves at any shrine of Pharasma they might encounter, should they ever find themselves in the living world.” This is a reference to an opportunity for unexpected aid in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c9purificati00]{C9} of Karahai.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.HIkFzolLNDjikUel]{Nosois' Payment}
If the PCs achieve four or more successes while serving tea, the psychopomps argue for a few minutes among themselves over which one of them should “pay the bill,” with each proclaiming that they’ll cover it. They finally compromise by deciding to split the payment, then argue about the specifics of who should pay what. Finally, they rifle through their feathers, producing a pile of trinkets as compensation. These items consist of a gallows tooth, a jade bauble, a silver and sapphire ring worth 800 gp, and a frost weapon runestone.

Reward: If the PCs achieve four or more successes when entertaining the nosois, grant them 120 XP. If they achieve fewer than that but still have at least 1 success, grant them 60 XP.

Event 11. Nosois’ Brunch.name: 事件11：疫鸟的早午餐 Event 11. Nosois’ Brunch
Event 11. Nosois’ Brunch.text:
事件11：诺索伊斯的早午餐 中等 8

在此之前，唯一会定期造访柳岸镇心景的引魂使，只有信藏的诺索伊监察者翼；但在PC于第8章末返回后，又有四位引魂使前来拜访。这四位在信藏与PC会面前迅速分散到镇中各处，随后花了数日时间观察与等待；在此期间，它们的出现导致当地成群的麻雀举止异常。每当发生特别危险的事件，或是在有镇民死去的日子里，麻雀们就会变得吵闹而躁动。

诺索伊斯的早午餐 中等 8

@UUID[Actor.EiOgIiuwocy6joyW]{诺索伊（4）}

生物：这四只诺索伊各自都显现为奇异的乌鸦，长着发出绿色光芒的眼睛。它们从不真正加入麻雀的群飞，但总是在附近出没。目击这些鸟的次数越来越多，没过多久，镇民们就将其视为可怕的凶兆，因为在神门，四是个不吉利的数字。

这四只诺索伊名为山口、坂口、井口与野口。它们是翼的同行，也同样知晓信藏与包裹柳岸镇的心景之间的关联。与信藏（以及因此受其影响的翼）不同，这四只诺索伊对拯救PC及其村民同伴并无特别兴趣，而且它们强烈认为，信藏对凡人的偏袒已经到了有失死之裁定者身份的地步。信藏未能协助马戈凯的驱邪师，反而继续帮助PC，这一点成了压垮这些诺索伊的最后一根稻草。虽然它们在技术上并未获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}授权进行干预，但这些官僚气十足的引魂使已经开始私下谋划，想要协力驱逐这片幽灵般的心景，并将柳岸镇这一异常事件归入它们“已解决事件”的档案记录中。

当这四只诺索伊抵达柳岸镇时，它们的首要任务是观察这片区域及其居民，以便日后拟定更有效的计划。你可以使用这四只诺索伊，为本幕各场景增添一种诡异氛围。除非出现让它们难以放过的机会（例如几乎必然能帮助杀死一只宁多鲁的机会），否则诺索伊不会干涉事件；它们更倾向于与任何可能危险的事物保持安全距离。若PC追踪到这些诺索伊并在战斗中与它们对峙，这些引魂使会立刻逃离，并会在信藏下一次离开时彻底放弃这片心景——这视为在接下来的社交遭遇中严重失败。

Event 11: Nosois’ Brunch Moderate 8

Before now, the only psychopomp to visit the Willowshore mindscape regularly was Shinzo’s nosoi watcher, Yix, but after the PCs return at the end of Chapter 8, four more psychopomps come to visit. These four quickly disperse into the town before Shinzo meets with the PCs, then spend several days observing and waiting, during which their presence causes local flocks of sparrows to behave strangely. Whenever a particularly dangerous event takes place, or on days when townsfolk perish, the sparrows grow loud and agitated.

Nosois' Brunch Moderate 8

@UUID[Actor.EiOgIiuwocy6joyW]{Nosois (4)}

Creatures: The four nosois each appear as strange crows with glowing green eyes. They never quite take part in the sparrows’ flocking but are always nearby. Sightings of these birds increase, and it doesn’t take long before the townsfolk interpret them as a terrible omen, since four is an unlucky number in Shenmen.

The four nosois are named Yamaguchi, Sakaguchi, Iguchi, and Noguchi. They are Yix’s professional colleagues and are likewise aware of Shinzo’s involvement with the mindscape that encapsulates Willowshore. Unlike Shinzo (and by extension Yix), these four nosois have no particular interest in saving the PCs and their fellow villagers, and they strongly feel that Shinzo has become biased toward mortals in a way that’s unbecoming for an arbiter of death. The fact that Shinzo failed to assist Mago Kai’s exorcists and instead continues to aid the PCs was the final straw for the nosois. While they aren’t technically authorized by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} to interfere, the bureaucratic psychopomps have begun scheming among themselves to help banish the ghostly mindscape and file the anomaly of Willowshore away in their resolved incident records.

When the four nosois arrive in Willowshore, their first order of business is to observe the area and its residents to better devise an effective plan later down the road. You can use these four nosois to add an eerie atmosphere to scenes throughout this act. The nosois don’t interfere in events unless presented with an opportunity too tempting to pass up (such as a near-certain chance to help kill a nindoru), preferring to keep a safe distance away from anything that might be dangerous. If the PCs track down the nosois and confront them in combat, the psychopomps flee at once, abandoning the mindscape entirely the next time Shinzo leaves—this counts as critically failing the following social encounter.

Event 10. The Claylight Festival.name: 事件 10。陶灯节 Event 10. The Claylight Festival
Event 10. The Claylight Festival.text:
事件 10：陶灯节

尽管本幕的前三周始终笼罩着凛冽的天气与迫近的时节压力，但直到这个月的第21天，冬季才会随着冬至真正降临。随着这一天临近，九耳神社的看护人噢，巴明（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w16nineearsh00]{W16}）会带着一个提议前来拜访玩家角色。上一季的第一长夜节日极大振奋了城镇的士气，而即便眼下局势看起来阴郁沉重，她仍建议柳岸镇再次参与一项古老传统，庆祝冬季的第一天：陶灯节。

陶灯节远没有第一长夜那样繁复，但依然需要整整一天。在这个真正意义上的冬季第一天，镇民们会制作小小的陶土屋，在里面放上一盏微光，再将它们摆到田野间或街道旁。当田地被这些小屋的点点灯火照亮后，居民们便会在篝火上烤制蔬菜，并祈求好运降临。噢，巴明希望至少有一名玩家角色能在冬至前的一周参与节日的准备。在这一周里，每位愿意参与的玩家角色都必须将自己该周的休整模式行动投入这一目标，然后尝试进行一次 @Check[crafting|dc:25] 检定或一次 @Check[religion|dc:24] 检定。节日期间，村民们会陆续前来，根据英雄们检定的结果称赞或嘲笑他们的努力。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.AO9vQaItI4LjcB92]{前廊}
虽然陶灯节看上去只是个简单的消遣，但参与其中并取悦当地精魂仍会带来好处。每有一名成功参与节日的玩家角色，第二天早晨他们就会在青天茶馆的前廊发现一瓶匿名留下的中效治疗药水（最多四瓶）。

奖励：如果至少有一名玩家角色在为陶灯节进行准备的技能检定中成功，他们的努力便会得到认可：柳岸镇获得 1 点希望点，而玩家角色获得 80 XP。如果所有玩家角色都参与了这些准备，只要至少有一名玩家角色在检定中成功，这些奖励就会提升为 2 点希望点和 120 XP。如果没有玩家角色参与，则节日以失败告终，柳岸镇失去 [[/r 1d4]] 希望点。

Event 10: The Claylight Festival

Although the first three weeks of this act feature stark weather and the looming season, it isn’t until the 21st day of the month that winter arrives with the solstice. As this day nears, Ouh Ba-Ming (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w16nineearsh00]{W16}), caretaker of Nine Ear Shrine, approaches the PCs with a proposition. Last season’s First Long Night festival did wonders for the town’s morale, and even though things seem grim and somber, she suggests that Willowshore participate in another old tradition to celebrate the first day of winter: the Claylight Festival.

Claylight is a much less involved festival than First Long Night, but it still requires an entire day. On this first true day of winter, the townsfolk create small clay huts and set them out in the fields or along streets with a small light inside. Once the fields are lit up with the tiny huts, the residents grill vegetables over fires and pray for good fortune to come. Ouh Ba-Ming would like at least one PC to take part in preparing for the festival on the week leading up to the solstice. On this week, each PC who wishes to do so must devote their downtime activity that week to that goal, then attempt either a @Check[crafting|dc:25] check or a @Check[religion|dc:24] check. Villagers come by over the course of the festivities to either praise or mock the heroes’ efforts, depending on the results of their checks.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.AO9vQaItI4LjcB92]{Front Porch}
While the Claylight Festival might seem like a simple diversion, there are benefits for participating and pleasing the local spirits. For each PC who succeeded at participating in the festival, they find a moderate healing potion (to a maximum of four potions) left anonymously on the front porch of the Cerulean Teahouse the next morning.

Reward: If at least one PC succeeds at their skill check to prepare for the Claylight Festival, their efforts are appreciated: Willowshore gains 1 Hope Point, and the PCs gain 80 XP. If all of the PCs take part in these preparations, these awards are increased to 2 Hope Points and 120 XP, as long as at least one PC succeeds at the check. If no PC takes part, the festival is a failure and Willowshore loses [[/r 1d4]] Hope Points.

Event 9. The Crane-Wife.name: 事件 9：鹤妻 Event 9. The Crane-Wife
Event 9. The Crane-Wife.text:
事件9：鹤妻

即使柳岸镇储备的食物还算充足，镇上也总有人并不满足。某位这样的本地猎人遇见了一只大型鹤鸟后，便将其杀死充作食物，回家烹制了一顿奢侈的大餐。消息很快传开，尽管柳岸镇里有些人会嫉妒这名猎人意外得来的丰盛收获，但更多人的反应却是忧虑。若有玩家角色在一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:18] 或 @Check[society|dc:20] 检定中成功，便会明白其中缘由，因为传说中鹤是一生只有一个伴侣的。若此次检定大成功，玩家角色还会想起一个古老故事：有位猎人在冬季杀死了一只鹤，随后一位悲痛欲绝的配偶前来拜访，请求他也将自己杀死。

果不其然，就在猎人享用完那顿饭的第二天，一位陌生人来到柳岸镇——对于这座在过去半年里一直与外界隔绝的城镇来说，这可是件不寻常的事。没人认得这位穿行于镇中的陌生美丽女子；她一边抽泣，一边呼喊着一位玩家角色的名字。从队伍中选择一位与自然世界联系最深，或者你认为最富同情心的玩家角色。这位奇怪女子会主动找到那名玩家角色，随后揭露一个令人心碎的事实：她的丈夫被人杀害了，而她来到这里，也是为了求死。这个没有名字的女子在悲伤中依旧安静而有礼，但她拒绝离开，除非有人杀了她，或者她自己活活饿死。奇怪的是，鹤妻死后并不会变回鹤，这也让人不禁怀疑，猎人捕获并吃掉的那只“鹤”一开始究竟是不是真的是鹤。

这个遭遇并不是为了引发战斗；相反，它是摆在玩家角色面前的一道道德难题。鹤妻可能不过是心景中显现出的一个思想形体，只是这一次，她并非诞生于苦迦菩提，而是源自镇民集体的绝望与忧虑。她也同样可能是一种超自然生物，比如水泽仙女或水妖。她甚至可能是柳岸镇中的某个人，因为对那名猎人怀有怨念，而借助 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.SswqJqeAWGtX3tTF]{Mage's Hat} 策划了一场品味低劣的复杂恶作剧。无论真相如何，真正重要的是玩家角色如何处理这一复杂局面。

这个遭遇通过难度等级24的检定来结算，以获取胜利点（开拓者 GM核心 184）。一旦玩家角色得知了这一情况，就询问每个人，他们希望如何应对鹤妻的请求。欺瞒、交涉或威吓都是很好的选择；若深入研究本地民间传说以寻求建议，则可以使用社群或柳岸镇学识；而若方案依赖于对原始魔法的了解，则使用自然。每位玩家角色都可以尝试一次技能检定来获得胜利点，最多共可进行四次尝试。

奖励：如果玩家角色获得5点或更多胜利点，那么无论他们采取了哪种方案，柳岸镇都会认为他们的处理是正确的，城镇居民也能够理解；在这种情况下，玩家角色获得120 XP。如果玩家角色获得2到4点胜利点，柳岸镇中许多人都会因这起事件而感到不安；玩家角色获得60 XP，并失去1点希望点。如果玩家角色获得1点或更少胜利点，镇民会因结果而沮丧，并始终被此事萦绕；玩家角色不会获得XP，并失去 [[/r 1d4+1]] 希望点。

Event 9. The Crane-Wife

Even if Willowshore’s food stores are robust, there are those in town who aren’t satisfied. When one such local hunter encounters a large crane, they kill the bird for food and return home to cook an extravagant meal. Word spreads, and while some in Willowshore might be jealous of this hunter’s unexpected bounty, a larger reaction is one of worry. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:18] or a @Check[society|dc:20] check understands why, for the stories say that cranes mate for life. With a critical success at this check, the PC recalls an old story of a hunter who killed a crane in the winter only to be visited by a grieving spouse who asked to be killed as well.

Sure enough, the day after the hunter’s meal, a newcomer arrives in Willowshore—an unusual event for a town that, for the past half year, has been cut off from the outside world. No one recognizes the strange, beautiful woman as she strides through town, sobbing and calling out one of the PCs’ names. Choose the PC from the group who has the strongest ties to the natural world or who you feel is the most compassionate. This strange woman seeks that PC out, then reveals the heartbreaking fact that her husband was slain and she’s here to seek death as well. The nameless woman is quiet and polite in her sorrow but refuses to leave until someone kills her, or until she starves to death. Curiously, the crane-wife doesn’t become a crane upon death, calling into question whether the “crane” the hunter captured and ate was a crane in the first place.

This encounter isn’t meant to be a combat; rather, it’s a moral quandary for the PCs to face. The crane-wife could be nothing more than a thoughtform manifested in the mindscape, but this time born from the collective despair and worry of the townsfolk rather than from Kugaptee. She could just as easily be a supernatural creature like a naiad or nixie. She could even be someone from Willowshore with a grudge against the hunter who has engineered a complex prank in poor taste with the aid of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.SswqJqeAWGtX3tTF]{Mage's Hat}. Regardless, it’s how the PCs handle this complex situation that matters.

This encounter is resolved via DC 24 checks to earn Victory Points (Pathfinder GM Core 184). Once the PCs learn of the situation, ask each how they wish to handle the crane-wife’s request. Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation all make great options; looking deep into local folklore for advice could suggest Society or Willowshore Lore, while a solution that draws upon knowledge of primal magic would use Nature. Each PC can attempt one skill check to earn Victory Points, to a maximum of four attempts.

Reward: If the PCs earn 5 or more Victory Points, their solution is viewed by Willowshore as the right call, regardless of the option they went with, and the town understands; in this case, the PCs earn 120 XP. If the PCs earn 2 to 4 Victory Points, many in Willowshore are unsettled by the event; the PCs earn 60 XP and lose 1 Hope Point. If the PCs earn 1 or fewer Victory Points, the townsfolk are depressed and haunted by the outcome; the PCs earn no XP and lose [[/r 1d4+1]] Hope Points.

Event 8. A Lonely Home.name: 事件 8. 孤独之家 Event 8. A Lonely Home
Event 8. A Lonely Home.text:
事件8：孤独之家 琐碎 8

在云纸坊事件发生几周后，于本幕的第10天，玩家角色遇见了神色紧张的阿鲁卡——她就是本幕开始时建筑坍塌时被他们救出的那位狐人女子。（如果阿鲁卡没有活下来，就改用另一位玩家角色喜爱的非玩家角色，甚至可以是镇上的长者。）阿鲁卡已经从造纸坊的那场磨难中恢复过来，但她很担心自己的上司八哥 川冈，并解释说，建筑的结构损坏也毁掉了川冈位于上层的一间私人宿舍。在建筑修缮期间，川冈搬回了城镇边缘那栋朴素而传统的老宅——自从他的父母去世、他搬进造纸坊的住处后，那栋小房子便一直无人居住。

阿鲁卡说，川冈已经好几天没离开那栋房子了。她前去调查时，和几名造纸坊员工发现他正坐在那座破败建筑的正中央，因受寒而瑟瑟发抖，看起来神志不清。当阿鲁卡走进屋里，想把他拖出来带去避风 shelter 时，他却奋力反抗并大喊：“不！我得待在这里，待在家里，待在我一直所属的地方！”当四周的瓦砾和碎片开始在屋中飞舞时，她意识到这栋房子真的闹鬼了，于是在几位同事协助下，勉强把川冈拖到了安全的地方。自那以后，这位行会首领就一直沉默寡言、郁郁不乐；他现在安全地待在阿鲁卡的客房里，但她和其他工人都担心，川冈的家被一个邪恶精魂盘踞了。阿鲁卡的同事原本准备一把火烧掉废墟，但她答应会请玩家角色帮忙，这才阻止了他们；如果还有别的解决办法，她实在不想毁掉上司的家人故居。

阿鲁卡请求玩家角色调查此事，看看他们能否说服那个“邪恶精魂”放过川冈。天狗的家族故居位于镇子南面的林地里，旁边是一座几乎坍塌的谷仓（区域W34）。川冈的父母最初曾希望在这里开垦农场，但始终没能真正办起来；几十年过去，这地方已被废弃，就连通往空地的小径也早已杂草丛生。若玩家角色愿意，阿鲁卡可以带他们前往那里，但她不会走进那栋破屋所在的空地。

生物：川冈的家族故居的确闹鬼，但并不是被幽灵缠上。真正的元凶是一种孤独的生物，名为逝宅神。这只潜伏的精魂名叫榫头；多年前川冈的父母去世后，作为独子的川冈在几个月后搬离了此地，八哥一家作为这栋屋宅住户的漫长岁月也就此结束，随后榫头便搬了进来。直到川冈最近回来前，榫头一直独自住在这座缓慢崩坏的废屋里。

榫头目前正藏在建筑残破的墙体之中，对自己的“客人”被带走感到懊恼。玩家角色一进入，他就会施放幻觉住宅，试图把所有玩家角色都困在屋里。如果失败了，他就会从墙中现身，含泪请求玩家角色留下来陪他住在这间屋子里——他实在太孤单了，而且也惊惧于再过几年，这栋建筑也许就会彻底崩塌，而到那时，他的生命也将随之终结。除非受到挑衅，否则榫头不会攻击；但若真打起来，他会战斗至死，并在几天后重新复苏。

如果玩家角色愿意和他说话，榫头会解释自己面临的困境：他被束缚于这栋屋宅，如果没有人和他一起住在这里，他就会永远孤独。更糟的是，一旦房屋最终因风化与失修而毁灭，他也会死去。他只希望有人能搬进这栋屋子居住，并把它修好，让它作为休息与安全之所的根源能够延续下去。他希望玩家角色能帮他解决这个问题；但如果他们看起来无能为力，或是不愿帮忙，他就会在绝望中哭喊并发动攻击——无论这导致玩家角色逃跑还是杀死他都无所谓，因为即便他们杀了他，他也只会在几天后复苏。

一个简单的解决办法是让某位玩家角色承诺住进这间农舍并负责修缮——如果有玩家角色自愿承担这项责任，将下述行动的结果提高一个成功等级。

解决榫头的问题

  • 探索
  • Secret

你花上一整天思考解决榫头问题的办法，与川冈及镇上的其他人交谈，尝试招募援助，然后把你的工作成果回报给榫头。进行一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:22]检定、一次 @Check[society|dc:24]检定，或一次 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:24]检定。这个行动只能尝试一次，但其他玩家角色可以通过在一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:20]、@Check[society|dc:20] 或 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20]检定中成功，以协助这次尝试。

大成功 玩家角色与川冈、松木老人以及镇上的几位工匠合作，招募到了足够的支援，得以立刻开始加固老农舍，确保它能撑过冬季。川冈和其他镇民也同意定期探望榫头，避免他再次陷入孤独，直到找到新的家人搬进这栋屋子。许多镇民都出手帮忙，加固并保护建筑免受即将到来的冬季风暴侵袭，而这一切都不需玩家角色或城镇付出任何安全上的代价。玩家角色获得120 XP和[[/r 1d4+1]]希望点。

成功 如同大成功，但玩家角色必须花费400 gp，或者城镇必须消耗2安全点，才能确保这栋房屋在即将到来的冬季中得到保护。玩家角色获得80 XP和1希望点。

失败 如同成功，但镇上没有人愿意花时间陪伴一个可能危险且难以预测的精魂，川冈也不例外。一名玩家角色可以承诺在整个冬季通过每周的休整模式行动，多次长时间造访这栋房子来陪伴榫头；但如果某一周没有玩家角色这么做，他的绝望就会压倒理智。在一阵挫败的爆发中，榫头会意外损坏房屋那草率的修缮部分，导致房屋彻底坍塌成废墟，并永久杀死榫头。如果发生这种情况，这则悲剧消息会使人失去1希望点。玩家角色获得40 XP。

大失败 如同失败，但会有一名本地人主动提出陪伴榫头。这个本地人应当是最近因镇上某次失踪或死亡而失去了挚爱之人或朋友的人——选择一个符合你游戏故事的非玩家角色即可。不幸的是，这名非玩家角色只是出于被误置的责任感才自愿如此，而且他们受到悲痛的影响比任何人——包括他们自己——所意识到的都更深。这个非玩家角色的悲伤会与榫头的绝望彼此叠加，形成一种毁灭性的循环，最终驱使其在自己仍身处屋内时放火烧屋。柳岸镇人口减少1；更糟的是，这场悲剧的结局会使人失去[[/r 1d4+1]]希望点。

@UUID[Actor.4RsT9ANu67WgoKMd]{榫头}生物 8

  • Small
  • 虚体
  • Kami
  • 精魂

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.h6x2FY0mvjGjnzmS]{地板木条}
如果玩家角色设法与榫头成为朋友，这位逝宅神就会透露一件连川冈自己都不知道的事——在破屋其中一块地板木条下方的中空夹层里，藏着他母亲的+1轰鸣短弓，那是他原以为早已遗失的武器。川冈握着这把短弓片刻后，将它交给玩家角色，说如果他们愿意把这件武器当作他的赠礼收下，他将深感荣幸，而他的母亲也一定会认可，这把武器应当由如此英勇之人持有。

Event 8: A Lonely Home Trivial 8

A few weeks after the events at Cloud Paper House, on the 10th day of the act, the PCs are approached by a nervous-looking Aruka—the kitsune woman whom they rescued during the building’s collapse at the start of this act. (If Aruka didn’t survive, substitute another NPC the PCs have grown fond of, or even the town’s elder.) Aruka has recovered from her ordeal at the paper mill but worries about her boss, Myna Kawaka, and explains that the structural damage to the building also destroyed Kawaka’s personal quarters on an upper floor. While the building is being repaired, Kawaka relocated to his humble and traditional home on the outskirts of town—a small structure that was left unoccupied after his parents died and he moved into accommodations in the paper mill.

Aruka says that Kawaka hasn’t left that house in a few days, and that upon investigating, she and a few other paper mill employees found him sitting in the middle of the ruined building, shivering from exposure and apparently delirious. When Aruka stepped into the house to try to drag him out to get him to shelter, he fought back and cried out, “No! I need to stay here, at home, where I’ve always belonged!” When bits of rubble and debris began to fly about the place, she knew the building was actually haunted, and with the aid of a few coworkers, she managed to drag Kawaka to safety. Since then, the guild leader has been uncommunicative and sullen; he’s safe now in Aruka’s guest room, but she and the other workers fear that Kawaka’s home is infested with an evil spirit. Aruka’s coworkers were ready to burn the ruin down, but she managed to prevent this by promising to ask the PCs for help; she would rather not destroy her boss’s family home if there’s another possible solution.

Aruka asks the PCs to investigate the situation and find out if they can convince the “evil spirit” to let Kawaka go. The tengu’s family home is located in the woods south of town, next to a mostly collapsed barn (area W34). Kawaka’s parents initially hoped to start a farm here but never got that venture off the ground, and in the decades since, the place has been abandoned; even the footpath leading to the clearing is overgrown. Aruka offers to escort the PCs to the location if they wish, but she won’t enter the clearing in which the decrepit house stands.

Creature: Kawaka’s family home is indeed haunted, but not by a ghost. The actual culprit is a lonely creature known as a silsyche. Named Tenon, this lurking spirit moved into the house after its long run as the Myna family home ended when Kawaka, the only child, moved out a few months after his parents’ death years ago. Until Kawaka’s recent return, Tenon lived alone in the slowly crumbling ruin.

Tenon is currently hiding in the building’s ruined walls, frustrated that his guest has been taken away. As soon as the PCs enter, he uses Hallucinatory Home to try to trap all of the PCs inside. If that fails, he steps out of the walls to tearfully ask the PCs to stay in the home with him—he’s so lonely, but he’s also frightened that in a few years, the building might fully crumble apart, and that with it, so shall his life. Tenon won’t attack unless provoked, but he fights to the death in that case, only to rejuvenate a few days later.

If the PCs speak to him, Tenon explains the situation he faces: he’s bound to this home, and if no one lives here with him, he’ll be lonely forever. Worse, once the home is finally destroyed by erosion and neglect, he’ll die. He only wants someone to come live in the home and repair it so that its tradition as a place of rest and safety can continue. He hopes the PCs can help him solve this problem, but if they seem unable or unwilling, he cries out in despair and attacks—whether this causes the PCs to flee or kill him is irrelevant, since even if they slay him, he’ll just rejuvenate in a few days.

One simple solution is for a PC to commit to living in the farmhouse and repairing it—if a PC volunteers for this responsibility, adjust the result of the following activity up by one degree of success.

Solving Tenon’s Problem

  • Exploration
  • Secret

You spend the day considering a solution to Tenon’s problem, speaking to Kawaka and others in town to try to recruit assistance, and then report the results of your work back to Tenon. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:22] check, a @Check[society|dc:24] check, or a @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:24] check. This activity can only be attempted once, but other PCs can Aid this attempt by succeeding at a @Check[diplomacy|dc:20], @Check[society|dc:20], or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20] check.

Critical Success The PCs—working with Kawaka, Old Matsuki, and several artisans in town—recruit enough support to begin work on shoring up the old farmhouse at once, ensuring that it will survive the winter. Kawaka and other townsfolk agree to visit Tenon regularly to keep him from getting lonely until a new family can be found to live in the house. Many townsfolk pitch in to help shore up and protect the building from the winter storms yet to come, at no cost to the PCs or the town’s security. The PCs earn 120 XP and [[/r 1d4+1]] Hope Points.

Success As critical success, but the PCs must either spend 400 gp or the town must expend 2 Security Points to ensure the house is protected from the coming winter. The PCs earn 80 XP and 1 Hope Point.

Failure As success, but no one in town is interested in spending time with a potentially dangerous and unpredictable spirit, including Kawaka. A PC can commit to keeping Tenon company through the winter by making several lengthy visits to the house as their weekly downtime activity; however, if no PC performs this in a week, his despair takes over. In a fit of frustration, Tenon accidentally damages the slipshod repair work on the house, causing the house to collapse into ruins, killing Tenon permanently. If this occurs, the tragic news costs 1 Hope Point. The PCs earn 40 XP.

Critical Failure As failure, but a local offers to keep Tenon company. This local should be someone who recently lost a loved one or friend to a vanishing or death in town—choose an NPC who fits your game’s story. Unfortunately, this NPC is only volunteering out of a misplaced sense of obligation and has been more affected by their grief than anyone (including themself) realizes. This NPC’s grief compounds with Tenon’s, forming a destructive cycle that eventually compels the NPC to burn the house down while they’re inside. Reduce Willowshore’s population by 1; worse, the tragic end costs [[/r 1d4+1]] Hope Points.

@UUID[Actor.4RsT9ANu67WgoKMd]{Tenon}Creature 8

  • Small
  • Incorporeal
  • Kami
  • Spirit

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.h6x2FY0mvjGjnzmS]{Floorboards}
If the PCs manage to befriend Tenon, the silsyche reveals something that not even Kawaka knows—hidden in a hollow below one of the ruined house’s floorboards is his mother’s +1 thundering shortbow, a weapon he’d assumed was lost. After holding the shortbow for a moment, Kawaka hands it to the PCs, saying he would be honored if they took this weapon as a gift from him and that his mother would approve of it being in such heroic hands.

Event 7. The Fox Ghost.name: 事件 7。狐狸幽灵 Event 7. The Fox Ghost
Event 7. The Fox Ghost.text:
事件7：狐狸幽灵 微不足道 8

冬季里的狩猎和采集一向收获寥寥，但即便日子愈发难熬，仍有一些本地人继续操持他们的营生。在此次遭遇前的铺垫中，一些猎人发现他们的若干陷阱和猎棚被撕开，并且有部分遭到烧灼。无论玩家角色是选择调查，还是在旅途中偶然来到案发现场，他们都能在这场遭遇中当场撞见犯人行凶。

生物：犯人看起来是个半野化的人类女孩，穿着一件烧焦的裙子，怀里紧抱着一只被烧伤的幼狐。她触碰到的任何东西都会被部分烧灼，这也正是她能够撕开陷阱并熏焦当地树木的原因。这个女孩名叫凛，是一名狐人幽灵；许多个轮回前，她意外闯入了柳岸镇心景，并被困在这里。她和她的弟弟悠死于另一座人类捕兽人村庄之手——那里的村民认定当地狐狸是一场超自然厄运的根源，于是烧毁了她们位于山地的家，想要杀死所有住在那里的狐人。

由于这段创伤，凛憎恨人类捕兽人，也憎恨人类整体。她的态度起始为不友善，因为她认为玩家角色会因她毁掉陷阱而愤怒并惩罚她。被发现时，她会逃跑，除非玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:27] 检定来阻止她。表明自己身份的狐人在此次检定中获得+2环境加值。如果玩家角色攻击她、威胁她，或在交涉检定中严重失败，她会试图对冒犯者施加她的狐火诅咒，然后逃走。玩家角色可以通过成功进行一次 @Check[survival|dc:28|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track]，沿着她路过时不由自主留下的小片焦痕，再次追踪到凛。

如果玩家角色将凛的态度调整为冷淡，她就愿意一边抽泣一边回答问题，尽管除了她自身的悲惨遭遇外，她几乎一无所知。她也愿意待在一个玩家角色之后还能找到她的地方，但除非她的态度提升为友善，否则她拒绝进入柳岸镇。如果她真的变为友善，凛通常会被发现和当地年轻人一起玩耍，一会儿朝他们尖叫并扔东西，一会儿又帮他们搞夜间恶作剧。如果玩家角色问凛怎样才能帮助她安息，她会耸耸肩说：“只要我能离开，我自然会走，但这个地方暂时把我留在了这里。”当玩家角色在本幕结束时对柳岸镇施放转生迁魂后，他们就能进一步帮助凛——见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12concludingth00]{终幕结束}。

@UUID[Actor.PblvhzuySMcnHQO2]{凛}生物 8

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.XyhI61LwKFrbynGO]{琳的赋礼}
如果玩家角色将凛的态度提升为友善，这名幽灵会感谢玩家角色的善意，并将自己的一部分作为奖励赠予他们——她俯身从地上拾起一块扁平的石头，那石头漂浮起来，并在她的虚体手中燃起火焰。她将这块漂浮燃烧的石头丢进一名玩家角色手中，石头随即瞬间冷却，显露出其本来面目：一枚炽焰武器符文石。凛只能施展这招一次。

奖励：如果玩家角色将凛的态度提升为友善，给予他们120 XP。如果允许她来到柳岸镇生活，当地人起初会有所戒备；这会消耗 [[/r 1d4]] 希望点。随着时间过去，人们对这位坚韧的年轻幽灵及其顽皮举动的欣赏，会让当地居民意识到并非所有幽灵都很残忍。在此后每周开始、你计算城镇损耗时，柳岸镇获得1点希望点。

Event 7: The Fox Ghost Trivial 8

Hunting and foraging is a sparse business in winter, yet still, a few locals continue to ply their trades even as the days grow crueler. In the lead-up to this encounter, some hunters find several of their traps and blinds have been ripped open and partially burned. Whether the PCs choose to investigate or stumble upon the scene of the crime while traveling, they can catch the culprit in the act in this encounter.

Creature: The culprit appears to be a half-feral human girl clad in a singed dress and clutching a burned fox kit in her arms. She partially burns anything she touches, which is what allowed her to rip open the traps and singe the local trees. This girl is Rin, a kitsune ghost who accidentally stumbled into Willowshore’s mindscape and became trapped here many cycles ago. She and her baby brother Yuu died when a different human trapper village, convinced the local foxes were the cause of some supernatural misfortune, burned down her mountain home to kill all of the kitsune who lived there.

Due to this trauma, Rin hates human trappers and humans in general. Her attitude begins at unfriendly, as she assumes the PCs will be mad and punish her for destroying the traps. She runs when caught unless the PCs succeed at a @Check[diplomacy|dc:27] check to stop her. Kitsune who reveal themselves as such receive a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. If the PCs attack her, threaten her, or critically fail the Diplomacy check, she attempts to inflict her foxfire curse on the offender and then flees. A PC can track Rin down again by following the small singe marks she can’t help but leave in passing by succeeding at a @Check[survival|dc:28|traits:secret,concentrate,exploration,move,skill,action:track|name:Track].

If the PCs adjust Rin’s attitude to indifferent, she’s willing to answer questions in between her sobs, though she knows very little outside of her own tragic circumstances. She’s also willing to stay in a place where the PCs can find her again but refuses to enter Willowshore unless her attitude is increased to friendly. If she does become friendly, Rin is most often found playing with local youths, alternating between screaming and throwing things at them or helping them with their nighttime pranks. If the PCs ask Rin how they can help her rest, she shrugs and says, “As soon as I can go, I shall, but this place keeps me here for now.” When the PCs transmigrate Willowshore at the end of the act, they’ll be able to help Rin further—see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12concludingth00]{Concluding the Act}.

@UUID[Actor.PblvhzuySMcnHQO2]{Rin}Creature 8

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.XyhI61LwKFrbynGO]{Rin's Gift}
If the PCs increase Rin’s attitude to friendly, the ghost thanks the PCs for their kindness and offers them a part of herself as reward—she reaches down to pick up a flat stone off the ground, the stone floating and then igniting with fire in her incorporeal hand. She drops the floating, burning stone into a PC’s hand, whereupon it instantly cools, revealing itself to be a flaming weapon runestone. Rin can perform this trick only once.

Reward: If the PCs increase Rin’s attitude to friendly, grant them 120 XP. If she’s allowed to come to Willowshore to live, the locals are initially wary; this costs [[/r 1d4]] Hope Points. Over time, their admiration of the tenacious young ghost and her playful antics causes the locals to realize not all ghosts are cruel. At the start of each following week when you calculate the town’s attrition, Willowshore gains 1 Hope Point.

Event 6. Little Gifts.text:

Event 5. Faceless Evil.name: 事件 5：无面邪祟 Event 5. Faceless Evil
Event 5. Faceless Evil.text:
事件5：无面邪祟 中等 8

从赫山宝的心景中跟随玩家角色而来的，不只有总督庄园。即使玩家角色在上一章中杀死了那些无面鬼模仿者，更多这种惹是生非的妖怪也会在玩家角色返回后出现在柳岸镇中制造麻烦。作为其显现的一部分，无脸妖会获得其所复制玩家角色的面孔，但会刻意在玩家角色平时不常出没的城镇区域活动。起初，它们只会做些恶毒的小事，例如把针藏进别人食物里、辱骂与玩家角色交好的非玩家角色，或用油漆破坏受玩家角色支持的地点，之后再逐步升级到谋杀。一旦玩家角色察觉到情况不对，就必须迅速采取行动，以挽救他们的声望和村民的性命。

生物：若放任不管，无脸妖每过[[/r 1d4]]天就会制造一起事件。在第一起此类事件发生后的第二天，玩家角色会得知无脸妖的存在：一名未与玩家角色交好的非玩家角色（或者更好的是，一名已经变得敌对的角色）会怒气冲冲地找上门来，指控某位玩家角色“把针塞进你给我的饺子里！”，接着张开嘴，展示自己所受的那些令人不适的伤口。若被指控的玩家角色未能成功通过一次@Check[diplomacy|dc:20]检定，这名非玩家角色就会向所有愿意听的人抱怨这个恶意恶作剧，而到当天结束时，玩家角色会从你选择的一个派系失去1点声望点。（记录下因本事件失去的所有声望点，因为如果玩家角色妥善解决本事件，他们很有机会将其重新获得。）

虽然柳岸镇的居民起初愿意接受“玩家角色是被人栽赃”的安抚说法（毕竟本幕期间已经发生了太多怪事，再对此提出理性质疑反而显得不合时宜），但这种说法维持不了多久。毕竟，玩家角色离开了村子，还总往各种古怪地方钻，因此同样有可能是他们已经被杀并被某种可怕之物取而代之——甚至更糟，他们其实早已暗中堕落，沦为了他们一直在对抗的腐化的一部分！

每过[[/r 1d4]]天，就会发生一次类似事件，并相应失去1点声望点。当无面鬼模仿者实施第5次“恶作剧”时，会有一名次要非玩家角色因此死亡（将柳岸镇人口减少1），这也让它们尝到了暴力的滋味。之后的每一次恶作剧都会导致新的谋杀。每发生一起谋杀，两个派系都会各失去3点声望点。

无面邪祟 中等 8

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21nopperaboimp00]{野箆坊冒名者（4）} | @UUID[Actor.vFNg9BATB9crqnDn]{奥术} @UUID[Actor.aYR61sI47XlE9ul8]{神圣} @UUID[Actor.2NmupNwbuAt5GcWy]{武斗} @UUID[Actor.UgfzkrEkFrdeegD0]{异能} @UUID[Actor.vmOACyFUJqWHY8YD]{原始} @UUID[Actor.n9L4akwW1KlBXQQd]{熟练}

每天一次，一名玩家角色可以花费数小时（除其每周正在进行的任何休整模式行动之外），通过尝试一次秘密的@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]、@Check[society|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]或@Check[perception|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]检定来调查这一谜团。成功时，他们确认有冒名者已潜入城镇；大成功时，无脸妖不会立刻注意到玩家角色，从而给予他们时间布置伏击，或将一只无脸妖从其他同伴身边引开。面对乐趣即将结束的局面，这些模仿者会为消灭玩家角色而战至死；若有可能，它们会先集结成一组，再向队伍发动攻击。

奖励：如果玩家角色公开揭露这些模仿者的本质，这一令人不安的真相会使队伍失去1点希望点（如果至少发生过一次谋杀，则失去1d6点希望点）。若没有城镇居民遭到谋杀，他们因本事件失去的所有声望点都会恢复。每发生一起谋杀，按此方式恢复的声望点总数就减少2点。

若在本事件期间没有城镇居民被谋杀，则给予玩家角色40 XP；每有一名本地居民被杀，这项XP奖励就减少10。

Event 5: Faceless Evil Moderate 8

The governor’s manor isn’t the only thing that followed the PCs from Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape. Even if the PCs slew their noppera-bo impersonators in the previous chapter, more of these disruptive yokai appear in Willowshore to cause trouble after the PCs return. As part of their manifestation, the noppera-bos gain their duplicated PC’s face but make sure to operate in parts of town the PCs don’t frequent. They initially perform small but spiteful acts, like hiding needles in people’s food, insulting NPCs the PCs have befriended, or vandalizing PC-supported locations with paint, before escalating toward murder. Once the PCs catch wind that something is wrong, they need to act quickly to save their reputations and the lives of the villagers.

Creatures: If left to their own devices, the noppera-bos perpetrate an incident every [[/r 1d4]] days. The PCs are alerted to the noppera-bos’ presence the day after the first of these incidents, when an NPC whom the PCs haven’t befriended (or better yet, one who’s become antagonistic) approaches them angrily, then accuses one of the PCs of “stuffing needles into the dumplings you gave me!” before opening their mouth to show off the uncomfortable wounds they’ve suffered. Without a successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:20] check from the accused PC, the NPC complains about the mean-spirited prank to anyone who’ll listen, and by the end of the day, the PCs lose 1 Reputation Point from a faction of your choice. (Keep track of all Reputation Points lost as a result of this event, as the PCs have a good chance of regaining them if they resolve this event well.)

While the residents of Willowshore are initially willing to accept reassurance that the PCs are being framed (enough strange things have happened over the course of the act that it’s hardly rational to protest), they won’t be placated by this for long. After all, the PCs have been out of the village and have been sticking their noses in strange places, meaning it’s just as likely they’ve been killed and replaced by something horrible—or worse, that they’ve secretly fallen to the corruption they’ve been fighting against!

Every [[/r 1d4]] days, a similar event takes place, along with a corresponding loss of 1 Reputation Point. When the noppera-bo impersonators perform their 5th “prank,” a minor NPC dies as a result (reduce Willowshore’s population by 1), giving them the taste for violence. Every following prank results in a new murder. Every murder that takes place results in a loss of 3 Reputation Points from both factions.

Faceless Evil Moderate 8

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21nopperaboimp00]{Noppera-bo Impersonators (4)} | @UUID[Actor.vFNg9BATB9crqnDn]{Arcane} @UUID[Actor.aYR61sI47XlE9ul8]{Divine} @UUID[Actor.2NmupNwbuAt5GcWy]{Martial}@UUID[Actor.UgfzkrEkFrdeegD0]{Occult} @UUID[Actor.vmOACyFUJqWHY8YD]{Primal} @UUID[Actor.n9L4akwW1KlBXQQd]{Skilled}

Once per day, a PC can spend a few hours (in addition to any weekly downtime activity they’re pursuing) Investigating this mystery by attempting a secret @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate], @Check[society|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate], or @Check[perception|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate] check. On a success, they confirm that impersonators have infiltrated the town, and on a critical success, the noppera-bos don’t immediately notice the PCs, giving them time to set up an ambush or lure a noppera-bo away from the others. Faced with the end of their fun, the impersonators fight to the death to eliminate the PCs, gathering as a group if they can before they attack the party.

Reward: If the PCs publicly reveal the nature of their impersonators, the unsettling revelation costs the party 1 Hope Point (or 1d6 Hope Points if there has been at least one murder). All Reputation Points they lose as a result of this event are restored if no townsfolk were murdered. Each murder that took place lowers the total Reputation Points restored in this manner by 2.

Grant the PCs 40 XP if no townsfolk were murdered during this event; reduce this XP reward by 10 for each murdered local.

Unexpected Troubles.name: 意外麻烦 Unexpected Troubles
Unexpected Troubles.text:
意外麻烦

每周开始时，进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:16]。若成功，柳岸镇会遭遇并发问题。也许镇上有人吃得超过了自己应得的份额，或是部分储存的食物已经腐坏。也可能是一场风暴损坏了镇中建筑的屋顶，或突如其来的降雨引发了洪水。又或者，随着居民开始意识到自身处境的严重性，绝望与厄运的流言正在镇中蔓延。

如果确实发生了预料之外的并发问题，就在本页顶部的表格上掷骰，以决定出现了哪种麻烦，并确定由于本周这场意外损耗而额外失去多少准备点数。玩家角色可以选择花费本周的休整模式来减轻这些影响，方式是尝试所列明的技能检定（其他玩家角色可以进行休整期行动来协助此次检定）。若大成功，则不会失去任何点数。若成功，则只失去1点。若大失败，则失去双倍数量的点数。如果玩家角色使用了特别乐于助人的法术、仪式或其他策略，你也可以允许他们将此次检定的结果提高一个成功等级。

掷骰 准备点损失 以 DC 24 将其减轻……
1–2 [[/r 1d4]] 食物点数 @Check[nature|dc:24] 或 @Check[survival|dc:24] 检定
3–4 [[/r 1d4+2]] 希望点 @Check[diplomacy|dc:24] 或 @Check[performance|dc:24] 检定
5–6 [[/r 1d4]] 安全点 @Check[athletics|dc:24] 或 @Check[crafting|dc:24] 检定

为柳岸镇创造食物

柳岸镇中有超过200张饥饿的嘴需要喂饱，而施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mt6ZzkVX8Q4xigFq]{Create Food} 所产生的餐食持续时间不会超过一天，这限制了它作为增加食物点数手段的作用。不过，在柳岸镇以0食物点数开始的一周里，这个法术仍然可以挽救性命。若在这样的一周中失去1点希望点会导致2d6名当地居民死亡，那么只要玩家角色在希望点损失发生后的1小时内，施放足够多的造粮法术来喂饱至少12人（无论[[/r 2d6]] 掷骰结果为何），他们就可以阻止这些死亡发生。

Unexpected Troubles

At the start of every week, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:16]. On a success, Willowshore faces complications. Perhaps someone in town has been eating more than their share or decay has spread through some of the food stores. A storm might have damaged the roofs of buildings in town or sudden rains could’ve caused flooding. Perhaps rumors of hopelessness and doom have been spreading through town as the citizens begin to realize the gravity of their situation.

If unforeseen complications do occur, roll on the table at the top of this page to determine what sort of trouble takes place and to find out how many additional Preparation Points are lost as a result of the unexpected attrition for the week. A PC can choose to spend their week’s downtime to minimize these effects by attempting the indicated skill check (other PCs can take downtime activities to Aid this check).
