On a critical success, no points are lost. On a success, only 1 point is lost. On a critical failure, twice as many points are lost. If the PCs use a particularly helpful spell, ritual, or other tactic, you can permit them to increase the result of this check by one degree of success if you like.

Roll Preparation Point Loss Minimize with a DC 24...
1–2 [[/r 1d4]] Food Points @Check[nature|dc:24] or @Check[survival|dc:24] check
3–4 [[/r 1d4+2]] Hope Points @Check[diplomacy|dc:24] or @Check[performance|dc:24] check
5–6 [[/r 1d4]] Security Points @Check[athletics|dc:24] or @Check[crafting|dc:24] check

Creating Food for Willowshore

There are over 200 hungry mouths to feed in Willowshore, and meals from castings of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mt6ZzkVX8Q4xigFq]{Create Food} don’t last longer than a day, which limits this option as a way to bolster Food Points. The spell can save lives, though, on weeks where Willowshore begins with 0 Food Points. If the loss of a Hope Point during such a week would result in the deaths of 2d6 locals, the PCs can prevent those deaths if they cast enough create food spells to feed a minimum of 12 people (regardless of the result of the [[/r 2d6]] die roll) within an hour of the Hope Point loss occurring.

Winter Events.name: 冬季事件 Winter Events
Winter Events.text:
冬季事件

在PC们必须等待才能施放转生仪式的这几周里，冬季并不会停下脚步。随着一周周过去，如本幕开头第151页所述，城镇必须承受希望、食物和安全不断流失的消耗。

除了这种持续不断的损耗之外，随着冬季无休无止地向前推进，还会发生若干其他事件。不同于“第二幕：任叶飘零”中秋季每周都会发生一个事件，冬季期间发生的事件要么安排在特定日期，要么留作可在任意时间发生。以下时间线总结了这13个事件应当在何时发生，其中也包括前一章中的事件。你完全可以根据自己游戏中的流程起伏，按需调整这些日期！

冬季时间线

本幕中的事件应大致按照以下顺序发生。未对应特定日期的事件列为“任意时间”，但仍应在其后所列事件之前发生。

第1天 第8章的事件；之后，PC们便可以依自己意愿施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{心景转移}，前往赫山宝的心景。

从赫山宝的心景返回后的次日 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event4shinzo00]{事件4：心藏的答案}。@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event5facele00]{事件5 - 无面邪祟}开始；PC们可以开始研究转生。

每7天 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event6little00]{事件6 - 小小礼物}

任意时间 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event7thefox00]{事件7 - 狐狸幽灵}

第10天 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event8alonel00]{事件8 - 孤独之家}

任意时间 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event8alonel00]{事件8 - 孤独之家}

第21天 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event10thecl00]{事件10 - 陶灯节}；冬季真正开始的第一天。

任意时间 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event11nosoi00]{事件11 - 疫鸟的早午餐}

任意时间 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event12these00]{事件12 - 降神仪式}

第44天 为施放转生仪式而准备的榊木板条最早会在这一天备妥。

第71天 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event13inter00]{事件13 - 与蜘蛛的会面}

第72天（新年第一天） 到了这时，PC们便可以开始将转生仪式作为一个5环仪式来施放。

处理这些事件的一个好方法，是按周程表以休整模式来运行。每过一周，先调整柳岸镇的损耗，然后允许每位玩家进行一个休整期行动。之后，再演出该周预定发生的所有事件（这些事件不会影响PC们投入所选休整期行动的时间）。

Winter Events

During the weeks the PCs must wait before they can cast transmigrate, winter doesn’t wait, and as the weeks go by, the town must endure the attrition of hope, food, and security as detailed on page 151 at the start of this act.

In addition to this steady attrition, several other events take place as winter marches ceaselessly onward. Unlike “Act 2: Let the Leaves Fall,” where an event took place every week of the fall season, the events that take place during winter are either scheduled to occur on specific days or are left open to happen at any time. The following timeline summarizes when these 13 events should occur, including those in the previous chapter. Feel free to adjust these dates as needed in your game to account for the ebb and flow of play!

Winter Timeline

The events in this act should occur in roughly the following order. Events that aren’t keyed to specific days are listed as “Any,” but should still take place before those that follow.

Day 1 Chapter 8’s events, after which the PCs can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VJgSQBYwXGDbMmiW]{Mindscape Shift} to visit Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape as they wish.

The day after returning from Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event4shinzo00]{Event 4. Shinzo’s Answers}. @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event5facele00]{Event 5 - Faceless Evil} begins; the PCs can start researching transmigration

Every 7 days @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event6little00]{Event 6 - Little Gifts}

Any @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event7thefox00]{Event 7 - The Fox Ghost}

Day 10 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event8alonel00]{Event 8 - A Lonely Home}

Any @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event8alonel00]{Event 8 - A Lonely Home}

Day 21 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event10thecl00]{Event 10 - The Claylight Festival}; first actual day of winter.

Any @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event11nosoi00]{Event 11 - Nosois’ Brunch}

Any @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event12these00]{Event 12 - The Seance}

Day 44 The earliest day by which the prepared sakaki slats for casting transmigrate will be ready.

Day 71 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event13inter00]{Event 13 - Interview with a Spider}

Day 72 (New Year’s Day) The PCs can begin casting transmigrate as a 5th-level ritual at this point.

A good way to run these events is via downtime mode on a week-by-week schedule. Each week that passes, adjust Willowshore’s attrition, then allow each player to pursue a downtime activity. After that, play out any events scheduled to take place during that week (these events won’t impact the time the PCs spend on a chosen downtime pursuit).

Researching Transmigration.name: 研究转生 Researching Transmigration
Researching Transmigration.text:
研究转生

关于转生仪式的笔记

显然，赫总督并不知道他自己的心景只是困住柳岸镇的更大思维空间的一个较小版本，但他的研究仍然很有价值，可以总结如下。

  • 总督在春季最后一天试图加固苦迦菩提的笼子，却以一场灾害告终，镇上所有人都因此丧命。赫总督被困在了他自己的小型思维空间中，而其他所有人则被困在了包含该地区腹地在内的更大思维空间里。
  • 尽管所有人都死了，他们现在仍继续“活着”，被困在这个不断重复、持续一整年的思维空间中。赫总督把灵魂在这样的思维空间里形成新身体的现象称为“转生”，这个词他也交替用来指代这样的人回归生者世界的概念。依照这个定义，转生与转生术相似，不同之处在于，为被杀死的灵魂创造出的新身体并不是另一个不同的身体；相反，那正是该灵魂在其最近一世中所拥有的同一个身体。
  • 赫总督关于转生术仪式的配方，本可以让被困在这个思维空间中的人借助柳岸镇长明灯发出的光，从这个思维空间前往生者世界；但这些笔记并不完整，部分原因在于他不了解转生术仪式，另一部分原因则是他独自研究，而且对灵性事务并不特别精通。对于知晓转生术仪式，或在异能或宗教事务方面更加博学的人来说，完成这项工作会容易得多。

赫总督的笔记是用通用语写成的，但阅读它们需要花费8小时工作。一旦某位玩家角色读完这些日记和笔记，他们学到的关键内容就总结在上方的《仪式笔记》讲义中。

玩家角色应当已经在前一幕中发现了 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{转生术} 的配方。有了这些笔记以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{复活术} 的配方（即使他们暂时还无法亲自学会或施放该仪式），他们就比赫总督当年更有希望完成他的工作。尽管如此，玩家角色仍必须花时间继续研究并开发 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生术}，之后才能尝试施放该仪式。要研究这个仪式，玩家角色必须花费8小时研究该主题，并使用以下研究数据表来追踪进度。

知晓 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{转生术} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{复活术} 的玩家角色，可使这些研究检定的所有难度等级降低2。若同时知晓两者，则可使这些研究检定的所有难度等级降低4。

转生 研究 8

单独调查 你花一整天研究赫总督的笔记，并推导你自己关于转生术仪式可能如何运作的理论；最大研究点 3

研究检定 @Check[academia-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[library-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]，或 @Check[arcana|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[occultism|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

请教专家 你花一整天与一位本地专家讨论这一主题；每名非玩家角色最大研究点 2

研究检定 @Check[arcana|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]（在慈母之环与井川十兵卫交流）；@Check[nature|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]（与木灵大柳树交流）；@Check[occultism|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]（在拜访期间与信藏交流）；@Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]（在魂流圣母堂与伊莉泽丝·坎多拉交流）

在圣祠中内省 你在柳岸镇众多圣祠之一或自然美景之地前，以安静思索或祷告的方式度过一天；最大研究点 3

研究检定 @Check[occultism|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] 或 @Check[religion|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research ]

2 研究点 让死者重返生命的仪式通常需要一具尸体（或者至少是尸体的一部分）。但在这里，并不存在尸体，而赫总督提出把长明灯之光用作这个世界与生者领域之间某种“通道”的想法，正是对这一问题的绝妙解决方案。给予玩家角色10 XP。

4 研究点 在仪式中纳入一种对长寿与生命本身的象征性致意与让步十分重要——鹭鸟的羽毛是完美的选择，因为人们长久以来相信鹭能活上数百年，并能在精魂过渡到新生命时“净化”它们。羽毛必须采自一只活着的鸟，而且在施放仪式时那只鸟仍必须活着。除此之外，焚烧珍稀熏香与经过特殊处理的榊木板条，也是此仪式最理想的成分；但准备这些榊木板条的过程既昂贵又耗时。更令人兴奋的是，研究中还暗示，威力更强的转生术版本也许能让不止玩家角色的更多灵魂逃离思维空间。给予玩家角色20 XP。

6 研究点 赫总督的大部分研究都集中于“牺牲”这一概念——尤其是牺牲一个生命，以推动另一个“更有价值”的生命脱离这个思维空间炼狱；在这一过程中，被牺牲的生命会在巨大窑炉内、包覆于黏土外壳中被仪式性焚化。这倒不完全是因为总督偏好邪恶，而更多是由于他缺乏关于转生术的知识所作出的让步。研究到这一阶段时，一名玩家角色会灵光一现——如果改为把要转生的人放入黏土外壳中，再将其置于巨大窑炉中烧制，那么生命的牺牲便可以被“内化”，从而只影响要转生的目标。当然，若仪式执行不正确，可能会导致痛苦的灼伤（甚至致命），但对于任何希望避免以一命换一命的人来说，这种风险都是值得承担的。更强大转生仪式的可能性也得到了确认——它甚至可能让玩家角色把镇上的建筑也一并转移到生者世界中，以替代如今那里存在的废墟。给予玩家角色30 XP。

8 研究点 玩家角色完成了转生术的配方，这是一种从长明灯汲取成功所需力量的仪式。玩家角色同时也知道，只要长明灯在生者世界中仍未点亮（这一点由信藏告知他们），他们便只能施放该仪式的4环版本，而无法施放能让他们更永久返回生者世界的5环版本。给予玩家角色60 XP。

建造窑炉：玩家角色必须建造一个足够容纳他们所有人的窑炉，以便他们能接受转生术。这样做需要一周工作时间、花费25 gp资源，并且需要一名角色成功通过一次 @Check[crafting|dc:20] 检定。如果玩家角色得到永焰铁工坊的支援，其主人雍武秀可以代为免费建造窑炉；制陶多少超出她的技能范围，但她对熔炉与火工的知识足以让她在一周工作后自动建成一个堪用的窑炉，使玩家角色可以自由进行其他休整期行动。

采集鹭羽：要从一只活鹭身上采集羽毛，一名玩家角色必须花一天时间在柳岸镇腹地狩猎中，并尝试一次 @Check[survival|dc:20] 检定。成功时，他们能采到足够尝试施放两次转生术的羽毛；若大成功，则他们获得的羽毛足够尝试该仪式六次。如果玩家角色得到银雾旅舍或九耳神社的支援，那么这些地点的朋友可以改为免费为他们提供这些羽毛（只要他们先有一天时间去采集即可）。

准备榊木板条：一名玩家角色可以通过将数十片榊木板条浸泡在特殊油料中，制备出足以多次施放该仪式的板条，但没有办法缩短所需时间。油料花费25 gp（如果玩家角色至少被柳岸镇两大派系之一所钦佩，则该费用可由任一派系支付），且无需检定即可完成制备。整个过程大约需要六周，这意味着玩家角色最早也要到冬季中期——如果他们在取得4研究点时进度较晚，甚至可能更晚——才能尝试施放转生术。在这种情况下，可酌情缩短准备板条所需的时间，以确保玩家角色至少还有几周时间完成 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{第10章}。

Researching Transmigration

Notes on Transmigration

While it’s apparent Governor Heh didn’t know his mindscape was a smaller version of the larger one Willowshore is trapped in, his research remains valuable and can be summarized as follows.

  • The governor’s failed attempt to bolster Kugaptee’s cage on the last day of spring ended in disaster, killing everyone in town. Governor Heh became trapped in his own small mindscape, while everyone else became trapped in the larger one that includes the region’s hinterlands.
  • Even though everyone died, they live on now, trapped in this repeating, year-long mindscape. Governor Heh’s term for a soul forming a new body in a mindscape like this is “transmigration”—a word he also uses interchangeably for the concept of such a person returning to the living world. Transmigration is similar to reincarnation in this definition, save that the new body created for the slain soul isn’t a different one; rather, it is the same one that soul possessed in its most recent life.
  • Governor Heh’s formula for a transmigrate ritual would allow those trapped within this mindscape to use the light shining from Willowshore’s Eternal Lantern to travel from this mindscape to the living world, but the notes are incomplete, in part due to his ignorance of the reincarnate ritual, and in part because he was working alone and wasn’t particularly well-versed in spirituality. Completing the work will be much easier for someone who knows the reincarnate ritual or is more learned in occult or religious matters.

Governor Heh’s notes are written in Common, but reading them takes 8 hours of work. Once a PC reads the journals and notes, the key elements they learn are summarized in the Ritual Notes handout above.

PCs should’ve discovered the formula for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{Reincarnate} in the previous act. Armed with these notes and the formula for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} (even if they can’t quite yet learn or cast the ritual themselves), they’re in a much better place to complete the governor’s work than he ever was. Still, the PCs must spend time continuing to research and develop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate} before they can attempt to cast the ritual. To research the ritual, the PCs must spend 8 hours researching the topic, using the following research stat block to track progress.

A PC who knows @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{Reincarnate} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} reduces all DCs for these research checks by 2. A PC who knows both reduces all DCs for these research checks by 4.

Transmigration Research 8

Solo Investigations You spend the day examining Governor Heh’s notes and working out your own theories on how the transmigrate ritual might work; Maximum RP 3

Research Checks @Check[academia-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[library-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research], or @Check[arcana|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[occultism|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research]

Consulting Experts You spend the day discussing the topic with a local expert; Maximum RP 2 per NPC

Research Checks @Check[arcana|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] (consulting with Igawa Jubei at Mother’s Coil); @Check[nature|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] (consulting with the kodama Great Willow); @Check[occultism|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] (consulting with Shinzo during a visit); @Check[religion|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] (consulting with Elizeth Candora at Her Fluvial Lady of Souls)

Introspection at a Shrine You spend the day in quiet thought or prayer, meditating in the presence of one of Willowshore’s many shrines or places of natural beauty; Maximum RP 3

Research Checks @Check[occultism|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[religion|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research ]

2 Research Points Rituals to bring the dead back to life typically require a dead body (or at least a part of one). In this case, no dead body exists, but Governor Heh’s idea of using the Eternal Lantern’s light as a sort of “pathway” between this world and the living realm is a brilliant solution to this problem. Grant the PCs 10 XP.

4 Research Points Including a metaphorical nod and concession toward longevity and life itself is important—feathers from a heron, long believed to live for centuries and to be capable of “purifying” spirits as they transition to new lives, would work perfectly. The feathers should be gathered from a living bird that must still be alive when the ritual is cast. Beyond this, the burning of rare incense and specially treated slats of sakaki wood serve as the best components for this ritual, but the process of preparing those sakaki slats is expensive and time consuming. Even more exciting, there are hints that a more powerful version of transmigrate might allow for many more souls than just the PCs to escape the mindscape. Grant the PCs 20 XP.

6 Research Points Most of Governor Heh’s research focused on the concept of sacrifice—in particular, the sacrifice of one life in order to propel another, “worthier” life out of this mindscape purgatory, in which the sacrificed life was ritualistically incinerated in a clay shell within a huge kiln. This was less because of a predilection toward evil on the governor’s part and more of a concession due to his lack of knowledge of reincarnation. At this point in the research, a PC has an epiphany—by placing the person to be transmigrated into the clay shell instead and then firing them in a huge kiln, the sacrifice of life can be internalized, so that only the target to be transmigrated is affected. Of course, failure to perform the ritual correctly can result in painful (and potentially lethal) burns, but such a risk would be worth it for anyone who wishes to avoid sacrificing one life for another. The possibility of a greater transmigration ritual is also confirmed—and it might even allow the PCs to transmigrate the town’s structures into the living world as well to replace the ruins that exist there now. Grant the PCs 30 XP.

8 Research Points The PCs complete the formula for transmigrate, a ritual that draws the power it needs to succeed from the Eternal Lantern. The PCs also know that as long as the Eternal Lantern remains unlit in the living world (as revealed to them by Shinzo), they’ll only be able to cast the 4th-rank version of the ritual, not the 5th-rank one that will allow for a more permanent return to the living world. Grant the PCs 60 XP.

Building the Kiln: The PCs must construct a kiln large enough for all of them to be placed in so that they can be subjected to transmigrate. Doing so requires a week’s work, an expenditure of 25 gp in resources, and for a character to succeed at a @Check[crafting|dc:20] check. If the PCs have the support of Eternal Blaze Ironworks, its owner, Yong Wu-Xiu, can step in to construct the kiln for them free of charge; pottery is somewhat outside of her skill set, but her knowledge of forges and working with fire allow her to construct a serviceable kiln automatically after a week’s work, leaving the PCs free to pursue other downtime activities.

Gathering Heron Feathers: To gather heron feathers from a living heron, a PC must spend a day on the hunt in Willowshore’s hinterlands and attempt a @Check[survival|dc:20] check. On a success, they net enough feathers to attempt to cast transmigrate twice, and with a critical success, they have enough to attempt the ritual six times. If the PCs are supported by Silvermist Lodge or Nine Ear Shrine, their friends at those locations can instead provide these feathers for them as needed for free (as long as they have a day to gather them first).

Preparing the Sakaki Slats: A PC can prepare dozens of sakaki slats, enough to cast the ritual many times over, by soaking them in special oils, but there is no way to shorten the time required to do so. The oils cost 25 gp (a cost that either of Willowshore’s factions can pay if the PCs are at least admired by one of them), and no check is required to prepare them. The process takes about six weeks, which means the earliest the PCs can attempt to cast transmigrate is the middle of winter—or perhaps even later if they’re late in achieving 4 Research Points on the topic. In this case, consider reducing the time it takes to prepare the slats as needed to give the PCs at least a few weeks to complete @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{Chapter 10}.

Spreading the News.name: 传播消息 Spreading the News
Spreading the News.text:
传播消息

如果PC将他们已经死去、实际上成了幽灵的事实告知其余村民，回应自然会充满惊讶、痛苦与愤怒——面对骇人的消息，说出真相并不总是最圆融、最能安抚人心的选择，但从长远来看，对镇民坦诚或许才是最好的做法。若PC把真相向所有人揭露，柳岸镇的居民会表现出比预料中更强的精神韧性；毕竟在这场战役先前的事件之后，死亡不过是神祇又朝他们砸来的另一桩不公而已。如果PC已经将自己塑造成村中的权威人物，一些更强势或更爱争吵的村民很快就会开始追问PC打算如何处理这局面。毕竟，是英雄们把这个问题提出来的，那修复它自然也是他们的责任！

虔诚的法拉斯玛信徒角色也许会建议顺其自然地接受死亡，而非设法重返生者世界，但这种观点显然极不受大众欢迎，甚至有些村民会威胁要把持这种意见的人扔进河流。揭露所有人都已经死去的真相，会使队伍的希望点减少[[/r 2d6]]；除非他们同时传播消息，说明他们或许能利用从赫总督那里获得的一项仪式找到让所有人重返生命的方法（在这种情况下，希望点减少量降至2点）。

如果赫山宝所作所为的真相被公之于众，大多数人都会公开表示愤恨。柳岸镇的人本来就谈不上多么爱戴这位总督，如今更会立刻宣称此人是个蠢货。像胡婆婆这样的年长村民会高声说出他们认为总督当初本该怎么做，不过由于柳岸镇的大多数居民对超自然现象的了解只来自道听途说和迷信，因此这些办法里真正切实可行的并不多。这条消息仍会削弱镇民对官府的信任，使队伍的安全点减少[[/r 1d4+2]]。不过，如果PC将能让柳岸镇恢复生命的仪式归功于赫总督，并且在这么做时成功通过一次@Check[diplomacy|dc:20]检定，那么这些批评者就会显得只是嘴上说说，很快便会原谅他（在这种情况下，只会失去1安全点）。

如果PC在自己得知这则消息后的几天内没有将其传播出去，那么一旦消息后来公开，他们就有失去柳岸镇居民信任的风险；若发生这种情况，每当一项重大的藏匿真相被公开时，PC与每个派系的声望点都会失去2点。

Spreading the News

Should the PCs inform the rest of the villagers that they’re dead and actually ghosts, the response is predictably filled with surprise, anguish, and anger—truth is not always the most diplomatic and calming choice to make when it comes to frightening news, but in the long run, it might be best to be honest with the townspeople. Willowshore’s inhabitants prove more mentally resilient than might be expected if the PCs reveal the truth to them all, as after the previous events of the campaign, being dead is simply one more outrage the gods have slung their way. If the PCs have positioned themselves as authorities within the village, some of the more assertive or quarrelsome villagers quickly start to ask what the PCs intend to do about the situation. After all, the heroes brought the problem up, which makes it their responsibility to fix!

Devout Pharasmin characters might suggest allowing death to take its natural course instead of seeking to return to life, but this viewpoint proves extremely unpopular among the general public, with some of the villagers threatening to throw anyone with that opinion into the river. Revealing the truth that everyone is dead reduces the party’s Hope Points by [[/r 2d6]] unless they also spread the news that they might be able to find a way to bring everyone back to life using a ritual they recovered from Governor Heh (in which case, the Hope Point reduction is minimized to 2 points).

Should the truth about Heh Shan-Bao’s actions be brought to light, the majority of people show open resentment. The governor was never particularly loved by Willowshore, and they’re quick to proclaim the man a fool now. Older villagers, such as Granny Hu, loudly share their thoughts on what the governor should’ve done instead, though since most of Willowshore’s residents know about the supernatural only through second-hand experience and superstition, few of these solutions are actually practical. This news still erodes the townsfolk’s trust in their government, reducing the party’s Security Points by [[/r 1d4+2]]. If the PCs credit Governor Heh with a ritual that can return Willowshore to life, however, and they succeed at a @Check[diplomacy|dc:20] check when doing so, these detractors prove insincere and are quick to forgive (in this case, only 1 Security Point is lost).

If the PCs don’t spread this news within a few days of learning it themselves, they risk losing trust among Willowshore’s residents if that news later becomes public; if this occurs, the PCs lose 2 Reputation Points with each faction every time a significant hidden truth is made public.

Current Objectives.name: 当前目标 Current Objectives
Current Objectives.text:
当前目标

在本章剩余的内容中，队伍的主要目标是研究（并完成）赫山宝的转生仪式，以重返人世；同时尽可能保护更多村民，好让这些村民也能被带回生者世界。正如信藏所指出的那样，玩家角色自己也可能已经推断出来：马戈凯麾下驱邪师的干扰，意味着玩家角色不能再无所作为地等待循环重置，然后再从更有利的位置重新尝试。要是旧伐木营地成功驱散英雄们与邻里如今所栖身的心景，他们就会彻底死亡。更糟的是，如果凯的工人们搜遍这片区域并砍倒丹杉，苦迦菩提就能够转生，而这名邪魔半神将被释放到神门之中！

当然，时间不会停下来等待玩家角色，即便是在死亡之后也是如此。在冬季的数月之间，各种事件接连出现，困扰着柳岸镇的居民，而玩家角色必须提前准备，并在这些事件到来时加以应对。其中一些事件有固定的时间范围，或取决于玩家角色的行动；除此之外，游戏主持应将它们分散安排在本幕的进程中。

此外，凯的驱邪师借助一口神圣的庙钟，在这片地区周围设下了灵性屏障。他们自认为是在隔离柳岸镇废墟中危险的超自然存在，但这些屏障也会妨碍转生仪式按预期生效；当玩家角色使用该仪式时，他们回到生者领域时会成为更接近不死而非活物的生物——而且只是暂时如此。若玩家角色想真正重返人世，而不是只享有那种苍白而短暂的生命仿制品，就必须摧毁或移除这些屏障。他们最有可能在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event12these00]{降神仪式}期间察觉到这些屏障的存在；但如果他们在尝试让自己复生之前还没有发现这些屏障，信藏或另一位对超自然现象敏感的非玩家角色也可以警告他们注意这些屏障。

Current Objectives

The party’s main goals for the rest of this chapter are to research (and finish) Heh Shan-Bao’s transmigrate ritual to return to life and to protect as many villagers as possible so the villagers can also be returned to life. As Shinzo noted and the PCs might have pieced together themselves, the interference of Mago Kai’s exorcists means the PCs can’t afford to sit idly and wait for the cycle to reset for them to try again from a more advantageous position. Should the lumber camp succeed at banishing the mindscape that the heroes and their neighbors currently inhabit, they’ll be dead for good. Worse yet, should Kai’s workers scour the area and chop down the Tan Sugi, Kugaptee will be able to reincarnate, and the fiendish demigod will be unleashed upon Shenmen!

Of course, time doesn’t sit still and wait for the PCs, even in death. Over the course of the winter months, various events appear to trouble the residents of Willowshore, and the PCs will have to prepare for and deal with them as they come. Some of these events have set time frames or depend on PC actions, but otherwise, the GM should space them out over the course of the act.

In addition, Kai’s exorcists have erected spiritual wards around the region using a holy temple bell. They believe themselves to be quarantining a dangerous supernatural presence in Willowshore’s ruins, but these wards also prevent the transmigrate ritual from working as intended; when the PCs use the ritual, they return to the living realm as creatures closer to undeath than life—and only temporarily. The PCs must destroy or remove the wards if they wish to return to life rather than enjoy a pale and fleeting facsimile of it. They’re most likely to discover the presence of these wards during @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event12these00]{The Seance}, but if they don’t discover the wards before attempting to revive themselves, Shinzo or another supernaturally inclined NPC could warn the PCs about the wards.

Event 4. Shinzo’s Answers.name: 事件 4：信藏的答案 Event 4. Shinzo’s Answers
Event 4. Shinzo’s Answers.text:
事件4：信藏的答案

玩家角色返回柳岸镇心景后不久，信藏便带着他那只形影不离的渡鸦同伴翼前来找他们。

信藏脸上带着一抹怅然的微笑向玩家角色打招呼。虽然他仍愿意像之前一样买卖物品，但他也知道，玩家角色已经朝着自救迈出了关键一步。在问候他们时，他以沉重的语气说道：“你们已经揭开了真相。恭喜。你们并不总能做到这一点。我想，你们一定还有许多问题。既然你们已经知道自己是什么，我就被允许回答了。”

信藏建议去一个更舒适的地方交谈，比如青天茶馆；但如果玩家角色等不及想听解释，他也愿意当场回答他们的问题。

你是谁？“我是朝比奈信三，负责收割那些扰乱天界秩序之人的死神。人类称我为‘死神’，也就是死亡之神。”若玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[occultism|dc:26] 或 @Check[religion|dc:26] 检定，便会认出死神是宇宙法则的化身，确保即便是超自然存在也无法逃避死亡。他们也会意识到，信藏似乎发展出了对死神而言异常“人性化”的性格——虽然这并非闻所未闻，但关于那些与凡人过于亲近的死神的传说，往往都以悲剧收场。

我们真的死了吗？“是的，恐怕你们确实已经死了，但你们也依然活着。你们被困在生死之间，困在这片心景之中；只要仍处于这种状态，你们就无法前往来世，但你们也仍有机会重返生命。”

你为什么不告诉我们，我们已经死了？“你为什么会觉得我没说过？躁动不安的灵魂很少会接受自己命运的真相。我刚一说出口，你们立刻就忘了。直到现在，你们靠自己学到了这些事，我们才终于能够自由交谈。”

你为什么会在这里？“一百多年来，这座城镇向每一座圣祠中的每一位神祇祈祷。你们乞求理解。你们乞求协助。你们乞求怜悯。我就是你们的理解，因此此刻我为你们带来答案。我就是你们的协助，因为我为你们带来了补给。我就是你们的怜悯，因为即便你们已经死去，却还没有真正迎来终结。”

我们被困在这里多久了？“柳岸镇死去七年后，我来到了这里。此后，我又在这里守望了一百零八年。你们已经把自己的那一年重复了一百一十五次。这一次或许会是最后一次，也可能不是。答案由你们来决定。”

如今活人的世界是什么样？“络新妇如今统治着神门。那些蜘蛛女人并不仁慈。她们索取白银、木材和人作为贡品。母亲们会划伤自己孩子的脸，只为避免他们因美貌招来艳羡或嫉妒。老人在屋里用蟋蟀安抚那些蜘蛛，希望这样能让怪物带走他们之前，自己还能再熬过一个冬季。柳岸镇早已沦为废墟，几十年来皆是如此。如今，一个名叫@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21magokai0000000]{马戈凯}的人正试图重新占据这里，把它当作行动基地，为了自己的利益采伐这片地区的木材。”

如果你是死神，而我们已经死了，你为什么没有带走我们？“坟墓女士很有耐心。无论你们是回去继续自己的人生，还是以死亡之身站到她面前，重要的都只是自然秩序得到纠正。到最后，你们终究都会来到她面前，无论是哪一种方式。”信藏说着，他的渡鸦发出一声高亢而颤动的鸣叫。若一名玩家角色成功通过一次 @Check[perception|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] 察言观色检定，就能看出，信藏其实更希望柳岸镇重返生命，而不是就此走向死亡——这种倾向远比一个公正无私的死神应有的程度更深。也很明显，死神与他的渡鸦在这个问题上彼此意见不合。

你能帮我们吗？“帮忙？难道我不是一直在帮你们吗？我的本性是夺走生命。我不能赐予你们生命。我也不能在没有命令的情况下杀戮。不过如果你们给我时间，我可以从活人的世界为你们带来情报，或者带来你们可能需要的东西。我也可以告诉你们未来会发生什么，因为有些事情无论轮回如何都会以相同的方式展开。三周后会有一场严酷的冬季风暴，伴随着浓雾。还有，络新妇公主任美璃的一个版本，也会在冬至时首次来到这里，逼迫你们宣誓效忠。她不是真正的公主，但她自己相信她是，而她依然能杀了你们。你们得设法说服她离开，别惹出麻烦；若做不到，就必须在她杀死你们之前先杀了她。这算……乐于助人吗？”这位死神露出不太确定的微笑。

如果你是在帮我们，为什么我们还得为你带来的物品付钱？“别把我误认为慷慨的朋友。我提供给你们的补给并不属于我。我只是给你们提供交易的机会，而这些款项会流向浩瀚众界中的其他存在。我无权掠夺他们的买卖，只为给你们赠送礼物。话虽如此，我确实为自己无法提供更多协助而道歉。我本打算在会面结束时再做这件事，不过既然你们提到了这个话题……”说到这里，信藏会赠予玩家角色《英雄传承》中“宝藏”部分详述的四件魔法物品，见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20heroiclegaci00]{英雄传承}。

你为什么能自由出入这片心景？“我能够在现实中旅行；跨越位面于我而言并不是什么困难的事。我不能带你们一起走，因为你们已死，因此无法随我同行。”

你为什么要这么做？“有些理由我将来可以告诉你们，但不是今天。你们只需安心知道，我在这里是为了帮助你们，不必忧虑我为何选择这么做。”他说话时，他的渡鸦在他脚边来回跳动，发出鸣叫，像是不耐烦，又像是在发出警告。

你为什么带着一只渡鸦旅行？“翼并不只是一只渡鸦。翼是我的监督者，也是我的提醒者。翼确保我不会越界。翼很有耐心，但不是永远如此。你们不必为翼操心，因为该操心翼的是我。”尽管他的话让翼显得十分强大，这只渡鸦实际上依然只是一只普通的疫鸟招魂者——但他被安置在这里，作为直接侍奉@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}的更高存在的观察代理，因此意义重大。

我们能不能等待并重置轮回？“你们以前这么做过，为的是试图拯救所有人，但都失败了。每一次轮回重置时，你们的记忆都会复原。不过无论你们怎么选，这都会是最后一次轮回，因为这一次，活人世界中的势力正试图驱邪你们家园的废墟。”

我们不能干脆让马戈凯的驱邪师完成他们的工作吗？“如果你们所寻求的是浩瀚众界和你们的来世，是去拥抱早已将你们带走的死亡，那么可以。你们什么都不必再做，只需要等待。这些驱邪师很快就会完成他们的工作，这片现实将会终结，而你们的灵魂将继续前行，站到坟墓女士面前。在我看来，也许，回到那些被中断的人生会是更好的选择？”

这些驱邪师为什么要这么做？“你们在这里每重复一年，活人的世界就向前推进一年。花了一个多世纪，这座偏远城镇失落的资源终于吸引来了那些想要掠夺它的人。驱邪师由马戈凯率领，此人被恐惧与傲慢驱使，想把柳岸镇据为行动基地，并开始采伐这片土地上的木材。然而，只要你们这些躁动不安的灵体尚未被驱散，他就无法真正展开事业，因为柳岸镇的人民所引发的灵异事件会扰乱一切在此地区开展工作的尝试。你们的幽灵是最后一道防线，而一旦你们消失，他的采伐就会开始。照现在的情况，用不了多久他就会发现谭杉并将其移走；到那时，苦迦菩提的死亡也会随之终结。绝不能容忍他转生到活人世界。”

还有办法救赫总督吗？如果玩家角色曾在他的心景中故意攻击并杀死赫总督，信藏会回答：“救他？摧毁他仅存那点灵魂的，正是你们。你们以为自己的罪行能如此轻易被抹去吗？”否则，这位死神会思索片刻，然后说道：“我不知道。我原以为在苦迦菩提吞噬他之后，已经什么都没剩下了，但是……我觉得你们没法让他重返生命，不过等你们回到活人的世界后，也许能救回他残存的精魂。”

我们该怎么办？“你们寻找失落的总督，以求得答案。虽然他自己或许都没意识到，但他的计划是有价值的。转生仪式就是你们的救赎，但你们必须完成他的研究。即便如此，我担心这种魔法一开始也只会让你们以精魂的形态显现。在活人的领域中，马戈凯把你们长明灯的火焰当作战利品夺走了。那是你们共同体的核心；没有它，我担心你们借由转生仪式最多也只能暂时显现为精魂——但即便作为精魂，你们也应该能对抗他。把提灯的火焰从唐入带回柳岸镇的废墟，它将成为锚点与诱饵。只有这样，你们和这座城镇的人民才能重新找到回家的路，重新找回生命。可惜的是，我对马戈凯及其计划所知甚少——我目前已经查明的这些，已经逼近了在不招致无法挽回的个人后果前提下，我所被允许追查的极限。”（说到这里，翼用力地点头，并高声叫了一次。）

结束会面：信藏与玩家角色会面的主要目的，是揭示他的身份，同时为队伍指出一条清晰的前进道路。死神会继续留在镇上，与玩家角色进行交易，然后再度离开；但他承诺今后每隔一周返回一次，带来新的购物机会，或提供帮助与建议。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.18Ml1AfEku1LqfaG]{神藏的赋礼}
无论是在玩家角色问到他为何向他们收钱购物时，还是在会面结束时，信藏都会向玩家角色揭晓：他为他们收集了一些非常特别的礼物——那些遥远过去名人曾拥有的著名魔法物品的可用复制品。这些英雄传承展示于 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20heroiclegaci00]{此处}。信藏为自己无法提供更多帮助而道歉，并希望这些礼物多少能让这份歉意显得更加真诚。

奖励：玩家角色发现自己已经重复了这一轮回115次，并得知了马戈凯的存在后，给予他们120 XP。

Event 4. Shinzo’s Answers

Soon after the PCs return to the Willowshore mindscape, they’re approached by Shinzo and his ever-present raven companion, Yix.

Shinzo greets the PCs with a wistful smile on his face, and while he’s willing to buy and sell as before, he also knows that the PCs have made a significant step toward their self-rescue. As he greets the PCs, he says in a somber tone, “You’ve uncovered the truth. Congratulations. You don’t always. I expect you have many more questions. Now that you know what you are, I am allowed to answer them.”

Shinzo suggests retiring to a more comfortable place to chat, such as the Cerulean Teahouse, but he is also comfortable answering their questions on the spot if the PCs can’t wait for explanations.

Who are you? “I am Asahina Shinzo, a reaper of those who subvert the celestial order. Humans call me ‘shinigami,’ a god of death.” PCs who succeed at a @Check[occultism|dc:26] or @Check[religion|dc:26] check recognize a shinigami as an incarnation of cosmic law that ensures even supernatural beings can’t escape death. They’re also aware that Shinzo appears to have developed an unusually human personality for a shinigami—while it isn’t unheard of, legends of shinigami who become too close to mortals tend to end in tragedy.

Are we really dead? “Yes, I’m afraid you are, yet you are also still alive. You are trapped between life and death, here in this mindscape, and as long as you remain so, you cannot move on to the afterlife, yet you can still return to life.”

Why didn’t you tell us we were dead? “What makes you think I didn’t? Unquiet spirits rarely accept the truth of their fates. You forgot my words the second I spoke them. Only now that you have learned things for yourselves can we freely converse.”

Why are you here? “For over a hundred years, this town has prayed to every god at every shrine. You begged for understanding. You begged for aid. You begged for mercy. I am your understanding, as now I grant you answers. I am your aid, for I have brought you supplies. I am your mercy, for even though you are dead, you have not yet died.”

How long have we been trapped here? “I arrived here seven years after Willowshore died. I’ve stood vigil here for one hundred and eight more. You have repeated your year a hundred and fifteen times. This may be the last. It may not. That is for you to decide.”

What’s the living world like now? “Jorogumo rule Shenmen now. The spider women are not kind. They take tribute in silver, lumber, and people. Mothers scar the faces of their children so as to avoid attracting admiration or jealousy. Old men placate the spiders in their houses with crickets, hoping it will buy them one more winter before the monsters take them. Willowshore lies in ruins, as it has for decades, and now a man named @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21magokai0000000]{Mago Kai} seeks to reclaim it, to use it as a base of operations to harvest the region’s lumber for his own profit.”

If you’re a shinigami and we’re dead, why haven’t you taken us? “The Lady of Graves is patient. Whether you return to resume your lives or go to stand before her in death, all that matters is that the natural order is righted. You’ll come to her in the end, either way,” Shinzo says, as his raven gives a loud, trilling caw. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] check to Sense Motive can tell Shinzo is invested in Willowshore returning to life rather than passing on to death—far more so than an unbiased shinigami should be. It’s also clear the shinigami and his raven are at odds with each other about this issue.

Can you help us? “Help? Haven’t I been helping you? My nature is to take life. I cannot grant life to you. I cannot kill without orders, either. But if you give me time, I can bring you information or things you might need from the living world. I can tell you what’s going to happen in the future, as well, for some things play out the same regardless of the cycle. There’s going to be a severe winter storm in three weeks, with heavy fog. And a version of the jorogumo princess, Ren Mei Li, will also make her first visit here during the winter solstice to force you to swear fealty. She isn’t the actual princess, but she thinks she is, and she can still kill you. You’ll need to convince her to leave without causing trouble or, barring that, to kill her before she kills you. Is that... helpful?” The shinigami smiles uncertainly.

If you’re trying to help us, why do we have to pay you for the items you bring us? “Do not mistake me for a generous friend. The supplies I provide are not my own. I offer you these chances for trade, but the payments go to others in the Great Beyond. It is not my place to rob them of their trade to provide you gifts. That said, I do apologize for not being able to provide more aid. I had intended to do this at the end of our meeting, but since you brought up the subject...” At this point, Shinzo gifts the PCs the four magic items detailed in Treasure on @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20heroiclegaci00]{Heroic Legacies}.

How is it you can come and go from this mindscape? “I can travel reality; stepping between planes is no significant task for me. I cannot take you with me, for you are dead and thus cannot travel at my side.”

Why are you doing this? “There are reasons I may share with you, but not today. Take solace in that I am here to help you, and worry not why I choose to do so.” As he speaks, his raven hops back and forth on his feet and caws as if impatient, or perhaps in warning.

Why do you travel with a raven? “Yix is more than a raven. Yix is a minder of me and a reminder to me. Yix ensures I do not overstep my bounds. Yix is patient, but not forever. Do not trouble yourself with Yix, for Yix is mine to worry about.” Despite his words making Yix seem powerful, the raven remains a typical nosoi psychopomp—but his placement here as an observer agent of greater powers who directly serve @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} make him important.

Can we wait and reset the cycle? “You’ve done so before, to try to save everyone, but have failed. Each time the cycle resets, your memories revert. But this will be the last cycle, regardless of your choice, for this time, forces in the living world seek to exorcise the ruins of your home.”

Can’t we just let Mago Kai’s exorcists do their job? “If what you seek is the Great Beyond and your afterlife, to embrace the death that has already claimed you, then yes. You need do nothing more than wait, and these exorcists will soon finish their work, this reality will end, and your souls will move on to stand before the Lady of Graves. It seems to me, perhaps, that a return to the lives cut short would be preferable?”

Why are the exorcists doing this? “With each year that you repeat here, the living world travels forward a year. It took over a century, but finally, the lost resources of this remote town have drawn the attention of those who would plunder it. The exorcists are led by Mago Kai, a man driven by fear and pride, who seeks to claim Willowshore as a base of operations and begin the harvest of this land’s lumber. Yet until your restless spirits have been banished, he cannot begin his endeavor in earnest, for the hauntings by the people of Willowshore disrupt any attempt to work in the region. Your ghosts are the last line of defense, and once you are gone, his harvest begins. It won’t be long at this point until he discovers the Tan Sugi and removes it, at which point Kugaptee’s death will end as well. His reincarnation into the living world is not to be tolerated.”

Is there any way to save Governor Heh? If the PCs deliberately attacked and killed Governor Heh in his mindscape, Shinzo responds, “Save him? You’re the ones who destroyed what little of his soul was left to him. Do you think your sins can be so easily erased?” Otherwise, the shinigami thinks for a moment before saying, “I don’t know. I didn’t think there was anything remaining after Kugaptee devoured him, but... I don’t think you can bring him back to life, though you might be able to rescue what remains of his spirit once you return to the living world.”

What can we do? “You sought your lost governor for answers, and while he may not have realized it, his plan has merit. Transmigration is your salvation, but you must complete his research. Even then, I fear that this magic will initially only allow you to manifest as spirits. In the living realm, Mago Kai has taken your Eternal Lantern's flame as a trophy. It was the heart of your community, and without it, I fear the most you can do with transmigration is to manifest temporarily as spirits—yet even as spirits, you should be able to move against him. Return the lantern’s flame from Karahai to Willowshore’s ruins, and it will serve as an anchor and a lure. Only then will you and the people of this town be able to find your way back home and back to life. Alas, I learned little of Mago Kai and his plans—what I’ve discovered already has strained the limits of what I am allowed to pursue without irrevocable personal repercussions.” (At this, Yix nods his head vigorously and caws loudly once.)

Ending the Meeting: The primary purpose of Shinzo’s meeting with the PCs is both to reveal his role and to provide the party with a clear path forward. The shinigami remains in town to trade with the PCs before leaving again, but promises to return once every other week to provide new opportunities to shop or to offer help and advice.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.18Ml1AfEku1LqfaG]{Shinzo's Gifts}
Either when the PCs ask why he has been charging them money to shop or at the end of the meeting, Shinzo reveals to the PCs that he has gathered some very special gifts for them—functional replicas of famous magical items once owned by notables from the distant past. These heroic legacies are presented @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog20advent.JournalEntryPage.20heroiclegaci00]{Here}. Shinzo apologizes for not being able to help more and hopes these gifts go some way toward making that apology all the more sincere.

Reward: For discovering that they’ve repeated this cycle 115 times and learning of Mago Kai, grant the PCs 120 XP.

Winter in Willowshore.name: 柳岸镇之冬 Winter in Willowshore
Winter in Willowshore.text:
柳岸镇之冬

当玩家角色终结赫山宝的心景时，这位镇长的灵魂继续前行，成为苦迦菩提的囚徒，而他的宅邸也回到了柳岸镇，仿佛它从未消失过一般。宅邸的大门已被扯开，用于守护的符箓也已破碎不堪，因此任何人都能轻易进入这栋建筑。不过，没有任何村民敢这么做，玩家角色也很快得知了这一情况。

如果玩家角色回到宅邸，他们会听见里面传来哀切的呜咽声，像是一个孩子虚弱的哭泣。若他们调查，就会发现声音来自一只被关在破旧橱柜里的小黑猫。这只猫名叫黑豆，惊惧、黏人，而且饿得厉害，不过除此之外还算健康。

Winter in Willowshore

When the PCs bring Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape to an end, the governor’s soul moves on to become Kugaptee’s prisoner while his manor returns to Willowshore as if it had never vanished to begin with. The building’s doors have been ripped open and the warding fulus lie in tatters, allowing anyone to enter the building easily. No villager dares do so, though, and the PCs are quickly made aware of this development.

If the PCs return to the manor, they hear the sound of plaintive wails coming from within, like a child crying weakly. Should they investigate, they find the sound comes from a little black cat shut inside a battered cupboard. This cat, Black Bean, is frightened, clingy, and starving but otherwise healthy.

Face-to-Face with Death.name: 直面死亡 Face-to-Face with Death
Face-to-Face with Death.text:
第9章： 直面死亡

随着时间推移，冬季逐渐逼近柳岸镇。白昼越来越短，天气也愈发严酷。每过一周，记得按照 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10weeklyattrit00]{每周损耗} 中的说明减少希望、食物和安全点。本章详细说明了许多额外的遭遇，玩家角色可能需要在其中花费更多点数，或者在少数情况下有机会赚回其中的一小部分。

虽然玩家角色可能不会在冬季的第一周前往赫山宝的心景，但预计他们会在第一个月结束前这么做。因此，本章没有安排任何重要事件在那时发生。冬季的其他事件与发展，则应在玩家角色从那片异界心景返回后，按照本章所列顺序展开。

Chapter 9: Face-to-Face with Death

As time passes, winter advances on Willowshore. The days grow shorter and the weather grows crueler. Each week, remember to reduce Hope, Food, and Security Points as detailed on @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog10oblivi.JournalEntryPage.10weeklyattrit00]{Weekly Attrition}. This chapter details many additional encounters where the PCs might need to spend more points or, rarely, have a chance to earn a few of them back.

While the PCs might not have traveled to Heh Shan-Bao’s mindscape in the first week of winter, it’s expected they’ll do so before the first month passes. As a result, no significant events are scheduled in this chapter to occur then. The other events and developments of winter should play out in the order they’re presented in this chapter, after the PCs’ return from the alternate mindscape.

Act 3.3: This Place is Ours.name: 第三幕 3.3：此地属于我们 Act 3.3: This Place is Ours

Running out of Time.name: 时间所剩无几 Running out of Time
Running out of Time.text:
时间所剩无几

玩家们必须赶在春季最后一天心景重置之前，成功施放 5 环版本的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{转生迁魂}，但如果因为某些原因，这点时间根本不够，又会发生什么呢？若无人阻止，马戈凯会在春季的最后一周砍倒丹杉；而当苦迦菩提脱离死亡时，他会吞噬柳岸镇心景以及其中所有居住者——在这种情况下，既不会有重置，玩家们也不会有任何来世。

如果你仍想继续进入这条冒险路径的下一幕，可以考虑让神秘商人信藏在最后关头出手协助玩家们，帮助他们转生迁魂。不过，这样做在某些小组看来可能会稍微破坏体验，所以如果你想在游戏中使用这一机械降神，务必要先和你的玩家沟通，或者问问他们，小组是否更愿意接受失败。毕竟，并不是每个故事都需要以胜利告终；如果所有人都同意的话，以一个阴郁而可怖的结局来收束这场恐怖主题战役，也未尝不是结束这个故事的糟糕方式！

场景注记宏

@UUID[Macro.qMjiMOWIstGMjrXk]{更换季节}

更改 @UUID[Scene.KjhqnhLwdTc2JUZV]{柳岸镇} 和 @UUID[Scene.6LzSSdZgPfQ2K0dL]{柳岸腹地} 场景的季节。

Running out of Time

The PCs have until their mindscape resets on the last day of spring to successfully cast the 5th-level version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Lk9K3tRnV68MQPW]{Transmigrate}, but what happens if, for whatever reason, that’s simply not enough time? Without being stopped, Mago Kai manages to chop down the Tan Sugi during the last week of spring, and as Kugaptee is released from death, he absorbs the Willowshore mindscape and all who dwell within it—there will be no reset, nor any afterlife for the PCs, in this event.

If you want to continue into the next act of the Adventure Path anyway, you might consider having the mysterious merchant Shinzo step in to aid the PCs at the last minute to help them transmigrate. Doing so can slightly sour the experience in some group’s minds, though, so be sure to communicate with your players if you want to pull this deus ex machina in your game, or ask them if the group would rather embrace failure. After all, not every story needs to end in a win, and a grim, horrific ending to a horror-themed campaign might not be the worst way to close out this tale if everyone agrees to it!

Scene NotesMacro

@UUID[Macro.qMjiMOWIstGMjrXk]{Change Season}

Changes the Season on the @UUID[Scene.KjhqnhLwdTc2JUZV]{Willowshore} and @UUID[Scene.6LzSSdZgPfQ2K0dL]{Willowshore Hinterlands} Scenes.

Concluding the Act.name: 终幕结束 Concluding the Act
Concluding the Act.text:
终幕结束

一旦玩家角色从马戈凯那里得到寺钟敲响者，他们就能轻松停用守护铃。由于寺钟敲响者是用从长明灯上取下的金属燃料容器锻造而成，玩家角色中任何人一接触它，便会本能地产生尽快将这枚钟锤送回长明灯的冲动。若将钟锤放入现世中柳岸镇废墟里的长明灯内，钟锤会立刻恢复成先前作为容器的形态，并迸发出光芒，无需再献上任何钱币。完成此事后，玩家角色只需等到农历新年的第一天，便可开始尝试施展第5环版本的转生仪式。在这段剩余时间里，他们是以魅影之身停留在现世，还是返回心景，都由他们自行决定，但转生仪式必须从心景之内施展。

玩家角色越早施放该仪式越好，因为仪式的整体成功部分取决于施法时柳岸镇还剩下多少准备点数。如果这些点数有一部分或全部降为零，那么能完成转生仪式的居民与建筑就会更少；但如果玩家角色保有足够的点数，整个镇子都能完成这场穿越时代与空间的旅程，重返现世。要让玩家角色和柳岸镇重获生机，请参见《肆季鬼志》冒险路径下一幕也是最后一幕的开篇。

尽管柳岸镇的救赎或许已近在眼前，但活着从来都不容易，而在未来的日子里，这座城镇仍将面临许多挑战。村民与英雄们为这座城镇倾注的爱情与努力，或许能帮助它的一部分灵性存在被带入他们的新世界，但柳岸镇仍必须努力，才能在这个早已将它遗忘的世界中开辟出一席之地。更糟的是，那些原本只能在间接层面伤害他们的政治势力，如今已真实迫近。周明霞对柳岸镇森林的执迷不会随着马戈凯一同消失，而络新妇也很快就会注意到这个突然出现的新村庄。玩家角色终于从死亡手中夺回了自己的生命。现在，就要由他们来保护自己的生命，不受生者野心的侵害。

Concluding the Act

Once the PCs gain the temple bell ringer from Mago Kai, they can easily deactivate the warding bell. As the temple bell ringer was forged from the metal fuel receptacle taken from the Eternal Lantern, the PCs feel an urge to return the bell ringer to the Eternal Lantern as soon as any of them touch it. If the ringer is placed within the Eternal Lantern in the ruins of Willowshore in the living world, the ringer instantly reverts back to its previous form as a receptacle and flares into light without the need for any offerings of coins. This done, the PCs need only wait until the first day of the lunar new year to begin their attempt at the 5th-rank version of transmigrate. Whether they spend their remaining time in the living world as phantoms or return to the mindscape is up to them, but transmigrate must be cast from within the mindscape.

The sooner the PCs cast the ritual, the better, for the overall success of the ritual depends in part on how many Preparation Points the town of Willowshore still has once the ritual is cast. If some or all of these points have been reduced to zero, fewer citizens and buildings will make the transmigration, but if the PCs have enough points, the entire township can make the journey through time and space to return to the living world. See the beginning of the next, and final, act in the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path to bring the PCs and Willowshore back to life.

Though Willowshore’s salvation might just be in sight, living isn’t easy, and the town has many challenges still facing it in the days ahead. The love and effort that the villagers and heroes put into the town might help draw some of its spiritual presence into their new world, but Willowshore still needs to work hard to carve a place in a world that has long forgotten it. Worse yet, the political forces that could only hurt them in the abstract are now very present. Chou Mingxia’s obsession with Willowshore’s forests won’t vanish alongside Mago Kai, and the jorogumo notice the sudden appearance of a new village before too long. The PCs have finally won their lives back from death. Now, it’s up to them to protect their lives from the ambitions of the living.

Garden.name: 花园 Garden
Garden.text:
C22. 花园 中等 9

一座打理得极为精致的花园占据了堡垒中央的庭院，中央有一口带顶棚的井。数棵修剪整齐的木棉树以赏心悦目的间距点缀其间。它们如今枝头光秃，仿佛参差的尖刺向天空伸展。花园南部立起了一顶用杆子支撑的彩色篷盖，其下铺着地毯，摆着一把椅子和一张桌子，桌上备好了茶与点心。

花园 中等 9

@UUID[Actor.d0rXk6BrTDxPSfk4]{马戈凯}

生物：马戈凯已渐渐喜欢上这座花园，几乎把那些木棉树当成了被困住的听众。在等待冬季过去、让他的驱邪师最终把柳岸镇变得足够安全以便重新接管期间，他大部分时间都待在这里，读自己最喜欢的小说放松身心，品茶，或为天气转暖后的春季收成拟定计划。他觉得冬日清冽的空气令人精神振奋，而篷盖则能挡雨。由于他的追随者都明白他重视隐私，玩家角色最有可能在这里遇见他，而且他是独自一人（除非他们在堡垒中散播恐怖时闹得实在太过张扬）。

一看见玩家角色，凯会从椅子上猛地跳起，伸手去抓他的斧头时甚至可能打翻一杯茶，但随后又停了下来。他的驱邪师一直定期向他汇报情况，因此即便玩家角色连1点恐怖值都还没积累，他也认得出他们是来自柳岸镇的精魂。考虑到他们竟能顶着守护铃的影响一路来到这里，这一点就足以警告他：这些精魂可能是危险的对手，因此他希望先用言语而不是斧头来解决这场初次遭遇。如果玩家角色同意与他交谈，参见他的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21magokai0000000]{非玩家角色条目}，了解他们可能打听到什么。

如果玩家角色表现出任何敌意，凯也会毫不迟疑地以同样方式回应。如果他的生命值降到100以下，他会试图在自己的宿舍重新集结。

恐怖 7：凯会撤退到区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c20kaisquart00]{C20} 中的宿舍以求安全。

奖励：如果玩家角色说服马戈凯提供帮助而无需与他交战，则给予他们如同在战斗中击败他一样的XP，然后再为所有仍然活着的驱邪师、雇佣兵和巫女额外给予XP，如同他们也在战斗中击败了那些生物一样。（无论玩家角色在这里本可获得多少XP，他们获得的总量都不应远超升到10级所需；但也不该因为高效地闹鬼而受到惩罚！）

和平的奖励

尽管这场冒险默认马戈凯会在与玩家角色的战斗中丧命，而他们也会获得唐入之中或其守卫携带的大部分宝藏，但此地大多数生物并非邪恶——他们只是对这片地区怀有一些无知的打算，并因此让柳岸镇的人民陷入危险。然而，下一章仍然默认玩家角色应当拥有符合10级角色预期的道具配置。

如果你的玩家角色完成@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{第10章}后，并未因自己的努力而明显变得更富有——若他们与马戈凯谈出了和平解决方案，这种情况就很可能发生——那么当他们返回柳岸镇时，应当由信藏在他最后几次进入心景时的一次现身迎接他们。虽然这次会面不会是玩家角色最后一次遇到这位神秘的死神，但这将是他以商人身份与他们的最后一次见面。信藏会祝贺他们在唐入找到了和平的解决办法，并指出即便身为“死之神”，他也欣赏凡人在暴力冲突中找到非暴力出路。为了表明自己的赞赏，他会给予每位玩家角色一笔可在其商品中购物的额度——这笔额度的价值应足以让玩家角色的道具达到10级角色应有的水平（每位玩家角色约1,500 gp，但如果你觉得他们的资源尤其匮乏，也可以将其上调至每位玩家角色最多3,000 gp）。

C22. Garden Moderate 9

A beautifully tended garden occupies the fortress’s central courtyard, which features a covered well at the center. Several well-pruned cotton trees dot the area at aesthetically pleasing intervals. Their branches are currently bare, giving the impression of jagged spines reaching up toward the sky. A colorful canopy has been erected on poles in the southern part of the garden, under which rugs, a chair, and a table set with tea and snacks has been set up.

Garden Moderate 9

@UUID[Actor.d0rXk6BrTDxPSfk4]{Mago Kai}

Creature: Mago Kai has grown fond of this garden and thinks of the cotton trees almost as a captive audience. While he waits out the winter for his exorcists to finally make Willowshore safe for reclaiming, he spends much of his time here, relaxing with his favorite novels, enjoying tea, or working out his springtime harvest plans for once the weather breaks. He finds the brisk winter air bracing, and the canopy keeps the rain away. Since his followers understand he values his privacy, he’s most likely encountered here, alone, by the PCs (unless they’ve been a bit too exuberant in spreading terror through the fortress).

Upon spotting the PCs, Kai leaps up from his chair, perhaps spilling a cup of tea as he reaches for his axe, but then pauses. He has been updated regularly by his exorcists, and even if the PCs haven’t accumulated a single point of Terror yet, he recognizes them as spirits from Willowshore. The fact that they’ve made it this far, despite the warding bell’s influence, is all he needs as a warning that these spirits are potentially dangerous foes, and so he hopes to solve this initial encounter with words rather than his axe. If the PCs agree to speak to him, see his @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21magokai0000000]{NPC Entry} for what they might be able to learn.

If the PCs show any hostility, Kai doesn’t hesitate to respond in kind. If brought below 100 Hit Points, he attempts to regroup in his quarters.

Terror 7: Kai retreats to his quarters in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c20kaisquart00]{C20} for safety.

Reward: If the PCs convince Mago Kai to help without having to fight him, grant them XP as if they’d defeated him in combat, and then grant them additional XP for all of the exorcists, mercenaries, and shrine maidens who still live, as if they’d defeated those creatures in combat as well. (Regardless of how much XP the PCs might earn here, they shouldn’t earn much more than is needed to reach 10th level, but neither should they be penalized for efficient haunting!)

Rewards for Peace

While this adventure assumes that Mago Kai perishes in a fight with the PCs and that they gain most of the treasure held in Karahai or carried by its defenders, the majority of the creatures found here aren’t evil—they merely have plans for the region that ignorantly put the people of Willowshore in peril. However, the next chapter still assumes the PCs will be geared up as expected for 10th-level characters.

If your PCs finish @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl]{Chapter 10} and don’t come out of it particularly richer for their efforts—as is likely the case if they negotiate a peaceful solution with Mago Kai—then when they return to Willowshore, they should be greeted by Shinzo on one of his final visits to the mindscape. While this meeting won’t be the last time the PCs encounter the mysterious shinigami, it will be their last meeting with him in his role as a merchant. Shinzo congratulates them on finding a peaceful solution in Karahai, noting that even as a “god of death,” he appreciates when mortals find nonviolent solutions to violent conflicts. To prove his admiration, he grants each PC credit to shop among his items—the value of this credit should be enough to bring the PCs’ gear up to where it should be for 10th-level characters (approximately 1,500 gp per PC, but feel free to adjust this up to a maximum of 3,000 gp per PC if you feel they’re particularly resource poor).

Treasury.name: 宝库 Treasury
Treasury.text:
C21. 宝库 中等 9

这间房间的铁门一直上着锁；唯一能打开它的钥匙，是马戈凯携带的唐入要塞钥匙。否则，玩家角色可以成功进行一次 @Check[athletics|dc:30|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] 检定来强行打开它，或者进行四次 @Check[thievery|dc:30|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] 检定来开锁将其打开。

乍看之下，这个房间显得有些平淡无奇，因为里面的搁板和陈列架大多空空如也。朴素无饰的木制箱子放在中央的搁板上，而东南侧的搁板上则随意地摆着一尊描绘国府幸的神像，仿佛只是顺手放在那里。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.vKj1Fw3hlclDB7K1]{宝库}
凯的所有资源与资金都保存在这些箱子里。尽管他为了在唐入站稳脚跟，并进行最初几次夺回柳岸镇的尝试，已经耗尽了大部分初始资金和资源，但这里剩下的仍然相当可观。箱子里可以找到成卷折叠的丝绸、象牙板条、青铜器皿，以及彼此堆叠成垛、形似小船的银锭。若遇紧急情况，这些简朴的方形箱子可以轻松装上运木货车并运出要塞。宝库的内容包括总价值 1,400 gp 的一批银锭、象牙与丝绸的收藏，外加一枚火焰跳跃戒指。

C21. Treasury Moderate 9

This room’s iron door is kept locked; the only key that can open it is the Karahai fortress key Mago Kai carries. Otherwise, a PC can Force it Open with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:30|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] check or unlock it with four @Check[thievery|dc:30|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] checks to Pick the Lock.

At first glance, the room appears somewhat underwhelming, as its shelves and displays are mostly empty. Unadorned wooden chests sit on the central shelf, while a haphazardly placed idol depicting Kofusachi stands almost as an afterthought on the southeastern shelf.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.vKj1Fw3hlclDB7K1]{Treasury}
All of Kai’s resources and funds are kept within the chests. While he has used up most of his initial funding and resources getting set up in Karahai and on his initial attempts to reclaim Willowshore, what remains here is still significant. Within the chests can be found folded bolts of silk, slats of ivory, bronze vessels, and boat-shaped silver ingots stacked on top of one another. In the event of an emergency, the simple square chests can easily be packed onto lumber wagons and carried out of the fortress. The contents of the treasury amount to a collection of silver ingots, ivory, and silk worth 1,400 gp total, along with a fire-jump ring.

Kai’s Quarters.name: 凯的宿舍 Kai’s Quarters
Kai’s Quarters.text:
C20. 凯的住处 微不足道 9

与堡垒的其他地方相比，这个房间带着几分奢华。这里并没有什么特别招摇显眼的东西，但这些私人厅室内摆放着结实且打磨光亮的木制家具。绘有优雅狩猎场景的折屏为房间的一部分提供了些许私密感，北墙边一个冒着烟的炭炉则提供了热量，让这片区域充满宜人的气味与暖意。两张矮桌位于房间西侧，一张上面摆着茶具和点心，另一张则堆满卷轴；而在东侧，这处厅室看起来更像是一间卧室。东墙上有一扇厚重的铁门，配着醒目的门锁，门两侧的墙上各装饰着一把看起来价格不菲的斧头。

这间厅室曾用作堡垒指挥者的宿舍（自龙华陷落后，这一职位便一直空缺），如今则由马戈凯作同样用途。桌上散落的卷轴概述了他对柳岸镇废墟的计划，从驱邪到夷平大部分废墟，再到在这座城镇的残骸之上重建一个更加高效、更加工业化的伐木营地。还有几份笔记标出了附近可能供应罕见木材的潜在地区，“这肯定至少能让周明霞总督满意一年”。在这些地点中，镇子西边生长着谭杉的那片树林似乎尤其令他感兴趣。

对PC们而言，也许更具眼前意义的是一本法典，记述了一件名为守护铃的防护物品的用法。启动守护铃的方法包括一系列吟唱、供品与富有节奏的摇铃，并与施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dbd5W6G8U2vzWolN]{祝圣}仪式同步进行。笔记中还写明了凯、巫女与驱邪师如何从柳岸镇的长明灯中取出燃料容器，再将其金属重铸为铃中的撞锤，并通过适当的仪式与献祭，为其注入一种对提灯中火焰曾赋予柳岸镇之防护的“逆转”。这种力量反而有助于将柳岸镇的精魂困在其中，使它们无法轻易从废墟中扩散。幸运的是，对PC们而言，笔记中还说明了如何用这个撞锤连续扎实敲击守护铃八次，从而使其失效。

凯的住处 微不足道 9

@UUID[Actor.W48BwZkFOHgaiAdO]{活化斧（4）}

生物： 安装在通往C21区域门两侧墙上的四把雅致斧头绝非只是装饰。如果有任何生物在凯不在场时进入房间，这四把斧头会突然活化并俯冲攻击，如同被隐形战士挥舞一般在空中飞舞。若凯在房内，他会简短地下达命令并打个响指；通过一个交互动作，他可以命令这些斧头攻击房间内除他自己之外的所有生物。

这四把斧头按活化物体运作。若被摧毁，它们会坠落在地，并像玻璃制成的一样粉碎。在此之前，这些斧头会一直在这个房间内与任何入侵者战斗，直到被击败；它们不会追击离开该区域的敌人。

恐惧 7： 马戈凯会撤退到自己的房间寻求安全。如同在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c22garden00000]{C22}中一样，他会先试着与PC们交谈，但如果爆发战斗，他会战斗到最后，至死方休。

C20. Kai’s Quarters Trivial 9

In contrast to the rest of the fortress, a modicum of luxury graces this room. While nothing particularly ostentatious catches the eye, these personal chambers feature solid and polished wooden furniture. Folding screens displaying elegant hunting scenes give parts of the room a nod toward privacy, and a smoking charcoal burner against the north wall provides heat, filling the area with a pleasant smell and warmth. Two low tables, one set with a tea service and snacks and another covered with scrolls, sit in the western portion of the room, while to the east, the chamber seems more akin to a bedroom. A large iron door with an imposing lock sits in the eastern wall, while a pair of expensive-looking axes adorn the walls to either side of it.

This chamber, once used as the fort commander’s chambers (a position that had remained vacant since the fall of Lung Wa), now serves the same purpose for Mago Kai. The scattered scrolls on the table outline his plans for Willowshore’s ruins, running from exorcism to razing much of the ruins and then rebuilding a more efficient and industrial logging compound on the town’s bones. Several notes map out potential regions nearby that might supply rare timber “that will certainly appease Governor Chou Mingxia for at least a year.” Among these sites, the grove west of town where the Tan Sugi grows seems of particular interest.

Perhaps of more immediate significance to the PCs is a codex that describes the use of a protective item called a warding bell. The method to activate the bell consists of a series of chants, offerings, and rhythmic rings, coinciding with the casting of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dbd5W6G8U2vzWolN]{Consecrate} ritual. The notes include the method by which Kai, the shrine maidens, and the exorcists extracted the fuel receptacle from Willowshore’s Eternal Lantern, then reforged the metal into a ringer for the bell that would imbue it, through proper rites and sacrifice, with a sort of “inversion” of the protection the flame within the lantern afforded Willowshore. This power instead helps to keep the spirits of Willowshore trapped so they can’t easily spread from the ruins. Fortunately for the PCs, the notes also describe how the ringer can be used to disarm the warding bell by striking it solidly eight times in succession.

Kai's Quarters Trivial 9

@UUID[Actor.W48BwZkFOHgaiAdO]{Animated Axes (4)}

Creatures: The four elegant axes mounted on the walls on opposite sides of the door to area C21 are no mere decorations. If any creature enters the room while Kai isn’t present, the four axes suddenly animate and swoop to attack, flying through the air as if wielded by invisible warriors. If Kai is in the room, he issues a brief command and snaps his fingers; with an Interact action, he can command the axes to attack all creatures in the room save himself.

The four axes function as animated objects. If destroyed, they drop to the ground and shatter as if made from glass. Until then, the axes fight any intruders in this room until defeated; they don’t pursue foes out of the area.

Terror 7: Mago Kai retreats to his room for safety. As in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c22garden00000]{C22}, he’ll first try to speak with the PCs, but if battle ensues, he fights to the bitter end.

Jail.name: 监狱 Jail
Jail.text:
C19. 监狱

这些牢房破败不堪，陈设也极其简陋，每间里只有一个简单的金属便盆和一张编织的灯心草垫。

这些牢门都可以通过一次成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:28|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] 检定来强行打开，或者通过三次 @Check[thievery|dc:25|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] 检定来开锁，也可以用马戈凯随身携带的唐入骷髅钥匙解锁。

生物：来自唐入的村民胡德明目前是这里唯一被关押的囚犯。他被锁链拴在东北侧牢房的地板上，脖子上还套着一副枷锁。木材大亨占领这座堡垒时，德明曾朝凯扔了一条鱼，从那以后就一直被关在这里。虽然他对玩家角色的意图心怀戒备，尤其是考虑到他们那种古怪、幽灵般的本质，但他当前的状态让他根本没有机会躲藏或逃跑。他同意以重获自由为交换，把自己知道的事情告诉他们。或者，若一名玩家角色成功进行一次 @Check[deception|dc:23|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie] 检定来说谎，也可以让他在对方并不打算兑现释放承诺的情况下开口；但一旦德明意识到自己被背叛了，或者玩家角色没能胁迫住他，他就会开始大声呼救。如果他这么做，外围环道上的任意一支巡逻队都会在 [[/r 1d4]] 分钟内赶来查看。

如果有机会，德明会对玩家角色滔滔不绝地说个没完；但实际上，他因长期被囚，掌握的信息也很有限。自从马戈凯搬进来后，建筑都被如何重新利用了，他并不清楚。下面列出了一些可能的问题及其回答。

你为什么会被关在这里？“其实也没什么大不了的；就是那头笨牛凯居然厚着脸皮叫我滚出我自己的商店时，我稍微闹腾了一下。”

你能告诉我们这座堡垒的情况吗？“当然，我在这儿干了一辈子活。直到今年早些时候马戈凯来了为止。卖鱼这行是挺腥臭的，可总得有人做，对吧？”德明夸张地眨了眨眼。“这地方的布局其实很简单。像个大车轮。四周一圈都是商店。马厩在西北边，如果我没记错，猪圈就在这儿东面一点。”

你能和我们说说马戈凯吗？“那个贪婪、蠢笨、偷鸡摸狗的猪崽子？当然能！他就是把猪头塞进马屁股里的货，脸上还长了一堆鬃毛，正好拿来刷里面。他像只泡烂了的甲鱼。像条死鱼眼的炒烂蛋。他爹娘要是当初生下来的是块烤猪肉，都比生他强。他整个人连一枚金币里两枚铜币的分量都不值。”德明这番怒骂至少会持续五分钟，措辞越来越花哨，还会扯出更多在解剖学上根本不可能成立的比喻，之后才会重新绕回有用的信息上。“他自称是什么司泽来的领主。根本不在乎我们，只在乎他能榨走多少木材和财富。身边总带着一把大斧子，不过我怀疑他连怎么挥都不会。”

你见过一口大型青铜钟吗？“见过，他们刚到的时候把它放在一辆车上。刚来的时候还敲过几下，不过后来就没再敲了。那种贵重东西多半锁在金库里。就在堡垒南边那栋内层建筑里。不过得小心；我听说有个醉醺醺的士兵晃进去，结果倒了大霉，既被肢解，脑袋又被砸了个稀巴烂。”

那凯的追随者呢？“我可说不上喜欢他们中的任何一个，毕竟他们都是那蠢货的狗腿子。不过嘛，等那个又大又坏的妖怪上门时，要说我不想让这些‘光明的高尚卫士’站岗，那我就是在撒谎。嗯，至少他们大多数人是这样。”

大多数人？“这里头有古怪。有几个祭司一直偷偷摸摸地四处活动，以为没人听见的时候就在那儿低声耳语。我不是什么专家，但整件事就是有哪里不对劲。有什么邪门的东西。脸颊上有疤的那个女人，看起来像是他们的头儿。”

恐慌值 6：德明因为听见牢房外那些可怕声响，已经在自己的偏执狂乱中煎熬许久了。如果他看见玩家角色，就会发出一声令人毛骨悚然的尖叫，使总恐慌值增加 1 点。这会像德明呼救时那样，同样惊动外围环道上的巡逻队。当然，由于他被关着，也不可能真的从鬼魂手中逃走；玩家角色仍可如上所述向他问话，而不必与他讨价还价，不过这时他的回答里会夹杂更多哭喊与哀求。

@UUID[Actor.8ad7swUxoJZ950Ui]{胡德明}生物 -1

  • 中型
  • 人类
  • 类人生物

奖励：如果玩家角色救出了胡德明并获知了他的情报，给予他们 80 XP。

C19. Jail

These jail cells are wretched and sparsely furnished, with a simple metal bed pan and a woven rush mat as the only appointments in each.

Each of these cell doors can be Forced Open with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:28|traits:attack,skill,action:force-open|name:Force Open] check, opened with three @Check[thievery|dc:25|traits:manipulate,skill,action:pick-a-lock|name:Pick a Lock] checks to Pick the Lock, or unlocked with the Karahai skeleton key carried by Mago Kai.

Creatures: Hu Deming, a villager from Karahai, is currently the only prisoner incarcerated here. He’s chained to the floor in the northeastern cell with a cangue fastened around his neck. Deming threw a fish at Kai when the lumber baron took over the fortress and has been imprisoned here ever since. While he’s wary of the PCs’ intentions, especially considering their strange, ghostly nature, his current condition leaves him no opportunity to hide or flee. He agrees to tell them what he knows in exchange for his freedom. Alternatively, a PC who succeeds at a @Check[deception|dc:23|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie] check to Lie can get him to open up without intending to follow through on a promise to release him, but once Deming realizes he has been betrayed, or if the PCs fail to Coerce him, he starts yelling for help. If he does so, any patrol on the periphery ring comes to check on him in [[/r 1d4]] minutes.

While Deming talks the PCs’ ears off if given the chance, in reality, his information is limited by his many months of incarceration. He doesn’t know how buildings have been repurposed since Mago Kai moved in. Some likely questions and their responses are listed below.

What are you in here for? “Nothing much, really; just got a little rowdy when that blundering ox Kai had the gall to tell me to get out of my own shop.”

What can you tell us about the fortress? “Plenty, worked here all my life. Until Mago Kai got here earlier in the year, that is. Fishmongering’s a smelly business, but someone’s got to do it, right?” Deming gives an exaggerated wink. “It’s a pretty simple design. Like a big wheel. Shops all around. Stables to the northwest, pig pen just east of here if I recall.”

Can you tell us about Mago Kai? “That greedy, blockheaded, thieving son of a sow? Sure thing! He’s a pig’s head shoved up a horse’s rear, with plenty of bristles on his face to scrub out the insides. He’s a soggy softshell turtle. A fish-eyed, scrambled-up egg. His parents would have been better off if his mother had given birth to a chunk of roasted pork. He’s two coppers out of a gold coin.” Deming continues on in this tirade for at least five minutes, his language growing more colorful and citing more anatomical impossibilities, before he circles back to useful information. “He claims to be some kind of lord from Sze. Doesn’t care about us; just whatever lumber and wealth he can squeeze. Carries around a big axe, but I doubt he even knows how to swing it.”

Have you seen a large bronze bell? “Yeah, they had it on a cart when they got here. Banged on it a bit when they first arrived, but not since. Something that fancy is probably locked up in the vault. Southern inner building in the fort. Watch out, though; I heard talk of a drunken soldier wandering in there and being simultaneously dismembered and having their head bashed in for their trouble.”

What about Kai’s followers? “Can’t say I care for any of them, on account of them being that oaf’s lackeys. But when the big bad yokai comes a-knocking, I’d be lying if I said I didn’t want these ‘virtuous defenders of the light’ standing guard. Well, most of them anyway.”

Most of them? “There’s something strange going on. A few of the priests have been sneaking around, whispering when they think no one is listening. I’m no expert, but there’s just something wrong about the whole thing. Something evil. The one with the scar on her cheek seems to be the ringleader of them.”

Terror 6: Deming has been stewing in his paranoia about the terrible noises he’s been hearing outside of his cell. If he sees the PCs, he lets out a bloodcurdling shriek, adding 1 Terror Point to the total. This alerts the patrol on the periphery ring, in the same manner as it would if Deming had called for help. Of course, as he’s imprisoned, he can’t exactly escape the ghosts; the PCs can question him as above without having to bargain with him, though his answers involve a lot more crying and begging.

@UUID[Actor.8ad7swUxoJZ950Ui]{Hu Deming}Creature -1

  • Medium
  • Human
  • Humanoid

Reward: If the PCs rescue Hu Deming and learn his information, grant them 80 XP.

Armory.name: 军械库 Armory
Armory.text:
C18. 军械库

成排的剑、薙刀和斧头将这个房间分隔成一条条过道。厚重的板甲套在靠远侧墙边的木制假人上，其中几个假人的手臂上挂着黑色盾牌。地板上放着两面大型战鼓。战鼓旁边是装满箭矢和弩矢的木桶。西南角落的一张工作台上整齐摆放着保养工具。一侧是一台脚踏砂轮，另一侧则是一座小型熔炉和铁砧。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.EBXeltUhDZe6ExAk]{军械库}
这里存放的大多数东西都是非魔法、做工寻常的武器和护甲，但若有玩家角色在这些装备中搜索，便能发现一把+2强击九环刀、两瓶各装有一份高等猎豹灵药的烧瓶，以及一块丝布包裹着的三支风暴箭矢。

更令人不安的是，同样的搜索还会在熔炉周围的地面上发现破损金属碎片；任何玩家角色都能辨认出这些碎片来自长明灯的燃料容器，这意味着有人把这件神器的钥匙部件当作基础金属，用来锻造成了某种新的东西。

C18. Armory

Racks of swords, naginatas, and axes split this room into aisles. Thick, plated armor sits on wooden dummies against the far wall, black shields hanging from a few of their arms. Two large war drums sit on the floor. Next to the drums are barrels filled with arrows and crossbow bolts. A workbench in the southwest corner is covered in neatly arranged maintenance tools. At one side is a foot pedal grindstone, while at the other are a small forge and anvil.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.EBXeltUhDZe6ExAk]{Armory}
Most of the items stored here are non-magical weapons and armor of mundane quality, but a PC who Searches among the armaments can discover a +2 striking jiu huan dao, a pair of flasks each containing a greater cheetah’s elixir, and a silk cloth wrapped around three storm arrows.

More distressingly, the same search turns up fragments of broken metal on the ground around the forge; any PC can identify these fragments as having come from the Eternal Lantern’s fuel receptacle, suggesting that someone has used the key part of the artifact as base metals to forge something new.

Chen’s Chambers.name: 陈的厅室 Chen’s Chambers
Chen’s Chambers.text:
C17. 陈的厅室 微不足道 9

这间厅室里的床铺只是地板上的一张简陋草垫和一条毯子。北侧和南侧的搁板上整齐摆放着上过漆的祭坛和各种驱魔师用具，西北角落则放着一面小型青铜锣。房间中央的天花板上悬挂着一面绘有彩画的大鼓。

这间房属于曹辰，也就是马戈凯手下资历最深的驱魔师；他每晚都会回到这间厅室睡上几个小时，但最近大部分时间都待在圣祠（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c11shrine00000]{C11}）。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.mz2A9ZWQRAqocbgm]{Peg}
卧室里的一根木栓上挂着一只雅致的香炉，其功能等同于一件中阶启示香炉。

C17. Chen’s Chambers Trivial 9

The chamber’s bed is a simple mat and blanket on the floor. Neat, lacquered altars and a variety of exorcist implements rest on shelves to the north and south, while a small bronze gong sits in the northwest corner. A large painted drum hangs from the ceiling in the center of the room.

This room belongs to Cao Chen, Mago Kai’s senior exorcist; he returns to this chamber to sleep for a few hours each night but has spent most of his time of late at the shrine (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c11shrine00000]{C11}).

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.mz2A9ZWQRAqocbgm]{Peg}
Hanging from a peg in the bedroom is an elegant incense holder that functions as a moderate thurible of revelation.

Fenfang’s Chambers.name: 芬芳的厅室 Fenfang’s Chambers
Fenfang’s Chambers.text:
C16. 芬芳的厅室 低等 9

这里的陈设很简陋，只有一个木制橱柜用来储存衣物和书籍。染色编织垫铺满地板，墙上装饰着绘有法拉斯玛与月夜尊宗教圣像的图画。床由一块架在炉灶上的黏土板制成，因此可以从下方加热。

这间房原本属于驱魔师芬芳，如今则归取代了她的阿卡什提宁多如所有。宁多鲁杀死芬芳后，将她的大部分遗骸弃置在林地里，但出于“感伤”，决定把她的骷髅留下来作为战利品。她把它藏在床内建的炉灶中；任何搜索这间房的人都会自动发现它。

恐慌 6： @UUID[Actor.RbRaSK08W7PUOOSr]{Chambers}
芬芳和她的两名驱魔师会转移到这个房间，以躲避来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c14generalst00]{C14}的威胁。如果玩家角色此前还没有机会在那里偷听他们的谈话，可以考虑让他们在这里有机会这么做。

宝藏： 一本名为《魁恩宗师》的书里夹着一张血族驱命卷轴。

C16. Fenfang’s Chambers Low 9

The furniture is sparse, with only a wooden cupboard serving as storage for clothing and books. Dyed woven mats cover the floor, and the walls are decorated with painted religious icons of Pharasma and Tsukiyo. The bed is made out of a clay slab that’s set over an oven, allowing it to be heated from below.

This room belonged to the exorcist Fenfang but now belongs to the akashti nindoru who replaced her. While the nindoru disposed of most of Fenfang’s remains in the woods after killing her, she “sentimentally” decided to keep the skull as a trophy. She keeps it hidden within the oven built into the bed, where it can be discovered automatically by anyone who Searches the room.

Terror 6: @UUID[Actor.RbRaSK08W7PUOOSr]{Chambers}
Fenfang and her two exorcists relocate to this room for safety from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c14generalst00]{C14}. If the PCs haven’t had a chance to eavesdrop on their conversation there, consider giving them a chance to do so here.

Treasure: Tucked into a book titled Grandmasters of Quain is a scroll of vampiric exsanguination.

Shrine Maiden Quarters.name: 巫女宿舍 Shrine Maiden Quarters
Shrine Maiden Quarters.text:
C15. 巫女宿舍 中等 9

这个房间里有一座小烤炉、几张铺盖卷、几个柜橱、一处供奉法拉斯玛的圣祠，以及一面靠墙放置的青铜锣。

巫女宿舍 中等 9

@UUID[Actor.3hLps0uPoHvijSi0]{巫女（2）}

生物：驻守在唐入此地的巫女对柳岸镇或马戈凯针对遗迹的计划都兴趣缺缺；她们之所以同意为他工作，纯粹是因为马戈凯一旦前往柳岸镇，便会允许她们将这座堡垒发展为一座供奉@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}的神殿。作为回报，她们的协助与建议在帮助他守护堡垒一事上至关重要；正是她们提议窃取长明灯的火焰（而巫女们则将此举视为将一项失落无闻的事业从湮没中解放出来）。三名巫女各自轮值8小时守卫守护铃，其余两名则在宿舍中休息并祈祷。她们将闯入的玩家角色视为此地邪恶精魂的显现，最坏是恶灵，最好也只是迷失的灵魂——无论如何，她们对玩家角色的反应都是尽快将其解决，好让他们能投入法拉斯玛的怀抱。

恐慌 4：这两名巫女离开房间，前去巡逻边缘路径（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c3peripheryp00]{C3}）。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.LgfOPt7fG6BD94hD]{Quarters}
对这个房间进行5分钟的搜索后，可以找到一张治疗术卷轴（5环级）、两张净化苦难卷轴（4环级）、四张澄明心智卷轴（4环级），以及一张短讯术卷轴。

C15. Shrine Maiden Quarters Moderate 9

This room contains a small oven, bed rolls, cupboards, a shrine to Pharasma, and a bronze gong set against the wall.

Shrine Maiden Quarters Moderate 9

@UUID[Actor.3hLps0uPoHvijSi0]{Shrine Maidens (2)}

Creatures: The shrine maidens stationed here at Karahai have little interest in Willowshore or Mago Kai’s plans for the ruins, having agreed to work for him solely in return for permission to develop the fortress into a temple to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} once Kai moves on to Willowshore. In return, their aid and advice has been instrumental in helping him to protect the fortress; it was they who suggested stealing the Eternal Lantern’s flame (an act the shrine maidens instead regard as liberating a lost cause from obscurity). The three shrine maidens each work an 8-hour shift guarding the warding bell, while the other two rest and pray here in their quarters. They regard the intruding PCs as manifestations of the evil spirits of the region at worst, or lost spirits at best—regardless, their reaction to the PCs is to put them down as quickly as possible so they can move on to Pharasma’s embrace.

Terror 4: These two shrine maidens exit the room to patrol the periphery path (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c3peripheryp00]{C3}).

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.LgfOPt7fG6BD94hD]{Quarters}
A 5-minute Search of this room turns up a scroll of heal (5th-rank), two scrolls of cleanse affliction (4th-rank), four scrolls of clear mind (4th-rank), and a scroll of sending.

General Storage.name: 通用储物空间 General Storage
General Storage.text:
C14. 通用储物空间 重度 9

这间摆满搁板的房间里杂乱地堆放着各种可能派上用场、却没有专门存放地点的东西，例如木锯、维护设备、成捆的树枝、动物毛皮、干燥的竹秆，以及用来修补墙上破洞的黏土。

生物：PC首次造访这间储藏室时，若唐入要塞的恐慌阈值低于6，马戈凯的三名驱邪师正聚集于此，其中包括潘芬芳——她正是在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event12these00]{事件12——降神仪式}期间在场的驱邪师之一。这三名驱邪师便构成了芬芳秘密邪教的全部成员。

如果PC没有被发现，他们就可以偷听这三人的谈话；他们会从降神仪式中认出芬芳的声音。芬芳正在对一名神色紧张的驱邪师说话，而第三人则手持薙刀，专注地站在芬芳身后数步之外。谈话会持续数分钟；每过1分钟，所有偷听谈话的PC都必须成功通过一次@Check[stealth|dc:26|traits:move,skill,secret,exploration,action:avoid-notice|name:Avoid Notice]检定以避免被察觉，以及一次@Check[perception|dc:22]检定以听清这段轻声交谈。每成功1分钟，PC便会得知更多信息，如下所述。

  • 第1分钟：芬芳让那名紧张的驱邪师确认，他已经厌倦了曹师傅的领导，并且很想听听芬芳要说什么。
  • 第2分钟：芬芳要求那名紧张的驱邪师发誓，不会泄露她接下来要告诉他的事，否则就要以死谢罪；那名紧张的驱邪师同意了，而那名专注的驱邪师也松了一口气，姿态不再那么敌对，并放低了他的薙刀。
  • 第3分钟：芬芳告诉那名紧张的驱邪师，她和自己的盟友一直在接收一位名叫谭隋靖的精魂传来的幻视——她是一位强大的圣洁女性，很久以前死在这片地区。
  • 第4分钟：芬芳接着解释说，谭隋靖的精魂被困在柳岸镇废墟之外一棵高耸巨树的下方；如果那名紧张的驱邪师加入他们、参与释放谭隋靖的计划，他就能分享她在幻视中许诺的丰厚奖励。
  • 第5分钟：那名紧张的驱邪师同意了，并加入了邪教；芬芳告诉他先回去继续职责，之后他们会再详细商讨如何掌控要塞资源，并集中力量释放谭隋靖的计划。随后，芬芳撤退到自己的宿舍（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c16fenfangsc00]{C16}），另外两名驱邪师则前往餐厅（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c6diningroom00]{C6}）。

通用储物空间 重度 9

@UUID[Actor.O0NKMBs5GZCEnskv]{"芬芳"} @UUID[Actor.E8jzdv6jEAjP5s5e]{驱邪师（2）}

如果在任何时候芬芳注意到PC，她就会与他们对峙；而一旦留意到他们那种诡异、异界般的外观，她就会指控他们是邪恶精魂，并命令她的驱邪师盟友协助她消灭他们，而她自己则退后观察战斗。虽然芬芳和其他驱邪师一样携带着薙刀与火把，但她不会用这些武器发动攻击——因为她根本不是真正的芬芳。在降神仪式之后、与PC这次新的会面之前的某个时候，芬芳遭受苦迦菩提腐化的过程走向了悲惨终点：某天夜晚，她走入林地。她找到一个无人能见的僻静处，试图对抗苦迦菩提的影响，却反而遭到袭击、谋杀，并被一只得以在此地显现的阿卡什提宁多如所取代（讽刺的是，这正是芬芳信念动摇所导致的结果）。

如今，这只恪尸魔伪装成芬芳，在战斗中于远处施放法术来支援其他驱邪师；它首先会施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻影生物}，让人看起来仿佛她召唤出了一头中型蛇形巨龙在身侧加入战斗。如果芬芳受到10点伤害，这些伤害会导致她显现出的身体从躯体上腐朽剥落，露出她的潘芬芳真身。她会狂怒嚎叫；若此时仍有任何驱邪师存活，他们会立刻逃离战斗。如果他们成功脱身，关于芬芳可怖变形的消息就会传遍整座要塞，增加3点恐慌点。

恐慌6：储藏室空无一人；芬芳已与她的两名驱邪师盟友一同撤退到自己的宿舍，直到危险过去。

场景注记效果

将@UUID[Item.FfYS95Q82b6NUDeR]{潘芬芳真身}效果拖到她身上以关闭她的伪装

奖励：PC每发现1分钟的信息，就获得10 XP奖励；如果他们完整偷听了5分钟，总计可获得50 XP奖励。

C14. General Storage Severe 9

This shelf-filled room contains an eclectic mess of anything that might be useful but doesn’t have its own dedicated space, such as lumber saws, maintenance equipment, bundles of branches, animal pelts, dried bamboo stalks, and clay for patching up holes in the walls.

Creatures: The first time the PCs visit this storeroom, and assuming that Karahai Fortress’s Terror Threshold is lower than 6, three of Mago Kai’s exorcists are gathered here, including Pan Fenfang, one of the exorcists who was present during @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog11faceto.JournalEntryPage.11event12these00]{Event 12 - The Seance}. These three exorcists comprise the total of Fenfang’s secret cult.

If the PCs avoid being detected, they can eavesdrop on the trio; they’ll recognize Fenfang’s voice from the seance. Fenfang speaks to one exorcist, who looks nervous, while the third stands intently a few paces behind Fenfang, his naginata in hand. The conversation lasts for a few minutes; each minute, all PCs eavesdropping on the conversation must succeed at a @Check[stealth|dc:26|traits:move,skill,secret,exploration,action:avoid-notice|name:Avoid Notice] check to Avoid Notice and a @Check[perception|dc:22] check to hear the quiet conversation. With each minute’s success, the PCs learn more, as detailed below.

  • 1st Minute: Fenfang has the nervous exorcist confirm that he is tired of Master Cao’s leadership and is eager to hear what Fenfang has to say.
  • 2nd Minute: Fenfang asks the nervous exorcist to swear not to reveal what she’s about to tell him under punishment of death, the nervous exorcist agrees, and the intent exorcist breathes a sigh of relief and adopts a less antagonistic stance, raising his naginata.
  • 3rd Minute: Fenfang tells the nervous exorcist that she and her ally have been receiving visions from a spirit named Tan Sui-Jing, a powerful holy woman who died in the area long ago.
  • 4th Minute: Fenfang goes on to explain that Sui-Jing’s spirit is trapped below a towering tree beyond the ruins of Willowshore, and that if the nervous exorcist joins with them in their plan to set Sui-Jing free, he’ll be able to share in the great rewards she promised in her visions.
  • 5th Minute: The nervous exorcist agrees and joins the cult; Fenfang tells him to return to his duties and that they’ll later speak further about a plan to take control of the fort’s resources and focus their efforts on freeing Tan Sui-Jing. Fenfang then retreats to her quarters (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c16fenfangsc00]{C16}), while the other two exorcists head to the dining hall (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog12thispl.JournalEntryPage.12c6diningroom00]{C6}).

General Storage Severe 9

@UUID[Actor.O0NKMBs5GZCEnskv]{"Fenfang"} @UUID[Actor.E8jzdv6jEAjP5s5e]{Exorcists (2)}

If at any point Fenfang notices the PCs, she confronts them, and upon noticing their eerie, otherworldly appearances, she accuses them of being evil spirits and orders her exorcist allies to help her destroy them while she steps back to observe the fight. While Fenfang carries a naginata and torch just like the other exorcists, she doesn’t attack with them—for she isn’t really Fenfang at all. At some point between the seance and this new meeting with the PCs, Fenfang’s corruption by Kugaptee reached a tragic conclusion when she headed into the woods one night. She found a private place where no one else could see and attempted to fight Kugaptee’s influence, only to be attacked, murdered, and replaced by an akashti nindoru that was able to manifest in the area (ironically as a result of Fenfang’s faltering belief).

Now disguised in Fenfang’s body, the akashti supports the other exorcists in a fight by casting spells from a distance, starting with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} to make it appear as if she summoned a Medium serpentine dragon to join the fight at her side. If Fenfang takes 10 damage, that damage causes her manifested body to decay away from her frame, revealing her true form. She howls in rage, and if any exorcists remain alive at this point, they flee the battle at once. If they escape, word of Fenfang’s horrific transformation spreads through the fortress, adding 3 Terror Points.

Terror 6: The storage room is empty; Fenfang has retreated to her quarters with her two exorcist allies until the danger has passed.

Scene NotesEffect

Drag on the @UUID[Item.FfYS95Q82b6NUDeR]{Pan Fenfang True Form} Effect to turn off her disguise

Reward: Each minute of information the PCs discover grants a 10 XP reward, for a total reward of 50 XP if they overhear the full five minutes.

Bath.name: 沐浴 Bath
Bath.text:
C13. 沐浴 Trivial 9

与堡垒中的其他地方不同，这个房间的地板铺设了瓷砖。它们在地板上构成同心圆图案，而且看起来像是刚刚清洗过。西北角立着三个摆放蹲厕的竹隔间，而东南角则是一座大型沐浴池。

沐浴 Trivial 9

@UUID[Actor.51Tl7LCWXtrMSi1T]{Sha Guanchao}

生物：沙广昊是参与了事件12：降神仪式的三名驱邪师之一，此刻就在这里。他佝偻着身子，正用一把小刷子卖力地刷洗地板；他的薙刀和未点燃的火把则靠在东北侧门框边。如果有人与他对峙，他会把刷子像武器一样挥舞起来，并宣称：“退后！我深谙宇宙的奥秘。只消看你们一眼，我就能把你们直接送去骨园！”若成功进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:19|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] 检定以察言观色，玩家角色就会看出广昊不过是在虚张声势。如果他遭到攻击，尽管处于劣势，他也会还手。由于他对自身极限缺乏认识，他会不知不觉地战斗至死。

另一方面，如果玩家角色在降神仪式期间将沙广昊的影响提升至4，他会认出玩家角色就是他和其他人先前交谈过的精魂。他会迟疑片刻，接着放下刷子，反射性地搓了搓后脑勺，说：“等一下，曹大师说过你们不可能在这里。你们怎么会在这儿？”只要玩家角色不攻击或威胁他，广昊愿意回答一些问题，虽然答起来有些费劲。以下列出了一些可能的回应。

你为什么会在这里？“因为我有强大的通灵之力。这方面我可是真正的天才。绝对不是说谎。”

但你为什么会在这里刷洗？“哦，那个。那、那是在积累灵力。能让我‘修炼精神’，”广昊说道，最后那句话像背书一样单调地重复出来。他盯着地板。“就是那种东西。至少曹大师是这么说的。”

你能告诉我们些什么关于曹大师的事吗？“一个老头子，懂得可真不少。手居然还快得惊人。”广昊又搓了搓自己的头。

你能告诉我们些什么关于这座堡垒的事吗？“如果我没记错的话，这地方的地基是龙华帝国大约一千年前修的，为了压制本地土匪。还是一万年前来着？反正，很久以前了。对。”

你能告诉我们些什么关于堡垒目前状况的事吗？“还行吧，我觉得。饭菜还不错，特别是你要是能赶上第一轮开饭。有些新来的佣兵打呼噜，不过要是往他们头上盖块布，你就几乎听不见了。”

你能告诉我们些什么关于马戈凯的事吗？“那个大块头？他挺厉害的。有一次把我从一只巨型蜘蛛手里救了下来。我说是‘救了我’，不过其实那场面我自己完全能搞定，你懂吧。但看到他把那把大斧头扔出去还是挺惊人的；他一下子就把那虫子劈成两半了！”

你见过一口大型青铜钟吗？“呃，见过。几周前你们就在那儿啊。你们脑子不太灵光，是吧？”

钟在哪里？“当然在圣祠那边啊。不然还能在哪儿？”他指着穿过厕所门后、走廊另一头的那扇门。“从那边过去，右转，再穿过几道门。你们不会错过的。”

长明灯的火焰怎么了？“那个大块头把它拿走，放进钟里去了；要想知道更多，你们恐怕得去问他。”
