PC结束报告后，任美璃向他们微微躬身致意，随后从袍袖褶层中取出一把巨大的金钥匙。四个圆形凹槽点缀在这把钥匙华丽的钥匙杆上，蜘蛛的尖牙从穿过镂空钥匙首的丝线上垂落。当五季宝藏的景泰蓝珠球嵌入钥匙杆时，它们会锁定到位，一层金色光辉随即笼罩这件物品。将景泰蓝珠球装好后，任美璃再次对PC说道：“向此职务宣誓，并明智而尽责地作为柳岸镇的管家效力。”说着，她递出那把金钥匙；PC只需接受这把钥匙，便会成为神门络新妇宫廷正式认可的管家。

这把钥匙被称为獠牙与钥匙。有了它，PC如今在法律上已成为现代柳岸镇政府的一部分，并与现任镇长一同被视为这座城镇的合法统治者。獠牙与钥匙是一件仪式性物品，除可充当一枚@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{永明水晶}外，本身并无真正内在功能。獠牙与钥匙所开启的最重要之处，是进入赫山宝领地的许可；只要有一名PC携带它，那片领地便会接纳他们为依法任命的统治者。他们可以进入他的庄园，并使用其中的心景之门前往腐化的柳岸镇心景，如第13章所述。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.YMpaXnskvQDnVskE]{管家的徽记} @UUID[Actor.MXAp7aimO3k06OKV]{任美璃的赋礼}
按照传统，成为管家的人不会得到额外赠礼，但如果PC表现得格外出色，任美璃就会破例而为。如果PC在完成五项仪式时获得了至少10点胜利点，她会拿出一个由蛛丝制成的II型宽敞袋，其中装有一面辟邪盾、一条财富绳、一根炼狱使者法杖和一把宗师阳伞。任美璃允许PC从这四件物品中选择一件作为奖励。PC每比10点多获得1点胜利点，她就允许他们额外选择一件奖励；如果PC获得了14点或更多胜利点，她会把这四件物品连同袋子本身一并赠与他们。

奖励： 当PC成为柳岸镇的管家并获得獠牙与钥匙时，给予他们80 XP。

The Fang and Key

When Ren Mei Li returns to Willowshore a week after sending the PCs on their trek along the Gossamer Path, she’s eager to find out what they’ve learned from the path maiden and asks them to give a full report. If the PCs didn’t ask the right question, she is disappointed but still wishes for them to become Willowshore’s stewards.

Once the PCs conclude the report, Ren Mei Li offers a slight bow of respect to the PCs, then produces from the folds of her robe a large golden key. Four circular hollows punctuate the key’s ornate shaft, and spider fangs dangle from silken threads strung through its pierced heads. When the cloisonne balls of the Five-Season Treasures are slotted into the key’s shaft, they lock into place, and a golden glow surrounds the object. After fitting the cloisonne balls in place, Ren Mei Li speaks once more to the PCs: “Swear yourself to the office and to serve as Willowshore’s stewards wisely and well.” As she speaks, she offers the golden key; the PCs need only accept this key to become official stewards of Shenmen’s jorogumo court.

This key is known as the Fang and Key. With it, the PCs are now legally part of modern Willowshore’s government and are considered the rightful rulers of the town alongside their currently serving governor. The Fang and Key is a ceremonial item and has no real intrinsic function of its own other than to serve as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everlight Crystal}. The most important thing the Fang and Key unlocks is access to Heh Shan-Bao’s domain, for as long as one of the PCs carry it, that domain welcomes them as legally appointed rulers. They can access his manor and use the mindscape door found within to travel to the corrupted Willowshore mindscape, as detailed in Chapter 13.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.YMpaXnskvQDnVskE]{Steward's Token} @UUID[Actor.MXAp7aimO3k06OKV]{Ren Mei Li's Gift}
Traditionally, no additional gifts are provided to those who become stewards, but if the PCs did exceptionally well, Ren Mei Li does just that. If the PCs earned at least 10 Victory Points from performing the five rites, she produces a type II spacious pouch made of spidersilk that contains an evil-reflecting shield, a fortune cord, a purgatory emissary’s staff, and a sensei’s parasol. Ren Mei Li allows the PCs to choose one of these four items as a reward. For every additional Victory Point above 10 the PCs earned, she allows them to choose one additional reward; if the PCs earned 14 or more Victory Points, she gives them all four items plus the bag itself.

Reward: When the PCs become stewards of Willowshore and gain the Fang and Key, grant them 80 XP.

Event 8. The Third Murder.name: 事件8。第三起谋杀 Event 8. The Third Murder
Event 8. The Third Murder.text:
事件8：第三起谋杀

更多谋杀案

如果PC们拖拖拉拉，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}可能会再次出手。任何更多的受害者都会被机会性地选中，取决于这名怪物般的镇长能找到谁落单，而这些目标本身并无特别意义。在这些谋杀现场找不到额外线索。他甚至可能开始以单独行动的PC为目标，在他认为能趁其落单伏击他们的时候下手。

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}的第三名受害者是守墓人兼炼金术师 尤素珍（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w3gravesidem00]{墓畔礼仪}），赫山宝盯上她是因为 他能感知到她最近正在试验一种新型炼金炸弹，而这种炸弹本来就特别适合对付宁多鲁斯。这起谋杀发生在PC们从薄纱小径返回之后、但在任美璃最后一次来访之前。尸体很可能要到上午较晚时才会被发现——那时夜间宵禁刚刚解除，一位顾客来到墓畔礼仪，却迎来了毕生难忘的惊骇一幕。

尤素珍的尸体在她的商店里被发现，横陈在一片被毁存货与破坏殆尽的炼金补给品的狼藉之中。她的遗体与其他受害者一样，处于同样可怖的惨状。

犯罪现场

搜寻线索 调查；@Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

下等 与前两起案件不同，凶手在犯罪现场停留了相当长一段时间——要么是在与受害者搏斗，要么是在翻找某样东西时把这里拆得七零八落。

中等 受害者看起来与其他人一样，是被迅速而高效地杀害的，这证实了商店中的破坏并非挣扎导致，而是在杀人结束后，一场疯狂搜寻或盛怒之下的肆意破坏所造成的。房屋后方的实验室首当其冲，已被砸得粉碎，绝大多数补给品也都毁了。如果PC们再花10分钟搜寻 这间被毁掉的炼金实验室，并且在一次 @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 检定中成功，他们会在一个未被完全毁坏的梳妆柜后方、一个小金属盒上面，发现一本藏起来的旧日志。这本日志已经在尤素珍家中传承了好几代，里面记载着她母亲、祖母与曾祖母留下的炼金术与草药研究笔记。关于这本日志与金属盒的更多细节，见下方宝藏，但这本日志本身也是一件重要的私人纪念物，可以在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15theherbalist00]{Chapter 13}中用来解放尤素珍的灵魂。

重大 PC们自动发现尤素珍的日志以及银魂炸弹。

错误线索 尤素珍对袭击者进行了出人意料的顽强抵抗，因此才造成了建筑物的严重破坏。也许她的草药技艺给了她某种意想不到的防护？

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.sSTaVc48j9x3Glx4]{商店}
如果PC们发现尤素珍的日志并花1小时通读，他们将会得知其中包含一种罕见炼金武器的配方：银魂炸弹。这份配方看起来是尤素珍的母亲生前开始研究、直到去世都未完成的成果，而尤素珍最近才刚刚完成相关研究。笔记中还表明，尤素珍原本打算在PC们从“最近那件差事”返回后，把这份配方与她制作的少量炸弹交给他们，以协助他们对抗宁多鲁斯；但她还未来得及实施这个计划，便已遭到谋杀。

在日志下方发现的金属盒中装有三枚银魂炸弹，以及价值500 gp的银粉及其他炼金补给品；若将这些材料用于制作额外的银魂炸弹，则对制作检定获得+2物品加值。

奖励： 若PC们发现了银魂炸弹及其相关配方，则给予他们80 XP。如果PC们成功阻止尤素珍被谋杀，她会在Chapter 13开始时将这些银魂炸弹与配方赠予他们。

Event 8: The Third Murder

Additional Murders

If the PCs dawdle, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao} might strike again. Any further victims are chosen opportunistically, depending on who the monstrous governor can find alone and have no particular significance as targets. There are no additional clues to be found at these murder sites. He might even begin to target individual PCs at points where he thinks he can ambush them while they’re alone.

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}’s third victim is the grave keeper–alchemist You So-Jin (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w3gravesidem00]{Graveside Manners}), whom Heh Shan-Bao targets because he can sense her recent work on experimenting with a new type of alchemical bomb that’s intended to work particularly well against nindorus. This killing occurs after the PCs return from the Gossamer Path but before Ren Mei Li’s last visit. The body is unlikely to be found until late morning, after the nightly curfew lifts, and a customer visits Graveside Manners only to find the shock of their life.

So-Jin’s body is found in her shop, sprawled amid a chaos of destroyed stock and ruined alchemical supplies. Her corpse is in the same grisly condition as the others.

Scene of the Crime

Search for Clues Investigate; @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

Minor Unlike the first two crimes, the murderer spent a significant amount of time at the crime scene—either fighting against the victim or tearing the place apart in search of something.

Moderate The victim appears to have been slain as quickly and efficiently as the others, confirming that the devastation in the shop wasn’t a result of a struggle but instead a frenzied search or a bout of enraged destruction after the killing was over. The lab at the back of the house bore the brunt of this devastation, as it has been smashed to splinters and most of the supplies have been ruined. If the PCs spend 10 more minutes Searching the ruined alchemical lab and succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check, they discover an old journal hidden behind a not-completely-destroyed dresser atop a small metal case. This journal has been in You So-Jin’s family for generations and contains alchemical and herbalism research notes from her mother, grandmother, and great-grandmother. See Treasure below for additional details on the journal and the metal case, but the journal serves as a significant personal token that can be used to free So-Jin’s soul in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15theherbalist00]{Chapter 13}.

Major The PCs automatically discover You So-Jin’s journal and silversoul bombs.

False Lead You So-Jin put up an unexpectedly powerful fight against her attacker, resulting in the devastation of the building. Perhaps her skill at herbalism afforded some sort of unexpected protection?

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.sSTaVc48j9x3Glx4]{Shop}
If the PCs discover So-Jin’s journal and spend an hour reading through it, they’ll discover it contains a rare formula for an alchemical weapon: a silversoul bomb. The formula appears to be one that So-Jin’s mother began researching up until her death and that So-Jin only recently completed the research for. The notes also indicate how You So-Jin intended to present the formula and the few bombs she crafted to the PCs to aid them in their fight against nindorus once they returned from their “latest errand,” but she was murdered before she could act on this plan.

The metal case found under the journal contains three silversoul bombs and 500 gp worth of powdered silver and other alchemical supplies that, if used to craft additional silversoul bombs, grants a +2 item bonus to the Crafting check.

Reward: Grant the PCs 80 XP for discovering the silversoul bombs and the associated formula. If the PCs manage to prevent So-Jin’s murder, she gifts them the silversoul bombs and formula at the start of Chapter 13.

Walking the Gossamer Path.name: 漫步于蛛丝之径 Walking the Gossamer Path
Walking the Gossamer Path.text:
漫步于蛛丝之径 低阶 11

薄纱小径在神门广为人知（因此也为所有居住在柳岸镇的人所熟悉，玩家角色自然也包括在内），这个词指的是所有蜿蜒盘绕、穿行于薄纱群山之间的山路与小路。虽然从玉鸟客栈向北延伸的道路最终会抵达这些群山，但玩家角色并不一定非得走这条路线才能漫步于蛛丝之径——只要在群山中的任意一段道路上行走，玩家角色就有充足的机会遭遇道途侍女。

薄纱群山位于柳岸镇以西近300英里处，但如果玩家角色选择沿着镇外那条蜿蜒向北的道路前行，旅程就会接近450英里。若没有任美璃赐予他们的罗网绶带，玩家角色若想寻求道途侍女的指点，就必须面对一段漫长旅程；但有了这件物品，他们便能在午夜之后，从神门的任何道路上“漫步于蛛丝之径”。本冒险默认玩家角色使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Q3ZYTbPGPDG6WINq]{罗网绶带} 来联系道途侍女；但如果他们选择亲自前往群山，你也可以借此机会加入更多由你自行设计的沿途遭遇——如果玩家角色还需要再经历几场遭遇，或者已经愈发渴望狠狠干上一架，这会是个绝佳选择。

最多4名玩家角色可以使用一条罗网绶带，进入一个拟真思维空间，与一群道途侍女会面；如果你的团队超过四人，要么让玩家选择哪四名玩家角色参与这次旅程，要么干脆调整罗网绶带的长度，好让所有玩家角色都能参加。当玩家角色在夜间沿道路行走一小时后启动绶带时，浓雾会降临在他们四周，随即又迅速散去，显露出他们如今正站在一条狭窄的山中道路上。这条道路宽10尺，右侧是一面陡峭绝壁，直插云间；左侧则是另一道断崖，坠入远下方一片雾气弥漫的森林之中。

这场遭遇并非设计来引发战斗，但如果玩家角色真的攻击道途侍女，你可以使用第二幕中的山中道路地图，或使用你自行设计的类似山路地图。

生物：当玩家角色进入心景后，不久便会有一名道途侍女出现在他们面前——她可能是在他们绕过一个弯道时走入视野，也可能是直接从道路中升起。她身着紫色与深海蓝色长袍，面容被面纱遮蔽，用低语般的声音向玩家角色开口，同时也以心灵感应直接对他们的意识说话。

“温血者，活血者，脆弱凡俗的盛宴。你们为何踏上薄纱小径？你们寻求的是谁死去的秘密，又打算为了谁的性命而使用它们？”

漫步于蛛丝之径 低阶 11

@UUID[Actor.kcER7jXFIce5IrKF]{行道女}

如果玩家角色并非借助罗网绶带的力量来寻找道途侍女，她几乎不会等待回答便会发动攻击。玩家角色只有一次迅速作答的机会——每名玩家角色都可以尝试一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:34] 检定，以让道途侍女暂缓她的攻击。只要至少有一名玩家角色在这次检定中获得至少成功，且没有任何玩家角色大失败，道途侍女就会允许玩家角色继续说下去。否则，她会战斗直到被摧毁，之后奇异镜子（见下文）便会显现。

道途侍女允许玩家角色向她提出一个问题。她的知识仅限于神门的死者，但也包括那些曾经死去、最近又重返人世者。关于苦迦菩提以及总督 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝} 的命运，她已准备好提供具体见解（见下文）；但如果玩家角色问的是其他事情，你可以尽你所能给出一个足以满足他们好奇心的答案。如果这个问题轻浮无聊或缺乏尊重，道途侍女也可能以攻击作为回答。问题得到回答后，玩家角色会突然发现自己回到了出发之处（如果这场遭遇发生在由 罗网绶带创造的心景中），或者道途侍女会从视野中淡去，让他们独自留在山间小路上（如果他们是亲自前往薄纱群山的话）。

问对问题：如果玩家角色询问苦迦菩提、赫山宝总督，或困扰柳岸镇的那些谋杀案，道途侍女便会一言不发地移到一旁，示意玩家角色继续沿路向前。前方道路中央会凭空显现出一面银色长椭圆镜子，悬浮在空中。镜中的倒影显示的是一条空无一人的道路，即使玩家角色就站在镜前也是如此，仿佛它映出的只是那条从未有人走过时的道路模样。

只要任何人接近镜子5尺以内，镜中的景象就会变化。柳岸镇的总督庄园映现出来，但并非它如今那副破败模样，而是一座辉煌宅邸：墙面新漆未褪，瓦片鲜艳多彩，门上高悬帝皇旗帜，提灯柱上垂落着金色流苏。画面向内推进，穿过宅邸大门，再穿过庭院，最终进入庄园的主套件，并停在北墙上的一扇门前——在玩家角色前两次造访这个房间时，这扇门都并不存在。那扇门由上等柏木制成，中央固定着一张青铜铸成的带獠牙邪魔面孔，其上嵌着一把华丽的金锁。那面孔张开的颚上方有两点红色光芒闪烁。紧接着，邪魔的面孔再次扭曲变化，变成了赫山宝的模样。他从镜中探视玩家角色，直接向他们说道。

“贪婪与羞耻。何等强效的催化之药，足以加速转变。一个人变成怪物。一个怪物变成门扉。一个村庄变成盛宴。贪婪与羞耻，羞耻与贪婪。它们编织出何等奇妙的锁链！多么可爱的把戏，多么精巧的锁！我会打开你们的门，再来造访几次，而很快，人和怪物就将合而为一。到那时，苦迦菩提便赢了，因为唯有真正的统治者，才会携带通往我领域的钥匙！”

随后，镜中的影像消散，片刻后，镜子本身也随之消失。雾气在小路四周愈发浓重，而它的存在似乎鲜活而饥饿，制造出先前不曾有过的、令人窒息的逼仄感。然而，这条小路也变得更加空寂了，因为那些蒙面的侍女已尽数消失。看来，她们这场奇异的试炼已经结束。

奖励：如果玩家角色完全避免了战斗，并且问对了问题，则给予他们如同在战斗中击败了道途侍女一样的XP奖励。

Walking the Gossamer Path Low 11

The Gossamer Path is well known in Shenmen (and thus to all who live in Willowshore, the PCs included) as a term that applies to all of the winding mountain roads and trails that coil their way through the Gossamer Mountains. While the road leading north from Canary Inn eventually reaches these mountains, the PCs need not take this route to walk the Gossamer Path—any length of road walked in the mountains gives the PCs ample opportunity to encounter path maidens.

The Gossamer Mountains lie nearly 300 miles to the west of Willowshore, but if the PCs choose to follow the winding road north from town, the journey is closer to 450 miles. Without the Gossamer Sash granted to them by Ren Mei Li, the PCs face a long journey if they wish to seek the advice of path maidens, but with the item, they can “walk the Gossamer Path” from any road in Shenmen after midnight. This adventure assumes the PCs use a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Q3ZYTbPGPDG6WINq]{Gossamer Sash} to contact path maidens, but if they choose to journey to the mountains in person, you can use this opportunity to introduce more encounters along the way of your own design—an excellent choice if the PCs could use a few additional encounters, or are growing eager for a fight.

Up to 4 PCs can use a Gossamer Sash to travel into an immersive mindscape to meet with a group of path maidens; if your group has more than four, either have the players choose which four PCs make the trip, or simply adjust the length of the Gossamer Sash to allow for all your PCs to take part. When the PCs activate the sash after an hour spent walking a roadway at night, a thick fog descends upon them, only to swiftly clear and reveal that they now stand on a narrow mountain pathway that measures 10 feet wide, with a sheer cliff rising into the clouds to their right and another dropping away into a foggy forest far below to their left.

This encounter isn’t intended to result in combat, but if the PCs do attack the path maiden, you can use the mountain path map from Act 2, or a similar mountain path map of your own design.

Creatures: When the PCs enter the mindscape, it won’t be long before a path maiden appears before them, either stepping into view as they walk around a bend or even rising up out of the road. Clad in robes of purple and deep sea blue with veils obscuring their features, the path maiden addresses the PCs in a whispering voice while simultaneously speaking telepathically to their minds.

“Warm-bloods, living-bloods, fragile mortal feasts. Why do you tread the Gossamer Path? Whose dead secrets do you seek, and for whose lives would you use them?”

Walking the Gossamer Path Low 11

@UUID[Actor.kcER7jXFIce5IrKF]{Path Maiden}

If the PCs didn’t seek a path maiden via the power of the Gossamer Sash, she barely waits for an answer before attacking. The PCs have one chance to swiftly answer—each PC can attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:34] check to get the path maiden to stay her attack. As long as at least one PC scores at least a success at this check and no PC critically fails it, the path maiden lets the PCs speak further. Otherwise, she fights until destroyed, after which the strange mirror (see below) manifests.

The PCs are allowed one question of the path maiden. Her knowledge is limited to the dead in Shenmen, but it includes those who have spent time dead only to recently return to life. The topics of Kugaptee and the fate of Governor @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao} are specific topics that she’s prepared to offer insights on (see below), but if the PCs ask about anything else, provide an answer as best you can that will satisfy their curiosity. If the question is frivolous or disrespectful, the path maiden might answer by attacking. Once the question is answered, the PCs suddenly find themselves back where they started (if this encounter took place in a mindscape created by a gossamer sash), or the path maiden fades from view, leaving them alone on the mountain trail (if they physically traveled to the Gossamer Mountains).

Asking the Right Question: If the PCs ask about Kugaptee, Governor Heh Shan-Bao, or the murders that have been plaguing Willowshore, the path maiden moves aside wordlessly and indicates the PCs should continue down the road, where an oblong silver mirror manifests out of nothingness, hovering in the air in the middle of the road. Its reflection shows an empty path, even when the PCs stand directly before it, as if reflecting only the road as it appears when not traveled at all.

As soon as anyone approaches within 5 feet of the mirror, the image shifts. The governor’s manor in Willowshore appears, not in its current dilapidated state, but as a splendid house, freshly painted and colorfully tiled, with imperial banners hanging above the doors and gold tassels streaming from the lantern posts. The image moves inward, passing through the mansion’s doors and then through its courtyard, to finally enter the manor’s primary suite before stopping at a door in the northern wall that didn’t exist in that room during either of the PCs’ two previous visits. The door is made of fine cypress wood, with an ornate golden lock worked into a fanged fiend’s face made of bronze affixed to the center of the door. Two glowing red points of light shimmer above the visage’s open jaws. The fiend’s face shifts again, now appearing to be that of Governor Heh Shan-Bao. He peers out of the mirror and addresses the PCs directly.

“Greed and shame. Such potent tonics to quicken a change. A man becomes a monster. A monster becomes a gateway. A village becomes a feast. Greed and shame, shame and greed. What marvelous chains they weave! What lovely tricks, what clever locks! I’ll open your doors and visit some more, and soon shall man and monster be one. And then Kugaptee has won, for only a rightful ruler shall carry the key to my domain!”

The image then dissipates, and a moment later, the mirror does as well. The mist thickens about the path, and its presence seems alive and hungry, creating a claustrophobic closeness that wasn’t present before. Yet, the path is emptier, too, as the veiled maidens have vanished. It seems their strange test is at its end.

Reward: Grant the PCs XP as if they’d defeated the path maiden in combat if they avoided battle entirely and asked the right question.

Event 7. The Final Season.name: 事件7。最后的季节 Event 7. The Final Season
Event 7. The Final Season.text:
事件 7：最后的季节

任美璃在约定的时间回到柳岸镇，也就是在派遣 PCs 前往低语蛛网神殿一周之后。她没有询问他们是如何收集到过滤冬季香料茶所需丝线的，但她要求他们护送自己前往青天茶馆，然后在冲泡过程中用收集来的丝线作为滤材，为她煮一杯饮品。无论 PCs 如何准备这杯饮品，她都欣然享用，并称赞他们迄今为止的工作，随后继续进行最后的仪式：漫步于蛛丝之径。当她喝完茶时，任美璃露出变幻莫测的微笑，接着舒展全身，在这个动作中，她的八条蜘蛛腿从背后舒展开来，立于地面，将她的人形身躯托举到空中。如今，既然 PCs 已完成前四项任务，她已不再觉得有必要掩饰自己的真实本性。

“既然你们已经令低语蛛网神殿的守护者满意，并准备去追寻第五份、也是最后一份季节宝藏，那么现在正是我们就柳岸镇的未来，在不带幻象与伪饰的情况下，达成清楚共识的时候了。

“我已准备好接纳你们所有人成为管事。我也准备以一份银印，给予柳岸镇相当程度的自治权。具体条款可以协商，但我想你们会发现，那些条件非常合理——比你们从任何其他宫廷那里能得到的，都要合理得多。

“作为交换，我想要的是这个：你们要宣誓向我个人效忠，此誓言将凌驾于你们对琅蕾夫人或络新妇宫廷其余成员的任何忠诚之上。我希望你们成为我的代理人，而且只属于我。当然，这一切都必须保密。表面上，你们必须扮演忠于络新妇宫廷臣属的角色，绝不能泄露我们之间的私下约定。如果你们发现我的同族提出了不合理的要求，你们必须请求我出面调停，而不是自行处置，不过我确实承诺，若你们的村庄有所需要，我会给予防护。

“我之所以提出这个提议，只因为你们至今展现出的技能令我印象深刻。我希望你们不要辜负我的信任。你们意下如何？”

如果 PCs 同意，或者成功通过一次 @Check[deception|dc:39|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie] 检定对她说谎，公主便会继续说下去。

“你们现在必须漫步于蛛丝之径，并寻求蒙面径之少女的 favor。她们是秘密的守护者，尤其是那些属于蒙羞死者的秘密，而我相信，对于你们城镇近来所经历的那些不幸残酷之事，她们会掌握对你们有价值的信息。去见她们吧。向她们询问你们想知道的事，以及原因。寻求她们睿智的劝告，以解决你们遭遇的谋杀案，并证明你们愿意冒巨大风险来解决自己城镇的痛苦。

“这是最后的季节，你们最后的考验。一个配得上这个职位的管事，必须有足够的勇气为自己的人民寻求帮助，而不会因高位者或个人危险而退缩。去吧，证明你们的胆识。”

@UUID[Actor.SSw3XpqxnqF6PH7E]{任美璃的补给} @UUID[Actor.HQxoO4AKbipQGFRv]{任美璃的卷轴}
在离开前，她会给 PCs 一条罗网绶带和四剂圣化豆。她解释说，这条绶带能让他们无需亲自前往薄纱群山，便可联系道途侍女；而这些豆子则会在他们与道途侍女的遭遇进展不顺时提供帮助。

如果 PCs 拒绝任美璃的提议，她会明显流露出失望。她不会给他们罗网绶带或圣化豆，而是改为给他们一张短讯术卷轴，并说道：“我不会强迫你们，但我希望你们对我们在此谈及之事严守秘密。你们不会希望我成为敌人。若你们日后改变主意，就用这张卷轴通知我，我会回来接受你们的道歉。在那之前，愿你们在未来几天面对降临于你们城镇之事时好运相伴。”

说完这些后，她承诺一周后回来，随后再次消失在迷雾之中。

Event 7: The Final Season

Ren Mei Li returns to Willowshore at the appointed time, a week after sending the PCs to Whisperweb Shrine. She doesn’t ask how they managed to gather the silk needed to strain winter’s spiced tea, but she asks them to escort her to the Cerulean Teahouse and then brew her a drink using the gathered silk as a filter during the steeping process. She enjoys the drink regardless of how the PCs prepare it and compliments them on their work so far before proceeding with the final rite: Walking the Gossamer Path. As she finishes her tea, Ren Mei Li smiles mercurially, then gives a full body stretch, during which her eight spider legs unfurl from her back to stand on the ground and lift her humanoid form into the air. Now that the PCs have completed the first four tasks, she no longer feels the need to obscure her true nature.

“Now that you have satisfied the guardians of the Whisperweb Shrine and are prepared to pursue the fifth and final season treasure, it is time for us to reach a clear understanding, without illusion or pretense, about Willowshore’s future.

“I am prepared to accept you all as stewards. I am also prepared to offer considerable autonomy to Willowshore with a Silver Seal. The precise terms can be negotiated, but I expect you will find them very reasonable—far more reasonable than you would receive from any other court.

“In exchange, what I want is this: an oath of personal fealty, superseding any loyalty you may have to Lady Lang Loi or the rest of the jorogumo court. I wish for you to be my agents, and mine alone. Naturally, this will be kept discreet. Outwardly, you must play the part of loyal subjects to the jorogumo court and never let our private agreement slip. If you find that my kindred make unreasonable demands, you must ask me to intercede rather than taking matters into your own hands, but I do promise my protection if your village should need it.

“I make this offer only because I have been impressed with your skills so far. I hope you will not betray my trust. What do you say?”

If the PCs agree, or succeed at a @Check[deception|dc:39|traits:action:lie,auditory,concentrate,linguistic,mental,secret|name:Lie] check to Lie to her, the princess continues.

“You must now walk the Gossamer Path and seek the favor of the veiled path maidens. They are guardians of secrets, particularly those of the shameful dead, and I believe they will have information of value to you about the unfortunate cruelties your town has been experiencing of late. Go to them. Ask of them what you wish to know, and why. Seek their wise counsel in solving your murders, and prove you are willing to take great risks to solve your town’s pains.

“This is the final season, your final test. A steward worthy of the office is courageous enough to seek assistance for their people without being cowed by high office or personal danger. Go then, and prove your mettle.”

@UUID[Actor.SSw3XpqxnqF6PH7E]{Ren Mei Li's Supplies} @UUID[Actor.HQxoO4AKbipQGFRv]{Ren Mei Li's Scroll}
Before she leaves, she gives the PCs a gossamer sash and four doses of sanctified beans. The sash, she explains, will allow them to contact path maidens without actually traveling to the Gossamer Mountains, while the beans will aid them if their encounter with the path maidens goes poorly.

If the PCs reject Ren Mei Li’s offer, she’s visibly disappointed. She doesn’t give them the gossamer sash or the sanctified beans, but instead gives them a scroll of sending and says, “I will not force you, but I expect you to keep what we spoke of here in confidence. You do not wish me as an enemy. If you change your minds later, use this scroll to inform me, and I shall return to accept your apologies. Until then, I wish you luck against what awaits your town in the coming days.”

With that, she promises to return in a week before she vanishes into the mist once more.

Event 6. The Second Murder.name: 事件6：第二起谋杀 Event 6. The Second Murder
Event 6. The Second Murder.text:
事件6：第二起谋杀

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}的第二名受害者是伊莉泽丝·坎多拉（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w9ladyofsoul00]{司魂娘娘}），她是柳岸镇供奉@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}——水名司魂娘娘——的神殿看护人。他将她选为目标，一部分是因为她与法拉斯玛有关；这位神祇司掌亡者灵魂，其领域与苦迦菩提所代表之物相冲突；另一部分则是因为他妖骸的本性，使他心中被灌输了对长笛乐声的恐惧与憎恨。某天夜里，当她在魂流圣母堂西南方的墓园中吹奏长笛，以安抚亡灵时，他袭击了她，希望借此在柳岸镇散播恐惧，让镇民担忧自己死后灵魂的归宿。

人们在墓园里发现了她的身体，横陈在大野新坟顶部，状态与上一名受害者如出一辙。玩家角色从低语蛛网神殿返回城镇后不久，便得知了这一发现。此次凶案过后，柳岸镇进入高度戒备状态，因为显然有一个怪物——无论是人类还是别的什么——正在夜里徘徊于街道之上。镇中长老下令实施日落宵禁。孩子们要么待在室内，要么受到严密看护；人们变得更不愿意外出采集食物和柴火；除紧急情况外，无人会在天黑后出门。笼罩城镇的恐惧使玩家角色在柳岸镇进行谋生或打探消息的所有检定时，受到–1环境减值。

犯罪现场

搜寻线索 调查；@Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

下等 虽然艾莉泽丝的遗体如今停放在教堂中供人瞻仰，但她那支破损的长笛仍 леж在大野墓旁的草地上。若玩家角色检查这支长笛并成功通过一次@Check[perception|dc:25]检定，他们会注意到它看起来并非被物理打击所毁，而是被音波伤害摧毁；若以一次DC 20的辨识魔法检定成功，他们便能辨认出其毁坏原因很可能来自一个粉碎音波法术（(@Check[arcana|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic] @Check[nature|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic] @Check[occultism|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic] @Check[religion|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic]))。这支破损的长笛是一件重要的私人纪念物，可在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15thewandering00]{第13章}中用于解放艾莉泽丝的灵魂。

中等 艾莉泽丝常常在新近亡故者的坟墓上方吹奏长笛，她相信音乐能帮助他们前往来世。她的长笛被毁，或许表明有人想进一步确保大野的灵魂会迷失无归，也显示出这些罪行中额外的一层残忍。玩家角色还会自动意识到，长笛上的损伤是由一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{粉碎音波}法术造成的。

重大 这支破损的长笛还可能指向另一种可能性——凶手也许是一种名为妖骸的超自然生物，据说它们厌恶并恐惧由圣职者演奏的长笛之音。

错误线索 艾莉泽丝曾在大野的坟前停留，这一事实暗示两人之间也许存在某种隐秘关系——莫非凶手是一名嫉妒心作祟或因情生恨的恋人？

奖励：若玩家角色发现艾莉泽丝那支破损的长笛，则给予他们60 XP。

Event 6: The Second Murder

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}’s second victim is Elizeth Candora (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w9ladyofsoul00]{Lady of Souls}), caretaker of Willowshore’s temple of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, Her Fluvial Lady of Souls. He targets her in part due to her association with Pharasma, a deity whose domain over the souls of the dead runs counter to what Kugaptee represents, but also because of the fear and hatred of flute music instilled within him as a result of his yohoi nature. He attacks her one night as she plays her flute to soothe the spirits in the graveyard just southwest of Her Fluvial Lady of Souls, hoping to spread fear in Willowshore about the fate of all of the townsfolk’s souls once they die.

Her body is discovered in the graveyard, sprawled over the top of Oono’s fresh grave, in the same state as the previous victim. The PCs learn of the discovery soon after their return to town from Whisperweb Shrine. After this killing, Willowshore goes on high alert as it becomes obvious there’s a monster—be they human or otherwise—stalking the streets at night. The town elder imposes a sundown curfew. Children stay indoors or under close supervision, people become much more reluctant to forage for food and firewood, and no one ventures out after dark except in cases of emergency. The fear infecting the town causes the PCs to take a –1 circumstance penalty to all checks in Willowshore to Earn Income or Gather Information.

Scene of the Crime

Search for Clues Investigate; @Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

Minor While Elizeth’s body now lies in state in the church itself, her broken flute lies in the grass near Oono’s grave. If the PCs examine the flute and succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:25] check, they note that it appears to have been destroyed by sonic damage rather than a physical blow; they can identify the cause of the destruction as likely coming from a shatter spell with a successful DC 20 check to Identify Magic ((@Check[arcana|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic] @Check[nature|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic] @Check[occultism|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic] @Check[religion|dc:20|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:identify-magic|name:Identify Magic])). The broken flute serves as a significant personal token that can be used to free Elizeth’s soul in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15thewandering00]{Chapter 13}.

Moderate Elizeth often played her flute over the graves of the recently deceased, believing that music would help guide them to the afterlife. Her flute being broken suggests, perhaps, that someone wanted to further ensure Oono’s soul would become lost and indicates an extra layer of cruelty to the crimes. The PC also automatically realizes the damage to the flute was caused by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter} spell.

Major The broken flute could suggest a different possibility—the murderer might be a supernatural creature called a yohoi, as they’re said to loathe and fear the sound of flute music performed by a holy person.

False Lead The fact that Elizeth spent time at Oono’s grave suggests that there might have been some hidden relationship between the two—perhaps the killer was a jealous or jilted lover?

Reward: Grant the PCs 60 XP for discovering Elizeth’s broken flute.

Event 5. Spiced Tea of Winter.name: 事件 5。冬日香料茶 Event 5. Spiced Tea of Winter
Event 5. Spiced Tea of Winter.text:
事件5：冬日香料茶 重度 11

任美璃派遣PC去复原苹果林后一周（也很可能是在PC调查第一起谋杀案几天之后），络新妇回到了柳岸镇。她感谢PC们所做的工作，但比起听到果园的复原工作已经开始，她对四只克拉夫戈登已死的消息显得更加欣喜。尽管她的举止一如既往地彬彬有礼，她的神态中却多了一股先前从未显露过的强烈意味。她眼中那层银色光泽变得更加明显，而她说话时，尖牙的尖端也清晰可见。

“你们来到第四个季节，也迎来了最能揭示真相的任务。冬季的仪式要求为众人奉上香料茶，以此象征管理者有能力在这个季节寒冷而饥饿的夜晚中提供温暖、食物与安全。这样的场合最好使用上等茶叶，但即便是最好的茶，若能用最细腻的蛛丝滤过，也会更上一层楼。

“西北方低语蛛网神殿的看守者就能提供这样上等的丝线，其质地与编织都非常适合滤制细致的茶饮。它们或许不是你们习惯接触的对象，但只要让它们品尝一下你们打算献上的茶，你们应该就能赢得它们的青睐。我不建议你们直接从它们那里取走所需之物，但一如既往，选择权仍在你们自己手中。”

这一次，她拿出那颗描绘着水果拼盘的景泰蓝球，同时留下最后一件饰物没有交出——那是一只冒着蒸汽的大锅，在白色雪花，或也可能是蛛网的背景前发着微光。随后，她再次向众人道别，并承诺一周后回来品尝那些用从低语蛛网神殿采集来的蛛丝滤过的茶。

柳岸镇中无人知晓“低语蛛网神殿”这个名字，因为在他们所处的一百年前，这个地点根本没有名字。那时，它仅仅被称作一座奇异而被遗忘的圣祠，比现代镇子本身还要古老。如果PC向唐入的人打听，或是询问像罗阔恩这样的本地人，他们都可以确认：位于柳岸镇以北数日旅行路程外的那座古老圣祠，在他们记忆中一直都叫低语蛛网；但实际上，这地方是在柳岸镇被拉入心景后的几年里才获得这个名字的。

前往圣祠：前往圣祠的旅程平静无事；它位于小路离开地图范围后再往北约十二英里处。不过，当PC逐渐接近时，一股不祥的寂静会降临这片土地。待PC接近实际地点时，朗读或转述以下内容。

本次遭遇使用低语蛛网神殿地图。

蜿蜒的小路在此豁然开朗，通向一片如画般美好的空地，其中心是一汪美得令人心痛的池塘。树枝上悬挂着各类饰物：纸提灯、镀金面具、编织丝带，以及与它们同样醒目地挂在其间的——动物和不止几个人的木乃伊化尸体。它们无声的尖叫被一层层紧密、令人窒息的丝线保存下来，仿佛这个地方的看守者觉得这种表情格外令人愉悦，或是可笑。

空地中央那座闪烁着微光的装饰水池，周围环绕着由层层堆叠石块砌成的古老石制圣祠；西北方一处低矮山脊边缘则有一道美丽的水流轻柔倾泻而下，注入池中，再从南边以一条狭窄的小溪流出。

池塘深20英尺，但水面相对平静——角色只要成功通过一次 @Check[athletics|dc:10|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] 检定，就能游过池塘。南边的小溪只有2英尺深，可以涉水通过，但视为困难地形。小溪本身具有季节性——到夏季稍晚些时候，细小的瀑流会变成真正的瀑布，溪流也会变宽，最终一路向南流入名为文命义左眼的洼地，然后排入地下蓄水层。

生物：低语蛛网神殿的守护者是六只被称为哀悼者的精魂——它们是蜘蛛般的、自封的古老遗忘圣祠看守者。哀悼者并非邪恶，但会迅速保卫自己的圣祠，周围遍布的那些被蛛网裹覆的骨骸与尸体便是明证。不过，它们不会一见面就发动攻击。

场景注记宏

@UUID[Macro.Ohk6Up1PvXsIC9LA]{哀悼者现身}

哀悼者一注意到PC，便会从周围林地中出现，爬上池塘东西两侧的六座岩石圣祠，对PC说话。离PC最近的那只哀悼者用柔和而优雅的声音开口。

“你们闯入了神圣之地。你们这一族曾将这座圣祠弃于我们之手。你们如今凭什么自称有权回来？”

哀悼者会听取PC的回应，但若PC要求它们交出一些丝线，它们的反应会变得僵硬；它们会转而告诉PC，既然他们已经来到这里，就不能在为“那些被你们遗忘之人”举行适当仪式与祷告之前离开。这座圣祠最初是供奉 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.M3eb94Nd6uXti2IK]{大吉津} 的，尽管那已是数百年前的事，如今哀悼者仍继续敬奉这位女神。若PC不主动这样做，哀悼者就会命令他们为这位农业女神举行一场茶道——详见下文“敬奉圣祠”。

事件5：冬日香料茶 重度 11

@UUID[Actor.E6fuG6L5VyWMvz08]{哀悼者（6）}

如果PC拒绝，或是他们攻击哀悼者，或试图从周围区域采集丝线，哀悼者便会愤怒地嘶叫并发动攻击。它们会战斗至死，但不打算杀死PC，而是设法将他们活捉，好让他们忏悔并献上祷告。注意，虽然杀死哀悼者能让PC轻松取得所需的丝线，但他们将没有机会在本次遭遇中获得胜利点。

敬奉圣祠：你不必要求玩家完整角色扮演整场茶道来敬奉圣祠，尽管有些团队会很享受将这一幕完整演出的机会。如果你的团队偏好这种延展场景，你应将此视作一个机会，让玩家进一步发挥他们至今所学到的茶文化知识；若他们对仪式的呈现尤其令人难忘，你也可以将本次遭遇中获取胜利点所需的难度等级降低2。

为了判定这场展示有多成功，询问每位玩家他们的角色会如何恰当地敬奉这座圣祠，然后让他们使用合适的技能尝试一次DC 28技能检定，以获得胜利点。如果PC是在没有哀悼者提示的情况下主动选择执行这项仪式，他们在这些检定上获得+2环境加值；但如果PC曾与哀悼者战斗、被其俘虏，并被迫进行茶道，则改为承受–2环境减值。对于想向圣祠祷告或正确执行茶道的PC来说，@Check[religion|dc:28] 或 @Check[tea-lore|dc:28] 是最明显的选择。@Check[diplomacy|dc:28] 可用于争取哀悼者的配合，@Check[performance|dc:28] 可用于辅助茶道，而施法者则可以视情况使用 @Check[arcana|dc:28]、@Check[nature|dc:28] 或 @Check[occultism|dc:28]。

哀悼者会欣赏一场执行得当的仪式，但并不强求完美。即便PC在这里完全没能获得任何胜利点，只要哀悼者相信他们已经尽了最大努力，它们仍会允许PC采集所需的丝线，并平静离开。如果PC获得了至少3点胜利点，哀悼者会被这场仪式深深打动，给予至多6名自愿接受的PC一个Pilgrim’s Ward。在这场冒险的剩余部分里，哀悼者不会再将这份护佑赐予其他任何人，因此若PC获得这一奖励，只要他们遵守崇拜大吉津的典范与禁忌，便能一直保有它。

奖励：若PC至少获得1点胜利点，则给予他们60 XP；若他们获得最高的4点胜利点，则给予80 XP。若他们在不诉诸暴力的情况下解决本次遭遇，则按在战斗中击败哀悼者所应获得的经验值授予他们XP。

Event 5: Spiced Tea of Winter Severe 11

A week after Ren Mei Li sends the PCs to restore the apple grove (and likely a few days after the PCs investigate the first murder), the jorogumo returns to Willowshore. She thanks the PCs for their work but is more delighted at the news that the four khravgodons are dead than to hear about the restoration work that has begun on the grove. While her demeanor is as courteous as ever, there’s an intensity to her manner that she never showed before. The silvery sheen over her eyes is more pronounced, and the tips of her fangs are visible when she speaks.

“You come to the fourth season, and to the most revealing task. The ritual of winter requires providing a spiced tea for the people, signifying the steward’s ability to provide warmth, sustenance, and safety throughout the season’s cold and hungry nights. It’s best to use fine tea for such an occasion, yet even the finest tea can be improved by filtering it through the most delicate of webbing.

“The caretakers of Whisperweb Shrine to the northwest provide such fine silk, the texture and weave are perfect for the straining of delicate teas. They might not be what you are accustomed to, but provide them with a taste of the teas you seek to present, and you should be able to secure their favor. I advise against simply taking from them what you need, but your choices, as always, remain your own.

This time, she offers the cloisonne ball depicting the fruit platter, while holding back one final ornament, which shows a steaming cauldron glowing against a backdrop of white snowflakes, or perhaps spiderwebs. Then, she once again bids the party farewell and promises to return in one week to sample the teas strained through spidersilk gathered from Whisperweb Shrine.

None in Willowshore know the name “Whisperweb Shrine,” for in their time a century ago, the site was without a name at all. Instead, it was known only as a strange, forgotten shrine that predated the modern township. If the PCs ask around Karahai or speak to a local like Lo Kuon, they can confirm that the old shrine located a few days travel north of Willowshore has been known as Whisperweb for as long as they can remember, when, in fact, the site gained that name only a few years after Willowshore was pulled into the mindscape.

Traveling to the Shrine: The journey to the shrine, which lies a dozen miles north of where the trail leads off the map, is uneventful, though an ominous hush descends upon the land as the PCs draw close. Read or paraphrase the following as the PCs approach the actual location.

Use the Whisperweb Shrine map for this encounter.

The winding path opens here into an idyllic clearing, at the heart of which shines an achingly beautiful pond. Ornaments hang from tree branches overhead: paper lanterns, gilt masks, braids of woven silk, and, hung among the rest with equal prominence, the mummified corpses of animals and more than a few people. Their silent screams are preserved in tight, suffocating layers of silk, as though the keepers of this place found that expression particularly pleasing or amusing.

The ornamental pool that glimmers in the middle of the clearing is surrounded by old stone shrines built out of stacked stones, while a beautiful cascade of water runs softly over the edge of a low ridge to the northwest to fill the pool, flowing back out to the south in a narrow creek.

The pool is 20 feet deep, but the waters are relatively calm—a character can Swim the pool with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:10|traits:move,skill,action:swim|name:Swim] check. The creek to the south is only 2 feet deep and can be waded through as difficult terrain. The creek itself is seasonal—later in the summer, the trickling cascade turns into a proper waterfall and the stream widens, with the water eventually flowing south into the hollow known as the Left Eye of Fumeiyoshi before draining into underground reservoirs.

Creatures: The guardians of Whisperweb Shrine are a half-dozen spirits known as algrievers—spider-like self-appointed custodians of forgotten shrines like this one. While not evil, the algrievers are quick to defend their shrine from intruders, as the large amount of web-shrouded bones and bodies that lie about the place testify. Still, they don’t attack on sight.

Scene NotesMacro

@UUID[Macro.Ohk6Up1PvXsIC9LA]{The Algrievers Emerge}

As soon as they notice the PCs, the algrievers emerge from the surrounding woods and clamber up onto the six rock shrines to the east and west of the pool to address the PCs. The algriever closest to the PCs speaks in a soft, eloquent voice.

“You intrude upon sacred ground. Your kind abandoned this shrine to us. By what right do you claim such a return?”

The algrievers listen to the PCs’ responses but react stiffly to any request for them to give over some of their silk, instead informing the PCs that, now that they’ve arrived, they can’t be allowed to leave before they perform proper rites and prayers to “those you have forgotten.” This shrine was originally devoted to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.M3eb94Nd6uXti2IK]{Daikitsu}, and while that was many centuries ago now, the algrievers still honor the goddess. If the PCs don’t do so themselves, they’re ordered to perform a tea ceremony in memory of the goddess of agriculture—see Honoring the Shrine below.

Event 5: Spiced Tea of Winter Severe 11

@UUID[Actor.E6fuG6L5VyWMvz08]{Algrievers (6)}

If the PCs refuse, or if they attack or attempt to harvest silk from the surrounding area, the algrievers hiss in fury and attack. They fight to the death but don’t seek to kill the PCs, instead working to trap them alive so that they can repent and offer prayers. Note that while killing the algrievers allows the PCs to gather the silk they need with ease, they won’t have a chance to earn Victory Points in this encounter.

Honoring the Shrine: You don’t need to have the players roleplay the entire tea ceremony to honor the shrine, although some groups will enjoy the chance to roleplay the scene out. If your group prefers such an extended scene, you should use this as an opportunity to give the players a chance to build on what they’ve learned so far about tea culture, and if they do a particularly memorable job at presenting the ceremony, feel free to reduce the DCs needed to earn Victory Points in this encounter by 2.

In order to determine how successful the display is, ask each player what their character does to properly honor the shrine, then have them attempt a DC 28 skill check with an appropriate skill to earn Victory Points. If the PCs chose to perform this service without being prompted by the algrievers, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to these checks, but if the PCs fought the algrievers and were captured and are forced to perform the ceremony, they take a –2 circumstance penalty instead. @Check[religion|dc:28] or @Check[tea-lore|dc:28] are the most obvious choices here for PCs who wish to pray to the shrine or to perform the tea ceremony correctly. @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] can be used to secure the algrievers’ cooperation, @Check[performance|dc:28] can be used to supplement the tea ceremony, and magic users can employ @Check[arcana|dc:28], @Check[nature|dc:28], or @Check[occultism|dc:28] as needed.

The algrievers appreciate a well-performed ceremony but don’t require it. Even if the PCs completely fail to earn any Victory Points here, as long as the algrievers believe that they did their best, they’ll allow the PCs to harvest the silk they desire and leave in peace. If the PCs earned at least 3 Victory Points, the algrievers are moved enough by the rite to give up to 6 willing PCs a Pilgrim’s Ward. The algrievers won’t be giving anyone else this ward for the remainder of this adventure, so if the PCs earn this reward, they’ll retain it as long as they obey the edicts and anathemas of worshipping Daikitsu.

Reward: Grant the PCs 60 XP if they earn at least 1 Victory Point, or 80 XP if they earn the maximum of 4 Victory Points. Grant them XP as if they’d defeated the algrievers in combat if they resolve this encounter without violence.

Event 4. The First Murder.name: 事件 4：第一场谋杀 Event 4. The First Murder
Event 4. The First Murder.text:
事件4：第一场谋杀

谋杀开始

本章给出了三起供玩家角色调查的谋杀案；如果你愿意，也可以加入更多，但很可能在那之前玩家角色手头就已经有了解决办法。这三名受害者都是柳岸镇中的特定非玩家角色。如果这些非玩家角色中有人已经被杀，或者你觉得他们的死亡会过度扰乱你这次特定的肆季鬼志故事，那就用其他非玩家角色替换他们。

搜寻线索

  • 专注
  • 探索
  • Secret

你花费10分钟调查一具尸体、一件证物，或与谋杀相关的地点（比如犯罪现场本身），或者花费2小时向潜在目击者打探消息。然后，你尝试该调查“搜寻线索”条目中列出的一项检定。拥有调查员职业的玩家角色在这么做时可以使用追查方向，以获得该能力对其检定的加值，并且可以使用提供线索来协助其他人搜寻线索。

大成功 你发现轻微、普通和重大线索。

成功 你得知轻微和普通线索。

失败 你得知轻微线索。

大失败 你得知错误线索，并把它当作轻微线索相信了。

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}会在某个时间点制造他的第一名受害者，正好是在玩家角色造访苹果林并与克拉夫戈登战斗期间，因此恢复果园的实际工作很可能会与他们对这起案件的调查同时进行。

当这起谋杀发生时（之后的几起杀人案发生时也是如此），赫山宝会利用一个从腐化的柳岸镇心景通往柳岸镇中他庄园废墟的传送门现身——直到本章结尾，玩家角色都无法接触到这个传送门，甚至不会知道它的存在。他在夜间出现，然后施展@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{传送}，瞬间出现在一个他先前到访过的地点，并把抵达时间拿捏在他希望选中的目标独处之时，以确保能出其不意。完成残暴行径后，他通过飞行返回庄园废墟，再穿过传送门回到腐化的柳岸镇心景，不留下任何可供追踪的痕迹。

第一名受害者是大野一真（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w19downtownw00]{柳岸镇镇区}），赫山宝之所以盯上他，一方面是因为几个月前、总督试图进行自己的仪式之前，这位导演对《织水者纪事》的一场演出处理方式让他愤懑不已；另一方面则是因为他担心大野一真可能会向玩家角色提供有用情报。山宝借由传送进入大野一真的房间，在他伏案写作时将其杀害，夺走了他的笔记本以防玩家角色拿到，然后砸穿建筑物飞回破败庄园中的传送门。

玩家角色返回柳岸镇前不久，大野一真的尸体在七彩鸣雀剧场的私人办事书房中被发现，因此迎接他们的将会是一座仍因这场事件而议论纷纷、震惊未平的城镇。房门是锁着的，门锁没有被动过的痕迹。一面纸墙从内部被向外砸开，断裂框架的内侧表面留有带血污痕。那个破洞显然大到足以让一个人类穿过。现场没有搏斗迹象。尸体周围满是鲜血，倒在写字桌旁的地板上，仿佛他只是从椅子上摔了下来，甚至没来得及站起身或以其他方式对袭击者作出反应。

这起谋杀的消息传开后，柳岸镇的人民哀悼这位深受爱戴的导演之死，并把目光投向玩家角色寻求答案。如“谋杀开始”侧栏中所述，玩家角色可以通过“搜寻线索”探索行动来调查这些谋杀案。之后还会发生更多谋杀（@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog14thepri.JournalEntryPage.14event6thesec00]{事件6}和@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog14thepri.JournalEntryPage.14event8thethi00]{事件8}），每一起都像这起一样，都会给出一个可供调查的犯罪现场，以及一些该事件专属的其他调查项目。除了这些事件专属调查之外，玩家角色还可以检查遗体以确定死因——三具尸体都有相似的线索可供进一步调查（他们枯槁消瘦的身体、他们失去的眼睛，以及他们手腕上奇怪的符文）。关于这四项额外调查的细节，可在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{这里}找到，与赫山宝的妖骸非玩家角色数据一并列出。

犯罪现场

搜寻线索 调查；@Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

轻微 凶手平静地进入了犯罪现场，没有破坏任何东西，但离开时却只是直接撞穿了脆弱的纸门，在外面庭院中没有留下任何可供追踪的痕迹。

普通 靠近被砸开处的一面墙边放着一只箱子，上面有血手印；里面是一叠册页，收着大野一真最喜欢的几部戏的带批注副本。书册看起来曾被一个双手沾满鲜血的人翻找过。若玩家角色成功通过一次@Check[theater-lore|dc:25]或@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:25]检定，就会注意到大野一真平常固定轮演的一部戏不见了：《织水者纪事》。

重大 玩家角色会自动意识到《织水者纪事》不见了。此外，玩家角色还发现了一叠掉落到大野一真写字桌后方的纸页——那是《无尽之岸》的服装草图和剧本初稿。这是一部关于柳岸镇在心景中的岁月的戏剧，其灵感来自玩家角色为@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog14thepri.JournalEntryPage.14event1bright00]{事件1 - 明春之鸟}所进行的演出。虽然这份手稿初稿与大野一真的谋杀案并无关联，但它是一个重要的私人信物，可在@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15thesilenceds00]{第13章}中用来解放大野一真的灵魂。

错误线索 众所周知，大野一真在政治上非常偏向北岭，而且常常用尖刻的话讽刺南岸人——也许凶手是某个被他冒犯、因而决定亲自动手的南岸人？

《织水者纪事》

搜寻线索 调查；@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

轻微 这出戏讲述的是一名武僧学会了如何用水织布，随后被卷入一场复杂阴谋之中：互相拌嘴的丝绸商人们争相博取一位反复无常的总督的青睐。

普通 大野一真历来会在每年夏至排演这出戏的新版本，但他今年没有这么做——很可能是因为柳岸镇诅咒相关事件的影响。

重大 大野一真原本已经开始筹备今年的版本，但当传言传开，说他正修改这出戏，准备把它变成对总督赫山宝的公开抨击时，总督在春末拜访了大野一真。此后，这年夏天该剧演出的所有讨论便戛然而止。

错误线索 大野一真早就对这出戏失去了兴趣，并把它移出了自己的常规轮演剧目；因此它从藏品中缺失并不值得大惊小怪。

访谈

搜寻线索 打探消息；@Check[diplomacy|dc:22|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information]

轻微 大野一真最后一次被人看见，是在他被杀当晚黄昏前不久，当时他饭后去了一趟乐河童浴场泡澡。他在那里和华·德格简短交谈了几句，当时看起来心情不错。

普通 大野一真正兴奋于创作一部新戏，内容取材于先前玩家角色在明春之鸟期间关于他们在心景中经历的演出，而且他觉得自己刚在灵感上有所突破。他一离开浴场就说，要立刻直接回戏剧去把这阵突如其来的灵感写下来，免得它转瞬即逝。

重大 虽然大野一真似乎没有什么明显的仇敌，但在春季最后一天前几周，赫总督确实拜访过他一次，而且有人听见了激烈争吵……从那以后，大野一真便显得格外消沉和沮丧。

错误线索 大野一真常用刻薄言辞把糟糕演员说得当场落泪——也许凶手是某个遭他羞辱或怀恨在心的演员？

奖励： 当玩家角色在调查中第一次找到指向赫山宝的关联，或发现那个重要私人信物时，给予玩家角色80 XP。

谋杀现场疑难排解

谋杀调查中一些可能出现的复杂情况可以按如下方式处理。

让任美璃参与： 如果玩家角色让任美璃参与调查，这位络新妇对提供帮助兴趣不大，她会指出：如果他们要成为柳岸镇可靠的守护者，那么处理这样的罪案和事件本就是他们职责的一部分。尽管如此，她仍对玩家角色的担忧抱有同情；如果玩家在案件上陷入困境，也可以借她之口帮助他们串联起一些线索。若她察觉玩家角色把她也视为嫌疑人，她会斥责他们太过多疑，并建议他们不要被“有问题的逻辑跳跃”分散注意力。

与死者交谈： 在肆季鬼志中，玩家角色不太可能获得死者交谈、唤灵术，或类似能让他们与死者说话的魔法，但如果他们的确有，这些方法应当提供与调查所得相同的信息。若被问及凶手的样貌，这些尸体会更强调凶手那树根般的身体、从他眼中飞出的蝴蝶，以及他那长而破损的双臂；如果你愿意，他们也可以指认凶手是总督赫山宝的扭曲版本。

蹲守庄园： 一旦玩家角色怀疑赫山宝与这些谋杀案有关，他们可能会选择调查他的庄园。若没有獠牙与钥匙，他们将无法进入修复后的庄园，而在破败建筑中也找不到任何关于他踪迹的新线索。玩家角色也可能决定蹲守庄园。如果他们在夜间这么做，那么由你裁定，玩家角色也许能在某起谋杀发生前（或发生后）与赫山宝对峙，在这种情况下他会与玩家角色战斗。与赫山宝的冲突是一场中等难度的11级遭遇。如果玩家角色杀了他，他会在腐化的柳岸镇心景中重新成形，并必须如第13章所述那样再次面对，但他将不再返回柳岸镇继续行凶。每阻止一起本可能发生的谋杀，就给予玩家角色80 XP。

Event 4: The First Murder

The Murders Begin

Three murders are presented in this chapter for the PCs to investigate; you can add more if you wish, but it’s likely the PCs will have a solution at hand before then. All three of the victims are specific NPCs from Willowshore. If any of these NPCs have already been slain, or if you feel that their deaths would overly derail your specific Season of Ghosts story, substitute a different NPC in their place.

Search for Clues

  • Concentrate
  • Exploration
  • Secret

You spend 10 minutes Investigating a body, piece of evidence, or location associated with the murder (such as the Scene of the Crime itself), or spend 2 hours Gathering Information from potential witnesses. You then attempt one of the checks listed in the investigation’s Search For Clues entry. A PC with the investigator class can use Pursue a Lead when they do so to gain that ability’s bonus to their check and can use Clue In to aid others in Searching for Clues.

Critical Success You discover minor, moderate, and major clues.

Success You learn the minor and moderate clues.

Failure You learn the minor clues.

Critical Failure You learn the false lead and believe it to be a minor clue.

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao} claims his first victim at some point while the PCs are visiting the apple grove and fighting khravgodons, so the actual work of restoring the grove will likely take place alongside their investigation of this crime.

When the time comes for this murder to occur (and again when subsequent slayings take place), Heh Shan-Bao uses a portal from the corrupted Willowshore mindscape to emerge into the ruins of his manor in Willowshore itself—a portal the PCs won’t be able to access or even know about until the end of this chapter. He emerges at night, then uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} to instantly appear at a location he has visited before, timing his arrival for when he hopes his chosen target is alone to ensure he catches them by surprise. After his violent work is done, he returns to the manor ruins via flight and passes back through the portal to the corrupted Willowshore mindscape, leaving nothing to track in his wake.

This first victim is Kazuma Oono (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog02willow.JournalEntryPage.02w19downtownw00]{Downtown Willowshore}), whom Heh Shan-Bao targets because he’s bitter about how the director handled a performance of The Chronicle of the Water-Weaver a few months before the governor attempted his ritual, but also because he’s afraid Oono might be able to provide useful information to the PCs. Shan-Bao entered Oono’s room via translocate, killed him as he worked at his writing desk, seized his notebook to prevent the PCs from obtaining it, and then smashed out of the building before flying back to the portal in the ruined manor.

Oono’s body is discovered in his private office at the Seven-Colored Songbird shortly before the PCs return to Willowshore, so they’ll be greeted with a town still abuzz and shocked at the event. The door was locked, and the lock is undisturbed. A paper wall has been smashed outward from within, and the inner surface of the splintered framework is marked with bloodstained smears. The hole is easily large enough for a human to have passed through. There are no signs of struggle. Copious amounts of blood surround the body, which lies on the floor next to a writing desk as if he’d simply fallen out of his chair without standing or otherwise responding to his attacker.

After word spreads of this murder, the people of Willowshore mourn the loss of the beloved director and look to the PCs for answers. As noted in the The Murders Begin sidebar, the PCs can investigate these murders via the Search for Clues exploration activity. Additional murders will occur later (@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog14thepri.JournalEntryPage.14event6thesec00]{Event 6} and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog14thepri.JournalEntryPage.14event8thethi00]{Event 8}), each of which, like this one, presents a scene of the crime to investigate, along with a few other event-specific investigations. In addition to these event-specific investigations, the PCs can examine the remains for a cause of death—all three bodies share similar clues that can be further investigated (their emaciated frames, their missing eyes, and strange runes on their wrists). Details on these four additional investigations can be found @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Here}, alongside Hen Shan-Bao’s yohoi NPC statistics.

Scene of the Crime

Search for Clues Investigate; @Check[perception|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

Minor The killer entered the crime scene calmly, without damaging anything, but they exited by simply smashing through the fragile paper doorway, leaving no tracks outside of the room in the courtyard beyond.

Moderate A trunk that rests against a wall near the smashed open section has bloody handprints on it; within lies a collection of folios that contain Oono’s annotated copies of his favorite plays. The books appear to have been pawed through by someone with blood-soaked hands. With a successful @Check[theater-lore|dc:25] or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:25] check, a PC notes that one play from Oono’s regular cycle of offerings is missing: The Chronicle of the Water-Weaver.

Major The PC automatically realizes The Chronicle of the Water-Weaver is missing. In addition, the PC discovers a sheaf of pages that fell behind Oono’s writing desk—costume sketches and a draft script for The Endless Shore, a play about Willowshore’s time in the mindscape inspired by the performances the PCs put on for @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog14thepri.JournalEntryPage.14event1bright00]{Event 1 - Bright Spring Bird}. While this draft manuscript has no relevance to Oono’s murder, it serves as a significant personal token that can be used to free Oono’s soul in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15thesilenceds00]{Chapter 13}.

False Lead Oono was known to be very allied with Northridge politically and often had snarky remarks about Southbankers—perhaps the killer was someone from Southbank who was insulted by him and decided to take matters into their own hands?

The Chronicle of the Water-Weaver

Search for Clues Investigate; @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate]

Minor This play is about a monk who learned how to weave cloth from water, then became embroiled in a complex plot involving bickering silk traders vying for the attentions of a fickle governor.

Moderate Oono traditionally directed a new version of this play at every summer solstice, but he didn’t this year—likely due to the events surrounding the Willowshore curse.

Major Oono was starting this year’s production, but when rumors spread that he was altering the play to make it a blatant critique of Governor Heh Shan-Bao, the governor paid Oono a visit at the end of spring, and all discussion of that summer’s production of the play went silent thereafter.

False Lead This play is one that Oono had lost interest in and took out of his regular rotation; it being missing from his collection is thus unremarkable.

Interviews

Search for Clues Gather Information; @Check[diplomacy|dc:22|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information]

Minor Oono was last seen shortly before dusk on the night he was killed, when he stopped by the Happy Kappa bathhouse for a post-dinner soak. He spoke briefly to Hua De-ge while he was there and seemed to be in good spirits at the time.

Moderate Oono was excited about writing a new play based on the PCs’ performance during the Bright Spring Bird earlier regarding their time spent in the mindscape, and he felt that he’d just had a breakthrough in his inspiration. As soon as he left the bathhouse, he said he was going straight back to the theater to write down his sudden flash of ideas before they evaporated.

Major While Oono didn’t have any obvious enemies, there was that time a few weeks before the last day of spring that Governor Heh paid him a visit, and folks reported hearing a heated argument... after which Oono seemed particularly depressed and frustrated.

False Lead Oono often reduced bad actors to tears with his cutting remarks—perhaps the murderer was a spurned or vengeful actor?

Reward: Grant the PCs 80 XP the first time they either find links to Heh Shan-Bao or discover the significant personal token during their investigation.

Murder Scene Troubleshooting

Some potential complications in the murder investigations can be handled as follows.

Involving Ren Mei Li: If the PCs involve Ren Mei Li in their investigations, the jorogumo has little interest in providing aid, noting that if they’re to be reliable stewards of Willowshore, dealing with crimes and events like these will be part of their duties. Still, she’s sympathetic to the PCs’ concerns and can be used to help the players connect some dots if they’re struggling with the case. If she gets the idea that the PCs consider her as a suspect, she chides them for being paranoid and suggests they don’t get distracted by “faulty leaps of logic.”

Speaking to the Dead: It’s unlikely for a PC in Season of Ghosts to have access to talking corpse, call spirit, or similar magic that lets them speak to the dead, but if they do, these methods should give the same information that investigations could. Asked to describe their killer, these corpses focus more on the killer’s rootlike body, the butterflies that come from his eyes, and his long broken arms, but they can also identify the killer as a distorted version of Governor Heh Shan-Bao if you wish.

Staking Out the Manor: Once the PCs suspect Heh Shan-Bao is somehow involved in the murders, they might choose to investigate his manor. Without the Fang and Key, they won’t be able to enter the restored manor, and no new clues of his presence can be found in the ruined structure. The PCs might decide to stake out the manor. If they do so at night, at your discretion, the PCs might be able to confront Heh Shan-Bao before (or after) a murder, in which case he fights the PCs. A conflict with Heh Shan-Bao is a Moderate 11 encounter. If the PCs slay him, he re-forms in the corrupted Willowshore mindscape and must be confronted again, as detailed in Chapter 13, but he won’t return to Willowshore to murder again. Grant the PCs 80 XP for each potential murder prevented in this way.

Event 3. Fall's Sweet Fruits.name: 事件3：秋日的甜美果实 Event 3. Fall's Sweet Fruits
Event 3. Fall's Sweet Fruits.text:
事件3：秋日的甜美果实 中等 11

所说的那片苹果林位于柳岸镇以南20英里处，是许多镇民都很熟悉、也长久以来一直享用其果实的地方。然而如今，这片苹果林已完全过度生长。苹果树依然在这里茂盛生长，结出的果实也依旧美味，但在过去七年里，这片区域一直是一群危险怪物的巢穴。

此次遭遇使用“过度生长的苹果园”地图。

曾经那片生长着数十棵优良苹果树的美丽空地，如今已被过度生长的野草与荆棘纠结蔓生所吞没。零星几棵苹果树仍立于矮丛环境之间，但其中也穿插着一些由某种大如大象之物踩踏出来的宽阔动物小路——小路两旁散落着无数巨大蜘蛛被碾碎、咀嚼后的残骸。

生物：并非所有栖息于神门的生物都会将络新妇及其蜘蛛视为恐惧的对象。对于某些掠食者而言，例如庞大的克拉夫戈多恩，蜘蛛是格外美味的一餐，而甲壳在齿间碎裂的触感更是一种享受。不是一只，而是四只这种超大型负鼠搬进了这片过度生长的苹果园，并将整片地区都视为自己的领地。每当这类掠食者迁入，络新妇采取行动也只是时间问题。而在这四只的情况里，那份行动便以玩家角色的形式显现。

事件3：秋日的甜美果实 中等 11

@UUID[Actor.93ScUkuBzeyh31bL]{克拉夫戈登（4）}

这些脾气暴躁的克拉夫戈登虽然更偏爱蜘蛛肉及其毒腺的辛辣滋味，但这些巨型动物也绝不会犹豫攻击玩家角色。它们会猛然从矮丛环境中扑出发动攻击，并以隐秘进行先攻。一只生命值降至40以下的克拉夫戈多恩会尝试逃跑，但最终仍会返回这片区域，夺回自己的领地。若玩家角色能与这些动物建立交流方式，他们或许可以达成协议，说服这些生物迁往别处；否则，在着手恢复苹果林之前，这四只生物都必须被杀死。

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.m7W9DIYrYhVAzM6F]{一名死去已久的冒险者的遗骸}
花费1小时在苹果林中搜寻的角色，会发现一名死去已久的冒险者那几乎完全被植物掩埋的遗骸。如今他几乎只剩下一具骷髅，但身上仍穿着他那醒目的龙龟甲，并携带着一根沉重的钢制圆筒——一门龙龟火炮。玩家角色一旦开始着手恢复苹果林，便会自动发现这份宝藏。

恢复苹果林：玩家角色不需要亲自完成恢复苹果林的任务，这个过程本身也不一定非得由他们执行，但在他们继续进行下一场仪式之前，任美璃交给他们的这项任务所需的前期规划必须先完成。为了判定当秋季苹果收获时，他们的计划究竟有多成功，让每位玩家说明自己的角色如何协助恢复苹果林，然后令其使用适当的技能进行一次DC 28技能检定以获得胜利点。对于希望运用自己有关植物生命的知识来帮助这处地点恢复的玩家角色来说，@Check[nature|dc:28] 是最显而易见的选择（无论是否借助原始魔法）；不过其他魔法也同样能提供帮助，在这种情况下，玩家角色可视情况掷出 @Check[arcana|dc:28]、@Check[occultism|dc:28] 或 @Check[religion|dc:28] 检定。@Check[diplomacy|dc:28] 可用于从柳岸镇招募工人。@Check[farming-lore|dc:28] 可用于修枝、除草，并确保苹果树拥有最好的茁壮成长机会。@Check[survival|dc:28] 可用于设置陷阱与防护，防止食腐动物伤害树木。

奖励：若玩家角色至少获得1点胜利点，则给予60 XP；若他们获得最高的4点胜利点，则给予80 XP。

Event 3: Fall's Sweet Fruits Moderate 11

The apple grove in question lies 20 miles south of Willowshore and is a place that many townsfolk know well and have long enjoyed the fruits of. Today, though, the grove is completely overgrown. Apple trees still thrive here, and their fruit remains delicious, but for the past seven years, the area has been the lair of a group of dangerous monsters.

Use the Overgrown Apple Grove map for this encounter.

Where once stood a beautiful clearing in which grew dozens of fine apple trees, now creeps an overgrown tangle of weeds and brambles. Here and there, apple trees still stand among the undergrowth, but wide animal trails left by something the size of an elephant do as well-trails lined with the crunched and chewed remnants of countless enormous spiders.

Creatures: Not every creature that dwells in Shenmen sees the jorogumo and their spiders as objects of fear. To certain predators, such as the hulking khravgodon, spiders make for a particularly delicious meal, and the sensation of chitin crunching between teeth is a delight. Not one but four of these oversized opossums have moved into this overgrown apple grove, and they consider the entire region part of their territory. Whenever these predators move in, it's only a matter of time before the jorogumo take action. In the case of these four, that action manifests in the form of the PCs.

Event 3: Fall's Sweet Fruits Moderate 11

@UUID[Actor.93ScUkuBzeyh31bL]{Khravgodons (4)}

While the ill-tempered khravgodons prefer the tang of spider meat and their poison glands, the giant animals won't hesitate to attack the PCs as well, lurching from the undergrowth to attack and using Stealth for initiative. A khravgodon reduced to fewer than 40 Hit Points attempts to flee but will eventually return to the area to reclaim its territory. If the PCs can establish a method of communication with the animals, they might be able to work out a deal and convince the creatures to relocate elsewhere, but otherwise, before work on restoring the grove can begin, the four creatures must be slain.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.m7W9DIYrYhVAzM6F]{Remains of a Long-Dead Adventurer}
A character who spends 1 hour Searching the grove uncovers the almost entirely overgrown remains of a long-dead adventurer. Little more than a skeleton now, he still wears his distinctive dragon turtle armor and carries a heavy steel cylinder-a dragon turtle artillery. The PCs automatically discover this treasure once they begin work on restoring the grove.

Restoring the Grove: The PCs don't need to complete the task of restoring the apple grove, nor does the process need to be done by them, but the preliminary planning for the task Ren Mei Li sets them must be done before they can move on to the next rite. To determine how successful their plans are once the apple season begins in autumn, ask each player what their character does to help restore the grove, then have them attempt a DC 28 skill check with an appropriate skill to earn Victory Points. @Check[nature|dc:28] is the most obvious choice here for PCs who wish to use their knowledge of plant life to help the site recover (with or without primal magic), but other magic can help as well, in which case a PC can roll an @Check[arcana|dc:28], @Check[occultism|dc:28], or @Check[religion|dc:28] check, as appropriate. @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] can be used to recruit workers from Willowshore. @Check[farming-lore|dc:28] can be used to prune and weed and ensure the apple trees have the best chance to thrive. @Check[survival|dc:28] can be called upon to set traps and protections to keep scavengers from harming the trees.

Reward: Grant the PCs 60 XP if they earn at least 1 Victory Point, or 80 XP if they earn the maximum of 4 Victory Points.

Event 2. Fiery Flower Fireworks.name: 事件 2：火花烟火 Event 2. Fiery Flower Fireworks
Event 2. Fiery Flower Fireworks.text:
事件2：烈焰花火

玩家角色接到的下一项任务，是筹办一场烟火表演，以庆贺夏日之美；传统上，这场表演也被认为能吓退心怀恶意的幽灵与精魂。虽说使用魔法——尤其像@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aKJf24RkDn0f1kG5]{幻景}这样的法术——也能造出令人惊艳的烟火效果，但任美璃希望这场表演货真价实。那就意味着，他们得采集一些罕见植物，以确保烟火绽放出传统所要求的那种精确无比的炽橙色。

这种传统原料，便是黑风之角的新鲜花瓣——一种罕见的亮橙色湿地花卉。虽然这种花零星生长于本地各处湿地，但花势最大、花质最好的大片花丛，丰盛地生长在月沼。月沼之名，正是因这些夜间绽放的花朵在月光辉映下会散发柔和的橙色发光。玩家角色并不知道，在过去几十年间，一位名叫伊索里的娜迦占星学者已在此地定居。

月沼可从城镇向北前往，穿过废弃村落与（很可能已重新开垦的）田地；季节性的月溪便穿流其间，向南汇入渡月河。春季时，这条溪流会干涸，但它依然比那条荒草蔓生的道路更可靠，适合循路前行。月沼位于地图边缘以北约6英里处，也就是柳岸镇以北约18英里。

寻找花朵：玩家角色一旦抵达月沼，便可花费8小时白昼时间搜索一片合用的黑风之角花丛；若在天黑之后，由于那时植物会开花并柔和发光，则只需1小时。这里的装饰物并不只有花。青铜与玻璃制成的日晷、星盘，以及各种透镜与棱镜，都悬挂在系于垂树枝上的绳索之上；而一串串硕大而扁平的玻璃珠，上面刻着几何符号与天文学配方，装点着垂挂于林间的绳索。

这些装饰物是由一位名叫伊索里的毗遮罗牟尼——一条启明娜迦——布置的。他已在这片沼泽生活了数十年。他喜爱在黑风之角的花丛中仰观天穹，并用自己漫长生命中收集来的各类占星与天文小饰品装点这里。伊索里大多独来独往，天性也并不暴戾，但若有人闯入他的观测地，他会立刻感到冒犯，自水中升起，用那双发光而睿智的眼睛静静打量玩家角色。

如果玩家角色一见面就发动攻击，他会愤怒地嘶嘶作响并予以还击，但并不会特别执着于长时间持续这场战斗。每轮他都会用一个动作向玩家角色提出休战，然后才继续作战。他会尽力避免杀死任何一名玩家角色，甚至会使用像生命之息这样的法术来救助在战斗中倒下的人。若生命值降至75以下，他便认定最好放弃此地并逃离。

如果玩家角色没有攻击（或者接受了休战提议），伊索里便会向他们致意，自称是“这片沼泽的守护者”，然后询问他们是谁、来自何方。关于柳岸镇归来的消息会引起他的兴趣——在他所知中，那地方一直都只是片废墟，而他曾在那里找到许多自己最喜爱的摆件。

作为研究天象的学者，伊索里最近一直被自己的天文与占星仪器所捕捉到的不祥征兆所困扰。他想知道，玩家角色是否对这片地区正在发生的事有所了解。他也在试图弄清，他们是否有可能——无论有意还是无意——应为那些他所见到的“蔓延锁链”负责；那些锁链如同饥饿的藤蔓般，正伸向自然世界。

正如玩家角色可能推测的那样，伊索里所察觉到的正是苦迦菩提的影响。这名邪魔的接触正迅速侵入湿地，而伊索里虽不了解威胁的真正规模，却无疑已经注意到了这些警兆。若玩家角色向他揭露真相（或者至少说服他相信他们并非元凶），他就会询问他们该如何应对。这个遭遇的设计意图，是让玩家角色意识到局势的利害，尤其是队伍中那些偏重自然的角色；但如果玩家角色能通过一次成功的@Check[diplomacy|dc:27|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression]留下印象交涉检定，让伊索里对他们的态度提升为友善或乐于助人（他最初的态度是冷淡），他便会与他们分享自己一件藏匿的宝藏，来帮助他们战斗。

只要玩家角色以尊重环境的方式采集，不无谓损伤植物，也不过量采摘，伊索里并不反对他们收集黑风之角的花瓣。

@UUID[Actor.SvKWVoIl2CPT1MJZ]{伊索里} 生物 6

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.PYXubF4kQUtM1ZQO]{伊索里之赠礼} @UUID[Actor.xvM3MRczzVobDx6H]{树洞}
若玩家角色让伊索里变为友善，他会从自己藏在一个不起眼树洞中的储藏里，送给他们一根千年龙根。如果他们让他变得乐于助人，他就会把三根根系全部送给他们。 否则，玩家角色在花费1小时搜索他的观测地之后，可通过一次成功的@Check[perception|dc:30|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] 搜索察觉检定来定位这三根千年龙根。

采收花朵：一名玩家角色可以尝试一次秘密的@Check[crafting|dc:28|traits:secret]、@Check[herbalism-lore|dc:28|traits:secret]、 @Check[nature|dc:28|traits:secret]或@Check[survival|dc:28|traits:secret]检定来采集花瓣，其他玩家角色则可以用上述任一技能进行DC 20检定来协助此次检定。若大成功，采得的花瓣会特别适合用于烟火，玩家角色之后在制作烟火并获得胜利点的检定中获得+2环境加值；但若失败，他们在这些检定中承受–2环境减值（若大失败则为–4环境减值）。

若玩家角色至少让伊索里变为友善，他会亲自提供有关如何采摘花瓣的建议，使所有采收所需的难度等级降低4。

制作烟火：当玩家角色返回柳岸镇后，下一步就是制作足够数量的烟火，以呈现一场像样的表演。和上一事件一样，当任美璃到来时，你不需要让玩家把整场表演完整角色扮演出来。为了判定表演有多成功，询问每位玩家他们的角色会做什么来确保烟火正常运作，然后让他们以合适的技能尝试一次DC 28技能检定来赚取胜利点。对于想亲手制作烟火的玩家角色而言，@Check[crafting|dc:28]是最显而易见的选择；但若有人想用魔法来增强表演，则可视情况进行@Check[arcana|dc:28]、@Check[nature|dc:28]、@Check[occultism|dc:28]或@Check[religion|dc:28]检定。对于那些想通过掌握何时、如何发射这场奇观来确保实际表演富有艺术性的角色而言，@Check[performance|dc:28]也是个很好的检定选择。

表演之后：当最后一枚烟火绽放后，聚集的镇民纷纷散去，各自回家，而任美璃再次走向玩家角色。和之前一样，她热切地称赞了玩家角色的努力，随后又从发间摘下一枚银簪。这一枚银簪上垂着两件掐丝饰物，以彩色丝线串连，其上带着苹果的香气。

“我恭喜你们呈现了一场精彩绝伦的表演，但我知道你们一定也急于知晓下一项任务。秋日甘果象征着司事者愿意为即将到来的冬季困苦收集并明智地储备资源。我知道——或许你们也知道——南边不远处有一片果园，那里生长着一种格外娇贵的苹果；但这里已经太久无人居住，我担心那片苹果林可能已经成了某种东西的巢穴……而那东西，对我这一类存在而言尤其令人不快。距离苹果时节还有几个月，不过如果你们现在就开始着手恢复这片果园，那么等到秋天，你们确实会收获甘美果实！而若那令人不快的因素还能受到惩治，那就再好不过了。还是一样，我给你们一周时间完成这项任务，祝你们好运！”

说完，任美璃便再次隐没于银色薄雾之中，没有进一步警告如今可能栖居在苹果林里的东西。

奖励：若玩家角色至少获得1点胜利点，则给予他们60 XP；若他们获得最高的4点胜利点，则给予80 XP。若他们让伊索里至少变为友善，额外再给予40 XP。

Event 2: Fiery Flower Fireworks

The next task given to the PCs involves putting on a fireworks display intended to celebrate the beauty of summer, but also one that is traditionally said to frighten away malicious ghosts and spirits. While the use of magic, particularly something like illusory scene, can produce a compelling fireworks display, Ren Mei Li wants this display to be the real thing, and that means gathering some rare plants to help make sure the fireworks burst in the exact precise shade of fiery orange that tradition demands.

This traditional ingredient is the fresh petals of Hei Feng’s horn, a rare, bright-orange wetlands flower. While this flower grows sporadically throughout the region’s wetlands, the largest swath with the best flowers grows in abundance in Moon Marsh, so named for the soft orange glow that these night-blooming flowers give under the radiance of moonlight. Unbeknownst to the PCs, in the intervening decades, a naga astrologer named Isori has taken up residence in this area.

Moon Marsh can be reached by traveling north from town, through the abandoned village and (likely recultivated) fields through which the seasonal Moon Creek flows south into the Duyue River. During the spring, this creek runs dry, but it remains a more reliable path to follow than the overgrown road. Moon Marsh lies about 6 miles north of the edge of the map, about 18 miles north of Willowshore.

Finding the Flowers: Once the PCs reach Moon Marsh, they can spend 8 hours of daylight searching for a serviceable patch of Hei Feng’s horn, or 1 hour after dark (since that’s when the plant blooms and softly glows). The flowers aren’t the only adornments in the area. Bronze and glass sundials, astrolabes, and various lenses and prisms hang from cords tied to overhanging tree branches, while strands of large, flat glass beads inscribed with geometric symbols and astronomical formulas adorn lengths of cord draped around the grove.

These adornments have been placed by a vicharamuni—an awakener naga—named Isori who has dwelt in this part of the marsh for decades. He has grown fond of admiring the heavens amid the grove of Hei Feng’s horns, decorating it with various astrological and astronomical trinkets he has gathered over his long life. Isori mostly keeps to himself and isn’t a naturally violent sort, but he’ll take swift offense at anyone who enters his observatory, rising up from the waters to quietly regard the PCs with his luminous, intelligent eyes.

If the PCs attack on sight, he hisses in anger and fights back, but isn’t particularly interested in continuing the battle for long. He uses an action each round to offer the PCs a truce before continuing to fight. He does his best to avoid killing any of the PCs, and even uses spells like breath of life to save any who fall in battle. If reduced to fewer than 75 HP, he decides it’s best to abandon the area and flees.

If the PCs don’t attack (or accept the offer of a truce) Isori greets them and introduces himself as the “guardian of this swamp” before he asks who they are and where they’re from. News of Willowshore’s return intrigues him—he has only ever known the site as a ruin where he gathered many of his favorite trinkets.

As a scholar of the heavens, Isori has recently been troubled by ominous portents captured by his astronomical and astrological instruments, and he wants to know whether the PCs have any idea what’s happening in the region. He’s also trying to figure out whether they might be responsible, either intentionally or unknowingly, for the “creeping chains” that he has seen reaching for the natural world like hungry vines.

What Isori has detected, as the PCs might surmise, is Kugaptee’s influence. The fiend’s touch has been encroaching upon the wetlands rapidly, and while Isori doesn’t understand the true extent of the threat, he has certainly noticed the warnings. If the PCs reveal the truth to him (or at the very least convince him they’re not the culprits), he asks them what’s to be done about it. This encounter is meant to underscore the stakes for the PCs, particularly any nature-oriented characters in the group, but if the PCs can make Isori friendly or helpful (his initial attitude is indifferent) with a successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:27|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] check to Make an Impression, he shares with them one of his hidden treasures to aid them in their fight.

Isori has no objection to letting the PCs gather petals of Hei Feng’s horn, provided they do so with respect for the environment, don’t damage the plants unnecessarily, and don’t take more than they need.

@UUID[Actor.SvKWVoIl2CPT1MJZ]{Isori} Creature 6

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.PYXubF4kQUtM1ZQO]{Isori's Gift} @UUID[Actor.xvM3MRczzVobDx6H]{Tree Hollow}
If the PCs make Isori friendly, he’ll offer them a single thousand-year dragonroot from a stash he keeps hidden in an unassuming tree hollow. If they make him helpful, he’ll offer them all three of the roots. Otherwise, the PCs can locate the three thousand-year dragonroots by succeeding at a @Check[perception|dc:30|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:search|name:Search] check after spending an hour Searching his observatory.

Harvesting the Flowers: One PC can attempt a secret @Check[crafting|dc:28|traits:secret], @Check[herbalism-lore|dc:28|traits:secret], @Check[nature|dc:28|traits:secret], or @Check[survival|dc:28|traits:secret] check to gather the petals, and the other PCs can Aid this check with DC 20 checks in one of the above skills. On a critical success, the harvested petals are particularly viable for use in fireworks, and the PCs get a +2 circumstance bonus to their checks later to craft fireworks and earn Victory Points, but on a failure, they take a –2 circumstance penalty to these checks (or a –4 circumstance penalty on a critical failure).

If the PCs have made Isori at least friendly, he provides his own advice on how to harvest the petals, reducing all DCs to harvest by 4.

Crafting the Fireworks: When the PCs return to Willowshore, the next step is to craft enough fireworks to put on a proper show. As with the previous event, you don’t need to have the players roleplay out the entire display once Ren Mei Li arrives. In order to determine how successful the display is, ask each player what their character does to make sure the fireworks function, then have them attempt a DC 28 skill check with an appropriate skill to earn Victory Points. @Check[crafting|dc:28] is the most obvious choice here for PCs who wish to build the fireworks, but those who seek to bolster the display with magic can roll an @Check[arcana|dc:28], @Check[nature|dc:28], @Check[occultism|dc:28], or @Check[religion|dc:28] check, as appropriate. @Check[performance|dc:28] is a good check to attempt for those who want to make sure that the actual display goes off artistically by knowing when and how to launch the spectacle.

After the Show: Once the last firework bursts, the gathered townsfolk disperse back to their homes, and Ren Mei Li once again approaches the PCs. As before, she eagerly compliments the PCs’ efforts before she again plucks a silver pin from her hair. This one is adorned with two cloisonne ornaments on strands of colored silk that carry the scent of apples.

“I congratulate you on a magnificent display, but I know you are eager to learn of your next task. The Sweet Fruits of Autumn symbolize the steward’s willingness to gather and wisely stockpile resources for the coming hardships of winter. I know, and perhaps you do as well, of a grove of particularly delicate apples that grow not far to the south, but no one has lived here for so long that I fear the grove may have become the home of something... particularly disagreeable to those of my persuasion. We are some months away from apple season, but if you begin the work of restoring this grove now, come autumn, you’ll be rewarded with sweet fruits indeed! And if this disagreeable element can be punished, all the better for it. Again, I give you a week to accomplish this task, and I wish you luck!”

Ren Mei Li then vanishes into the silver mist without further warning about what might now dwell in the apple grove.

Reward: Grant the PCs 60 XP if they earn at least 1 Victory Point, or 80 XP if they earn the maximum of 4 Victory Points. Grant them an additional 40 XP if they made Isori at least friendly.

Event 1. Bright Spring Bird.name: 事件 1：明春之鸟 Event 1. Bright Spring Bird
Event 1. Bright Spring Bird.text:
事件 1：明春之鸟

五季宝藏中的第一件是明春之鸟，正如任美璃所解释的那样，它应是一场戏剧表演，旨在唤起人们对于未来统治者治理之下的光明、喜悦与乐观。表演可以通过歌唱、舞蹈、演戏来呈现，也可以结合所有艺术形式共同创作。

这一首要仪式给了玩家角色一个机会，让他们反思自己在这场战役中的经历对他们意味着什么，这些经历如何影响了他们与柳岸镇的人民之间的关系，以及如今他们回到现实世界之后，这座城镇共同的希望与恐惧又停留在何处。若玩家角色陷入困境，镇上其他居民可以提供乐于助人的建议与物质支援；但如果玩家角色不需要他们帮忙，他们也很乐意配合玩家角色的艺术构想，不去碍事。

为演出做准备：明春之鸟的策划与演出，应当强化玩家角色为柳岸镇所取得的成功。这段冒险内容也是塑造个别非玩家角色的机会，可以让他们向玩家角色表达自己的感激、希望与忧虑。举例来说，如果玩家角色向村民询问他们从心景归来后的感受，或询问他们对玩家角色治理的期待，那么律师骆熙旸可能会忧心忡忡地说，如今络新妇已经施行了她们自己的法典，她精通龙华法律的专长恐怕已毫无用处。身为金属匠与发明家的霍天哲则会有些哭笑不得又略感恼火，因为他曾视作创新之物的发条装置，如今却被人看成讨喜却过时的古董玩意儿。金久元则会因许多旧日贸易伙伴已经离世而感到悲伤，但与此同时，他也为开始陆续流入商号的新样品而感到兴奋。

其他非玩家角色对于这场突如其来的时代跃迁也各有各的反应，而这一幕正是探索这些想法的机会，伴随着玩家角色逐步构思他们的演出。

上演节目：这场演出应当是一场盛大的庆典。镇上的每个人都兴奋地想要到场，一方面是为了看玩家角色将这场表演搬上舞台（本冒险假定演出地点是在这是七彩鸣鸾剧院——你可以利用这段时间让玩家角色在大野一真日后惨烈命运降临之前，先与这位剧院常驻导演互动片刻），另一方面也是为了见见这座城镇神秘的新赞助人任美璃。与之前一样，这位络新妇公主会在演出开始前数分钟伴随着一团银色薄雾现身，并且会小心翼翼地将自己的蜘蛛腿藏匿起来，不让人看见。

你不必让玩家把整场演出都角色扮演出来（虽然有些团可能会很享受这个机会）。为了判定演出有多成功，询问每位玩家他们的角色做了什么来确保演出成功，然后让他们以合适的技能尝试一次 DC 28 技能检定，以获取胜利点。对于想要表演、歌唱或为演出提供音乐的玩家角色来说，@Check[performance|dc:28] 是这里最显而易见的选择。那些希望负责布景与服装的人则可以尝试一次 @Check[crafting|dc:28]。那些试图用魔法特效来增强演出效果的人，则可以视情况掷一次 @Check[arcana|dc:28]、@Check[nature|dc:28]、@Check[occultism|dc:28] 或 @Check[religion|dc:28] 检定。@Check[acrobatics|dc:28] 与 @Check[athletics|dc:28] 可供希望以力量或敏捷为制作助一臂之力的玩家角色使用。对于想要在演出期间招待任美璃的角色而言，@Check[deception|dc:28]、@Check[diplomacy|dc:28] 与 @Check[intimidation|dc:28] 也都适用。

演出之后：那些不熟悉柳岸镇故事的新来者（例如罗阔恩，如果他幸存下来并已被社区接纳）会对玩家角色的成就表达钦佩。经历过那些事件并活下来的镇民，则会因在舞台上看到自己的亲身经历而震撼不已；不知为何，这让那些事件既显得更加真实，也更像传奇。你可以借此机会赞扬玩家角色那些令人惊叹的成就。

演出结束、其余观众也都散去之后，任美璃站起身来，最后一次带着赞许拍了拍手，随后走近玩家角色。不论演出结果是好是坏，她都会祝贺玩家角色，甚至连那些检定惨败的人，她似乎也总能找出一句称赞。她从发间取下一枚银簪，然后将簪子上穿着的那枚景泰蓝小球解下来——那小球描绘的是一只拖着多彩尾巴的鸟——并把它递给掷出最高结果的那位玩家角色。她将下一枚小球留在簪子上；那是一枚以深蓝珐琅为背景、描绘红色、金色与绿色光点重叠迸发的小球，显然象征着夜晚天空中的烟火。随后，她开口说道。

“夏日烈焰花将是你们的下一个任务。即便是在庆祝季节之时，一名称职的管事也不会让自己的职责遭到忽视。当然，他们也不会在受自己保护的人民之间引起不必要的恐惧。这些烟火以庆祝夏天之美的名义呈现给众人，同时也肩负着吓退恶意幽灵与精魂的作用。

“要达成这个目的，这些烟火必须用黑风之角的干燥花朵来制作。很遗憾，我手头没有这些花朵可供你们使用，但我毫不怀疑，你们一定能在北方的月沼某处找到更多，并且也不会难以采集到足够数量，好办一场精彩的表演。恐怕我还是得再说一次，时间相当重要。我们再给它一周时间，如何？很好；我很期待看看你们能做到什么！”

说完，络新妇再次化作一缕银色薄雾离去。

奖励：如果玩家角色至少获得 1 点胜利点，则给予他们 80 XP；如果他们获得最高的 4 点胜利点，则给予 120 XP。

Event 1: Bright Spring Bird

The first of the Five-Season Treasures is the Bright Spring Bird, which, as Ren Mei Li explained, is to be a theatrical performance intended to evoke brightness, joy, and optimism regarding the future governor’s rule. The performance can be sung, danced, acted, or created by combining all the arts.

This first rite provides a chance for the PCs to reflect on what their experiences in this campaign have meant to them, how it has affected their relationships with the people of Willowshore, and where it has left the town’s collective hopes and fears now that they’ve returned to the real world. The other townsfolk can provide helpful advice and material support if the PCs get stuck, but if the PCs don’t need their help, then they’re happy to assist the PCs’ artistic vision and not get in the way.

Preparing for the Show: The planning and performance of the Bright Spring Bird should reinforce the PCs’ successes on Willowshore’s behalf. This part of the adventure is also an opportunity to develop individual NPCs by having them express their gratitude, hopes, and worries to the PCs. For example, if the PCs ask the villagers for their experiences on returning from the mindscape, or what they hope for from the PCs’ governorship, then the lawyer Luo Xi Yang might worry aloud that her expertise in Lung Wa’s laws is useless now that the jorogumo have instituted their own legal codes. Huo Tian-Zhe, the metalsmith and inventor, is bemused and slightly annoyed that the clockwork gadgets he thought of as innovative are now viewed as charming, old-fashioned curios. Kim Gu-won is sad that many of his old trading partners have passed on but is also excited about the new samples that have begun to trickle into the trading house.

Other NPCs will have their own reactions to their abrupt lurch forward in time, and this section of the act is an opportunity to explore those thoughts as the PCs develop their performance.

Putting on the Show: The show should be a gala event. Everyone in town is excited to attend, both to see the PCs enact the show (which this adventure assumes takes place at the Seven-Colored Songbird theater—you can use this time to give the PCs a moment to interact with Kazuma Oono, the theater’s resident director, before his grisly fate later) and to see the town’s mysterious new patron, Ren Mei Li. As before, the jorogumo princess appears in a cloud of silver mist minutes before the show begins, and she takes pains to keep her spider legs hidden from view.

You don’t need to have the players roleplay out the entire show (although some groups might enjoy the opportunity). In order to determine how successful the show is, ask each player what their character does to make sure the show is a success, then have them attempt a DC 28 skill check with an appropriate skill to earn Victory Points. @Check[performance|dc:28] is the most obvious choice here, for PCs who wish to act, sing, or provide music for the show. Those who wish to instead work on the sets and costumes can attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:28]. Those who seek to bolster the show with magic special effects can roll an @Check[arcana|dc:28], @Check[nature|dc:28], @Check[occultism|dc:28], or @Check[religion|dc:28] check, as appropriate. @Check[acrobatics|dc:28] and @Check[athletics|dc:28] can be used by PCs who wish to lend their brawn or agility to the production. @Check[deception|dc:28], @Check[diplomacy|dc:28], and @Check[intimidation|dc:28] work for those who wish to play host or hostess to Ren Mei Li during the show.

After the Show: Newcomers who aren’t familiar with Willowshore’s story (such as Lo Kuon, if he survives and has been welcomed into the community) express admiration of the PCs’ achievements. Townsfolk who survived the events are awed by seeing their own experiences on stage, which somehow makes the events feel both more real and more legendary. You can use this chance to laud the PCs’ incredible achievements.

At the show’s conclusion and when the rest of the audience has dispersed, Ren Mei Li stands and claps her hands appreciatively one last time, then approaches the PCs. Regardless of how well or poorly the show went, she congratulates the PCs, somehow managing to find a compliment even for those who failed their checks miserably. She withdraws a silver pin from her hair, then unthreads the cloisonne ball depicting the bird with the many-colored tail attached to the pin, offering it to the PC who rolled the highest result. She keeps the next ball attached to the pin—a ball that shows overlapping bursts of red, gold, and green sparkles against a backdrop of deep blue enamel, presumably representing fireworks against the night sky—before she speaks.

“The Fiery Flowers of Summer are your next assignment. Even as one celebrates the season, a competent steward does not allow their duties to go neglected. Neither do they cause undue fear among the people being protected, however. These fireworks, presented to the people as a celebration of summer’s beauty, also serve to frighten away malicious ghosts and spirits.

“To fulfill this purpose, the fireworks must be made with dried blossoms of Hei Feng’s horn. Regrettably, I have no supplies of these blossoms to give you, but I have no doubt you will be able to find more somewhere in the Moon Marsh to the north, and will have no difficulty harvesting enough to put on a fine show. Once again, I’m afraid, time is rather important. Shall we give it another week? Good; I look forward to seeing what you can do!”

With that, the jorogumo once again departs in a waft of silver mist.
