Reward: Grant the PCs 80 XP if they earn at least 1 Victory Point, or 120 XP if they earn the maximum of 4 Victory Points.

Treasure and Murder.name: 宝藏与谋杀 Treasure and Murder
Treasure and Murder.text:
宝藏与谋杀

五季宝藏是领导者有能力且愿意统治并保护其人民、安然应对一年中所有变化无常的情势与挑战的象征。最初，与这些象征相关的五项仪式体现的是人们对生活中种种喜乐的感恩，而这种性相至今仍有所保留。尽管这些仪式的特殊变体主要是为了让任美璃考验玩家角色的能力，它们也应当成为一个机会，让玩家角色加深与柳岸镇非玩家角色之间的关系，并享受他们至今为止所取得的成就。

这五项仪式中的每一项都让玩家角色有机会获得胜利点，每项仪式最多可获得4点胜利点。最终任务完成后，他们累计获得的胜利点总数将影响任美璃最终提出的条件以及提供的奖励。

当玩家角色寻找五季宝藏时，另一连串更加阴险可怖的事件也在发生。赫山宝如今已彻底变成一个可怕的妖骸（一种脑生子），来到柳岸镇大开杀戒并传播恐惧。这些谋杀案发生时，玩家角色都不在镇上，但他们可以在寻找五季宝藏的间隙获得机会，调查犯罪现场与尸体。

什么是妖骸？

玩家角色最终会得知，一种在都市传说中被称为妖骸的生物可能已经在柳岸镇活动。若一名玩家角色在@Check[occultism|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]、@Check[society|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或@Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]检定中成功，以回忆知识，或在@Check[diplomacy|dc:20|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information]检定中成功，以打探消息，就会了解以下关于妖骸的信息之一。若大成功，玩家角色会学到其中两条不同的信息。

  • 妖骸以偏远乡村小镇为猎物，最初人们认为它们是遭忽视祖先之幽灵的显现，但如今，它们已成为神门乡村聚居地中一种更普遍的“床底妖怪”形象，尽管仍然较为鲜为人知。
  • 妖骸可以呈现任何形状，但你可以凭它们鼓胀的黄色眼睛、歪斜多毛的脖子，以及又长又脏的指甲辨认出来。它们的武器致死与其说依靠身体伤害，不如说是依靠它们所施加的精神痛苦。
  • 妖骸惧怕长笛乐声，乐声能够伤害它们，甚至将其驱离；若由祭司或拥有强大信仰之人演奏，效果尤其显著。
  • 妖骸死亡时，它的身体会在几分钟内消散。除非以某种能确保社群相信它们已永远消失的方式将其杀死，否则它们还会归来。
  • 学者认为，妖骸的显现源自某个人的思想，甚至可能源自整个社群的恐惧——在其他文化中，它们还有别的名字，比如“脑生子”。

奖励：一旦玩家角色得知有妖骸牵涉其中，就给予他们80 XP。

Treasure and Murder

The Five-Season Treasures are symbols of a leader’s ability and willingness to rule and protect their people across all the changing moods and challenges of the year. Originally, the five rites associated with these symbols reflected a people’s gratitude for the joys of their lives, and some of that aspect remains. Although these specific variants on the rites primarily test the PCs’ competence for Ren Mei Li’s benefit, they should also serve as an opportunity to deepen their relationships with the NPCs of Willowshore and enjoy their achievements up to this point.

Each of these five rites gives the PCs a chance to achieve Victory Points, up to a maximum of 4 Victory Points per rite. Once the final task is done, the total number of Victory Points they’ve accumulated impacts Ren Mei Li’s final offer and rewards offered.

As the PCs search for the Five-Season Treasures, another, far more sinister set of events takes place. Heh Shan-Bao, now fully transformed into a horrific yohoi (a type of brainchild), visits Willowshore to murder and spread terror. These murders take place while the PCs are out of town, but they’ll have opportunities to investigate the crime scenes and bodies in between seeking out the Five-Season Treasures.

What’s a Yohoi?

The PCs eventually learn that a creature from urban legend known as a yohoi might have become active in Willowshore. A PC who succeeds at a @Check[occultism|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge], @Check[society|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge], or @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:20|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge, or a @Check[diplomacy|dc:20|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] check to Gather Information, learns one of the following pieces of information about yohoi. On a critical success, the PCs learn two different bullet points of information.

  • Yohoi prey upon small rural towns and were initially believed to be manifestations of the ghosts of neglected ancestors, but today, they’ve become something of a generalized (if obscure) form of the “boogeyman” for Shenmen’s rural settlements.
  • Yohoi can be any shape, but you can recognize them by their bulging yellow eyes, crooked hairy necks, and long filthy fingernails. Their weapons can kill not so much by physical damage but by the mental anguish they inflict.
  • Yohoi fear flute music and can be harmed or even driven away by it, particularly when played by a priest or someone with powerful faith.
  • When a yohoi dies, its body fades away within minutes. Unless slain in a way that ensures society believes they’re gone forever, they can return.
  • Scholars believe that yohoi manifest as the result of a person’s thoughts, or even of an entire community’s fears—in other cultures, they’re known by other names, such as “brainchildren.”

Reward: Once the PCs learn a yohoi is involved, grant them 80 XP.

The Princess’s Requests.name: 公主的请求 The Princess’s Requests
The Princess’s Requests.text:
公主的请求

“是时候谈谈五季宝藏了。依照传统，新任管事者必须完成一场仪式，以证明他们的忠诚、勇气，以及担任使者的能力。这样的人必须了解自己的子民，并关心他们的福祉，你们同意吧？我们都太清楚忽视这些考量会导致什么后果了。

“至于你们，我认为，一场纪念你们历经艰辛才得以坐在这里与我相见的仪式就很合适，而我想不出还有什么比寻找五季宝藏更好的仪式了。其中四件宝藏象征生命的四季，寓意一位合格的统治者会终年恪守他们的誓约：明春之鸟、夏日烈焰花、秋日甘果，以及冬日香料茶。待它们齐备之后，还必须将生者的赠礼献给受尊崇的亡者，以求得祖先与守护者的赐福——这便是第五个季节，一个超越凡俗生命的季节。若祖先接受，并赐下他们的祝福，那么你们所需要做的，就只是向我宣誓效忠，而管事之位便归你们所有。”

精明的PC可能会注意到，任美璃要求他们向她本人宣誓效忠，而不是向琅蕾夫人或络新妇宫廷效忠。如果他们指出这一点，任美璃只是再次微笑，耸了耸肩：“哦，我是这么说的吗？”

如果PC询问这场仪式具体包括什么，任美璃会告诉他们以下内容：

“我们会依次处理每一项，不过首先，你们必须献给我一只明春之鸟。”

任美璃从发间取下一对银簪，刺入她面前的垫子里。她碰了碰第一枚簪子上垂下的两个景泰蓝小球中的一个，那上面描绘着一只白色的鸟，拖着一条由多彩羽毛组成的、长长卷曲的尾巴，随后再次开口。

“明春之鸟象征着喜悦与新生，冲破冬日的阴郁。若一位管事者足够优秀，那么他们的统治就代表着村庄好运的复苏。你们要进行一场符合自己才能的表演——音乐、舞蹈、戏剧皆可——来庆祝你们为柳岸镇带来最大益处的一件事。就你们而言，我想那应该是把你们的人民从思维空间中解救出来，不是吗？无论你们选择什么形式，这场演出都应包含色彩斑斓的服装、鲜明生动的背景、特殊效果，以及富有戏剧性的音乐。

“请在一周内准备好你们的表演。我会回来观看的。我很期待你们的演出。”

说完这些，任美璃站起身来，行了一礼，沿着来时的方式离去——在一阵银色雾气的旋动中消失无踪。若PC试图了解更多关于任美璃的信息，甚至在战斗中与她对峙，那么关于任美璃的更多资料（包括她如何借由那团雾气如此轻松地来去）见于她的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21renmeili000000]{非玩家角色条目}。

奖励：如果PC同意与任美璃合作，并开始着手完成她的请求，则给予PC 60 XP。

The Princess’s Requests

“It is time to discuss the Five-Season Treasures. Tradition demands that new stewards complete a ritual to prove their loyalty, courage, and capacity to serve as ambassadors. Such people must be acquainted with their citizens and concerned with their welfare, don’t you agree? We all know too well what happens when those considerations are ignored.

“For you, I think a ritual honoring the struggles you’ve endured to sit here with me shall do, and no better ritual than seeking the Five-Season Treasures comes to mind. Four of these treasures symbolize the four seasons of life, to symbolize that a worthy ruler keeps their pact year round: the bright bird of spring, the fiery flowers of summer, the sweet fruits of autumn, and the spiced tea of winter. Once gathered, the gifts of the living must then be offered to the honored dead, to gain the blessing of ancestors and guardians—this is the fifth season, a season beyond mortal life. If the ancestors accept, and grant their blessing, then all you need do is swear fealty to me, and the stewardship is yours.”

Canny PCs might note that Ren Mei Li asks for fealty to herself, rather than to Lady Lang Loi or the jorogumo court. If they point this out, Ren Mei Li merely smiles again and shrugs: “Oh, was that what I said?”

If the PCs ask what, specifically, the ritual entails, Ren Mei Li tells them the following:

“We shall address them all in turn, but to begin with, you must offer me a bright spring bird.”

Ren Mei Li draws a pair of silver pins from her hair and stabs them into the mat before her. She touches one of the two cloisonne balls dangling from the first pin, which depicts a white bird with a long, curling tail of many-colored feathers, then speaks again.

“The bright bird of spring is a symbol of joy and renewal breaking through winter’s drear. If a steward is good, then their rule represents a revival of good fortune for the village. You will put on a performance of whatever type suits your talents—music, dance, drama—to celebrate the greatest thing you have done to benefit Willowshore. In your case, I should imagine that would be freeing your people from the mindscape, no? Whatever you choose, the show should involve multicolored costumes, vivid backdrops, special effects, and dramatic music.

“Please have your performance ready within the week. I shall return to watch it. I quite look forward to your show.”

Without further ado, Ren Mei Li stands, bows, and leaves the same way she came—vanishing in a swirl of silver mist. Should the PCs seek to learn more about Ren Mei Li or even confront her in combat, additional information about Ren Mei Li (including how she comes and goes so effortlessly via that cloud of mist) appears in her @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21renmeili000000]{NPC Entry}.

Reward: Grant the PCs 60 XP if they agree to work with Ren Mei Li and begin to pursue her requests.

Meeting the Princess.name: 会见公主 Meeting the Princess
Meeting the Princess.text:
会见公主

在约定的时刻，一片闪烁的银色薄雾充满了青天茶馆（或者PC告诉阿迈要在那里接待她主人的任何地点）。一名银发女子从中迈步而出，她美得惊人，身穿最上等的淡蓝与海绿色丝绸。几支缀有珠宝蜘蛛的银簪将她的头发绾起。她带着毫不掩饰的兴趣环顾茶馆，审视其中的陈设与装饰，随后转向PC。她的声音轻柔，笑容宁静。她外观上唯一可能令人不安之处，是她双眼上覆盖的银色光泽，以及她发间那些蜘蛛的活动——那是活生生的生物，终究不是什么宝石制成的装饰。

任美璃独自前来，这既显示出她的从容自信，也确保若有必要，她与PC私下交谈的话语不会被可能回报朝廷的旁人偷听。她也没有伸展出自己的蜘蛛腿，试图以更像人类的模样出现，好让自己对PC不那么具有威慑感。她朝众人微笑，等他们先做自我介绍，然后开口说道。

“很高兴见到你们。我是任美璃。我不会久占你们履行职责的时间，因为我明白柳岸镇正需要你们的关注。我希望你们不会觉得我的直率太过失礼。

“长话短说，我想向你们提出结盟。我知道司泽已经贪婪地盯上了柳岸镇的资源，也想把贪婪之手伸向这里。我可以阻止此事。只要柳岸镇的管理者是我能够信任的人，我甚至愿意给予柳岸镇相当程度的自治。

“你们觉得，你们当中是否有一些人，或者全部人，愿意担任我的管理者呢？”

如果PC对管理者这一职位（某种与镇上实际总督分开的、驻络新妇一方的大使）表现出兴趣，哪怕只是试探性的，任美璃都会显得既高兴又觉得有趣，随后将敲定这项协议的细节暂且搁置，转而请他们饮茶用餐。在这段间歇中，她会询问PC关于他们自己的事——她尤其想知道他们来自哪里，以及他们是如何让柳岸镇从废墟中恢复过来的。假如PC说的是实话，或者至少部分属实，她都会完全相信，因为他们的解释与她的理论完全吻合。若她得知有一个她自己的版本曾在心景中拜访过PC，她会被勾起兴趣，并要求得知她当时行为举止的准确细节，对这场意料之外的相遇深感着迷。

任美璃对PC的初始态度为冷淡。如果PC佩戴或公开展示他们可能在那场遭遇中获得的银项圈，任美璃会明显流露出欣赏这一展示的神情。这会使她的起始态度从冷淡变为友善。在这场初步的用餐与交谈期间，允许PC尝试 @Check[diplomacy|dc:28]、@Check[performance|dc:28]、@Check[society|dc:28] 或 @Check[tea-lore|dc:28] 检定，或者进行 @Check[arcana|dc:23] 检定来打动她。成功意味着PC会累积胜利点；若PC以这种方式获得至少3点胜利点，她的态度会提升为友善（若她已经是友善，则提升为乐于助人）。

随着交谈继续，任美璃会就心景现象、他们与苦迦菩提的冲突，以及PC如何处理这一切，提出见多识广且一针见血的问题。如果PC描述了他们使用过的任何巧妙战术，或是他们对心景运作方式所做出的任何不同寻常的发现，她会明显受到打动。

如果PC说明了他们为帮助柳岸镇所做的具体事情，以及他们改善柳岸镇未来前景的计划，任美璃也会专心倾听。若PC讲述了他们为协助这座城镇而取得的重要成就（无论是在先前的冒险中，还是他们最近修桥与对抗匪徒的努力），任美璃都会向他们表示祝贺。如果他们询问她是否能帮助他们未来有关柳岸镇的计划，她会谨慎地不作出任何具体承诺，但会表示她会认真对待他们的建议。她并不反对将柳岸镇指定为银印村庄，“不过，当然了，那得取决于是否有一位值得信赖的管理者。”

最终，只要PC愿意接受她的提议，这位络新妇便会解释接下来将会发生什么。

Meeting the Princess

At the appointed hour, a shimmering silver mist fills the Cerulean Teahouse (or whatever location the PCs told Amai they’d be receiving her mistress at). From it steps a silver-haired woman of extraordinary beauty, clad in pale blue and sea green silk of the finest quality. Silver sticks, ornamented with jeweled spiders, bind up her hair. She looks around the teahouse with open interest, examining its furnishings and decor before turning to the PCs. Her voice is gentle and her smile serene. The only aspects of her appearance that might be unsettling are the silver sheen over her eyes and the movements of the spiders in her hair, which are living creatures and not, after all, decorations made of gemstones.

Ren Mei Li arrives alone, a display of her assurance but also so that, if needed, words spoken with the PCs in confidence won’t be overheard by others who might report back to the court. She also appears without her spider legs extended, looking human in an attempt to be less intimidating to the PCs. She smiles at the party, waits for them to introduce themselves, then speaks.

“How nice to meet you. I am Ren Mei Li. I will not draw you away from your duties for long, as I understand Willowshore demands your attention. I hope you will not find my directness too rude.

“In short, I wish to offer you an alliance. I understand that Sze has cast its greedy eyes upon Willowshore’s resources and wishes to cast its greedy hands upon it as well. I can prevent this. I am even willing to offer Willowshore a considerable degree of autonomy, provided its stewards are people I can trust.

“Do you suppose that some, or all, of you might serve as my stewards?”

If the PCs express interest in the position of steward (a sort of ambassador to the jorogumo apart from the town’s actual governor), however tentatively, Ren Mei Li seems both pleased and amused, then waves aside the particulars of settling on this accord in deference to tea and a meal. During this interlude, she asks the PCs about themselves—in particular, she’s interested to find out where they’re from and how they’ve managed to bring Willowshore back from ruins. Assuming the PCs tell the truth, or at least parts of it, she believes them entirely, as their explanation perfectly matches her theories. If she learns that a version of herself visited the PCs in the mindscape, she is intrigued and demands exact details of how she behaved, fascinated by this unexpected encounter.

Ren Mei Li’s initial attitude toward the PCs is indifferent. If the PCs wear or openly display the silver collars they might have gained during that encounter, Ren Mei Li makes an obvious visual note of appreciation at the display. This shifts her starting attitude from indifferent to friendly. During this preliminary meal and conversation, allow the PCs to attempt @Check[diplomacy|dc:28], @Check[performance|dc:28], @Check[society|dc:28], or @Check[tea-lore|dc:28] checks, or @Check[arcana|dc:23] checks to impress her. Successes mean the PCs accumulate Victory Points; if the PCs earn at least 3 Victory Points in this way, they improve her attitude to friendly (or if she’s already friendly, to helpful).

As the conversation continues, Ren Mei Li asks knowledgeable and incisive questions about the mindscape phenomenon, their clashes with Kugaptee, and how the PCs dealt with it all. If the PCs describe any inventive tactics they used, or unusual discoveries they made about the mindscape’s workings, she’s visibly impressed.

Ren Mei Li also listens attentively if the PCs explain concrete things they’ve done to help Willowshore and plans they have to improve its future prospects. If the PCs recount their significant achievements to aid the town (be it in previous adventures or their recent efforts to build bridges and fight bandits), Ren Mei Li congratulates them. If they ask whether she can help with their future plans for Willowshore, she’s careful not to promise anything specific but indicates that she’ll take their suggestions seriously. She isn’t opposed to designating Willowshore as a Silver Seal village, “but, of course, that would depend on having a trustworthy steward.”

Eventually, and assuming the PCs are receptive to her offer, the jorogumo explains what comes next.

Preparing for the Visit.name: 为来访做准备 Preparing for the Visit
Preparing for the Visit.text:
为来访做准备

在上一幕中，玩家角色只有 8 小时来为任美璃的来访做准备。这一次，他们有整整一周时间，而且玩家角色并不知道，任美璃已用一百年的时间来完善她的统治，并抑制自己更为专横与急躁的性格特质。在青天茶馆接待她依然是最佳选择，但玩家角色不必再那么担心要藏好天狗和桃木，也不必害怕她会决定把柳岸镇的居民带回去当作俘虏或食物。当然，玩家角色多半要等到她真正到来时，才会意识到这一点！

由于玩家角色有一周时间准备，你只需让他们描述自己希望如何为这场会面做安排即可。没有必要为是否成功尝试任何技能检定。若他们准备得恭敬周到，任美璃会很高兴；但如果他们没有这样做，或者明显失礼，那也只不过符合她的预期，她仍会继续这次来访，不会因此动怒。

与此同时，玩家角色或许会四处打听更多关于任美璃的消息。柳岸镇里没人对现代神门有足够了解，无法提供什么建议；不过，若他们花上几个小时在唐入四处询问，或者去问问那些丝蜂强盗中是否有人活了下来并愿意和玩家角色交谈，便有机会通过一次 @Check[diplomacy|dc:25|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] 打探消息检定来了解更多。

大成功 如同成功，但该玩家角色还会得知，任美璃被认为在奥秘技艺方面格外娴熟，而且她很可能会对任何表现出对奥秘感兴趣或具备深厚奥秘知识的人产生好感。

成功 该玩家角色发现，任美璃被视为络新妇中“较不那么可怕”的一位——依然令人畏惧，但比起其他同类要容易共事得多。因此，当地人很快便会积极讨好她，好让她继续留在这里，因为他们十分清楚，若换成下一位接替她的络新妇，十有八九会残酷得多。尤其值得强调的是，她愿意接纳天狗，而且极少要求以人作为贡品。若玩家角色有银项圈，也会被告知在她面前要佩戴上。

大失败 该玩家角色打探到的消息似乎表明，任美璃仍和上一幕中她“造访”柳岸镇心景时一样专横、傲慢，甚至可能比当时更加暴力。

奖励： 如果玩家角色在打听任美璃更多消息时至少取得一次成功，则给予他们 40 XP。

Preparing for the Visit

In the previous act, the PCs had only 8 hours to prepare for Ren Mei Li’s visit. This time, they have an entire week, and unknown to the PCs, Ren Mei Li has had a hundred years to perfect her rule and to curb her more imperious and impatient personality traits. Receiving her at the Cerulean Teahouse remains the best option, but the PCs don’t need to worry as much about hiding tengu and peachwood or being fearful that she might decide to take citizens of Willowshore back home with her as captives or meals. Of course, the PCs likely won’t realize this until her arrival!

Since the PCs have a week to prepare, simply have them describe to you what they wish to do to set up for the meeting. There’s no need to attempt any skill checks for success. If they prepare respectfully, Ren Mei Li is delighted, but if they don’t or if they’re actively disrespectful, that just plays into her expectations, and she proceeds with the visit without being ruffled.

In the meantime, the PCs might ask around for more information about Ren Mei Li. No one in Willowshore has enough experience with modern Shenmen to offer any advice, but a few hours spent asking around at Karahai, or even asking one of the Silkwasp Bandits if any of them survived and are willing to speak to the PCs, allows the PCs to potentially learn more with a @Check[diplomacy|dc:25|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] check to Gather Information.

Critical Success As success, but the PC also learns that Ren Mei Li is considered to be exceptionally adept in the arcane arts and will likely react well to anyone who displays an interest or deep knowledge in arcana.

Success The PC discovers that Ren Mei Li is regarded as one of the “less harrowing” of the jorogumo—still frightening, but much easier to work with than others. As such, the locals are quick and eager to please her in order to keep her around, knowing full well that the next jorogumo who would replace her would likely be much more cruel. In particular, her willing acceptance of tengu and the fact that she only very rarely demands tribute in the form of people is stressed. The PCs are also told to wear their silver collars in her presence if they have them.

Critical Failure The information the PC learns seems to support that Ren Mei Li remains as imperious, arrogant, and potentially more violent than she was during her “visit” to the Willowshore mindscape in the previous act.

Reward: Grant the PCs 40 XP if they achieve at least a success in asking around for more information about Ren Mei Li.

A Feline Emissary.name: 猫科使者 A Feline Emissary
A Feline Emissary.text:
猫科使者 Trivial 11

任美璃派出一名使者，提醒PC她即将抵达，但和上一幕不同的是，她已经明白了耐心的价值。她提前一周派出使者，这应当能给柳岸镇充足的准备时间。

生物：任美璃的使者是一只名叫阿迈的玄法猫，她（和同类中的大多数不同）是这位络新妇忠诚而可靠的伙伴。她对待在第一世界没什么兴趣，反而相当享受因为与神门某位贵族有关联而获得的恭敬与仰慕。当她被派来宣布女主人即将造访柳岸镇时，阿迈会花上一些时间躲起来观察镇民，以及越来越频繁地观察PC。当这场遭遇开始时，允许PC尝试进行@Check[perception|dc:27]检定。成功者会注意到那只奇异的紫色猫正躲在附近某处窥视他们——矮丛环境、昏暗的小巷、穿过一扇敞开的门望进黑暗的房间，诸如此类。由你酌情决定，如果PC仍和青天茶馆的化猫“吉祥物”亚弥保持友好关系，那么她可以先遇见阿迈。她会和这只玄法猫成为朋友，并把这位新朋友介绍给PC——两只猫对彼此名字如此相似这件事感到格外有趣。

无论阿迈是被发现并从藏身处叫出来，还是她用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{传送}直接现身在PC面前，这只玄法猫都会尽力表现出自己不是来战斗的——哪怕她最初的登场把PC吓了一跳。她蓝宝石般的皮毛上点缀着紫罗兰色的螺旋纹，而她佩戴的那条银与蛛丝织成的项圈，也远比络新妇通常发给盟友和代理人的那些精致得多。

阿迈对任美璃相当忠诚，尤其以玄法猫的标准来说更是如此。一个本该反复无常的存在竟然如此依恋自己的女主人，这本身就应当成为PC的第一个线索：这位络新妇既异常强大，也有能力赢得意想不到的盟友的忠诚。阿迈并非被魔法强迫服侍，任何这样的暗示都会令她感到受辱；在她看来，任美璃是个迷人的人物，能够用她理应享有的一切奢华来宠爱这只玄法猫，因此是值得作伴的人。阿迈会很自在地谈论任美璃的闲话，不过她说的几乎全是好话，除了偶尔抱怨几件没有分给她的闪亮小饰物，或是不让她把玩的有趣魔法。

阿迈说话时，声音优雅而女性化；她初次见到PC时，会这样向他们问候。

“向你们致意，柳岸镇。我是阿迈。我有幸侍奉任美璃女士，银丝公主，银丝卡西的辉耀之女。我的女主人对你们很好奇，希望与你们结识。七天后，你们愿意与她共饮一杯茶吗？”

阿迈愿意回答几个问题，而PC每问她一个问题，她也会反过来问一个自己的问题，通常是关于PC的穿着或习惯（“你头发上的那个是什么？”或者“你祈祷时为什么要拿着那个小玩意儿？”之类天真直白的问题）。阿迈和PC交谈大约5分钟后，便会离开。

任美璃女士是谁？“她当然是这片土地的统治者之一！哎呀，哎呀！你们可真是太不晓事了！她是一位络新妇，而且她光彩夺目！”（如果PC表示他们已经见过她，阿迈会短暂地显得震惊又困惑，然后若有所思地说：“我敢肯定，这会是女主人很想听到的事！”接着转到下一个问题。）

任美璃为什么想见我们？“她对你们很好奇。另外，这座城镇需要一位正式的总管。也许你们其中一人，或者你们所有人，都很合适。”

我们能得到什么？“难道你们不想继续住在这里吗？我的女主人能在很多方面帮助你们。哪怕只是带回一次令人满意的拜访结果，以避免惩罚也好。”

我们能相信络新妇吗？猫咪听到这种无礼的问题，笑了起来。“你们会相信我的回答吗？直接和她谈谈吧。然后再做决定。”

无论PC是否愿意接受阿迈带来的消息，他们其实都没有真正拒绝这次来访的选项；等这只玄法猫感到无聊并离开后，他们就有7天时间做准备。如果PC发动攻击，她会逃走。在这种情况下，任美璃女士会更少把PC视为潜在盟友，而更多把他们当作必须靠劳作偿还债务、以免被处决的罪犯。本冒险默认PC不会选择这条路，但如果他们真的这么做了，你应当相应调整后续遭遇的整体基调。

@UUID[Actor.RMUc5gzn3KdD6Y6H]{阿迈}生物 7

奖励：若PC愿意花时间与阿迈交谈，给予他们40 XP。

A Feline Emissary Trivial 11

Ren Mei Li sends an emissary to alert the PCs of her imminent arrival, but unlike in the previous act, she has learned the value of patience. She sends her emissary a week ahead of time, which should give Willowshore more than enough time to prepare.

Creatures: Ren Mei Li’s emissary is a dweomercat named Amai, who (unlike most of her kind) is a faithful and loyal companion to the jorogumo. She has little interest in spending time in the First World and quite enjoys the deference and admiration afforded her by dint of her association with one of Shenmen’s aristocrats. When she’s assigned the task of announcing her mistress’s imminent visit to Willowshore, Amai spends some time watching the townsfolk and, increasingly, the PCs from hiding. When this encounter begins, allow the PCs to attempt @Check[perception|dc:27] checks. Those who succeed notice the strange purple cat peering at them from somewhere nearby in hiding—the undergrowth, a shadowy alley, through an open door into a dark room, and so on. At your discretion, if the PCs remain friends with the Cerulean Teahouse’s bakeneko “mascot” Yami, then she can meet Amai first. She befriends the dweomercat and introduces her new friend to the PCs—the two cats are unusually amused at how similar their names are.

Whether Amai is spotted and confronted from her hiding spot, or whether she openly approaches the PCs by using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} to pop into their presence, the dweomercat does her best to make it apparent she isn’t here to fight—even if her initial appearance startles the PCs. Her sapphire fur is highlighted by violet spirals, and the silver and spidersilk collar she wears is much more elegant than those normally handed out by the jorogumo to their allies and agents.

Amai is quite faithful to Ren Mei Li, especially for a dweomercat, and the fact that an ordinarily fickle being is so attached to her mistress should be the PCs’ first clue that this jorogumo is both unusually powerful and able to earn loyalty from unexpected allies. Amai isn’t magically compelled to serve and is insulted by any such suggestion; she views Ren Mei Li as a fascinating individual who can pamper the dweomercat with all the luxuries she so richly deserves and, therefore, as company worth keeping. Amai gossips freely about Ren Mei Li but has only good things to say other than minor criticisms about shiny baubles the cat wasn’t given or interesting magic the cat wasn’t allowed to play with.

When Amai speaks, she does so in a cultured, feminine voice, and when she first meets the PCs, she greets them as follows.

“Greetings, Willowshore. I am Amai. I have the honor of serving Lady Ren Mei Li, the Silversilk Princess, Resplendent Daughter of Yin-Sichasi. My mistress is curious about you, and wishes to make your acquaintance. Will you meet with her for tea in seven days’ time?”

Amai is willing to answer a few questions, and after each question the PCs ask her, she asks a question of her own, generally directed at aspects of the PCs’ dress or habits (“What’s that thing in your hair?” or “Why do you hold that bauble when you pray?” and similarly guileless, blunt questions). Once Amai has talked to the PCs for 5 minutes or so, she leaves.

Who’s Lady Ren Mei Li? “She’s one of this land’s rulers, of course! My, my! You have been out of it! She’s a jorogumo, and she’s glorious!” (If the PCs indicate they’ve met her already, Amai seems shocked and confused for a moment, then muses, “I’m sure that’ll be something my mistress will be interested to hear about!” before moving on to the next question.)

Why does Ren Mei Li want to meet us? “She’s curious about you. Also, this town needs an official steward. Perhaps one or all of you will suit.”

What will we get out of it? “Do you not wish to continue living here? My mistress can help you in so many ways. Even if only reporting back a favorable visit to prevent punishment.”

Can we trust a jorogumo? The cat laughs at being asked such an impertinent question. “Would you trust my answer? Speak to her directly. Then decide.”

Whether or not the PCs are receptive to Amai’s message, there isn’t really an option for the PCs to deny the visit; they have 7 days to prepare once the dweomercat grows bored and departs. If the PCs attack, she flees. In this case, Lady Ren Mei Li treats the PCs less as potential allies and more as criminals who must work off a debt to avoid execution. This adventure assumes the PCs don’t take this route, but if they do, you should adjust the tenor of the encounters to come appropriately.

@UUID[Actor.RMUc5gzn3KdD6Y6H]{Amai}Creature 7

Reward: Grant the PCs 40 XP for taking the time to speak with Amai.

Ren Mei Li’s Return.name: 任美璃的归来 Ren Mei Li’s Return
Ren Mei Li’s Return.text:
任美璃的归来

任美璃此次初访柳岸镇，部分是为了欢迎这座久已失落的城镇重返“网下”（这是对处于络新妇统治之下的非蛛形生物的一种委婉说法），但她的首要目的其实是出于好奇：她想弄清柳岸镇究竟是如何、又为何能从毁灭中归来。她的关注很快转向PC们；为了测试他们可能具备的价值，任美璃给PC们布置了一系列任务，用以评估他们的技能，也借此判断他们对柳岸镇的忠诚程度，因为这些牵绊日后都可能成为她施加影响的筹码。若PC们成功完成，任美璃会对他们刮目相看，并提出让他们担任柳岸镇的管理者，以他们宣誓效忠作为交换。

让PC们出任管理者，能替任美璃解决两个问题——这能让柳岸镇拥有一批可靠的领导者，帮助保卫城镇并促进其发展（从而让她不必亲自处理这些工作），同时也给了她一个机会，暗中将PC们的忠诚据为己有，而不是让他们效忠于络新妇宫廷和琅蕾夫人。

一旦PC们证明了自己，任美璃就会开出异常优厚的条件来争取他们的帮助。尽管PC们或许会对与一名络新妇达成交易心存顾虑，但应当让他们清楚，这是确保柳岸镇在神门获得安全与繁荣的最佳选择。此外，由于任美璃更在意推进自己的野心，而非琅蕾夫人的利益，她愿意接受一种表面效忠、实则只承诺维护她个人利益的约定；她甚至可能放任PC们在暗中对抗络新妇在神门的整体统治。

PC们也应当有充分理由接受总督之位，因为只有取得络新妇宫廷的正式授权——其象征是一件名为獠牙与钥匙的礼仪物品——他们才能最终击败@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}，并阻止苦迦菩提转世。

獠牙与钥匙是本章中的关键要素。若干剧情发展都依赖PC们持有它。虽然没有獠牙与钥匙，他们仍能完成本章，但若未能获得它，PC们将错过这场冒险中的大量重要内容。因此，务必要不要把任美璃塑造成敌人，而应将她呈现为PC们可以合作的人——即便她未必会是他们首选的盟友。

Ren Mei Li’s Return

Ren Mei Li’s initial visit to Willowshore is in part to welcome the long-lost town back “below the web” (a euphemism for non-arachnid creatures who find themselves under jorogumo rule), but her primary goal is one of curiosity: she wants to find out how and why Willowshore returned from ruin. Her focus soon shifts to the PCs, and as a test of their possible value, Ren Mei Li sets the PCs a series of missions that will evaluate their skills and also assess the extent of their loyalty to Willowshore, since she can potentially use those ties as leverage. If the PCs succeed, Ren Mei Li is impressed and offers them stewardship of Willowshore in exchange for a promise of fealty.

Installing the PCs as stewards solves two problems for Ren Mei Li—it gives Willowshore a reliable set of leaders to help defend the town and cultivate its growth (thus freeing her up from having to handle that work directly), and it provides her a chance to secretly secure the PCs’ loyalties for herself rather than on behalf of the jorogumo court and Lady Lang Loi.

Once the PCs have proven themselves, Ren Mei Li offers unusually generous terms to secure their help. While the PCs might have qualms about striking a bargain with a jorogumo, it should be clear that this is their best option to assure Willowshore’s safety and prosperity in Shenmen. Further, because Ren Mei Li is more interested in advancing her own ambitions than Lady Lang Loi’s, she’s willing to accept an offer that secretly only promises to uphold her interests, and she might leave the PCs free to potentially work against the overall rule of the jorogumo in Shenmen.

The PCs should also have a significant incentive to accept the governorship because it’s only by obtaining the jorogumo court’s official mandate, as symbolized by a ceremonial item called the Fang and Key, that they can finally defeat @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao} and prevent Kugaptee’s reincarnation.

The Fang and Key is a critical element in this chapter. Several plot elements rely on the PCs having it. While they can complete this chapter without the Fang and Key, the PCs will miss significant portions of the adventure if they don’t obtain it. Therefore, it’s important that Ren Mei Li not be presented as an enemy, but as someone the PCs can work with—even if she might not be their first choice of allies.

The Princess’s Web.name: 公主之网 The Princess’s Web
The Princess’s Web.text:
第12章： 公主之网

络新妇是神门残酷而反复无常的统治者。这个国家的人民畏惧她们，因为她们对待治下臣民的方式充满了恐怖与压迫。对许多人来说，最好的结果不过是被遗忘，被任其自生自灭，得不到政府任何支援。任美璃女士是络新妇宫廷中的高阶成员，而落入她罗网的诸多社区之一，便是柳岸镇。虽然PC们在上一幕中遭遇过她的一个版本，但她实际上从未真正见过PC们——她第一次造访柳岸镇，是在镇民被屠杀并被卷入思维空间之后的新年第一天。她发现柳岸镇已遭废弃，便命令她的仆役洗劫镇上的贵重物品，作为献给琅蕾夫人的贡品（同时也给自己留下了相当一部分），而在过去一个世纪里，她几乎没有再把多少心思放在这片区域上。

柳岸镇归来的消息很快传入她耳中。任美璃不久后便重返柳岸镇，想弄清它和镇民们究竟去了哪里，并以络新妇最擅长的方式“欢迎”他们回来——提出残酷的要求，并施加令人难以承受的经济罚款。PC们可以缓和这些政治上的打击，也可以利用他们在上一幕与任美璃那个诡异回响的遭遇，为自己争取优势。

虽然本章前几个遭遇默认PC们为11级，但由于缺少战斗遭遇，即使是10级PC也仍然能够应对这些情节，并获得足够的XP，在开始执行任美璃的任务前升到11级。

Chapter 12: The Princess’s Web

The jorogumo are the cruel and capricious rulers of Shenmen. The nation’s citizens fear them, for their treatment of their subjects is fraught with horror and dread. The best many can hope for is to be forgotten and left to struggle on their own without any support from their government at all. Lady Ren Mei Li is a high-ranking member of the jorogumo court, and among the communities that fall into her web is Willowshore. While the PCs encountered a version of her in the previous act, she has never actually met the PCs—her first visit to Willowshore was on the first day of the year after the townsfolk had been slaughtered and whisked away to the mindscape. She found Willowshore abandoned and had her servants loot the place of its valuables as offerings to Lady Lang Loi (while keeping a fair amount for herself), and for the past century, she spared very little thought for the area.

News of Willowshore’s return reaches her ears quickly. Ren Mei Li soon returns to Willowshore to find out where it and its people have been, and to “welcome” them back in the best way the jorogumo know how—with cruel demands and economically fraught fines. The PCs can soften these political blows, and they can use their encounter with the strange echo of Ren Mei Li in the previous act to their advantage.

While the first few encounters in this chapter assume the PCs are 11th level, the lack of combat encounters means that 10th level PCs will still be able to navigate them and earn enough XP to be 11th level before they begin to run Ren Mei Li’s missions.

Act 4.3: A Fiend in Two Worlds.name: 第四幕 4.3：两界邪魔 Act 4.3: A Fiend in Two Worlds

Concluding the Adventure.name: 冒险总结 Concluding the Adventure
Concluding the Adventure.text:
冒险总结

随着赫山宝被击败或获救、苦迦菩提的最终死亡，以及谭杉的复原术，柳岸镇在现代神门中的地位已然稳固。未来，城镇仍将面对新的危险，但至少现在，柳岸镇的人民可以休息、恢复，并繁荣发展。

如果PC们回到丹杉寺的废墟，他们会发现那棵杉树比以往任何时候都更加健康，而入夜之后，它的叶片会闪烁着淡淡的银色光芒。如今，一股宁静而神圣的气息弥漫于废墟之中，而这一惊人的变化的消息也很快吸引来新一代朝圣者；终有一日，他们将使这座寺院恢复其最初的使命。

如果PC们在战役结束时与罗阔恩、大柳树或伊索里关系良好，那么接下来的几天里，他们会来拜访，并讲述自己在各自领地中观察到的变化。罗阔恩表示他希望重建丝蜂帮——他向柳岸镇提供这群人的服务，让他们充当道路上的代理人，协助保护穿越周边土地的旅人；如果PC们未来想要对抗络新妇宫廷，他甚至可能将这群人发展成一项宝贵资源。与此同时，大柳树和伊索里在自然界中察觉到的那些微妙扰动，以及他们曾亲眼见证的不祥征兆，都已经消失——不过，那伽尤其指出，在他占卜所能触及的边缘地带，仍残留着一些下等而令人不安的凶兆。

接下来的几个月里，柳岸镇过得颇为安宁愉快。天气良好，庄稼兴旺。重建工作迅速推进，只偶尔出现一些寻常问题，比如获取劳工和材料。任美璃信守诺言，而柳岸镇也通过私下低调的耳语，被人们视作一处多少能躲避络新妇掠夺的庇护术。

在这几个月之后，柳岸镇会走向何方，完全取决于PC们的动作以及他们对未来的打算。他们或许会选择更积极地介入络新妇宫廷的谋划，也许扶持任美璃成为琅蕾夫人的竞争者，或致力于从根本上破坏络新妇的势力。他们也可能将柳岸镇建设成神门中的一座小小安全孤岛，尽管总有可能会有某个备受瞩目的逃亡者或政治难民试图躲藏于此，从而让PC们陷入棘手的两难境地。

当然，最重要的悬而未决之事，仍是宁多鲁半神苦迦菩提。如今他再度沉寂，死在谭杉根系之下；但和所有宁多鲁斯一样，他依然存在再度转生的可能。若要将苦迦菩提彻底从灵魂循环中移除，那将是唯有最强大的英雄才该尝试的传奇任务。这一事业将要求一场漫长的征程——目的地并非被他死亡梦境腐化的心景，而是一个完全存在于这名宁多鲁邪恶心智之中的现实。那里的恐怖将使PC们在《肆季鬼志》冒险路径中奋战过的一切都相形见绌，也会比他们迄今为止面对过的任何挑战都更加艰巨！

Concluding the Adventure

With Heh Shan-Bao’s defeat or rescue, Kugaptee’s final death, and the restoration of the Tan Sugi, Willowshore’s place in modern Shenmen is assured. Future dangers will face the town, but for now, the people of Willowshore can rest, recover, and thrive.

Should the PCs return to the ruins of the Tan Sugi Monastery, they’ll find the sugi tree to be healthier than it has ever been before, and after dark, its leaves shimmer with a faint silvery light. An aura of peace and sanctity now pervades the ruins, and news of this astonishing transformation soon begins to draw a new generation of pilgrims who, in time, shall restore the monastery to its original cause.

If the PCs finished the campaign on good terms with Lo Kuon, Great Willow, or Isori, they visit in the next few days to describe the changes they’ve observed in their territories. Lo Kuon reports that he hopes to rebuild the Silkwasps—he offers the group’s services to Willowshore as road agents who’ll help defend travelers through the surrounding lands, and he could possibly grow the group into a valuable resource should the PCs seek to oppose the jorogumo in the future. Meanwhile, the subtle disturbances that Great Willow and Isori saw in the natural world, and the ominous portents they’ve borne witness to, have vanished—although the naga in particular notes that there are still some minor, disquieting omens in the outer reaches of his divinations.

The next few months pass pleasantly in Willowshore. The weather is good, and the crops thrive. Rebuilding proceeds apace, with only ordinary problems arising, like acquiring labor and materials. Ren Mei Li keeps her word, and Willowshore becomes known, via discreet whispers, as something of a sanctuary from the depredations of the jorogumo.

What happens with Willowshore beyond these months depends entirely on the PCs’ actions and plans for the future. They might choose to take a more active role in the schemes of the jorogumo court, perhaps advancing Ren Mei Li as a rival to Lady Lang Loi or working to undermine the jorogumo altogether. They might establish Willowshore as a small island of safety in Shenmen, although it’s always possible that a high-profile escapee or political refugee might try to hide there, putting the PCs in an uncomfortable predicament.

The most significant loose end, of course, is the nindoru demigod Kugaptee. Once again quiet and dead below the roots of the Tan Sugi, as with all nindorus, there remains the chance of his potential reincarnation. Removing Kugaptee entirely from the cycle of souls is the type of legendary quest only the most powerful of heroes should attempt. This endeavor would require a lengthy mission not into a mindscape corrupted by his dead dreams, but one found entirely within the nindoru’s evil mind—a reality that would put the horrors the PCs braved during the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path to shame and that would challenge them more than anything they’ve yet faced!

A Heroine Passes Her Burden.name: 女英雄卸下她的重担 A Heroine Passes Her Burden
A Heroine Passes Her Burden.text:
女英雄卸下她的重担

只要至少有一名玩家角色在苦迦菩提的最终死亡中幸存下来，那些幸存者就会蜷缩在柳岸镇的废墟幻影中，默然无语。雾气从四面八方翻涌而来，一阵轻柔吹奏的长笛声在烟霭般的寂静中蜿蜒回荡。那是一首看似简单的曲子，却有着一种让玩家角色从骨子深处感到熟悉的节奏。伴随着歌声而来的，是一阵无声却强烈的情感脉动：希望、恐惧、骄傲，以及面对痛苦时的不屈。一种共同的使命感与自我牺牲的意志驱散了疲惫，振奋了精神。

研习古乐的人可以通过一次成功的@Check[arts-lore|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]或@Check[performance|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge]回忆知识检定，认出这首歌名为《暮光火把》——这是一部同名古代英雄歌剧中一首曾经远比现在更为著名的曲目。这首作品的主题，是新一代英雄从陨落的前辈手中接过希望之光并将其延续；其象征意象则是在落日之前点燃火把，好在黑暗中保存下那光辉的一部分。

当乐曲结束时，每名玩家角色（包括任何已经死亡者）都会瞥见一段闪现的幻景：那是他们在保卫柳岸镇时展现勇武或怜悯的某个瞬间，随后画面转为一名身着古装的女剑士；她背对晚霞而立，面容隐没在剪影之中。那名战士丢下自己的剑，而每名玩家角色都看见自己的手伸出，将其握住。任何在@Check[perception|dc:20]检定中成功的玩家角色，都会认出那道身影正是谭隋靖——那位击败了苦迦菩提，并转生为如今仍生长在苦迦菩提之墓上的杉树的女英雄。

在幻景结束时，每名玩家角色都感到神清气爽、恢复如初。任何生命值伤害都被治愈，所有持续中的状态都被移除，甚至那些在苦迦菩提的最终死亡中死去的玩家角色也重获生命。当谭隋靖分享自己的力量以恢复玩家角色时，她也从他们身上汲取了各自的经历、信念与精神力量——这不会削弱或伤害玩家角色，但会修复苦迦菩提之墓上的杉树，使其在未来世代中更加茁壮，正如@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}曾希望以他失败的仪式达成的那样。

所有玩家角色都感到一阵疲惫、可怕的恐惧，以及一种再也无法抵抗的衰竭。片刻之后，他们全都在现实世界中醒来，从自己先前在心景版本的总督庄园里所处的位置起身——而这座庄园如今终于以修复后的样貌回到了生者的世界。

A Heroine Passes Her Burden

As long as at least one PC survives Kugaptee’s Final Death, those survivors huddle in silence within a ruined version of Willowshore. Mist rolls in all around them, and the sound of a softly playing flute winds through the smoky silence. It’s a deceptively simple song, but with a rhythm that the PCs recognize from somewhere deep in their bones. With the song comes a soundless but powerful pulse of mingled emotions: hope, fear, pride, and defiance in the face of pain. A shared sense of purpose and self-sacrifice lifts weariness and bolsters the spirit.

Students of old music can recognize the song as “The Dusklight Torch” with a successful @Check[arts-lore|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[performance|dc:25|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge—a once much-more-famous song from an old heroic opera by the same title. The theme of the piece concerns a new generation of heroes preserving the light of hope by claiming it from a fallen predecessor, symbolized by the lighting of a torch in front of the setting sun to preserve some fraction of its light in the darkness.

As the song ends, each PC (including any who are dead) receives a flashed vision of a moment when they displayed bravery or compassion in Willowshore’s defense, followed by the image of a swordswoman in ancient dress; her face unseen as it’s silhouetted against the sunset. The warrior drops her sword, and each PC sees their own hand reach out to grasp it. Any PC who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:20] check recognizes the figure as that of Tan Sui-Jing, the heroine who defeated Kugaptee and reincarnated as the sugi that grows still over his grave.

At the conclusion of the vision, each PC feels refreshed and restored. Any Hit Point damage is healed, all lingering conditions are removed, and even PCs who perished during Kugaptee’s Final Death are restored to life. As Tan Sui-Jing shares her strength to restore the PCs, she also draws from them their own experiences, convictions, and spiritual power—this doesn’t diminish or harm the PCs, but it does restore the sugi tree over Kugaptee’s grave, bolstering the tree for generations to come in the same way @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao} had hoped to do so with his failed ritual.

All the PCs feel a wave of weariness, terrible fear, and an exhaustion that can no longer be resisted. A moment later, they all awaken in the real world, rising from the same positions they occupied in the mindscape’s version of the governor’s manor—which has finally returned in its restored form to the living world.

Kugaptee’s Final Death.name: 苦迦菩提的最终死亡 Kugaptee’s Final Death
Kugaptee’s Final Death.text:
苦迦菩提的最终死亡

一旦玩家角色击败此处的敌人，并且 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝} 的命运已被决定，苦迦菩提终于直接作出反应。如果玩家角色未能击败敌人并就此殒命，他的爪子便会猛然向下砸落，摧毁宅邸以及其中玩家角色的遗骸，随后他将重生于现世之中，为整个神门带来可怖的全新现实。

否则，他的爪子会徒劳地抽搐挥舞，试图抓住周遭的世界，却开始被拖回地底。随着这一过程持续，玩家角色周围的世界将遭受震颤、刮骨蚀肉的灵堕魔蝴蝶风暴、灵能痛苦的浪潮，以及来自死亡本身、撕扯灵魂的拉拽；随后，苦迦菩提再次沉入真正而寂静的死亡。

场景注记氛围 / 音效

@UUID[Playlist.FGK5jsYreqU1AR5o.PlaylistSound.oJzJaUgSUvz1iSVu]{氛围: Kuraptree's Rise} | @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.odgltUm1HHlAxrpq]{1: 崩砸的手臂} @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.m1oFrwQQj59kIEw4]{2: 蝴蝶之云} @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.iTPjeUEOk6IAwKbo]{3: 恶魔咆哮} @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.bKPpzdkOEBNYuAPW]{4: 死亡咆哮}

这场灾变会持续四轮，在此期间，玩家角色无法在周围的心景被撕碎之际逃回现实。他们必须撑过并见证这个世界的终结，才有机会逃回家中；但如果他们已找回与赫山宝生命相关的四件联系之物，便会得到一些防护。

1：世界震颤

当苦迦菩提的手臂撼动世界时，会引发猛烈的地震。环绕玩家角色的宅邸轰然坍塌，他们被掀翻在地，又被瓦砾砸击；与此同时，透过宅邸屋顶被撕开的破洞，还能看见上方天空中苦迦菩提手臂屈伸的片段。每名玩家角色受到 @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 反射豁免）。如果某位玩家角色携带着在 七贤的智慧 中找到的那封信，他们便会沐浴在一种防护感之中，仿佛他们的父母正为他们抵挡震颤。那封信随即消失，且所有玩家角色都不受苦迦菩提死亡这一阶段的影响。

2：血肉撕裂

苦迦菩提手臂的整段长度上绽开裂口，成群长着剃刀般翅翼的灵堕魔蝴蝶俯冲而下，吞没整个世界；它们的翅膀、足肢与牙齿会刮削任何裸露的血肉。每名玩家角色受到 @Damage[5d6[slashing]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] 强韧豁免）。如果某位玩家角色携带着花国玉珍公主的破损肖像，他们便会沐浴在仿佛被恋人拥入怀中的庇护感里，使那些蝴蝶完全无视他们。肖像随即消失，且所有玩家角色都不受苦迦菩提死亡这一阶段的影响。

3：心智退缩

随着苦迦菩提的手臂被拖入地下，成群的灵堕魔蝴蝶也被吸回他的血肉之中；与此同时，他因被拖回死亡而产生的痛苦与恐惧，那令人心智麻木的心灵感应咆哮，会将连思想本身都轰成碎片。每名玩家角色受到 @Damage[5d6[mental]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:30|basic] 意志豁免）。如果某位玩家角色携带着《七贤者的智慧》，卷轴中承载的真理会巩固他们的心智，并让他们扎根于现实之中。卷轴随即消失，且所有玩家角色都不受苦迦菩提死亡这一阶段的影响。

4：最终死亡

当苦迦菩提的利爪滑回地底时，他的咆哮戛然而止，玩家角色会短暂瞥见死亡本质的一角。每名玩家角色受到 @Damage[5d6[void]] 伤害（DC 30 基础豁免；玩家角色可选择以 @Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] 强韧豁免承受该伤害、以 @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 反射豁免避开该伤害，或以 @Check[will|dc:30|basic] 意志豁免保护他们的灵魂）。如果某位玩家角色携带着保存完好的山茶花与缎带，这朵花会重新绽放出生机，而一种自己属于生者世界的感觉会保护玩家角色。花与缎带随即消失，且所有玩家角色都不受苦迦菩提死亡这最终阶段的影响。

Kugaptee’s Final Death

Once the PCs have defeated the foes here and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}’s fate has been determined, Kugaptee finally and directly reacts. If the PCs fail to defeat the foes and perish, his claw slams downward to destroy the manor and the PCs’ remains within before he’s reborn into the living world, resulting in a horrific new reality for all of Shenmen.

Otherwise, his claw thrashes and flails, grasping at the world around ineffectually as it begins to be drawn back into the ground. As this process continues, the world around the PCs is wracked by tremors, storms of flesh-scouring nindoru butterflies, a wave of psychic anguish, and a soul-wrenching pull from death itself before Kugaptee once again settles back into true and silent death.

Scene NotesAmbiance / SFX

@UUID[Playlist.FGK5jsYreqU1AR5o.PlaylistSound.oJzJaUgSUvz1iSVu]{Ambience: Kuraptree's Rise} | @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.odgltUm1HHlAxrpq]{1: Crashing Arms} @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.m1oFrwQQj59kIEw4]{2: Clouds Of Butterflies} @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.iTPjeUEOk6IAwKbo]{3: Demonic Roar} @UUID[Playlist.Mv66f1NNleR53M5o.PlaylistSound.bKPpzdkOEBNYuAPW]{4: Death Roar}

This catastrophe plays out over the course of four rounds, during which the PCs can’t escape back to reality while the mindscape around them is torn apart. They must endure and witness the end of this world if they’re to escape back home, but if they’ve recovered the four links to Heh Shan-Bao’s life, they’ll be afforded some protection.

1: The World Trembles

As Kugaptee’s arm shakes the world, it causes a violent earthquake. The manor surrounding the PCs collapses as they’re thrown to the ground and battered with rubble, while glimpses of Kugaptee’s arm flexing in the sky above are visible through holes tearing through the manor’s roof. Each PC takes @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). If a PC carries the letter found in The Wisdom of the Seven Sages, they’re bathed in a sensation of protection, as if their parents were shielding them from the tremors. The letter vanishes, and all the PCs are unaffected by this stage of Kugaptee’s death.

2: The Flesh Tears

Rents open along the length of Kugaptee’s arm and clouds of razor-winged nindoru butterflies swoop down to engulf the world, their wings, legs, and teeth scouring any exposed flesh. Each PC takes @Damage[5d6[slashing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] save). If a PC carries the ruined portrait of Princess Ok Jinju, they’re bathed in the sensation of being sheltered in a lover’s arms, causing the butterflies to ignore them completely. The portrait vanishes, and all the PCs are unaffected by this stage of Kugaptee’s death.

3: The Mind Recoils

The swarms of nindoru butterflies are drawn back into Kugaptee’s flesh as his arm is pulled down into the ground, and with it, the mind-numbing telepathic roar of his anguish and fear at being drawn back into death blasts even thought itself to shreds. Each PC takes @Damage[5d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:30|basic] save). If a PC carries The Wisdom of the Seven Sages, the truths carried in the scroll bolster their minds and ground them in reality. The scroll vanishes, and all the PCs are unaffected by this stage of Kugaptee’s death.

4: The Final Death

As Kugaptee’s talons slide back into the ground, his roar is cut off, and the PCs gain a momentary glimpse into the very nature of death. Each PC takes @Damage[5d6[void]] damage (DC 30 basic save; a PC can choose to endure this damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] save, avoid it with a @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save, or shield their souls with a @Check[will|dc:30|basic] save). If a PC carries the preserved camellia flower and ribbon, the flower blooms with new life, and a feeling of belonging to the world of the living protects the PCs. The flower and ribbon vanish, and all the PCs are unaffected by this final stage of Kugaptee’s death.

Heh Shan-Bao Freed.name: 赫山宝 解放者 Heh Shan-Bao Freed
Heh Shan-Bao Freed.text:
和善保 解放者

如果PC与@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}的影响至少达到7，他们就能说服他，让他抛弃苦迦菩提，尽管他们仍然必须击败那两个未生者——只有当他们的影响达到10时，他们才能驱逐未生者并在不战斗的情况下解放山宝。

当他被解放时，他如释重负地叹了口气，双手捂住自己脸部上半部分，难以置信地揉着恢复如初的双眼。他那扭曲的形体缓缓消融，使他恢复成原本的人类外观，身披破布；除非PC的影响达到10，那样的话他将身着华美服饰。

“感谢你们，”他低声说道。起初就很瘦弱的形体开始渐渐变得虚无缥缈，他继续说道：“感谢你们还我自由。我也感谢你们纠正了那个我太过软弱、未能阻止的错误，也感谢你们以我曾以为自己能够做到的方式引领柳岸镇。我失败了，而那是我最大的耻辱。我只能希望神祇裁定我已为此受尽了足够的苦难，因为我现在就要去接受他们的审判了。”

如果PC的影响达到7到9，他的表情会突然变得惊恐，并大喊道：“苦迦菩提！他在这里！”片刻之后，他痛苦地哀号起来，他那正在消散的身体猛然炸裂成一团猩红色的宁多鲁蝴蝶，随即迅速消逝。PC阻止了苦迦菩提重获生命，但代价是赫山宝永恒的灵魂。

如果PC的影响达到10，他的神情则会变得宁静安详。“我看见苦迦菩提了，”他低声说道，“但我现在知道，他无法接触我永恒的灵魂。谢谢你们……谢谢你们……”片刻之后，他彻底消散，灵魂前往骨园接受审判——无论是转世、升格还是惩罚，只有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{法拉斯玛}（以及作为游戏主持的你）才能断言。

Heh Shan-Bao Freed

If the PCs reach at least Influence 7 with @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}, they get through to him and convince him to cast aside Kugaptee, although they’ll still have to defeat the two unrisen—only if they reach Influence 10 do they banish the unrisen and free Shan-Bao without a fight.

As he is freed, he sighs in relief and claps his hands over the upper half of his face, rubbing at his restored eyes with astonishment. His warped form slowly dissolves, restoring him to his original human appearance, clad in rags unless the PCs reached Influence 10, in which case he wears resplendent attire.

“I thank you,” he whispers. His form, slight to begin with, begins to fade into insubstantiality as he continues, “I thank you for my freedom. I thank you, too, for righting the wrong I was too weak to prevent and for leading Willowshore in the way that I once believed I could. I failed, and it is my greatest shame. I can only hope the gods decree that I have suffered enough for it, for I go to their judgment now.”

If the PCs reached Influence 7 through 9, his expression suddenly turns to horror, and he cries out, “Kugaptee! He’s here!” A moment later, he wails in anguish as his fading body bursts into an explosion of crimson nindoru butterflies that swiftly fades away. The PCs have prevented Kugaptee from returning to life, but at the cost of Heh Shan-Bao’s eternal soul.

If the PCs reached Influence 10, his expression becomes one of serene peace. “I see Kugaptee,” he whispers, “But I know now he cannot touch my eternal soul. Thank you... thank you...” A moment later, he fades away entirely, his soul traveling to the Boneyard to be judged—be it reincarnation, ascension, or punishment, only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma} (and you as the GM) can say.

Speaking with Heh Shan-Bao.name: 与和善保说话 Speaking with Heh Shan-Bao
Speaking with Heh Shan-Bao.text:
与和善保说话

如果玩家角色与 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝} 说话，他们可以按自己认为合适的方式回应他的挑衅。这段对话应当自然展开，让赫山宝以一种高高在上、居高临下的态度对玩家角色作出反应。只要玩家角色继续与他说话，他们就能逐渐削弱苦迦菩提的影响，并提醒赫山宝他曾经也是人类。

这个影响遭遇的每一轮会持续 1 分钟。玩家角色起始有 1 分钟，并会根据队伍携带了多少与镇长前世有关的线索而获得额外轮次。他们可能已经发现了四项线索：来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c2courtyard000]{C2} 的玉锦珠残破肖像、来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c4meetingare00]{C4} 的《七贤的智慧》、在那卷轴中找到的信件，以及来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c8masterbedr00]{C8} 的保存花朵与丝带。队伍中每有人携带其中一件物品，队伍就获得 1 分钟额外时间来影响赫山宝——如果他们四项线索全都带在身上，他们就拥有最多 5 个影响轮来触及这位受折磨的镇长。

如果玩家角色在这场遭遇的最终轮结束前未能至少达到影响 7，赫山宝的耐心就会崩溃。“去死吧，冒牌货，”他咆哮道，“去死吧，永远被锁在灵魂轮回之外。”此时，他会发动攻击——进行与和善保战斗，见前一页。如果玩家角色达到影响 7，但在遭遇结束前未能达到影响 10，他们会说服他抛弃苦迦菩提，但两个未活之生仍会留下——这两个未生者会立刻发动攻击，必须先击败它们，玩家角色才能继续进行和善保 解放者。如果玩家角色在任意时刻达到影响 10，这场影响遭遇立即结束。两个未生者会在痛苦中尖叫，然后消失；赫山宝则将苦迦菩提甩开——继续进行和善保 解放者。

赫山宝

  • 独特
  • 中型
  • 邪魔
  • 幻术
  • 心灵

苦迦菩提的新生容器

察觉 +23

意志 +21

发现 @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:29|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[society|dc:30|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[perception|dc:32|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover]

影响技能 @Check[nindoru-lore|dc:28|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]（警告他宁多鲁斯与苦迦菩提的真实本质），@Check[religion|dc:30|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]（谈论他与苦迦菩提的联系如何是在自我毁灭），@Check[society|dc:32|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]（提醒他，作为更大社会中富有成效的一员曾是什么样子），@Check[diplomacy|dc:30|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[intimidation|dc:31|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[deception|dc:33|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]

影响 4 玩家角色成功触及赫山宝生前的记忆。从这一刻起，明显携带獠牙与钥匙的不利影响（见下文“减值”）被抵消，但玩家角色仍然可以通过将钥匙交给他来获得加值。

影响 7 赫山宝崩溃落泪，他的愤怒突然被悲伤所取代。他的灵魂仍被交付给苦迦菩提，而当他获得解放时，灵魂也会被这邪魔吞噬——他无法恢复生命，也没有来世。

影响 10 赫山宝止住泪水，变得无比决心；影响遭遇结束。继续进行下方的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15hehshanbaofr00]{和善保 解放者}。

抗力 赫山宝对任何暗示他是为了自身私利行事、而非在某种意义上为了拯救柳岸镇的说法都极为反感。任何时候，只要某位玩家角色暗示或直言他的行为给城镇带来了伤害术，该次影响检定的 DC 增加 2。

Weaknesses 如果某位玩家角色明显携带四件与赫山宝前世相连的物品之一（锦珠的肖像、《七贤的智慧》、卷轴中的信件或保存花朵），该玩家角色用来影响赫山宝的 DC 降低 2。如果某位玩家角色将獠牙与钥匙交给赫山宝（从而暗示他们即便现在？仍视他为自己的统治者），所有用于影响他的 DC 额外再降低 2。

减值 赫山宝傲慢地认为自己才是柳岸镇唯一真正的统治者。如果某位玩家角色明显携带獠牙与钥匙，这种对其统治权的隐含挑战会让他变得更加顽固。该玩家角色用来影响赫山宝的 DC 提高 2，即使该玩家角色之后将獠牙与钥匙躲藏起来或放弃携带也是如此——除非该玩家角色将獠牙与钥匙交给赫山宝，此时所有玩家角色用来影响他的 DC 反而会降低 2；这一降低可与上文其他弱点提供的 DC 降低叠加。

Speaking with Heh Shan-Bao

If the PCs speak to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}, they can reply to his challenge as they see fit. The conversation should play out naturally, with Heh Shan-Bao reacting to the PCs with an air of superiority and condescension. As long as the PCs continue to speak to him, they’ll wear away at Kugaptee’s influence and remind Heh Shan-Bao that he was once human.

Each round of this influence encounter plays out over the course of 1 minute. PCs start with 1 minute and gain additional rounds depending on how many links to the governor’s previous life the party carries. There are four potential links they could’ve discovered: the ruined portrait of Ok Jinju from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c2courtyard000]{C2}, The Wisdom of the Seven Sages from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c4meetingare00]{C4}, the letter found within that scroll, and the preserved flower and ribbon from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c8masterbedr00]{C8}. Each one of these items that someone in the group carries grants the party 1 additional minute to influence Heh Shan-Bao—if they all four links with them, they’ll have the maximum possible of 5 influence rounds to reach the tormented governor.

If the PCs fail to reach at least Influence 7 by the final round of this encounter, Heh Shan-Bao’s patience snaps. “Die, pretenders,” he roars, “die, and be chained outside the cycle of souls forevermore.” At this point, he attacks—proceed with Fighting with Heh Shan-Bao, see previous page. If the PCs reach Influence 7 but fail to reach Influence 10 by the end of the encounter, they convince him to abandon Kugaptee, but the two Unlived Lives remain—the two unrisen attack at once and must be defeated before the PCs can proceed with Heh Shan-Bao Freed. If the PCs reach Influence 10 at any point, the influence encounter ends immediately. Both unrisen cry out in anguish before vanishing, and Heh Shan-Bao casts Kugaptee aside—proceed with Heh Shan-Bao Freed.

Heh Shan-Bao

  • unique
  • Medium
  • Fiend
  • Illusion
  • Mental

Nascent vessel for Kugaptee

Perception +23

Will +21

Discovery @Check[willowshore-lore|dc:29|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[society|dc:30|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[perception|dc:32|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover]

Influence Skills @Check[nindoru-lore|dc:28|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence] (to warn him about the true nature of nindorus and Kugaptee), @Check[religion|dc:30|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence] (to speak about how his association with Kugaptee is self-destructive), @Check[society|dc:32|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence] (to remind him of what it was like to be a productive part of a larger society), @Check[diplomacy|dc:30|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[intimidation|dc:31|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[deception|dc:33|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence]

Influence 4 The PCs manage to reach Heh Shan-Bao’s living memories. At this point onward, the disadvantage for visibly carrying the Fang and Key (see “Penalty,” below) is negated, but the PCs can still gain a bonus by giving him the key.

Influence 7 Heh Shan-Bao breaks down in tears, his anger suddenly replaced by grief. His soul is still consigned to Kugaptee, and when he’s freed, it is consumed by the fiend—he can’t be restored to life and has no afterlife.

Influence 10 Heh Shan-Bao stanches his tears and grows fiercely determined; the influence encounter ends. Proceed with @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15hehshanbaofr00]{Heh Shan-Bao Freed} below.

Resistances Heh Shan-Bao bristles against any implication that he acted for his own self-interest and not, in some way, to save Willowshore. Any time a PC implies or states that his actions have brought harm to the town, the DC for that Influence check is increased by 2.

Weaknesses If a PC visibly carries one of the four items that link to Heh Shan-Bao’s past life (Jinju’s portrait, The Wisdom of the Seven Sages, the scroll’s letter, or the preserved flower), the DCs for that PC to Influence Heh Shan-Bao are reduced by 2. If a PC gives Heh Shan-Bao the Fang and Key (thereby implying that they view him as their ruler even now), all DCs to Influence him are reduced by an additional 2.

Penalty Heh Shan-Bao arrogantly views himself as Willowshore’s only true ruler. If a PC visibly carries the Fang and Key, the implied challenge to his rule makes him grow even more stubborn. The DCs for that PC to Influence Heh Shan-Bao are increased by 2, even if that PC later hides or relinquishes the Fang and Key—unless the PC gives the Fang and Key to Heh Shan-Bao, in which case the DCs to Influence him are instead reduced by 2 for all PCs; this reduction stacks with the DC reduction granted for the other Weaknesses above.

Fighting with Heh Shan-Bao.name: 与和善保战斗 Fighting with Heh Shan-Bao
Fighting with Heh Shan-Bao.text:
与赫山宝战斗

与赫山宝战斗 严重 12

@UUID[Actor.U8XsqkUGeomC67b3]{赫山宝} @UUID[Actor.yH76LIxgrsHWyllN]{未活之生（2）}

赫山宝命令两个未生者冲向玩家角色。战斗开始时，它们以可怕的接近方式踉跄前扑，分散开来，各自将近战攻击集中在不同的玩家角色身上。（虽然赫山宝会受到未生者的痛苦嚎叫影响，但他不会因目睹它们的可怕的接近方式而受影响。）

战斗开始时，赫山宝会先退在后方，前几轮对玩家角色使用他的天生法术，之后再改用爪击。如果某个玩家角色成为窃魂的有效目标，他会迅速移动以利用这一局势（如果尝试失败，这会让赫山宝恼怒到不再重蹈覆辙，也不再对玩家角色使用这一战术）。

获释的灵魂：玩家角色每释放三个被锁链束缚的灵魂中的一个，未生者在再度崛起时的生命值就减少20；如果三个灵魂全部获释，那么未生者在再度崛起时仅有40生命值。此外，玩家角色每释放这三个灵魂中的一个，赫山宝的传说之力就会动摇一分。如果已释放1个灵魂，他失去骇人气势；如果已释放2个灵魂，他失去骇人气势以及其打击造成的挥砍伤害；如果3个灵魂全部获释，他失去骇人气势、其打击造成的挥砍伤害，以及他对物理伤害的抗力。

击败赫山宝：当他的生命值降至0时，赫山宝会瘫倒在地，表面上看似已经死亡。只要未活之生仍然存在，战斗就会持续，直到它们也被彻底击败。此时，赫山宝的身体会猛然重新活动起来，勉强维持片刻，让他在爆发出一声痛苦尖啸后化作一团深红色的灵堕魔蝴蝶云，并迅速消散——他的灵魂已被苦迦菩提吞噬。继续进行 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15kugapteesfin00]{苦迦菩提的最终死亡}。

Fighting with Heh Shan-Bao

Fighting with Heh Shan-Bao Severe 12

@UUID[Actor.U8XsqkUGeomC67b3]{Heh Shan-Bao} @UUID[Actor.yH76LIxgrsHWyllN]{Unlived Lives (2)}

Heh Shan-Bao sends the two unrisen to clash with the PCs. As combat begins, they lurch forward with an Awful Approach, splitting up to each focus their melee attacks against a different PC. (While Heh Shan-Bao can be harmed by an unrisen’s Agonized Howl, he’s unaffected by the sight of their Awful Approach.)

Heh Shan-Bao hangs back at the start of a fight, using his innate spells against the PCs for the first few rounds before switching to his claws. If a PC becomes a viable target for Steal Soul, he quickly moves to take advantage of that situation (if the attempt fails, this frustrates Heh Shan-Bao enough that he won’t make that mistake again and no longer uses this tactic against the PCs).

Released Souls: For each of the three chained souls the PCs released, reduce an unrisen’s Hit Points when they Rise Again by 20; if all three souls are released, an unrisen has only 40 Hit Points upon Rising Again. In addition, for each of the three souls the PCs released, Heh Shan-Bao’s legend falters. If one soul has been released, he loses his frightful presence. If two souls are released, he loses frightful presence and the slashing damage from his Strikes. If all three souls are released, he loses frightful presence, the slashing damage from his Strikes, and his resistance to physical damage.

Defeating Heh Shan-Bao: Once he’s reduced to 0 Hit Points, Heh Shan-Bao collapses to the ground, apparently dead. As long as the unlived lives remain, combat continues until they too are fully defeated. At this point, Heh Shan-Bao’s body lurches back to life long enough for him to shriek in pain an instant before he bursts into a cloud of crimson nindoru butterflies that swiftly fades—his soul has been consumed by Kugaptee. Proceed with @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15kugapteesfin00]{Kugaptee’s Final Death}.

Heh Shan-Bao Arrives.name: 和善保抵达 Heh Shan-Bao Arrives
Heh Shan-Bao Arrives.text:
和善保抵达 重度 12

最后一只煞星魔一被杀死，庭院上方那只高耸的巨爪便猛然抽动了一下，手指屈伸，仿佛想从天空中摘下月亮。这一下屈伸沿着整条肢体传导下来，使庭院一阵震颤——还不至于把PC们震得倒地，但依然令人胆寒。

片刻之后，一扇通往庭院的门打开了，@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}走了进来，身旁还跟着两个对他外观的可怖拙劣模仿——那是扭曲、呜咽的残躯，踉跄着前行，用手脚并爬，身体上布满骇人的伤口，四肢以别扭而不自然的角度弯折。它们的动作比起人类更像蜘蛛，然而每一张脸却都是赫山宝的面容。这些是代表赫山宝曾经历过的失败人生的未生者。他左边那个穿着华美长袍，佩戴着人们想象中成功总督会有的优雅饰物，象征着如果他当初没有尝试那场注定让柳岸镇毁灭的仪式，本可以过上的人生。他右边那个穿着朴素却舒适的学者长袍，象征着如果他完全避开政治、始终做个学者，本可以过上的人生。两者都对站在它们中间的妖骸版赫山宝怀有彻底而盲目的忠诚。

如果PC们还没有释放任何锁链魂魄，赫山宝会带着怜爱伸手抚摸木瘤上被刺穿的眼球，而他初次对PC们开口时，声音会冷静而居高临下。反之，如果这些眼球有部分或全部消失了，赫山宝会愤怒地看着那些缺失之处，并以几乎压抑不住怒火的声音对PC们说话。

“于是，你们终于站到了我面前，站在我头顶上方那位大人的阴影之下。他归来的时代已经来临，而你们根本无力阻止；可即便如此……你们还是来了。你们究竟凭什么胆敢插手统治者与神祇的事务？”

此时，PC们有机会将赫山宝从苦迦菩提的影响中解救出来。他们能否成功，取决于他们从修复后的庄园中找回了多少物品，以及他们运用这些物品对付他时自身的技能。如果他们没能让他摆脱控制，那么与这位总督及他失败的过往人生作战——那两名未生者正是其显现——仍然可以阻止苦迦菩提回归。

除非PC们试图离开，否则赫山宝不会主动开始战斗。否则，只有在PC们先挑起战斗，或谈判失败的结果下，他才会作战。

Heh Shan-Bao Arrives Severe 12

As soon as the last shisagishin is slain, the towering claw looming over the courtyard gives a thunderous twitch, its fingers flexing as if attempting to pluck the moon from the sky. That flex translates down the limb’s length to rock the courtyard with a tremor—not violent enough to knock the PCs prone, but frightening nonetheless.

A moment later, one of the doors into the courtyard opens, and in steps @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}, accompanied by two horrific parodies of his appearance—twisted, mewling wreckages that stagger and crawl on their hands and knees, their bodies bearing gruesome wounds and limbs bending in awkward, unnatural angles. They move more like spiders than humans, yet each one’s face is that of Heh Shan-Bao. These are unrisen representing a failed life that Heh Shan-Bao lived. The one to his left wears fine robes and elegant accoutrements one might expect of a successful governor, symbolizing the life he could’ve lived had he not attempted the fateful ritual that doomed Willowshore. The unrisen to his right wears plain but comfortable scholar’s robes, symbolizing the life he could’ve lived had he avoided politics entirely and remained a scholar. Both are completely and mindlessly loyal to the yohoi version of Heh Shan-Bao who stands between them.

If the PCs haven’t released any of the chained spirits, Heh Shan-Bao lovingly reaches out to caress the eyes impaled on the wooden burl, and when he initially speaks to the PCs, his voice is calm and condescending. On the other hand, if some or all of these eyes are missing, Heh Shan-Bao regards the missing spots with fury and addresses the PCs with a voice that barely restrains his outrage.

“And so, you finally stand before me, in the shadow of my lord above. His time of return has come, and there is nothing you can do to stop it, yet still... here you are. By what right do you dare meddle in the affairs of rulers and gods?”

At this juncture, the PCs have an opportunity to free Heh Shan-Bao from Kugaptee’s influence. Their success depends on how many items they recovered from the restored manor and on their own skill in using these items against him. If they fail to free him, a fight against the governor and his failed past lives (manifested by the presence of the two unrisen) can still prevent Kugaptee’s return.

Heh Shan-Bao doesn’t start combat unless the PCs attempt to leave. Otherwise, he fights only if the PCs start a battle, or as a result of failed negotiations.

Below Kugaptee’s Claw.name: 苦迦菩提之爪下方 Below Kugaptee’s Claw
Below Kugaptee’s Claw.text:
苦迦菩提之爪下方 变化 12

一汪闪着微光的血池、一座由骨骸构成的花园喷泉，以及一簇簇染病的枝叶，把宅邸的中心变成了噩梦。几乎看不清的生物在血池中泼溅翻腾，而红翼蝴蝶则聚集在枝叶之间。这里那里，地上横七竖八地散落着一些看起来颇为熟悉的尸体。庭院边缘，环绕四周的柱廊屋檐下悬挂着一盏盏可怖却做工精良的提灯，那是用剥下的人类面孔制成的。上方的夜空中，一轮巨大、形如红色眼睛的月亮散发着光芒。自这座诡异城市北侧山顶处，高耸的巨爪拔地而起，俯临庭院，仿佛几乎要将那轮月亮揽入掌中。

在庭院北端，两张芦席之间的地面上放着一个木瘿。木瘿的根系向上扭曲，如同抓握的触须，每一条都沾着血迹。

北面的木瘿是苦迦菩提邪魔心脏的实体显现。若玩家角色已经将所有被害者都从他们的镣铐中释放出来（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15thechainedsp00]{锁链魂魄}），那么木瘿那些向上伸展的根系便只是染着血迹。每有一个灵魂仍被束缚，就会有一双眼睛被刺穿在两条不同的根系上，哀伤地凝望着庭院。

散落在庭院各处的尸体看起来十分熟悉，因为它们仿佛都是非玩家角色的遗体，而玩家角色在这条冒险路径的过程中已渐渐对他们产生了感情。这些尸体并不真实，但看起来却与真的无异。它们大多数不过是苦迦菩提布置在此的心理战元素，但其中有些却不止于此。

苦迦菩提之爪下方 变化 12

@UUID[Actor.pqi2xSTYoXw5MtwN]{尸萨吉辛（2到4只）}

生物：这里有若干具尸体其实是伪装成死者的煞星魔宁多鲁斯。尸体中潜伏着多少煞星魔，取决于玩家角色释放了多少锁链魂魄。若他们一个也没释放，那么这里有四具尸体其实是煞星魔（一次极限12遭遇）。若玩家角色至少释放了一个锁链魂魄，那么死者中便只有三只煞星魔（一次严峻12遭遇）。若玩家角色释放了全部三个锁链魂魄，他们将只会面对两只煞星魔（一次中等12遭遇）。

一旦任何一个煞星魔的尸壳被触碰，那只煞星魔就会使用它的死中暴起反应动作，试图对触碰它的玩家角色进行一次打击——随后所有宁多鲁斯都以隐秘检定进行先攻。若1分钟内无人触碰任何一只伪装中的煞星魔，或当庭院中的最后一人离开该区域时（以较早者为准），宁多鲁斯就会以隐秘检定进行先攻，并从它们的尸壳中起身发动攻击，但不会利用死中暴起。宁多鲁斯会战斗至死。

Below Kugaptee’s Claw Varies 12

A glistening pool of blood, a bone garden fountain, and clusters of diseased foliage turn the heart of the manor into a nightmare. Barely glimpsed creatures splash in the bloody pond, while red-winged butterflies gather in the foliage. Here and there, familiar looking bodies lie strewn on the ground. Grisly yet well-made lanterns crafted with skinned human faces hang along the edges of the courtyard from the eaves of the surrounding colonnade. The night sky above shines with the light of an immense red eye-shaped moon. From the hilltop north of the strange city, the towering claw rises, looming over the courtyard as it appears almost to cradle the moon in its grasp.

At the courtyard’s northern end, a wood burl sits on the ground between two reed mats. The roots of the burl twist upward like grasping tendrils, and each glistens with blood.

The burl of wood to the north is a physical manifestation of Kugaptee’s fiendish heart. If the PCs have released all of the murdered victims from their shackles (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15thechainedsp00]{The Chained Spirits}), then the upward reaching roots of the burl are merely bloodstained. For each soul that remains shackled, a pair of eyes are impaled upon two different roots, staring mournfully out into the courtyard.

The corpses sprawled across the courtyard appear familiar, for they seem to be the bodies of NPCs the PCs have grown fond of over the course of this Adventure Path. These bodies aren’t real, but they appear as if they are. Most of them serve as little more than psychological warfare elements placed here by Kugaptee, but some of them are more than that.

Below Kugaptee's Claw Varies 12

@UUID[Actor.pqi2xSTYoXw5MtwN]{Shisagishins (2 to 4)}

Creatures: A number of the corpses here are actually shisagishin nindorus disguised as the dead. The number of shisagishin present among the corpses depends on how many of the chained spirits the PCs released. If they released none of them, then four of the bodies here are shisagishins (an Extreme 12 encounter). If the PCs released at least one of the chained spirits, then only three shisagishins are among the dead (a Severe 12 encounter). If the PCs released all three chained spirits, they’ll face only two shisagishins (a Moderate 12 encounter).

Once any of the shisagishin Corpse Shells are touched, that shisagishin uses its Burst From Death reaction to attempt a Strike on the PC who touched it—all of the nindorus then roll Stealth for initiative. If no one touches a disguised shisagishin after a minute or when the last person in the courtyard leaves the area (whichever comes first), the nindorus roll Stealth for initiative and rise up from their Corpse Shells to attack without taking advantage of Burst From Death. The nindorus fight to the death.

The Governor’s Den.name: 总督的巢穴 The Governor’s Den
The Governor’s Den.text:
总督的巢穴

当区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d4springspat00]{D4} 北端的门被打开时，一片闪烁的薄雾遮蔽了后方的景象。那片薄雾翻涌而出，充满了整个建筑群，片刻后又消散，显现出玩家角色如今正站在总督庄园的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c1manorentra00]{C1}。滑动纸墙阻挡了通往庄园庭院的视线，但这一次，情况更加令人不安，因为玩家角色如今发现自己正身处苦迦菩提那压倒性影响的核心。

这里的庄园墙壁上覆盖着数百只模样阴森的红眼，它们在玩家角色之间随机扫视。这些眼睛的察觉加值为+26；如果它们发现了入侵者，那么在庄园庭院中等待玩家角色的@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}便会察觉到他们的到来。

玩家角色现在必须做出选择：他们可以退回南边的门，返回苦迦菩提之握（像他们初次抵达时那样，从总督庄园的废墟进入那个心景——他们需要再次穿过苦迦菩提之墓，才能重新到达此处），或者他们也可以继续向庄园深处前进。

这些区域与 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c3servantsqu00]{C3}– @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c8masterbedr00]{C8} 相同，只是其中没有生物、危害和宝藏。玩家角色一旦打开任何一扇通往庭院的门，便会触发肆季鬼志 冒险路径的最终遭遇。接着进行下文的苦迦菩提之爪下方。

The Governor’s Den

When the doors at the northern end of area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d4springspat00]{D4} are opened, a shimmering haze obscures what lies beyond. That haze billows out to fill the entire complex, fading a moment later to reveal the PCs now standing in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c1manorentra00]{C1} of the governor’s manor. Sliding paper walls block the view into the manor’s courtyard, but this time, things are more unsettling, for the PCs now find themselves at the very heart of Kugaptee’s overwhelming influence.

The manor walls here are covered with hundreds of sinister-looking red eyes that glance randomly between the PCs. These eyes have a Perception bonus of +26; if they spot intruders, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}, who awaits the PCs in the manor courtyard, becomes aware of them.

The PCs have a choice to make now: they can step back through the door to the south and return to Kugaptee’s Grasp (emerging into that mindscape from the ruins of the governor’s manor, just as they did when they first arrived—they’ll need to make a return journey through Kugaptee’s Grave to reach this point again), or they can move further into the manor.

These areas appear as in areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c3servantsqu00]{C3}– @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15c8masterbedr00]{C8}, except that they’re empty of creatures, hazards, and treasures. As soon as the PCs open any door into the courtyard, they trigger the final encounter of the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path. Proceed with Below Kugaptee’s Claw below.

Spring’s Path.name: 春之路 Spring’s Path
Spring’s Path.text:
D4. 春之路 中等 12

陡峭的悬崖峭壁向两侧延伸，上方直抵无云的夜晚天空，下方则坠入令人目眩的深邃云海。一条宽10尺的狭窄岩架沿着峭壁蜿蜒而行，途中通过两座宽5尺的天然石桥跨越断裂处，一路向北通往一组嵌入石壁中的木门。诡异的低语与遥远而哀恸的哭号从下方的迷雾中回荡升起，浓雾遮蔽了地面的任何景象。

玩家角色应当很快认出，这道狭窄裂谷正是他们在本幕早些时候走过的薄纱小径。其身后通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d3lordofwint00]{D3} 的门只是一扇普通石门，而北面的那扇门则由木头制成，立刻就能认出那是通往 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝}宅邸的入口门。

若有玩家角色从岩架上失足坠落，便会直坠下方100尺，摔向一片被浓雾笼罩的荒芜岩石地板；角色必须成功通过一次 @Check[reflex|dc:25|traits:manipulate,action:grab-an-edge|name:Grab an Edge] 反射豁免，才能抓住岩架边缘，阻止这次坠落。角色也可以通过成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:30|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] 运动检定来攀爬悬崖峭壁。

生物：随着玩家角色在此区域中前进，这处岩架与薄纱小径的相似之处愈发明显，因为一对道途侍女从岩壁中浮现，分别占据房间中央那座横跨岩架的石桥两端。与他们先前在薄纱小径上交谈过的那位行道女不同，这些道途侍女是由苦迦菩提死去的梦境塑造出的造物，这一点从围绕在她们身边成群飞舞的红色蝴蝶云便可见一斑。

D4. 春之路 中等 12

@UUID[Actor.ncYJqnROvZMNBU7Q]{道途侍女（2）}

与玩家角色先前交谈过的那位行道女不同，这些苦迦菩提的爪牙除了喝令玩家角色“回头——这条路尽头之物不是你们该面对的！”之外，对讨论毫无兴趣。若玩家角色不立刻返回区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d3lordofwint00]{D3}（或者即使返回，也只是稍后又回到这里），两名道途侍女便会立刻发动攻击。

先前遭遇的那位行道女拥有蔑视命运和复仇狂乱能力，而这些道途侍女则改为拥有渎神灵光（视觉上表现为成群蝴蝶聚成的云团）和腐化疑念能力。

D4. Spring’s Path Moderate 12

Sheer cliff walls stretch in both directions, up to a cloudless night sky above and down into a dizzying cloudy depth below. A ten-foot-wide ledge winds along the cliffs, crossing twice via five-foot-wide natural stone bridges as it winds its way north to a set of wooden doors built into the stone wall. Eerie whispers and distant, mournful cries echo up from the mists below, which obscure any sight of the ground.

The PCs should quickly recognize this narrow rift as the Gossamer Path they walked earlier in this act. While the door behind them leading back to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d3lordofwint00]{D3} is a plain stone door, the one to the north is made of wood and is immediately recognizable as being the entrance door to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}’s manor.

A PC who falls off the ledge plummets 100 feet down to a barren rocky floor below, shrouded in thick fog; a character must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:25|traits:manipulate,action:grab-an-edge|name:Grab an Edge] save to Grab the Edge of a ledge to stop such a fall. Characters can Climb the cliff walls with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:30|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check.

Creatures: The resemblance of this ledge to the Gossamer Path only grows as the PCs move through the area, as a pair of path maidens emerge from the rock walls to take up position at either end of the stone bridge that crosses the ledges at the midpoint of the room. Unlike the one they spoke with on the Gossamer Path, these path maidens are creations drawn from Kugaptee’s dead dreams, as the fluttering clouds of red butterflies that swarm around each one implies.

D4. Spring’s Path Moderate 12

@UUID[Actor.ncYJqnROvZMNBU7Q]{Path Maidens (2)}

Unlike the path maiden the PCs spoke to earlier, these minions of Kugaptee aren’t interested in discussion other than to order the PCs to “turn back—what lies beyond this path is not for you!” If the PCs don’t immediately return to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d3lordofwint00]{D3} (or if they do, only to return here later), the two path maidens attack at once.

While the path maiden encountered earlier has the Scorn Fate and Vengeful Frenzy abilities, these path maidens instead have the Blasphemous Aura (visually represented by clouds of swarming butterflies) and Corrupting Doubt abilities.

Lord of Winter.name: 寒冬领主 Lord of Winter
Lord of Winter.text:
D3. 寒冬领主 Moderate 12

这座杂草丛生的花园被一道环形石墙包围。树木沿着边缘生长，中央则有一口敞开的石井，井水几乎满到井沿。上方，乌云密布，倾盆大雨猛烈地砸落在这片区域，把地面变成一片长满杂草与泥泞的沼地；而南边立着一顶由杆子撑起的大型天篷，能为人提供一些躲避暴雨的遮蔽。色彩鲜艳的帐篷下铺着几条颜色鲜亮的毯子，还有一张小桌子，桌上放着一套茶具和四只银杯，以及一把带金色坐垫的大椅子。

玩家角色应该会立刻认出，这片区域与唐入中央的庭院颇为相似，只是没那么整齐有序。这里潮湿泥泞的地面是困难地形，而倾泻而下的暴雨冰冷刺骨，其中还蕴含着超自然的冬季最恶劣部分。一名角色若在自己的回合结束时暴露在雨中，必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:27] 强韧豁免，以抵抗变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}（若大失败，则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}），持续至其下个回合结束，因为这场雨会让他们感觉仿佛已经在可怕的冬季风暴中艰难跋涉了数小时。

站在南边的布质天篷下可以完全防护这场暴雨，但站在树下只能得到部分防护，使其在这次强韧豁免上获得+2环境加值。

生物：这房间里有两名住客在等待玩家角色——一个玩家角色应当立刻认出的熟悉身影：马戈凯；以及一名玩家角色在本战役中曾见过、但后来已经死去的非玩家角色。这名非玩家角色毕恭毕敬地站在马戈凯身旁，显然将他视为上级，因此你最好选择一位曾被玩家角色视为盟友或朋友的非玩家角色。凯坐在天篷下的椅子上，啜饮着茶，神态轻松，但与他们在第10章先前那次遭遇不同的是，他这次看起来完全没有携带武器。他一看到玩家角色，便向自己的仆役点头示意；那名仆役便邀请他们过来，到帐篷下躲雨，并用银杯为他们奉上茶水。一名在茶学识上达到大师熟练的玩家角色会自动注意到，使用银制茶杯是多么不寻常（因为银比更传统的材料导热得多），这或许会让他们意识到事情有些蹊跷。

事实上，这两个人影都是伪装起来的宁多鲁——马戈凯其实是一只稽折魔宁多鲁，使用了 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{幻象伪装} 来显现为玩家角色过去的宿敌，而他的仆役则是一只恪尸魔，塑造出与那名死去非玩家角色相符的身体。如果玩家角色没有立刻攻击，马戈凯希望他们每个人都接受仆役递上的一杯茶，随后祝贺玩家角色成功深入苦迦菩提的死梦至此。他邀请玩家角色把这些银制茶杯留下当作礼物，并继续穿过南边的门前往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d4springspat00]{D4}。

这四只银制茶杯全都带有稽折魔的染疫银诅咒（见 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21argyrzeihead00]{此处}）；他希望玩家角色收下这些“礼物”，前往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d4springspat00]{D4}，同时观察任何携带这些受诅咒茶杯的人，并尾随其后。若稽折魔觉得出现了一个特别有利于自己出手的时机，他和仆役便会加快速度追上玩家角色——至少，如果他们没有先被击败，他们会在 @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{赫山宝} 一侧加入战斗。

D3. 寒冬领主 Moderate 12

@UUID[Actor.obZ0KzlwyaZYuJxB]{稽折魔} @UUID[Actor.vLKeku6p1ZmUZR7L]{恪尸魔}

如果玩家角色拒绝或发动攻击，两只宁多鲁都会愤怒咆哮并发动攻击，以欺瞒进行先攻检定。当稽折魔的第一回合开始时，生效中的幻象伪装会让它看起来像是人类身体正在融化剥落，显露出它的真实形态：一头无头怪物，它迅速从自己颈部的断茬中抽出一把闪亮的银剑发动攻击。战斗一旦开始，宁多鲁便会战至死。由于雨水对它的影响与对玩家角色的影响一样大，所以若有可能，它们更喜欢在天篷的遮蔽下作战。

场景注记效果

将 @UUID[Item.SHQR9YToBxrci94Q]{"Mago Kai" True Form} 效果拖到其上以关闭他的伪装

宝藏： @UUID[Actor.bdk0kZ9ZrFiBNVsv]{茶杯} @UUID[Actor.i7rZJzFqFbf9UOqu]{被杀死的灵堕魔}
每只精致的银制茶杯都是价值50 gp的艺术品，但同样，每一只都带有稽折魔的染疫银诅咒。

当稽折魔被杀死时，它的身体会融化成一滩血肉，随后迅速汇流在一起并转化成一把闪亮的银制武器——这一结果与其说是宁多鲁自身真正拥有的天生能力，不如说更多源于这个奇异领域与苦迦菩提之间的关联。这件银制武器应当是一件某位玩家角色偏爱的挥砍武器类型，并且是一件+2高等强击银武器，带有染疫银诅咒（@Check[will|dc:33] 豁免）。

D3. Lord of Winter Moderate 12

This overgrown garden is surrounded by a circular stone wall. Trees grow around the perimeter, while in the center sits an open stone well that’s nearly full to the brim with water. Above, storm clouds fill the sky, pelting the area with driving rain and turning the ground into a morass of weeds and mud, while to the south stands a large canopy erected on poles that offers some shelter from the downpour. Below the brightly colored tent rest several colorful blankets, a small table atop which sits a tea set with four silver cups, and a large chair with a golden cushion.

The PCs should immediately recognize this area as being similar to the central courtyard of Karahai, although less organized. The wet muddy ground here is difficult terrain, and the driving rain is freezing cold and carries within it a supernatural infusion of the worst parts of winter. A character who ends their turn exposed to the rain must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure) until the end of their next turn, as the rain makes them feel like they’ve spent hours trudging through a terrible winter storm.

Standing under the fabric canopy to the south provides total protection from this downpour, but standing under one of the trees only provides partial protection, affording a +2 circumstance bonus to the Fortitude save.

Creatures: A pair of occupants awaits the PCs in this room—a familiar figure the PCs should immediately recognize as Mago Kai and an NPC whom the PCs have met before in this campaign but who has since died. This NPC stands deferentially at Mago Kai’s side, obviously treating him as their superior, so it’s best if the NPC you choose is someone who the PCs regarded as an ally or friend. Kai sits on the chair under the canopy, sipping tea and relaxing, but unlike their previous encounter in Chapter 10, he seems to be completely unarmed. He nods to his servant as he spots the PCs, and that servant invites them over to take shelter under the tent and offers them cups of tea served in silver cups. A PC who’s master at Tea Lore automatically notes how unusual it is to have a silver teacup (as silver conducts heat much more than more traditional material), perhaps indicating to them that something strange is afoot.

In truth, both of these figures are disguised nindorus—Mago Kai is an argyrzei nindoru who has used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} to appear as the PCs’ old nemesis, while his servant is an akashti who has manifested a body to match the dead NPC. If the PCs don’t attack at once, Mago Kai hopes each of them accepts a cup of tea from his servant, then congratulates the PCs on making it this far into Kugaptee’s dead dreams. He invites the PCs to keep the silver teacups as gifts and to proceed through the southern door on to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d4springspat00]{D4}.

The four silver teacups are all cursed with the argyrzei’s infected silver (See @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21argyrzeihead00]{Here}); he hopes the PCs take the “gifts” and move on to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog15afiend.JournalEntryPage.15d4springspat00]{D4}, during which he observes anyone who carries one of the cursed teacups and follows along behind them. The argyrzei and his servant speed up to reach the PCs if he ever feels there’s a particularly advantageous time for him to strike against them—at the very least, they’ll join the fight at @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog21bestia.JournalEntryPage.21hehshanbao0001]{Heh Shan-Bao}’s side if not defeated first.

D3. Lord of Winter Moderate 12

@UUID[Actor.obZ0KzlwyaZYuJxB]{Argyrzei} @UUID[Actor.vLKeku6p1ZmUZR7L]{Akashti}

If the PCs refuse or attack, both nindorus roar in anger and attack, rolling Deception for initiative. When the argyrzei’s first turn begins, the illusory disguise in effect makes it appear that his human body is melting away to reveal his true form: a headless monster that swiftly pulls a gleaming silver sword from the stump of its neck to attack. Once battle begins, the nindorus fight to the death. Since the rain can potentially affect him as much as the PCs, they prefer to fight from under the shelter of the canopy if possible.

Scene NotesEffect

Drag on the @UUID[Item.SHQR9YToBxrci94Q]{"Mago Kai" True Form} Effect to turn off his disguise

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.bdk0kZ9ZrFiBNVsv]{Teacups} @UUID[Actor.i7rZJzFqFbf9UOqu]{Slain Nindoru}
Each of the elegant silver teacups is a work of art worth 50 gp, but again, each bears the argyrzei’s infected silver curse.

When the argyrzei is slain, its body melts into a pile of gore that quickly flows together and transforms into a gleaming silver weapon—a result of this strange realm’s association with Kugaptee more than any real inborn ability possessed by the nindoru. This silver weapon should be a slashing weapon of a type favored by one of the PCs and is a +2 greater striking silver weapon that bears the infected silver curse (@Check[will|dc:33] save).

A Fallen Tree.name: 一棵倒下的树 A Fallen Tree
A Fallen Tree.text:
D2. 一棵倒下的树 中等 12

门穿过一面正在崩塌、爬满藤蔓的石墙，通向一座杂草丛生的寺院庭院。地面上长满了纠结繁密的荆棘与野草，而左侧和右侧则被一堵密密麻麻的树林墙阻断了去路。杂草蔓生的庭院对面墙上还有另一扇古老的石门，而中央则矗立着一棵高耸的杉树，它的树干染病，枝条光秃。它的上半部分看起来更像是一只扭曲的爪子，伸向上方阴沉的天空，而不像别的任何东西。

玩家角色会自动认出这里是丹杉寺的庭院，只是长在这片区域中央的那棵树显然已经死了。

生物：当玩家角色进入此区域时，让他们尝试进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:38] 检定；若成功，他们会注意到死去杉树发霉的树皮上长出了数十张人脸般的模糊形状，每一张嘴都无声地张开，仿佛在尖叫。这一细节可能让玩家角色意识到，一个强大的不死生物存在——一株尸根——已经由这棵树的一部分树干形成。若大成功，他们还会发现其中几张脸上的眼睛会抽动着转向靠近的玩家角色，投来凶恶的瞪视。

D2. 一棵倒下的树 中等 12

@UUID[Actor.v1Nf0CsNFXJAF4pw]{尸杉} @UUID[Actor.rwpq77CuinvdTFIh]{影隈(4)}

如果玩家角色没有意识到危险，尸杉便会猛然活动起来，从死去的杉树上撕裂脱身，并在蹒跚前进时带走大量死树的材料。与此同时，还会发生另外两件事。首先，嵌在树皮里的四张脸也会挣脱出来，拖曳着成捆的枯枝与树皮。它们是身穿长袍的影熊忍咄噜，那些长袍看起来与丹杉寺中那些堕落武僧所穿的相似。所有这些生物都使用隐秘掷先攻。与此同时，高耸的杉树轰然倒下，树干沿着尸根破体而出后留下的裂口四分五裂。尸根可以控制树木倒下的方向，并会这样做，以便让尽可能多的玩家角色落入一个从房间中央射出的 @Template[type:cone|distance:40] 内。该区域内的角色受到 [[/r 8d6[bludgeoning]]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] 豁免），且任何在此次豁免中大失败的人都会被倒下的树木禁足（挣脱 DC 27）。

如果玩家角色认出了危险并率先攻击，则尸杉与影熊忍咄噜使用察觉掷先攻。在这种情况下，当死去的杉树倒下时，尸根无法控制其倒向，树会朝随机决定的方向倾倒（而任何被卷入该区域的玩家角色在对抗树木倒下的反射豁免上获得 +4 环境加值）。

无论是谁先开始战斗，影熊忍咄噜都会尖叫道：“闯入者！不信者！杀了他们！”然后蹒跚着向前发起攻击。它们在战斗开始时便已经显化出成捆的枝条、细枝和树皮。虽然上方的红色天空只提供微光照明，但这已经足够让四只影隐熊和阴影啃咬的潜在目标都投下阴影。
