The Great Willow.name: 大尊柳 The Great Willow
The Great Willow.text:
W37. 大尊柳

柳岸镇坐落于一片在地理上被称为三山的山地区域山脚下，此地因区域内三座主要山峰而得名。智惠大师在她的回忆录中写道，她在其中最低的一座山的山顶发现了一棵体型异常巨大的古老柳树。在与守护此树的木灵神使结为朋友后，智惠大师得知了重要的信息，而这些信息最终引领她前往西方的谭杉林。凭借这些知识，这棵所谓的“大柳树”的木灵神使多年来一直受到柳岸镇居民与来访朝圣者的崇敬。

货品：采集来的食物与非金属原材料

W37. The Great Willow

Willowshore rests at the foot of a mountainous region known geographically as the Trimountains, named due to the three major peaks in the area. In her memoir, Master Zhi Hui noted how she found an ancient willow tree of unusual size at the summit of the lowest of these mountains. After befriending the kodama kami who protected the tree, Master Zhi Hui learned vital information that eventually led her to the Tan Sugi grove to the west. For this knowledge, the kodama of the so-called “Great Willow” has received much reverence from both Willowshore and visiting pilgrims over the years.

Wares: foraged foods and nonmetallic raw materials

Bones of the Forgotten.name: 遗忘者之骨 Bones of the Forgotten
Bones of the Forgotten.text:
W36. 遗忘者之骨

柳岸镇和许多偏远村落一样，也有自己的一套律法。重罪通常会被处以流放，除非此人的技能或知识仍有用处——那样的话，惩罚便是终身监禁。处决并不常见，因为被流放进幽魂之森往往本身就等同于死刑。

那些罪大恶极的罪犯，会被人在头皮上刺下罪印；死后，这道纹印还会被刻到骨头上，因此即使人已死亡、肉身腐朽，印记依然留存。带有罪印的尸体——无论来自柳岸镇、其他村落，还是龙华——都只能葬在这片杂草丛生、无人打理的区域里。

过去，这里的坟墓并没有标记；但最近竖起了几根木桩，上面挂着纸制手里剑，仿佛是在无声抗议，表示埋葬于此的人或许死得并不公正。又或者，这是试图阻止一个愤懑而复仇心切的幽灵出现。

W36. Bones of the Forgotten

Willowshore, like many remote villages, has its own set of laws. Grievous crimes were punished with exile unless the individual’s skill or knowledge was needed—the punishment was then permanent imprisonment. Executions were rare, as being exiled into Specterwood was often a death sentence in itself.

Particularly vile criminals had a Mark of Crime tattooed onto their scalp, and after death, this tattoo was transferred to the bones through carving, meaning even in death and decomposition, the mark remained. Bodies with a Mark of Crime—be it from Willowshore, another village, or Lung Wa—can only be buried in this overgrown and unkept area.

While graves were unmarked in the past, a few wooden posts have been erected recently and paper shuriken hung off them, seemingly in silent protest that the ones buried beneath might have died an unjust death. Or perhaps this is an attempt to stave off the rise of a bitter, vengeful ghost.

The Leshy’s Saloon.name: 蕈人酒馆 The Leshy’s Saloon
The Leshy’s Saloon.text:
W35. 蕈人酒馆

当地的莱西已经记不得他们是什么时候来到这片地区的了，只记得那是在柳岸镇建立很久以前。他们直到定居点扩张、无可避免时，才正式加入柳岸镇。在结盟家族的帮助下，贪婪的木材领主被挡在外面，莱西们建立起了自己的茶园生意，背着长方形竹制背篓，里面装着泡好的茶和茶具，走上道路做买卖。有些会高声叫卖口号，另一些则用简单的木鱼通知顾客他们到了。这些四处行商的人很快就成了柳岸镇生活中的一景与日常的一部分。自从青天茶馆关闭后，山巅草（玩世不恭的无性别莱西制茶师）——这群莱西的领袖——越来越专注于为他们偏爱的本地顾客调配专属的茶叶混合配方。

货物：陶土茶具、茶叶

W35. The Leshy’s Saloon

The local leshies don’t recall when they came to the region, just that it was long before Willowshore was founded. They didn’t officially join Willowshore until the expansion of the settlement made it inevitable. With allied families keeping the greedy lumber lords away, the leshies built their own tea farm business, taking to the roads with brewed tea and teaware stashed in rectangular bamboo backpacks. Some would shout slogans, while others used a simple temple block to inform customers of their arrival. These traveling merchants soon became an attraction and staple of Willowshore life. Ever since the Cerulean Teahouse closed, Mountain Summit Grass (irreverent agender leshy teamaker), the leader of this band of leshies, has been increasingly focusing on creating bespoke blends of tea for individual local customers they favor.

Wares: clay pottery tea ware, tea leaves

Spider Gate.name: 蜘蛛门 Spider Gate
Spider Gate.text:
W33. 蜘蛛门

断刃之夜后，柳岸镇的镇长屈从于民众的要求，在城镇入口增设了一盏新的提灯，以加强位于城镇中心的长明灯所提供的防护。原本的计划是由柳岸镇的木匠建造一座可悬挂提灯的鸟居或天枢门，但一位龙华贵族主动提出免费赠送一只原本摆在他花园里的石制守护蜘蛛，因为它已经不再符合花园的装饰风格。

大多数柳岸镇居民都觉得这尊巨大的雕像是他们见过最丑的东西。不过，他们仍然认为雕像中寄宿着守护精魂，因此始终对它心怀敬意。久而久之，村民们接受了这位独特的入口守护者，甚至把它当成了吉祥物，还给它取名为“丑萌”。丑萌用尖牙叼着的那盏提灯只是普通提灯，不像晨步桥那里的长明灯，但柳岸镇的人民同样珍视它，并努力让它始终保持点亮。

W33. Spider Gate

After the Night of Broken Blades, Willowshore’s governor caved to the demand for a new lantern at the entrance of the town to augment the protection afforded by the Eternal Lantern at the town’s heart. While the original plan was for the carpenters of Willowshore to build a tori gate or Tian-shu gateway on which lanterns could be hung, a Lung Wa aristocrat offered a free stone guardian spider from his garden since it no longer fit in with the garden’s decorations.

Most Willowshorers thought the giant statue was the ugliest thing they’d ever seen. Nevertheless, they assumed the statue housed a guardian spirit and respected it accordingly. In time, villagers accepted their unique entrance guardian, even adopting it as their mascot and naming it “Ugly Cute.” The lantern Ugly Cute holds in its fangs is a regular lantern, unlike the Eternal Lantern found at Dawnstep Bridge, but the people of Willowshore value it just as much and strive to keep it lit at all times.

The Mushroom House.name: 蘑菇屋 The Mushroom House
The Mushroom House.text:
W32. 蘑菇屋

这座偏远的砖砌农舍散发着腐朽与粪肥的气味。不过，所有人都知道，这座农舍里生长的可不只有蘑菇。只要价格合适，蘑菇屋几乎什么都能种出来。卢达·巴马（善于操控他人的女性半身人走私者）是一位身手矫健、上了年纪的半身人女性，也是这个非法市场的头目；她是在胡婆婆的明确许可下经营这里的。

货物：冒险道具、药物、毒素、纹身

W32. The Mushroom House

This remote brick farmhouse smells of decay and manure. Everyone knows that mushrooms aren’t the only things growing in the farmhouse, though. For the right price, the Mushroom House can grow almost anything. Luda Bama (manipulative female halfling smuggler), a spry, elderly halfling woman, is the head of this illicit market, which she runs with the explicit permission of Granny Hu.

Wares: adventuring gear, drugs, poisons, tattoos

Dock.name: 码头 Dock
Dock.text:
W31. 码头

大坝建成后，柳岸镇的旧码头被封堵，因此需要在木棉河河口修建一座新码头。新码头由拉朱尔·萨穆德拉（沉静的男性娜迦吉造船匠）运营和管理；他受雇于木棉河-杜月江瓦市，正是因为他精湛的造船技艺。

货物：河船租赁与出售

W31. Dock

After the construction of the dam, Willowshore’s old dock was blocked off, thus requiring the construction of a new dock at the mouth of the Ceiba River. The new dock is operated and managed by Rajul Samudra (serene male nagaji shipwright), who was hired by the Ceiba-Duyue Exchange specifically for his boat-building skills.

Wares: river boat rentals and sales

Fisheries.name: 渔场 Fisheries
Fisheries.text:
W30. 渔场

鱼类是柳岸镇的重要食物来源。当地人传统上会捕捉整群的鱼，保存超过一定大小的鱼，并把小鱼养在自家后院的池塘里。如今，这种做法已经扩大了规模，不过渔民们还没能做到让这里的养鱼池得以无限期维持。

座泽（善于观察的女性鼠族渔民）是柳岸镇首屈一指的养鱼人；她感知天气变化的能力让她在这一行中占尽优势。

货物：风干或熏制的鱼和虾、肥料、捕鱼道具、昆虫鱼饵

W30. Fisheries

Fish is an important food source for Willowshore. Locals traditionally capture entire schools of fish, preserve those above a certain size, and raise small ones in their backyard ponds. Today, this practice has been expanded, though the fishers have yet to reach a point where the fishery ponds here can be maintained indefinitely.

Zataku (observant female ratfolk fisher) is Willowshore’s foremost fish keeper; her ability to sense weather changes gives her the perfect edge in her occupation.

Wares: dried or smoked fish and shrimp, fertilizer, fishing gear, insect bait

The Ceiba-Duyue Exchange.name: 木棉河-杜月江瓦市 The Ceiba-Duyue Exchange
The Ceiba-Duyue Exchange.text:
W29. 木棉河-杜月江瓦市

当总督和善保在柳岸镇上任后，他下令在此建造数座新仓库和一座贸易栈，希望借此扩展城镇的产业，并加强与海岸要塞唐入之间的联系。在胡婆婆的建议下，善保亲自挑选了当地国府幸祭司金久元（有耐心的男性人类牧师）担任瓦市主管。久元不情不愿地接受了这份差事，因为他知道，凭胡婆婆手里握着的把柄，他根本无法拒绝。

货物：饮品、神圣卷轴、食物与香料、符箓、原矿、纺织品

W29. The Ceiba-Duyue Exchange

When Governor Heh Shan-Bao took office in Willowshore, he ordered several new warehouses and a trade office to be built here, hoping to expand the town’s industry and connection with the coastal fortress of Karahai. On Granny Hu’s advice, Shan-Bao handpicked the local Kofusachi priest, Kim Gu-won (patient male human cleric), to take the post of Exchange Manager. Gu-won reluctantly accepted the job, knowing that with what Granny Hu has on him, he wouldn’t be able to refuse.

Wares: beverages, divine scrolls, foods and spices, fulus, raw mineral, textiles

Mother’s Coil.name: 慈母之环 Mother’s Coil
Mother’s Coil.text:
W28. 慈母之环

在柳岸镇中，魔法传统上被视为神圣赐福的显现、人与精魂世界的联系，或仅仅是手法与心智的把戏。大多数人直到苏萨杜斯的安贾尔——一位年迈的娜迦吉法师——到来之后，才真正开始理解它也可以是一门能够被研究和学习的学问。安贾尔约在15年前来到此地，发现柳岸镇的天气对他们的干鳞症颇为温和，于是从一位打算搬到司泽城的农夫手中买下了一块土地。几乎一夜之间，一座纳迦卓风格的黑色玄武岩高塔便拔地而起，令村民们惊叹不已。

尽管对魔法感到好奇，大多数村民仍觉得这个话题艰深难近，更别提并不实用了。因此，安贾尔只有一名学徒——十兵卫。她还是个孩子时，曾被一对不负责任的“父母”遗弃在柳岸镇；那两人假扮成富有的商人，却在欠账未清的情况下逃离了城镇。安贾尔对竟有人胆敢如此危害一个孩子而怒不可遏；在其那林尼瓦提信仰的驱使下，这位年迈的法师将惊恐万分的十兵卫收留为己出。

如今，十兵卫已经成长为一名能干的年轻人。尽管安贾尔在去年去世令人悲痛，十兵卫仍决心通过她养父母留下的书籍继续钻研奥术艺术。

货物：奥术与异能卷轴、配方与食谱、魔杖

W28. Mother’s Coil

Magic was traditionally seen in Willowshore as either a manifestation of divine blessing, one’s connection to the spirit world, or just a trick of the hand and mind. Most folks didn’t quite understand it as a topic to be studied and learned until the arrival of Anjal of Thulsadus, an old nagaji wizard. Arriving about 15 years ago, Anjal found the weather of Willowshore to be gentle on their dryscale condition and thus bought a plot of land from a farmer looking to relocate to the city of Sze. Overnight, a Nagajor-styled tower of dark basalt appeared, much to the awe of the villagers.

Though curious about magic, most villagers find the topic to be formidable and unapproachable, not to mention impractical. Thus, Anjal had only one apprentice, Jubei, a child they raised after she was abandoned in Willowshore by a pair of irresponsible “parents” who posed as well-off merchants but then fled town without paying their bills. Infuriated that anyone dared endanger a child so, Anjal’s Nalinivatian beliefs prompted the old wizard to take the terrified Jubei in as their own.

Jubei has since grown into a capable young adult. While Anjal’s death last year was tragic, Jubei is determined to continue studying the arcane arts through the books her adopted parent left behind.

Wares: arcane and occult scrolls, formulas and recipes, wands

The Hand of Spring.name: 春之手 The Hand of Spring
The Hand of Spring.text:
W27. 春之手

在达米汉西格·马巴邦洛布医生到来之前，柳岸镇的医疗护理在很大程度上依赖民间偏方、草药汤剂和云游祭司。此人是一位和善的人类男医生，不过人人都简称他为达米。达米结合针灸、提纯化学药剂和外科手术来为人诊治。尽管他的疗法并非柳岸镇居民所习惯的方式，达米仍因其乐善好施而声名渐起——比起金钱收益，他更关心自己的病人。

货品：炼金治疗物品、医师工具包补给、非魔法治疗物品

W27. The Hand of Spring

Willowshore relied heavily on home remedies, herbal droughts, and traveling priests for medical care until the arrival of Doctor Damihansig Mababangloob (kindly male human doctor), whom everyone calls Dami for short. Dami uses a mix of acupuncture, purified chemicals, and surgery to provide care. Though his treatments aren’t what Willowshore is used to, Dami has developed quite a reputation for being a charitable doctor who cares more about his patients than monetary gain.

Wares: alchemical healing items, healer’s kit supplies, nonmagical healing items

Second Best.name: 第二佳作坊 Second Best
Second Best.text:
W26. 第二佳作坊

五年前，霍天哲（谦逊的男性人类发明家）与父亲从唐入（柳岸镇以东最近的邻近定居点）来到镇上，协助维护柳岸大坝。这个在城市长大的儿子原以为，自己终于能教教这些“乡下二流铁匠”该怎么把事情办好。然而没过多久，天哲便意识到，自己的技艺甚至比不上永焰铁坊里最年轻的学徒，而那些设计花哨的农用器具，与其说是精妙机械，不如说更像玩具。受到打击后，天哲请求父亲留在柳岸镇，好让自己学着成为一名“有用的铁匠”。天哲的父亲虽不情愿地答应了这个请求，却还是给了儿子一把金币，让他去订做一块新的商店招牌。为了提醒自己，天哲大胆地将自己的工坊命名为“第二佳作坊”。

天哲的产品已赢得了一些忠实顾客，而他对机械的了解也打动了雍武秀，使这位年迈的铁匠将大坝维护的工作交给了他。

商品：冒险工具、炼金弹药、炼金炸弹、发条装置，以及简易护甲、金属武器和盾牌

W26. Second Best

When Huo Tian-Zhe (humble male human inventor) arrived in town with his father from Karahai (Willowshore’s closest neighboring settlement to the east) five years ago to assist with the maintenance of Willowshore’s dam, the urban-born son thought he was about to show the “second-rated smiths of the countryside” how to get things done. Quickly, Tian-Zhe realized his skills were subpar to even the youngest apprentice of the Eternal Blaze and that his fancily-designed farm gadgets were more akin to toys than machines of marvels. Humbled, Tian-Zhe asked his father to stay in Willowshore so he could learn to be a “smith of use.” Begrudgingly accepting the request, Tian-Zhe’s father nevertheless gave his son a handful of gold to order a new shop sign. As a reminder to himself, Tian-Zhe boldly named his workshop “Second Best.”

Tian-Zhe’s products have garnered some loyal customers, and his knowledge of machinery won over Yong Wu-Xiu such that the old smith tasked him with the maintenance of the dam.

Wares: adventuring tools, alchemical ammunition, alchemical bombs, clockwork gadgets, and simple armor, metal weapons, and shields

Mercantile Street.name: 商贸街 Mercantile Street
Mercantile Street.text:
W25. 商贸街

柳岸镇较新的商家，尤其是那些与木雕有关的，大多都位于商贸街沿线的一栋栋红砖建筑中。为了确保木材大亨们不会偏袒任何人，木雕师们联合起来成立了一个行会，让年轻学徒在学艺期间有机会到不同的商店实习。云梦昂（天赋出众的女性木雕师）是现任由选举产生的木雕师行会首领，正是这种培养方式的成果。尽管她的工作备受赞誉，梦昂却更想成为一名画家或珠宝匠。

商品：艺术品、木制品、木质宗教象征物

W25. Mercantile Street

Willowshore’s newer businesses, particularly those associated with woodcarving, are mostly found in one of the red-brick buildings along Mercantile Street. To ensure the lumber lords would never favor anyone, the woodcarvers came together to form a guild, through which young apprentices have the opportunity to intern at different shops during their apprenticeship. Yun Mong-Un (talented female human woodcarver), the woodcarver’s current elected guild leader, is a product of such training. Though heaped with praise for her work, Mong-Un would rather be a painter or jewelry maker.

Wares: artwork, wood items, wooden religious symbols

Abandoned Estates.name: 废弃庄园 Abandoned Estates
Abandoned Estates.text:
W23. 废弃庄园

这些被废弃的木材大亨庄园在被彻底洗劫一空后，只偶尔被当作发泄室或胆量挑战的场所。其中一栋房子里有一座献给黛丝娜的废弃圣祠，许多人都在疑惑，是否该由某个人将这位女神迎入自己家中，而不是让她继续被遗落在庄园废墟里。

W23. Abandoned Estates

The abandoned lumber lords’ estates, after being thoroughly picked clean, were left to serve as the occasional rage room or dare challenge. An abandoned shrine to Desna sits in one of the houses, and many have questioned if someone should accept the goddess into their home instead of leaving her bereft in the estate ruins.

The Cerulean Teahouse.name: 青天茶馆 The Cerulean Teahouse
The Cerulean Teahouse.text:
W22. 青天茶馆

柳岸镇的木材业头头们一向自视甚高，与“平民百姓”混在一起的想法令他们颇为不快。贵族青麦莱的解决之道，便是在靠近这些木材大亨宅邸的地方建立了这座精致建筑。

青天茶馆凭借丰盛的奢华饮食、酒水与表演，迅速兴旺起来。然而，新鲜感一过，生意也很快冷清下来。尽管如此，麦莱仍坚持经营，先是将茶馆的重心转为承办茶饭，随后与莱希沙龙合作，将此地作为门面，最后又改作灵活经营的住宿兼早餐旅店。就在麦莱终于还清这处产业贷款后的几天，龙华崩溃的消息传到了柳岸镇。麦莱至此决定收手，并宣布退休；但她试图将茶馆的控制权转交给家人的努力却遇上了麻烦，因为很明显，她的亲属中没有人愿意搬到柳岸镇。上一年冬季初，麦莱去世时，这门生意的归属仍未确定，因为她始终没有留下遗嘱。如今，青天茶馆空置无人，正缓缓破败下去。

W22. The Cerulean Teahouse

Willowshore’s lumber bosses thought very highly of themselves, and the idea of mingling with the “common folk” rankled them. Aristocrat Qing Mai-Lai’s solution was the establishment of this fine structure, close to the lumber lords’ estates.

The Cerulean Teahouse took off quickly, thanks to its plentiful offerings of extravagant food, drinks, and performances. However, once the novelty wore off, business quickly died. Still, Mai-Lai persevered, first by changing the teahouse’s focus to banquet catering, then by collaborating with The Leshy’s Salon as a storefront, and finally as a flexible bed-and-breakfast. Just days after Mai-Lai finally paid off the loan on the property, news of Lung Wa’s collapse reached Willowshore. Mai-Lai called it quits at that point and announced her retirement, but her attempts to transfer control of the Teahouse to family met with complications after it became apparent that none of her relations wanted to move to Willowshore. When Mai-Lai passed away early in the previous winter, ownership of the business was still undetermined, for Mai-Lai never submitted a will. Today, the Cerulean Teahouse stands vacant and is slowly falling into ruin.

Luo and Laws.name: 骆氏状所 Luo and Laws
Luo and Laws.text:
W20. 骆氏状所

龙华的法律在一次次被谋取私利的统治者修订后，早已成了一堆自相矛盾的条文，让像骆熙旸这样独立执业的律师（热切的人类女性律师）得以靠试图理清其中头绪而过上体面的生活。受邀她前来的木材巨头们曾向她保证，乡村生活压力会小得多，于是熙旸只带着最基本的10卷《帝国法典汇编》来到此地。很快，这位律师便发现，柳岸镇的法律问题与她先前在司泽城中遇到的相比一样复杂，甚至有过之而无不及，因此她的图书馆也扩充到了旧居藏书规模的两倍。

W20. Luo and Laws

Lung Wa’s laws, after being revised time and time again by self-serving rulers, are a bag of contradictions allowing independent lawyers, such as Luo Xi Yang (eager female human lawyer), to make a decent living attempting to make sense of them. Promised by the lumber lords who invited her here that rural life would be less stressful, Xi Yang arrived with only the essential 10-volume Imperial Compendium. Quickly, the lawyer discovered that Willowshore’s legal issues were as complicated, if not more so, than what she’d previously encountered in the city of Sze, and thus her library grew to a size that doubled the one in her former home.

Downtown Willowshore.name: 柳岸镇镇区 Downtown Willowshore
Downtown Willowshore.text:
W19. 柳岸镇镇区

柳岸镇镇区依然是镇上主要的活动中心。东北方矗立着总督的宅邸与办事书房，这里同时也兼作村中的银行与宝库。庄园以南是帝皇兵营，由郑鹏（沉稳寡言的男性人类执勤官）统领。十字路口北面是村里每周举行蜀戏表演的戏台，属于七彩鸣雀剧场的一部分，场地由大野一真（善于交际的男性狐人导演）负责管理。道路两旁附近分别坐落着柳岸镇最繁忙的商铺之一树雀居，以及柳岸镇唯一的公共浴场乐河童浴场。树雀居是一家由家族经营的杂货店，由名户屋三美（友善的女性人类家族女家长）打理；而乐河童浴场的老板华德歌（健谈的男性半身人浴场老板）则因对清洁的执迷而在镇上闻名。

货物：酒精、沐浴、娱乐、谷物、家居用品与工具、腌制食品、口粮

W19. Downtown Willowshore

Downtown Willowshore remains a major hub of activity in town. To the northeast stands the governor’s home and office, which also serves as the village’s bank and treasury. South of the manor lie the imperial barracks, commanded by Zheng Peng (stoic male human watch officer). To the north of the crossroad is the stage for the village’s weekly Shu Opera performance, which is part of the Seven-Colored Songbird theater, a venue officiated over by Kazuma Oono (gregarious male kitsune director). Nearby on opposite sides of the road is one of Willowshore’s busiest stores, Treesparrow’s Rest, and Willowshore’s only public bathhouse, the Happy Kappa. Treesparrow’s is a family-owned grocery store run by Nadoya Sanmi (friendly female human family matriarch), while the Happy Kappa’s owner, De-Ge Hua (chatty male halfling bathhouse owner) is famous in town for his obsession with cleanliness.

Wares: alcohol, bathing, entertainment, grains, household supplies and tools, preserved foods, rations

Willowshore Dam.name: 柳岸大坝 Willowshore Dam
Willowshore Dam.text:
W18. 柳岸镇大坝

柳岸镇的大坝是一项小型工程奇迹。它的主体由巨大、严丝合缝的深灰色大理石板构成，表面雕刻着经过精密计算的弧度。大坝有两扇巨大的木制门，可以关闭或开启，以降低湖水水位。转动控制门的轮盘会自动使铃声响起，提醒下游的任何人撤离到安全地带。

W18. Willowshore Dam

Willowshore’s dam is a minor engineering marvel. Its main body is constructed out of immense, precisely fitted slabs of dark-gray marble, carved with a carefully calculated curvature. The dam has two giant wooden gates that can be closed or opened to lower the level of the lake. Turning the wheel that controls the gates automatically causes a bell to ring, signaling anyone downriver to move away to safety.

Woodraft Lake.name: 木筏湖 Woodraft Lake
Woodraft Lake.text:
W17. 木筏湖

第一位由龙华任命到柳岸镇的总督，曾试图通过各种工程壮举来驯服臭名昭著的木棉河。这项努力的一部分，再加上木材需要湿储存，促成了柳岸镇大坝——以及由此形成的木筏湖——的修建。

起初，许多人都反对这项工程，因为形成的湖泊会淹没一些房屋和农田——其中也包括村里供奉难病夫人的圣祠。几次监禁之后，所有抱怨都平息了。大坝最终如期完工。那位总督也因此获得晋升，并在不久后离开了柳岸镇，但还没来得及享受升迁之喜，便在一个阳光明媚的日子里被山体滑坡掩埋。尽管这个故事的真实性多少有些可疑，但此后的历任总督从未阻止柳岸镇的村民将这片湖泊视为苦难寡妇的圣祠。

W17. Woodraft Lake

The first governor appointed to Willowshore by Lung Wa made an effort to tame the notorious Ceiba River through various engineering feats. Part of that effort, plus the demand for wet storage for wood, led to the construction of the Willowshore Dam—and by extension, Woodraft Lake.

Many protested the construction at first, as the resulting lake would submerge some homes and farmlands—including the village’s shrine to Lady Nanbyo. A few imprisonments later, all complaints ceased. The dam was completed in due time. While the governor earned themself a promotion and left Willowshore soon after, they didn’t get to enjoy before a landslide buried them on a bright sunny day. While the story’s veracity is somewhat dubious, subsequent governors have never stopped Willowshore’s villagers from treating the lake as a shrine to the Widow of Suffering.

Nine Ear Shrine.name: 九耳神社 Nine Ear Shrine
Nine Ear Shrine.text:
W16. 九耳神社

这间泥墙小屋从外面看起来像是一座粮食储存屋。其内部向下延伸10尺，深入地下一处以石材砌衬的封闭空间；空间中央矗立着一尊15尺高的九尾狐大理石雕像。它的颈上垂挂着一条由干草编成的大型魂魄之绳。地下室的墙壁上装饰着彩绘雕刻，描绘了大吉津的故事。

十五年前，欧家一位走投无路的母亲在这里藏起了她的婴儿，当时一家人正被一名腐败的守卫押去处决。等守卫们发现少了这个孩子时，一大群狐狸已经包围了神殿。守卫们不愿招致神圣之怒，于是撤退了。家族的盟友不久后赶来救出了婴儿，而狐狸们也在那时消失无踪。

那个婴儿——欧跋鸣（虔诚的女性人类祭司）——在远亲的照料下长大。尽管她显露出欧家崇敬自然的倾向，欧跋鸣仍希望通过侍奉大吉津来报答这份救命之恩。虽然有些人质疑她的动机，但大多数柳岸居民都支持她的奉献。

货品：符箓、卷轴、护符

W16. Nine Ear Shrine

This mud-wall hut looks like a grain storage hut from the outside. Its interior descends 10 feet underground into an enclosed space lined with stone, in the middle of which sits a 15-foot-tall marble statue of a nine-tailed fox. A large spiritual rope made of hay hangs off its neck. The walls of the basement are decorated with painted carvings that depict stories of Daikitsu.

Fifteen years ago, a desperate mother of the Ouh family hid her baby here as the family was rounded up for execution by a corrupt guard. By the time the guards learned about the missing offspring, a large skulk of foxes had surrounded the temple. Unwilling to tempt divine wrath, the guards retreated. Allies of the family soon arrived to rescue the baby, at which point the foxes vanished.

That baby, Ba-Ming Ouh (devoted female human priest), grew up under the care of distant relatives. While she shows signs of the Ouh family’s inclinations toward the veneration of nature, Ba-Ming wishes to return her life debt by serving Daikitsu. While some question her intentions, most Willowshorers support her dedication.

Wares: fulus, scrolls, talismans

Industrial District.name: 工业区 Industrial District
Industrial District.text:
W13-W15. 工业区

柳岸镇龙华的木材业老板们还经营着许多与从林地获取的材料相关的其他生意。许多工业工人专门为了这份工作来到柳岸镇，把家人和朋友留在了身后。

木材业老板们离开后，赫总督夺取了控制权，并命令劳工们继续工作。由于自己对此事毫无选择权而感到愤怒，他们最近一直在夜晚时分聚集，在川冈（虔诚的男性天狗行会首领）、一位资深赌盘经纪人的带领下，商议该如何与总督谈判，好让那些想离开的人获准离开，也让那些选择留下的人得到公平报酬。

随着龙华的垮台，这里许多曾经兴盛的商店都已关门。如今仍在营业的只有云纸坊（由川冈经营的造纸坊）、玉液琼浆（一家蒸馏酒坊）以及里氏制革厂（一家制革坊）。

货品：酒精、精油和香水、玻璃器皿和玻璃物品、皮革与兽皮制品、纸张及纸制品，如法术书和配方簿

W13-W15. Industrial District

Willowshore’s Lung Wa lumber bosses had a host of other businesses related to materials taken from the woods. Many industrial workers came to Willowshore explicitly for this work, leaving family and friends behind.

After the lumber bosses left, Governor Heh seized control and ordered the laborers to continue working. Upset that they had no choice in the matter, they’ve been gathering late at night under the guidance of Kawaka (devoted male tengu guild leader), a senior bookmaker, to discuss how they should negotiate with the governor to release those who want to leave and fairly pay those who elect to stay.

With the collapse of Lung Wa, many of the businesses that once thrived here have closed up shop. The only ones still functioning are Cloud Paper House (a paper mill run by Kawaka), Jadeite Essentials (a distillery), and Rebel’s Leatherworks (a tannery).

Wares: alcohol, essential oils and perfume, glassware and glass items, hide and leather items, paper and paper products such as spellbooks and formula books

Dawnstep Bridge.name: 晨步桥 Dawnstep Bridge
Dawnstep Bridge.text:
W11. 晨步桥

长明灯

这件小型神器是一件不可移动的物体，由丹杉寺的创建者智惠赠予柳岸镇。纵观这座城镇的全部历史，长明灯始终矗立在定居点核心附近守望着；自从智惠往其中放入几枚铜钱后，它的光芒便从未摇曳。有人相信，只要往长明灯中放入铜钱，便能从柳岸镇中那些圣祠所供奉的神祇处获得祝福，以换取额外的防护；但大多数时候，柳岸镇的人民早已习惯了这盏立于晨步桥南侧台阶旁、长燃不熄的提灯。

在三福青楼建立之后（但在它变成旅店之前），柳岸镇的人口规模已增长到按神门的标准可被视为一座城镇，这意味着城中必须始终在入口附近、主要十字路口，或桥边维持一盏点亮的提灯。这些地点若缺少点亮的提灯，便意味着城镇已被废弃，而人们相信这会招来害虫、幽灵、危险的野兽，甚至更糟之物。如今，柳岸镇有两盏这样的提灯，但矗立于此的这一盏——长明灯——既是其中最古老的，也是最著名的。

W11. Dawnstep Bridge

The Eternal Lantern

This minor artifact is an immobile object gifted to the town of Willowshore by the founder of the Tan Sugi monastery, Zhi Hui. For the town’s entire history, the Eternal Lantern has stood sentinel near the settlement’s heart, its light never wavering after Zhi Hui placed a few copper coins within it. Some believe that it’s possible to receive blessings from the deities whose shrines stand in Willowshore by placing copper coins within the Eternal Lantern in exchange for additional protection, but for the most part, the people of Willowshore have become used to the ever-burning lantern at the southern steps of Dawnstep Bridge.

After the Thrice-Blessed Brothel was established (but before it became an inn), Willowshore’s population had grown enough in size to be considered a town by Shenmen standards, meaning that a lit lantern must be maintained at all times within the town near the entrance, at a major crossroads, or at a bridge. The lack of a lit lantern at one of these locations suggests that the town is abandoned, which is believed to invite vermin, ghosts, dangerous beasts, and worse. Today, Willowshore features two such lanterns, but the one that stands here, the Eternal Lantern, is both its oldest and most notable.

Lady of Souls.name: 司魂娘娘 Lady of Souls
Lady of Souls.text:
W9. 司魂娘娘

龙华最初扩张至柳岸镇时，首要关切之一便是降低亡灵暴动的可能性。他们通过建造一座献给法拉斯玛的大教堂来解决这个问题。

伊莉泽丝·坎多拉（富有同理心的女性人类牧师）是一位来自过峡的第二代塔尔丹移民，也是如今此地的女祭司。艾莉泽丝小时候曾到访过柳岸镇和丹杉寺院，当时的她从未想过，成为一名法拉斯玛牧师竟会让她有机会永久回到这个她记忆犹新的村庄。她将这份巧合视为法拉斯玛之手所安排的命运，因此始终恪尽职守、勤勉服务。她喜欢独自在墓园里与自己的长笛相伴，也常在那里吹奏，帮助安抚那些新近安葬于此者的灵魂。

货物：消耗性宗教物品、神圣卷轴

W9. Lady of Souls

One of Lung Wa’s chief concerns when they first expanded into Willowshore was to reduce the likelihood of an undead uprising. They solved it by building a cathedral to Pharasma.

Elizeth Candora (empathetic female human cleric), a second-generation Taldan from Goka, is the current priestess here. Having once visited Willowshore and the Tan Sugi monastery as a child, Elizeth never imagined that becoming a cleric of Pharasma would lead to an opportunity for her to permanently return to the village she vividly recalls. She sees the coincidence as fate arranged by Pharasma’s hands and therefore serves dutifully and diligently. She’s fond of spending time alone in the graveyard with her flute and often plays the instrument there to help soothe the spirits of those recently buried therein.

Wares: consumable religious items, divine scrolls

Milling Houses.name: 磨坊 Milling Houses
Milling Houses.text:
W8. 磨坊

柳岸镇有许多磨坊，其中两座以水力驱动，三座以风力驱动，还有十座由人力或役畜驱动。数量充足，确保即使有一两座磨坊因例行维护或故障停用，也绝不会危及村子的日常所需。

磨坊里的工作强度很大，而且由于每天的需求不同，工时也常常不规律。磨坊工们的领袖乔春虎（乐于支持他人的男性人类磨坊工）靠着鼓励众人、顶住不合理的要求、维持工资稳定，以及提供午夜点心，来保持大家的士气高昂。

商品：脱壳谷物、谷物面粉、石制物品

W8. Milling Houses

Willowshore has numerous millhouses, including two powered by water, three by wind, and ten powered by people or draft animals. The abundance ensures that losing one or two mills to routine maintenance or malfunction never jeopardizes the village’s needs.

Work at the mills is intense, and the hours can be irregular due to the demand each day. The millers’ leader, Choe Chung-hu (supportive male human miller), keeps morale high with encouragement, pushing back against unreasonable demands, keeping wages stable, and offering midnight snacks.

Wares: De-husked grain, grain flour, stone objects

Silvermist Lodges.name: 银雾斋 Silvermist Lodges
Silvermist Lodges.text:
W7. 银雾斋

银雾斋分布在城镇南边林地中的两处小型院落里。每处地点的旅舍木作都顺着木材纹理塑形，使这些建筑呈现出一种与精灵建筑相关的有机风貌。早年柳岸镇刚开始尝试自给自足时，曾有八位精灵冒险者来到这里，接受了在村中定居的提议；以他们的寿命来看，这不过是一份短期契约。尽管这最初的八位精灵如今已无人仍居住在柳岸镇，他们却留下了许多子嗣与后裔。

货物：动物部件、捕索补给

W7. Silvermist Lodges

The Silvermist Lodges are split between two small compounds in the woods south of town. At each location, the lodges’ woodwork conforms to the grain of the wood, giving the buildings an organic look associated with elven architecture. In the days when Willowshore first tried to become self-sufficient, eight elven adventurers came and took up an offer to settle in the village, seeing the request as a short-term contract given their life spans. Though none of these original eight elves live in Willowshore anymore, they left many offspring and descendants behind.

Wares: animal parts, snare supplies

Thrice-Blessed Inn.name: 三福客栈 Thrice-Blessed Inn
Thrice-Blessed Inn.text:
W6. 三福客栈

柳岸镇的三福客栈最初是三福青楼，因为它是由三位分别信奉国府幸、卡莉丝翠雅与希琳的神职人员创办的。政治上的纠葛迫使青楼老板奥蒂丝妈妈（精明的性别流动半精灵旅店老板）在龙华崩溃前仅仅数年关闭了这家店。借助柳岸镇本地律师骆熙旸的帮助，奥蒂丝妈妈得以援引一条鲜为人知的法律，既避免了自己被驱逐，也得以继续将这栋建筑作为客栈经营。

W6. Thrice-Blessed Inn

Willowshore’s Thrice-Blessed Inn began as the Thrice-Blessed Brothel, for it was founded by three clerics of Kofusachi, Calistria, and Shelyn. Political complications forced the brothel’s owner, Mother Otis (canny genderfluid half-elf innkeeper), to shut down the establishment only a few years before Lung Wa’s collapse. With the aid of Willowshore’s local lawyer, Luo Xi Yang, Mother Otis was able to rely upon an obscure law that prevented their eviction and allowed them to continue to operate the building as an inn.

Matsuki Estate.name: 松木宅邸 Matsuki Estate
Matsuki Estate.text:
W5. 松木宅邸

被柳岸镇人称作“松木老人”的人（怀旧的男性人类木匠）曾师从丹杉寺的首席木匠。离开师父后，他带领家人建起了一座大型的天书／明凯风格宅邸，供他们二十多口人一同居住。据说，这位迷信的家长随后特意让人用掺有受祝圣盐和圣水的石灰浆粉刷外墙。如今，松木老人是柳岸镇南岸派系中最有影响力的人物，并担任该派系的发言人。

W5. Matsuki Estate

The man that Willowshore calls “Old” Matsuki (nostalgic male human carpenter) once apprenticed to the head carpenter of the Tan Sugi monastery. After taking leave from his master, he led his family to construct a large Tian-shu/Minkaian estate to house all two dozen of them. Reportedly, the superstitious patriarch then made sure that the outer walls were whitewashed with limestone containing blessed salts and holy water. Today, Old Matsuki is the most influential of Willowshore’s Southbank faction and serves as the faction’s spokesman.

Abadar Shrine.name: 阿巴达尔神龛 Abadar Shrine
Abadar Shrine.text:
W4. 阿巴达尔神龛

这座雅致的神龛中安放着一尊3足高的石灰岩阿巴达尔雕像，它一手持铲，一手持泥刀。据说，这尊雕像最初先被运往过峡，在大银行举行仪式以迎请阿巴达尔的赐福，之后才用船运回柳岸镇。

W4. Abadar Shrine

This elegant shrine houses a 3-foot-tall limestone statue of Abadar that holds a shovel in one hand and a trowel in the other. The statue was reportedly taken to Goka first to ritualistically invite Abadar’s divine blessings at the Grand Bank before being ferried back to Willowshore.

Graveside Manners.name: 墓畔礼仪 Graveside Manners
Graveside Manners.text:
W3. 墓畔礼仪

柳岸镇的居民在早年实行火葬，以防止亡灵出现。这片古老墓园中的墓穴安放着许多早期定居者的骨灰瓮。如今，只有少数几个家族仍将墓畔礼仪用作埋葬之地。多亏了墓园的看守人尤素珍（一位神秘的女性精灵草药师），这里的墓碑始终不生地衣与苔藓。素珍曾是常去丹杉寺院的朝圣者；寺院倒塌后，她定居于柳岸镇，并经营着一家草药师商店——这也是如今人们造访墓畔礼仪的主要原因。

货物：炼金灵药与工具、炼金试剂、新鲜及干燥草药

W3. Graveside Manners

Willowshore’s residents practiced cremation in its early days to prevent undeath. The tombs in this old cemetery house the urns of many of those early settlers. Today, only a few families use Graveside Manners as a burial ground. The headstones remain free of lichen and moss thanks to the graveyard’s keeper, You So-Jin (mysterious female elf herbalist). Once a pilgrim who frequented the Tan Sugi monastery, So-Jin settled in Willowshore after the monastery’s collapse and maintains an herbalist shop—the primary reason anyone visits Graveside Manners today.

Wares: alchemical elixirs and tools, alchemical reagents, fresh and dried herbs

Willowshore Stables.name: 柳岸镇马厩 Willowshore Stables
Willowshore Stables.text:
W2. 柳岸镇马厩

柳岸镇马厩是镇上为家养动物、宠物和牲畜提供兽医服务的设施。顺带一提，柳岸镇马厩将牲畜用作驮兽的做法影响了村里的饮食文化，使许多家庭避免食用牛肉。店主昆舜重（富有关怀之心的男性人类兽医）和他十几岁的儿子孟松（尽职尽责的男性人类兽医）因其和善的态度以及对各种动物的怜爱而广为人知。

货物：动物租赁、坐骑护甲、鞍囊、陆行载具

W2. Willowshore Stables

Willowshore Stables is the town’s veterinary facility for household animals, pets, and livestock. Incidentally, Willowshore Stables’ use of livestock as beasts of burden influenced the village’s food culture, causing many households to avoid the consumption of beef. The owner, Kum Soon-chong (caring male human veterinarian), and his teenage son, Meng-sung (dutiful male human veterinarian), are well-known for their affable attitudes and compassion for all kinds of animals.

Wares: animal rentals, barding, saddle bags, land vehicles

Eternal Blaze Ironworks.name: 永焰铁工坊 Eternal Blaze Ironworks
Eternal Blaze Ironworks.text:
W1. 永焰铁工坊

在寺院建造的年代，永焰铁工坊负责打造各类金属制品，包括炊具、木工工具，以及铰链、锁和箱子的钥匙之类的小型金属零件。雍武秀（勤勉的女性狐人铁匠）大约在十年前从父亲手中继承了这门生意。

货物：金属制品、冒险道具（尤其是炊具）、金属护甲、金属武器、金属盾牌

W1. Eternal Blaze Ironworks

In the days of the monastery’s construction, the Eternal Blaze Ironworks was responsible for creating metal items from cookware, woodworking tools, and small metal parts, such as hinges, locks, and keys for chests. Yong Wu-Xiu (industrious female kitsune blacksmith) inherited the business from her father about a decade ago.

Wares: metalworks, adventuring gear (especially cookware), metal armor, metal weapons, metal shields

Willowshore Locations.name: 柳岸镇地点 Willowshore Locations
Willowshore Locations.text:
柳岸镇地点

下列页面详细介绍了柳岸镇中的重要建筑与关键人物，其编号对应城镇地图上的地点。未标注的建筑为木结构，可能是商店、住宅、农舍、储藏室，或根据其所在位置而有其他用途；在游戏主持许可下，也可以选作任何玩家角色的住处。

重新编号日志

为便于在共享的柳岸镇场景中进行交流，玩家指南已调整地点的顺序与编号，使其与游戏主持在完整冒险正文中所见一致。这意味着下方内容会与玩家指南 PDF 存在一些细微差异。

Willowshore Locations

Significant buildings and important people found in Willowshore are detailed on the following pages, with numbers corresponding to the locations on the town map. Unlabeled buildings are wooden structures that might be shops, homes, farmhouses, storerooms, or have other usage depending on their location and, with the GM’s permission, can be selected as homes for any PC.

RenumberingJournal

The order and numbering of locations have been changed in the Player's Guide to match what the GM sees in the full adventure text, to better facilitate communication on the shared Willowshore Scene. That means that the below will have small differences from the player's guide pdf.

People of Willowshore.name: 柳岸镇的人民 People of Willowshore
People of Willowshore.text:
柳岸镇的人民

柳岸镇的大多数居民都会按照自家最早是在何时定居镇上来认同自身身份，而这往往也会影响他们居住在木棉河的哪一岸。镇民的第一批浪潮，要么是参与寺院营建的人，要么是由寺院出资安置到柳岸镇定居的人。这些人最初住在河流南岸，因此被称为南岸人。另一方面，在龙华取得控制后到来的人，则定居在河北岸；那里因显著的斜坡而被称作北岭。这些定居者包括为木材老板工作的人、想要便利用到木材的商家，以及帝皇守卫。

尽管如今柳岸镇的这两派都使用“南岸”和“北岭”这些名称，但一个人的立场并不单由其居住或工作的地点决定。南岸居民较为传统，热衷于维持柳岸镇的文化，并以简朴方式靠土地生活。与此同时，北岭居民更重视务实与城镇发展。许多北岭人愿意接受络新妇统治神门这一想法，而南岸人则出于原则认为络新妇是邪恶怪物，最好敬而远之。

尽管存在分歧，双方仍一致认为应将柳岸镇的生存与安全放在首位。也有许多居民的看法两边都不偏，更认为自己不隶属于任何一派。总体而言，柳岸镇重视每个人都倾尽所能地付出。在许多方面，这座村庄也别无选择，尤其是在这场冒险的事件逐步发展之际。

在游玩《肆季鬼志》时，你们作为团体所采取的动作与做出的选择，将会在这两个派系中建立声望；随着游戏推进，你们的游戏主持掌握了追踪声望并在游戏中落实其效果所需的全部规则与指引。

柳岸镇当前的热门话题主要集中在木材领主近来的出走、络新妇将夺取全国控制权的传闻，以及即将到来的鬼季的准备。

柳岸镇 4级定居点

与世隔绝的伐木城镇

“胡奶奶”胡半娘（令人望而生畏的天书男性退休守卫队长）退休的帝国卫队长

“老松木”松木胜（怀旧的天书男性家长）退休木匠，也是柳岸镇的活历史

赫山宝（紧张不安的天书男性总督）柳岸镇的指派行政长官

People of Willowshore

Most of Willowshore’s citizens identify by when their family first settled in town, often affecting which bank of the Ceiba River they live on. The first wave of townspeople were either those who worked on the monastery or were paid to settle in Willowshore by the monastery. These folks originally lived south of the river and are thus referred to as Southbankers. Those who arrived after Lung Wa took control, meanwhile, settled on the river’s northern banks, called Northridge due to its prominent incline. These settlers included workers for the lumber bosses, businesses that wanted convenient access to the lumber, and imperial guards.

Though these two factions in Willowshore today use the names Southbank and Northridge, one’s allegiance isn’t solely determined by where they live or work. Southbank residents are traditionalists, keen on maintaining Willowshore’s culture and living simply off the land. Northridge residents, meanwhile, focus on pragmatism and urban growth. Many in Northridge are open to the idea of jorogumo ruling Shenmen, while Southbankers on principle think jorogumo are evil monsters and best avoided.

Despite disagreements, both sides have a consensus on putting Willowshore’s survival and safety first. Plenty of residents have their own opinions that lean in neither direction and consider themselves unaffiliated with either faction. Overall, Willowshore values giving all one has to offer. In many ways, the village has no choice, especially as the events of this adventure evolve.

As you play Season of Ghosts, your actions and choices as a group will build reputation with these two factions; your GM has all the rules and guidance needed to track reputation and implement its effects in the game as play progresses.

Current trending topics in Willowshore focus on the recent exodus of the lumber lords, rumors of jorogumo seizing control of the nation, and preparations for the upcoming season of ghosts.

Willowshore Gazetteer.name: 柳岸镇志 Willowshore Gazetteer
Willowshore Gazetteer.text:
柳岸镇志

7020年，丹杉寺由一位名为智惠的桑博齐武僧建立。寺院环绕着一棵据说拥有神秘力量的古老杉树而建，地处极为偏远，坐落于幽魂之森一片无人定居地带中的林木山谷里。柳岸镇最初的建立，是为了支援那些修建寺院的人，而连接城镇与寺院的漫长小路后来被称为朝圣者之路。寺院建成后，柳岸镇的重心逐渐转向一种愈发自给自足的生活方式，只有偶尔才需要支援寺中的武僧。

7054年，智惠去世，随着寺中的武僧开始陆续离开，柳岸镇本身也将重心转向伐木业。到了7060年，寺院已被废弃；但在7062年，一群伐木工试图砍伐生长在那里的古老杉树时，悲剧发生了。那天夜晚，伐木工们带着破损的武器和毫无生气的躯体回到了柳岸镇；尽管这些亡灵伐木工在天亮前被击败，仍有数十名镇民在这场冲突中丧生。如今，这起事件被称为“断刃之夜”，而在此后的46年间，几乎没有访客再前往那座荒废的寺院。如今，那里被视为一处受诅咒、闹鬼，甚至更糟的地方。

随着岁月流逝，神门正式将柳岸镇纳入龙华的伐木扩张计划之中。起初一切进展顺利，还修建了包括桥梁和水坝在内的基础设施。然而，经营采伐作业的木材老板们很快就因利用柳岸镇清苦的过往而遭人憎恨。更糟的是，他们开始把这处定居点——如今已正式称为城镇——包装成供龙华贵族消遣的“度假地”，让他们来此狩猎取乐，并享用那些以帝国之名强行征收来的食物与饮品。

7106年龙华崩溃时，柳岸镇的木材领主们带着财富，抛下他们的宅邸逃走了。大多数驻扎在城中的士兵返回了神门的首都，或是擅离职守，只留下那些已在当地扎下根的人。柳岸镇的偏远使其免遭猖獗的匪患与开始困扰神门的外部政治冲突，但正如你在开始游玩肆季鬼志时很快就会发现的那样，柳岸镇面对新世界的时刻已经到来。

Willowshore Gazetteer

In 7020, the Tan Sugi monastery was founded by a Sangpotshi monk named Zhi Hui. Built around an ancient sugi tree said to have mystic properties, the Tan Sugi monastery was incredibly remote, nestled in a wooded valley within an unsettled reach of Specterwood. Willowshore was originally founded to support those who built the monastery, and the long trail that connected the town to the monastery became known as the Pilgrim’s Path. Once construction of the monastery ended, Willowshore’s focus shifted to an increasingly self-sufficient lifestyle that only periodically needed to support the monks.

Zhi Hui passed away in 7054, and as the monks of the monastery began to drift away, Willowshore itself shifted focus to the lumber industry. By 7060, the monastery had been abandoned, but when a group of woodcutters attempted to harvest the ancient sugi trees that grew there in 7062, tragedy struck. The woodcutters returned to Willowshore with broken weapons and unliving bodies that evening, and while these undead woodcutters were defeated by morning, dozens of townsfolk had perished during the struggle. The event is remembered today as the “Night of Broken Blades,” and few visitors have made the journey to the ruined monastery in the 46 years since. The place is regarded now as cursed, haunted, or worse.

As the years wore on, Shenmen officially enlisted Willowshore to become part of Lung Wa’s lumber harvesting ambitions. Things started out well, with the construction of infrastructure including bridges and a dam. However, the lumber bosses who ran the harvesting operation soon became loathed for their exploitation of Willowshore’s ascetic past. Worse, they began to present the settlement (now properly called a town) as a “getaway” for Lung Wa aristocrats to hunt for sport and indulge in food and drinks forcefully seized in the empire’s name.

When Lung Wa collapsed in 7106, Willowshore’s lumber lords took their wealth, abandoned their estates, and fled. Most of the soldiers stationed in town returned to Shenmen’s capital or deserted their posts, leaving behind those who had put down local roots. Willowshore’s remoteness saved it from rampant banditry and external political conflicts that had begun to plague Shenmen, but as you will soon discover when you begin to play Season of Ghosts, the time has come for Willowshore to face the new world.

Home and Heirloom.name: 家园与传家宝 Home and Heirloom
Home and Heirloom.text:
家园与传家宝

八条戒律

柳岸镇的人民会在夏天最初的几周——幽灵出没的季节——遵循这八条建议。这些信念主要是本地的迷信说法，而它们是否真的能在遭遇任何恶意精魂时起到帮助作用，仍然备受争议。

  1. 不要把幽灵叫作幽灵；如果你非得称呼他们，就用友善的问候。
  2. 不要拍人的头或肩膀。
  3. 附近有幽灵时，避免进入水体中。
  4. 不要吃插着两根棍状物的食物。
  5. 白天不要倚靠墙壁。
  6. 夜晚不要吹口哨。
  7. 夜晚不要把洗好的衣物晾在外面。
  8. 如果你在夜晚听见身后有人叫你的名字，不要回头。

为你的肆季鬼志角色进行创建的最后一步，是选择你在柳岸镇住在哪里。第16页展示的城镇地图标出了柳岸镇中的所有建筑。如果你选择了一个肆季鬼志背景，这项选择会提示你在柳岸镇中的住处最可能位于哪里，但你不必受此限制——你可以从地图上任何一栋没有标注的小型建筑中挑选一处作为你角色的家（请注意，你的游戏主持可能对某些建筑另有建议或安排，其内容可能超出本冒险的预期范围，因此在你确定住处之前，需要得到游戏主持的批准）。

选定住处后，从以下四组宝藏中选择一组。当你开始肆季鬼志时，你所选择的宝藏仍存放在家中。虽然在第一场冒险开始时你还无法取得它们，但在冒险开始后不久，每位玩家角色都会有机会回家，把家中的传家宝取出来使用！

选择这些宝藏时，每位玩家都必须选择不同的选项——只有当队伍中玩家超过四人时，你才能选择其他玩家已经选过的宝藏。

  • 两瓶初级治疗药水，以及一件由玩家角色自选、价值不超过2 gp的通用冒险道具。
  • 一枚可预测银币，以及一个装有1剂潜能油的小瓶。
  • 警报圈套的材料、10 sp，以及两枚次级幽灵充能瓶。
  • 一块价值10 gp的寒铁块。

Home and Heirloom

The Eight Practices

The people of Willowshore follow these eight bits of advice during the first several weeks of summer—the season of ghosts. These beliefs are primarily local superstitions, and their capacity to actually help in an encounter with any sort of malicious spirit is hotly debated.

  1. Do not call a ghost a ghost; instead, address them with friendly greetings if you must.
  2. Do not pat people on the head or shoulders.
  3. Avoid entering bodies of water when a ghost is nearby.
  4. Do not eat food that has two stick-like objects protruding from it.
  5. Do not lean against walls during the day.
  6. Do not whistle at night.
  7. Do not leave laundry out at night.
  8. If you hear someone call your name from behind you at night, do not turn around.

The final step for creating your Season of Ghosts character is to choose where you live in Willowshore. The town map presented on page 16 shows all of the buildings in Willowshore. If you chose a Season of Ghosts background, that choice suggests where in Willowshore your home is most likely to be located, but you need not be limited by this suggestion—you can pick any unlabeled smaller building on the map as your character’s home (note that your GM might have suggestions or plans for certain buildings beyond the expected scope of the adventure, so before you settle on your home, you’ll need GM approval).

Once you’ve chosen your home, pick one of the following four sets of treasure. When you start Season of Ghosts, the treasure you selected is still stored back home. While you won’t have access to it when the first adventure begins, it won’t be long into the adventure before each PC will have the opportunity to return home and gather their family treasures for use!

When selecting these treasures, each player must choose a different option—only if there are more than four players in the group can you choose a treasure already selected by another player.

  • Two minor healing potions and one piece of common adventuring gear worth 2 gp or less of the PC’s choice.
  • One predictable silver piece and a vial containing one dose of oil of potency.
  • Supplies for an alarm snare, 10 sp, and two lesser ghost charges.
  • One cold-iron chunk worth 10 gp.

Background Adjustments.name: 背景调整 Background Adjustments
Background Adjustments.text:
背景调整

关于你的家人

尽管柳岸镇是你的角色的家，而且他们在镇上也可能有关系亲近的家人居住，但《肆季鬼志》完全不会将任何潜在的玩家角色家人纳入冒险剧情中。如果你的角色在柳岸镇与父母、兄弟姐妹、子女、恋爱伴侣或其他家人同住，请与你的游戏主持讨论，你是否希望他们只扮演背景中的角色，或是在游戏主持的协助下，于战役剧情中承担更为关键的部分。尤其是，请让你的游戏主持知道，你是否能够接受家人有可能受到《肆季鬼志》中某些要素的威胁，并确认其他玩家也能接受这一元素。再次说明，《肆季鬼志》中并没有任何会直接危及玩家角色家人的剧情要素（除了笼罩柳岸镇所有居民的生存危机之外），但对某些玩家和团队而言，让家人参与这样的故事，能使体验更具挑战性，也更有回报。

你可以将以下两项调整中的一项加入任何背景（包括通用语背景）中，进一步修改你的选择，使其更符合你对自己玩家角色的构想。

家人：你与另一名或多名玩家角色是关系亲近的家人（兄弟姐妹、亲子、已婚伴侣等）。如果你选择此调整，那么作为你家人的其他玩家角色也必须选择此调整。选择以下一项，替换你原本会从背景中获得的技能专长。（你和你的兄弟姐妹不必选择相同的项目——如果某位兄弟姐妹想保留其背景的技能专长，也可以从列表中选择“普通”。）

  • 拌嘴：你与自己的兄弟姐妹之间有着由来已久的龃龉。每当你的兄弟姐妹在一次重要的技能检定或攻击掷骰中大失败，且你目睹了他们的失败时，你的豁免骰获得+1状态加值，持续至你的下个回合结束，因为你会暗自（也可能并不那么暗自地）为他们的失败感到高兴。
  • 亲密无间：你与自己的兄弟姐妹配合默契，而当他们伤势严重时，你会竭尽全力帮助他们。当你对自己的兄弟姐妹提供协助或施行急救时，难度等级比正常低5。
  • 普通：你与自己的兄弟姐妹关系平常；你的背景技能专长不作改变。

弃儿：你并非柳岸镇本地人，但你的确是在镇上长大的。你可能有养父母，或者你是在街头长大的。选择以下一项，替换你原本会从背景中获得的额外专长。

  • 愤懑：你珍视柳岸镇这座城镇，但依然对导致自己被遗弃或被留在镇上的境遇心怀怨愤。你获得威吓瞪视技能专长。
  • 神秘：你守口如瓶，而柳岸镇中很少有人（若有的话）知道你在镇上定居之前的经历，这在一定程度上是因为你习惯于通过观察而非参与交谈来了解柳岸镇。你获得人情练达技能专长。
  • 外向：你感激柳岸镇居民向你伸出的归属感，并总是尽力回报这份善意。每周一次，当你尝试以一次技能检定来解决一项可能有益于柳岸镇的休整模式行动时（其中若干此类行动在各篇冒险中有详细说明，而若有其他行动是否符合条件，游戏主持也始终可以裁定），如果你在该检定中失败，则改为成功；如果你在该检定中大失败，则改为仅仅失败。

Background Adjustments

About Your Family

Although Willowshore is your character’s home, and they might have close family dwelling in town, Season of Ghosts doesn’t incorporate any potential PC family members into the adventure plots at all. If your character has parents, siblings, children, romantic partners, or other family living with them in Willowshore, talk with your GM about whether you’d like them to play purely a background role or, with the GM’s aid, take up a more integral part of the campaign’s plot. In particular, let your GM know if you’re comfortable potentially having family members become threatened by elements in Season of Ghosts, and make sure the other players are okay with this element as well. Again, there are no plot elements in Season of Ghosts that directly imperil any PC’s family (beyond the existential peril facing all of Willowshore’s inhabitants), but for some players and groups, involving family in stories like this one can make the experience more challenging and rewarding.

You can add one of the following two adjustments to any background (including a Common one) to further modify your choice to match your vision for your PC.

Family: You and one (or more) other PCs are close family members (siblings, parent/child, married, etc.). If you take this adjustment, the other PC(s) who are your family must also take this adjustment. Choose one of the following to replace the skill feat you otherwise would’ve gained from your background. (You and your sibling need not share the same choice—a sibling who wants to keep their background’s skill feat can pick “Typical” from the list.)

  • Bickering: You have a long-standing feud with your sibling(s). Whenever your sibling(s) critically fail a significant skill check or attack roll and you witness their failure, you gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws until the end of your next turn as you secretly (or perhaps not so secretly) delight in their failure.
  • Close-Knit: You and your sibling(s) work well together, and you go all-out to help them when they’re badly hurt. When you provide Aid or Administer First Aid to your sibling(s), the DC is 5 lower than normal.
  • Typical: You have a standard relationship with your sibling(s); don’t change your background’s skill feat.

Foundling: You aren’t a native to Willowshore, but you did grow up in the town. You might have adoptive parents, or you could’ve grown up on the streets. Choose one of the following to replace the bonus feat you otherwise would’ve gained from your background.

  • Bitter: You appreciate the town of Willowshore but still resent the conditions that resulted in you being abandoned or left in the town. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
  • Mysterious: You keep secrets, and very few in Willowshore (if anyone) know your history before you settled in the town, in part because you’ve taken to learning about Willowshore by watching rather than engaging in conversation. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.
  • Outgoing: You’re grateful for the sense of belonging the townsfolk of Willowshore have extended to you and always do your best to repay that kindness. Once per week when you attempt a skill check to resolve a downtime activity that could benefit Willowshore (several of these activities are detailed in the adventures, and your GM can always make the call if another activity would qualify) and you fail that check, you instead succeed at the check, or if you critically fail at that check, you instead simply fail that check.

Season of Ghosts Backgrounds.name: 鬼季背景 Season of Ghosts Backgrounds
Season of Ghosts Backgrounds.text:
鬼季背景

以下几页介绍的六个新背景可供《肆季鬼志》冒险路径中的所有角色选择。这些罕见背景都是为契合这条冒险路径的主题而量身打造的，并包含一些关于重演节以及你为何被选为节日“被掳者”的风味描述。

季节恩惠：这些背景中的每一个都会赋予你一项季节恩惠。你可以在任何时候以自由动作（）使用季节恩惠（其触发如你的背景所述），但每个季节只能使用一次（夏、秋、冬、春——分别对应《肆季鬼志》冒险路径的四个章节；你的GM会告知你何时开始新章节，而你的恩惠也会再次可用）。如果你在某一章节中没有使用季节恩惠，则该次使用机会会失去——未使用的季节恩惠不会延续到下一个章节。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.uker8dnTA7WhzXSR]{紧密联系} 背景

  • 罕见

你与柳岸镇一位知名居民建立了亲密友谊，并长期保持着一起饮茶的传统，一边闲聊共同兴趣、未来计划、镇上流言或其他值得一提的话题。与GM合作，从《柳岸镇志》中提到的NPC里选择一位（胡婆婆或松木老人除外）——你的GM也许会建议哪位NPC最适合你的角色，或者知道某位NPC在战役后续中会扮演什么角色，从而为你的角色提供一个引人入胜的故事节点。你可能是这位NPC的雇员或学徒、亲近的亲属或朋友，甚至也可能是某种意义上的友好竞争对手。

你的家很可能离这位NPC盟友的营业地点或住处比较近。

在重演节期间，你很可能与这位NPC盟友共度了一些时光，并可能约好了次日，也就是夏日第一天，再聚一聚——也许是一起喝茶。你会在重演节期间被选为被掳者，多半是因为你的NPC朋友或盟友觉得这段经历会很有趣，或对你有好处；又或者是他们在前一年应你的怂恿参加过，而现在“轮到你了”。

选择两项属性提升。其中一项必须加在魅力或智力上，另一项为自由属性提升。

你受训于交涉（技能）与茶学识。你获得独门手艺技能专长（选择一个与你的NPC盟友相关的专精类别），并且你的NPC盟友对整个队伍的初始态度为友善（而不是冷淡——柳岸镇所有NPC的通常初始态度都是冷淡）。

季节恩惠 f 触发 队伍中的某人使柳岸镇的一名NPC变为友善；效果 你的名声先于你而至，即使不是你本人在尝试影响该NPC也是如此。该NPC会变为乐于助人，而非友善。让一名NPC变为乐于助人，可能会解锁其在柳岸镇所在地提供的额外支援——关于这项机制，你的GM有更多信息。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.ia5aFzfmfnMjhcms]{民俗热衷者} 背景

  • 罕见

柳岸镇是神门乡野地带的一座小镇，但这并不意味着它能置身于奇异与未解之事之外。关于柳岸镇或柳岸腹地，流传着许多神秘事件与闹鬼传说，而受你的成长经历影响，你对深入了解这些事物产生了格外浓厚的兴趣。虽然这一地区的许多民间传说都源自柳岸镇众多宗教与地方信仰之一（你可能是其中某一信仰的虔诚信徒，也可能只是以世俗立场对这些传说感兴趣），但你也注意到，这些信念还会影响工匠与制作者，而他们自己甚至未必意识得到。你深信，这些地方信仰扎根于某场意义重大的深层历史事件，并希望有朝一日能了解柳岸镇真正的历史。

如果你有宗教信仰，你的家很可能靠近一座与你信仰相关的圣祠——如果你的信仰没有在柳岸镇的圣祠中体现出来，可以与GM讨论，看看是否能在你家中或家附近设有一座属于你信仰的圣祠。

在重演节期间，你很可能花时间与别人聊鬼故事，分享阴森可怖的传说与轶闻。与其说你是在重演节期间被选为被掳者，不如说你是满怀热情地主动报名争取了这个机会——你甚至可能往年也作为被掳者参加过！

选择两项属性提升。其中一项必须加在智力或感知上，另一项为自由属性提升。

你受训于宗教（技能）与艺术学识。你获得异常察觉技能专长。

季节恩惠 f 触发 你将要为一次回忆知识掷任意检定；效果 当你忆起一则古老寓言、冷门传说或与当前主题相关的故事时，灵光忽然一现。这次回忆知识检定失去秘密（特征）。将你此次回忆知识检定的结果提升一个成功等级。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.2nt2nsQMBXgQRlOu]{北岭学者} 背景

  • 罕见

北岭这一政治派系关注现代务实主义与城镇发展。这个派系里当然也有人把南岸的人看作乡巴佬、笨拙土包子，或是不愿让柳岸镇成长的顽固传统派；但大多数追随这一地方派系的人，还是把精力放在建设柳岸镇上，想象着有朝一日这座镇子会成长为重要的贸易枢纽。而你的兴趣更偏向于将柳岸镇建设成一个学习之地——一所学校、图书馆，甚至一所小型大学，都能为你的城镇带来莫大益处！当然，尽管研习与学习令人振奋，你也明白，以这样的方式扩展柳岸镇需要大量辛勤劳动，而你童年时帮忙打地基、盖房子的经历，也赋予了你一种不同于普通学者的体格。

你的家很可能位于木棉河以北、柳岸镇镇区以东的河岸一带。

在重演节期间，你很可能帮忙操办了一些庆典活动，或只是坐在一旁观察人群。你自愿在重演节期间成为被掳者，因为能够参与镇上延续最久的传统之一，是你一直以来都渴望体验的荣耀。

选择两项属性提升。其中一项必须加在体质或力量上，另一项为自由属性提升。

你受训于社群（技能）与学术学识。你获得额外学识专长。

季节恩惠 f 触发 队伍与北岭的声望提高；效果 队伍与北岭的声望额外提高2点（你的GM掌握关于柳岸镇声望的相关信息）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.GyFfqCZZVtazmwPD]{郊区居民} 背景

  • 罕见

虽然柳岸镇是一座美丽的小镇，但对你来说，哪怕只有200人口也还是有点太多了。不论你是在镇子边缘长大，还是后来对镇上生活感到烦闷压抑而决定搬去外围，只有在自然环绕之中时，你才真正有家的感觉。你并不轻视住在镇里的人，而且你可能正是那些为缺乏林地生存技能的人们提供重要支援的猎人、捕兽者、渔夫或草药师之一。

你的家位于柳岸镇外围，甚至可能并没有在地图上以一栋真实建筑标示出来。若经GM许可，你甚至可能住在柳岸腹地更远处的一间小屋中，但距离镇子不会超过几英里。

在重演节期间，你很可能到得比较晚，本来也不打算待太久，但你的朋友和盟友（其他PC）说服你留了下来。你是在最后一刻被选为重演节期间的被掳者的，因为原本的人不得不退出（也许是因为宴席上吃喝过度），而你的朋友们（其他PC）说服你加入他们，一同经历这场有趣的共同体验。再说，这事还包括在林地里星空下过夜——嗯，这可真是结束一个夜晚的绝妙方式！

选择两项属性提升。其中一项必须加在敏捷或感知上，另一项为自由属性提升。

你受训于自然（技能）与狩猎学识。你获得地形专精（森林）技能专长。

季节恩惠 f 触发 你将要掷先攻；效果 某种情势触动了你的防备，让你能更快对突如其来的危险作出反应。你的先攻掷骰获得等同于你开始《肆季鬼志》以来已历经季节数的状态加值（夏季为+1，直至冒险路径最终章节的春季最多为+4）。如果你能够向其他PC发出警告，他们的先攻也获得此加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.2W2jadmj4gPNfdQ9]{南岸传统派} 背景

  • 罕见

南岸这一政治派系代表着柳岸镇最初的建立者——一群健壮的拓居者，他们的技能与关注点多偏向朴实、脚踏实地的事务。这个派系里当然也有人把北岭视作浮华的城里人、商人和贪恋权势的政客；但南岸的大多数人，还是将精力投入到确保柳岸镇温饱无忧、尊重其悠久传统，以及维持相对自给自足上。你对柳岸镇历史的兴趣，与务农传统、亲手打造所需之物，以及参与这一地区共同口述历史的实践紧密相关。无论是与本地长者愉快地讨论往昔，还是帮助新来者学习柳岸镇的规矩，你总是热心于协助维护这座镇子的传统。

你的家很可能位于木棉河以南，镇子最南端的边缘地带。

在重演节期间，你很可能花时间帮忙准备宴席、协助操办一些活动，或以其他方式在幕后工作。你会在重演节期间被选为被掳者，可能是因为你打赌输了、欠了人情，或被家人、朋友或同事施压或哄骗着接下了这个角色。也可能原本该成为被掳者的人在最后一刻退出了，于是你顶替了对方。

选择两项属性提升。其中一项必须加在魅力或体质上，另一项为自由属性提升。

你受训于制作与务农学识。你获得交际达人专长。

季节恩惠 f 触发 队伍与南岸的声望提高；效果 队伍与南岸的声望额外提高2点（你的GM掌握关于柳岸镇声望的相关信息）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.0oTvU8dNFcT42CWV]{柳岸街童} 背景

  • 罕见

如同任何定居点一样，并非柳岸镇的每位居民都生来过着轻松安逸的生活。你在镇上的街头长大，不是孤儿，就是不得不在年幼时便帮忙养家的苦命孩子。从名义上说，你也许确实有过自己的家，但出于种种原因，你的童年大部分时光都在那些墙外度过，或者你更愿意如此。你可能曾与一群孩子结伴闯荡（其中一些甚至可能是其他PC），也可能是个孤身一人却硬是在重重困境中活下来的独行者。无论如何，你的童年充满了被迫而来的机敏、窘迫与体力劳动。几乎没有哪个星期，你不需要临时拼凑出某种办法来解决问题，或者干脆依靠反应与蛮力在事情恶化前迅速处理局面。虽然如今你已经长大，也许早已将旧日生活抛在身后，但你在柳岸镇街头度过的那些岁月，塑造了今天的你。

从严格意义上说，你也许至今仍然居无定所，靠在街头讨生活，从不连续两晚睡在同一个地方。你也可能在镇上某处保有一间小棚屋或藏身处。也有可能，尽管童年困苦，你还是有幸找到了一个家或家人；若是如此，你的住处可能位于柳岸镇任何地方。

在重演节期间，你很可能尽情享受了节庆狂欢……也许享受得有点太过头了！节日从小就是你生活中令人兴奋的时刻，这一次也不例外。你会在重演节期间成为被掳者，纯粹只是运气使然——也许你的名字在盲抽中被抽中了，也许是有人激你去参加，又或者你只是单纯渴望成为众人焦点。

选择两项属性提升。其中一项必须加在敏捷或力量上，另一项为自由属性提升。

你受训于运动（技能）与工程学识。你获得迷人骗子专长。

季节恩惠 f 触发 你（或一名邻接的PC）将要进行复苏检定；效果 你的复苏检定直接获得自动大成功，而非进行掷骰，因为你健壮的体格、顽强的态度，或单纯只是老天眷顾的好运，仍像你童年时那样帮助你活下来。如果你邻接一名将要进行复苏检定的PC，你也可以改为对其使用这项恩惠，使其获得此效果。

Season of Ghosts Backgrounds

The six new backgrounds presented on the following pages are available to all characters in the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path. Each of these rare backgrounds is tailor-made to match the themes of this Adventure Path and includes a bit of flavor about the Reenactment Festival and why you were chosen to be one of the festival’s abductees.

Seasonal Boon: Each of these backgrounds grants you a seasonal boon. You can use a seasonal boon at any time as a free action (with a trigger as described in your background), but only once per season (summer, fall, winter, spring—corresponding to the four acts of the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path; your GM can let you know when a new act begins and your boon is available for use once more). If you don’t use a seasonal boon during an act, that use is lost—unused seasonal boons don’t carry over into the next act.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.uker8dnTA7WhzXSR]{Close Ties} Background

  • RARE

You’ve forged a close friendship with one of Willowshore’s notable citizens, and you have a long tradition of sharing tea with each other while chatting about shared interests, plans for the future, town gossip, or other matters of note. Work with your GM to choose one of the NPCs mentioned in the Willowshore Gazetteer (other than Granny Hu or Old Matsuki)—your GM might have suggestions for which NPC makes the most sense for your character or might know something about an NPC’s eventual role in the campaign that would give your character a compelling story beat. You could be an employee or apprentice of this NPC, a close relation or friend, or even a friendly competitor in some way.

Your home is likely relatively close to the place of business or home of your NPC ally.

During the Reenactment Festival, you likely spent time with your NPC ally and might have made plans to get together the next day on the first day of summer, perhaps to have tea together. You were chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival because your NPC friend or ally suggested the experience would be fun or good for you, or because they’d done it the previous year at your urging and now “it’s your turn.”

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in the Diplomacy skill and the Tea Lore skill. You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat (choose a specialty associated with your allied NPC), and your allied NPC begins with an attitude of friendly toward the party (rather than indifferent, which is the initial norm for all Willowshore NPCs).

Seasonal Boon f Trigger Someone in the party makes an NPC in Willowshore friendly; Effect Your reputation precedes you, even if you aren’t the one making the attempt to influence an NPC. The NPC is made helpful instead of friendly. Making an NPC helpful can unlock additional support from their location in Willowshore—your GM has more information about this mechanic.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.ia5aFzfmfnMjhcms]{Folklore Enthusiast} Background

  • RARE

Willowshore is a small town in a rural part of Shenmen, but that doesn’t exempt it from the world of the strange and unexplained. There are plenty of mysterious events and haunting legends about Willowshore or its hinterlands, and as a result of your upbringing, you’ve become particularly interested in learning more about them. While much of the regional folklore comes from one of Willowshore’s many religions and local faiths (of which you might be a practicing member or perhaps instead have a secular interest in the lore), you’ve noticed that these beliefs also influence artisans and crafters in ways they might not even realize. You’re convinced that many of these local beliefs have roots in a deeper, historical event of great significance and hope one day to learn more about Willowshore’s true history.

If you’re religious, your home is likely near a shrine associated with your faith—if your faith isn’t represented among Willowshore’s shrines, speak with your GM about potentially having a shrine to your faith in or near to your home.

During the Reenactment Festival, you likely spent time chatting with others about ghost stories and sharing spooky legends and tales. You weren’t chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival so much as you volunteered, eagerly, for the chance—you might have even participated in previous years as an abductee!

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in the Religion skill and the Art Lore skill. You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat.

Seasonal Boon f Trigger You’re about to roll any check to Recall Knowledge; Effect You have a flash of insight as you recall an old parable, obscure legend, or applicable tale to the topic at hand. This Recall Knowledge check loses the secret trait. Increase the result of your check to Recall Knowledge by one degree of success.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.2nt2nsQMBXgQRlOu]{Northridge Scholar} Background

  • RARE

The political faction of Northridge is focused on modern pragmatism and urban growth. While there are certainly those in this faction who regard those of Southshore as rubes, bumbling yokels, or stubborn traditionalists who would prefer Willowshore never grow, most of those following this local faction instead put their energy into developing Willowshore, envisioning a time when the town might grow into an important hub for trade. Your interests lie more along the concept of Willowshore as a place for learning—a school, library, or even small university could do so much for your town! Of course, as invigorating as it is to study and learn, you also understand that expanding Willowshore in such a way will require lots of hard work, and your childhood helping to lay foundations or raise buildings has given you a physique that eludes the typical scholar.

Your home is likely somewhere along the northern banks of the Ceiba River to the east of downtown Willowshore.

During the Reenactment Festival, you likely helped to run some of the festivities or spent time simply sitting back to people-watch. You volunteered to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival because the experience of taking part in one of the town’s longest-running traditions is an honor you’ve always wanted to experience.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in the Society skill and the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Additional Lore feat.

Seasonal Boon f Trigger The party’s reputation with Northridge increases; Effect Increase the party’s reputation with Northridge by an additional 2 points (your GM has information about Willowshore reputation).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.GyFfqCZZVtazmwPD]{Outskirt Dweller} Background

  • RARE

While Willowshore is a lovely small town, even a population of 200 is a bit much for you. Whether you grew up in the town’s outskirts, or you grew frustrated and overwhelmed with town life and decided to move to the fringes, you’re only really at home when you’re surrounded by nature. You don’t look down on those who live in town, and you might be among the hunters, trappers, fishers, or herbalists who provide important support to those who lack such forestry skills.

Your home is on the outskirts of Willowshore and might not even be represented by an actual building on the map. With the GM’s permission, you might even dwell in a small building further out in the Willowshore hinterlands, but no further than a couple of miles from town.

During the Reenactment Festival, you likely showed up late and weren’t intending to stay for long, but your friends and allies (the other PCs) convinced you to stick around. You were chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival at the last minute when someone else had to back out (perhaps as a result of overindulging during the feast), and your friends (the other PCs) convinced you to join them on what would be a fun, shared experience. Since it involves sleeping out under the stars in the woods, well, that’s a pretty lovely way to end an evening!

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in the Nature skill and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise (forest) skill feat.

Seasonal Boon f Trigger You’re about to roll initiative; Effect Something about the situation triggers your defenses, allowing you to react to sudden peril more quickly. You gain a status bonus to your initiative roll equal to the number of seasons since you’ve started Season of Ghosts (+1 during summer, up to a maximum of +4 during spring in the Adventure Path’s final act). If you can communicate a warning to other PCs, they gain this bonus to their initiative as well.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.2W2jadmj4gPNfdQ9]{Southbank Traditionalist} Background

  • RARE

The political faction of Southbank represents the original founders of Willowshore, a hearty band of settlers whose skills and focus tend toward the earthly and humble. While there are certainly those in this faction who regard Northridge as vapid urbanites, merchants, and power-hungry politicians, most in Southbank devote their energy to helping Willowshore stay fed, honoring its long-standing traditions, and remaining relatively self-sufficient. Your interests in Willowshore’s history are closely tied to the traditions of farming and building what you need with your own two hands, as well as taking part in the shared oral history of the region. Whether it’s enjoying discussions with local elders about the past or helping newcomers learn Willowshore’s ways, you’re always eager to help uphold the town’s traditions.

Your home is likely located south of the Ceiba River, on the southernmost outskirts of town.

During the Reenactment Festival, you likely spent time helping to set up the feasts, assisted in running some of the events, and otherwise worked behind the scenes. You were chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival because you lost a bet, owed a favor, or otherwise got pressured or tricked into the role by a family member, friend, or coworker. Perhaps someone who was going to be one of the abductees but had to back out at the last moment, so you ended up taking their place.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in the Crafting skill and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber feat.

Seasonal Boon f Trigger The party’s reputation with Southbank increases; Effect Increase the party’s reputation with Southbank by an additional 2 points (your GM has information about Willowshore reputation).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.0oTvU8dNFcT42CWV]{Willowshore Urchin} Background

  • RARE

As with any settlement, not all of Willowshore’s citizens are born into easy lives. You grew up on the town streets, either as an orphan or hardscrabble youth who was forced at a young age to help provide for your family. You might technically have had a home of your own, but for various reasons, you had, or preferred, to live most of your childhood outside of those walls. You might have run with a gang of kids (some of whom might even be fellow PCs), or you could’ve been a loner who managed to survive against all odds. Regardless, your childhood was one of forced ingenuity, desperation, and physicality. Hardly a week would’ve passed without you having to jury-rig a solution to some problem or to simply use your reflexes or brawn to solve a situation quickly before things escalated. While you might have left your old life behind you now that you’re all grown up, the time you spent on Willowshore’s streets has made you the person you are today.

You might still be technically homeless, subsisting on the street and never sleeping in the same place twice in a row. You might keep a small shanty or hideout somewhere in town as well. It’s also possible that, despite your childhood, you’ve been fortunate enough to find a family or home, in which case your home could be anywhere in Willowshore.

During the Reenactment Festival, you likely enjoyed the revelry... perhaps a bit too much! Festivals were always times of excitement in your childhood, and this one is no exception. You were chosen to be an abductee during the Reenactment Festival simply by chance—maybe your name was selected by a blind draw, or perhaps someone dared you to take part, or you could simply have craved the attention.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in the Athletics skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar feat.

Seasonal Boon f Trigger You (or an adjacent PC) are about to roll a recovery check; Effect You gain an automatic critical success on the recovery check rather than rolling it as your hearty physique, tenacious attitude, or just plain old luck continues to help you survive the way it had during your childhood. If you’re adjacent to a PC who’s about to roll a recovery check, you can instead use this boon to grant them this effect.

Standard Background.name: 标准背景 Standard Background
Standard Background.text:
标准背景

如果你想直接从《玩家核心》中选择一个标准背景，那么适合《肆季鬼志》主题的好选择包括工匠、赏金猎人、江湖骗子、厨师、罪犯、侦探、艺人、农工、赌徒、守卫、草药师、隐士、猎人、劳工、武学弟子、商人、学者、教师、街头孤儿和战士。

《玩家核心2》中还提供了额外的标准背景；该书中适合这一主题的好选择包括朝圣者、根药师、仆役或受监护者。

季节恩惠：你不获得特定的季节恩惠（即选择鬼季背景的角色会获得的一项额外好处），而是改为获得以下选项：每个季节一次（夏天、秋季、冬季或春季——因此，在《肆季鬼志》中每一幕一次），你在尝试完成任何休整模式行动的检定时获得+4状态加值；你可以在掷出该检定后再决定是否应用该加值。

Standard Background

If you wish to simply pick a standard background from Player Core, good thematic choices for Season of Ghosts include artisan, bounty hunter, charlatan, cook, criminal, detective, entertainer, farmhand, gambler, guard, herbalist, hermit, hunter, laborer, martial disciple, merchant, scholar, teacher, street urchin, and warrior.

Additional standard backgrounds are available in Player Core 2; good thematic choices from that book include pilgrim, root worker, servant, or ward.

Seasonal Boon: Instead of gaining a specific seasonal boon (an additional benefit that characters who choose Season of Ghosts backgrounds gain), you instead gain the option to, once per season (summer, fall, winter, or spring—thus, once per act during Season of Ghosts), gain a +4 status bonus to a check attempted to resolve any downtime activity; you can choose to apply this bonus after you roll the check.

Backgrounds.name: 背景 Backgrounds
Backgrounds.text:
背景

不同于大多数冒险路径，《肆季鬼志》的故事几乎完全发生在柳岸镇及其周边，并默认所有玩家角色都是这处定居点的长期居民。因此，你的玩家角色很可能在镇上有家人或亲密朋友——你应当与游戏主持合作创建这些额外的非玩家角色，来帮助充实柳岸镇！本《玩家指南》中提供的每个自定义背景，都附有关于你的玩家角色住在镇上何处的建议，因此你可以借此决定你的角色直系家人中哪些人在镇上，哪些人可能不在。不过请记住，如果你决定让重要的家人位于柳岸腹地之外，那么在这场战役期间，你很可能无法去探望他们！

当你为《肆季鬼志》创建角色时，可以从以下两种方法中选择一种来决定你角色的背景。

Backgrounds

Unlike most Adventure Paths, Season of Ghosts takes place almost entirely in and near the town of Willowshore and assumes the PCs are all long-term citizens of this settlement. As such, it’s likely that your PC has family or close friends in town—you should work with your GM to create these additional NPCs to help populate Willowshore! Each of the custom backgrounds offered in this Player’s Guide comes with suggestions as to where your PC lives in town, so you can use this to help you decide who in your character’s immediate family is in town and who might not be. Keep in mind, though, if you decide to have important family members located outside of the Willowshore hinterlands, you likely won’t be able to visit them during this campaign!

When you create a character for Season of Ghosts, you can choose one of the following two methods for selecting your character’s background.

Gear.name: 道具 Gear
Gear.text:
道具

《肆季鬼志》的故事发生在天夏，因此，《玩家核心》中以下非普及武器在创建角色时对每位玩家角色开放：镰刃、武士刀、锡杖、双节棍、十手、手里剑和庙剑。

《玩家核心2》中以下非普及武器在创建角色时对每位玩家角色开放：大弓（进阶武器）、天狗烈风刃和胁差。

此外，《失落预兆：天夏角色指南》第127页所列出的所有武器，在创建角色时也都对每位玩家角色开放。

Gear

Season of Ghosts takes place in Tian Xia, and as such, the following uncommon weapons from Player Core are accessible to every PC upon character creation: kama, katana, khakkara, nunchaku, sai, shuriken, and temple sword.

The following uncommon weapons from Player Core 2 are accessible to every PC upon character creation: daikyu (advanced weapon), tengu gale blade, and wakizashi.

Additionally, all of the weapons listed on page 127 of the Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide are available to every PC upon character creation.

Archetypes.name: 变体 Archetypes
Archetypes.text:
变体

随着你愈发强大，选择一种变体的选项能帮助你进一步自定义你的角色，并让其在主题上更适合《肆季鬼志》。大多数多职业变体都很适合《肆季鬼志》战役（枪手除外），而《玩家核心2》中其他在主题上合适的变体包括以下这些：天眷者（与柳岸镇中某座圣祠所供奉的神祇之一相关）、赏金猎人或决斗家（尤其适合用来塑造一名浪人主题的角色）、草药师、统帅或武术家。仪式师变体尤其适合这场战役，因为《肆季鬼志》包含了大量仪式，并提供了许多使用这些仪式的机会。《失落预兆：天夏角色指南》中另外一些不错的变体选择包括灵斗士和游方厨师。

Archetypes

As you grow more powerful, the option to select an archetype can help you further customize your character and make them more thematically appropriate for Season of Ghosts. Most multiclass archetypes work well for a Season of Ghosts campaign (with the exception of gunslinger), while other thematically appropriate archetypes from Player Core 2 include the following: blessed one (associated with one of the deities who have shrines in Willowshore), bounty hunter or duelist (particularly when used to create a ronin-themed character), herbalist, marshal, or martial artist. The ritualist archetype is particularly well-suited to this campaign, as Season of Ghosts features a wide number of rituals and offers many opportunities to use them. Additional archetypes from Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide that are solid choices include spirit warrior and wandering chef.

Skills and Feats.name: 技能与专长 Skills and Feats
Skills and Feats.text:
技能与专长

在《肆季鬼志》中，你将面对各种各样的挑战与机会，尤其是在休整模式方面。毕竟，这条冒险路径横跨整整一年，而你也会时不时地花上数周时间来进行各种休整期行动。那些在战斗遭遇中（或紧随其后）经常派上用场的技能，例如特技、运动、医药和隐秘，在整个战役中都会持续有用；其中有些技能（尤其是运动）在各种休整追求中也有相当重要的其他用途。

在与四大魔法根源相关的四项技能中，自然和宗教将在整条冒险路径中拥有大量大放异彩的机会。奥秘则会在这场由四部分构成的战役后半段更加重要，神秘学也是如此。

有助于社交互动的技能，例如交涉、威吓和社群，在《肆季鬼志》中会始终频繁使用。当然，欺瞒在遭遇模式中也常常很有用，可以用来声东击西或佯攻，但在战斗之外，它在战役前半段大放异彩的机会很少——虽少却重要；到了后半段，擅长欺瞒就会变得重要得多。

无论是能够在休整期求生，还是帮助偏远的柳岸镇实现相同目标，求生都会成为整个战役中一项重要技能。巧手同样极其有用，不仅能用于应对危害，也会周期性地在某些休整期行动中派上用场，或用于那些需要更高明手腕的挑战。

在第一幕结束后，制作会成为一项重要技能。此后，在休整事件和行动中，你会越来越多地被需要去建造、修理，或以其他方式运用这项技能。虽然使用表演来达成目标的机会相对较少，但每个冒险中都会有几个时刻，让这方面的熟练足以轻松解决问题。

在这场战役中，大量学识技能都会相当乐于助人。当某项休整期行动可用时，特定的学识技能通常会比像欺瞒或社群这样更泛用的技能拥有更低的难度等级。这条冒险路径中最重要的学识技能，自然是柳岸镇学识——毕竟这场战役几乎完全发生在这座小镇及其周边！在战役中还有不少其他重要的学识技能，也都会有不止一两次大放异彩的机会，包括学术、艺术、工程、农业、狩猎、图书馆、桑博齐、茶学识。只有一两次发挥机会的学识技能则包括任何与非茶类食物或饮品相关的学识，以及建筑、烹饪、捕鱼、占卜、游戏、谱系、行会、草药、络新妇、劳工、商贸、助产、齐仲、河流、航海、侦察、戏剧、地底和战争学识。

还有一项值得注意的新学识技能，虽然在《玩家核心》中没有收录，但在这场战役中会变得越来越有用；它与《肆季鬼志》中引入的一类新怪物家族有关。一旦你的团队发现这种新怪物，接受其相关学识的受训将有助于你为对抗它们的战斗做准备，或研究之后将出现的剧情元素。话虽如此，在你开始《肆季鬼志》时并未接受这项特定学识技能的任何训练，不仅完全没问题，而且本来就是战役剧情逐步展开的一部分。这里提到它，只是为了让那些喜欢提前规划角色等级选择的玩家，能为未来的机会做好准备。

你应当避免选择那些在大型城市中效果最佳，或依赖于超出几天内可完成范围的长途旅行的专长，因为这些元素在《肆季鬼志》中并不重要。相较之下，那些能帮助你与镇上其他居民交互、增强你自给自足能力，或总体上对任何在偏远林地小镇生活一整年的人都有帮助的专长，会比平时更有用。

Skills and Feats

You’ll face a wide range of challenges and opportunities in Season of Ghosts, particularly when it comes to downtime. This Adventure Path spans an entire year, after all, and now and then, you’ll be spending weeks at a time pursuing various downtime activities. Skills that feature often in combat encounters (or immediately following), such as Acrobatics, Athletics, Medicine, and Stealth, will be consistently useful throughout the campaign, with some of them (particularly Athletics) having significant other applications during various downtime pursuits.

Of the four skills associated with magical traditions, Nature and Religion will have significant opportunities to shine throughout the entire Adventure Path. Arcana comes into its own more in the second half of this four-part campaign, as does Occultism.

Skills that help with social interaction, such as Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Society, will see constant use throughout Season of Ghosts. Deception will often be useful in encounter mode, of course, to Create a Diversion or Feint, but its chances to shine outside of combat are minimal (if important) during the first half of the campaign—in the second half, skill at Deception becomes much more important.

Being able to subsist or to help the remote town of Willowshore with the same goals makes Survival an important skill throughout the campaign. Thievery will likewise be of great use, both in dealing with hazards but also periodically for certain downtime activities or for challenges that might require more subtlety.

Crafting becomes an important skill after the first act concludes. Thereafter, you’ll increasingly be called upon during downtime events and activities to build, repair, or otherwise use this skill. While opportunities to use Performance to accomplish goals will be less common, each adventure will have a few moments where skill in this area can solve problems with ease.

An extensive number of Lore skills are helpful in this campaign. When a downtime activity becomes available, a specific Lore skill will often have a lower DC than more generalized skills like Deception or Society. The most important Lore skill in this Adventure Path is Willowshore Lore, as one would expect of a campaign set almost entirely within and around this small town! Other important Lore skills that will have more than a couple of opportunities to shine in the campaign include Academia, Art, Engineering, Farming, Hunting, Library, Sangpotshi, and Tea Lore. Lore skills that will have only one or two chances to shine include any to do with non-tea food or drink, Architecture, Cooking, Fishing, Fortune-Telling, Games, Genealogy, Guild, Herbalism, Jorogumo, Labor, Mercantile, Midwifery, Qi-Zhong, River, Sailing, Scouting, Theater, Underworld, and Warfare Lore.

One new lore skill worthy of note that isn’t represented in Player Core but that will become increasingly useful in this campaign is one associated with a specific family of new monster introduced in Season of Ghosts. Once your group discovers this new type of monster, becoming trained in its lore will help you prepare for combat against them or otherwise research plot elements to come. That said, not having any particular training in this specific Lore skill when you begin Season of Ghosts is not only fine, but part of the unfolding plot of the campaign. It’s mentioned here merely to prepare you for future opportunities for those players who enjoy building their character’s level choices out beforehand.

You should avoid feats that work best in large cities or that rely on long-distance travel beyond what you could do in a few days, as these elements don’t play a role in Season of Ghosts. Feats that help you to interact with other townsfolk, that would bolster your ability to be self-sufficient, or that would generally prove useful to anyone living out a year of their life in a remote woodland town will be more useful than normal.
