Beyond the Hinterlands.name: 远离荒野之地 Beyond the Hinterlands
Beyond the Hinterlands.text:
远离荒野之地

《肆季鬼志》的故事几乎全部发生在柳岸镇及其周边的柳岸腹地之内，如地图所示；但在地图边界之外，还存在着广阔的天地！当事件可能让你前往柳岸镇之外时，你的游戏主持会提供你所需的信息；不过，在为你的角色寻找灵感时，最容易聚焦的仍是柳岸镇及其腹地。

以下简要概述了地图外六条道路与小径所通往的柳岸腹地之外的地区。

中北大道：这条部分毁坏的道路蜿蜒穿过数片已经荒废的田地，四周散布着一座多年前被废弃村庄的遗迹，最终止于一片大型湿地。那里因生长着橙色、在夜晚绽放并于月光下闪耀的花朵，而被称为月沼。

东北东路：这条道路将柳岸镇与散布在幽魂之森各处的许多偏远小村庄和城镇相连，最终通向薄纱群山。沿这条路最近的下一处定居点是狐谷，但那里也要走上三天，而且规模比柳岸镇还小。

东大道：这条道路通往贸易堡垒唐入，是柳岸镇与神门其余地区之间最主要的经济纽带。唐入附近还有一座小村庄（规模比柳岸镇小得多）；而贸易堡垒本身，则是幽灵海西海岸众多经济枢纽之一。

东北大道：这条道路通往一处最近建立的农庄，坐落在俯瞰幽灵海的高崖上；那里还有一座牧牛场，归一位来自司泽城、以冷酷无情著称的流亡政客所有，此人与柳岸镇几乎没有什么往来。

西北小径：这条古老而杂草丛生的小径通向森林深处；大多数人相信它通往一座早已废弃的圣祠，但如今已很少有人走这条偏僻的路。

南路：南路是一条漫长的陆路路线，最终会连接上维护得更好的道路，以及南方数日路程外人口更多的村庄与城镇；不过，柳岸镇的大多数人都称它为“苹果路”，因为它通往一片野生苹果树林，每到秋天都会结出格外美味的果实。

Beyond the Hinterlands

Season of Ghosts takes place almost entirely within the town of Willowshore and its immediate hinterlands, as presented on the map, but there’s a whole world out there beyond the borders of the map! When events might send you beyond the Willowshore hinterlands, your GM will have the information you need, but it’s easiest to focus on Willowshore and its hinterlands when seeking inspiration to create your character.

Brief notes about what lies beyond the hinterlands down the six roads and trails that lead off the map are summarized below.

Central Northern Road: This partially ruined road winds through several fields that have gone fallow amid the ruins of a village that was abandoned many years ago, then eventually comes to an end at a large wetland known as Moon Marsh for the way the orange, night-blooming flowers that grow there shine under the moonlight.

Eastern Northern Road: This road connects Willowshore with numerous small but distant villages and towns scattered throughout Specterwood and eventually finds its way to the Gossamer Mountains. The next closest settlement down this road is Foxhollow, but it’s three days’ travel and even smaller than Willowshore.

Eastern Road: This road leads to the trade fortress of Karahai and represents Willowshore’s major economic link to the rest of Shenmen. Karahai has a small village (quite a bit smaller than Willowshore) nearby—the trade fortress itself being one of many economic hubs along the west coast of the Sea of Ghosts.

Northeastern Road: This road leads to a recently established farmstead on a bluff overlooking the Sea of Ghosts, a cattle ranch owned by a notoriously ruthless expatriate politician from the city of Sze who doesn’t have much to do with Willowshore.

Northwest Trail: This old overgrown trail leads off into the forest; most folks believe it leads to a long-abandoned shrine, but few travel this remote path today.

Southern Road: The southern road is a long overland route that eventually connects to better maintained roads and more populous villages and towns several days’ travel to the south, but most in Willowshore call it the “Apple Road,” as it leads to a grove of wild apple trees that produce particularly delicious fruit every fall.

Willowshore Hinterlands.name: 柳岸腹地 Willowshore Hinterlands
Willowshore Hinterlands.text:
柳岸腹地

城镇边界之外，便是崎岖起伏的腹地——西面是连绵的林木丘陵，逐渐拔升为苍翠山地；东面则有本地最大的河流，最终汇入幽灵海。这条河流入海之处，坐落着柳岸镇最近的邻居——沿海的设防集镇唐入，但即使是那里，距柳岸镇也有一日骑程。

紧邻城镇的腹地中分布着几处值得注意的小地点。渡月河是本地区最大的水道，柳岸镇则建立在其支流之一——木棉河——之上。另一条较浅的支流蜻蜓溪向南蜿蜒流去，穿过一片布满嶙峋岩石的开阔地，那地方被称为尖牙峡——这是一处天然采石场，曾为柳岸镇的道路与地基提供石料。位于柳岸镇下游的葫芦湖盛产渔获，但若有人想在湖上捕鱼，最好还是向栖居于深水之中、嬉戏于南岸的河童献上供品。将近2,000英尺高的绿绸峰，是腹地中海拔最高之处；而与之相反的，则是名为文业双眼的天然陷坑——地上寸草不生的荒芜深坑，里头积着混浊含砂的死水。

柳岸镇之外，这一地区的人类居住痕迹并不多，但也并非全无，而且大多已经废弃。东北方矗立着一处被焚毁的废弃路边客栈遗迹，它曾名为玉鸟客栈；而在渡月河源头附近，则有一座偏远的猎人小屋。北面还能找到一片旧日扩建区，原本打算用来支援柳岸镇，但那里的一众建筑与农地很快便被弃置，因为人们发现流经此地的小溪每年都会在某些时段随机干涸。西面靠近木棉河源头处，是几年前被本地木材商头弃置的旧伐木营地遗址——这处地点正慢慢被林地重新吞没。而在城镇西北方的低矮山地中，沿着名为朝圣之径的小路一路走到尽头，便能见到丹杉寺的废墟——如今，这里据说已成了怪物、鬼魂，甚至更可怕之物的巢穴。

环绕柳岸镇的林地，属于更广袤的一片大林地——幽魂之森的一部分；不过在柳岸腹地这里，那些因在林中肆虐而恶名昭彰的作祟与鬼魂，危险性倒没有那么高。当地野生动物数量众多，其中鹿和野猪是本地区主要的大型猎物；而更危险的掠食者，如黑熊、狼、巨锹甲虫与巨型蜘蛛，则构成了腹地更大的威胁，尤其是对那些离开道路太远，或在天黑后深入荒野探索的人而言。

Willowshore Hinterlands

Beyond the town’s borders lies the rugged terrain of its hinterlands—rolling forested hills rising to verdant mountains to the west, while to the east, the region’s largest river eventually flows into the Sea of Ghosts. Where this river meets the sea stands Willowshore’s closest neighbor, the coastal fortified market called Karahai, yet even this location is a day’s ride from town.

The immediate hinterlands feature a number of minor sites of interest. The Duyue River is the largest waterway in the region with Willowshore founded on one of its tributaries, the Ceiba River. A shallower tributary, Dragonfly Creek, winds south to an open area of rugged stone known as the Gorge of Fangs and Teeth—a natural quarry that supplied the stone for Willowshore’s roads and foundations. Gourd Lake, downriver from Willowshore, provides excellent fishing, but those who would ply its waters would do well to make offerings to the kappas who dwell in its depths and cavort on its southern shores. Green Silk Peak, nearly 2,000 feet high, is the highest point of elevation in the hinterlands, while the natural sinkholes known as the Eyes of Fumeiyoshi are the opposite—barren pits in the ground where nothing grows and gritty water has pooled.

Signs of habitation beyond Willowshore are sparse in the region, but they do exist and are largely abandoned. To the northeast stand the burnt-out ruins of an abandoned roadhouse once known as Canary Inn, while a remote Hunter’s Hut stands near the headwaters of the Duyue River. To the north can be found an old expansion once intended to support Willowshore, but these buildings and farms were soon abandoned when it became apparent the stream that flowed through the area tended to dry up at random intervals each year. To the west, near the source of the Ceiba River, are the remains of the old Lumber Camp abandoned a few years ago by the local lumber lords—a location that’s slowly being reclaimed by the forest. And in the low mountains northwest of town, at the far end of the trail known as Pilgrim’s Path, stand the ruins of the Tan Sugi monastery—a place reputed today to be the den of monsters, ghosts, or worse.

The forest surrounding Willowshore is part of the much larger woodland known as Specterwood, although here in Willowshore’s hinterlands, the haunts and ghosts notorious for plaguing these woods aren’t as dangerous. Wildlife is abundant with deer and boars making up the primary large game in the region, and more dangerous predators like black bears, wolves, giant stag beetles, and enormous spiders comprise the greater perils of the hinterlands to those who travel too far from the roads or explore the wilds after dark.

Languages.name: 语言 Languages
Languages.text:
语言

在肆季鬼志中，主要使用的语言是天语——在本《玩家指南》和整个《肆季鬼志》冒险路径中，这种语言被称为通用语。上述常见族裔所使用的语言（精灵语、半身人语、狐人语、娜迦吉语和天狗语）也可能会经常派上用场。

实用性较高、值得掌握的通用语言包括阿克罗语、冥地语、妖精语和死灵语。

还有一些更为特定的语言，虽然在整个战役中的总体用处没那么大，但在少数遭遇中可能会在特定情境下变得重要，包括龙语、天界语、地精语、环语、明凯语、雷奎安语和轮回裔语。

Languages

In Season of Ghosts, the primary language spoken is Tien—this language is referred to as Common in this Player’s Guide and throughout the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path. The languages of any of the common ancestries listed above (elven, halfling, kitsune, nagaji, and tengu) might find frequent use as well.

General-use languages that will be handy to know include Aklo, Chthonian, Fey, and Necril.

More specific languages that aren’t as useful for the entire campaign but might become situationally important for a small number of encounters include Draconic, Empyrean, Goblin, Hwan, Minkaian, Requian, and Samsaran.

Faiths.name: 信仰 Faiths
Faiths.text:
信仰

柳岸镇有两座神殿——一座供奉大吉津，一座供奉法拉斯玛——但镇民的信仰实际上要多样得多。除这两种信仰外，阿巴达尔与难病夫人也各自拥有许多信众，而大多数镇民都会向众多其他神祇致敬。这样的崇拜体现在遍布城镇各处的大量小型圣祠上。其中一些圣祠，如供奉大吉津与法拉斯玛的，位于众所周知的地点；但也有许多是私人圣祠，或几乎已被人遗忘的圣祠。

柳岸镇中可以找到供奉下列神祇的圣祠；如果你的角色信奉这些神祇之一，那么他们会自动知道该圣祠的位置：阿巴达尔、卡莉丝翠雅、大吉津、黛丝娜、克忒菲斯、国府幸、难病夫人、老鼠婆、安贾尔的莲华天女、法拉斯玛、齐仲、希琳、诗孜璐、月夜尊，以及虽然夜神。如果你选择信奉此处未列出的某位神祇，请与你的游戏主持商议——你的信仰甚至可能会让柳岸镇的名单上再增添一座圣祠！

请注意，某些信仰——例如阿拉兹尼、卡珊黛丽或诺克提库拉的信仰——要么尚不存在，要么还没有经历它们在预言破灭之年开始后约百年间发生的重大变化。同样地，虽然奥罗登之死仅仅发生在几年前，但他在天夏的信仰并不重要——在柳岸镇当然更是如此。由于冒险路径的时间线，你的角色应避免信奉这类神祇。

除了城镇中广泛存在的诸神信仰外，柳岸镇中还有许多人是善解的信徒。事实上，这座城镇最初的建立者便是这一信念的追随者。他们在西边山丘上建起了丹杉寺，作为一处偏远之地，以通过这一哲学追求启悟；而他们建立柳岸镇，起初是为了支援那些辛苦建造寺院的人，后来则将其发展为支援武僧的贸易枢纽。如今，丹杉寺已遭废弃，任其倾颓（而且，有些人坚持认为，那里也已任由各种幽灵和怪物盘踞），但柳岸镇中仍有许多人追随善解之道。

Faiths

Willowshore features two temples—one devoted to Daikitsu and one to Pharasma—but the townsfolk are much more diverse in their faith. In addition to these two faiths, both Abadar and Lady Nanbyo count many worshippers among their flock, and most townsfolk pay homage to a wide range of other deities. Their worship is reflected in the large number of small shrines to various faiths scattered throughout town. Some of these shrines, like those devoted to Daikitsu and Pharasma, are in well-known locations, but many are private shrines or shrines that have been all but forgotten.

Shrines to the following deities are found in Willowshore; if your character worships one of these deities, then they’ll automatically know the location of that shrine: Abadar, Calistria, Daikitsu, Desna, Ketephys, Kofusachi, Lady Nanbyo, Lao Shu Po, Nalinivati, Pharasma, Qi Zhong, Shelyn, Shizuru, Tsukiyo, and Yaezhing. If you choose to worship a deity beyond those listed here, speak with your GM—your faith might even result in another shrine being added to Willowshore’s list!

Note that certain faiths, such as those of Arazni, Casandalee, or Nocticula, either don’t yet exist or haven’t yet undergone the significant changes they made in the hundred or so years after the start of the Age of Lost Omens. Likewise, while Aroden’s death is only a few years in the past, his faith isn’t significant in Tian Xia—and certainly not in Willowshore. Your character should avoid worshipping such deities because of Adventure Path’s timeline.

Beyond the town’s wide range of deities, many in Willowshore are followers of Sangpotshi. Indeed, the original founders of the town were adherents to this belief. They built the Tan Sugi monastery up in the hills to the west as a remote place to pursue enlightenment through this philosophy, and they founded Willowshore first to support those who toiled to build the monastery and later as a trade hub to support the monks. The Tan Sugi monastery is now abandoned and has been left to ruin (and, some maintain, to various ghosts and monsters), but many in Willowshore still follow the path of Sangpotshi.

Classes.name: 职业 Classes
Classes.text:
职业

在《肆季鬼志》中，默认你的角色都是柳岸镇的居民。虽然柳岸镇的人口只有225人（不包括你们这些玩家角色！），但这座城镇的历史与地理位置，使其能够包容多种多样的角色职业，并让它们成为这批新晋英雄的一员。

炼金术师在柳岸镇备受尊敬与喜爱，这既是因为他们身为草药师的技艺，也是因为他们擅长为节日制作奇巧有趣的消遣之物。坟边居的本地草药师尤素珍更专注于炼金创新中的草药学一面，但如果你能赢得她的支持与友谊，获得她的炼金术师实验室与材料的使用许可，将会在整个战役中给你带来极大帮助。对于柳岸镇的炼金术师而言，外科师研究领域是最契合主题的选择，但在《肆季鬼志》中，任何研究领域都同样实用。

万灵师和神谕使一样，都是《肆季鬼志》中极具主题契合度的强力选择，尤其是那些以灵媒或萨满身份修行者。与乡野环境或古老民俗传统相关的显灵体是最好的主题选择，包括林苑守护者、失落时光之回响、暗处伪者、幽枝潜猎者，以及古战见证者。此外，更多关于宗教的指引请见第9页的“信仰”。

野蛮人在《肆季鬼志》中可能是较为复杂的选择，因为这一地区并没有已建立的野蛮人部族。虽然柳岸镇里没有这样的非玩家角色，但当地也不乏喜欢狠狠干上一架，或欣赏强健体魄的人。拥有兽性本能的野蛮人可能会因其狩猎技巧而受到重视，而拥有灵性本能的野蛮人则可能因能抵御本地人所惧怕的恶灵而备受尊敬（而且在《肆季鬼志》的许多战斗遭遇中，他们更容易伤害虚体敌人的能力肯定会是极大的优势！）。其他本能与柳岸镇并没有特别鲜明的主题联系，但总体而言，在这条冒险路径中也都不算差的选择。

吟游诗人在《肆季鬼志》的各个阶段都会有许多机会去影响非玩家角色、创作独特演出，或凭借音乐占据优势，但在这条冒险路径中，没有哪一种特定构筑会比其他构筑更有优势。如果你选择“谜团”作为自己的缪斯，那么谭隋靖（一位古老的民间英雄，其昔日功绩如今已成为柳岸镇传承的一部分）或大柳树（与镇北山丘上那棵高耸同名柳树相关的奇异木灵神使）都会是很有趣的选择——你也可以和你的游戏主持商量，看看是否还有其他神秘缪斯也说得通。在柳岸镇，经营七彩鸣雀剧场的主管大野一真，素来以会定期选拔表演者而闻名。

圣武士都适合用于《肆季鬼志》，前提是其理念不会让他们与队伍其他成员发生冲突。一个经典的例子是：一位定居小镇并成为其守护者的浪人——这正是像《肆季鬼志》这样的战役中，圣武士的标志性角色定位。虽然这条冒险路径中并没有很多要求玩家角色骑乘作战的遭遇，但无论在城镇还是荒野区域，都会有不少机会让坐骑在战斗中派上用场。

牧师应参考“信仰”条目下提供的额外信息，以确定适合崇拜哪位神祇。

指挥者与《肆季鬼志》的主题并不是特别贴合，但和战士一样，他们会在战斗中找到许多大放异彩的机会。不过，也请记住，这条冒险路径中存在大量非战斗挑战，因此可以考虑把一些技能提升投入到制作、交涉、威吓和社群等选项上。

德鲁伊会在《肆季鬼志》中拥有大量出色表现的机会，因为这条冒险路径聚焦于一整年的四季变化，而柳岸镇本身也是一处乡野之地。温带森林是本冒险路径中最主要的自然地形。动物结社、叶之结社与风暴结社是最契合本冒险路径主题的德鲁伊结社，但所有结社都能在这场战役中找到发光发热的机会。以下动物是柳岸镇周边地区最常见的生物，因此把它们之一选作你的动物伙伴，也会非常契合主题（如果你想选择不同的动物伙伴，请与游戏主持讨论它是在何种特殊情况下成为你伙伴的）：树人幼苗、獾、蝙蝠、熊、甲虫、鸟、野猪、猫、马、蛇或狼。

典范使可能会与《肆季鬼志》那种小镇主题与整体设定产生冲突，因此请务必将这条冒险路径的乡野背景牢记在心。同样，由于这条冒险路径发生在《神雨》事件一个多世纪之前，你需要与游戏主持一起决定你的神性火花源自何处。选择称号时，可以参考第9页“技能”中的建议；你也可以与游戏主持共同缩小选择范围，好让对方在需要时提供经过筛选、且不会剧透的指导。

战士会在《肆季鬼志》中有大量大显身手的机会，但也必须记住，这条冒险路径包含很多城镇与休整模式元素。可以考虑加强你在制作、交涉、威吓或社群等技能上的训练，这样在本冒险路径的非战斗部分，你也依然能有闪耀时刻。

守护者在这条冒险路径中会面临与指挥者相似的主题性挑战，尤其是在面对《肆季鬼志》中数量众多的非战斗挑战时。和指挥者与战士一样，请确保你接受了制作、交涉、威吓与社群等技能的训练，这样在战役的这些环节中你仍然有可发挥之处。

枪手从主题角度来说，并不是这条冒险路径中特别好的选择；除此之外，柳岸镇里也没有任何可供枪手依赖的资源。如果你想扮演一名枪手，最好先和你的游戏主持谈谈，不过更明智的做法可能还是把枪手玩家角色的点子留到别的战役中去。

发明家在神门并不常见，但也绝非闻所未闻，而他们搭造机关与提出创造性解决方案的才能，在像柳岸镇这样乡野地区会格外有价值，因为这里并不能保证总能取得更广泛的稀有或专用工具与道具。事实上，柳岸镇铁匠铺“第二佳作坊”的霍天哲，正是以其装置与创造物而广为人知；对于玩家角色发明家而言，他完全可能成为一位极佳的盟友或朋友。对于《肆季鬼志》而言，并不存在某种发明家革新比另一种更适合或更不适合的情况。

调查员在《肆季鬼志》的过程中，会有大量机会去研究信息、追踪线索并揭开谜团，因此总体而言，他们是这条冒险路径中特别出色的选择。炼金科学与法医学的方法论，是这条冒险路径中最契合主题的选项。

动能使是《肆季鬼志》中不错的选择，尽管柳岸镇本地对于元素或动能使风格并没有太多主题支撑——如果你想扮演一名动能使，可以和你的游戏主持讨论，看看是否能在某些方面稍作调整。尤其值得一提的是，“木对金属”这一主题，在本战役中扮演着一种微妙却持续存在的潜在角色；柳岸镇的人民更偏向于木，而金属则更明显地与构成战役对立面的某些元素相呼应。

魔剑士会发现他们的能力在《肆季鬼志》全程都很有用，但在主题上并没有与这条冒险路径的剧情特别紧密地绑定。当然，这也意味着魔剑士角色在做出有关自身力量成长的选择时，基本不会受到多少主题冲突的束缚！

武僧是柳岸镇非常契合主题的强力选择，因为这座城镇最初就是为支援一座偏远寺院而建立的。虽然那个地方——丹杉寺——如今已成废墟，不再运作，但武僧的生活方式在柳岸镇本地依然可能带来极大的回报，哪怕只是作为这座城镇丰厚历史与传承的一部分。更多关于宗教或信念的指引，请见第9页“信仰”。

神谕使若以神圣施法者而言，或许比牧师还更适合作为《肆季鬼志》的主题选择。大多数神谕奥秘都很契合这条冒险路径的主题，其中契合度最低的是战斗、寰宇与烈焰。此外，更多关于宗教的指引请见第9页的“信仰”。

灵能者在柳岸镇居民中并不常见，但他们的魔法实践为人所知，也受人钦佩。那些将自己的研究与力量专注于学识、发掘远古秘密，或对抗超自然力量等主题的人，会发现《肆季鬼志》中绝不会缺少适合他们发挥的机会。

游侠在柳岸镇的人民之中颇受重视，因为他们的求生本领与狩猎专长，有助于这座城镇在筹措食粮方面维持自给自足。镇上的银雾斋是本地游侠传统上的聚集地点，但到了今天，一名游侠几乎可以以镇上任何区域，或更外侧的乡野地带为活动据点。如果你获得了动物伙伴，请参照第7页德鲁伊条目下列出的建议。如果你选择“偏好地形”专长，那么森林地形无疑是你在《肆季鬼志》中最常面对的地形。水栖（特征）地形（以湖泊和河流的形式出现）与山地地形的重要性则小得多，其后平原、天空、沼泽与地下还会有更次要的戏份。《肆季鬼志》中不会出现极地或沙漠地形。

游荡者会在《肆季鬼志》中找到许多运用自身技能的机会，尤其是那些与驾驭乡野小镇政治人情相关的能力。决定将训练重点放在哪里时，可以参考第9页“技能”中的建议。

术士是这条冒险路径中极为契合主题的优秀选择，因为柳岸镇浸润在众多超自然且神秘的传统之中。所有术士血脉在《肆季鬼志》中都同样可能很有趣，但最契合主题的是帝皇或亡灵。

召唤师在构筑自己的幻灵时，应考虑本地地区环境（森林，夹杂一些低山，并有大量河流与湖泊），但除此之外，他们会发现自己在《肆季鬼志》中拥有极其广泛的选择范围。本冒险路径中最契合主题的幻灵选择是愤怒魅影、野兽、奉献魅影、植物或引魂使。

诡术剑客和战士有些相似，他们会在这场战役的战斗中找到许多展示身手的机会，但他们也应考虑训练一些其他选项，以便在休整模式期间，或身处城镇而战斗并非最佳解决方式时加以运用。

奇术师是《肆季鬼志》的绝佳选择。和调查员一样，他们将面对各种各样的谜团与远古秘密，等待他们探索与揭示。所有奇术师法器在这场战役中都能找到可供构筑的主题联系，但也许没有哪一种比提灯更贴切，尤其考虑到柳岸镇与其@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog22sogpgh.JournalEntryPage.00w11dawnstepb00]{长明灯}之间那深厚的传统联系。虽然你不能直接把这盏特定提灯选作你的法器，但若制作一盏仿照其形制打造的提灯，就会显得再合适不过！

女巫由于与神秘庇护主的联系，以及该职业内建的、贴近恐怖题材的主题，或许比术士还更适合作为《肆季鬼志》的施法者选择。选择庇护主时，请和你的游戏主持交流以获得进一步指导，但“信念守焰者”“怨憎”“雪中寂静”或“荒野管事”这些庇护主主题，永远都会是本冒险路径中的优秀选择。选择魔宠时，请记得柳岸镇与一位传统守护者有关。访客可以在镇东边道路旁的一座圣祠中看到一尊巨大的石蜘蛛雕像——因此，选择蜘蛛魔宠会非常契合主题！

法师会发现，柳岸镇的人民相当看重他们对魔法的掌握，只要他们专注的方向不是那种令人不安又可怖的领域！话虽如此，所有魔法学派在这条冒险路径中都会有充足的用武之地。玩家角色法师或许会想与慈母之环的井川十兵卫结盟或成为朋友，他是柳岸镇常驻的法师，也是研究一切魔法事物的学者。

Classes

In Season of Ghosts, your characters are assumed to be citizens of Willowshore. While Willowshore only has a population of 225 (excluding your PCs!), the town’s history and placement make it open toward a wide range of potential character classes to be represented by its newest cast of heroes.

Alchemists are respected and adored in Willowshore for both their skill as herbalists and talent in crafting fanciful distractions for festivals. Local herbalist You So-Jin of Graveside Manners focuses more on the herbalism side of alchemical innovation, but access to her alchemist’s lab and supplies, should you earn her support and friendship, will be of great use to you during the campaign. The chirurgeon research field is the most appropriate thematic choice for a Willowshore alchemist, but any research field will be of equal use in Season of Ghosts.

Animists are, like oracles, a strong thematic choice for Season of Ghosts, particularly those who practice as mediums or shamans. Apparitions associated with rural settings or old folk traditions are the best thematic choices, including Custodian of Groves and Gardens, Echo of Lost Moments, Impostor in Hidden Places, Stalker in Darkened Boughs, and Witness to Ancient Battles. Also, see Faiths on page 9 for additional guidance on religions.

Barbarians might be a complex choice for Season of Ghosts considering the lack of any established barbarian clans in the region. Though there are no such NPCs in Willowshore, there are plenty of locals who enjoy a good fight or appreciate physical strength. An animal instinct barbarian might be valued for their skills at hunting, while a spirit instinct barbarian might find themselves respected as a defender against the evil spirits that locals fear (and will certainly find their ability to harm incorporeal foes more easily to be a great boon during many combat encounters in Season of Ghosts!) Other instincts don’t have a particular thematic tie to Willowshore, but none of them are particularly poor choices overall for this Adventure Path.

Bards will have many opportunities to influence NPCs, craft singular performances, or use music to their advantage at various points during Season of Ghosts, but no specific build is more advantageous over another in this Adventure Path. If you select enigma as your muse, Tan Sui-Jing (an ancient folk hero whose accomplishments in the past are now a part of Willowshore’s legacy) or Great Willow (the strange kodama kami associated with the towering willow tree of the same name that looms atop a hill north of town) might be fun choices—speak with your GM to find out if any other mysterious muses might make sense. In Willowshore, Kazuma Oono, the director who runs the Seven-Colored Songbird theater, is known to periodically audition performers.

Champions are all appropriate for Season of Ghosts, provided their cause doesn’t set them up to clash against the rest of the party. The classic example of a ronin who settles in a small town and becomes its protector is an iconic role for a champion in a campaign like Season of Ghosts. While there aren’t many encounters in this Adventure Path that require the PCs to be mounted, there are be plenty of opportunities in both urban and wilderness areas where having a mount in combat could be helpful.

Clerics should consider the additional information presented under Faiths for guidelines on which deity to worship.

Commanders aren’t particularly strong thematic matches for Season of Ghosts, but like fighters, they’ll find many chances to shine during combat. Still, remember that there are a lot of non-combat challenges in this Adventure Path, so consider focusing some of your skill increases on options like Crafting, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Society.

Druids will have ample opportunity to excel in Season of Ghosts as a result of the Adventure Path’s focus on a year’s worth of seasons and the town of Willowshore being a rural location. Temperate forests are the primary natural terrain featured in this Adventure Path. The druid orders of animal, leaf, and storm are the most thematically appropriate choices for this Adventure Path, but all orders will find opportunities to shine in this campaign. The following animals are the most common in the region surrounding Willowshore, so choosing one of them as your animal companion will also be on theme (if you wish to choose a different animal companion, speak to your GM about how this animal might have become your companion under unusual circumstances): arboreal sapling, badger, bat, bear, beetle, bird, boar, cat, horse, snake, or wolf.

Exemplars might find themselves clashing with the small-town themes and setting of Season of Ghosts, so make sure to keep the Adventure Path’s rural setting in mind. Likewise, since this Adventure Path takes place over a century before the events of Godsrain, you’ll want to work with your GM to determine where your divine spark comes from. When choosing epithets, consider the advice featured in Skills on page 9; you can work with your GM to narrow down choices as well so that they can provide curated, non-spoiler guidance as needed.

Fighters will find ample opportunity to shine in Season of Ghosts, but it’s important to remember that there are a lot of urban and downtime elements in this Adventure Path. Consider bolstering your training in a skill like Crafting, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Society so that you’ll still have moments to shine during the noncombat portions of this Adventure Path.

Guardians will face similar thematic challenges in this Adventure Path as commanders do, particularly when confronted by the numerous non-combat challenges in Season of Ghosts. As with commanders and fighters, make sure you’re trained in skills like Crafting, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Society so you still have something to work with during these portions of the campaign.

Gunslingers aren’t a particularly good choice, thematically, for this Adventure Path, and beyond that, there are no resources for gunslingers to rely upon in the town of Willowshore. If you want to play a gunslinger, talk to your GM first, but it’s probably best to save your ideas for a gunslinger PC for another campaign.

Inventors aren’t common in Shenmen, but they’re hardly unknown, and their knack for rigging up contraptions and creative solutions can be quite valuable in a rural area like Willowshore where access to a wider range of rare or specialized tools and gear aren’t guaranteed. Indeed, Huo Tian-Zhe of Willowshore’s smithy, Second Best, is well-known for his contraptions and creations, and he could make for an excellent ally or friend to a PC inventor. There’s no inventor innovation that’s more or less appropriate for Season of Ghosts than another.

Investigators will find plenty of opportunities to research information, track clues, and unravel mysteries during the course of Season of Ghosts, making them a particularly excellent choice for this Adventure Path overall. The methodologies of alchemical sciences and forensic medicine are the most thematically appropriate options for this Adventure Path.

Kineticists are a fine choice for Season of Ghosts, although there isn’t much thematic support in Willowshore for an elemental or kineticist flavor—if you wish to play a kineticist, speak with your GM about potentially adjusting that in some way. In particular, a theme of “wood against metal” plays a subtle underlying role in this campaign; the people of Willowshore more align toward wood, while metal aligns more noticeably with certain elements that form a part of the campaign’s opposition.

Magi will find their abilities useful throughout Season of Ghosts but aren’t particularly tied, thematically, to this Adventure Path’s plot. Of course, that also means a magus character will be relatively free from thematic clashes when making choices about their increasing power!

Monks are a strong thematic choice for Willowshore, as the town was originally founded to serve as support for a remote monastery. While that place, the Tan Sugi monastery, is now in ruins and no longer operational, a monk’s lifestyle can still be exceptionally rewarding in Willowshore proper, if only as part of the town’s rich history and legacy. See Faiths on page 9 for additional guidance on religion or belief.

Oracles are perhaps an even stronger thematic choice for Season of Ghosts than clerics as far as divine spellcasters are concerned. Most oracle mysteries are strong thematic choices in this Adventure Path, with Battle, Cosmos, and Flames being the least so. Also, see Faiths on page 9 for additional guidance on religions.

Psychics aren’t well represented among Willowshore’s citizens, but their magical practices are known and admired. Those who focus their studies and powers on themes associated with lore, discovering ancient secrets, or battling supernatural forces will find themselves with no shortage of opportunity in Season of Ghosts.

Rangers are quite valued among Willowshore’s people, as their survivalist abilities and hunting acumen help the town maintain its self-sufficiency when it comes to gathering food. The town’s Silvermist Lodges are the traditional locations where local rangers would gather, but today, a ranger could be based out of nearly any part of town or the hinterlands beyond. If you gain an animal companion, consult the suggestions listed for druids on page 7. If you take the Favored Terrain feat, the terrain of Forest is far and above the most common terrain you’ll face during Season of Ghosts. The aquatic (in the form of lakes and rivers) and Mountain terrains have much more minor roles to play, after which there are even lesser roles for Plains, Sky, Swamp, and Underground. Season of Ghosts doesn’t feature arctic or desert terrains.

Rogues will find many uses for their skills in Season of Ghosts, particularly when it comes to those associated with navigating the politics of a small rural town. Consider the advice for Skills on page 9 when choosing where to focus your training.

Sorcerers are an excellent thematic choice for this Adventure Path, as Willowshore is steeped in many supernatural and mysterious traditions. All sorcerer bloodlines could be equally interesting in Season of Ghosts, but the most thematically appropriate ones are imperial or undead.

Summoners should consider the local regions (forests, with some low mountains and plenty of rivers and lakes) when building their eidolon, but apart from that, they’ll find they have a wide range of choices available to them during Season of Ghosts. The most thematic selections for eidolons in this Adventure Path are anger phantom, beast, devotion phantom, plant, or psychopomp.

Swashbucklers are like fighters in that they’ll find plenty of chances to show their stuff in this campaign’s battles, but they should consider also training other options to explore during downtime or while in urban areas when fighting isn’t the best solution.

Thaumaturges are excellent choices for Season of Ghosts. Like the investigator, they’ll be faced with a wide range of mysteries and ancient secrets to explore and uncover. All thaumaturge implements could find thematic links to build from in this campaign, but perhaps none more so than the lantern, considering Willowshore’s strong tradition with its @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2apsog22sogpgh.JournalEntryPage.00w11dawnstepb00]{Eternal Lantern}. While you can’t select this particular lantern as your implement, a lantern crafted in its image would fit right in!

Witches are perhaps an even more thematically appropriate choice for a spellcaster than sorcerer for Season of Ghosts due to their ties to a mysterious patron and the horror-adjacent themes built right into the class. Speak with your GM when choosing your patron to receive additional guidance, but the patron themes of Faith’s Flamekeeper, The Resentment, Silence in Snow, or Wilding Steward are always going to be excellent choices for this Adventure Path. When choosing a familiar, keep in mind that Willowshore is associated with a traditional guardian. Visitors can find a large stone spider statue in a shrine just off the road along the town’s eastern edge—as such, choosing a spider familiar is quite on theme!

Wizards will find their mastery over magic to be something the people of Willowshore quite value, provided their focus isn’t on something unsettling and frightening! That said, all schools of magic will have ample opportunities for use during this Adventure Path. A PC wizard might wish to pursue an alliance or friendship with Igawa Jubei of Mother’s Coil, who is Willowshore’s resident wizard and a scholar of all things magical.

Inappropriate Ancestries.name: 不恰当的族裔 Inappropriate Ancestries
Inappropriate Ancestries.text:
不恰当的族裔

水栖族裔在《肆季鬼志》中会发现自己确实有些格格不入，因为这类角色几乎没有多少能够大放异彩的时刻。柳岸镇位于一条河流岸边，镇中心还有一座湖，因此的确有可供栖身的水域，但在为你的角色做出这种选择之前，请先与你的游戏主持商量。

安卓人同样不适合这个战役。由于《肆季鬼志》的时间设定大约早于《钢铁众神冒险路径》中的事件100年，安卓人根本还没有扩散到足以在纽梅利亚边境之外、世界其他地方被合理遇见的程度。如果你想在《肆季鬼志》中扮演一名安卓人，你就需要与你的游戏主持合作，按需要调整你游戏中的正典设定，为一名安卓人出现在柳岸镇提供一个在世界观内合乎逻辑的理由。

最后，正如人们从这条冒险路径的标题中就能猜到的那样，亡灵族裔在《肆季鬼志》中会是尤其尴尬的选择，因此不应被玩家角色选用。

Inappropriate Ancestries

Aquatic ancestries will find themselves literally out of their element in Season of Ghosts, as there are very few moments for such characters to shine. Willowshore is located on the banks of a river and has a lake at its heart, so there is a source of water to dwell in, but speak with your GM before making such a choice for your character.

Androids are inappropriate for this campaign as well. Since Season of Ghosts is set roughly 100 years before the events of the Iron Gods Adventure Path, androids simply haven’t spread far enough beyond the borders of Numeria to be logically encountered elsewhere in the world. If you wish to play an android in Season of Ghosts, you’ll need to work with your GM to adjust your game’s canon as needed to provide a logical in-world reason for an android’s presence in Willowshore.

Finally, as one might guess from the title of this Adventure Path, undead ancestries would make for particularly awkward choices in Season of Ghosts and should not be chosen for a PC.

Ancestries.name: 族裔 Ancestries
Ancestries.text:
族裔

天狗的敌意

虽然柳岸镇的人民对镇上的天狗居民并无根本上的反感（实际上，其中有些人，比如川冈山人，还是备受尊敬的商铺主人），但现代神门的统治者——络新妇——却憎恨天狗，并且在与他们相遇时，众所周知会陷入充满杀意的狂暴。由于《肆季鬼志》的故事设定于络新妇统治神门的初期，偏远的柳岸镇至今尚未迎来任何络新妇访客；因此，天狗玩家角色通常不需要经常面对这种愤懑。如果在战役中出现有关络新妇造访柳岸镇的传闻或消息，游玩天狗角色的玩家应当留意——你的游戏主持在冒险中提供了如何处理此类情况的建议，所以如果你对扮演天狗玩家角色有所顾虑，请与游戏主持沟通，好让他们以自己觉得合适的方式，为你的游戏桌提供量身定制的建议。

作为柳岸镇的居民，玩家角色最适合选择的族裔，是那些在镇上有相当代表性的族裔。

常见族裔

以下族裔在柳岸镇都有一定程度的分布。人类毫无疑问是柳岸镇数量最多的族裔，来自整个天夏的人类族群在此都有体现。由于神门邻近神门邻近精瑛与和昆莱这样的国家，国内城镇中生活着相当数量的精灵、半精灵、莱西与天狗，柳岸镇也不例外。塔尔丹族群的人类和半身人（大多是从神门正北方的阿玛南达迁来的居民）也生活在柳岸镇。狐人与娜迦吉在整个神门并不算特别广泛，但在柳岸镇也有少量分布；请注意，这两种族裔在《开拓者失落预兆天夏角色指南》中都有更多可选项！

非常见族裔

这些族裔在柳岸镇较为少见——镇上可能只有寥寥几位，甚至除了潜在的玩家角色外一个也没有，但它们在主题上仍然适合《肆季鬼志》。在选择这些族裔之前，你或许应该先与游戏主持讨论，好让他们有机会视情况调整战役，并让你的选择在柳岸镇居民中更有存在感。

矮人、侏儒、地精和兽人并未在柳岸镇形成显著数量，但这些族群中的任何一支都可能从阿玛南达南迁至此定居。

吸血裔会是像《肆季鬼志》这样恐怖主题战役的绝佳贴题选择，尤其是拥有儒尸血系的那些（《族裔指南》26页），他们将自己的吸血血脉追溯至僵尸。一些鼠族（也称 ysoki；《玩家核心2》28页）生活在柳岸镇，也同样是合适的玩家角色选择。

拿非利人（尤其是那些从幽灵海彼岸国家天京前来神门的天界后裔）也可能已在神门定居。居住在神门的坎比昂常常被柳岸镇居民以恐惧和猜疑的目光看待，但若《肆季鬼志》中出现这种族裔的玩家角色，其他镇民通常早已知道他们是有别于刻板印象的“例外”——若你希望扮演这样的角色，请与游戏主持讨论如何将其融入本战役；若他们愿意，也可以调整战役中的某些方面来反映你的选择。

大地精玩家角色可能来自西方国家高陵来到柳岸镇，但和坎比昂一样，他们也常被人以恐惧或怀疑的态度看待。

虽然目前柳岸镇中并没有冥人、付丧神偶灵、轮回裔、影裔或妖怪裔居住，但这些族裔仍契合《肆季鬼志》的某些主题。如果你有兴趣扮演这些族裔之一，请与游戏主持沟通，因为他们可能会给你一些额外建议。

罕见族裔

任何未在上文提及（或未列于下方“不恰当的族裔”中的）其他族裔都被视为罕见——从游戏平衡角度来看，这些族裔当然也能运作，但它们与《肆季鬼志》的主题并不是特别契合。如果你想扮演罕见族裔，请先与游戏主持沟通。

Ancestries

Tengu Animosity

While the people of Willowshore harbor no intrinsic dislike of their tengu citizens (and indeed, some of them, like Kawaka Myna, are well-respected business owners), the rulers of modern Shenmen, the jorogumo, loathe tengu and are known to fly into murderous rages when confronted by them. Since Season of Ghosts is set at the onset of jorogumo rule over Shenmen, remote Willowshore has yet to face any jorogumo visitors; as such, tengu PCs won’t need to navigate this bitter animosity often. Should rumors or news of a jorogumo visit to Willowshore arise in the campaign, players of tengu characters should take note—your GM has advice in the adventures on how to handle such situations, so if you have concerns about playing a tengu PC, speak to your GM so they can provide advice customized to your table in a way they feel comfortable with.

As a citizen of the town of Willowshore, the most appropriate ancestries to choose for a PC are those that are represented significantly in the town.

Common Ancestries

The following ancestries are all represented to a certain degree in Willowshore. Humans are far and away the most numerous ancestry in Willowshore, with all of Tian Xia’s human ethnicities being represented. Shenmen’s proximity to nations like Jinin and Kwanlai has ensured that a noticeable number of elves, half-elves, leshies, and tengu live in the nation’s towns, and Willowshore is no exception. Humans of Taldan ethnicity and halflings (largely folk emigrated from the nation of Amanandar just north of Shenmen) are present in Willowshore as well. Kitsune and nagaji aren’t as widespread throughout Shenmen, but they’re present in small numbers in Willowshore; note that both of these ancestries have a few more options to choose from in Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide!

Uncommon Ancestries

These ancestries are less common in Willowshore—there might only be a handful living in town or none at all besides potential PCs, but they’re still thematically appropriate for Season of Ghosts. You might wish to speak to your GM before selecting one of these ancestries to give them a chance to potentially adjust the campaign and give your choice more visibility among Willowshore’s citizens.

Dwarves, gnomes, goblins, and orcs aren’t present in notable numbers in Willowshore, but any of these peoples could have emigrated south from Amanandar to settle there.

Dhampirs would make an excellent thematic choice for a horror-themed campaign like Season of Ghosts, particularly those of the ru-shi lineage (Ancestry Guide 26), who trace their vampiric bloodline to a jiang-shi. Some ysoki (aka ratfolk; Player Core 2 28) live in Willowshore and would also make appropriate PCs.

Nephilim (particularly empyreans who have traveled to Shenmen from the nation of Tianjing on the opposite shore of the Sea of Ghosts) might have settled in Shenmen as well. Cambions who dwell in Shenmen are often regarded with fear and suspicion by those in Willowshore, but any PCs of such an ancestry in Season of Ghosts is already known to the other townsfolk as an “exception” to the expectation—speak to your GM about integrating such a character into this campaign in the event they wish to adjust certain aspects of the campaign to reflect your choice.

Hobgoblins PCs might have come to Willowshore from the western nation of Kaoling, but like cambions, they are often regarded with fear or suspicion.

While there aren’t any duskwalkers, tsukumogami poppets, samsarans, wayangs, or yaoguai currently living in Willowshore, these ancestries still match certain themes in Season of Ghosts. Speak with your GM if you’re interested in playing one of these ancestries, as they might have additional advice for you.

Rare Ancestries

Any other ancestry not mentioned above (or in Inappropriate Ancestries below) is considered rare—while these ancestries can certainly work from a game balance perspective, they aren’t particularly on theme for Season of Ghosts. If you wish to play a rare ancestry, speak with your GM first.

Edicts and Anathemas.name: 典范与禁忌 Edicts and Anathemas
Edicts and Anathemas.text:
典范与禁忌

《肆季鬼志》的核心在于柳岸镇这座城镇——一个由数百名居民组成的乡村社区，这里的人们信念各异，性格也不尽相同。话虽如此，柳岸镇的整体风气明显远离残忍与其他邪恶行径，而这条冒险路径在很大程度上也依赖于玩家角色出于同情心去保护自己的镇民同胞，而非受到任何金钱奖励的明确许诺驱使。因此，那些鼓励邪恶动作，或不允许你与镇上同胞合作的典范与禁忌，在主题上并不是这条冒险路径的理想选择。不过一如既往，只要各个玩家角色能够彼此合作，并且（在此情况下）希望确保他们共同家乡的繁荣与求生，大多数典范与禁忌都能正常适用。如果你怀疑自己玩家角色的典范与禁忌可能不适合一位小镇英雄，请与你的游戏主持协商！

Edicts and Anathemas

The heart of Season of Ghosts lies in the town of Willowshore, a rural community made up of a couple hundred people with varying beliefs and personalities. That said, the primary attitude in Willowshore skews markedly away from cruelty and other evil acts, and a fair amount of this Adventure Path relies on the PCs being motivated through compassion to protect their fellow townsfolk without any particular promise of monetary rewards. As a result, edicts and anthemas that promote evil actions or don’t allow for cooperation with your fellow townsfolk aren’t a great thematic fit for this Adventure Path. As always, though, as long as the individual PCs are able to work together and (in this case) wish to ensure the prosperity and survival of their shared hometown, most edicts and anathemas will function just fine. Work with your GM if you suspect your PC’s edicts and anathemas might not be a good fit for a small-town hero!

Character Suggestions.name: 角色建议 Character Suggestions
Character Suggestions.text:
角色建议

以下信息为创建与柳岸镇城镇及神门国度中呈现的主题相契合的角色提供背景，也有助于你构建一个能够很好融入《肆季鬼志》整体剧情的角色。

Character Suggestions

The following information provides context for creating characters that fit well with the themes present in the town of Willowshore and the nation of Shenmen and also helps you to build a character that will fit well in the overall storyline of Season of Ghosts.

Horror and Consent.name: 恐怖与同意 Horror and Consent
Horror and Consent.text:
恐怖与同意

肆季鬼志是一场以恐怖为主题的战役，因此，随着这条冒险路径逐步展开，游戏主持和玩家应当共同努力，确保其中呈现的主题适合你们的游戏桌。如果你对恐怖题材中某些常见的套路或主题感到不适，请在开始肆季鬼志之前与游戏主持和其他玩家沟通，以便找到一个共同的接受范围，让桌上的每个人都能同样享受这场战役。

Horror and Consent

Season of Ghosts is a horror-themed campaign, and as such, the GM and players should work together to ensure that the themes presented as this Adventure Path unfolds are appropriate for the game table. If you aren’t comfortable with certain tropes or themes common to the horror genre, speak with your GM and the other players before beginning Season of Ghosts so you can arrive at a common ground where everyone at your table can enjoy the campaign equally.

About Shenmen.name: 关于神门 About Shenmen
About Shenmen.text:
关于神门

虽然天夏的一些国家受到了某些现实文化的启发，但神门主要汲取自现实世界中各种故事里的恐怖传统。它是一个虚构的国家，并不意在代表这些超自然恐怖传统之外的任何事物。在神门的历史上，它曾被龙华征服，接纳过来自花国的移民，也曾被络新妇所统治。因此，这里呈现出多种文化交融的面貌，其人民在姓名与地名中也采用了多种语言的词汇。在神门，鬼魂与怪物是生活中真实存在的一部分，而人们所采取的种种做法源于现实需要，而非迷信。

About Shenmen

While some nations in Tian Xia are inspired by certain real-life cultures, Shenmen is primarily inspired by horror traditions taken from a wide range of real-world stories. It’s a fictional nation and isn’t meant to represent more than these traditions of supernatural horror. During Shenmen’s history, it was conquered by Lung Wa, picked up immigrants from Hwanggot, and was taken over by jorogumo. It features a mix of cultures as a result, and its people have adopted words from multiple languages for their names and places. In Shenmen, ghosts and monsters are a very real part of life, and the practices employed by its people arise from necessity, not superstition.

In the Year 7108.name: 在 7108 年 In the Year 7108
In the Year 7108.text:
在 7108 年

《肆季鬼志》开始于 7108 年的夏日第一天，比其他《冒险路径》通常设定的当前年份还要早一个多世纪。虽然在这样遥远的过去进行一场战役，可能需要花费大量工作来修订格拉利昂各地的设定，但《肆季鬼志》在这方面几乎不需要做什么——柳岸镇地处偏远乡间，在预言破灭之年的最初几年里，基本上一直被忽视，自行其是。

预言破灭之年始于 7106 年，那是一个强大风暴肆虐格拉利昂大部分地区的时代。柳岸镇也不例外，席卷这片地区的冬季风暴是人们记忆中最严重的一次。如今，两年过去了，柳岸镇的人民对即将到来的冬季多少有些紧张。尽管 7107 年的冬季相对温和，7106 年的大雪、狂风与暴雨仍令人记忆犹新。

龙华帝国的崩溃对柳岸镇而言并不是那么迫切的问题，尽管从更大的地区尺度来看，这场政治动荡是塑造现代天夏最重要的事件之一。虽然神门在 7106 年结束了龙华的统治，但像柳岸镇这样的小镇，历来都是在由龙华典范任命的总督管理下被长期忽视、自行其是，因此柳岸镇在很大程度上免于承受帝国崩溃带来的后果。柳岸镇很幸运，帝国指派的总督赫山宝，按传统来看还算仁厚；如果说有什么影响的话，那就是每年不再有收税官或其他帝皇访客到来，反倒让这座乡间小镇迎来了田园般的岁月。与此同时，帝国崩溃带来的混乱则在更城市化的地区引发了暴力与动荡。龙华崩溃给柳岸镇带来的最大变化，是多位木材大亨离开了镇子，抛下了他们的宅邸和伐木营地，不再继续为距离柳岸镇最近的大型定居点——司泽城——供应木材。对柳岸镇的人民来说，这些令人不快的长期访客离去，几乎被一致视为一种解脱；而这些访客的庄园与伐木营地也一直无人打扰，一部分是出于恐惧，担心他们随时可能回来，但更多则是因为当地人相信，让这些建筑与地点被林地重新吞没，才是将龙华对柳岸镇的影响送入记忆中最体面的方式。

关于络新妇已经控制神门的说法，在此时仍只是一则“鬼故事”或“可怕的流言”。还没有络新妇来到过柳岸镇……至少据人们所知是如此。同样地，关于司泽统治者死去后又以幽灵之身归来的消息，如今也终于传到了镇上，但并不是所有人都相信这些故事。柳岸镇的人民仍满足于像往常一样生活——至少目前如此！

In the Year 7108

Season of Ghosts begins on the first day of summer in the year 7108, over a century before the current year assumed for other Adventure Paths. While playing a campaign this far in the past could result in significant work to revise the setting in various parts of Golarion, Season of Ghosts requires very little work in this regard—Willowshore is a remote rural location that, for the first several years of the Age of Lost Omens, was largely ignored and left to its own devices.

The Age of Lost Omens began in 7106, a time during which powerful storms wracked much of Golarion. Willowshore was no exception, and the winter storms that blasted the region were among the worst in memory. Now, two years later, the people of Willowshore are somewhat nervous about the coming winter season. Even though the winter of 7107 was relatively mild, memories of the snow, high winds, and torrential rains of 7106 linger.

The collapse of the Lung Wa Empire is a less immediate concern to Willowshore, even though on a larger regional scale, this political upheaval is one of the most important events to shape modern Tian Xia. While Shenmen’s rule under Lung Wa ended in 7106, the fact that small towns like Willowshore had traditionally been ignored and left to their own devices under governors installed by Lung Wa edicts has largely sheltered Willowshore from suffering from the ramifications of the empire’s collapse. Willowshore is fortunate that the governor assigned by the empire, a man named Heh Shan-Bao, is relatively benign as far as tradition goes, and if anything, the lack of a yearly tax collector or other imperial visitors has resulted in idyllic seasons in the rural town. Meanwhile, the mayhem of a collapsed empire has led to violence and upheaval in more urban areas. The largest change that hit Willowshore as the result of Lung Wa’s collapse was the abandonment of the town by various lumber lords, who left their estates and lumber camps rather than continue to supply the demands of the city of Sze, the closest large settlement to Willowshore. For the people of Willowshore, the loss of these unpleasant long-term visitors has been seen almost universally as a relief, and the visitors’ manors and lumber camps have been left alone, in part out of fear that they could return at any time, but mostly because locals believe letting these buildings and locations be reclaimed by the woods is the most respectful way to usher Lung Wa’s influence over Willowshore into memory.

The notion that jorogumo have taken control of Shenmen remains, at this point, a “ghost story” or “scary rumor.” No jorogumo has visited Willowshore yet... at least, as far as anyone knows. Likewise, news that the ruler of Sze died and returned as a ghost has finally reached town, but not everyone believes these stories. The people of Willowshore are content to live as they always have—for now!

What is the Season of Ghosts?.name: 什么是肆季鬼志？
What is the Season of Ghosts?.text:
《肆季鬼志》是什么？

在格拉利昂的何处（以及何时）？

《肆季鬼志》冒险路径完全发生在天夏大陆中部、闹鬼国度神门乡野中的一小片地区。具体来说，本冒险的大部分内容都发生在柳岸镇及其周边，关于此地的更多细节可从第 15 页开始查阅。

更值得注意的是《肆季鬼志》发生的时间——不同于其他冒险路径，《肆季鬼志》的事件大致跨越一年，从帝国纪年 7108 年夏日第一天开始（对应内海地区的阿罗登纪年 4608 年）。尤其值得一提的是，本作设定在一百年前，也就是预言破灭之年开始后仅仅几年的时期！

《肆季鬼志》冒险路径得名于神门的一段传统时节。这段时期发生在夏天最初几周，林地中的灵异事件、精魂与不死生物都会有所增加。尽管这些灵异事件增加的原因并不明确，但这些鬼魂常常会将人引向死亡。

在柳岸镇，春天最后一天会举行一场盛大的宴会与节日。这个庆典被称为“重演节”，它不仅是为了庆祝春天结束，也是为了欺骗那些被认为会在夏天最初几周从林中现身的邪恶精魂与鬼魂。随着节庆宴席接近尾声，镇民会重演受害者被“鬼魂”掳走的场景——这些“鬼魂”由戴着纸面具的镇民扮演。没有参与这场假绑架的人则会假装陷入集体恐慌；被指定的人会高声哀号，其他人则演出一场搜索与营救行动。镇民相信，这场闹剧能让真正的鬼魂误以为已经有人在这处定居点作祟过了，并诱使它们在次日鬼季开始后（也就是夏日第一天）转而去寻找更快乐的村庄施加苦难。

而命运就是如此安排：今年，你们的玩家角色被选中扮演镇上那些遭到掳走的人——他们被掳走的理由都已经内置在各个鬼季背景中，所以如果你在为角色创建角色时没有使用这些背景之一，请与游戏主持合作，创造一个与其中所示理由相近的原因，来解释你为何会成为节日中被掳走者的一员。

当你们在宴会上被“掳走”后，抓走你们的人会把你们卷进草席里，抬到镇外一处森林空地，在那里过夜。待到夏天的第一缕晨光降临时，这些“被掳走者”会由当年负责重演节的人出面“赎回”。而今年，这份荣誉落在深受柳岸镇磨坊工人爱戴的领袖崔春虎身上。他承诺次日清晨会把“赎金”（一批美味的早餐点心）带到森林空地交给玩家角色，让他们享用过后，再带他们返回城镇，宣布这场重演节取得了巨大成功。

虽然夏天常常下雨，但你们这次运气不错，在星空下度过了一个相当舒适的夜晚。当然，在任何林地中过夜都伴随着一定风险，而你们也都有充足时间为此做好准备。你们可以带上在创建角色时决定的所有初始物品与道具，一同经历这场“绑架”。任何没有随身携带的物品，都会留在你们家中等你们回去。

《肆季鬼志》冒险路径开始于你与其他玩家角色在夏日第一天的森林空地中醒来……可崔春虎和他承诺的早餐却都不见踪影！

What is the Season of Ghosts?

Where (and When) on Golarion?

The Season of Ghosts Adventure Path takes place exclusively in a small part of rural Shenmen, a haunted nation in the middle of the continent of Tian Xia. Specifically, the bulk of this adventure takes place in and around the town of Willowshore, which is presented in further detail beginning on page 15.

Of greater note is the time in which Season of Ghosts takes place—unlike other Adventure Paths, the events of Season of Ghosts occur roughly over the course of a year, starting on the first day of summer in the year 7108 ic (4608 ar in the Inner Sea region). Notably, it is set a hundred years in the past and only a few years after the start of the Age of Lost Omens!

The Season of Ghosts Adventure Path is named for a traditional period in Shenmen that takes place during the first few weeks of summer, when the woodlands see an increase in hauntings, spirits, and undead. While the cause of these increased hauntings is uncertain, these ghosts often lure people to their deaths.

In Willowshore, a massive feast and festival takes place on the last day of spring. Called the “Reenactment Festival,” this gala is meant not only to celebrate the end of spring, but also to trick the evil spirits and ghosts believed to come out of the woods during the first few weeks of summer. As the festival’s feast concludes, the town reenacts victims being snatched away by “ghosts” (played by townsfolk in paper masks). Those not involved in the faux abduction pretend to plunge into collective panic as designated wailers mourn loudly and others play out a search and rescue effort. The townfolk believe this farce tricks real ghosts into thinking that someone has already haunted the settlement and that it entices them into seeking happier villages to inflict misery on once the season of ghosts begins the next day (on the first day of summer).

As fate would have it, your PCs are chosen this year to play the role of the town’s abductees—reasons for their abduction are built in to the various Season of Ghosts backgrounds, so if you don’t use one of these backgrounds for your character, work with the GM to create a reason similar to those presented there to explain why you’re among the festival’s abductees.

Once you’re “abducted” from the feast, your captors roll you up in straw mats and carry you off into a forest clearing on the town’s outskirts, where you’re expected to stay overnight. With the first dawn of summer, the “abductees” are ransomed by whoever is in charge of that year’s Reenactment Festival. This year, that honor falls to Choe Chun-hu, the beloved leader of Willowshore’s millers. He has promised to bring the “ransom” (a selection of delicious breakfast delicacies) to the PCs in the forest clearing the next morning for them to enjoy before leading them back to town to proclaim the Reenactment Festival a grand success.

While it often rains during the summer, you luck out and spend a relatively comfortable night under the stars. Of course, staying overnight in any woodland carries some risk, and you’ve all have plenty of time to prepare for it. You can bring all your starting items and gear, as determined during character creation, with you during your abduction. Any items not brought along will be waiting for you back at home.

The Season of Ghosts Adventure Path begins when you and the other PCs awaken in a forest clearing on the first day of summer... but there’s no sign of Choe Chun-hu or the breakfast he promised!

Player’s Guide.name: 玩家指南 Player’s Guide
Player’s Guide.text:
玩家指南

如何使用本指南

欢迎来到《肆季鬼志》冒险路径！

这本玩家指南将帮助你为一场恐怖主题的战役做好准备。故事设定于神门乡野地区，你的角色是家乡英雄，必须挺身而出，保护柳岸镇的人民，使其免受邪恶诅咒与各种超自然威胁的侵害，同时还要为一个可能格外残酷的冬季做准备。你们将以1级角色开始冒险；如果你们并非一生都居住在柳岸镇，那么也应是在不久前来到镇上后，逐渐被视为本地人并受到接纳。

这条冒险路径分为四个部分，每一部分都发生在不同的季节。随着每个月流逝，你们的PC会变得更加强大，而柳岸镇所面对的威胁也会愈发致命、愈发骇人。《肆季鬼志》包含一些尤为重要的剧情反转与真相揭示，因此如果你已经提前得知了其中某些惊喜内容，请在避免剧透后续部分中等待被发现的秘密时，也体谅其他玩家的游戏体验！

要参与这场战役，你所需要的只有《探路者玩家核心》和一张角色卡。在得到你的游戏主持许可后，你也可以使用《探路者第二版》的补充规则书、战役设定书以及其他辅助资料，来进一步自定义你的角色。尤其是因为这场战役设定在天夏大陆上，当地最常见的族裔、信仰与其他元素，并不完全等同于设定在内海地区的战役中所默认的那些内容。

在接下来的页面中，你会看到一些具体建议，帮助你为《肆季鬼志》创建一个新角色。本玩家指南分为以下几个部分。

  • 角色建议：为你提供神导术、实用建议，以及创建适合本战役的1级角色的具体提示，让角色能够自然地融入这场战役。
  • 柳岸镇志：这本志书中收录了你（以及你的角色）需要了解的关于家乡柳岸镇的大部分信息。如果你所需要的信息没有出现在本节中，你的游戏主持还掌握着关于这座城镇的更多资料。

Player’s Guide

How to Use This Guide

Welcome to the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path!

This Player’s Guide will help you prepare for a horror-themed campaign set in the rural regions of the nation of Shenmen, where your characters are hometown heroes who must rise to the occasion and defend the people of Willowshore from a sinister curse and from all manner of supernatural threats, all while also preparing for what might be a particularly cruel winter season. You’ll begin as 1st-level characters who, if they haven’t lived in Willowshore their whole lives, have come to be recognized and welcomed as locals after arriving in town in the recent past.

This Adventure Path is split into four parts, each taking place during a different season. With every passing month, your PCs grow more powerful and the threats facing Willowshore grow deadlier and more shocking. Season of Ghosts features some particularly significant plot twists and revelations, so if you’ve had some of these surprises revealed to you already, please consider other players’ experiences before spoiling the secrets that await discovery during the later parts of this Adventure Path!

To play in this campaign, all you need is Pathfinder Player Core and a character sheet. With your Game Master’s permission, you can also use Pathfinder Second Edition supplemental rulebooks, campaign setting books, and other accessories to further customize your character, especially since this campaign is set on the continent of Tian Xia, where the most common ancestries, faiths, and other elements aren’t the same as those assumed in a campaign set in the Inner Sea region.

On the following pages, you’ll find specific suggestions to help you create a new character for Season of Ghosts. This Player’s Guide is organized into the following sections.

  • Character Suggestions: Guidance, practical advice, and specific tips for creating a 1st-level character that fits seamlessly into this campaign.
  • Willowshore Gazetteer: Much of what you (and your character) need to know about your hometown of Willowshore is presented in this gazetteer. Your GM has additional information about this town, should information you need not be present in this section.
